1: Petameko Kalunga okwa shiti egulu nevi.
Evi olya li lya vongakana nolya li owala. Omilema odha siikile omeya omale apehe, nOmbepo yaKalunga oya tengelele kombanda yomeya.
Kalunga okwa popi e ta ti: “Naku ninge uuyelele,” uuyelele nowa holoka.
Kalunga okwa mono kutya uuyelele owo opala, nokwa yoolola uuyelele momilema.
Uuyelele okwe u luku “omutenya” nomilema “uusiku.” Okwa toko kwa ningi ongulohi, nokwa shi kwa ningi ongula — olyo esiku lyotango.
Nena Kalunga okwa popi e ta ti: “Naku ninge eyalelo pokati komeya.”
Kalunga okwa yalaleke eyalelo lyokutopola omeya ngoka ge li kohi yalyo naangoka ge li kombanda. Osho sha li ngaaka.
Eyalelo okwe li luku “egulu.” Okwa toko kwa ningi ongulohi, nokwa shi kwa ningi ongula — olyo esiku etiyali.
Kalunga okwa popi e ta ti: “Omeya gokohi yeyalelo naga gongale pehala limwe, opo uukukutu u holoke.” Osho sha ningwa.
Kalunga okwa luku uukukutu “evi,” nomeya ngoka ga gongala kevi, okwe ga luku “efuta.” Kalunga nokwa mono kutya osho opala.
Nena okwa popi e ta ti: “Evi nali meneke iimeno yi ili noyi ili mbyoka yi na oomuma, nomiti ndhoka hadhi imi iiyimati.” Osho nosha ningwa.
Evi olya meneke iimeno yi ili noyi ili, naKalunga okwa mono kutya osho opala.
Okwa toko kwa ningi ongulohi, nokwa shi kwa ningi ongula — olyo esiku etitatu.
Kalunga okwa popi a ti: “Omaminikilo naga holoke keyalelo lyegulu, ga yoolole omutenya muusiku nokuutha omathimbomumvo, omasiku nomimvo.
Naga minikile keyalelo lyegulu nokugandja uuyelele kevi.” Osho nosha ningwa.
Kalunga okwa shiti omaminikilo omanene gaali, etango lyokupangela omutenya nomwedhi gwokupangela uusiku; okwa shiti wo oonyothi.
Kalunga okwa tula omaminikilo keyalelo lyegulu, ga minikile evi,
okupangela omutenya nuusiku nokuyoolola uuyelele nomilema. Kalunga okwa mono kutya osho opala.
Okwa toko kwa ningi ongulohi, nokwa shi kwa ningi ongula — olyo esiku etine.
Kalunga okwa popi a ti: “Momeya namu wiwime iinamwenyo yomaludhi gi ili nogi ili, noondhila nadhi tuke keyalelo lyegulu.”
Kalunga okwa shiti iikwameya iinene, iishitwa yomaludhi agehe hayi wiwima momeya, nomaludhi agehe goondhila. Kalunga okwa mono kutya osho opala.
Okwe yi yambeke e ta ti: “Valathaneni, ne mu indjipale nokuudha efuta, noondhila nadhi indjipale kombanda yevi.”
Okwa toko kwa ningi ongulohi, nokwa shi kwa ningi ongula — olyo esiku etitano.
Kalunga okwa popi e ta ti: “Evi nali etithe po iinamwenyo yomaludhi agehe: iimuna, iihono niiyamakuti.” Osho nosha ningwa.
Kalunga okwa shiti iiyamakuti ayihe, iimuna ayihe niihono ayihe. Okwa mono kutya osho opala.
Kalunga okwa popi e ta ti: “Natu shiteni aantu ye tu fe, oshifetha shetu. Oyo ye na okupangela oohi dhomefuta, oondhila dhokegulu, iimuna, iiyamakuti, evi alihe niihono ayihe.”
Kalunga okwa shiti omuntu oshifetha she, e ya shiti omulumentu nomukiintu.
Okwe ya yambeke e ta ti: “Valathaneni, ne mu indjipale nokuudha evi alihe. Li tuleni mepangelo lyeni; pangeleni oohi dhomefuta noondhila dhokegulu niinamwenyo ayihe tayi inyenge kombanda yevi.
Onde mu menithile iimeno ayihe yi na oomuma nomiti adhihe dhiiyimati. Nadhi kale oondya dheni.
Ihe iiyamakuti ayihe, oondhila adhihe dhokegulu niinamwenyo ayihe mbyoka hayi ipwedha, onde yi menithile omwiidhi niimeno, yi lye.” Osho sha ningwa.
Kalunga okwa tala eshito lye alihe nokwe li mono lyo opala lela. Okwa toko kwa ningi ongulohi, nokwa shi kwa ningi ongula — olyo esiku etihamano.
2: Ano osho ngeyi egulu nevi noongundu dhago adhihe odha pu okushitwa.
Mesiku etiheyali Kalunga sho a tsakanitha iilonga ye ayihe yeshito, okwa vululukwa.
Kalunga nokwa yambeke esiku etiheyali e te li yapula, oshoka okwa mana eshito lye alihe nokwa vululukwa kiilonga ye.

Ndika olyo ehokololo lyeshito lyegulu nevi, sho ga shitwa.
Omuwa Kalunga sho a shiti egulu nevi,
kevi kakwa li ku na iihwa yokelundu nenge omwiidhi komalundu, oshoka okwa li inaa lokitha manga omvula, nokakwa li ngoka a longo evi,
ihe oshimuke osha zi mevi e tali tosima.
Omuwa Kalunga okwa kutha ontsi yevi e te yi umbu omuntu. Okwe mu fudhile ombepo yomwenyo momayulu, omuntu nokwa ningi omunamwenyo.
Nena Omuwa Kalunga okwa toto eyana muEden, kuuzilo, nokwa langeke mo omuntu ngoka e mu shiti.
Okwa menithile mo omiti dhomaludhi gi ili nogi ili dho opala dhokutalwa nodhokuliwa. Pokati keyana okwa menithile po omuti gwomwenyo nomuti gwokutseya uuwanawa nuuwinayi.
Omulonga gwa tondoka muEden e tagu tutike eyana. Handiya yaEden ogwa topoka miimpanalonga ine.
Oshimpanalonga shotango oPishon tashi tondokele moshilongo ashihe shaHavila.
(Oshingoli shoshilongo shika oshiwanawa, noku na wo iizimba iiwanawa nomamanya gondilo.)
Oshimpanalonga oshitiyali oGihon tashi kunkula nevi alihe lyaKush.
Oshimpanalonga oshititatu oTigris, shoka tashi tondokele kuuzilo waAssur, noshimpanalonga oshitine osho Eufrat.
Omuwa Kalunga okwa langeke omuntu meyana lyaEden, opo e li longe ye e li keelele.
Okwa ti kuye: “Lya komuti kehe meyana,
kakele komuti gwokutseya uuwanawa nuuwinayi. Iiyimati yomuti ngoka ino yi lya; ngele oto shi ningi, oto si shili.”
Omuwa Kalunga okwa popi e ta ti: “Inashi opala, omuntu i ikalele oye awike. Otandi mu shitile omukwathi e mu opalela.”

Okwa kutha ontsi yevi e ta shiti iinamwenyo ayihe noondhila adhihe. Ayihe okwe yi eta komuntu a tale, nkene te yi luku omadhina gayo. Osho iinamwenyo ayihe oyi na omadhina gayo, ngaashi omuntu e yi luku.
Omuntu okwa luku iinamwenyo ayihe, oondhila adhihe niiyamakuti ayihe, ihe ini imonena omukwathi e mu opalela.
Omuwa Kalunga okwa kotheke omuntu omposi ondhigu, nomanga a li a kotha, okwa kutha mo olupati lwe lumwe nopehala mpoka e lu kutha, okwa thitike po nontumba.
Olupati okwe lu shiti omukiintu e te mu eta komulumentu.
Omulumentu okwa ti: “Ndika esipa lyomomasipa gandje nonyama yomonyama yandje. Na lukwe omukiintu oshoka okwa kuthwa momulumentu.”
Omolwashika omulumentu oku na okuthiga po he nayina e ta kwatathana nomukadhi, oyo notaa ningi omuntu gumwe.
Omulumentu nomukiintu ayehe oya li omudhuu, ihe inaa saathana ohoni.
3: Eyoka olya li li na omakoto unene li vule iinamwenyo ayihe mbyoka Omuwa Kalunga e yi shiti. Eyoka olya pula omukiintu lya ti: “Kalunga okwe mu lombwele shili, mwaa lye komiti adhihe dhomeyana?”
Omukiintu okwa yamukula a ti: “Ohatu li iiyimati yomiti adhihe dhomeyana.
Iiyimati yomuti ngoka gu li pokati kalyo, Kalunga okwe tu lombwele, twaaye yi lye tse twaa gume omuti; ngele tatu shi ningi, otatu ka sa.”
Eyoka olya yamukula lya ti: “Itamu si shili.
Oshoka Kalunga okwa tseya kutya uuna tamu li ko, omeho geni otaga tonata, one notamu fe Kalunga mokutseya uuwanawa nuuwinayi.”
Omukiintu okwa ndhindhilike, omuti nkene gwo opala niiyimati yagwo yi etitha olwiho okuliwa nokuninga omuntu omunandunge. Okwa toonona ko iiyimati yimwe e ta li. Okwa pe wo omulume, naye wo okwa li.
Nanziya omeho gawo ayehe oga tonata noya mono ye li omalutu gowala; oya hondjele kumwe iifo yomukwiyu e taa isiikile.
Komatango sho kwa talala, oyu uvu Omuwa Kalunga ta lyanga meyana noye ke mu holama momiti.
Ihe Omuwa Kalunga okwi ithana omuntu a ti: “Ou li peni?”
Omuntu okwa yamukula a ti: “Ondu uvu iikukulo yoye meyana, onkee nda tila, molwashoka ondi li olutu lwowala, e te holama.”
Omuwa nokwa ti: “Olye e ku lombwele kutya ou li olutu lwowala? Owa li nani komuti nde gu ku indike, waa lye ko?”
Omuntu okwa ti: “Omukiintu nguka wa pe ndje, oye a pe ndje iiyimati e tandi yi li.”

Omuwa Kalunga okwa pula omukiintu a ti: “Owe shi ningile shike?”
Omukiintu okwa yamukula: “Eyoka lya kotokele ndje nonda li.”

Nena Omuwa Kalunga okwa lombwele eyoka e ta ti: “Molwashoka wa ningi ngeyi, oto thingwa mokati kiinamwenyo ayihe. Okuza nena oto kala ho enditha ela lyoye, nou na okulya ontsi yevi omasiku goye agehe, manga u na omwenyo.
Otandi tula etondathano pokati keni nomukiintu, nopokati koluvalo lwoye noluvalo lwe. Oluvalo lwe otalu nyanyagula omutse gwoye, ongoye noto mu tsu moshithi shompadhi ye.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele omukiintu a ti: “Otandi ku indjipalithile uudhigu wuusimba woye nuuwehame woshitheta shokuvala. Omulumentu gwoye oto kala noku mu yuulukwa, ndele ota kala noku ku pangela.”

Oye okwa lombwele omulumentu a ti: “Owa pulakene oohapu dhomukiintu gwoye nowa li komuti nde gu indike. Molwashoka wa ningi ngeyi, evi otali thingwa molwoye. Ou na oku li longa u na omazigudhe mokukalamwenyo kwoye akuhe, opo li ku pe iipalutha.
Otali ku menithile oondjoho nomakwega, nou na okulya omboga yokelundu.
Ou na okulonga nuudhigu nokupusha, opo evi li ku pe sha, sigo to ka shuna mevi moka wa kuthwa mo. Owa kuthilwe mevi nou na okushuna mevi.”
Adam okwa luku omukadhi Eva, oshoka oyina yaanamwenyo ayehe.
Omuwa Kalunga okwa tungile Adam nomukadhi oonguwo dhiipa e te dhi ya zaleke.
Nena Omuwa Kalunga okwa ti: “Ngashingeyi omuntu okwe tu fe, e shi uuwanawa nuuwinayi. Ihe ke na okupitikwa, a lye we iiyimati yokomuti gwomwenyo ye a kale e na omwenyo sigo aluhe.”
Omuwa Kalunga okwe mu tidha mo meyana lyaEden, a ye a ka longe evi moka a kuthwa mo.
Kuuzilo weyana okwa langeke ko aakerubi ye na egongamwele tali yeta omulilo, opo li keelele shaa ngoka ta hedha komuti gwomwenyo.
4: Adam okwa lala nomukadhi Eva e ta ningi omusimba. Okwa vala okanona okamati e ta ti: “Kekwatho lyOmuwa onda pulumutha okamati.” Okwe ka luku Kain.
Konima yaambika okwa vala ishewe omumati, Abel. Abel okwa ningi omusita gwiimuna, ihe Kain omulongi gwepya.
Sho pwa piti omasiku, Kain okwa yambele Omuwa omayambo giiliwa yomepya lye.
Abel okwe eta onzigona ondjelipa yomoonzi dhe nokwe yi dhipaga e te yi yambele Omuwa. Omuwa okwa hokwa Abel nondjambo ye,
ihe ina hokwa Kain nondjambo ye. Kain okwa geye a sizimaneka oshipala she kondjahi.
Omuwa nokwa ti kuKain: “Omolwashike wa geya? Oshike wa sizimaneka oshipala?
Ngele to longo uuwanawa, nena oshipala shoye oshi li nawa, ihe ngele to longo uuwinayi, nena uulunde owe ku langele posheelo. Owo wa hala oku ku pangela, ihe ou na oku u pangela.”
Opo ihe Kain okwa lombwele mumwayina Abel ta ti: “Tu ye kelundu.” Sho ya yi ko, Kain okwa ponokele omumwayina e te mu dhipaga.

Omuwa okwa pula Kain a ti: “Omumwanyoko Abel oku li peni?”
Kain okwa yamukula a ti: “Kandi shi wo. Ongame omusita gwomumwameme nani?”
Nena Omuwa okwa ti: “Omolwashike wa longo iihuna yi thike mpono? Ombinzi yomumwanyoko otayi kugile ndje mevi.
Okuza ngashingeyi ongoye omuthingwa, noto tidhwa mo mepya. Evi olye ekama okana kalyo okutaamba ombinzi yomumwanyoko, sho we mu dhipaga.
Nge to longo epya lyoye, itali ku kutitha; oto ka ninga epongo nontembuki kombanda yevi.”
Kain okwa lombwele Omuwa a ti: “Ondjo yandje ondhigu unene, ite vulu oku yi humbata.
Oto tidha ndje mo mepya nokoshipala shoye. Otandi ka ninga epongo nontembuki kombanda yevi, noshaa ngoka ta mono ndje, ota dhipaga ndje.”
Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Aawe, ngele ope na ngoka te ku dhipaga, ota ka geelwa luheyali.” Omuwa okwa ndhindhilike Kain endhindhiliko lyokulondodha shaa ngoka te mu tsakaneke, keehe mu dhipage.
Kain nokwa zi ko koshipala shOmuwa e ta yi, a ka kale moshilongo hashi ithanwa Nod, kuuzilo waEden.
Kain okwa lala nomukadhi e ta ningi omusimba. Okwa vala okamati nokwe ka luku Enok. Kain okwa tungu oshilando e te shi lukile omwana Enok.
Enok okwa vala Irad, ngoka a li he yaMehujael, naMehujael okwa vala Metushael, he yaLamek.
Lamek okwa li a hokana ombanda, aakadhi oAda naZilla.
Ada okwa vala Jabal, ngoka a li hekulu yaanamatsali naanahambo.
Omumwayina okwa li Jubal, hekulu yaahiki yuuharpa noohiya.
Zilla okwa vala Tubal Kain, omuhambudhi gwiilongitho yi ili noyi ili yiiyela iikushu niiluudhe. Omumwayina omukiintu gwaTubal Kain oNaama.

Lamek okwa lombwele aakadhi a ti:
“Ada naZilla, pulakenii ndje,
aakulukadhi yaLamek, uveni oohapu dhandje.
Onda dhipaga omuntu, sho a dhenge ndje oshilalo,
omuntu omugundjuka omolwombole yandje.
Kain ngele ta geelwa luheyali, Lamek omilongo heyali luheyali.”
Adam okwa lala ishewe nomukadhi e ta ningi omusimba. Okwa vala omumati gulwe e ta ti: “Kalunga okwa pe ndje omumati peha lyaAbel, ngoka a dhipagwa kuKain.” Onkee okwe mu luku Set.
Set okwa vala omumati e te mu luku Enos. Pethimbo ndyoka aantu oya tameke okugalikana Omuwa.
5: Mpaka ope na omusholondondo gwoluvalo lwaAdam. (Kalunga sho a shiti aantu, okwe ya shiti ye mu fa.
Okwe ya shiti omulumentu nomukiintu. Okwe ya laleke nuuyamba e te ya luku “aantu.”)
Adam sho a gwanitha omimvo 130, okwa vala omumati e mu fa e te mu luku Set.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaSet, Adam okwa kala nomwenyo omimvo 800 nokwa vala aamati naakadhona.
Adam okwa si e na omimvo 930.
Set sho a gwanitha omimvo 105, okwa vala Enos.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaEnos, Set okwa kala e na omwenyo omimvo 807, nokwa vala aamati naakadhona.
Set okwa si e na oomvula 912.
Enos sho a gwanitha omimvo 90, okwa vala Kenan.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaKenan, Enos okwa kala e na omwenyo omimvo 815, oye nokwa vala aamati naakadhona.
Enos okwa si e na omimvo 905.
Kenan sho a gwanitha omimvo 70, okwa vala Mahalalel.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaMahalalel, Kenan okwa kala e na omwenyo omimvo 840. Oye nokwa vala aamati naakadhona.
Kenan okwa si e na omimvo 910.
Mahalalel sho a gwanitha omimvo 65, okwa vala Jared.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaJared, Mahalalel okwa kala e na omwenyo omimvo 830, oye nokwa vala aamati naakadhona.
Mahalalel okwa si e na omimvo 895.
Jared sho a gwanitha omimvo 162, okwa vala Enok.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaEnok, Jared okwa kala e na omwenyo omimvo 800. Okwa vala aamati naakadhona.
Jared okwa si e na omimvo 962.
Enok sho a gwanitha omimvo 65, okwa vala Metusala.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaMetusala, Enok okwe ende pamwe naKalunga omimvo 300 nokwa vala aamati naakadhona.
Enok okwa li e na omimvo 365.
Enok okwa longele Kalunga nokwa kana po, molwaashoka Kalunga e mu kutha po.
Metusala sho a gwanitha omimvo 187, okwa vala Lamek.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaLamek, Metusala okwa kala e na omwenyo omimvo 782 nokwa vala aamati naakadhona.
Metusala okwa si e na omimvo 969.
Lamek sho a gwanitha omimvo 182, okwa vala omumati
e ta ti: “Omunona nguka ote tu etele epupalitho netalaleko miilonga nomomaupyakadhi giikaha yetu mevi ndika lya thingwa kuKalunga” e te mu luku Noa.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaNoa, Lamek okwa kala e na omwenyo omimvo 595 nokwa vala aamati naakadhona.
Lamek okwa si e na omimvo 777.
Noa sho a gwanitha omimvo 500, okwa vala Sem, Ham naJafet.
6: Aantu sho yi indjipala kombanda yevi noya valelwa aakadhona,
aamati aana yaKalunga oya tala aakadhona aana yaantu yo opala noya hokana mboka ye yi ihogololele.
Nena Omuwa okwa popi e ta ti: “Ombepo yandje itayi kala nokukumagidha omuntu aluheluhe, oshoka oye omusi; omasiku ge naga ninge omimvo ethele nomilongo mbali.”
Muuyuni mbwiyaka nomuuyuni we u landula omwa li mu na aalefule. Oyo oluvalo lwaamati aana yaKalunga mboka ya hokana aakadhona aana yaantu. Oya li oofule naanamadhina okuza kuukulu wonale.
Omuwa sho a mono uuwinayi waantu kombanda yevi mpoka u thike, nomadhiladhilo gawo nkene ga pilaala ethimbo alihe,
oku uvu nayi, sho a shitile omuntu kombanda yevi.
Omuwa okwa popi e ta ti: “Aantu mbaka nde ya shiti, otandi ya kombo ko kombanda yevi, nosho wo iinamwenyo noondhila, oshoka ondi ipe ombedhi, sho nde ya shiti.”
Ihe Omuwa okwa li a hokwa Noa.
Ndjika oyo ondjokonona yaNoa. Okwa vala aamati yatatu: Sem, Ham naJafet. Noa ka li e na uusama, okwa li omuyuuki pethimbo lye. Okwa kala mekwatathano naKalunga,
ihe aantu ayehe oya li aawinayi koshipala shaKalunga, niikolokosha oya li ya taandela shaa mpoka.
Kalunga okwa tala uuyuni nokwa mono kutya owo uuwinayi, oshoka aantu mboka ya kala mo, oya kala muuwinayi.
Kalunga okwa lombwele Noa a ti: “Onda tokola ndi hulithe po aantu ayehe. Otandi ya kombo po thiluthilu, oshoka uuyuni ou udha iilonga yawo iiwinayi.
Itungila onguluwato yiipilangi yo opala, nayi kale yi na omala, ngoye u yi hote nomaka meni nokombanda.
Nayi kale oondya 300 momutaandelo, oondya 50 momutamo noondya 30 momuthika.
Konguluwato tula ko ondunda nokuthiga po othaalo yolundya lumwe pokati kondunda nolungenge lwonguluwato. Yi tunga moontala ndatu, nomweelo molupati.
Otandi ka tuma eyelu kombanda yevi, li yonagule po omufudho aguhe. Shaa shoka shi na omwenyo kombanda yevi, otashi si.
Ihe otandi ka dhika ehangano nangoye. Inda monguluwato nomukiintu gwoye, aamwoyemati naakadhi.
Monguluwato fala mo iinamwenyo yomaludhi agehe ooiyali, oshilumentu noshikiintu moludhi kehe lwiinamwenyo nolwoondhila, opo yi hupe yi kale yi na omwenyo.
Fala mo wo iikulya yomaludhi agehe, yoye mwene noyiinamwenyo.”
Noa okwa ningi, ngaashi Kalunga e mu lombwele.
7: Omuwa okwa lombwele Noa a ti: “Inda monguluwato negumbo lyoye alihe; onda mono kutya ongoye awike muuyuni auhe ho longo uuyuuki.
Fala mo iinamwenyo ooiyali luheyali yomomaludhi agehe ngoka gaa na oshipwe, opo ihe iinamwenyo ooiyali ayihe yoshipwe.
Fala mo oondhila oombali luheyali komaludhi gadho. Shi ninga, opo omaludhi giinamwenyo nenge goondhila ga kale ge na omwenyo go ga ka indjipale ishewe.
Ngele pwa piti omasiku gaheyali, otandi ka lokitha omvula tayi ka tilahi omeya omasiku omilongo ne omutenya nuusiku, opo yi hanagule po iinamwenyo ayihe nde yi shiti.”
Noa okwa ningi, ngaashi Omuwa e mu lombwele.
Noa okwa li e na omimvo omathele gahamano, eyelu sho lye ya kombanda yevi.
Oye nomukadhi, oyanamati naakadhi, oya yi monguluwato, ya ka holame eyelu.
Oshilumentu noshikiintu moludhi kehe lwiinamwenyo nolwoondhila lwaa na oshipwe ngaashika wo lwoshipwe
oya yi monguluwato pamwe naNoa, ngaashi Kalunga a ti.
Sho pwa piti omasiku gaheyali, eyelu olye ya.
Noa sho a gwanitha omimvo omathele gahamano, mesiku etimulongo netiheyali lyomwedhi omutiyali oothithiya adhihe dhomuule odhe eguluka, noombende adhihe dhokegulu odha makuka.
Omvula oya puuka noya loko omutenya nuusiku omasiku omilongo ne.
Esiku tuu ndyoka Noa nomukadhi oya yi monguluwato noyanamati yatatu: Sem, Ham naJafet naakadhi.
Oya yi mo niinamwenyo yomaludhi agehe gopaantu nogomokuti, iinene niishona, noondhila dhomaludhi agehe.
Iinamwenyo iilumentu niikiintu yomaludhi agehe oya yi monguluwato pamwe naNoa,
ngaashi Kalunga e mu lombwele. Nena Omuwa okwa pata omweelo konima yaNoa.
Eyelu olye ya kombanda yevi momasiku omilongo ne, onguluwato noya kaama kombanda yomeya omale.
Omeya oga lundalala, nonguluwato oya telagana kombanda yago.
Omeya ogi itumbu, sigo ga siikile oondundu oondeendeka;
oga tsikile okulundalala, sigo ga ningi oometa heyali kombanda yoondundu.
Oonakukala ayehe kombanda yevi ye na omwenyo, oya si: oondhila adhihe, iinamwenyo ayihe naantu ayehe.
Shaa shoka sha li shi na omufudho kombanda yevi, osha si.
Omuwa okwa hanagula po iinamwenyo ayihe kombanda yevi: aantu, iiyamakuti noondhila. ONoa awike a hupu ko naamboka ya li puye monguluwato.
Omeya oga siikile evi omasiku ethele nomilongo ntano.
8: Kalunga okwa dhimbulukwa Noa niinamwenyo ayihe ya li pamwe naye monguluwato. Okwa pepitha ombepo, nomeya oga tameke okupwina.
Oothithiya dhomuule noombende dhokegulu odha thiti. Omvula oya sheka,
nomeya oga tameke okukuluka momasiku ethele nomilongo ntano.
Mesiku etimulongo netiheyali lyomwedhi omutiheyali onguluwato oya hakele kondungu yondundu Ararat.
Omeya oge ende taga pwine, nomesiku lyotango lyomwedhi omutimulongo oondungu dhoondundu odha anduka ko.
Sho pwa piti omasiku omilongo ne, Noa okwe egulula ombende
e ta pititha mo edhilakola. Edhilakola inali galuka we, olya kala tali telagana, sigo omeya ga pwine.
Sho pwa piti okathimbo, Noa okwa piitha mo onguti, a tale, ngele omeya oga pwina,
ihe oshoka oga li ga siikile natango evi, onguti inayi mona nando eha lyokulambela. Oya galukile konguluwato, naNoa okwa ganeke oshikaha she e te yi shuna mo.
Noa okwa tegelele omasiku gaheyali e ta piitha mo ishewe onguti.
Ongulohi oya galukile kuye yi na efo lyomuolivi komulungu. Noa okwa koneke kutya nani omeya oga pwina.
Okwa tegelele ishewe omasiku gaheyali e ta piitha mo onguti, noinayi galuka we.
Noa sho a gwanitha omimvo 601, mesiku lyotango lyomwedhi gwotango, omeya oga adhika ga pwine. Noa okwa kutha ko ondunda yonguluwato e ta tala koombinga noombinga. Okwa mono kutya nani evi olya kaha.
Mesiku etimilongombali netiheyali lyomwedhi omutiyali evi olya li ekukutu thiluthilu.
Kalunga okwa lombwele Noa a ti:
“Za mo monguluwato, ongoye mwene nomukulukadhi gwoye naamwoyemati naakadhi.
Piitha mo oondhila adhihe niinamwenyo, opo yi valathane yo yi indjipale kombanda yevi alihe.”
Noa okwa piti mo nomukadhi noyanamati naakadhi.
Iinamwenyo ayihe noondhila odha piti mo monguluwato moongundu dhomaludhi gadho.
Noa okwa tungile Omuwa oshiyambelo; okwa kutha shimwe shomoludhi kehe lwiinamwenyo yaa na oshipwe nolwoondhila e te yi lungunitha po omidhidhindjambo koshiyambelo.

Ezimba lyoondjambo olya nyanyudha Omuwa, e ti ipopile ta ti: “Evi itandi li geelele we omuntu; onda tseya kutya omadhiladhilo ge omawinayi okuza kuunona we. Itandi ka hanagula po we iinamwenyo ayihe, ngaashi nda ningi ngashingeyi.
Ihe manga uuyuni u li po, otaku ka kala ethimbo lyokukuna nethimbo lyokuteya. Otaku ka kala aluhe uutalala nuupyu, othinge nokufu, omutenya nuusiku.”
9: Kalunga okwa yambeke Noa noyana e ta ti: “Kaleni mu na oluvalo ne mu indjipale kombanda yevi alihe.
Iinamwenyo ayihe, oondhila noohi otayi kala hayi mu tila. Ayihe oya tulwa mepangelo lyeni.
Ngashingeyi otayi ningi oondya dheni naanaa ngaashi iimeno, mbyoka nde yi mu pele, yi ninge oondya dheni.
Ihe inamu lya onyama yi na ombinzi; otandi yi indike, oshoka omwenyo ogwa kala mombinzi.
Ihe ngele ku na ngoka ta dhipaga omuntu, ota geelwa. Nokehe oshinamwenyo tashi dhipaga omuntu, otashi geelwa neso.
Omuntu okwa shitwa a fa Kalunga, onkee ngoka ta dhipaga omuntu mukwawo, ota ka dhipagwa wo.
“Kaleni mu na oluvalo ne mu indjipale kombanda yevi alihe.”
Kalunga okwa lombwele Noa e ta ti:
“Taleni, otandi dhike ehangano nane nonoluvalo lweni
noniinamwenyo ayihe kombanda yevi — oondhila adhihe, iimuna ayihe niiyamakuti ayiheyihe mbyoka ya piti monguluwato pamwe nangoye.
Otandi hangana nane notandi uvaneke kutya iinamwenyo itayi ka hanagulwa po we kefundja, eyelu itali ka hanagula po we evi.
Endhindhiliko lyehangano lyaaluhe ndyoka tandi hangana nane noniinamwenyo ayihe, olyo ndika:
otandi tula uutamvula miikogo, notau ningi endhindhiliko lyehangano lyandje nevi.
Uuna te tula iikogo kegulu, ndele uutamvula tau holoka,
nena otandi dhimbulukwa euvaneko ndyoka nde li mu uvanekele niinamwenyo ayihe kutya eyelu itali ka hanagula po we iinamwenyo ayihe.
Uuna uutamvula tau holoka miikogo, otandi u mono e te dhimbulukwa ehangano lyaaluhe pokati ketu noonakukala kombanda yevi ye na omwenyo.
Ndika olyo endhindhiliko lyeuvaneko ndyoka nda uvanekele oonakukala ayehe kombanda yevi.”
Aana yaNoa aamati mboka ya zi monguluwato, oyo Sem, Ham naJafet. (Ham ohe yaKaanan.)
Aana yaNoa mbaka yatatu oyo oohekulu yiigwana ayihe kombanda yevi.
Noa okwa li omunamapya, oye gwotango a ningi oshitsambe shomiviinu.
Ihe sho a nu omaviinu, okwa kolwa, a hula mo oonguwo dhe e ta lala e li omudhuu metsali lye.
Ham, he yaKaanan, sho a mono he e li omudhuu, okwa piti mo e te shi lombwele aamwayina yaali.
Nena Sem naJafet oya kutha elwaakani ye li humbata komapepe gawo. Oye ende oshaanimanima yu uka metsali e taa siikile he. Inaa tala nande konima, opo yaa mone epenge lyahe.
Noa sho a kololokwa, okwa dhimbulula shoka omwana onkelo e shi mu ningile,

e ta ti:
“Kaanan na tulwe omutima!
Na kale omupika gwaamwaina!

Omuwa, Kalunga kaSem,
na hambelelwe!
Kaanan na kale omupika gwaSem!

Kalunga na indjipalithe Jafet!
Jafet na kale momagumbo gaSem!
Kaanan na kale omupika gwawo!”
Konima yeyelu Noa okwa kala nomwenyo omimvo 350
nokwa si e na omimvo 950.
10: Mpaka ope na omusholondondo gwoluvalo lwaana yaNoa: Sem, Ham naJafet. Oyana mbaka yatatu oya ka mona aanona konima yeyelu.
Aana aamati yaJafet Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek naTiras — oyo oohekulu yiigwana mbyoka ya lukilwa omadhina gawo.
Oluvalo lwaGomer olwAashkenas, Aarifat nAatogarma.
Omaluvalo gaJavan oga li Aaelisha, Aaespania, Aakipro nAarodes;
oyo oohekulu yiigwana mbyoka yi li komunkulofuta nokoontuntu. Mbaka oyo oluvalo lwaJafet ye li momazimo gawo nomiilongo yawo yi ili noyi ili; ongundu kehe otayi popi elaka lyayo.
Oluvalo lwaHam Kush, Egipiti, Libia naKaanan — oyo oohekulu yiigwana mbyoka ya humbata omadhina gawo.
Oluvalo lwaKush olwo Aaseba, Aahavila, Aasabta, Aaragma nAasabteka. Oluvalo lwaRagma olwo Aasheba nAadedan.
Kush okwa li e na omwana edhina lye — Nimrod, ngoka a ningi ofule yotango mokusinda uuyuni.
Kekwatho lyOmuwa okwa ningi omukongo omunene, nomolwashoka aantu haa ti: “Omuwa ne ku ninge omukongo omunene ngaashi Nimrod.”
Petameko oshilongo she osha kwatelele mo Babel, Erek naAkkad, ayihe itatu muBabilon.
Okuza kevi ndyoka okwa yi kuAssur e ta tungu iilando Ninive, Rehobot Ir, Kala
naResen, shoka shi li pokati kaNinive noshilando oshinene Kala.
Omaluvalo gaEgipiti oga li Aalidia, Aayanam, Aalehab, Aanaftu,
Aapatros, Aakaslu, nAakreta, moka mwa za Aafilisti.
Aana yaKaanan aamati oyo osheeli Sidon naHet; oyo oohekulu yaantu mboka haa ithanwa nomadhina gawo.
Kaanan okwa li wo hekulu yAayebusi, yAayamori, yAagirgashi,
yAahevi, yAayarki, yAasini,
yAayarvadi, yAazemari noyAahamati. Omazimo gi ili nogi ili gAakaanana oga halakana,
noshitopolwa shAakaanana osha taandele okuza kuSidon sigo okuGerar kuumbugantu, popepi naGaza, nokuSodom, Gomorra, Adma naZebojim kuuzilo, popepi naLasha.
Ngaka ogo omaludhi goluvalo lwaHam ga kala miilongo yi ili noyi ili, noludhi kehe otalu popi elaka lyalwo.
Sem oye omukuluntu omumwayina gwaJafet, noye hekulu yAahebeli ayehe.
Aana yaSem aamati oyo Elam, Assur, Arpakshad, Lud naAram — oohekulu yaantu mboka haa ithanwa nomadhina gawo.
Aana yaAram aamati oyo Uz, Hul, Geter naMash.
Arpakshad ohe yaShela, ngoka a vala Eber.
Eber okwa li e na oyanamati yaali, gumwe oPeleg, molwashoka muuyuni mbwiyaka aantu oya topoka; namukwawo oye Joktan.
Omaluvalo gaJoktan oga li Aayalmodad, Aashelef, Aahazarmavet, Aajerak,
Aahadoram, Aausal, Aadikla,
Aaebal, Aayabimael, Aasheba,
Aaofir, Aahavila nAajobab. Ayehe mbaka oluvalo lwaJoktan.
Oya kala mevi lya taandela okuza kuMesha sigo okuSefar mevi lyoondundu dhokuuzilo.
Ngaka ogo omaludhi goluvalo lwaSem ga kala miilongo yi ili noyi ili, noludhi kehe otalu popi elaka lyalwo.
Ayehe mbaka oluvalo lwaNoa, oshigwana noshigwana pamaludhi gawo gi ili nogi ili. Konima yeyelu iigwana ayihe kombanda yevi oya zi moluvalo lwaana yaNoa.
11: Petameko aantu yomuuyuni auhe oya li haa popi elaka limwe alike, niipopya oya faathana.
Sho ye ende nevi muuzilo, oye ya kolushandja muBabilonia e taa tula mo.
Oya lombwelathana ya ti: “Ileni! Tu tholomeni oondhopi noku dhi yotha.” Oya tholoma oondhopi dhokutunga noya longitha onka yomevi yoku dhi kwatela kumwe.
Oya popi ya ti: “Natu umbeni oshilando shi na oshungo ya tsa megulu, opo tu iningile edhina lya simana tse twaa halakane nevi alihe.”
Nena Omuwa okwa kuluka, a tale oshilando noshungo ndjoka aantu taye yi tungu,
e ta ti: “Ngashingeyi aantu mbaka oyo oshigwana shimwe notaa popi elaka limwe; ndika olyo etameko lyowala lyaashoka taa ka ninga. Otaa ka tsakanitha mbala shoka ye shi hala!
Natu kulukeni nokuvundakanitha elaka lyawo, opo yaa uvathane.”
Omuwa okwe ya halakanithile nombanda yevi alihe, e taa etha okutunga oshilando.
Oshilando osha lukwa Babel, molwashoka Omuwa okwa vundakanitha elaka lyaantu ayehe, nopokuza mpoka okwe ya halakanithile kombanda yevi alihe.
Mpaka ope na oluvalo lwaSem. Omimvo mbali konima yeyelu, Sem sho a li e na omimvo 100, okwa vala omumati edhina lye Arpakshad.
Okuza mpoka okwa kala natango nomwenyo omimvo 500 nokwa vala aanona yalwe.
Arpakshad sho a gwanitha omimvo 35, okwa vala Shela.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaShela, Arpakshad okwa kala nomwenyo omimvo 403 nokwa vala aanona yalwe.
Shela sho a gwanitha omimvo 30, okwa vala omumati edhina lye Eber.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaEber, Shela okwa kala nomwenyo omimvo 403 nokwa vala aanona yalwe.
Eber sho a gwanitha omimvo 34, okwa vala omumati Peleg.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaPeleg, Eber okwa kala nomwenyo omimvo 430 nokwa vala aanona yalwe.
Peleg sho a gwanitha omimvo 30, okwa vala omumati Reu.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaReu, Peleg okwa kala nomwenyo omimvo 209 nokwa vala aanona yalwe.
Reu sho a gwanitha omimvo 32, okwa vala omumati Serug.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaSerug, Reu okwa kala nomwenyo omimvo 207 nokwa vala aanona yalwe.
Serug sho a gwanitha omimvo 30, okwa vala omumati Nahor.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaNahor, Serug okwa kala nomwenyo omimvo 200 nokwa vala aanona yalwe.
Nahor sho a gwanitha omimvo 29, okwa vala omumati Tera.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaTera, Nahor okwa kala nomwenyo omimvo 119 nokwa vala aanona yalwe.
Tera sho a gwanitha omimvo 70, okwa vala Abram, Nahor naHaran.
Nduka oluvalo lwaTera, he yaAbram, Nahor naHaran. Haran ohe yaLot.
Haran okwa sile muUr shaBabilonia, moshilando moka a valelwa, manga he Tera e na natango omwenyo.
Abram okwa hokana Sarai, naNahor okwa hokana Milka yaHaran. Haran ohe yaJiska.
Sarai okwa li ihaa vala.
Tera okwa kutha omwana Abram, omutekulu Lot yaHaran noshitenya she Sarai, omukadhi gwaAbram. Okwa yi nayo ya zi muUr shaBabilonia, ya ye kevi lyaKaanan. Oya yi sigo okuHaran e taa tula hoka.
Tera okwa sile nkoka, sho a li nomimvo 205.
12: Omuwa okwa lombwele Abram ta ti: “Za mo mevi lyaandjeni, mezimo lyeni nomegumbo lyaho, u ye kevi ndyoka tandi ke li ku ulukila.
Otandi ke ku pa oluvalo olwindji, olwo notalu ka ninga oshigwana oshinene. Otandi ku yambeke, edhina lyoye otandi li ningi enene, noto ka ninga elaleko nuuyamba.
Otandi ka yambeka mboka taye ku yambeke, ihe otii ka tula omutima mboka taye ku tula omutima. Omungoye iigwana ayihe otayi ka lalekwa nuuyamba.”
Abram sho a li e na omimvo omilongo heyali nantano, okwa tembuka mo muHaran, ngaashi Omuwa e mu lombwele; Lot nokwa yi pamwe naye.

Abram okwa kutha omukadhi Sarai, omwanagona Lot, omaliko gawo agehe naapika ayehe ya li ye ya na muHaran, oyo noya yi kevi lyaKaanan.
Sho ya thiki muKaanan,
Abram okwe ende noshilongo, sigo okwe ya peha eyapuki puShekem, pomuti gwomwandi gwaMore. (Pethimbo ndyoka Aakaanana oya li moshilongo.)
Omuwa okwa holokele Abram e ta ti kuye: “Oshilongo shika otandi ke shi pa oluvalo lwoye.” Abram okwa tungile Omuwa, ngoka e mu ihololele, oshiyambelo.
Okuza nkoka oku uka lwokuumbugantu, kevi lyoondundu kuuzilo waBetel e ta yungu ontanda a gama Betel kuuninginino naAi kuuzilo. Naahoka okwa tungu oshiyambelo e ta simaneke Omuwa.
Nena okwa lunduluka po ta yi kehala nehala u uka lwokuumbugantu waKaanan.
MuKaanan omwa li mu na ondjala yekomba. Ondjala sho ya geye, Abram okwa yi kuEgipiti e ta kala ko ethimbo lyontumba.
Sho a li pokutaaguluka ongamba a ye kuEgipiti, okwa ti komukadhi Sarai: “Ngoye omukiintu wa shitika.
Ngele Aayegipiti taye ku mono, otaa ka dhiladhila kutya ngoye ogwandje. Oyo notaa dhipaga ndje po notaye ku etha u kale nomwenyo.
Ya lombwela kutya ngoye omumwameme; nena otaa hupitha ndje molwoye e taa ningi ndje nawa.”
Sho ya thiki kuEgipiti, Aayegipiti oya mono kutya omukiintu okwa shitika.
Omalenga gomukwaniilwa sho ge mu mono, nkene e li po a shitika, oge shi hokololele omukwaniilwa, Sarai nokwa falwa kuuwa.
MolwaSarai omukwaniilwa okwa ningi Abram nawa e te mu pe iigunda yoonzi niikombo, oongombe, uusino, aapika noongamelo.
Ihe molwashoka omukwaniilwa okwa kutha po Sarai, Omuwa okwa tumine omukwaniilwa naantu ye yomuuwa uuvu uudhigu.
Omukwaniilwa okwi ithana Abram e ta ti kuye: “Owa ningi ndje ngiini? Omolwashike inoo lombwela ndje kutya Sarai omukiintu gwoye?
Omolwashike wa tile kutya omumwanyoko, sigo nde mu kutha po nokuli, a ninge gwandje? Mukadhoye oye nguka, mu kutha po, mu ye.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa lombwele aapiya ye, oyo noya kutha Abram e taye mu pititha mo moshilongo, pamwe nomukadhi neliko lye alihe.
13: Abram okwa zi muEgipiti e ta yi kuumbugantu waKaanan pamwe nomukadhi neliko lye alihe. Lot wo okwa yi naye.
Abram okwa li omuyamba unene e na oonzi, iikombo noongombe, osho wo oshisiliveli noshingoli.
Abram okwa zi ko nkoka e ta kala ta tembukatembuka u uka lwokuBetel. Okwe ya pehala li li pokati kaBetel naAi, mpoka a yungilile nale oontanda
nokwa li a tungile po oshiyambelo. Opo mpoka a simanekele Omuwa.
Lot okwa li wo e na oonzi, iikombo noongombe negumbo lye naapiya.
Omaunapelo oga li inaage ya gwanena, oshoka oya li ye na iimuna oyindji.
Oontamanana odha tukuka pokati kaasita yiimuna yaAbram naasita yiimuna yaLot. (Pethimbo ndyoka Aakaanana nAaperesi oya li moshilongo.)
Nena Abram okwa ti kuLot: “Tse aakwezimo. Inapu kala oontamanana pokati kaasita yandje noyoye.
Natu topokeni nombili. Hogolola ombinga yoshilongo ndjoka wa hala. Ngele to gama kombinga yimwe, ngame ote gama kombinga onkwawo.”

Lot okwa tala koombinga noombinga e ta mono ko olusilu lwaJordan aluhe, ondjila ayihe sigo okuZoar. Olwa li lu na omeya ogendji lwa fa oshikunino shOmuwa nenge lwa fa evi lyaEgipiti. (Shika osha ningwa, manga Omuwa inaa hanagula po Sodom naGomorra).
Lot okwi ihogololele olusilu lwaJordan e ta yi u uka lwokuuzilo. Osho ngaaka aalumentu mbaka yaali ya topoka.
Abram okwa kala mevi lyaKaanan, ihe Lot okwa kala miilando yomolusilu e ta yungu ontanda popepi naSodom.
Aantu yomuSodom oya li aayonaguli noya yono kOmuwa.
Lot sho a yi, Omuwa okwa lombwele Abram a ti: “Lengalenga koombinga adhihe okuza mpoka u li.
Evi alihe u wete otandi li ku pe pamwe noluvalo lwoye, notali ningi lyoye sigo aluhe.
Otandi ke ku pa oluvalo olwindji, notalu nyengana okuyalula ngaashi ontsi yevi.
Ngashingeyi shilila evi alihe, oshoka otandi ke li ku pa.”
Abram okwa tembudha omatsali ge e te ya, a kale popepi noomwandi oondjapuki dhaMamre puHebron; oko nkoka a tungile ko Omuwa oshiyambelo.
14: Aakwaniilwa yane: Amrafel gwokuBabilonia, Arjok gwokuEllasar, Kedorlaomer gwokuElam naTidal gwokuGoiim.
Oya ka hingila aakwaniilwa yakwawo yatano iita: Bera gwokuSodom, Birsha gwokuGomorra, Shinab gwokuAdma, Shemeber gwokuSeboim nomukwaniilwa gwaBela (kokutya gwaZoar).
Aakwaniilwa mbaka yatano oya hangana e taa gongele omatangakwiita gawo molusilu lwaSiddim, mpoka pu na ngashingeyi Efuta lya sa.
Oya adhika ya kala mepangelo lyaKedorlaomer omimvo omulongo nambali, ihe momumvo omutimulongo nomutitatu oya tsu ondumbo naye.
Momumvo omutimulongo nomutine Kedorlaomer naamboka ya gama kuye, oye ya nomatangakwiita gawo e taa dhenge Aarafa muAshterot-Karnajim, Aasusi muHam, Aaemim molushandja lwaKirjatajim
nAahori moondundu dhaEdom sigo okuElparan kooha dhombuga.
Nena oya galuka e taye ya kuKadesh (haku tiwa Enmishpat). Oya lala evi alihe lyaAayamaleki e taa dhenge Aayamori mboka ya kala muHazazon Tamar.
Nena aakwaniilwa gwaSodom, gwaGomorra, gwaAdma, gwaZebojim nogwaBela oya fala omatangakwiita gawo molusilu lwaSiddim e taa kondjitha
aakwaniilwa mboka gwaElam, gwaGoiim, gwaBabilonia nogwaEllasar, aakwaniilwa yatano ya kondjitha aakwaniilwa yane.

Ihe olusilu lwaSiddim olwa li lu udha iiko yi na onka yomevi, naakwaniilwa gwaSodom nogwaGomorra sho ya kambadhala okufadhuka po, oya gwile miiko, manga aakwaniilwa yakwawo yatatu ya yi ontuku koondundu.
Aakwaniilwa mboka yane oya yugu po shaa shoka muSodom nomuGomorra, osho wo iikulya, e taa yi.
Lot, omwanagona gwaAbram, okwa li wo muSodom, onkee oye mu kwata po pamwe nomaliko ge agehe.
Ihe omuntu gumwe okwi iyaka po e te ke shi lombwela Abram, Omuhebeli ngoka a li popepi noomwandi oondjapuki dhaMamre Omuamori. Mamre naamwayinamati Eshkol naAner oya li ye na ekwatathano naAbram.
Abram sho a kundana kutya omwanagona a kwatwa po, okwa homateke aapiya ye aainekelwa ayehe mboka ye shi okukondja, ye li 318 ayehe kumwe, e taa landula aakwaniilwa mbeyaka yane sigo okuDan.
Oko Abram a topola aantu ye moongundu e ta ponokele aatondi ye uusiku e te ya dhenge. Okwe ya tidha sigololo oHoba, kuumbugantu waDamaskus,
e ta galula ko iihakanwa ayihe ya li ya kuthwa po. Okwa galula ko wo omwanagona Lot nomaliko ge agehe pamwe naakiintu noonkwatwa adhihe.
Abram sho a galuka kokusinda Kedorlaomer naakwaniilwa ooyakwawo, omukwaniilwa gwaSodom okwe mu tsakaneke molusilu lwaShave (halu ithanwa wo Olusilu lwaakwaniilwa).
Nena Melkisedek, omukwaniilwa gwaSalem, ngoka a li wo omuyambi gwaKalunga kokombandambanda, okwe etele Abram oshikwiila nomaviinu
nokwe mu yambeke ta ti: “Kalunga kokombandambanda, ngoka a shiti egulu nevi, na yambeke Abram;
Kalunga kokombandambanda, ngoka e ku pe esindano okusinda aatondi yoye, na simanekwe!” Abram nokwa pe Melkisedek oshitimulongo shomiihakanwa ye ayihe e yi kutha miita.
Omukwaniilwa gwaSodom okwa lombwele Abram a ti: “Kwatha ndje, u galulile ndje aantu yandje ayehe, ihe iihakanwa kala nayo.”
Abram okwa yamukula a ti: “Otandi gana koshipala shOmuwa, Kalunga kokombandambanda, omushiti gwegulu nevi,
kutya itandi tindile sha shoye, nando okashona, nando oluthipathipa nenge omuya gwoongaku, opo waa tye, owa yambapaleke Abram.
Itandi ikuthile sha. Otandi zimine owala shoka aantu yandje ya longitha mokulya. Ihe aalumentu mbaka twa li nayo: Aner, Eshkol naMamre, naa taambe oshitopolelwa shawo.”
15: Konima yaambika Abram okwa mono emoniko noku uvu Omuwa te mu lombwele ta ti: “Abram, ino tila. Otandi ku shigi kiiponga e tandi ku pe ondjambi onene.”
Abram okwa yamukula a ti: “Omuwa Omupangeliawike, uuwanawa owashike to u ningile ndje, oshoka kandi na aanona. Elieser a za kuDamaskus, oye awike omuthigululi gwandje.
Ino pa ndje aanona, onkee gumwe gwomaapiya yandje ota ka thigulula ndje.”
Nena oku uvu Omuwa te mu popitha ishewe ta ti: “Omupika nguka Elieser haye te ke ku thigulula, ihe omumwoyelela te ke ku thigulula.”
Omuwa okwe mu fala pondje e ta ti: “Tala kegulu, u yalule oonyothi; osho to ka kala u na oluvalo olwindji lu thike pudho.”
Abram okwi inekele Omuwa, nomolwashika Omuwa okwe mu hokwa e te mu tala omuyuuki.
Nena Omuwa okwa ti kuye: “Ongame Omuwa nde ku tembudha muUr shaBabilonia, ndi ku pe evi ndika, li ninge lyoye mwene.”
Ihe Abram okwa pula a ti: “Omuwa Omupangeliawike, otandi shi tseya ngiini kutya otali ka ninga lyandje?”
Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Etela ndje ondema yomimvo ndatu, oshikombo oshikiintu shomimvo ndatu nonzi ontsezi yomimvo ndatu, onguti nongutyona.”
Abram okwe eta iinamwenyo mbika kuKalunga e te yi tandula olumana. Oombinga ndhoka dhonyama dha tandulwa olumana, okwe dhi tegameke momikweyo mbali, ihe oondhila ine dhi tandula.
Oontsa odha lambele ponyama, ihe Abram okwe dhi tidha po.
Etango sho lya li pokuningina, Abram okwa kotha omposi ondhigu nokwa adhika kuumbanda nehaluko.
Omuwa okwa ti kuye: “Oluvalo lwoye otalu ka kala aakwiilongo moshilongo shuundjendi; otaa ka ninga aapika e taa hepekwa omimvo omathele gane.
Ihe otandi ka geela oshigwana shoka tashi ya piki, nuuna taa tembuka mevi lyuundjendi, otaa ka faalela uuyamba owindji.
Ngoye mwene oto ka koka sigo omuukulupe e to ka sa nombili e to fumvikwa.
“Epipi etine olyo tali ka galukila huka, oshoka itandi tidha po Aayamori, sigo ya yono nokuyonenena.”
Etango sho lya ningine nokwa luudha, eziko lya tema nonyeka ya hwama oya holoka pokati komalumana giinamwenyo.
Osho ngeyi Omuwa okwa hangana naAbram. Okwa popi ta ti: “Otandi uvaneke okugandja evi ndika koluvalo lwoye okuza kongamba yaEgipiti sigo omulonga Eufrat,
mwa kwatelelwa iilongo yAakeni, yAakenasi, yAakadmoni,
yAaheti, yAaperesi, yAarafa,
yAayamori, yAakaanana, yAagirgashi noyAayebusi.”
16: Omukulukadhi gwaAbram Sarai ine mu valela nando aanona. Ihe Sarai okwa li e na omudhike Omuegipiti omupika, edhina lye Hagar,
onkee Sarai okwa ti kuAbram: “Omuwa okwa keelele ndje okuvala aanona. Inda, u ka lale nomupika gwandje, pamwe ta valele ndje okanona.” Abram okwa zimine ndhoka a lombwelwa kuSarai.
Sarai okwa kutha omupika gwe Hagar Omuegipiti e te mu gandja kuAbram, a kale omukiintu gwe. (Shika sho sha ningwa, Abram okwa adhika a kala muKaanan omimvo omulongo.)
Abram okwa lala naHagar e ta ningi omusimba. Sho i idhimbulula kutya a ningi omusimba, okwi inenepeke e ta dhini Sarai.

Nena Sarai okwa ti kuAbram: “Epuko olyoye, Hagar sho a dhini ndje. Ongame mwene nde mu gandja kungoye, ihe sho i idhimbulula kutya a ningi omusimba, okwa dhini ndje. Omuwa na tokole kutya olye e li mondjila, ongoye nenge ongame.”
Abram okwa yamukula a ti: “Onawa, omupika gwoye oku li mepangelo lyoye, mu ninga shoka wa hala.” Nena Sarai okwa ngwandjagula Hagar, sigo i iteka po puye e ta yi.
Omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwa tsakaneke Hagar poluthithiya mombuga mondjila yu uka kuShur

e ta ti: “Hagar, omupika gwaSarai, oto zi peni nowu uka peni?”
Hagar okwa yamukula a ti: “Ote yi ontuku mwene gwandje.”
Omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwa ti: “Shuna kuye, u kale omupika gwe.”
Nena omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwa ti: “Otandi ke ku pa oluvalo olwindji, nokape na ngoka ta vulu oku lu yalula.
Oto ka vala okamati; ka luka Ismael, oshoka Omuwa oku uvu okulila kwoye.
Ihe omumwoye ota ka kala a fa okasinokuti. Ota ka tsa ondumbo nomuntu kehe, nashaa ngoka ota tsu ondumbo naye. Ota ka kala kokule naakwanezimo lye.”
Hagar okwi ipopile e ta ti: “Onda mono tuu shili Kalunga notandi kala tuu ndi na omwenyo, opo ndi shi hokolole?” Onkee okwa luku Omuwa ngoka e mu popitha “Kalunga ngoka ha mono.”
Shika osho sha ningitha, aantu ya luke omuthima gwopokati kaKadesh naBered “Omuthima gwOmunamwenyo ngoka e wete ndje.”
Hagar okwa valele Abram omumati e te mu luku Ismael.
Pethimbo ndyoka Abram okwa li e na omimvo omilongo hetatu nahamano.
17: Abram sho a gwanitha omimvo omilongo omugoyi nomugoyi, Omuwa okwe mu ihololele e ta ti: “Ongame Kalunga Omunankondoawike. Vulika kungame e to longo shoka shu uka.
Otandi hangana nangoye e tandi ku pe oluvalo olwindji.”
Abram okwi ihata po a tsa oshipala she mevi, naKalunga okwa ti:
“Otandi dhike ehangano ndika nangoye. Otandi uvaneke kutya oto ka ninga hekulu yiigwana oyindji.
Edhina lyoye itali kala we Abram, ihe oAbraham, oshoka otandi ku ningi hekulu yiigwana oyindji.
Otandi ku pe oluvalo olwindji, nayamwe yomuyo otaa ka ninga aakwaniilwa. Oto ka kala u na oluvalo olwindji, notalu ka ninga iigwana.
“Otandi dhiginine euvaneko lyandje kungoye nokoluvalo lwoye momapipi gokomeho, naandika olyo ehangano lyaaluhe. Ote ningi Kalunga koye naKalunga koluvalo lwoye.
Evi moka u li ngashingeyi ondjendi, otandi li pe oluvalo lwoye. Evi alihe lyaKaanan otali ka ninga lyoluvalo lwoye sigo aluhe, nangame otii ka kala Kalunga kawo.”
Kalunga okwa ti kuAbraham: “Ngoye wo ou na okuzimina okudhiginina ehangano ndika, ongoye mwene noluvalo lwoye lwokomeho.
Ngoye mwene noluvalo omu na okuzimina, mu fukalekithe omulumentu kehe etanda.

Okuza nena okanona okamati kehe oke na okufukalekwa, nge ka ningi omasiku gahetatu, ayehe naapika taa valelwa maandjeni naapika mboka taa landwa ya za kaakwiilongo. Shika osho tashi holola ehangano pokati ketu nane.
Shaa ngoka na fukalekwe, naashika otashi ka ninga endhindhiliko lyokuholola kutya ehangano lyandje nane olyaaluhe.
Omulumentu kehe ngoka inaa fukalekwa, ita kala gwomaantu yandje, oshoka okwa yono ehangano lyandje.”
Kalunga okwa lombwele Abraham a ti: “Mukadhoye ino mu ithana we Sarai. Okuza nena edhina lye oSara
Otandi mu yambeke notandi mu pe oluvalo, e ku valele omumati. Otandi mu yambeke e ta ningi yina yiigwana, nomoluvalo lwe otamu ka za aakwaniilwa.”

Abraham okwi ihata po a tsa oshipala she mevi, ihe okwa tameke okumenya mo, sho a dhiladhila: “Omulumentu gwomimvo ethele ota vulu tuu okuvala okanona? Sara sho e na omimvo omilongo omugoyi, ota vala we?”
Abraham okwa pula Kalunga a ti: “Omolwashike Ismael itaa thigulula ndje?”
Kalunga okwa ti: “Aawe. Mukadhoye Sara ote ku valele omumati e to mu luku Isak. Otandi ka dhiginina ehangano lyandje naye nonoluvalo lwe sigo aluhe.

Ondu uvu epulo lyoye kombinga yaIsmael, onkee otandi mu yambeke e tandi mu pe aanona oyendji noluvalo olwindji. Oye ta ka ninga he yaawa omulongo nayaali, noluvalo lwe otandi ke lu ninga oshigwana oshinene.
Ihe ehangano lyandje otali kwatelele mo wo omumwoye Isak, ngoka ta ka valwa kuSara omumvo tagu ya pethimbo ngaandika.”
Kalunga sho a mana okupopya naAbraham, okwa yi.
Esiku ndyoka Abraham okwa vulika kuKalunga e ta fukalekitha Ismael naalumentu ayehe ya li maandjawo, aapika mboka ya valelwa maandjawo nenge ya landwa.
Abraham okwa li e na omimvo omilongo omugoyi nomugoyi, sho a fukala,
nomwana Ismael okwa li e na omimvo omulongo nandatu.
Ayehe yaali oya fukala esiku limwe,
Osho wo aapika ayehe yaAbraham.
18: Omuwa okwi ihololele Abraham moomwandi oondjapuki dhaMamre. Abraham manga a li a kuutumba posheelo shetsali lye omutenya,
okwa ligamene ko e ta mono aalumentu yatatu ya thikama komeho ge. Sho e ya mono, okwa matuka nziya, e ke ya tsakaneke. Okwi ihata po a tsa oshipala she mevi
e ta ti: “Omuwa gwandje, ngele wa sile ndje ohenda, ino pitilila ndje po, omuntu gwoye.
Etelweni omeya, mu yoge oompadhi dheni mu vule okugondja momuti nguka.

Otandi ke eta sha shokulya, shi mu koleke, opo mu tsikile ondjila yeni. Osho opala, sho mwe ya maandjetu.”
Oyo oya yamukula ya ti: “Ninga, ngaashi wa ti.”
Abraham okwa yi neendelelo metsali e ta ti kuSara: “Kutha mbala uusila womunziya, u ninge iikwiila.”
Opo ihe okwa matukile kiimuna e ta kutha ko ontana yo ondodhwa e te yi pe omupiya, e yi longekidhe mbala.
Okwa kutha omahini gomoosi nogomunya nonyama e ta fala iikulya kaalumentu mbaka. Ye mwene okwa li a thikama puyo momunzile gwomuti, manga taa li.

Oye mu pula ya ti: “Mukadhoye Sara oku li peni?”
Abraham okwa yamukula a ti: “Oku li metsali.”

Gumwe gwomuyo okwa ti: “Omumvo tagu ya pethimbo ngaandika otandi ka galuka, namukadhoye Sara ota ka kala e na okanona okamati.”
Sara okwa li konima ye posheelo shetsali, e ya pulakena.
Abraham naSara oya li ya kulupilila, naSara okwa li ihii imono we.
Sara okwi iyolele e ta ti: “Sho nda kulupa ngeyi, nomusamane gwandje naye wo okwa kulupilila, moondjokana ote mono mo we omulyo gwasha?”
Omuwa okwa pula Abraham a ti: “Omolwashike Sara a yolo ye ta ti: ‘Ote vulu we ngaa okuvala, sho nda kulupa ngeyi?’
Oku na sha tashi nyenge Omuwa? Ngaashi nda ti, omumvo tagu ya pethimbo ngaandika otandi ka galuka notandi adha Sara e na okanona okamati.”

Sara sho a li a tila, okwi ipatana a ti: “Inandi yola.”
Ihe Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Eeno, owe shi ninga, owa yola.”
Aalumentu oya thikama noya yi nondjila ndjoka yu uka kuSodom, naAbraham okwe ya thindikile.
Omuwa nokwi ipopile a ti: “Itandi holeke Abraham shoka tandi ka ninga.
Oluvalo lwe otalu ka ninga oshigwana oshinene noshinankondo, nomuye otandi ka yambeka iigwana ayihe.
Onde mu hogolola, opo a lombwele oyana noluvalo lwe, lu vulike kungame yo ya longe shoka shu uka noshoshili. Nongele taye shi ningi, nena otandi ka gwanitha shoka ndu uvanekele Abraham.”
Nena Omuwa okwa ti: “Oku na ekugo enene tali kugile aantu yomuSodom naGomorra, nuulunde wawo owa lunda pombanda.
Otandi yi ko ndi ka tale, ekugo ndyoka ndu uvu, ngele olyoshili.”
Nena aalumentu yaali oya yi yu uka kuSodom, ihe Abraham okwa kala po a thikama koshipala shOmuwa.
Abraham okwa hedha kOmuwa e ta ti: “Oto ka yona po omuyuuki pamwe nomukolokoshi?
Moshilando ngele omu na aayuuki omilongo ntano, oto shi hanagula po? Ito shi hupitha, opo u hupithe aayuuki mboka omilongo ntano?
Omuyuuki oto mu dhipagele mumwe nomunandjo? Ito vulu oku shi ninga. Itashi vulika, omuyuuki a yonuke po pamwe nomulunde. Omupanguli guuyuni auhe ita longo ando pauyuuki?”
Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “MuSodom ngele onda adha mo aayuuki omilongo ntano, ote hupitha oshilando ashihe omolwawo.”
Abraham okwa popi ishewe ta ti: “Ombili, kwatha ndje ngaa, sho tandi tsikile okupopya nOmuwa, nonando ngame omuntu gwowala, ontsi nomutoko.

Pamwe oto adha mo aayuuki omilongo ne nayatano peha lyomilongo ntano. Oto hanagula po oshilando ashihe, ngele aayuuki inaa adha omilongo ntano?” Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Oshilando itandi shi hanagula po, ngele otandi adha mo aayuuki omilongo ne nayatano.”

Abraham okwa popi ishewe a ti: “Ngele oye li owala omilongo ne?”
Oye nokwa yamukula: “Itandi shi hanagula po, ngele oku na omilongo ne.”

Abraham okwa ti: “Ombili, ino geya, Omuwa, sho te popi ishewe te ti: Ongiini, ngele oye li omilongo ndatu?”
Okwa ti: “Itandi shi ningi, ngele otandi mono mo omilongo ndatu.”

Abraham okwa ti: “Ombili, kwatha ndje, sho tandi tsikile okupopya nOmuwa. Ongiini, ngele omilongo mbali ayeke taa monika mo?”
Omuwa okwa ti: “Itandi shi hanagula po, ngele otandi adha mo omilongo mbali.”

Abraham okwa ti: “Ombili, Omuwa, ino geya, otandi popi natango lumwe. Ongiini, ngele otamu adhika omulongo?”
Okwa ti: “Itandi shi hanagula po, ngele otandi adha mo omulongo.”
Omuwa sho a mana okukundathana naAbraham, okwa zi po, naAbraham okwa shuna kegumbo.
19: Pethimbo lyongulohi aayengeli yaali oya thiki kuSodom, naLot okwa li a kuutumba peelo lyoshilando. Sho e ya mono, okwa thikama, e ke ya tsakaneke.

Okwi ihata po a tsa oshipala mevi e ta ti: “Ootatekulu, ngame omupiya gweni. Ileni maandjetu, mu iyoge koompadhi e tatu tokelweni. Ongula otamu penduka moontundumene, mu tsikile ondjila yeni.”
Ihe yo oya yamukula ya ti: “Aawe, uusiku otatu ke u lala pondje momapandaanda.”
Lot okwa dhiginine oku ya thiminika, nahugunina oya yi naye maandjawo. Lot okwe ya longekidhile iikulya. Okwe ya ningile oshikwiila inaashi fulikwa e taa li.
Aayenda manga inaa ka lala, aalumentu Aasodomu, aagundjuka naakokele, oye ya ya zi koombinga adhihe dhoshilando e taa kundukidha egumbo.
Oyi ithana Lot e taye mu pula: “Aalumentu mboka ya tokelwa maandjeni, oye li peni? Ya piitha mo, ye ye kutse, tse tu lale nayo.”
Lot okwa piti mo e ta yi kuyo pondje nokwe edhile po omweelo.
Okwa ti kuyo: “Ookuume, otandi mu galikana, inamu longa iihuna yi thike mpoka!
Taleni, ondi na aakadhona yaali inaaya lala nando nomulumentu. Otandi ya eta kune e tamu ningi, ngaashi mwa hala. Ihe aalumentu mbaka inamu ya hinda. Oyo aayenda maandjetu, nondi na oku ya popila.”
Ihe oya yamukula: “Za po putse! Omuntu nguka omukwiilongo, ihe nena okwa hala i ininge omupangeli. Otatu vulu tu ku ninge nayi shi vulithe pumboka.” Oyu undula Lot noya hala okuteya po omweelo.
Ihe aalumentu yaali ya li meni, oya hilile Lot megumbo e taa pata omweelo.
Nena aayenda mbaka oya tsikitha aantu ayehe ya li pondje e taa kala taa kongo osheelo osima.
Aalumentu yaali oya lombwele Lot ya ti: “Ngele ou na aakweni muka, aamwoye aamati nenge aakadhona, iitenya nenge aakwanezimo ya kala muka, ya lombwela ya tembuke mo,
oshoka otatu ka hanagula po ehala ndika. Omuwa oku uvu onkugo ondhigu molwaantu mbaka nokwe tu tumu, tu hanagule po Sodom.”
Nena Lot okwa yi kiitenya ye mbyoka ya li yi na okuhokana oyanakadhona e ta ti: “Endeleleni, oshoka Omuwa ota ka hanagula po oshilando.” Ihe oya tala kutya ota ningi omashendjo.
Eluwa sho tali tende, aayengeli oya kambadhala okuulumika Lot e taa ti: “Yambuka! Kutha mukadhoye naamwoyekadhona yaali, mu ye ontuku, opo mwaa yonukile mumwe noshilando, sho tashi geelwa.”
Lot sho a li ta kakadhala, aalumentu oye mu kwata mokwooko, nomukadhi noyanakadhona yaali, e taye ya pititha mo moshilando, oshoka Omuwa okwa li e ya uvitile ohenda.
Nena gumwe gwomaayengeli okwa ti: “Fadhukii po, mu ka hupithe oomwenyo dheni. Inamu tala konima ne inamu thikama molusilu nduka. Matukileni koondundu, opo mwaa dhipagwe.”
Lot okwa yamukula a ti: “Aawe, Omuwa gwandje.
Owa longele ndje uuwanawa uunene nowa hupitha omwenyo gwandje. Oondundu odhi li kokule unene, itandi adha ko; ehanagulo otali adha ndje e te si.
Ku wete okalando heya okashona? Oke li popepi hwepo. Pitika ndje, ndi ye hoka — okashona unene, hasho? Ihe ote hupitha omwenyo gwandje.”
Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Eewa ano, nda zimine. Okalando hoka itandi ka hanagula po.

Endelela! Matuka! Ite vulu okuninga sha, manga inoo thika ko.”
Okalando hoka noka lukwa Zoar.
Lot sho a thiki muZoar, lyo etango otali piti.
Ohaluka Omuwa okwa lokithile Sodom naGomorra osulufuli ya hwama
e ta hanagula po iilando mbyoka nolusilu aluhe pamwe naantu niimeno ayihe.
Ihe omukiintu gwaLot okwa tala konima e ta shituka oshaanda shomongwa.
Abraham okwa meneka ongula onene ta yi kehala nkoka a li koshipala shOmuwa.
Okwa ligamene lwokuSodom naGomorra nokolusilu aluhe e ta mono olwithi talu tsinagala koshilongo shoka lwa fa olwithi lweziko enenenene lyomulilo.
Ihe Kalunga sho a hanagula po iilando yomolusilu ndoka mwa kala Lot, okwa dhimbulukwa Abraham e ta hupitha Lot mehanagulo lyiilando mbyoka.
Lot noyanakadhona oya tembuka mo muZoar, oshoka oya li ya tila okukala mo. Oya yi koondundu e taa kala mekololo.
Omukadhona osheeli okwa ti konkelo: “Tate okwa kulupa, naampaka kape na nando omulumentu e tu hokane po, opo tu vale aanona.
Tu pe tate omaviinu a kolwe, opo tu lale naye tse tu mone aanona.”
Ongulohi ndjoka oya pe he omaviinu, nomukadhona osheeli okwa lala naye. Ihe he sho a li a kolwa, ina dhimbulula po sha.
Mesiku lya landula omukadhona osheeli okwa ti konkelo: “Onda lala natate uusiku wa zi ko; natu mu pe a nwe ishewe uusiku wonena ngoye e to lala naye, opo tu imonene aanona mutate.”
Uusiku mboka oye mu kolitha ishewe, nomukadhona onkelo okwa lala naye. Natango he okwa li a kolwa ye ina tseya sha.
Pamukalo nguka aana yaLot ayehe yaali oya ningithwa aasimba kuhe.
Omukadhona osheeli okwa vala omumati e te mu luku Moab. Oye hekulu yAamoabi yongashingeyi.
Omukadhona onkelo okwa vala omumati ngoka e mu luku Benammi. Oye hekulu yAayammoni yongashingeyi.
20: Abraham okwa tembuka po puMamre e ta yi kuumbugantu waKaanan nokwa kala pokati kaKadesh naShur. Konima sho a kala muGerar,
okwa ka tya omukadhi Sara omumwayina. Onkee omukwaniilwa gwaGerar Abimelek okwa tumu kuSara, a ninge gwe.
Uusiku wontumba Kalunga okwi ihololele Abimelek mondjodhi e ta ti kuye: “Oto ka sa omolwomukiintu ngoka u na, oshoka oku na mwene.”
Ihe Abimelek okwa adhika inee mu guma nando nokwa ti: “Omuwa, oto yonagula po aantu yaa na oondjo?
Abraham oye mwene a ti kutya omumwayina, nomukiintu osho a tile. Shika onde shi ningi neiyuvo ewanawa.”
Kalunga okwe mu yamukula mondjodhi e ta ti: “Eeno, onda tseya kutya owe shi ningi neiyuvo ewanawa, onkee nde ku keelele, waa yone kungame nomolwaasho inandi pitika, u mu gume.

Ngashingeyi shunitha omukiintu komulumentu gwe. Omulumentu ngoka oye omuhunganeki note ku galikanene, opo waa se. Ihe ngele ito mu shunitha, otandi ku londodha kutya oto ka sa, ongoye mwene naantu yoye ayehe.”
Abimelek okwa meneka ongula onene e ti ithana omalenga ge agehe e te ga lombwele shoka sha ningwa po, ogo noga li ga tila.

Nena Abimelek okwi ithana Abraham e ta pula ta ti: “Owe tu ningi ngiini ngeyi? Uuwinayi owashike nde ku ningile, opo u etele ndje omupya gu thike mpano nosho wo oshilongo shandje? Owa ningile ndje shoka ihaashi ningwa.”
Abimelek okwa tsikile ko natango ta pula: “Omolwashike we shi ningi?”
Abraham okwa yamukula a ti: “Onda dhiladhila kutya kamu na nando omuntu muka ha tila Kalunga; ayehe otaa ka dhipaga ndje, ya kuthe po mukadhandje.
Sho shene omuntu nguka omumwameme shili, twa za muhe gumwe, nonando hayina gumwe, onkee nde mu hokana po.
Kalunga sho a tembudha ndje maandjatate, ndi ye komavi guundjendi, onda lombwele Sara nda ti: ‘Akuhe hoka tatu ka ya, oto vulu okuhololela ndje ohole yoye nokutumbula to ti: Nguka oye omumwameme.’ ”
Abimelek okwa shunitha Sara kuAbraham nokwe mu pe oonzi, oongombe naapika.
Okwa ti kuAbraham: “Oshilongo shandje ou shi wete; kala shaa mpoka wa hala.”
Okwa ti kuSara: “Omumwanyoko otandi mu pe iimaliwa iisiliveli eyuvi omolweyono ndyoka nda yono kungoye, noshaa ngoka ota ka tseya kutya ngoye ku na uusama.”
Nena Abraham okwa galikana Kalunga, naKalunga okwa aludha Abimelek. Okwa aludha wo omukadhi naadhike ye naapika, opo ya vule okumona uunona.
Oshoka Omuwa okwa li a pata oluvalo megumbo lyaAbimelek omolwaSara, omukiintu gwaAbraham.
21: Omuwa okwa yambeke Sara, ngaashi u uvaneka.
Sara okwa ningi omusimba e ta valele Abraham okamati muukulupe. Okamati oka valwa pethimbo ndyoka Kalunga e li uvaneke.
Abraham okwe ka luku Isak.
Isak sho a gwanitha omasiku gahetatu, Abraham okwe mu fukalekitha, ngaashi Kalunga e mu lombwele.
Abraham okwa li e na omimvo ethele, Isak sho a valwa.
Sara okwa ti: “Kalunga okwa pe ndje enyanyu e tandi yolo. Shaa ngoka te shi uvu, ota ka yola pamwe nangame.”
Sara okwa gwedha ko a ti: “Olye a li ta vulu okulombwela Abraham kutya Sara ona ka yamutha aanona? Onkene tuu onde mu valele okamati muukokele we.”
Okamati oka koko, nuuna ndoka ka toya, Abraham okwa ningi oshituthi oshinene.
Ihe Sara sho a mono okamati hoka Hagar Omuegipiti e ka valele Abraham, taka popi oohapu dhomasheko,
okwa ti kuAbraham: “Tidha po omupika nguka nomwana. Omuna gwomukiintu nguka ke na okuthigulula uuthiga mboka tau thigululwa komumwandje Isak.”
Shika osha ningitha Abraham omwenyo omwiinayi, oshoka Ismael okwa li omwana.
Ihe Kalunga okwa ti kuAbraham: “Ino ipyakidhila nomumati nonomupika gwoye Hagar. Gwanitha shoka Sara te ku lombwele, oshoka muIsak omo to mono oluvalo nde lu ku uvanekele.
Omuna gwomupika otandi ke mu pa oluvalo olwindji nota ka ninga oshigwana, oshoka oye omumwoye wo.”
Abraham okwa meneka e ta pe Hagar iikulya nombago yu udha omeya. Abraham okwa tsike Hagar e te mu laleke, a ye. Okwa yi e ta alaala nombuga yaBeersheba.
Omeya sho ga pu po, okwa tula omunona poshihwa,
e ta ka kuutumba oshinano shi thike peumbilo lyoshikuti. Okwi ipopile ta ti: “Itandi vulu okutala omumwandje ta si.” Okwa kuutumba mpoka e ta lili.
Kalunga oku uvu elilo lyomunona, nomuyengeli gwaKalunga okwa popi megulu a lombwele Hagar a ti: “Hagar, oto lilile shike? Ino lila. Kalunga oku uvu elilo lyomunona, sho a lala mpee.
Inda, u ke mu kuthe po. Otandi mu ningi oshigwana oshinene.”
Kalunga okwa tonatitha omeho gaHagar e ta mono omuthima. Okwa yi e tu udhitha ombago omeya e ta nwetha omunona.
Kalunga okwa li pamwe nomunona mokukoka kwe. Okwa kala mombuga yaParan e ta ningi ondjumbeta.
Mokukala kwawo mombuga yina okwe mu kongele omukiintu Omuegipiti.
Pethimbo ndyoka Abimelek nondjayi yiita ye Pikol oye ya kuAbraham noye mu lombwele ya ti: “Kalunga oku li pamwe nangoye mwaayihe mbyoka to ningi.
Ngashingeyi gana koshipala shaKalunga kutya ito kotokele ndje, naamwandje naatekulu yandje. Hololela ndje ohenda yoye, osho wo oshilongo moka u li mo, ngaashi ngame nde ku ningile.”
Abraham okwa yamukula a ti: “Otandi gana.”
Abraham okwa nyenyetele Abimelek molwomuthima ngoka aapiya yaAbimelek ye gu mu yugile.
Abimelek okwa ti: “Inandi tseya ngoka e shi ningi, nangoye ino shi lombwela ndje nando onale. Opo tandi shi uvu lwotango nena mpa.”
Nena Abraham okwa pe Abimelek oonzi noongombe noyo ayehe yaali oya ningi euvathano.
Abraham okwa yoolola oonzigona heyali moonzi dhe,
naAbimelek okwe mu pula ta ti: “Omolwashike we shi ningi?”
Abraham okwa yamukula a ti: “Taamba oonzigona ndhika heyali, shi ninge onzapo kutya ongame nda hupa po omuthima nguka.”
Ehala ndyoka onkee lya lukwa Beersheba, molwashoka mboka yaali opo ya ganenathana.
Sho ya ningi euvathano puBeersheba, Abimelek naPikol oya shuna kuFilistea.
Nena Abraham okwa tsike omuti omutamariske muBeersheba, oye nokwa galikana Omuwa, Kalunga kaaluhe.
Abraham okwa kalele muFilistia ethimbo ele.
22: Konima yaambika Kalunga okwa yeleke Abraham. Okwa ti kuye: “Abraham!” Abraham okwa yamukula a ti: “Ee!”
Kalunga okwa ti: “Kutha omumwoye, epona lyoye Isak, ngoka u mu hole, ngoye u ye koshilongo shaMoria. Inda, u ke mu yambe, a ninge efikilondjambo kondundu ndjoka tandi yi ku ulukile.”
Abraham okwa meneka ongula onene e ta kutile okasino, a kutha omwana Isak naapiya ye yaali. Sho a panda iikuni yefikilondjambo, okwa yi u uka kehala hoka a lombwelwa.
Mesiku etitatu Abraham okwa lengalenga nokwa monene ehala ndyoka kokule.
Nena okwa lombwele aapiya ye a ti: “Kaleni mpaka nokasino. Tse nomumwandjemati otatu yi tu ka galikane hwiyaka notatu ka galukila huka.”
Abraham okwa tsike Isak iikuni yefikilondjambo, noye mwene okwa humbata omwele nomulilo. Manga ya li taa ende,

Isak okwa pula he Abraham ta ti: “Tate!”
He nokwa ti: “Ee.”
Isak okwa ti: “Otu na omulilo niikuni, ihe onzi yefikilondjambo oyi li peni?”
Abraham okwa yamukula a ti: “Kalunga mwene oti imonene.” Oyo noye ende pamwe ayehe yaali.
Sho ya thiki kehala ndyoka Kalunga e li mu lombwele, Abraham okwa tungu oshiyambelo e ta tula ko iikuni. Okwa manga omwana Isak e te mu langeke koshiyambelo kombanda yiikuni.
Okwa pweya mo omwele, e mu dhipage.

Ihe omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwe mu igidha megulu a ti: “Abraham, Abraham!”
Abraham okwa yamukula a ti: “Ee!”
Omuyengeli okwa ti kuye: “Oshikaha shoye ino shi gumitha omumwoye, u mu ningile ando uuwinayi washa. Ngashingeyi ondi shi shi kutya oho tila Kalunga, oshoka ino mu tindila omumwoye epona.”
Abraham okwa lengalenga e ta mono onzi yi li mengande ya kwatwa komankono. Okwa yi e te yi patukununa mo nokwe yi yamba efikilondjambo peha lyomwana.
Ehala ndyoka Abraham okwe li luku “Omuwa ti imonene.” Sigo onena aantu ohaa ti: “Okondundu yOmuwa ti imonene.”
Omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwi ithana Abraham megulu lutiyali
a ti: “Otandi iganene mwene — Omuwa osho ta ti — otandi ke ku yambeka. Molwashoka wa ningi shika noino tindila ndje omumwoye epona,
Otandi uvaneke kutya otandi ku pe oluvalo olwindji lwa fa oonyothi dhokegulu nenge ehekevi lyomooha dhefuta. Oluvalo lwoye otalu ka sinda aatondi yalwo.
Omungoye nomoluvalo lwoye aantu yomiigwana ayihe otaa ka lalekwa nuuyamba, oshoka owa vulika kelombwelo lyandje.”
Abraham okwa shuna kaapiya ye, noyo ayehe oye ya kuBeersheba, nkoka Abraham a tula.
Konima yaambika Abraham okwa lombwelwa: “Milka ota mono aanona; okwa valele omumwanyoko Nahor aamati.”
Osheeli oUz, taku landula Bus, Kemuel, he yaAram,
Kesed, Haso, Pildash, Jidlaf naBetuel.
Betuel ohe yaRebekka. Milka okwa valele Nahor, omumwayina gwaAbraham, aamati mbaka yahetatu.
Omukiintu gwaNahor gwoponto, edhina lye Reuma, okwa valele Nahor Tebak, Gaham, Tahash naMaaka.
23: Sara okwa kala nomwenyo omimvo ethele nomilongo mbali naheyali.
Okwa sile muHebron, kokutya Kiriatarba, mevi lyaKaanan, Abraham nokwe mu lili oosa.
Nena Abraham okwa zi po pomudhimba gwomukadhi e ta lombwele Aaheti ta ti:
“Ngame ondjendi ndi li mokati keni. Kwathii ndje, ndi lande kune eha, ndi fumvike mo omusi gwandje.”
Oya yamukula ya ti:
“Tatekulu, tu pulakena! Ongoye omuwiliki omunankondo mokati ketu. Fumvika mukadhoye mombila ombwanawa kwaadhihe ndhoka dhetu. Shaa ngoka gwomutse ota nyanyukwa oku ku pa ombila, opo u mu fumvike mo.”
Nena Abraham okwi inyongamene pevi koshipala shawo
e ta ti: “Ngele otamu pitika, ndi fumvike mukadhandje mpaka, kwathii ndje, mu pule Efron lyaZohar,
a landithe ndje po ekololo lyaMakpela ontega nepya lye. Mu puleni, e li landithe po kungame ondando yalyo ya gwana po, opo li ninge lyandje mwene lyomayendo.”
Efron mwene okwa li a kuutumba pamwe nAaheti pehala lyoshigongi posheelo shoshilando. Okwa yamukula montaneho yaantu ayehe a ti:
“Pulakena, tatekulu. Epya alihe otandi li ku pe nekololo ndyoka li li mulyo. Otandi li ku pe mpaka montaneho yaakwetu, opo u fumvike mo mukadhoye.”
Abraham okwi inyongamene pevi koshipala shAaheti
e ta ti kuEfron montaneho yaantu: “Kwatha ndje ngaa u pulakene. Epya alihe onda hala ndi li lande. Taamba iifuta yandje notii ka fumvika mo mukadhandje.”
Efron okwa yamukula a ti:
“Tatekulu, eyana ndyoka olyiimaliwa iisiliveli omathele gane, ihe kayi shi sha pokati ketu. Fumvika owala mukadhoye.”
Abraham okwa zimine e te mu yelekithile omwaalu ngoka Efron a tomona montaneho yaantu — iimaliwa iisiliveli omathele gane pamuthika ngoka hagu yelekwa kaalandithi.
Osho ngaaka eliko lyaEfron puMakpela, kuuzilo waMamre, olya ningi lyaAbraham, epya alihe nekololo ndyoka li li mo nomiti adhihe mepya nopooha dhalyo.
Osha ziminwa kAaheti ayehe ya li moshigongi posheelo shoshilando.
Abraham okwa fumvike mo omukadhi Sara mekololo ndyoka li li mevi lyaKaanan.
Osho ngaaka epya lyAaheti nekololo li li mulyo, olya ningi lyaAbraham lyomayendo.
24: Abraham okwa li a kulupilila, Omuwa okwe mu yambekele iilonga ye ayihe.
Abraham okwa lombwele omupiya gwe omukuluntu, ngoka a li ha tonatele eliko lye alihe, a ti: “Tula oshikaha shoye kohi yetundji lyandje e to gana.
Onda hala ndi ku ganithe medhina lyOmuwa, Kalunga kegulu nevi, kutya ino kongela omumwandje omukiintu maakadhona yaantu mbaka Aakaanana.
Ou na okuya kevi hoka nda valelwa, u ka kongele omumwandje Isak omukiintu mokati kezimo lyetu.”
Omupiya okwa yamukula a ti: “Otashi ningwa ngiini, omukadhona ngele ina hala okuza kaandjawo, e ye huka? Nandi shune omumwoye kevi hoka wa zile?”
Abraham okwa yamukula a ti: “Kotoka, waa shune ko omumwandje!

Omuwa, Kalunga komegulu, okwa tembudha ndje maandjatate nomevi lyaandjetu nokwa uvanekele ndje nokugana kutya evi ndika ote li pe oluvalo lwandje. Ote ku tetekelithile omuyengeli gwe, opo u monene omumwandje omukiintu.
Omukadhona ngele ina hala okuya nangoye, nena owa manguluka megano ndika. Ihe ino fala ko nando omumwandje nkwiyaka.”
Omupiya okwa tula oshikaha she kohi yetundji lyaAbraham, mwene gwe, e ta gana a gwanithe shoka Abraham a ti.
Omupiya okwa kutha oongamelo omulongo niinima yi ili noyi ili yondilo meliko lyamwene gwe e ta yi koshilando nkoka kwa kala Nahor, muumbangalantu waMesopotamia.
Sho a thiki ko, okwa tsitha oongamelo oongolo pomuthima gu li pondje yoshilando. Okwa li komatango, ethimbo ndyoka aakiintu haa ya okuteka omeya.
Okwa galikana a ti: “Omuwa, Kalunga kamwene gwandje Abraham, nena ndjika kwatha ndje, iinima yi ende nawa e to dhiginine euvaneko lyoye we li uvanekele mwene gwandje.
Ondi li mpaka pomuthima mpoka aakiintu yomoshilando taa ya okuteka omeya.

Otii ka pula gumwe gwomuyo te ti: ‘Kwatha ndje, u endeke oshuma shoye, ndi nwe mo.’ Ngele ota ti: ‘Nwa mo, noongamelo dhoye otandi dhi hugile wo,’ oye na ninge ngoka we mu hogololele omuntu gwoye Isak. Ngele shika tashi ningwa, otandi ka tseya kutya owa dhiginine euvaneko lyoye kumwene gwandje.”
Manga omupiya inaa mana okugalikana, ye Rebekka ota thiki nokuli a humbata oshuma she kepepe. Oye omuna gwaBetuel yaNahor, omumwayina gwaAbraham, e mu valelwa komukadhi Milka.
Okwa li a shitika, omukadhonalela. Okwa yi momuthima, ta teke oshuma she e ta zi mo.
Omupiya okwa yi kuye e ta ti: “Kwatha ndje ndi nwe mo moshuma shoye.”
Okwa ti: “Nwa mo, tatekulu,” nokwe endeke mbala oshuma she e shi kwata, manga ta nu.
Sho a mana, okwa ti: “Otandi hugile wo oongamelo dhoye dhi kumwe.”
Okwa tile mbala omeya metemba e ta shuna nziya momuthima, a ka tale omeya, sigo a hugile oongamelo dhe adhihe.
Omulumentu okwa thikama a fa a pugalala ta nongonona omukadhona, a tale ngele Omuwa e mu wilike tuu nondjila yi na elago.
Sho a mana, omulumentu okwa kutha okalinga koshingoli ke na ondilo e te ke mu zaleke keyulu, okwe mu zaleke wo uugondo uyali komaako.
Okwa ti: “Kwatha ndje u lombwele ndje, ongoye lye? Maandjeni omu na tuu ehala lyaayenda, tse naantu yandje tu ka lale mo?”
Okwa yamukula a ti: “Ongame Rebekka yaBetuel yaNahor. Yina yaBetuel oMilka.
Maandjetu omu na omwiidhi ogwindji, omu na wo ehala lyokulala.”
Nena omulumentu okwa tsu oongolo e ta hambelele Omuwa.
Okwa ti: “Omuwa, Kalunga kamwene gwandje Abraham, na hambelelwe, sho a li omudhiginini mokugwanithila mwene gwandje euvaneko lye. Omuwa okwe enditha ndje nondjila yu uka kezimo lyamwene gwandje.”
Omukadhona okwa matukile kuyina e te mu hokololele ayihe.
Rebekka okwa li e na omumwayina edhina lye Laban. Laban okwa matukile komuthima komupiya gwaAbraham.

Laban sho a mono okalinga kokomayulu nuugondo wokomaako gamumwayina ye ta pulakene shoka omulumentu e mu hokololele, okwa yi komupiya gwaAbraham. Omupiya okwa li a thikama natango poongamelo dhe pomuthima.
Laban okwa ti: “Ila, tu ye kegumbo. Ngoye omuntu ngoka a yambekwa kOmuwa. Omolwashike wa thikama pondje? Onda longekidha ehala maandjetu, nehala lyoongamelo dhoye wo.”
Omulumentu okwa yi megumbo. Laban okwa kutulula oongamelo e te dhi pe iikulya. Opo ihe okwe etele omupiya gwaAbraham naantu ye omeya gokuyoga oompadhi.

Iikulya sho ye etwa po, omulumentu okwa ti: “Itandi li, manga inaandi popya shoka she enditha ndje.”
Laban okwa ti: “Shi popya ano.”
Omulumentu okwa ti: “Ngame omupiya gwaAbraham.
Omuwa okwa yambeka mwene gwandje noonkondo e te mu ningi omuyamba. Okwe mu pe iigunda yoonzi noyiikombo, oongombe, oshisiliveli noshingoli, aapika aalumentu naakiintu, oongamelo nuusino.
Sara, omukulukadhi gwamwene gwandje, okwe mu valele omumati muukokele we, namwene gwandje okwe mu pa eliko lye alihe.
Mwene gwandje okwa ganitha ndje e ta ti: ‘Ino kongela omumwandje omukadhona maakadhona yomuKaanan.
Inda kaandjatate, kezimo lyandje, u ke mu kongele omukiintu.’
Onda pula mwene gwandje nda ti: ‘Otashi ningwa ngiini, omukadhona ngele ina hala, tu ze ko naye?’
Okwa yamukula a ti: ‘Omuwa mwene, ngoka handi vulika kuye aluhe, ota ka tuma omuyengeli gwe, a ende pamwe nangoye noku ku pa elago. Oto ka monena omumwandje omukiintu kaandjetu, kegumbo lyatate.
Nge wa thiki kezimo lyandje, yo taa tindi oku mu ku pa, nena owa manguluka keganitho lyandje.’
“Sho nda thiki pomuthima, onda galikana nda ti: ‘Omuwa, Kalunga kamwene gwandje Abraham, kwatha ndje, olweendo nduka lwandje lu kale lu na elago.
Ondi li mpaka pomuthima. Uuna omukadhona te ya okuteka omeya, otandi ke mu indila, ndi nwe mo moshiyuma she.
Ngele ota zimine e ta hugile wo oongamelo dhandje, oye na ninge ngoka wa hogololele omuna gwamwene gwandje, a ninge omukadhi.’
Manga inaandi mana egalikano lyandje lyomonguwi, ye Rebekka oye ngu e ya ko e na oshuma kepepe. Okwa yi momuthima e ta teke omeya. Onda ti kuye: ‘Kwatha ndje wo, ndi nwe mo.’
Okwe endekithile nanziya oshuma kungame e ta ti: ‘Nwa mo, notandi hugile wo noongamelo dhoye.’ Onda nu, e ta hugile oongamelo.
Onde mu pula nda ti: ‘Ho olye?’ Okwa yamukula a ti: ‘Tate oBetuel yaNahor, meme oMilka.’ Nena onde mu zaleke okalinga keyulu nuugondo komaako ge.

Onda tsu oongolo e tandi galikana Omuwa. Onda hambelele Omuwa, Kalunga kamwene gwandje Abraham, ngoka e enditha ndje nondjila yu uka kezimo lyamwene gwandje hoka nda monene omuna gwamwene gwandje omukadhona.
Ngashingeyi, ne ngele omwa tokola okuhololela mwene gwandje ohole nuudhiginini, kwathii ndje, mu lombwele ndje, nongele hasho, lombwelii ndje wo, opo ndi tokole shoka te ningi.”
Laban naBetuel oya yamukula ya ti: “Oshinima shika osha zi kOmuwa, tse itatu ti sha.
Rebekka oye nguka, na ninge omukiintu gwomuna gwamwene gwoye, ngaashi Omuwa ye mwene a ti.”
Omupiya gwaAbraham sho e shi uvu, okwi inyongamene pevi e ta hambelele Omuwa.
Nena okwa longolola mo oonguwo, oshisiliveli noshingoli e te yi pe Rebekka. Okwa gandja wo omagano ge na ondilo komumwayina omulumentu nokuyina.
Nena omupiya gwaAbraham naantu mboka ya li pamwe naye, oya li e taa nu e taa ka lala. Sho ya penduka ongula, okwa ti: “Lalekii ndje, ndi shune kumwene gwandje.”
Ihe omumwayina gwaRebekka nayina oya ti: “Omukadhona na kale ngaa putse manga omasiku gamwe nenge tu tye omulongo, ne mu ye ihe.”
Ihe okwa ti: “Inamu tu dhika. Omuwa okwe enditha ndje nawa, lalekii ndje ashike, ndi ye kumwene gwandje.”
Oya yamukula ya ti: “Natu ithane omukadhona, tu pulakene shoka ta ti.”

Oyi ithana Rebekka e taa pula: “Owa hala u ye nomulumentu nguka?”
Rebekka okwa yamukula a ti: “Eeno, onda hala.”
Oya laleke Rebekka nomuyamuthi gwe, ya ye nomupiya gwaAbraham naantu ye.

Oya yambeke Rebekka noku mu lombwela taa ti:
“Ngoye mumwameme,
ninga yina yomamiliyona!
Oluvalo lwoye nalu ka lale iiyelo yaaniita nangoye!”
Nena Rebekka naadhike ye oya pyakudhukwa e taa londo oongamelo, ya ye nomupiya gwaAbraham, noyi idhenge mela lyondjila.
Isak okwa adhika ta zi “kOmuthima gwOmunamwenyo e wete ndje,” oshoka okwa li a kala muumbugantu waKaanan.
Okwa piti mo komatango, a ka lyange kelundu e ta mono oongamelo tadhi hedha ko.
Rebekka sho a mono Isak, okwa londoloka ko kongamelo

e ta pula omupiya gwaAbraham ta ti: “Omulumentu ngono te ya e tu tsakaneke melundu, olye?”
Omupiya okwa yamukula a ti: “Omwene gwandje.” Rebekka okwa kutha oshisaali she e ta siikile oshipala she.
Omupiya okwa hokololele Isak ashihe e shi ningi.
Nena Isak okwa fala Rebekka metsali moka yina Sara a li ha kala e ta ningi omukadhi. Isak okwa li e hole Rebekka, noshe mu hupulitha yina.
25: Abraham okwa hokanununa omukulukadhi edhina lye Ketura.
Ketura okwe mu valele Simran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Jishbak naShua.
Jokshan ohe yaSheba naDedan. Oluvalo lwaDedan olwo Aayashuri, Aaletushi nAaleumi.
Aana yaMidian oyo Efa, Efer, Hanok, Abida naEldaa. Ayehe mbaka oyo oluvalo lwaKetura.
Abraham okwa gandja ayihe kuIsak, ihe manga a li e na omwenyo, okwa pe
oyana mboka ye mu valelwa kaakiintu ye yalwe, omagano. Nena okwa laleke aanona mbano, yu uke kevi lyokuuzilo, kokule nomwana Isak.
Abraham okwa si e na omimvo ethele nomilongo heyali nantano.
Okwa si muukokele uunene nokwa li a kuta omwenyo, sho a gongelwa poohekulu.
Oyana Isak naIsmael oye mu fumvike mekololo lyaMakpela meyana lyOmuheti Efron lyaZohar li li kuuzilo waMamre.
Eyana ndyoka Abraham e li landa kAaheti; Abraham nomukadhi ayehe yaali oya fumvikwa mo.
Konima yeso lyaAbraham Kalunga okwa yambeke Isak, ngoka a li a kala popepi “nOmuthima gwOmunamwenyo e wete ndje.”
Ndjika ondjokonona yaIsmael yaAbraham. Yina oHagar, omudhike Omuegipiti gwaSara.
Oyana aamati yaIsmael okuza kosheeli sigo konkelo oyo mbaka: Nebaiot, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Mishma, Duma, Massa,
Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Nafish naKedema.
Oya li oohekulu yomazimo omulongo nagaali, nomadhina gawo oga lukilwa omikunda dhawo nomahala gawo.
Ismael okwa si e na omimvo ethele nomilongo ndatu naheyali e ta taambelwa poohekulu.
Oluvalo lwaIsmael olwa kala moshilongo pokati kaHavila naShur, kuuzilo waEgipiti mondjila yu uka kuAssur. Olwa kala lu na uutondwe noluvalo lulwe lwaAbraham.
Ndika olyo ehokololo lyaIsak yaAbraham.
Isak okwa li e na omimvo omilongo ne, sho a hokana Rebekka yaBetuel, Omuaramea gwokuPaddan muMesopotamia. Rebekka omumwayina gwaLaban.
Isak okwa galikanene omukadhi Rebekka, oshoka okwa li omuntimbe. Omuwa oku uvu egalikano lye, naRebekka okwa ningi omusimba.
Okwa li metegelelo lyaakwaanambwiyu, nomanga aanona inaa valwa, oya kondjithathana mela lyayina. Rebekka okwa ti: “Omolwashike nda adhika kiinima ya tya ngeyi?” Nokwa yi a ka pule eyamukulo kOmuwa.

Omuwa okwa ti kuye:
“Mela lyoye omu na iigwana iyali.
Oto ka vala aantu yaali taa kondjithathana.
Gumwe ota ningi omunankondo e vule mukwawo.
Omukuluntu ota longele ondenge ye.”
Ethimbo lyokuvala sho lya thiki, Rebekka okwa vala epaha lyaamati yaali.
Osheeli osha li shi na olufufu olundjimbi lwa fa lwoshinamwenyo, nosha lukwa Esau.
Onkelo oya piti mo ya kwata oshithi shaEsau e taye mu luku Jakob. Sho ya valwa, Isak okwa li e na omimvo omilongo hamano.
Aamati oya koko. Esau okwa ningi omukongo omunene, omulumentu e hole mombuga, ihe Jakob okwa li omumweni e hole pegumbo.
Isak okwa hokwa Esau, oshoka okwa li e hole okulya onyama yiiyamakuti, ihe Rebekka okwa hokwa Jakob.
Esiku limwe manga Jakob a li a tula po oshigali, Esau okwa zi kuukongo u ulumbwambwa kondjala.
Okwa ti kuJakob: “Onde etwa mo kondjala, pe ndje wo moshigali shoye oshitiligane.” (Omolwashoka hi ithanwa Edom.)
Jakob okwa yamukula a ti: “Otandi shi ku pe ashike, ngele oto pe ndje uuthemba woye wuusheeli.”
Esau okwa ti: “Eewa! Ngame ote si; uuthemba wuusheeli otau kwatha ndje shike?”
Jakob okwa yamukula a ti: “Gana tango kutya oto pe ndje uuthemba woye.” Esau okwa gana e ta pe Jakob uuthemba we wuusheeli.
Nena Jakob okwe mu pe oshikwiila noshigali. Okwa li ihe ye e ta nu nokwa zi po. Osho ngaaka Esau a dhini uuthemba we wuusheeli.
26: Oshilongo osha adhika ishewe kondjala yekomba ya fa ndjiyaka ya li ko muuyuni waAbraham. Isak okwa yi kuAbimelek, omukwaniilwa gwAafilisti kuGerar.
Omuwa okwi ihololele Isak e ta ti: “Ino ya kuEgipiti; kala mevi ndyoka tandi ku lombwele.
Kala muka, notandi kala pamwe nangoye e tandi ku yambeke. Otandi ke ku pa oshilongo shika ashihe noluvalo lwoye. Otandi ka gwanitha euvaneko nde li uvanekele ho Abraham.
Otandi ke ku pa oluvalo lu thike poonyothi dhokegulu, notandi ke lu pa oshilongo shika ashihe. Iigwana ayihe otayi ka lalekwa nuuyamba moluvalo lwoye.
Otandi ke ku yambeka, oshoka Abraham okwa vulika kungame nokudhiginina iipango yandje ayihe, omautho nomalombwelo gandje agehe.”
Isak nokwa kala muGerar.

Aantu sho ye mu pula kombinga yomukadhi, okwa ti, oye omumwayina. Okwa li a tila okuholola kutya oye omukadhi. Okwa dhiladhila kutya aantu mbeyaka otaa vulu oku mu dhipaga, ya kuthe po Rebekka, oshoka okwa li a shitika.
Isak sho a kala ko ethimbo ele, omukwaniilwa Abimelek okwe entamene mekende lye esiku limwe, nokwa mono Isak ta kwatakwata Rebekka.

Abimelek okwi ithana Isak e ta ti: “Nani omuntu omukiintu gwoye: Omolwashike wa tile, oye omumwanyoko?”
Isak okwa yamukula a ti: “Onda dhiladhila kutya otandi ka dhipagwa, ngele tandi ti omukadhandje.”
Abimelek okwa ti: “Owe tu ningi ngiini? Ando gumwe gwomaantu yandje a lalele namukadhoye, ando we tu tula ondjo.”
Abimelek okwa londodha aantu ye ayehe ta ti: “Shaa ngoka ta gumu omulumentu nguka nenge omukadhi, oku na okusa.”
Isak okwa kunu oombuto mevi, nomumvo ngoka okwa teya lwethele shi vulithe pekuno, oshoka Omuwa okwe mu yambeke.
Okwa tsikile okulikola, sigo a ningi omuyamba omunene.
Molwashoka a li e na iigunda oyindji yoonzi noongombe naapiya oyendji, Aafilisti oye mu sile efupa.
Oya file po omithima ndhoka aapiya yahe Abraham ya hupile, manga a li e na omwenyo.
Nena Abimelek okwa ti kuIsak: “Za mo moshilongo shetu. Owa ningi omunankondo u tu vule.”
Isak okwa zi ko e ta ka yunga ontanda molusilu lwaGerar, moka a kala ethimbo.
Okwa hupulula omithima dha li dha hupwa muuyuni wahe Abraham, ndhoka dha li dha filwa kAafilisti, Abraham sho a si. Isak okwe dhi luku omadhina ngoka ga li ga lukwa kuhe.
Aapiya yaIsak oya hupu omuthima molusilu e taa yuula omeya.
Aasita yokuGerar oya tamanana naasita yaIsak e taa ti: “Omeya ngaka ogetu.” Isak okwe gu luku Esek.
Aapiya yaIsak oya hupu ishewe omuthima gulwe nogwa tamananenwa natango, onkee e gu luku Sitna.
Okwa zi ko hoka e ta hupu omuthima gulwe. Punguka inapa kala we oontamanana, onkee e gu luku Rehobot e ta ti: “Ngashingeyi Omuwa okwe tu pe ehala lya andjuka, tu indjipale moshilongo.”
Isak okwa zi po e ta yi kuBeersheba.
Uusiku mbwiyaka Omuwa okwe mu ihololele e ta ti: “Ongame Kalunga kaho Abraham. Ino tila, oshoka ondi li pungoye. Otandi ku yambeke e tandi ku pe oluvalo olwindji omolwomuntu gwandje Abraham.”
Isak okwa tungile ko oshiyambelo e ta galikana Omuwa. Okwa yungile ko ontanda, naapiya ye oya hupu omuthima.
Abimelek okwa zi kuGerar e li pamwe nomugandjindunge gwe Ahusat nondjayi yiita ye Pikol. Oye ya okutalela po Isak.
Isak okwa pula a ti: “Omolwashike mwe ya mu talele ndje po, nando ne omwa li mwaa na nangame nale nomwa tidha ndje moshilongo sheni?”
Oya yamukula ya ti: “Ngashingeyi otu shi shi kutya Omuwa oku li nangoye, onkee otatu dhiladhila, pokati ketu nangoye pu kale ehangano lya kolekwa negano. Otwa hala, u uvaneke
kutya ito tu etele omukundu, ngaashika natse wo itatu ku hindi. Otwa li tu na ombili nangoye notwe ku laleke nombili. Osha yela kutya Omuwa okwe ku yambeka.”
Isak okwe ya hangele oshituthi, oyo noya li e taa nu.
Ongula yoontundumene oya ningi euvathano e taye li koleke negano. Isak okwe ya laleke, oyo noya topoka nombili e taa yi.
Esiku tuu ndyoka aapiya yaIsak oye ya ye mu lombwele kutya omuthima ngoka ya hupu, ogwa yuuka.
Omuthima okwe gu luku Shiba omolwashoka oshilando shi ithanwa Beersheba.
Esau sho a gwanitha omimvo omilongo ne, okwa hokana aakadhona yaali Aaheti, Judit yaBeeri naBasemat yaElon,
noya li ya lulila Isak naRebekka.
27: Isak okwa li a kulupa, nomeho ge oga tsika. Okwi ithana osheeli she Esau e ta ti kuye: “Mentu gwandje.” Esau okwa ti: “Tate.”
Isak okwa ti: “Ou wete kutya onda kulupa nondi li pokusa.
Kutha ano uuta woye niikuti, u ye mokuti u dhipagele ndje oshiyamakuti.
Telekela ndje oondya dha dhoga, ndhoka ndi hole, u dhi etele ndje. Shampa nde dhi li, otandi ke ku yambeka, manga inaandi sa.”
Isak sho a li ta lombwele Esau, ye Rebekka okwa pulakena. Esau sho a yi kuukongo,
Rebekka okwa ti kuJakob: “Ondu uvu naanaa ho sho ta lombwele Esau ta ti:
‘Etela ndje oshiyamakuti, u shi telekele ndje. Shampa nde shi li, otandi ku yambeke montaneho yOmuwa, manga inaandi sa.’
Ano ngashingeyi, mumwandje, pulakena ndje sho te ti.
Inda kiimuna, u kuthe uukombwena uyali wo ondoka, opo ndi teleke iikulya yi holike kuho.
Oto yi mu faalele e te ke ku yambeka, manga inaa sa.”
Ihe Jakob okwa ti kuyina: “Ou shi shi kutya Esau oku na olufufu, manga ngame ndaa lu na.
Pamwe tate ota pampadhala ndje e ta dhimbulula kutya otandi mu kotokele. Pamukalo nguka otandi iyetele etulomutima, hayambeko.”
Yina okwa yamukula: “Etulomutima lyoye nali ye mungame, mumwandje. Ninga owala shoka tandi ti. Inda, u ka talele ndje uukombwena.”
Jakob okwa yi e ke u tale, e te u etele yina, yina nokwe u teleke oondya dha dhoga, ndhoka he e dhi hole.
