Nena okwa kutha oonguwo dhaEsau oombwanawa, ndhoka e dhi pungula megumbo, e te dhi zaleke Jakob.
Okwe mu zaleke uupa wiikombo komaako nomothingo ye yaa na olufufu.
Okwe mu pe iikulya ya dhoga pamwe noshikwiila shoka a ninga.

Nena Jakob okwa yi kuhe e ta ti: “Tate!”
He okwa yamukula a ti: “Ee. Ongoye lye, mentu gwandje?”
Jakob okwa yamukula a ti: “Osheeli shoye Esau. Onda ningi, ngaashi wa lombwele ndje. Penduka, u lye onyama ndjoka nde yi ku etele, opo u yambeke ndje.”

Isak okwa ti: “Mentu gwandje, owe endelele ngiini oku shi mona?”
Jakob okwa yamukula a ti: “Omuwa, Kalunga koye, okwa kwatha ndje, ndi shi mone.”
Isak okwa ti ku Jakob: “Hedha ko, opo ndi ku pampadhale. Ongoye ngaa shili omumwandje Esau?”
Jakob okwa hedha kuhe, ngoka e mu pampadhala e ta ti: “Ewi olyaJakob, ihe iikaha oyaEsau.”
Ina dhimbulula Jakob, oshoka omaako ge ga li ge na olufufu ga fa gaEsau. Opo a ale e mu yambeke,

ihe okwa pula ishewe a ti: “Ongoye ngaa shili Esau?”
Jakob okwa yamukula a ti: “Ee.”
Isak okwa ti: “Etela ndje nduno onyama. Konima nge nde yi li, opo tandi ku yambeke.” Jakob okwe yi mu etele nokwe mu etele nomaviinu wo, a nwe.
Nena he okwa ti kuye: “Mentu gwandje, hedha ko, u thipe ndje komilungu.”

Sho a hedha ko oku mu thipa komilungu, Isak okwa nika ko ezimba lyoonguwo dhe, onkee okwe mu yambeke. Okwa ti:
“Ezimba ewanawa lyomumwandje
olya fa ezimba lyelundu ndyoka lya yambekwa kOmuwa.

Kalunga ne ku pe oomume dhomegulu nevi lyo ondoka!
Ne ku pe eloolo lyiilya nolyomaviinu.

Iigwana nayi ku longele,
naantu naye ku inyongamene.
Pangela mokati kaanezimo lyoye,
oluvalo lwanyoko nalu ku inyongamene.
Oomboka taye ku tula omutima, naa tulwe omutima;
naamboka taye ku laleke nuuyamba, naa lalekwe nuuyamba.”
Isak opo tuu a mana okuyambeka Jakob, naJakob a zi po puye, omumwayina Esau okwa galuka kuukongo.
Naye wo okwa teleke oondya dha dhoga e te dhi fala kuhe. Okwa ti: “Tate, penduka, u lye onyama ndjoka nde yi ku etele, opo u yambeke ndje.”

Isak okwa pula a ti: “Ongoye lye?”
Esau okwa yamukula: “Ngame osheeli shoye Esau.”
Isak okwa tameke okukakama noonkondo e ta pula ta ti: “Olye ano ngwiyaka a dhipaga oshiyamakuti nokwe shi eta kungame? Opo nde shi li, manga inoo ya. Onde mu yambeka nosha pwa tuu ngaaka.”
Esau sho e shi uvu, okwa takuma mokule e ta ti: “Tate, yambeka ndje wo!”
Isak okwa yamukula: “Omumwanyoko okwi ile nokwa kotokele ndje. Okwa kutha po eyambeko lyoye.”

Esau okwa ti: “Nduka olutiyali, sho a kotokele ndje. Itashi kumitha, sho a lukwa Jakob. Okwa kutha ndje uuthemba wandje wuusheeli, nena a kutha po ishewe eyambeko lyandje. Ino thigila ndje po nando eyambeko?”
Isak okwa yamukula a ti: “Onde mu ningi nokuli omupangeli gwoye, naakwawo ayehe onde ya ningi aapiya ye. Onde mu pa eloolo lyiilya nolyomaviinu. Mentu gwandje, kape na we sho te vulu oku ku ningila.”
Esau okwa tsikile okuhehela he e ta ti: “Tate, ndele nando eyambeko limwelimwe olyo ngaa kuu na? Yambeka ndje wo, tate!” Ye ota tameke okulila nokuli.

Nena Isak okwa ti kuye:
“Oto kala kokule nevi lyo ondoka
nokokule noomume dhokegulu.

Oto hupithwa kegongamwele lyoye.
Oto ningi omupiya gwomumwanyoko.
Ihe ngele oto pwidhuka, oto ki inaga ondjoko ye.”
Esau okwa tondo Jakob, molwashoka he a yambeke Jakob. Okwa dhiladhila: “Omasiku gokulila oosa dhatate oga thikana. Konima otii ka dhipaga omumwameme Jakob.”
Rebekka sho u uvu edhiladhilo lyaEsau, okwi ithana Jakob e ta ti: “Omumwanyoko Esau okwi iyuvanene, e ku dhipage.
Ngashingeyi, mumwandje, ninga shoka tandi ti. Inda ontuku kaandjamumwameme Laban kuHaran,
u kale puye manga, sigo ondjahi yomumwanyoko tayi loto
e ta dhimbwa shoka we shi mu ningile. Otandi ke ku tumina elaka, u galukile kegumbo. Omolwashike ndi mu kanithe amuhe yaali esiku limwe?”
Rebekka okwa lombwele Isak a ti: “Omwenyo gwandje ogwa vulithwa kaakiintu mbaka yaEsau aakwiilongo. Jakob ngele ota ka hokana ishewe aakadhona mbaka Aaheti, otandi si owala.”
28: Isak okwi ithana Jakob e te mu laleke ta ti: “Ino hokana omukadhona Omukaanani.
Inda kuMesopotamia, kaandjahokulu Betuel, u hokane gumwe gwomaana yahokulu Laban.
Kalunga Omunankondoawike na yambeke ondjokana yoye, ye e ku pe aanona oyendji, opo u ka ninge he yiigwana oyindji!
Ne ku yambeke noluvalo lwoye, ngaashi a yambekele Abraham; ne ku pe evi ndika, moka wa kala mo ondjendi naandyoka Kalunga e li pe Abraham!”
Isak okwa laleke Jakob, a ye kuMesopotamia kaandjaLaban yaBetuel, Omuaramea, ngoka omumwayina gwaRebekka, yina yaJakob naEsau.
Esau okwa koneke kutya Isak okwa yambeke Jakob e te mu laleke, a ye kuMesopotamia, a ka konge omukiintu. Okwa koneke wo kutya Isak mokuyambeka Jakob okwe mu lombwele, kaa hokane aakiintu Aakaanana.
Okwe shi kutha mo wo kutya Jakob okwa vulika kuhe nayina e ta yi kuMesopotamia.
Nena Esau okwa li wo u uvite kutya he ina hokwa aakiintu Aakaanana.
Okwa yi kaandjaIsmael yaAbraham e ta hokana omwana Mahalat, omumwayina gwaNebaiot.
Jakob okwa zi kuBeersheba u uka kuHaran.
Peningino lyetango okwe ya pehala eyapuki e ta yungu ontanda. Okwa lala a kothe, a gwila omutse gwe kemanya.
Okwa yaguma e wete oshilondelo sha za pevi sha tsa megulu, naayengeli taa londo notaa kuluka ye li kusho.
Omuwa mwene oku li kondungu yasho e ta ti kuye: “Ongame Omuwa, Kalunga kaAbraham naIsak. Evi ndika mpoka wa lala, otandi li ku pe noluvalo lwoye.

Oluvalo lwoye otalu ka kala lu thike pontsi yevi, lwaa shi kuyalulwa. Otalu ka taandela kuuninginino nokuuzilo, kuumbangalantu nokuumbugantu. Mungoye nomoluvalo lwoye otandi ka yambekela iigwana ayihe kombanda yevi.
Dhimbulukwa, otandi kala nangoye e tandi ku gamene shaa nkoka to yi, notandi ke ku galulila kevi ndika. Itandi ku etha, sigo nda gwanitha ayihe nde yi ku uvanekele.”
Jakob okwa papudhuka po nokwa ti: “Omuwa oku li mpaka! Oku li mehala ndika, ngame inandi shi tseya!”
Okwa li a tila e ta ti: “Ehala ndika etilithi ngiini! Mpaka ope na egumbo lyaKalunga, mpaka ope na osheelo shegulu.”
Jakob okwa meneka ongula onene, okwa kutha emanya ndyoka a li a gwila ko omutse gwe e te li dhike, li ninge endhindhiliko. Nena okwa tile ko omagadhi gooholivi, opo e li yapulile Kalunga.
Ehala ndika okwe li luku Betel, nando oshilando shoka nale okwa li hashi ithanwa Lus.
Nena Jakob okwa ganene Omuwa a ti: “Ngele oto kala pungame e to gamene ndje mondjenda ndjoka tandi ende e to pe ndje iikulya noonguwo,
nongele tandi galukile kaandjatate, nena oto ningi Kalunga kandje.
Emanya ndika lyendhindhiliko nde li dhike, otali ka ninga ehala mpoka to galikanenwa, ongame notandi ke ku pa oshitimulongo mwaashihe shoka to shi pe ndje.”
29: Jakob okwa tsikile ondjila ye yokuuzilo.
Ohaluka okwa thiki pomuthima gu li melundu pu na iigunda yoonzi dha lala. Iigunda mbika oya li hayi hugilwa momuthima nguka gwa siikilwa nemanya edhigu.
Shampa oonzi dhe ya po adhihe, aasita ohayu undula po emanya e taye dhi hugile. Konima ohaye li shuna po ishewe pehala lyalyo.

Jakob okwa pula aasita a ti: “Yakwetu, ne oyapeni?”
Oya yamukula ya ti: “OyokuHaran.”

Okwa pula a ti: “Laban, omutekulu gwaNahor, omu mu shi?”
Oya yamukula ya ti: “Eeno, otu mu shi.”

Okwa pula a ti: “Oku li tuu nawa?”
Oya yamukula ya ti: “Eeno, oku li nawa. Tala, omwana omukadhona Rakel oye ngwiya te ya e na oonzi dhahe.”
Jakob okwa ti: “Tala, omutenya natango, nokali shi ethimbo lyokukongolola oonzi. Dhi hugileni, dho dhi ye dhi ka nape.”
Oya yamukula ya ti: “Itatu vulu oku shi ninga, manga oonzi adhihe inaadhi gwana po. Opo ihe emanya tali kuthwa po, e tatu dhi hugile.”
Jakob manga ta kundathana nayo, Rakel okwa thiki noonzi.
Jakob sho a mono Rakel pamwe noonzi dhahekulu Laban, okwa yi komuthima e ta kutha po emanya e te dhi hugile.
Nena okwe mu thipi komilungu nokwa lili kenyanyu.
Okwe mu hokololele a ti: “Ngame omunezimo lyaho, omuna gwaRebekka.” Rakel okwa matuka, a ka lombwele he.
Laban sho u uvu omutekulu gwe Jakob, okwa matuka e ke mu tsakaneke. Okwe mu papatele e te mu thipi komilungu e te mu fala megumbo. Jakob sho a hokololele Laban ayihe ya ningwa po,
Laban okwa ti: “Eeno, osho naanaa, ngoye onyama nombinzi yandje.” Jakob okwa kala ko omwedhi.
Laban okwa lombwele Jakob a ti: “Nando ngoye omukwetu, ku na okulongela ndje owala. Lombwela ndje kutya ondjambi yoye oyashike.”
Laban okwa li e na oyana aakadhona yaali. Edhina lyosheeli oLea, nonkelo oRakel.
Lea okwa li e na omeho ga nkundipala, ihe Rakel okwa li omwaanawa a shitika.
Jakob okwa li e hole Rakel nokwa ti: “Otandi ku longele omimvo heyali, ngele oto zimine ndje, ndi hokane Rakel.”
Laban okwa yamukula a ti: “Oku mu ku pa oku vule oku mu gandja komuntu gulwe; kala pungame.”
Jakob okwa longo omimvo heyali, opo a pewe Rakel, nomimvo ndhoka odha li dha fa kuye omasiku gowala omashona ga piti po, oshoka okwa li e mu hole.
Nena Jakob okwa ti kuLaban: “Ethimbo lya thiki; pe ndje omukiintu gwandje, ndi mu hokane.”
Laban okwa hanga ohango e ta hiya ayehe.
Ihe uusiku mbwiyaka Jakob a li e na okupewa Rakel, Laban okwa kutha Lea e te mu pe Jakob, naJakob okwa lala naye.
(Laban okwa gandja omupika gwe omukadhona Silpa, a ninge omudhike gwaLea.)
Ongula sho kwa shi, Jakob okwa mono kutya nani omuntu oLea. Okwa yi kuLaban e ta ti: “Omolwashike wa ningi ndje ngeyi? Ngame onda longo, ndi pewe Rakel. Omolwashike wa kotokele ndje?”
Laban okwa yamukula: “Kagu shi omukalo gwoshilongo shetu okugandja omunona a hokanwe tango, manga omukuluntu e li po.
Tegelela owala, omasiku gohango ga kuke, notandi ke ku pa Rakel, ngele oto ka longela ndje ishewe omimvo omikwawo heyali.”
Jakob okwa zimine, nomasiku gohango sho ga kuka, Laban okwe mu pe omwana Rakel, a ninge omukadhi.
(Laban okwa gandja omupika gwe omukadhona Bilha kuRakel, a ninge omudhike gwe.)
Jakob okwa ka lala ishewe naRakel, nokwa li e mu hole unene e vule Lea. Nena okwa longele Laban omimvo omikwawo heyali.
Omuwa sho a mono kutya Lea ke holike, okwe mu pe oluvalo, ihe Rakel okwa ningi omuntimbe.
Lea okwa ningi omusimba e ta vala omumati e ta ti: “Omuwa okwa mono uukweyi wandje, ngashingeyi omusamane gwandje ota kala e hole ndje.” Lea okwa luka omumati Reuben.
Okwa ningi omusimba ishewe e ta vala omumati. Okwa ti: “Omuwa okwa pe ndje omumati nguka, oshoka oku uvu kutya kandi holike.” Okwe mu luka Simeon.
Okwa ningi omusimba ishewe e ta vala omumati gulwe. Okwa ti: “Ngashingeyi omusamane gwandje ota kala a kanyatela ndje, oshoka onde mu valele aamati yatatu.” Oye nokwe mu luka Levi.
Nena okwa ningi omusimba ishewe e ta vala omumati gulwe. Okwa ti: “Ngashingeyi ote hambelele Omuwa.” Oye nokwe mu luka Juda. Nena okwa hulitha okuvala.
30: Ihe Rakel ina valela Jakob aanona. Okwa sile omumwayina efupa e ta ti kuJakob: “Valitha ndje aanona, ote ningi ndi se.”
Jakob okwa geele Rakel e ta ti: “Ongame Kalunga ngoka e ku keelele oluvalo?”
Rakel okwa ti: “Omudhike gwandje Bilha oye nguka. Lala naye, opo a valele ndje omunona poongolo dhandje. Pamukalo nguka ote vulu okuninga omuvali molwe.”
Okwa gandja Bilha komulume e ta lala naye.
Bilha okwa ningi omusimba eta valele Jakob omumati.
Rakel okwa ti: “Kalunga okwa tokola ndje nawa. Oku uvu egalikano lyandje e ta pe ndje omumati.” Okwe mu luku Dan.
Bilha okwa ningi omusimba ishewe e ta valele Jakob omumati.
Rakel okwa ti: “Onda kondjo olugodhi olunene nomumwameme, ihe onda sindana.” Okwe mu luku Naftali.
Lea sho a dhimbulula kutya nani ita vala we, okwa gandja omudhike gwe Silpa kuJakob, a ninge omukadhi.
Silpa okwa valele Jakob omumati.
Lea okwa ti: “Nda ningi elago,” nokwe mu luku Gad.
Silpa okwa valele Jakob ishewe omumati.
Lea okwa ti: “Ngame omunelago ngiini! Ngashingeyi aakulukadhi otaa ka ithana ndje omunelago.” Nokwe mu luku Aser.
Pethimbo lyeteyo lyiilya Reuben okwa yi kelundu e ti itsu iiyimati yohole, mbyoka e eta kuyina Lea. Rakel okwa ti kuLea: “Pe ndje mo wo miiyimati yomumwoye yohole.”

Lea okwa yamukula a ti: “Inashi gwana nani, sho wa yugu ndje omusamane gwandje? Ngashingeyi owa hala ishewe u kuthe po iiyimati yomumwandje yohole.”
Rakel okwa ti: “Ngele oto pe ndje iiyimati yomumwoye yohole, oto ka lala uusiku wonena naJakob.”
Jakob sho a galuka kepya lye ongulohi, Lea okwe ke mu tsakaneka ta ti: “Nena onde ku futa iiyimati yomumwandje yohole, ila kungame.” Oye nokwa lala naye uusiku tuu mboka.
Kalunga okwa yamukula egalikano lyaLea. Okwa ningi omusimba e ta valele Jakob omumati omutitano.
Lea okwa ti: “Kalunga okwa futu ndje, oshoka onda gandja omupika gwandje komusamane gwandje.” Oye okwe mu luku Issaskar.
Lea okwa ningi omusimba ishewe e ta valele Jakob omumati omutihamano.
Lea okwa ti: “Kalunga okwa pe ndje omagano omawanawa. Ngashingeyi omusamane gwandje ota taamba ndje, oshoka onde mu valele aamati yahamano.” Oye okwe mu luku Sebulon.
Konima yaambika okwa vala omukadhona e te mu luku Dina.
Omuwa okwa dhimbulukwa wo Rakel, okwa yamukula omagalikano ge e te mu pe oluvalo.
Okwa ningi omusimba e ta vala omumati. Okwa ti: “Kalunga okwa kutha po omupya gwandje, sho a pe ndje omumati.
Omuwa na pe ndje ishewe omumati gulwe.” Oye nokwe mu luku Josef.
Konima yokuvalwa kwaJosef Jakob okwa lombwele Laban a ti: “Laleka ndje, ndi shune kaandjetu.
Pe ndje aakiintu yandje naana yandje mboka nde ya mono, sho nde ku longele, note yi ihe. Ou shi shi kutya onde ku longele nawa.”
Laban okwa ti: “Ngele oto sile ndje ohenda, kala po, oshoka onda dhimbulula kutya Omuwa okwa yambeke ndje molwoye.
Lombwela ndje ondjambi yoye, notandi ku futu.”
Jakob okwa yamukula a ti: “Oto tseya, nkene nde ku longele nonkene iimuna yoye yi indjipala, sho nde yi dhiginine.
Oya li iishona, sho nde ya, noyi indjipala oyindji. Omuwa okwe ku yambeke shaa mpoka nde ende. Ngashingeyi ethimbo lyandje, ndi tameke okulongela egumbo lyandje mwene.”

Laban okwa pula a ti: “Otandi ku futu shike?”
Jakob okwa yamukula a ti: “Ine hala ondjambi yasha. Ote tsikile okulitha iimuna yoye, nge oto zimine edhiladhilo ndika.
Pitika ndje, ndi konakone iimuna yoye nena, ndi kuthe mo oonzigona adhihe oonduudhe nuukombwena auhe wiiyala nenge wuutotono. Owo ondjambi yandje nda hala.

Komeho sho to ka tala ondjambi yandje, oto ka dhimbulula nuupu, ngele ondi li tuu moshili. Ngele oto adha ndi na oshikombo kaashi na iiyala nenge uutotono nenge onzi yaa shi onduudhe, nena oto tseya kutya oya yakwa.”
Laban okwa yamukula a ti “Onawa. Otatu ningi, ngaashi wa ti.”

Ihe esiku ndyoka Laban okwa yoolola mo iikombo ayihe iilumentu yi na iiyala nuutotono niikombo iikiintu mbyoka yi na iiyala nuutotono nenge ya nika iitokele nando okashuushuu. Okwa yoolola mo wo oonzi adhihe oonduudhe. Iimuna mbika okwe yi tula muusita woyana
e ta zi puJakob nayo ye ende uule womasiku gatatu. Jakob okwa litha oshihupe shiimuna yaLaban.
Jakob okwa kutha uutayi uutalala womwaango, womumandeli nowomukwiyu e ta takele mo uupola, opo uutokele wu holoke.
Okwe u tula komeho giimuna momatemba. Okwe u tula mo, oshoka oya londelathana mpoka, sho tayi ya kehugilo.
Ano iikombo mbyoka ya kwatele montaneho yuutayi, oya vala uukombwena woompola, wiiyala nowuutotono.
Jakob okwa yoolola oonzi miikombo e te dhi taalelitha oonzi dhaLaban dhiiyala noonduudhe. Pamukalo nguka okwa likola iimuna ye mwene e te yi yoolola mo muyaLaban.
Aluhe pomathimbo gokulondathana Jakob okwa tula iimuna ya kola pomatemba mu na uutayi, noya londathana montaneho yawo.
Ihe uutayi ine u tula miimuna mbyoka iinkundi. Osho ngaaka Laban okwa mono iimuna iinkundi, manga Jakob mbyoka yo ondoka.
Pamukalo nguka Jakob okwa ningi omuyamba unene. Okwa li e na iimuna oyindji, aapika, oongamelo nuusino.
31:
Jakob okwa kundana kutya aana yaLaban aamati otaa ti:
“Jakob okwa kutha po iinima yatate ayihe. Uuyamba we auhe owatate.”
Sho a tala oshipala shaLaban, kasha li sha fa ohela nuunambo, sho a li e na ombili.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Jakob a ti: “Shuna koshilongo shooho nokaakweni, otandi kala pamwe nangoye.”
Jakob okwa tumine Rakel naLea elaka, ya ye kuye kiimuna kelundu.
Okwa ti kuyo: “Sho nda tala ho, ke na ombili nangame, ngaashi ha kala shito, ihe Kalunga katate oku li pungame.
Ne amuhe omu shi shi, nkene nda longele ho noonkondo dhandje adhihe.
Ndele okwa kotokele ndje nokulundulula ondjambi yandje lwomulongo. Ihe Kalunga ine mu pitika, a monithe ndje oshiponga.

Shampa Laban a ti: ‘Iikombo yuutotono otayi ka ninga ondjambi yoye,’ likombo ayihe otayi vala owala uukombwena wuutotono. Uuna ta ti: ‘Iikombo yiiyala otayi ka ninga ondjambi yoye,’ iikombo ayihe otayi vala uukombwena wiiyala.
Kalunga okwa kutha ho iimuna e te yi pe ndje.
“Pethimbo lyeepepelo lyiimuna onda yaguma ndi wete iikombo iitsezi mbyoka ya li tayi epepele, ya li yi na iiyala, iimbathi nuutotono.
Omuyengeli gwaKalunga okwa lombwele ndje mondjodhi a ti: ‘Jakob!’ Onda yamukula: ‘Ee.’
Okwa tsikile a ti: ‘Tala ko, iikombo ayihe iitsezi mbyoka tayi epepele, oyo oyi na iiyala, iimbathi nuutotono. Otandi ningi ngeyi, oshoka ondi wete Laban shoka te ku ningile.

Ongame Kalunga ngoka nde ku ihololele puBetel, hoka wa yapula emanya li ninge endhindhiliko, sho wa tilile ko omagadhi gooholivi nowa ganene ndje. Ngashingeyi thikama, u shune kevi lyaandjeni hoka wa valelwa.’ ”
Rakel naLea oya yamukula Jakob ya ti: “Tse katu na we uuthiga washa putate.
Ote tu ngwandjagula twa fa aayeni. Okwe tu landitha po nokwa hepitha owala iimaliwa mbyoka a futa molwetu.
Eliko alihe ndika Kalunga e li kutha tate, olyetu nolyaana yetu. Ninga ano shoka Kalunga e ku lombwele.”
Jakob okwa londeke oyana naakadhi koongamelo,
e ta faalele iimuna ye ayihe naashihe shoka a likola muMesopotamia. Osho a zi po, a ka shune kuhe Isak kevi lyaKaanan.
Laban okwa adhika a ka kulula oonzi dhe. Manga a li hoka, Rakel okwa yaka po iimenka yomegumbo lyahe.
Jakob okwa kotokele Laban Omuaramea, ine mu lombwela nando kutya ye ota yi.
Okwa gongele iinima ye ayihe e ta yi neulumo. Okwa tokola omulonga Eufrat e ta yi u uka koshilongo shokoondundu dhaGilead.
Omasiku gatatu sho ga piti po, Laban okwa lombwelwa kutya Jakob a yi ontuku.
Laban okwa kutha aantu ye e ta landula Jakob. Konima yomasiku gaheyali okwe mu adha moshilongo shokoondunda dhaGilead.
Uusiku tuu mboka Kalunga okwe ya kuLaban mondjodhi e ta ti kuye: “Kotoka, waa ende Jakob nayi.”
Jakob okwa adhika a yungu ontanda ye kondundu, naLaban okwa yungu ontanda ye koshilongo shokoondundu dhaGilead pamwe naantu ye.
Laban okwa ti kuJakob: “Omolwashike wa kotokele ndje e to kutha po aamwandje ya fa aakiintu ya kwatwa po kiita?
Omolwashike wa kotokele ndje e to iyaka po inoo lombwela ndje? Ando owa li wa laleke ndje, ando nde ku thindikile mondjila yoye nondigolo nokwiimba nokuhika oontunda nuuharpa.
Inandi pitikwa ndi laleke aatekulu yandje naamwandje nethipo lyokomilungu. Owa ningi uugoya!
Ondi na oonkondo oku ku monitha oshiponga, ihe uusiku mbuka wonena Kalunga kaho okwa londodha ndje, ndaahe ku ninge nayi.
Ondi shi shi kutya owa zi po, oshoka owa yuulukwa kegumbo, ihe omolwashike wa yaka po iimenka yandje yomegumbo?”
Jakob okwa yamukula a ti: “Onda li nda tila, oshoka onda dhiladhila kutya oto kutha ndje aamwoye.
Ihe ngoka to adha e na iimenka yoye, na dhipagwe. Montaneho yaantu yetu noyoye konga ashihe shoka shoye, ngoye u shi kuthe po.” Jakob ina tseya kutya Rakel okwa yaka po iimenka yaLaban.
Laban okwa hadha metsali lyaJakob, nena okwa yi metsali lyaLea nometsali lyaakulukadhi aapika yaali, ihe ina mona mo iimenka ye. Nena okwa yi metsali lyaRakel.
Rakel okwa li a kutha po iimenka e te yi tula kohi yomutumba gwongamelo nokwa li a kuutumba kugwo. Laban okwa hadha etsali alihe, ihe ine yi mona.
Rakel okwa lombwele he a ti: “Tate, ino geela ndje, oshoka ite vulu okuthikama montaneho yoye; ondi li komwedhi.” Laban okwa hadha, ihe ina mona iimenka ye yomegumbo.
Nena Jakob okwa geye e ta ti: “Uuwinayi washike nda ninga?” Okwa nyenyetele Laban e ta ti: “Oshinima naanaa nda yona, oshishike, sho to thiminike ndje ngeyi?
Ngashingeyi sho wa hadha iinima yandje ayihe, owa mona tuu iinima yoye? Yi tula nduno mpaka puuyelele, opo tse naantu yoye tu yi mone, yo ya tokole kutya olye gwomutse e li mondjila.
Onda kala pungoye omimvo omilongo mbali. Oonzi dhoye niikombo inayi gwitha mo omala, nangame inandi lya po nando onzi yoye yimwe.

Onzi ndjoka ya lika po kiilikama, ondi ihepeke nayo. Inandi yi kutha, ndi yi ete kungoye ngaye ndi tye kandi na mbedhi. Owa li ho pula ndje, ndi fute oshimuna kehe sha yakwa, ongele omutenya nenge uusiku.
Omutenya onda li nda pi omutenya nuusika onda si uutalala, omulumentu nda londokwa koomposi.

Osho sha li omimvo ndhoka omilongo mbali, sho nda kalele pungoye. Omimvo omulongo nane onde ku longelele aakadhona yoye yaali, nomimvo hamano iimuna. Nando ongeyi, owa lundulula ondjambi yandje lwomulongo.

Ando Kalunga kootate, Kalunga kaAbraham naIsak, ina kala pungame, ando wa shunitha ndje iikaha yowala. Ihe Kalunga okwa mono uudhigu wandje niilonga mbyoka nda ningi, nuusiku wa zi ko okwa pangula shoka shu uka.”
Laban okwa yamukula Jakob a ti: “Aakiintu mbaka aamwandje, oyana wo aamwandje, iimuna mbika oyandje. Tashi ti, iinima ayihe to mono mpaka, oyandje. Ihe aamwandje noyana otandi ya ningi ngiini?
Ondi ilongekidha okuhangana nangoye. Natu ninge ondumba yomamanya, yi ninge onzapo yehangano lyetu.”
Jakob okwa kutha emanya e te li dhike, li ninge endhindhiliko.
Jakob okwa lombwele aantu ye, ya ndumbile omamanya ondumba. Sho ye shi ningi, oya lile po pondumba.
Laban okwe li luku Jegar Sahaduta, manga Jakob e li luka Galed.
Laban okwa lombwele Jakob a ti: “Ondumba ndjika yomamanya oyo edhimbulutho lyetu atuhe yaali.” Omolwashoka ehala ndyoka olya lukwa Galed.
Laban okwa ti ishewe: “Omuwa ne tu tonatele, sho tatu topoka.” Onkee ehala olya lukwa Mispa.
Laban okwa tsikile a ti: “Ngele oto ningi aamwandje nayi nenge to hokana aakiintu yalwe, manga ndaaye shi shi, dhimbulukwa kutya Kalunga okwe tu tonatela.”
Laban okwa ti natango kuJakob: “Mpaka ope na ondumba yomamanya naampaka ope na endhindhilikomanya nde li dhike pokati ketu nangoye.

Ondumba ndjika nendhindhilikomanya ndika nayi kale onzapo okudhimbulutha ndje, ndaa konde omamanya ngaka, ndi ku matukile. Onzapo ndjika nayi ku dhimbuluthe wo, waa konde omamanya ngaka, u matukile ndje.
Kalunga kaAbraham naKalunga kaNahor na tokole pokati ketu.” Jakob okwa gana medhina lyaKalunga ngoka he Isak ha tila, a gwanithe euvaneko ndika.
Okwa dhipaga oshimuna e te shi yamba omagandjelondjambo kondundu e ta hiya aantu ye kiikulya. Sho ya li, oya lala kondundu.
Laban okwa meneka ongula onene e ta laleke aatekulu ye noyana nethipo lyokomilungu nokwa shuna kaandjawo.
32: Jakob sho a tsikile ondjila ye, okwa tsakanekwa kaayengeli.
Sho e ya mono, okwa ti: “Ndika etangakwiita lyaKalunga,” onkee ehala ndyoka e li luku Mahanaim.
Jakob okwa tumu aatumwa, ye mu tetekele, ya ye komumwayina Esau moshilongo shaEdom.
Okwe ya kumagidha ya tye: “Ongame Jakob, omupiya gwoye, tandi ihokolola kumwene gwandje Esau kutya onda li nda kala puLaban sigo ongashingeyi.
Onda likola oongombe, uusino, oonzi, iikombo naapika. Mwene gwandje, otandi ku tumine elaka, u sile ndje ohenda.”
Aatumwa sho ya galukile kuJakob, oya ti: “Otwa yile komumwanyoko Esau, nokuli oku li mondjila te ya e ku tsakaneke, oku na aalumentu omathele gane.”
Jakob okwa haluka e ta kunkwa. Okwa topola aantu ye moongundu mbali, osho wo oonzi, iikombo, oongombe noongamelo dhe.
Okwa dhiladhila: “Esau nge ta dhenge ongundu yotango, onkwawo otayi vulu okuya ontuku.”
Jakob okwa galikana a ti: “Kalunga katatekulu Abraham, Kalunga katate Isak, uva ndje! Omuwa, ongoye wa lombwele ndje wa ti: ‘Shuna kevi lyaandjeni nokezimo lyeni, ongame notandi ku ningi nawa.’

Inandi opalela esilohenda lyoye nuudhiginini woye we u ulukile ndje, ngame omuntu gwoye. Onda tokolele Jordan ndi li iikaha yowala, eeno, ondhimbo ayike nda li ndi yi na, ihe nena onda galuka ndi na oongundu mbali.
Hupitha ndje miikaha yomumwameme Esau, oshoka ongame nda tila kutya ote ke tu homona e te tu hanagula po atuhe, nokuli aakulukadhi naanona.
Dhimbulukwa, nkene u uvaneke, u ninge ndje nawa e to pe ndje oluvalo olwindji talu nyenge okuyalulwa, lu thike pehekevi lyomooha dhefuta.”
Sho ya tokelwa hoka uusiku, Jakob okwa yoolola miimuna ye omagano ga ye komumwayina Esau:
iikombo iinzinzi omathele gaali niilumentu omilongo mbali, oonzi oonzinzi omathele gaali noondumentu omilongo mbali,
oongamelo oonyali omilongo ndatu nuunimona wadho, oongombe oonzinzi omilongo ne noontsezi omulongo, uusino uukiintu omilongo mbali nuulumentu omulongo.
Okwe yi topola miigunda niigunda e ta tula moshigunda kehe omuwiliki gwasho. Okwe ya lombwele a ti: “Tetekelelii ndje, nopokati koshigunda noshigunda napa kale oshinano melandulathano.”
Okwa lombwele omupiya gwotango a ti: “Omumwamene Esau nge te ku tsakaneke nota pula ta ti: ‘Mwene gwoye olye? Oto yi peni? Iimuna mbika oyalye to hingi?’
Yamukula u tye: ‘Oyomupiya gwoye Jakob e yi tumine mwene gwe Esau omagano. Jakob ye mwene oku li konima e tu landula.’ ”
Osho wo a lombwele omutiyali, omutitatu nokaawiliki ayehe yiigunda a ti: “Osho naanaa shoka mu na okulombwela Esau, nge tamu mu tsakaneke.
Omu na okutya: ‘Eeno, omupiya gwoye Jakob oku li komina e tu landula.’ ” Jakob okwi ipopile ta ti: “Otandi mu geulukitha nomulongelo, nonge tatu tsakanene, ngiika ota ka taamba ndje nombili.”
Okwa tumu omagano ge mu tetekelele ye e ta lala montanda.
Uusiku tuu mboka Jakob okwa penduka e ta kutha aakadhi yaali, aadhikekadhi ye yaali noyana aamati omulongo nagumwe e taa taaguluka omulonga Jabbok.
Sho e ya laleke, ya ka taaguluke, okwa taagulukitha wo omaliko ge agehe.

Jakob okwa kala konima oye awike.
Nena omulumentu okwe ya e ta kondjo naye, sigo eluwa lya tende.
Omulumentu sho a dhimbulula kutya nani ite mu sindi molugodhi, okwa ngwamuna Jakob monto, oyo noya dhamuka.

Omulumentu okwa ti: “Etha ndje, ndi ye, eluwa otali tende.”
Jakob okwa yamukula a ti: “Itandi ku etha, manga inoo yambeka ndje.”

Omulumentu okwe mu pula a ti: “Ongoye lye ano?”
Oye okwa ti: “Ongame Jakob.”
Omulumentu okwa ti: “Edhina lyoye itali kala we Jakob. Sho wa kondjo naKalunga nonaantu nowa sindana, onkee edhina lyoye oIsrael.”
Jakob okwa ti: “Lombwela ndje edhina lyoye.” Ihe ye okwa yamukula a ti: “Omolwashike wa hala okutseya edhina lyandje?” Nena okwa yambeke Jakob.
Jakob okwa ti: “Onda tala Kalunga koshipala noshipala, ihe nando ongaaka, omwenyo gwandje ogwa hupithwa.” Ehala ndyoka okwe li luku Penuel.
Etango olya li tali piti, sho Jakob ta zi puPenuel, nokwa li ta tina omolwonto ye.
Sigo onena Aaisraeli ihaa li oothipa dhomonto, oshoka opo pehala mpoka omulumentu a dhengele Jakob.
33: Jakob okwa ligamene ko e ta mono Esau te ya naalumentu ye omathele gane, onkee a topolele Lea, Rakel naadhike ye yaali aanona.
Aadhike ye noyana okwe ya tula po tango, taku landula Lea noyana, nohugunina oRakel naJosef.
Jakob okwe ya tetekelele e ti inyongamene pevi luheyali, sho ta hedha kumumwayina.
Ihe Esau okwa matuka e mu tsakaneke, okwe mu papatele momaako ge e te mu thipi komilungu. Ayehe yaali oya lili.

Esau sho a lengalenga e ta mono aakulukadhi naanona, okwa pula a ti: “Oolye mbano u li nayo?”
Jakob okwa yamukula a ti: “Oyo aanona mboka Kalunga e ya pe omuntu gwoye omagano.”
Nena aadhike oya hedha ko noyana e tayi inyongamene pevi.
Lea noyana oye ya, nohugunina oJosef naRakel ye ya e taa inyongamene pevi.

Esau okwa pula a ti: “Ongundu ndjiya nda tsakaneke, oyashike? Elalakano lyayo olyashike?”
Jakob okwa yamukula a ti: “Oyoku ku geulukitha.”
Esau okwa ti: “Mumwameme, ondi na nale sha gwana; kala niinima yoye.”
Jakob okwa ti: “Aawe, ngele owa sila ndje ohenda, taamba omagano gandje. Ngame nge te tala oshipala shoye, onda fa nda tala oshipala shaKalunga, sho u na ombili nangame.
Kwatha ndje ngaa, u taambe omagano ngaka nde ge ku etele; Kalunga okwa sile ndje ohenda e ta pe ndje ayihe mbyoka nda pumbwa.” Jakob okwe mu thiminike, sigo e yi taamba.
Esau okwa ti: “Thikameni tu yeni, ngame otandi ku tetekelele.”
Jakob okwa yamukula e ta ti: “Ou shi shi kutya aanona aankundi. Ondi na wo oonzi noongombe oonyali nuunzona nuutana. Ngele otadhi ulumikwa nando esiku limwe, oshigunda ashihe otashi si.
Kwatha ndje, u tetekelele ndje, otandi isisidha tandi ku landula, te hingi iimuna tse naanona sigo tandi ku adha kuEdom.”

Esau okwa ti: “Onda hala ndi ku thigile po aantu yandje yamwe.”
Jakob okwa yamukula a ti: “Kandi na ompumbwe yasha we, onda li owala nda hala, u sile ndje ohenda.”
Esiku ndyoka Esau okwa tetekele a shuna kuEdom.
Ihe Jakob okwa yi kuSukkot, nkoka a dhike egumbo lye niigunda yiimuna ye, onkee ehala lya lukwa Sukkot.
Mokugaluka kwe kuMesopotamia Jakob okwa thiki nawa kuShekem mevi lyaKaanan e ta yungu ontanda ye melundu, popepi noshilando.
Elundu ndyoka okwe li landa koluvalo lwaHamor, he yaShekem, iimaliwa iisiliveli ethele.
Okwa dhikile ko oshiyambelo e te shi lukile El, Kalunga kaIsrael.
34: Esiku limwe omukadhona Dina yaJakob naLea okwa ka talela po aakadhona yomoshilando shAakaanan.
Shekem, omuna gwomunashikandjo Hamor Omuhevi, sho e mu ti tuu keho, okwe mu kwata koonkondo e ta lala naye nokwe mu mitike.
Ihe okwa pwile mohole naDina yaJakob e ta kala te mu ikumbu.
Shekem okwa lombwele he Hamor a ti: “Omukadhona nguka onde mu hala, a ninge mukadhandje.”
Jakob okwa koneke kutya omwana Dina okwa mitikwa, ihe oyanamati sho ya li kuusita wiimuna ye kohambo, ina ninga sha, sigo ya galuka.
Hamor, he yaShekem, okwa yi ya ka kundathane naJakob
pethimbo mpoka aana yaJakob ya zi kohambo. Sho ye shi uvu, oya li ya haluka noya geele Shekem, sho a ningi esithahoni muIsrael nokwa mitike omuna gwaJakob. Osho oshinima ihaashi ningwa.
Hamor okwa ti kuye: “Omumwandje Shekem oku hole omumwoye omukadhona, tu kwatheni, e mu hokane po.
Natu hanganeni, opo tu hokanathaneni tse nane.
Nena otamu vulu okukala mokati ketu moshilongo; otamu kala shaa mpoka mwa hala, omwa manguluka okushingitha nokulikola eliko.”
Nena Shekem okwa lombwele he yaDina naamwayina ta ti: “Silii ndje ohenda, otandi ke mu pa ashihe shoka mwa hala.
Lombwelii ndje iigonda mbyoka mwa hala ne mu yele pombanda eyambo lyomongalo, ngaashi mwa hala. Otandi mu pe shoka tamu pula, ngele tamu zimine, ndi mu hokane po.”
Molwashoka Shekem a yono po omumwayina Dina, aana yaJakob oya yamukula Shekem nahe Hamor nomakengelelo.
Oya ti kuye: “Itatu vulu okuzimina, omumwameme a hokanwe komulumentu inaa pita etanda; otashi tu sitha ohoni.
Otatu zimine ashike, ngele otamu kala mwe tu fa mwa pita etanda ne aalumentu amuhe.
Nena otatu zimine, tu hokanathaneni. Otatu kala mokati keni e tatu ningi yamwe yomune.
Ihe ngele itamu taamba edhiladhilo lyetu, mu pite etanda, otatu mu kutha omumwameme e tatu yi.”
Edhiladhilo ndika olyo opalele Hamor nomwana Shekem,
nomugundjuka ina kwatakwata we, oshoka okwa li e hole omukadhona omuna gwaJakob. Okwa li omunenentu mezimo lyawo alihe.
Hamor nomwana Shekem oya yi kehala lyoshigongi posheelo shoshilando e ta lombwele ooyakwawo taa ti:
“Aalumentu mbaka aanambili, ya pitikeni, ya kale moshilongo pamwe natse yo ye ende shaa mpoka. Evi olye ya gwanena wo. Natu hokane oyana, tse tu ya pe wo yetu, ye ya hokane.
Ihe aalumentu mbaka otaa zimine, ya kale mokati ketu yo ya ninge yamwe natse ashike, ngele aalumentu ayehe otaa piti etanda, ngaashi yo ya pita etanda.
Omaliko gawo, iimuna yawo niinima yawo ayihe, itayi ka ninga yetu? Natu zimineni, opo ya kale putse.”
Aantu ayehe yomoshilando oya zimine shoka Hamor naShekem ya ti, aalumentu ayehe noya piti etanda.

Sho pwa piti omasiku gatatu, manga aalumentu ya li ye na iilalo yetanda, aana yaJakob yaali, Simeon naLevi, aamwayina yaDina, oya kutha omagongamwele gawo e taa yi moshilando, manga inaashi fekela sha, e taa dhipaga aalumentu ayehe.
Oya dhipaga wo Hamor nomwana Shekem. Oya kutha mo Dina maandjaShekem e taa yi.
Konima yedhipago aana yaJakob yalwe oya yugu oshilando e taye ya galulile ondjahi molwokuyona omumwayina.
Oya kutha po iigunda yiimuna, oonzi niikombo, oongombe nuusino noshaa shoka sha li moshilando nokomalundu.
Oya kutha iinima ayihe yi na ondilo, oya kwata po aakiintu ayehe naanona e taa hakana po shaa shoka sha li momagumbo.

Jakob okwa lombwele Simeon naLevi a ti: “Omwa etele ndje uudhigu; ngashingeyi Aakaanana nAaperesi noshaa ngoka moshilongo ota tondo ndje. Kandi na aantu oyendji; ngele ayehe taa hangene ndje ya ponokele ndje, ezimo lyetu alihe otali ka hanagulwa po.”
Oya yamukula ya ti: “Inatu hala, omumwameme ta ningwa ngaaka a fa ohonda.”
35: Kalunga okwa lombwele Jakob a ti: “Inda kuBetel, u kale ko. Tungila ndje ko oshiyambelo, Kalunga ngoka nde ku ihololele, sho wa li to yi ontuku omumwanyoko Esau.”
Jakob okwa lombwele egumbo lye alihe naayehe mboka ya li puye ta ti: “Thigii po iikalunga ayihe iikwiilongo mbyoka mu na, iyapuleni ne mu zale oonguwo dha yela.
Otatu tembukeni po mpaka, tu ye kuBetel, nkoka tandi ka tungila Kalunga oshiyambelo, Kalunga ngoka a kwatha ndje methimbo lyuudhigu wandje naangoka a kala pungame shaa mpoka nda yile.”
Oyo noya gandja kuJakob iikalunga yawo ayihe mbyoka ya li ye yi na nosho wo uutenda womomakutsi mboka ya li ya zala. Oye nokwe u fumvike momwandi popepi naShekem.
Jakob noyana sho ya zi po, etilo enene olya kwata aantu yomiilando yopopepi, yo inaye ya landula.
Jakob okwe ya naantu ye ayehe puLus, ngashingeyi oBetel, mevi lyaKaanan.
Okwa tungu oshiyambelo e ta luku ehala Kalunga kaBetel, oshoka Kalunga okwe mu ihololele hoka, sho a li ta yi mumwayina ondapo.
Omuyamuthi gwaRebekka, Debora okwa si nokwa fumvikwa momwandi kuumbugantu waBetel. Onkee gwi ithanwa “Omwandi gwokulila oosa.”
Jakob sho a galuka kuMesopotamia, Kalunga okwe mu ihololele ishewe e te mu yambeke.
Kalunga okwa ti kuye: “Edhina lyoye oJakob, ihe okuza konena otali ningi Israel.” Osho ngaaka Kalunga e mu luku Israel.
Kalunga okwa ti kuye: “Ongame Kalunga Omunankondoawike. Kala u na oluvalo olwindji. Iigwana nayi ze moluvalo lwoye, oto ka ninga hekulu yaakwaniilwa.
Otandi ku pe evi ndyoka nda pele Abraham naIsak, notandi li pe oluvalo lwoye talu ku landula.”
Nena Kalunga okwe mu thigi po a yi.
Peha mpoka Kalunga e mu popitha, Jakob okwa dhike po endhindhilikomanya e te li yapula noku li tila omaviinu nomagadhi gooholivi.
Ehala okwe li luku Betel.
Jakob naantu ye oya tembuka po puBetel, nomanga ya li natango oshinano shimwe okuza kuEfrata, ethimbo olya thikana, Rakel a vale okanona; okwa li e na oshitheta oshilulu.
Oshitheta sho sha li tashi lundalala mokuvala, omuvalithi okwa ti kuye: “Rakel, ino tila, owa eta ko omumati ishewe.”
Ihe okwa li nokuli pokusa, nopethimbo ta fudha mo omufudho gwe gwahugunina, okwa luku omwana Benoni, ihe he okwe mu luku Benjamin.
Rakel sho a si, okwa fumvikwa pondjila yu uka kuEfrata, ngashingeyi oBetlehem.
Jakob okwa dhike po endhindhilikomanya pombila ye; olyo endhindhiliko lyombila yaRakel sigo onena.
Jakob okwa humu ko e ta ka yunga ontanda peha lilwe handiyaka yaEder.

Jakob manga a li moshilongo shika, Reuben okwa lala naBilha, omudhike gwahe. Jakob okwe shi uvu nokwa li a thita po kondjahi.
Jakob okwa li e na oyana aamati omulongo nayaali.
Aana yaLea oyo Reuben (osheeli shaJakob), Simeon, Levi, Juda, Issaskar naSebulon.
Aana yaRakel oyo Josef naBenjamin.
Aana yaBilha, omupika gwaRakel, oyo Dan naNaftali.
Aana yaSilpa, omupika gwaLea, oyo Gad naAser. Aanona mbaka oya valelwa muMesopotamia.
Jakob okwa yi kuhe Isak kuMamre, popepi naHebron, nkoka Abraham naIsak ya li ya kala.
Isak okwa li e na omwenyo omimvo ethele nomilongo hetatu.
Oye okwa si muukulupe uunene nokwa li a kuta omwenyo, sho a gongelwa poohekulu. Oyana Esau naJakob oye mu fumvike.
36: Nduka olwo oluvalo lwaEsau, haku tiwa Edom.
Esau okwa hokana aakulukadhi Aakaanana: Ada yaElon Omuheti, Oholibama yaAna yaZibon Omuhevi
naBasemat yaIsmael, omumwayina gwaNebaiot.
Ada okwa vala Elifas; Basemat okwa vala Reuel;
naOholibama okwa vala Jeush, Jalam naKora. Aanona mbaka ayehe oya valelwa Esau muKaanan.
Esau okwa kutha aakadhi, oyana aamati naakadhona naantu ye ayehe pamwe niinima ye ayihe nomaliko ge agehe a likola muKaanan e ta zi po pomumwayina Jakob e ta tembukile kevi lilwe.
Okwa zi po, oshoka evi moka ya kala yo naJakob, inaa gwana mo we. Oya li ye na iimuna oyindji, noinaa vula we okukala pamwe.
Esau okwa kala moshilongo shokoondundu dhaEdom.
Nduka olwo oluvalo lwaEsau, hekulu yAaedom.

Omukulukadhi gwaEsau Ada okwe mu valele omumati edhina lye Elifas. Elifas okwa li e na oyana aamati yatano: Teman, Omar, Zefo, Gatam naKenas. Timna okwa li omudhike gwaElifas yaEsau, oye nokwa valele Elifas Amalek.
Omukulukadhi gwaEsau Basemat okwe mu valele omumati Reuel, naReuel okwa li e na oyanamati yane. Oyo Nahat, Sera, Shamma naMissa.
Omukulukadhi gwaEsau Oholibama yaAna yaZibon okwe mu valele aamati yatatu: Jeush, Jalam naKora.
Ngaka ogo omazimo goluvalo lwaEsau. Elifas, osheeli shaEsau, okwa li hekulu yomazimo ngaka taga landula mpa: lyaTeman, lyaOmar, lyaZefo, lyaKenas,
lyaKora, lyaGatam nolyaAmalek. Nduka olwo oluvalo lwomukulukadhi gwaEsau Ada.
Reuel yaEsau okwa li hekulu yomazimo ngaka taga landula mpa: lyaNahat, lyaSera, lyaShamma nolyaMissa. Nduka oluvalo lwomukulukadhi gwaEsau Basemat.
MuOholibama yaAna, omukulukadhi gwaEsau, omwa zi omazimo lyaJeush, lyaJalam nolyaKora.
Omazimo ngaka agehe ogo oluvalo lwaEsau.
Aakali yomuEdom aakulukulu oya topolwa momazimo ngoka ga za koyanamati mbaka yaSeir Omuhori: Lotan, Shobal, Zibon, Ana, Dishon, Ezer naDishan.
Lotan ohekulu yomaludhi gaHori naHeman. (Lotan namumwayina Timna.)
Shobal ohekulu yomaludhi gaAlvan, Manahat, Ebal, Shefo naOnam.
Zibon okwa li e na oyanamati yaali, Aja naAna. (Ana nguka oye ngoka i itsile oothithiya dhomeya omapyu mombuga, sho a li ta litha uusino wahe.)
Ana ohe yaDishon, ngoka a li hekulu yomaludhi gaHemdan, Eshban, Itran naKeran. Ana okwa li e na omwana omukadhona Oholibama.
Ezer ohekulu yomaludhi gaBilhan, Saavan naAkan.
Dishan ohekulu yomaludhi gaUz naAran.
Mbaka oyo aaniikandjo yomazimo gAahori mevi lyaEdom: Lotan, Shobal, Zibon, Ana, Dishon, Ezer naDishan.

Aakwaniilwa mboka ya lele Edom ya landulathana muuyuni mbwiyaka, manga muIsrael kaamwa li omukwaniilwa, oyo:
Bela yaBeor gwomuDinhaba
Jobab yaSera gwomuBozra
Husham gwokoshikandjo Teman
Hadad yaBedad gwomuAvit (okwa sindi Aamidiana molugodhi moshilongo Moab).
Samla gwomuMasreka
Shaul gwomuRehobot
shopomulonga (Eufrat)
Baal-Hanan yaAkbor
Hadar gwomuPau (omukadhi oMehetabel yaMatred, omutekulu gwaMe-Sahab).

Esau oye hekulu yaaniikandjo mbaka muEdom: Timna, Alva, Jetet, Oholibama, Ela, Pinon, Kenas, Teman, Mibzar, Magdiel naIram. Oshikandjo shoka sha li sha kalwa koludhi kehe, osha tseyika nedhina lyoludhi ndoka.
37: Jakob okwa kala natango muKaanan, moka mwa kala wo he,

nehokololo lyegumbo lyaJakob olyo ndika.
Josef, omugundjuka gwomimvo omulongo naheyali, okwa li ha litha oonzi niikombo pamwe naamwahe, aana yaBilha naSilpa, aadhike yahe. Okwa li ha lombola ko aamwahe kuhe, nge ya ningi sha oshiwinayi.
Jakob okwa li e hole Josef e vule oyana ayehe, oshoka Josef okwe mu valelwa muukulupe. Okwe mu tungile ohema onde yi na omaako omale.
Aamwahe sho ya mono kutya he oku hole Josef e ya vule, oye mu tondo yo inaa popya we naye oohapu dhombili.
Esiku limwe Josef okwa lala ondjodhi. Sho e yi hokololele aamwahe, oye mu tondo noku mu tondelela.
Okwa ti kuyo: “Pulakeneni ondjodhi ndjoka nda yaguma.
Otwa lyeni mepya atuhe tatu mangeni iihampi yiilya. Oshihampi shandje osha thikama po e tashi kala shu ukilila. Iihampi yeni oye shi gongalele e tayi inyongamene kusho.”
Aamwahe oya pula ya ti: “Oto dhiladhila, to ka ninga omukwaniilwa u tu pangele?” Oyo noye mu tondele oondjodhi dhe noohapu dhe shi vule shito.
Josef okwa lalulula ondjodhi ishewe e te yi hokololele aamwahe ta ti: “Onda lalulula ondjodhi ndi wete etango, omwedhi noonyothi omulongo nayimwe tayi inyongamene kungame.”
Okwa hokololele wo he ondjodhi, nahe okwe mu ganda ta ti: “Oondjodhi ndono odha tya ngiini? Oto dhiladhila ano, nyoko, aamwaho nangame tatu ya e tatu ku inyongamene?”
Aamwahe yaJosef oye mu sile efupa, ihe he okwa pungula oshinima shika momwenyo gwe noku shi dhiladhila.
Esiku limwe, manga aamwahe yaJosef ya li kohambo kuShekem kiimuna yahe,

Jakob okwa lombwele Josef ta ti: “Onda hala ndi ku tume kuShekem, nkoka ku na aamwaho taa litha iimuna.”
Josef okwa yamukula a ti: “Otandi yi.”

He okwa ti: “Inda ko, u ka tale, ngele aamwaho oye li nawa, niimuna ngele oyi li nawa; ngoye u galuke u ye u lombwele ndje.” Osho ngaaka he e mu tumu okuza kolusilu lwaHebron.
Josef okwe ya kuShekem
nosho a li te ende ta alaala nomalundu, okwi itsu omulumentu gumwe. Omulumentu okwe mu pula ta ti: “Oto kongo shike?”
Josef okwa yamukula a ti: “Otandi kongo aamwatate taa litha iimuna yawo. Oto vulu u lombwele ndje mpoka ye li?”
Omulumentu okwa yamukula ta ti: “Oya tembuka po nale mpaka. Ondu uvile taa ti, otaa yi kuDotan.” Josef okwa landula aamwahe e te ya adha kuDotan.
Sho ye mu mono e li kokule, manga inaa thika kuyo, oye mu uvanene monanguwi, ye mu dhipage.
Oya lombwelathana ya ti: “Omumentu gwoondjodhi oye ngwiyaka te ya.
Ileni tu mu dhipageni tse tu umbile omudhimba gwe momuthima gwa pwina e tatu ti, oshilikama she mu lya po. Nena otatu tala, ngele oondjodhi dhe otadhi tsu.”
Reuben okwe ya uvu nokwa kambadhala okuhupitha Josef e ta ti: “Inatu mu dhipageni.
Natu mu umbileni ashike momuthima ngwiyaka gwomombuga, ihe inatu mu monitha oshiponga.” Okwa popi ngaaka, oshoka a li a dhiladhila oku mu hupitha miikaha yawo, ye e mu tume kuhe.
Josef sho a thiki kaamwahe oye mu hula ohema ye onde yi na omaako omale.
Nena oye mu kutha po e taye mu umbile momuthima gwa pwina.
Manga ya kuutumba ya lye, ohaluka oya mono osheendo shAaismaeli taa zi kuGilead yu uka kuEgipiti. Oongamelo dhawo odha li dha humbata iizimba nomaka ga nika nawa gomaludhi gi ili nogi ili.
Juda okwa ti kaamwahe: “Otatu likola shike, nge tatu dhipaga omumwatate e tatu holeke ombinzi ye?
Natu mu landithii po kAaismaeli. Nena itatu iyetele nando oshiponga; nokuli oye omukwetu, onyama yetu nombinzi yetu.” Aamwahe oya zimine,
nosho aahalithi Aamidiana ya thiki puyo, oya hili mo Josef momuthima e taye mu landa po iimaliwa iisiliveli omilongo mbali kAaismaeli, mboka ye mu fala kuEgipiti.
Reuben sho a yi komuthima noina adha ko Josef, okwa tuula oonguwo dhe moluhodhi.
Okwe ya kaamwahe e ta ti: “Omunona ke mo! Otandi ningi ngiini?”
Oya dhipaga oshikombo e taa yaya onguwo yaJosef mombinzi yasho.
Oya kutha onguwo ye e taye yi tumu kuhe taa ti: “Otwe yi toola. Yi tala nawa, ngele oyomumwoye nenge aawe.”
He okwe yi dhimbulula e ta ti: “Eeno shili, onguwo oyomumwandje ndji! Oshilikama she mu lya po! Josef a lika, a tuulagulwa po!”
Jakob okwa tuula oonguwo dhe moluhodhi. Okwa lili omwana ethimbo ele.
Oyana aamati ayehe naakadhona oye ya oku mu hupulutha, ihe okwa tindi okutalalekwa e ta ti: “Aawe, otii ka kulukila muusi komumwandje tandi mu lili.” Osho ngaa a tsikile okulila omwana.
Aamidiana oye mu landitha po naPotifar, elenga lyomukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti, omukuluntu gwaalangeli yuuwa.
38: Pethimbo ndyoka Juda okwa tembuka paamwahe nokwa ka kala pamwe nomulumentu, edhina lye Hira, gwokoshilando Adullam.
Oko nkoka i itsu omukadhona gwaShua, omulumentu Omukaanani. Okwe mu hokana,
e te mu valele omumati e te mu luku Er.
Okwa ningi ishewe omusimba e ta vala omumati nokwe mu luku Onan.
Okwa vala ishewe omumati e te mu luku Shela. Omumati nguka sho a valwa, Juda okwa li muKesib.
Juda okwa kongele osheeli she Er omukiintu edhina lye Tamar.
Er okwa li inaa opalela Omuwa, nomolwashoka Omuwa okwe mu etha a se.
Juda okwa lombwele omumwayina gwaEr Onan a ti: “Inda, u ka lale nomuselekadhi gwomumwanyoko. Gwanitha oshilonga shoye, opo omumwanyoko a kale e na oluvalo.”
Ihe okwa li e shi shi kutya uunona kau shi we, onkee shaa tuu a lala nomuselekadhi gwomumwayina, omasita goluvalo okwe ga sitamene pevi, opo kaaha valele omumwayina oluvalo.
Shika osha geyitha Omuwa e te mu dhipaga po ishewe.

Nena Juda okwa ti koshitenya she Tamar: “Shuna kaandjaho, u kale omuselekadhi, sigo omumwandje Shela ta koko.” Okwa popi ngaaka, oshoka a tila, pamwe Shela naye wo ota ka dhipagwa, ngaashi aamwayina ya ningwa. Tamar okwa shuna kaandjawo.
Konima yethimbo ele omukulukadhi gwaJuda, omuna gwaShua, okwa si. Oosa sho dha halakana, Juda nakuume ke Hira gwomuAdullam oya yi kuTimna, a ka kululithe oonzi dhe.
Yamwe oya lombwele Tamar kutya hemweno ota yi kuTimna, a ka kululithe oonzi dhe.

Tamar okwa hula mo oonguwo dhuuselekadhi e ta siikile oshipala she newiiwili e ta ka kuutumba posheelo shaEnaim, oshilando shi li pondjila yokuya kuTimna. Okwa li a tseya kutya onkelo yaJuda Shela oya koka, ihe ine mu pewa, e mu hokane po natango.
Juda sho e mu mono, okwa li e shi ohonda, oshoka okwa siikila oshipala she.

Okwa kanduka mondjila, a yi kuye e ta ti: “Ila, tu lale.” (Ine mu dhimbulula kutya oye oshitenya she.)
Tamar okwa ti: “Oto futu ndje shike?”

Juda okwa yamukula a ti: “Otandi ke ku tumina okakombwena komoshigunda shandje.”
Tamar okwa ti: “Eewa, ihe ongele to pe ndje ombambyona yi kale po, sigo wa tumu oshikombo.”

Juda okwa pula a ti: “Ombambyona oyashike?”
Tamar okwa yamukula a ti: “Okalinga koshihako shoye nongodhi yako nondhimbo ndjoka u na moshikaha shoye.” Okwe yi mu pe. Nena okwa lala naye e ta ningi ela.
Tamar okwa shuna kaandjawo e ti isuukulula ewiiwili nokwa zala oonguwo dhe dhuuselekadhi.
Juda okwa tumu kuume ke Hira, a fale oshikombo ye a etelele iinima yombambyona, ihe Hira ina mona Tamar.

Okwa pula aantu yopuEnaim ta ti: “Ohonda ndjiyaka ya li pondjila mpano, oyi li peni?”
Aantu oya yamukula ya ti: “Kapwa li ohonda yasha mpaka.”
Hira okwa shuna kuJuda e ta ti: “Inandi mu mona ko. Aantu otaa ti kutya kakwa li nando ohonda hwiyaka.”
Juda okwa ti: “Iinima mbyoka ne yi pungule. Inatu hala, aantu ye tu yole. Onda kambadhala oku mu futa, ihe ino mu mona ko.”
Sho pwa piti oomwedhi ndatu, Juda okwa lombwelwa taku tiwa: “Oshitenya shoye Tamar a pundukile moluhondelo noku na ela.” Juda okwa gandja elaka tali ti: “Mu pitithii mo, mu ke mu fike po a se.”
Sho a li ta pitithwa mo, okwa tumu elaka kuhemweno tali ti: “Epunda onde li pewa kumwene gwiinima mbika. Yi tala nawa, ngoye u mone kutya oyalye-okalinga koshihako nongodhi yako nondhimbo.”
Juda okwe yi dhimbulula e ta ti: “Oku li mondjila, ngame inandi mu gwanithila oshinakugwanithwa shandje, oshoka inandi mu pa omumwandje Shela, e mu hokane po.” Okuza mpoka Juda ina lala we naye.
Ethimbo lye lyokuvala sho lya thikana, osha holoka kutya ota ka vala epaha.
Manga a li ta thetwa, gumwe gwaakwanambwiyu okwa pititha mo okwaako; omuvalithi okwe ku kwata e te ku manga okangodhi okatiligane e ta ti: “Nguka osheeli.”
Ihe okwa shunitha mo okwaako kwe, omumwayina oye a valwa tango. Nena omuvalithi okwa ti: “Owa gwaya mo ngiini,” e te mu luku Perez.
Nena omumwayina okwa valwa e na ongodhi ontiligane poshikesho e te mu luku Sera.
39: Aaismaeli oya fala Josef kuEgipiti e taye mu landa po naPotifar, elenga lyomukwaniilwa, omukuluntu gwaalangeli yuuwa.
Omuwa okwa li pamwe naJosef nokwe mu pe elago ewanawa. Okwa kala megumbo lyamwene gwe Omuegipiti,
ngoka a mono kutya Omuwa okwa pe Josef elago ewanawa mwaayihe te yi ningi.
Potifar okwa li e mu hokwa e te mu ningi elenga lye lyomekolo; osho ngaaka a tula egumbo lye niinima ye ayihe metonatelo lye.
Okuza mpoka Omuwa okwa yambeke egumbo lyOmuegipiti omolwaJosef, osho wo ayihe e yi na megumbo nenge komalundu.

Potifar okwa gandja ayihe a li e yi na miikaha yaJosef nokwa li kee na we oshimpwiyu shasha, shila okulya akuke.
Josef okwa li omwaanawa a shitika,
nokonima yethimbo omukulukadhi gwaPotifar okwa haluka Josef e te mu lombwele ta ti: “Tu lale.”
Josef okwa tindi e ta ti: “Tala ko, mwene gwandje ke na oshimpwiyu shasha megumbo muka, oshoka omo ndi li. Okwa ningi ndje omutonateli gwaayihe e yi na.
Megumbo muka ondi na mo oonkondo dhi thike pudhe, noina keelela ndje sha shilwe, kakele koye. Ondi longe ngiini uuwinayi u thike mpono, ndi yone kuKalunga?”
Nando omukulukadhi a kala ta pula Josef esiku nesiku, Josef ina zimina a lale naye.
Ihe esiku limwe Josef sho a yi megumbo, a longe iilonga ye, megumbo kamwa li nando omupiya gumwe.
Omukulukadhi okwe mu kwata konguwo ye e ta ti: “Tu lale.” Ihe Josef okwa thigi onguwo ye miikaha ye e ta yi ondapo pondje.
Omukulukadhi sho a mono kutya Josef a thigi po onguwo ye e ta yi ondapo pondje,

Okwi igidha aapiya ye yomegumbo e ta ti: “Taleni ko nduno! Okahebeli haka ke etwa komusamane gwandje maandjetu, otake tu sitha ohoni. Oke ya mondjugo yandje noka kambadhala okulala nangame, ihe onda kugu onkugo mokule.
Sho nda kugu onkugo, oka yi ontuku pondje, ka thigi po onguwo yako pungame.”
Omukulukadhi okwa pungula onguwo puye, sigo mwene gwaJosef e ya kegumbo.
Okwe mu hokololele wo e ta ti: “Omupika ngoka Omuhebeli we eta huka, okwe ya kungame, a sithe ndje ohoni.
Ihe sho nda kugu onkugo, okwa yi ontuku pondje, a thigi po onguwo ye pungame.”
Mwene gwaJosef sho u uvu ehokololo lyomukulukadhi gwe ta ti: “Osho omupika gwoye a ningi ndje,” okwa geye noonkondo
e ta kwata Josef e te mu tula mondjedhililo moka mu na oonkwatwa dhomukwaniilwa, nomo a kala e edhililwa moka.
Ihe Omuwa okwa li naJosef e te mu yambeke, onkee omukuluntu gwondjedhililo okwe mu hokwa.
Okwa langeke Josef, a ninge omutonateli gwoonkwatwa adhihe e te mu inekelele iinima ayihe mondjedhililo.
Omukuluntu gwondjedhililo ka li we e na oshimpwiyu shasha, oshoka ayihe oya li miikaha yaJosef, nOmuwa okwe mu pe elago ewanawa mwaayihe e yi longo.
40: Konima yethimbo omupindi gwomaviinu gomukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti nomuteleki omukuluntu gwiikwiila oya yono komukwaniilwa.
Okwa geele omalenga ngaka agehe gaali
e te ga tula mondjedhililo megumbo lyomukuluntu gwaalangeli, moka mwa li Josef.
Oya kala ethimbo ele mondjedhililo, nomukuluntu gwondjedhililo okwa gandja Josef, a ninge omuyakuli gwawo.
Uusiku umwe mondjedhililo, omupindi gwomaviinu nomuteleki gwiikwiila oya lala oondjodhi. Odha li dhi ili, inadhi faathana.
Josef sho e ya kuyo ongula, okwa mono kutya oya sa oluhodhi.
Okwe ya pula a ti: “Omolwashike mwa nika uuthigwa nena?”

Oya yamukulwa ya ti: “Otwa lala oondjodhi, nokape na ngoka te dhi tu fatululile.”
Josef okwa ti: “Kalunga oye ta gandja owino wokufatulula oondjodhi. Hokololelii ndje oondjodhi dheni.”
Omupindi gwomaviinu okwa ti: “Mondjodhi yandje onda mono omuviinu gu li komeho gandje.
Omuviinu nguka ogwa li gu na iitayi itatu. Sho tuu omafo ga tameke okumbunyuka, oongala odha holoka wo, nomandjembele oga tiligana.
Onda li ndi na oshitenga shomukwaniilwa meke. Onda kutha omandjembele e tii ga kolele moshitenga e tandi mu pe.”
Josef okwa ti: “Otayi ti: iitayi itatu oyo omasiku gatatu.
Konima yomasiku gatatu omukwaniilwa ote ku mangulula e te ku shuna muulenga woye. Oto ke mu pa oshitenga she, ngaashi wa li ho shi mu pe, sho wa li omupindi gwomaviinu.
Ihe dhimbulukwa ndje, ngele ayihe tayi ku endele nawa. Sila ndje ohenda, u popile ndje komukwaniilwa, a kuthe ndje mondjedhililo muka.
Oshoka ngame onda yakwa kevi lyAahebeli, naampaka wo inandi ilongela okutulwa mondjedhililo muka.”
Omuteleki omukuluntu gwiikwiila sho u uvu efatululo ewanawa lyondjodhi yomupindi gwomaviinu, okwa ti kuJosef: “Ngame wo onda yaguma nda humbata oontungwa ndatu dhiikwiila komutse gwandje.
Montungwa yokombanda omwa li mu na iikwiila yi ili noyi ili yokuliwa komukwaniilwa, ihe oondhila odhe yi shomona mo.”
Josef okwa yamukula a ti: “Otayi ti: oontungwa ndatu odho omasiku gatatu.
Konima yomasiku gatatu omukwaniilwa ote ku mangulula — e ta tetitha ko omutse gwoye. Olutu lwoye ote lu tula kohake, noondhila otadhi li onyama yoye.”

Omasiku gatatu sho ga piti po, omukwaniilwa okwa hangele omalenga ge agehe oshituthi shesiku lyokuvalwa kwe; okwa mangulula omupindi gwomaviinu nomuteleki omukuluntu gwiikwiila e te ya eta komeho gomalenga.
Okwa shunine omupindi gwomaviinu muulenga we,
ihe okwa dhipagitha omuteleki omukuluntu gwiikwiila. Ayihe oya ningwa, ngaashi Josef a ti.
Ihe omupindi gwomaviinu ina dhimbulukwa Josef; okwe mu dhimbwa thilu.
41: Sho pwa piti omimvo mbali, omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti okwa lala ondjodhi a thikama pomulonga Niili.
Oonzinzi heyali dho ondoka odha anduka momulonga nodha napa omwiidhi.
Nena omwa anduka ishewe oonzinzi oonkwawo heyali oonshona nodha nanga. Odhe ya e tadhi thikama poonzinzi oonkwawo pomunkulo gwomulonga,
noonzinzi dha nanga odha li po ndhoka dho ondoka. Nena omukwaniilwa okwa papudhuka.
Okwa kothulula ishewe e ta lala ondjodhi onkwawo. Oonyapi heyali dha mena moshihenguti shimwe dha vala nawa.
Mudho omwa tsapuka oonyapi oonkwawo heyali. Odha li oonshona nodha thetekwa kombepo yokuuzilo.
Oonyapi dha theta odha nina po ndhoka dha vala nawa. Omukwaniilwa okwa papudhuka e ta dhimbulula kutya nani okwa lala oondjodhi.
Ongula sho kwa shi, okwa li u uvite nayi. Okwi ithana oompulile noonkulungu dhomuEgipiti. Okwe dhi hokololele oondjodhi dhe, ihe inadhi vula oku dhi mu fatululila.
Omupindi gwomaviinu okwa lombwele omukwaniilwa a ti: “Ngashingeyi otandi dhimbulukwa kutya onda yona.
Owa li wa geela ndje tse nomuteleki omukuluntu gwiikwiila e to tu tula mondjedhililo megumbo lyomulangeli omukuluntu.
Uusiku umwe otwa lala oondjodhi dhi ili nodhi ili.
Omumati Omuhebeli okwa li putse, omupika gwomulangeli gwondjedhililo. Otwe mu hokololele oondjodhi dhetu, e te dhi tu fatululile.
Iinima oya ningwa, ngaashi a tile; owa shuna ndje muulenga wandje, ihe owa dhipaga omuteleki gwiikwiila.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa tumu Josef e ki ithanwe. Oye mu pititha mo mbala mondjedhililo. Okwi ikululitha e ta zala nawa e te ya komukwaniilwa.
Omukwaniilwa okwa ti kuye: “Onda lala ondjodhi, nokape na ngoka ta vulu oku yi fatulula. Onda hokololelwa kutya ngoye oho fatulula oondjodhi.”
Josef okwa yamukula a ti: “Ngame itandi vulu, Nkeyama, ihe Kalunga ota pe omukwaniilwa eyamukulo lyo opala.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa ti: “Onda lala ondjodhi nda li nda thikama pomunkulo gwomulonga Niili,
oonzinzi heyali dho ondoka nodho opala dha anduka momulonga e tadhi napa omwiidhi.
Nena momulonga omwa anduka oonzinzi oonkwawo heyali oombwinayi dha nanga nodha nama. Inandi mona nale muEgipiti alihe oongombe oombwinayi dha fa ndhoka.
Ndhika odha li po oongombe ndhoka dhotango dho opala,
ihe kapwa li ngoka e shi ndhindhilike, oshoka odha li natango oombwinayi dha fa shito. Opo mpoka onda papudhuka.
Onda lala ondjodhi ishewe. Ondi wete oonyapi heyali dho opala nodha vala nawa dha tsapuka moshihenguti shimwe.
Konima opwa tsapuka oonyapi heyali dha theta noonshona.
Ndhoka dha theta odha nina po ndhoka dha vala nawa. Oondjodhi onde dhi hokololele oompulile, ihe kape na nando oyimwe ya vulu oku dhi fatululila ndje.”
Josef okwa ti komukwaniilwa: “Oondjodhi adhihe mbali otadhi popi oshinima shimwe; Kalunga ote ku lombwele shoka ta ka ninga.
Oonzinzi heyali dho ondoka odho oomvula heyali, oonyapi heyali dha vala odho oomvula heyali. Otadhi popi oshinima shimwe.
Oonzinzi heyali dha anduka mo konima yaandhoka dho ondoka noonyapi heyali dha theta odho oomvula heyali dhondjala yekomba.
Oshi li naanaa; ngaashi te ti — Kalunga okwe ku ulukile shoka ta ka ninga.
Otaku ya omimvo heyali dheloolo muEgipiti alihe.
Konima yaandhika otaku ya omimvo heyali dhondjala yekomba. Omimvo dheloolo otadhi ka dhimbiwa, oshoka ondjala otayi ka shundula oshilongo.
Omimvo dheloolo otadhi ka dhimbiwa thiluthilu, oshoka ondjala ndjoka ya landula ko, oyo ondhigundhigu.
Sho wa yaguma lwaali, otashi ti kutya Kalunga okwa tokola shili shoka ta ka longa.
“Hogolola ano omulumentu omunandunge e na owino, u mu langeke melelo lyaEgipiti alihe.
Langeka wo aambala yalwe, ya taambe oshititano shomateyo momimvo ndhoka heyali dheloolo.
Ya lombwela, ya gongele iilya momimvo dheloolo ndhoka tadhi ya, e to ya pe uuthemba wokupungula iilya miilando noku yi tonatela.
Iilya otayi ka hepulutha oshilongo pethimbo lyomimvo heyali dhondjala ndjoka tayi ya muEgipiti. Pamukalo nguka aantu itaa ka sa po kondjala.”
Oohapu ndhika odho opalele omukwaniilwa nomalenga ge.
Oye nokwa ti kugo: “Itatu ka moneni omuntu omwaanawa e vule Josef, ngoka e na ombepo yaKalunga.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa ti kuJosef: “Oshoka Kalunga okwe ku ulukile ayihe mbika, kape na ngoka e ku vule muunongo nomowino.
Otandi ku lenge moshilongo shandje, naantu yandje ayehe otaa vulika kiipango yoye. Ongame awike tandi kala ndi ku vule.
Otandi ku langeke omupangeli gwaEgipiti alihe.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa hukula ko okalinga ke koshihako komunwe gwe e te ka zaleke komunwe gwaJosef. Okwe mu zaleke onguwo yoliina nelyenge lyoshingoli mothingo ye.
Okwe mu pe etemba lye etiyali meopalo, a londe mo, naalangeli mboka ye mu tetekelele, oyi igidha taa ti: “Isizimikeni! Isizimikeni!” Osho ngaaka Josef a langekwa omupangeli gwaEgipiti.
Omukwaniilwa okwa ti kuJosef: “Ngame omukwaniilwa, ihe muEgipiti inamu kala omuntu ta yelutha okwooko nenge ompadhi kee na ezimino lyoye!”

Okwe mu luku edhina lyOshiegipiti Zafenat Paneak e te mu pe omukiintu Asenat, omuna gwomuyambi Potifera gwokuOn.
Josef okwa li e na omimvo omilongo ndatu, sho a holoka koshipala shaFarao, omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti. Okwa zi muuwa e te endaenda naEgipiti alihe.
Momimvo ndhoka heyali dheloolo oshilongo osha teya iilya oyindji.
Josef okwe yi gongele e te yi pungula miigandhi yomiilando. Moshilando kehe okwa pungula mo iilya ya zi momapya gopuushiinda.
Okwa li ku na iilya oyindjiyindji, noye etha oku yi yeleka — oya li ya fa ehekevi lyomooha dhefuta.
Ondjala manga inaayi ya, Josef okwa valelwa aamati yaali kuAsenat.
Okwa ti: “Kalunga okwa dhimbitha ndje okuhepekwa kwandje negumbo lyatate.” Okwa luku osheeli she Manasse.
Okwa ti ishewe: “Kalunga okwa pe ndje aanona mevi lyuudhigu wandje.” Okwe mu luku Efraim.
Omimvo heyali dheloolo ndhoka dha nyanyudha Egipiti, odha hulu po,
nomimvo heyali dhondjala odha tameke, ngaashi naanaa Josef a tile. Okwa li ku na ondjala miilongo ayihe, ihe muEgipiti omwa li mu na iilya.
Aayegipiti sho ya tameke okusa ondjala, noya pula omukwaniilwa iilya, okwe ya lombwele, ya ye kuJosef, e taa ningi shoka te ya lombwele.
Ondjala oya geye e tayi taandele noshilongo ashihe. Nena Josef okwa matula iigandhi ayihe e ta landitha po iilya kAayegipiti.
Aantu yomuuyuni auhe oye ya kuEgipiti, ya lande iilya kuJosef, oshoka ondjala oya li ya geya muuyuni auhe.
42: Jakob sho a kundana kutya kuEgipiti oku na iilya, okwa lombwele oyana a ti: “Otamu talathana ngiini?
Ondu uvu kutya kuEgipiti oku na iilya. Indeni ko, mu ka lande iilya, opo twaa se kondjala.”
Aamwahe yaJosef omulongo oya ka landa iilya kuEgipiti,
ihe Jakob ina tuma onkelo Benjamin, omumwayina gwaJosef, oshoka a li a tila, pamwe ota adhika koshiponga.
Aana yaJakob pamwe nayalwe wo oye ya, ya lande iilya, oshoka muKaanan omwa li mu na ondjala.
Josef okwa li omupangeli gwoshilongo nokwa landitha po iilya kaantu yomuuyuni auhe. Aamwahe yaJosef oye ya e taa inyongamene kuye ya tsa iipala mevi.

Josef sho a mono aamwahe, okwe ya dhimbulula, ihe okwe ya idhimbike a fa kee ya shi. Okwe ya pula nomagandambadhi a ti: “Otamu zi peni?”
Oya yamukula ya ti: “Otwa zi kuKaanan, twe ya okulanda iilya.”
Josef okwa dhimbulula aamwahe, ihe yo inaye mu dhimbulula.
Okwa dhimbulukwa oondjodhi ndhoka a yagumine e ta ti kuyo: “One oondaadhi; omwe ya okutala, oshilongo ngele osha nengena.”
Oya yamukula ya ti: “Aawe, tatekulu. Tse aapika yoye twe ya okulanda iilya.
Tse atuhe aantu naamwayina. Katu shi oondaadhi; tse aantu aayinekelwa.”
Josef okwa ti: “Aawe, omwe ya owala mu tale, oshilongo shetu ngele osha nengena.”
Oya ti: “Otwa li atuhe kumwe aantu naamwayina omulongo nayaali, aana yomusamane gumwe mevi lyaKaanan. Mukwetu okwa sa, nonkelo oyi li putate kegumbo.”
Josef okwa yamukula a ti: “Osho naanaa, ngaashi nda ti: one oondaadhi.
Natu taleni, ngele otamu popi oshili. Ote gana medhina lyomukwaniilwa kutya itamu zi po mpaka, manga ondenge yeni onkelo inee ya mpaka.
Gumwe gwomune na ye e ke mu tale, yamwe manga taa kala po ya dhigininwa, sigo oshili tayi holoka, ngaashi mwa ti. Ngele hasho, one oondaadhi. Osho oshili, ngaashi omukwaniilwa e na omwenyo.”
Nena okwe ya tula mondjedhililo e taa kala mo omasiku gatatu.
Mesiku etitatu Josef okwa ti kuyo: “Ngame omutilikalunga nonda hala okuhupitha oomwenyo dheni, ngele otamu ningi ngeyi:
Opo tu mone kutya one aantu aayinekelwa, gumwe gwomune na kale mondjedhililo moka mu li, manga yalwe tamu faalele aanaluhepo iilya mbyoka mwa landa.
Nena omu na okweetela ndje omumwanyoko onkelo, opo shi ninge ekoleko kutya omwa lombwela ndje oshili, ne mwaa dhipagwe.”

Oya zimine e taa lombwelathana taa ti: “Eeno, otatu hepekwa naanaa molwashoka twa ningile omumwamene. Otwa mwene uudhigu we uunene, sho a li e tu indile ohenda, ihe tse inatu pulakena ko. Omolwashoka tu li muudhigu wa tya ngaaka.”
Reuben okwa ti: “Inandi mu lombwela, mwaa ehameke omunona, ihe inamu pulakena? Ngashingeyi otatu pulwa ombinzi ye.”
Josef oku uvu shoka taa ti, ihe yo inaye shi tseya, oshoka oya popile naye nomutoloki.
Josef okwa zi puyo e ta lili. Sho a fudha po, okwa galuka e ta kutha Simeon mokati kawo e te mu mangitha montaneho yawo.
Josef okwa ti, oompunda dhawo nadhi udhithwe iilya, iimaliwa yawo yi tulwe mompunda yashaa ngoka, yo ya pewe onguta yomondjila. Shika osha ningwa.
Aamwahe oya kutile uusino wawo iilya mbyoka ye yi landa e taa yi.
Montanda gumwe okwa dhitulula ompunda ye, a paluthe okasino ke e ta mono iimaliwa mokana kompunda.
Okwa lombwele aamwayina a ti: “Iimaliwa yandje oya galukila ndje, oyo mbika mompunda yandje!” Omitima dhawo odha kukuka, nomuumbanda oya lombwelathana ya ti: “Akwetu, Kalunga okwe tu ningi ngiini?”
Sho ya thiki kuhe kuKaanan, oye mu hokololele ayihe mbyoka ya ningilwa ya ti:
“Omupangeli gwaEgipiti okwe tu popitha nomagandambadhi e te tu pe oombedhi dhokundaadha oshilongo she.
Otwa yamukula twa ti: ‘Tse katu shi oondaadhi, tse aantu aainekelwa.
Otwa li aantu naamwayina omulongo nayaali, aana yahe gumwe. Omumwameme gumwe okwa sa, nonkelo oku li kuKaanan putate.’
Omulumentu omupangeli okwa yamukula a ti: ‘Ningeni ngeyi, opo ku monike kutya ne aantu aainekelwa: Gumwe gwomune na kale pungame, manga yalwe taa ka faalela aanaluhepo iilya.
Etelii ndje omumwanyoko onkelo, nena otandi ka tseya kutya ne kamu shi oondaadhi, ihe aayinekelwa. Otandi mu galulile omumwanyoko, opo tamu vulu okweenda noshilongo ashihe.’ ”
Sho taa pimpi oompunda dhawo, shaa ngoka okwa mono okampunda ke kiimaliwa. Sho ya mono uumpunda wiimaliwa, oyo pamwe nahe Jakob oya li ya tila.
He okwa ti kuyo: “Omwa hala mu yuge ndje aamwandje? Josef ke po; Simeon ke po; ngashingeyi omwa hala mu kuthe ndje Benjamin. Ayihe otayi ehameke ndje.”
Reuben okwa ti kuhe: “Ngele itandi ku galulile Benjamin, oto vulu okudhipaga po aamwandje aamati yaali. Mu tula mesiloshimpwiyu lyandje, notandi mu galulile kungoye.”
Ihe Jakob okwa ti: “Omumwandje ita yi nane. Omumwayina okwa sa, oye awike a kala po. Ota ningi a adhike koshiponga mondjila. Onda kulupa, noluhodhi ndoka tamu etele ndje, otalu dhipaga ndje.”
43: Ondjala oya li ya gehelela muKaanan.
Egumbo lyaJakob sho lya mana po iilya mbyoka ya li ya ka hehela kuEgipiti, Jakob okwa ti koyana: “Indeni ko, mu ke tu landele uulya.”
Juda okwa ti kuye: “Omulumentu ngwiyaka okwe tu kumagidha noonkondo, twaa holoke koshipala she twaa na omumwameme.
Ngele oto zimine, u tu tume nomumwameme, otatu yi tu ke ku landele iilya.
Ngele ino hala, itatu yi ko, oshoka omulumentu ngwiyaka okwe tu lombwele kutya itatu ziminwa okuholoka koshipala she, ngele katu na omumwameme.”
Jakob okwa ti: “Omolwashike mwe etele ndje uudhigu u thike mpano, sho mwa lombwele omulumentu ngoka kutya omu na omumwanyoko gulwe?”

Oya yamukula ya ti: “Omulumentu ngwiyaka okwe tu pula kombinga yezimo lyetu ta ti: ‘Ho oko e li e na omwenyo? Omu na omumwanyoko natango gulwe?’ Otwa li tu na okuyamukula omapulo ge agehe. Katwa li tu shi shi nando kutya ote ke tu lombwela oku mu etela omumwameme.”
Juda okwa ti kuhe: “Tuma omunona nangame, tu ye mbala. Nena kape na we ngoka ta ka sa kondjala.
Otandi mu hupulile omwenyo gwandje, oto mu pula ndje. Ngele itandi mu galulile kungoye ondjangandjele, ote kala ndi na ondjo koshipala shoye okukalamwenyo kwandje akuhe.
Andola okwa li inaatu kandakanda, ando otwa ya ko nale lwaali nokuli.”

He okwa ti kuyo: “Ngele ano osho ngaaka, tuleni iilikolwa iiwanawa yomevi ndika moompunda dheni, mu faalele omupangeli ngwiyaka ombalagelo: omugwayo gwokanakamuma, omagadhi goonyushi, iizimba, omaka ga nika nawa, omankete nomahuku.
Kutheni ofuto ya mbalipalekwa, mu shunithe ko iimaliwa mbyoka ya li moompunda dheni. Pamwe osha ningwa mepuko.
Kutheni wo omumwanyoko, ne mu shune komulumentu ngwiyaka mbala.
Kalunga Omunankondoawike ne mu silithe ohenda komulumentu ngwiyaka, opo a pitike Benjamin nomumwanyoko okugaluka pamwe nane. Ngele te kanitha aamwandje, nandi ya kanithe!”
Oya kutha ombalagelo nofuto ya mbalipalekwa noya yi kuEgipiti naBenjamin. Oya holoka koshipala shaJosef.
Josef sho a mono Benjamin e li puyo, okwa lombwele elenga lyomegumbo lye a ti: “Fala aantu mbaka megumbo. Ya tselela ontselela, u ya pakele po, oshoka otaa ka lya omwiha nangame nena.”
Elenga olya ningi, ngaashi lya lombwelwa, e tali ya fala megumbo lyaJosef.

Sho ya li taa falwa megumbo, oya haluka e taa dhiladhila: “Otwe etwa muka molwiimaliwa mbiyaka ya li ya shunwa moompunda dhetu, sho twi ile huka lwotango. Otaye tu nukile e taa yugu po uusino wetu, notse otatu ningi aapika.”
Posheelo shegumbo oya lombwele elenga lyomegumbo e taa ti:
“Tatekulu, sho twi ile huka tu lande iilya lwotango,
otwa ka yunga ontanda mondjila yokuya kegumbo. Sho twa dhitula oompunda dhetu, kehe gumwe gwomutse okwa adha iimaliwa ye yi li mompunda ye — ayihe ya gwana po. Otwe yi etelele kungoye.
Otwe eta wo iimaliwa yilwe, tu lande iilya. Inatu tseya ngoka a tula iimaliwa moompunda dhetu.”
Elenga olya ti: “Inamu tila. Inamu piyagana. Kalunga keni, Kalunga kaho, oye e mu tulile iimaliwa moompunda dheni. Onda taamba iifuta yeni.” Olyo olye eta wo Simeon kuyo.
Elenga olye ya fala megumbo. Olye ya pe omeya, ya yoge oompadhi dhawo, nomwiidhi kuusino wawo.
Oya longekidha ombalagelo yawo, ye yi pe Josef, sho te ya komwiha, oshoka oya lombwelwa kutya otaa ka lya pamwe naye.
Josef sho e ya kegumbo, oya kutha ombalagelo, ye yi mu pe, e taa inyongamene pevi koshipala she.
Josef okwe ya kundu e te ya pula a ti: “Omwa lombwelele ndje kutya ho okwa kulupa — oku li po ngiini? Oku na omwenyo natango noku li nawa?”
Oya yamukula ya ti: “Omupiya gwoye, tate, oko e li e na omwenyo noku li nawa.” Oya tsu oongolo noye mu inyongamene.
Josef sho a mono omumwayina Benjamin, okwa pula a ti: “Oye omumwanyoko onkelo ngono mwa li tamu lombwele ndje?” Nokwa ti: “Mentu gwandje, Kalunga ne ku yambeke.”
Nena Josef okwa zi po mbala, oshoka omwenyo gwe ogwa li tagu tende molwomumwayina. Okwa yi mongulu ye e ta lili.
Sho i iyogo moshipala, okwa zi mo ti idhidhimike e ta ti, iikulya nayi etwe.
Josef okwa li e li poshitaafula shimwe, manga aamwahe ye li pushawo. Aayegipiti oya li pushawo shi ikalela, oshoka otaye shi tala oshidhila okulila pamwe nAahebeli.
Aamwahe oya kuutumba poshitaafula ya taalela Josef palandulathano lyuukuluntu wawo okuza kosheeli sigo okonkelo. Sho ya mono, nkene ya kuutumba ya taalelathana, oye shi kuminwa.
Iikulya oye yi pewa tayi zi koshitaafula shaJosef, naBenjamin okwa pewa lutano e vule ayehe. Oya li e taa nu pamwe naJosef e taa nyanyukwa.
44: Josef okwa lombwele elenga lyomegumbo lye e ta ti: “Udhitha oompunda dhaalumentu mbano iilya nou tule iimaliwa yawo moompunda dhawo.
Mompunda yonkelo tula mo oshitenga shandje shoshisiliveli pamwe niimaliwa ye mbyoka ya li tayi landwa iilya.” Elenga olya ningi ngaashi lya lombwelwa.
Ongula onene oya lalekwa noyi idhenge mela lyondjila nuusino wawo.
Sho ye ende ko owala oshinano oshifupi okuza koshilando, Josef okwa ti kelenga lyegumbo lye: “Endelela, u ya landule. Ngele we ya adha, ya pula u tye: ‘Uuwanawa oshike tamu u galulile uuwinayi?
Omolwashike mwa yaka po oshitenga shoshisiliveli shamwene gwandje? Omo amuke ha nwine nosho ha anekelitha. Omwa longo iihuna!’ ”
Elenga sho lye ya adha, olya popi, ngaashi lya lombwela.
Oye li yamukula ya ti: “Tatekulu, oto dhiladhila ngiini, sho to ti ngawo? Oshinima shoka oshi li kokule natse sho.
Oto tseya kutya otwe etelele niimaliwa mbiyaka twa monene moompunda dhetu twa zile nayo kuKaanan. Otatu vulu ngiini okuyaka po oshitenga shoshisiliveli shamwene gwoye megumbo lye nokuli?
Tatekulu, ngoka ta adhika e shi na, oye na dhipagwe, natse atuhe otatu ningi aapika yoye.”
Elenga olya ti: “Ote zimine, ihe ngoka awike a kutha po oshitenga, oye ta ningi omupika gwandje, manga ne yalwe otamu yi nombili.”
Oya kutululile omitsalo dhawo pevi noshaa ngoka okwa dhitulula ompunda ye.
Elenga lyaJosef olya hadha nuudhiginini, okutameka kuyomukuluntu sigo okoyonkelo, oshitenga nosha adhika mompunda yaBenjamin.
Aamwayina oya tuula oonguwo dhawo moluhodhi, oya kutile uusino wawo e taa shuna koshilando.
Juda naamwayina oye ya kaandjaJosef noye mu adha ko. Oye mu inyongamene,
Josef nokwa ti: “Omwa ningi ngiini? Kamu shi kutya omuntu ngangame ote vulu oku mu mona muunkulungu wokwaanekela?”
Juda okwa yamukula a ti: “Tatekulu, otatu ti nduno ngiini? Otatu patana shike? Otatu iyopaleke ngiini? Kalunga okwa holola uusama wetu. Atuhe tse aapika yoye pamwe naangoka a adhika e na oshitenga.”
Josef okwa ti: “Aawe! Shivalelwe ndi shi ninge! Ngoka awike a adhika e na oshitenga, oye na ninge omupika. Ne yalwe indeni nombili kuho.”
Juda okwa hedha kuJosef e ta ti: “Ombili, tatekulu, kwatha ndje ndi popye nangoye. Ino geela ndje; ngoye owa fa omukwaniilwa polwoye mwene.
Tatekulu, owe tu pulile to ti: ‘Omu na ho nenge omumwanyoko gulwe?’
Otwa yamukulile twa tile: ‘Otu na tate a kulupa nomumwameme onkelo e mu valelwa muukulupe. Omumwayina gwomunona okwa sa, noye awike gwayina e na po omwenyo; he oku mu hole unene.’
Tatekulu, owe tu lombwelele, tu mu ete huka, opo u mu mone.
Otwa yamukulile kutya omunona ita vulu okuza po puhe; nge ta zi po, he ota si.
Owa tile: ‘Itamu pitikwa okuholoka koshipala shandje, ngele omumwanyoko onkelo ite ya nane.’
“Sho twa shunine kutate, otwe mu hokololele shoka wa tile.
Nena okwe tu lombwele, tu galuke tu ye tu lande iilya.
Otwa yamukula twa ti: ‘Itatu vulu okuya; itatu pitikilwa tu holoke koshipala shomulumentu ngwiyaka, ngele omumwameme onkelo itatu yi naye. Otatu vulu okuya ashike, ngele omumwameme onkelo ota yi wo.’
Tate okwe tu lombwele a ti: ‘Omu shi shi kutya mukadhandje Rakel okwa valele ndje aamati yaali ayeke.
Gumwe okwa thiga ndje po nale. Ngiika okwa lika po kiilikama, oshoka inandi mu mona we sigo onena.
Ngele otamu kutha po ishewe nguno pungame, e ta ka adhika koshiponga, oluhodhi ndoka tamu etele ndje, otalu dhipaga ndje.’ ”

Juda okwa tsikile a ti: “Ngashingeyi, tatekulu, ngele ote shuna kutate ndaa na omunona, shampa tuu a mono kutya omunona ke li pamwe nangame, ota si. Omwenyo gwe ogu li momwenyo gwomunona ngu, nokwa kulupa lela, tashi ti, oluhodhi nduka tatu mu etele, otalu mu dhipaga.
Ngame ondu uvanekele tate, ndi sile omunona oshimpwiyu. Onde mu lombwele kutya, ngele itandi eta omunona kuye, ote kala ndi na ondjo koshipala she okukalamwenyo kwandje akuhe.
Ngashingeyi, tatekulu, ote kala po, ndi ninge omupika gwoye peha lyomunona; mu etha a ye pamwe naamwahe.
Ote vulu ngiini okushuna kutate, ngele omunona inandi ya naye? Ite vulu okwiidhidhimikila okutala oluhodhi lwatate lu thike mpoka.”
45: Josef ina vula okwiidhidhimika we komeho gaamati ye. Okwe ya lombwele, ya pite mo mongulu. Kamwa li we omuntu gulwe, Josef sho i ihololele aamwahe.
Okwa tameke okulila nokulililila. Aayegipiti oye shi uvu, noshu uvika wo muuwa womukwaniilwa.
Josef okwa ti kaamwahe: “Ongame Josef. Tate oku na omwenyo natango?” Aamwahe sho ye shi uvu, oya li ya kunkwa noinaa tya we sha.
Nena Josef okwa ti kuyo: “Hedheni huka.” Oyo noya hedha ko, oye nokwa ti: “Ongame omumwanyoko Josef, ngoka mwe mu landitha kuEgipiti.
Ngashingeyi inamu shi ningila omwenyo omwiinayi nenge mwi ipe oombedhi, sho mwa landitha ndje po. Kalunga mwene okwa tetekelitha ndje huka, opo a hupithe oomwenyo dheni nodhaantu yalwe.
Omumvo nguka omutiyali gwondjala. Oku na natango omimvo ntano itaaku longwa ko itaku teywa.
Kalunga okwa tetekelitha ndje huka, opo mune mu thigale oshihupe kombanda yevi, noluvalo lweni lu kale lu na omwenyo, sigo ehupitho enene tali ya.
Hane ano mwe eta ndje huka, ihe oKalunga. Okwa ningi ndje elenga enene lyomukwaniilwa. Ongame te lele oshilongo she ashihe; ngame omupangeli gwaEgipiti alihe.
“Endeleleni ano, mu ye kutate, mu mu lombwele mu tye: ‘Omumwoye Josef ota ti ngeyi: Kalunga okwa ningi ndje omupangeli gwaEgipiti alihe, ila kungame pwaa na ekwatakwato.
Oto vulu okutula moshikandjo shaGoshen, moka to vulu okukala popepi nangame — ongoye mwene, aamwoye, aatekulu yoye, oonzi dhoye, iikombo yoye, oongombe dhoye niinima yoye ayihe u yi na.
Ngele ou li muGoshen, ote vulu oku ku sila oshimpwiyu. Oku na natango omimvo ntano dhondjala, ihe ngame ine hala, ngoye mwene, egumbo lyoye naayihe u yi na yi se po kondjala.’ ”
Josef okwa tsikile a ti: “Omeho geni oge shi wete, nomeho gomumwameme Benjamin oge shi wete kutya ongame Josef.
Ka lombweleni tate kutya onda simana muEgipiti, ne mu mu hokololele ayihe mwe yi mono. Mu eteni mbala huka.”
Josef okwi idhingile Benjamin omaako mothingo e ta lili, naBenjamin okwa lilile mothingo ye.
Okwa thipi aamwahe ayehe komilungu nokwa lilile mothingo yakehe gumwe. Konima yaambika oya kundathana naamwayina.
Elaka olya thiki muuwa kutya aamwayina yaJosef ye ya ko. Omukwaniilwa nomalenga ge oya nyanyukwa.
Omukwaniilwa okwa ti kuJosef: “Lombwela aamwanyoko, ya kutile uusino wawo, ya ye kuKaanan.
Naa ka tale ko he pamwe negumbo lye, ye ye huka. Otandi ya pe evi ewanawa muEgipiti, notaa ka kala ye na eloolo lyiikulya.
Ya lombwela, ya kuthe omatemba muEgipiti, ga ka humbate aakadhi noyana nahe, ye ya ete huka.
Inaa ipyakidhila niikolokolo yawo, oshoka iinima ayihe iiwanawa yomuEgipiti oyawo.”
Aana yaJakob oya ningi, ngaashi ya lombwelwa. Josef okwe ya pe omatemba, ngaashi omukwaniilwa a ti, nonguta yomondjila.
Omulumentu kehe okwa pewa omutsuhu omupe, ihe Benjamin okwa pewa iimaliwa iisiliveli omathele gatatu nomitsuhu ntano.
Josef okwa tumine he uusino omulongo wa humbata iinima iiwanawa yomuEgipiti, iilya, iikwiila nonguta yomondjila.
Okwa laleke aamwahe, ya ye, e ta ti kuyo: “Inamu tamanana mondjila.”
Oya zi kuEgipiti e taa yi kuhe Jakob kuKaanan.
Oye mu lombwele ya ti: “Josef oko e li e na omwenyo. Oye omupangeli gwaEgipiti alihe.” Jakob okwa kunkwa noina wapa oku ya itaala.
Ihe sho ye mu hokololele ayihe mbyoka Josef e ya lombwele, nosho a mono omatemba ngoka ga tumwa kuJosef, ge mu fale kuEgipiti, ehaluko olye mu zi.
Okwa ti: “Omumwandje Josef oku na omwenyo natango! Nda gwana ihe. Otandi yi ndi ke mu tale, manga inaandi sa.”
46: Jakob okwa manga po iinima ye ayihe e ta yi kuBeersheba, hoka a yamba oontselelandjambo kuKalunga kahe Isak.

Kalunga okwe mu popitha memoniko uusiku e te mu ithana ta ti: “Jakob, Jakobwee!”
Jakob okwa yamukula a ti: “Ee!”
Kalunga okwa ti: “Ongame Kalunga, Kalunga kaho. Ino tila okuya kuEgipiti; oluvalo lwoye otandi ke lu ninga oshigwana oshinene.
Otandi yi nangoye kuEgipiti notandi ka galulila oluvalo lwoye kevi huka. Josef oye te ku thithikilitha omeho goye, sho to si.”
Jakob okwa zi muBeersheba. Oyana oye mu londeke pamwe naanona naakulukadhi yawo momatemba ngoka ga zi komukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti.
Oya kutha iinima yawo ayihe mbyoka ye yi imonene muKaanan e taa yi kuEgipiti. Jakob okwa yi noluvalo lwe aluhe:
Oyana aamati, aatekulu ye aamati, oyana aakadhona naatekulu ye aakadhona.
Aaisraeli mboka ya yi kuEgipiti, oyo mbaka: Jakob nosheeli she Reuben,
aana yaReuben Hanok, Pallu, Hezron naKarmi.
Simeon noyana Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar naShaul, omuna gwomukulukadhi Omukaanani.
Levi noyana Gerson, Kohat naMerari.
Juda noyana Shela, Perez naSera. (Aana yaJuda yalwe Er naOnan oya sile muKaanan). Perez okwa li e na aanona Hezron naHamul.
Issaskar noyana Tola, Puwa, Jashub naShimron.
Sebulon noyana Sered, Elon naJahleel.
Mbaka aamati yaLea e ya valele Jakob muMesopotamia pamwe nomumwayina omukadhona Dina. Aantu ayehe kumwe aamati naakadhona omilongo ndatu nayatatu.
Gad noyana Zifjon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi naAreli.
Aser noyana Imna, Ishva, Ishvi, Beria nomumwayina omukadhona Sera. Aana yaBeria oyo Heber naMalkiel.
Mbaka omulongo nayahamano yomoluvalo lwaJakob ya valwa kuSilpa, omudhike ngoka Laban e mu pele omwana Lea.
Rakel, omukulukadhi gwaJakob, okwe mu valele aamati yaali, Josef naBenjamin.
Oyanamati yaJosef oyo Manasse naEfraim. Oye mu valelwa muEgipiti kuAsenat, omuna gwomuyambi Potifera gwokuOn.
Oyanamati yaBenjamin oyo Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naeman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim naArd.
Mbaka omulongo nayane oyo oluvalo lwaJakob yomuRakel.
Dan nomwana Hushim.
Naftali noyana Jakzeel, Guni, Jezer naShillem.
Mbaka yaheyali oyo oluvalo lwaJakob muBilha, omudhike ngoka Laban e mu pele omwana Rakel.
Oluvalo lwaJakob aluhe kumwe ndoka lwa yi kuEgipiti, olwo omilongo hamano nahamano, aakiintu yoyana inaa yalulilwa mo.
Josef okwa valelwa aamati yaali muEgipti. Nopo ihe, Aaisraeli ayehe muEgipiti oya ningi omilongo heyali.
Jakob okwa tetekelitha Juda, a ka tale Josef e mu tsakaneke muGoshen. Sho a thiki ko,
Josef okwa londo metemba lye e ta yi kuGoshen, a ka tsakaneke he. Sho ya tsakanene, Josef okwi idhingile omaako ge mothingo yahe e ta lili olule.
Jakob okwa lombwele Josef a ti: “Ngashingeyi otandi ka sa nenyanyu, sho nda mono oshipala shoye nondi shi kutya ou na omwenyo.”
Nena Josef okwa ti kaamwahe nokaanegumbo lyahe: “Otandi ka tseyithila omukwaniilwa kutya aamwameme natate negumbo lye alihe mboka ya kala muKaanan, oye ya kungame.
Otandi ke mu hokololela kutya one aasita yiimuna mwe etelela oonzi, iikombo, oongombe naayihe mu yi na.
Omukwaniilwa nge te mu ithana e te mu pula iilonga yeni,

tyeni kutya one aasita yiimuna mokukalamwenyo kweni akuhe, ngaashi naanaa oohokulu ya li haa litha. Nena ote mu pitika, mu kale moshikandjo shaGoshen.” Josef okwa popi ngaaka, oshoka aasita yiimuna oyo oshidhila kAaegipiti.
47: Josef okwa kutha aamwahe yatano e ta yi nayo komukwaniilwa nokwa ti: “Tate naamwameme oye zi kuKaanan niimuna yawo naayihe ye yi na. Ngashingeyi oye li moshikandjo shaGoshen.”
Okwa ulukile omukwaniilwa aamwayina mboka yatano.
Omukwaniilwa okwe ya pula a ti: “Iilonga yeni oyashike?” Oya yamukula ya ti: “Nkeyama, otse aasita yiimuna ngaashi ootatekulu.
Otwe ya, tu kale moshilongo shika oondjendi, oshoka moshilongo shaKaanan omu na ondjala ondhigu nokamu na uunapelo wiimuna yetu. Tu kwatha epitikilo, tu kale moshikandjo shaGoshen.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa ti kuJosef: “Ngashingeyi ho naamwanyoko oya thiki.
Evi lya Egipiti olyawo. Ya langeka moshikandjo shaGoshen, oshitopolwa oshiwanawa moshilongo. Nongele ope na aalumentwelela mokati kawo, naa ninge aasita yiimuna yandje.”
Josef okwe eta he Jakob koshipala shomukwaniilwa. Jakob okwa yambeke omukwaniilwa,
omukwaniilwa nokwe mu pula a ti: “Ou na omimvo ngapi?”
Jakob okwa yamukula a ti: “Omimvo dhuundjendi wandje ethele nomilongo ndatu. Omimvo ndhika odho omishona nomiwinayi, inadhi fa omimvo dhuundjendi wootatekulu muuwindji.”
Jakob okwa laleke omukwaniilwa nuuyamba e ta yi.
Josef okwa langeke he naamwahe muEgipiti e te ya pe oshitopolwa oshiwanawa moshilongo popepi noshilando Rameses, ngaashi omukwaniilwa a ti.
Josef okwa pe he naamwahe negumbo lyahe alihe iikulya ya yeleka omwaalu gwaanona.
Ondjala oya li ya geya moshilongo. Iikulya oya li ya pumba akuhe, nAayegipiti nAakaanana oya nanga kondjala.
Sho ya landa iilya, Josef okwa gongele iimaliwa e te yi fala kuuwa.
Iimaliwa sho ya pu mo muEgipiti nomuKaanan, Aayegipiti oye ya kuJosef taa ti: “Tu pa iikulya! Ino tu sitha ondjala! Ninga po sha! Iimaliwa yetu ayihe ya pu po.”
Josef okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Eteni iimuna yeni; otandi mu pe iilya peha lyiimaliwa ngele oya pwa po.”
Oyo noye eta iimuna yawo kuJosef, e te ya pe iilya ya gu uukambe wawo, oonzi, iikombo, oongombe nuusino. Omumvo ngoka okwe ya pe iilya ya landa niinima yawo ayihe.

Omumvo gwa landula ko oye ya taa ti: “Tatekulu, sho tu li mpaka, itatu iholeke nando, nokutya iimaliwa yetu niimuna yetu ayihe ya pu po, nena oyoye. Inapa hupa we sha, tu ku pe ando, kakele komalutu getu nomapya getu.

Ino tu etha, tu se! Ninga po sha! Ino etha omapya getu ga ninge omaputu! Tu landa po, tu gwe iilya, osho wo omapya getu! Otatu ka ninga aapika yomukwaniilwa, noye ta ningi mwene gwomapya getu. Tu pa iilya, tu kale tu na omwenyo, noombuto tu kune omapya getu!”
Josef okwa landa po omapya agehe muEgipiti, ga ninge gomukwaniilwa, Aayegipiti ayehe oya landitha po omapya gawo, oshoka ondjala oya li ya geya; omapya agehe noga ningi eliko lyomukwaniilwa.
Josef okwa piki aantu okuza kooha dhaEgipiti sigo okooha oonkwawo.
