Omapya gaayambi ogo ageke ga hupu ko inaaga landwa po. Inaa landitha po omapya gawo, oshoka oya li haa pewa eziminino lyiilya komukwaniilwa.
Josef okwa lombwele aantu ta ti: “Omu wete ko kutya onde mu landa po nomapya geni, nde mu landele omukwaniilwa. Oombuto dhokukuna omapya geni odho ndhika.
Pethimbo lyeteyo omu na okupa omukwaniilwa oshititano, ihe oshihupe osheni, mu shi longithe ombuto, okwiipalutha nokupalutha aantu yomomagumbo geni naanona yeni.”
Oyo noya yamukula ya ti: “Owa hupitha oomwenyo dhetu; owe tu longele uuwanawa, tatekulu. Otatu ningi aapika yomukwaniilwa.”
Josef okwa toto po ompango yomapya gomuEgipiti, nokutya oshititano sheteyo oshomukwaniilwa. Ompango ndjika oyi li po sigo onena. Omapya gaayambi ageke kage shi gomukwaniilwa.
Aaisraeli oya kala muEgipiti moshikandjo shaGoshen, moka ya yambapala ye na aanona oyendji.
Jakob okwa kala muEgipiti omimvo omulongo naheyali, sigo a gwanitha omimvo ethele nomilongo ne naheyali.
Ethimbo sho lya hedha ko, a se, okwi ithana omwana Josef e ta ti kuye: “Tula oshikaha shoye kohi yetundji lyandje e to gana kutya ito fumvike ndje muEgipiti.

Onda hala ndi fumvikwe pootate; kutha ndje muEgipiti, u ka fumvike ndje mpoka ya fumvikwa.”
Josef okwa yamukula a ti: “Otii ka ninga, ngaashi to ti.”
Jakob okwa ti: “Gana ano kutya osho to ka ninga.” Josef okwa gana, naJakob okwi inyongamene e ta galikana i ikwatelela kombete.
48: Konima yaambika Josef okwa lombwelwa kutya he ota alukwa. Josef okwa kutha oyana yaali, Manasse naEfraim, e ta yi a ka talele po he.
Jakob sho a lombwelwa kutya omwana Josef okwe ya oku mu talela po, okwi ikankameke e ta kuutumba kombete ye.
Jakob okwa ti kuJosef: “Kalunga Omunankondoawike okwi ihololele ndje puLus mevi lyaKaanan e ta yambeke ndje.
Okwa lombwele ndje a ti: ‘Otandi ku pe aanona oyendji, opo oluvalo lwoye lu ka ninge oshigwana oshinene. Otandi gandja evi ndika koluvalo lwoye, li ninge eliko lyalwo sigo aluhe.’ ”
Jakob okwa tsikile a ti: “Josef, aamwoye yaali ye ku valelwa muEgipiti, manga inaandi ya huka, oyandje. Efraim naManasse oye thike paamwandje mboka Reuben naSimeon.
Aamwoye yalwe ye ku valelwa konima yawo, naa kale yoye; mokugandja iitopolwa yevi eliko lyawo nali pitile muEfraim naManasse.
Sho nda li mokugaluka kuMesopotamia, onda silwa Rakel mondjila muKaanan, popepi naEfrata. Onde mu fumvike mooha dhondjila yokuEfrata.” (Efrata nena ohaku tiwa Betlehem.)
Jakob sho a mono aana yaJosef, okwa pula a ti: “Aanona mbano oolye?”

Josef okwa yamukula a ti: “Mbaka aamwandje, Kalunga e ya pele ndje muka muEgipiti.”
Jakob okwa ti: “Ya eta kungame, opo ndi ya yambeke.”
Omeho gaJakob oga li ga tsiyala kuukulupe, ka li ta mono ko nawa. Josef okwe eta aamati kuye, oye nokwe ya idhingile e te ya thipi komilungu.
Jakob okwa lombwele Josef a ti: “Kanda li nda tegelela tandi ku mono we, ihe Kalunga okwa monitha ndje aana yoye nokuli.”
Nena Josef okwe ya kutha po pekolo lye e te mu inyongamene a tsa oshipala mevi.
Josef okwa tula Efraim kolumoho lwaJakob naManasse kolulyo lwe.
Ihe Jakob okwa shigakaneke iikaha ye e ta tenteke olulyo lwe komutse gwaEfraim, nando oye ondenge, nolumoho lwe okomutse gwaManasse, ngoka a li omukuluntu.

Okwa yambeke Josef a ti:
“Kalunga ngoka a longelwa kootate Abraham naIsak,
na yambeke aamati mbaka!
Kalunga ngoka e enditha ndje sigo onena,
ne ya yambeke!

Omuyengeli ngoka a hupitha ndje miiponga ayihe,
ne ya yambeke!
Edhina lyandje nedhina lyootate Abraham naIsak
nali kale maamati mbaka!
Yo naa kale ye na okakwiyu, oluvalo olwindji.”
Josef okwa li e shi tala epuko, sho a mono he a tenteke olulyo lwe komutse gwaEfraim. Okwa kutha ko oshikaha shahe komutse gwaEfraim e te shi tula komutse gwaManasse.
Okwa ti kuhe: “Hangaaka, tate. Omukuluntu oye nguka; tenteka oshikaha shoye shokolulyo komutse gwe.”

He okwa tindi e ta ti: “Ondi shi shi, mentu gwandje, ondi shi shi. Oluvalo lwaManasse otalu ka ninga oshigwana oshinene. Ihe ondenge ota ka ninga omunene e mu vule, noluvalo lwe otalu ka ninga iigwana iinene.”

Osho ngaaka e ya yambeke esiku ndyoka ta ti: “Aaisraeli otaa ka tumbula omadhina geni, uuna taa tomona omayambeko. Otaa ka tya: ‘Kalunga ne ku faathanithe naEfraim naManasse.’ ” Osho Jakob a tula Efraim komeho gaManasse.
Jakob okwa lombwele Josef a ti: “Ngaashi u shi wete, ondi li pokusa, ihe Kalunga ota kala nane note ke mu tembudhila kevi lyoohokulu.
Eyana lyokuShekem ongoyelela tandi li pe, haamwanyoko, etathapya ndyoka nda yugu Aayamori negongamwele lyandje nuutati wandje.”
49: Jakob okwi ithana oyana e ta ti kuyo: “Gongaleni, notandi ke mu hokololela shoka tamu ka ningilwa komasiku gokomeho:

“Ileni pamwe, mu pulakene,
ne aana yaJakob.
Pulakeneni ho Israel shoka te mu lombwele.

“Reuben, ngoye osheeli shandje, oonkondo dhandje,
osheeli shuukolele wandje,
osheeli mesimano nomondjundo,
u vule aamwanyoko.

Owa fuluka wa fa omeya, hangoye to ningi omukuluntu,
oshoka wa londele kombete yaho, nowe yi nyateke.
Eeno, owa londele kontala yandje.

“Simeon naLevi aantu namumwayina.
Omagongamwele gawo ohaga dhipaga.

Itandi zimine oonkundathana dhawo,
itandi kala moshigongi shawo,
oshoka ya dhipaga aalumentu mondjahi,
nomuuntsa wawo oya lemaneke oontsezi.

Ondjahi yawo nayi thingwe,
oshoka oya pindjala.
Uupyakadhi wawo nau thingwe,
oshoka kau na ohenda.
Otandi ya napeke mokati kaJakob,
otandi ya halakanithile muIsrael.

“Juda, aamwanyoko otaye ku tanga.
Oshikaha shoye osha kwata ekothi lyaatondi yoye.
Aamwanyoko otaa inyongamene koshipala shoye.

Juda oku li po a fa onkoshi, ya kwata oshihakanwa shayo
e tayi shuna mekololo lyayo tayi inana ya taandela pevi.
Kape na ngoka ta vulu oku mu pendutha.

Ondhimbo yuukwaniilwa itayi zi mo muJuda nepangelo moluvalo lwe,
sigo taku ya ngoka te li pewa,
ngoka iigwana tayi vulika kuye.

Ota pandekele okasino ke pomuviinu
nokasinogona ke opekota lyomuviinulela.
Oonguwo dhe ote dhi yogele momaviinu.

Omeho ge ga tiligana ngaashi omaviinu,
omayego ge ga tokithwa ga fa omahini.

“Sebulon ota ka kala pooha dhefuta,
mpoka tapu ka kala etulilo lyoosikepa.
Oshitopolwa she otashi ka adha sigo oSidon.

“Issaskar oye okasino ka kola
taka lala pokati kiigunda.

Okwa mono ko ehala lyaa na uupyakadhi,
nevi ndyoka olye mu opalele.
Ota petama a humbate ondjoko,
ta thiminikilwa iilonga yuupika.

“Dan ota tokolele aantu ye,
ongaakwawo haa tokolele omazimo gaIsrael.

Dan ota kala ngeyoka mepola,
a ontela a fa epili mondjila tali shomona okakambe mekondo,
nomukayili ta gu okafinyukila.

“Ehupitho lyoye, Omuwa,
otandi li tegelele.

“Gad ota matukilwa kekumbu,
ihe ote ya pilukile e te ya landula.

“Aser iikulya ye omagadhi,
ota ka gandja iitowale yo opalela aakwaniilwa.

“Naftali oye oholongo yi na ontuku,
oyana oyo opala.

Josef okwa fa omuti hagu imi,
omuti omutalala pomatondokelo
iitayi yagwo tayi taandele kekuma.

Oondjumbeta otadhi mu itakeke,
otadhi mu ponokele.

Ihe uuta we owa kola,
omaako ge oga pama.
Oga kolekwa kOmunankondo, Kalunga kaJakob,
okOmusita nokOmugameni gwaIsrael.

Kalunga kooho ne ku kwathe,
Kalunga Omunankondoawike ne ku yambeke.
Ne ku pe omayambeko taga zi megulu pombanda,
omayambeko gefundja mpaka pevi
nomayambeko gokomagundji nogomoshivalelo.

Omayambeko gaho oge vule ngeyaka gootatekulu,
oge vule eopalo lyoondundu dhaaluhe.
Omayambeko ngaka naga lambele komutse gwaJosef,
okomutse gwomuhogololwa mokati kaamwahe.

“Benjamin oye embungu hali lyana.
Ongula otali hutagula oshihakanwa shalyo,
ongulohi otali topola oshikwatwa shalyo.”
Ngaka ogo omazimo gaIsrael omulongo nagaali, noohapu dhomalaleko odho ndhika e dhi tumbulile moku ga yambeka kehe limwe neyambeko lye li opalela.
Jakob okwa lombwele oyana a ti: “Otandi yi nondjila yaakuuyuni ayehe; fumvikii ndje mekololo ndyoka li li meyana lyaEfron Omuheti,
puMakpela, kuuzilo waMamre, mevi lyaKaanan. Ekololo ndika neyana Abraham okwe li landa kuEfron, li ninge omayendo.
Omo tuu moka mwa fumvikwa Abraham nomukadhi Sara, omo mwa fumvikwa Isak nomukadhi Rebekka, nangame nda fumvike mo Lea.
Epya nekololo olya li lya landwa kAaheti. Omo tuu fumvikii ndje moka.”
Jakob sho a mana omautho ge koyana, okwa taandeleke omagulu ge e ta fudha mo omwenyo gwe, nokwa yi kooyinagulu.
50: Josef okwi iyumbile puhe ta lili e te mu thipi koshipala.
Josef okwa ti, omudhimba gwahe nagu gwayekwe, gu kukutikwe.
Osha pula omasiku omilongo ne, opo egwayeko lyekukutiko li pwe. Aayegipiti oye mu lili omasiku omilongo heyali.
Omasiku gokulila oosa sho ga hulu, Josef okwa ti komalenga gomukwaniilwa: “Kwathii ndje, mu fale elaka ndika komukwaniilwa tamu ti:
‘Tate sho a li popepi nokusa, okwa uvanekitha ndje, ndi ke mu fumvike mombila e yi longekidha mevi lyaKaanan. Laleka ndje, ndi ye ndi ka fumvike tate e tandi galuka.’ ”
Omukwaniilwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Inda, u ka fumvike ho, ngaashi wu uvaneke to shi ningi.”
Josef okwa yi a ka fumvike he. Omalenga agehe gomukwaniilwa, aanenentu yomombala naawiliki ayehe yaEgipiti oya yi pamwe naJosef.
Egumbo lye, aamwahe naanegumbo lyahe ayehe oya yi pamwe naye. Aanona ayeke noonzi dhawo, iikombo noongombe oya kalele moshikandjo shaGoshen.
Aalumentu aanamatembakwiita naalondinkambe oya yi wo naye noya li ongundu onene.
Sho ya thiki polupale lwaAtad kuuzilo waJordan, oya lili mokule ethimbo ele, naJosef okwa utha, oosa dhi lile omasiku gaheyali.
Aakwashilongo Aakaanana sho ya mono aantu mboka taa lili puAtad, oya ti: “Oshituthi shoka oshoosa dhAayegipiti.” Ehala ndyoka nolya lukwa Abel Mizraim.
Aana yaJakob oya ningi, ngaashi e ya lombwele.
Oya fala omudhimba gwahe kuKaanan e taye gu fumvike mekololo puMakpela, kuuzilo waMamre meyana ndyoka Abraham e li landa kuEfron Omuheti, li ninge omayendo.
Josef sho a fumvike he, okwa shuna kuEgipiti pamwe naamwahe mboka ya yile pamwe naye kefumviko.
Aamwahe yaJosef sho ya mono he a si, oya ti: “Josef pamwe ote tu tondo e te tu galulile shoka twa li twe mu ningile, sho twe mu ehamekele.”
Oya tumu elaka kuJosef tali ti: “Ho manga a li inaa sa,

okwe tu lombwele, tu ku indile ombili, ta ti: ‘Kuthila po aamwaho, sho ya li ye ku longele uuwinayi.’ Ngashingeyi tu dhimina po omayono ngoka tse, aapika yaKalunga kaho, twe ga longo.” Josef okwa lili, sho a taamba elaka ndika.
Aamwahe yo yene oye ya e taa inyongamene kuye e taa ti: “Otu li mpaka koshipala shoye, aapika yoye.”
Josef okwa ti kuyo: “Inamu tila. Kandi li peha lyaKalunga.
Omwa ningile shili uuwinayi, ihe Kalunga okwe u mu galulile uuwanawa, opo a gamene oomwenyo dhaantu oyendji mboka ye na omwenyo pethimbo ndika molwashoka sha ningwa po.
Itamu pumbwa okutila. Otandi mu sile oshimpwiyu pamwe naana yeni.” Osho ngaaka e ya ngungumaneke noohapu dhombili ndhoka dha talaleke oomwenyo dhawo.
Josef negumbo lyahe oya kala muEgipiti. Sho a si, okwa li e na omimvo ethele nomulongo.
Okwa kala e na omwenyo e ta mono aana yaEfraim naatekulu sigo aatekulululwa yepipi etitatu. Okwa kala e na omwenyo e ta mono wo aana yaMakir gaManasse ye ya mezimo.
Okwa lombwele aamwahe a ti: “Ondi li pokusa, ihe Kalunga ote ke mu dhimbulukwa. Ote mu tembudha mo mevi ndika e te mu fala kevi e li uvanekele Abraham, Isak naJakob nokugana.”
Nena Josef okwa ganitha aana yaIsrael e ta ti: “Uvanekelii ndje kutya Kalunga ngele te mu fala kevi ndiyaka, nane wo otamu fala ko iipongo yandje.”
Josef okwa sile muEgipiti mepipi lyomimvo ethele nomulongo. Oye mu gwayeke ya kukutike omudhimba gwe e taye gu langeke moshiketha shomudhimba muEgipiti.

1: Aana yaIsrael mboka ya yi kuEgipiti, kehe ngoka negumbo lye, oyo
Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Juda,
Issaskar, Sebulon, Benjamin,
Dan, Naftali, Gad naAser.
Omwaalu gwaantu ayehe mboka ya za muJakob, oya li omilongo heyali. Omwana Josef okwa kala nale muEgipiti.
Josef okwa si, osho wo aamwayina ayehe nepipi ndiyaka alihe,
ihe Aaisraeli oya li ye na aanona oyendji noyi indjipala noonkondo nokuudha evi.
Nena omukwaniilwa ngoka inaa tseya Josef, okwa lala Egipiti.
Okwa lombwele aantu a ti: “Aaisraeli mbaka oyendji noye na oonkondo ye tu vule.
Natu ya ningile po ondunge, opo yaa indjipale we; otaa ningi ya game kaatondi yetu, uuna tatu matukilwa, yo ya fadhuke po ya ze mo moshilongo.”
Aayegipiti oye ya thiminike niilonga iidhigu tayi ehameke oomwenyo dhawo. Aaisraeli oya tungu iilando Pitom naRameses, yi ninge iipungulilolando yomukwaniilwa.
Ihe mpoka pu thike Aaisraeli taa hepekwa, opo wo pu thike Aaisraeli taa indjipala noya taandele nevi alihe. Aayegipiti oya tila Aaisraeli
e taye ya thiminike ye ya tsike iilonga iidhigu yuupika taye ya longitha nonyanya. Oye ya tungitha omatungo noye ya longitha omapya noinaye ya yaalela nando.
Omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti okwa lombwele aavalithi yAahebeli Shifra naPua a ti:
“Ngele tamu valitha aakulukadhi Aahebeli, uumati u dhipagii po, ihe uukadhona u etheni u kale u na omwenyo.”
Ihe aavalithi oya tila Kalunga noinaa vulika komukwaniilwa. Oye etha uumati inaaye u dhipaga po.
Omukwaniilwa okwi ithana aavalithi e te ya pula ta ti: “Omolwashike mwa ningi ngeyi? Omolwashike mwe etha uumati u kale nomwenyo?”
Aavalithi oya yamukula ya ti: “Aakulukadhi Aahebeli kaa fele aakulukadhi Aayegipiti. Ohaa vala nuupu, uuhanona wawo otau valwa, manga inaatu thika ko nokuli.”
Molwashoka aavalithi ya li ya tila Kalunga, Kalunga okwe ya yambeke e te ya pe oluvalo lwawo yene. Aaisraeli oya tsikile okwiindjipala nokunkondopala.
Omukwaniilwa okwa gandja oshipango kaantu ye ayehe tashi ti: “Uumati auhe mboka tau valwa kAahebeli, u kuthii po, mu u umbile momulonga Niili, ihe uukadhona u etheni u kale u na omwenyo.”
2: Pethimbo ndika omulumentu gwomezimo lyaLevi okwa hokana omukiintu gwomezimo lye.
Omukiintu okwe mu valele okamati. Sho e ka mono okawanawa, okwe ka kutha e te ka holeke oomwedhi ndatu.
Ihe sho a nyengwa oku ka holeka, okwa kutha okatemba komanenge e te ka hoto neka. Okwa langeke mo okahanona e te ka tula momanenge komunkulo gwomulonga.
Omumwayina omukadhona gwokahanona okwa thikama mpeyaka, a tale, nkene taka ningwa.
Omuna gwomukwaniilwa omukadhona okwe ya komulonga i iyoge, manga aadhike ye taa kunkula nomulonga. Ohaluka okwa ndhindhilike okatemba ke li momanenge e ta tumu omupika gwe e ke ka tale mo.
Omuna gwokombanda okwe ka siikulula e ta mono okamati taka lili. Okwa li e ka uvitile ohenda e ta ti: “Okanona haka okAahebeli.”
Omumwayina gwako omukadhona okwa pula a ti: “Nandi ke ku talele omukulukadhi Omuhebeli, e ye e ke ku yamuthile okanona?”
Omuna gwokombanda okwa yamukula a ti: “Eeno, inda.” Omukadhona okwa yi e ti ithana yina yokanona.
Omuna gwokombanda okwa lombwele omukulukadhi a ti: “Taamba okahanona haka, u ke ka yamuthile ndje, e tandi ke ku futa.”
Okanona sho ka koko, okwe ka fala komuna gwokombanda, ngoka e mu taamba ongomwana. Okwi ipopile a ti: “Ndishi onde ka kutha momeya, otandi ka luku Moses.”
Moses sho a koko, okwa yi a ka talele po Aahebeli aakwawo nokwa mono, nkene taa longithwa iilonga iidhigu. Okwa mono nokuli Omuegipiti ta dhenge Omuhebeli, gumwe gwomaakwawo.
Moses okwa lengalenga koombinga noombinga. Sho a mono kutya kaku na omuntu, okwa dhipaga Omuegipiti e te mu fumvike mehekevi.
Esiku lyanofu okwa yi ko ishewe e ta adha ko Aahebeli yaali taa kondjo. Okwa lombwele ngoka a li e na uusama a ti: “Omolwashike to dhenge mukweni?”

Omudhengi okwa yamukula a ti: “Olye e ku ningi omuleli nomutokolihapu gwetu? Oto dhipaga ndje, ngaashi wa dhipagele Omuegipiti?” Nena Moses okwa tila nokwi ipopile ta ti: “Nani shoka nda ninga osha tseyika.”
Omukwaniilwa sho u uvu shoka sha ningwa po, okwa kambadhala a dhipage Moses, ihe Moses okwa fadhuka po e ta yi kuMidian. Sho a thiki ko, okwa kuutumba pomuthima.
Jetro, omuyambi gwaMidian, okwa li e na aakadhona yaheyali. Oye ya okuteka omeya, opo ya hugile oonzi niimuna yahe.
Ihe aasita yalwe oye ya tidha po. Nena Moses okwe ya popile e ta hugile iimuna yawo.
Sho ya shuna kuhe Reuel, okwe ya pula a ti: “Omolwashike nena mwa zi ko mbala?”
Aakadhona oya yamukula ya ti: “Omulumentu Omuegipiti okwe tu kanyutulula miikaha yaanahambo e ta hugile iimuna yetu.”
Reuel okwa pula oyana aakadhona ta ti: “Oku li peni? Omolwashike mwe mu thigile ko? Indeni mu ke mu ithane, a pewe iikulya.”
Moses okwa kala hoka, naJetro okwe mu pe omwana omukadhona Sippora, e mu hokane po.
Sippora e mu valele omumati. Moses okwi ipopile a ti: “Ngame ondjendi mevi ndika,” e te mu luku Gersom.
Momukokomoko gwomimvo omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti okwa si, ihe Aaisraeli oya li taa keme notaa kugu moluupika wawo. Onkugo yawo oya thiki kuKalunga,
ngoka u uvu ekemo lyawo e ta dhimbulukwa ehangano lyawo naAbraham, Isak naJakob.
Okwa mono okupikwa kwAaisrael e ta kala e ya ipyakidhilila.
3: Esiku limwe Moses sho a li ta litha oonzi niikombo yahemweno Jetro, omuyambi gwokuMidian, iimuna okwe yi tokolitha ombuga e te ya kuSinai, ondundu yaKalunga.
Omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwe mu ihololele momulilo gwa hwama moshihwa sheno. Moses okwa mono oshihwa sha hwama, ihe itashi lunguna po.
Okwi ipopile ta ti: “Ndika emoniko enene. Omolwashike oshihwa itashi lunguna po? Otandi ke shi tala popepi.”

Omuwa sho a mono Moses ta hedha ko, okwe mu ithana mokati koshihwa ta ti: “Moses! Mosesee!”
Moses okwi itaale a ti: “Ee.”
Kalunga okwa ti: “Ino hedha ko huka. Hula ko oongaku koompadhi dhoye, oshoka pehala mpoka wa thikama, opehala eyapuki.
Ongame Kalunga koohokulu, Kalunga kaAbraham, Kalunga kaIsak naKalunga kaJakob.” Nena Moses okwa siikile oshipala she, oshoka okwa li a tila okutala Kalunga.
Omuwa okwa ti: “Onda mono, nkene aantu yandje taa hepekwa muEgipiti; ondu uvu taa kugile emanguluko kaapiki yawo. Onda tseya omahepeko gawo agehe,

onkee nda kuluka ndi ya mangulule mAayegipiti noku ya tembudha muEgipiti, ya ye kevi lya mbwalangandja, evi lya tondoka omahini nomagadhi goonyushi, evi lya kalwa kAakaanana, Aaheti, Aayamori, Aaperesi, Aahevi nAayebusi.
Ondu uvu shili onkugo yaantu yandje nonda mono, nkene Aayegipiti taye ya thindile pevi.
Ngashingeyi otandi ku tumu komukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti, opo u tembudhe mo aantu yandje moshilongo she.”
Moses okwa ti kuKalunga: “Ongame lye? Ote vulu ngiini okuya komukwaniilwa nokutembudha mo Aaisraeli muEgipiti?”
Kalunga okwa yamukula a ti: “Ondi li pamwe nangoye, nongele wa tembudha mo aantu yandje muEgipiti, oto ka simanekela ndje pondundu ndjika. Shika otashi holola kutya onde ku tuma.”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Nge te yi kAaisraeli e tandi ya lombwele te ti: ‘Kalunga koohokulu okwa tumu ndje kune,’ otaa ka pula ndje taa ti: ‘Edhina lye olye?’ Nandi ya lombwele ndi tye ngiini?”
Kalunga okwa ti: “Ngame nda kala ngu NGAME-NDA-KALA. Oto ya lombwele to ti: ‘Ngoka haku tiwa NGAME-NDA-KALA, okwa tumu ndje kune.’

Lombwela Aaisraeli to ti: ‘Omuwa, Kalunga koohokulu, Kalunga kaAbraham, Kalunga kaIsak naKalunga kaJakob, okwa tumu ndje kune. Ndika olyo edhina lyandje sigo aluhe. Osho tandi ka tumbulwa komaluvalo nomaluvalo.’

Inda u ka hiye aakuluntu yAaisraeli ya gongale e to ya lombwele to ti: ‘Omuwa, Kalunga koohokulu, Kalunga kaAbraham, Kalunga kaIsak naKalunga kaJakob, okwi ihololele ndje e ta ti: Onde mu tala nondi wete shoka Aayegipiti taye mu ningile.
Onda tokola ndi mu tembudhe muEgipiti, moka mwa hepekwa nonyanya, notandi mu fala kevi lya tondoka omahini nomagadhi goonyushi, kevi lyAakaanana, Aaheti, Aayamori, Aaperesi, Aahevi nAayebusi.’

“Aantu yandje otaa ka pulakena shoka to ya lombwele. Nena otamu yi pamwe naakuluntu yAaisraeli komukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti e tamu ti kuye: ‘Omuwa, Kalunga kAahebeli okwe tu ihololele. Tu zimina tu ye ondjenda yomasiku gatatu mombuga, tu ka yambele Omuwa, Kalunga ketu, oontselelandjambo.’
Onda tseya kutya omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti ita ka pitika mu ye, manga inaa thiminikwa oku shi ninga.
Otandi ka taganeka oshikaha shandje nokudhenga Egipiti niikumithalonga. Oye note ke mu etha, mu ye.
“Otandi ka ninga Aayegipiti aanahenda nane, opo aantu yandje nge taa yi, yaa ze mo iikaha yowala.

Omukulukadhi kehe Omuisraeli ota ka ya kaashiinda ye nokomukulukadhi kehe Omuegipiti a kala maandjawo, a pule omizalo, oshingoli noshisiliveli. Niinima mbika naa yi zaleke oyana aamati naakadhona nokufaalela omauyamba gAayegipiti.”
4: Nena Moses okwa yamukula Omuwa e ta ti: “Ondu uvite, Aaisraeli itaa ka itaala ndje noitaa ka pulakena shoka tandi ti. Otaa ka tya: Omuwa ine ku ihololela.”

Omuwa okwe mu pula a ti: “Ou na shike moshikaha?”
Moses okwa yamukula: “Ondhimbo.”
Omuwa okwa ti: “Yi umbila pevi.” Moses sho e yi umbile pevi, oya shituka eyoka, nokwa yi ontuku.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Petama, u li kwate komushila.” Moses okwa petama e te li kwata, nolya shituka ishewe ondhimbo.
Omuwa okwa ti: “Shi ninga, u hololele Aaisraeli kutya Omuwa, Kalunga koohokulu, Kalunga kaAbraham, Kalunga kaIsak naKalunga kaJakob okwe ku ihololele.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses ishewe a ti: “Tula oshikaha shoye monkwapa yoye.” Moses okwe shi ningi. Sho e shi kutha mo, osha li sha kwatwa koshilundu, shi na iitotono iitokele.
Omuwa okwa ti: “Shuna mo ishewe oshikaha shoye monkwapa.” Moses okwe shi ningi nasho e shi kutha mo, osha li sha aluka sha faathana nolutu lwe.
Omuwa okwa ti: “Ngele itaye ku itaale, nenge ya tompwe koshinyengandunge shotango, nena shika otashi ke ya tompa.
Ngele iinyengandunge mbika iyali itaye yi itaale, nenge taa tindi okupulakena shoka to ti, teka omeya muNiili e to ga tile pevi. Omeya ngaka otaga ka shituka ombinzi.”
Moses okwa ti: “Aawe, Omuwa, ino tuma ndje, kandi shi kupopya. Osho nda kala nale nosho ndi li nena, sho wa popitha ndje. Ongame omunyengwi mokupopya, omukakadhali nomukokomi.”
Omuwa okwa ti kuye: “Olye a shitile omuntu okana? Olye te mu ningi ombolo nenge omuthitawi? Olye te mu pe omeho nenge te mu tsikitha? Ongame Omuwa.
Ngashingeyi inda! Otandi ke ku popitha notandi ku lombwele shoka to ka tya.”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Aawe, Omuwa, kwatha ndje u tume ko gulwe shila.”
Nena Omuwa okwa geele Moses e ta ti: “Mumwanyoko Aaron, Omulevi, ke ko? Ondi shi shi kutya oku shi kupopya nawa. Ote ke ku tsakaneka nota ka nyanyukilwa oku ku mona.
Oto vulu oku mu lombwela e to mu hokololele shoka e na okutya. Ne amuhe yaali otandi ke mu lombwela shoka mu na okuninga.
Ota ka ninga omupopi peha lyoye nokulombwela oshigwana peha lyoye. Oto kala wa fa Kalunga to mu lombwele shoka e na okutya.
Kutha ondhimbo yoye e to ka ninga nayo iinyengandunge.”
Moses okwa shuna kuhemweno Jetro e ta ti kuye: “Kwatha ndje ndi ye ndi ka talele po aakwetu muEgipiti, ndi tale, ngele oko ye li ye na omwenyo.” Jetro okwa zimine e te mu laleke nombili.
Manga Moses a li muMidian, Omuwa okwa ti kuye: “Shuna kuEgipiti, oshoka ayehe mbeyaka ya li ya hala oku ku dhipaga, oya sa.”
Moses okwa kutha omukadhi noyana aamati e te ya londeke kokasino nokwa yi kuEgipiti a humbata ondhimbo ndjoka Kalunga a ti ne yi kuthe.

Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses ishewe a ti: “Sho to shuna kuEgipiti, ka ninge koshipala shomukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti iinyengandunge mbyoka nde yi ku pe. Ihe otandi ka kukutika omukwaniilwa noita ka etha aantu ya tembuke.
Nena ou na oku mu lombwela kutya ngame, Omuwa, otandi ti: ‘Israel oye omumwandje osheeli.
Onde ku lombwele, u ethe omumwandje a ye a ka simaneke ndje, ihe ngoye owa tindi. Nena otandi ka dhipaga omumwoye osheeli.’ ”
Montanda mondjila yokuya kuEgipiti Omuwa okwa tsakaneke Moses, a hala oku mu dhipaga.

Nena omukadhi Sippora okwa kutha emanya lya tsa e ta kenke omwana omumati, nokapa okwe ka umbile koompadhi dhaMoses. Pamukalo gwefukaleko okwa ti kuMoses: “Oshili, ngoye ombushikimbinzi gwandje.” Omuwa nokwe mu etha, a hupitha omwenyo gwaMoses.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Aaron a ti: “Inda kombuga u ka tsakaneke Moses.” Aaron okwa yi nokwe mu tsakanekele pondundu yaKalunga e te mu thipi komilungu.
Moses okwa hokololele Aaron shoka Omuwa a popi, sho e mu lombwele a shune kuEgipiti. Okwe mu hokololele wo iinyengandunge mbyoka Omuwa e mu lombwele e yi tsakanithe.
Nena Moses naAaron oya yi kuEgipiti e taa hiya aakuluntu ayehe yAaisraeli ya gongale.
Aaron okwe ya hokololele ayihe mbyoka Omuwa a lombwele Moses. Moses kombinga ye okwa longo iinyengandunge ayihe montaneho yaantu.
Oyo noyi itaale. Sho yu uvu kutya Omuwa oku na oshimpwiyu nayo nokwa mono nkene taa hepekwa nonyanya, oyi inyongamene pevi noya galikana.
5: Moses naAaron oya yi komukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti noya ti: “Omuwa Kalunga kaIsrael ota ti: ‘Etha aantu yandje ya ka dhanene ndje oshituthi mombuga nokugalikana ndje.’ ”
Omukwaniilwa okwa ti: “Omuwa olye, ndi pulakene ewi lye nondi laleke Aaisraeli ya ye? Omuwa ngoka kandi mu shi noite laleke Aaisraeli.”

Moses naAaron oya yamukula ya ti: “Kalunga kAahebeli okwe tu ihololele. Tu zimina, tu ye ko ondjenda yomasiku gatatu mombuga, tu ka yambele Omuwa, Kalunga ketu, omafikilondjambo. Ngele itatu shi ningi, ote tu dhipaga po nuuvu nenge niita.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa ti kuMoses naAaron: “Omolwashike tamu kateke aantu, sho tamu tonyalitha aantu miilonga yawo? Indeni kiilonga yeni!
Aantu yeni oyi indjipala ye vule Aayegipiti. Ngashingeyi omwa hala mu kankeke iilonga!”
Esiku tuu ndyoka omukwaniilwa okwa lombwele aalongithi yaapika naawiliki yiilonga Aaisraeli ta ti:
“Etheni okupa aantu omwiidhi gwokutholomitha oondhopi. Naa ke gu ikongele yo yene.

Ihe naa gwanithe omwaalu gwoondhopi ngaashi shito, itapu kala nando ondhopi yimwe inaayi gwanithwa. Oyo aananyalo unene, nomolwashoka taa pula ndje, ndi ya laleke, ya ka yambele Kalunga kawo omafikilondjambo.
Iilonga yaantu mbaka yi ningeni oyindji, opo yi itule mo, yaa kale ye na olweedhe lwokupulakena oohapu dhiifundja.”
Aalongithi yaapika naawiliki Aaisraeli oya yi e taa lombwele Aaisraeli taa ti: “Omukwaniilwa ota ti, ite mu kwatha we omwiidhi gwokutholoma.
Indeni mu ki ikongele omwiidhi mpoka tamu gu mono, ihe omwaalu gwoondhopi omu na oku gu gwanitha.”
Aantu noya andjalala Egipiti alihe taa kongo omwiidhi.
Aalongithi yaapika oya dhiginine oku ya thiminika, ya gwanithe omwaalu gwoondhopi esiku kehe, ngaashi ya li haa ningi shito, sho ya li haa pewa omwiidhi.
Aalongithi yaapika Aayegipiti oya dhenge aawiliki Aaisraeli ya li haa tonatele iilonga. Oya ti: “Omolwashike aantu yeni inaa gwanitha omwaalu gwoondhopi, ngaashi haa ningi shito?”
Nena aawiliki oya yi komukwaniilwa noya yemata ya nyenyeta taa ti: “Nkeyama, omolwashike to tu ningi ngeyi?
Itatu pewa omwiidhi, ndele otatu lombwelwa, tu tholome oondhopi! Nongashingeyi otatu dhengwa, nando ombedhi oyi li koshigwana shoye.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa yamukula a ti: “One aananyalo. Inamu hala okulonga, nomolwashoka hamu pula ndje, ndi mu laleke, mu ka yambele Omuwa omafikilondjambo.
Shuneni kiilonga yeni! Itamu pewa we omwiidhi, ihe otamu gwanitha omwaalu gwoondhopi.”
Aawiliki oya dhimbulula kutya ngashingeyi oye li muudhigu, sho ya lombwelwa kutya otaa tholoma omwaalu gwoondhopi gu thike pungoka haa tholoma shito.
Sho ya zi po, oya tsakaneke Moses naAaron, mboka ya li ye ya tegelela.
Oya lombwele Moses naAaron ya ti: “Omuwa okwa mono shoka mwa ningi note ke mu geela, oshoka omwe tu tonditha komukwaniilwa nomalenga ge. Omwe ya pe egongamwele, ye tu dhipage.”
Nena Moses okwa shuna kOmuwa e ta ti: “Omuwa, omolwashike to hepeke aantu yoye? Omolwashike wa tumu ndje huno?
Okuza mpoka nda yile komukwaniilwa ndi mu lombwele medhina lyoye, okwa hepeke aantu yoye nonyanya. Ihe ngoye ino ninga sha u ya kwathe.”
6: Nena Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Ngashingeyi otamu ka mona shoka te ningile omukwaniilwa. Otandi ke mu thiminika, a laleke aantu yandje. Otandi ke mu thiminika, a tidhe mo aantu yandje mevi lye.”
Kalunga okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Ongame Omuwa.
Ondi ihololele Abraham, Isak naJakob, ngame Kalunga Omunankondoawike, ihe inandi itseyitha kuyo ngame mwene, ndi tseyithe edhina lyandje eyapuki, Omuwa.
Onda hangana nayo nondu uvaneke ndi ya pe evi lyaKaanan, moka ya li mo oondjendi.
Ngashingeyi ondu uvu ekemo lyAaisraeli, mboka ya pikwa kAayegipiti, ongame nonda dhimbulukwa ehangano lyandje.

Lombwela Aaisraeli kutya ngame otandi ya lombwele te ti: ‘Ongame Omuwa; otandi mu mangulula e tandi mu kanyutulula mo muupika wAayegipiti. Otandi yelutha okwooko kwandje kwoonkondo e tandi ya etele omageelo guuwehame notandi mu hupitha.
Otandi mu ningi oshigwana shandje mwene, ongame notandi ningi Kalunga keni. Otamu ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa, Kalunga keni, sho tandi mu mangulula muupika muEgipiti.
Otandi ke mu fala kevi ndyoka ndu uvanekele Abraham, Isak naJakob nokugana. Otandi li mu pe, li ninge eliko lyeni. Ongame Omuwa.’ ”
Moses okwa hokololele Aaisraeli shika, ihe inaye mu pulakena, molwashoka oomwenyo dhawo odha li dha lulilwa kuupika uululululu.
Nena Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses ta ti:
“Inda u ka lombwele omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti, a laleke Aaisraeli ya ze mo moshilongo she.”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Aaisraeli sho itaa pulakene ndje, ngele nduno omukwaniilwa? Ngame omusama mokupopya.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses naAaron ta ti: “Lombweleni Aaisraeli naFarao, omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti, kutya onde mu lombwela, mu tembudhe mo Aaisraeli muEgipiti.”
Reuben, osheeli shaJakob, okwa li e na oyana aamati yane. Oyo Hanok, Pallu, Hezron naKarmi; oyo ya li oohekulu yomaludhi ngoka ge na omadhina gawo.
Simeon okwa li e na oyana aamati yahamano. Oyo Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar naShaul, omuna gwomukulukadhi Omukaanani. Oyo ya li oohekulu yomaludhi ngoka ge ya lukilwa
Levi okwa li e na oyana aamati yatatu. Oyo Gerson, Kohat naMerari. Oyo ya li oohekulu yomaludhi ngoka ga lukilwa omadhina gawo. Levi okwa kala e na omwenyo omimvo 137.
Gerson okwa li e na oyana aamati yaali. Oyo Libni naShimei, noyo ya li ye na oluvalo olwindji.
Kohat okwa li e na oyana aamati yane. Oyo Amram, Izhar Hebron naUssiel. Kohat okwa li e na omwenyo omimvo 133.
Merari okwa li e na oyana aamati yaali. Oyo Mahli naMushi. Ngaka omaludhi gaLevi nomaluvalo gago.
Amram okwa hokana hegona omukadhona Jokebed e te mu valele Aaron naMoses. Amram okwa li e na omwenyo omimvo 137.
Izhar okwa li e na oyana aamati yatatu. Oyo Kora, Nefeg naSikri.
Ussiel okwa li wo e na oyana aamati yatatu: Mishael, Elzafan naSitri.
Aaron okwa hokana Elisheba lyaAminadab, omumwayina gwaNahshon. Elisheba okwe mu valele Nadab, Abihu, Eleasar naItamar.
Kora okwa li e na oyana aamati yatatu. Oyo Assir, Elkana naAbiasaf. Oyo ya li oohekulu yomaludhi gaKora.
Eleasar lyaAaron okwa hokana omuna gwaPutiel, e te mu valele Pinehas. Mbaka oyo aakuluntu yomazimo nomaludhi gondhikwa yaLevi.
Aaron naMoses oyo mboka ya lombwelwa kOmuwa, ya tembudhe mo Aaisraeli muEgipiti.
Oyo mboka ya lombwele omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti, a ethe Aaisraeli ya ye.
Omuwa sho a popi naMoses mevi lyaEgipiti,
Okwa ti: “Ongame Omuwa. Lombwela omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti ashihe shoka tandi ku lombwele.”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Ou shi ndje kutya ngame omukakadhali mokupopya, omukwaniilwa ota pulakene ndje ngiini?”
7: Omuwa okwa ti: “Otandi ke ku ninga wa fa Kalunga komukwaniilwa, namumwanyoko Aaron ote ke mu lombwela a fa omuhunganeki gwoye.
Hokololela Aaron ashihe shoka tandi ku lombwele, noye ta ka lombwela omukwaniilwa, a laleke Aaisraeli ya tembuke mo moshilongo she.
Ihe otandi ka kukutika omukwaniilwa, noite ke mu pulakena nando, kashi na mbudhi, nando ndi longe iitilithi oyindji muEgipiti.
Nena otandi ka etela Egipiti egeelo edhigu nokutembudha mo omazimo gaantu yandje moshilongo.
Aayegipiti otaa ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa, sho tandi yelutha okwooko kwandje ndi ya kondjithe e tandi tembudha mo Aaisraeli moshilongo.”
Moses naAaron oya ningi sho ya lombwelwa kOmuwa.
Pethimbo ndyoka sho taa popi nomukwaniilwa, Moses okwa li e na omimvo omilongo hetatu, naAaron omimvo omilongo hetatu nandatu.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses naAaron a ti:
“Omukwaniilwa ngele ote mu lombwele ta ti: ‘Ningii po oshinyengandunge shasha’, lombwela Aaron a umbile ondhimbo ye komeho gomukwaniilwa, oyo notayi shituka eyoka.”
Moses naAaron oya yi komukwaniilwa e taa ningi, ngaashi Omuwa e ya lombwele. Aaron oku umbile ondhimbo ye komeho gomukwaniilwa nomalenga ge, noya shituka eyoka.
Nena omukwaniilwa okwi ithana aanongo noompulile dhe, nokoonkondo dhawo dhuumpulile osho ya ningi wo.
Oyu umbile oondhimbo dhawo pevi, nodha shituka omayoka. Ihe ondhimbo yaAaron oye dhi nina po.
Omukwaniilwa okwa kukutike omwenyo gwe, ngaashi Omuwa a ti, ye ina pulakena Moses naAaron.
Nena Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Omukwaniilwa okwa kukuta unene nokwa tindi okulaleka aantu ya ye.
Inda u ke mu tsakaneke ongula, sho ta yi kuNiili. Inda nondhimbo yoye ndjoka ya shitukile eyoka, u mu tegelele pomunkulo gwomulonga.
Mu lombwela u tye: ‘Omuwa, Kalunga kAahebeli, okwa tumu ndje, ndi ku lombwele, u laleke aantu ye ya ye ye ke mu simaneke mombuga. Ihe ngoye ino pulakena sigo opo mpaka.
Ngashingeyi, Nkeyama, Omuwa ote ke ku ulukila kutya oye lye, sho ta ka longa sha. Tala ko, otandi dhenge omeya gomomulonga nondhimbo ndjika, nomeya otaga shituka ombinzi.
Oohi otadhi ka sa, nomulonga otagu ka nika unene; Aayegipiti itaa ka vula okunwa mo.’ ”

Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Lombwela Aaron a kuthe ondhimbo ye, e yi taganekele komilonga, komikanka nokomadhiya agehe gaEgipiti. Omeya otaga ka shituka ombinzi, notayi ka menka nevi alihe notayi ka kala momatenga nomiiyuma.”
Moses naAaron oya ningi, ngaashi Omuwa e ya lombwele. Montaneho yomukwaniilwa nomalenga ge Aaron okwa yelutha ondhimbo ye e ta dhenge omulonga, nomeya agehe gamo oga shituka ombinzi.
Oohi odha sile momulonga, nogwa li tagu nika nayi, nAayegipiti inaa vula we okunwa mo. MuEgipiti alihe omwa li mu na ombinzi.
Nena oompulile dhomukwaniilwa odhe shi ningi wo koonkondo dhuumpulile wadho, omukwaniilwa nokwa kukutike omwenyo gwe e vule nale. Okwa tindi okupulakena Moses naAaron, ngaashi Omuwa a tile.
Okwa shuna kuuwa we ye ina pupa ko kwaashika.
Aayegipiti ayehe oya hupu momunkulo gwomulonga, ya mone omeya gokunwa, oshoka oya li itaa vulu okunwa omeya gomomulonga.
Opwa piti omasiku gaheyali, Omuwa sho a dhenge omulonga Niili.
8: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Inda komukwaniilwa u mu lombwele u tye: ‘Laleka aantu yandje ya ye, opo ya ka simaneke ndje.
Ngele oto tindi, otandi geele oshilongo shoye noku shi siikila nomafuma.

Niili otagu ka ndumbakana omafuma, notaga ka za mo tage ya muuwa woye nomondjugo yoye yokulala nokombete yoye, osho wo momagumbo gomalenga goye nogaantu yoye, otage ya nokuli meziko lyoye nomiipana yoye yokukangela.
Otage ke ku nukila ngoye naantu yoye nomalenga goye agehe.’ ”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Lombwela Aaron a yeluthile ondhimbo ye komilonga, komikanka nokomadhiya, opo omafuma ga ndjituke ga siikile evi lyaEgipiti.”
Aaron okwe yi yeluthile komeya agehe, nomafuma oga ndjituka e taga siikile evi.
Ihe oompulile odha longitha uumpulile, nadho wo odha ndjitukitha omafuma ga holoka.
Omukwaniilwa okwi ithana Moses naAaron e ta ti: “Galikaneni Omuwa a kuthe po omafuma ngaka, notandi ka laleka aantu yeni ya ye, opo ya ka yambele Omuwa omafikilondjambo.”

Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Otandi nyanyukilwa oku ku galikanena. Utha ethimbo, uuna tandi ke ku galikanena, osho wo omalenga goye naantu yoye. Nena oto ka manguluka komafuma, noitaku ka kala we nando olimwe, shila omuNiili amuke.”

Omukwaniilwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Galikanena ndje ongula.”
Moses okwa ti: “Otandi ka ninga, ngaashi wa pula. Ngoye oto ka tseya kutya kaku na kalunga e thike pOmuwa, Kalunga ketu.
Ngoye, omalenga goye naantu yoye otamu ka manguluka komafuma noitaku ka kala we nando olimwe, shila omuNiili amuke.”
Moses naAaron oya zi pomukwaniilwa, Moses nokwa galikana Omuwa, a kuthe po omafuma ngoka u undulile omukwaniilwa.
Omuwa okwa ningi, ngaashi Moses a pula, nomafuma ngoka ga li momagumbo, momalundu nomuuwa, oga si.
Aayegipiti oye ga ndumbile moondumba oonene, nevi alihe olya nika komafuma.
Omukwaniilwa sho a mono omafuma ga si, okwa kukutike ishewe omwenyo gwe, naanaa ngaashi Omuwa a tile kutya omukwaniilwa ita ka pulakena Moses naAaron.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Lombwela Aaron a fundule ontsi yevi nondhimbo ye, nontsi otayi ka shituka uumbululu muEgipiti alihe.”
Aaron okwa fundula evi nondhimbo ye, nontsi ayihe muEgipiti oya shituka oomwe dha siikile aantu niimuna.
Oompulile odha kambadhala okulonga kuumpulile wadho, dhi hololithe po uumbululu, ihe odha nyengwa. Uumbululu odha li apehe,
noompulile odha lombwele omukwaniilwa dha ti: “Kalunga oye a ningi shika!” Ihe omukwaniilwa okwa li a kukuta, naanaa ngaashi Omuwa a ti, noina pulakena Moses naAaron.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Meneka ongula onene u ka tsakaneke omukwaniilwa, sho ta yi komulonga, u mu lombwele kutya Omuwa ota ti: ‘Laleka aantu yandje ya ye, opo ya ka simaneke ndje.
Ngele oto tindi, otandi ku geele noku ku tumina omatopola, ngoye mwene, omalenga goye naantu yoye. Omatopola otaga ka udha omagumbo agehe gAayegipiti notaga siikile evi alihe.
Ihe otandi yoolola mo omukuma gwaGoshen, moka mwa kala aantu yandje, noitamu kala nando omatopola. Otandi shi ningi, opo u tseye kutya ongame Omuwa tandi longo moshilongo shika.
Otandi ka ninga eyooloko pokati kaantu yandje naantu yoye. Oshinyengandunge shika otashi ka ningwa ongula.’ ”
Omuwa okwa tumu oshikogo shomatopola muuwa womukwaniilwa nomomagumbo gomalenga ge. Oshilongo ashihe shaEgipiti osha hepekwa nayi komatopola.
Omukwaniilwa okwi ithana Moses naAaron e ta ti: “Indeni mu ka yambele Kalunga keni omafikilondjambo, ihe omoshilongo muka tuu.”

Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Itashi opala oku shi ningila muka, oshoka Aayegipiti otaa ka hindwa komafikilondjambo getu giimuna mbyoka tatu ka yambela Omuwa, Kalunga ketu. Ngele tatu yamba iimuna e tatu hindi Aayegipiti pomafikilondjambo getu ye tu wete, otaye tu dhipaga nomamanya.
Otu na okweenda omasiku gatatu tu ye kombuga, tu ka yambele Omuwa, Kalunga ketu, omafikilondjambo, naanaa ngaashi e tu lombwele.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa ti: “Otandi ke mu etha, mu ka yambele Omuwa, Kalunga keni, omafikilondjambo mombuga, ngele itamu yi kokule unene. Galikanenii ndje.”

Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Mbalambala shampa nda zi mpaka, otandi ka galikana Omuwa. Ongula omatopola otage mu thigi po, ngoye mwene, omalenga naantu yoye. Ihe ino tu kotokela we nokwiimba aantu koku ka yambela Omuwa omafikilondjambo.”
Moses okwa zi pomukwaniilwa e ta galikana Omuwa,
nOmuwa okwa ningi, ngaashi Moses a pula. Omatopola oga thigi po omukwaniilwa, omalenga ge naantu ye; inaku kala we nando etopola limwelimwe.
Ihe nando ongaaka, omukwaniilwa okwa kukutike omwenyo gwe noina laleka aantu ya ye.
9: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Inda u ka lombwele omukwaniilwa kutya Omuwa, Kalunga kAahebeli, ota ti: ‘Laleka aantu yandje, opo ya ka simaneke ndje.
Ngele oto tindi ishewe oku ya laleka,
otandi ke ku tumina oshivu oshidhigu miimuna yoye ayihe: uukambe, uusino, oongamelo, oongombe, oonzi niikombo.
Otandi ka yoolola pokati kiimuna yAaisraeli naambyoka yAayegipiti; kape na oshimuna shAaisraeli shimwe tashi ka sa.
Ngame Omuwa ondu utha, ndi shi tsakanithe ongula yanakwasha moshilongo shika.’ ”
Esiku lya landula Omuwa okwa ningi, ngaashi a tile. Iimuna ayihe yAayegipiti oya si, ihe kape na nando oshimuna shOmuisraeli shimwe sha sa.
Omukwaniilwa okwa tumu okutala iimuna yAaisraeli, ihe inaku sa nando oshimwe. Ihe omwenyo gwomukwaniilwa ogwa li gwa kukuta, noina laleka oshigwana shi ye.
Nena Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses naAaron a ti: “Kutheni omutoko peziko gu udha omake geni; Moses ne gu gundile mombepo koshipala shomukwaniilwa.
Otagu ka gunduka gwa fa ontsi naEgipiti alihe, noshaa mpoka otagu tukula po iitumbuka mbyoka tayi ningi iilalo tayi ehameke aantu niimuna.”
Oya kutha omutoko e taa yi koshipala shomukwaniilwa. Moses okwe gu gundile mombepo, nogwe eta iitumbuka e tayi ningi iilalo kaantu nokiimuna.
Oompulile inadhi holoka ko we koshipala shaMoses, oshoka odha li dha kakata iitumbuka dha fa Aayegipiti ooyakwawo.
Ihe Omuwa okwa kukutike omwenyo gwomukwaniilwa, naanaa ngaashi a tile, nomukwaniilwa ina pulakena we Moses naAaron.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Meneka ongula onene, u ka tsakaneke omukwaniilwa u mu lombwele kutya Omuwa, Kalunga kAahebeli, ota ti: ‘Laleka aantu yandje, opo ya ka simaneke ndje.
Ngashingeyi otandi ke ku tumina omageelo gandje agehe, ge ku hepeke ngoye mwene, omalenga goye naantu yoye, opo u ke shi tseye kutya kaku na ngu a fa ndje muuyuni auhe.
Ando nde ku dhenge pamwe naantu yoye noshivu, ando wa kombwa po nale kombanda yevi.
Ihe opo ndi ku ulukile oonkondo dhandje, onde ku kaleke ko u na omwenyo, opo esimano lyandje li taandele nuuyuni auhe.
Ihe natango owa tangalala nowa tindi okulaleka aantu yandje ya ye.
Ongula pethimbo ngaandika otandi ka tukula oshikungulu shoompawe oshidhigu shoka inaashi tseyika nale muEgipiti okuza ketameko ndongo onena.
Ngashingeyi lombwela ayehe naayihe u yi na, yi kale megumbo meni. Oompawe otadhi ka lokela kaantu nokiimuna ayihe tayi adhika pondje notayi si.’ ”
Omalenga gamwe gomukwaniilwa ngoka ga li ga tila oohapu dhOmuwa, oga fala aapika yawo niimuna yawo, yi ondame meni megameno.
Gamwe inaga pupa ko kelondodho lyOmuwa noye ethele aapika yawo niimuna yawo pondje.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Yeluthila okwooko kwoye kegulu, noompawe otadhi ka loka mevi alihe lyaEgipiti kaantu, kiimuna nokiimeno ayihe yokelundu.”
Moses sho a yeluthile ondhimbo ye kegulu, Omuwa okwa zigike iikogo nomindundumo noompawe, nolwaadhi olwa tsu mevi. Omuwa okwa tumu
oshikungulu oshidhigu shoompawe, noombadhi odha li tadhi shelagana. Osha li oshikungulu oshitilithi inaashi tseyika kuEgipiti hela a za.
Oompawe odha nyanyagula muEgipiti alihe ashihe sha li pondje, aantu niimuna ayihe. Osha thepagula iimeno ayihe momapya nokuteyagula po omiti adhihe.
Omukuma gwaGoshen, moka mwa kala Aaisraeli, omo amuke kaamwa li nando ompawe yimwe.
Omukwaniilwa okwi ithana Moses naAaron e ta ti: “Nena onda yono. Omuwa oku li mondjila, tse naantu yandje otwa puka.
Galikaneni Omuwa! Omindundumo noompawe odha lunda pombanda! Otandi uvaneke oku mu laleka, itamu kala mo we muka olule.”
Moses okwa ti kuye: “Mbalambala sho tandi zi mo moshilando, otandi ka yelutha omaako gandje megalikano kOmuwa. Omindundumo otadhi ka mwena noitaku ka kala we oompawe, opo u tseye kutya evi olyOmuwa.
Ihe ondi shi shi kutya ne nomalenga goye natango ihamu tila Omuwa Kalunga.”
Iigwanga yoliina niishokelya oya li ya thepagulwa po, oshoka iishokelya oya li ya vala, niigwanga yoliina oya li ya sheneka oongala.
Ihe omaludhi gosiima inaga yonwa po, oshoka ogo ga hugunina okutiligana.
Moses okwa zi pomukwaniilwa e ta piti mo moshilando e ta yelutha omaako ge megalikano kOmuwa. Omindundumo, oompawe nomvula oya sheka.
Ihe omukwaniilwa sho a mono kutya omvula, omindundumo noompawe odha mwena, okwa yono ishewe. Oye nomalenga ge oya kukutike oomwenyo dhawo,
Ngaashi Omuwa e shi lombwelele Moses. Omukwaniilwa ina laleka Aaisraeli ya ye.
10: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Inda komukwaniilwa, oshoka onda kukutike omwenyo gwe noomwenyo dhomalenga ge, opo ndi tsakanithile iinyengandunge mbika mokati kawo,
nopo u wape okuhokololela aamwoye naatekulu yoye, nkene nda goyapaleke Aayegipiti, sho nda tsakanitha iinyengandunge mbika. One amuhe otamu ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa.”
Moses naAaron oya yi komukwaniilwa e taa ti kuye: “Omuwa Kalunga kAahebeli ota ti: ‘Sigo uunake to tindi okuvulika kungame? Laleka aantu yandje ya ye, opo ya ka simaneke ndje.
Ngele oto tindi natango, ongula otandi ka undulila oombahu moshilongo shoye.
Otadhi ka kala odhindjidhindji tadhi siikile evi. Otadhi ka lya po ashihe shoka sha thigwa po koompawe, nomiti ndhoka dha hupu ko.
Otadhi ka udha muuwa woye nomomagumbo gomalenga goye nogaantu yoye ayehe. Owindji wadho inau monika nokoohokulu, hela ya kalele kombanda yevi.’ ” Nena Moses okwa pilamene ko e ta shuna.

Omalenga gomukwaniilwa oga ti kuye: “Sigo uunake omulumentu nguno te tu talitha omalwa? Laleka aalumentu Aaisraeli ya ye, opo ya ka simaneke Omuwa, Kalunga kawo. Ou wete ko tuu kutya Egipiti otali ka teka po?”
Oyo noya galulile Moses naAaron komukwaniilwa, e ta ti kuyo: “Otamu vulu okuya, opo mu ka simaneke Omuwa, Kalunga keni. Oolye naanaa ya hala okuya?”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Atuhe otatu ka ya, aanona yetu naakulupe yetu. Otatu yi naana yetu aamati naakadhona, oonzi niikombo noongombe dhetu, oshoka otatu ka dhana oshituthi, tu simaneke Omuwa.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa ti: “Otandi gana kOmuwa kutya itandi mu pitika nando, mu kuthe aakulukadhi yeni naanona! Osha yela kutya ne omu na iipotha.
Aawoo! Aalumentu oyo ayeke naa ye ndati, mu ka simaneke Omuwa, ngele osho mwa hala.” Oyo noya tidha po Moses naAaron pomukwaniilwa.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Yeluthila okwooko kwoye kombanda yevi lyaEgipiti alihe, opo oombahu dhi ye. Otadhi ya e tadhi li po ashihe hashi koko, ashihe shoka sha hupu ko koompawe.”
Moses okwa yelutha ondhimbo ye, Omuwa nokwa pendutha ombepo yokuuzilo tayi pepe noshilongo omutenya nuusiku auhe. Ongula sho kwa shi, oombahu odha holoka.
Odhe ya miiluku nodha halakana noshilongo ashihe. Odha li iiluku iinenenene yoombahu inaayi monika nale, noinayi monika we.
Odha siikile evi ndele tali ti tuu tye. Odha li po ashihe sha thigwa po koompawe, niiyimati yokomiti. MuEgipiti alihe inamu kala we efo li li komuti nenge oshimeno sha ziza.
Opo mpoka omukwaniilwa okwi ithana Moses naAaron onkolonkolo e ta ti: “Onda yono kOmuwa, Kalunga keni, nokune.
Dhiminii ndje po oondjo dhandje lumwe natango ne mu galikane Omuwa, Kalunga keni, a kuthe po egeelo ndika lyeso pungame.”
Moses okwa zi pomukwaniilwa e ta galikana Omuwa.
Omuwa okwa pepitha ombepo yokuuzilo ya piluka tayi zi kuuninginino, ndjoka ya yelutha po oombahu e tayi dhi undulile mEkololo lyaSues. MuEgipiti inamu kala we nando ombahu yimwe.
Omuwa okwa kukutike omwenyo gwomukwaniilwa noina laleka we Aaisraeli, ya ka ye.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Yeluthila okwooko kwoye kegulu, nomilema omiluudhe thokothoko, ngomuntu oto hala u tye oto dhi kwata, otadhi siikile evi alihe lyaEgipiti.”
Moses okwa yeluthile okwooko kwe kegulu, nomuEgipiti omwa kala omilema thokothoko omasiku gatatu.
Aayegipiti inaa vula we okumonathana, nokape na we ngoka a zi maandjawo pethimbo mpoka. Mpoka pwa li Aaisraeli, opwa li uuyelele.
Omukwaniilwa okwi ithana Moses e ta ti: “Otamu vulu okuya, mu ka simaneke Omuwa; aakulukadhi yeni naanona yeni otamu yi nayo wo. Ihe oonzi niikombo noongombe dheni nadhi kale po.”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Tu pa wo iimuna mbyoka yoontselelandjambo noyomafikilondjambo okuyambela Omuwa, Kalunga ketu.

Aawoo, otatu yi niimuna yetu; itatu thigi po nando oshimwe. Tse yene otatu hogolola iimuna mbyoka tatu ka yambela Omuwa, Kalunga ketu. Nokuli inatu tseya iimuna oyini tatu ka yambela Omuwa, sigo twa thiki ko.”
Omuwa okwa kukutike omwenyo gwomukwaniilwa, noine ya etha ya ye.
Okwa ti kuMoses: “Za po pungame! Inandi ku mona we! Esiku to shi ningi, oto si!”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Owa popi dhu uka. Itandi ka mona we oshipala shoye.”
11: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Otandi tumu owala egeelo limwe komukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti naantu ye. Nena ote mu laleke mu ye. Nokuli ote ke mu tidha mo moshilongo.
Ngashingeyi lombwela Aaisraeli, ya lombwelathane ayeheyehe to ti naa hehele kaashiinda yawo iinima yiingoli noyiisiliveli.”
Omuwa okwa simanekitha Aaisraeli kAayegipiti. Eeno, nomalenga go gene wo naantu ayehe oya simaneke Moses omuntu omunene.
Moses okwa ti komukwaniilwa: “Omuwa ota ti: ‘Pokati kuusiku otandi taakana Egipiti,

nomumati kehe osheeli muEgipiti ota ka sa, okuza kosheeli shomukwaniilwa, ngoka te mu landula muukwaniilwa, sigo okosheeli shomukulukadhi omupika, ngoka ha tsu koshini. Iisheeli ayihe yiimuna wo oyi na okusa.
MuEgipiti otamu ka kala elilagano enene, noshinima shika inashi kala mo nale noitashi ka kala mo we.
Ihe kape na nokuli ombwa tayi ka gwedha Aaisraeli nenge iimuna yawo. Nena otamu ka tseya kutya ngame Omuwa tandi ningi eyooloko pokati kAayegipiti nokAaisraeli.’ ”

Moses okwa tsikile ko ta ti: “Omalenga goye agehe otage ke ya kungame e tagi inyongamene kungame nokwiindila ndje, ndi kuthe po aantu yandje ayehe, ndi ze po ndi ye. Konima yaambika otandi ka ya.” Nena Moses okwa zi po pomukwaniilwa a geya omulilo gwowala.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses e ta ti: “Omukwaniilwa ota ka tinda oku mu pulakena, opo ndi longe iinyengandunge iinene muEgipiti.”
Moses naAaron oya tsakanitha iinyengandunge mbika ayihe koshipala shomukwaniilwa, ihe Omuwa okwa kukutike omwenyo gwe, noina laleka Aaisraeli ya ze mo moshilongo she.
12: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses naAaron muEgipiti ta ti:
“Omwedhi nguka nagu ninge omwedhi gwotango gwomumvo gweni.
Lombweleni egongalo alihe lyaIsrael omakumagidho ngaka: Mesiku etimulongo lyomwedhi nguka omulumentu kehe na hogolole onzigona nenge oshikombo omolwaanegumbo.
Egumbo lye ngele eshona okumana po oshimuna ashihe, oye pamwe namushiinda naa topole oshimuna pokati pawindji waanegumbo ya gwanena shaa ngoka a lye.
Omu na okuhogolola onzi nenge oshikombo, ihe nashi kale oshilumentu shomumvo gumwe shaa na oshipwe.
Ongulohi yesiku etimulongo netine lyomwedhi egongalo alihe lyaIsrael nali yi dhipage.
Aantu naa kuthe ko ombinzi ye yi gwayeke kiikulo nopiipamba yomiyelo dhomagumbo ngoka tamu lilwa iimuna.
Uusiku mboka onyama nayi yothwe, notayi liwa niigwanga iilulu pamwe niikwiila inaayi tulwa efulika.
Onyama inamu yi lya ombihu nenge ya fumikwa, ihe yi lyeni ya yothwa ayihe, nomutse nomagulu nomandjandja.
Inamu hupitha ko yimwe yi thike kongula; ngele otapa hupu sha, shi lungunitheni.
Yi lyii po mbala, ne mwa zalela olweendo, oongaku koompadhi noondhimbo dheni pomake. Shika osho oshituthi shaPaasa shokusimaneka ndje, ngame Omuwa.
“Uusiku mboka otandi ka taakana evi lyaEgipiti, nokudhipaga aatango ayehe aalumentu, ayehe yaantu noyiimuna, note pangula iikalunga ayihe yaEgipiti. Ongame Omuwa.
Ombinzi kiikulo yomiyelo otayi ka kala endhindhiliko okudhimbululitha omagumbo moka mu li mo. Shampa nda mono ombinzi, otandi mu pitilile po noitandi mu etele oshiponga, sho tandi geele Aayegipiti.
Dhaneni esiku ndika li ninge oshituthi shelongelokalunga, li mu dhimbuluthe shoka ngame Omuwa nda ningi. Kaleni tamu li dhana nomaluvalo geni sigo aluhe.”

Omuwa okwa ti: “Omasiku gaheyali inamu lya iikwiila ya tulwa efulika; lyeni owala iikwiila inaayi tulwa efulika. Mesiku lyotango kuthii mo efulika alihe maandjeni, oshoka ngele ope na ngoka ta li oshikwiila sha tulwa efulika momasiku ngoka gaheyali, ita talwa we gwomaantu yandje.
Mesiku lyotango nomesiku etiheyali otamu gongala melongelokalunga. Omasiku ngoka inamu longa sha, ihe omu na ngaa okuteleka iikulya.
Dhiginineni oshituthi shika, oshoka mesiku ndika onda tembudha omazimo geni muEgipiti. Omathimbo agehe tage ya, omu na okudhana oshituthi mesiku ndika.
Okuza kongulohi yesiku etimulongo netine lyomwedhi gwotango sigo ongulohi yesiku etimilongombali nolyotango inamu lya oshikwiila sha tulwa efulika.
Omasiku gaheyali efulika inali monika mo momagumbo geni, oshoka shaa ngoka, omuvalelwamo nenge omukwiilongo, ta li oshikwiila sha tulwa efulika, ita ka yalulilwa maantu yandje.”
Moses okwa hiya aawiliki ayehe yaIsrael e ta ti kuyo: “Shaa ngoka gwomune oku na okuhogolola onzigona nenge oshikombo noku shi dhipaga, opo omagumbo geni ga dhane Opaasa.
Kutheni oshisopi noku shi yaya mokayo moka mu na ombinzi yoshimuna, ne mu gwayeke ombinzi kiikulo nopiipamba yomiyelo dhomomagumbo geni. Inapa kala nando omuntu ta piti pondje, sigo taku shi.
Omuwa sho ta taakana Egipiti ta dhipaga Aayegipiti, ota mono ombinzi kiikulo nopiipamba yomiyelo noita pitika omuyengeli gweso a ye momagumbo geni e mu dhipage.
Ne naana yeni omu na okuvulika koshipango shika sigo aluhe.
Sho tamu ka ya mevi ndyoka Omuwa a uvaneke oku li mu pa, omu na okutsakanitha omusindilo nguka.
Aana yeni nge taye mu pula taa ti: ‘Iinima mbino otayi ti ngiini?’

Otamu yamukula tamu ti: ‘Oyo eyambo lyOpaasa lyokusimaneka Omuwa, molwashoka a pitilila omagumbo gAaisraeli muEgipiti. Okwa dhipaga Aayegipiti, ihe okwe tu hupitha.’ ”
Aaisraeli oya tsu oongolo noya galikana.
Opo ihe oya yi noya ningi shoka Omuwa a lombwele Moses naAaron.

Pokati kuusiku Omuwa okwa dhipaga aatango ayehe muEgipiti okuza komuna gwomukwaniilwa, ngoka a li te mu landula melelo, sigo okomuna gwonkwatwa, ngoka e li mokakuma komeni lyevi; aatango ayehe yiimuna oya dhipagwa wo.
Uusiku mbwiyaka omukwaniilwa, omalenga ge nAayegipiti ayehe yalwe oya penduka noya lili. Omwa li oosa muEgipiti alihe, oshoka kamwa li nando egumbo moka inaamu sa omumati.
Uusiku tuu mboka omukwaniilwa okwi ithana Moses naAaron e ta ti: “Indeni, one nAaisraeli yeni. Zii mo moshilongo shandje; indeni mu ka simaneke Omuwa, ngaashi mwi indile.
Indeni noonzi niikombo noongombe dheni. Galikanenii ndje wo, ndi yambekwe.”
Aayegipiti oya ulumike aantu ye endelele ya thige po oshilongo shawo. Oya ti: “Otatu ka sa po atuhe, ngele itamu yi.”
Aantu oyu udha uuyo wawo nondombo inaayi tulwa efulika e taye u mangele miikayiwa noye u humbata komapepe gawo.
Aaisraeli oya ningi, ngaashi ya lombwelwa kuMoses, e taa hehela Aayegipiti iinima yiingoli noyiisiliveli noonguwo.
Omuwa okwa tula mAayegipiti ondjaalela ya yaalele Aaisraeli e taye ya pe shoka ya pula. Pamukalo nguka Aaisraeli oya faalele uuyamba wAayegipiti.
Aaisraeli oya zi muRameses yu uka kuSukkot. Ayehe kumwe aalumentu omayuvi omathele gahamano, aakiintu naanona inaa yalulwa.
Aantu yalwe aayeni pamwe noonzi niikombo noongombe odhindji oya yi pamwe nayo.
Mondombo ndjoka ya zi nayo muEgipiti, oya yotha mo iikwiila inaayi lulikwa. Ondombo oya li inaayi lula, oshoka muEgipiti oya tidhwa mo neulumo, noya li yaa na olweedhe okwiilongekidhila onguta.
Aaisraeli oya kalele muEgipiti omimvo 430.
Mesiku ndyoka omimvo 430 sho dha tsakana, omazimo agehe goshigwana shOmuwa oga tembuka muEgipiti.
Okwa li uusiku, Omuwa sho a tonatela nokwe ya tembudha mo muEgipiti; uusiku tuu mbuka Aaisraeli ayehe naa dhiginine ya kale ya tonata, opo ya simaneke Omuwa sigo okomaluvalo agehe.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses naAaron ta ti: “Omautho gOpaasa ogo ngaka: Kape na omukwiilongo ta li uulalelo waPaasa,
ihe omupika kehe ngoka we mu landa, ota vulu oku u lya, ngele we mu fukalekitha tango.
Kape na omweendanandjila nenge omulongi a hehelwa te u li.
Uulalelo auhe nau lilwe megumbo moka wa telekelwa; inau falwa pondje. Inamu nyanyula nando esipa limwe lyoshimuna.
Egongalo alihe lyaIsrael nali dhane oshituthi shika,

ihe inashi liwa kaafukolume nando. Ngele ope na omukwiilongo a kala mokati keni nokwa hala okudhana Opaasa, a simaneke Omuwa, nena fukalekitheni aalumentu ayehe yomaandjawo. Nena ota vulu okuyalulwa ngaashi omuvalwa Omuisraeli nota yi mongundu yoshituthi.
Omautho ngaka otaga kwatelele mo aavalwa Aaisraeli naakwiilongo mboka ya kala mokati keni.”
Aaisraeli ayehe oya vulika noya ningi, ngaashika Omuwa a lombwele Moses naAaron.
Esiku ndyoka Omuwa okwa tembudha mo Aaisraeli muEgipiti.
13: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Yapulilii ndje aatango ayehe aalumentu, oshoka omutango kehe Omuisraeli omulumentu nomutango kehe gwoshimuna ogwandje.”

Moses okwa lombwele aantu a ti: “Dhimbulukweni esiku ndika, uuna ndoka mwa tembuka muEgipiti, moka mwa li aapika. Esiku olyo ndika Omuwa e mu tembudha mo koonkondo dhe oonene. Inamu lya iikwiila ya tulwa efulika.
Otamu tembuka muEgipiti mesiku ndika momwedhi gwotango, omwedhi Abib.

Omuwa okwa uvanekele oohokulu nokugana e mu pe evi lyAakaanana, Aaheti, Aayamori, Aahevi nAayebusi. Shampa e mu fala mevi ndyoka lya tondoka omahini nomagadhi goonyushi, omu na okudhana oshituthi momwedhi gwotango omumvo kehe.
Omasiku gaheyali omu na okulya iikwiila inaayi tulwa efulika nomesiku etiheyali oku na oshituthi shokusimaneka Omuwa.
Omasiku gaheyali inamu lya iikwiila yi na efulika; moshilongo shoye ashihe inamu kala nande efulika nenge ondombo ya lulikwa.
Uuna oshituthi tashi tameke, fatululila omumwoye omumati kutya otandi ningi ngeyi, oshoka Omuwa okwe shi ningile ndje, sho nda tembuka muEgipiti.

Oshinima shika nashi kale edhimbulukitho lya fa lya mangelwa koshikaha shoye nenge li li moshipala shoye; otashi ku dhimbulutha okutsikila okutotomona nokwiilonga ompango yOmuwa, oshoka Omuwa okwe ku tembudha muEgipiti koonkondo dhe oonene.
Dhaneni oshituthi shika mesiku lyu uthwa omumvo kehe.”
“Omuwa ote ku fala mevi lyAakaanana, ndyoka e li ku uvanekele nokugana, nosho wo oohokulu. Shampa e li ku pe,
ou na okuyambela Omuwa omumati kehe osheeli. Osheeli kehe shiimuna oshOmuwa,
ihe oshi na okukulilwa, ngele osheeli shokasino, u yambe onzigona peha lyasho. Ngele ino hala okukulila okasino, teya othingo yako. Ou na okukulila osheeli shoye shomumati.
Konakuyiwa omumwoye omumati nge te ku pula kutya shika otashi ti ngiini, mu yamukula u tye: ‘Omuwa okwe tu tembudha muupika muEgipiti koonkondo dhe oonene.

Omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti sho a li a kukutika omwenyo gwe nokwa tindi oku tu laleka tu tembuke, Omuwa okwa dhipaga aatango ayehe aalumentu muEgipiti noyiimuna wo. Omolwashoka tatu yambele Omuwa omutango kehe gwoshimuna oshilumentu, ihe aana yetu aamati ohatu ya kulile.
Shika nashi kale edhimbulukitho lya fa lya mangelwa koshikaha shoye nenge li li moshipala shoye; otashi ku dhimbulutha kutya Omuwa okwe tu tembudha muEgipiti koonkondo dhe oonene.’ ”

Omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti sho a laleke aantu ya ye, Kalunga ine ya fala mondjila yu uka komunkulo gwaFilistia, nando oyo ya li ondjila ya tetula. Kalunga okwa ti: “Inandi hala aantu ya lundulule omadhiladhilo gawo e taa shuna kuEgipiti, shampa ya dhimbulula nani kutya otaa ka kondja.”
Ndele okwe ya fala nondjila ya dhingoloka mombuga yu uka kEkololo lyaSues. Aaisraeli oya li ya homata, sho ya tembuka.
Moses okwa kutha iipongo yaJosef, ngaashi Josef a uvanekitha Aaisraeli nokugana ye shi ninge. Josef okwa tile: “Kalunga nge te mu mangulula, omu na okufaalela iipongo yandje mu ze nayo mpaka.”
Aaisraeli oya zi muSukkot e taa ka yunga oontanda puEtam kooha dhombuga.
Omutenya Omuwa okwe ya tetekelele moshikogo shomuzile e ya ulukile ondjila, nuusiku okwe ya tetekelele moshikogo shomulilo e ya minikile, opo ya vule okweenda uusiku nomutenya.
Oshikogo shomunzile osha li aluhe komeho gaantu omutenya aguhe, nuusiku oshikogo shomulilo.
14: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli ya shune ya ka yunge oontanda peelo lyaPi Hahirot pokati kaMigdol nEfuta etiligane, popepi naBaal Zefon.
Omukwaniilwa ota ka dhiladhila kutya Aaisraeli otaye endagula noshilongo ya kondekwa kombuga.

Otandi ka kukutika omwenyo gwe note ke mu landula, ihe esindano lyandje lyokusinda iita ye otali ka simanekitha ndje. Nena Aayegipiti otaa ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa.” Aaisraeli oya ningi, ngashika ya lombwelwa.
Omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti sho a lombwelwa kutya aantu ya yi, ye nomalenga ge oyi itedhulula e taa ti: “Otwa ningi ngiini? Otwe etha Aaisraeli ya ye, e tatu kanitha aapika yetu!”
Omukwaniilwa okwa londo metembakwiita lye, netangakwiita lye oli ilongekidha.
Okwa piti mo nomatembakwiita ge agehe, mwa kwatelelwa mo ngoka omathele gahamano ga simana, taga wilikwa komalenga ge.
Omuwa okwa kukutike omwenyo gwomukwaniilwa e ta landula Aaisraeli mboka ya tembuka mo nomukumo.
Etangakwiita lyAayegipiti, uukambe wawo auhe, omatembakwiita naahingi oye ya landula e taye ya endje mo mpoka ya yunga oontanda pEfuta etiligane popepi naPi Hahirot naBaal Zefon.
Aaisraeli sho ya mono omukwaniilwa netangakwiita lye taye ya landula, oya haluka e taa kugile Omuwa ekwatho.

Oya ti kuMoses: “MuEgipiti kamwa li oombila nani? Owe tu tembudha mo, tu ye tu sile mombuga? Tala nduno shoka wa ningi, sho we tu tk
embudha muEgipiti.
Inatu ku lombwela nale kutya etha, tu longele Aayegipiti? Oshoka okukala muupika oku vule okusila mombuga muka.”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Inamu tila! Ikoleleleni ne mu tale ehupitho ndyoka Omuwa te mu hupitha nalyo nena ndjika; oshoka Aayegipiti mboka mwa tala itamu ya mono we sigo aluhe.
Omuwa ote mu kondjele, nane omu na okumwena thilu.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Omolwashike to kugile ndje ekwatho? Lombwela aantu ya hume ko.
Yeluthila ondhimbo yoye kefuta. Omeya otaga ka topoka pokati, nAaisraeli otaa ka enda mefuta puukukutu.
Otandi ka kukutika oomwenyo dhAayegipiti notaye ya landulile mo, notandi ka likola esimano mesindano lyandje, sho te sindi omukwaniilwa, aakwiita ye, omatembakwiita ge naahingi ye.
Shampa nde ya dhenge, Aayegipiti otaa ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa.”
Omuyengeli gwaKalunga ngoka a li komeho gosheendo shaIsrael, okwa lunduluka e ta yi konima yawo. Oshikogo shomunzile wo osha lundulukile konima yawo,
sha yi pokati kAayegipiti nAaisraeli. Kombinga yAayegipiti osha ningi omilema, ihe osha minikile Aaisraeli, onkee omatangakwiita inaga wapa okuhedhathana uusiku auhe.

Moses okwa yeluthile okwooko kwe kefuta, Omuwa nokwa tondokitha po efuta lya shunithwa kombepo ondhigu yokuuzilo. Oya pepe uusiku auhe e tayi kutha po omeya, omeya noga thikama. Omeya oga topoka pokati,
nAaisraeli oya yi mefuta taa ende puukukutu. Omeya oga thikama ga fa omakuma koombinga noombinga.
Aayegipiti oye ya landulile mo mefuta pamwe nuukambe wawo auhe, nomatembakwiita gawo naahingi.
Ongula yoontundumene Omuwa okwa talele Aayegipiti moshikogo shomulilo noshomunzile e te ya piyaganeke.
Omagulu gomatemba gawo oga yi montopo noya humu ko nuudhigu. Aayegipiti oya ti: “Omuwa ota kondjele Aaisraeli note tu kondjitha. Tu yeni ontuku.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses e ta ti: “Yeluthila okwooko kwoye kombanda yefuta, nomeya otaga siikile Aayegipiti nomatembakwiita gawo naahingi.”
Moses okwa ganeke oshikaha she kombanda yefuta, nopokutenda kweluwa omeya oga shuna kumwe ga kale ngashika shito. Aayegipiti oya kambadhala ye ga ye ontuku, ihe Omuwa okwe ya undulile mefuta.
Omeya oga shuna kumwe e taga siikile omatembakwiita, aahingi netangakwiita lyAayegipiti alihe ndyoka lya landulile Aaisraeli mefuta; inapa hupa nando ogumwe.
Aaisraeli oya taaguluka efuta puukukutu pokati komakuma gaali gomeya koombinga noombinga.
Esiku ndyoka Omuwa okwa hupitha Aaisraeli miikaha yAayegipiti, nAaisraeli oya mono omidhimba dhawo komunkulo gwefuta.
Aaisraeli sho ya mono, Omuwa nkene a dhenge Aayegipiti koonkondo dhe oonene, oya tila Omuwa; oyo noyi itaale Omuwa nomuntu gwe Moses.
15:
Omuwa oye oonkondo dhandje neimbilo lyandje;
oye tuu a hupitha ndje.
Oye Kalunga kandje, notandi mu tanga,
Kalunga katate, notandi mu imbile molwuunene we.

Omuwa oye ofule;
edhina lye Omuwa.

Aakwiita yAayegipiti nomatembakwiita gawo okwe ga umbile mefuta;
omalenga gawo ga simana okwe ga dhogele mEfuta etiligane.

Uulefuta we ya siikile;
oya ka ningina mo sigo okondaandelo ngomamanya.

Olulyo lwoye, Omuwa, olwa simana noonkondo;
olwa tetagula aatondi iintimbu.

Mesimano lyoye enene owa dhenge aatondi yoye;
ondjahi yoye ya hwama oye ya lungunitha ya fa iiyagaya.

Omuwa, olye ngo e ku fa mokati kookalunga?
Olye e ku fa meadhimo nomuuyapuki?
Olye ta vulu okulonga iinyengandunge niilongankondo e ku fa?

Owa ganeke okwooko kwoye kwokokulyo,
evi nolya nina po aatondi yetu.

Owa dhiginine euvaneko lyoye,
owa wilike oshigwana shoka we shi mangulula;
koonkondo dhoye owe shi wilike,
u shi fale kevi eyapuki.

Iigwana oye shi uvu, oyo notayi kakama;
Aafilisti oya kwatwa kehaluko.

Ehaluko netilo lye ya lambele.
Omuwa, oya tala oonkondo dhoye
noya pugalala ya kumwa ko,
osigo aantu yoye ya piti taa katuka —
aantu tuu mboka wa mangulula muupika.

Owe ya eta mo e to ya tsike kondundu yoye,
ehala ndyoka ngoye, Omuwa, we li ihogololele, li ninge onganda yoye,
otempeli ndjoka ngoye mwene we yi tungu.
Ongoye, Omuwa, to kala omukwaniilwa aluhe sigo aluhe.”
Aaisraeli oye ende mefuta puukukutu. Ihe omatembakwiita gAayegipiti nuukambe wawo naahingi sho ya yi mefuta, Omuwa okwe ya siikile nomeya gefuta.
Omuhunganeki omukiintu Miriam, omumwayina gwaAaron, okwa kutha okantunda ke, naakulukadhi ayehe oye mu landula taa hiki uuntunda yo taa tembula.

Miriam okwe ya yamukula ti imbi ta ti:
“Imbileni Omuwa,
oshoka okwa mono esindano enene;
uukambe naakayili yawo okwe undulile mefuta.”
Moses okwa kutha po Aaisraeli pEfuta etiligane e te ya fala mombuga Shur. Oye ende omasiku gatatu mombuga, ihe inayi itsa nando omeya.
Nena oye ya kehala hali ithanwa Mara, ihe omeya gamo omalulu inaa vula nando oku ga nwa. Omolwashoka ehala lya lukwa Mara.
Aantu oya ngungutulile Moses noya pula ya ti: “Otatu ka nwa shike?”

Moses okwa galikana Omuwa a pwila po, Omuwa nokwe mu ulukile oshiti shoka e shi umbile momeya, nomeya oga ningi omatoye, taga nuwa.
Pehala mpoka Omuwa okwe ya pe iipango, ye yi dhiginine nokwe ya makele.

Okwa ti: “Ngele otamu vulika kungame shili mokugwanitha shoka tandi shi tala shu uka e tamu dhiginine iipango yandje, nena itandi mu geele ndi mu undulile nando olimwe lyomomahepeko ngoka nde ga undulile Aayegipiti. Ongame Omuwa, ngoka te mu aludha.”
Esiku lyanofu oye ya kuElim, nkoka kwa li oothithiya omulongo nambali nomilunga omilongo heyali. Oyo noya yungu ontanda yawo pomeya.
16: Egongalo alihe lyaIsrael olya zi po puElim nomesiku etimulongo netitano lyomwedhi omutiyali, sho ya zi muEgipiti, oye ya mombuga Sin, ndjoka ya li pokati kaElim naSinai.
Mombuga moka oya ngungutulile Moses naAaron

noya ti kuyo: “Otwa hala Omuwa andola e tu dhipagelele muEgipiti. Hwiyaka otwa li hatu kuutumba poombiga dhoonyama niikulya oyindjiyindji ngaashi twa hala. Ne omwe tu tembudha mo, mu tu ete mombuga muka, mu tu sithe kondjala.”

Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses e ta ti: “Ngashingeyi otandi ke mu lokithila iikulya megulu. Aantu naa ye ko esiku kehe, ya ka toole iikulya ya gwanena esiku ndyoka alike. Pamukalo nguka otandi ya makele ndi tale, ngele otaa landula omapukululo gandje.
Mesiku etihamano oye na okweeta mo oyindji lwaali yi vule yesiku limwe, ye yi longekidhe.”
Moses naAaron oya lombwele Aaisraeli ayehe ya ti: “Ongulohi yonena otamu ka tseya kutya Omuwa oye e mu tembudha mo muEgipiti.
Ongula nge kwa shi, otamu ka mona eadhimo lyOmuwa. Okwa uvu omayemato geni, sho tamu mu nyenyetele — eeno, omwe mu tamaneke, oshoka tse otatu gwanitha owala omalombwelo ge.”

Moses okwa ti natango: “Omuwa ote mu pe onyama yokulya ongulohi niikwiila ya gwana ongula, oshoka oku uvu engungutulo lyeni, sho mwe mu ngungutulile. Hatse mwa ngungutulile, aawe, omwa ngungutulile Omuwa.”
Moses okwa lombwele Aaron a ti: “Lombwela egongalo alihe li ye li thikame koshipala shOmuwa, oshoka oku uvu engungutulo lyawo.”
Aaron manga tu uvithile egongalo, oye mu pilamene ya taalela kombuga, nohaluka eadhimo lyOmuwa olya holoka moshikogo.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:

“Ondu uvu omangungutulo gAaisraeli. Ya lombwela kutya peningino lyetango sho taku wiwile, otaa ka mona onyama yokulya, nongula sho kwa shi, otaa ka mona eloolo lyiikwiila. Nena otaa ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa, ngame oKalunga kawo.”
Ongulohi sho ye ya, okwa zi iimote oyindji noya halakana nontanda, nongula sho kwa shi, okwa li omume ya kunkula nontanda.
Omume sho ya kaha, okwa monika uunima uushuushuu wa fa uumuma uunenguni u li pevi. Owa li wa fa oompawe.

Aaisraeli sho ye u mono, inaye u tseya noya pulathana ya ti: “Shino oshikwashike?”
Moses okwa ti kuyo: “Mbika iikwiila mbyoka Omuwa e mu pe mu lye.
Omuwa okwa gandja oshipango tashi ti, shaa ngoka gwomune na gongele shi thike poompumbwe dhe, oshiyelekitho shogomer komuntu kehe maandjawo.”
Aaisraeli oye shi ningi, yamwe oya gongele oshindji, nayamwe oshishona.
Sho ye shi yeleke, mboka ya gongele oshindji, inaa hupitha ko sha, naamboka ya gongela oshishona, inaa kokota. Shaa ngoka okwa gongele pampumbwe dhe.
Moses okwe ya lombwele a ti: “Inamu yi hupithila ongula.”
Yamwe oye shi ningi, inaa pulakena Moses, e taa hupitha ko sha. Ongula sho kwa shi, oya li yu udha omazinyo noyo ola, Moses nokwe ya geele.
Ongula kehe shaa ngoka okwa gongele shi thike poompumbwe dhe, nomutenya nge gwa tsu, mbyoka ya hupu ko otayi hemukile mevi.
Mesiku etihamano oya gongele lwaali yi vule iikulya yesiku limwe, oogomer mbali komuntu kehe. Aawiliki yegongalo ayehe oye ya kuMoses e taye shi mu lombwele,

oye nokwe ya lombwele ta ti: “Omuwa okwa gandja oshipango tashi ti kutya ongula esiku eyapuki lyevululuko, lye mu yapulilwa. Telekeni shoka tamu teleke, ne mu pake po shoka tamu paka po nena. Shoka tamu hupitha, shi pungulileni ongula.”
Oya pungula, ngaashi ya lombwelwa kuMoses, sigo esiku lyongula noinashi yonuka nenge shi ninge omazinyo.
Moses okwa ti: “Shi lyeni nena, oshoka nena Esabati, esiku lyevululuko lya yapulilwa Omuwa, noitamu ka mona we iikulya pondje yontanda.
Omu na okugongela iikulya omasiku gahamano, ihe mesiku etiheyali, esiku lyevululuko, itaku kala sha.”
Mesiku etiheyali yamwe yomaantu oya yi ya ka konge iikulya, ihe inaa mona ko sha.
Omuwa okwa ti kuMoses: “Sigo uunake aantu taa tindi okuvulika kiipango yandje?

Dhimbulukweni kutya ongame Omuwa nde mu pe esiku lyevululuko, nomolwashoka mesiku etihamano tandi mu pe aluhe iikulya ya gwana omasiku gaali. Shaa ngoka na kale mpoka a kala mesiku etiheyali, ina za mo maandjawo!”
Ano aantu inaa longa sha mesiku etiheyali!
Aaisraeli iikulya mbyoka oye yi luku “Omanna.” Oya li ya fa oombuto oonshona oontokele, yi na omulyo gwa fa guumbisikiti womagadhi goonyushi.
Moses okwa ti: “Omuwa okwe tu lombwele, tu kuthe ogomer yomanna tu yi pungulile omaluvalo tage ke ya, opo ya mone iikulya mbyoka e tu palutha nayo mombuga, sho e tu tembudha muEgipiti.”
Moses okwa ti kuAaron: “Kutha okayo e to tula mo ogomer yu udha omanna. Ka tula koshipala shOmuwa, opo omanna yi pungulilwe omaluvalo getu.”
Aaron okwe yi tula komeho goshikethahangano, yi pungulwe, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Aaisraeli oya lile omanna omimvo omilongo ne, sigo ya thiki mevi lyaKaanan, moka ya tula.
(Ogomer yimwe oolita 20.)
17: Egongalo alihe lyaIsrael olya zi mo mombuga Sin, lya zi mehala limwe e tali yi kekwawo palombwelo lyOmuwa. Oya yungu ontanda muRefidim, ihe kamwa li omeya gokunwa.

Oya ngungutulile Moses noya ti: “Tu pa omeya tu nwe.”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Omolwashike tamu ngungutula? Omolwashike tamu hindi Omuwa?”
Ihe aantu oya li ya sa enota e taa tsikile okungungutulila Moses. Oya ti: “Omolwashike we tu tembudha mo muEgipiti? Ou tu dhipage po tse naana yetu niimuna yetu, tu se po kenota?”
Moses okwa galikana Omuwa e ta ti: “Aantu mbano otandi ya ningi ngiini? Oya hala nokuli ya dhipage ndje nomamanya.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Kutha aawiliki yamwe yAaisraeli e to yi pamwe nayo komeho goshigwana. Faalela ondhimbo yoye ndjoka wa dhengele nayo Niili.
Otandi ka thikama komeho goye pemanya pondundu Sinai. Dhenga emanya, nomeya otaga ka za mo, ga nuwe kaantu.” Moses nokwe shi ningi montaneho yaawiliki yaIsrael.
Ehala ndyoka olya lukwa Massa naMeriba molwashoka Aaisraeli oya tamanana noya hindi Omuwa, sho ya pula ya ti: “Omuwa omo tuu e li mokati ketu nenge aawe?”
Aayamaleki oye ya noya ponokele Aaisraeli muRefidim.

Moses okwa lombwele Josua a ti: “Ihogololela aalumentu yamwe, u ye u ka kondjithe Aayamaleki ongula. Otandi ka thikama kondungu yondundu nda yelutha ondhimbo ndjoka Kalunga a lombwele ndje ndi yi humbate.”
Josua okwa ningi, ngaashi Moses e mu lombwele, e ta zi mo a ka kondjithe Aayamaleki, manga Moses, Aaron naHur ya londo kondungu yondundu.
Moses shampa a yelutha omaako ge, Aaisraeli oya sindi, ihe shampa e endjeleleke omaako ge, nena Aayamaleki oya tameke okusindana.
Omaako gaMoses sho ga vulwa, Aaron naHur oya kutha emanya e taye mu kuutumbike ko, manga yo ya thikama kombinga nombinga ya yelutha omaako ge, ye ga yelutha sigo etango tali ningine.
Pamukalo nguka Josua okwa dhenge Aayamaleki e te ya sindi thilu.
Nena Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses e ta ti: “Nyola shika membo, shi ninge edhimbulutho. Lombwela Josua kutya Aayamaleki otandi ke ya hanagula po thiluthilu.”
Moses okwa tungu oshiyambelo e te shi luku “Omuwa oye epandela lyandje.”
Okwa tsikile a ti: “Yelutheni epandela lyOmuwa pombanda. Omuwa oku na olugodhi nAayamaleki okuza koluvalo sigo okoluvalo.”
18: Hemweno yaMoses, Jetro omuyambi gwaMidian, okwa kundana ashihe shoka Kalunga a ningile Moses noshigwana shaIsrael, sho e shi tembudha muEgipiti.
Okwe ya kuMoses, e etelele omukulukadhi gwaMoses Sippora, ngoka Moses e mu shunine kaandjawo.
Sippora okwe ya noyana aamati yaali, Gersom naElieser. Moses okwa tile: “Onda ningi omukwiilongo mevi lyuundjendi,” nokwa luku omwana gumwe Gersom.
Okwa tile ishewe: “Kalunga katate okwa kwatha ndje e ta hupitha ndje mokudhipagwa komukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti;” nosho a luku omumati omukwawo Elieser.
Jetro okwe etelele omukulukadhi gwaMoses noyana aamati yaali mombuga, moka Moses a li a yunga ontanda pondundu yaKalunga.
Okwa tumu elaka kuMoses kutya oye li mondjila taye ya.
Moses okwa piti mo a yi e ke mu tsakaneke. Okwe mu inyongamene e te mu thipi komilungu. Oyu uhalekathana nokupulathana, nkene ye li po e taa yi ketsali lyaMoses.

Moses okwa hokololele Jetro ayihe mbyoka Omuwa e yi ningile omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti naantu ye, opo a mangulule Aaisraeli. Okwe mu hokololele wo omaudhigu ngoka ya piti mugo mondjila nonkene Omuwa e ya hupitha.
Jetro sho u uvu ayihe mbika, okwa nyanyukwa
nokwa ti: “Omuwa na hambelelwe, ngoka e mu hupitha komukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti naantu ye! Omuwa na hambelelwe, ngoka a hupitha aantu ye muupika!
Ngashingeyi onda tseya kutya Omuwa oye omunene e vule ookalunga ayehe, oshoka a longo shika, Aayegipiti sho ya hepeke Aaisraeli noku ya dhina.”
Nena Jetro, hemweno yaMoses, okwe eta omafikilondjambo noontselelandjambo okuyambelwa Kalunga; naAaron naawiliki yaIsrael ayehe oya ka lya pamwe naye iikulya iiyapuki koshipala shaKalunga.
Esiku lyanofu Moses hela a kuutumbile tu utha iihokolola mokati kaantu, nokwa li e na uupyakadhi okuza ongula sigo ongulohi.

Hemweno Jetro sho a mono ayihe mbyoka Moses ta ningi, okwa pula a ti: “Aantu oto ya ningile ano ngiini? Omolwashike ongoye awike to longo, naantu ya thikama ngaa mpano ongula sigo uusiku taa pula omayele kungoye?”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Ondi na oku shi ninga, oshoka aantu otaye ya kungame yi ilonge ehalo lyaKalunga.
Uuna yaali ye na oontamanana, otaa ya kungame, nangame otandi tokola ngoka gwomuyo kee na uusama e tandi ya hokololele omautho niipango yaKalunga.”
Nena hemweno yaMoses okwa ti: “Omukalo nguka wa lamba kagu shi omwaanawa.
Oto ivulitha ngoye mwene naantu mbaka. Iilonga mbika iidhigu, ku yi vulu ongoye awike.
Ngashingeyi otandi ku pe omayele omawanawa, Kalunga nota kala pamwe nangoye. Kalela po aantu koshipala shaKalunga nokufala oontamanana dhawo kuye.
Ya nongeka iipango noku ya fatululila, nkene ye na okukala naashoka ye na okulonga.

Ndele hogolola mo moshigwana ashihe aalumentu yamwe ya yeleka, u ya langeke aawiliki yasho okutonatela oongundu dhomayuvi, dhomathele, dhomilongo ntano nodhomulongo. Naa kale aantu haa tila Kalunga, aainekelwa yo itaa pukithwa koombumbo.
Naa kale ethimbo alihe taa tokola oohapu. Iinima iidhigu ayihe naye yi ete kungoye, ndele yo otaa vulu okutokola oontamanana oonshona. Shika otashi ke ku pupalela, ngele taa topolelwa omutenge gwoye.
Ngele oto ningi ngeyi, ngaashi Kalunga ta ti, ito ivulitha nayi, naantu mbaka ayehe otaa vulu okuya kaandjawo ye na ombili.”
Moses okwa pulakene omayele gahemweno Jetro,
e ta hogolola aalumentu ya yeleka mokati kAaisraeli ayehe. Okwe ya langeke aawiliki yoongundu dhomayuvi, dhomathele, dhomilongo ntano nodhomulongo.
Oya tokola iinima ethimbo alihe. Iinima iidhigu oye yi fala kuMoses, ihe oontamanana oonshona oye dhi tokola yo yene.
Nena Moses okwa laleke hemweno Jetro, oye nokwa yi kaandjawo.
19: Aaisraeli oya zi puRefidim, nomesiku lyotango lyomwedhi omutitatu sho ya tembuka muEgipiti, oye ya mombuga yaSinai. Oya yungu ontanda ponyonga yondundu Sinai,

Moses nokwa londo kondundu kuKalunga.
Omuwa okwe mu ithana kondundu e te mu lombwele, a lombwele Aaisraeli, oluvalo lwaJakob, a tye:
“Omwa mono shoka ngame, Omuwa, nda ningile Aayegipiti, nonkene nde mu humbata, ngaashi ekodhi tali humbata uunimona komawawa galyo, nonde mu eta huka.
Ngashingeyi, ngele otamu vulika kungame e tamu dhiginine ehangano lyandje, otamu ningi aantu yandje mwene. Evi alihe olyandje, ihe ne otamu ka ninga oshigwana shandje sha hogololwa,
oshigwana sha yapulilwa ndje ngame awike, notamu ka ninga onkwaniilwa yaayambi.”
Moses nokwa londoloka e ti ithana aawiliki yoshigwana ya gongale e te ya hokololele ayihe mbyoka Omuwa e mu lombwele.
Nena aantu ayehe oya yamukula kumwe oshita ya ti: “Otatu gwanitha ashihe shoka Omuwa a popi.” Moses okwa fala eyamukulo lyoshigwana kOmuwa.

Omuwa okwa ti kuMoses: “Otandi ke ya kungoye moshikogo oshinene, opo aantu ya uve ndje tandi popi nangoye noye ku itaale.”
Moses okwa hokololele Omuwa shoka aantu ya popi.
Omuwa okwa ti kuye: “Inda kaantu u ya lombwele, yi iyapule nena nongula omolwelongelokalunga. Naa yoge oonguwo dhawo,
noyi ilongekidhile esiku lyahela. Mesiku ndyoka otandi kulukile kondundu Sinai montaneho yaantu.
Ninga ongamba ya dhingoloka ondundu, opo aantu yaahe yi taaguluke nando. Ya lombwela, yaa londe kondundu nenge ye yi gume. Ngele pe na ngoka te yi lyata ompadhi, na dhipagwe.
Na dhipagwe nomamanya nenge a yahwe niikuti pwaa na ngoka te mu gumu. Shika nashi ningwe, ngele omuntu nenge oshinamwenyo; nashi dhipagwe. Ihe enkuma ngele lya hikwa, nena aantu naa londe kondundu.”
Moses okwa londoloka kondundu e ta lombwele aantu yi ilongekidhile elongelokalunga. Oya yogo oonguwo dhawo,
Moses nokwa ti kuyo: “Ilongekidhileni esiku etitatu ne inamu lala naakiintu.”

Ongula yesiku etitatu okwa ningi omindundumo noombadhi tadhi shela, oshikogo oshinene osha holoka kondundu, nokwa uvika enkuma tali hikwa tali kugagana. Aantu ayehe montanda oya kala taa kakama kuumbanda.
Moses okwe ya piitha mo montanda, ya ka tsakaneke Kalunga, oyo noya thikama ponyonga yondundu.
Ondundu ayihe yaSinai oya kala tayi gundumuka olwithi, oshoka Omuwa okwa kulukile ko e li momulilo. Olwithi olwa gundumuka lwa fa olwithi lweziko enenenene, naantu ayehe oya li taa kakama noonkondo.
Ewi lyenkuma olya mbololoka nokukugagana pombanda. Moses okwa popi, naKalunga okwe mu yamukula mendundumo.
Omuwa okwa kulukile kondungu yondundu Sinai e ti ithanene Moses kondungu yondundu. Moses okwa londo,
nOmuwa okwa ti kuye: “Kulukila pohi, u ka londodhe aantu yaa taaguluke ongamba, ye ye yo ya tale ndje. Ngele taye shi ningi, nena oyendji yomuyo otaa si.
Nokuli aayambi taa hedha popepi nangame, oye na okwiiyapula, opo ndaahe ya geele.”
Moses okwa ti kOmuwa: “Aantu itaa vulu okulonda ko, oshoka owe tu londodha wa ti: ‘Ningila ondundu olugumbo, u yi yapule.’ ”
Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Kulukila pevi, u ka tale ko Aaron, mu ye naye. Ihe aayambi naantu inaa taaguluka ongamba, ya londe ye ye kungame, ote ningi ndi ya geele.”
Moses okwa kulukile pevi kaantu e te ya hokololele shoka Omuwa a ti.
20: Kalunga okwa popi oohapu ndhika a ti:
“Ongame Omuwa, Kalunga koye, nde ku tembudha muEgipiti, moka wa li omupika.
“Ino kala u na ookalunga yalwe koshipala shandje.
“Ino ihongela oshiyelekela nenge efano lyashaashoka megulu nenge kombanda yevi nenge momeya kohi yevi.
Ino yi inyongamena nenge u yi simaneke, oshoka ongame Omuwa, Kalunga koye, omulaadhi; otandi geele mboka haa tondo ndje sigo okoluvalo lwawo olutitatu nolutine.
Ihe otandi sile ohenda omayuvi mboka ye hole ndje notaa vulika kiipango yandje.
“Edhina lyandje ino li tumbulila iinima yowala, oshoka ongame Omuwa, Kalunga koye, tandi geele ayehe mboka taa tumbulile edhina lyandje iinima yowala.
“Dhimbulukwa esiku lyEsabati ngoye u li yapule.
Ou na omasiku gahamano moka to longo,
ihe esiku etiheyali olyo esiku lyevululuko lya yapulilwa ndje. Mesiku ndyoka kape na ngoka ta longo — ngoye mwene, aamwoye, aapika yoye, iimuna yoye nenge aakwiilongo ya kala moshilongo sheni.
Momasiku gahamano ngame, Omuwa, onda shiti egulu nevi nefuta naayihe yi li mo, ihe mesiku etiheyali onda vululukwa. Omolwashoka ngame, Omuwa, nda yambeke esiku lyEsabati nonde li yapula.
“Simaneka ho nanyoko, opo u kale u na omwenyo omule mevi ndyoka tandi ke li ku pa.
“Ino dhipaga.
“Ino hondela.
“Ino yaka.
“Ino lundila mukweni.
“Ino haluka egumbo lyamukweni; ino haluka omukiintu gwamukweni, omupika gwe, oongombe nenge uusino we, nenge eliko lye kehe.”
Aantu sho yu uvu endundumo nenkuma tali hikwa e taa mono olwaadhi nondundu sho tayi gundumuka olwithi, oya kwatwa kehaluko noya thikama kokule.
Oya ti kuMoses: “Ngele to tu uvithile, otatu pulakene; ihe otwa tila kutya Omuwa ngele te tu uvithile, otatu ningi tu se.”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Inamu tila; Kalunga ote mu yeleke owala, ngele ohamu mu tila tuu, opo mwaa yone.”
Ihe aantu oya kala ngaa kokule, Moses awike a hedha popepi noshikogo oshiluudhe, moka mwa li Kalunga.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a lombwele Aaisraeli a tye: “One yene mwa mono nkene ngame, Omuwa, nde mu uvithile okuza kegulu.
Inamu ihambulila iikalunga yoshisiliveli nenge yoshingoli, mu yi longele ponto yandje.
