Tungilii ndje oshiyambelo shevi, ne mu yambelele ndje ko omafikilondjambo nomakwatathanondjambo goonzi nogoongombe dheni. Mehala kehe nda hala edhina lyandje li simanekwe, otandi ya kune notandi mu yambeke.
Ngele tamu tungu oshiyambelo shomamanya, inamu tunga shomamanya ga hongwa, oshoka uuna tamu longitha epanda, otamu ga nyateke gaa opalele ndje we.
Inamu tungila ndje oshiyambelo shi na iilyatelelo yokulondela ko. Ngele tamu shi ningi, epenge lyeni otali monika, sho tamu londo ko.”
21: “Longa Aaisraeli oompango ndhika:
Ngele to landa omupika Omuhebeli, ne ku longele omimvo hamano. Momumvo omutiheyali oku na okumangululwa pwaa na iifuta yasha.
Ngele okwa ningi omupika gwoye, manga inaa ya mondjokana, ina ya nomukiintu nge ta manguluka, ihe ngele okwa li mondjokana, sho a ningi omupika gwoye, nena na ye nomukadhi.
Ngele omwene gwe te mu pe omukiintu e te mu valele aamati naakadhona, nena omukiintu naanona oyamwene gwe, nomulumentu ota yi awike.
Ihe ngele omupika ota ti, ye oku hole mwene gwe, omukadhi noyana noina hala okumanguluka,
nena mwene gwe ne mu fale kehala lyelongelokalunga e te mu tula pomweelo nenge piikulo yomweelo e tu ulula okutsi kwe noniho. Nena ota kala omupika gwe sigo aluhe.
“Ngele oku na omuntu ta landitha po omwana omukadhona a ninge omupika, ina mangululwa, ngaashi aapika aalumentu haa ningwa.
Ngele okwa landithwa po kungoka e mu hala a ninge omukadhi, ihe ine mu hala we, nena ne mu landithulule po, a shune kuhe; mwene gwe ita vulu oku mu landitha po kaakwiilongo, oshoka okwe mu henge po.
Ngele oku na omuntu ta landa omupika omukiintu, e mu pe omwana, nena na kale naye ngaashi omwana omukadhona.
Ngele ope na omuntu tu ushike omukiintu omutiyali, oku na okupa omukadhi gwotango natango iikulya, omizalo nuuthemba mboka a kala nawo nale.
Ngele ite mu gwanithile mbika itatu, ne mu ethe a ye pwaa na iikahu yasha.”
“Ngele oku na ngoka ta dhenge omuntu e ta si, na dhipagwe.
Ihe ngele oshiponga shohaluka, molwashoka ina dhiladhila a dhipage omuntu, nena ota vulu okufadhuka po, a ye kehala ndyoka tandi mu hogololele nota hupu.
Ihe uuna omuntu a geya e ta dhipaga mukwawo owina, na dhipagwe, nonando na ka holame koshiyambelo.
“Ngele oku na ngoka ta dhenge he nenge yina, na dhipagwe.
“Ngele ope na ngoka ta yaka po omuntu, ashihe shimwe ngele te mu landitha po nenge ta ningi omupika gwe, na dhipagwe.
“Ngele oku na ngoka ta tuku he nenge yina, na dhipagwe.
“Ngele oku na olugodhi, nagumwe ta dhenge mukwawo nemanya nenge nongonyo, ye ine mu dhipaga, nena ina geelwa. Ngele omudhengwa okwa kala momulalo,
nokomeho okwa aluka e ta yi pondje ti itsile koshiti, ngoka e mu dhengele oku na oku mu futila ethimbo lye ndyoka a kanitha noku mu sila oshimpwiyu, sigo a ti po nawa.
“Ngele oku na ngoka ta kutha oshitago e ta dhenge omupika gwe omulumentu nenge omukiintu, nomupika ta sile miikaha ye, na geelwe.
Ihe ngele omupika ina sa esiku ndyoka nenge konima yomasiku gaali, nena mwene gwe ina geelwa, oshoka oye eliko lye.
“Ngele oku na omukiintu omusimba, ndele ela tali gu mo, ye ina mona we oshiponga shilwe, ngoka e mu ehameke na fute, omulume shoka ta pula, nongaashi aatokolihapu ya koleke.
Ihe ngele omukiintu mwene oye a si, nena egeelo otali pula omwenyo gu futwe nomwenyo,
eho okeho, eyego okeyego, oshikaha okoshikaha, ompadhi okompadhi,
efiko okefiko, oshilalo okoshilalo, ombole okombole.
“Ngele ope na omuntu ta dhenge omupika gwe omulumentu nenge omukiintu keho e tali tsipuka mo, nena ne mu mangulule omolweho lye.
Ngele ota kula mo eyego lyomupika, ne mu mangulule omolweyego lye.”
“Ongombe ngele tayi tsu omuntu e ta si, nayi dhipagwe nomamanya, nonyama yayo inayi liwa, ihe mwene gwayo ina geelwa.
Ihe ongombe ngele ohayi tsu aantu, namwene okwe shi lombwelwa noine yi edhilila moshili — nena nge tayi tsu omuntu e ta si, nayi dhipagwe nomamanya, ndele namwene gwayo na dhipagwe wo.
Mwene gwayo ngele okwa ziminwa a fute oshikolo, a hupithe omwenyo gwe, nena na fute omwaalu aguhe gwa pulwa.
Ongombe ngele otayi tsu omumati nenge omukadhona e ta si, osho ngaa tashi ningwa, ngaashi sha tiwa.
Ongombe ngele otayi tsu omupika omulumentu nenge omukiintu e ta si, mwene gwayo na fute mwene gwomupika iimaliwa iisiliveli omilongo ndatu, nongombe nayi dhipagwe nomamanya.
“Ngele oku na omuntu itaa siikile onyombo, nenge te yi hupu ye ite yi siikile, ndele ongombe nenge okasino taka gwile mo,
na fute oshimuna shoka. Iimaliwa mbyoka ne yi pe mwene gwasho ye ta kala noshimuna shoka sha sa.
Ngele ongombe yomuntu tayi tsu ongombe yamukwawo e tayi si, nena aantu ayehe yaali naa landithe po ongombe yi na omwenyo, yo ya topolelathane iimaliwa. Otaa topolelathana wo onyama yongombe ya sa.
Ihe ngele okwa tseyika kutya ongombe ndjoka ohayi tsana, namwene gwayo ine yi dhiginina, nena na gandje ongombe yi na omwenyo ye a kuthe po ndjoka ya sa.”
22: “Ngele oku na omuntu ta yaka ongombe nenge onzi e te yi dhipaga nenge te yi landitha po, na fute oongombe ntano mongombe yimwe, noonzi ne monzi yimwe.

Na fute shoka a yaka. Ngele ke na sha, na landithwe po a ninge omupika, opo a fute shoka a yaka. Ngele oshimuna sha yakwa — ongombe nenge okasino nenge onzi — tashi monika miimuna ye, ota futu iyali molwoshimuna shimwe.
“Omufuthi ngele ota fulu egumbo uusiku e ta kwatwa nota dhipagwa, nena ngoka e mu dhipaga ke na ondjo yedhipago. Ihe ngele otashi ningwa omutenya, nena oku na ondjo yedhipago.

“Ngele oku na omuntu te etha iimuna ye yi ye mepya nenge moshitsambe shomiviinu e tayi lyatagula mo nokulya po iimeno ya mena mepya lyamukwawo, na kuthe miilikolwa yomepya nenge moshitsambe she shomiviinu e yi fute.

“Ngele ope na omuntu ta hwameke omulilo mepya lye e tagu taandele sigo okepya lyaantu e tagu fike po iilya mbyoka tayi koko nenge mbyoka ya teywa noya ndumbilwa, omutomeki gwomulilo na fute oshiponga shoka.
“Ngele ope na omuntu ta zimine okupungula iimaliwa nenge iinima yilwe yamukwawo e tayi yakwa mo megumbo lye, omufuthi ngele okwa monika, na fute ayihe oohiyali.
Ihe omufuthi ngele ina monika, omuntu ngoka a li a pungula iinima, ne etwe kehala lyelongelokalunga, noko nkoka ta gana kutya ye ina yaka iinima yaantu.

“Moontamanana adhihe dhomaliko, mwa kwatelelwa oongombe, uusino, oonzi, omizalo nenge ekanitho lyasha shilwe, aantu mboka taa tamananene eliko, naa falwe kehala lyelongelokalunga. Ngoka ta hololwa kuKalunga kutya oye omunandjo, na fute mukwawo lwaali.

“Ngele ope na omuntu ta zimine a kale nokasino kamukwawo nenge ongombe nenge onzi nenge oshimuna shilwe, noshimuna tashi si nenge tashi mono oshiponga nenge tashi yiwa nasho mokuluwa, nongele kaku na oonzapo,
omuntu ngoka na ye kehala lyelongelokalunga e ta gana kutya ye ina yaka oshimuna shomuntu. Oshimuna ngele inashi yakwa, mwene gwasho ita futwa sha, nomudhiginini ita pumbwa okufuta sha;
ihe oshimuna ngele osha yakwa po, omudhiginini na fute mwene gwasho.
Ngele osha lika po kiilikama, omudhiginini ne ete iipongo yi ninge onzapo; ita pumbwa okufuta shoka sha lika po kiilikama.
“Ngele ope na omuntu ta hehela mukwawo oshimuna notashi adhika koshiponga nenge tashi si mwene manga kee po, oku na oku shi futa.
Ihe ngele osha ningwa mwene opo e li, nena ita futu. Ngele oshimuna osha hehelwa, ekanithopo olya siikilwa kiimaliwa yehehelo.”
“Ngele ope na omuntu ta pukitha omukadhonalela inaa yalekwa e ta lala naye, oku na okufuta iikulila yuukadhona we ye e te mu hokana po.
Ihe ngele he ota tindi e mu hokane po, nena na fute he iimaliwa yi thike piikulila yaafuko.
“Ino etha omukiintu ompulile a kale e na omwenyo.
“Omulumentu kehe ta lala noshimuna, na se.
“Shaa ngoka ta yambele kalunga kalwe kee shi ngame, Omuwa, na pangulilwe eso.
“Ino ehameka omukwiilongo nenge u mu thindile kongundhi; dhimbulukwa kutya ne omwa li aakwiilongo muEgipiti.
Inamu ehameka omuselekadhi kehe nenge othigwa.
Ngele tamu shi ningi, ngame, Omuwa, otandi ya uvu, sho taa kugile ndje ekwatho,
notandi ka geya notandi mu dhipagele miita. Aakulukadhi yeni otaa ka ninga aaselekadhi naana yeni oothigwa.
“Ngele ope na gumwe gwomaantu yandje ohepele te ku lile oongunga dhiimaliwa, ino mu thiminika wa fa omugandjingunga omulandithi, ngoye ino tegelela ontanitho kuye.
Ngele ope na ngoka to mu kutha elwaakani lye ombambyona, opo e ku fute, ou na oku li mu shunithila, etango manga inaali ningina,
Oshoka olyo alike eisiikilo lye lyoku mu shiga kuutalala. Ota vulu okukotha ngiini kee li na? Ngele ta kugile ndje ekwatho, otandi ke mu uva, oshoka ngame omunamutimahenda.
“Ino tuka Kalunga, ngoye ino sheka omuleli gwoshilongo shaandjeni.

“Ino dhikaleka omayambo taga zi miilya yoye nomomaviinu goye.
“Pe ndje osheeli shomaana yoye aamati.
Pe ndje iisheeli yiimuna yoye yoongombe noyoonzi. Iisheeli nayi kale pooyina omasiku gaheyali, nomesiku etiheyali otayi yambelwa ndje.
“One aantu yandje aayapuki. Inamu lya onyama ya lika kiilikama mokuti; yi umbileni oombwa.”
23: “Ino taandelitha oluhoko, ngoye ino kwatha omunandjo mokugandja uumbangi wiifundja.
Ino landula ongundu muuwinayi nenge u gandje pamwe nongundu uumbangi mboka tau goyokitha uuyuuki.
Ino tondola ohepele, nge tayi tamanekwa.
“Ngele owi itsu ongombe nenge okasino komutondi gwoye ka kanena mokuti, ka shunithila kumwene.
Ngele okasino ke oka gundikwa komutenge gwako, mu kwatha mu kutulule okasino.
“Ino pataneka uuyuuki wohepele, uuna ta pangulwa.
Ino gandja uusama wiifundja, ngoye ino dhipagitha omuntu kee na ondjo, oshoka otandi pangula ayehe mboka ya tya ngaaka.
Ino taamba ombumbo, oshoka ombumbo otayi posipaleke aantu okulonga uuyuuki notayi goyokitha omukanka gwaakaanandjo.
“Ino ehameka omukwiilongo; ou shi shi nkene omukwiilongo e li, oshoka omwa li aakwiilongo muEgipiti.”
“Kuna epya lyoye omimvo hamano nou pungule shoka to likola mo.

Ihe momumvo omutiheyali li etha li vululukwe, ino teya shoka shi imenitha mo. Oohepele oyo naa lye shoka sha mena mo, naashoka ya thigi mo, nashi liwe kiiyamakuti. Osho wo to ningi oshitsambe shoye shomiviinu noshomiolivi.
“Longa omasiku gahamano, ihe ino longa mesiku etiheyali, opo aapika yoye naakwiilongo mboka haye ku longele, nokuli niimuna yoye otayi vulu okuvululukwa.
“Dhiginina adhihe ndhoka ngame, Omuwa, nde ku lombwela. Ino galikana ookalunga yalwe; ino tumbula nokuli omadhina gawo.”
“Dhaneni iituthi itatu momumvo, mu simaneke ndje.

Momwedhi Abib, omwedhi ngoka mwa tembuka muEgipiti, dhaneni Oshituthi shiikwiila inaayi tulwa efulika pamukalo ngoka nde mu lombwele. Inamu lya oshikwiila sha tulwa efulika momasiku gaheyali goshituthi. Koshipala shandje inamu holoka mu li iikaha yowala.

Dhaneni Oshituthi shoshipe, uuna tamu tameke okuteya iilya yeni.
“Dhaneni Oshituthi shokulikola, sho tamu likola iiyimati miitsambe yeni pehulilo lyomumvo.
Omumvo kehe miituthi mbika itatu aalumentu yeni ayehe oye na okuya, ya simaneke ndje, ngame, Omuwa, Kalunga keni.
“Ino yamba iikwiila ya tulwa efulika pamwe nombinzi yiimuna. Oofu dhiimuna nadhi yambelwe ndje momasiku giituthi, dhaa hupe ko sigo ongula tayi landula.

“Omumvo kehe eta kongulu yOmuwa, Kalunga koye, oshipe shomepya lyoye.
“Onyama yokanzona nenge yokakombwena ino yi teleka momahini gayina.”
“Otandi ku tumine omuyengeli, e ku gamene mondjila noku ku kwatela komeho, sho to ende to yi kehala hoka nde ku longekidhile.
Mu pulakena ngoye u vulike kuye. Ino mu tsila ondumbo, oshoka ongame nde mu tumu, noye ita ka vula okwiidhidhimikila oondumbo.
Ihe ngele oto vulika kuye, e to ningi shoka tandi ku lombwele, nena ngame otandi ka kala omutondi gwaatondi yoye nomuthiminiki gwaathiminiki yoye.
Omuyengeli gwandje ote ku tetekelele okuya mevi lyAayamori, Aaheti, Aaperesi, Aakaanana, Aahevi nAayebusi, ongame notandi ke ya hanagula po.
Ino inyongamena kookalunga yawo nenge u ya galikane, noino taamba eitaalo lyawo u li holele. Hanagula po ookalunga yawo ngoye u kumune po oongundhimanya dhawo.
Ngele oto longele ndje, ngame Omuwa Kalunga koye, otandi ku yambekele iikulya nomeya e tandi kutha po uuvu auhe.
Moshilongo shoye itamu kala omukiintu ta gwitha ela nenge omuntimbe. Otandi ku kaleke nomwenyo omule kombanda yevi.
“Otandi ka tula uumbanda maakondjithi yoye. Otandi ka piyaganeka iigwana ayihe mpoka to yi e tandi tidha po aatondi yoye ayehe komeho goye.
Otandi ka tuma omambonzi komeho goye, opo ga tidhe po Aahevi, Aakaanana nAaheti mondjila yoye.
Itandi ya tidha po momumvo gumwe; ngele tandi shi ningi, evi otali mbugala, niithitukuti otayi ku gwililile po.
Ano otandi ke ya tidha po kashona nakashona, sigo wa tana u lale oshilongo.

Oongamba dhevi lyoye otandi ke dhi taandeleka okuza kEkololo lyaAkaba sigo okomulonga Eufrat nokuza kEfuta lyopokati sigo okombuga. Otandi ke ku pa oonkondo u sinde aakalimo yevi ndyoka, noto ke ya tidha mo, opo u kale mo.
Ino hangana nando okuli nayo nenge nookalunga yawo.
Aantu mboka ino etha ya kale moshilongo shoye; ngele to shi ningi, otaye ke ku yonitha kungame. Ngele to longele ookalunga yawo, otashi ka ninga omwigo gwoye.”
24: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Londa kondundu u ye kungame pamwe naAaron, Nadab, Abihu naawiliki yaIsrael omilongo heyali; nomanga mu li kokule kashona, inyongameneni megalikano.
Ongoye awike to hedha popepi nangame; yalwe inaa hedha ko. Aantu inaa londa kondundu!”
Moses okwa yi e ta lombwele aantu iipango yaKalunga ayihe nomautho ge agehe, aantu ayehe noya yamukula ya ti: “Otatu ningi ayihe mbyoka Omuwa a popi.”

Moses okwa nyola oohapu adhihe ndhoka dha popiwa kOmuwa. Ongula onene okwa meneka e ta tungu oshiyambelo ponyonga yondundu e ta dhike po omamanya omulongo nagaali, kehe limwe lyomazimo gaIsrael omulongo nagaali.
Okwa tumu aamati, oyo noya fikile Omuwa omafikilondjambo e taa yamba iimuna yimwe omakwatathanondjambo.
Moses okwa kutha etata lyombinzi yiimuna e te yi tula miiyaha, etata ekwawo okwe li shashamine oshiyambelo.
Nena okwa kutha embo lyehangano, moka mwa nyolelwa iipango yOmuwa e te li leshele aantu mokule. Oya ti: “Otatu vulika kOmuwa e tatu ningi ashihe sho ta ti.”
Nena Moses okwa kutha ombinzi miiyaha e te yi shashamine aantu ta ti: “Ombinzi ndjika oyehangano ndyoka Omuwa a hangana nane, sho a gandja iipango mbika ayihe.”
Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu naawiliki yaIsrael omilongo heyali oya londo kondundu
noya mono Kalunga kaIsrael. Meni lyoompadhi dhe omwa li mu na oshinima sha fa olupanda lwoosafire, tashi tayima sha fa egulu lyo lyene.
Kalunga ina ganeka oshikaha she a gume aawiliki yaIsrael. Oya tala Kalunga noya li e taya nu.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Londa kondundu u ye kungame, ongame notandi ku pe iipelende yomamanya, moka mu na oompango adhihe ndhoka nda nyola okukumagidha aantu.”
Moses nomuyakuli gwe Josua oyi ilongekidha, naMoses okwa tameke okulonda kondundu yaKalunga.
Moses okwa lombwele aawiliki a ti: “Tu tegeleleni mpaka montanda, sigo tatu galuka. Aaron naHur oyo mbaka ye li pune; ngoka e na oontamanana, ne ye kuyo.”
Moses okwa londo kondundu Sinai, noshikogo oshe yi siikile.

Eadhimo lyokukalapo kwOmuwa olya kulukile kondundu. KAaisraeli eadhimo olya li lya fa uuyelele weziko enene kondungu yondundu. Oshikogo osha siikile ondundu omasiku gahamano, nomesiku etiheyali Omuwa okwi igidha Moses moshikogo.
Moses okwa londo kondundu a yi moshikogo. Omasiku omilongo ne okwa kala kondundu omutenya nuusiku.
25: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli ya yambele ndje omayambo. Shaa ngoka na gandje, ngaashi omwenyo gwe tagu mu lombwele.
Omayambo taga etwa, ogo oshingoli, oshisiliveli, oshikushu,
oongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili, iiyata yoliina ombwanawa nomafufu giikombo;
iipa yoonzi oondumentu ya tetwa iitiligane, iipa yoongombefuta, iipilangi yomuthiya,
omagadhi gomoolamba, iizimba yokugwaya noyokufikitha iitsinino;
omamanya gaoniks nuuwe wokutula momapepenguwo gomuyambimukuluntu nomoshipapa shomontulo.
Aantu naa tungile ndje etsali eyapuki, opo ndi kale mokati kawo.
Nali tungwe niikwaniipangitho yalyo pandunge tandi yi ku ulukile.
“Pangeleni oshiketha shiipilangi yomuthiya, uule washo oondya mbali netata, omutamo gwasho olundya lumwe netata nomuthika gwasho olundya lumwe netata.
Shi kolonga noshingolilela meni nokombanda ngoye u shi tule oongenge dhoshingoli dha kunkula nasho.
Shi ningila oonkogo ne dhoshingoli komakuvu gasho, kombinga kehe oonkogo mbali.
Honga omitenge dhomuthiya e to dhi kolongitha oshingoli.
Dhi hwekela moonkogo kombinga kehe yoshiketha.
Omitenge odhi na okukala moonkogo, inadhi kuthwa mo.
Moshiketha pungula mo iipelende iyali yomamanya mbyoka tandi ku pe, moka mwa nyolelwa iipango.
“Ninga oshisiikilo shoshingoli sho shene, uule washo oondya mbali netata nomutamo gwasho olundya lumwe netata.
Longekidha aakerubi yaali moshingoli sha hambulwa,
gumwe komutse nguka namukwawo komutse ngwiyaka gwoshisiikilo. Naa kale ya kwatathana noshisiikilo.
Aakerubi naa kale ya taalelathana poshisiikilo nomawawa gawo ge shi siikila.
Moshiketha pungula mo iipelende iyali yomamanya e to tenteke ko oshisiikilo.
Oko tuu nkoka tandi ku tsakaneke, poshisiikilo pokati kaakerubi tandi ku pe oompango dhandje adhihe, u dhi lombwele Aaisraeli.”
“Pangela oshitaafula shiipilangi yomuthiya, uule oondya mbali, omutamo olundya lumwe nomuthika olundya lumwe netata.
Shi kolongitha oshingoli sho shene e to shi tula oongenge dhoshingoli dha kunkula nasho.
Shi ningila eketsu li thike peke lya kunkula nasho, noongenge dhoshingoli dha kunkula neketsu.
Shi hambulila oonkogo ne dhoshingoli u dhi tule komakuvu gane pomagulu.
Oonkogo odhokuhwekela omitenge dhokuhumbata oshitaafula tadhi tulwa popepi neketsu.
Honga omitenge moshiti shomuthiya e to dhi kolongitha oshingoli.
Shi hambulila iiyaha, iitsininitho, iitenga nuuyo wokutula iinuwandjambo. Ayihe mbika otayi ningwa moshingoli sho shene.
Oshitaafula nashi tulwe komeho goshikethahangano, nokoshitaafula naku kale aluhe iikwiila iiyapuki.”
“Hambula oshihukikwanyeka shoshingoli sho shene. Ninga ompadhi yasho niimpana yasho moshingoli sha hambulwa; uulenga wiiyimino, woonkuto nowoongala dha sheneka nau kale wa hambulilwa mumwe niimpana.
Moombati dhasho namu kale mwa tsapuka iimpana ihamano, itatu kombinga ndjika niitatu kombinga onkwawo.
Oshimpaga kehe shomwiihamano nashi kale shi na uulenga utatu wa fa iiyimino, oonkuto noongala dha sheneka dhomumandeli.
Molutu lwoshihukikwanyeka namu kale uulenga wa fa iiyimino, oonkuto noongala dha sheneka dhomumandeli.
Onkuto yimwe nayi kale kohi yepando kehe lyiimpana ya tsapuka molutu.
Oonkuto niimpana nayi kale ya kwatathana noshihukikwanyeka noya hambulwa moshingoli sha yela.
Longekidhila oshihukikwanyeka oolamba heyali tadhi minikile lwokomeho.
Iikonde yokutetitha omalapi goolamba niikangwa yokutula mo omutoko gwokomalapi nayi kale oshingoli sho shene.
Iilongitho ayihe mbika yi ninga moshitalendi shimwe shoshingoli sho shene.
Ndhindhilika tuu nawa, u yi ninge pashiholelwa nde shi ku ulukile kondundu.”
26: “Tunga etsali lyotenda momalapi omulongo goliina ombwanawa ga tungilwa oongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili. Tungila mo omafano gaakerubi paunkulungu.
Elapi kehe nali kale oondja omilongo mbali nahetatu muule noondja ne momutamo.
Hondjela kumwe oondja ntano, dhi ninge oshitopolwa shimwe, osho wo oondja ntano okuninga oshitopolwa oshitiyali.
Kolungenge lwelapi lyotango moshitopolwa kehe ninga ko omalulo gongodhi ombulau omilongo ntano. Miitopolwa mbika iyali omalulo naga kale ga tegama.
Monguwo yimwe na mu tulwe oombululu omilongo ntano nokoongenge dhonguwo onkwawo ya shiga kooha oonkwawo, na mu kale mu na oombululu omilongo ntano opo dhi tsaathane.
Ninga uuhake woshingoli omilongo ntano, u kogeke iitopolwa mbika iyali kumwe.
“Longa po esiikilo lyotenda lyomalapi omulongo nalimwe lya tungwa momafufu giikombo.
Ga ninga ge thike pamwe guule woondja omilongo ndatu nomutamo gwoondja ne.
Hondjela oondja ntano kumwe, osho wo oonkwawo hamano kumwe. Elapi etihamano li gonyena kumwe kombanda komeho gotenda.
Tula omalulo omilongo ntano kolungenge lwelapi lyahugunina moshitopolwa shimwe, nomalulo omakwawo omilongo ntano kolungenge lwelapi lyahugunina moshitopolwa oshikwawo.
Hambula uuhake woshikushu omilongo ntano e to u tula momalulo, u kogeke kumwe iitopolwa, yi ninge esiikilo limwe.
Etata lyuule womalapi, mboka wa pitilila, nali endjelele konima yetsali.
Uule wolundya lumwe lwelapi kehe nau endjelele koombinga dhotenda noku yi siikila.
“Tunga natango omasiikilo gaali gokusiikila otenda, limwe olyiipa yoonzi oondumentu iitiligane nalimwe olyiipa yoongombefuta.
“Honga momuthiya iipilangi yokuthikameka etsalihangano lyOmuwa.
Oshipilangi kehe nashi kale shuule woometa ne nomutamo gwoosentimeta omilongo hamano nahamano.
Oshipilangi kehe nashi kale shi na iikwatakanithi iyali tayi shi kwatakanitha kumwe noshikwawo. Iipilangi ayihe oyi na okukala yi na iikwatakanithi mbika.
Honga iipilangi omilongo mbali omolwombinga yokuumbugantu wotenda,
noku yi tholomena oompadhi omilongo ne dhoshisiliveli, mu hwekelwe iikwatakanithi yiipilangi yoku yi thikamitha.
Honga iipilangi omilongo mbali omolwombinga yokuumbangalantu wotenda,
noompadhi dhoshisiliveli omilongo ne, mbali kohi yoshipilangi kehe.
Konima yotenda kuuninginino hongela ko iipilangi ihamano
niipilangi iyali yokomakuvu.
Iipilangi mbika yokomakuvu otayi kwatathana pekota e tayi kwatele kumwe ayihe sigo opombanda. Iipilangi iyali mbyoka tayi ningi omakuvu, otayi longwa pamukalo nguka.
Otaku kala iipilangi ihetatu yi na oompadhi dhayo dhoshisiliveli omulongo nahamano, koshipilangi shimwe oku na mbali.
“Honga omalukambo omulongo nagatano gomuthiya, gatano omolwiipilangi kombinga yimwe yetsali,
gatano ogokombinga onkwawo nagatano ogokuuninginino konima.
Olukambo lwopokati nalu kale pokati kiipilangi lwa shigakana lwa tsa koombinga adhihe.
Iipilangi yi kolonga noshingoli e to tula ko oonkogo dhoshingoli dhokukwatela kumwe omalukambo, ngoka nago wo oge na okukolongwa noshingoli.
Tunga etsali pashiholelwa nde shi ku ulukile kondundu.
“Tula po etopolitho lyoshiyata sholiina ombwanawa sha tungilwa oongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili. Nali tungilwe omafano gaakerubi paunkulungu.
Li endjelelitha koongundhi ne dhomuthiya dha kolongwa noshingoli, ku na uuhake, dha thikama koompadhi dhoshisiliveli.

Etopolitho li tula kohi yomukweyo guuhake moombuli dhetsali, ngoye u pungule handiyaka yetopolitho oshikethahangano shi na iipelende iyali yompango. Etopolitho otali yoolola Ehala lyUuyapuki kEhala lyUuyapukielela.
Tula oshisiikilo koshikethahangano.
Pondje yEhala lyUuyapukielela tula po oshitaafula sha gama kuumbangalantu wetsali noshihukikwanyeka lwokuumbugantu.
“Posheelo shetsali tula po eshigolapi lyoliina ombwanawa lya tungilwa oongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili.
Eshigolapi ndika li hongela oongundhi ntano dhomuthiya dha kolongwa noshingoli nokwa tulwa uuhake woshingoli; dhi tholomena oompadhi dhoshikushu ntano.”
27: “Ninga oshiyambelo shiipilangi yomuthiya. Nashi kale shi na uule woondya ntano, omutamo gwoondya ntano nomuthika gwoondya ndatu.
Komakuvu gasho gane ninga ko ooniga dha kwatathana noshiyambelo. Ayihe nayi kolongithwe oshikushu.
Hambula iikangwa yokuyuka omutoko nou hambule wo iihupulo, iiyaha, iizigitho niikangwa yomakala. Iilongitho mbika ayihe nayi hambulwe moshikushu.
Hambula oshihaya shoshikushu e to tula ko oonkogo ne dhoshikushu komakuvu gasho gane.
Tula oshihaya kohi yoongenge dhoshiyambelo, opo oshihaya shi endjelele sigo olwopokati koshiyambelo.
Honga omitenge dhomuthiya e to dhi kolonga noshikushu.
Dhi hukula moonkogo kombinga nombinga yoshiyambelo, sho tashi humbatwa.
Ninga oshiyambelo shiipilangi shi na omututu. Shi ninga pashiholelwa nde shi ku ulukile kondundu.”
“Etsalihangano lyandje li dhikila wo ehale lyomalapi goliina ombwanawa. Kombinga yokuumbugantu omalapi naga kale guule woondya ethele,
ge li koongundhi omilongo mbali noompadhi dhadho dhoshikushu omilongo mbali; uuhake nomalukambo goongundhi naga kale goshisiliveli.
Shika osho wo tashi ningwa kombinga yokuumbangalantu wehale.
Kombinga yokuuninginino naku kale omalapi guule woondya omilongo ntano, oongundhi omulongo noompadhi omulongo.
Kombinga yokuuzilo, nkoka ku na osheelo, ehale nali kale oondya omilongo ntano.
Kombinga kehe yosheelo naku kale omalapi goondya omulongo nantano, oongundhi ndatu noompadhi ndatu.

Nopomweelo gwehale napu kale eshigolapi lyuule woondya omilongo mbali, lyoshiyata sholiina ombwanawa sha tungilwa paunkulungu oongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili. Olya thikama koongundhi ne noompadhi dhadho ne.
Omalukambo nuuhake woongundhi adhihe nau kale woshisiliveli, ihe oompadhi dhadho odhoshikushu.
Ehale nali kale lyuule woondya ethele nomutamo gwoondya omilongo ntano. Elapi lya kunkula nalyo nali kale lyomutumbo gwoondya ntano, lya tungwa moongodhi oombwanawa dholiina.
Oompadhi nadhi kale dhoshikushu noomboha adhihe dhetsali nadhi ningwe moshikushu.”
Lombwela Aaisraeli ye etele oolamba dhoshihukikwanyeka omagadhi omawanawa gooholivi, opo dhi wape okutema ongulohi kehe.

Aaron noyana naa hwameke oshihukikwanyeka metsalihangano, pondje yetopolitho, ndyoka li li komeho goshikethahangano, opo shi minikile montaneho yandje okuza ongulohi sigo taku shi. Oshipango shika nashi dhigininwe kAaisraeli nomaluvalo gawo sigo aluhe.
28: “Ithana omumwanyoko Aaron noyana Nadab, Abihu, Eleasar naItamar. Ya yoolola mAaisraeli, opo ya longele ndje muuyambi.
Tungila omumwanyoko Aaron oonguwo dhuuyambi dhi na uulenga nodha simana.
Ithana oonkulungu adhihe ndhoka ndu udhitha nombepo yuunongo, u dhi lombwele, dhi tungile Aaron oonguwo, opo a yapulilwe oshilonga shuuyambi, a longele ndje.
Dhi lombwela, dhi tunge oshipapa shomontulo, omapepenguwo, eguyo, ohema yiiyala, egala nekwamo. Nadhi tungile omumwanyoko Aaron noyana aamati oonguwo ndhika oondjapuki, opo ya longele ndje muuyambi.
Oonkulungu nadhi longithe oshingoli noongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili noliina ombwanawa.
“Omapepenguwo oge na okutungwa nuunkulungu noongodhi dhoshingoli, noongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili nonoongodhi dholiina ombwanawa.
Oge na okukala ge na omakwi gaali ge enda komapepe goku ga kwatakanitha.
Ekwamo ndjoka li li ko, oli na okukala lya tungikika lya faathana nomapepenguwo, opo li tse kumwe nago.
Kutha omamanya gaali gaoniks e to takele mugo omadhina omulongo nagaali gaana yaIsrael
melandulathano lyokuvalwa kwawo, gahamano memanya limwe nagahamano mekwawo.
Konga omulongi guuwe onkulungu gwokutakela momamanya gaali omadhina gaana yaIsrael noku ga dhamithitha muundambo woshingoli.
Ga tula komakwi gomapepenguwo, ga kalele po omazimo omulongo nagaali gaIsrael. Pamukalo nguka Aaron ota humbata omadhina gawo komapepe ge, opo ngame, Omuwa, ndi dhimbulukwe aluhe aantu yandje.
Panda uupando uyali woshingoli
nuulyenge uyali woshingoli wa dhingwa wa fa oongodhi e to u mangele kuupando.”

“Tungila omuyambimukuluntu oshipapa shomontulo tashi longithwa mokupula ehalo lyaKalunga. Nashi tungwe moshiyata shimwe nomapepenguwo: sha tungikika noongodhi dhoshingoli, noongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili nonoongodhi dha dhingwa dholiina ontokele.
Nashi kale shi na oonkotso ne, sha gonywa, uule washo oshitine sholundya, osho wo omutamo.
Tula mo omikweyo ne dhomamanya gondilo: momukweyo gwotango tula mo ospineli, otopasi nosmaragdi;
momukweyo omutiyali orubini, osafire nojaspes;
momukweyo omutitatu oturkoisi, oagate noametiste;
nomomukweyo omutine oberil, okarnelia nojasper. Oga li ga dhamithwa muundambo woshingoli.
Pamwaalu gwaana yaJakob omamanya naga kale omulongo nagaali, kehe limwe lyokukalela po ezimo limwe padhina ndyoka lya takelwa mo.
Koshipapa shomontulo oto ningile ko uulyenge woshingoli sho shene wa dhingwa nawa wa fa oongodhi.
Hambula uulinga uyali woshingoli e to u tula koonkotso dhopombanda dhoshipapa shomontulo.
Kuulinga mbuka uyali mangela ko oongodhi dhoshingoli.
Oondungu oonkwawo dhadho dhi mangela komapando gaali e to ga mangele ishewe komakwi gomapepenguwo, kombinga yokomeho.
Hambula ishewe uulinga uyali woshingoli e to u tula koonkotso mbali dhokohi dhoshipapa shomontulo, koongenge dhomeni dha gama pomapepenguwo.
Hambula po ishewe uulinga uyali woshingoli e to u tula koondungu dhopevi dhopontulo dhomakwi agehe gaali gomapepenguwo, popepi nomuhondjo kombanda yekwamo lyuulenga.
Mangela uulinga woshipapa shomontulo kuulinga womapepenguwo nongodhi ombulau, opo oshipapa shomontulo shi kankame kombanda yekwamo noitashi dhituluka we.
“Aaron uuna ta yi mEhala lyUuyapuki, na zale oshipapa shika shomontulo mwa nyolelwa omadhina gomazimo gaIsrael, opo ngame, Omuwa, ndi kale aluhe tandi dhimbulukwa aantu yandje.

Tula Urim naTummim moshipapa shomontulo, opo Aaron e u humbate, nge te ya koshipala shandje mEhala lyUuyapuki. Poompito dha tya ngaaka oku na okuzala aluhe oshipapa shomontulo, opo a vule okuhumbata eutho lyandje kAaisraeli.
“Eguyo lyokombanda yomapepenguwo ou na oku li hondja moshiyata oshimbulau.
Otali kala li na ombululu yokuya omutse, nombululu ndjika nayi kolekwe nomugoyo gwa tungikika, opo yaa tuuke.
Komugoyo gwopevi aguhe tula ko omafano giiyimati yomugranati omambulau, omambwilili nomatiliganembwilili ga togwa mumwe nuungendjo woshingoli.
Aaron na zale eguyo ndika, uuna ta longo iilonga yuuyambi. Uuna te ya koshipala shandje mEhala lyUuyapuki nenge uuna ta zi mo, ewi lyuungendjo otali uvika, opo kaa se.
“Hambula epapa lyoshishani lyoshingoli sho shene e to takele mo enyolo tali ti: ‘Osha yapulilwa Omuwa.’
Li mangela mongodhi ombulau komeho gegala.
Aaron ne li zale komutse gwe, opo ngame, Omuwa, ndi taambe omayambo agehe ngoka Aaisraeli taa yapulile ndje, nando ya yone moku ga yambela ndje.
“Tungila Aaron ohema yoshiyata sholiina sha tungika nou mu tungile egala lyoliina lya tungika nosho wo ekwamo lyuulenga.
“Aana ya Aaron ou na oku ya tungila oohema omakwamo nomatsilu, opo ya simanekwe noya kale yo opala.
Oonguwo ndhika dhi zaleka Aaron noyana. Ya gwayeka nomagadhi gooholivi, opo u ya yapule okulongela ndje muuyambi.
Ya tungila oombulukweya dholiina dha za mombunda sigo okomatundji, opo dhi siikile epenge lyawo.

Aaron noyana naye dhi zale aluhe, uuna taa yi metsalihangano nenge taa hedha koshiyambelo, ya ka yakule miilonga yuuyambi mEhala lyUuyapuki, opo yaa itsike ondjo ya se. Eutho ndika olyaaluhe lyaAaron noluvalo lwe.”
29: “Nge to yapula Aaron noyana, ya ninge aayambi, oto ningi ngeyi. Oto kutha ongombe ondumentu yomutanda noonzi mbali oondumentu dhaa na oshipwe.
Kutha osiimela, ihe ino kutha efulika. Ninga iikwiila mu na omagadhi gooholivi, iikwiila yimwe mwaa na omagadhi nayimwe molupe lwekaka yomapapi ya gwayekwa omagadhi.
Yi tula montungwa e to yi yambele ndje, uuna to yamba ongombe ondumentu noonzi mbali oondumentu.
“Eta Aaron noyana kosheelo shetsalihangano e to ya yogo nawa nomeya.
Opo ihe zaleka Aaron omizalo dhuuyambi — ohema, omapepenguwo, eguyo lyokombanda, oshipapa shomontulo nekwamo.
Mu zaleka etsilu e to mangele ko epapa eyapuki.
Nena kutha omagadhi gokugwaya, ga tila komutse gwe e to mu gwayeke.
“Hedhitha ko oyana e to ya zaleke oohema;
ya zaleka omakwamo moombunda dhawo nomatsilu komitse dhawo. Osho ngaaka to yapula Aaron noyana. Oyo noluvalo lwawo oye na okulongela ndje muuyambi sigo aluhe.
“Eta ongombe ondumentu kosheelo shetsalihangano e to lombwele Aaron noyana, ya tenteke iikaha yawo komutse gwayo.
Dhipagela ongombe ondumentu koshipala shandje oshiyapuki posheelo shetsalihangano.
Kutha mombinzi yongombe e to yi gogo kooniga dhoshiyambelo nomunwe gwoye. Ombinzi onkwawo yi tila pekota lyoshiyambelo.
Nena kutha ko oofu dhomiikwamela, ekalokwa lyokehuli niitiyanathigo ayihe iyali niinkene mbyoka yi li kuyo e to yi lungunithile koshiyambelo yi yambelwe ndje.
Ihe onyama yongombe, ekunka lyayo nehoho lyayo yi lungunithila pondje yontanda. Ndika eyambo lyokukutha po oondjo dhaayambi.
“Kutha yimwe yomoonzi oondumentu e to lombwele Aaron noyana, ya tenteke iikaha yawo komutse gwayo.
Yi dhipaga e to kutha ombinzi yayo e to shashamine koombinga adhihe dhoshiyambelo.
Tetagula onzi miintimbu, yoga iikwamela yayo e to yi tula pomutse nopiintimbu iikwawo.
Onzi ayihe yi lungunithila koshiyambelo yi ninge iikulyandjambo. Oyo efikilondjambo kOmuwa, oyo eyambo lyezimba etoye kOmuwa.
“Kutha onzi onkwawo ondumentu e to lombwele Aaron noyana, ya tenteke iikaha yawo komutse gwayo.

Yi dhipaga e to kutha ko ombinzi yayo yimwe e to yi gwayeke koshipapatsi shokutsi kwokolulyo kwaAaron nokiipapatsi yomakutsi gokomalulyo goyana nokomilumenwe dhawo dhokiikaha yokomalulyo nokominwe dhawo ominene dhokoompadhi dhokomalulyo. Shashamina ombinzi onkwawo koombinga adhihe dhoshiyambelo.
Kutha mo ombinzi yimwe nombinzi ndjoka yi li koshiyambelo nomomagadhi gokugwaya e to ga shashamine Aaron noyana noonguwo dhawo. Osho ngaaka ye mwene, oyana noonguwo dhawo otaa yapulilwa ndje.
“Konzi kutha ko iinkene, omushila, oofu dhokiikwamela, ekalokwa lyokehuli, iitiyanathigo ayihe iyali niinkene yayo noshilama shokolulyo, molwashoka onzi ndjika oyeyapulo.
Montungwa yiikwiila mbyoka ya yapulilwa ndje, kutha mo oshikwiila shimwe moludhi kehe: oshikwiila shimwe sha ningwa nomagadhi gooholivi, shimwe inaashi ya omagadhi nashimwe shepapi.
Ayihe mbika yi tenteka peke lyaAaron nopomake goyana e to yi dhungadhunga koshipala shOmuwa.
Nena yi kutha po pomake gawo, u yi lungunithile koshiyambelo kombanda yefikilondjambo, yi ninge iikulyandjambo yokuyambelwa ndje. Ezimba lyondjambo ndjika ohali opalele ndje, ngame Omuwa.
“Kutha ondete yonzi ndjika ondumentu e to yi dhungadhunga koshipala shOmuwa. Oshitopolwa shika otashi ningi shoye.
“Uuna omuyambi ta yapulwa, ondete noshilama shonzi tayi longithwa peyapulo, nayi yapulilwe ndje, yi ninge omagano gedhungadhungo, mu ga itulile ga ninge gaayambi.
Eutho ndika itali lunduluka nando, uuna aantu yandje taa yamba omakwatathanondjambo; ondete noshilama shoshimuna nashi ninge shaayambi. Omagano ngaka aantu otaye ga yambele ndje, ngame Omuwa.
“Konima yeso lyaAaron oonguwo dhe dhuuyambi nadhi thigululwe po koyana, ye dhi zale, uuna taa gwayekwa ya yapulilwe oshilonga.
Omuna gwaAaron ngoka te mu landula muuyambi e ta yi metsalihangano, a longele ndje mUuyapuki, na zale oonguwo ndhika omasiku gaheyali.
“Kutha onyama yonzi ondumentu ya longithwa meyapulo lyaAaron noyana, e to yi telekele pehala eyapuki.
Aaron noyana naye yi lile posheelo shetsalihangano pamwe niikwiila mbiyaka ya hupile montungwa.
Oye na okulya shoka sha longithwa momusindilo gwokudhima po oondjo dhawo peyapulo lyawo, sho taa langekwa miilonga. Aayambi oyo ayeke naa lye iikulya mbika, oshoka oyo iiyapuki.
Nongele onyama yimwe nenge iikwiila yimwe ya hupu ko e tayi lala sigo ongula, nayi lungunithwe po; inayi liwa we, oshoka oyo iiyapuki.
“Gwanitha omisindilo dheyapulo lyaAaron noyana omasiku gaheyali, naanaa ngaashi nde ku lombwele.
Esiku kehe ou na okuyamba ongombe ondumentu, yi ninge efikilondjambo, opo oondjo dhi dhimbwe po. Otayi yelitha oshiyambelo. Nena shi gwayeka nomagadhi gooholivi, shi ninge oshiyapuki.
Ninga shika esiku kehe momasiku gaheyali. Nena oshiyambelo otashi ningi naanaa oshiyapuki, ndele shaa ngoka nenge shaa shoka tashi shi gumu, otashi ningi oshiyapuki.”
“Esiku kehe ethimbo alihe koshiyambelo naku yambelwe oonzigona mbali dhomumvo gumwe.
Onzigona yimwe ou na oku yi yamba ongula, nonkwawo oto yi yamba lwokongulohi.
Onzigona yotango oto yi yamba pamwe noolita mbali dhosiimela ya pilulilwa mumwe nolita yimwe yomagadhi gooholivi ga yengwa. Tila mo ishewe olita yimwe yomaviinu, ga ninge omayambo.
Onzigona ontiyali yi yamba ongulohi pamwe niikulyandjambo noshinuwandjambo naanaa ngaashi ongula. Ezimba etoye lyondjambo ndjika ohali opalele ndje, ngame Omuwa.
Esiku kehe ethimbo alihe kala ho yamba efikilondjambo ndika koshipala shandje posheelo shetsalihangano. Opo mpoka tandi tsakaneke aantu yandje e tandi ku popitha.
Opo mpoka tandi tsakaneke Aaisraeli, nehala ndyoka otali yapulwa keadhimo lyandje.
Otandi yapula etsalihangano noshiyambelo, notandi yapula Aaron noyana, ya longele ndje muuyambi.
Otandi ka kala mokati kAaisraeli, ongame Kalunga kawo.
Otaa ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa, Kalunga kawo, nde ya tembudha muEgipiti, opo ndi wape okukala mokati kawo. Ongame Omuwa, Kalunga kawo.”
30: “Tunga oshiyambelo shiipilangi yomuthiya shokufikila ko iitsinino.
Nashi kale nuule wolundya lumwe nomutamo gwolundya lumwe nomuthika gwoondya mbali. Ooniga dhokomakuvu nadhi kale dha kwatathana noshiyambelo.
Kolonga kombanda yasho, olutu nooniga dhasho noshingoli sha yela, u shi ningile wo epaya lyoshingoli.
Koombinga adhihe mbali dholutu kohi yoongenge, shi ningila oonkogo mbali dhoshingoli dhokuhukilwa omitenge dhoku shi humbata.
Omitenge dhi honga dhomuthiya e to dhi kolonga noshingoli.
Oshiyambelo shika shi tula pondje yetopolitho ndjoka lye endjelela komeho goshikethahangano. Pehala mpoka opo tandi ku tsakanekele.
Ongula kehe Aaron sho te ya a opaleke oolamba, na fikile ko iitsinino ya nika nawa.
Nonge ta ka hwameka oolamba ongulohi, osho natango ta ningi. Etsininondjambo ndika nali kale tali yambwa esiku kehe koshipala shOmuwa sigo aluhe.
Koshiyambelo shika inamu yambela ko iitsinino yi indikwa nenge omafikilondjambo nenge iikulyandjambo; inamu tila ko oshinuwandjambo.

Lumwe momumvo kehe Aaron na yelithe oshiyambelo pamisindilo nokutula ko kooniga dhasho ne ombinzi yeyonondjambo. Shika nashi ningwe omumvo kehe aluhe sigo aluhe. Oshiyambelo shika oshiyapukilela, sha yoololelwa ndje, ngame Omuwa.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Nge to yalula Aaisraeli, kehe ngoka e na okukala meyalulo, na fute iikulila yomwenyo gwe, opo kaa kwatwe koshivu pethimbo lyeyalulo.
Kehe ngoka e li meyalulo, na fute etatasekeli pandjele yosekeli ndjoka hayi longithwa motempeli. Iimaliwa mbika nayi kale eyambo kungame Omuwa.
Shaa ngoka ta yalulwa meyalulo, omulumentu kehe gwomimvo omilongo mbali noku vule po, na fute omwaalu nguka.
Omuyamba ina futa oshindji, nohepele ina futa oshishona, uuna taa futu iikulila yoomwenyo dhawo.
Gongela iimaliwa mbika kAaisraeli, u yi longithile iilonga yometsalihangano. Iigandjwa mbika otayi ningi iikulila yoomwenyo dhawo, notandi dhimbulukwa oku ya gamena.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Hambula oshiyaha shoshikushu nomagulu gasho goshikushu. Shi tula pokati ketsalihangano noshiyambelo e to tula mo omeya.
Aaron noyana naa yoge iikaha noompadhi dhawo,
manga inaaya ya metsalihangano nenge manga inaaya hedha koshiyambelo ya yambe iikulyandjambo, opo yaa se.
Naa yoge tuu iikaha noompadhi dhawo, opo yaa se. Shika nashi kale eutho taye li gwanitha nomaluvalo gawo sigo aluhe.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Kutha iizimba iiwanawa: ookilograma hamano dhomira ya hemuka, ookilograma ndatu dhokanela ya nika nawa, ookilograma ndatu dholutope
nookilograma hamano dhakasia (ayihe ya vihwa pamuthika gu uthwa). Kutha wo oolita ne dhomagadhi gooholivi
e to lungu omugwayo omuyapuki gwa longekidhwa paunkulungu niizimba.
Gwayeka nagwo etsalihangano noshikethahangano,
oshitaafula niinima yasho ayihe, oshihukikwanyeka niikwaniipangitho yasho ayihe, oshiyambelo shiitsinino,
oshiyambelo shomafikilondjambo niikwaniipangitho yasho ayihe noshiyaha shokwiiyogela nomagulu gasho.
Iinima mbika yi yapula pamukalo nguka, e tayi ningi iiyapukilela, noshaa ngoka te yi gumu, ota yapuka.
Gwayeka Aaron noyana noku ya yapula, ya ninge aayambi taa longele ndje.
Lombwela Aaisraeli u tye: ‘Omugwayo nguka omuyapuki nagu longithwe melongelokalunga lyandje aluhe sigo aluhe.
Inamu gu tila kolutu lwomuntu gwowala ne inamu gu holela, mu ilungile omugwayo gwa fa nguka. Ogwo omuyapuki, nomu na oku gu tala omuyapuki.
Ngele oku na ngoka te gu ilungile nenge te gu gwayeke omuntu kee shi omuyambi, na dhimwe mo maantu yandje.’ ”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Kutha oondumba dhi thike pamwe dhiinima mbika ya nika nawa: eka lya nika nawa, iipakosolwa ya nika nawa, iitowaleki ya nika nawa niitsinino yo yeneyene.
Yi ninga iitsinino ya nika nawa, ya longwa nuunkulungu. Gunda mo omongwa gwoku yi ninga iiyogoki niiyapuki.
Vundula po yimwe yi ninge uusila, u yi fale metsalihangano e to yi gundu komeho goshikethahangano, mpoka tandi ku tsakaneke. Otayi kala iiyapukilela nokune wo.
Inamu iningila iitsinino yilwe ya tya ngeyi. Yi taleni iiyapuki ya yapulilwa ndje, ngame Omuwa.
Ngele ope na ngoka te shi yelekele a longithe iizimba ngaambika, na dhimwe mo maantu yandje.”
31: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Onda hogolola Bezalel yaUri, omutekulu gwaHur gwomezimo lyaJuda
nonde mu udha ombepo onkwakalunga, uunongo, oondunge, ontseyo nuunkulungu
okuthaneka iinima yuungomba noku yi longa moshingoli, moshisiliveli nomoshikushu,
okuwega nawa omamanya gondilo noku ga tula moondambo, okuhonga omiti nokulonga oshilonga kehe shuunkulungu.
Onda hogolola ishewe Oholiab yaAhisamak, gwomezimo lyaDan, a longe pamwe naye. Aanongo ayehe yalwe onde ya pa uunkulungu, ya vule okugwanitha iilonga ayihe nde yi ku lombwele:
etsalihangano, oshikethahangano noshisiikilo shasho, iipumbiwa ayihe yometsalihangano,
oshitaafula niikwaniipangitho yasho, oshihukikwanyeka shoshingoli sho shene niikwaniipangitho yasho ayihe, oshiyambelo shiitsinino,
oshiyambelo shomafikilondjambo niikwaniipangitho yasho ayihe, oshiyaha shokwiiyogela nomagulu gasho,
oonguwo dha tungikika dhomuyambi Aaron noyana dhokuzala, sho taa yakula moshilonga shuuyambi,
omugwayo gwomagadhi niitsinino yezimba lya nika nawa omolwEhala lyUuyapuki. Iinima mbika ayihe naaye yi ninge, naanaa ngaashi nde ku lombwele.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses,

a lombwele Aaisraeli ta ti: “Dhiginineni Esabati, esiku lyandje lyevululuko, oshoka olyo endhindhiliko pokati ketu nane sigo okoluvalo noluvalo lyokuhokolola kutya ongame mwene, Omuwa, tandi mu yapula.
Omu na okudhiginina esiku lyevululuko, oshoka olyo eyapuki. Kehe ngoka itee li yapula, ndele ota longo esiku ndyoka, na dhipagwe.
Omu na omasiku gahamano moka tamu longo iilonga yeni, ihe esiku etiheyali olyo Esabati, esiku lyevululuko lya yapulilwa ndje. Oongoka ta longo esiku ndyoka, na dhipagwe.
Aaisraeli oye na okudhiginina esiku ndika, olyo ehangano lyaaluhe.
Olyo endhindhiliko lyaaluhe pokati ketu nAaisraeli, oshoka ongame, Omuwa, nda shiti egulu nevi momasiku gahamano nomesiku etiheyali onda zimbuka e tandi vululukwa.”
Kalunga sho a mana okupopya naMoses kondundu Sinai, okwe mu pe iipelende iyali yomamanya, moka Kalunga mwene a nyolela mo iipango.
32: Aantu sho ya mono Moses a kala ko kondundu inaa za ko, oya gongalele Aaron e taa ti kuye: “Katu shi wo tuu shoka sha adha omulumentu nguka Moses, ngoka e tu tembudha muEgipiti; tu ningila kalunga e tu kwatele komeho.”
Aaron okwa ti kuyo: “Kuthii mo omagola goshingoli ngoka ga zalwa momakutsi kaakiintu nokaana yeni aamati naakadhona, mu ga etele ndje.”
Aantu ayehe oya hula mo omagola gawo goshingoli momakutsi gawo e taye ga eta kuAaron.

Oye okwa taamba omagola nokwe ga hemuna e ga tula montelekelo e te ga tholoma ontana yoshingoli.
Aantu oya popi ya ti: “Israel, kalunga koye oye ngu e ku tembudha muEgipiti!”
Aaron sho e shi mono, okwa tungile oshiyambelo komeho gontana yoshingoli e ta ti: “Ongula esiku lyoshituthi shOmuwa.”
Aantu oya meneka ongulangula noya yamba omafikilondjambo nomakwatathanondjambo. Oya kuutumba ya lye e taa nu noya thikama ya dhane.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Londoloka u ye pohi, oshoka aantu yoye mboka wa tembudha muEgipiti, oya yono noye ekelehi ndje.
Oye etha ondjila ndjoka nde ya lombwele ye yi landule; oyi iningile ontana ya tholomwa moshingoli noye yi simaneke noku yi yambela omayambo. Otaa ti, oyo kalunga kawo, ngoka e ya tembudha muEgipiti.”
Omuwa okwa ti ishewe kuMoses: “Aantu mbaka onde ya tala, oyo aatangalali.
Ano ngashingeyi etha ndje, ndi ya geele. Otandi ya kombo po, ihe ngoye otandi ku ningi oshigwana oshinene.”
Moses okwa galikana Omuwa, Kalunga ke, e ta ti: “Omuwa, omolwashike to geele aantu yoye, mboka we ya mangulula muEgipiti koonkondo dhoye oonene noshikaha shoye sha kola?

Omolwashike to pe Aayegipiti ompito yokutya, aantu yoye owe ya tembudha muEgipiti, opo u ya dhipagele moondundu noku ya komba po thilu? Geyuluka, itedhulula, waa etele aantu yoye omupya gu thike mpoka.

Dhimbulukwa euvaneko lyoye we li uvanekele aantu yoye Abraham, Isak naJakob nokugana wa ti: ‘Otandi mu pe oluvalo lu thike poonyothi dhokegulu; evi alihe ndjoka ndu uvaneke, otali ningi uuthiga wawo sigo aluhe.’ ”
Omuwa nokwi itedhulula noine etela we aantu ye uuwinayi mboka a li e u ya dhiladhilile.
Moses okwa punguluka e ta londoloka ko kondundu a humbata iipelende yomamanya yiipango ya nyolwa koombinga adhihe mbali.
Kalunga oye mwene a hongo iipelende mbika e ta takele mo iipango.
Josua oku uvu ombuyagano yaantu, sho taa kudhile e ta ti kuMoses: “Ondu uvite onkugo yolugodhi montanda.”
Moses okwa ti: “Ewi ndika kali shi lyekaluluko lyekandanga lyesindano nenge lyaamboka taa kugu sho ya sindika, ondu uvite ewi lyaantu taa imbi meziminathano.”
Ano Moses sho a hedha kontanda e ta mono ontana naantu nkene taa dhana, ondjahi ye oya hwama. Oye nokwe ekelehi iipelende mbyoka a li a humbata e te yi tatulile mpoka ponyonga yondundu.
Okwa kutha ontana ndjoka ye yi hambula e te yi lungunitha po momulilo e tayi ningi omutoko, ngoka a pilulile momeya e te ga nwetha Aaisraeli.
Okwa ti kuAaron: “Aantu mbaka oye ku ningi shike, sho we ya etele eyono enene li thike mpano?”
Aaron okwa yamukula a ti: “Ino geela ndje, mwene gwandje, ou shi shi naanaa kutya aantu mbaka aawinayi shili.
Oya lombwele ndje ya ti: ‘Katu shi wo shoka sha adha omulumentu nguka Moses, ngoka e tu tembudha muEgipiti; tu ningila kalunga e tu kwatele komeho.’
Onde ya indile, ye etele ndje iingoli yawo, mbyoka ye yi ikutha e taye yi etele ndje. Onde yi tula meziko e tamu zi ihe ontana ndjika.”
Moses okwa mono kutya aantu oya tangalala, oshoka Aaron okwe ya ethele etangalalo, ya ninge ekugililo kaatondi yawo.
Moses okwa thikama muuyanda wontanda e ti igidha ta ti: “Shaa ngoka a gama kOmuwa, ne ye kungame.” Aalevi ayehe noye mu gongalele,

e ta ti kuyo: “Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, ta ti: ‘Omulumentu kehe na zale egongamwele lye ponto, ye a ye moontanda okuza posheelo shika sigo okoshikwawo nokudhipaga shaa ngoka, ngele omumwayina nenge kuume ke nenge omushiinda.’ ”
Aalevi oya vulika noya dhipaga po aalumentu ye thike pomayuvi gatatu esiku ndyoka.
Moses okwa ti kAalevi: “Nena omwi iyapula ne yene mwa ningi aayambi mokulongela Omuwa, sho mwa dhipaga aana yeni aamati naamwanyoko aalumentu, onkee Omuwa te mu yambeke.”
Esiku lyanofu Moses okwa lombwele aantu a ti: “Omwa yono nayi. Ano ngashingeyi otandi londo ndi ye kOmuwa kondundu, pamwe tandi ningile wo tuu eyono lyeni epopilokwatathano.”
Moses okwa shuna kOmuwa e ta ti: “Aantu mbaka oya yono nayi. Oyi iningile kalunga koshingoli.
Dhima po oondjo dhawo; ihe ngele nani hasho, dhima ndje mo shila membo lyoye moka wa nyolele aantu yoye.”
Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Ngoka a yono kungame, oye tandi dhimi mo membo lyandje.
Ngashingeyi inda u ka fale aantu kehala ndyoka nde ku lombwele. Tala, omuyengeli gwandje ote ku kwatele komeho, ihe esiku tandi ke ya adha, otandi ya geelele ondjo yawo.”
Omuwa nokwa tumu oshivu maantu, oshoka oya thiminikile Aaron e ya hambulile ontana.
33: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Inda, za po mpaka, ngoye mwene naantu we ya tembudha muEgipiti, mu ye kevi nde li uvanekele Abraham, Isak naJakob nomaluvalo gawo.
Otandi ka tuma omuyengeli gwandje e ku tetekele, notandi ka tidha mo Aakaanana, Aayamori, Aaheti, Aaperesi, Aahevi nAayebusi.
Oto yi koshilongo hashi kunguluka omahini nomagadhi goonyushi, ihe ngame mwene itandi yi nane, molwaashoka ne aatangalali, ote ningi ndi mu hanagulile mondjila.”
Aantu sho ye shi uvu, oya tameke okulila noinaa zala we uulenga.

Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses, a lombwele aantu a tye: “Ne aantu aatangalali. Andola ndi ende nando okathimbo ndi li mokati keni, ando otandi mu mana po. Ngashingeyi huleni mo uulenga weni, ndi tale sho tandi mu ningi.”
Aaisraeli noyi ihula ihe uulenga wawo okuza pondundu Sinai.

Aaisraeli shampa ya yungu ontanda, Moses oha kutha otenda noku yi dhika kokule kashona nontanda. Oya lukwa etsalihangano, noshaa ngoka a hala okupula Omuwa, oku na okuza mo montanda a ye kulyo pondje.
Moses shampa ta yi ko, nena aantu otaa thikama pomatsali gawo noku mu tongolola, sigo ota ka ningina mo.
Moses shampa a ningine mo, oshikogo otashi kuluka e tashi kala posheelo shetsalihangano, Omuwa nota popitha Moses e li moshikogo.
Mbalambala shampa tuu aantu ya mono oshikogo shokugulu posheelo shetsalihangano, yo otaa inyongamene pevi, shaa ngoka posheelo shetsali lye.

Omuwa okwa li ha popi naMoses koshipala noshipala, naanaa ngaashi omuntu ta popi nakuume ke. Opo ihe Moses ota shuna montanda. Ihe omugundjuka omuyakuli gwe, Josua yaNun, okwa kala metsalihangano ina za mo.

Moses okwa lombwele Omuwa a ti: “Eeno, odhoshili, sho wa lombwele ndje, ndi fale aantu mbaka kevi ndyoka, ihe ngoye ino lombwela ndje ngoka to tumu, a ende pamwe nangame. Owa tile, ou shi ndje nawa nou na ombili nangame.

Ngashingeyi ngele nda mono ohenda koshipala shoye, tseyithila ndje oondjila dhoye, opo ndi ku tseye nondi kale ndi na ombili nangoye. Dhimbulukwa wo kutya owa hogolola oshigwana shika, shi ninge shoye mwene.”
Omuwa okwa ti: “Ongame mwene tandi yi nangoye notandi ke ku vululukitha.”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Ngele ito yi natse, ino tu etha tu ze mpaka.
Olye ta tseya kutya ou na ombili naantu yoye, nonangame, ngele ito ende pamwe natse? Okukala kwoye mokati ketu otaku tu yoolola kiigwana yilwe yokombanda yevi.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Otandi ningi naanaa ngaashi wi indile, oshoka ondi ku shi nawa nondi na ombili nangoye.”
Nena Moses okwa ti: “Talitha ndje eadhimo lyoye.”

Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Otandi ka pititha eadhimo lyandje koshipala shoye nokutumbula edhina lyandje eyapuki. Ongame Omuwa, tandi sile ohenda ngoka tandi sile ohenda notandi sile olukeno ngoka tandi sile olukeno.
Itandi etha u tale oshipala shandje, molwaashoka kaku na ngoka ta tala ndje e ta kala e na omwenyo,
ihe mpaka ope na ehala ponto yandje mpoka to vulu okuthikama pemanya.
Eadhimo lyandje sho tali piti po, otandi ke ku tula mekololo li li memanya e tandi ku siikile noshikaha shandje sigo tandi pitilile po.
Nena otandi kutha po oshikaha shandje, noto mono ndje ombunda, ihe hashipala shandje.”
34: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Ihongela iipelende yomamanya iyali ya faathana naambiyaka yotango, notandi ka nyolela mo oohapu ndhiyaka dha li miipelende yotango mbyoka wa tatula.
Ilongekidhila ngula, opo ongula u londe u ye kondundu Sinai, kungame kondungu yayo.
Ino ya ko nomuntu; nopondundu inapa monika tuu nando omuntu; hanzi nenge ongombe tayi napa ponyonga yondundu.”
Moses okwa hongo iipelende iyali yomamanya ya fa mbiyaka yotango. Ongula okwa meneka e te yi humbata ta londo kondundu Sinai, ngaashi Omuwa e mu lombwele.
Omuwa okwa kulukile ko e li moshikogo e ta thikama pamwe naye nokwa tumbula edhina lye, Omuwa.
Omuwa okwa piti koshipala she ti igidha ta ti: “Ongame Omuwa, ongame Kalunga omunamutimahenda, omunalukeno nomutalanteni, ihandi geye mbala nondu udha esilohenda nuudhiginini.
Ohandi dhiginine ohole yandje koluvalo lwomayuvi note dhimi po uukolokoshi omayono noondjo, ihe itandi etha okugeela omayono goohe koyana nokaatekulu sigo oluvalo olutitatu nolutine.”
Moses okwi inyongamene pevi meendelelo e ta galikana.
Okwa ti: “Omuwa, ngele onda silwa ohenda kungoye, kala mokati ketu. Oshigwana shika osha tangalala, ihe dhima po uukolokoshi wetu noondjo dhetu, ngoye u tu ninge aantu yoye mwene.”

Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Ngashingeyi otandi dhike ehangano nAaisraeli. Montaneho yawo otandi ka longa iinyengandunge mbyoka inaayi ningwa mo nale mokati kiigwana muuyuni. Aantu ayehe otaa ka mona iinyengandunge mbyoka ngame, Omuwa, tandi yi longo, oshoka otandi ke ku ningila iinima iitilithi.
Vulikeni koompango ndhoka tandi dhi mu pe nena. Otandi ka tidha mo Aayamori, Aakaanana, Aaheti, Aaperesi, Aahevi nAayebusi mondjila yeni.
Inamu hangana naantu yomoshilongo shoka tamu ka ya mo, opo shaa ninge omwigo gweni.
Kumunii po iiyambelo yawo, hanagulii po oongundhi dhawo dhiidhila ne mu keke po iiyelekela yawo yoshikalungakiintu Asheera.
“Ino simaneka kalunga gulwe, oshoka ngame Omuwa omulaadhi, Kalunga omukodhi.

Ino hangana naantu yoshilongo shoka, oshoka uuna taa longele iikalunga yawo notaye yi yambele omayambo, otaa ke ku hiya, u ye kuyo, noto ka kwatwa kemakelo, u lye iikulya ye yi yambele iikalunga yawo.
Aana yoye aamati otaa ningi ya hokane aakiintu aakwiilongo, mboka taye ya fala mokwaaitaala ndje nokulongela iikalunga yawo.
“Ino ihambulila iiyelekela yookalunga, u yi longele.
“Dhiginina Oshituthi shiikwiila inaayi tulwa efulika. Lya iikwiila inaayi tulwa efulika omasiku gaheyali momwedhi Abib, ngaashi nde ku lombwele, oshoka momwedhi ngoka owa tembuka muEgipiti.
“Omwiiyelipwa kehe omulumentu noshiiyelipwa kehe oshilumentu shoshimuna oshandje,

ihe oshiiyelipwa shokasino ou na oku shi kulilitha onzi, ihe ngele ito shi ningi, shi teya othingo. Osheeli kehe shomumati shi kulila ko.
“Koshipala shandje inaku holoka omuntu e li iikaha yowala.
“Ou na okulonga omasiku gahamano, ihe ino longa mesiku etiheyali, vululukwa nando pu kale pethimbo lyoondima nenge lyeteyo.
“Dhiginina Oshituthi shoshipe, uuna to teya iilya yoye yotango, noto dhiginine Oshituthi shomatsali, sho to likola iiyimati moshitsambe shoye pehulilo lyomumvo.
“Aalumentu ayehe oye na okuholoka lutatu momumvo kehe koshipala shOmuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael.
Otandi ke ku tidhila po iigwana nokutaandelitha oshilongo shoye, nokape na ngoka ta ka haluka evi lyoye, sho to ka holoka koshipala shOmuwa, Kalunga koye, lutatu momumvo.
“Ino yamba oshikwiila sha tulwa efulika, uuna to yambele ndje omafikilondjambo. Onyama yoshimuna sha dhipagelwa oshituthi shaPaasa, ino yi hupithila ongula.

“Omumvo kehe oto eta kongulu yOmuwa oshipe shiilya yoye mbyoka wa teya.
“Okakombwena ino ka telekela momahini gayina.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Inyolela oohapu ndhika, oshoka okomukanka gwadho nda dhike ehangano pamwe nangoye nonaIsrael.”
Moses okwa kala pOmuwa omasiku omilongo ne uusiku nomutenya, ina lya sha noina nwa sha. Oye nokwa nyola oohapu dhehangano kiipelende, odho iipango omulongo.
Moses sho a londoloka kondundu Sinai a humbata iipelende iyali yiipango omulongo, oshipala she osha li tashi adhima, oshoka okwa popi nOmuwa, ihe ye ine shi tseya.
Aaron naantu ayehe oya tala Moses noya mono oshipala she tashi adhima noya tila okuhedha puye.
Moses okwe ya ithana, Aaron naawiliki yegongalo oya galukile kuye, Moses nokwe ya popitha.
Konima yaashika Aaisraeli ayehe oya gongala puye, naMoses okwe ya pe oompango adhihe ndhoka e dhi pewa kOmuwa kondundu Sinai.
Moses sho a mana oku ya lombwela, okwa siikile oshipala she nelapi.
Ihe shampa ta yi metsalihangano koshipala shOmuwa, ota siikulula oshipala she. Nge ta zi mo, otu uvithile Aaisraeli mbyoka a pewa e yi ya lombwele,
noyo taa mono oshipala she tashi adhima. Nena ota siikile oshipala she, ihe nge ta yi a ka popye nOmuwa, ota siikulula oshipala she.
35: Moses okwa gongele egongalo alihe lyAaisraeli e ta ti kulyo: “Oohapu ndhika Omuwa okwa ti nadhi gwanithwe:
Ne omu na omasiku gahamano gokulonga iilonga yeni, ihe esiku etiheyali olyo eyapuki, esiku lyevululuko lya yapulilwa ndje, ngame Omuwa. Shaa ngoka ta longo esiku ndyoka, na dhipagwe.
Inamu tema nokuli omulilo momagumbo geni mEsabati.”
Moses okwa lombwele Aaisraeli ayehe a ti: “Omuwa okwa utha ngeyi:
Momaliko geni kuthii mo omayambo gokuyambela Omuwa. Shaa ngoka a hala oku shi ninga, ne ete omayambo goshingoli, goshisiliveli nenge goshikushu;
oongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili, iiyata yoliina ombwanawa nomafufu giikombo;
iipa yoonzi oondumentu ya tethwa iitiligane, iipa yoongombefuta, iipilangi yomuthiya,
omagadhi gomoolamba, iizimba yokugwaya noyokufika iitsinino,
omamanya gaoniks nuuwe wokutula momapepenguwo gomuyambi nomoshipapa shomontulo.”
“Oonkulungu adhihe dhomokati keni nadhi ye dhi longe ashihe shoka Omuwa a ti:
otenda nesiikilo lyetsalihangano, uuhake, iipilangi, omalukambo, oongundhi noompadhi dhadho,
oshikethahangano nomitenge dhasho, oshisiikilo shasho netopolitho lyoku shi shiga;
oshitaafula, omitenge dhasho niikwaniipangitho ayihe; iikwiila iiyapuki;
oshihukikwanyeka shokuminikila niipumbiwa yasho; oolamba nomagadhi gadho;
oshiyambelo shiitsinino nomitenge dhasho; omagadhi gomugwayo, iitsinino yezimba etoye neshigolapi lyoposheelo shetsalihangano;
oshiyambelo shomafikilondjambo noshihaya shoshikushu, omitenge niikwaniipangitho yasho ayihe; oshiyaha shokwiiyogela nomagulu gasho;
omalapi gehale, oongundhi dhago noompadhi dhago, eshigolapi lyoposheelo shehale;
oomboha noongodhi dhothayila yetsalihangano nodhomalapi gehale;
noonguwo dha tungika dhaayambi dhokuzala, sho taa yakula mEhala lyuuyapuki — oonguwo oondjapuki dhomuyambi Aaron nodhoyana.”
Aaisraeli ayehe oya zi puMoses ya yi,
noshaa ngoka a li a hala, okwe etele Omuwa omayambo gokutunga etsalihangano. Oye eta shaa shoka sha pumbiwa meyakulo nomokutungitha oonguwo dhaayambi.
Shaa ngoka a hala oku shi ninga, omulumentu nenge omukiintu, okwe eta oompate, omagola, uulinga, uugondo wuulenga nuulenga auhe woshingoli noku yi yapulila Omuwa.
Shaa ngoka a li e na oongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili, oliina ya tungika, omafufu giikombo, iipa yoonzi oondumentu ya tethwa iitiligane niipa yoongombefuta, okwe yi eta.
Ayehe mboka ya li ye na oshisiliveli nenge oshikushu, oye shi etele Omuwa ombalagelo, naamboka ya li ye na iipilangi yomuthiya yokulongitha, oye yi eta.
Aakiintu ayehe oonkulungu oya yogoha oongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili noongodhi oontokele dholiina noye dhi eta.
Oya yogoha wo oongodhi dhomafufu giikombo.
Aawiliki oye eta omamanya gaoniks nomamanya omakwawo gondilo gokutula momapepenguwo nomoshipapa shomontulo,
niizimba nomagadhi gomoolamba, gomugwayo nogiitsinino yezimba etoye.
Aaisraeli ayehe mboka ya li ya hala okweetela Omuwa omayambo gawo molwiilonga mbyoka Omuwa a lombwele Moses, oye shi ningi.
Moses okwa lombwele Aaisraeli a ti: “Omuwa okwa hogolola Bezalel yaUri, omutekulu gwaHur gwomezimo lyaJuda.
Kalunga okwe mu udhitha ombepo ye e te mu pe uunongo, oondunge, ontseyo nuunkulungu
okuthaneka iinima yuungomba noku yi longa moshingoli, moshisiliveli nomoshikushu,
okuwega nawa omamanya gondilo noku ga tula moondambo, okuhonga omiti nokulonga oshilonga kehe shuunkulungu.
Omuwa okwe mu pa wo omagano guulongi, a longe yakwawo, nosho wo Oholiab yaAhisamak gwomezimo lyaDan e mu pa omagano gokulonga yakwawo.

Okwe ya pe uunkulungu wiilonga yi ili noyi ili mbyoka hayi longwa kaawegi yomamanya, kaafaneki nokaatungi yiiyata yi na uulenga yoongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili, yiiyata yoliina ombwanawa noyiiyata yilwe. Oyo mboka taa vulu okulonga shaa shoka noku shi faneka.”
36: “Bezalel naOholiab nayakwawo oonkulungu ayehe mboka ya pewa kOmuwa uunongo noondunge okutseya, nkene oshilonga kehe shi na okulongwa metungo lyetsalihangano, oye na okuninga ashihe, naanaa ngaashi Omuwa e shi utha.”
Moses okwi ithana Bezalel naOholiab noonkulungu adhihe ndhoka dha pewa kOmuwa uunongo nodha hala okulonga.
Odha pewa kuMoses omayambo agehe ngoka ge etwa kAaisraeli okutunga etsalihangano. Ihe aantu oya tsikile okweetela Moses oombalagelo ongula kehe.
Nena oonkulungu ndhoka dha li tadhi longo, odha yi
e tadhi tseyithile Moses tadhi ti: “Aantu otaye eta oshindji shi vulithe shoka sha pumbiwa miilonga mbyoka Omuwa e yi utha yi longwe.”
Moses okwa tumu elaka lya yi noontanda adhihe kutya aantu inaye eta we oombalagelo dhokutungitha etsalihangano. Osho ngaaka aantu ya zimbuka okweeta oombalagelo.
Mbyoka ya gongelwa oya li ya gwanenena noya pitilila metungo alihe.

Aalumentu oonkulungu mokati kaalongi yiilonga oya tungu etsalihangano momalapi omulongo goliina ombwanawa ga tungilwa oongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili nomafano gaakerubi paunkulungu.
Elapi kehe olya li li thike pekwawo, lyuule woondya omilongo mbali nahetatu nomutamo gwoondya ne.
Oya hondjele kumwe oondya ntano, dhi ninge oshitopolwa shimwe, osho wo oondya ntano okuninga oshitopolwa oshitiyali.
Kolungenge lwelapi lyotango moshitopolwa kehe oya ningi ko omalulo gongodhi ombulau.

Oya ningi omalulo omilongo ntano kolungenge lwelapi lyahugunina moshitopolwa shimwe nomalulo omakwawo omilongo ntano kolungenge lwelapi lyahugunina moshitopolwa oshitiyali. Miitopolwa ayihe iyali omalulo oga li ga tegama.
Oya hambula uuhake woshingoli omilongo ntano wokukogekela iitopolwa kumwe.
Oya ningi esiikilo lyotenda lyomalapi omulongo nalimwe lya tungwa momafufu giikombo.
Elapi kehe olya li li na uule woondya omilongo ndatu nomutamo gwoondya ne.
Oya hondjele oondya ntano kumwe, osho wo oonkwawo ntano kumwe.
Oya tula omalulo omilongo ntano kolungenge lwelapi lyahugunina moshitopolwa shimwe nomalulo omilongo ntano kolungenge lwelapi lyahugunina moshitopolwa oshikwawo.
Oya hambula uuhake woshikushu omilongo ntano wokukogekela iitopolwa kumwe, yi ninge esiikilo limwe.
Oya ningi omasiikilo gaali galwe, limwe olyiipa yoonzi oondumentu ya tethwa iitiligane nekwawo lyiipa yoongombefuta.
Oya hongo momuthiya iipilangi yokuthikameka etsalihangano.
Oshipilangi kehe osha li shi na uule woometa ne nomutamo gwoosentimeta omilongo hamano nahamano.
Oshipilangi kehe osha li shi na iikwatakanithi iyali tayi shi kwatakanitha kumwe noshikwawo. Iipilangi ayihe oya li yi na iikwatakanithi mbika.
Oya hongo iipilangi omilongo mbali omolwombinga yokuumbugantu wotenda,
noku yi tholomena oompadhi omilongo ne dhoshisiliveli, mu hwekelwe mo iikwatakanithi yiipilangi yoku yi thikamitha.
Oya ningi iipilangi omilongo mbali omolwombinga yokuumbangalantu wotenda,
noompadhi dhoshisiliveli omilongo ne, mbali kohi yoshipilangi kehe.
Konima yotenda kuuninginino oya hongele ko iipilangi ihamano
niipilangi iyali yokomakuvu.
Iipilangi mbika yokomakuvu oya kwatathana pekota nokukwatela kumwe ayihe sigo opombanda. Iipilangi iyali mbyoka ya ningi omakuvu, oya longwa pamukalo nguka.
Okwa li ku na iipilangi ihetatu yi na oompadhi dhayo dhoshisiliveli omulongo nahamano, koshipilangi shimwe okwa li mbali.
Oya hongo omalukambo omulongo nagatano gomuthiya, gatano omolwiipilangi kombinga yimwe yetsali,
gatano ogokombinga onkwawo nagatano ogokuuninginino konima.
Olukambo lwopokati olwa tulwa pokati kiipilangi lwa shigakana lwa tsa koombinga adhihe.
Oya kolonga iipilangi noshingoli noya tula ko oonkogo dhoshingoli dhokukwatela kumwe omalukambo, ngoka nago wo ga kolongwa noshingoli.
Oya ningi etopolitho lyoshiyata sholiina ombwanawa sha tungilwa oongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili nomafano gaakerubi paunkulungu.
Oya hongele eshigolapi oongundhi ne dhomuthiya dha kolongwa noshingoli, dhi na uuhake woshingoli. Oya tholoma oompadhi ne dhoshisiliveli dhokuthikamitha oongundhi.
Posheelo shetsali oya tula po eshigolapi lyoliina ombwanawa lya tungilwa oongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili.
Etopolitho ndika oye li hongele oongundhi ntano dhi na uuhake; omitse nomalukambo gadho oga kolongwa noshingoli nodha tholomenwa oompadhi dhoshikushu ntano.
37: Bezalel okwa pangele oshiketha shiipilangi yomuthiya, uule washo oondya mbali netata, omutamo gwasho olundya lumwe netata nomuthika gwasho olundya lumwe netata.
Okwe shi kolonga noshingolilela meni nokombanda nokwe shi tula oongenge dhoshingoli dha kunkula nasho.
Okwe shi ningile oonkogo ne dhoshingoli komakuvu gasho, kombinga kehe oonkogo mbali.
Okwa hongo omitenge dhomuthiya nokwe dhi kolongitha oshingoli.
Okwe dhi hwekele moonkogo kombinga kehe yoshiketha.
Okwa ningi oshisiikilo shoshingoli sho shene, uule washo oondya mbali netata nomutamo gwasho olundya lumwe netata.
Okwa longekidha aakerubi yaali moshingoli sha hambulwa,
gumwe komutse nguka namukwawo komutse ngwiyaka gwoshisiikilo. Okwe ya ningi ya kwatathana noshisiikilo.
Aakerubi oya li ya taalelathana poshisiikilo nomawawa gawo ge shi siikila.
Okwa pangele oshitaafula shiipilangi yomuthiya, uule oondya mbali, omutamo olundya lumwe nomuthika olundya lumwe netata.
Okwe shi kolongitha oshingoli sho shene nokwe shi tula oongenge dhoshingoli dha kunkula nasho.
Okwe shi ningile eketsu li thike peke lya kunkula nasho noongenge dhoshingoli dha kunkula neketsu.
Okwe shi hambulile oonkogo ne dhoshingoli nokwe dhi tula komakuvu gane pomagulu.
Oonkogo dhokuhwekela omitenge dhokuhumbata oshitaafula okwe dhi tula popepi neketsu.
Okwa hongo omitenge moshiti shomuthiya nokwe dhi kolongitha oshingoli.
Iinima yokoshitaafula okwe yi hambula moshingoli sho shene: iiyaha, iitsininitho, iitenga nuuyo wokutula iinuwandjambo.

Okwa hambula oshihukikwanyeka shoshingoli sho shene. Okwa ningi ompadhi yasho niimpana yasho moshingoli sha hambulwa; uulenga wiiyimino, woonkuto nowoongala dha sheneka okwe dhi hambulile mumwe niimpana.
Moombati dhasho omwa tsapuka iimpana ihamano, itatu kombinga ndjika niitatu kombinga onkwawo.
Oshimpana kehe shomwiihamano osha li shi na uulenga utatu wa fa iiyimino, oonkuto noongala dha sheneka dhomumandeli.
Molutu lwoshihukikwanyeka omwa li uulenga une wa fa iiyimino, oonkuto noongala dha sheneka dhomumandeli.
Onkuto yimwe oya li kohi yepando kehe lyiimpana ya tsapuka molutu.
Oonkuto niimpana oya li ya kwatathana noshihukikwanyeka noya hambulwa moshingoli sha yela.
Okwa longekidhile oshihukikwanyeka oolamba heyali; iikonde yokutetitha omalapi goolamba niikangwa yokutula mo omutoko gwokomalapi. Okwe yi ningi moshingoli sho shene.
Iilongitho ayihe mbika okwe yi ningi moshitalendi shimwe shoshingoli sho shene.

Okwa tungu oshiyambelo shiipilangi yomuthiya shokufikila ko iitsinino. Osha li shi na uule wolundya lumwe nomutamo gwolundya lumwe nomuthika gwoondya mbali. Ooniga dhokomakuvu odha li dha kwatathana noshiyambelo.
Okwa kolonga kombanda yasho, olutu nooniga dhasho noshingoli sha yela nokwe shi ningile epaya lyoshingoli.
Koombinga adhihe mbali dholutu kohi yoongenge okwe shi ningile oonkogo mbali dhoshingoli dhokuhukilwa omitenge dhoku shi humbata.
Omitenge okwe dhi hongo dhomuthiya nokwe dhi kolonga noshingoli.
Okwa lungu omugwayo omuyapuki, osho wo iitsinino yezimba etoye ya longekidhwa paunkulungu.
38: Okwa ningi oshiyambelo shomafikilondjambo miipilangi yomuthiya. Osha li shuule woondya ntano, omutamo gwoondya ntano nomuthika gwoondya ndatu.
Komakuvu gasho gane okwa ningile ko ooniga dha kwatathana noshiyambelo. Ashihe okwe shi kolonga noshikushu.
Okwa hambula iikwaniipangitho ayihe yoshiyambelo: Iipana, iihupulo, iiyaha, iizigitho niikangwa yomakala. Iikwaniipangitho mbika ayihe oya li ya hambulwa moshikushu.
Okwa hambula oshihaya shoshikushu e te shi tula kohi yoongenge dhoshiyambelo, she endjelela sigo olwopokati koshiyambelo.
Okwa hambula oonkogo ne e te dhi tula komakuvu gane goshihaya.
Okwa hongo omitenge dhomuthiya e te dhi kolonga noshikushu.
Okwe dhi hwekele moonkogo koombinga adhihe mbali dhoshiyambelo. Oshiyambelo osha li sha pangelwa miipilangi shi na omututu meni.
Okwa hambula oshiyaha shoshikushu shi na omagulu goshikushu. Okwe shi ningi miiyitalelo yaakiintu mboka haa yakula posheelo shetsalihangano.
Etsalihangano okwe li dhikile ehale lyomalapi goliina ombwanawa. Kombinga yokuumbugantu omalapi oga li guule woondya ethele,
ga tsilikwa koongundhi omilongo mbali noompadhi dhadho dhoshikushu omilongo mbali; uuhake nomalukambo goongundhi oga li goshisiliveli.
Osho wo a ningi kombinga yokuumbangalantu wehale.
Kombinga yokuuninginino omalapi oga li guule woondya omilongo ntano, oongundhi omulongo noompadhi omulongo.
Kombinga yokuuzilo, nkoka kwa li osheelo, ehale olya li oondya omilongo ntano.
Kombinga kehe yosheelo okwa li omalapi goondya omulongo nantano, oongundhi ndatu noompadhi ndatu.
Omalapi agehe ga dhingilila ehale oga li ga tungwa moshiyata sholiina ombwanawa.

Oompadhi dhoongundhi odha li dhoshikushu, ihe uuhake nomalukambo oga li goshisiliveli, nomitse dhoongundhi odha li dha kolongwa noshisiliveli. Oongundhi adhihe dhehale odha li dha kwatelwa kumwe nomalukambo goshisiliveli.

Eshigolapi lyoposheelo shehale olya li lya ningwa moshiyata sholiina ombwanawa sha tungilwa oongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili. Olya li li na uule woondya omilongo mbali nomuthika gwoondya ntano gwa faathana nomalapi gehale.
Olya li lya tsilikwa koongundhi ne dhi na oompadhi ne dhoshikushu. Uuhake nomalukambo gadho oga li goshisiliveli, nomitse dhadho odha li dha kolongwa noshisiliveli.
Oomboha adhihe dhotenda nodhehale odha li dhoshikushu.

Mpaka ope na elandulathano lyuutale mboka wa longithwa metungo lyetsalihangano, moka mwa pungulwa iipelende yomamanya iyali mwa nyolelwa iipango omulongo. Elandulathano olya ningwa kuMoses keyalulo lyAalevi mboka ya longo mewiliko lyaItamar, omuna gwomuyambi Aaron.
Bezalel yaUri, omutekulu gwaHur, gwomezimo lyaJuda, okwa gwanitha ashihe shoka Omuwa a popi.

Omukwathi gwe Oholiab yaAhisamak, gwomezimo lyaDan, okwa li omuwegi gwomamanya, omufaneki nomutungi gwiiyata yi na uulenga woongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili nogwiiyata yoliina ombwanawa.

Oshingoli ashihe shoka sha yapulilwa Omuwa okutunga etsalihangano nosha gandjwa ombalagelo, osha li iitalendi omilongo mbali nomugoyi noosekeli omathele gaheyali nomilongo ndatu pandjele yosekeli ndjoka hayi longithwa motempeli.
Oshisiliveli shoka sha zi meyalulo lyegongalo, osha li iitalendi ethele noosekeli eyuvi limwe omathele gaheyali omilongo heyali nantano pandjele yosekeli ndjoka hayi longithwa motempeli.
Omuntu kehe meyalulo okwa futu etatasekeli pandjele yosekeli ndjoka hayi longithwa motempeli. Ayehe mboka ya yalulwa yomimvo omilongo mbali nenge dhi vule po, oya li 603 550.
Oshisiliveli shondjundo yoograma 3,400 osha tholoma oompadhi dhetsalihangano nodhetopolitho, oshitalendi shimwe ompadhi yimwe.
Oosekeli eyuvi limwe omathele gaheyali omilongo heyali nantano Bezalel okwe dhi hambula uuhake nomalukambo koongundhi nokusiikila omitse dhadho.
Oshikushu shoka she etwa ombalagelo, osha li iitalendi omilongo heyali noosekeli omayuvi gane.
Oshikushu shika okwe shi hambula oompadhi dhomweelo gwetsalihangano, oshiyambelo shoshikushu, oshihaya niikwaniipangitho ayihe yasho,
oompadhi dhehale nodhosheelo shalyo noomboha adhihe dhetsalihangano nodhehale lye li kunduka.
39: Oya tungu oonguwo dhuuyambi noongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili, dhi zalwe kaayambi, sho taa ka yakula mEhala lyuuyapuki. Oya tungile Aaron oonguwo, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Oya tungu omapepenguwo noongodhi dhoshingoli, noongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili nonoongodhi dholiina ombwanawa.
Oya ndanda oshingoli, sigo sha pepuka noonkondo noye shi kondo oondali noku dhi tungila mumwe noongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili nonoongodhi dholiina.
Oya ningile omapepenguwo omakwi gaali ge ga kwatakanitha koombinga adhihe mbali.
Ekwamo olya ningwa moshiyata shomapepenguwo nolya kwatakanithwa kugo, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Oya longo omamanya gaoniks e taye ga tula muundambo woshingoli; omadhina gaana yaJakob omulongo nayaali oga li ga takelwa mo nuunkulungu.
Oye ga tula komakwi gomapepenguwo, ga kalele po omazimo omulongo nagaali gaIsrael, naanaa ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Oya tungu oshipapa shomontulo moshiyata shimwe nomapepenguwo: sha tungikika noongodhi dhoshingoli, noongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili nonoongodhi dha dhingwa dholiina ontokele.
Osha li shi na oonkotso ne, sha gonywa, uule washo oshitine sholundya, osho wo omutamo.
Oya tula mo omikweyo ne dhomamanya gondilo: momukweyo gwotango oya tula mo ospineli, otopasi nosmaragdi;
momukweyo omutiyali orubini, osafire nojaspes;
momukweyo omutitatu oturkoisi, oagate noametiste;
momukweyo omutine oberil, okarnelia nojasper. Oga li ga dhamithwa muundambo woshingoli.
Pamwaalu gwaana yaJakob omamanya oga li omulongo nagaali, kehe limwe lyokukalela po ezimo limwe padhina ndyoka lya takelwa mo.
Koshipapa shomontulo oya ningile ko uulyenge woshingoli sho shene wa dhingwa nawa wa fa oongodhi.
Oya hambula uulinga uyali woshingoli e taye u tula koonkotso dhopombanda dhoshipapa shomontulo.
Kuulinga mboka uyali oya mangele ko oongodhi dhoshingoli.
Oondungu oonkwawo dhadho oye dhi mangele komapando gaali e taye ga mangele ishewe komakwi gomapepenguwo, kombinga yokomeho.
Oya hambula ishewe uulinga uyali woshingoli e taye u tula koonkotso mbali dhokohi dhoshipapa shomontulo, koongenge dhomeni dha gama pomapepenguwo.
Oya hambula po ishewe uulinga woshingoli e taye u tula koondungu dhopevi dhopontulo dhomakwi agehe gaali gomapepenguwo, popepi nomuhondjo kombanda yekwamo lyuulenga.

Oya mangele uulinga woshipapa shomontulo kuulinga womapepenguwo nongodhi ombulau, opo oshipapa shomontulo shi kankame kombanda yekwamo noitashi dhituluka we. Ashihe osha ningwa, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Eguyo lyokombanda yomapepenguwo olya hondjwa moshiyata oshimbulau.
Olya li li na ombululu yokuya omutse, nombululu ndjika oya kolekwa nomugoyo gwa tungikika, opo yaa tuuke.
Komugoyo gwopevi aguhe oya tula ko omafano giiyimati yomugranati omambulau, omambwilili nomatiliganembwilili ga togwa mumwe nuungendjo woshingoli, naanaa ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Oya tungile Aaron noyana oohema dhoongodhi oontokele dholiina,
egala, omatsilu, oombulukweya
nekwamo lyoongodhi oontokele dha dhingwa dholiina li na uulenga woongodhi oombulau, oombwilili noontiliganembwilili, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Oya hambula uulenga wokoshipala, epapa lyoshishani oshiyapuki lyoshingoli sho shene e taa takele mo enyolo tali ti “Osha yapulilwa Omuwa.”
Oye li mangele nongodhi ombulau kegala lwokomeho, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Iilonga ayihe yetsalihangano oya hulithwa ya pu. Aaisraeli oya gwanitha ashihe shoka Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Oye etele Moses otenda niikwaniipangitho yayo ayihe, uuhake wayo, iipilangi yayo, omalukambo gayo, oongundhi dhayo noompadhi dhadho;
esiikilo lyiipa yoonzi oondumentu ya tethwa iitiligane; esiikilo lyiipa yoongombefuta; etopolitho lyokushiga;
oshikethahangano shi na iipelende yomamanya, omitenge dhasho noshisiikilo shesilohenda;
oshitaafula niikwaniipangitho yasho ayihe niikwiila iiyapuki;
oshihukikwanyeka shoshingoli sho shene, oolamba dhasho, iikwaniipangitho yasho ayihe nomagadhi gomoolamba;
oshiyambelo shoshingoli; omugwayo; iitsinino yezimba etoye; eshigolapi lyoposheelo shetsalihangano;
oshiyambelo shoshikushu noshihaya shasho shoshikushu, omitenge dhasho niikwaniipangitho yasho ayihe; oshiyaha shokwiiyogela nomagulu gasho;
omalapi gehale noongundhi dhago noompadhi dhadho; eshigolapi lyoposheelo shehale noongodhi dhalyo; oomboha dhotenda; iikwaniipangitho ayihe tayi longithwa metsali;
oonguwo dha tungika dhokuzalwa kaayambi, nge ye li meyakulo mEhala Lyuuyapuki — oonguwo oondjapuki dhomuyambi Aaron nodhoyana.
Aaisraeli oya ningi ayihe mbika, naanaa ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Moses okwa konakona ayihe nokwa mono kutya oya ningwa, naanaa ngaashi Omuwa a gandjele oshipango shoku yi longa. Moses okwe ya laleke nuuyamba.
40: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses e ta ti:
“Mesiku lyotango lyomwedhi gwotango thikameka etsalihangano.
Pungula mo oshikethahangano shi na iipelende yiipango omulongo e to tula etopolitho komeho goshikethahangano.
Tula mo oshitaafula e to tenteke ko iikwaniipangitho yasho ayihe. Tula mo wo oshihukikwanyeka e to hwameke oolamba dhasho.
Tula mo oshiyambelo shoshingoli shokufikila iitsinino komeho goshikethahangano e to endjeleleke eshigolapi posheelo shetsalihangano.
Oshiyambelo shomafikilondjambo oto shi tula komeho getsalihangano.
Oshiyaha shokwiiyogela oto shi tula pokati ketsalihangano noshiyambelo e to shi udhitha omeya.
Dhika olugumbo lwehale e to endjeleleke eshigolapi posheelo shalyo.
“Nena yapula etsalihangano niikwaniipangitho yalyo ayihe noku yi gwayeka nomagadhi omayapuki, notali ningi eyapuki.
Otaku landula eyapulo lyoshiyambelo niikwaniipangitho yasho ayihe, notashi ningi oshiyapuki.
Gwayeka wo oshiyaha shokwiiyogela nomagulu gasho, opo u shi yapule.
“Eta Aaron noyana posheelo shetsalihangano e to ya yogo nomeya.
Zaleka Aaron oonguwo oondjapuki e to mu gwayeke noku mu yapula, opo a ninge omuyambi a longele ndje.
Eta wo oyana e to ya zaleke oohema.
Nena ya gwayeka, naanaa ngaashi wa gwayeke he, opo ya ninge aayambi ya longele ndje. Egwayeko ndika otali ya ningi aayambi sigo okoluvalo noluvalo.”
Moses okwa gwanitha ayihe, ngaashi Omuwa a popi.
Mesiku lyotango lyomwedhi gwotango omumvo omutiyali, sho ya tembuka muEgipiti, etsalihangano olya thikamekwa.
Moses okwa tenteke po oompadhi dhetsalihangano niipilangi yalyo, okwa tula ko omalukambo gayo nokwa dhike oongundhi dhalyo.
Okwa hwanuna ko otenda e ta tula ko esiikilo kombanda, naanaa ngaashi Omuwa a popi.
Nena okwa kutha iipelende iyali yomamanya e te yi pungula moshikethahangano. Okwa hwekele omitenge moonkogo dhoshiketha e ta tenteke ko oshisiikilo shesilohenda.
Okwa langeke oshiketha metsalihangano e te endjeleleke etopolitho nolya siikile oshikethahangano, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Okwa tula oshitaafula meni lyetsalihangano lwokuumbangalantu kombinga yopondje yetopolitho
e ta tenteke ko iikwiila iiyapuki koshipala shOmuwa, naanaa ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Okwa tula oshihukikwanyeka metsalihangano lwokuumbugantu sha taalelathana noshitaafula,
nokwa hwameke oolamba koshipala shOmuwa, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Okwa tula oshiyambelo shoshingoli metsalihangano komeho getopolitho,
nokwa lungunitha iitsinino yezimba etoye, naanaa ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Okwe endjeleleke eshigolapi posheelo shetsalihangano,
noshiyambelo shomafikilondjambo okwe shi tula komeho gosheelo shetsalihangano. Okwa yambele ko efikilondjambo niikulyandjambo, naanaa ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Okwa tula oshiyaha shokwiiyogela pokati ketsalihangano noshiyambelo e te shi udhitha omeya.
Moses, Aaron noyana oya yogo iikaha yawo noompadhi dhawo moshiyaha shoka,
shampa taa yi metsalihangano nenge koshiyambelo, naanaa ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Moses okwa thikameke olugumbo lwehale lwa kunduka etsalihangano noshiyambelo e te endjeleleke eshigolapi posheelo shehale. Nena okwa manitha iilonga ayihe.
Oshikogo osha kwidhidhike etsalihangano, neadhimo lyOmuwa olye li udhitha.
Omolwashika, Moses ina wapa okuya mo metsalihangano.
Aaisraeli oya dhilukitha po ontanda yawo yu uka palwe aluhe, oshikogo sho sha yeluka kombanda yetsalihangano
Oya kala mpoka, sigo oshikogo sha yeluka po ishewe, nena oya dhilutha wo ontanda yawo.
Moondjenda dhawo adhihe oya vulu okumona oshikogo shOmuwa sha kala kombanda yetsalihangano omutenya, nomulilo tagu yeta musho uusiku.

1: Omuwa okwa li metsalihangano e ti ithana Moses nokwe mu pe omautho ngaka

Aaisraeli ye na oku ga gwanitha uuna taa yamba omafikilondjambo.
Ngele oku na ngoka ta yamba oshimuna, na yambe ongombe nenge onzi nenge oshikombo.
Nenge ota yamba ongombe ye efikilondjambo, na ete ongombe ondumentu yaa na oshipo. Ne yi ete posheelo shetsalihangano, opo Omuwa e yi taambe nohokwe.
Na tenteke oshikaha she komutse gwayo, notayi taambwa yi ninge efikilondjambo lyokukutha po oondjo dhe.
Ongombe ne yi tselele mpoka koshipala shOmuwa, naana yaAaron aayambi naa gandje ombinzi yayo kOmuwa e taye yi shashamine koombinga ne dhoshiyambelo shoka shi li posheelo shetsalihangano.
Na yuye oshimuna e te shi tete iintimbu.
Aayambi naa tule iikuni koshiyambelo e taye yi tomeke.
Iintimbu naye yi tule momulilo pamwe nomutse noofu.
Naa yoge iikwamela nomagulu momeya. Omuyambi na lungunithe iinima mbika ayihe koshiyambelo. Ndika olyo efikilondjambo li na ezimba lya nika nawa notali opalele Omuwa.
Omuntu ngele ota yamba onzi nenge oshikombo, nashi kale oshilumentu shaa na oshipo.
Ne shi dhipagele kuumbangalantu woshiyambelo koshipala shOmuwa, naayambi naa shashamine oshiyambelo ashihe nombinzi yasho.
Na tete onyama iintimbu, nomuyambi ne yi tule pamwe nomutse noofu dhasho piikuni mbyoka yi li momulilo koshiyambelo.
Na yoge iikwamela momeya, omuyambi note yi pe Omuwa efikilondjambo e te yi lungunithile po ayihe koshiyambelo. Olyo efikilondjambo li na ezimba lya nika nawa notali opalele Omuwa.
Ngele oku na omuntu ta yambele Omuwa efikilondjambo lyondhila, nali kale lyonguti nenge lyokangutyona.
Omuyambi ne yi fale koshiyambelo e te yi thingonona othingo e ta lungunitha omutse gwayo koshiyambelo. Ombinzi yayo nayi ndondithilwe molumbumbu lwoshiyambelo.
Ne yi kuthe oshikutunino nomalwenya e te yi umbile pelunda lyomutoko lwokuuzilo woshiyambelo.
Ne yi tandule olumana, ewawa li kale kombinga kehe pwaa naa okuteta ewawa, noyi lungunithilwe ayihe kombanda yiikuni koshiyambelo. Olyo efikilondjambo li na ezimba lya nika nawa notali opalele Omuwa.
