Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
Lombwela Aaisraeli u tye Mesiku etimulongo netitano lyomwedhi omutiheyali oku na oshituthi shomatsali giihwa iitalala shomasiku gaheyali.
Mesiku lyotango lyomomasiku ngaka gongaleni kelongelokalunga ne inamu longa sha.
Esiku kehe lyomomasiku gaheyali yambeni ondjambo yiikulya. Mesiku etihetatu gongaleni okuhulitha oshituthi e tamu yamba ondjambo yiikulya. Osho oshigongi oshiyapuki, inamu longa sha.
(Ngaka ogo omatango omanene moka tamu gongala okusimaneka Omuwa e tamu yamba oondjambo: omafikilondjambo, oondjambo dhiikulya, oontselelandjambo niinuwandjambo, ngaashi tadhi pumbiwa esiku nesiku.

Omatango ngaka omanene oga gwedhwa kOmasabati goshito, noondjambo ndhika otadhi gwedhelwa koondjambo dheni dhoshito, oondjambo dhegwanitho lyomauvaneko noondjambo dhopahalo lyeni ndhoka tamu pe Omuwa.)

“ ‘Uuna mwa teya omapya geni, dhaneni oshituthi shika omasiku gaheyali tashi tameke mesiku etimulongo netitano lyomwedhi omutiheyali. Esiku lyotango olyo esiku lyevululuko lya sheywa, nesiku etihetatu osho wo.
Mesiku lyotango toononeni iiyimati iiwanawa komiti dheni, kutheni iiyale yomilunga niitayi yomiti dha hapa e tamu tameke okudhana oshituthi tamu simaneke Omuwa Kalunga keni.
Shi dhaneni omasiku gaheyali. Eutho ndika nali dhigininwe koluvalo lweni aluhe sigo aluhe.
Aaisraeli ayehe naa kale momatsali omasiku gaheyali,
opo oluvalo lweni lu tseye kutya Omuwa okwa kaleke aantu ye momatsali, sho a li te ya enditha moku ya tembudha muEgipiti. Ongame Omuwa Kalunga keni.’ ”
Moses okwa pe Aaisraeli omautho gomatango ngaka omanene gokusimaneka Omuwa.
24: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses
a gandje kAaisraeli omautho ngaka. Eteleni oolamba dhoshihukikwanyeka omagadhi omayelele gooholivi, opo omulilo gu kale gwa tema aluhe.

Ongulohi kehe Aaron ne dhi hwameke metsalihangano, pondje yetopolitho, ndyoka li li komeho goshikethahangano, opo dhi minikile montaneho yOmuwa okuza ongulohi sigo taku shi. Eutho ndika oli na okudhigininwa koluvalo noluvalo aluhe sigo aluhe.
Aaron na sile oolamba dhomoshihukikwanyeka shoshingolilela oshimpwiyu nokutala kutya odha tema aluhe koshipala shOmuwa.
Kutha uusila womunziya e to ningi iikwiila ya mbumbwakana omulongo niiyali. Moshikwiila kehe namu kale uusila womakopi gane.
Iikwiila yi tula moondongelwa mbali, iikwiila ihamano mondongelwa kehe ya tentekwa koshitaafula shoshingoli sho shene, shoka shi li koshipala shOmuwa.
Kombanda yondongelwa kehe tula ko iitsinino, yi ninge ombinga ndjoka tayi yambelwa koshiyambelo peha lyiikwiila.
Esabati kehe aluhe sigo aluhe iikwiila mbika nayi tulwe koshipala shOmuwa. Oyo omagano Aaisraeli taye ga gandja aluhe sigo aluhe.
Iikwiila otayi ningi yaAaron noyana. Oyo naye yi lile mehala eyapuki, oshoka oyo iiyapukilela. Oyo oshipewa shaaluhe tashi zi moondjambo tadhi yambelwa Omuwa.

Montanda yAaisraeli omwa li omulumentu a zi maandjawo muEgipiti e te ende pamwe nAaisraeli. Yina, omukulukadhi Omuisraeli, ihe he Omuegipiti. Edhina lyayina oShelomit yaDibri gwomezimo lyaDan. Omulumentu nguka okwa tameke okutamanana nomulumentu Omuisraeli. Okwa sheke edhina lyOmuwa nokwe li tuku. Nena oye mu eta kuMoses.
Oye mu tula moonkandja ya tegelela eutho lyOmuwa.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Kutha mo omuntu ngoka montanda. Shaa ngoka e mu uvile ta sheke, na tenteke oshikaha she komutse gwe, shi mu ningile onzapo. Nena egongalo alihe nali mu dhipage nomamanya.
Lombwela nduno Aaisraeli kutya shaa ngoka ta sheke Kalunga, ota pewa ondjo
nota dhipagwa. Omuisraeli kehe nomukwiilongo kehe a kala muIsrael ta sheke Omuwa, ota dhipagwa nomamanya kegongalo alihe.
“Oongoka ta dhipaga omuntu, na dhipagwe,
noshaa ngoka ta dhipaga oshimuna shaantu, oku na oku shi futa — omwenyo omomwenyo.
“Ngele oku na omuntu ta monitha mukwawo oshiponga, shoka a ningi mukwawo, osho na ningwe wo.

Ngele okwe mu teya esipa, esipa lye nali teywe; ngele okwe mu tsipula eho, eho lye limwe nali tsipulwe mo; ngele okwe mu kula eyego, eyego lye limwe nali kulwe mo. Ano shoka a ningile mukwawo, osho naanaa na ningilwe.
Shaa ngoka a dhipaga oshimuna, ne shi fute, ihe ngele okwa dhipaga omuntu, na dhipagwe.
Ompango oyimwe kune amuhe, Aaisraeli nenge aakwiilongo ya kala mokati keni, oshoka ongame Omuwa Kalunga keni.”
Moses sho a lombwele Aaisraeli oohapu ndhika, oya fala omulumentu ngoka kondje yontanda e taye mu dhipaga nomamanya. Aaisraeli oya gwanitha shoka Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
25: Omuwa okwa popi naMoses kondundu Sinai,
a gandje kAaisraeli omautho taga landula. Uuna tamu ka thika mevi ndyoka mwe li pewa kOmuwa, evi nali ningile Omuwa Esabati momumvo omutiheyali.
Momimvo hamano kuneni omapya geni, nomomimvo hamano opalekeni iitsambe yeni yomiviinu ne mu likole iiyetwamo yayo.
Ihe omumvo omutiheyali ogwo omumvo gwevululuko lyevi, omumvo gwa yapulilwa Omuwa. Inamu kuna omapya geni ne inamu opaleka iitsambe yeni yomiviinu.
Iilya mbyoka yi imenitha, inamu yi teya ne inamu likola omahila gomiviinu inaadhi opalekwa. Nguka ogwo omumvo gwevululuko lyevi.
Evi nali kale inaali longwa momumvo ngoka, otali mene iilya yoye noyaapika yoye, aalongeli yoye naakwiilongo ya kala mokati keni,
iimuna yoye niiyamakuti momalundu geni. Ashihe shoka tashi mene mo, iipalutha yayo.
Yaluleni omimvo heyali lwomimvo heyali, opo omimvo dhi ninge omilongo ne nomugoyi.
Nena mesiku etimulongo lyomwedhi omutiheyali hikitheni enkuma; mesiku lyegeyulukitho enkuma nali hikwe mevi alihe.

Yoololeni omumvo omutimilongontano e tamu igidha emanguluko lyaakalimo ayehe mevi. Omumvo nguka nagu kale omumvo gweligolo. Omaliko agehe ngoka ga landwa, naga shune kooyene nenge koyana, naangoka a landwa omupika, na shune koyaandjawo.
Inamu kuna omapya geni nenge mu teye iilya yi imenitha yo yene e tayi koko nenge mu likole omandjembele momiviinu dheni inaadhi opalekwa.
Omumvo aguhe otagu mu ningile omuyapuki; otamu li owala iilya mbyoka yi imenitha yo yene.
Momumvo nguka omaliko ngoka ga landwa, oge na okushuna kooyene yonale.
Uuna tamu landitha po omapya kAaisraeli ooyakweni nenge tamu ga landa kuyo, inamu thindilathana kongundhi.
Ondando nayi yelekwe nomimvo ndhoka epya tali vulu okugandja iilya sigo okomumvo gweligolo.
Ngele oku na omimvo odhindji, ondando otayi londo, ihe ngele oku na owala omimvo omishona, ondando otayi kuluka, oshoka shoka tashi landithwa po, iilya mbyoka tayi ka mena mepya moka.
Ino kotokela mukweni, tila Kalunga koye; oshoka oye Omuwa Kalunga koye.
Vulikeni koompango dhOmuwa adhihe nokomautho ge agehe, opo mu kale mu na ombili moshilongo.
Evi otali menitha iilya, notamu ka mona iikulya ya gwana po e tamu kala mu na ombili.
Ihe otashi vulika tamu pula tamu ti: “Oshike tashi ka liwa momumvo omutiheyali, omapya sho inaaga kunwa ko kwaa na eteyo?”
Omuwa ota yambeke evi momumvo omutihamano, li menithe iikulya ya gwana omimvo ndatu.
Sho tamu kunu omapya geni momumvo omutihetatu, otamu ka lya natango shoka mwa kunine momumvo omutihamano; otamu ka kala mu na iikulya ya gwana sigo tamu teya iilya momumvo omutimugoyi.
Omapya inaga landithwa po sigo aluhe, oshoka evi kali shi lyoye, olyaKalunga. Ngoye omukwiilongo ngoka a zimininwa oku li longitha.
Uuna epya tali landithwa po, uuthemba woshito wamwene gwalyo nau dhimbulukiwe.
Omuisraeli ngele ta shunduka a ninge ohepele e tashi mu thiminike a landithe po epya lye, omunezimo gwe gwomekota ne ke li landulule ko.
Omuntu ngoka kee na omunezimo gwomekota gwoku li landulula ko, ngele ota ningi omuyamba, e ke li landulule ko ye mwene,
na yalule omimvo ndhoka dha piti okuza kelandithopo lye, opo a fute omuntu ngoka e li landa iisimpo mbyoka tayi gwana sigo okomumvo gweligolo tagu ya. Nena ote li mono ishewe.
Ihe ngele ke na iimaliwa e li landulule ko, epya otali kala miikaha yaangoka e li landa sigo okomumvo gweligolo. Momumvo ngoka otali shuna kumwene gwalyo.
Ngele oku na omuntu ta landitha po egumbo li li moshilandohote, oku na uuthemba e ke li landulule ko omumvo gwotango gu udha okuza kesiku ndyoka lya landithwa po.
Ihe ngele ite li landulula ko momumvo ngoka, ota kanitha uuthemba woku li monununa. Egumbo otali ningi eliko lyanakulanda noluvalo lwe; itali ka galuka we omumvo gweligolo.
Ihe omagumbo ngoka ge li momikunda, naga ningwe ngaashi omapya; mwene e na uuthemba woku ga landulula notaga shuna omumvo gweligolo.
Ihe Aalevi naa kale ye na uuthemba waaluhe wokulandulula omagumbo miilando mbyoka ye yi pewa.
Ngele egumbo otali landithwa kOmulevi lyo inali landululwa we, nali shune momumvo gweligolo, oshoka omagumbo miilando yAalevi ogo eliko lyawo yene mokati kAaisraeli.
Ihe omaunapelo ga kunduka iilando yAalevi, inaga landithwa po; ogo eliko lyawo aluhe.
Ngele omushiinda gwoye Omuisraeli omukweni ta ningi ohepele ye ita vulu okwiikwatha, ou na oku mu kwatha ngaashi wo omukwiilongo nenge omuntu a kala maandjeni.
Ino mu pula ontanitho, ihe tila Kalunga nou kaleke omukweni pungoye.
Miimaliwa mbyoka te ku hehela, ino mu pula ontanitho nenge elikolo kiikulya mbyoka we yi mu landitha.
Oshipango shika oshOmuwa Kalunga keni, ngoka e mu tembudha muEgipiti, opo e mu pe evi lyaKaanan ye a ninge Kalunga keni.
Ngele Omuisraeli omukweni a kala pungoye ta hepa noti ilanditha po kungoye, a ninge omupika, ino mu longitha papika.
Na kale pungoye omulongeli gwoye note ku longele sigo okomumvo gweligolo.
Nena nge gwa thiki, ota manguluka pamwe noyana e ta shuna kaandjawo keliko lyoohekulu.
Aaisraeli oyo aapika yOmuwa, ngoka e ya tembudha muEgipiti, itaa landithwa po aapika.
Ino ya pangela nonyanya, ihe tila Kalunga.
Ngele owa pumbwa omupika, mu landa kiigwana yopuushiinda woye.
Otamu vulu wo okulanda aana yaakwiilongo mboka ya kala mokati keni. Aanona mboka ya valelwa mevi lyeni, otaa vulu ya ninge yeni,
notamu vulu oku ya thigila aana yeni ya ninge eliko lyawo noku ya longela mokukalamwenyo kwawo akuhe. Ihe Omuisraeli ino mu pangela nonyanya.
Omukwiilongo a kala mokati keni ngele ta yambapala, manga Omuisraeli omukweni ta thigonapala e ti ilanditha po, a ninge omupika komukwiilongo nenge komuntu gwaandjawo,
Omuisraeli oku na uuthemba wokumangululwa. Gumwe gwomaamwayina
nenge hekulu nenge gwaantsezi ye nenge omunezimo gulwe gwomekota ota vulu oku mu mangulula a shune; nenge ngele okwi iyadha ye mwene, ota vulu okwiikulila ko.
Na pule omayele komulandi gwe, oyo notaa yalula omimvo okuza kethimbo, uuna i ilanditha po sigo okomumvo gweligolo, e ta yeleke iikulila pandjele yondjambi yokufuta omuntu gwomiilonga.
Na fute oshitopolwa shoka shondando ye shi thike pomwaalu gwomimvo ndhoka dha thigala ko okwaadha omumvo gweligolo.
Iikulila nayi yalulwe pandjele ndjoka omuntu ta longele ondjambi. Ihe mwene gwe na kale itee mu pangele nonyanya.
Ngele ita mangululwa pamukalo nguka, na ka mangululwe pamwe noyana momumvo gweligolo tagu ya.
Omuisraeli ita vulu okukala omupika aluhe, oshoka Aaisraeli oyo aapika yOmuwa. Okwe ya tembudha muEgipiti. Oye Omuwa Kalunga kawo.
26: “Inamu iningila iimenka nenge mu idhikile iiyelekela, oongundhimanya nenge omamanya ga hongwa, mu ga tsile oongolo. Ongame Omuwa Kalunga keni.
Dhiginineni Esabati lyandje ne mu simaneke ehala mpoka handi simanekelwa. Ongame Omuwa.
“Ngele otamu ende paipango yandje e tamu vulika komautho gandje,
otandi mu lokithile omvula pethimbo lyo opala, opo evi li menithe iilya nomiti dhi ime iiyimati.

Iilya yeni otayi ka ninga oyindji notamu ka yungula iilya sigo opethimbo lyokulikola omandjembele notamu ka likola omandjembele sigo opethimbo lyokukuna iilya. Otamu ka mona iikulya ya gwana po notamu ka kala mu na ombili moshilongo.
“Otandi mu pe ombili mevi lyeni, notamu ka kotha mwaa na omahalutho gasha. Otandi ke mu mangulula miiponga yiilikama moshilongo, noitaku ka kala we iita.
Otamu ka sinda aatondi yeni;
yatano yomune otaa ka tidha ethele, nethele lyomune otali ka sinda omayuvi omulongo.
Otandi ke mu yambeka noku mu pa oluvalo olwindji; otandi dhiginine ehangano ndyoka nda hangana nane.
Eteyo lyeni otali ka kala eloolo tali adha sigo okomumvo omukwawo, nando iigandhi tamu yi opalekele eteyo epe.
Otandi ka kala mokati keni metsalihangano lyandje, noitandi mu thigi po nando.
Otandi ka kala pamwe nane. Otandi ka ninga Kalunga keni, none aantu yandje.
Ongame, Omuwa Kalunga keni, nde mu tembudha muEgipiti, opo mwaa kale we aapika. Onda sindi oonkondo ndhoka dhe mu thindile pevi nonde mu enditha mwa thikameka omitse.”
“Iipango yandje ngele itamu yi dhiginine,
ihe otamu tindi okuvulika koompango dhandje nokomautho gandje e tamu yono ehangano lyetu nane,

otandi ke mu geela. Otandi mu undulile oshivu — omikithi dha nyengana nomalwiidhi tage mu tsikitha omeho e tage mu uvitha omwenyo omutoye. Otamu ka kuna oombuto dheni, ihe osima yowala, oshoka aatondi yeni otaye ke mu sinda e taa li po shoka mwa kokitha.
Otandi mu pilukile e tamu ka sindika, naamboka ye mu tonde, otaye ke mu pangela. Otamu ka haluka tamu pwampwauka, ko kwaa na ngo te mu tidha.
“Ngele natango itamu vulika kungame, otandi ka indjipalitha egeelo lyeni luheyali.
Otandi ka teyagula po omatha guuntsa weni; itaku ka lokwa we, evi lyeni notali ka sa oluteni e tali kolonda lya fa osheela.
Oonkondo dheni otadhi ka hepa, oshoka evi lyeni itali ka menitha we iimeno, nomiti itadhi ka ima we iiyimati.
“Ngele otamu tsikile natango okutangalala e tamu tindi okuvulika kungame, egeelo lyeni otandi li indjipalitha ishewe luheyali.
Otandi ka tuma iilikama hayi lyana mokati keni, notayi ka lya po aana yeni, tayi thekula po iimuna yeni notayi thigi po aashona yowala, nomapola geni taga mbugala.
“Ihe ngele natango konima yegeelo ndika inamu pulakena ndje, ndele otamu tsikile okwiinenepekela ndje,
nena otandi mu pilukile e tandi mu geele luheyali ndi vulithe ponale.
Otandi mu undulile iita, opo ndi mu geelele eyono lyehangano lyandje, nongele tamu gongala miilando mu holame, otandi ke mu tumina elega notamu ka gandjwa miikaha yaatondi yeni.
Otandi ka kutha po ondjundo yoondya dheni, opo aakulukadhi omulongo taa vulu okuninga oshikwiila shimwe ashike. Otaye shi topola, ihe nge mwe shi li, otamu kala mwa nkololoka.
“Konima yaambika ngele otamu tsikile natango okwiinenepekela ndje nokutinda okuvulika kungame,
nena mondjahi yandje otandi mu pilukile, negeelo lyandje otandi li ningi edhigu luheyali li vule nale.
Ondjala yeni otayi ka geya, sigo tamu li po aana yeni nokuli.
Otandi ka hanagula po omahala geni gomalongelokalunga koondundu, tandi kumuna po iiyambelo yeni yiitsinino, e tandi umbile omidhimba dheni kombanda yiimenka ya hatwa po. Menyanyalo
otandi kumuna po iilando yeni nokuhanagula po omahala geni gelongelokalunga, notandi tindi okutaamba oontselelandjambo dheni.
Oshilongo sheni otandi shi hanagula po thiluthilu, naatondi mboka ye shi lala, otaa ka haluka pehanagulo.
Otandi ke mu undulila iita noku mu halakanitha nomavi gaakwiilongo. Evi lyeni tali ka mbugala, niilando yeni tayi ningi omakulukuma.
Nena evi otali ka nyanyukilwa omimvo dhevululuko li ihwa po ndyoka inaamu li gandja; otali ka kala lye ethiwa li vululukwe, manga ne mu li muupongekwa mevi lyaatondi yeni.
“Mboka ya hupu ko ye li muupongekwa, otandi ke ya kukumitha noshihomo shombepo tayi pepe komafo. Otamu matuka mwa fa tamu tidhwa molugodhi notamu punduka, nando omutondi ina thika pune.
Otamu ka tantagala tamu londathana, nando kape na ngoka te mu tidha, noitamu vulu okukondjitha aatondi yeni.
Otamu ka sila muupongekwa mwa ninwa po kevi lyaatondi yeni.
Aashona yomune mboka taa hupu ko moshilongo shaatondi yeni, otaa ka thithonokela mo omoluulunde weni nomoluulunde woohekulu.
“Ihe oluvalo lweni otalu ka hempulula oondjo dhalwo noondjo dhoohekulu mboka ya tindi ndje noya tsu ondumbo nangame,
opo ndi ya pilukile noku ya undulila muupongekwa mevi lyaatondi yawo. Hugunina, oluvalo lweni sho lwi ifupipike nolwa futu eiteko lyalwo,
nena otandi dhimbulukwa ehangano lyandje nda hangana naJakob, naIsak nonaAbraham, notandi ningi euvaneko lyandje epe ishewe, opo ndi pe aantu yandje oshilongo.
Ihe tango evi otali mbugala e tali nyanyukilwa evululuko lyi ihwa po, manga aantu kaaye mo. Aantu oye na okufuta eiteko lyawo, sho ye ekelehi oompango dhandje nomautho gandje.
Ihe nando ye li mevi lyaatondi yawo, itandi ya etha thiluthilu nenge ndi ya yone po. Itandi hulitha po ehangano lyandje nayo, oshoka ongame Omuwa Kalunga kawo.
Onda hangana ehangano noohekulu, sho nde ya tembudha muEgipiti montaneho yiigwana, opo ndi kale Kalunga kawo. Ehangano ndika otandi li ningi epe ishewe. Ongame Omuwa.”
Oompango ndhika adhihe nomautho ngaka agehe Omuwa e ga gandja kuMoses kondundu Sinai, opo e ga pe Aaisraeli.
27: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli to ti: ‘Ngele oku na omuntu tu uvaneke euvaneko ta gandja omuntu kOmuwa, omuntu ngoka a gandjwa ota vulu okumangululwa nokufutilwa ngeyi.
Ngele omulumentu gwomimvo omilongo mbali sigo omilongo hamano: iimaliwa iisiliveli omilongo ntano pandjele yoshimaliwa oshisiliveli shoka hashi longithwa motempeli,
ihe ngele omukiintu: iimaliwa omilongo ndatu;
omulumentu gwomimvo ntano sigo omilongo mbali: iimaliwa omilongo mbali, ihe ngele omukiintu: iimaliwa omulongo;
okanona okamati kohi yomimvo ntano: iimaliwa itano, ihe ngele okakadhona: iimaliwa itatu;
omusamane e vule omimvo omilongo hamano: iimaliwa omulongo niitano, ihe ngele omukulukadhi: iimaliwa omulongo.
“ ‘Omuntu ngoka tu uvaneke ngele ohepele ta nyengwa okufuta, mu faleni komuyambi, nomuyambi ota fupipike ondando pandjele yomufuti.
“ ‘Ngele oshimuna shaa na oshidhila tashi uvanekwa, nena ayihe mbyoka tayi pewa Omuwa, nayi kale iiyapuki.
Omuntu ngoka tu uvaneke ina landakanitha oshimuna shilwe nasho. Nge te shi ningi, iimuna ayihe oyOmuwa.
Ihe ngele oshimuna oshoshidhila, shoka inaashi opalela okuyambela Omuwa, na fale oshimuna komuyambi.
Omuyambi ote shi uthile ondando pandjele yasho yuuwanawa noyondjundo, nondando otayi mana po oohapu.
Omuntu ngele okwa hala e shi kulile ko, na fute ondando a gwedha ko oshititano.
“ ‘Ngele oku na omuntu ta yoololele Omuwa egumbo lye, omuyambi na uthe ondando pandjele yuuwanawa nondjundo yalyo, ondando notayi mana po oohapu.
Omugandji gwalyo ngele okwa hala e li kulile ko, na fute ondando a gwedha ko oshititano.
“ ‘Omuntu ngele ota yapulile Omuwa oshipambu shepya lye, ondando otayi yelekwa nombuto tayi kunwa mo. Oolata omulongo nambali dhombuto yiilya otadhi gu iimaliwa iisiliveli omilongo ntano.
Ngele ote li gandja mbala okuza komumvo gweligolo, nena ondando ayihe otayi pulwa.
Ngele ote li gandja komeho, omuyambi na tale ondjundo pamwaalu gwomimvo dha hupu ko sigo okomumvo gweligolo, e tu utha ondando ya kuthilwe ko.
Omuntu ngoka ta gandja epya ngele okwa hala oku li kulila ko, na fute ondando mwa gwedhwa oshititano.
Ngele ota landitha po epya komuntu gulwe, manga inee li kulila ko kOmuwa, nena ota kanitha uuthemba woku ke li kulila ko ishewe.
Komumvo gweligolo epya otali ningilile lyOmuwa; otali ningi eliko lyaayambi.
“ ‘Omuntu ngele ota yapulile Omuwa epya e li landa,
omuyambi na tale ondando pamwaalu gwomimvo sigo okomumvo gweligolo, nomuntu na fute ondando esiku tuu ndyoka; iimaliwa mbika oyOmuwa.
Momumvo gweligolo epya nali shune kumwene gwalyo nenge koluvalo lwe.
“ ‘Oondando adhihe nadhi yelekwe pandjele yoshimaliwa oshisiliveli hashi longithwa motempeli.
“ ‘Osheeli shoshimuna oshOmuwa, onkee kaku na ngoka te shi mu yoololele we. Okatana, okanzigona nenge okakombwena kosheeli okOmuwa,
ihe osheeli shoshimuna shi na oshidhila, otashi kulilwa pandando ya yeleka ya gwedhwa oshititano shimwe. Ngele itashi kulilwa, nashi landithwe kushaa ngoka pandando ya yeleka.
“ ‘Kaku na omuntu ta landa nenge ta kulile shoka a yapulila Omuwa nokugana, nashi kale omuntu nenge oshimuna nenge epya. Otashi ningilile shOmuwa.
Nokuli omuntu ngoka a yapulilwa okuhanagulwa po, ina kulilwa; na dhipagwe.
“ ‘Iitimulongo ayihe yomiilikolwa yomomapya, iilya nenge iiyimati, oyOmuwa.
Ngele oku na omuntu e yi kulile, na fute pandando ya yeleka mwa gwedhwa oshititano shimwe.
Shimwe shomiimuna omulongo kehe oshOmuwa. Uuna iimuna tayi yalulwa, oshimuna oshitimulongo oshOmuwa.
Mwene ina simonona iimuna, a mone kutya shika oshiwanawa nenge oshiwinayi, noine shi landakanitha, ihe ngele ote shi landakanitha, ayihe iyali oyOmuwa, itayi kulilwa.’ ”
Iipango mbika oyo mbyoka Omuwa e yi pe Moses kondundu Sinai yokulombwela Aaisraeli.

ye na omimvo omilongo mbali nenge dhi vule po, mboka ya gwana okuhinga iita.
Puleni omukuluntu mezimo kehe, e mu kwathe.”

oya hiya egongalo alihe mesiku lyotango lyomwedhi omutiyali e taa nyola aantu pamaludhi nopamagumbo gawo. Omadhina gaalumentu ayehe yomimvo omilongo mbali nenge dhi vule po, oga nyolwa e taa yalulwa,
ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses. Moses okwa yalula aantu mombuga Sinai.

Aalevi inaa yalulwa pamwe nomazimo galwe,
oshoka Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Uuna to yalula aalumentu mboka ya gwana okuhinga iita, ino kwatelela mo ezimo lyaLevi.
Tula Aalevi metonatelo lyetsalihangano niikwaniipangitho ayihe yalyo. Naye li humbate niikwaniipangitho yalyo. Oyo ayeke ye na okuyakula mo, e taa dhike ootenda dhawo dhe li kunduka.
Uuna to tembudha po ontanda, Aalevi naa humbate etsalihangano e taye li dhike ishewe montanda ompe. Shaa ngoka gulwe ta hedha ketsalihangano, na dhipagwe.
Aaisraeli yalwe naa yunge oontanda, ongundu nongundu, shaa ngoka nongundu ye mwene yi na epandela lyayo.
Ihe Aalevi naa yunge ontanda ya kunduka etsalihangano ye li langele, opo pwaa kale ngoka ta hedha kulyo okupendutha ondjahi yandje, yi hwamene Aaisraeli.”
Aaisraeli noya ningi ayihe, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.

Omwaalu aguhe kumwe gwAaisraeli mboka ya yalulwa miitopolwa pamaludhi gawo, ogwa li 603 550.
Aalevi inaa yalulilwa mo, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Aaisraeli oya ningi ayihe mbyoka Omuwa a lombwele Moses. Oya yungu oontanda shaa ngoka pombaaneli yawo noya zi po shaa ngoka noludhi lwe.
3: Ezimo lyaAaron naMoses olyo ndika, uuna ndoka Omuwa a popi naMoses kondundu Sinai.
Aaron okwa li e na oyana aamati yane; oyo Nadab, osheeli, Abihu, Eleasar naItamar.
Oya li ya gwayekwa noya yapulwa ya ninge aayambi,
ihe Nadab naAbihu oya dhipagwa, sho ya yambele Omuwa mombuga Sinai omulilo gwaa shi omuyapuki. Kaya li ye na aanona, onkee Eleasar naItamar oya longo oshilonga shuuyambi muuyuni wahe Aaron.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Hedhitha huka Aalevi, u ya langeke aayakuli yomuyambi Aaron.
Naa longe iilonga tayi pumbiwa metsalihangano yo ya yakule omuyambi Aaron negongalo alihe.
Naa tonatele iikwaniipangitho ayihe metsalihangano e taa longo peha lyAaisraeli.
Aaisraeli naa gandje Aalevi, opo ya yakule Aaron noyana.
Ihe Aaron noyana oto ya langeke miilonga yuuyambi. Ngele oku na gulwe ta kambadhala oku ya holela, na dhipagwe.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:

“Ngashingeyi Aalevi oyandje. Sho nda dhipaga aatango yAayegipiti, osheeli shomegumbo kehe lyomuIsrael onde shi iyapulile, nosheeli shoshimuna kehe. Ngashingeyi peha lyokukala niisheeli yomuIsrael ondi na Aalevi; oyo oyandje. Ongame Omuwa.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses mombuga Sinai,
a yalule Aalevi pamaludhi nopamagumbo gawo nokunyola omulumentu kehe gwomwedhi gumwe nenge e vule po.
Moses okwe shi ningi.

Levi okwa li e na oyana aamati yatatu: Gerson, Kohat naMerari, mboka ya li oohekulu yomaludhi ngoka ge ya lukilwa. Gerson okwa li e na oyana aamati yaali: Libni naShimei. Kohat okwa li e na oyana aamati yane: Amram, Izhar, Hebron naUssiel. Merari okwa li e na oyana aamati yaali: Mahli naMushi. Oyo ya li oohekulu yomaludhi ngoka ge ya lukilwa.
MuGerson omwa zi ezimo lyaLibni nolyaShimei. Mbaka Aakwagerson.
Omwaalu gwawo aguhe gwaalumentu yomwedhi gumwe naamboka ye vule po, ogwa li 7 500.
Oludhi nduka olwa li halu yungu ontanda kuuninginino konima yetsalihangano
pamwe naEljasaf lyaLael, omukuluntu gwoludhi.
Oya li ye na oshimpwiyu shotenda, omasiikilo gayo, eshigolapi lyayo,
omalapi gehale lyetsalihangano, eshigolapi lyoposheelo shehale, oshiyambelo noongodhi dhehale. Oya li ye na oshimpwiyu shomayakulo agehe ge na ekwatathano niinima mbika.
MuKohat omwa zi ezimo lyaAmram, lyaIzhar, lyaHebron nolyaUssiel. Mbaka Aakwakehat.
Omwaalu gwawo aguhe gwaalumentu yomwedhi gumwe naamboka ye vule po, ogwa li 8 600.
Oludhi nduka olwa li halu yungu ontanda kuumbugantu wetsalihangano
pamwe naElisafan lyaUssiel, omukuluntu gwoludhi.

Oya li aanashimpwiyu yoshikethahangano, oshitaafula, oshihukikwanyeka, iiyambelo, iikwaniipangitho mbyoka hayi longithwa kaayambi melongelokalunga, netopolitho tali yoolola Ehala lyUuyapuki kEhala lyUuyapukielela. Oya li ye na oshimpwiyu shomayakulo agehe ge na ekwatathano niinima mbika.
Omukuluntu gwAalevi okwa li Eleasar lyaAaron omuyambi. Oye a li ta tonatele ayehe mboka taa yakula metsalihangano.
MuMerari omwa zi ezimo lyaMahli nolyaMushi. Mbaka Aakwamerari.
Omwaalu gwawo aguhe gwaalumentu yomwedhi gumwe naamboka ye vule po, ogwa li 6 200.
Oludhi nduka olwa li halu yungu ontanda kuumbangalantu wetsalihangano pamwe naSuriel yaAbihail, omukuluntu gwoludhi.
Oya li ya pewa oshimpwiyu shiipilangi yokuthikameka etsalihangano, omalukambo, oongudhi, oompadhi niipumbiwa yalyo ayihe. Oya li ye na oshimpwiyu shomayakulo agehe ge na ekwatathano niinima mbika.
Oya sile wo oongundhi dhehale noompadhi, oongodhi noomboha dhadho oshimpwiyu.

Moses naAaron noyana oya li ye na okuyunga ontanda komeho getsalihangano lwokuuzilo. Oya li ye na oshimpwiyu shokutsakanitha omayakulo metsalihangano molwAaisraeli. Shaa ngoka gulwe te shi yelekele e shi ninge, oku na okudhipagwa.
Omwaalu gwaalumentu Aalevi ayehe kumwe yomwedhi gumwe naamboka ye vule po payalulo lyomaludhi lya ningwa palombwelo lyOmuwa, ogwa li 22 000.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Yalula aamati ayehe aatango yAaisraeli okuza kumboka yomwedhi gumwe naamboka ye vule po; kutha omwaalu gwomadhina gawo.
Aalevi oye na okukala yandje peha lyaatango ayehe yAaisraeli, niimuna yAalevi otayi pingene po iimuna yAaisraeli. Ongame Omuwa.”
Moses okwa vulika nokwa yalula aamati ayehe aatango
yomwedhi gumwe naamboka ye vule po, nomwaalu gwawo aguhe ogwa li 22 273.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Ngashingeyi yoololela ndje Aalevi ya ninge yandje peha lyaamati ayehe aatango yAaisraeli. Yoolola wo iimuna ayihe yAalevi peha lyiimuna ayihe iitango yAaisraeli.
Aatango mbaka 273 ye vule omwaalu gwAalevi ou na oku ya kulila ko.
Shaa ngoka ota gu iisiliveli itano pandjele yiimaliwa mbyoka hayi longithwa motempeli.
Gandja iimaliwa mbika yiikulila kuAaron noyana.”
Moses okwa kutha iimaliwa yiikulila yomwaalu gwaatango mboka ye vule omwaalu gwAalevi.
Okwa kutha iimaliwa iisiliveli 1 365
e ta pe Aaron noyana ofuto yekulilo, ngaashi Omuwa e mu lombwele.
4: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses naAaron a ti:
“Yalula omwaalu gwAalevi yoludhi lwaKohat pamazimo nopamagumbo gawo,
aalumentu ayehe yomimvo omilongo ndatu sigo omilongo ntano mboka ya gwana miilonga yeyakulo lyetsalihangano.
Eyakulo lyawo olya kwatelela mo iinima iiyapukilela.
“Uuna ontanda tayi tembudhwa, Aaron noyana naya ye metsalihangano e taa kutha mo etopolitho ye li siikile oshikethahangano.
Naye shi siikile noshipa shongombefuta e taa yala ko onguwo ombulau kombanda nokuhwekela omitenge moonkogo.
“Naa siikile oshitaafula shiikwiila iiyapuki nelapi embulau e taa tenteke ko iiyaha, iitsinino, uuyo womayambo niitenga yiinuwandjambo. Koshitaafula naku kale aluhe iikwiila iiyapuki.
Naa siikile ayihe mbika nelapi etiligane e taa tula ko oshipa shongombefuta nokuhwekela omitenge moonkogo.
“Naa kuthe onguwo ombulau e taa siikile nayo oshihukikwanyeka noolamba dhasho, iikonde yokutetitha omalapi goolamba, iikangwa yokutula mo omutoko gwokomalapi niikwatelwa yomagadhi gooholivi.
Naye shi dhingile niikwaniipangitho yasho ayihe moshipa shongombefuta e taye shi tula piihumbatelo.
“Naa siikile oshiyambelo shoshingoli nelapi embulau e taa tula ko oshipa shongombefuta notaa hwekele mo omitenge.
Naa kuthe iilongitho ayihe hayi longithwa metsalihangano, notaye yi dhingile melapi embulau e taye yi siikile noshipa shongombefuta noku yi tula piihumbatelo.
Naa kuthe omutoko koshiyambelo e taye shi siikile nelapi etiliganembwilili.
Naa tenteke ko iikwaniipangitho ayihe hayi longithwa poshiyambelo: iikangwa yomakala, iizigitho, iihupulo nuuyo. Naye yi siikile ihe noshipa shongombefuta e taa hwekele mo omitenge.

Ontanda nge tayi tembuka, oludhi lwaKohat nalu humbate iinima iiyapuki, Aaron noyana shaa ya mana oku yi siikila niipumbiwa yayo ayihe. Oludhi lwaKohat inalu guma iinima iiyapuki, otaa ningi ya se.
“Shika oshimpwiyu sholudhi lwaKohat, uuna etsalihangano tali tembuka.
“Eleasar, omuna gwomuyambi Aaron, na sile etsalihangano oshimpwiyu nomagadhi gomoolamba, iitsinino, oondjambo dhiikulya, omagadhi gokugwaya noshaa shoka metsalihangano sha yapulilwa Omuwa.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses naAaron e ta ti:
“Inamu pitika, oludhi lwaKohat
lu dhipagwe po kokuhedha popepi niinima iiyapukilela. Opo shaa ningwe, Aaron noyana naa ye mo e taa pe omuntu kehe oshilonga she e taye mu lombwele shoka e na okuhumbata.
Ihe Aakwakehat ngele taa yi metsalihangano, ya tale aayambi nkene taa longekidhile iinima iiyapuki etembu, otaa si.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Yalula wo omwaalu gwAalevi yoludhi lwaGerson pamazimo nopamagumbo,
aalumentu ayehe yomimvo omilongo ndatu sigo omilongo ntano mboka ya gwana okuyakula metsalihangano.
Eyakulo lyawo olyo okuhumbata iinima tayi landula:
etsalihangano, esiikilo lyalyo lyomeni, esiikilo lyokombanda lyiipa yoongombefuta, eshigolapi lyoposheelo,
omalapi noongodhi dhehale lya kunduka etsalihangano noshiyambelo, eshigolapi lyoposheelo shehale, niipumbiwa ayihe yokuthikameka iinima mbika. Naa gwanithe iilonga ayihe tayi pumbiwa miinima mbika.
Moses naAaron naa tale, nkene oludhi lwaGerson talu gwanitha iilonga yalwo ayihe notalu humbata shaa shoka talu pewa kuAaron noyana.
Iimpwiyu yoludhi lwaGerson mokuyakula metsalihangano oyo mbika; naye yi gwanithe mewiliko lyaItamar yaAaron omuyambi.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a yalule Aalevi yoludhi lwaMerari pamazimo nopamagumbo gawo,
aalumentu ayehe yomimvo omilongo ndatu sigo oyomilongo ntano mboka ya gwana okuyakula metsalihangano.
Eyakulo lyawo olyo okuhumbata iipilangi, omalukambo, oongundhi noompadhi dhetsalihangano,
nosho wo oongundhi, oompadhi, oomboha noongodhi dhehale lya kunduka etsalihangano niipumbiwa yadho ayihe. Omulumentu kehe ota kala e na oshilonga shokuhumbata iinima yontumba.
Iimpwiyu yoludhi lwaMerari meyakulo metsalihangano oyo mbika; naye yi gwanithe mewiliko lyaItamar yaAaron omuyambi.

Omulumentu kehe okwa yalulwa, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses; nopalombwelo lyOmuwa lya pewa Moses, omulumentu kehe okwa pewa oshimpwiyu shokuhumbata.
5: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Aaisraeli naa tidhe mo moontanda shaa ngoka e na uuvu woshilundu nenge ngoka i ikwatitha oshidhila, sho a gumu omudhimba.
Aantu mbaka ya nika oshidhila naa tidhwe mo, opo yaa nyateke oontanda moka nda kala mokati kawo.”
Aaisraeli oya vulika e taye ya tidha mo moontanda.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli kutya ngele ope na omulumentu nenge omukiintu ti iteka Omuwa e ta yono komuntu mukwawo, ota kala e na ondjo.
Oku na okuhempulula eyono lye e ta futu ongunga ye a gwedhela ko oshititano.

Ihe omuntu ngoka a yono, ngele okwa si ye kee na omunezimo lyomekota gwokufutwa, ofuto nayi pewe Omuwa, yi ninge yomuyambi. Omufuti na gandje wo onzi ondumentu yehanganitho, ndjoka tayi dhimi po ondjo ye.
Oshigandjwa kehe oshiyapuki Omuisraeli te shi etele Omuwa, otashi ningi shomuyambi ngoka e shi etelwa.
Omuyambi kehe ota dhiginine omayambo e ga pewa.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli omautho moshinima sha tya ngeyi. Otashi vulika omukiintu ta kotokele omulume e ta yi komulumentu gulwe.
Omulumentu nguka ota lala naye, ihe omukiintu ote shi holeke omulume. Kaku na wo ngoka e mu kwata onkankeka, nando ye mwene okwa yona shili.
Omulume ngele ota kwatwa kuukodhi molweyono ndika, nenge ota kwatwa kuukodhi, nando omukadhi ina yona,

ne mu fale komuyambi. Na fale wo ondjambo yomukadhi, yi thike pomakopi gaali guusila wiishokelya, ihe ina tula ko omagadhi nenge iitsinino, oshoka oyo ondjambo yuukodhi, ondjambo tayi dhimbulukitha eyono.
“Omuyambi ne ete po omukiintu e te mu thikameke komeho goshiyambelo.
Na tile omeya gamwe moshiyuma sheloya e ta kutha evi polupanda lwetsalihangano e te li tula momeya.

Opo ihe na thikameke omukiintu koshipala shOmuwa nokuhwatununa omafufu gomukiintu e ta tula ondjambo yedhimbulukitho, kokutya ondjambo yuukodhi, peke lyomukiintu. Meke lyomuyambi omu na omeya omalulu gethingano.
Omuyambi na ganithe omukiintu e ta ti kuye: ‘Ngele ino hondela, omeya gethingano itage ku etele oshiponga.
Ihe ngele owa hondela,
nena Omuwa na thinge edhina lyoye mokati kooyakweni. Na thinge oshivalelo shoye shi ganye, nela lyoye li zinde.

Omeya ngaka gethingano naga ye mela lyoye, opo ge li zindike, noshivalelo shoye shi ganye.’
“Omukiintu na yamukule ta ti: ‘Otandi zimine; Omuwa na longe.’
“Konima yaambika omuyambi na nyole etulomutima ndika nokuyoga enyolo momeya gethingano.
Manga inaa nwetha omukiintu omeya gethingano,
omuyambi na kuthe ondjambo yuukodhi miikaha yomukiintu, ye ne yi dhugadhuge koshipala shOmuwa e te yi tula koshiyambelo.
Na kuthe mondjambo eke lyu udha lyuusila noku u lungunithila koshiyambelo. Hugunina na nwethe omukiintu omeya.
Ngele omukiintu okwa hondela, omeya otage mu ehameke; ela lye otali zindi, noshivalelo she tashi ihunyu mumwe. Ota kala omuthingwa mokati koyaandjawo.
Ihe ngele ke na ondjo, ita ningwa sha nota vulu okuvala.
“Ndjika ompango yuukodhi, omukiintu nge ta kotokele omulume e ta hondele.
Ngele omulumentu ta kwatwa kuukodhi e ta kodhilile omukadhi, na tule omukadhi koshipala shOmuwa, nomuyambi ni ipyakidhile naye pautho lyompango ndjika.
Omulumentu na kale a manguluka kondjo, ihe omukiintu ngele oku na ondjo, na tegelele egeelo.”
6: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses nokwa ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli u tye: Ngele ope na omulumentu nenge omukiintu ta gana egano lya sheywa, a ninge omunasiri noti iyapulile Omuwa,
ni idhilike omaviinu nomalovu. Na kale itaa nu sha sha kolwa moomviinu nenge a lye omandjembele omatalala nenge goonganye.
Ethimbo alihe manga e li muunasiri, ina lya sha sha za moomviinu, nando shi kale oonkenya nenge omayula gomandjembele.
“Ethimbo alihe e li kohi yegano lyuunasiri, ina tetitha omafufu ge nenge e ga kulule. Okwa mangwa kegano ethimbo alihe ndyoka i iyapulila Omuwa; na ethe omafufu ge noombenzi dhe dhi koke.
Omasiku agehe sho i iyapulila Omuwa, ke na okuhedha pomudhimba.
Nando na kale ohe nenge yina a sa, nenge omumwayina omulumentu nenge omukiintu, ini ikwatitha oshidhila kuyo, oshoka endhindhiliko lyeiyapulo lye kuKalunga oli li komutse gwe.
Ethimbo alihe manga e li muunasiri, okwa yapulilwa Omuwa.

“Omafufu omayapuki gomunasiri ngele oga nyatekwa, molwashoka pe na omuntu a si ombaadhilila popepi naye, na tegelele omasiku gaheyali, opo a kulule omafufu ge noombenzi dhe; osho ngeyi ta ka kala a yogoka.
Mesiku etihetatu ne ete oonguti mbali nenge uungutyona uyali komuyambi posheelo shetsalihangano.
Omuyambi na yambe yimwe yi ninge eyonondjambo, nonkwawo yi ninge efikilondjambo, opo a gwanithe eitheto lye pamusindilo molwekwatathano lye nomudhimba. Esiku tuu ndyoka omuntu na yapule omafufu ge,
ye a tamekulule okwiiyapulila Omuwa ethimbo lye alihe lyuunasiri. Ethimbo lyonale itali yalulwa we, oshoka okwa kwatitha omafufu ge oshipwe. Na yambe ondjondjambo yonzigona yomumvo gumwe.
“Uuna omunasiri ta tsakanitha euvaneko lye, na gwanithe omisindilo. Na ye kosheelo shetsalihangano
e te etele Omuwa iimuna itatu yaa na oshipo: onzigona ondumentu yomumvo gumwe omolwefikilondjambo, onzigona onkiintu yomumvo gumwe omolwondjondjambo nonzi ondumentu omolwekwatathanondjambo.

Ne ete wo ontungwa yi na iikwiila inaayi tulwa efulika: iikwiila ya mbumbwakana ya ningwa nuusila womunziya wa lungilwa momagadhi gooholivi, uukwiila wa pepuka wa gwayekwa omagadhi gooholivi nondjambo yiikulya niikunuwa pamwe niimuna mbyoka.
“Ayihe mbika omuyambi ne yi ete koshipala shOmuwa, ye a yambe ondjondjambo nefikilondjambo.
Na yambele Omuwa onzi ondumentu omolwekwatathanondjambo te yi yamba pamwe nontungwa yiikwiila yaa na efulika; na yambe wo ondjambo yiikulya niikunuwa.
Omunasiri na kululithe omutse gwe posheelo shetsalihangano, nomafufu ge ne ga umbile momulilo ngoka tagu lungunitha po ekwatathanondjambo.
“Shampa oshooko shonzi sha pi mombiga, omuyambi ne shi kuthe pamwe noshikwiila shimwe sha mbumbwakana, e te yi tula peke lyomunasiri.

Omuyambi ne yi dhungadhungithe koshipala shOmuwa. Oyo ondjambo ondjapuki tayi ningi yomuyambi, pamwe nondete noshilama shonzi, mbyoka tayi ningi yomuyambi pampango. Konima yaambika omunasiri ota pitikwa a nwe omaviinu.
“Ndjika oyo ompango yaanasiri, ihe omunasiri ngele ota gandja euvaneko tali pitilile shoka egano lye tali pula, na tsakanithe shili euvaneko ndyoka.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela Aaron noyana kutya mokuyambeka Aaisraeli oye na okutya ngeyi:
Omuwa ne ku laleke nuuyamba ye ne ku gamene.
Omuwa ne ku yelithile oshipala she ye ne ku sile ohenda.
Omuwa ne ku taalelithile oshipala she ye ne ku pe ombili.”
Osho ngeyi naa tumbulile Aaisraeli edhina lyandje, ngame notandi ya yambeke.
7: Moses sho a mana okudhika etsalihangano, okwe li gwayeke e te li yapula niikwaniipangitho yalyo ayihe, osho wo oshiyambelo niikwaniipangitho yasho.
Nena aakuluntu yomaludhi mboka ya li aawiliki yomazimo gaIsrael, aalumentu tuu mboka ya li aatonateli yomayalulo,
oye eta omayambo gawo kOmuwa: Omatemba gahamano noonani omulongo nambali, etemba limwe olya zi kaawiliki yaali, nonani okomuwiliki kehe. Sho ye ga gandja,
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses e ta ti:
“Taamba omagano ngaka gokulongithwa miilonga omolwetsalihangano; ga pa Aalevi pailonga mbyoka ye na oku yi longa.”
Moses okwa gandja omatemba noonani kAalevi.
Omatemba gaali noonani ne okwe dhi gandja kAakwagerson,
nomatemba gane noonani hetatu okwe dhi gandja kAakwamerari. Iilonga yawo ayihe oya li yi na okulongwa mewiliko lyaItamar yaAaron.
Moses ina gandja omatemba nenge oonani kAakwakohat, oshoka oyo taa si oshimpwiyu shiilongitho iiyapuki mbyoka ye na oku yi humbata komapepe gawo.
Aawiliki oye eta wo omayambo, opo ya dhane oshituthi sheyapulo lyoshiyambelo. Sho ya li yi ilongekidha okugandja omagano gawo poshiyambelo,
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Ya lombwela kutya esiku kehe lyethimbo lyomasiku omulongo nagaali, gumwe gwomaawiliki oku na okugandja omagano ge e ga gandjele eyapulo lyoshiyambelo.”

Omayambo ngoka ge etwa, oga li ga faathana: oshiyaha shimwe shoshisiliveli shoosekeli 130 nokayaha koshisiliveli koosekeli 70, ayihe pandjele yosekeli ndjoka hayi longithwa motempeli, ayihe iyali oya li yu udha uusila womunziya mwa tulwa omagadhi gooholivi omolwondjambo yiikulya; oshiyaha shimwe shoshingoli shoosekeli omulongo, shu udha uutsinino; ongombe yimwe ondumentu yomutanda, onzi yimwe ondumentu, onzigona yimwe yomumvo gumwe omolwefikilondjambo; noontsezi mbali, oonzi ntano oondumentu, iikombo itano noonzigona ntano dhomumvo gumwe omolwekwatathanondjambo.

Omayambo agehe kumwe ngoka ge etwa kaawiliki omulongo nayaali omolweyapulo lyoshiyambelo, oge li ngaashi taga landula mpaka:
— iiyaha yoshisiliveli omulongo niiyali,
uuyaha woshisiliveli omulongo nuuyali,
ayihe kumwe yoosekeli 2 400
— iiyaha yoshingoli omulongo niiyali,
ayihe kumwe yoosekeli 120, yu udha iitsinino
— oontsezi omulongo nambali,
oonzi oondumentu omulongo nambali
noonzigona omulongo nambali dhomumvo gumwe
pamwe noondjambo dhiikulya, omolwomafikilondjambo
— iikombo omulongo niiyali, omolwoondjondjambo
— oontsezi omilongo mbali nane,
oonzi oondumentu omilongo hamano,
iikombo omilongo hamano,
oonzigona omilongo hamano dhomumvo gumwe, omolwomakwatathanondjambo.
Moses sho a yi metsalihangano a ka popye nOmuwa, okwa uvu Omuwa ta popi naye ewi tali zi koshisiikilo shoshikethahangano, pokati kaakerubi yaali.
8: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela Aaron kutya sho ta tula oolamba heyali koshihukikwanyeka, ne dhi tule tuu tadhi minikile lwokomeho goshihukikwanyeka.”
Aaron okwe shi ningi: okwa tula oolamba okuminikila lwokomeho goshihukikwanyeka.
Oshihukikwanyeka ashihe, okuza kompadhi yasho sigo okuulenga woongala osha li sha ningwa moshingoli sha hambulwa, pashiholelwa shoka Omuwa u ulukile Moses.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Yoolola mo Aalevi mAaisraeli noku ya yelitha
mohedhi tayi landula: ya shashamina nomeya geyelitho e to ya lombwele, yi ikululithe sheke omalutu gawo noya yoge oonguwo dhawo. Nena otaa kala ya yogoka.
Naa kuthe ontana yomutanda ondumentu nondjambo yiikulya kokutya, uusila womunziya mwa tulwa omagadhi gooholivi, manga ngoye to kutha ongombe ondumentu yi ninge eyonondjambo.
Gongaleka egongalo alihe lyaIsrael e to thikameke Aalevi komeho getsalihangano.
Aaisraeli naa tenteke iikaha yawo komitse dhAalevi,
manga Aaron te ya yapulile ndje, ya ninge ondjambo yedhugadhugo ya zi kAaisraeli, opo ya yakule ndje.
Aalevi naa tenteke iikaha yawo komitse dhoongombe mbali oondumentu; yimwe nayi yambwe eyonondjambo nonkwawo efikilondjambo, opo eyelithoyapulo lyAalevi li tsakanithwe.
“Yapulila ndje Aalevi, ya ninge ondjambo yandje yedhugadhungo nou ya tule metonatelo lyaAaron noyana.
Yoolola Aalevi mAaisraeli, opo ya ninge yandje.
Sho wa yelitha nokuyapula Aalevi, otaa vulu okuyakula metsalihangano.
Onde ya ithana peha lyaatango ayehe yAaisraeli, oyo noya ningi yandje mwene.
Sho nda dhipaga aatango yAayegipiti, onda yapula osheeli kehe shomuntu noshoshimuna, shi ninge shandje.
Ngashingeyi otandi kutha Aalevi peha lyaatango ayehe yAaisraeli,

notandi gandja Aalevi kuAaron noyana, ya ninge omagano ga za kAaisraeli okuyakula metsalihangano peha lyAaisraeli, opo ndi gamene Aaisraeli koshiponga shoka tashi ya adha, ngele taa hedha pehala eyapuki.”
Moses, Aaron nAaisraeli ayehe oya yapula Aalevi, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Aalevi oyi iyelitha e taa yogo oonguwo dhawo, naAaron okwe ya yapula, ya ninge omagano gOmuwa. Okwe ya tsakanithile eyelithoyapulo.
Aantu oya longo ashihe, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses kombinga yAalevi. Aalevi noya tameke okulonga metsalihangano mewiliko lyaAaron noyana.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses e ta ti:
“Omulevi kehe e na omimvo omilongo mbali nantano nenge dhi vule po, oku na oku ka yakula metsalihangano,
nomepipi lyomimvo omilongo ntano ota zimbuka.
Ota vulu ngaa okukwatha Aalevi aakwawo okugwanitha iilonga yawo metsalihangano, ihe ke na okulonga we iilonga yo yene. Ano osho ngeyi u na okuuthila Aalevi iilonga yawo mbyoka ye yi pewa.”
9: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses mombuga Sinai momwedhi gwotango gwomumvo omutiyali Aaisraeli sho ya tembudha mo muEgipiti. Okwa ti:
“Mesiku etimulongo netine lyomwedhi nguka, peningino lyetango, Aaisraeli oye na okudhana Opaasa pamautho agehe gayo.”
Moses okwa lombwele aantu ya dhane Opaasa,
nongulohi yesiku etimulongo netine lyomwedhi gwotango oye shi ningi mombuga Sinai. Aantu oya gwanitha ayihe, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Okwa li aalumentu yi ikwatitha oshidhila shokukwata omudhimba, noinaa vula we okudhana Opaasa esiku ndyoka. Oya yi kuMoses naAaron
e taa ti: “Otwa nika oshidhila, oshoka otwa guma omudhimba, ihe omolwashike itaatu pitikilwa tu gandje omayambo gOmuwa pamwe nAaisraeli yalwe?”
Moses okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Tegeleleni, sigo nda mono eutho kOmuwa.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses
a lombwele Aaisraeli ta ti: “Ngele ope na gumwe gwomune nenge gwomoluvalo lweni i inikitha oshidhila a guma omudhimba nenge a ya mondjenda yokokule, ndele okwa hala ngaa okudhana Opaasa,
ota pitikwa e yi dhane momwedhi tagu landula, ongulohi yesiku etimulongo netine lyomwedhi omutiyali. Naye yi dhane niikwiila inaayi tulwa efulika niigwanga iilulu.
Inaa hupitha ko iikulya sigo esiku tali landula yo inaa teya nando esipa lyoshimuna. Naa dhane Opaasa pamautho agehe.

Ihe omulumentu ngoka omuyelele ye ina za po a ye kokule ando note etha okudhana Opaasa, na dhimwe mo maantu yandje, oshoka ine eta omayambo gOmuwa pethimbo lyu uthwa. Omuntu a tya ngaaka oku na ondjo.
“Ngele ope na omukwiilongo a kala mokati keni a hala a dhiginine Opaasa, ne yi dhane pamautho nopamisindilo. Ompango oyo tuu ndjoka yimwe tayi utha aavalelwamo naakwiilongo.”
Esiku ndyoka etsalihangano lya thikamekwa, oshikogo oshe li siikile. Ongulohi osha kala sha yeta omulilo, sigo taku shi.
Shika osha kala aluhe; oshikogo oshe li siikile, uusiku osha kala sha yeta omulilo.
Ano shampa tuu oshikogo sha yeluka po, Aaisraeli oya tembudha po oontanda e taye dhi yungile pokuma mpoka oshikogo sha kankama.
Aantu oya lundulula oontanda palombwelo lyOmuwa noye dhi yungu pashipango she. Oshikogo manga sha siikila etsalihangano, oya kala moontanda.
Uuna oshikogo sha siikila etsalihangano ethimbo ele, oya vulika kOmuwa yo inaa huma ko komeho.
Pomathimbo gamwe oshikogo osha kala owala sha siikila etsalihangano omasiku gamwe ageke, ihe aluhe oya kala moontanda nenge ya tembuka palombwelo lyOmuwa.
Momasiku gamwe oshikogo osha kala owala okuza ongulohi sigo ongula, noya tembuka, shaa tuu oshikogo sha yeluka po. Nando nashi kale uusiku nenge omutenya oshikogo sho sha yeluka po, otaa yi ashike.
Uuna oshikogo sha siikile etsalihangano omasiku gaali, omwedhi nenge omumvo nenge ethimbo ele, itaa tembuka. Ihe sho sha yeluka po, otaa tembuka.
Oya li haa tembudha po oontanda noku dhi yunga palombwelo lyOmuwa, ngaashi e ya lombwelithitha Moses.
10: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses ta ti:
“Ihambulithila omankuma gaali goshisiliveli ga hambulikika gokwiithana egongalo li gongale, opo mu tembuke moontanda.
Ewi lyomankuma agehe gaali shampa lyu uvika, egongalo alihe nali gongale posheelo shetsalihangano.
Ihe ngele enkuma limwe alike tali hikwa, nena aawiliki yomazimo naa gongalele pungoye.
Uuna omankuma taga hikwa momadhengo omafupi, nena omazimo ngoka ge li kuuzilo, naga tembuke.
Shampa taga hikwa olutiyali, nena omazimo gokuumbugantu naga tembuke. Omankuma nge taga hikwa, oontanda otadhi tembudhwa,
ihe opo egongalo li ithanwe li gongale, omankuma oge na okuhikwa newi li ili.

Omankuma ohaga hikwa kaayambi aana yaAaron.
“Omautho ngaka oge na okudhigininwa komaluvalo geni aluhe sigo aluhe.
Uuna mwa ponokelwa kaatondi moshilongo sheni, hikeni omankuma ga kuge onkugo yolugodhi. Ngame, Omuwa Kalunga keni, otandi mu kwatha notandi mu hupitha miikaha yaatondi yeni.

Osho wo methimbo lyenyanyu — mOshituthi shomwedhi omupe nomiituthi yeni yilwe — omu na okuhika omankuma, sho tamu yamba omafikilondjambo nomakwatathanondjambo geni, nena otandi mu kwatha. Ongame Omuwa Kalunga keni.”
Mesiku etimilongombali lyomwedhi omutiyali gwomumvo omutiyali oshikogo osha yeluka po kombanda yetsalihangano.
Aaisraeli noya tameke ondjenda yawo taa zi mombuga Sinai. Oshikogo osha kankama mombuga Paran.
Oyo oya zi po palombwelo lyOmuwa, ngaashi e ya lombwelithitha Moses,
noshaa ethimbo ya humu ko, oye shi ningi melandulathano limwe. Mboka ye li kohi yepandela lyoshitopolwa shaJuda, oya zi po tango, etanga netanga, mewiliko lyaNahshon yaAminadab.
Netanel yaZuar okwa li ta wilike ezimo lyaIssaskar,
naEliab lyaHelon oondyoka lyaSebulon.
Etsalihangano sho lya dhikulwa po, aantu yoludhi lwaGerson nolwaMerari oya zi po ya humbata etsalihangano.
Okwa landula ihe mboka ye li kohi yepandela lyoshitopolwa shaReuben taa ende etanga netanga mewiliko lyaElizur lyaShedeur.
Shelumiel yaSurishaddai okwa li ta wilike ezimo lyaSimeon,
naEljasaf lyaDeuel okwa li ta wilike ezimo lyaGad.
Opo ihe Aalevi yoludhi lwaKohat oya landula ko ya humbata iinima iiyapuki. Manga inaa thika kontanda ompe, etsalihangano olya adhika lya dhikwa nale.
Okwa landula mboka ye li kohi yepandela lyoshitopolwa shaEfraim, etanga netanga, mewiliko lyaElishama lyaAmmihud.
Gamaliel yaPedazur okwa li ta wilike ezimo lyaManasse,
naAbidan yaGidoni okwa li ta wilike ezimo lyaBenjamin.
Hugunina, mongundu yokugamena aatembuki konima okwa li mboka yokohi yepandela lyoshitopolwa shaDan ya piti mo etanga netanga mewiliko lyaAhiezer yaAmmishaddai.
Pagiel yaOkran okwa li ta wilike ezimo lyaAser,
naAhira yaEnan okwa li ta wilike ezimo lyaNaftali.
Ndika olyo elandulathano lyokuza moontanda etanga netanga, Aaisraeli sho taa thigi po oontanda e taa tembuka.

Moses okwa lombwele suwala ye Hobab yaJetro Omumidiana ta ti: “Otu li pokuthika kehala ndyoka Omuwa a ti ote li tu pe. Okwa uvaneke a laleke Israel nuuyamba, onkee ila tu yeni pamwe, notatu ka topoleni oshihakanwa.”
Hobab okwa yamukula a ti: “Aawe, ngame ondi na okushuna kevi lyetu nokoyaandjetu.”
Moses okwa ti: “Tu kwatha tuu, waa tu thige po, oshoka ongoye wa tseya nawa ombuga noto vulu oku tu ulukila mpoka tatu yungile oontanda.
Ngele otatu yeni, nena omayambeko agehe ngoka Omuwa te ke tu yambeka nago, otatu ke ga topoleni.”
Aantu sho ya zi puSinai, ondundu yOmuwa, oye ende omasiku gatatu. Oshikethahangano shOmuwa oshe ya tetekelele, opo shi ya monene ehala lyokuyunga oontanda.
Ethimbo kehe taa zi montanda, oshikogo shOmuwa osha tengelele kombanda yawo omutenya.
Shampa oshikethahangano sha thikama shi ye, Moses oti igidha ta ti: “Omuwa, yambuka: halakanitha aatondi yoye nou kondjithe mboka ye ku tonde.”
Uuna tashi kankama, oti igidha ta ti: “Omuwa, galuka, u ye koongundu dhomayuvi ogendji dhAaisraeli.”
11: Aantu oya tameke okungungutulila Omuwa omolwomaudhigu. Omuwa sho e ya uvu, okwa geye, nomulilo gwOmuwa ogwa yaka mokati kaantu. Ogwa hwama mokati kawo e tagu lungunitha po oontanda dhokooha.
Aantu oya kugile Moses ekwatho; oye okwa galikana Omuwa, omulilo nogwa dhimi.
Ehala ndyoka olya lukwa Tabera, oshoka omulilo gwOmuwa ogwa li gwa hwama mokati kawo.
Okwa li ku na aakwiilongo mokati kAaisraeli. Oya li ye na omwamwa gwonyama, nAaisraeli yo yene oya tameke okungungutula taa ti: “Akwetu, olye te tu pe onyama tu lye?
MuEgipiti otwa li hatu li oohi, ngaashi twa hala, dho inadhi futwa nando osha. Otatu dhiladhila okatanga kombihu, ookanuwa, oomboganyanga, oonyanga noonyalanyanga.
Ihe ngashingeyi otwa loloka, oshoka kape na sha shokulya kape na sha shilwe, omanna owala aluhe!”
(Omanna oya li ya fa oombuto oonshona oontokeleshunga.
Aantu oya yi ko noye yi toola, ye yi tsu koshini e taye yi teleke mombiga e taye yi anda omakaka.
Oya li yi na omulyo gwa fa oshikwiila she elelwa momagadhi gooholivi. Omume sho ya gwile moontanda, nomanna oya gwile mo wo.)
Moses okwa uvu aantu taa ngungutula yo ya thikama moongundu piiyelo yomatsali gawo. Ondjahi yOmuwa noya hwama, naMoses wo okwa li u uvite nayi.
Moses okwa ti kOmuwa: “Omolwashike wa hindi ndje? Omolwashike inoo sila ndje ohenda? Omolwashike wa pe ndje omutenge gwaantu mbano ayehe?
Hangame nde ya shita, hangame nde ya vala ndishi! Omolwashike to ti nandi ya yamuthe noku ya humbata momaako ya fa uuhanona noku ya fala kevi ndyoka we li uvanekele ootatekulu nokugana?
Onyama otandi yi adha peni yokuliwa kaantu ayehe mbano? Oshoka otaa lilile ndje taa ti: ‘Tu pa onyama tu lye.’
Itandi vulu we okwiihumbatela aantu mbaka ongame awike, oya tona ndje.
Ngele osho to ningi ndje ngaaka, sila ndje ohenda u dhipage ndje, opo ndaa kale we muudhigu u thike mpaka.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Gongaleka aalumentu omilongo heyali ya simana ya talwa oyo aawiliki yoshigwana. Ya eta kungame posheelo shetsalihangano e to ya lombwele, ya thikame pamwe nangoye.

Otandi ka kulukila pohi e tandi popi nangoye notandi kutha ombepo mombepo ndjoka nde ku pa e tandi yi tula muyo. Nena otaye ku kwatha mokuhumbata omutenge gwaantu mbaka, opo waa gu humbate ngoye awike.

Ngashingeyi lombwela aantu to ti: ‘Iyapuleni omolwesiku lyangula; otamu ka mona onyama mu lye. Omuwa okwe mu uvu, sho tamu mu thiminike tamu ti: Otwa hala onyama tu lye! MuEgipiti otwa li nawa. Ngashingeyi Omuwa ote ke mu pa onyama, one nomu na oku yi lya.
Omu na oku yi lya, hasiku limwe nenge omasiku gaali nenge gatano nenge omulongo nenge omilongo mbali nokuli,

aawe, omwedhi aguhe, sigo tayi pitile momayulu notayi mu kungitha. Shika otashi ningwa, oshoka omwe ekelehi Omuwa, ngoka e li mokati keni, nomwe mu ngungutulile tamu ti ando otwa kalele nani muEgipiti.’ ”
Moses okwa ti kOmuwa: “Otandi enditha aantu 600 000, noto ti oto ya pe onyama ya gwana omwedhi.
Oku na tuu oongombe, iikombo noonzi dha gwana dhi dhipagwe, opo ya kute? Nenge oohi adhihe dhomefuta tadhi ya gwanene?”
Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Oshikaha shOmuwa oshifupi nani? Oto ke shi tala, ngele shoka nda popi, otashi gwanithwa nenge aawe!”
Moses okwa piti mo e ta lombwele aantu shoka Omuwa a popi. Okwa gongaleke aawiliki omilongo heyali e te ya tula momukunkulo gwetsalihangano.

Omuwa okwa kulukile pohi e li moshikogo e ta popi naye. Okwa kutha ombepo mombepo ndjoka a pele Moses e te yi tula maawiliki omilongo heyali. Ombepo sho ye ya lambele, oya tameke okuhunganeka, ihe inashi kala olule.
Aawiliki yaali yomomilongo heyali, Eldad naMedad, oya li ya thigala montanda yo inaa ya kosheelo shetsalihangano. Ombepo ye ya lambelele montanda noya tameke okuhunganeka.
Omugundjuka gumwe okwa matuka a ka lombwele Moses shoka Eldad naMedad taa ningi.
Nena Josua yaNun, ngoka a kala omuyakuli gwaMoses okuza kuugundjuka we, okwa nukile moohapu ta lombwele Moses ta ti: “Tatekulu, ya ganda!”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Owa sila ndje efupa? Ngame onda hala, Omuwa a pe aantu ayehe ombepo, ya hunganeke!”
Opo ihe Moses naawiliki Aaisraeli omilongo heyali oya shuna moontanda.
Omuwa okwa pepitha ombepo ya zi kefuta ye etelele iimote e tayi tengele oondja mbali kombanda yontanda. Iimote oya lambele montanda nomudhingoloko gwayo oshinano shesiku limwe.

Aantu oya tameke okukwata iimote. Oye yi kwata omutenya tuu ngoka aguhe, uusiku auhe nesiku lya landula. Ngoka a kwata iishona, oye ngoka a kwata oondoloma omulongo nayimwe. Oye yi aneke nontanda ayihe, opo yi kukute.
Onyama manga yi li momakana gawo, ondjahi yOmuwa oya hwamene aantu e tayi ya tukulile elega mokati kawo.
Ehala ndyoka olya lukwa Kibrot Taava (kokutya Oombila dhomwamwa), molwashoka omo ya fumvike aantu mboka ya li ye na omwamwa gwonyama.
Aantu oya tembuka muKibrot-Taava ya yi kuHazerot e taa lumbu ko.
12: Moses okwa hokana omukiintu Omukusha, ihe Miriam naAaron oye shi mu tamanekele.
Oya ti: “Omuwa ota popi ashike naMoses? Ita popi nando natse?” Omuwa oku uvu shoka ya ti.
(Moses okwa li omulumentu omwiifupipiki e vule aantu ayehe kombanda yevi.)
Ohaluka Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses, Aaron naMiriam a ti: “Onda hala ne amuhe yatatu mu pite mo mu ye ketsalihangano.” Oyo noya yi ko,
nOmuwa okwa kulukile pohi moluzigi lwoshikogo a thikama posheelo shetsalihangano nokwi igidha a ti: “Aaron! Miriam!” Oyo ayehe yaali oya holoka komeho,
Omuwa nokwa ti: “Ngashingeyi uvii ko shoka tandi popi! Ngele ope na aahunganeki mokati keni, ongame tandi ya ihololele momamoniko notandi ya lombwele moondjodhi.
Ope na eyooloko, ngele otandi popi nomuntu gwandje Moses. Onde mu langeke omudhiginini gwaantu yandje ayehe Aaisraeli.
Otandi popi naye twa talathana oshipala noshipala, sha yela, hamootumbutumbu. Okwa mono nokuli olupe lwandje! Omolwashike ano inaamu tila okusheka omuntu gwandje Moses?”
Omuwa okwe ya geele nokwa zi po.
Oshikogo sho sha yeluka po petsalihangano, ohaluka Miriam okwa toka oshilundu a fa omahegele gomongwa. Aaron sho e mu tala nokwa mono, sho a toka oshilundu,
okwa ti kuMoses: “Tatekulu, ombili, ino tu geelela uulunde wetu mboka twe u ningi muugoya wetu.
Ino mu etha a ninge a fa okahanona ka valwa ka sa, olutu lwako lwo olela kombinga moshivalelo shayina.”
Moses okwa kugile Omuwa ekwatho a ti: “Kalunga, mu aludha!”
Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Ando ohe e mu hiyile omayeye moshipala, oku na okuhumbata omupya gwe omasiku gaheyali. Mu yoolola montanda omasiku gaheyali, konima yago ota vulu okugalukila mo.”
Miriam okwa li e edhililwa pondje yontanda omasiku gaheyali, naantu inaa huma ko, sigo a galukile mo.
Konima yomasiku ngaka aantu oya tembuka muHazerot e taa ka yunga oontanda mombuga Paran.
13: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Hogolola gumwe gwomaawiliki mezimo kehe lyomazimo omulongo nagaali, opo u ya tume oondaadhi ya ka ndaadhe evi lyaKaanan, ndyoka tandi ka pa Aaisraeli.”

Moses okwa tumu aawiliki, ngaashi taa landula:
Ezimo
Omuwiliki
Reuben
Shammua yaSakkur
Simeon
Shafat yaHori
Juda
Kaleb kaJefunne
Issaskar
Igal yaJosef
Efraim
Hosea yaNun
Benjamin
Palti yaRafu
Sebulon
Gadiel yaSodi
Manasse
Gadi yaSusi
Dan
Ammiel yaGemalli
Aser
Setur yaMikael
Naftali
Nakbi yaVofsi
Gad
Geuel yaMaki
Ndhika odho oondaadhi ndhoka Moses a tumu, dhi ka ndaadhe oshilongo. Okwa lundulula edhina lyaHosea yaNun, li ninge Josua.
Moses sho e dhi tumu, okwa ti kudho: “Indeni lwokuumbangalantu mu ye kuumbugantu waKaanan, sigo omoshilongo shokoondundu.
Taleni, evi nkene li li, naantu ye li mo oye thike peni noye na oonkondo dhi thike peni.
Taleni, evi ngele ewanawa nenge ewinayi, naantu yalyo ngele oya kala miilando yi li puuyelele nenge oya tungilwa omadhingililokuma ga kola.
Taleni, evi ngele olyo ondoka nenge olya hekuka, nongele oli na omiti. Seni oshimpwiyu mu etelele iiyimati mbyoka yi li ko.” (Olya li ethimbo lyetiligano lyomandjembele.)
Aalumentu oya yi kuumbangalantu e taa ndaadha evi okuza kombuga Zin muumbugantu ondjila ayihe sigo oRehob, popepi netaulilo lyaHamat muumbangalantu.

Tango oya yi kuumbugantu wevi noye ya kuHebron, hoka kwa kala omaludhi gaAhiman, gaSheshai nogaTalmai, oluvalo lwomuhoko gwaalefule halu ithanwa Aayanaki. (Hebron osha tungwa, sho pwa piti omimvo heyali, opo Zoan muEgipiti shi tungwe.)
Oye ya mesilu Eshkol noya tete mo ehila lyomandjembele lya humbatwa komutenge kaalumentu yaali ye li inda. Oye eta wo oondunga dhomugranati noonkwiyu.
(Ehala ndyoka oye li luku Eshkol molwehila lyomandjembele ndyoka Aaisraeli ya tete mo.)
Sho ya ndaadha evi omasiku omilongo ne, oondaadhi odha shuna
kuMoses, Aaron nokegongalo alihe lyaIsrael muKadesh mombuga Paran. Oya hokolola shoka ya mono noye ya ulukile iiyimati mbyoka ye yi eta.
Oya ti kuMoses: “Otwa ndaadha evi notwe li mono kutya olya tondoka shili omahini nomagadhi goonyushi; iiyimati yimwe oyo mbika.
Ihe aantu mboka ye li mo, oya kola, niilando yawo iinene unene noya kola. Mupyamunene otwa mwene mo wo aalefule, oluvalo lwaAnak.
Aayamaleki oya kala muumbugantu wevi; Aaheti, Aayebusi nAayamori oya kala moshilongo shokoondundu; Aakaanana oya kala pEfuta lyopokati nokulambalala omulonga Jordan.”
Kaleb okwa ngungumaneke aantu mboka ya li taa tamaneke Moses e ta ti: “Otatu vulu oku ya matukila noku ya sinda. Otu na oonkondo okulala evi ndyoka.”
Ihe aantu mboka ya yile ko naKaleb, oya ti: “Aawe, katu na oonkondo oku ya matukila. Aantu mbeyaka oye na oonkondo ye tu vule.”
Oya taandelitha omutoto mokati kAaisraeli omolwevi ndyoka ya ka ndaadhele. Oya ti: “Evi ndyoka twe endagula, kali na olunza lwokupalutha aakalimo; naantu mboka twa mono, aaleeleka,
otwa mwene mo nokuli aalefule, oluvalo lwaAnak. Sho twi itala, otu wete aashuushuka; nomomeho gawo osho tu li wo.”
14: Egongalo alihe olya tameke okukudhila nolya lili uusiku auhe.
Oya tamaneke Moses naAaron noya ti: “Osha li oshihwepo okusila muEgipiti, nenge nokuli mombuga muka!
Omolwashike Omuwa te tu fala koshilongo shoka? Otatu ka dhipagelwa molugodhi, naakiintu yetu naana yetu taa ka kwatwa po. Kashi shi oshipu, tu shune kuEgipiti?”
Oya lombwelathana ya ti: “Natu hogololeni omuwiliki, tu shuneni kuEgipiti!”
Nena Moses naAaron oyi inyongamene pevi montaneho yaantu ayehe.
Josua yaNun naKaleb kaJefunne, oondaadhi mbali, oya tuula oonguwo dhawo moluhodhi
e taa lombwele aantu taa ti: “Evi ndyoka twa ndaadha, olyo evi ewanawa.
Omuwa ngele okwe tu hokwa, ote tu fala ko e te tu pe evi ndyoka lya tondoka omahini nomagadhi goonyushi.
Inamu tsa ondumbo nOmuwa, ne inamu tila aantu mboka ya kala mo. Otatu ya sindi nuupu. Omuwa oku li pamwe natse nokwa sindi iikalunga mbyoka tayi ya gamene, ano inamu tila.”
Egongalo alihe olya ti, naa dhipagwe nomamanya, ihe ohaluka aantu oya mono olwaadhi lwa adhimine etsalihangano.
Omuwa okwa ti kuMoses: “Sigo uunake aantu mbaka taa kala nokudhina ndje? Sigo uunake taa tindi okwiinekela ndje, nando onda longa iikumithalonga mokati kawo?
Otandi ya tumine elega li ya kombe po, ihe otandi ku ningi he yoshigwana oshinene noshi na oonkondo dhi vule dhaambaka.”
Moses okwa ti kOmuwa: “Owa tembudha aantu mbaka muEgipiti koonkondo dhoye. Aegipiti nge taa kundana shoka wa ningile aantu yoye,

otaye ke shi lombwela aantu mboka ya kala mevi ndika. Aantu mbaka oyu uva nale kutya ongoye, Omuwa, u li putse nowe tu ihololela, oshikogo shoye sho tashi tu siikile noto tu tetekelele moshikogo shomuzile omutenya, nuusiku omoshikogo shomulilo.
Ngashingeyi ngele to dhipaga po aantu yoye ayehe, iigwana mbyoka tayi kundana shoka wa ningi, otayi ka tya:
‘Omuwa okwa dhipagele aantu ye mombuga, oshoka okwa nyengwa oku ya thikitha kevi ndyoka e ya uvanekele e li ya pe.’
Ngashingeyi, Omuwa, otandi galikana, tu ulukila oonkondo dhoye, ngoye u ninge ngaashi wa uvaneke wa ti:
‘Ongame, Omuwa, omunamutimahenda nomunesilohenda enene. Ohandi dhimi po oondjo nomayono, ihe ihandi etha inaandi geela. Ohandi kongolola omayono goohe moyana sigo okoluvalo olutitatu nolutine.’
Ngashingeyi, Omuwa, paunene wesilohenda lyoye ndyoka ihaali lunduluka, dhima po oondjo dhaantu mbaka, ngaashi ho ya dhimine po shito, sho ya tembudha muEgipiti.”
Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Otandi ya kuthile po, ngaashi wa galikana.
Ihe otandi uvaneke kutya oshili, ngaashi ndi na omwenyo, nevi alihe lyu udha eadhimo lyOmuwa,

kape na nando ogumwe gwomaantu mbaka ye na omwenyo ngashingeyi, ta yi mevi ndyoka. Oya mono eadhimo lyandje niinyengandunge mbyoka nde yi longo muEgipiti nomombuga, ihe oya hindi ndje lwomulongo yo inaa pulakena ewi lyandje.
Itaa ka ya mo mevi ndyoka nde li uvanekele oohekulu. Kape na ngoka gwomuyo a dhini ndje, ta yi mo.
Ihe omuntu gwandje Kaleb, ngoka e na ombepo yi ili nokwi inekela ndje, otandi ke mu fala mevi ndyoka e ke li ndaadhele, notali ningi eliko lyoluvalo lwe.
Ihe oshoka Aayamaleki nAakaanana oya kala momasilu, shuneni ngula mu ye kombuga nondjila ndjoka yu uka kEkololo lyaAkaba.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses naAaron a ti:
“Sigo uunake aantu mbaka aawinayi taa tsikile okutamaneka ndje? Onda vulwa okupulakena oontamanana!
Ya lombwela u tye: ‘Otandi gana kutya oshili, ngaashi ndi na omwenyo, otandi ningi ngaashi mwa pula. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.
Payalulo amuhe mboka mwa li mwa adha oomvula omilongo mbali nenge dhi vule po, otamu ka sa, nomidhimba dheni otadhi ka halakana mombuga ndjika, oshoka mwa tsu ondumbo nangame.
Kape na nando ogumwe gwomune ta yi mevi ndyoka nda li ndu uvaneke negano nde li mu pe, kakele kaKaleb naJosua.
Omwa ti aana yeni otaa ka kwatwa po, ihe oyo tandi ka fala mevi ndyoka mwe li ekelehi, notali ka ninga lyawo.
Ne otamu ka sila mombuga muka.
Aana yeni otaa ka endagula nombuga omimvo omilongo ne taa hepekwa kokwiitekapo kweni, sigo omuhugunini gwomune a si po.
Otamu ke shi mona moluulunde weni omimvo omilongo ne, omumvo gumwe ogu lile po esiku kehe mwa pititha mokundaadha evi. Otamu ke shi tseya shoka tashi ti, ngele tandi mu iteka.
Otandi gana kutya otandi shi mu ningile, aantu ne aawinayi mwa gongala mu tse ondumbo nangame. Amuhe otamu ka sila muka mombuga, ongame, Omuwa, nde dhi popya.’ ”
Ihe aalumentu mboka Moses a tumine okundaadha evi, sho ya taandelitha moshigwana uumbanda molwevi ndyoka e tashi tamanekitha Moses, Omuwa okwe ya tumine oshivu e taa si.
Josua naKaleb ayeke oya hupu ko maalumentu mboka ya ka ndaadhele evi.
Moses okwa hokololele oshigwana ashihe shoka Omuwa a popi, oyo noya lili omahodhi omapyu.
Ongula sho kwa shi, oya meneka ya ye koshilongo shokoondundu taa ti: “Otwi ilongekidha okuya kevi ndyoka Omuwa e li tu uvanekele. Otwa zimina eyono lyetu.”
Moses okwa ti: “Omolwashike itaamu vulika kOmuwa ngashingeyi? Itamu tompola sha!
Inamu ya. Omuwa ke li pamwe nane, naatondi yeni otaye ke mu sinda.
Ngele tamu tsakaneke Aayamaleki nAakaanana, otamu ka sila molugodhi; Omuwa ita ka kala pamwe nane, oshoka omwa tindi oku mu landula.”
Natango oya tangalala e taa yi koshilongo shokoondundu, nando oshikethahangano shOmuwa naMoses ina za mo montanda.
Nena Aayamaleki nAakaanana mboka ya kala mo, oye ya ponokele e taye ya sindi e taye ya lambalala sigo okuHorma.
15: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli u tye: Ngele tamu ka ya mevi lyokukalamo, ndyoka tandi li mu pe,

otamu vulu okuyambela Omuwa ongombe ondumentu, onzi ondumentu, onzi nenge oshikombo, shi ninge efikilondjambo nenge ontselelandjambo mokugwanitha euvaneko nenge omuntu ta yamba pahalo lye mwene nenge ondjambo yomoshituthi shontumba; ezimba lyoondjambo ndhika otali opalele Omuwa.

Kehe ngoka ta yambele Omuwa efikilondjambo lyonzi nenge lyoshikombo, ne ete pamwe noshimuna kehe oograma mbali dhuusila womunziya wa lungilwa molita yimwe yomagadhi gooholivi, u ninge ondjambo yiikulya. Ne ete wo olita yimwe yomaviinu ga ninge oshinuwandjambo.
Uuna onzi ondumentu tayi yambwa, pamwe nayo napa yambwe ondjambo yiikulya yoograma ne netata lyuusila womunziya wa lungilwa momagadhi gooholivi golita yimwe noshititano.
Omolwoshinuwandjambo omuntu ne ete olita yimwe noshititano shomaviinu. Ezimba lyoondjambo ndhika otali opalele Omuwa.
Uuna ongombe ondumentu tayi yambelwa Omuwa yi ninge efikilondjambo nenge ontselelandjambo mokugwanitha euvaneko nenge ekwatathanondjambo,
napa yambwe ondjambo yiikulya yuusila womunziya woograma hamano netata wa lungilwa moolita mbali dhomagadhi gooholivi,
pamwe noolita mbali dhomaviinu. Ezimba lyondjambo ndjika otali opalele Omuwa.
“Shika osho shoka tashi ningwa, ngele taku yambwa ongombe ondumentu, onzi ondumentu, onzi nenge oshikombo.
Uuna taku yambwa iimuna yi vule shimwe, pamwe noshimuna kehe naku yambwe ondjambo yasho yiikulya nomaviinu.
Omuisraeli kehe ne shi ninge, uuna ta yamba ondjambo yiikulya, ezimba lya nika nawa tali opalele Omuwa.

Pethimbo kehe omukwiilongo a kala mokati keni, kashi na nee mbudhi, okathimbo okafupi nenge ethimbo ele, ta yamba oondjambo dhiikulya, ezimba lya nika nawa tali opalele Omuwa, oku na okugwanitha omautho tuu ngoka.
Osho ngaaka omautho ngoka tage mu manga aluhe sigo aluhe one yene naakwiilongo mboka ya kala mokati keni. Ne nayo omu thike pamwe koshipala shOmuwa.
Oompango tuu ndhoka dhimwe nomautho tage mu pula, osho nayo wo.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli u tye: Ngele tamu ka ya mevi ndyoka tandi li mu pe,
omu na okugandja omagano kOmuwa miikulya mbyoka tamu li.
Nge tamu teleke iikwiila, gandjeni oshikwiila shotango shiilya iipe omagano kOmuwa. Nashi ninge ondjambo tayi zi kolupale.
Ondjambo ndjika yomiikwiila ya telekwa miilya iipe, ne omu na oku yi gandja kOmuwa aluhe sigo aluhe.
“Ngele otamu ningi epuko noitamu gwanitha oshipango shontumba Omuwa a lombwele Moses,
— ano okuza kesiku ndyoka Omuwa a lombwele Moses iipango ye sigo okomaluvalo tage ya ngele itamu gwanitha sha shomiipango —

ihe egongalo lya yono mokwaashiwo, nali yambe ongombe ondumentu yi ninge efikilondjambo, ezimba lya nika nawa tali opalele Omuwa, pamwe nondjambo yiikulya nomaviinu. Naa yambe wo oshikombo oshilumentu shi ninge eyonondjambo.
Omuyambi na gwanithe eyelithoyapulo lyegongalo, notali dhiminwa po, oshoka epuko olya li mokwaashiwo, nolye etele Omuwa efikilondjambo neyonondjambo lyalyo.
Egongalo alihe lyaIsrael naakwiilongo ya kala mokati kawo otaa dhiminwa po, oshoka shaa ngoka okwa li mepuko.
“Ngele omuntu gumwe oye a yono mokwaashiwo, na yambe oshikombo oshikiintu shomumvo gumwe shi ninge eyonondjambo.
Poshiyambelo omuyambi ota gwanitha eyelithoyapulo lyomuntu ngoka, nota kala a dhiminwa po.
Eutho ndika olimwe kukehe ngoka ta yono mokwaashiwo, na kale nee Omuisraeli nenge omukwiilongo a kala mokati kAaisraeli.
“Ihe omuntu ngoka ta yono owina, na kale nee omuvalelwamo nenge omukwiilongo, oku na ondjo yokuhinda Omuwa noku na okudhipagwa,
oshoka okwa dhini shoka Omuwa a popi nokwa yono owina iipango ye. Okwi ilongela eso.”
Esiku limwe manga Aaisraeli ya li mombuga, okwa monika omulumentu ta tyaya iikuni mEsabati.
Okwa falwa kuMoses, Aaron negongalo alihe,
noye mu manga, oshoka inaa tseya nkene ye na oku mu ninga.
Omuwa okwa ti kuMoses: “Omulumentu ngoka oku na okudhipagwa; egongalo alihe nali mu dhipage nomamanya pondje yoontanda.”
Egongalo alihe olye mu fala pondje yoontanda e tali mu dhipaga nomamanya, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli u tye: Itungileni oondjendjelela dhi endjelele koonkotso dhomizalo dheni ne mu tule ko ongodhi ombulau kondjendjelela kehe. Shika omu na oku shi ninga aluhe sigo aluhe.
Oondjendjelela ohadhi mu dhimbulutha iipango yandje shaa ethimbo tamu dhi tala, opo mu vulike kuyo; nena itamu pilamene ndje we nokulandula omahalo nuuhalu weni.
Oondjendjelela ohadhi mu dhimbulutha mu dhiginine iipango yandje notamu ningi ihe yandjelela.
Ongame Omuwa, Kalunga keni; onde mu tembudha muEgipiti ndi ninge Kalunga keni. Ongame Omuwa.”
16: Kora kaIzhar, omutekulu gwaKohat yaLevi, yo pamwe naDatan naAbiram, aana yaEliab, naOn yaPelet yaReuben oya tsile Moses ondumbo pamwe naalumentu 250 yomAaisraeli, aawiliki ya simana ya hogololwa kegongalo.

Oya gongalele Moses naAaron e taa ti kuyo: “Omwa pitilila unene! Iilyo ayihe yegongalo oyOmuwa, nOmuwa oku li pamwe natse atuhe. Omolwashike ano ngoye, Moses, to inenepekele kombanda yegongalo lyOmuwa?”
Moses sho e shi uvu, okwi ihata pevi e ta galikana.
Opo ihe okwa ti kuKora naalanduli ye: “Ongula yanakwasha Omuwa ota ka ulika, olye ngoka gwe. Ngoka gwe, kokutya ngoka e mu hogolola, ote mu pitika a hedhe koshiyambelo.

Ongula yanakwasha, ngoye Kora naalanduli yoye, kutheni iikangwa yomulilo, tulii mo omakala ga hanya niitsinino ne mu yi fale koshiyambelo. Opo mpoka tatu ka mona, olye gwomutse a hogololwa kOmuwa. Aalevi ne, omakamba geni oga vuka unene!”
Moses okwa lombwele natango Kora a ti: “Aalevi ne, pulakeneni!
Inashi mu gwanena nani, Kalunga kaIsrael sho e mu yoolola megongalo lyaIsrael mu hedhe kuye metsalihangano, opo mu thikame montaneho yegongalo noku li yakula?
Okwe mu pe esimano ndika pamwe nAalevi ooyakweni, ihe ngashingeyi omwa hala ishewe noshilonga shuuyambi.
Sho tamu tsu ondumbo naAaron, otashi ti otamu kondjitha Omuwa.”
Moses okwa tumu elaka i ithana Datan naAbiram, ihe oya ti: “Itatu ya ko!
Inashi gwana nani, sho we tu tembudha mevi lya tondoka omahini nomagadhi goonyushi, opo u tu dhipagele mombuga? Ngashingeyi owa hala u tu pangele?
Ou shi owe tu eta kevi ndyoka lya tondoka omahini nomagadhi goonyushi nowe tu pe omapya niitsambe yomiviinu? Ou shi oto vulu u tu kotokele? Itatu ya ko!”
Moses okwa geye nokwa lombwele Omuwa a ti: “Ino taamba omayambo gaalumentu mbaka taye ga yamba. Ngame inandi ya ninga nayi. Ine kutha nando ogumwe nando oko okasino.”
Moses okwa ti kuKora: “Ongula yanakwasha ngoye naalanduli yoye ayehe omu na okuholoka ketsalihangano. Aaron oko ta ka kala wo.
Shaa ngoka gwomune ota kutha oshikangwa she shomulilo a tula mo iitsinino note yi yamba koshiyambelo.”
Omulumentu kehe okwa kutha ihe oshikangwa she a tula mo omakala ga hanya niitsinino nokwa thikama posheelo shetsalihangano pamwe naMoses naAaron.
Kora okwa gongaleke egongalo alihe, nolya thikama lya taalela Moses naAaron posheelo shetsalihangano. Ohaluka eadhimo lyOmuwa olya adhimine egongalo alihe,
Omuwa nokwa lombwele Moses naAaron ta ti:
“Zii po utale paantu mbano, notandi ya kombo po mbalambala.”
Ihe Moses naAaron oya tsu iipala yawo pevi e taa ti: “Akutu, Kalunga, Kalunga, ongoye othithiya yomwenyo aguhe. Ndishi omuntu gumwe awike a yono noto geele egongalo alihe?”
Omuwa okwa ti kuMoses:
“Lombwela aantu ya ze po pomatsali gaKora, Datan naAbiram.”
Moses okwa yi kuDatan naAbiram a thindikilwa kaawiliki yAaisraeli.
Okwa lombwele aantu a ti: “Thikameni kokule nomatsali gaantu mbaka aadhudhu, ne inamu guma iinima yawo ayihe, opo mwaa kombwe po pamwe nayo moluulunde wawo.”

Aantu noya zi po pomatsali gaKora, Datan naAbiram.
Datan naAbiram oya piti mo ya thikama piiyelo yomatsali gawo, ye li pamwe naakulukadhi yawo noyana.
Moses okwe ya lombwele a ti: “Nena otamu ke shi tseya kutya Omuwa okwa tumu ndje ndi longe iilonga mbika noitandi yi longo pahalo lyandje mwene.
Aantu mbaka ngele otaa si, ngaashi aantu ayehe haa si pwaa na egeelo lyaKalunga, nena Omuwa ina tuma ndje.

Ihe ngele Omuwa ota ningi sha inaashi uvika nale, nevi otali makula okana kalyo noku ya huta po niinima yawo ayihe, e taa kulukile muusi ye na omwenyo, otamu ka tseya kutya aantu mbaka oya sheke Omuwa.”
Mbalambala Moses manga inaa mana okupopya, evi olye ekama mpoka ya li
nolya nina po Datan naAbiram, omatsali gawo, aalanduli yaKora ayehe nomaliko gawo agehe.
Oya kulukile muusi ye na omwenyo, pamwe nomaliko gawo. Evi olye ya siikile noya ningine mo.
Aaisraeli ayehe mboka ya li ko, oya yi ontuku, sho yu uvu onkugo yawo. Oyi igidha ya ti: “Tu fadhukii po! Evi otali ningi li tu nine po wo!”
Omuwa okwa tumu omulilo gwa hwama, nogwa lungunitha po aalumentu 250 mboka ya li ye na iitsinino.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela omuyambi Eleasar lyaAaron a kuthe mo iikangwa yomulilo momutoko noku halakanithe omakala muyo shaa mpoka, oshoka iikangwa yomulilo oyo iiyapuki.

Oya yapulwa, sho ya tulwa poshiyambelo shOmuwa. Ano kuthii po iikangwa yomulilo yaalumentu mboka ya dhipagwa moluulunde wawo, yi hambulii po iisha ya pepuka e tamu yi siikilitha oshiyambelo. Otayi ka londodha Aaisraeli.”
Omuyambi Eleasar okwa kutha iikangwa yomulilo e te yi hambulitha iisha ya pepuka yi siikile oshiyambelo.

Ndika olya li elondodho kAaisraeli kutya hamuntu gulwe kee shi oluvalo lwaAaron ta hedha koshiyambelo, opo a fikile Omuwa iitsinino. Ota ningi a yonwe po ngaashi Kora naantu ye. Ayihe mbika oya ningwa, ngaashi Omuwa a popitha Moses e shi lombwele Eleasar.
Esiku lyanofu egongalo alihe olya tamaneke Moses naAaron lya ti: “Ne omwa dhipaga aantu yOmuwa.”
Ayehe sho ya gongala ya tamaneke Moses naAaron, oya pilamene etsalihangano noya mono lya siikilwa koshikogo, neadhimo lyOmuwa olya monika.
Moses naAaron oya yi noya thikama komeho getsalihangano.
NOmuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:

“Zii po paantu mbaka, notandi ya kombo po mbala!”
Ayehe yaali oya tsu iipala yawo mevi,

naMoses okwa lombwele Aaron a ti: “Kutha oshikangwa shoye shomulilo, tula mo omakala ga hanya gokoshiyambelo e to tula mo iitsinino momakala. Endelela u ye mokati kaantu, opo u ya gwanithile eyelithoyapulo. Endelela! Ondjahi yOmuwa oya hwama nokuli, nelega olya tameka.”

Aaron okwa ningi, ngaashi Moses e mu lombwele. Okwa yi, a kutha oshikangwa e ta matukile mokati kaantu. Sho a mono oshiponga sha tameka nale nokuli, okwa tula iitsinino momakala e ta ningi eyelithoyapulo.
Elega olya kodha, nokwa li a thikama pokati kaanamwenyo noonakusa.
Omwaalu gwaantu mboka ya si, ogwa li 14 700, moka inaamu yalulilwa mboka ya sile moshipotha shaKora.
Elega sho lya kodha, Aaron okwa galukile kuMoses posheelo shetsalihangano.
17: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli ye ku pe oondhimbo omulongo nambali, ondhimbo yimwe oyomuwiliki mezimo kehe. Kondhimbo kehe nyola ko edhina lyamwene gwayo,
nedhina lyaAaron li nyola kondhimbo ndjoka yi lile po Aalevi. Otaku ka kala ondhimbo yimwe yomuwiliki mezimo kehe.
Dhi fala metsalihangano e to dhi tula komeho goshikethahangano, nkoka tandi ku tsakaneke.
Ondhimbo yomuntu ngoka nda hogolola, otayi tutuma. Pahedhi ndjika otandi mweneke omangungutulo gAaisraeli, sho haye ku tamanekele ndje.”
Moses okwe shi lombwele Aaisraeli, nomuwiliki gwezimo kehe mokati kawo okwe mu pe ondhimbo yimwe, adhihe kumwe omulongo nambali pamwe nondhimbo yaAaron.
Moses okwa tula oondhimbo adhihe metsalihangano komeho goshikethahangano shOmuwa.
Esiku lyanofu Moses sho a yi mo metsalihangano, okwa mono ondhimbo yaAaron, ndjoka ya kalele po ezimo lyaLevi, ya tutuma. Oya tsapuka noya sheneka oongala noyi ima oomandeli dho oloya.
Moses okwa kutha ko oondhimbo adhihe e te dhi ulukile Aaisraeli. Oya mono shoka sha ningwa po, nomuwiliki kehe okwa taamba ondhimbo ye.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Shuna ondhimbo yaAaron komeho goshikethahangano. Oyi na okupungulwa, yi kale elondodho kAaisraeli mboka ye na omangungutulo, opo yaa se.”
Moses okwa ningi, ngaashi Omuwa e mu lombwele.
Aaisraeli oya lombwele Moses ya ti: “Tala, otatu hulu po, tse atuhe tatu ka kana!
Shaa ngoka ta hedha ketsalihangano, ota si. Otwa uthilwa ano, tu se po atuhetuhe?”
18: Omuwa okwa lombwele Aaron e ta ti: “Ngoye mwene, aamwoye nAalevi, one tamu pewa kehe uusama mboka u na ekwatathano netsalihangano; ihe ngoye naamwoye amuke tamu pewa uusama mboka wa ningwa muuyambi.
Eta aakweni, ezimo lyaLevi, ya longe pamwe nane, manga ngoye naamwoye tamu yakula komeho getsalihangano.
Naa kale ye na oshimpwiyu shiilonga yoye niilonga ayihe yetsalihangano, ihe inaa kwatathana niinima iiyapuki mEhala Lyuuyapuki nenge noshiyambelo. Ngele taye shi ningi, ne pamwe nayo otamu dhipagwa.
Oyo ye na okulonga pamwe nangoye nokutsakanitha iinakugwanithwa yawo yeyakulo alihe metsalihangano, ihe omuntu gulwe kee shi Omulevi ita longo nangoye.
Ongoye naamwoye amuke tamu longo iilongo yomEhala Lyuuyapuki noshiyambelo, opo ondjahi yandje yaa hwamene we Aaisraeli.
Ongame nde mu hogololele aakweni Aalevi mokati kAaisraeli, opo ya ninge omagano ga yapuliwa Omuwa noye mu yakule metsalihangano.

Ihe ngoye naamwoye, one amuke tamu gwanitha iinakugwanithwa yuuyambi kombinga yoshiyambelo nomEhala Lyuuyapuki. Mbika oyo iilonga yenilela, molwaashoka onde mu pa uuyambi omagano. Omuntu gulwe kee shi Omulevi, ngoka ta hedha popepi niinima iiyapuki, na dhipagwe.”

Omuwa okwa lombwele Aaron a ti: “Aaisraeli uuna taa etele ndje iigandjwa iiyapuki, ongame tandi ku pe mbyoka itaayi lungunithilwa koshiyambelo. Nayi kale oshitopolelwa shoye naamwoyemati aluhe sigo aluhe.

Komagano omayapukilela ngoka itaaga lungunithwa koshiyambelo, oto pewa ngaka taga landula mpaka: oondjambo dhiikulya, omayonondjambo noondjondjambo. Oondjambo ndhika adhihe oondjapukilela tadhi yambelwa ndje, otadhi ningi dhoye naamwoyemati.
Adhihe ndhika dhi lileni pehala eyapuki, aalumentu ayeke taa dhi li; nadhi kale oondjapuki kune.

“Oondjambo adhihe dhomadhungadhungo dhAaisraeli otadhi ningi wo dhoye. Otandi dhi ku pe, ngoye mwene naamwoye aamati naakadhona aluhe sigo aluhe. Omuntu kehe megumbo lyoye ngoka kee na oshipwe, ote dhi li.
“Otandi ku pe oshipe ashihe shomagadhi omawanawa gooholivi, shomaviinu omawanawa noshiilya shoka aantu taa etele Omuwa.
Oshipe shaayihe mevi lyawo tashi etelwa Omuwa, oshoye. Omuntu kehe megumbo lyoye ngoka kee na oshipwe, ote shi li.
“Ashihe shomuIsrael shoka tashi yapulilwa Omuwa nokugana, otashi ningi shoye.
“Osheeli kehe shomuntu nenge shoshimuna shoka Aaisraeli taa yambele ndje, otashi ningi shoye. Ihe ou na okutaamba ofuto tayi kulile osheeli shomuntu nenge osheeli shoshimuna shoka shi na oshidhila.
Uunona nau kulilwe mepipi lyomwedhi gumwe niimaliwa iisiliveli itano pandjele yoshimaliwa oshisiliveli hashi longithwa motempeli.

Ihe osheeli shongombe, shonzi nenge shoshikombo inashi shunithwa; oyandjelela, noyi na okuyambwa oontselelandjambo. Ombinzi yayo otayi tilwa koshiyambelo nokulungunitha oofu dhi ninge ondjambo yiikulya, ezimba lya nika nawa lyo opalela Omuwa.
Onyama yayo oyoye ngaashi wo ondjambo yedhugadhugo lyondete noshilama shokolulyo.
“Iigandjwa ayihe iiyapuki Aaisraeli taa etele Omuwa, otandi yi ku pe naamwoye aamati naakadhona aluhe sigo aluhe. Ehangano ndika nde li hangana nangoye noluvalo lwoye, olya kola nokukolelela.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Aaron e ta ti: “Mevi lyawo ito ka thigulula mo sha, oshitopolwa shevi lyaIsrael ito shi pewa. Ongame mwene oshipewa shoye nuuthiga woye mokati kAaisraeli.”
Omuwa okwa ti: “Aalevi otandi ya pe iitimulongo ayihe muIsrael, yi ninge uuthiga wawo molwiilonga mbyoka taa longo, sho taa sile etsalihangano oshimpwiyu.
Aaisraeli yalwe inaa hedha we ketsalihangano, opo yaa dhipagwe.
Okuza nena Aalevi oyo ayeke naa tonatele etsalihangano, noyo ye na oku li pulwa. Eutho ndika olyaaluhe tali ka dhigininwa wo komaluvalo gawo. Aalevi oye na okukala yaa na uuthiga mokati kAaisraeli,
oshoka otandi ya pe iitimulongo mbyoka Aaisraeli taye yi etele ndje. Omolwaashoka nde ya lombwele kutya itaa pewa uuthiga mokati kAaisraeli.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses e ta ti:
“Lombwela Aalevi to ti: Uuna tamu taamba iitimulongo kAaisraeli, mbyoka Omuwa te yi mu pe yi ninge yeni, omu na okugandja mo oshitimulongo shi ninge shOmuwa.
Oshitimulongo shika otashi talwa osho oshigandjwa sheni shi thike pamwe noshipe shiilya tashi gandjwa kolupale nenge shomaviinu tashi kuthwa metemba lyokukolela.
Pahedhi ndjika nane wo otamu etele Omuwa iigandjwa tayi zi miitimulongo ayihe mbyoka tamu taamba kAaisraeli. Omuyambi Aaron ta taamba iigandjwa mbika tamu yi pe Omuwa.
