Gandjeni kOmuwa iigandjwa ya gwana po mwe yi kutha miitaambwa yeni ayihe; gandjeni oshitopolwa oshiwanawa.
Uuna tamu gandja oshitopolwa oshiwanawa, otashi talwa osho oshigandjwa sheni shi thike pamwe noshipe shiilya tashi gandjwa kolupale nenge shomaviinu tashi kuthwa metemba lyokukolela.
Mbyoka ya kala po, otamu yi li naanegumbo yeni shaa mpoka, oshoka oyo ondjambi yeni yokuyakula metsalihangano.
Nge tamu yambele Omuwa tango oshitopolwa oshiwanawa shomiitaambwa yeni, itamu pewa ondjo shampa itaamu nyateke omagano omayapuki gAaisraeli, opo mwaa se.”
19: Omuwa okwa popi naMoses naAaron
e tu uthile Aaisraeli omautho ngaka ta ti: “Eteni ondema ontiligane yaa na oshipo yo inayi tulwa kondjoko,
mu yi gandje komuyambi Eleasar. Nayi falwe pondje yontanda e tayi dhipagelwa montaneho ye.
Eleasar na kuthe nomunwe gwe mombinzi yayo e te yi ndondele luheyali lwokomeho getsalihangano.
Ondema ayihe, ekunka, onyama, ombinzi niikwamela nayi lungunithwe montaneho yomuyambi.
Omuyambi na kuthe oshiti shomusedeli, oshisopi nongodhi ontiligane e te yi umbile meziko.
Konima yaambika na yoge oonguwo dhe e ti itile omeya nota shuna kontanda, ihe ota kala a nika oshidhila sigo ongulohi.
Omulumentu ngoka a lungunitha po ondema, oku na okuyoga oonguwo dhe nokwiitila omeya, ihe naye wo ota kala a nika oshidhila sigo ongulohi.
Omulumentu gumwe a yogoka na kuthe po omutoko gwondema e te gu fala pehala eyelele pondje yontanda. Nagu pungulilwe egongalo lyAaisraeli, gu longithwe momeya geyelitho. Ohaga yogo po omayono.
Omulumentu ngoka a yuku omutoko, na yoge oonguwo dhe, ihe ota kala a nika oshidhila sigo ongulohi. Eutho ndika otali kala aluhe sigo aluhe kAaisraeli nokaakwiilongo ya kala mokati kawo.”
“Oongoka ta gumu omudhimba, ota kala a kwata oshidhila omasiku gaheyali.
Oku na okwiiyelitha nomeya geyelitho mesiku etitatu nomesiku etiheyali, nota kala a yela. Ihe ngele iti iyelitha momasiku agehe gaali, ita kala a yela.
Oongoka ta gumu omudhimba noini iyelitha, ota kala a kwata oshidhila, oshoka omeya geyelitho inage mu tilwa. Ota nyateke etsalihangano lyOmuwa, noku na okudhimwa mo maantu yaKalunga.
“Ngele oku na ngoka ta sile metsali, shaa ngoka ta adhika metsali pethimbo lyetokoko nenge ta yi mo, ota kala a kwata oshidhila omasiku gaheyali.
Oshuma kehe metsali shoka shaa na oshisiikilo, otashi kala sha kwata oshidhila.
Shaa ngoka ta gumu omuntu a dhipagwa nenge i isila kelundu nenge omuntu ta gumu iipongo yomuntu nenge ombila, ota kala a kwata oshidhila omasiku gaheyali.
“Nakukwata oshidhila na kuthilwe mo omutoko gwondema ndjoka ya yambelwa edhimopo lyoondjo, e tagu tulwa moshuma notamu gwedhwa omeya omayelele.

Omuntu gumwe a yogoka na kuthe oshisopi, te shi yaya momeya e ta shashamine etsali, ayihe yi li mo naantu ya li mo. Omuntu ngoka omuyelele na shashamine wo omeya komuntu ngoka a guma iipongo yomuntu nenge omudhimba nenge ombila.

Mesiku etitatu nomesiku etiheyali omuntu ngoka omuyelele na shashamine omeya komuntu ngoka a kwata oshidhila. Mesiku etiheyali ota yelitha omuntu ngoka. Omuyelithwi na yoge oonguwo dhe nokwiitila omeya, nopeningino lyetango ota kala omuyelele.
“Shaa ngoka a kwata oshidhila noita iyelitha, ota kala a nika oshidhila, oshoka omeya geyelitho inage mu tilahilwa. Ota nyateke etsalihangano lyOmuwa, noku na okudhimwa mo maantu yaKalunga.
Ne omu na okudhiginina eutho ndika aluhe sigo aluhe. Omuntu ngoka ta shashamine omeya geyelitho, oku na wo okuyoga oonguwo dhe; shaa ngoka ta gumu omeya, ota kala a kwata oshidhila sigo ongulohi.
Shaa shoka omuntu ngoka e na oshidhila te shi gumu, otashi nika oshidhila, noshaa ngoka te shi gumu, ota kala a kwata oshidhila sigo ongulohi.”
20: Momwedhi gwotango egongalo alihe lyAaisraeli olye ya mombuga Zin e tali yungu ontanda muKadesh. Miriam okwa mana oondjenda e ta fumvikwa.
Mpoka ya yungu ontanda, kapwa li omeya, aantu noya gongalele Moses naAaron
noya tamanana ya ti: “Akutu, osha li oshihwepo, ando twa sile komeho getsalihangano pamwe nooyakwetu, sho ya yonukile po koshipala shOmuwa.
Omolwashike mwe tu etele mombuga muno? Otu sile mo niimuna yetu?

Omolwashike mwe tu tembudha mo muEgipiti mu tu ete meha ndino ewiwiwiwi noihamu mene nando osha? Mwaa na iilya nomwaa na oonkwiyu, mwaa na omandjembele nomwaa na oondunga dhomigranati. Nokuli kamu na omeya gokunwa!”
Moses naAaron oya zi mokati kaantu e taa thikama posheelo shetsalihangano. Oya tsu iipala yawo mevi, neadhimo lyOmuwa olye ya adhimine.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses e ta ti:

“Kutha ondhimbo, ithana omumwanyoko Aaron e tamu gongaleke egongalo alihe. Montaneho yalyo alihe lombwela emanya, nomeya otaga tsipuka mo. Pahedhi ndjika oto kutha omeya memanya ga nuwe kaantu nokiimuna.”
Moses okwa yi nokwa kutha ondhimbo, ngaashi Omuwa e mu lombwele.
Pamwe naAaron oya gongaleke egongalo alihe pemanya, naMoses okwa ti: “Pulakeneni, ne aatangalali! Natu mu kuthile omeya memanya ndika?”
Moses okwa yelutha ondhimbo e ta dhenge nayo emanya lwaali, nomwa tsipuka omeya ogendji, aantu niimuna noya nu mo.
Omuwa okwa ganda Moses naAaron e ta ti: “Molwaashoka ne kamu na eitaalo lya gwana okwiinekela oonkondo dhandje montaneho yAaisraeli, itamu ya fala we mevi ndyoka nde ya uvanekele tandi li ya pe.”
Shika osha ningwa puMeriba, mpoka Aaisraeli ya tamaneke Omuwa naampoka i iholola kuyo kutya oye omuyapuki.
MuKadesh Moses okwa tumu aatumwa ya ye komukwaniilwa gwaEdom taa ti: “Elaka ndika olya zi kaakweni, omazimo gaIsrael. Owa tseya nkene twa talithwa omalwa,
sho ootatekulu ya yi kuEgipiti, nkoka twa kala omimvo odhindji. Aegipiti oya hepeke ootatekulu noonkondo,
otse notwa kugile Omuwa ekwatho. Oku uvu onkugo yetu e ta tumu omuyengeli, ngoka e tu tembudha muEgipiti. Ngashingeyi otu li muKadesh, oshilando shi li pongamba yoshilongo shoye.

Tu kwatha, u tu pitikile tu tokole oshilongo shoye. Otse niimuna yetu itatu zi mo mondjila tu ye momapya goye nenge miitsambe yomiviinu dhoye, noitatu nu momithima dhoye. Otatu kala mondjila, sigo twa pitilile oshilongo shoye.”
Ihe omukwaniilwa gwaEdom okwa yamukula a ti: “Itamu pitikwa okutokola oshilongo shandje! Ngele tamu shi yelekele, otatu ya tu mu tsakaneke tu na egongamwele.”
Aaisraeli oya ti: “Otatu kala mondjila, nongele tatu nu omeya geni nenge iimuna yetu tayi ga nu, otatu futu. Otwa hala owala tu pite mo.”
Omukwaniilwa gwaEdom okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Aawe, ndati!” Aaedom oya piti mo ya homata noya ponokele Aaisraeli.
Molwaashoka Aaedom inaa pitika Aaisraeli ya tokole oshilongo shawo, Aaisraeli oya shuna e taa yi nondjila yilwe.
Egongalo alihe lyAaisraeli olya zi muKadesh e tali thiki pondundu Hor,
pongamba yaEdom. Oko Omuwa a lombwele Moses naAaron a ti:
“Aaron ita yi mevi ndyoka ndu uvaneke tandi li pe Israel; ota si, oshoka ne yaali omwa tindi oshipango shandje puMeriba.
Kutha Aaron nomwana Eleasar, mu londe kondundu Hor,
naankoka to hula Aaron oonguwo dhe dhuuyambi e to dhi zaleke Eleasar. Aaron ota ka sila ko.”
Moses okwa ningi, ngaashi Omuwa e mu lombwele. Oya londo kondundu Hor montaneho yegongalo alihe,
naMoses okwa hula Aaron oonguwo dhuuyambi e te dhi zaleke Eleasar. Aaron nokwa sile kondungu yondundu, Moses naEleasar oya galuka ko ya kulukile pohi.
Egongalo alihe olya koneke kutya Aaron a mana oondjenda, olyo nolye mu lili oosa omasiku omilongo ndatu.
21: Ano omukwaniilwa Omukaanani gwaArad muumbugantu waKaanan sho a kundana kutya Aaisraeli otaa ya nondjila yokuAtarim, okwe ya matukile e ta kwata po yamwe oonkwatwa.
Nena Aaisraeli oya ningi euvaneko kOmuwa ya ti: “Ngele oto tu sinditha aantu mbaka, otatu ku yapulile nokugana iilando yawo.
Omuwa okwe ya uvu e te ya kwatha okusinda Aakanaan. Aaisraeli noye ya hanagula po niilando yawo, nehala ndyoka oye li luku Horma.”
Aaisraeli oya zi po pondundu Hor taa ende nondjila yu uka kEkololo lyaAkaba, opo ya dhingoloke oshilongo shaEdom. Ihe mondjila aantu oya kanitha eidhidhimiko lyawo
noya tamaneke Kalunga naMoses ya nyenyeta ya ti: “Omolwashike mwe tu tembudha muEgipiti, tu sile mombuga muno? Muka kamu na iikulya nenge omeya. Iikulya mbino yomukaga otwe yi kenyanana!”
Nena Omuwa okwa tumu omayoka ge na uuzigo mokati kaantu, nAaisraeli oyendji oya lika noya si.
Aantu oye ya kuMoses noya ti: “Otwa yono, sho twa popi twa tsa ondumbo nOmuwa nonangoye. Galikana Omuwa, a kuthe mo omayoka mokati ketu.” Moses nokwa galikanene aantu.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a hambule eyoka e li endjeleleke koshiti, opo shaa ngoka a lika e li tale ye a kale nomwenyo.
Moses okwa hambula eyoka lyoshikushu e te li endjeleleke koshiti. Shaa ngoka a lika e ta tala keyoka lyoshikushu, okwa kala nomwenyo.
Aaisraeli oya tembuka po e taa ka yunga oontanda puObot.
Sho ya zi po, oya ka yunga oontanda pomakulukuma gaAbarim, mombuga yokuuzilo woshilongo Moab.
Opo ihe oya yungu oontanda molusilu Sered.
Okuza nkoka oya tembudha ishewe e taa ka yunga oontanda kombinga yuumbangalantu womulonga Arnon, mombuga ndjoka ya tsa koshilongo shAayamori. (Arnon ogwa li ongamba pokati kAamoabi nAayamori.)

nomasilukila gomasilu ga adha koshilando Ar
nokuuka kongamba yaMoab.”
Okuza hoka oya yi keha hali ithanwa Beer, ogwo omuthima ngoka Omuwa a lombwele Moses ta ti: “Gongaleka aantu, ndi ya pe omeya.”

Omuthima ogwa hupwa kaana yokombanda,
gwa yuulwa kaakuluntu yoshigwana.
Oya hupu nondhimbo yuukwaniilwa,
oya panda nomapanda gawo.”
Oya zi mombuga yu uka kuMattana.
Okuza kuMattana oyu uka kuNahaliel nokuza kuNahaliel oyu uka kuBamot.
Okuza kuBamot oyu uka kolusilu lwoshilongo shAamoabi, ponyonga yondundu Pisga, ndjoka ya tumbalala mombuga.
Aaisraeli oya tumu aatumwa kuSihon, omukwaniilwa gwAayamori, nelaka tali ti:

“Tu pitika tu tokole moshilongo shoye. Otse niimuna yetu itatu zi mondjila tu ye ando momapya goye nenge miitsambe yoye yomiviinu, noitatu nu nando omeya momithima dhoye, otatu kala owala mondjila, sigo twa tokola oshilongo shoye.”
Ihe Sihon ina pitika Aaisraeli ya taaguluke oshilongo she. Okwa hiya iita e ta zi mo a yi kuJahas mombuga e ta ponokele Aaisraeli.
Aaisraeli oya dhipaga aantu oyendji e taa lala po evi lyawo okuza komulonga Arnon sigo okuJabbok, tashi ti sigo evi lyAayammoni, oshoka ongamba yAayammoni oya li ya gamenwa noonkondo.
Osho ngaaka Aaisraeli ya lala iilando ayihe yAayamori, mwa kwatelelwa mo Heshbon nomikunda dhe shi kunduka e taa kala mo.
Heshbon osha li oshilandopangelo shomukwaniilwa gwAayamori Sihon, ngoka a kondjitha omukwaniilwa gwonale gwaMoab e ta yugu ko evi lye sigo okomulonga Arnon.

Omolwashoka aatoti yiitewo taa ti:
“Ileni kuHeshbon, koshilando shomukwaniilwa Sihon!
Otwa hala tu shi tale tashi tungululwa notashi ningwa oshipe.

Oshoka muHeshbon omwa zi omulilo,
ondalu yanelyanga moshilando shaSihon.
Oya lungunike po oshilando Ar muMoab
nokulatha po omitumbo puArnon.

Memekukwee, ne Aamoabi!
Ne aalongeli yaKemosh, omwa hanagulwa po!
Kalunga keni okwe etha aantu ye, ya ninge oontauki,
naakulukadhi ya ninge oonkwatwa dhomukwaniilwa gwAayamori.

Ihe ngashingeyi oluvalo lwawo olwa yonwa po,
okuza kuHeshbon ndongo oDibon,
okuza kuNashim sigololo Nofak popepi naMedeba.”
Aaisraeli oya tula moshilongo shAayamori,
naMoses okwa tumu aalumentu ya ka ndaadhe Jaser. Aaisraeli oye shi kwata po nomikunda dhe shi kunduka e taa tidha mo Aayamori mboka ya li mo.
Opo ihe Aaisraeli oya galuka noya lamba ondjila yokuBaasha. Og, omukwaniilwa gwaBaasha, okwa piti mo naakwiita ye e te ya ponokele puEdrei.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Ino mu tila. Otandi mu gandja miikaha yoye, aantu ye ayehe noshilongo she. Mu ningila, ngaashi wa ningile Sihon, omukwaniilwa gwAayamori ngoka a pangele muHeshbon.”
Aaisraeli oya dhipaga Og, oyana aamati naantu ye ayehe, noinaa etha pu hupe ngoka e na omwenyo, e taa lala oshilongo she.
22: Aaisraeli oya tembuka po e taa ka yunga oontanda molushandja lwaMoab kuuzilo waJordan ontega naJeriko.
Balak yaZippor, omukwaniilwa gwaMoab, sho a kundana shoka Aaisraeli ya ningile Aayamori nonkene Aaisraeli ye li po oyendjiyendji,
oye pamwe naantu ye oya sholola.
Aamoabi oya lombwele aawiliki yAamidiana ya ti: “Engathithi ndika otali tu mana po ongondumetana tayi gugula po omwiidhi omutalala komaunapelo.” Omukwaniilwa Balak

okwa tumu aatumwa ya ka tale Bileam yaBeor, ngoka a li muPetor popepi nomulonga Eufrat mevi lyoyaandjawo Amaw, ye mu lombwele ya tye: “Onda hala ndi ku tseyithile kutya muEgipiti omwa zi oshigwana oshindji, aantu yasho oya andjalala apehepehe notaa hala okukwata po evi lyetu.

Otaye tu nyenge okuyalula. Tu kwatha ano, u ye u ya lile ndje muumpulile. Pamwe tatu vulu oku ya sinda noku ya tidha mo mevi lyetu. Ondi shi shi kutya shaa to tomonene omuntu eyambeko, ota kala a yambekwa, naangoka to mu tomonene etulomutima, ota kala a tulwa omutima.”
Aawiliki Aamoabi naawiliki Aamidiana oya faalele iikahu kuBileam e taye mu lombwele etumwalaka lyaBalak.
Bilean okwe ya lombwele e ta ti: “Laleni mpaka, ongula otandi mu lombwele shoka Omuwa a lombwele ndje.” Aawiliki Aamoabi noya tokelwa puBileam.
Kalunga okwe ya kuBileam e ta ti: “Aalumentu mboka ya tokelwa pungoye, oolye?”
Bileam okwa yamukula a ti: “Balak yaZippor, omukwaniilwa gwaMoab, oye e ya tumu kungame, ya lombwele ndje
kutya aantu ya tembuka muEgipiti, oya siikila oshilongo ashihe. Nokwa hala ndi ye mu lile muupulile, opo a wape oku ya kondjitha noku ya tidha po.”
Kalunga okwa ti kuBileam: “Ino ya nando naantu mboka ngoye ino tula Aaisraeli omutima, oshoka oyo aalalekwa nuuyamba.”
Ongula sho kwa shi, Bileam okwa yi kaatumwa yaBalak e ta ti: “Shuneni kevi lyeni, Omuwa okwa tindi okuzimina ndje ndi ye nane.”
Oyo noya shuna kuBalak e taye mu lombwele kutya okwa tindi ko.
Nena Balak okwa tumununa ko aawiliki oyendji noya simana ye vule mbeyaka yotango.
Oya yi kuBileam e taye mu pe elaka lyaBalak yaZippor tali ti: “Inapa kala shoka tashi ku dhike waa ye kungame.”
Otandi ke ku futa ondjambi onene notandi ningi shaa shoka to lombwele ndje. Kwatha ndje u ye u lile ndje aantu mbaka muumpulile.
Bileam okwa yamukula a ti: “Balak nando na pe ndje oshisiliveli noshingoli shu udha egumbo lye, itandi vulu okutaaguluka elaka lyOmuwa Kalunga kandje nando okashona.
Kwathii ndje mu lale mpaka ongulohi ndjika, opo ndi koneke shoka Omuwa ta lombwele ndje.”
Kalunga okwe ya kuBileam uusiku tuu mbwiyaka e ta ti: “Aalumentu mbaka ngele oye ya kungoye ye ku ile, inda ano nayo, ihe longa ashike shoka tandi ku lombwele.”
Ongula sho kwa shi, Bileam okwa kutile okasino ke e ta yi naawiliki Aamidiana.
Kalunga okwa geele Bileam, sho a yi. Bileam okwa kayile okasino ke a thindikilwa kaamati ye yaali, nomuyengeli gwOmuwa okwa thikama mondjila a keelele ondjila ye.
Okasino sho ka mono omuyengeli a thikama mondjila a yedha egongamwele, oka peguka mo mondjila ku uka mepya. Bileam okwa dhenge okasino e te ka galulile mondjila.
Nena omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwa humu ko e ta ka thikama pothina pokati kiitsambe yomiviinu ya gumbilwa omankolo gomakuma.
Okasino sho ka mono omuyengeli, oki iwegenyene kekuma e taka thengenyene ko ompadhi yaBileam. Bileam okwe ka dhengulula.
Omuyengeli okwa humu ko ishewe e ta thikama pokuma pwaa na ompito yokuhenukila kolulyo nenge kolumoho.
Okasino sho ka mono omuyengeli, oka tsu po oongolo. Bileam okwa geye e ta dhenge okasino noshitago.
Nopo mpoka Omuwa okwa makula okana kwokasino e taka ti kuBileam: “Onde ku ningi shike? Omolwashike wa dhenge ndje lutatu?”
Bileam okwa yamukula a ti: “Omolwashoka wa tala ndje egoya! Ando nda li ndi na egongamwele, ando otandi ku dhipaga.”

Okasino oka yamukula ka ti: “Kandi shi okasino koye ho kayile ndje noshito? Onde ku ningile nale ngawo?”
Bileam okwa yamukula a ti: “Aawe!”
Omuwa okwa tonatitha omeho gaBileam e ta mono omuyengeli a thikama e na egongamwele; naBileam okwi iyundulile pevi koshipala shomuyengeli.
Omuyengeli okwa pula a ti: “Omolwashike wa dhenge okasino koye lutatu? Onde ya ndi ku keelele mondjila yoye, oshoka kakwa li u na okuya molweendo nduka.
Okasino koye oka mono ndje, noka peguka ndje lutatu. Ando oka li inaake shi ninga, ando nde ku dhipaga, ihe ando ko onde ka etha ka kale ke na omwenyo.”
Bileam okwa yamukula a ti: “Onda yona. Inandi shi tseya kutya omo u li mondjila to keelele ndje, ihe ngashingeyi ngele ino hala ndi tsikile nondjila yandje, otandi shuna kegumbo.”
Omuyengeli okwa ti: “Inda ngaa naalumentu mbaka, ihe popya ashike shoka tandi ku lombwele u shi popye.” Bileam nokwa yi naantu yaBalak.
Balak sho ku uvu kutya Bileam ote ya, okwa yi e ke mu tsakaneke puAr, oshilando shi li pomulonga Arnon pongamba yaMoab.
Balak okwa ti kuBileam: “Omolwashike inoo ya, sho nde ku tuminine lwotango? Oto dhiladhila kutya ite vulu oku ku futa ondjambi ya gwana?”
Bileam okwa yamukula a ti: “Ngashingeyi onde ya, ihe ondi na oonkondo dhashike? Ote vulu owala okupopya shoka Kalunga ta lombwele ndje ndi shi popye.”
Bileam nokwa yi naBalak kuKirjat Huzot,
nkoka Balak a tselele oongombe noonzi e ta pe Bileam naawiliki mboka a li nayo onyama.
Ongula sho kwa shi, Balak okwa kutha Bileam e te mu fala kondungu yondundu Bamot Baal pombanda, mpoka ta vulu okumona ombinga yimwe yAaisraeli.
23: Bileam okwa lombwele Balak a ti: “Tungila ndje mpaka iiyambelo iheyali ngoye u etele ndje oongombe heyali noonzi oondumentu heyali.”
Balak okwa ningi, ngaashi a lombwelwa, oye naBileam noya yamba ongombe nonzi ondumentu poshiyambelo kehe.

Opo ihe Bileam okwa ti kuBalak: “Kala mpaka pefikilondjambo lyoye, manga tandi ka tala, pamwe Omuwa ta tsakaneke ndje. Otandi ya ndi ku lombwele, ngele okwi ihololele ndje.” Okwa londo koshikulundundu shimwe,
naKalunga okwe mu tsakaneke. Bileam okwa ti kuye: “Onda tungu iiyambelo iheyali nonda yambele ongombe nonzi ondumentu koshiyambelo kehe.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Bileam shoka e na oku shi popya e te mu tumu kuBalak, opo e mu lombwele elaka lye.
Okwa shuna e ta adha Balak a thikama pefikilondjambo e li pamwe naawiliki yaMoab.

Bileam okwa totomona ehunganeko lye e ta ti:
“Balak okwi ile ndje muAram,
omukwaniilwa gwaMoab okoondundu dhokuuzilo, a ti:
‘Ila, u lile ndje Jakob muumpulile;
ila, u tikilile ndje Israel.’

Otandi mu li ngiini,
Kalunga sho ite mu li?
Otandi mu tikile ngiini,
Omuwa sho ite mu tikile?

Opombanda mpaka nde mu tala,
okiikulundundu tandi mu ligamene.
Tala, oshigwana shi iyoololelwa
sho itaashi yalulilwa maantu yalwe.

Olye ta vulu okuyalula oluvalo lwaJakob,
nenge okuyeleka omwaalu gwaIsrael?
Nandi se eso lyaayuuki,
ndi tokoke ndi na ombili,
ngaashi aantu yaKalunga!”
Balak okwa ti kuBileam: “Owa ningi ndje ngiini? Onde ku ithana, u ye u lile ndje aatondi yandje muumpulile, ihe owe ya laleke nuuyamba.”
Bileam okwa yamukula a ti: “Otandi popi ashike shoka Omuwa ta lombwele ndje, ndi shi popye.”
Balak okwa lombwele Bileam a ti: “Ila, tu ye kehala lilwe nkoka to vulu okutala ombinga onkwawo yAaisraeli, ngoye u ya lile ndje muumpulile.”
Okwe mu fala kelundu lyaZofim kondungu yondundu Pisga. Okwa tungile ko iiyambelo iheyali e ta yambele ongombe nonzi ondumentu koshiyambelo kehe.
Bileam okwa ti kuBalak: “Kala mpaka pefikilondjambo lyoye, manga tandi ka tsakaneka Kalunga hwiyaka.”
Omuwa okwa tsakaneke Bileam e te mu lombwele shoka e na okupopya, nokwe mu shunitha kuBalak, e mu faalele elaka.
Okwa shuna e ta adha Balak a thikama pefikilondjambo lye, pamwe naawiliki yaMoab. Balak okwa pula shoka Omuwa a ti,

naBileam okwa totomona ehunganeko lye a ti:
“Thikama, Balak, u pulakene!
Omuna gwaZippor, pulakena ndje!

Kalunga hamuntu a popye iifundja,
Ye hamuna gwomuntu i idhiladhilulule.
A uvaneke sha ye kee shi gwanithe;
a popye sha ye kee shi ninge.

Onda nongekwa okuyambeka,
nongele Kalunga a yambeke,
ite vulu oku shi galula.

Omuntu ka mono omukundu muJakob
nenge okundhindhilika oshiponga muIsrael.
Omuwa, Kalunga kawo, oku li puyo,
nesimano lyomukwaniilwa tali ligolelwa mokati kawo.

Kalunga okwe ya tembudha muEgipiti;
oku ya lile po a fa ooniga dhonyati.

Kaku na uumpulile tau li Jakob,
kaku na uulodhi tau logo Israel.
Ngashingeyi aantu taa popi Jakob naIsrael taa ti:
‘Tala shoka Kalunga a ningi!’

Oshigwana shaIsrael osha thikama sha fa onkoshi onyali.
Ongaashi onime otashi iyelutha po,
itashi ka lala, manga inaashi lya shoka she shi yugu,
manga inaashi nwa ombinzi yoshihakanwa shasho she shi dhipaga.”
Nena Balak okwa ti kuBileam: “Owa tindi okuthinga Aaisraeli, ihe ino ya laleka wo nuuyamba!”
Bileam okwa yamukula a ti: “Inandi ku lombwela nani kutya otandi ningi ashike shoka Omuwa ta lombwele ndje?”
Balak okwa ti: “Ila, tu ye ndi ku fale kehala lilwe. Pamwe Kalunga ota ka pitika, u ya lile ndje muumpulile nkoka.”
Okwa fala Bileam kondungu yondundu Peor, ndjoka ya tumbalala mombuga.
Bileam okwe mu lombwele e ta ti: “Tungila ndje iiyambelo iheyali mpaka e to etele ndje oongombe heyali noonzi oondumentu heyali.”
Balak okwa ningi, ngaashi a lombwelwa, e ta yambele ongombe nonzi ondumentu koshiyambelo kehe.
24: Ngashingeyi Bileam sho a ndhindhilike kutya Omuwa nani okwe mu hala a yambeke Aaisraeli, ina anekela we, ngaashi ha ningi shito. Okwa pungululile oshipala she kombuga
e ta mono Aaisraeli ye li moontanda omazimo nomazimo. Ombepo yaKalunga oye mu lambele,

Ndika ehunganeko lyomuuvi gwoohapu dhaKalunga,
lyanakumona omamoniko gOmunankondoawike
nolyomukakuki ngoka e na omeho ga tonata:

Omatsali goye, Jakob, ogo opala ngiini!
Oonkalelo dhoye, Israel, odha poleka ngiini!

Odha andjalala dha fa omalusilu gomeya,
odha fa iitsambe pooha dhomulonga,
odha fa omandombo ga tsikwa kOmuwa
nenge omisedeli pooha dhomeya.

Omeya otaga kungulukile miiyuma yawo.
Otaa kunu oombuto dhawo momapya ga tosima.
Omukwaniilwa gwawo omunene e vule Agag,
nelelo lye olya taandela nolya yeluka.

Kalunga okwe ya tembudha muEgipiti;
oku ya lile po a fa ooniga dhonyati.
Otaa ka nyanyagula aatondi yawo,
taye ya teyagula omasipa
notaye ya yaha niikuti.

Otaa hundjunine
notaa ka lala ya fa onkoshi, ongonime onyali;
olye te ya pendutha?
Ngoka te ku yambeke, Israel, ota yambekwa,
ihe ngoka te ku thingi, ota thingwa.”
Nena Balak okwa geele Bileam. Okwa dhenge iikaha ye kumwe e ta lombwele Bileam ta ti: “Onde ku ithana u ye u lile ndje aatondi yandje muumpulile, ihe peha lyasho owe ya laleke nuuyamba lutatu nokuli.
Shuna kaandjeni! Onda li ndu uvaneke tandi ku futu, ihe Omuwa okwe ku keelele okutaamba ondjambi.”
Bileam okwa yamukula a ti: “Onda lombwele aatumwa mboka wa tumine kutya
nando u pe ndje iisiliveli ayihe niingoli ayihe yu udha egumbo lyoye, itandi pandakana noshipango shOmuwa, ndi ninge sha mungame mwene. Otandi popi owala shoka Omuwa ta lombwele ndje, ndi shi popye.”
Bileam okwa ti kuBalak: “Ngashingeyi otandi shuna koyaandjetu, ihe manga inaandi ya, otandi ku lombwele shoka Aaisraeli taa ka ningila aantu yoye monakuyiwa.”

Ndika ehunganeko lyomuuvi gwoohapu dhaKalunga,
lyanakutseya uunongo waanguka Gwokombandambanda,
nolyaangoka ha mono omamoniko gOmunankondoadhihe:

Ondi mu wete, ihe hangashingeyi,
otandi mu ligamene, ihe hapopepi.
Onyothi otayi piti muJakob,
ondhimbo yuukwaniilwa otayi yeluka muIsrael.
Oye ta nyanyagula po aawiliki yaMoab,
nota kombo po oluvalo aluhe lwaSet.

Ota sindi aatondi ye muEdom
e ta lala evi lyawo Seir,
ihe Israel ota nkondopala aluhe.

MuJakob otamu zi omupangeli,
nota kombo po mboka ya hupile ko.”

Bileam okwa mono wo Amalek nokwa totomona ehunganeko lye a ti:
“Amalek oye oshigwana oshinankondo shotango,
ihe ehulilo lyasho olyo ekano lyasho.”

Sho a mono Aakeni, okwa totomona ehunganeko lye a ti:
“Oonkalelo dhoye odha gamenwa,
odhi li puule pemanya ngoshihandhila shontsa.

Ihe ne Aakeni otamu ka hanagulwa po.
Assur ote mu fala muupika.”

Bileam okwa tsikile okutotomona kwe a ti:
“Yayee, akwetse, olye ta kala nomwenyo,
Kalunga ngele ta gwanitha mbika?

Aayendifuta otaa zi kombinga yaKipro.
Otaa teya po Assur naEber,
ihe nayo wo otaa ka yonuka po thilu.”
Bileam sho a mana, okwa thikama e ta shuna kaandjawo, naBalak wo okwa yi nondjila ye.
25: Aaisraeli sho ya kala muShittim, aantu oya hondele naakadhona Aamoabi,
mboka ye ya hiya kiituthi yomasaagelo. Aaisraeli oya li iikulya yawo noyi inyongamene kiikalunga yawo.
Aaisraeli sho ya simaneke ngeyi Baal, oshikalunga shaPeor, Omuwa okwe ya geele
e ta ti kuMoses: “Kutha aawiliki yAaisraeli ayehe, u ya tule kohake montaneho yaantu, opo ondjahi yOmuwa yokugeela Israel yi lote.”
Moses okwa lombwele aatokolihapu yaIsrael a ti: “Kehe gumwe gwomune oku na okudhipaga omuntu ngoka a ningi omulongeli gwaBaal Peor.”
Omulumentu gumwe Omuisraeli okwa kutha omufuko Omumidiana e te mu fala ketsali lye montaneho yaMoses negongalo alihe lyaIsrael, manga ya li taa lilile posheelo shetsalihangano.
Omuyambi Pinehas yaEleasar, omutekulu gwaAaron, sho e shi mono, okwa thikama a zi moshigongi. Okwa kutha egonga
e ta landula omulumentu ngoka e na omufuko sigo ometsali e te ya tsu negonga ayehe yaali, Omuisraeli nomufuko Omumidiana. Pahedhi ndjika elega ndyoka lya yono po Aaisraeli, olya kodha,
ihe olya faalele nokuli aantu 24 000.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses e ta ti:
“Molwoshinima shoka sha ningwa kuPinehas, itandi kala we nda geela Aaisraeli. Okwa tindi okwiidhidhimikila okusimaneka iikalunga, nomolwashoka inandi ya yonagula po ayehe.
Lombwela Pinehas kutya otandi dhike ehangano naye, ndyoka tali kala aluhe sigo aluhe.
Oye noluvalo lwe tandi ya langeke ya ninge aayambi sigo aluhe, molwashoka okwa kodhilile esimano lyaKalunga ke e te etele aantu edhimopo lyomayono gawo.”
Edhina lyOmuisraeli ngoka a dhipagelwa pamwe nomufuko Omumidiana, oSimri yaSalu, omukuluntu gwegumbo mezimo lyaSimeon.
Edhina lyomufuko Omumidiana oKosbi yaSur; he okwa li omukuluntu gwongundu yomaludhi gAamidiana.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Ponokela Aamidiana, opo u ya hanagule po,
omoluuwinayi mboka ye mu ningile, sho ye mu kotokele puPeor nomolwaKosbi, ngoka a dhipagwa pethimbo lyelega puPegor.”
26: Elega sho lya kodha, Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses naEleasar lyaAaron
e ta ti: “Yaluleni omwaalu gwegongalo alihe lyaIsrael pamazimo, aalumentu ayehe yepipi lyomimvo omilongo mbali naamboka ye vule po ya gwana okuhinga iita.”
Moses nomuyambi Eleasar oye ya uvithile molushandja lwaMoab puJordan ontega naJeriko ya ti:

“Naa holoke ayehe mboka yomimvo omilongo mbali naamboka ye vule po, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.”
Aaisraeli mboka ya tembuka muEgipiti, oyo mbaka
Ezimo lyaReuben, osheeli shaJakob: omaludhi gaHanok, Pallu,
Hezron naKarmi.
Omaludhi ngaka oga li ge na aalumentu 43 730.
Oluvalo lwaPallu oEliab
noyana Nemuel, Datan naAbiram. (Datan naAbiram oyo mbeyaka ya li ya hogololwa kegongalo. Oyi itumbile Moses naAaron e tayi itula maalanduli yaKora, sho ya li ya tsu ondumbo nOmuwa.
Evi olya makuka e tali ya nina po, noya sile pamwe naKora naalanduli ye, omulilo sho gwa lungunitha po aalumentu 250; oya ningi elondodho koshigwana.
Ihe aana yaKora inaa dhipagwa.)
Ezimo lyaSimeon: omaludhi gaNemuel, Jamin, Jakin,
Sera naShaul.
Omwaalu gwaalumentu momaludhi ngaka ogwa li 22 200.
Ezimo lyaGad: omaludhi gaZefon, Haggi, Shuni,
Osni, Eri,
Arod naAreli.
Omwaalu gwaalumentu momaludhi ngaka ogwa li 40 500.
Ezimo lyaJuda: omaludhi gaShela, Perez, Sera, Hezron naHamul. (Aana yaJuda yaali aamati, Er naOnan oya sile mevi lyaKaanan.)
Omwaalu gwaalumentu momaludhi ngaka ogwa li 76 500.
Ezimo lyaIssaskar: omaludhi gaTola, Puwa,
Jashub naShimron.
Omwaalu gwaalumentu momaludhi ngaka ogwa li 64 300.
Ezimo lyaSebulon: omaludhi gaSered, Elon naJahleel.
Omwaalu gwaalumentu momaludhi ngaka ogwa li 60 500.
Omazimo gaJosef, ngoka a li he yaamati yaali, Manasse naEfraim.
Ezimo lyaManasse: Makir gaManasse okwa li he yaGilead, nomaludhi taga landula oga zi muhekulu Gilead:
omaludhi gaIeser, Helek,
Asriel, Shekem,
Shemida naHefer.
Zelofhad yaHefer ka li e na aanona aamati, ihe aakadhona ayeke; omadhina gawo ogo Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka naTirza.
Omwaalu gwaalumentu momaludhi ngaka ogwa li 52 700.
Ezimo lyaEfraim: omaludhi gaShuthela, Beker naTahan.
Oludhi lwaEran olwa zi moludhi lwaShuthela.
Omwaalu gwaalumentu momaludhi ngaka ogwa li 32 500. Ngaka ogo omaludhi ga za muJosef.
Ezimo lyaBenjamin: omaludhi gaBela, Ashbel, Ahiram,
Shefufam naHufam.
Omaludhi gaArd naNaeman oga zi muBela.
Omwaalu gwaalumentu momaludhi ngaka ogwa li 45 600.
Ezimo lyaDan: oludhi lwaShuham,
lu na omwaalu gwaalumentu 64 400.
Ezimo lyaAser: omaludhi gaImna, Ishvi naBeria.
Omaludhi gaHeber naMalkiel oga zi muBeria.
Aser okwa li e na omwana omukadhona edhina lye Sera.
Omwaalu gwaalumentu momaludhi ngaka ogwa li 53 400.
Ezimo lyaNaftali: omaludhi gaJakzeel, Guni,
Jezer naShillem.
Omwaalu gwaalumentu momaludhi ngaka ogwa li 45 400.
Omwaalu gwaalumentu Aaisraeli aguhe kumwe ogwa li 601 730.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses e ta ti:
“Topolela omazimo ngaka evi pamiyalu dhago.
Oshilongo oto shi topola mokuumba iihogololitho e to gandja oshitendelwa oshinene kezimo enene noshishona kezimo eshona.”
Ezimo lyaLevi lya thikama momaludhi gaGerson, Kohat naMerari.
Omaluvalo gawo oga kwatelela mo omaludhi gaLibni, Hebron, Mahli, Mushi naKora. Kohat ohe yaAmram,
ngoka a hokanene omuna gwaLevi omukadhona Jokebed, ngoka a valelwa muEgipiti. Jokebed okwa valele Amram aamati yaali, Aaron naMoses, nomukadhona Miriam.
Aaron okwa li e na aanona aamati yane: Nadab, Abihu, Eleasar naItamar.
Nadab naAbihu oya si, sho ya yamba omulilo gwaa shi omuyapuki.
Aalevi aalumentu mboka ya li ye na omwedhi gumwe nenge ye vule po, omwaalu gwawo 23 000. Oya li ya yoololwa mAaisraeli, oshoka inaa pewa oshitendelwa muIsrael.
Omaludhi agehe ngaka oga li ga yalulwa kuMoses nomuyambi Eleasar, sho ya yalula Aaisraeli molushandja lwaMoab pomulonga Jordan ontega naJeriko.
Maalumentu mbaka kamwa li nando ogumwe gwaambeyaka ya yalulilwe kuMoses nomuyambi Aaron mombuga Sinai.
Omuwa okwe ya lombwelele kutya otaa ka sila mombuga. Muyo inamu hupa nando ogumwe, kakele kaKaleb kaJefunne naJosua yaNun.
27: Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka naTirza oya li aakadhona aana yaZelofhad yaHefer yaGilead yaMakir gaManasse gaJosef
Oya yi noya thikama koshipala shaMoses nomuyambi Eleasar naawiliki negongalo alihe posheelo shetsalihangano e taa ti:
“Tate okwa sile mombuga ye ina thiga po aamati. Ka li nando mokati kaalanduli yaKora, mboka ya tsu ondumbo nOmuwa; okwa sile uulunde we mwene.
Molwashoka ka li e na aanona aamati, edhina lye otali kana mo muIsrael. Tu pa oshitendelwa shevi mokati kaamwayina yatate!”
Moses okwa tula oshinima shawo koshipala shOmuwa.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Shoka sha pulwa kaana yaZelofhad, oshi li mondjila, ya pa oshitendelwa mokati kaamwayina yahe. Ya pa oshitendelwa shahe.
Lombwela Aaisraeli kutya ngele oku na omuntu ta si ye ke na aanona aamati, omwana omukadhona na thigulule eliko lye.
Ngele ke na omwana omukadhona, aamwayina naye mu thigulule.
Ngele ke na aamwayina, oohegona naye mu thigulule.
Ngele ke na aamwayina nenge oohegona, nena omukwawo ngoka e mu li popepi, ne mu thigulule, opo eliko li ninge lye. Aaisraeli oye na okugwanitha eutho ndika Omuwa a lombwele Moses.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Londa kondundu Abarim u tale evi ndyoka tandi li pe Aaisraeli.
Shampa tuu we li tala, oto si, ngaashika omumwanyoko Aaron a si,

oshoka ne amuhe yaali omwa tsile ondumbo noshipango shandje mombuga Zin. Egongalo alihe sho lya ngungutulile ndje pomeya gaMeriba, omwa tindi okwiinekela oonkondo dhandje oondjapuki montaneho yalyo.” (Meriba olwo oluthithiya puKadesh mombuga Zin.)
Moses okwa lombwele Omuwa e ta ti:
“Omuwa Kalunga, ongoye othithiya yomwenyo aguhe, langeka po omulumentu ngoka ta wilike aantu mbaka
note ya kwatele komeho molugodhi, opo egongalo lyoye lyaa kale lya fa oonzi dhaa na omusita.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses e ta ti: “Kutha Josua yaNun, omulumentu ependa, u mu tenteke iikaha yoye komutse.
Mu thikameka montaneho yomuyambi Eleasar negongalo alihe, nomontaneho yawo oto mu langeke a ninge omulanduli gwoye.
Mu pa oonkondo dhoye, opo egongalo alihe lyaIsrael li vulike kuye.
Na thikame koshipala shomuyambi Eleasar, ngoka ta koneke ehalo lyandje mokulongitha Urim naTummim. Pahedhi ndjika Eleasar ota wilike Josua negongalo alihe lyaIsrael miinima yawo ayihe.”
Moses okwa ningi, ngaashi Omuwa e mu lombwele. Okwa thikameke Josua montaneho yomuyambi Eleasar negongalo alihe.
Moses okwa tenteke iikaha ye komutse gwaJosua, ngaashi Omuwa e mu lombwele e te mu langeke a ninge omulanduli gwe.
28: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli u tye: ‘Seni oshimpwiyu, mu yambele ndje iikulya mbyoka tayi opalele ndje.’
Ya lombwela kutya ondjambo ndjoka ye na okweetela Omuwa, oyo ndjika: oonzigona mbali oondumentu dhomumvo gumwe dhaa na oshipo nadhi ninge efikilondjambo lyesiku kehe.
Onzigona yimwe nayi yambwe ongula, nontiyali ongulohi,
shaa ndjoka pamwe noograma mbali dhuusila womunziya wa pilulilwa molita yimwe yomagadhi gooholivi.
Ndika olyo efikilondjambo lyesiku kehe lya yambelwa lwotango pondundu Sinai, li gandje ezimba lya nika nawa lyo opalela Omuwa.
Oshinuwandjambo pamwe nonzigona tashi tililwa koshiyambelo, osho olita yimwe yomaviinu.
Ongulohi otaku yambwa onzigona, ngaashi naanaa pwa ningilwe ongula, pamwe nondjambo yiikunuwa, yi gandje ezimba lya nika nawa lyo opalela Omuwa.”
“Mesiku lyEsabati otamu yambwa oonzigona mbali dhomumvo gumwe dhaa na oshipo, pamwe niikulyandjambo yuusila womunziya woolita ne netata wa pilulilwa momagadhi gooholivi, nondjambo yomaviinu.
Efikilondjambo ndika oli na okuyambwa Esabati kehe, mwa gwedhwa efikilondjambo lyoshito nondjambo yalyo yomaviinu.”
“Yambeleni Omuwa efikilondjambo petameko lyomwedhi kehe: oonzigona mbali oondumentu, onzi yimwe ondumentu noonzigona heyali oondumentu dhomumvo gumwe dhaa na oshipo.

Pamwe nongombe ondumentu kehe yamba ondjambo yiikulya yuusila womunziya woograma hamano netata wa pilulilwa momagadhi gooholivi; pamwe nonzi ondumentu yamba uusila womunziya woograma ne netata wa pilulilwa momagadhi gooholivi,
nokonzigona kehe oograma mbali dhuusila womunziya wa pilulilwa momagadhi gooholivi. Ndika olyo efikilondjambo li na ezimba lya nika nawa lyo opalela Omuwa.
Kongombe ondumentu kehe oku na okukala ondjambo yomaviinu goolita mbali, konzi ondumentu olita yimwe noshititano nokonzigona kehe olita yimwe. Ndika olyo efikilondjambo lyomwedhi omupe kehe momumvo.
Kakele kefikilondjambo lyesiku kehe noshinuwandjambo shalyo yamba ondjondjambo yoshikombo shimwe oshilumentu.”
“Momwedhi gwotango esiku etimulongo netine olyo Opaasa yOmuwa.
Mesiku etimulongo netitano oshituthi otashi tameke tashi kala omasiku gaheyali; momasiku ngoka otamu liwa iikwiila inaayi tulwa efulika.
Mesiku lyotango lyoshituthi otamu gongala kelongelokalunga, noitaku longwa nando.
Yambeleni Omuwa efikilondjambo lyoongombe mbali oondumentu, onzi ondumentu noonzigona heyali oondumentu dhomumvo gumwe dhaa na oshipo.
Yambeni ondjambo yiikulya yuusila womunziya woograma hamano netata wa pilulilwa momagadhi gooholivi kongombe kehe, oolita ne netata konzi kehe
noolita mbali konzigona kehe.
Yambeni wo oshikombo oshilumentu shi ninge ondjondjambo. Pahedhi ndjika otamu gwanitha eyelithoyapulo lyoshigwana.
Yambeni mbika ya gwedhela kefikilondjambo lyongulohi kehe.
Pamukalo nguka yambeleni Omuwa oondjambo dhiikulya momasiku agehe gaheyali, ezimba lya nika nawa lye mu opalela. Dhi yambeni mwe dhi gwedha kefikilondjambo lyesiku kehe nokoshinuwandjambo shalyo.
Mesiku etiheyali gongaleni kelongelokalunga, ihe inamu longa sha.”
“Mesiku lyoshipe, uuna tamu yambele Omuwa ondjambo yiilya iipe mOshituthi shoshiwike, gongaleni kelongelokalunga ne inamu longa sha.
Eteleni Omuwa omitanda mbali, onzi ondumentu noonzigona heyali dhomumvo gumwe dhaa na oshipo, dhi ninge efikilondjambo li na ezimba lya nika nawa tali mu opalele.
Komutanda kehe yambeni ondjambo yiikulya yuusila womunziya woograma hamano netata wa pilulilwa momagadhi gooholivi, oolita ne netata konzi kehe
noolita mbali konzigona kehe.
Yambeni wo oshikombo oshilumentu okugwanitha eyelithoyapulo lyoshigwana.
Yambeni oondjambo ndhika mwe dhi gwedha kefikilondjambo lyesiku kehe nokiikulyandjambo.”
29: “Mesiku lyotango lyomwedhi omutiheyali omu na okugongala kelongelokalunga, noitaku longwa sha. Esiku ndyoka omankuma naga hikwe.
Yambeleni Omuwa efikilondjambo, ezimba lya nika nawa lye mu opalela: omutanda gumwe, onzi yimwe ondumentu noonzigona heyali dhomumvo gumwe dhaa na oshipo.
Yambeni wo ondjambo yalyo yiikulya, uusila womunziya wa pilulilwa momagadhi gooholivi: oograma hamano netata pamwe nomutanda, oograma ne netata pamwe nonzi ondumentu
noograma mbali pamwe nonzigona kehe.
Yambeni wo oshikombo oshilumentu shi ninge ondjondjambo, opo mu gwanithe eyelithoyapulo lyoshigwana.

Gwedheni oondjambo ndhika kefikilondjambo lyomwedhi omupe nondjambo yalyo yiikulya nokefikilondjambo lyesiku kehe nondjambo yalyo yiikulya niikunuwa. Odho oondjambo dhi na ezimba lya nika nawa tali opalele Omuwa.”
“Gongaleni kelongelokalunga mesiku etimulongo lyomwedhi omutiheyali; idhilikeni iikulya ne inamu longa sha.
Yambeleni Omuwa efikilondjambo, ezimba lya nika nawa lye mu opalela: omutanda gumwe, onzi yimwe ondumentu noonzigona heyali oondumentu dhomumvo gumwe dhaa na oshipo.
Yambeni wo ondjambo yalyo yiikulya, uusila womunziya wa pilulilwa momagadhi gooholivi: oograma hamano netata pamwe nomutanda, oograma ne netata pamwe nonzi ondumentu
oograma mbali pamwe nonzigona kehe.
Kakele koshikombo sheyelithoyapulo lyoshigwana nefikilondjambo lyesiku kehe pamwe nondjambo yalyo yiikulya niikunuwa, yambeni wo oshikombo oshilumentu shi ninge ondjondjambo.”
“Gongaleni kelongelokalunga mesiku etimulongo netitano lyomwedhi omutiheyali. Dhaneni oshituthi mokusimaneka Omuwa omasiku gaheyali noitamu longo sha.

Mesiku lyotango yambeleni Omuwa efikilondjambo lyiikulya, ezimba lya nika nawa tali mu opalele: omitanda omilumentu omulongo nandatu, oonzi oondumentu mbali noonzigona oondumentu omulongo nane dhomumvo gumwe dhaa na oshipo.
Yambeni wo ondjambo yiikulya yuusila womunziya wa pilulilwa momagadhi gooholivi: oograma hamano netata pamwe nomutanda kehe, oograma ne netata pamwe nonzi kehe
oograma mbali pamwe nonzigona kehe.
Kefikilondjambo lyesiku kehe pamwe nondjambo yalyo yiikulya niikunuwa gwedhii ko oshikombo oshilumentu shi ninge ondjondjambo.
“Mesiku etiheyali yambeni omitanda omilumentu omulongo nambali, oonzi oondumentu mbali noonzigona oondumentu omulongo nane dhomumvo gumwe dhaa na oshipo.
Pamwe nomitanda, oonzi oondumentu noonzigona yambeni wo oondjambo dhiikulya niikunuwa pamiyalu dhadho, ngaashi kwa uthwa.
Kefikilondjambo lyesiku kehe pamwe nondjambo yalyo yiikulya niikunuwa gwedhii ko oshikombo oshilumentu shi ninge ondjondjambo.
“Mesiku etitatu yambeni omitanda omilumentu omulongo nagumwe, oonzi oondumentu mbali noonzigona oondumentu omulongo nane dhomumvo gumwe dhaa na oshipo.
Pamwe nomitanda, oonzi oondumentu noonzigona yambeni wo oondjambo dhiikulya niikunuwa pamiyalu dhadho, ngaashi kwa uthwa.
Kefikilondjambo lyesiku kehe pamwe nondjambo yalyo yiikulya niikunuwa gwedhii ko oshikombo oshilumentu shi ninge ondjondjambo.
“Mesiku etine yambeni omitanda omilumentu omulongo, oonzi oondumentu mbali noonzigona oondumentu dhomumvo gumwe omulongo nane dhaa na oshipo.
Pamwe nomitanda, oonzi oondumentu noonzigona yambeni wo oondjambo dhiikulya niikunuwa pamiyalu dhadho, ngaashi kwa uthwa.
Kefikilondjambo lyesiku kehe pamwe nondjambo yalyo yiikulya niikunuwa gwedhii ko oshikombo oshilumentu shi ninge ondjondjambo.
“Mesiku etitano yambeni omitanda omilumentu omugoyi, oonzi oondumentu mbali noonzigona oondumentu dhomumvo gumwe omulongo nane dhaa na oshipo.
Pamwe nomitanda, oonzi oondumentu noonzigona yambeni wo oondjambo dhiikulya niikunuwa pamiyalu dhadho, ngaashi kwa uthwa.
Kefikilondjambo lyesiku kehe pamwe nondjambo yalyo yiikulya niikunuwa gwedhii ko oshikombo oshilumentu shi ninge ondjondjambo.
“Mesiku etihamano yambeni omitanda omilumentu hetatu, oonzi oondumentu mbali noonzigona oondumentu dhomumvo gumwe omulongo nane dhaa na oshipo.
Pamwe nomitanda, oonzi oondumentu noonzigona, yambeni wo oondjambo dhiikulya niikunuwa pamiyalu dhadho, ngaashi kwa uthwa.
Kefikilondjambo lyesiku kehe pamwe nondjambo yalyo yiikulya niikunuwa gwedhii ko oshikombo oshilumentu shi ninge ondjondjambo.
“Mesiku etiheyali yambeni omitanda omilumentu heyali, oonzi oondumentu mbali noonzigona oondumentu dhomumvo gumwe omulongo nane dhaa na oshipo.
Pamwe nomitanda, oonzi oondumentu noonzigona yambeni wo oondjambo dhiikulya niikunuwa pamiyalu dhadho, ngaashi kwa uthwa.
Kefikilondjambo lyesiku kehe pamwe nondjambo yalyo yiikulya niikunuwa gwedhii ko oshikombo oshilumentu shi ninge ondjondjambo.
“Mesiku etihetatu gongaleni kelongelokalunga, noitamu longo sha.
Yambeleni Omuwa efikilondjambo, ezimba lya nika nawa tali mu opalele: omutanda gumwe, onzi yimwe ondumentu noonzigona heyali oondumentu dhomumvo gumwe dhaa na oshipo.
Pamwe nomutanda, onzi ondumentu noonzigona, yambeni wo oondjambo dhiikulya niikunuwa pamiyalu dhadho, ngaashi kwa uthwa.
Kefikilondjambo lyesiku kehe pamwe nondjambo yalyo yiikulya niikunuwa gwedhii ko oshikombo oshilumentu shi ninge ondjondjambo.”

Ngaka ogo omautho kombinga yomafikilondjambo, oondjambo dhiikulya, oondjambo dhiikunuwa nomakwatathanondjambo ngoka mu na okuyambela Omuwa miituthi yeni. Koondjambo ndhika otaku gwedhwa oondjambo dhomauvaneko noondjambo ndhoka tadhi yambwa pahalo lyomuntu mwene.
Moses okwa lombwele Aaisraeli ayihe mbyoka Omuwa e mu lombwele.
30: Moses okwa lombwele aawiliki yomazimo gaIsrael e ta ti: “Omuwa okwa gandja omautho ngaka:
Ngele ope na omuntu tu uvanekele Omuwa sha nenge ta gana kutya oti idhilike sha, ina yona tuu euvaneko lye, ihe na gwanithe shoka a popi.
“Ngele oku na omukiintu omugundjuka e li maandjahe e tu uvanekele Omuwa sha nenge ta gana kutya oti idhilike sha,
na gwanithe shoka u uvaneke nenge a gana, he ngele ite mu indike, sho e shi uvu.
Ihe he ngele te mu indike okugwanitha egano, sho e li uvu, nena ita pumbwa oku li gwanitha. Omuwa ote mu dhimine po, oshoka he okwe mu indike.
“Ngele omukiintu ngoka u uvaneke sha nenge a popi shoka tashi mu manga, ta ka hokanwa,
nena na gwanithe shoka u uvaneke nenge a ganene, ngele omulume ite shi indike, sho e shi uvu.
Ihe omulume ngele ote mu indike okugwanitha euvaneko lye, sho e li uvu, nena ita pumbwa we oku li gwanitha. Omuwa ote mu kuthile po.
“Omuselekadhi nenge omukiintu a hengwa na gwanithe euvaneko lye kehe e li uvanekele Omuwa.
“Omuhokanwa ngele ta gana nenge tu uvaneke okwiidhilika sha,
na gwanithe shoka a ganene nenge u uvaneke, ngele omulume ite shi indike, sho e shi uvu.
Ihe ngele omulume te mu indike okugwanitha egano, sho e li uvu, ita pumbwa oku li gwanitha. Omuwa ote mu dhimine po, oshoka omulume okwe mu indike.
Omulume oku na uuthemba okukoleka nenge okudhima po egano nenge euvaneko kehe ndyoka omukadhi a gana nenge u uvaneka.
Ihe ngele omulume ine mu indika, uuna u uvu egano nenge euvaneko ndyoka, nena na gwanithe shoka a gana nenge u uvaneka. Okwa koleke egano nenge euvaneko, sho inee li tinda, uuna e li uvu.
Ihe ngele ota dhimi po egano nenge euvaneko konima, nena ota humbata ondjo yomukadhi.”
Ngaka ogo omautho ngoka Omuwa e ga pe Moses kombinga yomauvaneko gu uvanekelwa Omuwa komukiintu e li maandjahe nenge komuhokanwa.
31: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Geelela Aamidiana shoka ya ningile Aaisraeli. Shampa we shi ningi, oto ka mana oondjenda.”
Moses okwa lombwele oshigwana a ti: “Ilongekidhileni iita, opo mu ponokele Aamidiana mu ya geelele shoka ya ningile Omuwa.
Mezimo kehe lyaIsrael namu ze aalumentu eyuvi ya ye kiita.”
Aalumentu eyuvi oya hogololwa mezimo kehe, aalumentu ayehe kumwe omayuvi omulongo nagaali yi ilongekidhila olugodhi.
Moses okwe ya tumu kiita mewiliko lyomuyambi Pinehas yaEleasar, ngoka ta tonatele iinima iiyapuki nomankuma gokukuga onkugo.
Oya ponokele Midian, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses e taa dhipaga aalumentu ayehe,
mwa kwatelelwa aakwaniilwa yatano yaMidian: Evi, Rekem, Sur, Hur naReba. Oya dhipaga wo Bileam yaBeor.
Aaisraeli oya kwata po aakiintu naanona Aamidiana, oya kutha po oongombe, oonzi niikombo yawo e taa yugu po uuyamba wawo auhe.
Oya fike po iilando nomagumbo gawo.
Oya kutha po iihakanwa ayihe mbyoka ye yi hakana, mwa kwatelelwa oonkwatwa niimuna,
e taye yi eta kuMoses naEleasar nokegongalo lyAaisraeli, mboka ya li moontanda momalundu gaMoab puJordan ontega naJeriko.
Moses, Eleasar naawiliki ayehe yegongalo oya piti mo moontanda, ya ka tsakaneke iita.
Moses okwa geele aawiliki yiita, aakuluntu yeyuvi naakuluntu yethele mboka ya galuka kiita.
Okwe ya pula a ti: “Omolwashike mwe etha aakiintu ayehe ya kale nomwenyo?
Dhimbulukweni kutya aakiintu mbaka oyo mboka ya landula ondunge yaBileam puPeor noya pukitha oshigwana shi iteke Omuwa. Oyo tuu mboka ye etithile elega moshigwana shOmuwa.
Dhipagii po uumati auhe naakiintu ayehe ya lalwa nayo,
ihe ihupithileni aakadhonalela ayehe.
Ngashingeyi amuhe mboka mwa ningi oontoni nenge mwa guma omidhimba, otamu kala pondje yoontanda omasiku gaheyali. Mesiku etitatu nometiheyali otamu iyelitha ne yene noonkwatwa dheni.
Yelitheni wo onguwo kehe yoshipa, iinima ayihe yomafufu giikombo nenge yiiti.”
Omuyambi Eleasar okwa lombwele aantu mboka ya galuka kiita a ti: “Omautho ngaka Omuwa okwe ga pe Moses:
oshingoli, oshisiliveli, oshikushu, osheela oshiluudhe, otina, oshumbu

noshinima kehe tashi vulu okupita momulilo, shi pititheni momulilo, notashi kala oshiyelele; ihe nonando ongeyi, nashi yogwe tuu momeya. Ihe ayihe mbyoka itaayi vulu okupita momulilo, nayi pite tuu momeya.
Mesiku etiheyali yogeni oonguwo dheni; nena otamu kala mwa yogoka notamu pitikilwa okuya moontanda.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses ta ti:
“One naEleasar naawiliki yalwe yegongalo omu na okuyalula shaa shoka sha kwatwa miita, oonkwatwa niimuna.
Topola, shoka sha hakanwa miitopolwa iyali yi thike pamwe, oshitopolwa shimwe oshaakwiita noshikwawo oshegongalo.
Moshitopolelwa shaakwiita kutha mo oshitimathelegatano shimwe shoonkwatwa, shoongombe, shuusino, shoonzi noshiikombo shi ninge oompale kOmuwa.
Dhi pa omuyambi Eleasar, dhi ninge omagano gOmuwa.
Moshitopolelwa shegongalo kutha mo oshitimilongontano shimwe shoonkwatwa, shoongombe, shuusino, shoonzi noshiikombo. Yi pa Aalevi mboka ye li mesiloshimpwiyu lyetsalihangano.”
Moses neEleasar oya ningi, ngaashi Omuwa a ti.
Oshihakanwa, iihupe yeliko mbyoka aakwiita ye yi kwata po, oyo oonzi niikombo 675 000,
oongombe 72 000,
uusino 61 000
naantu mboka yomaakiintu inaa lala naalumentu ayehe kumwe 32 000.
Etata lyasho, oshitopolelwa shaamboka ya yile kiita, osho oonzi niikombo 337 500,
moka mwa zi oompale dhOmuwa, iimuna 675;
oongombe 36 000 mwaandhoka 72 odho oompale;
uusino 30 500, moka mwa zi oompale 61;
naantu 16 000, moka mwa zi oompale kOmuwa 32.
Moses okwa gandja oompale komuyambi Eleasar, omagano ngoka gu uthilwa Omuwa, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Oshitopolelwa shegongalo lyaIsrael shoka Moses a yoolola moshitopolelwa shaakwiita,
etata lyoshihakanwa ashihe, osho oonzi niikombo 337 000,
oongombe 36 000,
uusino 30 500
naantu 16 000.
Metata ndika lyegongalo Moses okwa kutha mo oshitimilongontano shimwe shoonkwatwa noshiimuna, ngaashi Omuwa a popi, e te yi pe Aalevi mboka ye li mesiloshimpwiyu lyetsalihangano.
Aawiliki yiita oya yi kuMoses
e taa ti: “Tatekulu, otwa yalula aakwiita mewiliko lyetu noinatu kanitha nando ogumwe.

Omolwashoka otatu eta uulenga woshingoli, uugondo wokomaako nowopiikesho, uulinga, uutenda womomakutsi nuulyenge womothingo mbyoka twa yugu ko. Otatu yi yambele Omuwa, tu popile oomwenyo dhetu koshipala shOmuwa, opo e tu gamene.”
Moses naEleasar oya taamba oshingoli nuulenga auhe.
Oshingoli ashihe shoka aawiliki yiita ye shi gandja omagano kOmuwa, osha li oosekeli 16 750.
Aakwiita yowala oyi ipungulile iihakanwa yawo, inaa gandja sha.
Moses naEleasar oya tula oshingoli metsalihangano, opo Omuwa a gamene Israel.
32: Omazimo gaReuben naGad oga li ge na iigunda iinene yiimuna. Ano sho ya mono kutya oshilongo Jaser naGilead osho opalela iimuna,
oya yi kuMoses, Eleasar nokaawiliki yalwe yegongalo e taa ti:
“Atarot, Dibon, Jaser, Nimra, Heshbon, Elale, Sibma, Nebo naBehon,
evi ndika Omuwa e li kwatele Aaisraeli ye li lale, otali opalele iimuna, notse aaniimuna.
Tu kwatha u tu pe evi ndika, li ninge eliko lyetu, tse twaa taaguluke we omulonga Jordan.”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Ongiini, ooyakweni ye na okukondja, manga ne tamu kala mpano?
Otamu kumike ngiini Aaisraeli ya tokole Jordan, ya ye kevi ndyoka Omuwa e li ya pe?
Osho naanaa sha ningilwe kooho, sho nde ya tumine muKadesh Barnea, ya ka ndaadhe evi.
Oya yile sigo okesilu Eshkol e taa tala evi, ihe sho ya galuka, oya tyololokitha oshigwana shi ye kevi ndyoka Omuwa e li ya pe.
Omuwa okwa li a geya esiku ndyoka e tu uvaneke nokugana ta ti:
‘Oshoka inaa inekela ndje, kape na gumwe gwomaalumentu mboka yomimvo omilongo mbali nenge ye vule po ya tembuka muEgipiti ta yi mevi ndyoka ndu uvanekele Abraham, Isak naJakob.
Kaleb kaJefunne Omukenasi naJosua yaNun oyo ayeke mboka taa yi mo, oshoka oyi inekele Omuwa.’
Omuwa okwa geele oshigwana e te shi endagulitha nombuga omimvo omilongo ne, sigo epipi ndyoka alihe lya pu po okusa.
Ihe ngashingeyi ne otamu yi ishewe pehala lyooho, ne omahe gaayoni, otamu tukula ondjahi yOmuwa a geele Israel ishewe!
Ngele ne Aareuben nAagad tamu tindi oku mu landula ngashingeyi, nena ote ethele oshigwana ashihe mombuga, none tamu pulwa ekano lyasho.”
Oya hedha kuMoses e taa ti: “Tu zimina owala, tu dhikile iimuna yetu iigunda mpaka nokutungila aakiintu naana yetu iilando.
Opo ihe otatu homata e tatu kwatele Aaisraeli ooyakwetu komeho molugodhi, sigo twe ya thikitha komathikilo gawo. Ihe aakiintu naana yetu ya kale mpaka miilandohote ya gamenwa kaantu yaamuka.
Itatu galukile komagumbo getu, manga Aaisraeli ooyakwetu ayehe inaa taamba omaliko gawo gevi ndyoka ye na oku ga pewa.
Tse itatu ka taamba nando oshitopolwa mokati kawo handiyaka yaJordan, oshoka otwa taamba ombinga yetu mpaka kuuzilo waJordan.”
Moses okwa yamukula a ti: “Ngele otamu ningi, ngaashi tamu ti, ilongekidhileni olugodhi mpaka koshipala shOmuwa.
Aakwiita yeni naa tokole Jordan, opo mewiliko lyOmuwa ya ponokele aatondi yetu, sigo Omuwa e ya sindi

e taa kwata po evi. Konima yaambika otamu vulu okugaluka, oshoka omwa gwanitha oshinakugwanithwa sheni kOmuwa nokAaisraeli ooyakweni. Nena Omuwa ota ka zimina kutya evi ndika lyokuuzilo waJordan olyeni.
Ihe ngele itamu dhiginine euvaneko lyeni, otamu yono kOmuwa notamu ke shi mona.
Onkee ano tungeni iilando yeni niigunda yiimuna yeni, ihe gwanitheni euvaneko lyeni!”
Aagad nAareuben oya ti: “Tatekulu, otatu ningi, ngaashika wa ti.
Aakiintu naana yetu otaa kala muka miilando yaGilead, osho wo oongombe noonzi dhetu.
Ihe tse atuhe otatu yi kolugodhi mewiliko lyOmuwa. Otatu tokola Jordan tu ka kondje, ngaashika wa ti.”
Moses okwa gandja elaka komuyambi Eleasar, Josua nokaawiliki yalwe yaIsrael tali ti:
“Aagad nAareuben ngele otaa tokola Jordan yi ilongekidhila olugodhi mewiliko lyOmuwa, nokekwatho lyawo ngele otamu vulu okulala evi, nena ya peni evi lyaGilead li ninge eliko lyawo.
Ihe ngele itaa tokola Jordan noitaa yi molugodhi pamwe nane, nena oye na okutaamba oshitopolwa shawo muKaanan ngaashika ne.”
Aagad nAareuben oya yamukula ya ti: “Tatekulu, tse otatu ningi, ngaashika Omuwa a ti.
Mewiliko lye otatu tokola Jordan tu ye kuKaanan kolugodhi, opo tu pewe eliko lyetu mpaka kuuzilo waJordan.”
Moses okwa gandja komazimo gaGad naReuben netatazimo lyaManasse oshilongo ashihe shomukwaniilwa gwAayamori Sihon noshomukwaniilwa gwaBaasha Og, pamwe niilando yasho nomikunda dhe yi kunduka.
Ezimo lyaGad olya tungulula iilandohote Dibon, Atarot, Aroer,
Atarot Shofan, Jaser, Jogbeha,
Bet Nimra naBet Haran.
Ezimo lyaReuben olya tungulula Heshbon, Elale, Kirjatajim,
osho wo Nebo, Baal Meon (omadhina gayo oga lundululwa) naSibma. Oya luku iilando ye yi tungulula omadhina omape.
Oludhi lwaMakir gaManasse olwa matukile evi lyaGilead e talu li sindi. Olwa tidha mo Aayamori mboka ya li mo.
Moses okwa gandja Gilead koludhi lwaMakir, nolwa kala mo.
Jair gwomezimo lyaManasse okwa ponokele omikunda dhimwe nokwe dhi sindi e te dhi luku “Omikunda dhaJair.”
Nobak okwa matukile e ta lala Kenat nomikunda dhasho e te shi lukulula Nobak, e shi ilukile mwene.
33: Ndjika ondjila yAaisraeli sho ya tembuka muEgipiti oongundu noongundu mewiliko lyaMoses naAaron.
Moses okwa nyola omadhina gomahala mpoka ya yungu oontanda palombwelo lyOmuwa.
Aaisraeli oya thigi po Egipiti etimulongo netitano lyomwedhi gwotango gwomumvo, esiku lya landula Opaasa. Oya thigi po oshilando Rameses megameno lyOmuwa montaneho yAayegipiti,
manga taa fumvike aatango mboka ya dhipagwa kOmuwa. Omuwa okwi iholola mpaka kutya oye omunankondoawike e vule ookalunga yaEgipiti.
Aaisraeli oya zi muRameses e taa yungu oontanda muSukkot.
Okuza mpoka oya ka yunga oontanda muEtam kooha dhombuga.
Okuza kuEtam oya shuna kuPi Hahirot kuuzilo waBaal Zefon noya yungu oontanda popepi naMigdol.
Oya zi puPi Hahirot e taa tokola Efuta etiligane e taa yi mombuga Etam. Sho ye ende omasiku gatatu, oye ya kuMara noya yungu oontanda.
Okuza kuMara oya yi kuElim noya yungile ko oontanda dhawo, oshoka nkoka okwa li omithima omulongo nambali dhi na omeya, nomilunga omilongo heyali.
Oya zi po puElim e taa ka yunga oontanda mooha dhEkololo lyaSues.
Oya zi pEfuta lyomanenge noya ka yunga oontanda mombuga Sin.
Oya zi mombuga Sin e taa ka yunga oontanda kuDofka.
Oya zi kuDofka noya ka yunga oontanda muAlush.
Oya zi kuAlush noya ka yunga oontanda muRefidim, nkoka ya li yaa na omeya gokunwa.

Okuza kuRefidim sigo okondundu Hor oya yungu oontanda pomahala taga landula: ombuga Sinai, Kibrot Taava (nenge “Oombila dhomwamwa”), Hazerot, Ritma, Rimmon Perez, Libna, Rissa, Kehalata, ondundu Shefer, Harada, Makkelot, Tahat, Tera, Mitka, Hashmona, Moserot, Bene Jaakan, Hor Haggidgad, Jotbata, Abrona, Eziongeber, ombuga Zin (kokutya Kadesh) nondundu Hor kooha dhoshilongo Edom.
Omuyambi Aaron okwa londo kondundu Hor, ngaashi Omuwa a popi, e ta sile ko momumvo omutimilongone okuza mpoka Aaisraeli sho ya tembuka muEgipiti; osha li momwedhi omutitano esiku lyotango lyomwedhi.
Aaron sho a sile kondundu, okwa li e na omimvo 123.
Omukwaniilwa Omukaanani gwaArad, ngoka a li muumbugantu woshilongo Kaanan, okwa kundana kutya Aaisraeli oya thiki.

Okuza kondundu Hor sigo okolushandja lwaMoab Aaisraeli oya yungile oontanda pomahala taga landula: Zalmona, Punon, Obot, Iye Abarim moshilongo Moab, Dibon-Gad, Almon Diblataim, ondundu Abarim popepi nondundu Nebo nomolushandja lwaMoab kuuzilo waJordan ontega naJeriko.
Pomulonga Jordan oontanda dhawo odha li pokati kaBet Jeshimot naAbel Shittim molushandja lwaAkasia.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses molushandja lwaMoab pomulonga Jordan ontega naJeriko e ta ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli u tye kuyo: Ngele tamu tokola Jordan mu ye kuKaanan,
tidhii mo aakwashilongo ayehe nokuteyagula po iimenka yawo ayihe ya hongwa memanya nenge ya hambulwa mosheela. Hanagulii po omitumbo dhawo adhihe dhiinonoma yuupagani.
Kwatii po oshilongo ne mu kale mo, oshoka otandi shi mu pe.
Topoleni evi pamazimo nopamaludhi geni mokuumba iihogololitho. Oludhi olunene nalu pewe oshitopolwa oshinene, noludhi olushona oshitopolwa oshishona.
Ihe ngele itamu tidha mo aakalimo yomoshilongo, mboka taa ka hupila mo, otaa ningi ya fa omakwega momeho geni noongona moombati dheni notaye mu kondjitha moshilongo.
Ngele itamu ya tidha mo, otandi ke mu hanagula, ngaashi nda dhiladhilile oku ya hanagula po.”
34: Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli to ti: ‘Ngele tamu ka ya mevi Kaanan, oshilongo shoka tandi shi mu pe, oongamba otadhi ka kala, ngaashi tashi landula mpaka:
Ongamba yokuumbugantu otayi ka taandela ya za kombuga Zin ya lambalala ongamba yaEdom. Otayi tameke muuzilo kohulo yokuumbugantu wEfuta lya sa.
Okuza ketaulilo lyondundu Akrabbim, otayi goyokele lwokuumbugantu, tayi pitilile Zin sigo okuKadesh Barnea. Okuza nkoka otayi goyokele lwokuuningininombangalantu sigo okuHazar Addar nokuAzmon.
Nkoka tayi goyokele lwokokamulonga pongamba yaEgipiti nokuhulila mEfuta lyopokati.’ ”
Ongamba yokuuninginino oyo Efuta lyopokati.
Ongamba yokuumbangalantu otayi landula ompola ya za kEfuta lyopokati sigo okondundu Hor,
nokuza hoka oyu uka ketaulilo lyaHamat. Otayi tsikile sigo okuZedad
nokuSifron notayi hulile puHazar Enan.
Ongamba yokuuzilo otayi landula ompola ya za kuHazar Enan sigo okuSafam.
Otayi tsikile yu uka kuumbugantu kuRibla, kuuzilo waAin, nokoondundu komunkulo gwokuuzilo gwefuta lyaGalilea.

Okuza nkoka ongamba otayi lambalala omulonga Jordan sigo Efuta lya sa.
Ndhika odho oongamba ne dhevi lyeni.
Moses okwa lombwele Aaisraeli a ti: “Ndika olyo evi ndyoka tamu ka taamba moku li umbila iihogololitho, evi ndyoka Omuwa e li gandja komazimo omugoyi netata.
Omazimo gaReuben naGad netatazimo lyaManasse oga taamba nale oshitendelwa shago sha topolelwa omaludhi gago,
kuuzilo waJordan ontega naJeriko.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Omuyambi Eleasar naJosua yaNun oyo taa ka tendela aantu evi.
Kutha wo mezimo kehe omuwiliki gumwe, opo e ya kwathe mokutenda evi.”

Omuwa okwa hogolola aalumentu mboka:
Ezimo
Omuwiliki
Juda
Kaleb kaJefunne
Simeon
Shemuel yaAmmihud
Benjamin
Elidad lyaKislon
Dan
Bukki yaJogli
Manasse
Hanniel yaEfod
Efraim
Kemuel kaShiftan
Sebulon
Elisafan lyaParnak
Issaskar
Paltiel yaAsan
Aser
Ahihud yaShelomi
Naftali
Pedahel yaAmmihud
Mbaka oyo aalumentu mboka Omuwa e ya pe oshilonga shokutendela Aaisraeli evi lyaKaanan.
35: Molushandja lwaMoab pomulonga Jordan ontega naJeriko Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli kutya momaliko ngoka taa pewa, naa pe mo Aalevi iilando yimwe yokukala mo nomaunapelo ge yi kunduka.
Iilando mbyoka nayi ninge yAalevi, notaa kala mo. Omaunapelo otaga ningi giimuna yawo, oongombe noonzi niinamwenyo ayihe.
Evi lyomaunapelo nali kale lya taandela okuza kedhingililokuma lyoshilando oondya 1 000 koombinga adhihe,
opo pu kale ombine yoondja 2 000 lwoondja 2 000, noshilando shi li pondingandinga yayo.

Mokati kiilando mbyoka tamu yi pe Aalevi, namu kale iilando ihamano yokwiigamena, moka omuntu ngoka a dhipaga mukwawo hanowina ta vulu okuya mo. Kakele kiilando mbika ya peni ishewe iilando yilwe omilongo ne niiyali
yi na omaunapelo gayo, opo yi ninge omilongo ne niihetatu ayihe kumwe.
Omwaalu gwiilando yAalevi mezimo kehe nagu uthwe komwaalu gwiilando moshitopolwa shalyo.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses e ta ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli u tye: Shampa mwa tokola omulonga Jordan e tamu yi mevi lyaKaanan,
ihogololeleni iilando yokwiigamena, moka omuntu ta vulu okuholama, ngele a dhipaga mukwawo hanowina.
Omo moka ta ka hupila, kaa dhipagwe kaakwawo yanakusa. Omuntu ngoka e na ondjo yedhipago, ina dhipagwa pwaa na ompangu tango.
Hogololeni iilando ihamano,
itatu okuuzilo waJordan niitatu omuKaanan.
Mbika otayi kala iilando yegameno kOmuisraeli, omukwiilongo omukaleleli nge omuyeni kehe mokati keni, ngoka a dhipaga omuntu hanowina. Ota vulu okumatukila mo a holame.
“Ngele oku na omuntu ta dhipaga mukwawo nomatati giiyela nenge nemanya nenge noshiti, oye omudhipagi gwowina; na dhipagwe.
Omukwawo nakupula ombinzi yanakudhipagwa oku na uuthemba wokudhipaga omudhipagi. Ngele te mu mono, ne mu dhipage.
“Ngele oku na omuntu ta tondo mukwawo e te mu dhipaga noku mu ndwangulila pevi nenge e mu dhaadhiga nasha,
nenge e mu thendula nongonyo, oku na ondjo yedhipago, nomuntu a tya ngaaka na dhipagwe. Omukwawo nakupula ombinzi oku na uuthemba woku mu dhipaga. Uuna te mu itsu, ne mu dhipage.
“Ihe ngele oku na omuntu ta dhipaga mukwawo hanowina ye ine mu tonda, sho e mu ndwangulile pevi nenge e mu dhaadhiga nasha,
nenge u umbu emanya ye ina lengalenga tango e ta dhipaga omuntu ngoka inaa dhiladhila nando e mu dhipage ye ke shi omutondi gwe,
egongalo nali pangule pokati kaangoka a dhipaga mukwawo nomukwawo nakupula ombinzi tali shi ningi pamautho ngaka.

Egongalo nali hupithe omudhipagi miikaha yomukwawo gwanakudhipagwa, nakupula ombinzi. Egongalo nali mu pitike, a shune koshilando shokwiigamena, nkoka a li a holama. Na kale hoka sigo okeso lyomuyambimukuluntu.
Omudhipagi ngele okwa zi moshilando shokwiigamena,
e ti itsuwa kunakupula ombinzi, ngoka te mu dhipaga, nena nakupula ombinzi ke na ondjo yasha.
Omudhipagi oku na okukala moshilando shokwiigamena sigo okeso lyomuyambimukuluntu, ihe konima yalyo ota vulu okushuna kaandjawo.
Omautho ngaka omu na oku ga dhiginina nomaluvalo geni miilongo yeni sigo aluhe.
“Omudhipagi ota vulu okumonika ondjo yeso, ngele ope na oonzapo mbali, onzapo yimwe inayi gwana okudhipagitha omudhipagi.
Omudhipagi na dhipagwe. Ita vulu okuhenuka eyono lye a fute ondjo ye.
Ngele ope na omuntu ta yi ontuku koshilando shokwiigamena, ita ziminwa a fute ye a shune, manga omuyambimukuluntu inaa sa.
Ngele tamu shi ningi, otamu nyateke evi moka mu li mo. Ombinzi yedhipago otayi nyateke evi, nokape na eyelithoyapulo lyalyo lilwe, ombinzi ayike yaangoka a dhipaga.
Inamu nyateka evi moka mwa kala mo, oshoka ongame Omuwa nonda kala mokati kAaisraeli.”
36: Aakuluntu yomagumbo moludhi lwaGilead yaMakir, omutekulu gwaManasse gaJosef, oya yi kuMoses nokaawiliki yalwe.
Oya ti: “Omuwa okwe ku lombwele, u tendele Aaisraeli evi mokuumba iihogololitho. Okwe ku lombwele wo, u gandje eliko lyomukwetu Zelofhad koyana aakadhona.
Ihe ngele taa hokanwa kaayeni, nena eliko otali yi komazimo omayeni, noshitendelwa shetu tashi ka shonopala.
Momumvo gweligolo iinima sho tayi ka shuna kooyene yonale mboka ye yi landithile po, eliko lyaana aakadhona yaZelofhad otali ka kala kezimo hoka ya hokanwa, notatu li kanitha.”
Moses okwa yamukula Aaisraeli nohapu yOmuwa a ti: “Shoka tashi pulwa kezimo lyaManasse, oshi li mondjila.
Omuwa ota ti kutya aana aakadhona yaZelofhad oya mangulukila okuhokanwa kungoka ya hala, ihe ogwomezimo lyawo.
Eliko lyOmuisraeli kehe nali kale mezimo lyahe lyaa ye kezimo ekwawo.
Omukiintu kehe ngoka ta thigulula uuthiga mezimo lyontumba lyAaisraeli, oku na okuhokanwa komulumentu gwezimo ndyoka. Pahedhi ndjika Omuisraeli kehe oha thigulula oohekulu,
nuuthiga itau zi we mezimo ndika nokuya kundiyaka. Ezimo kehe ohali dhiginine uuthiga walyo.”
Aana aakadhona yaZelofhad oya ningi, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Moses.
Mahla, Tirza, Hogla, Milka naNoa, aana aakadhona yaZelofhad oya hokanwa po koohegona.
Oya hokanwa komaludhi gezimo lyaManasse gaJosef, nuuthiga wawo owa kala mezimo lyoohe.
Mbika oyo iipango nomautho ngoka Omuwa e ga pethitha Aaisraeli kuMoses molushandja lwaMoab puJordan ontega naJeriko.

1: Membo muka omu na oohapu ndhoka Moses e dhi lombwele Aaisraeli, manga ye li mombuga kuuzilo waJordan. Oya li mesilu lyaJordan popepi naSuf, pokati komukunda Paran kombinga yimwe nomikunda Tofel, Laban, Hazerot naDi Sahab kombinga onkwawo.
(Otashi pula omasiku omulongo nalimwe okuza kuSinai nokuya kuKadesh Barnea mondjila yokoondundu dhomoshilongo Seir.)
Mesiku lyotango lyomwedhi omutimulongo nagumwe gwomumvo omutimilongone, Aaisraeli sho ya tembuka muEgipiti, Moses okwe ya hokololele ashihe shoka Omuwa e mu lombwele, e ya lombwele.
Shika osha ningwa Omuwa sho a sindi Sihon, omukwaniilwa gwAayamori, ngoka a li ta pangele moshilando Heshbon, naOg, omukwaniilwa gwaBaasha, ngoka a li ta pangele miilando Ashtarot naEdrei.

Kuuzilo waJordan moshilongo shaMoab Moses okwa tameke okufatulula oompango nomalongo gOmuwa.
Okwa ti:
“Manga twa li puSinai, Omuwa Kalunga ketu okwe tu lombwele ta ti: ‘Ethimbo ndyoka mwa kala pondundu ndjika, olya gwana.

Dhilukitheni po oontanda mu hume ko. Indeni koshilongo shokoondundu shAayamori nokomahala agehe ge shi kunduka — sigo esilu lyaJordan, koshilongo shokoondundu, kiikulundundu yoponyonga yadho, koshitopolwa shokuumbugantu nokomunkulofuta. Indeni kevi lyAakaanana nokombanda yoondundu dhaLibanon sigololo omulonga omunene Eufrat.
Ayihe mbika oyo evi ndyoka ngame Omuwa ndu uvaneke ndi li pe oohokulu Abraham, Isak naJakob nomaluvalo gawo. Indeni mu ke li lale.’ ”
Moses okwa lombwele aantu a ti: “Manga twa lyeni pondundu Sinai, onde mu lombwele nda tile: ‘Oshimpwiyu shoku mu wilika otashi hepeke ndje unene. Itandi vulu oku shi ihumbatela ongame awike.
Omuwa Kalunga keni okwe mu indjipaleke mu thike poonyothi dhokegulu.
Omuwa Kalunga koohokulu ne mu indjipaleke neyuvi ye e mu laleke nuuyamba, ngaashi u uvaneka!
Ihe otandi vulu ngiini ongame awike okuhumbata omutenge gwokuloteka oontamanana dheni?
Hogololeni aalumentu aanawino, aanandunge naasimani mezimo kehe, notandi ya langeke moku mu tonatela!
Omwa zimina kutya shika osho opala.

Onkee nda kutha aawiliki aanawino naasimani mboka mwa hogolola momazimo geni, nonde ya langeke ye mu tonatele. Yamwe oya ningi aatonateli yaantu eyuvi, yamwe oyethele, yamwe oyomilongo ntano nayamwe oyomulongo. Onda langeke ishewe aakuluntu yalwe momazimo agehe.’

“Pethimbo ndyoka onda londodha aatokolihapu yeni nda ti: ‘Pulakeneni nawa iihokolola mbyoka tayi tukuka maakweni. Iihokolola ayihe yi panguleni pauyuuki, nonando nayi kale yaakweni yomekota nenge yaakwiilongo mboka ya kala mokati keni.

Momatokolo geni inamu kala nando ondhipi; ayehe ya tokoleni pamuthika gumwe, nando naa kale oyo oolye yalye. Inamu tila nando olye, oshoka omatokolo ngoka tamu tokola, oga za kuKalunga. Ngele ope na shoka tashi mu nyenge, shi eteni kungame, notandi ke shi utha.’
Pethimbo tuu ndyoka onde mu lombwelele ashihe shoka mu na oku shi ninga.”

“Otwa gwanitha shoka Omuwa Kalunga ketu e tu lombwele. Otwa thigi po ondundu Sinai e tatu ka taaguluka ombuga ndjoka onene nontilithi mondjila yetu okuya koshilongo shokoondundu shAayamori. Sho twa thiki muKadesh Barnea,

onda tile: ‘Otamu yi koshilongo shokoondundu shAayamori, shoka Omuwa Kalunga ketu, Kalunga kootatekulu te shi tu pe. Taleni, osho shiyaka. Indeni mu ke shi lale, ngaashi a tile. Inamu tenguka nenge mu kukuke kuumbanda.’
“Ihe ne omwe ya kungame tamu ti: ‘Tumii ko aalumentu, ya ka ndaadhe evi, opo ye ye ye tu lombwele kutya natu ende ondjila yini niilando mbyoka yi li ko oya tya ngiini.’
“Osha li sho opala okuningwa, onkee nda hogololele aalumentu omulongo nayaali, gumwe mezimo kehe.
Oya yi moshilongo shokoondundu sigololo esilu Eshkol e taye li konakona.
Sho ya galuka, oye tu etele iiyimati mbyoka ya adhele ko, noya hokolola kutya evi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga ketu te li tu pe, ewanawa noonkondo.
“Ihe ne omwa tsu ondumbo noshipango shOmuwa Kalunga keni, noinamu ya we mevi ndyoka.
Ne omwa ngungutulilathana mwa ti: ‘Omuwa oku tu tonde. Okwe tu tembudha muEgipiti, opo e tu gandje miikaha yAayamori mbaka, opo ya wape ye tu dhipage.

Otatu yile ko we shike? Tse otwa tila ko. Aantu mboka twe ya tumine ko, oye tu hokololele kutya aantu yaahoka oya kola naaleeleka ye tu vule, noya kala miilando yi na omakuma ga tsa kegulu. Oya mwene ko nokuli aalefule!’
“Ihe ngame onda tile: ‘Inamu tila aantu mboka.
Omuwa Kalunga keni ote mu enditha, noye te ke mu kondjela, naanaa ngaashi mwe shi mono muEgipiti
nomombuga. Omwa mono, nkene e mu enditha nawa ondjila ayihe sigo okehala ndika, ngaashi yina ta kwiinine omwana omumati.’
Ihe nando ongeyi, ne inamu inekela Omuwa Kalunga keni,
ngoka e mu kwatele komeho, mu mone eha mpoka tamu yungu oontanda. Okwe mu ulukile ondjila te mu tetekelele moshikogo shomulilo uusiku noshomuzile omutenya.”
“Omuwa oku uvu omangungutulo geni e ta geye e ta gana ta ti:
‘Kape na nando omuntu gumwe gwomoluvalo nduka oluwinayi ta ka thika mevi ndyoka ewanawa ndu uvaneke oku li pa oohokulu.
Kaleb kaJefunne oye awike ta ka ya mo. Okwa li i inekela ndje. Otandi mu pe noluvalo lwe evi ndyoka e ke li ndaadhele.’
Molweni Omuwa okwa geele ndje e ta ti: ‘Nangoye wo ito ka thika mo mevi ndyoka.
Ihe koleka eutho lyomukwathi gwoye, Josua yaNun. Oye ta ka wilika Israel okulala oshilongo.’

“Omuwa okwe tu lombwele aluhe ta ti: ‘Aana yeni mboka aashona nokaye shi manga okuyoolola uuwanawa muuwinayi, oyo taa ka thika mo mevi ndyoka, nando omwa ti, otaa ka kwatwa po kaatondi yeni. Otandi ke ya pa oshilongo, notaye ke shi lala.
Ihe ne shuneni mu ye kombuga mondjila yu uka kEkololo lyaAkaba.’

“Omwa yamukulile mwa ti: ‘Moses, tse otwa yono kOmuwa. Ihe ngashingeyi tse otatu ka homona, naanaa ngaashi Omuwa Kalunga ketu e tu lombwele.’ Noshaa ngoka gwomune okwa li i ilongekidhila olugodhi nota dhiladhila kutya oshipu okutondokela moshilongo shokoondundu.
“Ihe Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: ‘Ya londodha yaa homone, oshoka itandi kala pamwe nayo, naatondi yawo otaye ya sindi.’
Onde mu hokololele shoka Omuwa a ti, ihe ne inamu pupa ko. Omwa tsu ondumbo naye, nomuuntsa weni omwa matukile oshilongo shokoondundu.
Nena Aayamori mboka ya li moondundu, oye ya ye mu kondjithe ya fa ehunga lyoonyushi. Oye mu tidha sigo oHorma e taye mu dhengele moshilongo shokoondundu dhaEdom.
One nomwa kugile Omuwa onkugo, ihe okwi ipwililike ye ine mu pulakena.”
“Ano sho twa kala muKadesh ethimbo ele,
2: Ohugunina otwa shuna e tatu yi mombuga twa lambalala ondjila yokEkololo lyaAkaba, ngaashi Omuwa a popi, notwa kala tatu endagula noshilongo shokoondundu dhaEdom.
“Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti:
‘Omwa kala unene tamu endagula noondundu ndhika; ukeni ihe kuumbangalantu.
Lombwela aantu to ti: Otamu taakana oshilongo shokoondundu dhaEdom, oshilongo shaakweni, oluvalo lwaEsau. Otaa ke mu tila,
ihe inamu ya hingila iita, oshoka itandi ke mu pa nando okapambu kevi lyawo ke thike pepandja lyompadhi. Edom onde li pa oluvalo lwaEsau.
Futeni niimaliwa iikulya nomeya ngoka tamu landa kuyo.’

“Dhimbulukweni, nkene Omuwa e mu yambeke mwaayihe mwe yi longo. Okwe mu sile oshimpwiyu, sho mwa li tamu endagula nombuga ndjika onene. Okwa kala pamwe nane omimvo adhihe omilongo ne, nomwa kala mu na ayihe mwe yi pumbwa.
“Otwa humu ko notwe etha ondjila ndjoka ya za kiilando Elat naEziongeber yu uka kEfuta lya sa notwa pungulukile lwokuuzilombangalantu lwokuMoab.
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: ‘Ino piyaganeka Aamoabi, oluvalo lwaLot nenge u ya hingile iita. Onde ya pe oshilando Ar, noitandi mu pe nando oshitopolwa mevi lyawo.’ ”
(Nale muAr omwa li mwa kala Aaemimi, oshigwana oshinene shaalefule naanankondo ngaashi Aayanaki.
Pamwe nAayanaki oya li yomoludhi lwAarafa, ihe Aamoabi oye ya luku Aaemimi.
MuEdom nale omwa li Aahori, ihe oluvalo lwaEsau olwe ya tidha mo nokuhanagula po oshigwana shawo e talu tula mo, naanaa ngaashi Aaisraeli ya tidha mo aatondi yawo mevi ndyoka Omuwa e li ya pe.)
“Otwa taaguluka omulonga Sered, ngaashi Omuwa e tu lombwele tu shi ninge.
Omumvo nguka omutimilongondatu nahetatu, sho twa zi muKadesh Barnea. Aakwiita ayehe yepipi ndyoka oya sa po, ngaashi Omuwa a tile, otaa ka sa po.
Oshikaha shOmuwa oshe ya dhenge, sigo e ya yonagula po ayehe.
“Ayehe sho ya si po,
Omuwa okwe tu lombwele a ti:
‘Nena otamu ka taakana oshilongo Moab tamu piti muAr.
Otamu ka ya popepi nevi lyAayammoni, oluvalo lwaLot. Inamu ya piyaganeka tuu nenge mu ya hingile iita, oshoka itandi ke mu pa nando oshitopolwa shevi lyawo ndyoka nde ya pele.’ ”
(Noshilongo shika wo osha li nale shAarafa, ihe Aayammoni oye ya luku Aasamsumi.
Oya li aaleeleka ya fa Aayanaki. Oya li mo oyendji naanankondo. Ihe Omuwa okwe ya hanagula po, nAayammoni oya kutha po evi lyawo noya tula mo.
Osho Omuwa a ningi wo omolwoluvalo lwaEsau, ndoka lu li koshilongo shokoondundu dhaEdom, sho a hanagula po Aahori. Oya tidha mo Aaedom mevi lyawo noye li lala nomo ye li natango.
Evi lya kunkula nEfuta lyopokati olya kwatwa po kaantu yokontuntu Kreta. Oya hanagula po Aayavvim, aakalimo yamo aakulu, e taa kutha po evi lyawo sigololo okoshilando Gaza kuumbugantu.)

“Sho twa taakana Moab, Omuwa okwe tu lombwele ta ti: ‘Thikameni mu tokole omulonga Arnori. Otandi gandja miikaha yoye omukwaniilwa gwAayammon Sihon, ngoka a kala muHeshbon, pamwe noshilongo she. Mu ponokela u lale oshilongo she.
Okuza konena otandi ku ningi omutilithi gwuuyuni auhe. Shaa ngoka ota ka kakama kuumbanda, shaa te ku uvu to popiwa.’ ”
“Onda tumu aatumwa okuza mombuga Kedemot, ya ye komukwaniilwa gwaHeshbon edhina lye Sihon ye na elaka lyombili tali ti:
‘Tu pitika tu taakane oshilongo shoye. Otatu ende tu ukilila; itatu zi mondjila tu uka kolulyo nenge kolumoho.
Otatu landa iikulya nomeya gokunwa. Otwa hala ashike tu pite moshilongo shoye,
sigo twa tokola omulonga Jordan tu ye kevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga ketu te li tu pe. Oluvalo lwaEsau, ndoka lu li muEdom, nAamoabi, mboka ye li muAr, oye tu zimine tu taakane miilongo yawo.’

“Ihe omukwaniilwa gwaHeshbon Sihon ine tu pitika, tu tokole oshilongo she. Omuwa Kalunga keni okwe mu ningi omutangalali nomunandumbo, opo tu mu dhenge nokukutha po oshilongo she, shoka twe shi lala wo tuu shili.
“Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: ‘Tala ko, onda tyololokitha omukwaniilwa Sihon noshilongo she; ponokela evi lye, opo u li lale.’
Sihon okwe ya naakwiita ye ayehe, e tu kondjithe popepi naJahas,
ihe Omuwa Kalunga ketu okwe mu gandja miikaha yetu, e tatu mu dhipaga pamwe noyana naantu ye ayehe.
Pethimbo tuu ndyoka otwa kwata po nokuhanagula po oshilando kehe notwa dhipaga aalumentu, aakiintu naanona. Inatu hupitha nando ogumwe e na omwenyo.
Otwa kutha po iimuna notwa yugu iilando.

Omuwa Kalunga ketu okwe tu kwatitha po omikunda adhihe okuza kuAroer kooha dhesilu lyaArnon noshilando pokati kesilu, ondjila ayihe sigo oGilead. Kakwa li ku na oshilando shi na omakuma ge tu nyenge ando.
Ihe inatu ya nando popepi noshilongo shAayammoni nenge komunkulo gwomulonga Jabbok nenge kiilando yokoshilongo shokoondundu nenge ehala lilwe nkoka Omuwa Kalunga ketu inee tu lombwela tu ye ko.”
3: “Nosho twa hedha kuumbangalantu twa taalela oshilongo Baasha, omukwaniilwa Og okwe ya naakwiita ye ayehe, e tu kondjithe popepi noshilando Edrei.
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: ‘Ino tila, otandi mu gandja naantu ye noshilongo she ashihe miikaha yoye. Mu ninga ngaashi wa ningi Sihon, omukwaniilwa gwAayamori ngoka a kala muHeshbon.’
“Omuwa okwa gandja Og naantu ye miikaha yetu, e tatu ya dhipaga po ayehe.

Pethimbo tuu ndyoka otwa kwata po iilando ye ayihe. Kakwa li nando oshimwe inaatu shi kwata po. Ayihe kumwe oya li iilando omilongo hamano — oshikandjo ashihe shaArgob, moka omukwaniilwa Og gwaBashan a li ta pangele.
Iilando ayihe mbika oya li ya tungwa nomakuma omale, nomiyelo nomalukambo goku dhi patitha; okwa li wo omikunda dhaa na omankolokuma.
Iilando ayihe otwe yi hanagula po notwa dhipaga aalumentu ayehe naakiintu naanona, naanaa ngaashi twe shi ningile Sihon, omukwaniilwa gwaHeshbon.
Otwa kutha po iimuna notwa yugu iilando.
“Pethimbo tuu mpoka otwa yugu aakwaniilwa mbeyaka yaali yAayamori evi lyokuuzilo waJordan, okuza komulonga Arnon sigo okondundu Hermon.
(Ondundu Hermon oya lukwa kAasidoni Sirjon nokAayamori Senir.)
Otwa lala oshilongo ashihe shaOg, omukwaniilwa gwaBaasha: iilando yoketumbalalovi, Gilead alihe naBashan alihe sigo okiilando Salka naEdrei kuuzilo.”

(Omukwaniilwa gwaBaasha Og oye a li Omurafe omuhugunini mokudhipagwa. Oshiketha she shomudhimba sha hongwa memanya osha li shuule woometa omugoyi noshomutamo gwoometa ne. Otashi monika moshilando shAayammoni Rabba.)
“Sho twa lala oshilongo, onda pe omazimo gaRuben naGad oshilongo shokuumbangalantu woshilando Aroer popepi nomulonga Arnon noshitopolwa shoshilongo shokoondundu dhaGilead nomikunda dhasho.

Etatazimo lyaManasse onde li pe oshihupe shaGilead naBaasha alihe, moka Og a li ta pangele, kokutya oshitopolwa ashihe shaArgob.”
(Bashan osha li oshilongo shAarafa.
Jair gwomezimo lyaManasse okwa kutha po oshitopolwa ashihe shaArgob, kokutya Baasha, sigo ongamba yaGeshur naMaaka. Omikunda okwe dhi ilukile, nohadhi ithanwa omikunda dhaJair.)
“Gilead onde li gandja koludhi lwaMakir gwomezimo lyaManasse.

Omazimo gaRuben naGad onde ga pe oshitopolwa shaGilead sigo omulonga Arnon. Ongamba yokuumbugantu oya li pokati komulonga, nongamba yawo yokuumbangalantu oya li omulonga Jabbok, ngoka oshitopolwa shimwe shagwo sha li ongamba yAayammoni.
Kuuninginino oshitopolwa shawo osha taandela sigo omulonga Jordan, okuza kefuta lyaGalilea kuumbangalantu sigo okEfuta lyeso kuumbugantu noponyonga yondundu Pisga kuuzilo.

“Pethimbo tuu ndyoka onde ya pe omakumagidho taga ti: ‘Omuwa Kalunga ketu okwe mu pe evi ndika kuuzilo waJordan, mu li lale. Ngashingeyi ihomatekeni, ne aalumentu amuhe mboka tamu vulu okukondja, mu kwatele Aaisraeli ooyakweni komeho, mu tokole Jordan noku ya kwathela okulala evi lyawo.
Aakulukadhi yeni ayehe, aana yeni niimuna yeni — ondi shi shi kutya omu na iimuna oyindji — otayi kala po miilando nde yi mu pe.

Kwatheni Aaisraeli ooyakweni, sigo ya lala evi ndyoka Omuwa te li ya pe kuuninginino waJordan, sigo Omuwa te ya pe evululuko, ngaashi e mu ningile mpaka. Konima otamu ka galuka, mu ye kevi lyeni ndika nde li mu pe.’
“Onda lombwele Josua nda ti: ‘Owa mono ayihe mbyoka Omuwa Kalunga keni e yi ningile aakwaniilwa mbeyaka yaali, Sihon naOg. Osho ta ka ningila ayehe mboka tamu ka matukila evi lyawo.
Inamu ya tila, oshoka Omuwa Kalunga keni ote mu kondjele.’ ”
“Pethimbo ndyoka onda galikana nda mana mo e tandi ti:

‘Omuwa Omupangeliawike, ondi shi shi kutya owu ulukile ndje etameko lyiinima iinene niikumithi mbyoka to ka ninga. Kape na kalunga megulu nenge kombanda yevi ta vulu okulonga iilongankondo mbyoka wa longo!
Taagulukitha ndje Jordan, ndi ka mone evi ndyoka lyo opala handiyaka, oshilongo sho opala shokoondundu noondundu dhaLibanon.’
“Ihe Omuwa okwa geele ndje molweni noina hala okupulakena ndje. Okwa ti owala: ‘Opuwo tuu ngaaka! Mwena nokuli, ino popya we nangame!
Londa kondungu yondundu Pisga e to tala lwokuumbangalantu nolwokuumbugantu, kuuzilo nokuuninginino. Lengalenga u tale nawa shoka to mono, oshoka ito ka taaguluka Jordan nando okuli.
Nongeka Josua. Mu tsa omukumo noku mu koleka, oshoka oye ta ka wilika oshigwana shi tokole Jordan, opo shi ka lale evi ndyoka to li tala.’
“Otwa kala mesilu lya taalelathana noshilando Betpeor.”
4: “Aaisraeli, vulikeni koompango adhihe tandi dhi mu nongeke, opo mu kale mu na omwenyo nomu ka lale evi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koohokulu te li mu pe.
Inamu gwedha ko sha koohapu ndhoka tandi dhi mu lombwele, ne inamu kutha mo sha. Vulikeni kiipango yOmuwa Kalunga keni mbyoka nde yi mu pe.
Omwa mono ne yene shoka Omuwa a ningi pondundu Peor. Okwa yono po ayehe mboka ya longele Baal, oshikalunga shaPeor.
Ihe ne amuhe mboka mwa dhiginine okwiinekela Omuwa Kalunga keni, omu na omwenyo sigo ongashingeyi.
“Onde mu nongeke oompango adhihe, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele ndje ndi shi ninge. Vulikeni kudho mevi ndyoka tamu ka kwata po.

Vulikeni kudho ne mu dhi dhiginine, notashi ulukile iigwana yilwe kutya ne aanandunge. Shampa taa kundana oompango adhihe ndhika, otaa ka tya: ‘Oshigwana shika oshi na uunongo noondunge dhi thike peni!’
“Kaku na oshigwana shilwe shi na kalunga kasho e li popepi nasho, ngaashika Omuwa Kalunga ketu e li natse. Ote tu yamukula, sho tatu mu kugile ekwatho.
Kaku na oshigwana shilwe shi na oompango dhuuyuuki dha fa ndhoka nde dhi mu nongeke nena.
Kotokeni! Ndhindhilikeni, ne mwaa dhimbwe ayihe mbyoka mwe yi mono nomeho geni yene, manga mu na omwenyo. Hokololeleni aana yeni naatekulu yeni

esiku ndyoka mwa thikama koshipala shOmuwa Kalunga keni pondundu Sinai, sho a lombwele ndje a ti: ‘Gongaleka oshigwana. Onda hala yu uve shoka ndi na okupopya, opo ya koneke okuvulika kungame aluhe, manga ye na omwenyo, nopo ya nongeke oyana okutila ndje.’
“Hokololeleni aana yeni, nkene mwa yi nomwa thikama ponyonga yondundu ndjoka ya li ya siikilwa kiikogo yolwithi nomulilo tagu lilima gu uka mombanda.
Ya hokololeleni, nkene Omuwa e mu popitha e li mehayango lyomulilo nonkene mwe mu uvu ta popi, ihe ne inamu mu mona nando e li molupe lwasha.
Okwe mu lombwele shoka mu na okuninga, mu dhiginine ehangano ndyoka e li hangana nane. Omu na okudhiginina Iipango Omulongo mbyoka e yi nyola miipelende iyali yomamanya.
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje, ndi mu nongeke oompango adhihe ndhoka mu na okuvulika kudho mevi ndyoka tamu yi, mu ke li lale.”
“Omuwa sho e mu popitha e li mehayango lyomulilo kondundu Sinai, inamu mona nando olupe lwasha. Omoluuwanawa weni yene kotokeni,
mwaa yone mokwiihambulila iimenka molupe lwasha — kashi na nee mbudhi kutya omolupe lwomulumentu nenge lwomukiintu,
lwoshinamwenyo nenge lwondhila,
lwoshihono nenge lwohi.
Inamu kwatwa kohwehwe yokusimaneka nokulongela mbyoka yi li mewangandjo — etango, omwedhi noonyothi. Omuwa Kalunga keni okwe yi topolele aantu ayehe yomuuyuni.
Ihe one oshigwana e shi mangululile muEgipiti, meziko lyomulilo. Okwe mu tembudha mo, mu ninge aantu ye mwene, ngaashi mu li ngashingeyi.
Molweni Omuwa okwa geele ndje nokwa uvaneke nokugana kutya itandi ka tokola we Jordan ndi ye kevi ndyoka ewanawa te ke li mu pa.
Otandi ka sila mevi ndika noitandi ka tokola Jordan, ihe ne otamu yi mu gu taaguluke ne mu ka lale evi ndyoka lyo ondoka.
Kotokeni tuu, mwaa dhimbwe ehangano ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga keni a hangana nane. Vulikeni koshipango she noinamu iningila iimenka yasha,
