oshoka Omuwa Kalunga keni oye omulilo hagu lyana, Kalunga omulaadhi.
“Nongele tamu kala olule moshilongo e tamu mono aanona naatekulu, inamu yona mokwiihambulila iimenka molupe lwasha. Mbika oyo iihuna koshipala shOmuwa notayi mu geyitha.

Otandi ithana egulu nevi, yi ninge oonzapo dheni kutya ngele itamu vulika kungame, otamu kana mo moshilongo nziya. Itamu ka kala mo olule moshilongo shahandiyaka yaJordan shoka tamu ka lala. Otamu ka hanagulwa po thilu.
Omuwa ote ke mu halakanithila kiilongo niilongo, nkoka taku ka hupila aantu yamweyamwe ayeke yomune.
Oko nkoka tamu ka longela ookalunga ya hambulwa kiikaha yaantu, ookalunga yiiti noyomamanya mboka ihaa mono ko noihaa uvu ko, ihaa li noihaa thimbula ezimba.
Hoka otamu ka konga Omuwa Kalunga keni, nongele tamu mu kongo nomutima aguhe, otamu ke mu mona.
Uuna tamu adhika kuudhigu niinima mbika ayihe tamu yi ningilwa, nena ohugunina otamu galukile kOmuwa e tamu vulika kuye.
Oye Kalunga omunamutimahenda. Ite mu etha nando nenge e mu hanagule po, noita dhimbwa nando ehangano ndyoka ye mwene e li hangana noohokulu.

“Konakoneni utale omathimbo gonale, manga ne inaamu valwa, ethimbo alihe lyonale okuza mpoka Kalunga sho a shiti omuntu kombanda yevi. Konakoneni evi alihe. Iinima iinene yi thike mpaka oya ningilwe uunake nale? Oku na tuu ngoka u uvile iinima ya tya ngeyi?
Oku na tuu oshigwana shilwe shu uvile Kalunga ta popi e li momulilo ndele tashi kala shi na we omwenyo, ngaashi ne mu li?

Oku na tuu kalunga gulwe a yelekelele okutembudha mo oshigwana shontumba moshigwana shilwe e te shi ningi she mwene, ngaashi Omuwa Kalunga keni e mu ningile muEgipiti? Omontaneho yenilela a longitha oshikaha she shoonkondo nokwooko kwa taganana; okwe eta iiponga niita, a longo iilongandhindhiliko niinyengandunge nokwe eta iitilithilonga ya ningwa.
Omuwa okwe mu hololele mbika, opo e mu ulukile kutya oye awike Kalunga nokaku na we gulwe.
Okwe mu uvititha ewi lye tali zi megulu, opo e mu nongeke; naampaka kombanda yevi okwe mu talitha omulilo gwe omuyapuki e ta popi mugwo.
Okwe mu hogolola, oshoka oku hole oohokulu, nokoonkondo dhe oonene okwe mu tembudha mo muEgipiti.
Okwa tidha mo iigwana iinene niinankondo mondjila yeni, opo e mu ete mo mevi lyawo, evi ndyoka tali ningi lyeni.
Dhimbulukweni ano nena ne mwaa dhimbwe nando kutya Omuwa oye Kalunga komegulu nokombanda yevi. Kaku na we kalunga gulwe.
Vulikeni koompango adhihe ndhika tandi dhi mu pe nena ndjika, opo ayihe yi kale nawa kune naana yeni mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga keni te li mu pe sigo aluhe.”
Moses okwa yoolola iilando itatu kuuzilo waJordan
moka tamu vulu okuholama omuntu ngoka a dhipaga mukwawo hanowina ye ke shi omutondi gwe. Ota vulu okuya ontuku moshilando shimwe mwaambika nota hupu.
Ezimo lyaRuben olya li li na oshilando Bezer metumbalalovi lyombuga; ezimo lyaGad olya li li na Ramot moshilongo Gilead; nezimo lyaManasse olya li li na Golan moshilongo Baasha.
Moses okwa gandja oompango dhaKalunga kAaisrael.
Okwa gandja omalongo noompango ndhika kAaisrael, sho ya tembuka mo muEgipiti
noya li mesilu kuuzilo waJordan ya taalelathana noshilando Betpeor, moshilongo shaSihon, omukwaniilwa gwAayamori, ngoka a pangele muHeshbon. Moses nAaisrael oye mu sindi, sho ya zi muEgipiti.
Oya kutha po oshilongo she noshilongo shaOg, omukwaniilwa gwaBaasha. Og okwa li omukwawo gwomaakwaniilwa yAayamori kuuzilo waJordan.
Oshilongo shika osha taandela okuza koshilando Aroer kooha dhomulonga Arnon sigo ondundu Sirjon, kokutya Hermon.
Osha kwatelela mo oshikandjo ashihe shokuuzilo waJordan sigo okEfuta lya sa kuumbugantu noponyonga yondundu Pisga kuuzilo.
5: Moses okwa hiya Aaisraeli ayehe e ta ti kuyo: “Aaisraeli ne, pulakeneni oompango adhihe ndhoka tandi mu pe nena. Dhi ilongeni, ne mu vulike kudho shili.
Omuwa Kalunga ketu okwa hangana natse pondundu Sinai.
Ina hangana nootatekulu ayeke, ihe onatse atuhe mboka tu na omwenyo ngashingeyi.
Mpeyaka pondundu okwa popi nane oshipala noshipala e li momulilo.

Onda li nda thikama pokati keni nOmuwa pethimbo ndyoka nonde mu lombwele shoka a ti, oshoka omwa li mwa tila omulilo noinamu londa kondundu.
“Omuwa okwa ti:
‘Ongame Omuwa, Kalunga koye, nde ku tembudha muEgipiti, moka wa li omupika.
“ ‘Ino kala u na ookalunga yalwe koshipala shandje.
“ ‘Ino ihongela efano lyashaashoka megulu nenge kombanda yevi nenge momeya kohi yevi.
Ino inyongamena kiimenka nenge u yi galikane, oshoka ongame Omuwa, Kalunga koye, omulaadhi; otandi geele mboka ye tonde ndje nomaluvalo gawo sigo okepipi etitatu netine.
Ihe otandi sile ohenda omapipi gomayuvi gaamboka ye hole ndje nohaa vulika koompango dhandje.
“ ‘Edhina lyandje ino li tumbulila iinima yowala, oshoka ongame Omuwa, Kalunga koye, tandi geele ayehe mboka taa tumbulile edhina lyandje iinima yowala.
“ ‘Dhimbulukwa esiku lyEsabati ngoye u li yapule, ngaashi ngame Omuwa Kalunga koye nde shi ku lombwele.
Ou na omasiku gahamano moka to longo,

ihe esiku etiheyali olyo esiku lyevululuko lya yapulilwa ndje. Mesiku ndyoka kape na ngoka ta longo — ngoye mwene, aamwoye, aapika yoye, oongombe, uusino nenge iimuna yoye yilwe naakwiilongo ya kala moshilongo sheni. Aapika yoye oye na okuvululukwa, naanaa ngaashi ngoye mwene to ningi.

Dhimbulukwa kutya owa li omupika muEgipiti, moka ngame Omuwa, Kalunga koye, nde ku tembudha mo noshikaha shandje shoonkondo nokwooko kwa taganana. Omolwashoka tandi ku lombwele, u dhimbulukwe esiku lyevululuko.
“ ‘Simaneka ho nanyoko, ngaashika Omuwa Kalunga koye e ku lombwele, opo u kale u na elago nomwenyo omule mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li ku pe.
“ ‘Ino dhipaga.
“ ‘Ino hondela.
“ ‘Ino yaka.
“ ‘Ino lundila mukweni
“ ‘Ino haluka omukiintu gwamukweni; ino haluka egumbo lye, aapika ye, oongombe dhe, uusino we nenge shaa shoka she.’

“Mbika oyo iipango Omuwa e yi mu pe amuhe, sho mwa li mwa gongala pondundu. Okwa popi newi lyendundumo e li momalaka gomulilo nomoshikogo sha zigakana nokwa gandja iipango mbika nohasha shilwe. Okwe yi nyola kiipelende iyali yomamanya e te yi pe ndje.”
“Ondundu ayihe sho ya li ya yaka omulilo nomu uvu oshihomo tashi zi muuluudhe thokothoko, aawiliki yeni naakuluntu yomazimo geni oye ya kungame

e taa ti: ‘Omuwa Kalunga ketu okwe tu ulukile uunene we neadhimo lye, sho twe mu uvu ta popi e li momalaka gomulilo! Nena otwa mono kutya nani otashi vulika omuntu ta kala ngaa e na omwenyo, nando Kalunga okwa popya naye.
Omolwashike tatu hupula oomwenyo dhetu? Omulilo nguka omunene otagu tu lungunitha po. Otatu si shili, ngele tatu uvu Omuwa Kalunga ketu ta popi ishewe.
Oku na tuu omuntu a kalele e na omwenyo, u uvile Kalunga ta popi momalaka gomulilo?
Moses, shuna e to pulakene ayihe mbyoka Omuwa Kalunga ketu ta ti. Galuka ihe u ye u tu lombwele shoka e ku lombwele. Otatu ke shi pulakena nokuvulika.’
“Omuwa sho e shi uvu, okwa lombwele ndje a ti: ‘Ondu uvite ko shoka aantu mbaka ya ti noye li mondjila.
Ando ya kale aluhe osho yu uvite ngaaka! Ando ya kale aluhe taa simaneke ndje e taa vulika kiipango yandje ayihe, opo ya kale nawa nomaluvalo gawo sigo aluhe!
Inda u ke ya lombwele, ya shune komatsali gawo.
Ihe ngoye, Moses, oto kala mpaka pungame, notandi ke ku pa iipango, omautho noompango dhandje adhihe. Yi nongeka Aaisraeli, opo ya vulike kuyo mevi ndyoka tandi li ya pe!’
“Aaisraeli ne, kaleni ano tamu dhiginine nawa ashihe shoka Omuwa Kalunga keni e shi mu lombwele. Inamu kala tuu inaamu vulika koompango dhe adhihe.
Vulikeni kudho adhihe, opo mu kale nawa nomu vule okukala mevi ndyoka tamu ke li lala.”
6: “Ndhika odho oompango ndhoka Omuwa Kalunga keni e dhi lombwele ndje, ndi mu nongeke. Vulikeni kudho mevi ndyoka tamu ke li lala.
Omasiku agehe manga mu na omwenyo, one nomaluvalo geni mu na okusimaneka Omuwa Kalunga keni nokuvulika koompango dhe adhihe ndhoka tandi dhi mu pe, opo mu kale mu na omwenyo omule moshilongo shoka.

Aaisraeli, dhi pulakeneni ano, ne mu dhi dhiginine nawa! Nena otamu ka kala nawa e tamu ningi oshigwana oshinankondo nokukala mevi ndyoka lya tondoka omahini nomagadhi goonyushi, ngaashi Omuwa Kalunga koohokulu u uvaneke.
“Israel, pulakena! Omuwa Kalunga ketu oye awike Kalunga.
Ano hola Omuwa Kalunga koye komutima gwoye aguhe, komwenyo gwoye aguhe nonoonkondo dhoye adhihe.
Ino dhimbwa oohapu ndhika tandi dhi ku lombwele nena.
Dhi nongeka aamwoye. Dhi hokolola, uuna u li moyaandjeni nuuna u li mepola, uuna to vululukwa nuuna to longo.
Nadhi kale edhimbulukitho lya fa lya mangelwa koshikaha shoye nenge li li moshipala shoye.
Dhi nyolela miikulo yomiyelo dhegumbo lyoye nomuuyanda.”
“Uuna Omuwa Kalunga koye te ku fala mevi ndyoka e li uvanekele oohokulu Abraham, Isak naJakob, oto ka pewa iilando iinene noyo opala mbyoka inoo yi tunga.

Oto ka pewa omagumbo gu udha omaliko omawanawa inoo ga pungula mo, omithima inoo dhi hupa, iitsambe yomiviinu niikunino yomiolivi inoo dhi tsika. Omuwa nge te ku fala mevi ndyoka, noto kala u na ayihe wa hala okulya,
kotoka tuu, waa dhimbwe Omuwa ngoka e ku tembudha muEgipiti, moka wa li omupika.
Tila Omuwa Kalunga koye, mu longela oye awike, nokuuvaneka omauvaneko goye medhina lye amuke.
Ino longela ookalunga yalwe, oomboka yiigwana ye ku kunduka.
Ngele to longele ookalunga yalwe, ondjahi yOmuwa otayi ku hwamene ya fa omulilo tagu ku lungunitha po thiluthilu, oshoka Omuwa Kalunga koye, ngoka e li pungoye, oye omulaadhi.
“Ino hinda Omuwa Kalunga koye, ngaashi we shi ningi puMassa.
Dhiginina iipango ayihe mbyoka Omuwa e yi ku pe nomikalo nomautho ge agehe.
Gwanitha shoka shu uka nosho opalela Omuwa. Nena ayihe otayi kala nawa, noto ka vula okuya mo nokulala evi ndyoka ewanawa Omuwa u uvanekele oohokulu.
Noto ka tidha mo aatondi yoye, ngaashi u uvaneke.
“Komongula omumwoye nge te ku pula ta ti: ‘Omolwashike Omuwa Kalunga ketu a gandja omikalo, omautho noompango ndhika adhihe kune?’
Mu yamukula u tye: ‘Otwa li aapika yomukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti, ihe Omuwa okwe tu tembudha mo noshikaha she shoonkondo.
Otwa mono nomeho getu yene iilongandhindhiliko niinyengandunge iinene niitilithi ya ningilwa Aayegipiti, omukwaniilwa gwawo nomalenga ge agehe.
Okwe tu mangulula muEgipiti nokwe tu eta huka e te tu pe evi ndika, ngaashi u uvanekele ootatekulu nokugana.
Omuwa Kalunga ketu okwe tu lombwele tu dhiginine omautho ngaka agehe noku mu tila. Ngele otatu shi ningi, ota ka tonatela aluhe oshigwana shetu e te shi kaleke melago.
Ngele otatu vulika shili kiipango mbika ayihe Omuwa Kalunga ketu e tu lombwele, ota kala e na ombili natse.’ ”
7: “Omuwa Kalunga koye ote ku fala mevi ndyoka to ke li lala, oye nota ka tidha mo iigwana. Ote ke ku tidhila mo iigwana iheyali iinene niinankondo yi ku vule: Aaheti, Aagirgashi, Aayamori, Aakaanana, Aaperesi, Aahevi nAayebusi.
Omuwa Kalunga koye shampa a tula aantu mbaka miikaha yoye e to ya sindi, ou na oku ya dhipaga po ayehe. Ino hangana nayo nenge u ya sile ohenda.
Ino hokanathana nayo, yo yaa hokane aamwoye,
oshoka otaa ka kutha aamwoye pOmuwa yo ya ka longele iikalunga. Ngele shika tashi ningwa, Omuwa ote ku geele e te ku dhimi po ohaluka.
Onkee ano kumuna po iiyambelo yawo, teyagula po oongundhimanya dhawo dhiidhila, ne mu keke po iiyelekela yoshikalungakiintu shawo Asheera, nokulungunitha po iimenka yawo.
Shi longa, oshoka ngoye oshigwana sha yapulilwa Omuwa Kalunga koye. Omuwa Kalunga koye okwe ku hogolola mokati kiigwana ayihe yomuuyuni, u ninge oshigwana she mwenelela.
“Omuwa ke ku hole ye ine ku hogolola ando molwashoka u vule iigwana yilwe muuwindji, aawe, owa li okagwana okashona miigwana ayihe yokombanda yevi.
Ihe Omuwa okwa li e ku hole nokwa hala okudhiginina euvaneko e li uvanekele oohokulu. Omolwashoka e ku tembudha mo noshikaha she shoonkondo e te ku mangulula muupika womukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti.
Kala u shi shi kutya Omuwa Kalunga koye oye awike Kalunga noye omudhiginini. Ota dhiginine ehangano lye nota hololele omapipi geyuvi esilohenda lye kumboka ye mu hole e taa vulika kiipango ye,
ihe iha lwedha okugeela mboka ye mu tonde.
Vulika ano kumbyoka we yi nongekwa; vulika kiipango nomautho noompango adhihe ndhoka nde dhi ku pe nena.”
“Ngele otamu pulakene iipango mbika e tamu yi dhiginine, nena Omuwa Kalunga keni ota ka dhiginina ehangano lye nane e te mu hololele esilohenda lye, ngaashika u uvanekele oohokulu nokugana.

Ota ka kala e mu hole e te mu yambeke noku mu indjipaleka. Ote ke mu pa aanona oyendji note ke mu yambeka noku mu pa eloolo lyiilya, omaviinu nomagadhi gooholivi; ote ke mu yambeka noku mu pa oongombe noonzi odhindji. Ote ke mu pa omayambeko agehe ngaka mevi ndyoka u uvanekele oohokulu nokugana kutya ote ke li mu pa.
Kaku na oshigwana muuyuni tashi ka kala shi na eyambeko she mu fa. Mokati keni itamu ka kala omulumentu nenge omukiintu ihaa vala nenge miimuna yeni.
Omuwa ote mu gamene koshivu kehe; ite mu ethele nando elega, ngaashi mwe shi koneke muEgipiti, ihe ote li undulile maatondi yeni.
Hanagulii po oshigwana kehe Omuwa Kalunga keni te shi gandja miikaha yeni; inamu shi sila nando ohenda. Inamu longela iikalunga yasho, otashi ka ninga omwigo gweni.
“Inamu ilombwela ne yene kutya iigwana mbika oyindji yi mu vule noitamu vulu oku yi tidha po.
Inamu yi tila; dhimbulukweni shoka Omuwa Kalunga keni e shi ningile omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti naantu ye ayehe.

Dhimbulukweni omageelo giihuna ngoka mwa tala nomeho geni yene, iilongandhindhiliko niinyengandunge, oshikaha shoka shoonkondo nokwooko kwa taganana nkoka Omuwa Kalunga keni e mu mangulula nakwo. Pahedhi tuu ndjika otamu ka hanagula po iigwana ayihe mbyoka hamu yi tila ngashingeyi.
Omuwa Kalunga keni ota ka tuma omambonzi mokati kawo, sigo ayehe ya pu po mboka ye mu hunuka ya ka holama.
Osho ano inamu tila aantu mboka. Omuwa Kalunga keni oku li pamwe nane; oye Kalunga omunene nomutilithilela.
Kashona nakashona ote mu tidhile po iigwana mbika. Inamu yi hanagula po polumwe; ngele tamu shi ningi, iithitukuti otayi indjipala e tayi mu gwililile po.
Omuwa Kalunga keni ota ka gandja aatondi yeni miikaha yeni e te ya piyaganeke nayi, sigo ya dhimwa po.
Ota ka gandja aakwaniilwa yawo miikaha yeni. Otamu ke ya dhipaga po, e taa dhimbiwa. Kape na ngoka ta ka vula oku mu kankeka; otamu ka hanagula po ayehe.
Lungunithii po iimenka yawo. Inamu haluka iisiliveli nenge iingoli mbyoka yi li kuyo noinamu yi ikuthila. Ngele tamu shi ningi, otashi mu ningile omwigo, oshoka oyo iihunalela kOmuwa Kalunga keni.
Iimenka mbika inamu yi eta nando okuli momagumbo geni, opo ethingano tuu ndyoka lyawo lyaaye mu kwate. Omu na okutonda nokudhina iimenka mbyoka, oshoka oya thingwa kOmuwa.”
8: “Dhiginineni nawa iipango ayihe mbyoka tandi yi mu pe nena ndjika, opo mu kale mu na omwenyo, tamu indjipala notamu vulu okulala evi ndyoka Omuwa e li uvanekele oohokulu nokugana.

Dhimbulukweni, nkene Omuwa Kalunga keni e mu enditha ondjila ndjika onde mokutokola ombuga momimvo ndhika omilongo ne. Okwa tumu omaudhigu e mu yeleke, opo a koneke shoka mwa dhiladhila okuninga nongele otamu vulika kiipango ye.

Okwe mu sitha ondjala, e te mu pe omanna mu lye, iikulya mbyoka inaayi liwa nale kune nokoohokulu. Shika okwe shi ningi, opo e mu longe kutya omuntu iha kala e na omwenyo koshikwiila ashike, ihe okohapu kehe tayi zi mokana kwOmuwa.
Momimvo ndhika omilongo ne oonguwo dheni inadhi kulupa, noompadhi dheni inadhi zinda.
Dhimbulukweni kutya Omuwa Kalunga keni ohe mu utha noku mu putudha, naanaa ngaashi he ta tekula oyana.
Longeni ano, ngaashi Omuwa e mu lombwele: Dhiginineni iipango ye e tamu kala mwe mu tila.
Omuwa Kalunga keni ote mu fala mevi ndyoka lyo ondoka — evi lyomilonga nolyoothithiya, evi lyoonza tadhi fuluka omeya momasilu nokoondundu,
evi li na olunza lwosiima niishokelya, omandjembele, oonkwiyu, oondunga dhomuti gwomugranati, ooholivi nomagadhi goonyushi.
Mevi ndyoka itamu ka sa we ondjala nenge mu kale mu na oluhepo. Momamanya galyo omu na oshimanya shosheela oshiluudhe nomoondundu dhalyo otamu vulu okulikola oshikushu.
Otamu ka kala mu na ashihe mwa hala oku shi lya notamu ka hambelela Omuwa Kalunga keni molwevi ewanawa ndyoka e li mu pe.”
“Kotokeni tuu, mwaa dhimbwe Omuwa Kalunga keni; dhiginineni okuvulika kiipango, omautho noompango dhe tandi dhi mu pe nena.
Uuna mwa kala mu na ayihe mbyoka mwa hala okulya nomwa tunga omagumbo omawanawa mu kale mo,
nuuna iimuna noonzi dheni dha valathana, oshisiliveli noshingoli neliko lyeni lilwe tali indjipala,
kaleni mu shi shi kutya kamu na okwiitanga nokudhimbwa Omuwa Kalunga keni, ngoka e mu tembudha mo muEgipiti, moka mwa li aapika.
Okwe mu pititha ombuga ontilithi nonene yi na omayoka guuzigo noondje. Mombuga ya kalanda yaa na omeya okwe mu tsipukithile omeya memanya ekukutu.
Mombuga tuu moka okwe mu pe omanna mu lye, iikulya mbyoka inaayi liwa koohokulu. Okwe mu tumine uudhigu e mu yeleke, opo pehulilo a wape e mu ningile uuwanawa.
Inamu dhiladhila ano kutya one yene mwi iningi aayamba koonkondo dheni yene.
Dhimbulukweni kutya Omuwa Kalunga keni oye he mu pe oonkondo dhokuninga aayamba. Ote shi ningi, oshoka oye omudhiginini, sigo onena ta dhiginine ehangano ndyoka a hangana noohokulu.
Inamu dhimbwa nando Omuwa Kalunga keni nenge mu game kiikalunga mu yi longele noku yi simaneka. Ngele tamu shi ningi, otandi mu londodha kutya otamu ka hanagulwa po shili.
Ngele itamu vulika kOmuwa, nena otamu ka hanagulwa po naanaa mwa fa iigwana mbyoka te yi hanagula po, opo mu kale mo.”
9: “Pulakena, Israel! Ngashingeyi oto ka taaguluka Jordan nokulala evi lyiigwana iinene niinankondo yi ku vule. Iilando yawo iinene yi na omankolokuma ga tsa mombanda.
Aantu yo yene oyo Aayanaki aaleeleka naanankondo, mboka wu uva taku tiwa: ‘Kaku na ngoka te yi itakeke.’

Ihe ngashingeyi oto ki italela ko ngoye mwene kutya Omuwa Kalunga koye ote ku tetekele a fa omulilo hagu lyana. Ote ke ya sinda; ote ye ku tidhile mo. Ngoye oto ke ya tidha mo noku ya hanagula po mbala, ngaashi Omuwa u uvaneke.
“Omuwa Kalunga koye ngele te ye ku tidhile mo, ino dhiladhila u tye: ‘Okwe eta ndje mo, ndi likole evi ndika moluuyuuki wandje.’ Aawe, Omuwa ote ke ku tidhila po iigwana mbika moluukolokoshi wayo.

Hamolwashoka ngoye omwaanawa ando noho ningi shoka shu uka, Omuwa ando te ku pitikile okulala evi lyawo. Ote ke ya tidha mo, oshoka oyo aakolokoshi nomolwashoka ta lalakanene okugwanitha euvaneko ndyoka e li uvanekele oohokulu Abraham, Isak naJakob.
Kala tuu u shi shi kutya Omuwa ite ku pe evi ndika ewanawa omolwuuyuuki woye, oshoka ongoye oshigwana oshitangalali.
“Ino dhimbwa nando okuli, nkene wa geyitha Omuwa mombuga. Okuza uuna wa tembuka mo muEgipiti sigo uuna wa thiki mpaka, owa tsu ondumbo nOmuwa.
Nokuli pondundu Sinai owa geyitha Omuwa ondjahi ya gwana oku ku hanagulitha po.

Onda londo kondundu, ndi ka taambe iipelende yomamanya, moka mwa li mwa nyolelwa ehangano ndyoka Omuwa a hangana nangoye. Onda kala ko omasiku omilongo ne, uusiku nomutenya, inandi lya sha ngaye ine nwa sha.
Omuwa nokwa pe ndje iipelende yomamanya, moka a nyolela shoka ye mwene e ku lombwele e li momulilo esiku ndiyaka wa li pondundu.
Eeno, konima yomasiku ngoka omilongo ne, uusiku nomutenya, Omuwa okwa pe ndje iipelende iyali yomamanya, moka a li a nyolela ehangano noshikaha she mwene.

“Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: ‘Londoloka u ye pevi u ze kondundu mbala, oshoka aantu yoye mboka we ya tembudha mo muEgipiti, oya ningi esithahoni. Oya gamuka nokuli mondjila ndjoka nde yi ya lombwele ya kale mo noyi iningile oshimenka.’
“Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje ishewe a ti: ‘Aantu mbaka ondi ya shi kutya oyo aatangalali.
Ino mweneka ndje we. Onda hala ndi ya hanagule po nokudhima po edhina lyawo kombanda yevi. Ihe ngoye otandi ke ku ninga he yoshigwana oshinene noshinankondo shi ya vule.’
“Ngame nonda galuka ihe kondundu nda humbata iipelende iyali yomamanya, moka mwa nyolelwa ehangano. Ondundu oya li tayi lilima omalaka gomulilo.
Onda mono kutya ne omwa yono kOmuwa Kalunga keni: omwi ihambulile oshimenka shoshingoli molupe lwontana; omwa zi mbala mondjila ndjoka Omuwa e mu lombwele mu ende nayo.
Opo mpoka nda hata pevi iipelende ayihe iyali ya li miikaha yandje, e tandi yi tatula montaneho yeni.
Lumwe natango ondi isizimike pevi koshipala shOmuwa omasiku omilongo ne, uusiku nomutenya, ngame inandi lya sha noine nwa sha. Onde shi ningi, oshoka omwa yono kOmuwa nomwe mu geyitha.
Onda li nda tila uupyu wondjahi yOmuwa, oshoka okwa li a geya noonkondo e mu hanagule po thilu, ihe Omuwa okwa pulakene ndje natango.
Omuwa okwa li a geele wo Aaron noonkondo a hala oku mu dhipaga, nopethimbo tuu ndyoka onda galikanene wo Aaron.
Onda kutha oshiningomwa sheni shuulunde, ontana ndjoka yoshingoli, nonde yi umbile meziko. Onde yi nyanyagula nde yi ningi omutoko e tandi gu gundu momeya ngoka taga tondoka taga zi mondundu.
“Ne omwa geyitha Omuwa ishewe, sho mwa li puTabera, Massa naKibrot Taava.
MuKadesh Barnea Omuwa sho e mu tumu a ti: ‘Indeni mu ka lale evi ndyoka tandi li mu pe,’ omwa tsu ondumbo nelombwelo lyOmuwa; ne inamu mu itaala nokuvulika kuye.
Ondi shi shi kutya ne otamu thengalalele Omuwa.
“Ondi isizimike pevi koshipala shOmuwa omasiku omilongo ne, omutenya nuusiku, molwashoka Omuwa okwa ti, ote mu hanagula po.
Onda galikana nda ti: Omuwa Omupangeliawike, ino hanagula po aantu yoye, oshigwana shoka we shi mangulula noku shi tembudha mo muEgipiti noshikaha shoye shoonkondo.
Dhimbulukwa aapiya yoye Abraham, Isak naJakob noino pupa ko kuutangalali, kuukolokoshi nokuulunde woshigwana shika.
Aayegipiti otaa ningi ya tye: ‘Omuwa okwa nyengwa okufala aantu ye kevi ndyoka e ya uvanekele. Okwa kutha mo ashike aantu ye, e ke ya dhipagele mombuga, oshoka okwa li e ya tonde.’
Aantu mbaka oyoye, oshigwana shoye shoka we shi tembudha mo muEgipiti noshikaha shoye shoonkondo nokwooko kwa taganana.”
10: “Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: ‘Honga iipelende iyali yomamanya ya faathana naambiyaka yotango e to pangele oshiketha shiipilangi shoku yi pungula mo. Londa ihe kondundu u ye kungame,
notandi ka nyolela miipelende mbyoka shoka nda nyolele miipelende mbyoka we yi tatula; yi pungula moshiketha.’
“Onda pangele oshiketha shiipilangi yomuthiya e tandi hongo iipelende iyali yomamanya ya faathana naambiyaka yotango e tandi yi fala kondundu.

Omuwa nokwa nyolele miipelende mbyoka oohapu tuu ndhoka a li a nyola tango, iipango omulongo mbyoka e yi mu pe, sho a li ta popi e li momalaka gomulilo, uuna mwa li mwa gongala pondundu. Omuwa okwa pe ndje iipelende,
nonda galuka nda londoloka kondundu. Onde yi pungula moshiketha shoka nda pangele, naanaa ngaashi a ti, nomo yi li ngashingeyi.”
(Aaisraeli noya zi ko kuBeerot Bene Jaakan e taa yi kuMoser. Oko Aaron a sile ko e ta fumvikwa, nomwana Eleasar okwa yi peha lye moshilonga shuuyambi.
Okuza hoka oya yi kuGudgoda nokuza kuGudgoda oya yi kuJotbata, ehala lyiipemba yomeya.

Pethimbo ndiyaka Omuwa okwa langeke aalumentu yezimo lyaLevi ya ninge aahumbati yoshikethahangano, ye mu longele muuyambi noya tumbulile aantu omayambeko medhina lye. Mbika oyo iilonga yawo sigo onena.
Omolwashoka ezimo lyaLevi inali pewa oshitendelwa shevi nuuthiga mokati komazimo omakwawo, oshoka Omuwa oye uuthiga walyo, ngaashi Omuwa Kalunga e shi popi.)
“Onda kala kondundu omasiku omilongo ne, uusiku nomutenya, ngaashi nda ningile nale lwotango. Omuwa okwa pulakene ndje natango nokwa zimine kee ku yone po.
Okwa lombwele ndje a ti: ‘Inda u ka endithe oshigwana, opo shi ka lale evi ndyoka nde li uvaneke tandi li pe oohokulu.’ ”
“Israel, pulakena ngashingeyi shoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te ku pula: Tila Omuwa, ngoye u landule ondjila ye. Kala u mu hole, mu longela komutima gwoye aguhe nokomwenyo gwoye aguhe,
ngoye u dhiginine iipango nomautho ge agehe. Otandi yi ku pe nena omolwelago lyoye.
“Taleni ko! Egulu nomagulu gokombandambanda ogOmuwa, nevi noshaa shoka shi li mo.
Ihe ohole yOmuwa mokuhola oohokulu oya li onene, nokwe mu hogolola, one noluvalo lwawo, peha lyiigwana yilwe. One oshigwana sha hogololwa natango.
Onkee ano okuza kongashingeyi pititheni omitima dheni etanda ne inamu kukutika we oothingo dheni.
Omuwa Kalunga keni oye Kalunga kokombanda yookalunga ayehe noye e vule oonkondo adhihe. Oye omunene, omunankondo nomutilithi. Ke na ontondo ye iha taamba oombumbo.
Ohu uthile oothigwa naaselekadhi; oku hole aakwiilongo mboka ye li mokati keni te ya pe iikulya nomizalo.
Kaleni ano mu hole aakwiilongo, oshoka ne omwa li aakwiilongo muEgipiti.
Tileni Omuwa Kalunga keni, noye awike mu longeleni. Mu inekeleni, nomedhina lye awike ningeni omauvaneko geni.
Mu hambeleleni — oye Kalunga keni, omwa mono nomeho geni yene iinima iinene niitilithi mbyoka e yi mu longele.
Oohokulu sho ya yi kuEgipiti, oya li owala aalumentu omilongo heyali. Ihe ngashingeyi Omuwa Kalunga keni okwe mu indjipaleke mu thike poonyothi dhokegulu.”
11: “Holeni Omuwa Kalunga keni, ne mu dhiginine aluhe omalombwelo, omautho, oompango niipango ye.
Molwokupyokoka kweni dhimbulukweni nena ndjika shoka mwa koneke kOmuwa. Onelela mwa mono owino, haana yeni. Omwa tala uunene wOmuwa, oshikaha she shoonkondo, okwooko kwe kwa taganana
niilongandhindhiliko ye. Omwa mono shoka a ningile omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti noshilongo she ashihe.
Omwa tala, nkene Omuwa a kombo po omatangakwiita gAayegipiti, pamwe nuukambe wawo nomatembakwiita gawo, noku ya ninginitha mEfuta etiligane, sho ya li taye mu landula.
Omu shi shi shoka Omuwa e mu ningile mombuga, manga inaamu thika mpaka.

Otamu dhimbulukwa shoka a ningile Datan naAbiram, aana yaEliab yomezimo lyaRuben. Montaneho yaayehe evi olya makula okana kalyo e tali ya nina po, pamwe noyaandjawo, nomatsali gawo, naapiya yawo ayehe noniimuna yawo.
Eeno, one tuu mboka mwa mono nomeho geni yene iinima iinene mbyoka Omuwa e yi longo.”
“Dhiginineni iipango ayihe nde yi mu pe nena, opo mu ninge aanankondo nomu wape okutokola omulonga noku ka lala evi ndyoka moka tamu ka ya mo,
nopo mu kale ethimbo ele mevi ndyoka lya tondoka omahini nomagadhi goonyushi, mevi olyo tuu ndyoka Omuwa u uvaneke te li pe oohokulu nomaluvalo gawo.
Evi ndyoka tamu ka lala, inali faathana naEgipiti, moka mwa tembuka mo. MuEgipiti sho mwa kunu oombuto dheni, omwa tekele iimeno yomomapya geni nuudhigu.
Ihe mevi ndyoka mu uka, olyo evi lyoondundu nomasilu, evi hali lokwa.
Omuwa Kalunga keni ota sile evi ndika oshimpwiyu note li tonatele omumvo aguhe.
“Dhiginineni ano nawa iipango mbyoka nde yi mu pe nena ndjika. Holeni Omuwa Kalunga keni e tamu mu longele komitima dheni adhihe nokoomwenyo dheni adhihe.
Ngele otamu shi ningi, ota ka lokithila evi lyeni omvula, uuna sha pumbiwa, pethimbo lyoshikufuthinge nolyoshitemamvula, opo mu kale mu na iilya, omaviinu nomagadhi gooholivi,
nomwiidhi gwiimuna yeni. Otamu ka kala mu na iikulya ayihe mwe yi hala.
Inamu etha mu kuthwe po pOmuwa, ne mu ka longele ookalunga yalwe.

Ngele tamu shi ningi, Omuwa ote ke mu geela. Ota kaleke omvula yaa loke we, evi lyeni otali ka kalanda koluteni, niimeno yeni tayi si. One notamu ka sa po mbala, nando mu kale mu li mevi ewanawa ndyoka Omuwa te li mu pe.
“Thindileni ano oohapu ndhika dhandje moomwenyo, ne mu dhi dhiladhile. Nadhi kale edhimbulutho lya mangelwa kiikaha yeni nenge li li miipala yeni.
Dhi nongekeni aana yeni. Dhi hokololeni, uuna mu li moyaandjeni nuuna tamu ende mepola, uuna tamu vululukwa nuuna tamu longo.
Dhi nyoleleni miikulo yomiyelo dhomagumbo geni nomuuyanda.
Opo ihe ne naana yeni otamu ka kala olule mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga keni u uvaneke oku li pa oohokulu. Otamu kala mo, manga egulu nevi li li po.
“Dhiginineni nawa iipango ayihe mbika nde yi mu pe: Holeni Omuwa Kalunga keni, landuleni ondjila ye, ne mu mu inekele.
Nena ote ke mu tidhila mo iigwana mbyoka ayihe, notamu ka lala evi lyiigwana iinene niinankondo yi mu vule.

Evi alihe ndyoka tamu ke li lyata, otali ningi lyeni. Oshilongo sheni otashi ka taandela okuza kombuga kuumbugantu sigo okoondundu dhaLibanon, nokuza komulonga Eufrat kuuzilo sigo Efuta lyopokati kuuninginino.
Mevi ndyoka shaa mpoka tamu yi, Omuwa Kalunga keni ote ke mu ninga etilitho lyiigwana, ngaashi u uvaneka, nokape na ngoka ta vulu oku mu ya moshipala.
“Nena ndjika otandi mu pe, mu hogolole pokati keyambeko netulomutima —
eyambeko, ongele tamu vulika kiipango yOmuwa Kalunga keni mbyoka tandi yi mu pe nena;
ihe etulomutima, ongele itaamu vulika kiipango mbika notamu pilamene ko, mu ze po, mu ka longele ookalunga yalwe mboka inaamu ya longela nale.
Omuwa Kalunga keni ngele te mu fala mevi ndyoka tamu ke li lala, ka uvithileni eyambeko kondundu Garizim netulomutima kondundu Ebal.
(Oondundu ndhika mbali odhi li handiyaka yaJordan kuuninginino woshitauwa hoka haku ningine etango, popepi noomwandi dhaMore moshilongo shAakaanana mboka ya kala muAraba ontega naGilgal.)
Otamu ka tokola Jordan e tamu ka lala evi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga keni te li mu pe. Shampa mwe li kwata po e tamu tula mo,
dhiginineni shili oompango adhihe ndhoka tandi dhi mu pe nena.”
12: “Ndhika odho oompango ndhoka mu na oku dhi dhiginina nawa, manga mu li mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koohokulu te li mu pe. Dhi pulakeneni!
Hanagulii po omahala agehe moka aantu ya li haa simanekele ookalunga yawo koondundu oondeendeka, kiikulundundu nomomizile dhomiti omitalala mevi ndyoka tamu ke li lala.
Kumunii po iiyambelo yawo ne mu teyagule po oongundhimanya dhawo dhiidhila. Fikii po iiyelekela yawo yoshikalungakiintu Asheera ne mu komangele po iimenka yawo, opo yaa simanekwe we pomahala ngoka.”
“Inamu longela Omuwa Kalunga keni pahedhi ndjoka aantu mbaka haa longele iikalunga yawo.
Ihe ehala limwe ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga keni te li hogolola moshitopolwa shomazimo geni, otamu li kongo, nopulyo opo tamu kala hamu gongalele, mu mu longele.
Oko tuu hoka tamu fala omafikilondjambo noontselelandjambo dheni, iitimulongo yeni, omagano ngoka gu uvanekelwa Omuwa nomayambo pahalo lyeni yene niisheeli yoongombe noonzi dheni.
Noko nkoka koshipala shOmuwa Kalunga keni, ngoka e mu yambeka nomagumbo geni, otamu li nokunyanyukilwa iinima iiwanawa mbyoka mwa longo.”
“Ethimbo ndyoka nge lya thiki, inamu ninga ngaashika mwa ningile. Sigo onena shaa ngoka okwa longo ngaashika e shi wete sho opala,
oshoka inamu thika natango mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga te li mu pe, moka tamu ka kala mu na ombili.
Shampa mwa tokola Jordan, Omuwa ote ke mu langeka moshilongo e tamu kala mo. Ote mu gamene kaatondi yeni ayehe, e tamu kala nombili.

Omuwa ota ka hogolola ehala lyontumba, moka ta longelwa, nopulyo otamu ka eta po ashihe shoka tandi mu lombwele: omafikilondjambo noontselelandjambo dheni, iitimulongo yeni nomagano ngoka gu uvanekelwa Omuwa.
Nyanyukilweni koshipala shOmuwa Kalunga keni pamwe naana yeni, aapiya yeni nAalevi mboka ya kala miilando yeni; dhimbulukweni kutya Aalevi itaa ka kala ye na oshitendelwa shevi lyawo yene.
Inamu yamba omafikilondjambo geni shaa mpoka tamu hogolola,
ihe opehala limwe alike ndyoka Omuwa te li hogolola moshitopolwa shomazimo geni. Nopo apeke tamu yambele omafikilondjambo geni e tamu gwanitha iinima ayihe tandi yi mu lombwele.”

“Owa manguluka okudhipaga oshimuna shoye noku shi lya shaa mpoka u li. Oto shi li, ngaashi Omuwa te shi ku pe. Ashihe shimwe nge omuyogoki nenge ngoka a nika oshidhila, ota vulu oku shi lya, ngaashi naanaa haku liwa onyama yomenye nenge yohumba.
Ihe ombinzi yayo ino yi lya nando, yi tilahi pevi ya fa omeya.

Shoka to yambele Omuwa, inashi lilwa pehala ndyoka wa kala, nashi kale iitimulongo yiilya yomaviinu nenge yomagadhi goye gooholivi, osheeli shongombe nenge shonzi yoye, omagano ngoka wu uvanekele Omuwa, omagano to ga gandja pahalo lyoye mwene nenge omayambo galwe.

Ongoye naamwoye, pamwe naapiya yoye nAalevi mboka ye li miilando yeni, u na okulila omayambo ngaka koshipala shOmuwa Kalunga koye mehala tuu ndyoka limwe lyelongelokalunga lya hogololwa kOmuwa Kalunga koye. Nowu na okunyanyukilwa ayihe mbyoka we yi longo.
Sa oshimpwiyu waa dhimbwe po Aalevi ethimbo alihe to kala mevi lyeni.
“Omuwa Kalunga koye ngele ta nenepeke oshilongo shoye, ngaashi u uvaneka, oto vulu okulya onyama, ngaashi wa hala.
Ehala lyelongelokalunga ngele oli li kokule unene, nena pahalo lyoye mwene oto vulu okudhipaga oongombe nenge oonzi ndhoka Omuwa e dhi ku pe noto lile onyama maandjeni, ngaashi nde ku lombwele.
Shaa ngoka omuyelele nenge a nika oshidhila, ota vulu okulya onyama ndjoka, ngaashi haku liwa onyama yomenye nenge yohumba.
Shaa owala itoo yi li yi na ombinzi, oshoka omwenyo ogwa kala mombinzi, onkee ino lya omwenyo pamwe nonyama.
Ombinzi ino yi ninga iikulya; yi tilahi pevi ya fa omeya.
Ngele to vulika koshipango shika, Omuwa ota ka nyanyukwa, oku na ombili nangoye, naayihe otayi ke ku opalela, ongoye mwene naamwoye.
Ihe omayambo goye nomagano goye ngoka wu uvanekele Omuwa, ga fala kehala lyelongelokalunga tuu ndyoka limwe.
Onyama nombinzi yomafikilondjambo goye yi yambela koshiyambelo shOmuwa Kalunga koye. Moontselelandjambo ombinzi nayi tilwe koshiyambelo shOmuwa Kalunga koye, ihe onyama oto vulu oku yi lya.
Vulika shili kwaayihe mbika nde ku lombwele, ngoye noluvalo lwoye, noto kala nawa aluhe sigo aluhe, oshoka oto ningi shoka shu uka nosho opalela Omuwa Kalunga koye.”
“Omuwa Kalunga keni ota ka hanagula po iigwana, nge tamu ka matukila evi lyawo. Otamu ke li kwata po e tamu tula mo.
Omuwa nge a hanagula po iigwana mbyoka, taleni nawa mwaa landule uupagani wawo, oshoka otashi ka ninga omwigo gweni. Inamu simonona tuu, nkene haa longele iikalunga yawo, opo mu shi yelekele.

Inamu longela Omuwa Kalunga keni pahedhi ndjoka haa longele iikalunga yawo, oshoka mokulongela kwawo iikalunga otaa ningi iinima iikungitha mbyoka Omuwa te yi tondo. Nokuli ohaa fikile oyana kiiyambelo yawo.”
“Gwanitheni ayihe mbyoka nde yi mu lombwele; inamu gwedha ko sha ne inamu kutha mo sha.”
13: “Omuhunganeki nenge omulalindjodhi ota vulu okuuvaneka oshilongandhindhiliko nenge oshinyengandunge,
opo e mu fale mokusimaneka nokulongela ookalunga mboka inaamu ya simaneka nale. Nonando shoka u uvaneka tashi tsu,
inamu mu pulakena. Omuwa Kalunga keni ote mu longitha, opo e mu lole a tale, ngele omu hole tuu shili Omuwa komutima aguhe.
Landuleni Omuwa Kalunga keni, ne mu mu tile; vulikeni kuye ne mu dhiginine iipango ye; mu longeleni noku mu inekela.

Ihe omuhunganeki nenge omulalindjodhi kehe te mu tsitha ondumbo nOmuwa Kalunga keni, ngoka e mu tembudha mo muEgipiti, moka mwa li aapika, mu dhipagii po. Omuntu a tya ngaaka omudhudhu nota kambadhala e mu gamune mondjila ndjoka Omuwa Kalunga keni e mu lombwele mu kale mo. Na dhipagwe, opo mu ikanyutulule kuuwinayi.

“Ngele oku na mumwanyoko nenge omumwoyemati nenge omumwoyekadhona nenge omukulukadhi u mu hole unene nenge kuume koye kopothingo te ku hongolola monanguwi ta ti: ‘Natu ka longele ookalunga yalwe,’ mboka ne noohokulu inaamu ya tseya,
ookalunga yiigwana mbyoka ye mu kunduka, mbyoka yi li popepi nenge kokule nane, okuza kooha dhevi sigo okoonkwawo,
ino mu pitika e ku heke; ino mu pulakena nokuli. Ino mu sila ohenda nande nenge u mu etele olukeno, ino mu gamena.
Mu dhipaga! Ongoye mu dhaadhiga tango nemanya, opo ihe ayehe naye mu dhenge nomamanya!
Mu dhipaga nomamanya! Okwa kambadhala e ku gamune kOmuwa Kalunga koye, ngoka e ku mangulula muEgipiti, moka wa li omupika.
Nena Aaisraeli ayehe otaye shi uvu shoka sha ningwa po e taa tila, nokape na ngoka na longo we oshinima oshiwinayi sha tya ngaaka.”
“Oto vulu okuuva kutya moshilando shontumba mwaambyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te ku pe,
mokati keni omu na aalumentu yaamakaha mboka taa hekaheka aantu yomoshilando shawo okulongela ookalunga yalwe mboka inaamu ya tseya.
Shi konakona nokupulakena nawalela. Ngele oshoshili kutya iinima iinyanyalithi ya tya ngaaka oya ningwa mokati keni.
Nena dhipaga po aantu ayehe yomoshilando shoka niimuna yawo ayihe. Oshilando shi dhima po thilu.

Gongela omaliko agehe gaantu mboka ya kala mo e to ga ndumbile ondumba mehalandjandja lyoshilando. Fika po ihe oshilando naashihe shi li mo, shi ninge omudhidhindjambo kOmuwa Kalunga koye. Nashi ninge ondumba yomakulukuma aluhe sigo aluhe noitashi tungululwa we.
Ino ihupithila sha mushoka sha pangulilwa okudhimwa po, opo Omuwa a geyuluke e te ku sile ohenda. Ote ku etele olukeno e te ku indjipaleke, u ninge aantu oyendji, ngaashi u uvanekele oohokulu,
ngele to vulika kiipango ye ayihe mbyoka nde ku pe nena, e to ningi shoka shu uka momeho gOmuwa Kalunga koye.”
14: “One aantu yOmuwa Kalunga keni. Ngele tamu lili oosa, inamu ishata oonsha nenge mu ikulule omapalu momitse, ngaashi aantu yalwe haa ningi.
One oshigwana oshiyapuki, aantu yOmuwa Kalunga keni; okwe mu hogolola mu ninge ye mwene mokati kiigwana ayihe kombanda yevi.”
“Inamu lya sha shiihuna.
Iimuna mbyoka tamu vulu okulya, oyo mbika: ongombe, onzi, oshikombo,
ohumba, omenye, ompengu, etungu, oholongo, osino, okapundja.
Otamu vulu okulya iinamwenyo ayihe mbyoka yi na omakondo ga shandjuka nohayi ekeshele.

Ihe iinamwenyo yaa na omakondo ga shandjuka noihayi ekeshele, inayi liwa. Inamu lya oongamelo, uulimba nenge uundjele. Nayi talwe oyo iinamwenyo yoshipwe; ohayi ekeshele, ihe kayi na omakondo ga shandjuka.
Inamu lya iingulu. Nayi talwe oyi na oshipwe; oyi na omakondo ga shandjuka, ihe ihayi ekeshele. Inamu lya iinamwenyo ya tya ngaaka nenge mu gume omituntu dhayo.
“Otamu vulu okulya oohi adhihe ndhoka dhi na omilenge niipeta,
ihe ayihe mbyoka yi li momeya yaa na omilenge niipeta inamu yi lya; nayi talwe oyi na oshipwe.
“Otamu vulu okulya oondhila adhihe oondjelele.
Ihe moondhila inamu lya ndhika: ekodhi eluudhe, ekwatandimba, onkwalukwa,
embiimbili, oondhila oonkwakodhi,
omaludhi gomakola,
ompo, lumbamba, kakwaya, ookakodhi,
oshukutula, ehwiyu, kakulu,
onyundu, ontsa, ontyololola,
kandoko, omaludhi gomayamakalwa, dhepupu nelimalima.”
“Iipethipethi ayihe yomawawa oyi na oshidhila; inamu yi lya.”
Otamu vulu okulya iipethipethi ayihe ya yela.

“Inamu lya oshinamwenyo shi isila. Otamu vulu oku shi pa omukwiilongo ngoka a kala mokati keni, a lye, nenge otamu shi landitha po komuyeni. Ihe one oshigwana sha yapulilwa Omuwa Kalunga keni.
“Onyama yokanzona nenge yokakombwena inamu yi teleka momahini gayina.”
“Yoolola tuu oshitimulongo shaambyoka tayi zi momapya goye omumvo kehe.

Inda kehala ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li hogolola omo a longelelwe; omo moka koshipala she to lile oshitimulongo shiilya, shomaviinu noshomagadhi gooholivi dhoye nosheeli shongombe noshonzi yoye. Shi ninga, opo u nongele okusimaneka Omuwa Kalunga koye aluhe.
Ehala lyelongelokalunga ngele oli ku li kokule, opo u fale ko wa humbata oshitimulongo shaambyoka Omuwa e ku yambeke nayo, nena ninga ngeyi.
Landitha po iinima, ngoye u fale iimaliwa kehala lyelongelokalunga.
Yi landa po shoka wa hala — oongombe, oonzi, omaviinu nenge iikunwa yilwe — opo ihe oto ke yi lila mpeyaka koshipala shOmuwa Kalunga keni one noyaandjeni e tamu nyanyukwa.
“Ino ngunguninina Aalevi ya kala miilando yeni, oshoka kaye na oshitendelwa shevi lyawo yene.
Pehulilo lyomumvo omutitatu kehe eta oshitimulongo shiilya yoye ayihe e to yi pungula moshilando sheni.

Iilya mbika otayi ningi yAalevi, mboka kaaye na oshitendelwa shasha, yaakwiilongo, oothigwa naaselekadhi mboka ye li miilando yeni. Naye ye, ya hawale oompumbwe dhawo. Shi ninga, opo Omuwa Kalunga koye e ku yambeke mwaayihe to longo.”
15: “Momumvo omutiheyali ou na okudhima po oongunga dhaamboka ye ku hehelele iimaliwa.
Oto shi ningi ngeyi. Shaa ngoka a hehelelwe ongunga kumukwawo, ne yi dhime po. Ina kambadhala i ilikolele sha. Omuwa mwene ota dhimi po oongunga.
Oto pula ongunga komuyeni, ihe ino pula komukweni.
“Omuwa Kalunga koye ote ke ku yambeka mevi ndyoka te li ku pe. Moshigwana shoye itamu kala ohepele,
ngele oto vulika kOmuwa Kalunga koye e to gwanitha shili ayihe mbyoka tandi ku lombwele nena.
Omuwa ote ke ku yambeka, ngaashi u uvaneka. Oto ka pa iigwana oyindji oongunga, ihe ngoye ito pumbwa okuhehela sha kuyo. Oto ka pangela iigwana oyindji, ihe kape na oshigwana tashi ke ku pangela.”
“Pungoye ngele ope na ohepele, gumwe gwomooyakweni moshilando shimwe shomevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li ku pe, ino mu kukutikila omwenyo gwoye, neke lyoye ino li kamininina omumwanyoko ohepele.
Mu kamunukila eke lyoye noku mu pa nenyanyu shoka te ku yaala uuthigona.

Ino mu tindila shoka te ku indile, molwashoka omumvo ngoka oongunga hadhi dhimwa po gu li popepi. Ino pitika edhiladhilo lya tya ngeyi ewinayi li mene momwenyo gwoye. Ngele oto tindi okugandja ongunga, ota ka kugila ndje te ku tamaneke, noto humbata ondjo.
Mu pa nohokwe, nomwenyo gwoye gwaa kale noshizimbi, nge to mu pe, oshoka omolwashika Omuwa Kalunga koye ote ku yambeke miilonga yoye ayihe nomwaayihe mbyoka to yi ningi.
Oohepele itadhi pu mo moshilongo; omolwashoka tandi ku lombwele te ti: ‘Eke lyoye ou na oku li kamunukila mukweni omuthigona nohepele mevi lyoye.’ ”
“Ngele oku na Omuisraeli omukweni ti ilanditha po kungoye a ninge omupika, ou na oku mu mangulula, sho e ku longele omimvo hamano. Momumvo omutiheyali oto mu mangulula a ye.
Nonge to mu mangulula a ye, ino mu etha a ye niikaha yowala.
Mu pa meloolo ndyoka Omuwa e ku yambekele — oonzi, iilya nomaviinu.
Dhimbulukwa kutya owa li omupika muEgipiti, nOmuwa Kalunga koye okwe ku mangulula. Omolwashoka tandi ku pe oshipango shika.”
“Ihe ngele ote ku lombwele ta ti: ‘Inandi hala okuza po pungoye,’ molwashoka e ku hole negumbo lyoye noku uvite uutoye pungoye,
nena mu fala meelo lyegumbo lyoye e to mu ulula kokutsi noniho, nota kala omupika gwoye aluhe. Naapika yoye aakiintu osho to ya ningi ngaaka.
Ino kala u na olungwenye, uuna to laleke omupika; ndishi okwe ku longela omimvo hamano nondjambi yomulongeli lwaali nokuli. Shi gwanitha, nOmuwa Kalunga koye ote ke ku yambeka mwaayihe to yi ningi.”
“Yoololela Omuwa Kalunga koye iisheeli ayihe iilumentu yoongombe noyoonzi. Oongombe dha tya ngaaka ino dhi longitha, noonzi ndhoka ino dhi kulula.
Omumvo kehe ngoye naanegumbo lyoye omu na oku yi lila koshipala shOmuwa pehala ndyoka Omuwa e li hogolola.
Ihe ngele iinamwenyo oyi na oshipwe shasha, ngele iilema, iiposi nenge yi na oshipo shasha, ino yi yambela Omuwa Kalunga koye.
Iimuna ya tya ngaaka yi lila paandjeni. Ne amuhe, ongele aayogoki nenge mboka ye na oshidhila, otamu vulu oku yi lya, naanaa ngaashi onyama yomenye nenge yohumba.
Ihe ombinzi yayo inamu yi lya nando, nayi tilwehi pevi ya fa omeya.”
16: “Simaneka Omuwa Kalunga koye mokudhana Opaasa momwedhi Abib. Osha li uusiku momwedhi ngoka, sho e ku tembudha mo muEgipiti.
Inda kehala lyelongelokalunga, u dhipagele ko onzi yoye nenge ongombe, yi ninge uulalelo Opaasa okusimaneka Omuwa Kalunga koye.

Uuna to li uulalelo mbuka, ino lya oshikwiila sha tulwa efulika. Omasiku gaheyali oto li iikwiila inaayi tulwa efulika, ngaashi wa ningile sho wa tembuka muEgipiti meulumo enene. Lya oshikwiila shika — otashi ka lukwa oshikwiila shuuwehame — opo, manga u na omwenyo, u dhimbulukwe, uuna wa tembuka muEgipiti, ehala lyuuwehame.
Omasiku gaheyali kape na omuntu ta kala e na efulika mevi lyeni megumbo lye; nonyama yoshimuna sha dhipagwa ongulohi yesiku lyotango nayi liwe po uusiku tuu mboka.
“Onzigona yaPaasa yi dhipagela pehala lyelongelokalunga — nohashaa mpoka mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li ku pe. Shi ninga peningino lyetango, pethimbo ndyoka lyesiku wa tembuka mo muEgipiti.
Onyama yi paka po, u yi lile pehala lyelongelokalunga; nongula nge kwa shi, oto shuna kegumbo.
Omasiku gahamano taga landulathana oto li iikwiila inaayi tulwa efulika nomesiku etiheyali oto yi kelongelokalunga lyOmuwa Kalunga koye, noino longa esiku ndyoka.”
“Yalula iiwike iheyali okuza kesiku ndyoka wa tameke okuteya iilya yoye,
e to dhana Oshituthi shoshiwike, u simaneke Omuwa Kalunga koye noku mu etela omaganoyambo pamuthika ngoka e ku yambekele elikolo lyoye.
Kala wa nyanyukwa koshipala shOmuwa pamwe naamwoye, aapiya yoye, Aalevi, aakwiilongo, oothigwa naaselekadhi mboka ye li miilando yeni. Shi ningila pehala lyelongelokalunga.
Kotoka tuu u dhiginine iipango mbika. Ino dhimbwa tuu kutya owa li omupika muEgipiti.”
“Shaa wa yungula iilya yoye ayihe, nowa kolo oomviinu dhoye, dhana Oshituthi shomatsali giihwa iitalala omasiku gaheyali.
Shi nyanyukilwa pamwe naamwoye, aapiya yoye, Aalevi, aakwiilongo, oothigwa naaselekadhi mboka ya kala miilando yeni.
Simaneka Omuwa Kalunga koye nokudhana oshituthi shika omasiku gaheyali pehala lyelongelokalunga. Nyanyukwa, oshoka Omuwa okwa yambeka eteyo lyoye niilonga yoye.”

“Aalumentu ayehe yoshigwana shoye oye na okuya, ya galikane Omuwa Kalunga koye lutatu momumvo kehe pehala lyelongelokalunga: pOpaasa, Oshituthi shoshiwike nOshituthi shomatsali giihwa iitalala. Omulumentu kehe oku na okweeta omagano,
ngaashi ta vulu pamuthika ngoka Omuwa Kalunga koye e mu yambekele elikolo lye.”
“Langeka aatokolihapu naambala yalwe miilando ayihe mbyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te ku pe. Aalumentu mboka oye na okutokola oohapu dhaantu pwaa na ondhipi.
Kaye na okupilika uuyuuki nenge ya holole ondhipi; kaye na okutaamba oombumbo, oshoka iisimpo ohayi tsikitha omeho gaanandunge nohayi pilike oohapu dhaakaanandjo.
Kala aluhe omunashili nomuyuuki, opo u ka lale evi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li ku pe, u kale mo.
“Ngele to tungile Omuwa Kalunga koye oshiyambelo, pooha dhasho ino tsika po omiti dhiiyelekela yoshikalungakiintu Asheera.
Ino dhika ongundhimanya yoshikalunga, Omuwa ohe yi tondo.”
17: “Omuwa Kalunga ino mu yambela ongombe nenge onzi ndjoka yi na oshipo; Omuwa ohe yi tondo.
“Oto vulu okukundana kutya miilando yeni omu na omulumentu nenge omukiintu ta ningi shoka inaashi uka koshipala shOmuwa Kalunga koye nota taaguluka ehangano lye,
sho ta simaneke nokulongela iikalunga nenge etango nenge omwedhi nenge oonyothi, nando onde shi indika.
Ngele oto kundana ehokololo lya tya ngaaka, nena li konakona nawa. Ngele oshoshili kutya iinima mbika iinyanyalithi oya ningwa muIsrael,
nena fala omuntu ngoka pondje yoshilando e to mu dhipaga nomamanya.
Ota dhipagwa ashike, ngele ope na oonzapo mbali nenge odhindji tadhi mu tompo; ita dhipagwa, ngele ope na owala onzapo yimwe ayike.
Oonzapo otadhi mu dhaadhiga tango nomamanya, opo ihe aantu ayehe otaa dhipaga omuntu ngoka; pahedhi ndjika oto dhimi po uuwinayi.

“Ngele iinima yimwe tayi ku dhigupalele oku yi tokola ngaashi oontamanana dhuumwene womaliko nenge omaehameko golutu nenge okuyoolola pokati kedhipago lyowina naandyoka lyaa shi lyowina, inda kehala lyelongelokalunga lya hogololwa kOmuwa Kalunga koye,
tula omukundu gwoye miikaha yaayambi Aalevi noyomutokolihapu ngoka e li miilonga pethimbo ndyoka, opo ye ku tseyithile etokolo moshinima shoka.
Otaa gandja etokolo lyawo, nangoye ou na okuninga naanaa shoka taa ti.
Taamba epangulo lyawo nokuninga naanaa patokolo ndyoka taye li ku tseyithile.
Shaa ngoka ta ningi oshityani ye ita vulika komutokolihapu nenge komuyambi gwomiilonga, na dhipagwe po; pahedhi ndjika oto kutha mo uuwinayi muIsrael.
Opo shaa ngoka te shi uvu, ota tila, nokape na ngoka te ke shi yelekela we.”
“Ngele to ka thika mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li ku pe, e to li lala, oto ka dhiladhila kutya oto pumbwa omukwaniilwa ngaashi iigwana ayihe ye ku kunduka yi na aakwaniilwa.
Kala u shi shi kutya omuntu ngoka to mu hogolola a ninge omukwaniilwa, oye ngoka ta hogololwa kOmuwa Kalunga koye. Na kale tuu gwomaakweni; omukwiilongo ino mu ninga omukwaniilwa.
Omukwaniilwa ina kala e na uukambe owindji wetangakwiita, noke na okutuma aantu kuEgipiti ya ka lande uukambe, oshoka Omuwa okwa ti, aantu ye inaa shuna we kuEgipiti.
Omukwaniilwa ina kala e na aanyekadhi oyendji, oshoka shika otashi mu pilamenitha Omuwa; ini ilikolela iisiliveli niingoli oyindjiyindji.
Uuna ta kwaniilekwa, na nyolithe oshifeka shembo lyompango ndjika sha kuthwa membo lyompango lya dhigininwa kaayambi Aalevi.
Embo ndika na kale nalyo ta lesha mo mokukalamwenyo kwe akuhe, opo i ilonge okutila Omuwa Kalunga ke nokudhiginina oohapu adhihe dhompango ndjika nomautho ngaka.

Shika otashi mu keelele kuuntsa, i itale kutya ye omwaanawa e vule Aaisraeli ooyakwawo, nokokwaavulika kiipango yOmuwa pahedhi kehe. Nena ota lele omimvo odhindji, noluvalo lwe otalu lele Israel omapipi ogendji.”
18: “Ezimo lyaLevi lyuuyambi itali taamba oshitopolwa shevi muIsrael; otali kala hali hupu koondjambo nomagano galwe ngoka ga yambelwa Omuwa.
Kaye na oshitendelwa shevi lyawo yene ngaashi omazimo omakwawo. Omuwa oye mwene oshipewa shawo, ngaashi u uvaneka.
“Shaa ngoka ta yamba ongombe nenge onzi, oku na okupa aayambi oshooko, oondjego nela.
Oye na okupewa oshipe shiilya, shomaviinu, shomagadhi gooholivi noshomafufu goonzi.
Momazimo geni agehe Omuwa okwa hogolola mo ezimo lyaLevi, li kale lyaayambi ye mu longele aluhe sigo aluhe.”
“Omulevi kehe ngoka a hala okuza moshilando kehe muIsrael ta yi kehala lyelongelokalunga,
ota vulu okuyakula nkoka Omuwa Kalunga ke miilonga yuuyambi, a fa Aalevi mboka taa yakula ko.
Oku na okupewa iipalutha yi thike pumbyoka yaayambi yalwe, nando na kale a thigulula sha meliko lyezimo lyahe.”
“Nge to ka ya mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li ku pe, ino landula omikalo dhi nyanyalitha dhiigwana mbyoka ya kala mo.
Ino yamba aamwoye omafikilondjambo kiiyambelo; ino pitika aantu yoye ya nonome nenge ya anekele, ya kale nuumpulile nenge ya lye omayuku,
ya tikile nenge ya pule iihehelela, oombepo dhuumpulile nenge aathithi.
Omuwa Kalunga koye oha tondo aantu mboka haa ningi iinima mbika iinyanyalithi, nomolwashoka te ku tidhitha mo iigwana mbyoka mevi.
Kala waa na ondjo yasha koshipala shOmuwa Kalunga koye.”
Moses okwa ti: “Iigwana mbyoka to ka tidha mo, ohayi pulakene aayanekeli noompulile, ihe Omuwa Kalunga koye ite ku pitika, u ninge ngaaka.
Ote ku tumine omuhunganeki a fa ndje ta zi mokati kooyakweni; oye mu na oku mu pulakena.
“Mesiku ndiyaka wa li pondundu Sinai, owa galikana, waa uve Omuwa ta popi ishewe nenge u mu tale momulilo, oshoka wa li wa tila, opo waa se.
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: ‘Oya popi dhu uka.
Otandi ke ya pa omuhunganeki e ku fa ta zi maantu yawo yene; otandi ka tula oohapu dhandje mokana ke, oye nota ka lombwela aantu ayihe mbyoka tandi ti.
Ota ka popya medhina lyandje, notandi ka geela shaa ngoka ta tindi okuvulika kuye.
Ngele oku na omuhunganeki ta fulu oohapu medhina lyandje ngame inaandi mu lombwela e shi ninge, otashi mu dhipagitha, osho wo omuhunganeki kehe ta popi medhina lyiikalunga.’
“Oto vulu okwiipopila momutima gwoye to ti: ‘Otatu tseya ngiini oohapu ndhoka Omuwa inee dhi popya?’
Ndhindhilika uuna omuhunganeki ta popi medhina lyOmuwa, naashoka a ti ngele inashi gwanithwa, nena inashi za kOmuwa. Omuhunganeki ta popi paye mwene, ino mu tila.”
19: “Omuwa Kalunga koye ngele a hanagula po iigwana yevi ndyoka te ke li ku pa, nangoye ngele wa lala iilando nomagumbo gawo nowa tula mo.
Topola evi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te ke li ku pa, miitopolwa itatu. Moshitopolwa kehe yoolola oshilando shimwe shopokati, moka omuntu ta vulu okuholama, ngele a dhipaga mukwawo.
Ngele omuntu ta dhipaga mukwawo hanowina ye ke shi omutondi gwe, ota vulu okumatukila mushimwe shomiilando mbika, a holame.

Ngaashika ando aantu yaali taa yi mokuti ya ka komangele omiti, ndele gumwe ta keke omuti, ekuya e tali hukuka ko e tali dhipaga mukwawo, ota vulu okumatukila kushimwe shomiilando mbika itatu e ta hupu.

Ngele oku na owala oshilando shimwe, noshinano oshile noonkondo, omukwawo gwanakudhipagwa ngoka te mu galulile iikonene yokudhipaga, ote mu kwata nomondjahi ota dhipaga omukeenandjo. Ndishi shika oshiponga, sho omuntu a dhipaga mukwawo ngoka a li kee shi omutondi gwe.
Omolwashoka tandi ku lombwele, wi iyoololele iilando itatu.
“Omuwa Kalunga koye ngele ta taandelitha oshilongo, ngaashi a lombwele oohokulu kutya ote shi ningi note ku pe evi alihe e li uvaneka,
ihogololela tuu natango iilando itatu. (Ote ke ku pa evi ndika, ngele oto gwanitha ayihe mbyoka tandi ku lombwele nena ndjika nongele ou hole Omuwa Kalunga koye e to ende pamalongo ge.)
Shi ninga, opo aantu aakaanandjo yaa se nowaa kale u na ondjo yoku ya dhipaga mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li ku pe.
“Ihe ngele oku na ngoka e tonde mukwawo e te mu langele note mu dhipaga owina e ta ka holama mushimwe shomiilando mbika itatu,
nena aakuluntu yoshilando she naye mu tume ko a ze ko notaye mu gandja miikaha yanakupula ombinzi, opo e mu dhipage.
Ino mu sila ohenda. Kutha Israel momadhipagathano, opo u kale u na elago.”
“Ino lundulula ongamba yamushiinda shoye ndjoka ya tendwa nalenale koohokulu mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te ke li ku pa.”
“Onzapo yimwe ayike inayi gwana okutompitha omuntu moontamanana, shila ongele oonzapo dhi li po mbali nenge ndatu dhi holole kutya omuntu omusama.
Ngele ope na omuntu te ehameke mukwawo te mu etele ondjo yiifundja nenge uusama,
ayehe yaali naa ye kehala lyelongelokalunga e taa tokolwa kaayambi naatokolihapu mboka ye li moshilonga.
Aatokolihapu naa konakone oshinima nawa, nongele omuntu okwa ningi onzapo yiifundja okutamaneka mukwawo,
na geelwe negeelo ndyoka lya li li na okugeelwa mukwawo a lundilwa. Pahedhi ndjika oto kombo po uuwinayi mbuka.
Nena ayehe taye shi kundana, otaa tila nokape na we ngoka ta ka halela mukwawo uuwinayi u thike mpoka.
Miinima ya tya ngeyi ino kala nando u na ohenda; egeelo nali kale tuu omwenyo omomwenyo, eho omeho, eyego omeyego, oshikaha omoshikaha nompadhi omompadhi.”
20: “Ngele to ka hinga iita, u kondjithe aatondi yoye e to mono omatembakwiita nuukambe naakwiita oyendji ye ku vule, ino ya tila. Omuwa Kalunga koye, ngoka e ku tembudha mo muEgipiti, oku li pamwe nangoye.
Manga inaamu tameka ehomono, omuyambi na holoke komeho e ta popitha aantu ta ti:
‘Aaisraeli ne, pulakeneni! Ngashingeyi otamu ka homona. Inamu tila aatondi yeni nenge mu kanithe omukumo nenge mu piyagane.
Omuwa Kalunga keni ote ende pamwe nane e te mu pe esindano.’

“Opo ihe omalenga otaga lombwele aantu taga ti: ‘Pamwe ope na omuntu opo a tungu egumbo ye ine li yapula natango. Nongele osho, na shune kaandjawo. Ota ningi a dhipagelwe molugodhi, negumbo tali ka yapulwa kugulwe.

Pamwe ope na omuntu opo a tsike oshitsambe shomiviinu, ihe ina likola mo manga omandjembele gasho. Ngele osho ngaaka, na ye kegumbo. Ota ningi a ka dhipagelwe molugodhi, nagulwe ta ka nyanyukilwa omaviinu ngoka.
Pamwe ope na omuntu i ipyakidhila nohango e na omufuko. Ngele osho ngaaka, na ye kegumbo. Ota ningi a dhipagelwe molugodhi, nagulwe ta ka hokana po omufuko gwe.’
“Omalenga oge na ishewe okulombwela aantu taga ti: ‘Pamwe ope na omuntu e na uumbanda nokwa sholola. Ngele osho ngaaka, na ye kegumbo ota ningi a shoshomeke aantu.’
Omalenga sho ga mana okupopitha aantu, oondjayi dhiita nadhi tulwe komeho gaantu.
“Manga inoo ponokela oshilando shontumba, tango shi pa ompito yokwiigandja kungoye.
Ngele otaye egulula omiyelo notayi igandja, ayehe oye na okuninga aapika yoye notaye ku longele.
Ihe aantu yomoshilando shoka ngele itayi igandja, oya hala okukondja, shi kondeka netangakwiita lyoye.
Omuwa Kalunga koye ngele okwe ku pe po oshilando, dhipaga aalumentu yamo ayehe.
Yuga po aakulukadhi, aanona niimuna naashihe shi li moshilando. Oto vulu okulongitha eliko lyaatondi yoye alihe ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li ku pe.
Iilando ayihe mbyoka yi li kokule noshilongo shoye, osho to yi ningi ngaaka.
“Ihe uuna to kwata po iilando mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li ku pe, dhipaga omuntu kehe.
Aantu ayehe ya dhima po thilu: Aaheti, Aayamori, Aakaanana, Aaperesi, Aahevi nAayebusi, ngaashi Omuwa a ti nashi ningwe.
Ya dhipaga po, opo yaa ku yonithe kOmuwa, sho taye ku longo iinonoma yawo yiihuna mbyoka haa ningi mokusaagela iikalunga yawo.
“Ngele to kambadhala okukwata po oshilando, omiti dhasho dhiiyimati ino dhi keka po, nando shi kale ethimbo ele mekondeka lyoye. Lya iiyimati, ino keka po omiti; omiti kadhi shi aatondi yoye.
Oto vulu okukomangela po omiti ndhoka hadhi imi iiyimati ihaayi liwa, opo u dhi dhike mekondeka lyoshilando, sigo sha kwatwa po.”
21: “Pamwe otaku monika omuntu a dhipagelwa melundu mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li ku pe, ngoye waa shi wo ngoka e mu dhipaga.
Aawiliki naatokolihapu yoye naa ye ko ya yeleke oshinano okuza mpoka pu na omudhimba sigo okiilando mbyoka yi li popepi.
Aawiliki yoshilando shoka shi li popepi naampoka pwa monika omudhimba, oyo naa hogolole ondema yongombe inaayi longithwa sha.
Naye yi fale kesilu hali tondoka omeya, ihe mooha dhalyo inamu pululwa mo inamu kunwa sha. Oko naye yi teyele othingo hoka.
Aayambi Aalevi oye na okuya ko wo, oshoka oyo ye na okutokola iinima ayihe yoontamanana noyomaponokelo. Omuwa Kalunga koye okwe ya hogolola ye mu longele noya tumbulile aantu omayambeko medhina lye.
Aawiliki ayehe ya za moshilando shi li popepi nehala ndyoka omuntu a dhipagelwa, naa yogele iikaha yawo kombanda yondema
e taa ti: ‘Tse inatu dhipaga omuntu nguka, tse katu shi ngoka e mu dhipaga.
Omuwa, dhimina po aantu yoye Aaisraeli, mboka we ya mangulula muEgipiti. Tu dhimina po ngoye ino tu tala tu na ondjo yedhipago lyomuntu nguka kee na ondjo.’
Ano mokuninga shoka sho opalela Omuwa ito kala we u na ondjo yedhipago.”
“Uuna Omuwa Kalunga koye te ku pe esindano molugodhi e to kwata oonkwatwa,
mokati kawo oto vulu okumona mo esingi noto mu hokwa wa hala oku mu hokana.
Mu kutha u mu fale kaandjeni, nkoka ta kulula omutse gwe nokuteta oonyala dhe
e ta lundulula oonguwo dhe. Ota kala ihe maandjeni e ta lili he nayina uule womwedhi; konima yaambika oto vulu oku mu hokana.
Komeho ngele nani ino mu hala we, mu etha a ye. Ino mu landitha po ngoye ino mu pika, oshoka owa lala naye.”
“Ngele oku na omulumentu e na aakiintu yaali naayehe taye mu valele aamati, ihe nani osheeli kashi shi omuna gwomuholike gwe, ogwaanguka kee holike unene,
omusamane mokutopolela oyana eliko lye, ina pa nando omuna gwomuholike gwe oshindji, a tondole osheeli koshitopolelwa she shuusheeli.
Osheeli ne shi pe lwaali, nando inashi valwa komuholike gwe. Omusamane oku na okutunda osheeli e te shi pe oshipewa she shi sheyelwa.”
“Ngele oku na omuntu e na omwanamati omutangalali nomulunduki, ngoka ihaa vulika kuhe nayina, nando naye mu geele,
he nayina naye mu fale koshipala shaawiliki yoshilando shaandjawo posheelo shoshilando.
Naa lombwele aawiliki yoshilando taa ti: ‘Omumwetu nguka omutangalali nomulunduki ta tindi okuvulika kutse; oye omuntu omuhanaguli nonkolwi.’
Nena aantu yomoshilando naye mu dhipage nomamanya, nosho ngaaka to dhimi mo uuwinayi. Aantu ayehe muIsrael otaye ke shi kundana e taa tila.”
“Momuntu ngele omu na ombedhi onene yoku mu dhipagitha e ta tulwa kohake,

omudhimba gwe inagu endjelela komuti sigo ongulohi. Nagu fumvikwe esiku ndyoka, oshoka ngoka e endjelela momuti, okwa thingwa kuKalunga. Fumvika omudhimba, opo waa nyateke evi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li ku pe.”
22: “Ngele to mono ongombe nenge onzi yamukweni ya kana, yi galula e to yi shuna kumwene.
Mwene ngele oku li kokule nenge ku mu shi, nena yi fala kaandjeni. Uuna mwene gwayo te yi kongo, yi mu pa.
Osho wo ninga, ngele owa mono okasino, oonguwo nenge shaa shoka shilwe mukweni a kanitha.”
“Ngele okasino nenge ongombe yamukweni ya gundila mondjila, ino mu holama. Mu kwatha mu yi tumbe po, yi thikame ishewe.”
“Aakiintu inaa zala omizalo dhoshilumentu, naalumentu inaa zala omizalo dhoshikiintu; Omuwa Kalunga koye oha tondo aantu haa ningi iinima ya tya ngaaka.
“Ngele ou li mondjila e to itsu oshihandhila momuti, nenge pevi pu na omvugo nondhila yu utumanena uunimona nenge omayi, ino kutha po yina nuunimona wayo.
Oto vulu okukutha po uudhilona, ihe yina yi etha yi ye, opo ngoye u kale nelago nonomwenyo omule.”
“Ngele to tungu ongulu ompe, kontala yayo tungila ko omushigo, opo waa etele egumbo lyoye ondjo yombinzi, ngele gulwe ta gu ko e ta si.”
“Moshitsambe shoye shomiviinu ino kuna mo oombuto dhomaludhi gaali. Ngele oto shi ningi, owa keelelwa okulongitha omaludhi agehe gaali, omandjembele noshilikolwa shoka shilwe.”
“Ino kutila onani nokasino kondjoko yimwe mepululo.”
“Ino zala onguwo ya tungwa momafufu goonzi noliina mumwe.”
“Itungila oondjendjelela dhi endjelele koonkotso ne dhomuzalo gwoye.”
“Ngele oku na omulumentu ta hokana omukiintu e ta lala naye, ndele te mu kunyukwa
te mu lundile nokutaandelitha oohapu oombwinayi ta ti: ‘Onda hokana omukiintu nguka, ihe sho nda yi kuye, ine mona uukadhona we,’
nena he nayina naa kuthe endhindhiliko lyuukadhona we e taye li fala koompangu kaawiliki yoshilando.
He yomukadhona ota ti kuyo: ‘Onda gandja omumwandjekadhona komulumentu nguka a ninge omukadhi, ihe okwe mu tondo.

Okwe mu lundile oohapu dhiifundja ta ti, ka li omukadhona, sho e mu hokana, ihe mpaka ope na endhindhiliko tali holola kutya omumwandjekadhona okwa li shili omukadhonalela.’ Oyo notaa yala onguwo komeho gaawiliki.
Nena aawiliki yoshilando naa kuthe omuntu ngoka e taye mu dhenge.

Naye mu futithe iimaliwa iisiliveli ethele, niimaliwa mbika otaye yi pe he yomukadhona, oshoka omuntu ngoka okwe etele omukadhona Omuisraeli ohoni. Ota ningi omukadhi sigo aluhe, noita vulu oku mu henga po omasiku ge agehe, manga e na omwenyo.
“Ihe ngele omufuko oku na uusama, noinapu monika endhindhiliko kutya oye omukadhonalela,
na falwe keelo lyaandjahe, nkoka aalumentu yomoshilando taye mu dhipagele nomamanya. Okwa ningi esithahoni muIsrael, sho a hondelelwa maandjahe. Pahedhi ndjika oto dhimi po uuwinayi wa tya ngaaka.
“Ngele oku na omulumentu ta kwatwa moluhondelo a lala nomukiintu gwamukwawo, ayehe yaali naa dhipagwe. Osho ngeyi to kombo mo uuwinayi muIsrael.
“Ngele oku na omukiintu a yalekwa kumwene, nomuntu gulwe te mu tsakaneke moshilando e ta lala naye,

nena ayehe yaali ya faleni keelo lyoshilando e tamu ya dhipaga nomamanya. Omukiintu na dhipagwe, oshoka okwa li e na okukuga onkugo moshilando, nomulumentu, oshoka okwa lala nomuyalekwa gwamukwawo. Osho ngeyi to kombo po uuwinayi mokati keni.
“Ngele oku na omulumentu ta adha omukadhona a yalekwa e li melundu, e te mu kwata nokulala naye, omulumentu ngoka a lala naye, oye awike na se.
Ihe omukadhona ina ningwa sha, ke na ondjo yokusa. Shika osha fa owala omuntu a ponokelwa kumukwawo e te mu dhipaga.
Omulumentu okwe mu tsakaneke melundu, omukadhona omuyalekwa okwa kugu, ihe kakwa li ngoka a tondoka onkugo ye.
“Ngele oku na omulumentu ta adha omukadhona ngoka inaa yalekwa, e te mu kwata nokulala naye e taa adhikilila,
nena omulumentu ngoka a lala naye oku na okufuta he yomukadhona iimaliwa iisiliveli omilongo ntano noku na oku mu hokana po, oshoka okwe mu kwata koonkondo. Na kale itee mu henge po sigo aluhe.
“Hamulumentu ta hokana omukiintu gwahe, opo kaa sithe he ohoni.”
23: “Omulumentu a tetwa uulumentu nenge a thelekenywa omatondo, ita kala mo megongalo lyOmuwa.
“Omuntu gwoombinzi mbali ita vulu okukala megongalo lyOmuwa, nokuli oluvalo lwe olutimulongo italu vulu okukala megongalo lyOmuwa.
“Omuammoni nenge Omumoabi ke na okukala megongalo lyOmuwa, nando oluvalo lwepipi etimulongo.
Oya tindi oku ku yakula niikulya nomeya, sho wa li mondjila to zi kuEgipiti, noya futu Bileam yaBeor gwokoshilando Petor muMesopotamia, e ku lye muumpulile.
Ihe Omuwa Kalunga koye ina pulakena Bileam, peha lyoku ku thinga okwe ku laleke nuuyamba, oshoka oku ku hole.
Aluhe sigo aluhe ino ninga sha tashi kwatha iigwana mbika okumona elago.
“Ino nyanyala Aaedom, oshoka oyo aakweni. Ino dhina Aayegipiti; owa li mevi lyawo.
Epipi etitatu lyoluvalo lwawo otali vulu okukala megongalo lyOmuwa.”
“Uuna u li montanda pethimbo lyiita, ou na okukutha po ashihe shoka tashi ku nyateke.
Ngele omulumentu okwa nyata, molwaashoka okwa hiha omasita goluvalo uusiku, na pite mo a ye pondje yontanda.
Lwokomatango ni iyoge, nopeningino lyetango ota vulu okuya montanda.”
“Ou na okukala u na ehala pondje yontanda, nkoka to ka hundama.
Kala u na okapani, opo nge wa yi kondje u fulile oonyata dhoye.
Dhiginina uuyogoki wontanda, oshoka Omuwa Kalunga koye oku li pungoye montanda, e ku gamene noku ku pa esindano okusinda aatondi yoye. Ino ninga esithahoni lyasha tali pilamenitha Omuwa kungoye.”
“Omupika ngele okwa yi mwene gwe ontuku e te ya, a konge egameno kungoye, ino mu shunitha.”
Na kale mushimwe shomiilando yoye shoka a hogolola; ngoye ino mu ninga onyanya.
“Aakadhona aana yAaisraeli inaa ninga oohonda dhiikalunga, naamati inaa kala aasithahoni.
Mokugwanitha euvaneko lyoye ino yambela Omuwa iimaliwa ya za miihuna yoluhondelo. Oyo iikungitha koshipala shOmuwa.
“Ino pula Omuisraeli omukweni ontanitho kiimaliwa nenge elikolo kiikulya nenge sha shilwe sha hehelwa.

Omukwiilongo oto vulu oku mu pula ontanitho kiimaliwa ya hehelwa, ihe omukweni ino yi mu pula. Vulika keutho ndika, nOmuwa Kalunga koye ote ku yambeke mwaayihe mbyoka to ningi mevi ndyoka to ke li lala.
“Ngele to uvanekele sha Omuwa Kalunga koye, ino shelelelwa okugwanitha shoka wu uvaneke; Omuwa ota tegelele euvaneko lyoye, notashi ningi ondjo, ngele ino li gwanitha.
Kayi shi ondjo, ngele ito uvaneke sha,
ihe ngele oto uvaneke sha pahalo lyoye mwene, nena gwanitha shili euvaneko lyoye.”
“Uuna to ende mepola moshitsambe shamukweni, oto vulu okulya omandjembele agehe wa hala, ihe ito vulu oku ga tula mompunda yoye u ye nago.
Uuna to ende mepola mepya lyamukweni, oto vulu okupolola omaha u lye, ihe ito vulu okumwa po iilya yaantu noshimwitho.”
24: Natu tye omuntu ota hokana omukiintu e te mu kunyukwa, molwashoka a mono muye ombedhi yasha. Ota nyola onzapo yehengo e te yi mu pe noku mu laleka mo megumbo lye.
Omukiintu ngoka ota hokanwa kugulwe,
naanguka wo ote mu si uunye, ta nyola onzapo yehengo, te yi mu pe noku mu laleka mo megumbo lye; nenge omulume nguka ota mana oondjenda.

Nena omulumentu gwe gwotango ita vulu we oku mu hokanununa, ihe oku mu tala a nyata. Ngele ote mu hokanununa, shoka otashi ningi ondjo momeho gOmuwa. Ino longa iihuna ya tya ngaaka mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li ku pe.
“Omulumentu ngele opo a hokana, ita pumbwa okuya kiita nenge kiilonga yuupyakadhi ulwe; na manguluke kuupyakadhi kehe omumvo gumwe, opo a wape okukala pegumbo a nyanyudhe omukadhi.”
“Kape na ngoka ta kutha po oshini ombambyona, oshoka oshini osho hashi tsilwa iilyamwenyo gwomuntu.
“Ngele ope na ngoka ta kwata Omuisraeli omukwawo, e mu ninge omupika gwe nenge e mu landithe po muupika, na dhipagwe. Komba po uuwinayi mokati keni.”
“Uuna to adhika kuuvu woshilundu, kotoka u ninge shili, ngaashi aayambi Aalevi taye ku lombwele. Dhiginina nawa omapukululo ngoka nde ge ya pa.
Dhimbulukwa Omuwa Kalunga koye shoka a ningile Miriam mondjila yokutembuka kweni muEgipiti.”
“Ngele owa hehelelwe sha kumukweni, ino ya maandjawo, u kwate po ekumbyatha lye ombambyona;
tegelela pondje, e li ete kungoye ye mwene.
Ngele oye ohepele, ino kala nalyo sigo ongulohi;
li shunitha kuye ongulohi kehe, e ki isiikile nalyo. Nena ota pandula, nOmuwa Kalunga koye ote ku yambeke.
“Ino kotokela nakufutwa ohepele nomukweyi, ongele Omuisraeli omukweni nenge omukwiilongo a kala miilando yoye.
Mu futa ondjambi ye esiku kehe, manga etango inaali ningina; ota pumbwa iimaliwa noku na etegameno kutya ote ke yi pewa. Ngele ito mu futu, ota kugile Omuwa onkugo, notashi ku ningile ondjo.”
“Aakuluntu inaa dhipagelwa oondjo dhoyana, noyana inaa dhipagelwa oondjo dhahe. Shaa ngoka na dhipagelwe iipogo ye mwene.
“Ino goyokitha uuthemba waakwiilongo nowoothigwa, nekumbyatha lyomuselekadhi ino li kwata po ombambyona.
Dhimbulukwa tuu kutya owa li omupika muEgipiti, nOmuwa Kalunga koye okwe ku mangulula; omolwashoka tandi ku pe oshipango shika.
“Uuna to teya iilya yoye, e to dhimbwa ondudhi yimwe mepya, ino ya ko we, u ke yi tale ko; nayi ninge yaakwiilongo, yoothigwa noyaaselekadhi, opo Omuwa Kalunga koye e ku yambeke mwaayihe to yi ningi.
Ngele to shopola ko ooholivi dhoye, ino kutha ko nomakukila; naga ninge gaakwiilongo, goothigwa nogaaselekadhi.
Nge to likola omandjembele goye, omuviinu ino gu sinasina thiluthilu; omandjembele ngoka taga kala po, naga ninge gaakwiilongo, goothigwa nogaaselekadhi.
Dhimbulukwa tuu kutya owa li omupika muEgipiti, nomolwashoka tandi ku pe oshipango shika.”
25: “Ngele Aaisraeli yaali otaa tamanana e taa yi koompangu, nagumwe ta monika kee na ondjo namukwawo omunandjo,
omunandjo ngele ota dhengwa, omutokolihapu ne mu langeke egombe ye e mu dhengithe. Omwaalu gwomadhengo nagu faathanithwe nondjo ndjoka e na.
Ina dhengwa oongola dhi vule omilongo ne, opo kaa sithwe ohoni koshipala shoye.”
“Ino manga okana konani ndjoka tayi yungula nokulyatagulithwa iilya molupale.”
“Ngele ope na omuntu namumwayina ya kalathana puushiinda, nagumwe gwomuyo ta si inaa vala omumati, omukiintu gwanakusa ina hokanwa kaayeni, suwala ye ne mu kuthe po, e mu hokane po.
Omunona gwotango omumati ota ka yalulwa omuna gwanakusa, opo ezimo lye li kale po muIsrael.

Ihe omumwayina gwanakusa ngele ina hala e mu kuthe po, nena omukiintu ota yi kaawiliki yoshilando e ta ti: ‘Suwala yandje ina hala a gwanithe oshinakugwanithwa she; okwa tinda okupa omumwayina oluvalo mokati kAaisrael.’
Nena aawiliki yoshilando oye na okwiithana omulumentu ngoka, ye mu popithe. Ngele natango ota tindi okuhokana suwala ye,
omuselekadhi na ye kuye montaneho yaawiliki, ta kutha po olukaku lwe noku mu hiyila omayeye moshipala ta ti: ‘Osho ngaaka tashi ningilwa omuntu ngoka ta tindi okupa omumwayina oluvalo.’
Ezimo lye muIsrael otali ka tseyika ‘ezimo lyomuntu a hulwa olukaku.’ ”
“Ngele oku na aalumentu yaali taa kondjo, nomukulukadhi gwagumwe gwaambaka taa kondjo te ya a popile omulume nomoku shi ninga ta kwata ngwiyaka komatondo,
ina silwa nando ohenda; oshikaha she nashi tetwe ko.
“Ino kotokela mokulongitha iiyelekitho yiifundja yuudhigu nenge yiipindomwa.
Longitha oomasandjundo dhi shi kwiinekelwa, opo u kale u na omwenyo omule mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li ku pe.
Omuwa oha tondo aantu mboka haa kotokele.”
“Dhimbulukwa shoka Aayamaleki ye ku ningile, sho wa li mondjila to zi muEgipiti.
Oya li inaa tila Kalunga noye ku kaakene, sho wa li wa vulwa nowa nkundipala, e taa dhipaga ayehe mboka ya li monima taa ende taa gaganyata.

Onkee ano shampa Omuwa Kalunga koye e ku pe evi ndyoka nokwe ku gamene kaatondi yoye ayehe mboka ye ku kunduka, dhipaga po Aayamaleki ayehe, opo pwaa kale ngoka te ya dhimbulukwa we kombanda yevi. Ino shi dhimbwa tuu!”
26: “Ngele wa kwata po evi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te li ku pe e to tula mo,
tula oshipe shiilikolwa yoye ayihe montungwa e to yi nayo kehala lyelongelokalunga.

Inda komuyambi ngoka e li miilonga pethimbo ndyoka e to mu lombwele to ti: ‘Ngashingeyi ngame otandi koleke koshipala shOmuwa Kalunga kandje kutya onde ya mevi ndyoka e li uvanekele ootatekulu te li tu pe.’
“Omuyambi ota kutha po ontungwa pungoye e te yi tula komeho goshiyambelo shOmuwa Kalunga koye.

Tangumuna ihe koshipala shOmuwa Kalunga koye to ti: ‘Tatekulu okwa li Omuaramea ondjendi nokwa yi kuEgipiti negumbo lye a kale ko. Oya li aashona momwaalu, sho ya yi ko, ihe oyi indjipala noya ningi oshigwana oshinankondo.
Aayegipiti oye tu ningi onyanya noye tu thiminikile iilonga yuupika.
Nena otwa kugile Omuwa Kalunga kootatekulu onkugo. Okwe tu uvu e ta mono uuwehame, uudhigu nuukweyi wetu.
Okwe tu tembudha mo muEgipiti noshikaha she shoonkondo nokwooko kwa taganana. Okwa longo iilongandhindhiliko niinyengandunge niitilithilonga ya ningwa.
Okwe tu eta huka e te tu pe evi ndika lya tondoka omahini nomagadhi goonyushi.

Onkee ngashingeyi onde etele Omuwa oshipe shiilikolwa yevi e li pe ndje.’
“Tula ihe ontungwa koshipala shOmuwa e to galikana.
Nyanyukilwa iinima ayihe iiwanawa Omuwa Kalunga koye e yi ku pe negumbo lyoye; nyanyudha wo Aalevi naakwiilongo mboka ye li pungoye.”

“Omumvo omutitatu kehe ogwo omumvo gwoshitimulongo. Gandja oshitimulongo shiilya yoye ayihe kAalevi, kaakwiilongo, koothigwa nokaaselekadhi yomiilando yoye, opo ya mone iipalutha noya kute. Ngele wa ningi ngeyi,

tya kOmuwa Kalunga koye: ‘Onda kutha megumbo lyandje oshitimulongo ashihe oshiyapuki nonde shi pa Aalevi, aakwiilongo, oothigwa naaselekadhi, ngaashi wa pa ndje oshipango ndi shi ninge. Kombinga yoshitimulongo inandi yona kiipango yoye nenge ndi yi dhimbwe.

Ine lya sha shomusho, sho nda li moluhodhi; ine kutha mo sha maandjetu, sho nda li nda nika oshidhila; noinandi gandja mo sha shi ninge ondjambo yoonakusa. Onda vulika kungoye, Omuwa; onda gwanitha ashihe wa popi kombinga yoshitimulongo.
Tu taalela megulu, monkalelo yoye ondjapuki, u yambeke aantu yoye Aaisraeli; yambeka wo evi ndika lya tondoka omahini nomagadhi goonyushi, ndyoka we li tu pe, ngaashi u uvanekele ootatekulu.’
“Nena ndjika Omuwa Kalunga koye ote ku lombwele, u vulike koompango dhe adhihe; dhi dhiginina ano komutima gwoye aguhe nokomwenyo gwoye aguhe.
Nena ndjika owa koleke kutya Omuwa oye Kalunga koye; owu uvaneke okuvulika kuye, okudhiginina oompango dhe adhihe nokuninga ashihe ta popi.
Nena ndjika Omuwa okwa koleke kutya ongoye oshigwana she mwene, ngaashi e ku uvanekele; nokwe ku lombwele, u dhiginine oompango dhe adhihe.
Ote ku nenepeke u vule iigwana ayihe yilwe mbyoka e yi shiti, noto ka etela edhina lye ehambelelo, esimano nepandulo. Oto ka ninga oshigwana she mwene, ngaashi u uvaneke.”
27: Moses naawiliki yaIsrael oya lombwele aantu ya ti: “Dhiginineni iipango ayihe tandi yi mu lombwele nena ndjika.
Uuna tamu ka tokola Jordan, mu ye mevi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga keni te li mu pe, omu na okudhika omamanya omanene e tamu ga gwayeke nokaalaka.
Nyoleleni kugo oompango ndhika adhihe nomalongo. Uuna mwa thiki kevi ndyoka lya tondoka omahini nomagadhi goonyushi, Omuwa Kalunga koohokulu e li mu uvanekele,
nomwa yi handiyaka yaJordan, dhikeni omamanya ngaka kondundu Ebal, ngaashi tandi mu lombwele nena ndjika, ne mu ga gwayeke nokaalaka.
Tungilii ko oshiyambelo shomamanya inaaga gumithwa osheela,
molwashoka oshiyambelo kehe tamu tungile Omuwa Kalunga keni, oshi na okutungwa nomamanya inaaga hongwa. Oko nkoka tamu yambele Omuwa Kalunga keni omafikilondjambo,
noko nkoka tamu yambele ko nokulya omakwatathanondjambo e tamu nyanyukilwa koshipala shOmuwa Kalunga keni.
Komamanya ngoka ga gwayekwa nokaalaka, otamu nyolele ko iitya ayihe ya tonata nawa yoompango dhaKalunga.”
Moses pamwe naayambi Aalevi oya lombwele ihe Aaisraeli ayehe ya ti: “Aaisraeli ne, mweneni ne mu pulakene ndje. Onena tuu ndjika mwa ningi oshigwana shOmuwa Kalunga keni.
Vulikeni ano kuye ne mu dhiginine oompango dhe adhihe tandi dhi mu pe nena ndjika.”
Moses okwa lombwele Aaisraeli e ta ti:
“Shampa mwa tokola Jordan, omazimo ngoka ge na okuthikama kondundu Garizim, uuna omayambeko taga tumbulilwa aantu, ogo: Simeon, Levi, Juda, Issaskar, Josef naBenjamin.
Omazimo taga thikama kondundu Ebal, uuna etulomutima tali tumbulwa, ogo: Ruben, Gad, Aser, Sebulon, Dan naNaftali.
Aalevi otaa ka popya oohapu ndhika mokule taa ti:

“ ‘Kalunga na tule omutima kehe ngoka ta hongo oshimenka shemanya, shoshiti nenge shosheela note shi saagele meholamo; Omuwa oha tondo iimenka.’
“Aantu ayehe naa yamukule taa ti: ‘Amen!’

“ ‘Kalunga na tule omutima shaa ngoka ta dhini he nenge yina.’
“Aantu ayehe naa yamukule taa ti: ‘Amen!’

“ ‘Kalunga na tule omutima shaa ngoka ta lundulula ongamba yamukwawo.’
“Naantu ayehe naa yamukule taa ti: ‘Amen!’

“ ‘Kalunga na tule omutima shaa ngoka ta pukitha omuposi.’
“Naantu ayehe naa yamukule taa ti: ‘Amen!’

“ ‘Kalunga na tule omutima shaa ngoka ta goyokitha uuyuuki waakwiilongo, woothigwa nowaaselekadhi.’
“Naantu ayehe naa yamukule taa ti: ‘Amen!’

“ ‘Kalunga na tule omutima shaa ngoka ta lala nomukulukadhi gwahe, oshoka okwa sitha he ohoni.’
“Naantu ayehe naa yamukule taa ti: ‘Amen!’

“ ‘Kalunga na tule omutima shaa ngoka ta lala noshimuna.’
“Naantu ayehe naa yamukule taa ti: ‘Amen!’

“ ‘Kalunga na tule omutima shaa ngoka ta lala nomumwayina nenge nomumwahe.’
“Naantu ayehe naa yamukule taa ti: ‘Amen!’

“ ‘Kalunga na tule omutima shaa ngoka ta lala nayinamweno.’
“Naantu ayehe naa yamukule taa ti: ‘Amen!’

“ ‘Kalunga na tule omutima shaa ngoka ta dhipaga meholamo.’
“Naantu ayehe naa yamukule taa ti: ‘Amen!’

“ ‘Kalunga na tule omutima shaa ngoka ta taamba ombumbo, opo a dhipage omukeenandjo.’
“Naantu ayehe naa yamukule taa ti: ‘Amen!’

“ ‘Kalunga na tule omutima shaa ngoka itaa vulika koompango nomalongo gaKalunga agehe ngaka.’
“Naantu ayehe naa yamukule taa ti: ‘Amen!’ ”
28: “Ngele oto vulika kOmuwa Kalunga koye e to dhiginine shili iipango ye ayihe mbyoka tandi yi ku pe nena, ote ke ku nenepeka u vule iigwana ayihe kombanda yevi.
Vulika ano kOmuwa Kalunga koye, nomayambeko ngaka agehe otaga ka ninga goye.
“Omuwa ota yambeke omikunda dhoye nomapya goye.
“Omuwa ote ku yambekele oluvalo lwoye, eloolo lyiimeno yoye niimuna yoye oongombe noonzi.
“Omuwa ota yambeke iilya yoye niikulya ya za muyo.
“Omuwa ota yambeke ashihe to shi ningi.
“Omuwa ota ka dhenga aatondi yoye, uuna taye ku ponokele. Nge taye ya, otaa ziilile kombinga yimwe, ihe otaa ka halakana noondjila heyali taa yi ontuku.
“Omuwa Kalunga koye ota ka yambeka iilonga yoye nota ka udhitha iigandhi yoye iilya. Ote ku yambeke mevi ndyoka te li ku pe.
“Ngele oto vulika kOmuwa Kalunga koye e to gwanitha ayihe mbyoka a popi, ote ku ningi oshigwana she mwene, ngaashi u uvaneke.
Nena iigwana ayihe kombanda yevi otayi ka mona kutya Omuwa okwe ku hogolola u ninge oshigwana she mwene, oyo notayi ku tila.
Omuwa ote ke ku pa oluvalo olwindji, iimuna oyindji neloolo lyiilya mevi ndyoka e li uvanekele oohokulu te li ku pe.

Ota ka lokitha omvula pethimbo lyo opala tayi zi mompungulo ye yeloolo megulu nokuyambeka iilonga yoye ayihe; oto ka lilwa oongunga kiigwana oyindji, ihe ngoye ito pumbwa okuhehela nando okushimwe shayo.
Omuwa Kalunga koye ote ke ku ninga omuwiliki mokati kiigwana, hamulandulishinkoti; oto ka kala aluhe u na elago noito shunduka, ngele to vulika shili kiipango mbyoka ayihe tandi yi ku pe nena ndjika.
Ihe ino gamuka ko kuyo, u uke kolulyo nenge kolumoho nenge u simaneke nokulongela iikalunga.”
“Ihe ngele ito vulika kOmuwa Kalunga koye noito dhiginine shili omautho niipango ye ayihe mbyoka tandi yi ku pe nena, etulomutima alihe ndika otali ku adha e tali ku thingi:
“Omuwa ota ka tula omutima iilando yoye nomalundu goye.
“Omuwa ota ka tula omutima iilya yoye niikulya ya za muyo.
“Omuwa ote ke ku tula omutima gwoluvalo lwa pumba, gwiilya ya theta noongombe noonzi dhimwedhimwe adhike.
“Omuwa ota ka tula omutima ashihe to shi ningi.
“Ngele oto ningi nayi nokutinda Omuwa, ote ku undulile omupya, evundakano nomalwa mwaayihe to yi ningi, sigo wa yonuka po thiluthilu.
Ote ku tumine omalega, sigo wa pu mo naanaa moshilongo shoka to ka lala.
Omuwa ote ku umbu uuvu wepunga, olwiidhi nomuthithilalo; ote ku tumine omutenya gwetokopya noluteni nokukukutika po iimeno yoye. Omupya nguka otagu ku hepeke, sigo wa si.
Omvula itayi ka loka we, nevi lyoye otali ka kalanda lya fa emanya.
Peha lyomvula Omuwa ote ke ku tumina ontsi nomutoko, sigo wa hanagulwa po.

“Omuwa ote ku sinditha kaatondi yoye. Oto ya homona to ziilile kombinga yimwe, ihe oto ke ya ya ontuku wa lamba oondjila heyali, naantu ayehe kombanda yevi otaa ka tila, ngele taa mono mbika tayi ku ningilwa.
Uuna tamu ka sa, oondhila niithitukuti otayi ka lya po omidhimba dheni, nokape na ngoka te yi halutha.
Omuwa ote ke ku tumina iitumbuka, ngaashi a ningile Aayegipiti. Olutu lwoye ote ke lu tutitha iilalo. Oto ka kakata iitumbuka nomaankadhi e to ka kala to nyu, ihe itaku ka kala omuti gwasha.
Omuwa ote ku umbu uuvu woonkwengu e te ku umbile uuposi nepiyagano.
Oto ka pampadhala moshanga shomutenya wa fa omuposi, noito vulu okumona ondjila yoye. Ito ka kala u na elago mwaayihe to yi ningi. Oto ka thindilwa pevi aluhe nokuyugwa, nopwaa na ngoka te ku kwatha.
“Oto ka yaleka omukadhona — ihe gulwe te ke mu hokana po. Oto ka tunga ongulu — ihe ito ka kala mo nando. Oto ka tsika omiviinu — ihe ito li omandjembele gadho.

Oongombe dhoye otadhi ka tselelwa montaneho yoye, ihe onyama yadho ito ke yi lya. Uusino woye otau ka kookololwa po, manga we u tala, noitau ke ku galulilwa we. Oonzi dhoye otadhi ka pewa po aatondi yoye, nokape na ngoka te ke ku kwatha.
Aamwoye aamati naakadhona otaa ka gandjwa po kaakwiilongo, ya ninge aapika, manga we shi tala. Esiku kehe oto ka nzana mo omeho goye to ligamene, pamwe aamwoye otaa galuka, ihe osima yowala.
Oshigwana oshikwiilongo otashi ka kutha po iimeno yoye ayihe mbyoka wi ihepekele oku yi kokitha, manga to kala po owala, kakele kedhiginino lyomahepeko nonyanya.
Omahepeko goye otaga piyaganeke omutse gwoye.
Omuwa ote ku umbu iitumbuka okuza komutse sigo okoshithi shompadhi.
“Omuwa ote ke ku kutha po ngoye nomukwaniilwa gwoye e te mu fala kevi lyaakwiilongo, nkoka ngoye mwene nenge oohokulu inaamu kala ko nale; nkoka oto ka longela iikalunga ya hongwa miiti nomomamanya.
Miilongo mbyoka Omuwa te ke ku halakanithila mo, aantu otaa ka haluthwa kwaashoka she ku ningilwa: otaye ke ku nyekelela noku ku sheka.
