“Oto ka kuna ombuto oyindji, ihe oto ka teya oshishonashona, oshoka oombahu otadhi ka lya po iimeno yoye.
Oto ka tsika iitsambe yomiviinu e to yi helele, ihe ito ka likola omandjembele nenge u nwe omaviinu gayo, oshoka omazinyo otaga ka lya po oomviinu.
Omiolivi otadhi ka mena shaa mpoka mevi lyeni, ihe ito ka kala nando u na omagadhi gooholivi, oshoka ooholivi otadhi ka yagumuka ko.
Oto ka kala u na aamati naakadhona, ihe oto ke ya kanitha, oshoka otaa ka kwatwa po oonkwatwa miita.
Omiti dhoye adhihe niilikolwa yevi lyoye otayi ka lika po kuupuka.
“Aakwiilongo mboka ya kala mevi lyoye, otaye ke ku gwililila po ye ku vule, ngoye noto ka kanitha oonkondo.
Otaa ka kala ye na iimaliwa ye ku pe oongunga, ihe ngoye ito ka kala u na sha u ya pe oongunga. Pehulilo otaa ka ninga aapangeli yoye.
“Omathingano ngaka agehe otage ku adha, e taga kala ge ku na, sigo wa hanagulwa po thiluthilu, oshoka ino vulika kOmuwa Kalunga koye nokudhiginina omautho niipango ayihe e yi ku pe.
Omathingano ngoka otaga ka ninga endhindhiliko sigo aluhe kutya ngoye noluvalo lwoye omwa pangulwa kuKalunga.
Omuwa okwe ku yambeke pamikalo adhihe, ihe ino mu longela nenyanyu nonomwenyo gwa tundulukwa.

Onkee ano oto ka longela aatondi mboka Omuwa te ku tumine, ye ku kondjithe. Oto ka kala wa sa ondjala nenota nou li omudhuu — u li moluhepo lwiinima ayihe. Omuwa ote ke ku hepeka nayi, sigo wa hanagulwa po thiluthilu.
Omuwa ote ke ku tukulila oshigwana tashi zi kokule kooha dhevi, shi ye shi ku kondjithe, oshigwana shoka elaka lyasho kuu li shi. Otashi ke ku fegula po sha fa ekodhi.
Otaa ka kala aananyanya, itaa ningile mo molwaakulupe noitaa si ohenda aagundjuka.

Otaa ka lya po oongombe dhoye niilikolwa yomevi lyoye, nangoye oto ka sa po kondjala. Itaye ku thigile po nando omuma yimwe yiilya, eta lyomaviinu, uugadhi wooholivi, ongombe nenge onzi; nangoye oto ka sa po.
Otaa ka ponokela oshilando kehe moshilongo shoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te shi ku pe sigo omadhingililokuma omaleeleka ngoka wi itula, otaga ka kumunwa po.
“Uuna aatondi yoye taa kondeke iilando yoye, oto ka pumbwa iikulya, oto kala muuwehame nomeiyekelelo, sigo to li po aamwoye, onyama aamwoye aamati naakadhona mboka Omuwa Kalunga koye e ku pe.
Nokuli omulumentu omvalekele nomulelwa ondembula ke na ohenda namumwayina, omukadhi omuholike nenge oyana mboka ya hupu ko;
ite ya pe nando okantumba konyama yoyana ndjoka ye mwene ta li muuwehame nomeiyekelelo molwompumbwe yiikulya, sho u li wa kondekwa kaatondi.
Omukiintu omvalekele nomulelwa ondembula, ngoka moluuyamba inee enda kolupadhi nando olumwe, ke na ohenda nomulume omuholike nenge omwana omumati nomukadhona.
Ite ya pe okahanona e ka vala, nontungwa yako tayi zi moshivalelo she, oshoka muuwehame nomeiyekelelo omolwompumbwe yiikulya ye mwene ote yi li po meholamo, sho u li wa kondekwa kaatondi.
“Ngele ito dhiginine shili oompango ndhika adhihe nomalongo ga nyolwa membo ndika, nongele ito simaneke edhina lyOmuwa Kalunga koye ekumithi netilithi,
ote ku tumine ngoye noluvalo lwoye omauwehame gaa shi kupangwa, omalega omatilithi nomikithi omiwinayi dhomambwengelela.
Ote ku undulile ishewe omikithi omitilithi ndhoka we dhi mwene muEgipiti noito ka hwepopala we.
Ote ke ku undulila omavu nomalega ngeyaka gi ili nogi ili inaaga tumbulwa membo ndika lyoompango nomalongo gaKalunga, ongoye noto ka hanagulwa po.
Nonando u indjipale u thike poonyothi dhokegulu, yamweyamwe yomune ayeke taa ka hupa ko, oshoka ino vulika kOmuwa Kalunga koye.
Omuwa ngaashi a li a nyanyukilwa elago lyoye nokwiindjipala kwoye, osho wo ta ka nyanyukilwa moku ku yona po noku ku hanagula po. Oto ka nakulwa mo mevi ndyoka to ke li lala.

“Omuwa ote ke ku halakanithila mokati kiigwana ayihe okuza kooha dhevi sigo okoonkwawo, naankoka oto ka longela iikalunga ya hongwa miiti nomomamanya, iikalunga mbyoka ngoye mwene nenge oohokulu inaaye yi longela nale.
Ito ka mona ombili akuhe, kape na ehala to ka tya olyoye. Omuwa ote ke ku tula uumbanda, etyololoko neziyalalo.
Okukala kwoye aluhe otaku kala moshiponga. Uusiku nomutenya oto ka kala nomwenyo tagu nuka mo noto ka kala muumbanda weso wa pitilila.
Ongula oto ka tya: ‘Ando okwa li ongulohi,’ nongulohi oto ka tya: ‘Ando okwa li ongula.’ Osho u li u na ehaluko lya tya ngeyi momutima nomahaluhalu ga tya ngeyi momeho goye.

Omuwa ote ke ku shunithila kuEgipiti mooskepa, nando ye mwene a tile: ‘Ito ka shuna we kuEgipiti.’ Oko hoka to ki ilanditha po kaatondi yoye u ninge omupika, ihe kaku na ngoka ta hala oku ku landa po.”
29: Ndhika odho oohapu dhehangano ndyoka Omuwa a lombwele Moses e li dhike nAaisraeli mevi lyAamoabi; adhihe ndhika odha gwedhwa kehangano ndyoka Omuwa a hangana nayo pondundu Sinai.
Moses okwa hiya Aaisraeli ayehe e ta ti kuyo: “Omwa mono nomeho geni shoka Omuwa a ningile omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti, omalenga ge noshilongo she ashihe.
Omwa mono omageelo omatilithi, iilongandhindhiliko niinyengandunge mbyoka Omuwa a tsakanitha.
Ihe sigo onena Omuwa ine mu pa omutima gwokuuva ko, omeho gokumona ko nomakutsi gokuuva ko.
Omuwa okwe mu enditha omimvo omilongo ne mombuga, noonguwo dheni inadhi kulupa noongaku dheni inadhi nyanyuka po.
Inamu lya oshikwiila nenge mu nwe omaviinu nenge omalovu, ihe Omuwa okwe mu kongele iipalutha, opo e mu longe kutya oye Kalunga keni.
Sho twa thiki peha mpaka, Sihon, omukwaniilwa gwaHeshbon, naOg, omukwaniilwa gwaBaasha, oya piti mo ye ya ye tu kondjithe. Ihe otwe ya sindi
e tatu kutha po evi lyawo e tatu li topolele omazimo gaRuben naGad netatazimo lyaManasse.
Vulikeni shili komautho agehe gehangano ndika, opo mu kale mu na elago mwaayihe tamu yi ningi.
“Nena omwa thikama mpaka koshipala shOmuwa Kalunga keni, ne amuhe — aawiliki yeni nomalenga, aasamane yeni,
aakulukadhi yeni, aana yeni naakwiilongo mboka ya kala mokati keni haye mu tyayele iikuni noku mu tekela omeya.
Omu li mpaka nena, mu ye mehangano ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga keni ta hangana nane nokugana,
opo Omuwa a wape oku mu taamba oshigwana she nokuninga Kalunga keni, ngaashi e shi mu uvanekele noohokulu Abraham, Isak naJakob.
Hane amuke Omuwa ta hangana nane ehangano ndika nokugana.
Ota hangana natse atuhe mbaka twa thikama nena mpaka koshipala she nonomaluvalo getu ngoka inaaga valwa natango.
“Otamu dhimbulukwa okukala kwetu muEgipiti nokweenda mokati kiigwana mbika.
Omwa mono iimenka yawo yi nyanyalitha ya ningwa miiti, momamanya, moshisiliveli nomoshingoli.

Kotokeni, pwaa kale omulumentu nenge omukiintu, egumbo nenge ezimo lya thikama mpaka nena, tali pilamene Omuwa Kalunga ketu noku ka longela iikalunga yaapagani. Oshinima sha tya ngeyi osha fa omudhi tagu tsapuka oshigwanga shuuzigo uululu.

Kotokeni, pwaa kale omuntu ta pulakene omakumagidho ngaka, ihe natango oti itompo kutya ayihe otayi mu opalele, nando oye omutangalali mondjila ye. Shika otashi mu hanagula po amuhe, aawanawa naawinayi.
Omuwa ita dhimine po omuntu a tya ngaaka. Ondjahi yOmuwa otayi mu hwamene, niiponga ayihe ya nyolelwa membo ndika, otayi ke mu undulilwa, sigo Omuwa e mu kombo po.
Omuwa ote mu ningi oshiholelwa mokati komazimo gaIsrael e te mu undulile iiponga yomathingano mehangano ndika ga nyolelwa membo ndika lyompango yOmuwa.
“Momapipi gokomeho oluvalo lweni naakwiilongo taa zi komavi gokokule, otaa ka tala iiponga nomahepeko ngoka Omuwa a tula mevi lyeni.

Omapya otaga ka mbugala ga siikilwa kosulufuli noshimongwa; itamu kunwa sha, noitamu mene omwiidhi. Evi lyeni otali ka fa iilando Sodom naGomorra, Adma naZebojim, mbyoka Omuwa e yi yonagula po, sho a li a geya noonkondo.
Nena uuyuni auhe otau ka pula tau ti: ‘Omolwashike Omuwa a ningile ngeyi oshilongo shika? Ondunge yondjahi ndjoka ontilithi otayi ti naanaa ngiini?’
Eyamukulo otali ka kala: ‘Omolwashoka aantu yOmuwa oye etha ehangano ndyoka ya hangana naye, Kalunga koohekulu, sho e ya tembudha muEgipiti.
Oya longele ookalunga yalwe, mboka inaaye ya longela nale, iikalunga mbyoka Omuwa e yi ya indike yaaye yi longele.
Nomolwashoka Omuwa a geele oshigwana she e te shi undulile iiponga ayihe mbika ya nyolelwa membo ndika.
Omuwa okwa geye noonkondo, nondjahi ye onene oye ya nakula mo mevi lyawo e tayi ya umbile mevi ekwiilongo, moka ye li sigo onena.’
“Ope na iinima yimwe mbyoka Omuwa Kalunga ketu e yi holeka; ihe okwa holola ompango ye, natse nomaluvalo getu otu na okuvulika kuyo aluhe sigo aluhe.”
30: “Onde ku pe ngashingeyi ehogololo pokati keyambeko netulomutima. Uuna ayihe mbika tayi ku ningilwa noto kala mokati kiigwana, moka Omuwa Kalunga koye e ku halakanithila mo, nena oto ka dhimbulukwa ehogololo ndyoka nde li ku pe.
Ngele oto galukile kOmuwa, ngoye mwene noluvalo lwoye, e to vulika komwenyo gwoye aguhe kiipango mbika tandi yi ku pe nena,
Omuwa Kalunga koye ote ku sile ohenda. Ote ke ku kongolola mo miigwana, moka e ku halakanithila mo, note ke ku ninga omunelago ishewe.
Nonando u halakanene kooha dhuuyuni, Omuwa Kalunga koye ote ke ku gongela e te ku galula ko,
opo u ka likole ishewe evi ndyoka lya kalwa koohokulu. Ote ke ku ninga omunelagolela noku ku indjipaleka u vule oohokulu.
Omuwa Kalunga koye ote ke ku pa, ngoye noluvalo lwoye, omutima omuvuliki e to kala u mu hole komutima gwoye aguhe, noto kala ihe mevi ndyoka.
Omatulomutima agehe ngaka ote ga tula maatondi yoye, mboka ye ku tonde nohaa ku hepeke,
ongoye noto ka vulika kuye e to dhiginine iipango ayihe mbika tandi yi ku pe nena.
Omuwa ote ke ku yambekela ayihe to yi ningi, noto kala u na oluvalo olwindji, iimuna oyindji neloolo lyiilya. Ota ka nyanyukilwa oku ku ninga omunelago, ngaashi a ningile oohokulu aanelago,
ihe ngoye ou na okuvulika kuye e to dhiginine iipango nomautho ge ga nyolelwa membo ndika lyompango. Ou na okugalukila kuye komutima gwoye aguhe nokomwenyo gwoye aguhe.
“Oshipango shika tandi shi ku pe nena ndjika, kashi shi oshidhigu unene nenge shi li kokule nangoye.
Kashi li pombanda megulu, u pule ando u tye: ‘Olye ta londo e ke shi tu talele ko, opo tu shi uve tse tu vulike kusho?’
Kashi li handiyaka yefuta, u pule ando u tye: ‘Olye ta taaguluka a ye handiyaka yefuta e ke shi tu talele ko?’
Aawe, oshi li mpaka pungoye. Ou shi shi noto vulu oku shi tumbula nokuvulika kusho.
“Nena otandi ku pe, u hogolole pokati kuuwananwa nuuwinayi, pokati komwenyo neso.

Ngele oto vulika kiipango, omautho noompango dhOmuwa Kalunga koye ndhoka tandi dhi ku pe nena, ngele ou mu hole, to vulika kuye e to dhiginine oompango dhe adhihe, nena oto ka ninga omunelago e to ningi oshigwana oshinene. Omuwa Kalunga koye ote ke ku yambeka mevi ndyoka to ke li lala.
Ihe ngele oto tangalala e to tindi okupulakena e to falafalwa kelongelo lyiikalunga,
oto ka hanagulwa po — otandi ku londodha shili mpaka. Ito kala mo olule mevi ndyoka lyahandiyaka yaJordan ndyoka to ke li lala.
Nena otandi ku pe, u hogolole pokati komwenyo neso, pokati keyambeko lyaKalunga netulomutima lye, notandi hiya egulu nevi li ninge onzapo yehogololo ndyoka to hogolola. Hogolola omwenyo.
Hola Omuwa Kalunga koye, vulika kuye nou mu dhame, nena ngoye mwene noluvalo lwoye otamu ka kala olule mevi ndyoka u uvaneke te li pe oohokulu Abraham, Isak naJakob.”
31: Moses okwa tsikile okulombwela Israel
ta ti: “Onda gwanitha ngashingeyi omimvo ethele nomilongo mbali noite vulu we oku ku wilika. Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje wo kutya kandi na okutokola omulonga Jordan.
Omuwa Kalunga koye oye mwene te ku kwatele komeho e ta yono po iigwana yaankoka, opo u lale evi lyayo. Josua oye ta ningi omuwiliki gwoye, ngaashi Omuwa a ti.
Omuwa ota ka hanagula po aantu mboka, naanaa ngaashi a ningi Sihon naOg, aakwaniilwa yAayamori, nokwa hanagula po oshilongo shawo.
Omuwa ote ya gandja miikaha yoye, ihe ya ninga tuu, ngaashi nde ku lombwela.
Ikolelela e to kala u na omukumo. Ino ya tila. Kalunga koye, Omuwa oye mwene, ta kala pamwe nangoye. Ite ku thigi po noite ku etha.”
Moses okwi ithana Josua e ta ti kuye montaneho yAaisraeli ayehe: “Ikolelela ngoye u kale nomukumo; ongoye tuu ngoka to ka wilika aantu mbaka, ya ka kwate po evi ndyoka Omuwa e li uvanekele oohekulu.
Omuwa oye mwene te ku wilike e ta kala pamwe nangoye. Ite ku thigi po noite ku etha, onkee ano ino tyololoka nenge u kale wa tila.”
Moses okwa nyola ompango yaKalunga e te yi pe aayambi Aalevi, mboka ya li haa tonatele oshikethahangano shOmuwa, naakuluntu yaIsrael.
Okwe ya kumagidha a ti: “Omumvo omutiheyali kehe, uuna oongunga tadhi dhimwa po, lesheni ompango ndjika mokule mOshituthi shomatsali giihwa iitalala.
Yi lesheleni Aaisraeli, sho taa ya kelongelokalunga lyokulongela Omuwa Kalunga keni pehala ndyoka limwe lyelongelokalunga te li hogolola.

Gongalekeni oshigwana ashihe, aalumentu, aakiintu aanona naakwiilongo mboka ya kala miilando yeni, opo shaa ngoka te yi uvu, oti ilongo okutila Omuwa Kalunga keni nokudhiginina oohapu adhihe dhompango ndjika.

Pahedhi ndjika omaluvalo geni ngoka inaaga uva nando ompango yOmuwa Kalunga keni, otage ke yi uva. Osho ngeyi otagi ilongo oku mu tila, manga mu li mevi ndyoka tamu ke li kwata po, nge mwa tokola Jordan.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Ito kala we u na omwenyo olule. Ithana Josua u mu ete ketsalihangano, opo ndi mu langeke moshilonga.” Moses naJosua oya yi ketsalihangano,
Omuwa nokwe ya holokele moshikogo shokuungululu, shoka sha thikama posheelo shetsalihangano.

Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses a ti: “Oto si nziya, nokonima yeso lyoye aantu itaa inekele ndje we, otaa teya ehangano ndyoka nda hangana nayo. Otaa ka etha ndje e taa longele iikalunga yaapagani yomevi ndyoka taa ka ya mo.

Uuna shika tashi ningwa, otandi ya geele; otandi ya etha, e taa ka hanagulwa po. Otaa adhika kiiponga iinene nokomikundu odhindji, notaa ka dhimbulula kutya iinima mbika otaye yi ningilwa, oshoka ngame Kalunga kawo kandi li we pamwe nayo.
Otandi ka tinda oku ya kwatha, oshoka oya ningi nayi noya longele iikalunga.”
Ngashingeyi nyola eimbilo ndika. Li nongeka Aaisraeli, opo li ninge onzapo puyo.

Otandi ya fala kevi ndyoka lya kunguluka omahini nomagadhi goonyushi, ngaashi ndu uvanekele oohekulu. Nkwiyaka otaa ka kala ye na iikulya ayihe ye yi hala, notaa ka kala kaaye na nando ombudhi. Ihe otaa ka pilamena ko e taa longele iikalunga. Otaa ka ekelahi ndje e taa yono ehangano lyandje,

niiponga oyindji iitilithi otayi ke ya adha. Ihe eimbilo ndika otali ka imbwa natango, notali ka ninga onzapo puyo. Nokuli ngashingeyi manga inaandi ya fala kevi ndyoka ndu uvaneke tandi li ya pe, ondi shi shi shoka taa dhiladhila.
Esiku ndyoka Moses okwa nyola eimbilo ndika e te li nongeke Aaisraeli.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Josua yaNun e ta ti kuye: “Ikolelela ngoye u kale nomukumo. Oto ka fala Aaisraeli kevi ndyoka nde ya uvanekele, notandi ka kala pamwe nangoye.”
Moses okwa nyolele ompango yaKalunga membo a kotoka kaa thige po nando osha.
Sho a mana, okwa ti kaayambi Aalevi mboka taa tonatele oshikethahangano:
“Taambeni embo ndika lyompango, mu li pungule ontega noshikethahangano shOmuwa Kalunga keni, opo li kale nkoka li ninge onzapo paantu ye.
Ondi shi shi kutya oyo aantu aapandala naatangalali. Oya tsu ondumbo nOmuwa, manga nda li ndi na omwenyo, nosho taa ka tsa ondumbo konima yeso lyandje.
Gongalekeni aakuluntu yomazimo geni ayehe nomalenga geni koshigongi shandje, opo ndi ya lombwele iinima mbika; otandi ithana egulu nevi, yi ninge oonzapo puyo.

Ondi shi shi kutya konima yeso lyandje aantu otaa ka ninga aakolokoshi notaa ekelehi shoka nde ya nongeke. Komeho otaa ka adhika koshiponga, oshoka oya geyitha Omuwa, sho ya longo shoka ye shi indikwa.”
Moses okwa tangumuna eimbilo ndika alihe, manga Aaisraeli ya pulakena.
32:
“One omagulu, pulakeneni, sho te ti,
nangoye evi, uva oohapu dhomokana kandje.

Omalongo gandje naga loke ngomvula,
noohapu dhandje nadhi ndonde ngomume,
ngaashi omata komwiidhi gwohuluhulu,
ngaashi omvula yontemuna kiimeno tayi lelema.

Otandi uvitha edhina lyOmuwa;
aakwetu, hambeleleleni uunene waKalunga ketu.

“Oye emanya; iilonga ye oyolela,
noondjila dhe adhihe odhu uka.
Kalunga omudhiginini kee na uugoyoki, omuyuuki nomunashili.

Ihe ne aahasha noinamu gwana okuninga aantu ye,
oshigwana shuulunde noshomakoto.

Oyo nduno ompito yokuhinda Omuwa ndjono,
shigwana ngoye oshilayi noshigoya?
Oye ho, Omushiti gwoye,
oye e ku ningi oshigwana.

Gwokombandambanda okwa pe iigwana omavi,
sho a yoolola aantu naantu.
Okwa utha omihoko mpoka dhi na okukala.
Oshigwana kehe okwe shi uthile oongamba dhasho
pamwaalu gwaana yaIsrael.

Oshoka oshitendelwa shOmuwa osho oshigwana she,
Jakob a yelekwa uuthiga we.

“Okwe mu adha mombuga, montale mu udha elilagano lyiilikama.
Okwe mu kunduka e mu tonatele
ongota gamene ondanda yeho lye mwene,

ongekodhi tali gamene oshihandhila shalyo,
notali tengelele kombanda yuukodhigona walyo
tali u kutha po noku u humbata komawawa galyo.

Omuwa awike e mu enditha,
nokapwa li kalunga kiigwana yilwe nando ogumwe puye.

Okwe mu londeke kiikulundundu yevi
nokwe mu palutha niilikolwa yomomapya.
Okwe mu thipitha omagadhi goonyushi moonkunkulumanya
nomagadhi gooholivi momamanya omakukutu.

Okwe mu pe omagadhi goongombe
nomahini goonzi nogiikombo;
okwe mu pe oonzi oonyali
noondumentu dho ondoka,
osiimela ombwanawa
nomaviinu ga dhindolwa.

“Jeshurun okwo ondoka e ta gu okafinyukila.
A ondoka nduno taa,
a ndinda, omagadhi gowala.
Okwe ekelehi Kalunga ngoka e mu shiti,
e ta dhini emanya lyehupitho.

Oya pendutha uulaadhi wOmuwa
mokulongela iikalunga yiigwana,
oye mu geyitha niinima yawo iinyanyalithi.

Oya yambele oompwidhuli, ndhoka dhaa shi Kalunga,
iikalunga mbyoka inaaye yi tseya nale,
iipeepeka opo ya holoka,
noohekulu inaye yi kakamena.

Emanya ndyoka lye ku vala, owe li dhini,
owa dhimbwa Kalunga ngoka e ku eta po.

Omuwa sho e shi mono, okwe ya ekelehi,
mondjahi ye a geele aamati naakadhona ye.

Okwa popi ta ti: ‘Onda hala ndi ya holeke oshipala shandje;
onda hala okutala ehulilo lyawo,
oshoka oyo oluvalo olutangalali,
oluvalo lwaa na uudhiginini.

Oya tukulutha ondjahi yandje molwiimenka yawo,
oya geyitha ndje niikalunga yawo.
Otandi ka tukulukitha ondjahi yawo oshigwana shaamakaha;
otandi ke ya geelitha koshigwana shanathangwa.

Oshoka omulilo ogwa hwamekwa mondjahi yandje,
ndele otagu tema sigo omoshaasi.
Otagu lungunike po evi niimeno yalyo,
otagu fike po omakankameno goondundu.

“ ‘Otandi ke ya ndumbila iiponga.
Iikuti yandje otandi ke yi ya umbila.

Otaa ka gundikwa kondjala nokolwiidhi;
otaa ka sa koshivu oshitilithi.
Otandi ke ya tumina iilikama yi na omayego omapyu
nomayoka ge na uuzigo.

Pondje egongamwele otali ka lyana,
nomeni momagumbo otamu kala ehaluko,
shamumati shamukadhona, okahanona pamwe nomukulupe.

Ndi tye: Onda hala oku ya komba po,
nokudhima po okudhimbulukiwa kwawo mokati kaantu.

Ando onda li inaandi angala aatondi,
aatamaneki ye shi tale ko pombambo yo ya tye:
Otwa li aanankondo, nOmuwa haye a longo ayihe mbika.’

Oshoka oshigwana shika kashi na omayele
nokashi na nando owino.

Ando ya li aanandunge,
ando oye shi dhimbulula,
ando ya mono ehulilo lyawo.

Gumwe ota vulu ngiini okutidha po eyuvi,
nayaali omayuvi omulongo?
Emanya lyawo olye ya landitha po,
nOmuwa okwe ya gandja po.

Oshoka emanya lyawo inali fa emanya lyetu,
osho aatondi yetu taa tumbula.

Omuviinu gwawo ogwa za momuviinu gwaSodom
nomoshitsambe shaGomorra.
Omandjembele gawo oge na uuzigo,
nomahila gawo omalulululu ga fa onyango.

Omaviinu gawo uuzigo weyoka,
omalulululu nguuzigo wontoka.

“Omuwa ota dhimbulukwa shoka aatondi yawo ya ninga;
ota tegelele ethimbo lyo opala, opo e ya geele.

Egeelo olyandje; otandi ka futa.
Pethimbo lyu uthwa oompadhi dhawo otadhi tenguka;
esiku lyekano lyawo oli li popepi,
nepangulo lyawo otali ya mbala.

Omuwa ota ka uthila aantu ye
nota sile aapiya ye olukeno,
sho ta mono kutya oya nzanzama,
nehulilo lyawo oli li popepi.

Nena ota pula ta ti: ‘Ookalunga kawo oye li peni,
nopeni pe na emanya ndyoka ye li inekele?

Ookalunga mboka ya li oofu dhoontselelandjambo dhawo
noya nu omaviinu giinuwandjambo yawo, oye li peni?
Naa ye ye mu kwathe, opo mu kale megameno lyawo.

“ ‘Talii ko, ngame ongame awike Kalunga,
nokaku na gulwe ontega nangame.
Otandi dhipaga e tandi mwenyeke,
otandi dhenge e tandi aludha,
nokaku na ngoka ta hupitha moshikaha shandje.

Otandi yelutha omaako gandje lwokegulu e tandi ti:
Oshili, ngaashi ndi na omwenyo aluhe sigo aluhe,

Uuna tandi upike egongamwele lyandje hali adhima
e tii li kwata, ndi tameke okupangula,
nena aakondjithi yandje otandi ya geele
naatondi yandje otandi ya galulile uutondwe wawo.

Iikuti yandje otayi ka kolwa kombinzi,
negongamwele lyandje tali ka lya onyama:
ombinzi yaadhipagwa noyoonkwatwa,
nomitse dhoondjayi dhaatondi.’

“Ne iigwana, tangeni aantu yOmuwa,
oshoka ota ka pula ombinzi yaantu ye;
ota ka geela aakondjithi ye
nota ka tsakanitha eyelithoyapulo lyevi lye naantu ye.”
Moses naJosua yaNun oya totomona oohapu adhihe dheimbilo ndika momakutsi gAaisraeli.
Moses sho a mana okunongeka aantu omalongo gaKalunga,
okwa ti: “Vulikeni shili kiipango ayihe mbika tandi yi mu pe nena ndjika. Yi hokololeleni aana yeni, opo ya vulike shili komalongo gaKalunga agehe.
Omalongo ngaka kage shi osima yowala; ogo omwenyo gweni. Vulikeni kugo notamu kala mu na omwenyo omule mevi lyahandiyaka yaJordan ndyoka tamu ke li lala.”
Esiku ndyoka Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses e ta ti:
“Londa u ye koondundu Abarim, moshilongo shaMoab ontega noshilando Jeriko, inda kondundu Nebo e to tala evi lyaKaanan, ndyoka tandi li pe Aaisraeli.
Oto ka sila kondundu ndjoka, ngaashika omumwanyoko Aaron a sile kondundu Hor,
oshoka ne amuhe yaali inamu inekela ndje montaneho yAaisraeli. Sho mwa li pomeya gaMeriba popepi nomukunda Kadesh mombuga Zin, inamu vulika kungame montaneho yAaisraeli.
Eeno, evi lyo lyene oto li tala, ihe ito yi mo mulyo, evi ndyoka tandi li pe Aaisraeli.”
33: Ngaka ogo omayambeko ngoka Moses, omupiya gwaKalunga, a tumbulile Aaisraeli, manga inaa sa.

Omuwa ote ya ta zi kuSinai;
ota yeluka ngetango kombanda yaEdom
e ta minikile aantu ye okuza kondundu Paran.
Puye ope na aayengeli yomayuvi omulongo,
kolulyo lwe oku na onyeka ya hwama.

Omuwa oku hole aantu ye
nota popile mboka ye.
Osho tatu inyongamenene koompadhi dhe,
e tatu vulika kiipango ye.

Otatu vulika kompango twe yi pewa kuMoses,
eliko lyoshigwana shetu.

Omuwa okwa ningi omukwaniilwa muJeshurun,
aakuluntu yoshigwana sho ya gongala, omazimo gaIsrael agehe kumwe.

Moses okwa ti kezimo lyaRuben:
“Ruben, kala nomwenyo waa se,
nando aantu yoye aashona.”

Kezimo lyaLevi okwa ti:
“Levi okwa pewa Tummim naUrim,
oye omuyakuli gwoye omudhiginini.
Owe mu yeleke muMassa
nowe mu lolo pomeya gaMeriba.

Ohe ku simaneke unene
shi vule okusimaneka he nayina nenge aamwayina noyana.
Oha vulika kiipango yoye nokudhiginina ehangano lyoye.

Ota longo Jakob omautho goye
nompango yoye okuIsrael.
Komeho goye ota tula ko iitsinino nomidhidhindjambo koshiyambelo shoye.

Omuwa, yambeka oonkondo dhe,
niilonga yiikaha ye, yi ku opalele.
Nyanyagula oonto dhaakondjithi ye,
naatondi ye u ya dhenge, opo yaa penduke po we.”

Kezimo lyaBenjamin okwa ti:
“Oye omulelwa gwOmuwa omuholike.
Omuwa ohe mu gamene esiku kehe,
ota kala puye aluhe.”

Kezimo lyaJosef okwa ti:
“Omuwa na yambeke evi lye nomagano gondilo:
omume ndjoka tayi zi megulu,
omeya ngoka taga zi mevi,

iilya ya tiliganekwa ketango,
uuyamba wiiyimati yothinge kehe,

omagano ngoka taga zi koondundu oonkulu
neloolo ndyoka tali etwa po kiikulundundu.

Oshilongo she nashi ete po uuyamba auhe tau zi mevi.
Nashi kale sha yambekwa kOmuwa,
ngoka a popi moshihwa sha hwama.
Omayambeko agehe nage ye kuJosef.
Oye a li omuwiliki mokati kaamwahe.

Josef a fa ontsezi ondhilikwa
yi na ooniga dha fa dhosino.
Ooniga dhe omayuvi gaManasse
nomayuvi omulongo gaEfraim.
Otu ulula nadho iigwana,
te yi undulile sigo okooha dhevi.”

Kezimo lyaSebulon nolyaIssaskar okwa ti:
“Sebulon na mone elago miipindi yokefuta,
nuuyamba waIssaskar nau tane maandjawo.

Otaa hiyile aakwiilongo kondundu yawo
notaa yambele ko omafikilondjambo go opala.
Uuyamba wawo okefuta taa likola
nomehekevi lyopomunkulo gwalyo.”

Kezimo lyaGad okwa ti:
“Na hambelelwe ngoka a taandelitha oshitopolwa shevi lyaGad.
Gad okwa langele a fa onime,
ota kutha oshooko, nomutse wo.

Okwi ikuthile oshitopolwa sho opala shevi,
noshipewa shuuwiliki osha ningi she.
Okwa vulika komalombwelo noompango dhOmuwa,
aawiliki yaIsrael sho ya gongala pamwe.”

Kezimo lyaNaftali okwa ti:
“Naftali okwa yambekwa kesilohenda lyOmuwa.
Evi lyawo olya taandela lwokuumbugantu okuza kefuta lyaGalilea.”

Kezimo lyaAser okwa ti:
“Aser okwa yambekwa e vule omazimo galwe.
Na kale omuningilwakombunda kaamwayina.
Evi lye nali mene omiolivi odhindji

Iilando ye nayi gamenwe nomiyelo dhiiyela.
Aluhe na kale kee na ombudhi.”

“Kaku na ngoka a fa Kalunga kaJeshurun,
nakutaakana egulu meadhimo,
nakweenda miikogo mookathele,
opo e ku kwathe.

Egameno lyoye oKalunga komathimbo agehe,
omaako ge gaaluhe otage ku ukata.
Okwe ku tidhile po aatondi yoye
e te ku lombwele, u ya dhime po ayehe.

Israel ota kala nombili,
noluvalo lwaJakob lwa gamenwa mevi lyiilya nolyomaviinu,
egulu lyalyo ohali gu omume.

Israel, ngoye omunelago ngiini!
Kape na ngoka e ku fa.
Ongoye oshigwana sha hupithwa kOmuwa.
Omuwa oye mwene oshikandekitho negongamwele lyoye.
Aatondi yoye ohaye ku nyenkele,
ihe oto ya lyatele pevi.”
34: Moses okwa zi molushandja lwaMoab a londo kondundu Nebo, kondungu yondundu Pisga kuuzilo waJeriko. Oko nkoka Omuwa e mu ulukile evi alihe: oshilongo shaGilead sigo okoshilando Dan kuumbangalantu,
evi alihe lyaNaftali, iilongo yaEfraim naManasse, oshilongo shaJuda sigo okEfuta lyopokati kuuninginino,
ombinga yokuumbugantu waJuda, nolushandja ndoka lwa taandela okuza kuZoar sigo oJeriko, oshilando shomilunga.
Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses ta ti: “Ndika olyo evi ndyoka ndu uvanekele Abraham, Isak naJakob tandi li pe oluvalo lwawo. Otandi li ku ulukile, ihe itandi ku pitika u ye mo.”
Osho ngaaka Moses, omupiya gwOmuwa, a sile mevi lyAamoabi, ngaashi Omuwa e shi tile.
Omuwa okwe mu fumvike mesilu limwe lyomuMoab, ontega noshilando Betpegor, ihe sigo onena kape na ngoka a tseya naanaa mpoka a fumvikwa.
Moses okwa li e na omimvo ethele nomilongo mbali, sho a si; nokwa li e na oonkondo natango, nomeho ge oga li ge wete ko natango.
Aaisraeli oye mu lili oosa omasiku omilongo ndatu molushandja lwaMoab.
Josua yaNun okwa li u udha ombepo yuunongo, oshoka Moses okwe mu langeke a ninge omulanduli gwe. Aaisraeli oya vulika kuJosua e taa dhiginine iipango mbyoka Omuwa e yi ya pele muMoses.
Kamwa li we omuhunganeki muIsrael a fa Moses; Omuwa a popi naye oshipala noshipala.

Nokaku na omuhunganeki a longa iilongandhindhiliko niinyengandunge, ngaashi mbyoka ya longwa kuMoses, Omuwa sho e mu tumine, e yi ninge mokukondjitha omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti, omalenga ge noshilongo she ashihe.
Nokaku na omuhunganeki gulwe e na oonkondo okuninga iinima iinene niitilithi mbyoka Moses e yi longo montaneho yAaisraeli.

1: Konima yeso lyaMoses, omumati gwOmuwa, Omuwa okwa popitha omukwathi gwaMoses, Josua yaNun.
Okwa ti kuye: “Omuntu gwandje Moses okwa si. Ngashingeyi ilongekidha, ngoye noshigwana shaIsrael, mu tokole omulonga Jordan, mu ye mevi ndyoka tandi ke li ya pa.
Ngaashi nda lombwele Moses, onde mu pe noshigwana shandje ashihe evi alihe ndyoka tamu ka lyata.

Oongamba dhalyo otadhi ka tameka okuza kombuga muumbugantu, sigo okoondundu dhaLibanon muumbangalantu; okuza komulonga omunene Eufrat muuzilo otadhi ka taakana oshilongo shAaheti, sigo Efuta lyopokati kuuninginino.
Josua, kape na ngoka te ku itakeke e te ku dhenge ando, manga u na omwenyo. Ote kala pamwe nangoye, ngaashi nda li naMoses. Ote kala nangoye aluhe; itandi ke ku etha nando.
Ikolelela e to kala nomukumo, oshoka oto ka ninga omuwiliki gwoshigwana shika, nge tashi ka lala evi ndika nde li uvanekele oohekulu nokugana.
Onkee ano ikolelela e to kala nomukumo; dhiginina ompango ayihe ndjoka omuntu gwandje Moses e yi ku pe. Ino dhina nando okatumbulo kamwe kayo, opo u kale nawa shaa mpoka to yi.
Kotoka aluhe, embo ndika lyompango li kale aluhe tali leshwa melongelokalunga lyeni. Yi ilonga omutenya nuusiku, u vulike kwaayihe ya nyolelwa mo. Nena oto kala omusindani nomunelago.
Dhimbulukwa kutya onde ku lombwela, u ikolelele nou kale nomukomo. Ino tila ngoye ino tyololoka, oshoka ongame, Omuwa Kalunga koye, ndi li pungoye shaa nkoka to yi.”
Nena Josua okwa lombwele aawiliki,
ye ende nontanda, yo ya lombwele oshigwana ya tye: “Longekidheni iikulya, oshoka konima yomasiku gatatu otamu ka tokola omulonga Jordan, mu ka lale evi ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga keni te li mu pe.”
Josua okwa lombwele ezimo lyaRuben nolyaGad netatazimo lyaManasse ta ti:
“Dhimbulukweni shoka omuntu gwOmuwa Moses e mu lombwele kutya Omuwa Kalunga keni ote ke mu pa evi ndika lyokuuzilo waJordan, li ninge lyeni.
Aakiintu yeni, aana yeni niimuna otayi kala mpaka, ihe aakwiita yeni ya homatela olugodhi otaa ka taaguluka, ya tetekele Aaisraeli ooyakweni, opo ye ya kwathe,

sigo ya lala evi lyokuuninginino waJordan, ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga keni e li ya pe. Ihe ngele a gandja egundjilo komazimo agehe gaIsrael, nena otamu galuka, mu ye mu kale mevi lyeni muka muuzilo waJordan, ndyoka Moses, omuntu gwaKalunga, e li mu pe.”
Oyo ya yamukula Josua ya ti: “Otatu ningi ashihe shoka to tu lombwele notatu yi nkoka to tu tumu.
Otatu vulika kungoye, naanaa ngaashi twa li hatu vulika kuMoses. Omuwa Kalunga koye na kale nangoye, ngaashi a li naMoses.
Oongoka ta thindanda komalombwelo goye ye ita vulika kugo, na dhipagwe. Ikolelela ngoye u kale u na omukumo.”
2: Nena Josua okwa tumu oondaadhi mbali okuza kontanda yokuShittim nokwe dhi lombwele, dhi ye dhi ka ndaadhe evi lyaKaanan, unene oshilando Jeriko. Sho dhe ya moshilando, odha ka lala megumbo lyohonda edhina lyayo Rahab.
Omukwaniilwa gwaJeriko oku uvu kutya Aaisraeli yamwe oye ya uusiku, ya ndaadhe oshilongo.
Onkee a tumu elaka kuRahab tali ti: “Aalumentu mboka ye ya maandjeni, oye ya okundaadha oshilongo ashihe. Ya piitha mo.”

Rahab okwa yamukula: “Aalumentu yamwe oyi ile shili maandjetu, ihe inandi tseya mpoka ya zi. Yo yene oya yi peningino lyetango, manga omweelo gwoshilando inaagu edhilwa. Kandi shi wo nkoka yu uka, ihe ngele otamu ya landula mbala, otamu vulu oku ya kwata.” (Ihe Rahab okwa adhika a fala oondaadhi ndhoka mbali pombanda yondunda noku dhi holeka kohi yiigwanga yoliina, mbyoka e yi tulile ko.)
Aantu yuuwa oya zi mo moshilando, nomweelo ogwa patwa. Oya ka lengaalenga oondaadhi dhAaisraeli, sigo oponkondo yaJordan.
Oondaadhi manga inaadhi ilongelela, dhi ka lale, Rahab okwa londo pombanda
e ta ti kudho: “Ondi shi shi kutya Omuwa okwa gandja evi ndika miikaha yeni. Kehe omuntu moshilongo shika okwe mu tila.
Otu uvu, nkene Omuwa a pwinike Efuta etiligane komeho geni, sho mwa tembuka muEgipiti. Otu uvu, nkene mwa dhipaga Sihon naOg, aakwaniilwa yaali yAayamori kuuzilo waJordan.
Sho twe shi uvu, otwa tameke okusholola. Otwa kanitha omukumo omolweni. Omuwa Kalunga keni oye Kalunga e li megulu nokombanda yevi wo.
Ngashingeyi ganeni kuye kutya otamu ka ninga nawa egumbo lyandje, ngaashi ngame nde mu ningile nawa, ne mu pe ndje endhindhiliko lyontumba, opo ndi mu inekele.
Uvanekelii ndje kutya otamu ka hupitha tate nameme, aamwameme aakiintu naalumentu, naangandjawo ayehe. Inamu tu etha, tu dhipagwe.”

Aalumentu oya ti kuye: “Kalunga ne tu geele, ngele tse itatu ningi, ngaashi tatu ti. Ngele ito lombwele aantu shoka twe endele, otatu ku uvanekele kutya Omuwa ngele a gandja evi ndika miikaha yetu, otatu ke ku ninga nawa.”
Rahab okwa li megumbo lya tungilwa mekuma lyoshilando, onkee okwa kulukitha aalumentu mekende ye endjelele kongodhi.
Okwa ti kuyo: “Indeni kevi lyokoondundu, opo aambala kaaye mu mone. Holameni nkwiyaka omasiku gatatu, sigo taa galuka. Nena otamu vulu okutsikila ondjila yeni.”
Aalumentu oya ti kuye: “Otatu dhiginine omauvaneko ngoka twe ge ku pe.
Ninga ano ngeyi. Uuna tatu ponokele evi lyeni, tula ongodhi ndjika ontiligane mekende moka we tu piithile. Kaleka aakuluntu yoye naamwanyoko maandjeni.
Ngele ope na ngoka ta zi mo megumbo, nena ombedhi oye mwene ngele ta si; tse katu na ndjo mpoka. Ihe ngele opu na gumwe megumbo ta mono oshiponga shasha, nena ombedhi oyetu.
Ihe ngele oto lombwele ngandi sho twa ningi, nena itatu dhiginine we euvaneko lyetu ndyoka tu uvathana nangoye.”
Rahab okwa zimine e te ya etha, ya ye. Sho ya yi, okwa mangele ongodhi ontiligane mekende.
Oondaadhi odha yi moondundu nodha holama. Aambala oye dhi kongo noshilongo ashihe omasiku gatatu, ihe inaye dhi mona. Onkee oya shuna kuJeriko.
Nena oondaadhi ndhoka mbali odha kuluka koondundu nodha taaguluka omulonga e tadhi shuna kuJosua. Odhe mu lombwele ashihe shoka sha ningwa po
nodha ti: “Otu shi shi nawalela kutya Omuwa okwe tu pa oshilongo shika ashihe. Aantu ayehe yaahoka oye tu tila.”
3: Josua noshigwana ashihe shaIsrael oya meneka ongula onene, ya zi montanda yaShittim noya yi kuJordan, nkoka ya yungu ontanda, ya tegelele okutokola omulonga.
Konima yomasiku gatatu aawiliki oye ende nontanda
noya lombwele aantu ya ti: “Shimpa mwa mono aayambi ya humbata oshikethahangano shOmuwa Kalunga keni, zii mo montanda, mu ya landule.
Otaye mu kwatele komeho, oshoka ondjila kamu yi shi. Ihe omu na okukala kokule noshikethahangano, tu tye oshinano shi thike pokilometa yimwe.”
Josua okwa lombwele oshigwana a ti: “Iyapuleni, oshoka ngula Omuwa ota ka longa iikumithalonga mokati keni.”
Nena okwa lombwele aayambi, ya kuthe oshikethahangano, ya tetekele nasho komeho gaantu. Oyo noya ningi, ngaashi ya lombwelwa.
Omuwa okwa ti kuJosua: “Shoka tandi ningi nena, otashi ku simanekitha kAaisraeli ayehe, u ninge omuntu omunene, notaa dhimbulula kutya ondi li nangoye, ngaashi nda li naMoses.
Lombwela aayambi taa humbata oshikethahangano kutya nge ya adha omulonga, oye na okuthikama popepi nomunkulo.”
Nena Josua okwa ti kAaisraeli: “Ileni, mu pulakene shoka Omuwa Kalunga keni ta ti.
Ngele tamu humu komeho, ote ke mu tidhila po Aakaanana, Aaheti, Aahevi, Aaperesi, Aagirgashi, Aayamori nAayebusi. Otamu ka tseya kutya Kalunga omunamwenyo oku li mokati keni,
sho oshikethahangano shOmuwa gwevi alihe tashi tokola Jordan komeho geni.
Ngashingeyi hogololeni aalumentu omulongo nayaali, gumwe mezimo kehe lyaIsrael.

Shimpa tuu aayambi mboka taa humbata oshikethahangano shOmuwa gwevi alihe, taa lyata oompadhi dhawo momeya, nena Jordan otagu kankama okukunguluka, nomeya ngoka taga zi kombanda, otaga gongala peha limwe.”
Ethimbo olya li lyeteyo, nomulonga ogwa li gu na efundja. Aantu sho ya zi montanda, ya tokole Jordan, aayambi oye ya tetekelele ya humbata oshikethahangano. Naanziya sho aayambi ya lyata omeya,
omeya oga mwena okumatuka noga gongala puAdam, oshilando shi li pooha dhaSaretan. Ekunguluko lyokuuka kEfuta lyeso olya li lya tokolwa thilu; Aaisraeli oya vulu okupita popepi naJeriko.
Manga taa ende puukukutu, aayambi mboka ya humbata oshikethahangano, oya li ya thikama puukukutu pokati kaJordan, sigo oshigwana ashihe sha piti.
4: Oshigwana ashihe sho sha taaguluka Jordan, Omuwa okwa ti kuJosua:
“Hogolola aalumentu omulongo nayaali, gumwe mezimo kehe,
e to ya lombwele, ya toole omamanya omulongo nagaali pokati kaJordan, peha naanaa mpoka pwa li pwa thikama aayambi. Ya lombwela, ya humbate omamanya ngaka, ye ga tule mpoka tamu ka tula nena.”
Nena Josua okwi ithana aalumentu omulongo nayaali mboka a hogolola
e ta ti: “Indeni momulonga komeho goshikethahangano shOmuwa Kalunga keni. Kehe gumwe na toole emanya e te li itsike, emanya limwe kezimo kehe muIsrael.
Omamanya ngaka otaga dhimbulutha oshigwana kushoka Omuwa a ningi. Konakuyiwa aana yeni nge taye mu pula kutya omamanya ngaka otaga ti ngiini kune,
otamu ya hokololele, nkene omeya gaJordan ga thikama, sho oshikethahangano sha tokola omulonga. Omamanya ngaka otaga dhimbulutha aluhe Aaisraeli shoka sha ningilwa nkoka.”

Aalumentu oya ningi, ngaashi Josua e ya lombwele. Ngaashi naanaa Omuwa a lombwele Josua, oya kutha omamanya omulongo nagaali pokati kaJordan, emanya limwe kezimo kehe, e taye ga fala mpoka ya ka lala noye ga tula mpoka.
Josua okwa tula po ishewe omamanya omulongo nagaali pokati kaJordan mpoka aayambi ya li ya thikama, sho ya humbata oshikethahangano. (Omamanya ngoka oko ge li sigo onena.)

Aayambi oya thikama pokati kaJordan, sigo ashihe sha gwanithwa, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Josua, a lombwele Aaisraeli. Shika osho shoka Moses a tile nashi ningwe.
Aantu oye endelele okutokola omulonga.
Ayehe sho ya gama handiyaka yomulonga, nena aayambi pamwe noshikethahangano shOmuwa oya zi momulonga noye ya komeho goshigwana.
Aalumentu yomezimo lyaRuben nolyaGad netatazimo lyaManasse, mboka ya li yi ilongekidhila olugodhi, oya ka tetekela oshihupe shoshigwana, ngaashi Moses e ya lombwelele, ye shi ninge.
Aalumentu konyala omayuvi omilongo ne ya homatela olugodhi, oye ende koshipala shOmuwa ya yi kolushandja lwaJeriko.
Shoka sha ningwa kOmuwa esiku ndyoka, osha nenepekitha Josua momeho gAaisraeli. Oye mu simaneke mokukalamwenyo akuhe, ngaashi ya li ya ningi Moses.
Nena Omuwa okwa lombwele Josua,
a lombwele aayambi ya humbata oshikethahangano, ya ze mo muJordan.
Josua okwe shi ningi.
Aayambi sho ya thiki koontuni, omulonga ogwa shuna kumwe, nomeya oga kala ngaashi shito.
Aaisraeli oya tokola Jordan mesiku etimulongo lyomwedhi gwotango e taa yungu ontanda puGilgal, kuuzilo waJeriko.
Oko nkoka Josua a dhike nduno omamanya ngoka omulongo nagaali ga zile muJordan.
Okwa ti kAaisraeli: “Konakuyiwa, uuna aana yeni taye ke mu pula omamanya ngaka shoka taga ti,
otamu ke ya hokololela ethimbo ndyoka Israel a tokola Jordan puukukutu.
Ya hokololeleni kutya Omuwa Kalunga keni okwe mu pwinikile omeya gaJordan, sigo mwe gu tokola, ngaashi e shi tu ningile pEfuta etiligane.
Omolwashika omuntu kehe kombanda yevi ota ka tseya, oonkondo dhOmuwa nkene oonene, nane wo otamu ka kala mwa tila Omuwa Kalunga keni sigo aluheluhe.”
5: Aakwaniilwa ayehe yAayamori kuuninginino waJordan naakwaniilwa ayehe yAakaanana komunkulo gwEfuta lyopokati oyu uvu kutya Omuwa okwa pwinike omeya gaJordan, sigo oshigwana shaIsrael she gu tokola. Oya sholola e taa tyololoka molwAaisraeli.
Nena Omuwa okwa lombwele Josua ta ti: “Longekidha iimbele yomamanya, u kenke nayo Aaisraeli ishewe.”
Josua okwa ningi, ngaashi Omuwa e mu lombwele e ta kenkele Aaisraeli pehala lya lukwa Oshikulundundu shefukaleko.

Oshigwana shaIsrael sho sha zi muEgipiti, aalumentu ayehe oya li ya fukalekwa nokuli. Ihe momukokomoko gwondjila yomombuga omimvo omilongo ne oya li yi ipyakidhila nolweendo, onkee uunona wuumati owa li inaau fukalekwa. Ishewe, pethimbo ndyoka aalumentu ayehe yepipi lyokuhinga iita sho ya zi muEgipiti, oya li ya hulu po kokusa, oshoka oya li inaa vulika kOmuwa. Ngaashi naanaa a li e ya ganene, inaa pitikwa okumona evi ndyoka eyamba noli na omalunza, ngaashi e shi uvanekele oohekulu.
Oyanamati yaantu mbaka oya li inaa fukalekwa, ano oluvalo nduka olupe olwo aluke lwa fukalekwa kuJosua.
Konima yefukaleko oshigwana ashihe osha kala montanda, sigo iilalo ya polo nawa.
Omuwa okwa ti kuJosua: “Onena tuu ndjika onde mu pengitha omupya gwokukala aapika muEgipiti.” Onkee eha ndyoka lya lukwa Gilgal, nosho li li sigo onena.
Manga Aaisraeli ya li montanda puGilgal, polushandja ontega naJeriko, oya dhana Opaasa ongulohi yesiku etimulongo netine lyomwedhi ngoka.
Esiku lya landula ko olya li esiku lyotango, sho ya tameke okulya iikulya yomuKaanan, iikwiila inaayi fulikwa nomaha giilya ga yaywa.
Omanna oga sheka okuloka nduno, Aaisraeli inaye ga mona we. Okuza kesiku ndyoka oya li iikulya yomuKaanan.
Josua manga a li popepi naJeriko, ohaluka oku wete omulumentu a thikama komeho ge a yelutha egongamwele. Josua okwa yi kuye e te mu pula: “Ngoye omukwiita omukwetu nenge ogwaatondi yetu?”

Omulumentu okwa ti: “Aawe, ngame ondjayi yiita yOmuwa.”
Josua okwi ihata pevi koshipala she e te mu simaneke ta ti: “Ngame omupiya gwoye, tatekulu. Owa hala, ndi ninge shike?”
Ondjayi yiita yOmuwa oya ti kuye: “Hula ko oongaku dhoye, oshoka owa thikama peha eyapuki.” Josua nokwa ningi, ngaashi a lombwelwa.
6: Omiyelo dhaJeriko odha li dha patwa nodha langelwa, opo Aaisraeli ya keelelwe. Kapwa li nando ogumwe ta vulu okuya mo nenge okuza mo.
Omuwa okwa ti kuJosua: “Jeriko otandi shi gandja miikaha yoye nomukwaniilwa gwasho naakwiita yasho oofule.
Ongoye naakwiita yoye omu na okudhingoloka oshilando esiku kehe momasiku gahamano.
Aayambi naa kale yaheyali ya tya oombenda ya tetekela oshikethahangano. Mesiku etiheyali ongoye naakwiita yoye otamu dhingoloka oshilando luheyali, manga aayambi taa hiki oombenda.
Nena shaa ya hiki omunzinzi omule, nongele mwe shi uvu, nena aantu ayehe naa kugilile, nedhingililokuma lyoshilando otali ka kumuka po. Nena etangakwiita alihe otali ningine moshilando.”
Josua okwi ithana aayambi e ta ti kuyo: “Kutheni oshikethahangano, nayaheyali yomune naa tetekele komeho ya tya oombenda.”
Nena okwa lombwele aantu ye, ya tameke okudhingoloka oshilando noshikethahangano sha tetekelwa kaalangeli.

Ngaashi Josua e ya lombwele, aalangeli oya tameke okutetekela aayambi mboka taa hiki oombenda. Konima yawo okwa li aayambi mboka ya humbata oshikethahangano noya landulwa kaatonateli. Ethimbo alihe oombenda odha li tadhi hikwa.
Ihe Josua okwa li a lombwele aantu ye, yaaha kugilile noyaa tye sha, sigo te ya lombwele.
Osho nduno a lombwele ongundu yaantu ye, ya kuthe po oshikethahangano, ya dhingoloke lumwe oshilando. Opo ihe oya shuna kontanda e taa lala nkoka.

Josua okwa meneka ongula onene esiku lya landula, aayambi naakwiita oya dhingoloka oshilando melandulathano ndyoka ye shi ningi esiku lya tetekela: aalangeli, taku landula aayambi yaheyali taa hiki oombenda, nena aayambi ya humbata oshikethahangano nohugunina aatonateli. Ethimbo alihe oombenda odha li tadhi hikwa.
Esiku ndika etiyali oya dhingoloka oshilando ishewe lumwe e taa shuna kontanda. Shika oye shi ningi omasiku gahamano.
Mesiku etiheyali oya meneka petendo lyeluwa noya dhingoloka oshilando pamukalo ngoka luheyali — esiku ndika olyo alike ya dhingoloka oshilando luheyali.
Moshikando oshitiheyali manga aayambi ya hala okuhika oombenda, Josua okwa lombwele aantu ye, ya kugilile, e ta ti: “Omuwa okwe mu pe oshilando shika!
Oshilando naashihe shoka shi li mo, nayi yonagulwe po, yi ninge omayambo gOmuwa. Shila ohonda Rahab noyaandjawo oyo ayeke taa hupu, oshoka okwa holeke oondaadhi dhetu.
Inamu ikuthila nando osha shoka shi na okuhanagulwa po. Ngele tamu shi ningi, otamu kongo oshipwe e tamu etitha ehanagulo montanda yaIsrael.
Oshisiliveli, oshingoli niinima ayihe yoshikushu noyosheela nayi yoololelwe Omuwa. Oyi na okutulwa meliko lyOmuwa.”
Aayambi oya hiki oombenda. Aantu sho ye dhi uvu, oya kugilile, nedhingililokuma olya kumuka po. Nena aakwiita oya matukile oshilando noye shi kwata po.
Oya dhipaga negongamwele kehe gumwe moshilando, aalumentu naakiintu, aagundjuka naakuluntu. Oya dhipaga wo iimuna, oonzi nuusino.
Josua okwa lombwele aalumentu mboka yaali ya ndaadhele oshilando: “Indeni megumbo lyohonda, mu yi ete naangandjawo ngashingeyi, ngaashi mwe yi uvanekelele.”
Oya yi noye eta Rahab, he, yina, aamwayina naanegumbo ye ayehe. Oye ya eta naapika yawo noye ya tula megameno popepi nontanda yaIsrael.
Oshilando oye shi tomeke omulilo noye shi lungunitha po ashihe niinima ayihe pamwe nasho, kakele kiinima ya ningwa moshingoli, oshisiliveli, oshikushu nosheela, mbyoka ya tulwa meliko lyOmuwa.
Ihe Josua okwa hupitha ohonda Rahab naanegumbo ye, oshoka okwa li a holeke oondaadhi ndhoka mbali a tumine kuJeriko. (Ombuto ye oyi li muIsrael Sigo onena.)

Esiku ndyoka Josua okwa tumbula eganolondodho ta ti: “Shaa ngoka ta kambadhala okutungulula Jeriko, na thingwe kOmuwa.
Ngoka ta fulu omukanka gwasho,
ota kanitha omwanamati osheeli;
Ngoka ta kula omiyelo dhasho,
ota kanitha omwanamati onkelo.”
Omuwa okwa li pamwe naJosua, nepopiwo lye olya taandele nevi alihe.
7: Elombwelo lyOmuwa kutya Israel ina kutha nando osha muJeriko, inali gwanithwa. Omuntu gumwe edhina lye Ashan ina vulika kelombwelo ndika, onkee Omuwa okwa geele Aaisraeli (Ashan oyaKarmi, omutekulu gwaZabdi nogwomoludhi lwaSera gwomondhikwa yezimo lyaJuda.)
Josua okwa tumu aalumentu yamwe okuza kuJeriko ya yi kuAi, oshilando shi li kuuzilo waBetel, popepi naBetaven. Okwe ya lombwele, ya ka ndaadhe oshilongo shoka. Sho ye shi ningi,

oya hokololele Josua taa ti: “Itashi pumbiwa unene, aantu ayehe ya matukile Ai. Tuma ko owala shila aantu omayuvi gaali nge gatatu. Ino tuma etangakwiita alihe kolugodhi ndoka; oshilando kashi shi oshinene.”
Aaisraeli konyala omayuvi gatatu oye shi matukile, ihe oya dhengwa e taa shunithwa ko.

Aantu yomuAi oye ya tidha okuza komweelo gwoshilando, sigo okoshitapo shomamanya, e taa dhipaga po aalumentu omilongo ndatu nayahamano, sho ya kuluka koshikulundundu. Nena Aaisraeli oya tyololoka noya li ya tililila.
Josua naawiliki yaIsrael oya tuula oonguwo dhawo moluhodhi e tayi ihata pevi komeho goshikethahangano shOmuwa. Oko ya kala ya lala ndongo ongulohi noyi ifundile omavi komitse, ya holole oluhodhi.
Josua nokwa ti: “Omuwa Kalunga! Akwetu! Oshike we tu taagulukitha Jordan? Ou tu gandje nduno kAayamori? Oto tu hanagula po? Oshike inaatu kala ngaa handiyaka yaJordan?
Nena otandi ti ngiini, Omuwa, Israel sho a tidhwa kaatondi ye?
Aakaanana nokehe nee ngaa ngoka moshilongo ote ke shi uva. Otaa ke tu dhingilila e taa dhipaga shaa ngoka. Nena oto ka ninga shike, u popile esimano lyoye?”
Omuwa okwa ti kuJosua: “Thikama! Oshike wi iyekelahi ngawo pevi?
Aaisraeli oya yono! Oya teya euvaneno lyandje ndyoka nde ya lombwele, ye li dhiginine. Oya kutha iinima yimwe mbyoka ya tokolelwa efikwopo. Oye yi yaka, oya fundju e taye yi tula momaliko gawo.

Ndika olyo epuko lyAaisraeli, mboka itaa vulu we nokuli okukondjitha aatondi yawo. Otaye ya sindi, oshoka Aaisraeli oya geelwa nehanagulo. Itandi kala we nokuli nane, manga inaamu hanagula po iinima mbyoka mwa lombwelelwe, kaamu yi gume.

Thikama, yelitha oshigwana, u shi longekidhile okuholoka kungame. Ya lombwela, yi ilongekidhe ngula, oshoka ongame Omuwa Kalunga kaIsrael nda popi ndhika nda ti: ‘Israel, momaliko goye owa tula mo iinima nde yi ku lombwele, u yi yonagule po. Ito vulu okukondjitha aatondi yoye, manga inoo holola iinima mbika!’

Ya lombwela kutya ngula naa holoke po omazimo nomazimo. Ezimo ndyoka tandi ke li ulika, olyo nali holoke montaneho, oludhi noludhi. Oludhi ndoka tandi lu ulike, nena nalu ye montaneho egumbo negumbo. Negumbo ndyoka tandi li ulike, nena nali ye montaneho omuntu nomuntu.
Ngoka nee tu ulikwa nota monika e na iinima yi indikwa, oye na fikwe po pamwe naangandjawo neliko lye alihe, oshoka okwe eta oshiponga nesithahoni muIsrael, sho a yono ehangano lyandje.”
Josua okwa meneka e ta gongele Aaisraeli ezimo nezimo, nezimo lyaJuda olya li lyu ulikwa.
Nena okwe eta po ezimo lyaJuda alihe oludhi noludhi, noludhi lwaSera olwa tothwa mo. Nena okwe eta po oludhi lwaSera egumbo negumbo, negumbo lyaZabdi olya tothwa mo.
Okwe eta po egumbo lyaZabdi omuntu nomuntu, naAshan yaKarmi, omutekulu gwaZabdi, okwa tothwa mo.
Josua okwa ti kuye: “Mumwandje, popya oshili koshipala shOmuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, ihempulula. Lombwela ndje ngashingeyi shoka wa ninga. Ino kambadhala okuholeka ndje sha.”
Ashan okwa yamukula a ti: “Eeno, oshili, onda yono kOmuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael. Onda ningi ngeyi.

Mokati kiinima mbyoka twa hakana, onda mono ondjatha yOshibabiloni yo opala, ookilograma mbali dhoshisiliveli nuutale woshingoli wuudhigu wetata lyokilograma. Onde yi holeke e tandi yi kutha po. Onde yi fumvike motenda yandje, noshisiliveli shi li kohi.”
Josua okwa tumu aantu, ya matukile otenda noya mono iinima yi indikwa ya fumvikwa, noshisiliveli shi li kohi.
Oye yi kutha mo motenda noye yi fala kuJosua nAaisraeli ayehe noye yi tula koshipala shOmuwa.

Josua noshigwana ashihe shaIsrael oya kwata Ashan, oshisiliveli, ondjatha nuutale woshingoli pamwe naana yaAshan aamati naakadhona, iimuna, uusino noonzi, otenda ye neliko lye alihe; ayihe oye yi fala kEsilu lyomalwa.

Josua nokwa ti: “Omolwashike we tu etele uudhigu u thike mpaka? Omuwa nena ote ku undulile omupya.” Nena oshigwana ashihe osha dhipaga Ashan nomamanya, oye mu dhipaga e taa fike wo aangandjawo neliko lye alihe.

Oye mu ndumbile ondumba yomamanya onenenene, ndjoka oko yi li sigo onena. Omolwashoka ehala ndyoka ohali ithanwa sigo onena Esilu lyomalwa.
Nena Omuwa okwa geyuluka ihe.
8: Omuwa okwa lombwele Josua a ti: “Kutha aakwiita ayehe, u ye nayo kuAi. Ino tila ngoye ino tyololoka. Otandi ke ku pa esindano lyokusinda omukwaniilwa gwaAi; aantu ye, oshilando nevi otayi ningi yeni.
Ai nomukwaniilwa gwasho oto mu ningi, ngaashi wa ningi Jeriko nomukwaniilwa gwasho, ihe nena otamu ka likola iinima niimuna. Longekidha, u matukile oshilando ombaadhilila kosindo yasho.”
Josua okwa pyakudhukwa okuya kuAi pamwe naakwiita ye ayehe. Okwa kutha po aakwiita ya pyokoka omayuvi omilongo ndatu e te ya tumu uusiku
nelaka ndika: “Holameni kombinga ndjiya yoshilando, ihe hakokule unene; ilongekidheni oku ya matukila.
Aantu yandje nangame otatu ki ikokela moshilando. Shimpa Aayai ya zi mo taye tu matukile, otatu finyuka tatu fadhuka po, ano ngaashi twe shi ningi moshikando shotango.
Otaye ke tu tidha, sigo twe ya heke okuza ko koshilando. Otaa ka dhiladhila kutya otatu ya yi ontuku, ngaashi twa ningile nale.
Nena ne otamu hololoka mo miilangela yeni e tamu kwata po oshilando. Omuwa Kalunga keni ote ke shi mu pa.
Shimpa mwa kwata po oshilando, shi tomekeni omulilo, ngaashi Omuwa a ti. Omalombwelo ogo ngaka.”
Josua okwe ya tumu e taa yi kiilangela pokati kaAi naBetel, kuuninginino waAi, noya tegelele nkoka. Josua okwa tokelwa uusiku mboka montanda.
Ongulangula Josua okwa penduka e ta gongele aakwiita. Oye naawiliki yaIsrael oye ya kwatele komeho okuya kuAi.
Aakwiita pamwe naye oya yi popepi noshilando e taa yungu ontanda kuumbangalantu washo. Pokati kawo naAi opwa li olusilu.
Josua okwa kutha konyala aalumentu omayuvi gatano e te ya holeke kuuninginino woshilando, pokati kaAi naBetel.
Aakwiita oya longekidhilwa olugodhi. Ontanda onene oya li kuumbangalantu woshilando noshihupe shaakwiita osha li kuuninginino washo. Josua okwa tokelwa molusilu uusiku mboka.

Omukwaniilwa gwaAi sho a mono aantu yaJosua, oku uluma. Oye naantu ye oya hwanuka yu ukilila olusilu lwaJordan, ya ka kondje nAaisraeli, ngaashi ya ningile nale. Oya li inaa tseya kutya otaa vulu okumatukilwa okuza konima.
Josua naantu ye oya shuna ya fa taa yi ontuku noya fadhuka po yu uka kombuga.
Aalumentu ayehe yomoshilando oya lombwelwa, ye ke ya landule. Sho ya tidha Josua, oya yi kokule kashona noshilando.
Aalumentu ayehe yomuAi nenge Betel, oya ka tidha Aaisraeli; moshilando inamu kala we omupopili.
Nena Omuwa okwa ti kuJosua: “Ganeka egonga lyoye kuAi, otandi shi ku pe.” Josua okwa ningi, ngaashi a lombwelwa.
Ohaluka sho a yelutha oshikaha she, aalumentu mboka ya li ya holama, oya hituluka mo mbala e taa yi moshilando e taye shi kwata po. Ohaluka oye shi tomeke omulilo.
Aalumentu yomuAi sho ya tala konima, oya mono olwithi lwa tsinagala kegulu. Kaya li we ye na ompito yokuhenuka, oshoka Aaisraeli mbeyaka ya li yu uka lwokombuga, oya piluka, opo ye ya homone.
Josua naakwiita ye sho ya mono kutya yakwawo mbeya oya kwata po oshilando notashi tsinagala olwithi, oya piluka e taa dhipaga aalumentu yaAi.
Aaisraeli yomoshilando oye ya wo kolugodhi. Aalumentu yaAi oya dhimbulula kutya oya kondekwa kAaisraeli, noya dhipagwa ayehe. Inapu za nando ondhi po inapu kala ngoka e na omwenyo,
shila omukwaniilwa gwaAi, okwa kwatwa nokwa falwa kuJosua.
Aaisraeli oya dhipaga kehe gumwe gwaatondi yawo meyalala kombuga, nkoka ye ya tidhile. Nena oya galukile ishewe kuAi e taa dhipaga ayehe.

Josua okwa kala a taganekela egonga lye kuAi noine li tenteka pohi, manga aantu ayehe inaaya pwa po okudhipagwa. Oshigwana ashihe shaAi osha dhipagwa esiku ndyoka — aalumentu naakiintu omayuvi omulongo nagaali.
Aaisraeli oyi ihupithile iimuna niinima mbyoka ya hakana moshilando, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele Josua.
Josua okwa fike po Ai e te shi lokotitha po ashihe. Osha ningi eputu nosho shi li sigo onena.

Okwa mangeleke omukwaniilwa gwaAi komuti okusa e te ethele omudhimba gwe nkoka sigo ongulohi. Peningino lyetango Josua okwa lombwele, omudhimba gu kuthwe ko, nogu umbilwa posheelo shoshilando. Oye gu siikile nondumba yomamanya, ndjoka tayi monika natango nkoka.
Josua okwa tungile Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, oshiyambelo kondundu Ebal.

Okwe shi tungu pamaudhikilo ngoka Moses, omumati gwOmuwa, e ga pe Aaisraeli, ngaashi tashi popiwa mompango yaMoses taku tiwa: “Oshiyambelo nashi kale shomamanya inaaga hongwa niiyela.” Oya yambele ko Omuwa omafikilondjambo noye mu etele omakwatathanondjambo.
Josua okwa kutha emanya e li hongo montaneho yAaisraeli e ta nyola mo oohapu dhompango yaMoses.

Aaisraeli pamwe naawiliki yawo, aambala naatokolihapu naakwiilongo mboka ya li mokati kawo, oya li ya thikama koombinga noombinga dhoshikethahangano ya tongolola aayambi Aalevi mboka ye shi humbata. Etata limwe lyaantu oya li ya thikama ya pilamena kondundu Garizim, manga etata limwe lya thikama lya pilamena kondundu Ebal. Omumati gwOmuwa Moses okwe ya lombwelele, ya ninge ngeyi, ngele ethimbo lyeyambeko lyawo lya thiki.
Josua okwa lesha mokule ompango ayihe mwa kwatelelwa omayambeko nomatulomutima, ngaashi naanaa sha nyolwa membo lyompango.
Oshipango kehe shaMoses osha leshwa kuJosua pokugongala kwaayehe, nkoka kwa kwatelele mo aakiintu naanona nosho wo aakwiilongo mboka ya kala mokati kawo.
9: Omasindano gaIsrael oga tseyika kaakwaniilwa ayehe ya li kuuninginino waJordan — koondundu, kiikulundundu yoponyonga yadho nokombinga ayihe yomunkulo gwEfuta lyopokati, sigo okuLibanon kuumbangalantu. Mbaka oyo aakwaniilwa Aaheti, Aayamori, Aakaanana, Aaperesi, Aahevi nAayebusi.
Oya gongala kumwe, ya hangane okukondjitha Josua nAaisraeli.
Ihe aantu yomuGibeon, mboka ya li Aahevi, sho yu uvu, Josua nkene a ningile Jeriko naAi,
oya tokola, ye mu kotokele. Oya yi niikulya yimwe ye yi londeke kuusino nomahahi omakulu noompunda dhomaviinu dha andekwa.
Oya zala oonguwo dha kulupa noongaku oonkulu dha andekwa. Iikwiila yawo oya li ya kukuta noyi na oshushi.
Oya yi kontanda kuGilgal taa ti kuJosua nokaalumentu yaIsrael: “Otwa zi koshilongo shokokule; otwa hala, mu ninge euvaneno natse.”
Ihe aalumentu Aaisraeli oya ti: “Omolwashike tu na okuninga euvaneno nane? Mwa fa ngaa mu li popepi mpoka.”

Oyo ya ti kuJosua: “Tse aapiya yoye.”
Josua okwe ya pula: “One oolye notamu zi peni?”
Oyo ye mu hokololele ya ti: “Otatu zi kevi lyokokule, tatekulu, oshoka otwa kundana Omuwa Kalunga keni. Otu uvu ayihe mbyoka a ningi muEgipiti.
Naashoka a ningile aakwaniilwa yaali yAayamori kuuzilo waJordan: omukwaniilwa Sihon gwaHeshbon nomukwaniilwa Og gwaBaasha, mboka ya kala muAshtarot.

Aawiliki yetu naantu ayehe moshilongo shetu oye tu lombwele, tu kuthe iikulya yimwe, tu idhenge mondjila, tu ye tu ku tsakaneke. Otwa lombwelwa, tu ninge aayakuli yoye noku ku pula, u ninge euvaneno natse.
Tala kiikwiila yetu. Sho twa zi kegumbo, tu ye tu ku tsakaneke, oya li ya pupyala. Ihe yi tala ngashingeyi! Oya kukuta noyi na oshushi.
Sho tu udha oompunda ndhika dhomaviinu, odha li oompe, ihe ngashingeyi odha kulupa. Oonguwo dhetu noongaku dhetu odha kulupile mondjila onde.”
Aalumentu Aaisraeli oya taamba kuyo iikulya yimwe, ihe inaa pula nando omayele kOmuwa moshinima shika.
Josua okwa ningi euvaneno lyombili naantu yomuGibeon e te ya pitika, ya kale ye na omwenyo. Aawiliki yAaisraeli oye shi koleke nokugana.
Omasiku gatatu sho ga piti po okuza keuvaneno, Aaisraeli oya koneke kutya nani aantu mbaka oya zi popepi.
Onkee Aaisraeli oya thikama nokonima yomasiku gatatu oya thiki kiilando yawo: Gibeon, Kefira, Beerot naKiriat Jearim.
Ihe Aaisraeli inaye ya dhipaga, oshoka aawiliki oya adhika ya ninga naantu mbaka euvaneko lyokwakola medhina lyOmuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael. Aantu ayehe oye shi nyenyetele kaawiliki,
ihe mbaka oya yamukula: “Otse twe ya pe euvaneko lyokwakola medhina lyOmuwa Kalunga kaIsrael. Onkee itatu vulu oku ya ninga nayi.
Otu na oku ya etha, ya kale ye na omwenyo omolweuvaneko lyetu; ngele itatu shi ningi, nena Kalunga ote tu geele.
Naa kale ye na omwenyo, ihe oye na okutyaya iikuni noku tu tekela omeya.” Osho aawiliki ya tokola omolwawo.
Josua okwi ithanitha aantu yomuGibeon, ye ye kuye, nokwe ya pula: “Omolwashike tamu tu kotokele noku tu lombwela kutya omwa zi kokule, nando omu li popepi natse?
Molwashoka mwa ningi ngeyi, Kalunga okwe mu tokola. Oshigwana sheni otashi ka kala aluhe oshipika, aatyayi yiikuni naateki yomeya gomotempeli yaKalunga kandje.”

Oya yamukula ya ti: “Shika otwe shi ningi, tatekulu, oshoka otu uvile kutya Omuwa Kalunga koye okwa li a lombwele omumati gwe Moses, e mu pe evi ndika alihe nokudhipaga aantu ayehe mondjila yeni. Otwe shi ningi, oshoka otwa li twe mu tila nokutya otamu tu dhipaga.
Ngashingeyi otu li miikaha yoye; tu ninga shoka she ku opalela noshu uka.”
Josua osho a ningi. Okwe ya gamene noina zimina, Aaisraeli ye ya dhipage.
Ihe okwe ya ningi aapika yokutyaya iikuni nokuteka omeya gAaisraeli nogoshiyambelo shOmuwa. Sigo ongashingeyi oya tsikile okulonga mbika meha ndyoka Omuwa a hogolola, a simanekelwe mo.
10: Adonizedek, omukwaniilwa gwaJerusalem, oku uvu kutya Josua okwa sindi nokuyonagula po Ai thiluthilu nokwa dhipaga omukwaniilwa gwasho, ngaashi naanaa a ningile Jeriko nomukwaniilwa gwasho. Oku uvu wo kutya oshigwana shaGibeon osha panga uukuume nAaisraeli noye li mokati kawo.

Aantu yomuJerusalem oya li ya lulilwa kushika, oshoka Gibeon osha li oshilando oshinene shi thike pamwe noshilando kehe shi na omukwaniilwa; osha li shi vule Ai, naalumentu yomuGibeon oya li aakwiita ya pyokoka.
Ano Adonizedek okwa tumu elaka komukwaniilwa Hoham gwaHebron, omukwaniilwa Piram gwaJarmut, omukwaniilwa Jafia gwaLakish nomukwaniilwa Debir gwaEglon. Elaka otali ti:
“Ileni, mu kwathe ndje okuponokela Gibeon, oshoka osha panga uukuume naJosua nAaisraeli.”
Aakwaniilwa mbaka yatano yAayamori, ngoka gwaJerusalem, ngoka gwaHebron, ngoka gwaJarmut, ngoka gwaLakish naangoka gwaEglon, oya hangenene olugodhi, ya kondeke Gibeon e taye shi ponokele.

Aalumentu yomuGibeon oya tumu elaka kuJosua kontanda kuGilgal tali ti: “Ino tu ethela, tatekulu! Endelela, u tu kwathe! Tu hupitha! Aakwaniilwa ayehe yAayamori mevi lyokoondundu oya hangenene olugodhi noye tu ponokele.”
Onkee Josua okwa zi muGilgal pamwe netangakwiita lye alihe, moka mwa li oofulelela adhihe.
Omuwa okwa ti kuJosua: “Ino ya tila. Onde ku pa nale esindano. Kaku na nando ogumwe gwomuyo ta vulu oku ku thikamena.”
Uusiku auhe Josua naantu ye oya li mondjila okuza kuGilgal, sigo oGibeon, noya koloka e taa ponokele Aayamori.

Omuwa okwa vundakanitha Aayamori, sho ya mono etangakwiita lyAaisraeli. Aaisraeli oye ya dhipaga puGibeon noye ya tidha nondjila yuupitilo waBethoron e taye ya dhipaga, sigo okuAseka naMakkeda kuumbugantu.

Manga nee Aayamori ya li taa yi ontuku yetangakwiita lyAaisraeli taa kuluka metaulilo lyaBethoron, Omuwa okwe ya lokithile omamanya omanene goompawe ethimbo alihe, sigo okuAseka. Mboka ya si koompawe, oya li oyendji ye vule mboka ya dhipagwa kAaisraeli.

Etango olya kala lya mwena, nomwedhi inagu inyenga, sigo oshigwana sha sindi aatondi yasho. Shika osha nyolwa mEmbo lyaJashar. Etango olya thikama lya mwena pokati komutenya noinali peguka esiku alihe.
Muuyuni wonale nenge mboka wa landula ko inamu kala esiku lya fa ndika, Omuwa sho a vulika komuntu. Omuwa okwa kondjele shili Aaisraeli.
Konima yaambika Josua naakwiita ye oya shuna kontanda kuGilgal.
Aakwaniilwa mbeyaka yatano yAayamori oya adhika ya fadhuka po e taa holama mekololo lyaMakkeda.
Omuntu gumwe okwe ya mono, naJosua okwa lombwelwa mpoka ya holama.
Oye a ti: “Galangatithilii po omamanya gamwe omanene posheelo shekololo. Tulii po wo aalangeli,
ihe inamu kala po ne yene. Ka landuleni aatondi, ne mu ya homone tamu zi molutako lwawo. Inamu ya etha, ya ka shune miilando yawo. Omuwa Kalunga keni okwe ye mu sinditha.”
Josua naakwiita ye oye ya dhipaga, nando aanelago yamwe ya hupu ngaa, sho ya ka holama moohote dhiilando yawo noinaa dhipagwa.

Nena aantu yaJosua ayehe oya galukile kuye kontanda puMakkeda yaa na mbudhi.
Moshilongo kamwa li nando ogumwe ta vulu okwiitakeka Aaisraeli.
Nena Josua okwa ti: “Thitululeni osheelo shekololo, ne mu ete aakwaniilwa mboka yatano kungame.”
Ekololo olye egululwa, naakwaniilwa gwaJerusalem, gwaHebron, gwaJarmut, gwaLakish nogwaEglon oya kuthwa mo
e taa falwa kuJosua. Josua okwi ithanene kuye aalumentu ayehe yaIsrael, e ta lombwele aambala mboka ye ende pamwe naye, ya lyate aakwaniilwa koothingo. Osho ya ningi.
Nena Josua okwa ti kaambala: “Inamu tila nenge mu tyololoke. Ikoleleni, ne mu kale nomukumo, oshoka shika osho shoka Omuwa ta ka ninga aatondi yeni ayehe.”
Nena Josua okwa dhipaga aakwaniilwa e te ya endjeleleke komiti ntano, nkoka omidhimba dhawo dha kala sigo ongulohi.
Peningino lyetango Josua okwa lombwele, omidhimba dhi kuthwe ko dho dhi umbilwe mekololo moka ya li ya holama nale. Omimanya ominene odha tulwa posheelo shekololo noko dhi li natango.
Josua okwa homona e ta sindi Makkeda nomukwaniilwa gwasho esiku ndyoka. Okwa dhipaga aantu ayehe moshilando; inaku hupa nondhi. Omukwaniilwa gwaMakkeda okwe mu ningi ngaashi omukwaniilwa gwaJeriko.
Konima yaambika Josua netangakwiita lye oya zi muMakkeda yu uka kuLibna e taye shi ponokele.

Omuwa okwa sinditha Aaisraeli oshilando shika nomukwaniilwa gwasho. Inaa hupitha nando ogumwe, ndele oya dhipaga omuntu kehe musho. Omukwaniilwa oye mu ningi, ngaashi ya ningile omukwaniilwa gwaJeriko.
Konima yaambika Josua netangakwiita lye oya zi muLibna yu uka kuLakish. Oye shi kondeke e taye shi ponokele.
Omuwa okwa pe Aaisraeli esindano okusinda Lakish esiku etiyali lyolugodhi. Ngaashi naanaa ya ningile puLibna, inaa hupitha nando ogumwe, ihe oya dhipaga ayehe moshilando.
Omukwaniilwa Horam gwaGeser okwe ya okukwatha Lakish, ihe Josua okwe mu dhenge netangakwiita lye ye ina hupitha nando ogumwe gwomuyo, a kale e na omwenyo.
Opo ihe Josua netangakwiita lye oya zi muLakish yu uka kuEglon noye shi kondeke e taye shi ponokele.
Oye shi kwata po esiku tuu ndyoka e taa dhipaga omuntu kehe, ngaashi naanaa ya ningile muLakish.
Konima yaambika Josua netangakwiita lye oya zi muEglon yu uka koondundu kuHebron. Oye shi ponokele
e taye shi kwata po. Oya dhipaga omukwaniilwa nomuntu kehe moshilando shika, osho wo miilando yopuushiinda. Josua okwa yono po oshilando thiluthilu, naanaa ngaashi a ningi Eglon. Ina hupitha nondhi.
Nena Josua netangakwiita lye oya pilukile kuDebir noye shi ponokele.
Okwe shi kwata po nomukwaniilwa gwasho niilando ayihe yopuushiinda. Oya dhipaga ayeheyehe. Josua okwa ningi Debir nomukwaniilwa gwasho, ngaashi a ningile Hebron naLibna nomukwaniilwa gwasho.

Josua okwa lala evi alihe. Okwa sindi aakwaniilwa yomevi lyokoondundu, komasilukila gadho gokuuzilo nokiikulundundu yoponyonga yadho kuuninginino, osho wo mboka yokombinga yokuumbugantu ihaaku lokwa. Ina hupitha nando olye; ayeheyehe oya dhipagwa. Osho Omuwa Kalunga kaIsrael okwa li a lombwele Aaisraeli.
Josua okwa lala evi alihe okuza kuKadesh Barnea kuumbugantu, sigo oGaza popepi nomunkulo, oshitopolwa ashihe shaGoshen nosigo okuGibeon kuumbangalantu.
Oshitopolwa shika naakwaniilwa ayehe yasho Josua okwe shi kwata po moshikando shimwe, oshoka Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, okwa kondjele Israel.
Konima yaambika Josua netangakwiita lye oya shuna kontanda kuGilgal.
11: Omukwaniilwa Jabin gwaHazor sho u uvu onkundana yomasindano gAaisraeli, okwa tumu elaka komukwaniilwa Jobab gwaMadon, ngoka gwaShimron naangoka gwaAksaf,
osho wo kaakwaniilwa mboka ya kala mevi lyokoondundu kuumbangalantu, molusilu lwaJordan kuumbugantu wEfuta lyaGalilea, kiikulundundu yoponyonga nopomunkulofuta popepi naDor.
Okwa tumu wo elaka kAakaanana koombinga adhihe mbali dhaJordan, kAayamori, kAaheti, kAaperesi nokAayebusi mevi lyokoondundu, osho wo kAahevi ya kala ponyonga yondundu Hermon mevi lyaMispa.
Oye ya naakwiita yawo ayehe. Oya li oyendjiyendji ya fa ehekevi pooha dhefuta. Oya li ye na wo uukambe owindji nomatembakwiita ogendji.
Aakwaniilwa mbaka ayehe oya hangenene olugodhi noye ya kumwe e taa yungu ontanda pokalonga kaMerom, ya kondjithe Israel.
Omuwa okwa ti kuJosua: “Ino ya tila. Ngula pethimbo ndika otandi ya gandja ayehe ya sindika miikaha yaIsrael. Otamu ka lemaneka uukambe wawo nokufika po omatemba gawo guukwiita.”
Josua naakwiita ye oye ya homona oshikumithi okalonga kaMerom.

Omuwa okwa pe Aaisraeli esindano; Aaisraeli oye ya ponokele noye ya tidha sigo oMisrefot Majim naSidon kuumbangalantu nokolusilu lwaMispe kuuzilo. Oye ya kondjitha, sigo inaku hupa we nando ogumwe gwawo.
Josua okwe ya ningile, ngaashi Omuwa e mu lombwele. Okwa lemaneke uukambe wawo nokwa fike po omatemba gawo guukwiita.
Opo ihe Josua okwa piluka, a kwata po Hazor e ta dhipaga omukwaniilwa gwasho. (Pethimbo ndiyaka Hazor osha li oshilando oshinankondo shi vule ayihe yilwe.)
Oya dhipaga ayeheyehe; inapu hupa nando ogumwe, noshilando osha fikwa po.
Josua okwa kwata po iilando mbika ayihe naakwaniilwa yayo nokwa dhipagitha ayehe, naanaa ngaashi Moses, omumati gwOmuwa, a li e mu lombwele.
Ihe Aaisraeli inaa fika nando oshimwe shomiilando mbyoka yokiikulundundu kakele kaHazor, shoka Josua a fike po.
Miilando mbika Aaisraeli oya hakana iinima ayihe yondilo niimuna noya kala nayo. Ihe oya dhipaga omuntu kehe; inaa hupitha nando ogumwe.
Omuwa okwa li a lombwele omumati gwe Moses, osho wo Moses okwa li a lombwele Josua, naJosua okwa li a vulika. Okwa ningi ashihe shoka Omuwa a li a lombwele Moses.
Josua okwa lala evi alihe — evi lyokoondundu niikulundundu yoponyonga yadho, kuumbangalantu nokuumbugantu, oshitopolwa ashihe shaGoshen nombinga ihaayi lokwa

kuumbugantu washo, osho wo olusilu lwaJordan. Oshitopolwa osha li sha taandela okuza kondundu Halak kuumbugantu popepi naEdom, sigo oBaal Gad kuumbangalantu molusilu lwaLibanon kuumbugantu wondundu Hermon. Ethimbo ele Josua okwa li ta kondjitha aakwaniilwa yoshitopolwa shika, ndele okwe ya sindi ayehe e te ya dhipaga.
Oshilando shimwe ashike shoka sha panga ombili nAaisraeli, osha li Gibeon, shoka sha kalwa kAahevi. Iilando ayihe yilwe oya sindika miita.
Omuwa okwa li e ya uthile okukondjitha Israel, opo ya wape okupangulilwa okuhanagulwapo pwaa na henda. Shika osho shoka Omuwa a lombwele Moses.

Pethimbo ndiyaka Josua okwa yi e ta thekagula po oludhi lwaalefule halu ithanwa Aayanakim. Oya kala mevi lyokoondundu — muHebron, Debir, Anab nomevi alihe lyokoondundu dhaJuda naIsrael. Josua okwe ya hanagula po sheke niilando yawo.
Mevi lyAaisraeli inamu thigala nando Omuanakim gumwe; omandaangela oga kala ngaa muGaza, Gat naAshdod.

Josua okwa kwata po evi alihe, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwelele Moses. Josua okwe li pe Aaisraeli, li ninge lyawo nokwe li topola miitopolwa, ezimo kehe oshitopolwa shalyo.
Osho ngeyi Aaisraeli oya ngungile ihe, iita sho ya kuka.
12: Okuza kolusilu lwaArnon okuuka nolusilu lwaJordan, sigo okondundu Hermon kuumbangalantu, Aaisraeli oya adhika ya kwata po nokulala evi lyokuuzilo waJordan. Oya sindi aakwaniilwa yaali.

Gumwe oSihon, omukwaniilwa gwAayamori, ngoka a li ta pangele muHeshbon. Oshilongo she osha kwatelele mo etata lyaGilead: okuza kuAroer (kooha dholusilu lwaArnon) noshilando shi li pondinga yolusilu ndoka, sigo okomulonga Jabbok, ngoka ongamba yaAmmon;
e tashi kwatelele mo olusilu lwaJordan okuza kEfuta lyaGalilea okuuka lwokuumbugantu, sigo oBet Jeshimot (kuuzilo wEfuta lya sa) noponyonga yondundu Pisga.
Oyo ya sindi wo omukwaniilwa Og gwaBaasha, ngoka a li gumwe gwomAarafa yahugunina; okwa lele muAshtarot naEdrei.
Oshilongo she osha kwatelele mo ondundu Hermon, Salka naBaasha, ashihe, sigo okoongamba dhaGeshur naMaaka, osho wo etata lyaGilead, sigo okoshitopolwa shomukwaniilwa Sihon gwaHeshbon.
Aakwaniilwa mbaka yaali oya li ya sindwa kuMoses nAaisraeli. Omumati gwOmuwa Moses okwa gandja evi lyawo kezimo lyaRuben nolyaGad noketatazimo lyaManasse, li ninge eliko lyawo.

Josua nAaisraeli oya sindi aakwaniilwa ayehe yomoshitopolwa shokuuninginino waJordan, okuza kuBaal Gad molusilu lwaLibanon, sigo ondundu Halak kuumbugantu popepi naEdom. Josua okwa topolele omazimo evi ndika, ga kale mo aluhe.

Oshitopolwa shika osha kwatelele mo evi lyokoondundu, iikulundundu yoponyonga yadho kuuninginino, olusilu lwaJordan niikulundundu yoponyonga yalwo, omasilukila gokuuzilo nevi lyokuumbugantu hoka ihaaku lokwa. Evi ndika olya li lyAaheti, lyAayamori, lyAakaanana, lyAaperesi, lyAahevi nolyAayebusi.
Aaisraeli oya sindi aakwaniilwa yiilando mbika: Jeriko, Ai (popepi naBetel),
Jerusalem, Hebron,
Jarmut, Lakish,
Eglon, Geser,
Debir, Geder,
Horma, Arad,
Libna, Adullam,
Makkeda, Betel,
Tappua, Hefer,
Afek, Lashar on,
Madon, Hazor,
Shimron Meron, Aksaf,
Taanak, Megiddo,
Kedesh, Jokneam (ponyonga yaKarmel),
Dor (komunkulo), Goiim (muGalilea)
naTirza — kumwe aakwaniilwa omilongo ndatu nagumwe.
13: Josua okwa li a kulupa nokuli. Omuwa okwa ti kuye: “Ngoye owa kulupa nokuli, ihe oku na natango ombinga onene yevi ndyoka li na okukuthwa ko:
oshilongo ashihe shAafilisti noshAageshur,

osho wo shoka shAayavvim kuumbugantu. (Evi okuza kokalonga Shihor pongamba yaEgipiti, sigo okoshitopolwa shaEkron, olya talwa lyAakaanana; aakwaniilwa yAafilisti oya kala muGaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gat naEkron.)
Nkoka oku na natango oshilongo ashihe shAakaanana, naMeara (shoka oshAasidoni), sigo Afek pongamba yAayamori;
evi lyAagebali; Libanon ashihe kuuzilo okuza kuBaal Gad kuumbugantu wondundu Hermon, sigo eelo lyaHamat.

Shika osha kwatelele mo oshilongo ashihe shAasidoni, mboka ya kala mevi lyokoondundu pokati koondundu dhaLibanon naMisrefot Majim. Otandi ka tidha mo iigwana mbika ayihe mokuhuma komeho kwoshigwana shaIsrael. Ou na okutopolela Aaisraeli evi, naanaa ngaashi nde ku lombwela.
Ngashingeyi evi ndika li topolela omazimo omulongo netatazimo lyaManasse, li ninge eliko lyago.”
Ezimo lyaRuben nolyaGad netatazimo lyaManasse oga taamba nale nokuli evi ndyoka Moses, omumati gwOmuwa, e li ga pe; olya li kuuzilo womulonga Jordan.
Oshitopolwa shago osha li sha taandela sigo Aroer (kooha dholusilu lwaArnon) nokoshilando shopondinga yolusilu ndoka nosha kwatelele mo etumbalalovi okuza Medeba, sigo oDibon.
Osha adha kongamba yaAmmon notashi kwatelele mo iilando ayihe mbyoka ya li ya pangelwa komukwaniilwa gwAayamori Sihon, ngoka a pangele muHeshbon.
Osha kwatelele mo Gilead, oshitopolwa shaGeshur noshaMaaka, ondundu Hermon ayihe naBaasha ashihe, sigo oSalka.
Osha kwatelele mo oshilongo shaOg, Omurafa omuhugunini, ngoka a pangele muAshtarot naEdrei. Moses okwa sindile aantu mbaka e te ya tidha po.
Onkene tuu Aaisraeli inaa tidha po Aageshuri nAamaaka; oya kala mAaisraeli sigo onena.
Moses ina gandja nando evi kAalevi. Ngaashi Omuwa a lombwelele Moses, oya li ye na okupewa oshitopolwa moondjambo ndhoka dha lungunithilwa Omuwa Kalunga kaIsrael.
Moses okwa adhika a gandja oshitopolwa shimwe shevi komaludhi gomezimo lyaRuben.
Oshitopolwa shago osha li sha taandela sigo Aroer (kooha dholusilu lwaArnon) nokoshilando shopondinga yolusilu ndoka nosha kwatelele mo etumbalalovi alihe momudhingoloko gwaMedeba.
Osha kwatelele mo Heshbon niilando ayihe yoketumbalalovi: Dibon, Bamot Baal, Bet Baal Meron,
Jahas, Kedemot, Mefaat,
Kirjatajim, Sibma, Zeret Shakar koshikulundundu shomolusilu,
Betpeor, omasilukila goondundu Pisga naBet Jeshimot.

Osha kwatelele mo iilando ayihe yoketumbalalovi noshilongo ashihe shomukwaniilwa Omuamori Sihon, ngoka a li a pangele kuHeshbon. Moses okwe mu sindi, osho wo aapangeli yaMidian: Evi, Rekem, Sur, Hur naReba. Ayehe mbaka oya li aaniikandjo moshilongo shomukwaniilwa Sihon.
Mokati kaamboka ya dhipagwa kAaisraeli, omwa li wo omwaanekeli Bileam yaBeor.
Jordan ogwa li ongamba yokuuninginino yezimo lyaRuben. Mbika oyo iilando nomikunda dha pewa omaludhi gomezimo lyaRuben, dhi ninge eliko lyawo.
Moses okwa li a gandja wo oshitopolwa shimwe shevi komaludhi gomezimo lyaGad.
Oshitopolwa shago osha kwatelele mo Jaser niilando ayihe yomuGilead, etata lyevi lyaAmmon sigo Aroer, shoka shi li kuuzilo waRabba;
evi lyago olya li lya taandela okuza Heshbon, sigo oRamat Mispe naBetonim, okuza Mahanaim, sigo ongamba yaDebir.

Molusilu lwaJordan osha kwatelele mo Bet Haram, Bet Nimra, Sukkot naZafon, oshihupe shoshilongo shomukwaniilwa Sihon gwaHeshbon. Ongamba yasho yokuuninginino oya li omulonga Jordan, sigo Efuta lyaGalilea.
Mbika oyo iilando nomikunda dha pewa omaludhi gomezimo lyaGad, dhi ninge eliko lyawo.
Moses okwa li a gandja oshitopolwa shimwe shevi komaludhi gometatazimo lyaManasse.
Oshitopolwa shago osha li sha taandela sigo oMahanaim nosha kwatelele mo Baasha ashihe — oshilongo ashihe shaOg, omukwaniilwa gwaBaasha, osho wo omikunda adhihe omilongo hamano dhaJair muBaasha.
Osha kwatelele mo etata lyaGilead, osho wo Ashtarot naEdrei, iilandopangelo yoshilongo shaOg muBaasha. Ayihe mbika oya pewa omaludhi ga za muMakir yaManasse.
Osho Moses a topola evi lyokuuzilo waJeriko naJordan, sho a li kolushandja lwaMoab.
Ihe Moses ina gandja evi lyasha kezimo lyaLevi. Okwe ya lombwele kutya oshitopolwa shawo otashi zi moondjambo tadhi yambelwa Omuwa Kalunga kaIsrael.
14: Mpaka otapa landula ehokololo, nkene evi lyaKaanan kuuninginino waJordan lya topolelwa Aaisraeli. Osha ningwa komuyambi Eleasar, kuJosua yaNun nokaawiliki yomaludhi gomomazimo gaIsrael.
Ngaashi Omuwa a li a lombwele Moses, iitopolwa yomazimo omugoyi netata kuuninginino waJordan oyu uthwa nokuumba oshihogololitho.

Moses okwa li a gandja nokuli evi kuuzilo waJordan komazimo gaali netata. (Oluvalo lwaJosef olwa li lwa topolwa momazimo gaali: ndyoka lyaManasse naandyoka lyaEfraim.) Ihe Aalevi inaa pewa kuMoses oshitopolwa shasha. Oya pewa ashike iilando yokukala mo nomalundu guunapelo okulitha oongombe dhawo, oonzi niikombo yawo.
Aaisraeli oya topola evi, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwelele Moses.

Esiku limwe aantu yamwe yomezimo lyaJuda oye ya kuJosua kuGilgal. Gumwe gwomuyo, Kaleb kaJefunne Omukenasi, okwa ti kuye: “Ou shi shi shoka Omuwa a popi muKadesh Barnea kombinga yetu nangoye kuMoses, omuntu gwaKalunga.
Onda li ndi na omimvo omilongo ne, sho Moses, omumati gwOmuwa, a tumu ndje okuza kuKadesh Barnea okundaadha evi ndika. Onde mu etele ondjokonona yoshili.
Aalumentu mboka ya yile ko pamwe nangame, oya mbandameke oshigwana shetu, ihe ngame onda li nda dhiginine okuvulika kOmuwa, Kalunga kandje.
Sho nda ningi ngeyi, Moses oku uvanekele ndje euvaneko lya kola nokutya ngame noluvalo lwandje otatu ka pewa eliko lyetu mevi ndyoka nde li lyata oompadhi.

Eewa, ngashingeyi opwa piti omimvo omilongo ne nantano, Omuwa sho e shi lombwele Moses. Shika osha ningwa, manga Israel a li mombuga. Pauvaneko lye Omuwa okwa gamene ndje, ndi kale ko natango ndi na omwenyo. Ondi na oomvula omilongo hetatu nantano,
ihe oonkondo dhandje natango tuu odhi thike pundhoka, Moses sho a tumine ndje. Natango tuu onda gwana okuhinga iita nenge okuninga sha shilwe.

Pe ndje ano evi ndyoka lyokoondundu Omuwa u uvanekele ndje esiku ndiyaka. Ngoye owa kundana esiku ndiyaka kutya hwiyaka oku na oludhi lwaalefule halu ithanwa Aayanakim, ya kala miilando iinene yomadhingililokuma. Ondi inekela, Omuwa ota ka kala pamwe nangame, opo ndi ya tidhe mo, naanaa ngaashi Omuwa a ti.”
Josua okwa yambeke Kaleb kaJefunne e te mu pe oshilando Hebron, shi ninge eliko lye.
Sigo onena Hebron osholuvalo lwaKaleb kaJefunne Omukenasi, oshoka okwa li a vulika kOmuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael.

Nale Hebron osha li hashi ithanwa oshilando shaArba. (Arba okwa li nale omunenentu mokati kAayanakim.)
Nomoshilongo omwa li ombili.
15:
Omaludhi gomezimo lyaJuda oga pewa oshitopolwa shevi, ngaashi tashi landula:
Kuumbugantu evi olya li lya taandela sigo onkotso yahugunina yombuga Zin pongamba yaEdom.
Ongamba ndjika yokuumbugantu oya tameke kohulo yEfuta lya sa,
yu uka lwokuumbugantu okuza pomulondo gwondundu Akrabbim, sigo oZin, sigo oKadesh Barnea, tayi pitilile Hezron, tayi londo yu uka kuAddar, tayi goyokele lwokuKarka,
yu uka kuAzmon nokulandula ihe okalonga pongamba yaEgipiti, sigo okEfuta lyopokati, mpoka ongamba tayi hulile. Ndjika oyo ongamba yokuumbugantu yaJuda.

Ongamba yokuuzilo oyo Efuta lya sa, sigo oompoka Jordan tagu yi mulyo.
Oko nkoka ongamba yokuumbangalantu tayi tameke.
Oya adha kuBet Hogla nokupitilila Bet Araba kuumbangalantu washo. Okuza nkoka oyu uka kemanya lyaBohan (omuna gwaRuben),

okuza kEsilu lyomalwa otayi londo yu uka kuDebir nokugoyokela kuumbangalantu yu uka lwokuGilgal, shoka sha taalela omulondo gwaAdummim handiyaka yolusilu kuumbugantu. Nena otayi tsikile yu uka koothithiya dhaEnshemesh nokuhulila muEnrogel.

Okuza nkoka ongamba otayi londo ya lambalala olusilu lwaGe Ben Hinnom kuumbugantu woshikulundundu, nkoka kwa li Jerusalem shAayebusi. Opo ihe otayi londo komutse gwoshikulundundu kuuninginino wolusilu lwaHinnom, kombinga yokuumbangalantu wolusilu lwaRefaim.
Okuza nkoka otayi uka komaluthithiya gaNeftoak nokiilando yi li popepi nondundu Efron. Nkoka otayi piluka yu uka kuBaala (kokutya Kiriat Jearim),
mpoka otayi goyokele kuuninginino yu uka kevi lyokiikulundundu yaSeir, tayi kunkula nondundu yaKiriat Jearim (kokutya Kesalon) kuumbangalantu nokusilukila kuBet Shemesh nokuTimna.
Opo ihe ongamba tayi tsikile yu uka koshikulundundu kuumbangalantu waEkron, tayi goyokele lwokuShikkaron, tayi pitilile ondundu Baala yu uka kuJamnia. Oya hulile mEfuta lyopokati,

ndyoka tali ningi ongamba yokuuninginino.
Meni lyoongamba ndhika aantu yomaludhi gaJuda oya kala mo.
Kaleb kaJefunne, ogwomezimo lyaJuda, okwa pewa okambinga moshitopolwa shaJuda, ngashi Omuwa a lombwele Josua. Okwa pewa Hebron, oshilando shaArba, he yAayanak.
Kaleb okwa tidha mo oluvalo lwaAnak — oludhi lwaSheshai, lwaAhiman, nolwaTalmai.
Okuza nkoka okwa ka matukila aantu yomuDebir. (Oshilando shika osha li hashi ithanwa Kiriat Sefer.)
Kaleb okwa ti: “Omulumentu ngoka ta tompola okusinda Kiriat Sefer, otandi mu pe omumwandje omukadhona Aksa, e mu hokane po.”
Otniel yaKenas, omuna gwamumwayina Kaleb, okwe shi sindi; osho ngaaka Kaleb okwe mu pe omwana Aksa, a ninge omukadhi.
Mohango Otniel oku ulumike omukadhi, i indile he epya. Aksa okwa londoloka kokasino ke, naKaleb okwe mu pula sho a hala.
Okwa yamukula: “Onda hala omithima dhimwe dhomeya. Evi ndyoka we li pe ndje, oli na enota.” Nena Kaleb okwe mu pe omatope gokiiheke noonyombo dhomomadhiya.
Ndika olyo evi omaludhi gezimo lyaJuda ge li taamba, li ninge eliko lyago.
Iilando yawo mbyoka ya tsa kokule kuumbugantu popepi nongamba yaEdom, oyo Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
Kina, Dimona, Adada,
Kedesh, Hazor, Jitnan,
Sif, Telem, Bealot,
Hazor Hadatta, Kerijot-Hezron (kokutya Hazor),
Amam, Shema, Molada,
Hazar Gadda, Heshmon, Bet Pelet,
Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziotia nomikunda dhasho,
Baala, Ijim, Ezem,
Eltolad, Kesil, Horma,
Ziklag, Madmanna, Sansanna,
Bet Lebaot, Shilhim, Ain naRimmon: iilando omilongo mbali nomugoyi nomikunda dhayo.
Iilando yoponyonga yoondundu oyo mbika: Eshtaol, Soar, Ashna,
Sanoa, En-gannim, Tappua, Enam,
Jarmut, Adullam, Soko, Aseka,
Shaarajim, Aditajim, Gedera, Gederotajim: iilando omulongo niine nomikunda dhayo.
Okwa li wo Zenan, Hadasha, Migdal Gad,
Dilean, Mispe, Jokteel,
Lakish, Bozkat, Eglon,
Kabbon, Lakmas, Kitlish,
Gederot, Bet Dagon, Naama naMakkeda: iilando omulongo niihamano nomikunda dhayo.
Okwa li wo Libna, Eter, Ashan,
Jiftak, Ashna, Nezib,
Keila, Aksib, Maresha: iilando omugoyi nomikunda dhayo.
Okwa li Ekron niitayilando yasho nomikunda dhasho,
niilando ayihe nomikunda adhihe popepi naAshdod okuza kuEkron, sigo okEfuta lyopokati.
Okwa li Ashdod naGaza niitayilando yayo nomikunda dhayo dha adha sigo okalonga kongamba yaEgipiti nokomunkulo gwEfuta lyopokati.
Mevi lyokoondundu omwa li Shamir, Jattir, Soko,
Danna, Kirjat Sanna (kokutya Debir),
Anab, Eshtemoa, Anim,
Goshen, Holon naGilo: iilando omulongo nashimwe nomikunda dhayo.
Okwa li Arab, Duma, Eshan,
Janim, Bet Tappua, Afek,
Humta, Hebron naZior: iilando omugoyi nomikunda dhayo.
Okwa li Maon, Karmel, Sif, Jutta,
Jesreel, Jokdeam, Sanoa,
Kain, Gibea naTimna: iilando omulongo nomikunda dhayo.
Okwa li Halhul, Bet-Sur, Gedor,
Maarat, Bet Anot, naEltekon: iilando ihamano nomikunda dhayo.
Okwa li Kirjat Baal (kokutya Kiriat Jearim) naRabba: iilando iyali nomikunda dhayo.
Mombuga omwa li Bet Arab, Middin, Sekaka,
Nibshan, Oshilando shOmongwa, naEn-gedi: iilando ihamano nomikunda dhayo.
Ihe oshigwana shaJuda inashi wapa okutidha mo Aayebusi mboka ya kala muJerusalem. Natango tuu Aayebusi omo ya kala pamwe nAajuda.
