16: Ongamba yokuuninginino wevi lya pewa oluvalo lwaJosef, otayi tameke muJordan popepi naJeriko, kuuzilo woothithiya dhaJeriko, yu uka kombuga. Okuza kuJeriko oyu uka kevi lyokoondundu, sigo okuBetel.
Okuza kuBetel oyu uka kuLus notayi tsikile kuAtarot, nkoka Aayarki ya kala.
Nena oyu uka kuuninginino kehala lyAajaflet, sigo okuBethoron shomolusilu. Okuza nkoka otayi tsikile kuGeser nokuhulila mEfuta lyopokati.
Oluvalo lwaJosef, ezimo lyaEfraim nolyaManasse kuuninginino, olwa pewa evi ndika, li ninge eliko lyalwo.
Oshitopolwa shomaludhi gomezimo lyaEfraim osho shika: Ongamba yasho oyu uka okuza kuAtarot Addar lwokuuzilo kuBethoron shopombanda,
nokuza nkoka sigo Efuta lyopokati. Kuumbangalantu Mikmetat oyo ongamba. Kuuzilo waahoka ongamba otayi goyokele lwokuTaanat Shilo noku shi pitilila kuuzilo yu uka kuJanoa.
Okuza kuJanoa otayi silukile kuAtarot naNaara, tayi adha Jeriko e tayi hulile muJordan.
Okuza kuTappua ongamba oyu uka kuuninginino kokalonga Kana e tayi hulile mEfuta lyopokati. Evi ndika olya pewa omaludhi gomezimo lyaEfraim, li ninge eliko lyago,
pamwe niilando nomikunda dhimwe dhi li meni lyoongamba dhaManasse.
Ihe inaa tidha mo Aakaanana mboka ya kala muGeser, onkee Aakaanana oya kala mokati kAaefraim sigo onena, ihe oya thiminikwa okulonga ngaapika.
17: Oshitopolwa shimwe shevi kuuninginino osha pewa omagumbo gamwe gomoluvalo lwaManasse, osheeli shaJosef, Makir, he yaGilead, okwa li osheeli shaManasse. Shoka okwa li omukwiita ofule, okwa pewa Gilead naBaasha kuuzilo waJordan.

Evi lyokuuninginino waJordan olya pewa oshihupe shomomagumbo gaManasse: Abieser, Helek, Asriel, Shekem, Hefer naShemida. Mbaka oya li aalumentu yomoluvalo lwaManasse gaJosef noya li aakuluntu yomagumbo.
Zelofhad yaHefer yaGilead yaMakir gaManasse okwa li kee na nando omwanamati, aakadhona ayeke. Omadhina gawo ogo Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka naTirza.

Oya yi komuyambi Eleasar naJosua yaNun nokaawiliki e taa ti: “Omuwa okwa lombwele Moses, e tu pe ngaashi aalumentu aakwetu oshitopolwa shevi, shi ninge eliko lyetu.” Oyo noya pewa eliko lyawo mokati koohegona aasamane, ngaashi sha tiwa kOmuwa.
Osho ngeyi Manasse okwa pewa iitopolwa omulongo kakele kaGilead naBaasha kuuzilo waJordan,
oshoka noluvalo lwe lwaakiintu olwa pewa evi ngaashi ndoka lwaalumentu. Evi lyaGilead olya pewa oshihupe sholuvalo lwaManasse.
Oshitopolwa shaManasse osha li okuza Aser, sigo oMikmetat kuuzilo waShekem. Ongamba oyu uka kuumbugantu nokweedhilila mo aantu yomuEntappua.
Evi momudhingoloko gwaTappua olya li lyaManasse, ihe oshilando Tappua pongamba osha li sholuvalo lwaEfraim.

Opo ihe ongamba tayi silukile kokalonga Kana. Iilando yokuumbugantu wokalonga oya li yaEfraim, nando oya kala moshitopolwa shaManasse. Ongamba yaManasse otayi ende kombinga yokuumbangalantu wokalonga notayi hulile mEfuta lyopokati.
Efraim okwa li kuumbugantu, Manasse okuumbangalantu, nEfuta lyopokati olya li ongamba yawo yokuuninginino. Aser okwa li kuuningininombangalantu nalsaskar okuuzilombangalantu.
Miitopolwa yaIssaskar noyaAser Manasse okwa pewa mo Betshan naJibleam pamwe nomikunda dhayo, osho wo Dor (shoka shokomunkulo), Endor, Taanak, Megiddo niitayilando yayo.
Ihe Aamanasse inaa wapa okutidha mo aantu miilando mbika, onkee Aakaanana oya tsikile okukala muyo.
Nokuli Aaisraeli nando oya ningi aanankondo, inaa tidha mo Aakaanana, ihe oye ya thiminike oku ya longela.
Oluvalo lwaJosef olwa ti kuJosua: “Omolwashike we tu pe ashike oshitopolwa shimwe shevi, shi ninge eliko lyetu? Otu li oyendji, oshoka Omuwa okwe tu yambeka.”
Josua okwa yamukula: “Ngele ne oyendji nevi lyokoondundu dhaEfraim eshona nane, nena indeni momakuti, mu ki ikokolele omapya mevi lyAaperisi nolyAarafa,”

Oyo ya yamukula: “Evi lyokoondundu inali tu gwanena, ihe Aakaanana ya kala momalushandja, oye na omatembakwiita giiyela, ayehe mboka ye li muBetshan nomikunda dhasho naamboka ye li molusilu lwaJesreel.”
Josua okwa ti kezimo lyaEfraim nolyaManasse: “Eeno shili, ne oyendji, ne aanankondo wo unene. Ne otamu pumbwa evi enene li vule oshitopolwa shimwe.
Evi lyokoondundu olyeni. Nonando olyo okuti, li kokoleni, li ninge lyeni, sigo okooha dhalyo. Kombinga yAakaanana, ya tidhii po, nando oye na omatembakwiita giiyela yo aanankondo.”
18: Konima yokusinda evi, oshigwana ashihe shaIsrael osha gongala muShilo e tashi dhiki etsalihangano lyOmuwa.
Okwa li kwa hupa omazimo gaheyali goshigwana shaIsrael, ngoka ga li inaaga pewa natango iitopolwa yago yevi.
Ano Josua okwa ti kAaisraeli: “Sigo uunake tamu ka tegelela, manga inaamu ka kwata po evi ndyoka mwa pewa kOmuwa, Kalunga koohokulu?
Mezimo kehe namu ze aalumentu yatatu, otandi ke ya tuma nevi alihe, ye li koneke mpoka ya hala okupewa omaliko gawo. Konima nge ye shi ningi, naye ye kungame.
Evi nali topolwe miitopolwa iheyali. Juda na kale moshitopolwa she kuumbugantu ngaashika wo Josef mushe kuumbangalantu.
Nyoleni ehokololo lyiitopolwa mbika iheyali, mu li etele ndje. Nena otandi ke mu umbila oshihogololitho koshipala shOmuwa Kalunga ketu.

Ihe Aalevi itaa ka pewa oshitopolwa shevi mokati keni, oshoka uuyambi wOmuwa owo oshitopolwa shawo. Nokuli ezimo lyaGad nolyaRuben netatazimo lyaManasse oga pewa nale kuMoses, omumati gwaKalunga, evi kuuzilo waJordan.”

Aalumentu oya yi nondjila yawo e taa thaneke evi membo, ngaashi Josua e ya lombwele a ti: “Endeni evi alihe noku li thaneka membo e tamu galukile kungame. Nena otandi mu umbile oshihogololitho koshipala shOmuwa muka muShilo.”
Osho aalumentu ya yi noye ende evi alihe nokuthaneka membo, nkene tali topolwa miitopolwa iheyali niilando ayihe yalyo. Opo ihe oya galukile kuJosua pontanda yaShilo.
Josua okwe ya umbile oshihogololitho koshipala shOmuwa muShilo nokwa topolele oshihupe shomazimo gaIsrael evi.
Omaludhi gomezimo lyaBenjamin oge ya tango molufo. Oshitopolwa shago oshi li pokati kezimo lyaJuda nolyaJosef.
Kuumbangalantu ongamba yasho otayi tameke puJordan e tayi londo tayi uka koshikulundundu kuumbangalantu waJeriko nolwokuuninginino ya taakana evi lyokoondundu, sigo okombuga yaBetaven.
Okuza nkoka ongamba otayi uka koshikulundundu kuumbugantu waLus (ohashi ithanwa wo Betel), nena otayi kulukile kuAtarot Addar, kondundu kuumbugantu waBethoron shopohi.

Opo ihe ongamba tayi goyokele kuumbugantu okuza kesilukila lyokuuninginino wondundu yaBethoron tayi uka kuKirjat Baal (kokutya Kiriat Jearim), shoka oshezimo lyaJuda. Ndjika oyo ongamba yokuuninginino.
Ongamba yokuumbugantu otayi tameke kooha dhaKiriat Jearim nokuuka koothithiya dhaNeftoak.

Okuza nkoka otayi kulukile ponyonga yondundu ndjoka ya taalela kolusilu lwaGeben Hinnom kombinga yokuumbangalantu wolusilu lwaRefaim. Opo ihe otayi lambalala olusilu lwaGeben Hinnom kombinga yuumbugantu woshikulundundu shAayebusi nokuuka lwokuEnrogel.
Okuza nkoka otayi goyokele lwokuumbangalantu kuEnshemesh nokuGelilot sha taalela omulondo gwaAdummim. Opo ihe ongamba otayi silukile kemanya lyaBohan (omuna gwaRuben)
nokupitilila oshikulundundu sha taalela Bet Arab kombinga yuumbangalantu nokusilukila kuBet Arab.
Nena ongamba otayi ende kombinga yuumbangalantu woshikulundundu shaBet Hogla e tayi hulile muumbangalantu wEfuta lya sa mpoka Jordan tagu yi mulyo.
Jordan ogwo ongamba yokuuzilo. Ndhika odho oongamba dhevi ndyoka lya gandjwa, li ninge eliko lyomaludhi gomezimo lyaBenjamin.
Iilando yomaludhi gomezimo lyaBenjamin oyo mbika: Jeriko, Bet Hogla, Emek Keziz,
Bet Araba, Semaraim, Betel,
Avvim, Para, Ofra,
Kefar Ammon, Ofni naGeba: iilando omulongo niiyali pamwe nomikunda dhayo.
Okwa li wo Gibeon, Rama, Beerot,
Mispe, Kefira, Moza,
Rekem, Jirpeel, Tarala,
Zela, Elef, Jebus (kokutya Jerusalem), Gibea naKiriat Jearim: iilando omulongo niine nomikunda dhayo. Ndika olyo evi lya gandjwa, li ninge eliko lyomaludhi gomezimo lyaBenjamin.
19: Egandjo etiyali olya ningilwa omaludhi gomezimo lyaSimeon. Oshitopolwa shago osha li sha taandela, sigo omokati kevi lya pewa ezimo lyaJuda.
Osha kwatelele mo Beersheba, Sheba, Molada,
Hazar Shual, Baala, Ezem,
Eltolad, Betul, Horma,
Ziklag, Bet Markabot, Hazar Susa,
Bet Lebaot naSharuhen: iilando omulongo niitatu nomikunda dhayo.
Okwa li wo Ain, Rimmon, Eter naAshan: iilando ine nomikunda dhayo.
Shika osha kwatele mo omikunda adhihe momidhingoloko dhiilando mbika, sigo oBaalat Beer (kokutya Rama) shokuumbugantu. Ndika olyo evi lya gandjwa, li ninge eliko lyomaludhi gomezimo lyaSimeon.
Oshoka oshitopolwa shaJuda osha li oshinene kuyo, ombinga yoshitopolwa shawo oya pewa ezimo lyaSimeon.
Egandjo etitatu olya ningilwa omaludhi gomezimo lyaSebulon. Evi ndyoka ga taamba olya adha sigo oSarid.
Okuza nkoka ongamba oyu uka kuuninginino kuMarala nokuguma kuDabbeshet nokokalonga kuuzilo waJokneam.
Kombinga onkwawo yaSarid tayi uka kuuzilo kongamba yaKislot Tabor, nena okuDaberat e tayi londo kuJafia.
Okuza nkoka otayi tsikile kuuzilo kuGat Hefer naEt Kazin nokugoyokela lwokuNea mondjila yokuuka kuRimmon.
Kuumbangalantu ongamba otayi goyokele lwokuHannaton nokuhulila molusilu lwaIftahel.
Evi lyawo olya kwatelele mo Kattat, Nahalal, Shimron, Jidala naBetlehem: iilando omulongo niiyali nomikunda dhayo.
Iilando mbika nomikunda dhayo oya li mevi ndyoka lya gandjwa, li ninge eliko lyomaludhi gomezimo lyaSebulon.
Egandjo etine olya ningilwa omaludhi gomezimo lyaIssaskar.
Oshitopolwa shago osha kwatelele mo Jesreel, Kesullot, Shunem,
Hafarajim, Shion, Anahara,
Rabbit, Kishion, Ebez,
Remet, En-gannim, En Hadda naBet Pazzez.
Ongamba oya guma kuTabor, Shahazuma naBet Shemesh e tayi hulile muJordan. Otayi kwatelele mo iilando omulongo niihamano nomikunda momidhingoloko dhayo.
Iilando mbika nomikunda dhayo oya li mevi ndyoka lya ningi eliko lyomaludhi gomezimo lyaIssaskar.
Egandjo etitano olya ningilwa omaludhi gomezimo lyaAser.
Oshitopolwa shago otashi kwatelele mo Helkat, Hali, Beten, Aksaf,
Alammelek, Amad naMishal. Kuuninginino ongamba oya guma kuKarmel naShihor Libnat.
Okuza nkoka otayi goyokele lwokuuzilo, tayi adha kuBet Dagon, tayi gumu kuSebulon nokolusilu lwaIftahel e tayi uka kuBet Emek naNegiel kuumbangalantu. Otayi tsikile yu uka kuumbangalantu kuKabul,
Ebron, Rehob, Hammon naKana nosigo oSidoni.
Opo ihe ongamba otayi goyokele kuRama nokwaadha oshilandohote Tiro; nena otayi goyokele kuHosa nokuhulila mEfuta lyopokati. Otayi kwatelele mo Mahalab, Aksib,
Umma, Afek naRehob: iilando omilongo mbali niiyali nomikunda dhayo.
Iilando mbika nomikunda dhayo oya li mevi ndyoka lya gandjwa, li ninge eliko lyomaludhi gomezimo lyaAser.
Egandjo etihamano olya ningilwa omaludhi gomezimo lyaNaftali.
Ongamba yago otayi zi kuHelef yu uka komwandi gwokuZaanannim, kuAdaminekeb, kuJamnia nokuLakhum, sigo tayi hulile muJordan.
Okuza nkoka ongamba otayi goyokele lwokuuninginino kuAsnot Tabor nokuHukkok nokuguma kuSebulon kuumbangalantu, kuAser kuuninginino nokuJordan kuuzilo.
Iilandohote oya li Ziddim, Zer, Hammat, Rakkat, Kinneret,
Adama, Rama, Hazor,
Kedesh, Edrei, Enhazor,
Jiron, Migdalel, Horam, Betanat naBet Shemesh: iilando omulongo nomugoyi nomikunda dhayo.
Iilando mbika nomikunda dhayo oya li mevi ndyoka lya ningi eliko lyomaludhi gomezimo lyaNaftali.
Egandjo etiheyali olya ningilwa omaludhi gomezimo lyaDan.
Oshitopolwa shago otashi kwatelele mo Soar, Eshtaol, Ir-Shemesh,
Shaalbim, Ajalon, Jitla,
Elon, Timna, Ekron,
Elteke, Gibbeton, Baalat,
Jehud, Beneberak, Gatrimmon,
Mejarkon naRakkon, osho wo omudhingoloko gwaJoppa.

Ihe Aadan sho ya kanitha evi lyawo, oya yi kuLaish e taye shi ponokele. Oye shi kwata po e taa dhipaga aantu yasho e taye shi ningi shawo yene. Oya tula mo noya lundulula edhina lyasho Lajish e tali ningi Dan, ye shi lukile hekulu Dan.
Iilando mbika nomikunda dhayo oya li mevi lya gandjwa, li ninge eliko lyomaludhi gomezimo lyaDan.
Aaisraeli sho ya mana okutopola evi, oya pe Josua yaNun oshitopolwa, shi ninge she mwene.
Palombwelo lyOmuwa oye mu pe oshilando shoka a pula: Timnat Sera kevi lyokoondundu dhaEfraim. Okwa tungulula oshilando nokwa tula mo.

Omuyambi Eleasar, Josua yaNun naawiliki yomaludhi gomomazimo gaIsrael oya topola iitopolwa mbika nokuumba oshihogololitho koshipala shOmuwa posheelo shetsalihangano muShilo. Osho ngaaka oya mana okutopola evi.
20: Nena Omuwa okwa lombwele Josua ta ti:
“Lombwela Aaisraeli u tye: ‘Ihogololeleni iilando yokwiigamena, ngaashi nda popi naMoses, e mu lombwele.
Omuntu ngoka a dhipaga mukwawo hanowina, ota vulu okuya mo, a holame ngoka a hala oku mu shunina uuwinayi.

Ota vulu okutondokela mushimwe shomiilando mbika e ta yi kehala lyepangulo posheelo shoshilando, a fatululile aawiliki sho a ningi. Nena otaye mu fala moshilando e taye mu pe eha lyokukala mo, opo a kale puyo.
Ngele ota landulwa kungoka a hala oku mu dhipagela eyono lye, kaye na oku mu gandja miikaha ye. Naye mu gamene, oshoka ina dhipaga omuntu owina ye ke mu tonde shito.

Omudhipagi na kale moshilando shoka, sigo a pangulwa montaneho yaayehe nosigo okeso lyomuyambimukuluntu ngoka ta adhika pethimbo ndyoka. Nena omulumentu ota vulu okushuna koshilando shaandjawo, nkoka a zile ontuku.’ ”
Onkee kuuninginino waJordan oya hogolola Kedesh muGalilea, mevi lyokoondundu dhaNaftali, Shekem mevi lyokoondundu dhaEfraim naHebron mevi lyokoondundu dhaJuda.
Kuuzilo waJordan, metumbalalovi lyombuga kuuzilo waJeriko, oya hogolola Bezer moshitopolwa shaRuben, Ramot Gilead moshitopolwa shaGad naGolan muBaasha moshitopolwa shaManasse.

Mbika oyo iilando yokwiigamena ya hogololelwa Aaisraeli ayehe naakwiilongo ayehe ya kala mokati kawo. Kehe ngoka a dhipaga omuntu hanowina, ota vulu okwiimonena egameno muyo komuntu ngoka a hala oku mu dhipagela eyono lye. Ina wapa okudhipagwa, manga inaa pangulwa tango montaneho yaayehe.
21: Aawiliki yomaludhi gAalevi oya yi komuyambi Eleasar, kuJosua yaNun nokaawiliki yomaludhi gomazimo agehe gaIsrael.
MuShilo mevi lyaKaanan oye ya lombwele: “Omuwa okwa lombwelele Moses, tu pewe iilando yokukala mo, osho wo omaunapelo giimuna yetu momidhingoloko dhayo.”
Onkee palombwelo lyOmuwa Aaisraeli oya kutha miitopolwa yawo yene iilando yimwe nomaunapelo e taye yi pe Aalevi.
Omagumbo gomoludhi lwaKohat mezimo lyaLevi oga pewa tango iilando. Omaludhi ngoka ga za momuyambi Aaron, oga pewa iilando omulongo niitatu moshitopolwa shaJuda, shaSimeon noshaBenjamin.
Oshihupe sholudhi lwaKohat osha pewa iilando omulongo moshitopolwa shaEfraim, shaDan noshaManasse kuuninginino.
Oludhi lwaGerson olwa pewa iilando omulongo niitatu moshitopolwa shaIssaskar, shaAser, shaNaftali noshaManasse kuuzilo.
Omagumbo gomoludhi lwaMerari oga pewa iilando omulongo niiyali moshitopolwa shaRuben, shaGad noshaSebulon.
Paumbo lyoshihogololitho Aaisraeli oya pe Aalevi iilando mbika niinapelo yayo, ngashi Omuwa a li a lombwele Moses.
Mpaka otapa landula omadhina giilando yomoshitopolwa shaJuda noshaSimeon, mbyoka ya pewa
oludhi lwaKohat moluvalo lwAaron lwomezimo lyaLevi. Egandjo ndika olya ningwa tango.
Okwa pewa oshilando shaArba (Arba oye he yaAnak), shoka shi ithanwa ngashingeyi Hebron, mevi lyokoondundu dhaJuda, pamwe nomaunapelo momudhingoloko gwasho.
Ihe omapya goshilando nomikunda dhasho oga li ga pewa Kaleb kaJefunne, ga kale eliko lye.
Kakele kaHebron (oshilando shimwe shokwiigamena), iilando tayi tumbulwa mpaka, oya pewa oluvalo lwomuyambi Aaron: Libna,
Jattir, Eshtemoa,
Holon, Debir,
Ain, Jutta naBet Shemesh pamwe nomaunapelo gayo: iilando omugoyi yomezimo lyaJuda nolyaSimeon.
Moshitopolwa shaBenjamin oya pewa iilando ine: Gibeon, Geba,
Anatot naAlemet pamwe nomaulithilo gayo.
Ayihe kumwe iilando omulongo niitatu pamwe nomaulithilo gayo oya pewa aayambi yomoluvalo lwAaron.
Omagumbo galwe gAalevi moludhi lwaKohat oga pewa iilando yimwe moshitopolwa shaEfraim.
Oga pewa iilando ine: Shekem nuunapelo washo mevi lyokoondundu dhaEfraim (oshilando shimwe shokwiigamena), Geser,
Kibzajim naBethoron nomaunapelo gayo.
Moshitopolwa shaDan oga pewa iilando ine: Elteke, Gibbeton,
Ajalon naGatrimmon pamwe nomaunapelo gayo.
Moshitopolwa shaManasse kuuninginino oga pewa iilando iyali: Taanak naGatrimmon nomaunapelo gayo.
Omagumbo ngaka gomoludhi lwaKohat oga taamba iilando omulongo ayihe kumwe pamwe niinapelo yayo.
Ongundu yimwe yAalevi, oludhi lwaGerson, oya pewa moshitopolwa shaManasse kuuzilo iilando iyali: Golan muBaasha (oshilando shimwe shokwiigamena) naAshtarot niinapelo yayo.
Moshitopolwa shaIssaskar oya pewa iilando ine: Kishion, Daberat,
Jarmut naEn-gannim niinapelo yayo.
Moshitopolwa shaAser oya pewa iilando ine: Mishal, Abdon,
Helkat naRehob nomaulithilo gayo.
Moshitopolwa shaNaftali oya pewa iilando itatu: Kedesh muGalilea nomaunapelo gasho (oshilando shimwe shokwiigamena), Hammot Dor naKartan niinapelo yayo.
Omagumbo gomoludhi lwaGerson oga pewa iilando omulongo niitatu ayihe kumwe niinapelo yayo.
Oshihupe shAalevi, oludhi lwaMerari, osha pewa moshitopolwa shaSebulon iilando ine: Jokneam, Karta,
Dimna naNahalal niinapelo yayo.
Moshitopolwa shaRuben osha pewa iilando ine: Bezer, Jahas,
Kedemot naMefaat niinapelo yayo.
Mezimo lyaGad osha pewa iilando ine: Ramot Gilead noshinapelo shasho (oshilando shimwe shokwiigamena), Mahanaim,
Heshbon naJaser niinapelo yayo.
Onkee oludhi lwaMerari olwa pewa ayihe kumwe iilando omulongo niiyali.
Kevi ndyoka Aaisraeli ye li likola, iilando ayihe kumwe omilongo ne niihetatu pamwe niinapelo momidhingoloko dhayo oya pewa Aalevi.
Osho Omuwa a pe Israel evi alihe ndyoka e li uvanekele oohekulu nokugana, e li ya pe. Sho ya mana oku li kwata po, oya tula mo.

Omuwa okwe ya kaleke mo nombili mevi alihe, naanaa ngaashi a adhika u uvanekele oohekulu. Kapwa li nando ogumwe maatondi yawo a vulu oku yi itakeka, oshoka Omuwa okwa pe Aaisraeli esindano okusinda aatondi yawo ayehe.
Omuwa okwa dhiginine euvaneko lye kehe a li u uvanekele oshigwana shaIsrael.
22: Nena Josua okwi ithana, aantu yomezimo lyaRuben, lyaGad netatazimo lyaManasse ya gongale.
Oye a ti kuyo: “Ne omwa tsakanitha ashihe shoka omumati gwOmuwa Moses e mu lombwele, mu shi ninge, nomwa vulika komalombwelo gandje agehe.
Ethimbo ndika alihe inamu ethela Aaisraeli yakweni. Ne omwa kala mwa dhiginina omalombwelo agehe gOmuwa Kalunga keni.
Ngashingeyi Omuwa Kalunga keni okwa kaleke yakweni nombili, ngaashi u uvaneke. Shuneni kaandjeni kevi ndyoka mwe li pewa komumati gwOmuwa Moses kuuzilo waJordan, li ninge lyeni.
Dhiginineni nawa ompango ndjoka Moses e mu lombwele: holeni Omuwa Kalunga keni, gwanitheni ehalo lye, vulikeni komalombwelo ge, gameni kuye, ne mu mu longele nomutima aguhe nomwenyo aguhe.”

Josua okwe ya shunitha kaandjawo nomayambeko nokwe ya lombwele: “Otamu shuna kaandjeni aayamba mu na iigunda yiimuna, iisiliveli, iingoli, iikushu, iiyela noonguwo odhindji. Topolelathaneni naanezimo yakweni mbyoka mwa yugu aatondi yeni.” Noya shuna ihe kaandjawo.
Moses okwa adhika a pe etatazimo lyaManasse evi kuuzilo waJordan, ihe etata ekwawo olya li lya pewa evi kuuninginino waJordan pamwe nomazimo omakwawo.

Onkee Aareuben, Aagad nAamanasse kuuzilo oya shuna komagumbo. Oya thigi po oshihupe shAaisraeli muShilo mevi lyaKaanan noya yi kevi lyawo, evi lyaGilead, ndyoka ya taamba, ngaashi Omuwa a li a lombwele Moses.
Ezimo lyaRuben, lyaGad nolyaManasse kuuzilo sho ga thiki kuGelilot pomulonga Jordan, oga tungile ko oshiyambelo oshinene.
Oshihupe shAaisraeli osha kundana kutya Aareuben, Aagad nAamanasse kuuzilo oya tungu oshiyambelo puGelilot kombinga yahandika yaJordan.
Aaisraeli sho ye shi uvu, egongalo alihe lyAaisraeli olya gongala muShilo, ya ye kiita okukondjitha omazimo gokuuzilo.
Nena Aaisraeli oya tumu ko Pinehas, omwana gwomuyambi Eleasar, kAareuben, Aagad nAamanasse kuuzilo kevi lyaGilead.
Aawiliki omulongo oya yi pamwe naPinehas; mezimo kehe kuuninginino omwa zi omuwiliki gumwe, omukuluntu gwegumbo lyontumba lyomomaludhi.
Oye ya kevi lyaGilead kAareuben, Aagad nAamanasse kuuzilo
noye ya lombwele ya ti: “Omolwashike mwa ningi uuwinayi u thike mpono okuyona kuKalunga kaIsrael? Omwa tukulile Omuwa oshipotha, sho mwi itungile oshiyambelo shika! Nani ne itamu mu landula we?
Dhimbulukweni epogo lyetu puPeor, Omuwa sho a geelele oshigwana she nuuvu welega. Natango otatu ehamekwa kusho. Nani epogo ndyono inali gwana?
Otamu ka tinda oku mu landula natango? Ngele otamu tukulile Omuwa oshipotha ngashingeyi, ota ka geela kehe omuntu muIsrael.

Ngashingeyi nduno, ngele evi lyeni inali gwanena esimaneko, ileni kevi lyOmuwa, nkuka ku na etsalihangano. Indileni evi mokati ketu, ihe inamu tukulila Omuwa oshipotha ne inamu tu tukulila oshipotha, sho tamu itungile oshiyambelo shi ili shaa shi shoka shOmuwa Kalunga ketu.
Dhimbulukweni Ashan yaSera nkene a tindi okuvulika kelombwelo tali keelele iinima ya tokolelwa okuyonagulwapo; egongalo alihe lyaIsrael olye shi geelelwa. Ashan haye awike ngoka a si molweyono lye.”
Aareuben, Aagad nAamanasse kuuzilo oya yamukula aakuluntu yomagumbo gomomazimo gokuuninginino:

“Kalunga Omupangelinkondoawike! Oye Omuwa! Kalunga Omupangelinkondoawike! Oye Omuwa! Oye a tseya nokutya omolwashike twa ningi shika, tse notwa hala, nane wo mu shi tseye! Ngele otwe shi ningile oshipotha noinatu dhiginina okulandula Omuwa, nena ino tu pitika we okukala nomwenyo!
Ngele otwa tungu oshiyambelo mokwaavulika kOmuwa, tu lungunithile ko omidhidhindjambo nenge iikulyandjambo nenge tu ete po omakwatathanondjambo, nena Omuwa mwene ne tu geele.
Aawe! Otwe shi ningi ashike, oshoka otwa li twa tila nokutya konakuyiwa omaluvalo geni otaga vulu okulombwela ngoka getu: ‘Ne omu na shike nOmuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael?
Jordan okwe gu ningi ongamba pokati ketu nane Aareuben nAagad. Ne kamu na sha nOmuwa.’ Nena omaluvalo geni otaga vulu okukeelela omaluvalo getu, gaa galikane we Omuwa.
Onkee otwa tungu oshiyambelo, hakufikila ko omidhidhindjambo nenge oondjambo,

ihe okukala endhindhiliko pokati ketu nane, osho wo pokati komapipi ngoka tage tu landula, nokutya tse otwa hala shili okusimaneka Omuwa petsalihangano lye nomidhidhindjambo, oontselelandjambo nomakwatathanondjambo. Shika otashi keelele omaluvalo geni, gaa lombwele ngoka getu: ‘Ne kamu na sha nOmuwa.’

Otwa dhiladhila, ngele shika tashi ka ningwa, nena omaluvalo getu otaga vulu okutya: ‘Taleni koshiyelekela shoshiyambelo shOmuwa sha tungwa kootatekulu. Kashi shi shokufikila omidhidhindjambo nenge oontselelandjambo, ihe osho endhindhiliko pokati ketu nane.’

Tse inatu hala okutukulila Omuwa oshipotha nenge tu mu iteke ngashingeyi noku mu tungila oshiyambelo shi ili shomidhidhindjambo, shiikulyandjambo nenge shoontselelandjambo, kakele kaashoka shi li komeho getsalihangano.”
Omuyambi Pinehas naawiliki omulongo yoshigwana, ano aakuluntu yomagumbo gomomazimo gokuuninginino mboka ya li pamwe naye, oyu uvu ko shoka Aareuben, Aagad nAamanasse kuuzilo ya ti noya ngungumana.
Pinehas, omuna gwomuyambi Eleasar, okwa ti kuyo: “Nena otu shi shi kutya Omuwa oku li pamwe natse. Ne inamu mu tukulila nando oshipotha, onkee omwa hupitha Aaisraeli kondjahi yOmuwa.”
Nena Pinehas naawiliki oya laleke Aareuben nAagad muGilead e taa shuna kuKaanan kAaisraeli noye ya tseyithile ashihe.
Aaisraeli oya ngungumana noya hambelele Kalunga. Inaa dhiladhila we oku ka hinga iita, ya vunyagule po evi moka mwa tula Aareuben nAagad.
Aareuben nAagad oya ti: “Oshiyambelo shika osho onzapo kutseni atuheni kutya Omuwa oye Kalunga.” Noye shi luku “Onzapo”.
23: Konima yethimbo ele okuza mpoka Omuwa sho a kalekele Aaisraeli nombili mokati kaatondi yawo, Josua, ngoka a li muukulupe uunene,
okwi ithana Aaisraeli ayehe, aakuluntu, aawiliki, aatokolihapu naambala yoshigwana nokwa ti kuyo: “Ngame onda kulupa ngashingeyi.
Omwa mono iinima ayihe Omuwa Kalunga keni e yi ningile iigwana mbika omolweni. Omuwa Kalunga keni okwe mu kondjele.

Ngame onda gandja komazimo geni evi lyiigwana ayihe mbyoka ya hupu po natango, li ninge eliko lyeni, ngashika wo evi lyiigwana ayihe mbyoka nda sindi okuza komulonga Jordan kuuzilo, sigo Efuta lyopokati kuuninginino.
Omuwa Kalunga keni ote ya gamuna kune note ya tidha po mokuhuma ko kweni. Otamu ka kwata po evi lyawo, ngaashi Omuwa e li mu uvanekele.
Kotokeni ano, mu vulike kwaayihe mbyoka ya nyolwa membo lyompango yaMoses. Inamu hunutha po nando okantoko kamwe kayo,
mwaa kwatathane naantu mbaka ye li mokati keni nenge mu ithane iikalunga yawo nokugana komadhina gayo nenge okusimaneka iikalunga mbyoka nokwiinyongamena kuyo.
Gameni kOmuwa, ngaashi mwa kala sigo onena.
Omuwa okwa tidha po iigwana iinene niinankondo, ngaashi mwa humu ko nokapwa li shimwe sha vulu oku mu itakeka.
Kehe ngoka gwomune ota vulu okukukumitha aalumentu eyuvi, oshoka Omuwa Kalunga keni ote mu kondjele, ngaashi u uvaneke.
Kotokeni ano, mu kale mu hole Omuwa Kalunga keni.
Ihe ngele tamu ningi aahethi e tamu vundakana niigwana mbika ya hupile mokati keni e tamu hokanathana nayo,

nena kaleni mu shi shi kutya Omuwa ite ke mu tidhila po we iigwana mbika mokuhuma ko kweni. Nena otayi ka ninga emakelo, elulo nekelo lyeni, ongaashi ongola tayi tapata moombunda dheni nenge uuyagaya momeho geni, sigo mwa hulu po amuhe mevi ndika ewanawa Omuwa Kalunga keni e li mu pe.

“Ngashingeyi etembu lyandje olya hedha popepi. Kehe gumwe gwomune oku shi shi momutima gwe nomomwenyo gwe kutya Omuwa Kalunga keni okwe mu pe iinima ayihe iiwanawa mbyoka e yi mu uvanekele. Okwa gwanitha euvaneko kehe e li uvaneke; kape na nando olimwe lya gwile pohi.
Ihe ngaashi a dhiginine euvaneko kehe ndyoka e li mu uvanekele, osho wo ta ka tsakanitha iihuna ayihe,

ngele itamu dhiginine ehangano ndyoka Omuwa Kalunga keni e mu uthile, mu li dhiginine. Nongele tamu longele iikalunga noku yi simaneka, nena ote mu geele muupyundjahi we, nanziya itapu hupu nando ogumwe mevi ndika ewanawa e li mu pe.”
24: Josua okwa gongele omazimo agehe gaIsrael puShekem. Okwi ithana aakuluntu, aawiliki, aatokolihapu naambala yaIsrael, oyo noya holoka miipathi yaKalunga.
Josua okwa ti koshigwana ashihe: “Omuwa Kalunga kaIsrael ota ti: ‘Nalenale oohokulu oya li ya kala handiyaka yomulonga Eufrat noya simaneke iikalunga. Gumwe gwawo oTera, he yaAbraham naNahor.
Nena onda kutha hokulu Abraham handiyaka yaEufrat nonde mu enditha a taakana evi alihe lyaKaanan. Onde mu pe oluvalo olwindji. Onde mu pe Isak,
naIsak onde mu pe Jakob naEsau. Esau onde mu pe evi lyokoondundu dhaEdom, li ninge eliko lye, ihe hokulu Jakob noyana oya yi kuEgipiti.
Konale onda ka tuma Moses nAaron nonda tumine Egipiti uudhigu uunene. Ihe onde mu tembudha mo.
Onda tembudha oohokulu muEgipiti, nAayegipiti oye ya landula nomatembakwiita naakawilinkambe. Ihe oohokulu sho ye ya pEfuta etiligane,

oya kugile ndje onkugo, ndi ya kwathe, nonda tula omilema pokati kawo nAayegipiti. Onda wayulile Aayegipiti efuta nonde ya li omeya. Omu shi shi shoka nda ningile Aayegipiti.
“ ‘Omwa kala mombuga ethimbo ele.
Nena onde mu eta mevi lyAayamori, mboka ya kala kuuzilo waJordan. Oye mu kondjitha, ihe onde ye mu sinditha. Omwa kutha po evi lyawo, nonde ya yonagula po komeho geni.
Nena omukwaniilwa gwaMoab, Balak yaZippor, okwe mu kondjitha. Okwa tumu elaka kuBileam yaBeor, e mu thinge.
Ihe ngame inandi pulakena nando Bileam, onkee okwe mu yambeke, nonde mu yululula kuBalak.
Omwa tokola Jordan nomwe ya kuJeriko. Aalumentu yaJeriko oye mu kondjitha, ngashika wo Aayamori, Aaperesi, Aakaanana, Aaheti, Aagirgashi, Aahevi nAayebusi. Ihe onde ye mu sinditha ayehe.
Onda tumu omambonzi ge mu tetekele noga tidha po aakwaniilwa mbeyaka yaali Aayamori. Shika inashi ningwa komagongamwele geni nokomatati geni.
Onde mu pe evi ndyoka inaamu li kokola, niilando mbyoka inaamu yi tunga. Ngashingeyi omo mu li tamu li omandjembele gomiviinu ndhoka inaamu dhi tsika, nomu na ooholivi dhomiti inaamu dhi kuna.’ ”

Josua okwa tsikile: “Ngashingeyi nduno simanekeni Omuwa noku mu longela mevuliko nomuudhiginini. Mangulukeni kiikalunga mbyoka oohokulu ye yi simaneke muMesopotamia nomuEgipiti, mu longele Omuwa awike.

Ngele inamu hala okulongela Omuwa, tokoleni nena ndjika ngoka tamu longele; ongele iikalunga yoohokulu yomuMesopotamia nenge mbyoka yAayamori mboka mwa kala mevi lyawo. Ihe ngame negumbo lyandje, tse otatu longele Omuwa.”
Oshigwana osha yamukula: “Katu na mpoka tatu etha Omuwa, tse tu longele iikalunga.
Omuwa Kalunga ketu okwa tembudha ootate natse muupika womuEgipiti, otse notwa mono iinyengandunge mbyoka a ningi. Oye e tu gamene shaa mpoka twa yi mokati kiigwana ayihe mbyoka twa pitilile.
Sho twe ya mevi ndika, Omuwa okwa tidha po Aayamori ayehe ya kala mpaka. Onkee natse wo otatu longele Omuwa, oshoka oye Kalunga ketu.”
Josua okwa ti koshigwana: “Ihe itamu vulu okulongela Omuwa, oye Kalunga omuyapuki noita dhimi po oondjo dheni. Ita vulu okwiidhidhimikila ookalunga yalwe,
nongele tamu mu etha, mu longele iikalunga yiigwana mbyoka, nena ote mu pilukile e te mu geele. Ote mu thekeke po, nonando okwa li nale omwaanawa kune.”
Oshigwana osha ti kuJosua: “Aawe! Otatu longele Omuwa.”

Josua okwa ti kuyo: “One oonzapo kune yene moshinima shika, sho mwa hogolola okulongela Omuwa.”
Oya yamukula ya ti: “Eeno, osho tu li.”
Okwa ti: “Etheni nduno iikalunga yiigwana mbyoka, ne mu igandje mevuliko kOmuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael.”
Oshigwana osha yamukula Josua: “Tse otatu longele Omuwa Kalunga ketu. Otatu vulika kiipango ye.”
Onkee esiku ndyoka Josua okwa ningi ehangano noshigwana nokwe ya pele muShekem iipango nomautho, ye ga landule.
Josua okwa nyola iipango mbika membo lyompango yaKalunga. Nena okwa kutha emanya enene e te li dhike momwandi gwopuuyapuki wOmuwa.
Okwa ti koshigwana ashihe: “Emanya ndika otali kala onzapo yetu. Olyu uvu oohapu adhihe ndhoka Omuwa e dhi tu lombwele. Olyo onzapo yoku mu pangula, ngele otamu tukulile Kalunga keni oshipotha.”
Nena Josua okwa laleke oshigwana, noya shuna kehe gumwe koshitopolwa shezimo lye.
Konima yaambika omumati gwOmuwa Josua yaNun okwa sile muukulupe wepipi lyomimvo ethele nomulongo.
Oye mu fumvike mevi lye mwene puTimnat Sera mevi lyokoondundu dhaEfraim kuumbangalantu wondundu Gaash.
Josua manga a li e na omwenyo, oshigwana shaIsrael osha longele Omuwa. Osho sha li pethimbo lyaawiliki ayehe mboka ya li ya mono yo yene shoka Omuwa e shi ningile Israel.

Iipongo yaJosef, mbyoka Aaisraeli ye yi etelele okuza nayo kuEgipiti, oye yi fumvike puShekem, meyana ndyoka Jakob e li landele niimaliwa yiisiliveli ethele limwe kaana yaHamor, he yaShekem. Eyana ndika olya ningi eliko lyoluvalo lwaJosef.
Eleasar lyAaron okwa mana oondjenda nokwa fumvikwa puGibea, oshilando shomevi lyokoondundu dhaEfraim shoka sha adhika sha pewa omwana Pinehas.

1: Josua sho a si, oshigwana shaIsrael osha pula Omuwa sha ti: “Olini po lyomomazimo getu tali yi tango, li ka homone Aakaanana?”
Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Ezimo lyaJuda olyo nali ye tango. Otandi li pe epangelo lyevi.”
Aantu yaJuda oya lombwele aantu yaSimeon: “Ileni, tu ka kondjitheni Aakaanana, tu ya kuthe omikunda dhetu. Opo ihe tatu ke mu kwathela kombinga yeni.” Osho ngaaka aantu yaSimeon
naJuda oya yi pamwe molugodhi. Omuwa okwe ya sinditha Aakaanana nAaperesi noya dhenge aalumentu omayuvi omulongo puBesek.
Oya tsakaneke Adonibesek noye mu kondjitha.
Okwa fadhuka po, ihe oye mu tidha e taye mu kwata, oye mu tete omilumenwe dhokiikaha nodhokoompadhi.

Adonibesek okwa ti: “Aakwaniilwa omilongo heyali ya li ya tetwa ngeyi, oya toola uundjagumuke kohi yoshitaafula shandje. Ngashingeyi Kalunga okwa ningile ndje, ngashi nde ya ningile.” Okwa falwa kuJerusalem, nkoka a manene oondjenda.
Aalumentu Aajuda oya matukile Jerusalem noye shi sindi. Oya dhipaga aantu noshilando ye shi tomeke omulilo.
Oya tsikile okukondjitha Aakaanana mboka ya kala koondundu, kiikulundundu yoponyonga yadho nokombinga yokuumbugantu ihaaku lokwa.
Oya homona Aakaanana ya kala muHebron haku tiwa Kiriatarba. Nkoka oya sindi oludhi lwaSheshai, Ahiman naTalmai.
Okuza nkoka Aajuda oya matukile oshilongo shaDebir shi ithanwa Kiriat Sefer.
Gumwe gwomuyo haku tiwa Kaleb, okwa ti: “Omulumentu ngoka ta tompola okusinda Kiriat Sefer, otandi mu pe omumwandje omukadhona Aksa, e mu hokane po.”
Otniel yaKenas, omuna gwondenge yaKaleb, okwe shi sindi; osho ngaaka Kaleb okwe mu pe omwana Aksa, a ninge omukadhi.
Mohango Otniel oku ulumike omukadhi, i indile he epya. Aksa okwa londoloka kokasino ke, naKaleb okwe mu pula sho a hala.
Okwa yamukula: “Onda hala omithima dhimwe dhomeya. Evi ndyoka we li pe ndje, oli na enota.” Nena Kaleb okwe mu pe omatope gokiiheke noonyombo dhomomadhiya.
Oluvalo lwahemweno yaMoses, Aakeni, oya zi pamwe naantu yaJuda kuJeriko, oshilando shomilunga, noya yi moshilongo sha hekulu muumbugantu waArad muJuda. Hwiya oya tula mokati kAayamaleki.
Aantu yaJuda ya yi pamwe naantu yaSimeon e taa sindi Aakaanana mboka ya kala moshilando Zefat. Oya thingi oshilando noye shi hanagula po e taye shi luku Horma.

Omuwa okwa kwatha aantu yaJuda e taa lala evi lyokoondundu. Ihe inaa lala manga Gaza, Ashkelon nenge Ekron nuushiinda wayo. Aantu mboka ya kala komunkulo gwefuta, oya li ye na omatembakwiita giiyela, onkee aantu yaJuda ya nyengwa oku ya tidha mo.
Palombwelo lyaMoses Hebron osha pewa Kaleb, ngoka a tidha mo omazimo gatatu goluvalo lwaAnak.
Ihe aantu yezimo lyaBenjamin inaa tidha mo Aayebusi ya li muJerusalem. Aayebusi noya kala pamwe naantu yaBenjamin muJerusalem, sigo onena.
Ezimo lyaEfraim nolyaManasse oga yi ga ka matukile Betel haku tiwa Lus. Omuwa okwe ya kwatha. Oya tumu oondaadhi moshilando,
ndhoka dha adha omulumentu ta zi moshilando nodha ti: “Tu ulukila, nkene moshilando hamu yiwa, opo twaaye ku ningile nando uuwinayi washa.”
Okwe ya ulukile, naantu yaEfraim nAamanasse oya dhipaga shaa ngoka moshilando kakele komulumentu ngoka naangandjawo.
Konima okwa tembukile kevi lyAaheti e ta tungile ko oshilando e te shi luku Lus, nolya ningi ngaaka edhina lyasho.
Aamanasse inaa tidha po nando aantu mboka ya li ya kala miilando Betshan, Taanak, Dor, Jibleam, Megiddo nomuushiinda wayo. Aakaanana oya kala ko.
Aaisraeli sho ya tana, oya thiminike po Aakaanana, ye ya longele, onkee inaye ya tidha po we.
Aaefraim inaa tidha po Aakaanana mboka ya li muGeser, onkee Aakaanana ya kala pamwe nayo.
Aasebulon inaa tidha po aantu ya li miilando Kitron naNahalal, nosho Aakaanana ya kala puyo. Aasebulon noye ya thenyenene kongundhi, ye ya longele.
Aayaser inaa tidha po aantu ya li miilando Akko, Sidon, Ahlab, Aksib, Helba, Afek naRehob.
Aayaser oya kala mokati kAakaanana, oshoka inaye ya tidha mo.
Aanaftali inaa tidha po aantu ya li miilando Bet Shemesh naBetanat. Aanaftali oya kala mokati kAakaanana, ihe oye ya thiminike, ye ya longele.
Aayamori oya thiminike Aadan, ya tembukile kevi lyokoondundu, noinaye ya pitikila, ya ye polushandja.
Aayamori oya kala muAjalon, Shaalbim nokondundu Heres. Ihe Aaefraim nAamanasse oye ya thiminikile melelo lyawo e taye ya thiminike, ye ya longele.
Oshilongo shAayamori osha li sha taandela okuza kondundu Akrabbim, tashi uka kuuzilombangalantu wondundu Sela.
2: Omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwa zi kuGilgal u uka kuBokim e ta ti kAaisraeli: “Onde mu tembudha muEgipiti nonde mu eta mEvi lyeuvaneko nde li uvanekele oohokulu. Onda tile: ‘Ngame itandi etha okuhangana nane.
One kamu na okuhangana nando naantu ya kala mevi ndika. Omayambelo gawo ga mbonyagulii po.’ Ihe inamu ninga shoka nde mu lombwele. Omwa ningi naanaa shoka inaashi pitikwa.
Onkee tii mu lombwele ngashingeyi kutya kandi na mpoka ne tidha po we aantu mbaka mondjila yeni. Oyo aatondi yeni, niikalunga yawo otayi ningi epundukitho lyeni.”
Omuyengeli sho a popi ndhika, oshigwana ashihe shaIsrael osha tameke okulila.
Onkee ehala ndyoka lyi ithanwa Bokim. Oko nkoka ya yambele Omuwa omayambo.
Josua nokwe etha Aaisraeli, ya ye shaa ngoka nondjila ye, nomuntu kehe okwa ka lala oshitopolwa she shomevi.
Manga Josua a li e na omwenyo, aantu oya longele Omuwa, nokonima yeso lye oya tsikile ngaaka molwaawiliki mboka ya li ya mono iilongankondo yOmuwa e yi ningile Israel.
Omupiya gwOmuwa Josua yaNun okwa mana oondjenda muukokele womimvo ethele nomulongo.
Okwa fumvikwa mepya lye puTimnat Sera mevi lyokoondundu dhaEfraim kuumbangalantu wondundu Gaash.
Epipi lye alihe olya mana oondjenda, nepipi lya landula olya dhimbwa Omuwa naashoka a ningile Israel.
Oshigwana shaIsrael osha yono kOmuwa nosha tameke okulongela ooBaal.

Oye etha elongelokalunga okulongela Kalunga koohekulu, Kalunga ngoka e ya tembudha muEgipiti, noya tameke okulongela iikalunga, iimenka yaantu yopuushiinda wawo. Oye yi inyongamene nosho ngeyi ya geyitha Omuwa.
Oye etha okulongela Omuwa noya longele ooBaal nooAstarte.
Omuwa nokwa pindjile Aaisraeli nokwe etha aaponokeli, ye ya matukile noku ya yuga. Okwe etha aatondi ayehe ye ya kunduka, ye ya gwililile po. Aaisraeli noinaa vula we okwiipopila.
Ethimbo kehe ya yi molugodhi, Omuwa okwe ya gamuka, ngaashi naanaa a tile. Oya li ya lulilwa.
Onkee ano Omuwa okwe ya penduthile aawiliki mboka ye ya mangulula maaponokeli.

Ihe Aaisraeli inaa vulika kaawiliki yawo. Israel okwa li kee na uudhiginini wokudhiginina Omuwa nokwa longele iikalunga yilwe. Oohekulu oya li ya vulika kiipango yOmuwa, ihe epipi epe olye shi etha po.

Uuna Omuwa a gandja kuIsrael omuwiliki, Omuwa okwa li a hala oku mu kwatha nokumangulula aantu miikaha yaatondi yawo. Oya kala nawa, manga omuwiliki e na omwenyo. Omuwa okwa li a hala oku ya sila ohenda, oshoka oya kugu muupyu womahepeko nowomalwa gawo.
Uuna omuwiliki a si, aantu oya shuna kuukulu wawo noyi inyateke ye vule oohekulu. Oya li ya hala okusimaneka nokulongela iikalunga noya tindi okweetha oondjila dhawo oombwinayi.
Ndele Omuwa okwa li a geele Israel e ta ti: “Aantu mbaka oya yono ehangano ndyoka nda lombwele oohekulu, ye li dhiginine. Sho inaa vulika kungame,
itandi tidha po nande oshigwana shimwe shomwaambyoka ya hupile ko, sho Josua a si.
Otandi yi longitha okuulukila Aaisraeli, ngele ya hala okulandula oondjila dhandje, ngaashi oohekulu ya ningi, nenge aawe.”
Osho Omuwa a pitikile iigwana mbika, yi hupe ko. Ine yi gandja miikaha yaJosua noine yi tidhitha mo mbala konima yeso lye.
3: Omuwa okwe ethele iigwana yimwe mevi, a makele Aaisraeli mboka inaa pitila miita muKaanan.
Okwe shi ningi ashike, opo a longe epipi kehe lyAaisraeli okuhinga iita, unene tuu mboka inaaya kondja nkene ya valwa.
Osho mevi mwa kala iilando itano yAafilisti, Aakaanana ayehe, Aasidoni nAahevi mboka ya kala koondundu dhaLibanon okuza kondundu Baal Hermon sigololo eelo lyaHamat.
Oyo ya li emakelo lyaIsrael okutala tuu, Israel ngele ota vulika kiipango mbyoka Omuwa e yi pele oohekulu ya pitile muMoses.
Ano Israel okwa kala mokati kAakaanana, Aaheti, Aayamori, Aaperesi, Aahevi nAayebusi.
Oya hokanathana naantu yiigwana mbyoka e taa longele iikalunga yawo.
Oshigwana shaIsrael osha dhimbwa Omuwa Kalunga kasho. Oya yono kuye e taa longele iikalunga yaBaal naAsheera.
Omuwa a geele Israel e te etha omukwaniilwa Kushan Rishataim gwaMesopotamia oku ya sinda noku ya pangela omimvo hetatu.
Nena Aaisraeli oya kugu kOmuwa nokwe ya tumine ekanda ndyoka lye ya mangulula. Oye nee Otniel, omuna gwondenge yaKaleb Kenas.
Ombepo yOmuwa ye mu lambele e ta ningi omuwiliki muIsrael. Otniel okwa yi kiita, Omuwa nokwe mu sinditha omukwaniilwa gwaMesopotamia.
Oshilongo sha kala mevululuko omimvo omilongo ne, opo nduno Otniel a mana oondjenda dhe.
Oshigwana shaIsrael osha yonununa ishewe kOmuwa. Molwashika Omuwa okwa nkondopaleke Eglon, omukwaniilwa gwaMoab, e vule Israel.
Eglon okwa hangana nAayammoni nAayamaleki. Oya dhenge Israel e taa sindi Jeriko, oshilando shomilunga.
Eglon okwa pangele Aaisraeli omimvo omulongo nahetatu.

Nena Aaisraeli oya kugu kOmuwa nokwe ya tumine omulumentu, e ya mangulule. Oye Ehud, omulumentu gwolumoho, omuna gwaGera, mezimo lyaBenjamin. Oshigwana shaIsrael osha tumu Ehud komukwaniilwa Eglon gwaMoab e na ombalagelo yomukwaniilwa.
Ehud okwi ihambulile omwele gwa tsa e gu zala miiteta kombinga yokolulyo.
Okwa kutha omagano gaEglon, ngoka a li omunenenene.
Ehud sho e mu pe omagano, okwa lombwele aalumentu mboka ya li ya humbata omagano, ya shune kegumbo.

Ehud mwene okwa galukile piihongwamenka mbyoka ya li muGilgal a shuna kuEglon e ta ti: “Nkeyama, ondi na oshiholekwa okukundathana nangoye.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa lombwele aapiya ye: “Natu ikalele.” Ayehe noya zi mo.
Omukwaniilwa manga a kuutumba metala mezile lyaalofu, Ehud okwa yi kuye e ta ti: “Ondi ku nine elaka lya zi kuKalunga.” Omukwaniilwa okwa thikama po.
Ehud okwa hiti olumoho lwe miiteta kombinga yokolulyo e ta homonona mo omwele e te gu mbwangula mela lyaEglon.
Omwele aguhe gwa ningine mo noshikwatelo, oofu nodha mbathuka mo. Ehud ine gu kutha mo, ogwa mbandukile kombunda.
Nena Ehud okwa piti mo e edhile omiyelo noku dhi pata
e ta yi. Aapiya sho ye ya, oya mono omiyelo dha patwa. Oya dhiladhila, omukwaniilwa omo e li owala moshinyanga shokombanda kokandjugo.
Oya tegelele, ngaashi taa dhiladhila, ihe sho inee egulula omiyelo, oya kutha iipatululo noya patulula. Oya adha omukwaniilwa a kangawala a sa, a lala polupanda.
Ehud okwa yi nale, manga ya tegelela. A pitilila nale iihongwamenka. Onkee a fafagula sigo oSeira.
Sho a thiki kevi lyokoondundu dhaEfraim, okwa hiki epoli, i ithane Aaisraeli kiita. Nena okwe ya kwatele komeho ya kuluka ya zi koondundu.

Okwa ti: “Landulii ndje! Omuwa okwe mu pe esindano, mu sinde aatondi yeni Aamoabi.” Osho ngaaka oya landula Ehud e taa kwata ehala mpoka Aamoabi ya li ye na okutaaguluka omulonga Jordan noinaa pitika nando omuntu gumwe a taaguluke.
Uuna ndoka oya dhipaga aakwiitalela Aamoabi konyala omayuvi omulongo; inapu hupa nondhi.
Uuna ndoka Aaisraeli oya sindi Moab, moshilongo nomwa kala ombili omimvo omilongo hetatu.
Omuwiliki a landula ko oye Shamgar, omuna gwaAnat, ngoka a mangulula Israel, sho a dhipaga Aafilisti omathele gahamano negonga.
4: Ehud sho a si, oshigwana shaIsrael osha yono ishewe kOmuwa.
Osho Omuwa e ya gandja miikaha yaJabin, omukwaniilwa Omukaanani, ngoka a li ta pangele muHazor. Ondjayi yetangakwiita lye oSisera, ngoka a kala muHaroshet shaakwiilongo.
Jabin okwa li e na omatembakwiita omathele omugoyi nokwa tyakalekele Aaisraeli omimvo omilongo mbali. Oshigwana shaIsrael nosha pula ekwatho kOmuwa.
Nena Debora, mukadhaLappidot, okwa li omuhunganeki nokwa li ta wilike Aaisraeli pethimbo ndyoka.
Okwa li ha kuutumba momulunga gwontumba pokati kaRama naBetel mevi lyokoondundu dhaEfraim, nAaisraeli oya yi kuye, e ya tokolele oohapu.

Esiku limwe okwa tumu Barak, omuna gwaAbinoam a zi koshilando Kedesh muNaftali e ta ti kuye: “Omuwa Kalunga kaIsrael ota gandja elombwelo ndika: ‘Kutha aalumentu omayuvi omulongo momazimo gaNaftali nogaSebulon, u ya fale kondundu Tabor.
Otandi eta Sisera, ondjayi yetangakwiita lyaJabin, e ku kondjithe pomulonga Kishon. Ote ke ya nomatembakwiita giiyela naakwiita ye, ihe otandi mu gandja miikaha yoye.’ ”
Barak okwa yamukula a ti: “Otandi yi ashike, ngele to yi nangame, ihe ngele ito yi nangame, nangame wo itandi yi ko.”

Debora a yamukula: “Eeno, onawa, otandi yi nangoye, ihe esimano lyesindano itali ka ninga lyoye, oshoka Omuwa ota gandja Sisera miikaha yomukiintu.” Okuza mpoka Debora naBarak oya thikama e taa yi kuKedesh.
Barak okwi ithana ezimo lyaNaftali nolyaSebulon kuKedesh, naalumentu omayuvi omulongo oye mu landula. Debora okwa yi pamwe naye.
Pokati mpoka Heber Omukeni okwa dhike otenda ye puKedesh popepi nomwandi puZaanannim. Okwa li a tembuka pAakeni yalwe yomoluvalo lwaHobab, suwala yaMoses.
Sisera sho u uvu kutya Barak okwa londa kondundu Tabor,
okwi ithanene kuye omatembakwiita ge giiyela omathele omugoyi naalumentu ayehe nokwe ya tumu ya zi muHaroshet-shaakwiilongo, ya ye komulonga Kishon.
Nena Debora okwa ti kuBarak: “Unduka! Omuwa ote ku wilike! Nena ota gandja Sisera miikaha yoye.” Osho ngaaka Barak a kuluka ta zi kondundu Tabor pamwe netanga lye lyaalumentu omayuvi omulongo.
Barak sho e ya mbolokotele netanga lye, Omuwa okwa vundakanitha Sisera pamwe nomatembakwiita ge agehe naakwiita ye. Sisera a nuka metemba lye e ta yi ontuku.
Barak okwa tidhagana omatembakwiita netangakwiita, sigo oHaroshet-shaakwiilongo, netangakwiita lyaSisera alihe olya dhipagwa; inapu hupa nondhi.
Sisera okwa matukile motenda yaJael, mukadhaHeber Omukeni, oshoka omukwaniilwa gwaHazor Jabin okwa li e na ombili negumbo lyaHeber.
Jael okwa piti mo, a tsakaneke Sisera e ta ti kuye: “Ila mo, tatekulu, ila motenda yandje. Ino tila.” Osho ngaaka a yi mo, nomukulukadhi okwe mu holeke e mu gumbika omulapi.
Sisera okwa ti kuye: “Kwatha ndje omeya, onda kangala.” Jael okwa siikulula ombago yomahini e te mu pe, a nwe, nokwe mu siikile ishewe.
Nena Sisera okwe mu lombwele: “Ka thikame posheelo shotenda, nongele taku zi omuntu te ku pula ta ti, olye e li mo muno, tya aawe, kamu na muntu.”

Sisera okwa li a tatuka ontulo nokwa kwatwa koomposi. Nena Jael okwa kutha ohamala nomboha yotenda e ta nyootoka u uka kuye nokwe mu dhipaga nokumbambalela omboha pombandu ye e tayi mbathuka kombinga onkwawo e tayi yi mevi.

Barak sho e ya ta kongo Sisera, Jael okwe ke mu tsakaneka e ta ti kuye: “Ila, ndi ku ulukile omulumentu ngoka to kongo.” Osho a yi mo pamwe naJael nokwa adha Sisera a kangawala a sa nomboha ye mu ndjikwa momutse.
Esiku ndyoka Kalunga okwa pe Aaisraeli esindano, sho ya sindi Jabin, omukwaniilwa Omukaanani.
Oya li taye mu thininike nokuthininika, sigo ye mu thekula po.
5: Esiku ndyoka Debora naBarak yaAbinoam oyi imbi eimbilo ndika taa ti:

Pulakeneni, ne aakwaniilwa!
Pakalekeni omakutsi, ne aapangeli!
Ngame otandi imbi, otandi hiki okahumba
tandi shi ningile Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael.

Omuwa, sho wa zi koondundu dhaSeir,
sho wa zi komikuma dhaEdom,
evi olya kakama, nomvula oya puuka ya zi mealelo.
Eeno, omeya oga pooka ga zi miikogo.

Oondundu dha kakama koshipala shOmuwa gwaSinai,
okoshipala shOmuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael.

Muuyuni waShamgar yaAnat, momasiku gaJael,
iiyendo yoongamelo inayi taakana we evi,
naayendanandjila oye ende moondjila dha kunkula.

Mevi omwa kala nduno iita, sho Israel a hogolola iikalunga.
Ihe momayuvi omilongo ne gaalumentu
muIsrael inamu monika ngoka e na oshikandekitho nenge egonga.

Omutima gwandje gwa gama kaakwatelikomeho yaIsrael,
gwa pamba kaantu mboka ya zimine nenyanyu.
Hambeleleni Omuwa!

Shi hokololeni, ne mboka mwa londa kuusino uutokele,
one mboka mwa kuutumba piithala,
nane mboka tamu lyanga akuhe.

Pulakeneni! Ewi lyombuyagano tali ziilile komadhiya,
ndjoka tayi hokolola omasindano gOmuwa,
omasindano gaantu ye Aaisraeli!
Nena aantu yOmuwa otaa katuka taa zi miilando yawo.

Wilika, Debora! Kwata komeho! Wilika!
Imba eimbilo! Wilika!
Thikama, Barak yaAbinoam,
kwatela komeho oonkwatwa dhoye!

Nena aainekelwa oye ya kaawiliki yawo;
aantu yOmuwa oye ya kuye yi ilongekidha okukondja.

Oya zi kuEfraim yu uka molusilu,
handiyaka yaBenjamin naantu ye.
Aawiliki oya zi kuMakir,
oondjayi odha koloka kuSebulon.

Omolwashike ya kala handiyaka pamwe noonzi,
taa pulakene aasita taa ithana iigunda yoonzi?
Eeno, ezimo lyaReuben olya li lya limbililwa;
inaa vula okutokola, ngele otaye ya.

Ezimo lyaGad olya kala kuuzilo waJordan,
nezimo lyaDan olya thigala petulilo lyoosikepa.
Ezimo lyaAser olya kala komunkulo,
olya thigala pooha dhefuta.

Ihe aantu yaSebulon noyaNaftali
oya hupula oomwenyo dhawo melundu lyolugodhi.

PuTaanak, pomulonga gwaMegiddo,
aawa oye ya, opo ya kondje,
aawa yaKaanan oya kondjo, ihe inaa hakana nando oshisiliveli.

Oonyothi odha kondjo okuza kealelo,
nkene dha taakana egulu,
odha kondjitha Sisera.

Efundja lyomuKishon olye ya kungulula po —
epomboloko lyomulonga Kishon.
Otii ka katuka, te katuka ndi na omatha!

Nena uukambe otau ya tau lapata
tau lyata evi nomakondo gawo.

Omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwa ti: “Thingeni Meros,
aantu yaahoka naa thingwe, naa thingwe.
Yo inaye ya okukwatha Omuwa,
okukondjela Omuwa mengathithi lye.”

Omukiintu omunelagwelela oJael,
omukadhaHeber Omukeni —
omukiintu omunelagwelela oye ngoka e li mootenda.

Sisera okwa ongotele pevi,
okwa gu e ta kangawala a tya thilu poompadhi dhaJael.
Eeno, opoompadhi dhe a ongotele e ta gu;
a gwile pevi a sa thilu.

Yina yaSisera okwa talele mekende
a kwidhidhikwa kiitenda ya tatakana.
“Omolwashike etemba lye lya tokelwa ngeyi?” osho a pula.
“Omolwashike uukambe we itaau endelele okugaluka?”

Ookanee ke aanandunge oye mu yamukula,
nokwe endulula oohapu dhawo a ti:

“Otaa kwata owala omakumbu nokwiitopolela,
omukwiita kehe ota yi nomukadhona gumwe nenge yaali,
iihakanwa yiiyata yuuzeko oyaSisera,
iisaali ya nyonyombwa oyomothingo yomunyekadhi.”

Omuwa, aatondi yoye ayehe naa se ngaaka,
ihe aaholike yoye naa yele ongetango tali piti.
Moshilongo nomwa li ombili ethimbo lyoomvula omilongo ne.
6: Aaisraeli oya yono ishewe kOmuwa, nokwe ya gandja miikaha yAamidiana, mboka ye ya pangele omimvo heyali.
Aamidiana oya li ye na oonkondo ye vule Aaisraeli, noshigwana shaIsrael oshe ya holama momakololo nomomaholameno moondundu.
Shaa uuna Aaisraeli ya kunu omapya, Aamidiana nAayamaleki oye ya pamwe naantu yokombuga noye ya matukile.
Oya yungu oontanda noya thekeke po iilya kuumbugantu sigo opuushiinda waGaza. Oya yugu po oonzi, iimuna nuusino noya thigi Aaisraeli ye li owalawala.
Oye ya nuukambe wawo nootenda dhawo, engathithi oto ti oombahu. Oye ya noongamelo dhawo dhaa shi kuyalulwa. Oye ya noya mbugaleke evi,
naIsrael ina vula we okutya sha kuyo.
Nena Aaisraeli oya kugu onkugo kOmuwa, e ya hupithe miikaha yAamidiana,
noye e ya tumine omuhunganeki, ngoka e ya etele elaka lya zi kOmuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, tali ti: “Onde ku tembudha muupika waEgipiti.
Onde ku yululula miikaha yAayegipiti nomiikaha yaantu mboka ye ku kondjitha mevi ndika. Onde ya tidha mo miipathi yeni nonde mu pe evi lyawo.
Onde mu lombwele nda ti: ‘Ongame Omuwa, Kalunga keni, inamu longela iikalunga yAayamori mboka mu li mevi lyawo. Ihe inamu pulakena ndje.’ ”

Omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwe ya komukunda gwaOfra nokwa kuutumba momwandi gwaJoas, omulumentu gwomezimo lyaAbieser. Omwana Gideon okwa li ta yungula iilya iishona meholamo moshikolelo shoomviinu, opo kaa monike kAamidiana.
Omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwe mu ihololele nkoka nokwa ti kuye: “Omuwa oku li nangoye, ngoye ependa nomulumentu gwonkama.”

Gideon okwa ti kuye: “Nandi ku pule, tatekulu, ngele Omuwa oku li pamwe natse, oshike tatu mono iihuna? Oshike Omuwa itaa longo iinyengandunge mbyoka twa hokololelwa kootate, nkene e tu tembudha muEgipiti? Omuwa okwe tu gandja miikaha yAamidiana e tu ekelehi.”
Nena Omuwa okwe mu lombwele: “Inda noonkondo dhoye oonene, u ka mangulule Aaisraeli miikaha yAamidiana. Ongame tandi ku tumu.”
Gideon okwa yamukula: “Ihe otandi mangulula ngiini Aaisraeli? Oludhi lwetu kalu na edhina mezimo lyaManasse, nangame mwene omunima gwowala mezimo lyandje.”
Omuwa okwa yamukula: “Oto shi vulu, oshoka otandi ku kwatha. Oto ka nyanyagula Aamidiana wa fa to lyatagula omuntu gumwe.”
Gideon okwa yamukula: “Ongame ngele nda silwa ohenda kungoye, pe ndje endhindhiliko, li holole kutya ongoye shili Omuwa.

Kwatha ndje, u kale mpaka, sigo tandi ku etele omayambo giikulya.”
Okwa ti: “Otandi kala mpaka, sigo to galuka.”

Gideon okwa yi maandjawo e ta paka po okakombwena nokwa ningi oshikwiila shaa na efulika shuusila wookilograma omilongo. Okwa tula onyama montungwa nomahoka mokayiga nokwe yi fala komuyengeli gwOmuwa momwandi nokwe yi mu pe.
Omuyengeli okwe mu lombwele: “Tula onyama noshikwiila kemanya ndika e to tile ko omahoka.” Gideon okwe shi ningi.

Nena omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwa ganeke oshikaha e ta gumu onyama noshikwiila noshiti sha li moshikaha she. Omulilo ogwa zi memanya e tagu lungunitha po onyama noshikwiila. Omuyengeli nokwa kana momeho ge.
Nena Gideon okwa dhimbulula kutya nguka a mono, nani omuyengeli gwOmuwa nokwi ipopile kuumbanda a ti: “Kalunga omusimanekwa pombanda, onda mono omuyengeli gwoye moshipala!”
Omuwa okwa ti kuye: “Kala nombili, ino tila. Ito si.”
Gideon okwa tungile Omuwa oshiyambelo e te shi luku “Omuwa Oye Ombili.” (Oshi li natango muOfra, momukunda gwAayabieser.)

Uusiku mbwiyaka Omuwa okwa lombwele Gideon: “Kutha ontsezi yaho nontsezi yilwe yomimvo heyali, hanagula po oshiyambelo shaho shoka a tungile Baal, e to komangele po wo omuti gwoshikalungakiintu Asheera ngoka gu li pooha dhasho.

Tunga po oshiyambelo sha tungika, u shi tungile Omuwa Kalunga koye kombanda yoshikulundundu shika. Nena kutha ontsezi ontiyali, u yi lungunithe po omudhidhi to tema niikuni tayi zi komuti gwaAsheera ngoka we gu komangele po.”
Gideon okwa kutha omulongo gwomaamati ye nokwa ningi, ngaashi Omuwa e mu lombwele. Okwa li a tila unene aakwawo naantu yomoshilando oku shi ninga omutenya, onkee okwe shi ningi uusiku.
Aantu yomoshilando sho ya penduka ongula onene, oya mono oshiyambelo shaBaal nomuti gwaAsheera ya yonagulwa po. Oya mono wo ontsezi ontiyali ya lungunithwa poshiyambelo shoka a tungile ko.
Oya pulathana: “Olye a ningi ngeyi?” Oya konakona noya mono kutya oGideon yaJoas e shi ningi.
Nena oya lombwele Joas: “Eta omumwoye, tu mu dhipage. Okwa kumuna po oshiyambelo shaBaal nokwa komangele po omuti gwaAsheera.”

Ihe Joas okwa lombwele aatamaneki ye ta ti: “Omwa gama kuBaal? Otamu mu gamene? Shaa ngoka te mu kondjele, oye na se, manga ngula inaali sha. Baal ngele okalunga, ni ipopile mwene, oshoka oshiyambelo oshe sha yonagulwa po.”
Okuza mpoka Gideon okwa lukwa Jerubbaal, oshoka Joas okwa ti: “Baal ni ipopile ye mwene, oshoka oshiyambelo oshe sha yonagulwa po.”
Nena Aamidiana ayehe, Aayamaleki nomazimo gokombuga oya gongala ya taaguluka omulonga Jordan noya yungu oontanda mesilu lyaJesreel.
Ombepo yOmuwa oya yi muGideon nokwa hiki enkuma ti ithana aalumentu yomoludhi lwaAbieser, ye mu landule.
Okwa tumu elaka kiitopolwa ayihe iyali yAamanasse, ye mu landule. Okwa tumu elaka kAayaser, kAasebuloni nokAanaftali, noye ya kuye.
Nena Gideon okwa ti kuKalunga: “Owa ti kutya owa tokola okulongitha ndje, ndi mangulule Israel.
Eewa, ote tula nduno omafufu gonzi polupale. Ngele oga kwatwa komume ongula, manga evi lya kukuta, nena ote tseya kutya oto ka longitha ndje, ndi mangulule Israel.”
Osho naanaa sha ningwa. Gideon sho a penduka ongula onene, okwa kama omafufu nokuthinina mokayo e taku udha omeya.
Nena Gideon okwa ti kuKalunga: “Ino geela ndje, pitika ndje, ndi popye lumwe natango. Kwatha ndje, ndi ninge ishewe elolelo limwe nomafufu. Omafufu naga kale omakukutu, manga evi lya tosima.”
Uusiku Kalunga osho a ningi. Ongula ya landula omafufu oga li omakukutu, ihe evi olya li lyu udha omume.
7: Esiku limwe Gideon okwa meneka ongula onene pamwe netanga lye e ta yungu ontanda ontega noluthithiya lwaHarod. Ontanda yAamidiana oya li mesilu kuumbugantu wawo pondundu More.
Omuwa okwa ti kuGideon: “Ou na aalumentu oyendji unene mokusinditha Aamidiana. Otaa ningi ya tye, oya sindi kuyo yene yo itaa simaneke ndje.
Lombwela aantu to ti: ‘Shaa ngoka a tila, na shune kegumbo, notatu kala mpaka pondundu Gilead.’ ” Omayuvi omilongo mbali nagaali oga shuna, ihe opwa kala omayuvi omulongo.

Nena Omuwa okwa lombwele Gideon ta ti: “Natango ou na aalumentu oyendji. Inda nayo kedhiya notandi ku yoololelemo yamwe. Ngoka tandi ku lombwele, u ye naye, oye inda naye. Ngoka tandi ti, ino ya naye, na kale po, ino ya naye.”
Gideon okwa fala aalumentu kedhiya, nOmuwa okwa ti kuye: “Yoolola mo aalumentu mboka taa shakumine omeya mumboka taa kotamene, ya nwe.”
Okwa li aalumentu omathele gatatu mboka ya shakumine. Yalwe oya kotamene ya tsa oongolo, ya nwe.
Omuwa okwa ti kuGideon: “Otandi ku hupitha noku ku sinditha Aamidiana kaalumentu mbaka omathele gatatu mboka ya shakumine. Lombwela yalwe, ya shune komagumbo.
Osho ngaaka Gideon okwa shunitha Aaisraeli ayehe komagumbo kakele kaamboka omathele gatatu, mboka ya li ye na onguta yomondjila noombenda. Ontanda yAamidiana oya li komeho gawo mesilu.”
Uusiku mbwiyaka Omuwa okwa lombwele Gideon: “Thikama, matukila ontanda; otandi ku sinditha.
Ihe ngele owa tila oku yi matukila, inda ko kuyo nomupiya gwoye Pura.
Oto ku uva shoka taa ti, e to kala wa nyatipala oku yi matukila.” Gideon nomupiya gwe oya kuluka ya yi popepi nontanda yaatondi.
Aamidiana, Aayamaleki naantu yokombuga oya li ya gumbakana nesilu ya fa oshapapa noye na oongamelo odhindjidhindji, oto ti ehekevi lyopooha dhefuta.

Gideon sho a thiki ko, oku uvu omulumentu ta hokololele kuume ke ondjodhi. Okwa li ta ti: “Onda yaguma oshikwiila shiishokelya sha galangatele montanda yetu e tashi dhenge otenda yimwe. Otenda oya ongotele pevi e tayi yalalala.”
Kuume ke okwa yamukula: “Ndyoka egonga lyOmuisraeli Gideon, omuna gwaJoas. Kashi shi sha shilwe. Kalunga okwa gandja Midian miikaha ye netangakwiita lyetu alihe.”

Gideon sho u uvu ondjodhi yomulumentu naashoka tayi ti, okwa tsu oongolo e ta hambelele Kalunga. Nena okwa galukile kontanda yAaisraeli e ta ti: “Thikameni! Omuwa okwa gandja etangakwiita lyaMidian miikaha yeni.”
Okwa topola aalumentu ye omathele gatatu momatanga gatatu nokwa pe omulumentu kehe ombenda noshiyuma shi na onyeka meni.
Okwe ya lombwele: “Shimpa nda thiki kooha dhontanda, talii ndje nawa, ne mu ninge shoka te ningi.
Uuna tatu hiki oombenda pamwe netanga lyandje, nane wo hikeni dheni mwa kunduka ontanda ne tamu igidha tamu ti: ‘OmolwOmuwa nomolwa Gideon.’ ”
Mokati kuusiku Gideon netanga lye lyaalumentu ethele oye ya popepi nontanda, naanaa konima aatonateli aape sho ye ya miilonga. Nena oya hiki oombenda e taa tatula iiyuma mbyoka ya li nayo,
nomatanga gaali ongashikwawo. Oya yelutha oonyeka nomalumoho gawo noombenda okomalulyo gawo noyi igidha taa ti: “Egonga lyOmuwa nolyaGideon!”
Aalumentu ayehe oya thikama ya dhingilila ontanda, etangakwiita lyaatondi nolya yi ondapo tali kaluluka.

Manga aantu yaGideon taa hiki oombenda dhawo, Omuwa okwa vundakanitha aatondi, ya pilukilathana nomagonga gawo ga tagananenathana. Oya fadhukile kuSaretan, sigololo oBet Shitta nandongo oshilando Abel Mehola popepi naTabbat.
Nena aalumentu yomezimo lyaNaftali, lyaAser nolyiitopolwa ayihe iyali yAamanasse oyi ithanwa noya tidha Aamidiana.

Gideon okwa tumu aatumwa nevi alihe lyokoondundu dhaEfraim ta ti: “Londolokeni, tu kondjeni nAamidiana. Tonateleni omulonga Jordan noompanalonga, sigo oBet-Bara, mu keelele Aamidiana, yaa taaguluke.” Aaefraim oya hiywa noya tonatele omulonga Jordan noompanalonga, sigo oBetbara.

Oya kwata aakwaniilwa yaali yAamidiana, Oreb naSeeb. Oya dhipaga Oreb pemanya lyaOreb naSeeb poshikolelo shoomviinu shaSeeb. Oya tsikile okutidhagana Aamidiana noye eta omitse dhaOreb naSeeb kuGideon, ngoka a li kuuzilo waJordan.
8: Nena Aaefraim oya lombwele Gideon ya ti: “Oshike inoo tu lombwela, sho wa ka homona Aamidiana? Omolwashike we tu ningile ngeyi?” Oye shi tamaneke noonkondo.
Ihe Gideon okwa ti: “Shoka nda li te vulu okuninga, kashi shi sha nokuyelekwa naashoka mwe shi ningi. Nokuli oshishona shoka mwe shi ningi, oshi vule shoka ezimo lyandje alihe lye shi ningi.
Sho shene, okoonkondo dhaKalunga mwa dhipaga aawa yaali yAamidiana, Oreb naSeeb. Oshike nda ningi, shi tukule shino?” Sho a ti ngeyi, oya gololoka.
Gideon netanga lye lyaalumentu omathele gatatu oye ya komulonga Jordan noye gu taaguluka. Oya li ya loloka nayi, ihe oya landula ngaa aatondi yawo.
Sho ye ya kuSukkot, okwa lombwele aantu yomoshilando: “Peni wo aantu yandje iikwiila yimwe. Oya loloka, nangame onda landula Seba naZalmunna, aakwaniilwa yAamidiana.”
Ihe aakuluntu yaSukkot oya ti: “Omolwashike tu na okupa aakwiita yoye iikulya? Ndishi inamu kwata natango Seba naZalmunna.”
Gideon okwa ti: “Eewa ano! Omuwa ngele okwa gandja Seba naZalmunna miikaha yandje, nena otii ke mu takula nomano nomapokolo gokombuga!”
Gideon okwa yi kuPenuel nokwe ya hehela ngaashi puSukkot, ihe aantu mbaka oya yamukula ngaashi Aasukkot.
Okwa ti kuyo: “Ote yi, ihe otii ka galuka ondjolowele nonda ndjanga, nongele nda galuka, otii ka hanagula po epopilongulu lyeni.”
Seba naZalmunna oya li puKarkor pamwe netangakwiita lyawo. Maakwiita ayehe yomazimo gokombuga omwa li mwa hupu ashike 15 000; aakwiita 120 000 oya dhipagwa.
Gideon okwa yi nondjila yokooha dhombuga kuuzilo waNobak naJogbeha e ta koloka ta matukile etangakwiita.
Aakwaniilwa mbeyaka yaali yAamidiana, Seba naZalmunna, oya yi ontuku, ihe okwe ya landula e te ya kwata e ta shoshomeke etanga lyawo alihe.
Gideon sho a li ta galuka kolugodhi ta piti metaulilo lyaHeres,
okwa kwata omumati Omusukkot e te mu pula. Omumati okwe mu nyolele omadhina gaakuluntu omilongo heyali yaSukkot.

Nena Gideon okwa yi kaantu yaSukkot nokwa ti: “Dhimbulukweni, nkene mwa tindile okukwatha ndje. Omwa tile, itamu pe aakwiita yandje ya loloka iikulya, oshoka onda li manga inaandi kwata Seba naZalmunna. Eewa, oyo mbaka nduno!”
Opo ihe okwa kutha omano nomapokolo gokombuga e ta takula nago aakuluntu yaSukkot.
Okwa hanagula po wo epopilongulu puPenuel nokudhipaga aalumentu yomoshilando shoka.
Nena Gideon okwa pula Seba naZalmunna: “Ongiini kombinga yaantu mbeya mwa dhipagele puTabor?” Oya yamukula: “Oye ku fa, shaa ngoka okwa fa munyembala.”
Gideon okwa ti: “Oya li aamwameme yomekoto, ndele ote gana naanaa kutya ando omwa li inaamu ya dhipaga, ando itandi mu dhipaga.”
Nena okwa lombwele osheeli she Jeter: “Ila, u ya dhipage!” Ihe omumati ina pweya mo nande egongamwele lye. Okwa li ta kakama, oshoka oye omputu natango.
Nena Seba naZalmunna oya ti kuGideon: “Ila, u tu dhipage ngoye mwene, oshoka ngoye omulumentu gwomatha.” Osho Gideon e ya dhipaga nokwa kutha po iiwengendje ya li moothingo dhoongamelo dhawo.
Konima yaambika Aaisraeli oya ti kuGideon: “Ninga omuleli gwetu — ongoye noluvalo lwoye. Owe tu yululula miikaha yAamidiana.”
Gideon okwa yamukula: “Itandi ningi nando omuleli gweni, nohamumwandje. Omuwa oye omuleli gweni.”
Ihe okwa tsikile ta ti: “Nandi mu pule oshinima shimwe. Shaa ngoka gwomune na pe ndje omagola ngoka a hakana.” (Aamidiana naambuga oya li haa zala omagola giingoli.)
Aantu oya yamukula: “Otatu nyanyukilwa oku ge ku pa.” Oya yala ekumbyatha pevi noshaa ngoka oku umbile po omagola ngoka a hakana.

Omagola giingoli ngoka Gideon a taamba, oge na uudhigu u thike konyala pookilograma omilongo mbali, inaamu yalulilwa omitsuhu nomakwilika noonguwo oombwilili, ndhoka hadhi zalwa kaakwaniilwa yAamidiana, niiwengendje mbyoka ya li moothingo dhoongamelo dhawo.

Gideon okwe yi tungitha ondjatha ya nyeleketela e te yi tula moshilando shaandjawo Ofra. Aaisraeli oya gamuka ko kuKalunga kawo noye yi simaneke ya ningi oshikalunga shawo. Osha ningi epundukitho kuGideon noluvalo lwe.
Osho Aamidiana ya sindwa kAaisraeli nokapwa li we omahindo. Oshilongo osha li shi na ombili omimvo omilongo ne, sigo okeso lyaGideon.
Gideon okwa shuna kaandjawo noko a kala.
Okwa li e na oyana aamati omilongo heyali, oshoka okwa li a hokana ombanda.
Okwa li e na ohonda muShekem; noye mu valele okamati e te ka luku Abimelek.
Gideon yaJoas okwa si muukokele wa tya ko nokwa fumvikwa mombila yahe Joas puOfra, oshilando shezimo lyaAbieser.
Konima yeso lyaGideon oshigwana shaIsrael inashi dhiginina Kalunga; osha longele ooBaal. Oya ningi Baal-Berit oshimenka shawo
yo inaa tsikila we okulongela Omuwa Kalunga kawo, ngoka e ya mangulula miikaha yaatondi yawo ye ya kunduka.
Inaa sila ohenda egumbo lyaGideon moluuwanawa mboka e u ningile Israel.
9: Abimelek yaGideon okwa yi kuShekem, nkoka kwa kala ezimo lyayina,
e te ya lombwele: “Oshike shi mu vulile oshikwawo? Okupangelwa kaalumentu omilongo heyali, ayehe aana yaGideon, nenge okomulumentu gumwe? Dhimbulukweni kutya Abimelek oye omukweni gwomekoto.”
Aakwawo yayina oye shi lombwele aalumentu Aashekem, mboka ya tokola okulandula Abimelek, oshoka omukwawo.
Oye mu pe iimaliwa iisiliveli omilongo heyali ya zi motempeli yaBaal-Berit, Abimelek nokwa thitha nayo aantu yaamakaha naakolokoshi.
Okwa yi koohe kuOfra, nokemanya limwe okwa dhipagele ko aamwahe omilongo heyali, aana yaGideon. Ihe Jotam, onkelo yaGideon, okwa holama ye ina dhipagwa.
Nena aalumentu ayehe yaShekem noyaBetmillo oya yi komwandi gwiidhila kuShekem, nkoka ya ningi Abimelek omukwaniilwa.
Jotam sho e shi uvu, okwa londo kondungu yondundu Garizim nokwe ya igidha a ti: “Pulakenii ndje, ne aalumentu yaShekem, opo Kalunga e mu pulakene!
Konalenale omiti odha li dha gongala, dhi ihogololele omukwaniilwa. Odha lombwele omuholivi: ‘Ninga omukwaniilwa gwetu.’
Omuholivi ogwa yamukula: ‘Ndi ethe ooholivi dhandje hadhi zi omagadhi haga simanekitha ndje kaantu nokiikalunga, opo ndi mu pangele? Aawe.’
Nena omiti odha lombwele omukwiyu: ‘Ila, u ninge omukwaniilwa gwetu.’
Ihe omukwiyu ogwa yamukula: ‘Ndi ethe oonkwiyu dhandje oontoye, ngaye ndi mu pangele? Aawe.’
Opo ihe omiti odha lombwele omuviinu: ‘Ila, u ninge omukwaniilwa gwetu.’
Ihe omuviinu ogwa yamukula: ‘Ndi ethe omaviinu gandje haga nyanyudha aantu niikalunga, ngaye ndi mu pangele? Aawe.’
Osho ngaaka omiti adhihe odha lombwele eno: ‘Ila, u ninge omukwaniilwa gwetu.’

Eno olya yamukula: ‘Ngele omwa hala shili, ndi ninge omukwaniilwa gweni, nena ileni, mu gondje momuzile gwandje. Ngele itamu shi ningi, nena omulilo nagu ndwafuke miitayi yandje yomakwega notagu fike po omisedeli dhaLibanon.’ ”
Jotam okwa tsikile ko a ti: “Omwa kala tuu moshili nomuuyuuki, sho mwa ningi Abimelek omukwaniilwa gweni? Omwa simaneke tuu Gideon nokuninga nawa egumbo lye, ngaashi e shi ilongela?
Dhimbulukweni kutya tate okwa li e mu kondjele. Okwa hupula omwenyo gwe, opo e mu hupithe kAamidiana.
Ihe nena ndjika otamu kondjitha ezimo lyatate. Omwa dhipagele oyana aalumentu omilongo heyali kemanya limwe. Omukweni Abimelek, omuna gwohonda, omwe mu ningi omukwaniilwa gwaShekem.
Ngashingeyi ano shono mwe shi ningile Gideon negumbo lye, ngele oshu uka noshoshili, kaleni mu na ombili naAbimelek, naye na kale nombili nane.
Ihe ngele hasho, nena omulilo nagu ndwafuke muAbimelek, gu tyotyomeke aalumentu yaShekem naBetmillo. Omulilo nagu ndwafuke nomaalumentu yaShekem naBetmillo, gu lungunithe Abimelek.”
Ano Jotam sho a li a tila omumwahe Abimelek, okwa fadhuka po nokwa yi, a ka kale muBeer.
Abimelek okwa pangele Israel omimvo ndatu.
Nena Kalunga okwa tula etondathano pokati kaAbimelek naalumentu yaShekem noya tukulilathana iipotha.
Shika osha ningilwa okugeelela uutoni waAbimelek naalumentu yaShekem, mboka ya li ye mu kingika okudhipaga aana yaGideon omilongo heyali.
Aalumentu yaShekem oya tula aalangeli koondungu dhoondundu, noya yugu ayehe mboka taa piti po. Abimelek okwe shi hokololelwa.
Nena Gaal yaEbed okwe ya kuShekem naamwayina, naalumentu yaShekem oye mu inekele.
Oya yi ayehe komayana gawo gomiviinu e taa toonona omandjembele e taa ga kolo omaviinu e taa hanga oshituthi. Oya yi motempeli yoshikalunga shawo, moka ya li e taa nu noya nyana Abimelek.

Gaal okwa ti: “Tse aantu twa tya ngiini ano muShekem? Omolwashike tatu longele Abimelek? Oye olye nokwa zi peni? Omuna gwaGideon! Sebul oye elenga lye, ihe oshike tatu mu longele? Vulikeni kunyokokulu Hamor, omutoti gwezimo.
Ando ndi kale te wilike oshigwana shika, ando otandi shi kanyutulula kuAbimelek! Onda hala ndi tye kuye: ‘Ikolelela! Koleka omatanga goye e to ya okukondja!’ ”
Sebul, omuleli gwoshilando, okwa geye, sho a kundana omulombo gwaGaal.
Okwa tumu aatumwa kuAbimelek puAruma, ya tye: “Gaal yaEbed naamwayina oye ya kuShekem noitaa ke ku pitika nando, u kale moshilando.
Onkee ano ngoye naantu yoye zii ko uusiku, mu ye koshilangela kelundu.
Ngula penduka pepito lyetango, u ponokele oshilando ohaluka. Gaal sho te ya naantu ye oku ku kondjitha, ya gopagula, ngaashi tashi vulika.”
Osho Abimelek naantu ye oya yi uusiku e taa holama pondje yaShekem momatanga gane.
Abimelek naantu ye sho ya mono Gaal ta zi mo e ta thikama posheelo shoshilando, oya hololoka mo miilangela yawo.
Gaal okwe ya e ta ti kuSebul: “Heyi! Tala! Aalumentu oombeya taa ya taa zi koondundu.” Sebul okwa yamukula: “Kaye shi aantu, ndhoka omizizimba monyonga yondundu.”
Gaal okwa ti ishewe: “Tala nduno! Aalumentu oombeya taa kuluka taa ende kombanda yondundu, nongundu yimwe oya lambalala ondjila ya za komwandi gwiidhila.”

Nena Sebul okwa ti kuye: “Okana koye hoka wa lenga ho, oke li peni? Ndishi owa ti, oshike tatu longele omulumentu nguno Abimelek? Mbaka oyo aalumentu mboka wa popi nondhino. Ya matukila nduno, oyo mbo!”
Gaal okwa wilike aalumentu yaShekem e ta kondjitha Abimelek.
Gaal okwa fadhuka po, naAbimelek okwe mu landula. Oyendji oya li ye ehamekwa, unene posheelo shoshilando.
Abimelek okwa kala muAruma, naSebul okwa tidha Gaal naamwayina muShekem, opo yaa kale mo we.
Esiku lyanofu Abimelek okwa dhimbulula kutya Aasikem oya dhiladhila okuya ondapo momalundu.
Onkee a kutha aantu ye e te ya topola momatanga gatatu, ya ka langele momalundu. Sho a mono aantu ya thigi po oshilando, okwa hololoka ko, opo e ya dhipage.
Abimelek nongundu ye manga taa matuka yu uka komweelo gwoshilando, ye gu tonatele, omatanga omakwawo gaali oga ponokele aantu momalundu e taye ya dhipaga ayehe.
Olugodhi olwa tsikile esiku alihe. Abimelek okwa kwata oshilando, a dhipaga aantu yasho e te shi hanagula po noku shi gunda uuzigo.
Ano aawiliki ayehe mepopilongulu lyaShekem sho ye shi uvu, oya ka holama mohote yomotempeli yaBaal-Berit.
Abimelek okwa lombwelwa kutya oya gongala nkoka,
onkee okwa yi a londo kondundu Salmon naalumentu ye. Oko a kutha ekuya e ta tete oshitayi shomuti e te shi leke kepepe lye.

Osho ngaaka omulumentu kehe a tete oshitayi shomuti, noya landula Abimelek noya ndumbike iiti pohote. Oye yi tomeke, manga aantu ye li meni; aantu ayehe yomohote noya lokotele mo komulilo. Mbaka oya li aalumentu naakiintu ye thike peyuvi.
Nena Abimelek okwa yi kuTebes e ta kondeke oshilando e te shi kwata po.
Oshilando osha li shi na epopilongulu lya kola. Aantu ayehe, aalumentu naakiintu, naawiliki wo, oya ka holama ya matukile mo. Oyi ipatele mo e taa yi pombanda.
Abimelek sho e ya, a matukile epopilongulu, okwa yi komweelo, opo e li tomeke.
Ihe omukulukadhi gumwe oku umbu oshikweyithilomanya e tashi mokola nokunyanyula omutse gwe.

Abimelek okwi igidha nziya omumati omuhumbati gwomatati ge e te mu lombwele: “Pweya mo egongamwele lyoye, u dhipage ndje. Inandi hala taku tiwa kutya omukulukadhi a dhipaga ndje.” Omumati okwe mu tsu e ta si.
Aaisraeli sho ya mono Abimelek a si, oya shuna kaandjawo.
Osho Kalunga okwa galulile Abimelek shoka a ningile egumbo lyahe mokudhipaga aamwahe omilongo heyali.
Kalunga a talitha wo aalumentu yaShekem uudhigu moluugoyoki wawo, ngaashi Jotam yaGideon a ti, sho e ya tula omutima.
10: Konima yeso lyaAbimelek Tola yaPua, omutekulu kwaDodo, okwa holoka, a mangulule Israel. Okwa li gwomezimo lyaIssaskar nokwa kalele muShamir kevi lyokoondundu dhaEfraim.
Okwa wilike Israel omimvo omilongo mbali nandatu. Nena okwa mana oondjenda nokwa fumvikwa muShamir.
Tola okwa landulwa kuJair gwokuGilead. Okwa wilike Israel omimvo omilongo mbali nambali.
Okwa li e na oyanamati omilongo ndatu, mboka ya kayile uusino omilongo ndatu. Oya li ye na iilando omilongo ndatu muGilead, mbyoka hayi ithanwa nduno iilando yaJair.
Jair okwa si nokwa fumvikwa puKamon.
Aaisraeli oya yono ishewe kOmuwa, sho ya simaneke ooBaal nooAstarte, osho wo iikalunga yaSiria, yaSidoni, yaMoab, yaAmmon noyAafilisti. Oye etha Omuwa yo inaye mu simaneka we.
Onkee Omuwa okwa geele Aaisraeli nokwe etha Aafilisti nAayammoni ye ya sinde.
Omimvo omulongo nahetatu oya thininike nokuhepeka Aaisraeli ayehe mboka ya kala moshilongo shAayamori kuuzilo womulonga Jordan muGilead.
Aayammoni oya taaguluka nokuli omulonga Jordan ye ya, ya kondjithe ezimo lyaJuda, lyaBenjamin nolyaEfraim. Israel okwa li muudhigu kaawu shi kutumbulwa.
Nena Aaisraeli oya kugile Omuwa e taa ti: “Otwa yono kungoye, oshoka otwe ku etha, Kalunga ketu, notwa simaneke ooBaal.”
Omuwa okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Aayegipiti, Aayamori, Aayammoni, Aafilisti,
Aasidoni, Aayamaleki nAamaon oye mu hepeke monale, nomwa kugu kungame. Inandi mu hupitha miikaha yawo?
Ihe ne omwe etha ndje owala e tamu simaneke iikalunga yilwe, onkee itandi mu hupitha we.
Indeni, ki ithaneni iikalunga yeni mbyoka mwa hogolola. Nayi mu mangulule, sho mwa adhika kuudhigu.”
Ihe oshigwana shaIsrael osha yamukula sha ti kOmuwa: “Otwa yono. Ninga shoka she ku opalela, shaa tuu to tu hupitha nena.”
Osho ya manguluka kiikalunga yawo iikwiilongo noya longele Omuwa; oye nokwe ehamenwa uudhigu waIsrael.
Nena Aayammoni oya gongala, ya ye kiita noya yungu ontanda muGilead. Aaisraeli oya gongala wo noya yungu ontanda muMispe muGilead.
Nkwiyaka oshigwana naawiliki yomazimo gaIsrael oya pulathana: “Olye ta wilike olugodhi okukondjitha Aayammoni? Ngoka te shi ningi, oye na kale omuwiliki gwaantu ayehe yomuGilead.”
11: Jefta, omukwiita ofule gwokuGilead, okwa li omuna gwohonda. He Gilead
okwa li e na oyana yalwe nomukadhi. Sho ya koko, oya tidha po Jefta noya ti kuye: “Ito ka thigulula nando osha putate, oshoka nyoko okwi ili.”
Jefta okwa yi ontuku yaamwahe e ta ka kala mevi lyaTob. Okwi ihilile ongundu yaantu yaamakaha noye ende ye mu tula mokakuwilili.
Konima yethimbo Aayammoni oya hingile Aaisraeli iita.
Shika sho sha ningwa, aawiliki yaGilead oya ka tala Jefta kevi lyaTob.
Oya ti: “Ila, u tu wilike, opo tu kondjithe Aayammoni.”
Ihe Jefta okwa yamukula: “Ne omwa tondo ndje nayi, sigo mwa tidha ndje maandjatate. Omolwashike tamu ya kungame ngashingeyi, sho mwa adhika kuudhigu?”
Oya ti kuye: “Otwi igameke kungoye, oshoka otwa hala, tu ye nangoye, tu ka kondjithe Aayammoni, ngoye u wilike aantu ayehe muGilead.”
Jefta okwa ti kuyo: “Ngele otamu galulile ndje kegumbo, ndi kondjithe Aayammoni, nOmuwa ta pe ndje esindano, nena otii ka ninga omuleli gweni.”
Oya yamukula: “Otwa zimine. Omuwa oye onzapo yetu.”
Osho ngaaka Jefta a yi naawiliki yaGilead, naantu oye mu ningi omuleli nomuwiliki gwawo. Koshipala shOmuwa muMispa Jefta okwe endulula oohapu dhe adhihe e dhi popi naawiliki.
Nena Jefta okwa tumu aatumwa komukwaniilwa gwaAmmon nelaka tali ti: “Oshike to tamanana natse? Omolwashike to matukile oshilongo shetu?”

Omukwaniilwa gwaAmmon okwa yamukula aatumwa yaJefta ta ti: “Aaisraeli sho ya zile muEgipiti, oya kutha po evi lyandje okuza komulonga Arnon sigo omulonga Jabbok nomulonga Jordan. Ngashingeyi li galulila ndje nombili.”
Jefta okwa tumununa ko ishewe aatumwa komukwaniilwa gwaAmmon,
neyamukulo lye tali ti: “Kashi shi oshili kutya Israel okwa kutha po evi lyaMoab nenge evi lyaAmmon.
Shoka sha ningwa, osho shika. Aaisraeli sho ya thigi po Egipiti, oya taula ombuga, sigo okEkololo lyaAkaba, e taa thiki kuKadesh.

Nena oya tumu aatumwa komukwaniilwa gwaEdom, ye mu pule epitikilo, ya taakane evi lye. Ihe omukwaniilwa gwaEdom ine ya pitikila. Oya pula ishewe omukwaniilwa gwaMoab, naye ongashikwawo, ine ya pitikila, ya pite mevi lye. Osho nduno Aaisraeli ya kala muKadesh.
Nena oya tsikile ya piti mombuga taa dhingoloka evi lyaEdom nevi lyaMoab, handiyaka yomulonga Arnon. Oko ya yungu ontanda, ihe inaa tokola nando Arnon, oshoka ogwa li ongamba yaMoab.
Nena Aaisraeli oya tumu aatumwa kuSihon, omukwaniilwa gwAayamori gwokuHeshbon noye mu pula epitikilo, ya taakane oshilongo she, ya ye kevi lyaandjawo.
Ihe Sihon ina pitika nando, Aaisraeli ye shi ninge. Okwe eta aakwiita ye ayehe e taa yungu ontanda puJahas nokwa matukile Aaisraeli.
Ihe Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, okwa sinditha Aaisraeli ya sindi Sihon niita ye. Osho ngaaka Israel a lala oshilongo ashihe shAayamori mboka ya kala moshilongo shoka.
Oya kutha po oshilongo shAayamori ashihe okuza kuArnon muumbugantu sigo oJabbok muumbangalantu nokuza kombuga kuuzilo sigo oJordan kuuninginino.
Shika osha ningwa kOmuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, ngoka a kwatha aantu ye Aaisraeli, ya tidhe po Aayamori.
Owa hala, u kambadhale oku li kutha ko? Dhiginina ndyoka wa pewa kukalunga koye Kemosh. Ihe tse otatu ka takamitha ashihe shoka Omuwa, Kalunga ketu, e tu pe.
Oto dhiladhila kutya ongoye omwaanawa u vule Balak yaZippor, omukwaniilwa gwaMoab? Okwa homona tuu Israel nenge e ya etela iita nando olumwe?
Oshoka pwa piti omimvo omathele gatatu, sho Israel a lala Heshbon naAroer, niilando yomuushiinda wayo, niilando ayihe komunkulo gwomulonga Arnon. Oshike inoo yi kutha ko nale?
Aawoo, inandi ku hinda nando okashona. Ongoye to hindi ndje, sho to etele ndje iita. Omuwa oye omutokoli. Oye ta ka tokola pokati kAaisraeli nAayammoni.”
Ihe omukwaniilwa gwaAmmon ina pupa ko nokuli kelaka lyaJefta.
Ombepo yOmuwa oya lambele Jefta. Okwa taakana Gilead naManasse e ta galukile kuMispe muGilead e ta yi kuAmmon.
Jefta oku uvanekele Omuwa: “Ngele oto sinditha ndje Aayammoni,
omuntu ngoka ta ka tsakaneka ndje tango ta zi maandjetu, otandi ke mu gandja kOmuwa omayambo, sho te galuka kiita nda sindana. Omuntu ngoka otandi ke mu ninga efikilondjambo.”
Osho Jefta a tokola omulonga, a ka kondje nAayammoni; Omuwa nokwe mu pe esindano.
Okwe ya thepagula okuza kuAroer nombinga ayihe muushiinda waMinnit, iilando omilongo mbali ayihe kumwe, sigololo Abel Keramim. Opwa li omulape gwowala, Aayammoni noya sindika kAaisraeli.
Jefta sho a galukile kegumbo kuMispe, omwana omukadhona okwe ke mu tsakaneka ta tembula ye ta hiki ontunda. Okwa li epona.

Sho e mu mono, okwa tuula oonguwo dhe moluhodhi e ta ti: “O, mumwandje! Owa tatula omutima gwandje! Omolwashike wa undulile ndje momupya gu thike mpano? Onda ninga euvaneko nde li uvanekele Omuwa, noite vulu oku li lundulula.”
Omwanakadhona okwa ti kuye: “Ngele owa uvanekele Omuwa euvaneko, ninga sho wa ti, u shi ningile ndje. Omuwa ndishi okwe ku pa esindano, sho wa dhenge aatondi yoye Aayammoni.”
Ihe okwi indile he a ti: “Ningila ndje shika. Etha ndje manga oomwedhi mbali, ndi ye nookanee kandje koondundu, ndi ka lilile ko uukadhona wandje, sho te si inaandi fukala.”
He okwe mu lombwele, a ye, nokwe mu etha, a kale oomwedhi mbali. Okwa yi nookanee ke koondundu nokwa lilile ko uukadhona we, oshoka ina hokanwa noke na oluvalo.

Konima yoomwedhi mbali okwa galukile kuhe. Jefta okwa ningi, ngaashi u uvanekele Omuwa, nomwana okwa si manga ye omukadhona.
Shika osha ningile ondjigilile muIsrael.
Aakiintu aagundjuka haa yi omasiku gane omumvo kehe oku ka lila omwana omukadhona gwaJefta gwokuGilead.
12: Aantu yaEfraim oyi ilongekidhile olugodhi. Oya tokola omulonga Jordan yu uka kuZafon noya ti kuJefta: “Omolwashike wa kondo oongamba wa ka kondja nAayammoni, nando ino tu lombwela, tu yeni nangoye? Otatu fike po egumbo lyoye.”
Ihe Jefta okwa ti kuyo: “Tse noshigwana shandje otwa li tu na oontamanana dha kwata miiti nAayammoni. Onde mu ithana, ihe ne inamu ya, mu hupithe ndje miikaha yawo.

Sho nda mono kutya inamu shi ninga, onda hupula omwenyo gwandje nonda tokola oongamba, ndi ke ya kondjithe, Omuwa nokwa pe ndje ompolo yoku ya sinda. Omolwashike mwa hala okukondjitha ndje ngashingeyi?”
Nena Jefta okwa gongele aalumentu ayehe yaGilead, a matukile Aaefraim, e te ya dhenge. (Aaefraim oya tile: “Ne Aagilead mu li muEfraim naManasse, one oontauki mwa za kuEfraim.”)

Aagilead oya kala poonkondo dhaJordan apehe mpoka hapu tokolwa, opo ya keelele Aaefraim, yaa taaguluke omulonga, yaa ye ondapo. Omuefraim kehe ngoka a hala okutaaguluka omulonga ta yi ondapo, sho a pula eziminino, nena Aagilead oya pula: “Ngoye Omuefraim?” Ngele ota ti: “Aawe”,

nena otaye mu lombwele e taa ti: “Tya ‘Shibbolet.’ ” Ngele ota ti: “Sibbolet”, oshoka ita vulu oku shi tumbula nawa, nena otaye mu kwata e taye mu dhipaga ponkondo ndjoka yaJordan. Pethimbo ndyoka Aaefraim omayuvi omilongo ne nagaali oya dhipagwa.
Jefta okwa wilike Israel omimvo hamano. Nena okwa mana oondjenda nokwa fumvikwa moshilando shaandjawo muGilead.
Jefta sho a si, Ibzan Omubetlehem okwa wilike Israel.
Okwa li e na oyanamati omilongo ndatu naakadhona omilongo ndatu. Okwa hokanitha oyana aakadhona kaayeni nokwa tenyitha oyana aamati kaayeni. Ibzan okwa wilike Israel omimvo heyali.
Okwa si nduno nokwa fumvikwa puBetlehem.
Konima yaIbzan Elon Omusebulon okwa wilike Israel omimvo omulongo.
Oye a si nduno nokwa fumvikwa puAjalon moshilongo shaSebulon.
Elon okwa landulwa kuAbdon yaHillel gwokuPiraton.
Okwa li e na oyanamati omilongo ne naatekulumati omilongo ndatu, mboka ya li haa londo kuundoongi omilongo heyali. Abdon okwa wilike Israel omimvo hetatu.
Okwa si nokwa fumvikwa puPiraton moshitopolwa shaEfraim omevi lyoondundu lyAayamaleki.
13: Aaisraeli oya yono ishewe kOmuwa, oye nokwe ya gandja miikaha yAafilisti, ye ya pangele omimvo omilongo ne.
Pethimbo ndyoka opwa li omulumentu, edhina lye Manoak, gwokoshilongo Soar. Okwa li gwomezimo lyaDan. Omukadhi okwa li ihaa mono uunona.
Omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwe mu holokele nokwa ti kuye: “Sigo ongashingeyi ino mona uunona, ihe oto ka kala metegelelo, u vale omumati.
Kotoka, waa nwe nando omaviinu nenge omalovu, ngoye waa lye iikulya yi indikwa.
Omunona ngele a valwa, ino kulula ko omafufu ge, oshoka okuza kevalo lye ota ka kala omunasiri, a yoololelwa Kalunga. Oye ta ka mangulula Israel miikaha yAafilisti.”
