Moshilando omwa li omukulukadhi omunandunge i igidha handiyaka yekuma a ti: “Pulakeneni! Pulakeneni! Lombweleni Joab, e ye huka; onda hala ndi kundathane naye.”

Joab okwa yi kuye, nomukiintu okwe mu pula a ti: “Ongoye ngaa Joab?”
Joab okwa yamukula a ti: “Ee, ongame.” Omukulukadhi okwa ti kuye: “Pulakena ndje, tatekulu.”
Joab okwa yamukula: “Onda pulakena.”
Omukulukadhi okwa ti: “Muuyuni wonale okwa li haku tiwa: ‘Inda, u ka tsuwe omayele moshilando Abel,’ nosho naanaa ya ningi.
Oshilando shetu oshinene, osho shimwe shomiilando yombilielela noshi inekelwa muIsrael. Omolwashike to shi hanagulile po? Owa hala okukumuna po oshilando shOmuwa?”
Joab okwa yamukula a ti: “Shivalelwe! Itandi shi kumuna po nenge ndi shi hanagule po.

Ndyoka kali shi ando edhiladhilo lyetu. Omulumentu gumwe, edhina lye Sheba yaBikri koshilongo shokoondundu dhaEfraim, okwa tameke okutukulila omukwaniilwa David oshipotha. Tu peni owala omuntu nguka, notandi ka etha oshilando, ndi shune.”
Omukulukadhi okwa ti: “Omutse gwe otatu ke gu umbila pondje.”

Nena okwa yi kaantu yomoshilando nedhiladhilo lye ndyoka, oyo noya tete ko omutse gwaSheba e taye gu umbile handiyaka yekuma kuJoab. Joab okwa hiki ombenda endhindhiliko lyokutya aantu naa ethe oshilando, noya shuna kaandjawo. NaJoab okwa shuna kuJerusalem komukwaniilwa.
Joab okwa li ondjayi yomatangakwiita gaIsrael; Benaia yaJehoiada okwa li omukuluntu gwaalangeli yaDavid;
Adoniram okwa li omukuluntu gwiilonga yethiminiko; Jehosafat yaAhilud okwa li amushangandjayi;
Sheva okwa li amushangampangu; Sadok naAbiatar oya li aayambi.
NaIra gwomuJair okwa li wo gumwe gwomaayambi yaDavid.
21: Muuyuni waDavid okwa li ondjala yekomba ya kala omimvo ndatu. David okwa pula Omuwa molwayo, Omuwa nokwa ti: “Saul nezimo lye oyo ye na oshipwe shedhipago; okwa dhipagele Aagibeon.”
(Aagibeon kaya li Aaisraeli; oya li okangundu okashona kAayamori mboka ya li yu uvanekelwa kAaisraeli, ye ya hupithe, ihe Saul okwa kambadhala oku ya komba po molwokuladhipalela Israel naJuda.)
David okwi ithana Aagibeon nokwe ya pula ta ti: “Nandi mu ninge ngiini? Onda hala okwoopaleka epuko ndyoka mwe li ningilwa, opo mu yambeke oshigwana shOmuwa.”

Oya yamukula ya ti: “Oontamanana dhetu naSaul nezimo lye itadhi vulu okwoopalekwa noshisiliveli nenge noshingoli, tse inatu hala wo okudhipaga Omuisraeli nando gumwe.”
David okwa pula a ti: “Nena nduno otamu dhiladhila, ndi mu ningile shike?”
Oya yamukula ya ti: “Saul okwa li a hala e tu hanagule po, pwaa kale nando ogumwe gwetu e na omwenyo shaa mpoka muIsrael.

Onkee tu pa mo aalumentu yaheyali yomoluvalo lwe, notatu ke ya endjeleleka montaneho yOmuwa puGibea, omukunda gwaSaul, omukwaniilwa a hogololwa kOmuwa.”
Omukwaniilwa David okwa yamukula a ti: “Otandi ye mu pe.”
Ihe molweuvaneko eyapuki ndyoka yu uvanekelathana naJonatan, David okwa hupitha omuna gwaJonatan Mefiboshet, omutekulu gwaSaul.
Ihe okwa kutha Armoni naMefiboshet, aamati yaali mboka Rizpa yaAja e ya valele Saul; okwa kutha wo aamati yatano yomuna gwaSaul Merab, mboka a valele Adriel yaBarsillai gwokuMehola.
David okwe ya gandja kAagibeon, mboka ye ya endjeleleke kondundu koshipala shOmuwa; ayehe yaheyali oya sile pamwe. Oya dhipagwa petameko lyomasiku gotango gokuteya, petameko lyeteyo lyiishokelya.

Nena ohonda yaSaul Rizpa yaAja oya yala iinguma yomahahi pemanya mpoka pwa li omidhimba; oya kala hoka okuza ketameko lyokuteya, sigo omvula ya loko iipongo. Inayi pitika oondhila dhi lambele puyo omutenya nenge iilyani yi yi gume uusiku.
David sho u uvu shoka Rizpa yaAja a ningi,

okwa yi e ta kutha ko iipongo yaSaul noyomwana Jonatan kAajabesh muGilead. (Oye yi yakele kekuma lyoshilando muBetshan, nkoka Aafilisti ya li ya tsilika omidhimba, uuna ya dhipagele Saul kondundu Gilboa.)
David okwa kutha iipongo yaSaul naJonatan nokwa gongele wo iipongo yaalumentu yaheyali mboka ya li ye endjelelekwa.

Nena oya fumvike iipongo yaSaul noyaJonatan mombila yaKish, he yaSaul, muZela moshilongo shaBenjamin, ya gwanitha ayihe mbyoka omukwaniilwa a popi. Konima yaambika Kalunga okwa yamukula omagalikano gawo e ta sile evi ohenda.
Okwa li wo ku na iita yilwe pokati kAafilisti naIsrael. David okwa yi naantu ye, ya kondjithe Aafilisti. Metifa lyolugodhi David okwe etwa mo komvulwe.
Omulefule, edhina lye Ishbibenob, ngoka a li a humbata egonga lyoshikushu lyuudhigu wookilohalama ndatu netata nokwa li a zala egongamwele epe, okwa dhiladhila kutya ota dhipaga David.

Ihe Abisai, omuna gwaZeruia, okwe ya a popile David. Okwa ponokele omulefule e te mu dhipaga. Nena aantu yaDavid oyu uvaneke kutya ita lyata we kiita. Oya ti: “Ongoye etegameno lyaIsrael; tse inatu hala, tu ku kanithe.”
Konima yaambika opwa li olugodhi nAafilisti puGob; molugodhi nduka Sibbekai Omuhusha okwa dhipaga omulefule edhina lye Saf.
Okwa li ishewe olugodhi olukwawo nAafilisti puGob. Nena Elhanan yaJair gwokuBetlehem okwa dhipaga Goliat Omugat, ngoka a li e na egonga li na oshikwatelo shi thike pondisimbumu.
Okwa li ishewe olugodhi olukwawo muGat, moka mwa li omulefule e hole okukondja. Okwa li e na ominwe oohamano kiikaha nokoompadhi.
Sho a sheke Israel, Jonatan, omuna gwamumwayina gwaDavid, edhina lye Shamma, okwe mu dhipaga.
Ayehe mbaka yane oya li oluvalo lwaalefule yokuGat, noya li ya dhipagwa po kaantu yaDavid.
22: Omuwa sho a hupitha David miikaha yaSaul noyaatondi ye ayehe, David okwi imbile Omuwa ondjimbo ndjika:

Omuwa oye omugameni gwandje;
oye epopilongulu lyandje lya kola.

Otandi ithana Omuwa,
oye nota gamene ndje kaatondi yandje.
Omuwa na hambelelwe.

Omakuthikuthi geso oga kundukidha ndje;
omakuthikuthi geyonuko oga tookele ndje.

Oshiponga sheso osha dhingilila ndje,
noshilambo shombila oshe ekamena ndje.

Olwithi olwa gundumuka momayulu ge,
omalaka gomulilo nomakala ga hanya oga zi mokana ke.

Okwa tuula eyalelo e ta kulukile pevi
noshikogo oshiluudhe kohi yoompadhi dhe.

Okwa tuka nondapo onene metembakwiita lyokegulu;
okwe ende komawawa gombepo.

Okwi ikuwikile momilema;
iikogo iiluudhe yu udha omeya oye mu kundukidha.

Omakala ga geta oga tyotyomoka
ga zi metayimo koshipala she.

Nena Omuwa okwa ndunduma mewangandjo;
newi lyaKalunga Omunankondoawike olyu uvika.

Oku umbu iikuti ye, aatondi ye e taa halakana;
nomashelo goombadhi okwe ya halakanitha po.

Ondaandelo yefuta oya mbenzuka ko,
nomakankameno gevi oge ya pontundulu,
Omuwa sho a ganda aatondi ye nokwe ya ndundumine mondjahi.

Oye a hupitha ndje maatondi yandje aanankondo
nomwaayehe mboka haa tondo ndje —
oyo ya tono ndje oonkondo.

Sho nda li moshiponga, oya ponokele ndje,
ihe Omuwa okwa gamene ndje.

Oye a pititha ndje moshiponga;
okwa hupitha ndje, oshoka okwa hokwa ndje.

Onda vulika kompango yOmuwa;
inandi pilamena Omuwa gwandje.

Onda dhiginine iipango ye ayihe;
inandi iteka omalombwelo ge.

Omuwa okwa tseya kutya kandi na uusama,
nonda kala ndi ikeelela okulonga uuwinayi.

Nena ota futu ndje, oshoka onda longo shoka shu uka,
oshoka oku shi shi kutya kandi na oondjo.

Omuwa, ongoye omwiinekelwa mokukalathana naamboka ye ku inekela;
ngoye omwaanawalela kumboka yaa na oshipo shasha.

Ngoye omuyogoki kumboka aayogoki,
ihe ou tonde aadhudhu.

Oto hupitha mboka haa ishonopeke,
ihe oto shonopeke mboka ye hole uuntsa.

Omuwa, oto pe ndje uuyelele;
oto tidha po omilema pungame.

Oto tsu ndje omukumo okuhomona aatondi yandje,
noonkondo okusinda omaigameno gawo.

Kalunga oha longo nawa!
Oohapu dhe odhi shi kwiinekelwa!
Oye a fa oshikandekitho kumboka taa kongo egameno.

Omuwa oye awike Kalunga;
Kalunga oye awike omupopili gwetu.

Kalunga nguka oye epopilongulu lyandje lya kola;
ota gamene ndje mondjila.

Ota koleke oompadhi dhandje, ndi tondoke ngompundja;
ota gamene ndje, ngele tandi ende koondundu.

Ota longo ndje olugodhi,
opo ndi longithe omatati ngo ga kola.

Owa gamene ndje, ndaa yiwe nangame,
noine gwila po.

Otandi landula aatondi yandje e tandi ya dhenge;
itandi mwena, sigo nde ya thekeke po.

Oto pe ndje omukumo molugodhi,
ndi sinde aatondi yandje.

Oto fadhukitha po aatondi yandje;
otandi hanagula po mbo ye tonde ndje.

Otaa kongo ekwatho, ihe kaku na nando ogumwe te ya hupitha;
otaa ithana Omuwa, ihe ite ya yamukula.

Otandi ya nyanyagula po, e taa ningi ngaashi ontsi yevi,
ndjoka tayi pepwa po kombepo.
Otandi ya lyatagula ngaashi enono lyomondjila.

Aakwiilongo otaa tsile ndje oongolo;
ngele te popi, otaa vulika.

Otaa tyololoka
notaa zi moohote dhawo taa kakama

Omuwa oku na omwenyo!
Omupopili gwandje na hambelelwe!
Uvitheni uunene waKalunga omunankondo, omuhupithi gwandje.

Ota sinditha ndje aatondi yandje;
iigwana ote yi tula mepangelo lyandje,

Onkee tandi ku simaneke mokati kiigwana;
otandi ku imbile omahambelelo.
23: David yaIsai okwa li omuntu omunene gwaKalunga, a hogololwa kuKalunga kaJakob, a ninge omukwaniilwa, ngoka a li omutoti gwomaimbilo omawanawa. Oohapu dhaDavid dhahugunina odho ndhika:

Ombepo yaKalunga otayi popi mungame;
etumwalaka lye oli li komilungu dhandje.

Kalunga kaIsrael okwa popi;
omugameni gwaIsrael a ti kungame:
“Omukwaniilwa ngo ta lele nuuyuuki,
ngoka ta lele mevuliko kuKalunga,

okwa fa etango tali minikile kegulu lyaa na iikogo,
etango ndyoka tali tayimitha omwiidhi opo gwa lokwa.”

Kalunga ota ka yambeka oluvalo lwandje,
oshoka okwa hangana nangame ehangano lyaaluhe,
euvathano ndyoka itaali yonuka po we,
euvaneko ndyoka itaali lunduluka nando.
Shika osho shoka nda yuulukwa nale;
otashi ka ninga esindano lyandje,
naKalunga ote shi gwanitha.

Ihe aakaanakalunga oya fa omano taga ekelwahi;
kape na ngoka te ga kwata noonyala dhowala.

Shila oto longitha oshipani shosheela, nenge oshitsitho;
otaa ka lunguna po thilu.

Omadhina gaakwiita yaDavid oofule ogo ngaka: omutango oJosheb Bashebet gwokuTakemon. Okwa li omuwiliki mokati koofule ndatu, okwa kondjitha negonga lye aalumentu omathele gahetatu e te ya dhipaga molugodhi lwoshikando shimwe.
Omutiyali gwomoofule oye Eleasar lyaDodo gwomoludhi lwaAho. Esiku limwe okwa li naDavid ya kulumanena Aafilisti mboka ya gongalele olugodhi. Aaisraeli ya shuna,

ihe Eleasar okwa thikama omuthika e ta kondjitha Aafilisti, sigo oshikaha she sha vulwa sha kanyatela kegonga. Omuwa okwa sindana esindano enene esiku ndyoka. Konima yelotelo Aaisraeli oya galukile kuEleasar e taa kutha ko omatati komidhimba.
Omutitatu gwomoofule ndatu oye Shamma yaAge a za kuHarar. Aafilisti oya li ya gongala puLehi, mpoka pwa li epya lyuukunde. Aaisraeli oya yi Aafilisti ontuku,
ihe Shamma okwa kala mepya, e li popile e ta dhipaga Aafilisti. Omuwa okwa sindile esindano enene esiku ndyoka.
Lwopetameko lyethimbo lyokuteya, oofule ndatu dhomomilongo ndatu oya yi kekololo lyaAdullam, nkoka David a li, manga ongundu yAafilisti ya li ya yunga ontanda mesilu lyaRefaim.
Pethimbo ndyoka David okwa li mepopilongulu lyokondundu, netanga limwe lyAafilisti olya li lya kwata po Betlehem.
David okwa li u uvite uupongo e ta ti: “Ando pu kale omuntu te etele ndje omeya gokunwa ga za momuthima gu li posheelo shaBetlehem.”
Aakwiita mbeyaka yatatu oofule oya taakana montanda yAafilisti e taa teke omeya momuthima e taye ga eta kuDavid. Ihe ina hala oku ga nwa; okwe ga tile pevi omayambo kOmuwa
e ta ti: “Omuwa, itandi vulu oku ga nwa! Onda fa tandi nu ombinzi yaalumentu mboka ya hupula oomwenyo dhawo!” Onkee okwa tindi oku ga nwa. Mbika oyo iilonga yuupenda yaakwiita yatatu oofule.
Abisai, omumwayina gwaJoab, (yina oZeruia) okwa li omuwiliki gwomapenda omilongo ndatu. Negonga lye okwa kondjitha aalumentu omathele gatatu e te ya dhipaga e ta yelwa mokati komilongo ndatu.
Okwa li ependa lyomilongo ndatu e ta ningi omuwiliki gwawo, ihe ka li a fa yatatu mboka oofule.

Benaia yaJehoiada gwokuKabzeel okwa li omukwiita gulwe a simana omolwiilonga yuufule, mwa kwatelwa edhipago lyaakwiita yaali Aamoabi ya simana. Esiku limwe lyolumi okwa ningine monyombo e ta dhipaga onime.
Okwa dhipaga wo Omuegipiti, omulumentu omutilithi a li e na egonga. Benaia okwe mu ponokele e na onkulundhimbo, a nakula mo egonga miikaha yOmuegipiti e te mu dhipaga nalyo.
Mbyoka oyo iilonga yuupenda yaBenaia, gumwe gwomapenda omilongo ndatu.
Okwa li a simana mokati kawo, ihe ka li a fa yatatu mboka oofule. David okwe mu ningi omukuluntu gwetanga lyaalangeli ye mwene.

Yamwe yomomapenda omilongo ndatu oyo mbaka:
Asahel, omumwayina gwaJoab
Elhanan yaDodo gwokuBetlehem
Shamma naElika yokuHarod
Helez gwokuPelet
Ira yaIkkesh gwokuTekoa
Abieser gwokuAnatot
Mebunnai gwokuHusha
Salmon gwokuAhoh
Maharai gwokuNetofa
Heleb yaBaana gwokuNetofa
Ittai yaRibai gwokuGibea muBenjamin
Benaia gwokuPiraton
Hiddai gwokomasilu gaGaash
Abialbon gwokuAraba
Asmavet gwokuBahurim
Eliahaba gwokuShaalbon
Omuna gwaJashen
Jonatan
Shamma gwokuHarar
Ahiam yaSharar gwokuHarar
Elifelet yaAhasbai gwokuMaaka
Eliam yaAhitofel gwokuGilo
Hezro gwokuKarmel
Paarai gwokuArab
Igal yaNatan gwokuZoba
Bani gwokuGad
Zelek gwokuAmmon
Naharai gwokuBeerot, omuhumbati gwomatati gaJoab
Ira naGareb yokuJattir
Uria Omuheti.
Oya li aakwiita ya simana omilongo ndatu nayaheyali ayehe kumwe.
24: Ondjahi yOmuwa oya hwamene Israel ishewe. Okwa hongakanitha David, e ya etele oshiponga. Omuwa okwa ti kuye: “Inda, u ka yalule Aaisraeli nAajuda.”

Nena David okwa lombwele Joab, ondjayi yetangakwiita lye ta ti: “Inda nomalenga goye komazimo agehe gaIsrael okuza kooha dhoshilongo sigo okooha oonkwawo, u yalule oshigwana. Onda hala okutseya omwaalu gwasho.”

Ihe Joab okwa yamukula omukwaniilwa a ti: “Nkeyama, Omuwa Kalunga koye ni indjipaleke Aaisraeli lwethele ye vule mpo ye thike ngashingeyi, nangoye kala u na omwenyo, u shi mone. Ndele omolwashike wa hala okuninga ngawo?”
Ihe omukwaniilwa okwa vulikitha Joab nomalenga ge; oya zi koshipala she e taa yi, ya ka yalule Aaisraeli.
Oya tokola Jordan e taa yungu ontanda kuumbugantu waAroer, oshilando shopokati kolusilu moshitopolwa shaGad. Okuza mpoka oyu uka kuumbangalantu kuJaser,
nokuGilead nokuKadesh, moshitopolwa shAaheti. Nena oya yi kuDan, nokuza kuDan oya yi kuuninginino kuSidon.
Opo ihe oya yi kuumbugantu koshilandohote Tiro nokiilando ayihe yAahevi nAakaanana, nohugunina okuBeersheba, muumbugantu waJuda.
Konima yoomwedhi omugoyi nomasiku omilongo mbali oya galukile kuJerusalem, sho ya mana okweenda oshilongo ashihe.
Oya hokololele omukwaniilwa omwaalu gwaantu mboka taa vulu okuya kiita; aakwiita 800 000 muIsrael na 500 000 muJuda.
Ihe konima David sho a yalulitha aantu, eiyuvo lye olye mu hepeke nokwa ti kOmuwa: “Onda yono nayi kungoye, sho nda ningi ngeyi. Kwatha ndje u dhimine ndje po. Onda ningi uugoya.”

Omuwa okwa lombwele Gad, omuhunganeki gwaDavid, ta ti: “Inda, u ka lombwele David, otandi mu pe oompito ndatu, a hogolole po yimwe. Otandi ka gwanitha ndjoka ta hogolola.” Ongula yanakwasha, konima David sho a penduka,

Gad okwa yi kuye, te mu hokololele shoka Omuwa a popi e ta pula ta ti: “Oshike tashi kala po? Omimvo ndatu dhondjala yekomba moshilongo shoye, nenge oomwedhi ndatu hamu yaayaa ontuku aatondi yeni, nenge omasiku gatatu gelega mevi lyeni? Shi dhiladhila nduno, u lombwele ndje shoka tandi ka lombwela Omuwa.”
David okwa yamukula a ti: “Ngame ondi li muudhigu uunene! Ihe ine hala ndi geelwe kaantu. Omuwa oye mwene ne tu geele, oshoka oye omunahenda.”
Osho ngaaka Omuwa okwa tumu elega muIsrael lya kala okuza ongula ndjoka ethimbo ndyoka a hogolola. Okuza kooha dhoshilongo sigo kooha oonkwawo Aaisraeli omayuvi omilongo heyali oya si.
Omuyengeli gwOmuwa sho a li pokuhanagulapo Jerusalem, Omuwa okwa geyuluka e ta ti komuyengeli ngoka a li te ya dhipaga: “Opuwo nduno! Sha gwana!” Omuyengeli okwa li polupale lwaArauna Omuyebusi.
David okwa mono omuyengeli ngoka a li ta dhipaga aantu e ta ti kOmuwa: “Ngame, ongame omusama. Ongame nda puka. Aantu mbaka oya ningi shike? Geela ndje negumbo lyandje.”
Esiku olyo tuu ndyoka Gad okwa yi kuDavid e ta ti kuye: “Inda kolupale lwaArauna, u tungile Omuwa oshiyambelo.”
David okwa vulika kOmuwa e ta yi, ngaashi Gad e mu lombwele.
Arauna sho a mono omukwaniilwa nomalenga ge taye ya kuye, okwa yi kuye e ti inyongamene kuye

e ta pula ta ti: “Nkeyama, oshike we ya mpano?”
David okwa yamukula a ti: “Onde ya, ndi lande po olupale lwoye nokutungila Omuwa oshiyambelo, opo elega li pite po.”
Arauna okwa ti: “Nkeyama, lu kutha po, u yambele Omuwa, ngaashi wa hala. Oondumetana odho ndhika, u dhi fikile omayambo koshiyambelo, oondjoko dhadho niiyungulitho oyo mbika, yi longitha iitemitho.”
Arauna okwa gandja ayihe mbika komukwaniilwa e ta ti kuye: “Omuwa Kalunga koye na taambe omayambo goye.”

Ihe omukwaniilwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Aawe, otandi yi futu. Itandi yambele Omuwa Kalunga kandje omafikilondjambo inaaga pula ndje sha.” Oye nokwa landa olupale noondumetana iimaliwa iisiliveli omilongo ntano.
Nena okwa tungile Omuwa oshiyambelo e ta yamba omafikilondjambo nomakwatathanondjambo. Omuwa okwa yamukula omagalikano ge, nelega olya kodha muIsrael.

1: Omukwaniilwa David okwa li muukokele womutoko. Ina vula we okuuva omuyenye, nando aapiya ye mu siikile nomakumbyatha.
Nena omalenga ge oga ti kuye: “Nkeyama, natu ku kongele omukadhona, a kale nangoye, e ku sile oshimpwiyu. Ota ka lala e ku tula mekolo, e ku ningile omuyenye.”
Oya kongo muIsrael ashihe omukadhona a shitika, nomuShunem oya mono mo omukadhona a tya ngaaka, edhina lye Abishag, noye mu eta komukwaniilwa.
Abishag okwa li a shitika nokwa yakula omukwaniilwa e te mu sile oshimpwiyu, ihe omukwaniilwa ina lala naye.

Absalom sho a si, Adonia, omuna gwaDavid naHaggit, okwa li omukuluntu gwokulipo maana yaDavid. Okwa li omulumentu gwondjelo ombwanawa. David okwa adhika inee mu nyenyetelela nando osha, nokwa li a halelela a ninge omukwaniilwa. Okwi ikongele omatembakwiita, uukambe nongundu yaamati omilongo ntano ya dheuka.
Adonia okwa popi naJoab (omuna gwaZeruia) nomuyambi Abiatar noya zimine okugama kuye.
Ihe omuyambi Sadok, Benaia yaJehoiada, omuhunganeki Natan, Shimei, Rei netanga lyaalangeli yaDavid inaa gama kuAdonia.

Esiku limwe Adonia okwa yamba omafikilondjambo goonzi, goontsezi nogoompunya dho ondodhwa pEmanya lyomayoka popepi noluthithiya Rogel. Okwa hiya aana yomukwaniilwa David nomalenga gomukwaniilwa mboka ya za kuJuda, ye ye koshituthi she shomafikilondjambo,
ihe ina hiya nando omumwahe Salomo nenge omuhunganeki Natan, nenge Benaia nenge etanga lyaalangeli yomukwaniilwa.
Nena Natan okwa yi kuBatseba, yina yaSalomo, e te mu pula ta ti: “Omwa uva tuu kutya omuna gwaHaggit, Adonia, okwi ikwaniileka? Nomukwaniilwa David ina tseya sha kombinga yiinima mbika?
Ngele owa hala okuhupitha omwenyo gwoye nomwenyo gwomumwoye Salomo, otii ku tsu omayele
u ye mbala komukwaniilwa David e to pula to ti: ‘Nkeyama, ino uvanekela ndje nani nokugana kutya omumwandje Salomo oye te ku landula muukwaniilwa? Ongiini ano, Adonia sho a ningi omukwaniilwa?’ ”
Natan nokwa gwedha ko a ti: “Sho to popi nomukwaniilwa, otandi ke ya mo e te koleke ehokololo lyoye.”
Batseba okwa yi komukwaniilwa mombete ye. Okwa li a koka unene, naAbishag, omukadhona a za kuShunem, okwa li te mu sile oshimpwiyu.
Batseba okwi inyongamene koshipala shomukwaniilwa. Omukwaniilwa okwe mu pula: “Owa hala shike?”
Batseba okwa yamukula a ti: “Nkeyama, owa uvanekele ndje nokugana medhina lyOmuwa, Kalunga koye, kutya omumwandje Salomo ota ka ninga omukwaniilwa te ku landula.
Ihe Adonia a ningi nokuli omukwaniilwa ngoye waa shi shi.
Okwa yamba omafikilondjambo goontsezi odhindji, oonzi noompunya dho ondodhwa nokwa hiya aamwoyemati, omuyambi Abiatar nondjayi yetangakwiita lyoye Joab koshituthi, ihe ina hiya nando omumwoye Salomo.
Nkeyama, Aaisraeli ayehe otaa tala kungoye, u ya lombwele kutya olye ngoka te ku landula muukwaniilwa.
Ngele ito shi ningi mbala manga inoo sa, tse nomumwandje otatu ka talwa aagwaaleki.”
Batseba manga ta popi, ye Natan ota thiki muuwa.
Omukwaniilwa okwa lombwelwa kutya omuhunganeki oko e li. Natan okwa yi mo e ti inyongamene koshipala shomukwaniilwa.
Okwa ti kuye: “Nkeyama, owa tseyitha ngaa kutya Adonia ne ku landule muukwaniilwa?

Esiku ndika lyonena okwa ya a ka yamba omafikilondjambo goontsezi odhindji noompunya dho ondodhwa. Okwa hiya aamwoye ayehe aamati, ondjayi yetangakwiita lyoye Joab nomuyambi Abiatar. Ngashingeyi otaa dhana oshituthi yo taa kugilile taa ti: ‘Omukwaniilwa Adonia na kale e na omwenyo omule!’
Ihe ina hiya ndje nando, tatekulu, nenge omuyambi Sadok nenge Benaia nenge Salomo.
Nkeyama, mbika ayihe oya zi tuu mungoye shili ngoye inoo lombwela nando omalenga goye ngoka te ku landula muukwaniilwa?”
Omukwaniilwa David okwa ti: “Ithaneni Batseba, e ye mo.” Batseba okwe ya mo a thikama komeho gomukwaniilwa.
Nena David okwa ti kuye: “Otandi ku uvanekele mOmuwa omunamwenyo, a hupitha ndje momaudhigu agehe,
kutya nena otandi gwanitha omauvaneko nde ge ku uvanekele medhina lyOmuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, kutya omumwoye Salomo ota landula ndje muukwaniilwa.”
Batseba okwi inyongamene pevi e ta ti: “Mwene gwandje, omukwaniilwa na kale e na omwenyo aluhe!”
Nena omukwaniilwa David okwa tumu kuSadok, Natan naBenaia. Sho ye ya mo,
okwa ti kuyo: “Kutheni aambala yandje, mu ye nayo. Londekeni omumwandje Salomo kemulutiya lyandje mwene noku mu fala koluthithiya lwaGihon.
Sadok naNatan naye mu gwayeke, a ninge omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael. Nena hikeni ombenda tamu igidha tamu ti: ‘Omukwaniilwa Salomo na kale e na omwenyo!’
Mu landuleni, sho te ya, a kuutumbe koshipangelapundi shandje. Oye ta landula ndje muukwaniilwa, oshoka oye nda hogolola, a ninge omuleli gwaIsrael naJuda.”
Benaia okwa yamukula a ti: “Otashi ka gwanithwa. Omuwa, Kalunga koye, ne shi koleke.
Ngaashi Omuwa a kalele nangoye, Nkeyama, osho wo na kale naSalomo. Na ninge elelo lyaSalomo li na elago li vule lyoye.”
Nena Sadok, Natan, Benaia naalangeli aainekelwa oya londeke Salomo kemulutiya lyomukwaniilwa David e taye mu thindikile koluthithiya lwaGihon.

Sadok okwa kutha ohanga yomagadhi ndjoka a li e etelele, sho a zi metsalihangano, e ta gwayeke Salomo. Oya hiki ombenda, naantu ayehe oyi igidha ya ti: “Omukwaniilwa Salomo na kulupe nomeho, mayego tu mu taasinine! Na kale e na omwenyo omule!”
Nena oyo ayehe oye mu landula ya galuka, taa kugilile kenyanyu e taa hiki oohiya; eigidho lyawo olya li lya fa tali kakameke nevi.
Adonia naayenda ye ayehe pokumana oshituthi shawo oyu uvu ekugililo. Joab sho u uvu ombenda, okwa pula a ti: “Ekugililo lyomawi ngoka taga zi moshilando, otaga ti ngiini?”
Manga inaa mana okupopya, Jonatan, omuna gwomuyambi Abiatar ota thiki. Adonia okwa ti: “Ila mo, mumati gwandje. Ondi inekela, owe eta onkundana ombwanawa.”
Jonatan okwa yamukula a ti: “Aawe, omukwaniilwa David okwa kwaniileke Salomo.
Okwa tumu Sadok, Natan, Benaia naalangeli aainekelwa, ye mu thindikile. Oye mu londeke kemulutiya lyomukwaniilwa,

nopoluthithiya lwaGihon Sadok naNatan oye mu gwayeke, a ninge omukwaniilwa. Nena oya shuna moshilando taa igidha kenyanyu, noshilando ashihe otashi fuluka ngashingeyi kenyanyu. Ekudhilo olyo ndyoka mu uvite ngashingeyi.
Salomo ngashingeyi omukwaniilwa.

Ope na natango sha, omalenga guuwa oga yi komukwaniilwa David, ye mu simaneke, noya ti: ‘Kalunga koye na ninge Salomo omusimani e ku vule, nelelo lyaSalomo nali kale li na elago li vule lyoye.’ Nena omukwaniilwa David okwa galikana mombete ye
ta ti: ‘Natu hambeleleni Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, ngoka a landulitha muukwaniilwa wandje omuntu gwomoluvalo lwandje, nokwa kalitha ndje ndi na omwenyo, ndi shi mone!’ ”
Nena aayenda yaAdonia oya li ya tila, oya yambuka po e taa yi; shaa ngoka okwi iyukila.
Ye Adonia mehaluko lye, sho a tila Salomo, okwa yi ketsalihangano e ta kwata kooniga dhoshiyambelo.
Omukwaniilwa Salomo okwa lombwelwa nokutya Adonia okwe mu tila nokwa kwata nokuli kooniga dhoshiyambelo e ta ti: “Onda hala, omukwaniilwa Salomo a ganene ndje kutya ita dhipaga ndje.”
Salomo okwa yamukula a ti: “Ngele ota kala omwiinekelwa, nena kape na ngoka ta gumu nando efufu lyokomutse gwe, ihe ngele hasho, ota ka sa.”
Omukwaniilwa Salomo okwa tumu Adonia a ka talwe, a ze ko koshiyambelo. Adonia okwa yi komukwaniilwa e ti inyongamene koshipala she. Omukwaniilwa okwa ti kuye: “Inda kegumbo.”
2: David sho a li pokusa, okwi ithana omwana Salomo e te mu longo omalongo ge gahugunina ta ti:
“Ethimbo lyandje lyokusa lya thikana. Kala omwiinekelwa nomulumentwelela

e to ningi shoka Omuwa Kalunga koye te ku lombwele, u shi ninge. Vulika kiipango ye ayihe nokomisindilo dhe, ngaashi sha nyolwa mompango yaMoses, opo u kale u na elago shaa mpoka to ka ya noshaa shoka to ka ninga.

Ngele oto vulika kuye, Omuwa ota ka gwanitha euvaneko e li uvanekele ndje kutya oluvalo lwandje otalu ka lela Israel, ngele otaa si oshimpwiyu okuvulika komisindilo dhe e taye dhi dhiginine momitima nomoomwenyo dhawo.

“Ope na iinakugwanithwa yimwe. Oto dhimbulukwa shoka Joab a ningile ndje, sho a dhipaga aawiliki yaali yiita yaIsrael, Abner yaNer naAmasa gaJeter. Oto dhimbulukwa, nkene e ya dhipagele epwanga po pwaa na lugodhi, molwiikonene yeso ye li ningile pethimbo lyiita. Okwa dhipagele aantu yaa na ndjo, nongashingeyi ongame nda humbata oshilanduli notashi ehameke ndje.
Ou shi shoka to ningi; ino etha a se eso lyopaunshitwe.
“Ihe sila ohenda aana yaBarsillai gwokuGilead ngoye u ya sile oshimpwiyu, oshoka oya li ya ningi ndje nawa, sho nda li nda yi ondapo omumwanyoko Absalom.

“Oku na ishewe Shimei yaGera gwomezimo lyaBenjamin muBahurim. Okwa tukile ndje nayi, uuna nda yile ontuku kuMahanaim, ihe sho a tsakaneke ndje pomulonga Jordan, onde mu uvanekele nokugana medhina lyOmuwa kutya itandi mu dhipaga.
Ihe ngoye ino mu etha, i isile inaa geelwa. Oto tseya shoka to ningi, ino dhimbwa oku mu dhipaga.”
David okwa si e ta fumvikwa moshilando she.
Okwa kalele omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael omimvo omilongo ne; muHebron okwa lele omimvo heyali nomuJerusalem omimvo omilongo ndatu nandatu.
Salomo okwa landula he David muukwaniilwa, nuukwaniilwa we wa li wa kola.

Nena Adonia, omuna gwaHaggit, okwa yi kuBatseba, yina yaSalomo. Batseba okwe mu pula ta ti: “Ou na tuu ombili?”
Adonia okwa yamukula a ti: “Ombili ngaa.”

Nena okwa gwedha ko a ti: “Onde ya okupula sha kungoye.”
Batseba okwe mu pula a ti: “Oshike?”

Adonia okwa ti: “Otwa tseya tuu kutya ongame nda li ndi na okuninga omukwaniilwa, naayehe muIsrael oya li ye shi tegelela? Ihe hasho sha ningwa, nomumwameme oye a ningi omukwaniilwa, oshoka osho Omuwa a hala.
Ngashingeyi ondi na epulo limwe, ndi ku pule, ihe kwatha ndje, waa li tinde.”

Batseba okwa pula a ti:
“Olyashike?”
Adonia okwa yamukula a ti: “Ondi shi shi kutya omukwaniilwa Salomo ite ke shi ku tindila, ngele oto mu pula, a pe ndje Abishag, omukadhona gwokuShunem, a ninge mukadhandje.”
Batseba okwa yamukula a ti: “Eewa, otandi ke ku popila komukwaniilwa.”

Batseba okwa yi komukwaniilwa, a popye naye peha lyaAdonia. Omukwaniilwa okwa thikama, a kunde yina nokwe mu inyongamene. Nena okwa kuutumba koshipangelapundi she noshipundi shilwe oshe etelwa mo yina, e shi kuutumbe e li kolulyo.

Yina okwa ti: “Ondi na okaindilo okashona, ndi ku pule. Kwatha ndje, u ka ziminine ndje.”
Salomo okwa pula a ti: “Oshike, meme? Itandi shi tindi.”

Batseba okwa yamukula a ti:
“Pitika, mumwanyoko Adonia a ushike po Abishag.”

Omukwaniilwa okwa pula a ti:
“Omolwashike to pula ndje, ndi mu pe Abishag? Ando u mu indilile wo, ndi mu pe oshipangelapundi! Ndishi oye omumwameme omukuluntu; omuyambi Abiatar naJoab oya gama kuye.”
Nena Salomo okwa gana medhina lyOmuwa ta ti: “Kalunga na dhipage ndje, ngele itandi dhipaga Adonia molwokupula shika!
Omuwa okwa kuutumbike ndje shili koshipangelapundi shatate David; okwa gwanitha euvaneko lye e ta pe ndje uukwaniilwa noluvalo lwandje. Otandi gana kOmuwa omunamwenyo kutya Adonia ota si nena ndji!”
Nena omukwaniilwa Salomo okwa tumu Benaia yaJojada nokwa yi e ta dhipaga Adonia.

Nena omukwaniilwa Salomo okwa ti komuyambi Abiatar: “Inda koshilongo shaandjeni kuAnatot. Owi ilongela okusa, ihe inandi hala oku ku dhipaga ngashingeyi, oshoka owa humbata oshikethahangano shOmuwa, manga wa li natate David nowa monene omalwa pamwe naye.”
Nena Salomo okwa tidha Abiatar miilonga yuuyambi wOmuwa. Okwa gwanitha shoka Omuwa a popile muShilo kombinga yomuyambi Eli noluvalo lwe.
Joab okwa kundana shoka sha ningwa po. (Okwa li a gama kuAdonia, ihe hakuAbsalom.) Onkee okwa fadhuka po e ta yi ketsalihangano e ta kwata kooniga dhoshiyambelo.

Onkundana sho ya adha omukwaniilwa Salomo kutya Joab okwa fadhuka po a yi ketsalihangano noku li koshiyambelo, Salomo okwa tumu omutumwa kuJoab, e mu pule kutya omolwashike a fadhukile koshiyambelo. Joab okwa yamukula kutya ye okwa matukile kOmuwa, oshoka okwa li a tila Salomo. Nena omukwaniilwa Salomo a tumu Benaia yaJojada, e mu dhipage.

Benaia okwa yi ketsalihangano e ta ti kuJoab: “Omukwaniilwa okwa ti: ‘Za ko.’ ”
Joab okwa yamukula a ti: “Aawoo, ote sile mpaka.”
Benaia okwa galukile komukwaniilwa e te mu hokololele shoka Joab a ti.

Salomo okwa yamukula a ti: “Ningeni shoka Joab ta ti. Mu dhipageni ne mu mu fumvike. Nena ongame nenge oluvalo lwaDavid italu ka kala we lu na uutoni wombinzi yaJoab, molwaasho a dhipagele aantu epwanga lyowala yaa na ndjo.

Omuwa ota geele Joab molwomadhipago ngoka a ningi tate David kee shi shi. Joab okwa dhipaga aalumentu yaali yaa na ndjo, mboka ya li aawanawa ye mu vule: Abner, omuwiliki gwiita yaIsrael, naAmasa, omuwiliki gwiita yaJuda.
Egeelo lyomadhipago gawo nali ka lambele Joab noluvalo lwe sigo aluhe. Ihe oluvalo lwaDavid, ndoka talu kala koshipangelapundi she, nalu kale aluhe lu na elago nombili tayi zi kOmuwa.”
Benaia yaJojada okwa yi ketsalihangano e ta dhipaga Joab, nokwa fumvikwa maandjawo mombuga.
Omukwaniilwa okwa lenge Benaia omuwiliki gwaakwiita peha lyaJoab e ta tula omuyambi Sadok peha lyaAbiatar.
Omukwaniilwa okwa tumu, a ka etelwe Shimei e ta ti kuye: “Dhika egumbo lyoye muka muJerusalem. Kala mo ngoye ino za mo nando moshilando.
Ngele oto zi mo e to taaguluka okalonga Kidron, oto ka sa shili, nuusama otau kala woye mwene.”
Shimei okwa yamukula a ti: “Eewa, Nkeyama, otandi ningi shoka to ti.” Onkee okwa kala ethimbo ele muJerusalem.
Sho pwa piti omimvo ndatu, aapika yaali yaShimei oya fadhuka po ya yi kuAkish yaMaaka, omukwaniilwa gwaGat. Shimi sho u uvu kutya oye li muGat,
okwa kutile okasino ke e ta yi komukwaniilwa Akish muGat, a ka konge aapika ye. Okwe ya mono e te ya eta kegumbo.
Salomo sho u uvu shoka Shimei a ningi,

okwe mu tumu, e ye kuye, nokwa ti: “Onde ku uvanekitha medhina lyOmuwa, waa ze mo muJerusalem. Nonde ku londodha kutya ngele to shi ningi, oto si shili. Kwa li we shi zimina e to ti, oto vulika kungame?
Omolwashike nduno wa yono euvaneko lyoye noino vulika koshipango shandje?
Owa tseya nawa omapuko ngoka wa ningile tate David. Omuwa ote ge ku geelele.
Ihe ota ka yambeka ndje e ta ka koleka uukwaniilwa waDavid sigo aluhe.”
Nena omukwaniilwa okwa lombwele Benaia, a ka dhipage Shimei. Salomo nokwa kala e na uukwaniilwa wa kola.
3: Salomo okwa hangana nomukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti e ta hokana omwanakadhona. Okwe mu eta, a kale moshilando shaDavid, sigo a mana okutunga uuwa we, otempeli nedhingililokuma lyaJerusalem.
Otempeli oya li inaayi tungilwa Omuwa natango, onkee aantu oya li haa yambele omafikilondjambo kiiyambelo oyindji yi ili noyi ili.
Salomo okwa li e hole Omuwa e ta landula omalongo gahe David, ihe naye wo okwa tsele iimuna e te yi yamba omafikilondjambo piiyambelo yi ili noyi ili.
Esiku limwe omukwaniilwa okwa yi kuGibeon, a ka yambe omafikilondjambo, oshoka oko kwa li ku na oshiyambelo sha simana. Okwa adhika a yamba omafikilondjambo eyuvi koshiyambelo shiyaka.
Uusiku mboka Omuwa okwe mu ihololele mondjodhi e te mu pula ta ti: “Owa hala, ndi ku pe shike?”

Salomo okwa yamukula a ti: “Aluhe owa li ho hololele omuntu gwoye David ohole yoye onene, nokwa li omwaanawa, omwiinekelwa nomuyuuki mekwatathano nangoye. Nowa tsikile oku mu ulukila ohole yoye onene yaa na ndjele, sho we mu pe omwana ngoka ta lele nena peha lye.
Omuwa Kalunga, ongoye wa landulitha ndje tate muukwaniilwa, nando ngame omunona, kandi shi kulela.
Ondi li mokati koshigwana we shi hogolola, shi kale shoye mwene, aantu oyendji yaa shi kuyalulwa.
Onkene ano pe ndje owino tandi u pumbwa mokulela aantu nuuyuuki nokutseya eyooloko pokati kuuwanawa nuuwinayi. Oshoka ote vulu ngiini okulela aantu yoye mbano oyendji?”
Omuwa okwa li a hokwa eindilo lyaSalomo.
Okwa ti kuye: “Molwaashoka owa pula ndje owino okulela nuuyuuki peha lyomwenyo omule gwoye mwene nenge uuyamba nenge eso lyaatondi yoye,
otandi ku ningile shoka wa pula. Otandi ku pe owino owindji noondunge u vule ayehe mboka ye ku tetekela nenge mboka taye ku landula ishewe.
Otandi ku pe ishewe shoka inoo pula ndje nokuli: okukalamwenyo kwoye akuhe oto kala u na uuyamba nesimano u vule aakwaniilwa ayehe yalwe.
Nongele oto vulika kungame e to gwanitha iipango yandje nomautho gandje, ngashika ho David a ningile, otandi ku pe omwenyo omule.”

Salomo okwa papudhuka nokwa dhimbulula kutya Kalunga okwe mu popitha mondjodhi. Nena okwa yi kuJerusalem e ta thikama komeho goshikethahangano shOmuwa e ta yambele Omuwa omafikilondjambo nomakwatathanondjambo. Konima yaambika okwa ningile aambala ye oshituthi shomatelekela.
Esiku limwe aakiintu yaali oohonda oye ya komukwaniilwa Salomo.
Gumwe gwawo okwa ti: “Nkeyama, tse nomukulukadhi nguka otwa li mongulu yimwe. Ngame onda vala okanona okamati, manga ye e li mo.
Sho pwa piti omasiku gaali, omumwandje sho a valwa, naye wo a vala okanona okamati. Mondunda kamwa li nande omuntu gulwe, otse atuke yaali.
Uusiku umwe okwa laminine okanona ke e taka si.
Okwa penduka uusiku e ta kutha mo okanona kandje mekolo, manga nda kotha, e te ka fala pombete ye. Nena okwa tula okanona ke hoka ka sa pombete yandje.
Sho nda penduka ongula, ndi yamuthe okamwandje, onda mono kutya oka sa. Onde ka tala nawa noku ka konakona nonda dhimbulula kutya kake shi kandje.”

Ihe omukulukadhi mukwawo okwa ti: “Aawoo! Okanona haka ke na omwenyo, oko kandje, naankoka ka sa oko koye!”
Omukulukadhi gwotango okwa ti: “Ahawe! Okanona ha ka sa oko koye, nokanona ke na omwenyo, okandje!”
Osho ngeyi ya tamanana koshipala shomukwaniilwa.
Nena omukwaniilwa Salomo okwa ti: “Shaa ngoka gwomune ota ti kutya okanona ke na omwenyo oko ke, naaha ka sa okamukwawo.”
Okwa tumu e etelwe egongamwele, nosho lye etwa,
okwa ti: “Teteni okanona hoka ke na omwenyo pokati, etata limwe li pewe omukulukadhi ngu, nekwawo li pewe omukulukadhi mukwawo.”

Yina yokanona molwohole yomuvali okuhola omwana okwa ti komukwaniilwa: “Aawe, Nkeyama, ino ka dhipaga! Ka gandja kumukwetu!”
Ihe omukulukadhi mukwawo okwa ti: “Inaka pewa nando ogumwe gwomutse, ka teteni owala pokati.”
Nena Salomo okwa ti: “Inamu dhipaga okanona! Ka peni omukulukadhi gwotango. Oye yina shili.”
Aaisraeli sho yu uvu eutho lyaSalomo, oya li yu udha esimaneko lyoku mu simaneka, oshoka oya tseya kutya Kalunga okwe mu pe owino wokuutha oontamanana nawa.
4: Salomo okwa li omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael alihe,

naambaka taa landula mpaka, oyo omalenga ge omanene:
Omuyambi oAzaria yaSadok.

Oohamushangampangu oyo Elihoref naAhija, aana yaShisha.
Elenga lyiiniwe oJehosafat yaAhilud.

Ondjayi yiita oBenaia yaJehoiada.
Aayambi oSadok naAbiatar.

Omukuluntu gwaaniikandjo oAzaria yaNatan.
Omugandjindunge omwiinekelwa omuyambi Sabud yaNatan.

Omukuluntu gwaamati yuuwa oAhishar.
Elenga ekuluntu lyiilongo yethiminiko oAdoniram yaAbda.
Salomo okwa langeke aalumentu omulongo nayaali aaniikandjo muIsrael. Oya li haa etele omukwaniilwa naantu ye iikulya taa kutha kiikandjo yawo, shaa ngoka ota sile omwedhi gumwe oshimpwiyu momumvo.

Mpaka otapa landula omadhina gomalenga omulongo nagaali niikandjo mbyoka ya li taa tonatele.
Omuna gwaHur: oshilongo shokoondundu dhaEfraim.
Omuna gwaDeker: iilando Makaz, Shaalbim, Bet Shemesh, Elon naBetahanan.
Omuna gwaHesed: Arubbot naSoko noshitopolwa ashihe shaHefer.
Omuna gwaAbinadab, ngoka a li a hokana omuna gwaSalomo Tafat: omukuma aguhe gwaDor.
Baana yaAhilud: iilando Taanak, Megiddo nomukuma aguhe popepi naBetshan, popepi noshilando Saretan kuumbugantu woshilando Jesreel sigo oshilando Abel Mehola noshilando Jokmeam.

Omuna gwaGeber: Oshilando Ramot muGilead nomikunda dholudhi lwaJair moluvalo lwaManasse muGilead nomukuma gwaArgob muBaasha, iilando iinene omilongo hamano yi na omadhingililokuma niipateko yoshikushu pomiyelo.
Ahinadab yaIddo: oshikandjo shaMahanaim.
Ahimaaz, ngoka a hokana Basemat yaSalomo: oshitopolwa shaNaftali.
Baana yaHushai: omukuma gwaAser noshilando Bealot.
Jehosafat yaParuak: oshitopolwa shaIssaskar.
Shimei yaEla: oshitopolwa shaBenjamin.

Geber yaUri: omukuma gwaGilead, ngoka gwa li tagu lelwa komukwaniilwa gwAayamori Sihon nomukwaniilwa gwaBaasha Og.
Kakele nee kaambaka omulongo nayaali, okwa li ngoloneya gumwe mevi alihe.
Aajuda nAaisraeli oya li yaa shi kuyalulwa ya fa ehekevi lyomooha dhefuta; oya li e taa nu noya li ye li nawa.
Oshilongo shaSalomo osha kwatelela mo iigwana ayihe okuza komulonga Eufrat, sigo okuFilistia nokoongamba dhaEgipiti. Oya gandja oompale kuye noya li aapangelwa ye okukalamwenyo kwe akuhe.
Iikulya maandjaSalomo mesiku kehe oya li oolata omayuvi gatano dhuusila womunziya, noolata omayuvi omulongo dhuusila womufululwa,
oompunya omulongo dho ondodhwa nodha tekulilwa miigunda, noonzi ethele, kakele koomenye, oombambi, uupundja noombaka.

Salomo okwa lele evi alihe lyokuuninginino womulonga Eufrat okuza kuTifsak puEufrat sigo okuGaza kuuninginino. Aakwaniilwa ayehe kuuninginino waEufrat oya li haa vulika kuye nokwa li e na ombili niilongo ayihe yopuushiinda.
Manga a li e na omwenyo, aantu ayehe muJuda nomuIsrael oya li kaaye na mbudhi yasha. Egumbo kehe olya li li na omiviinu nomikwiyu dhalyo.
Salomo okwa li e na uukambe wokuhila omatembakwiita ge omayuvi omilongo ne noonkawilwankambe omayuvi omulongo nagaali.
Aaniikandjo ye omulongo nayaali shaa ngoka momwedhi moka u uthilwa olufo okwe etele omukwaniilwa Salomo iipalutha te yi pumbwa ye mwene naayehe mboka haa li mombala; aluhe oye eta ayihe tayi pumbiwa.
Omunashikandjo kehe okwe eta wo oshitopolwa she shiishokelya nomwiidhi peha mpoka ya pumbiwa moluukambe wokuhila omatembakwiita nokoonani.
Kalunga okwa pe Salomo owino tau kumitha noondunge nomayele kaage shi kuyelekwa.
Salomo okwa li omunandunge e vule aanandunge ayehe yokUuzilo nomuEgipiti.
Okwa li omunandungelela e vule aantu ayehe; omunandunge e vule Omuesrahi Etan naHeman, Kalkol naDarda, aana yaMahol. Esimano lye olya taandele niilongo ayihe yomuushiinda.
Okwa toto omayeletumbulo omayuvi gatatu nomaimbilo oga li ge vule eyuvi.
Okwa tanga omiti niimeno, omiti omisendeli dhokuLibanon sigo oshisopi shoka hashi mene komakuma. Okwa tanga wo iinamwenyo, oondhila, iihono noohi.
Aakwaniilwa yomuuyuni auhe oya kundana owino we e taa tumu aantu, ye ye ye mu pulakene.
5: Hiram, omukwaniilwa gwaTiro, okwa li kuume kaDavid. Sho u uvu kutya Salomo a landula he David muukwaniilwa okwa tumu aakalelipo ye kuye.
Salomo okwa shunitha elaka ndika kuHiram tali ti:

“Owu shi shi kutya tate David okwa li aluhe miita okukondjitha iigwana mbyoka ye mu thininike koombinga adhihe. Omolwashoka ina wapa okutungila Omuwa, Kalunga ke, otempeli, sigo Omuwa e mu sinditha aatondi ye.
Ihe nena Omuwa, Kalunga kandje, okwa kalitha ndje nombili koombinga adhihe. Kandi na aatondi, nokape na shiponga sha thikamena ndje.

Omuwa oku uvanekele tate David ta ti: ‘Omumwoye, ngoka tandi ke mu kwaniileka te ku landula, oye ta ka tungila ndje otempeli.’ Ano ngashingeyi onda tokola nee okutungila Omuwa otempeli yokusimanekela mo Omuwa, Kalunga kandje.

Tuma ano aantu yoye kuLibanon, ya ka kele ndje omisedeli. Aantu yandje otaa ka longa pamwe nayo, e tandi ka futa aantu yoye shoka wa tokola noto shi lombwele ndje. Ngaashi wa tseya nawa, aantu yandje kaa shi ku ka omiti, ngashi aantu yoye taye shi ningi.”
Hiram okwa li a nyanyukwa noonkondo, sho u uvu elaka lyaSalomo, e ta ti: “Omuwa na hambelelwe, sho a pe David omunona a tya ngeyi omunandunge, ngoka e mu landula muukwaniilwa woshigwana oshinene.”
Nena Hiram okwa tumine Salomo elaka tali ti: “Ondu uvu elaka lya zi kungoye, nondi ilongekidha okuninga shoka wa pula. Otii ka gandja omisendeli nomikiperesi.

Aantu yandje otaa ka kutha omiti kuLibanon, taye dhi fala kefuta e taye dhi mangele kumwe, dhi ende momeya, sigo okehala nkoka wa hala. Aantu yandje otaye ke dhi dhitulula, nokuza mpoka aantu yoye otaye dhi sile oshimpwiyu. Kombinga yoye, onda hala u paluthe aantu yandje.”
Osho ngaaka Hiram a pe Salomo omiti omisedeli nomikiperesi adhihe te dhi pumbwa.
Salomo okwa futu Hiram iilya yoolata omayuvi omathele gane nomagadhi gooholivi oolata omathele gane omumvo kehe.
Omuwa okwa gwanitha euvaneko lye e ta pe Salomo owino. Pokati kaSalomo naHiram opwa li ombili noya li ya hangana.
Omukwaniilwa Salomo okwa langeke miilonga ye yethiminiko aaniilonga 30 000 e ya kutha muIsrael ashihe,
e ta lenge Adoniram omuwiliki gwawo. Okwe ya topola moongundu dhaalumentu 10 000, nongundu kehe oya kala omwedhi gumwe muLibanon noomwedhi mbali otayi galukile kegumbo.
Salomo okwa li wo e na aalumentu 80 000 moshilongo shokoondundu taa tandula omamanya, naalumentu 70 000 taye ga tutu,
nokwa langeke aawiliki 3 300 okutonatela iilonga yawo.
Palombwelo lyomukwaniilwa Salomo oya hongo omamanya omanene ga heyulwa nawa gekankameno lyotempeli.
Aantu yaSalomo noyaHiram naantu ya zi muGebal, oya longekidha omamanya noya hongo omiti dhokutunga otempeli.
6: Omimvo omathele gane nomilongo hetatu sho dha piti po, Israel sho a tembuka muEgipiti, momumvo omutine gwelelo lyaSalomo, momwedhi omutiyali, omwedhi Ziv, Salomo okwa tameke okutunga otempeli.
Meni oya li oometa 27 muule, oometa 9 momutamo noometa 13,5 muule wopombanda.
Ondjugo yethikilo oya li oometa 4,5 momutaandelo noometa 9 momutamo yi thike petsalihangano.
Omakuma gotempeli oga li ge na oombululu dhomakende dha ninga ooshona kondje dhi vule meni.
Komakuma gopombanda koombinga adhihe mbali nokonima yotempeli okwa tungilwa etungo lyoponto moontala ndatu li na omala gomutumbo gwoometa 2,2.

Ela kehe montala yotango olya li oometa 2,2 momutamo, montala yopokati oometa 2,7 nomontala ontintatu oometa 3,1. Ekuma lyotempeli montala kehe olya li li na epepe, opo oontala dhi kankame kekuma dhaa na omiti dha tungilwa mo.
Omamanya ngoka ga tungithwa otempeli, oga hongelwa poshikuthilo shago; inaku uvika nando ekonkolo lyosilwa, ewi lyekuya nenge lyoshilongitho kehe shosheela, manga otempeli ya li tayi tungwa.
Osheelo shokuya montala yopokati metungo lyoponto osha li kuumbugantu wotempeli; iikolo oya li tayi fala montala ontiyali nontintatu.
Omukwaniilwa Salomo okwa mana okutunga otempeli. Okwa tula mo ontala ya tungwa nomiti niipilangi yomisedeli.
Etungo lyoponto lyoontala ndatu olya li lya tungilwa komakuma gopombanda gotempeli lya kwatakanithwa nago nomiti dhomisedeli. Montala kehe omwa li omala goometa 2,2 momutumbo.
Omuwa okwa ti kuSalomo:
“Ngele to vulika kiipango yandje ayihe nokomautho gandje, otandi ke ku ningila shoka ndu uvanekele ho David.
Otandi ka kala mAaisraeli motempeli ndjika to tungu noitandi ke ya etha nando.”
Osho ngaaka Salomo a hulitha okutunga otempeli.
Meni lyomakuma omwa li mwa siikilwa niipilangi yomisedeli okuza kolupanda sigo oombuli, nolupanda olwa li lwa tungwa niipilangi yomikiperesi.

Ela lyomeni, ndyoka hali ithanwa Ehala lyUuyapukielela, olya li lya tungilwa kosindo yotempeli. Olya li li na oometa 9 momutaandelo nolya li lya topolwa ko kiipilangi yomisedeli ya za kolupanda sigo omoombuli.
Ela li li komeho gEhala lyUuyapukielela, olya li oometa 18 momutaandelo.
Miipilangi yomisedeli omwa takelwa uulenga wuutanga wamuthithi noongala; meni amuhe omwa pangelwa niipilangi yomisedeli, opo omamanya ngoka ga tunga omakuma gaa monike.
Mokati kotempeli omwa tungwa ela lyomeni, moka tamu kala oshikethahangano shOmuwa.
Ela ndika lyomeni olya li li na omutaandelo gwoometa 9, omutamo gwoometa 9 nomutumbo gwoometa 9, ayihe oya kolongwa noshingoli sho shene. Oshiyambelo osha siikilwa niipilangi yomisedeli.
Meni lyotempeli omwa kolongwa noshingoli, omalyenge goshingoli oga shindjakanithwa posheelo shela lyomeni, ndyoka lya kolongithwa wo oshingoli.
Mokati kotempeli amuhe omwa kolongwa noshingoli nongaashi wo oshiyambelo shomEhala lyUuyapukielela.
Aakerubi yaali yuule woometa 4,4 ya hongwa moshiti shomuolivi, oya tulwa mEhala lyUuyapukielela.

Ayehe yaali oya li ya faathana muunene nomolupe. Shaa ngoka okwa li e na omawawa gaali, ewawa kehe oli thike puule woometa 2,2, opo oshinano okuza kondungu yewawa limwe sigo okondungu yekwawo oometa 4,4.
Oya tulwa kombinga nombinga mEhala lyUuyapukielela, omawawa ga yalalekwa taga hala okugumathana mokati kela ndyoka, manga omakwawo gu uka komakuma.
Aakerubi yaali oya kolongithwa oshingoli.
Omakuma agehe gela enene motempeli oga tulwa uulenga womafano gaakerubi, gomilunga nogoongala.
Olupanda olwa kolongwa wo noshingoli.
Osheelo shomiyelo mbali dhomawawa dha pangelwa miipilangi yomiolivi, odha tulwa meha lyoposheelo lyokuya mEhala lyUuyapukielela; kombanda yomiyelo okwa tulwa etivu.
Omiyelo odha tulwa uulenga womafano gaakerubi, gomilunga nogoongala. Omiyelo, aakerubi nomilunga oya kolongithwa oshingoli.
Iikulo noshipamba shosheelo shokuya motempeli oya pangelwa miipilangi yomiolivi.
Okwa li omiyelo mbali dhokwiigonya dhiipilangi yomikiperesi
nodha tulwa uulenga womafano gaakerubi, gomilunga nogoongala dha kolongwa noshingoli.
Ehala lyomeni komeho gotempeli olya tungilwa edhingililokuma lya tentekwa iiyalo itatu yomamanya ga hongwa noshiyalo shimwe shomiti dhomisendeli dha hongwa.
Omukanka gwotempeli ogwa tamekwa momwedhi omutiyali, omwedhi Ziv, momumvo omutine gwepangelo lyaSalomo.
Momwedhi omutihetatu, omwedhi Bul, momumvo omutimulongo nagumwe gwepangelo lyaSalomo, otempeli oya li ya pwa thiluthilu, naanaa ngaashi ya fanekwa. Oya pula Salomo omimvo heyali oku yi tunga.
7: Salomo okwi itungile wo uuwa we mwene, noshe mu pula omimvo omulongo nandatu.

Oshinyanga shomiti dhokuLibanon osha li shi na omutaandelo gwoometa 4,4, omutamo gwoometa 22 nomutumbo gwoometa 13,5. Osha li shi na omikweyo ndatu dhoongundhi dhomisedeli, momukweyo kehe omwa li oongundhi omulongo nantano dha tentekwa omiti omisendeli. Ontala yomisedeli oya li ya taandela kombanda yomala gokupungula, ngoka ga kwatwa koongundhi.
Mekuma kehe lyomutaandelo omwa li omikweyo ndatu dhomakende.
Omiyelo nomakende oga li gookolonela ne, nomikweyo ndatu dhomakende mekuma kehe odha li dha taalelathana.
Oshinyanga shoongundhi osha li oometa 22 momutaandelo noometa 13,5 momutamo. Komeho gasho okwa li ondunda yokuthikila yi na oongundhi noshipamba sha kwidhidhika iikolo.
Omakuma goshinyanga shoshipangelapundi, kokutya oshinyanga shoompangu, moka Salomo a tokolele oohapu, oga li ga siikilwa niipilangi yomisedeli okuza kolupanda sigo okontala.

Omuhandjo gwaSalomo mwene ogwa li pehala handiyaka yoshinyanga shoompangu. Ogwa li gwa tungwa ngaashi omatungo omakwawo. Salomo okwa tungu wo ongulu ya tya ngaaka yomunyekadhi gwe, omufuko omuna gwomukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti.

Omatungo agehe ngaka oga li ga tungwa nomamanya gondilo okuza komukanka sigo okontala. Omamanya ngaka oga li ga longekidhwa poshikuthilo shomamanya nokuteta ga yelekwa nawa, meni nokombanda oga li ga saahwa nawa.
Omakankameno oga li ga tungwa nomamanya omanene gondilo, gamwe gomugo oga li oometa 3,5 momutaandelo, gamwe oometa 4.
Kombanda yago okwa tentekwa omamanya ga tetwa pandjele nosho wo omisedeli.
Ehala enene lyotempeli, ndyoka lyomeni komeho gotempeli naandyoka lyuuwa oga li ge na edhingililokuma li na iiyalo itatu yomamanya ga hongwa noshiyalo shimwe shomiti dhomisendeli dha hongwa.
Omukwaniilwa Salomo okwa tumu ko Hiram, a ka talwe koshilando Tiro.

Okwa li omuna gwomuselekadhi mezimo lyaNaftali. Nakusa he Omutiro okwa li omuhambudhi gwoshikushu. Hiram okwa li onkulungu mokuhambula oshikushu. Okwa taamba ehiyo lyomukwaniilwa Salomo nokwe mu hambulile iinima ayihe yoshikushu ya pumbiwa.
Hiram okwa tholoma oongundhi mbali dhoshikushu, shaa ndjoka yoometa 8 muule noometa 5,3 molumbumbu.
Okwa hambula wo iipaka iyali yoshikushu, shaa shoka oometa 2,2 momuthika, yi tentekwe koombando dhoongundhi.
Koshipaka shongundhi kehe okwa li uulenga wa tatwa
nomikweyo mbali dhiiyimati yoshikushu yomuti omugranati.
Iipaka yuule wometa 1,8 oya li ya tholomwa ya fa oongala dhomavo,
noya li ya tulwa kombanda yoshitopolwa sha ngolongwa, mpoka inaapa kala we uulenga wa tatwa. Okwa li iiyimati yomugranati omathele gaali momikweyo mbali dha kunduka oshipaka kehe.
Hiram okwa tula oongundhi ndhika mbali dhoshikushu posheelo shotempeli: yimwe kombinga yokuumbugantu oya lukwa Jakin, nonkwawo kuumbangalantu oya lukwa Boas.

Iipaka yoshikushu molupe lwoongala dhomavo oya tentekwa koombando dhoongundhi.
Osho ngaaka iilonga koongundhi ya hulithwa po thilu.
Hiram okwa hambula ondama yoshikushu ya ngolongwa yi na ontaakano yoometa 2,2 nomutumbo gwoometa 4,4. Olumbumbu lwayo olwa li oometa 13,2.
Koongenge dhondama okwa li uulenga womikweyo mbali dhomafano gokatanga kamuthithi, ngoka ga tholomenwa molumbumbu lwondama.
Ondama oya tentekwa koontsezi omulongo nambali dhoshikushu, ndhoka dha pilamenathana: ndatu odha taalela kuumbangalantu, ndatu okuuninginino, ndatu okuuzilo.
Oongenge dhondama odha li dhi na uupapi woomilimeta 75. Ongenge yayo oya li ya fa yekopi, ya tivulilwa kondje ya fa ongala ya sheneka. Ondama otayi gwana konyala oolita 40 000.
Hiram okwa hambula wo uutemba woshikushu omulongo. Okatemba kehe oke na omutaandelo gwometa 1,8, omutamo gwometa 1,8 nomutumbo gwometa 1,3.
Owa li wa hambulwa momayambi ga tulwa moshikundukilo.
Oge na omafano goonime, goongombe nogaakerubi. Koshikundukilo, pombanda nopohi yoonime noyoongombe, okwa li ku na uulenga woondhingila.
Okatemba kehe oka li ke na omagulu goshikushu gane nooakisa dhoshikushu. Iitakamithi yokomakuvu gokatemba oya li yi na omakwatelo ga tholomenwa kohi yomakuvu noge na uulenga woondhingila.
Komulungu gwondhingila okwa li oluuli lwoosentimeta 45 momutamo noosentimeta 18 okuuka kondambo. Oya li ya takelwa uulenga.
Omagulu oga li ge na uule woosentimeta 66; oge li oogaali noogaali, kohi yoongenge adhihe mbali dhokatemba, nooakisa odha li kumwe nokatemba.
Omagulu oga li ga fa ngoka gomatembakwiita; ooakisa dhago, oofeli, iisipilingi nuumbundju oya li yoshikushu.
Kohi yomakuvu gokatemba kehe okwa li iitakamithi, mbyoka ya li kumwe nokatemba.
Kombanda yokatemba kehe okwa li oluuli lwoosentimeta 22 lwe ka kunduka. Iikwatitho yalwo oya li kumwe nokatemba.
Iikwatitho yoluuli lwako oya li ya takelwa omafano gaakerubi, goonime nogomilunga, nehala kehe lyomwaka olya li lya tulwa uulenga woondhingila.
Osho uutemba wa li wa hambulwa ngaaka, owa li wa faathana, ou thike pamwe muunene nou na olupe lumwe.
Hiram okwa hambula ishewe oombaali omulongo, okatemba kehe ombaali yako. Ombaali kehe oya li ometa 1,8 montaakano yayo notayi gwana oolata 800.
Okwa tula uutemba utano kombinga yokuumbugantu wotempeli, nuutano okwe u tula kombinga yokuumbangalantu. Ondama okwe yi tula mokolonela yokuuzilombugantu.

Hiram okwa longekidha wo oombiga, iihupulo niiyaha. Okwa tsakanitha ayihe mbyoka a li e na okulongela omukwaniilwa Salomo omolwotempeli yOmuwa. Mbyoka a longo, oyo mbika:
Oongundhi mbali
Iipaka iyali koombando dhoongundhi
Uulenga wa tatwa koshipaka kehe
Omafano giiyimati yomugranati yoshikushu omathele gane ya kunduka oshipaka kehe momikweyo mbali, kehe gumwe ethele limwe
Uutemba omulongo
Oombaalitha omulongo
Ondama
Oontsezi omulongo nambali dha humbata ondama
Oombiga, iihupulo niiyaha.
Iikwaniipangitho ayihe yotempeli mbyoka Hiram a longekidhile omukwaniilwa Salomo, oya ningwa moshikushu sha yelithwa.
Omukwaniilwa okwe yi tholomitha ayihe moshitholomeno pokati kaSukkot naSaretan molusilu lwaJordan.
Salomo ina yelekitha iinima mbika, oshoka oya li oyindji noonkondo; inayi yelekwa nando olumwe.
Salomo okwa hambulithile otempeli iiyopalekithi yilwe wo: Oshiyambelo, oshitaafula shiikwiila iiyapuki,
iihukikwanyeka omulongo, mbyoka ya li komeho gEhala lyUuyapukielela, itano kuumbugantu niitano kuumbangalantu; oongala, oolamba niikonde yokutetitha uulapi woolamba;
iiyaha, iimbele, omatemba, iitsininitho niikangwa yomakala; nomakandula gomiyelo dhEhala lyUuyapukielela nogomiyelo dhela lya tetekela. Iinima mbika ayihe oya ningwa moshingoli.
Omukwaniilwa Salomo sho a mana iilonga yotempeli, okwa tula moompungulilo dhayo iinima ayihe mbyoka he David a li e yi yoololele Omuwa — iisiliveli, iingoli niinima iikwawo.
8: Salomo okwi ithana aawiliki ayehe yomazimo noyomaludhi gaIsrael, ye ye kuye muJerusalem, opo ya kuthe ko oshikethahangano shOmuwa koshilando shaDavid, kokutya Sion, yo ye shi fale motempeli.
Ayehe oya gongala pethimbo lyoshituthi shomatsali giihwa iitalala momwedhi omutiheyali, omwedhi Etanim.
Aawiliki ayehe sho ya gongala, aayambi oya yelutha po oshikethahangano
e taye shi fala kotempeli. Aalevi naayambi oya dhikulula po etsalihangano, iikwaniipangitho yalyo ayihe noye yi fala kotempeli.
Omukwaniilwa Salomo nAaisraeli ayehe oya gongala komeho goshikethahangano e taa yamba oonzi noongombe odhindji — kaadhi shi kuyalulwa.
Nena aayambi oya fala oshikethahangano motempeli e taye shi tula pehala lyasho mUuyapukielela pokati komawawa gaakerubi.
Omawawa gawo ga yalalekwa oga kwidhidhike oshiketha niihumbatitho yasho.
Oombando dhiihumbatitho otadhi vulu okumonika kushaa ngoka ta thikama a taalela Ehala lyUuyapukielela, ihe hapalwe we. (Iihumbatitho oko yi li nonena.)
Moshikethahangano kamwa li sha, kakele komayambi gaali giipango ga tulilwe mo kuMoses kondundu Sinai, Omuwa sho a hangana nAaisraeli mokuza kwawo kuEgipiti.
Aayambi sho ya li taa zi motempeli, oshikogo oshe yi udhitha ohaluka.
Aayambi inaa vula we okulonga oshilonga shawo, oshoka eadhimo lyOmuwa olyu udhitha otempeli.

Nena Salomo okwa galikana a ti:
“Ongoye, Omuwa, wa langeke etango mewangandjo
Ongoye tuu ngoka wa hogolola u kale moshikogo oshiluudhe.

Ngashingeyi onde ku tungile otempeli yo opala,
egumbo moka to kala sigo aluhe.”
Aantu manga ya li ya thikama, omukwaniilwa Salomo okwa pungulukile kuyo nokwe ya indilile eyambeko lyaKalunga.
Okwa ti: “Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, na hambelelwe! Okwa gwanitha euvaneko ndyoka a uvanekele tate David, sho a tile:

‘Okuza kethimbo ndyoka nda tembudha aantu yandje muEgipiti, inandi hogolola oshilando shasha mevi lyaIsrael shokutungila mo otempeli moka ndi na okulongelwa. Ndele onde ku hogolola, ngoye David, u lele aantu yandje.’ ”
Salomo okwa tsikile a ti: “Tate David okwa dhiladhilile a tunge otempeli yokusimanekela mo Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael,
ihe Omuwa okwa ti kuye: ‘Onawa, sho wa hala okutungila ndje otempeli,
ihe ito ke yi tunga. Omumwoye, omumwoyelela, oye ta ka tungila ndje otempeli.’
“Ngashingeyi Omuwa okwa gwanitha euvaneko lye. Ngame onda landula tate muukwaniilwa waIsrael nonda tungu otempeli yokusimanekela mo Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael.
Onda longekidha ishewe eha motempeli lyoshikethahangano moka mwa pungulwa omayambi giipango yehangano ndyoka a hangana nootatekulu, sho e ya tembudha muEgipiti.”
Montaneho yaantu Salomo okwa yi komeho goshiyambelo, a yelutha omaako ge

e ta galikana ta ti: “Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, kaku na kalunga megulu pombanda nenge kombanda yevi pohi e ku fa! Oto dhiginine ehangano lyoye naantu yoye noto ya hololele ohole yoye, oomboka taa vulika kungoye mokukala kwawo akuhe.
Owa gwanitha euvaneko we li uvanekele tate David; nena ohapu kehe oya gwanithwa.

Ano ngashingeyi, Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, otandi galikana, u dhiginine wo euvaneko lilwe we li uvanekele tate, sho we mu lombwele kutya moluvalo lwe otamu ka kala aluhe omukwaniilwa ngoka ta ka pangela Israel, ngele oluvalo lwe otalu vulika kungoye, ngaashi tate a ningile.
Ano ngashingeyi, Kalunga kaIsrael, tsakanitha omauvaneko goye ngoka wa uvanekele tate David, omuntu gwoye.
“Omuwa, ndishi ito vulu okukala shili kombanda yevi? Eeno, negulu nomagulu inage ku gwanena, ano otempeli ndjika nde yi ku tungile, oto gwana mo ngiini?
Omuwa, Kalunga kandje, ngame omuntu gwoye. Pulakena omagalikano gandje, ngoye u taambe omaindilo tandi ga hehela nena.
Tonatela otempeli ndjika omutenya nuusiku, ehala ndika wa hogolola u longelelwe mo. Uva ndje, sho te taalele otempeli ndjika note galikana.
Uva omagalikano gandje nomagalikano gaantu yoye, uuna taa galikana muka. Megumbo lyoye megulu tu uva, u tu dhimine po oondjo.
“Ngele ope na omuntu ta tamanekelwa oondjo ye ke dhi na e te etwa koshiyambelo shoye motempeli ndjika, a gane kutya ye ke na ndjo,
Omuwa, mu pulakena megulu lyoye nou tokole aantu yoye. Pangulila uuwinayi ngoka e shi ilongela, nou yululule omukeenandjo.
“Aantu yoye Aaisraeli nge taa dhengwa kaatondi yawo molwashoka ya yono kungoye, e taa galukile kungoye notaa ya motempeli ndjika, taa ku galikana yi ifupipika, u ya dhimine po,
ya pulakena megulu. Dhima po omayono gaantu yoye, noku ya galulila kevi ndyoka we li pe oohekulu.
“Uuna to ya kalaganyekele oluteni molwashoka ya yono kungoye, ndele taa itedhulula e taa ya motempeli ndjika taa ku galikana neifupipiko,

ya pulakena megulu. Dhima po oondjo dhomukwaniilwa nodhAaisraeli ayehe. Ya longa okuninga shoka shu uka. Nena, Omuwa, lokithila evi ndika lyoye omvula, ndyoka we li pe aantu yoye, li ninge eliko lyawo lyaaluhe.

“Moshilongo ngele otamu ya ondjala nenge elega, nenge iilya tayi ningi oshikombo nenge omulegu nenge tayi lika po koshapapa nenge koombahu, nenge aantu yoye taa matukilwa kaatondi yawo nenge taa adhika koshivu nenge komikithi,
pulakena omagalikano gawo. Omuisraeli kehe ta adhika koluhodhi momwenyo gwe, e ta yelutha omaako ge motempeli ndjika yoye,
uva egalikano lye. Ya pulakena megumbo lyoye megulu, ya dhimina po ngoye u ya kwathe. Ongoye awike wa tseya omadhiladhilo gomomutima gwomuntu. Shaa ngoka mu ningila, ngaashi i ilongela,
opo aantu yoye ya kale ya vulika kungoye mokukala kwawo akuhe mevi ndika we li pe ootatekulu.
“Ngele omukwiilongo ngoka a kala mevi lyokokule, ta kundana esimano lyoye niinima iinene we yi ningile aantu yoye, e te ya, e ku longele nokugalikana motempeli ndjika,

pulakena omagalikano ge. Mu uva megulu lyoye, moka wa kala mo, nou ninge shoka te shi pula, opo iigwana ayihe yomuuyuni yi ku tseye noyi vulike kungoye, ngaashi aantu yoye Aaisraeli taa ningi. Nena otaa ka tseya kutya otempeli ndjika nde yi tungu, oyo ehala moka to simanekelwa.
“Uuna to tumu aantu yoye, ya ye kolugodhi okukondjitha aatondi yawo notaa ku galikana shaampoka ye li, ya taalela koshilando shika we shi hogolola, notempeli ndjika nde yi ku tungile,
pulakena omagalikano gawo. Ya uva megulu, u ya pe esindano.
“Ngele aantu yoye otaa yono kungoye — ko kwaa na ngo inaa yona — nomondjahi yoye oto etha, aatondi yawo ye ya sinde, e taye ya fala muupika komavi galwe, nando evi ndyoka li kale kokule,
pulakena omagalikano gaantu yoye. Ngele otayi itedhululile mevi ndyoka e taa ku galikana taa hempulula oondjo dhawo, nkene ya yono, nuuwinayi ye u longo, Omuwa, uva omagalikano gawo.
Ngele otayi itedhululile shili mevi ndyoka koomwenyo dhawo adhihe e taye ku galikana ya taalela kevi ndika we li pe ootatekulu, koshilando shika we shi hogolola, notempeli ndjika nde yi ku tungile,
nena pulakena omagalikano gawo. Ya uva megumbo lyoye megulu ngoye u ya sile ohenda.
Dhima po omayono gawo agehe noondumbo dhawo ye ku tsile ondumbo ngoye u ya silithe ohenda kaatondi yawo, ya kale nayo nombili.
Oyo aantu yoye mwene, mboka we ya tembudha muEgipiti, muupyu wa hanya.
“Omuwa Omupangeliawike, tala aluhe nolukeno aantu yoye Aaisraeli nomukwaniilwa gwawo nou uve omagalikano gawo, ngele taye ku ithana taa kugile ekwatho.
Ongoye we ya hogolola mokati kiigwana ayihe, ya ninge aantu yoye mwene, ngaashi we ya lombwelitha omuntu gwoye Moses, sho wa kutha ootatekulu muEgipiti.”
Salomo sho a zimbuka okugalikana Omuwa, okwa thikama komeho goshiyambelo, nkoka a li a tsa oongolo ye a yelutha iikaha ye.
Okwi igidhile aantu ayehe eyambeko lyaKalunga. Okwa ti:
“Omuwa na hambelelwe, ngoka a pe aantu ye ombili, ngaashi u uvaneka. Okwa dhiginine omauvaneko agehegehe ngoka u uvanekitha omuntu gwe Moses.
Omuwa Kalunga ketu na kale natse, ngaashi a li nootatekulu; na kale itee tu etha nando nenge e tu thige po;
ne tu ninge aavuliki kuye, opo tu kale aluhe, ngaashi a hala tu kale nokudhiginina iipango ayihe nomautho agehe e ga pele ootatekulu.
Omuwa Kalunga ketu na dhimbulukwe omathimbo agehe egalikano ndika nomaindilo ngaka nde mu indile. Na kale aluhe e na ohenda naantu ye Aaisraeli nomukwaniilwa gwawo, opampumbwe dhawo dhesiku kehe.
Nosho ngaaka iigwana ayihe yomuuyuni tayi ka tseya kutya Omuwa oye awike Kalunga — kaku na gulwe.
Ne aantu ye, kaleni mwa dhiginina Omuwa, Kalunga ketu, vulikeni kiipango ye ayihe nokomautho ge, ngaashi tamu ningi ngashingeyi.”
Nena omukwaniilwa Salomo pamwe naantu ayehe oya yamba omafikilondjambo kOmuwa.
Salomo okwa yamba ekwatathanondjambo lyoongombe 22 000 noonzi 120 000. Osho ngaaka omukwaniilwa naantu ayehe ya sindilile otempeli.

Esiku tuu ndyoka okwa yapula wo endiki lyehale lyokomeho gotempeli e ta yambele nkoka: omidhidhindjambo, iikulyandjambo noofu dhiimuna yomekwatathanondjambo. Okwa ningi ngaaka, oshoka oshiyambelo shoshikushu osha li oshishona okuyambela mo omayambo ngaka agehe.

Mpeyaka potempeli Salomo nAaisraeli ayehe oya dhanene po oshituthi shomatsali giihwa iitalala shomasiku gaheyali. Okwa li ongundu onenenene yaatu ya kongoloka okuza ketaulilo lyaHamat kuumbangalantu nokongamba yaEgipiti muumbugantu.
Mesiku etihetatu Salomo okwa laleke aantu, ya ye kaandjawo. Ayehe oye mu pandula noya yi kaandjawo ya nyanyukilwa omayambeko agehe ngoka Omuwa e ga pe omuntu gwe David naantu ye Aaisraeli.
9: Salomo sho a mana etungo lyotempeli nombala naayihe yilwe a halele oku yi tunga,
Omuwa okwe mu ihololele ishewe, ngaashi e shi ningile muGibeon.
Omuwa okwa ti kuye: “Otandi yapula otempeli ndjika we yi tungu, yi ninge eha lyokulongela ndje mo sigo aluhe. Otandi yi tonatele e tandi yi gamene aluhe.
Ngele oto longele ndje muuyuuki nomuuyapuki, ngaashi ho David a ningile, nongele to vulika kiipango yandje e to gwanitha ayihe nde ku uthile,
otii ka gwanitha euvaneko nde li uvanekele ho David, sho nde mu lombwele kutya Israel ota ka lelwa aluhe koluvalo lwe.
Ihe ngoye nenge oluvalo lwoye ngele tamu etha okulandula ndje, ngele itamu vulika kiipango yandje, nokomautho gandje nde ge mu pa, e tamu longele ookalunga yalwe,

nena otandi ka kutha aantu yandje Aaisraeli mevi ndika nde ya pele. Otandi ka thiga po otempeli ndjika nda yapula, yi ninge eha moka tandi simanekelwa mo. Iigwana koombinga noombinga otayi ka sheka Israel noku mu dhina.
Otempeli otayi ka ninga ondumba yomakulukuma, noshaa ngoka ta ka pita po, ota ka haluka e ta kumwa. Yamwe otaa pula taa ti: ‘Omolwashike Omuwa a ningi ngeyi noshilongo shika notempeli ndjika?’

Aantu otaa yamukula taa ti: ‘Osha ningwa, oshoka oyo oye etha Omuwa, Kalunga kawo, ngoka a tembudha oohekulu muEgipiti. Oyi inekele ookalunga yalwe e taye ya simaneke. Omolwashoka Omuwa e ya etele omupya nguka.’ ”
Osha pula Salomo omimvo omilongo mbali okutunga otempeli nuuwa we.

Omukwaniilwa gwaTiro Hiram okwe mu longekidhile omisedeli nomikiperesi niingoli ayihe ya pumbilwa iilonga mbika. Okutunga sho kwa pu, omukwaniilwa Salomo okwa pe Hiram iilando omilongo mbali moshitopolwa shaGalilea.
Hiram okwa yi e ke yi tale noine yi hokwa.
Onkee a ti kuSalomo: “Mukwetu, no pe ndje iilando, oyo mbino?” Omolwashika oshitopolwa osha lukwa Kabul.
Hiram okwa li a tumine Salomo oshingoli shookilograma dhi vule omayuvi gane.
Omukwaniilwa Salomo okwa tula aantu miilonga yethiminiko mokutunga otempeli nombala, Millo nedhingililokuma lyaJerusalem. Okwe ya tungitha wo iilando Hazor, Megiddo naGeser.
(Omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti okwa li a matukile Geser e te shi kwata po, a dhipaga aakalimo yasho e te shi tomeke omulilo. Nena okwe shi umbu mongalo yohango yomwana omufuko, sho a hokanwa kuSalomo,
Salomo nokwe shi tungulula.) Miilonga yethiminiko Salomo okwa tungulula wo Bethoron shopohi,
Baalat naTamar mombuga yaJuda,
iilando moka a pungula iipumbiwa ye, iilando yuukambe we nomatembakwiita ge noshaa shoka a halele okutunga muJerusalem, muLibanon nopalwe moshilongo she.

Miilonga ye yethiminiko Salomo okwa longitha oluvalo lwAakaanana mboka inaa dhipagwa po kAaisraeli, sho ya kutha ko evi lyawo. Oluvalo nduka olwa kwatelela mo Aayamori, Aaheti, Aaperesi, Aahevi nAayebusi, mboka omaluvalo gawo ga kala aapika sigo onena.
Salomo ina pika Aaisraeli; oya li aakwiita, aanambelewa, oondjayi dhiita, aakuluntu yomatembakwiita naakuluntu yaakayilinkambe.
Aanambelewa aatonateli yiilonga yi ili noyi ili yethiminiko yaSalomo oya li 550.
Salomo okwa tungu Millo, sho omunyekadhi gwe, omuna gwomukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti, a zi moshilando shaDavid a tembukile muuwa mboka Salomo e u mu tungile.

Lutatu momumvo Salomo okwa yamba omafikilondjambo nomakwatathanondjambo koshiyambelo shoka a tungile Omuwa. Okwa lungunithile wo Omuwa omatsininondjambo. Osho ngaaka a hulitha iilonga yetungo lyotempeli.
Omukwaniilwa Salomo okwa pangelitha oosikepa puEziongeber, popepi naElat, komunkulo gwEkololo lyaAkaba mevi lyaEdom.
Omukwaniilwa Hiram okwe mu tumine aapyokoki yomefuta ya zi moosikepa dhe, ya longe pamwe naantu yaSalomo.
Oya thayile yu uka kevi lyaOfir noye etele Salomo oshingoli omathele gane nomilongo mbali.
10: Omukwaniilwa omukiintu gwaSheba okwa kundana esimano lyaSalomo nokwa yi kuJerusalem e te mu pula omapulo gokanaku.
Okwe ya pamwe nongundu onene yaakalele noongamelo dha humbata omilongelo dhiizimba, uuwe noshingoli oshindjishindji. Sho ya tsakanene naSalomo, okwe mu pula omapulo agehe a li e ga na.
Salomo okwe ga yamukula agehe; kapwa li sha oshidhigu unene kuye okufatulula.
Omukwaniilwa omukiintu gwaSheba okwa uvu uunongo waSalomo e ta tala ombala ndjoka a tungu.

Okwa mono iikulya mbyoka tayi tentekwa koshitaafula, aambala ye mpoka ya kala nonkene ya yakula niizala ya zala, aayakuli yopiililo miituthi, iinuwa ye nomafikilondjambo ngoka ha yamba motempeli. Mbika ayihe oye mu mana oohapu e ta kumwa.
Okwa ti komukwaniilwa Salomo: “Shoka nde ku kundanene ngoye mwene nuunongo woye moshilongo shandje, owoshili!
Ihe kanda li te vulu oku shi itaala, sigo nde ya nonde shi mono ngame mwene. Ihe nani netatatata olyo ngaa inaandi uva; uunongo woye nuuyamba woye uunene u vule shoka nda lombwelwa.
Aanyekadhi yoye aanelago ngiini! Aapiya yoye aanelago ngiini, mboka taa kala aluhe koshipala shoye noye na ompolo okuuva, sho to popi uunongo woye!

Hambelela Omuwa, Kalunga koye! Okwa holola kutya okwe ku hokwa, sho e ku ningi omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael. Ohole ye yokuhola Israel oyaaluhe, nokwe ku ningi omukwaniilwa gwawo, opo u popile ompango nelandulathano.”
Okwa pe omukwaniilwa Salomo omulongelo ngoka e gu eta: oshingoli shondjundo yookilograma 4,000, iizimba oyindjiyindji nuuwe. Iizimba mbyoka a pe Salomo, oya li oyindjiyindji inee yi pewa nando onale.
(Oosikepa dhaHiram, ndhoka dhe eta oshingoli sha zi kuOfir, odhe eta wo iipilangi oyindjiyindji yondilo nuuwe.
Salomo okwa hongitha muyo iinima yomotempeli noyomuuwa we, niiketala nuuharpa waayimbi. Oya li iipilangi yo opala yi vule ayihe ye etelwe muIsrael, noinayi monika we.)

Omukwaniilwa Salomo okwa gandja komukwaniilwa omukiintu gwaSheba ashihe shoka a li a pula, nokombanda yaayihe mbika okwe mu pe wo omagano ogendji pasimano. Konima omukwaniilwa omukiintu naantu ye oya shuna kevi lyawo kuSheba.
Salomo okwa taamba omumvo kehe oshingoli shookilograma omayovi 23 000.
Okwa taamba wo oompale dha futwa kaahalithi, iihohela ya zi momapindiko nomaliko ga futwa kaakwaniilwa Aayarabia nokaaleli yiikandjo muIsrael.
Salomo okwi ihambulithile iikandekitho iinene omathele gaali nokwa kolongitha kehe shimwe noshingoli sha ngolongwa shookilograma konyala heyali.
Okwa hambulitha wo iikandekitho iishona omathele gatatu ya kolongithwa oshingoli shookilograma mbali kehe shimwe. Iikandekitho ayihe mbika okwe yi pungula moshinyanga shomiti dhokuLibanon.
Okwa pangelitha wo oshipangelapundi oshinene. Ombinga yimwe oya li yomayego goondjamba, nonkwawo oyoshingolilela.

Oshipangelapundi osha li shi na iilyatelelo ihamano. Kombanda yoshilyatelelo koluha kehe okwa li efano lyonime, oonime adhihe kumwe omulongo nambali. Konima yoshipangelapundi okwa li efano lyomutse gwontsezi, nopooha dhosheegameno kehe shokwaako okwa li efano lyonime. Miilongo ayihe kamwa li oshipangelapundi sha fa shika.
Iitenga yaSalomo ayihe yokunwina oya li yoshingoli, niiyuma ayihe moshinyanga shomiti dhokuLibanon oya li yoshingolilela. Inaa longitha oshisiliveli, oshoka sha li kaashi na mwago muuyuni waSalomo.
Okwa li e na oosikepa mefuta, ndhoka dhe ende pamwe noosikepa dhaHiram. Momumvo omutitatu kehe odha galuka dhe etelele oshingoli, oshisiliveli, omayego goondjamba, oondjima noondhila dhoonankwe.
Omukwaniilwa Salomo okwa li omuyambalela nomunandunge e vule aakwaniilwa ayehe,
nuuyuni auhe owa halele okuya, u pulakene uunongo mboka Kalunga e u mu pa.
Shaa ngoka e ya ko, okwe mu etele oombalagelo — iisiliveli, oshingoli, oonguwo, omatati, iizimba, uukambe nomamulutiya. Shika osha ningwa omumvo nomumvo.
Salomo okwi iningile omatembakwiita eyuvi limwe nomathele gane, naakawilinkambe omayuvi omulongo nagaali. Ongundu yimwe yomuyo oya kala muJerusalem, manga ombinga onene ya kala miilando yilwe.
Muuyuni we oshisiliveli osha li oshindjishindji muJerusalem sha fa evi, nomisedeli odha li wo odhindji dha fa omikwiyu muShefela.
Aalongeli yomukwaniilwa oye ke mu landela uukambe kuMusri naKilikia
nomatembakwiita okuEgipiti. Oya landa uukambe nomatembakwiita kaakwaniilwa Aaheti nAasiria. Omatembakwiita oga gu iimaliwa iisiliveli 600 kehe limwe nuukambe owa gu 150 kukehe.
11: Salomo okwa li e hole aakiintu oyendji aakwiilongo. Kakele komuna omukadhona gwomukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti okwa hokana aakulukadhi Aaheti, nayalwe ya za kuMoab, Ammon, Edom naSidon.
Okwe ya hokana, nando Omuwa okwa li a lombwele Aaisraeli, yaa hokanathane naantu mboka, oshoka otaa ningi ya hongolole Aaisraeli, yi inekele iikalunga yawo.
Salomo okwa hokana aana yokombanda omathele gaheyali nokwa li e na natango aakiintu yalwe omathele gatatu. Oye mu pilamenitha Kalunga,
nosho a kulupa oye mu simanekitha iikalunga iikwiilongo. Ina dhiginina Omuwa, Kalunga ke, ngaashi he David a ningile.
Okwa longele Astarte, oshikalungakiintu shaSidon, naMilkom, oshikalunga shi nyanyalitha shAayammoni.
Okwa yono kOmuwa noine mu landula, ngaashi he David a ningile.
Kondundu kuuzilo waJerusalem okwa tungile ko eha lyokulongela Kemosh, oshikalunga oshinyanyalithi shaMoab, nehala lyokulongela Milkom, oshikalunga oshinyanyalithi shAayammoni.
Okwa tungu wo omahala gaakadhi aakwiilongo, opo ya lungunithile ko nokuyamba omafikilondjambo kiikalunga yawo.
Omuwa Kalunga kaIsrael nando okwa li a holokele Salomo lwaali nokwe mu indike okulongela iikalunga iikwiilongo, Salomo ina vulika kOmuwa, ihe okwe mu pilamene. Omolwashoka Omuwa okwa geele Salomo
e ta ti kuye: “Ano sho wa teya ehangano lyetu nangoye noino vulika komautho gandje, otandi ku kutha oshilongo e tandi shi pe gumwe gwomaapiya yoye.
Nando molwaho David itandi shi ningi, manga u na omwenyo, ihe omelelo lyomumwoye.
Itandi ke mu kutha oshilongo ashihe; otandi mu pe ezimo limwe molwomuntu gwandje David nomolwaJerusalem, oshilando nde shi hogolola, shi ninge shandje mwene.”
Omuwa okwa sikumudha Hadad, omuvalekele gwokuEdom, a kondjithe Salomo.
Konalenale David sho a sindi Edom, ondjayi yiita ye Joab okwa yile ko, a ka fumvike aasi. Okwa kalele muEdom oomwedhi hamano nomethimbo ndika oya dhipagele aalumentu ayehe muEdom,
kakele kaHadad naapiya yahe yamwe Aaedom, mboka ya yi ontuku kuEgipiti. (Pethimbo ndiyaka Hadad okwa li omunona.)
Oya thigi po Midian e taa yi kuParan, nkoka aantu yamwe ya yi mongundu yawo. Nena oya yi kuEgipiti e taa yi komukwaniilwa, ngoka a pe Hadad epya negumbo niikulya.
Hadad okwa hokiwa komukwaniilwa, nomukwaniilwa okwe mu pe suwala ye, omumwayina gwomunyekadhi gwe Takpenes, e mu hokane.
Takpenes okwe mu valele omumati Genubat, ngoka a falwa komunyekadhi mombala, a putukile pamwe naana yomukwaniilwa.
Hadad sho a kundana muEgipiti kutya David a si naJoab, ondjayi yetangakwiita, okwa si, Hadad okwa ti komukwaniilwa: “Laleka ndje, ndi shune koshilongo shaandjetu.”

Omukwaniilwa okwa pula a ti: “Omolwashike? Owa hepa sha moshilongo shandje, sho wa hala okushuna koshilongo shaandjeni?”
Hadad okwa yamukula omukwaniilwa a ti: “Etha ndje owala, ndi ye.” Oye nokwa shuna koshilongo shaandjawo. Hadad okwa ningi omukwaniilwa gwaEdom nokwa li omutondilela gwaIsrael.
Kalunga okwa pendutha wo Reson yaEliada, a kondjithe Salomo. Reson okwa li a yi ontuku yamwene gwe, omukwaniilwa Hadadeser gwaZoba,

e ta ningi omuwiliki gwongundu yaamentu yowala. (Shika osha ningwa, sho David a dhengele Hadadeser e ta dhipaga aahangani naye Aasiria.) Reson naantu ye oya yi, ya ka kale muDamaskus, nkoka aantu ye ye mu ningi omukwaniilwa gwaSiria.
Okwa li omutondi gwaIsrael muuyuni waSalomo.
Omulumentu gumwe ngoka a pilukile omukwaniilwa Salomo, ogumwe gwomaanambelewa ye, Jeroboam yaNebat, gwokuZereda muEfraim. Yina okwa li omuselekadhi edhina lye Zerua.

Oshikumungu shika oshe ende ngeyi.
Salomo okwa li mokutunga Millo e ta thitike ngaaka ompito medhingililokuma lyoshilando shahe David.
Jeroboam okwa li omugundjuka ependa. Salomo sho a ndhindhilike, nkene ta longo nuudhiginini, okwe mu tula metonatelo lyiilonga ayihe ya thiminikwa moshikandjo shezimo lyaManasse nolyaEfraim.
Esiku limwe, manga Jeroboam e li moondjenda ta zi kuJerusalem, omuhunganeki Ahija gwokuShilo okwe mu tsakaneke oye awike mondjila yomolushandja.
Ahija okwi ihula elwaakani ndyoka epe a li a zala e te li tuula iitogonyona omulongo niiyali,
e ta ti kuJeroboam: “Kutha po iitogonyona omulongo, oshoka Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, ote ku lombwele ta ti: ‘Salomo otandi ke mu kutha oshilongo notandi ke ku pa omazimo omulongo.
Salomo ota kala nezimo limwe, omolwomuntu gwandje David nomolwaJerusalem, oshilando nde shi hogolola, shi ninge shandje mwene mevi alihe lyaIsrael.

Otandi ka ninga shika, oshoka Salomo okwe etha ndje nokwa longele iikalunga iikwiilongo; Astarte, oshikalungakiintu shaSidon; Kemosh, oshikalunga shaMoab; naMilkom, oshikalunga shaAmmon. Salomo okwa tindi okuvulika kungame; okwa puka noina dhiginina iipango yandje nomautho gandje, ngaashi he David a ningile.

Ndele oshilongo ashihe itandi shi kutha Salomo, notandi mu dhiginine muukwaniilwa, manga e na omwenyo. Shika otandi shi ningi omolwomuntu gwandje David, ngoka nda hogolola nokwa dhiginine iipango yandje nomautho gandje.
Oshilongo otandi shi kutha omuna gwaSalomo e tandi ku pe omazimo omulongo,
ihe omuna gwaSalomo otandi mu thigile ezimo limwe, opo ndi kale aluhe ndi na oluvalo lwomuntu gwandje David ta lele muJerusalem, oshilando shoka nda hogolola, shi ninge eha mpoka tandi simanekelwa.
Jeroboam, otandi ku kwaniileke omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael, noto ka lela iikandjo ayihe mbyoka wa hala.

Ngele oto vulika shili kungame, to kala miipango yandje, to opalele ndje, sho to gwanitha shoka tandi shi ku lombwele, ngaashi omuntu gwandje David a ningile, nena otandi ka kala pamwe nangoye. Otandi ke ku kwaniileka omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael, notandi ka tonatela oluvalo lwoye, lu ka lele konima yoye, ngaashi nda ningile David.
Moluulunde waSalomo otandi geele oluvalo lwaDavid, ihe hasigo aluhe.’ ”
Salomo okwa kambadhala okudhipaga Jeroboam, ihe okwa yi ontuku kuShishak, omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti, nokwa kala nkoka, sigo okeso lyaSalomo.
Iinima ayihe yilwe kombinga yaSalomo, iilonga ye nuunongo we, oya nyolelwa membo lyondjokonona yaSalomo.
Okwa li omukwaniilwa muJerusalem, a lele Israel alihe omimvo omilongo ne.
Okwa si nokwa fumvikwa moshilando shaDavid, nomwana Rehoboam okwe mu landula muukwaniilwa.
12: Rehoboam okwa yi kuShekem, nkoka Aaisraeli ayehe yokuumbangalantu ya gongala, ye mu kwaniileke.
Jeroboam yaNebat, ngoka a li a ya ontuku omukwaniilwa Salomo kuEgipiti, sho e shi kundana, okwa galuka a zi kuEgipiti.
Aantu yomazimo gokuumbangalantu oye mu tumu a ze ko, noyo ayehe oya yi kuRehoboam e taa ti kuye:
“Ho Salomo okwe tu tsike omitenge omidhigu. Ngele oto pupaleke omitenge ndhika e to tu vululukitha, otatu ningi aapiya yoye.”
Rehoboam okwa yamukula a ti: “Galukeni, nge pwa piti omasiku gatatu, otandi ke mu yamukula.” Oyo noya yi.
Omukwaniilwa Rehoboam okwa pula omayele kaasamane aakulupe mboka ya li haa pe he Salomo omayele. Okwe ya pula a ti: “Otamu pe ndje eyamukulo lya tya ngiini, ndi yamukule aantu mbaka?”
Aasamane oya yamukula ya ti: “Ngele owa hala, u ninge aantu mbaka nawa, gandja eyamukulo li na olukeno mushoka taa pula, oyo notaa ke ku longela aluhe nuudhiginini.”
Rehoboam okwa dhini omayele gaasamane aakulupe nokwa yi kaagundjuka yepipi lye mboka ya li ya putukila pamwe naye noya li aagandjindunge ye.
Okwe ya pula a ti: “Otandi ka tya ngiini kaantu mbo ya pula ndje, ndi ya pupalekele omitenge dhawo?”
Oyo ya yamukula ya ti: “Ya lombwela to ti: ‘Okanwegona kandje okanene ke vule oombwetelo dhatate!’
Ya lombwela to ti: ‘Tate okwe mu tsike omitenge omidhigu; ngame otandi ke dhi dhigupaleka noonkondo. Okwe mu dhenge nongola; ngame otandi ke mu kwinunitha ekoosa!’ ”
Omasiku gatatu sho ga piti po, Jeroboam naantu ayehe oya galukile komukwaniilwa Rehoboam, ngaashi e ya tseyithilile.
Omukwaniilwa okwa dhini omayele gaasamane aakulupe e ta vavele aantu,
ngaashi a taamba omayele gaagundjuka. Okwa ti: “Tate okwe mu tsike omitenge omidhigu; ngame otandi ka gwedha ko, dhi dhigupale. Okwe mu dhenge nongola; ngame otandi ke mu kwinunitha ekoosa!”
Shika osha li ehalo lyOmuwa, a gwanithe shoka a popile kuJeroboam yaNebat momuhunganeki Ahija gwokuShilo. Omolwashoka omukwaniilwa ina pupa ko nando kaantu, e ya pulakene.

Aantu sho ya mono kutya nani omukwaniilwa ite ya pulakene, oyi igidha ya ti: “Otu na shike naDavid negumbo lye nuuthiga womuna gwaIsai? Oye tu ningile shike? Aaisraeli ne, tu yeni komagumbo. Rehoboam na tale sho ta ningi!”
Osho ngaaka Aaisraeli ya pindjala
noya thigi po Rehoboam, a kale ashike omukwaniilwa gwaantu mboka ye li moshikandjo shaJuda.

Nena omukwaniilwa Rehoboam okwa tumu Adoniram, ngoka a li omuwiliki gwiilonga ya thiminikwa, a ye kAaisraeli, ihe oye mu dhipaga nomamanya. Opo mpoka Rehoboam okwa nukile metembakwiita lye e ta yi ontuku kuJerusalem.
Okuza mpoka aantu yokuumbangalantu waIsrael oyi iteka ezimo lyaDavid.
Aaisraeli sho ya kundana kutya Jeroboam a galuka ko kuEgipiti, oye mu hiyile koshigongi shAaisraeli e taye mu kwaniileke omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael. Ezimo lyaJuda olyo alike lya kala poluvalo lwaDavid.

Rehoboam sho a thiki muJerusalem, okwa hiya aakwiita ya pyokoka 180 000 yomezimo lyaJuda nolyaBenjamin. Okwa dhiladhila, a ye miita, a galule omazimo gAaisraeli gokuumbangalantu, e ga pangele natango.
Ihe Kalunga okwa lombwele omuhunganeki Shemaja,
a fale elaka ndika kuRehoboam nokaantu ayehe yomazimo gaJuda nogaBenjamin
tali ti: “Inamu matukila aamwanyoko Aisraeli. Shuneni komagumbo, ne amuhe. Shika sha ningwa, ongame nde shi hala.” Ayehe oya vulika keutho lyOmuwa e taa shuna kaandjawo.
Omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael Jeroboam okwa ningi Shekem shomevi lyokoondundu dhaEfraim oshilandohote e ta kala mo okathimbo. Nena okwa zi mo e ta ka ninga Penuel oshilandohote.
Okwi ipopile a ti: “Iinima ngele tayi ka piluka, nena uukwaniilwa otau ka shuna kegumbo lyaDavid.
Ngele aantu yandje otaa yi kuJerusalem e taa ka yambela Omuwa oontselelandjambo motempeli, otaa ka tula einekelo lyawo momukwaniilwa gwaJuda Rehoboam e taa dhipaga ndje.”

Sho e shi kutha mo nawa momadhiladhilo ge, okwa hambulitha oontsezi mbali dhoshingoli e ta ti kaantu ye: “Sha gwana nduno okuya kuJerusalem. Aantu yaIsrael, ookalunga yeni oyo mbaka ye mu tembudha muEgipiti.”
Okwa tula ontsezi yimwe yoshingoli muBetel nonkwawo muDan.
Nosho ngaaka aantu ya yono, sho ye ke dhi galikana muBetel nomuDan.
Jeroboam okwa tungu wo omahala gomagalikano koondungu dhoondundu e ta hogolola aayambi momazimo ngoka gaa shi gaLevi.

Jeroboam okwa toto po oshituthi hashi dhanwa mesiku etimulongo netitano momwedhi omutihetatu, sha fa shAajuda. Koshiyambelo shomuBetel okwa yambele ko omafikilondjambo koontsezi dhoshingoli ndhoka a hambulitha, nomuBetel okwa langeke mo aayambi ya yakule pomahala ngoka e ga tungu.
Mesiku etimulongo netitano lyomwedhi omutihetatu, ndyoka ye mwene e li utha, okwa yi kuBetel e ta yamba efikilondjambo koshiyambelo mokudhana oshituthi shoka e shi totele Aaisraeli.
13: Palombwelo lyOmuwa omuhunganeki a zi muJuda, okwa yi kuBetel e ta thiki ko, manga Jeroboam a li a thikama poshiyambelo ta yamba efikilondjambo.
