Nkeyama, ngele tashi ku opalele, gandja eutho lyopakwaniilwa kutya Vashti ke na mpoka na holoka we koshipala shomukwaniilwa. Eutho ndika nali nyolwe moompango dhokwaalunduluka dhaPersia naMedia. Omukwaniilwa na konge omukiintu gulwe omwaanawa e vule Vashti, a ninge omunyekadhi.
Shampa eutho lyoye lya tseyika noshilongo ashihe oshinene, omukulukadhi kehe ota vulika komulumentu gwe nesimaneko, na kale omuyamba nenge ohepele.”
Omukwaniilwa nomalenga ge oya hokwa ondunge ndjika, omukwaniilwa nokwa gwanitha shoka Memukan a faneke.

Koshitopolwa kehe shoshilongo okwa tumu ko etumwalaka lya nyolwa melaka lyasho nomoondanda dhelaka ndyoka. Etumwalaka otali ti kutya omusamane kehe na pangele egumbo lye, noohapu dhe nadhi kale ompango yegumbo.
2: Konima yethimbo, ondjahi yomukwaniilwa sho ya adhika ya lota, okwa dhiladhila shoka Vashti e shi ningi neutho ndyoka lya gandjwa omolwe.
Gamwe gomomalenga gomukwaniilwa gopothingo oga ti: “Omukwaniilwa na kongelwe aakadhona ya shitika.

Nkeyama, oto vulu okulangeka omalenga moshitopolwa kehe shoshilongo e to ga lombwele, ga ete aakadhona aawanawa komuhandjo gwaanyekadhi yoye muka muSusa. Naa tulwe metonatelo lyaHegai, omuthonwantu ngoka ha tonatele aanyekadhi yoye nembonzolo lyawo.

Nena oto kutha po omukadhona ngoka we mu hokwa unene, oye a ninge omunyekadhi peha lyaVashti.”
Ondunge ndjika oyo opalele omukwaniilwa, nokwe yi landula.
MuSusa omwa li Omujuda edhina lye Mordekai yaJair yaShimei yaKish gwomezimo lyaBenjamin.
Nebukadnezzar, omukwaniilwa gwaBabilonia, sho a falele omukwaniilwa gwaJuda Jehoiakin muupika pamwe noonkwatwa dhilwe muJerusalem, mongundu ndjoka omwa li wo Mordekai.

Okwa li nomwanagona Ester, edhina lye mOshihebeli oHadassa. Ester okwa li omukadhona o opala e na ondjelo ombwanawa. Aakuluntu ye sho ya si, Mordekai okwe mu kutha po e te mu putudha ongomwana omukadhona.
Omukwaniilwa sho a gandja eutho lye, naakadhona oyendji oye etwa muSusa, Ester okwa li mokati kawo. Naye wo a tulwa moshimpwiyu shaHegai, ngoka ha tonatele omuhandjo gwaanyekadhi.
Hegai okwa hokwa Ester nokwe mu opalele. Mbalambala okwa tameke embonzolitho lye e te mu pe iikulya ya sheywa. Okwe mu pe wo aayakuli yaheyali aahogololwa nelugo dhingi momuhandjo gwaanyekadhi.
Ester ina holola kutya oye Omujuda, oshoka Mordekai okwa li e mu indike oku shi ninga.
Esiku nesiku Mordekai okwa li te ende pondje yehale lyomuhandjo gwaanyekadhi, opo a kundane, ngele Ester oku li nawa naashoka she mu ningilwa.
Omukadhona manga inaa falwa komukwaniilwa, okwa mbonzolwa oomwedhi omulongo nambali: muule woomwedhi hamano okwa thetwa nomagadhi gomira noomwedhi hamano nomagadhi gokanakamuma niinima yilwe yuutiko.
Sho ta zi momuhandjo gwaanyekadhi u uka mombala, ota vulu okuzala ngaashi a hala.

Oha yi mo ongulohi, nongula nge kwa shi, ota falwa komuhandjo omukwawo e ta kala moshimpwiyu shaShaashgas, omuthonwantu gwokutonatela aakiintu yopooha. Ita yi we komukwaniilwa, shila omukwaniilwa e mu hokwa e te mu ithana kedhina.

Olufo lwaEster olwe ya okuya komukwaniilwa. Ester olyaAbihail, omwanagona gwaMordekai, ngoka e mu taamba a ninge omwana. Ester okwa ziminwa kukehe ngoka e mu tsu keho. Sho a yi, okwa zala ngaashi a lombwelwa kelenga Hegai, ndyoka hali tonatele omuhandjo gwaanyekadhi.
Ester okwa falwa komukwaniilwa Kserkses momwedhi omutimulongo, omwedhi Tebet, momumvo omutiheyali gwepangelo lye.

Omukwaniilwa okwe mu hokwa unene shi vule aakiintu ayehe, nokwa li e mu opalela shi vule aakadhona ayehe. Omukwaniilwa okwe mu zaleke uulenga womunyekadhi komutse gwe e te mu ningi omunyekadhi peha lyaVashti.
Mokusimaneka Ester, omukwaniilwa okwe mu ningile omatelekela e ta hiya aakwanepangelo noongoloneya ye ayehe. Okwa utha ongondji moshilongo ashihe nokwa gandja omagano gopakwaniilwa.
Mordekai okwa adhika a pewa iilonga yontumba kehale lyuuwa, aakadhona sho ya li taa gongelwa olutiyali.
Ester okwa li inaa holola manga ezimo nuukwashigwana we, oshoka Mordekai okwa li e mu indike oku shi ninga, naEster okwa vulika kuye, ngaashi a li ha vulika muunona we.
Methimbo ndyoka Mordekai a taamba iilonga muuwa, Bigtan naTeresh, yaali yomaalangeli yopomiyelo dhoongulu dhomukwaniilwa, oya geele omukwaniilwa noyu uvanene, ye mu dhipage ofuthi.
Mordekai okwe shi koneke e ta yakele ko omunyekadhi Ester, ngoka a lombwele omukwaniilwa shoka Mordekai a dhimbulula.
Oshinima osha konakonwa nosha monika mo kutya oshoshili, onkee aalumentu ayehe yaali oya tulwa kohake. Omukwaniilwa okwa nyolitha oshiningwanima shika mondjokonona yoshilongo.
3: Konima yaambika omukwaniilwa Kserkses okwa lenge omulumentu, edhina lye Haman, a ninge elenga ekuluntu lyomalenga agehe. Haman oyaHammedata gwomoluvalo lwaAgag.
Omukwaniilwa okwa gandja eutho, omalenga ge agehe ga simaneke Haman nokutsa oongolo noku mu inyongamena. Oge shi ningi, kakele kaMordekai, ngoka a tindi.
Omalenga galwe gomukwaniilwa oge mu pula kutya omolwashike itaa vulika keutho lyomukwaniilwa.
Esiku nesiku oge mu kumagidha, ihe ine ga pulakena. Okwa ti, ite shi ningi, oshoka oye Omujuda. Nena omalenga oge shi tseyithile Haman, opo ga mone, ngele etompelo lyaMordekai tali ziminwa.
Haman okwa li a thita po kondjahi, sho a dhimbulula kutya Mordekai iha tsu oongolo noku mu inyongamena.
Sho a koneke wo kutya nani Mordekai Omujuda, Haman okwa tokola okuninga sha oshinene shi vule okugeela Mordekai awike. Okwa dhiladhila a dhipage Omujuda kehe moshilongo shaPersia.

Momumvo omutimulongo nomutiyali gwepangelo lyomukwaniilwa Kserkses, momwedhi gwotango, omwedhi Nisan, Haman okwa umbitha iihogololitho (oya li hayi ithanwa “purim”), opo ku monike esiku nomwedhi gwo opala okugwanitha ompangela ye. Oshihogololitho osha kwata esiku etimulongo netitatu lyomwedhi omutimulongo nomutiyali, omwedhi Adar.

Haman okwa lombwele omukwaniilwa Kserkses ta ti: “Moshilongo shoye omu na oshigwana shimwe shi iyoolola, sha halakanena miitopolwa ayihe. Ohaa dhiginine omikalo inaadhi faathana naandhoka dhi niwe kiigwana yilwe, yo ihaa vulika koompango dhoshilongo. Itashi opalele omukwaniilwa oku ya idhidhimikila.
Nkeyama, ngele osho opala, gandja eutho, ya dhipagwe. Ngele oto shi ningi, otandi ka gandja oshisiliveli ookilograma 340 000 moompungulilo dhuuwa mokuyakula oshilongo ashihe.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa hukula ko okalinga ke koshihako e te ka pe Haman yaHammedata gwomoluvalo lwaAgag, omutondi gwAajuda.
Omukwaniilwa okwe mu lombwele ta ti: “Aantu mboka niimaliwa yawo oyoye, ya ninga ngaashi wa hala.”

Mesiku etimulongo netitatu lyomwedhi gwotango Haman okwa hiya oohamushanga yomukwaniilwa e te ya nyolitha eutho momalaka agehe moondanda dhago, li tuminwe oongoloneya, ookomufala naaleli ayehe miitopolwa ayihe yoshilongo. Eutho ndika olya gandjwa medhina lyomukwaniilwa Kserkses nolya hakwa nokalinga ke.

Aatondoki oya fala eutho ndika koshitopolwa kehe shomoshilongo ashihe. Elaka otali ti kutya mesiku etimulongo netitatu lyomwedhi Adar Aajuda ayehe — aagundjuka naakuluntu, aakulukadhi nuunona — oye na okudhipagwa. Oye na okutsuwa pwaa na henda, nomaliko gawo oge na okuyugwa po.
Enyolululo lyeutho ndika oli na okuninga ompango moshitopolwa kehe noyi na okutseyithilwa iigwana ayihe, opo ayehe ya kale yi ilongekidhila esiku ndyoka.

Palombwelo lyomukwaniilwa eutho olya hololwa puuyelele moshilandolelo Susa, naatondoki oya yi koondjila nokweendelela. Omukwaniilwa naHaman oya kuutumba yo taa nu, ihe moshilandolelo Susa omwa li ekuyunguto enene.
4: Mordekai sho a koneke shoka sha ningwa po, okwa tuula oonguwo dhe moluhodhi. Okwa zala ehahi, i igundu omutoko momutse e te endagula noshilando ta kugu mokule a lulilwa,
sigo ta thiki peelo lyuuwa. Ina ya mo muuwa, oshoka ihamu yio muntu a zala ehahi.
Kiitopolwa ayihe, nkoka eutho lyomukwaniilwa lya tseyithwa, okwa li elilagano enene mokati kAajuda. Oyi idhilike iikulya, ya lili nokukuga; oyendji oya zala omahahi e taa lala momutoko.
Aadhike yaEster naathonwantu oye mu hokololele shoka tashi ningwa kuMordekai. Ester okwa si oluhodhi olunene. Okwa tumine Mordekai oonguwo, e dhi zale peha lyehahi, ihe ine dhi taamba.
Nena Ester okwi ithana Hatak, gumwe gwomaathonwantu yomuuwa, ngoka a tulwa po komukwaniilwa a kale omupiya gwe, e te mu lombwele, a ye kuMordekai a uve shoka sha ningwa po nomolwashike.
Hatak okwa yi kuMordekai mehalandjandja lyoshilando peelo lyuuwa.
Mordekai okwe mu hokololele ashihe shoka she mu ningilwa. Okwe mu tseyithile wo ondjundo yoshisiliveli Haman e yi uvaneka, yi tulwe moompungulilo dhuuwa, ngele Aajuda ayehe oya dhipagwa po.

Okwa pe Hatak ombapila yenyolululo lyeutho ndyoka lya gandjwa muSusa lyokudhipaga Aajuda, opo e yi fale kuEster noku mu tseyithila oshinima ashihe. Ester ne ki ikumbe omukwaniilwa noku mu indila, opo a sile ohenda oshigwana she Oshijuda.
Hatak okwe shi ningi,
naEster okwe mu pe elaka, e li fale kuMordekai, tali ti:

“Shaa ngoka, omulumentu nenge omukiintu, ta yi kehale lyomeni a mone omukwaniilwa ye ini ithanwa, oku na okusa. Ndjika ompango; omalenga gomukwaniilwa agehe naantu ayehe miitopolwa yoshilongo she oye yi tseya. Ope na ompito yimwe ayike okukala nomwenyo. Omuntu ngoka omukwaniilwa te mu ganeke nondhimbo ye yuukwaniilwa yoshingoli, ita dhipagwa. Ihe opwa piti omwedhi omukwaniilwa ini ithana ndje, ndi ye kuye.”
Mordekai sho u uvu oohapu dhaEster,
okwe mu tumine eyamukulo tali ti: “Ino ifundjaleka kutya ou li megameno u vule Aajuda yalwe, sho u li muuwa womukwaniilwa.
Ngele to mwenene ompito ndjika, ekwatho otali zile Aajuda palwe e taa ka hupithwa, ihe ngoye nezimo lyaho otamu ka yonuka po. Olye e shi tseya kutya ino ninga omunyekadhi omolwompito ndjika?”
Ester okwa tumine Mordekai eyamukulo tali ti:

“Inda, u ka gongele Aajuda ayehe muSusa; idhilikeni iikulya ne mu galikanene ndje. Inamu lya ne inamu nwa sha omasiku gatatu, uusiku nomutenya. Nangame osho te ningi pamwe naadhike yandje. Konima yaambika otandi ka ya komukwaniilwa, nando nashi kale sha pingathana nompango. Ngele ote si, nandi se.”
Mordekai okwa yi e ta ningi, ngaashi Ester e mu lombwele.
5: Mesiku etitatu lyeidhiliko lyiikulya Ester okwa zala oonguwo dhe dhuunyekadhi e ta yi e ta thikama mehalandjandja lyomeni lyuuwa a taalela oshinyanga shoshipangelapundi. Omukwaniilwa okwa li meni a kuutumba koshipangelapundi shuukwaniilwa a taalela kosheelo.
Omukwaniilwa sho a mono Ester a thikama pondje, okwe mu sile ohenda e te mu ganeke nondhimbo ye yoshingoli. Ester okwa hedha ko e ta gumu ondhimbo komutse gwayo.
Omukwaniilwa okwa pula a ti: “Munyekadhi Ester, oshike ano? Lombwela ndje shoka wa hala, notandi shi ku pe — nashi kale nando etata lyoshilongo shandje ashihe.”
Ester okwa yamukula a ti: “Nkeyama, ngele otashi ku opalele, onda hala ne naHaman mu ye ongulohi komatelekela nde ge mu longekidhila.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa ti: “Ka taleni Haman mbala, tu ninge ngaashi Ester a hala.” Omukwaniilwa naHaman oya yi komatelekela gaEster.
Manga taa nu omaviinu, omukwaniilwa okwa ti kuEster: “Lombwela ndje shoka wa hala, ongame notandi shi ku pe. Otandi ka gwanitha eindilo lyoye, nando li pule ndje etata lyoshilongo shandje.”
Ester okwa yamukula ta ti:
“Ngele oshe ku opalela, Nkeyama, u uve eindilo lyandje, onda hala, ne naHaman mu ye ishewe ongula komatelekela gandje tandi ge mu longekidhile. Pethimbo ndyoka otandi ke ku lombwela shoka nda hala.”
Haman okwa zi mo momatelekela a nyanyukwa nokwa panda nawa. Ihe sho a mono Mordekai peelo lyuuwa, ye Mordekai ina thikama nenge e mu hololele esimaneko lyasha, Haman okwe mu geele noonkondo.
Ihe okwi idhidhimike e ta yi kegumbo. Opo ihe okwa hiya ookuume ke e ta pula omukadhi Seresh e ye kuyo.
Okwe ya inomene omoluuyamba we wa pitilila, oyanamati oyendji, nonkene omukwaniilwa e mu lenge elenga enene e vule omalenga agehe galwe gomukwaniilwa.
Okwa tsikile ko a ti: “Nokuli omunyekadhi Ester ina telekela yalwe omatelekela kakele komukwaniilwa nangame tuu nguka. Otwa hiywa, tu ye ko ishewe ongula.
Ihe ayihe mbika itayi gwanene ndje, manga ndi wete Omujuda nguka Mordekai a kuutumba peelo lyuuwa.”

Omukadhi Seresh nookuume ke oye mu lombwele ya ti: “Omolwashike itoo dhikitha ohake yi na omutumbo gwoondya omilongo ntano? Ngula ongula oto vulu okupula omukwaniilwa, Mordekai a tulwe ko. Opo to vulu okuya komatelekela u na enyanyu.” Oohapu ndhoka odho opalele Haman, nokwa dhikitha ohake.
6: Uusiku tuu mboka omukwaniilwa okwa londokwa koomposi, nokwa gandja elaka, ondjokonona yoshilongo yi etwe kuye, e yi leshelwe.
Moshitopolwa sha leshwa omwa li wo ehokololo, nkene Mordekai a holola Bigtan naTeresh, aathonwantu yaali aalangeli yoposheelo, mboka ya li ya tsile omukwaniilwa ondumbo, ye mu dhipage ofuthi.

Omukwaniilwa okwa pula a ti: “Mordekai okwa simanekwa nokwa futwa ngiini, sho a ningi ngeyi?”
Aapiya oya yamukula ya ti: “Ina pewa nando osha.”

Omukwaniilwa okwa pula a ti: “Olye e li kehale?”
Haman okwa li opo a thiki kehale lyopondje, opo a indile omukwaniilwa, a endjeleleke Mordekai kohake ya dhikwa nale nokuli.

Aapiya oya yamukula: “Haman oko e li.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa ti: “Ne ye mo.”

Haman sho e ya mo, omukwaniilwa okwe mu pula: “Omuntu ngoka omukwaniilwa a hala oku mu simaneka unene, oku na okuningwa ngiini?”
Haman okwi idhiladhilile: “Olye mbela omukwaniilwa a hala oku mu simaneka? Ndishi ongame.”

Haman okwa yamukula omukwaniilwa ta ti: “Omulumentu ngoka omukwaniilwa a hala oku mu simaneka, na etelwe oonguwo dhuukwaniilwa, ndhoka wa li wa zala ngoye mwene. Na etelwe wo okakambe haka kayilwa komukwaniilwa noka zalekwa uulenga wopaukwaniilwa komutse.”

Nena lombwela elenga limwe lya simana, li zaleke omulumentu ngoka oonguwo ndhoka noku mu enditha nehalandjandja lyoshilando a londa kokakambe. Elenga lya simana nali igidhe li tye: “Omulumentu ngoka ta simanekwa komukwaniilwa, osho ta ningwa ngeyi.”

Nena omukwaniilwa okwa ti kuHaman: “Endelela, u ka kuthe oonguwo nokakambe, ngaashi wa ti. Esimaneko ndika nali ningilwe Mordekai Omujuda, ngoka a kuutumba peelo lyuuwa. Mu ningila naanaa ashihe shoka wa popi.”

Haman okwa kutha oonguwo nokakambe e ta zaleke Mordekai. Mordekai okwa kayile okakambe, naHaman okwe mu enditha nehalandjandja lyoshilando ti igidha, sho taa ende ta ti: “Omulumentu ngoka ta simanekwa komukwaniilwa, osho ta ningwa ngeyi!”
Mordekai okwa shuna keelo lyuuwa, manga Haman ta yi kegumbo nokweendelela a siikila oshipala she a tyololoka.

Okwa lombwele omukadhi nookuume ke ashihe shoka she mu ningilwa. Nena omukadhi nookuume ke aanandunge oya ti kuye: “Eyonuko lyoye olya tameke montaneho yaMordekai. Oye Omujuda, nangoye ito vulu oku mu sinda. Ote ke ku sinda lela.”
Manga ya li taa kundathana, aathonwantu yomukwaniilwa oye ya noya fala Haman neendelelo komatelekela.
7: Osho ngaaka omukwaniilwa naHaman ya yi, ya ka lye naEster

olutiyali. Manga taa nu omaviinu, omukwaniilwa okwa pula Ester a ti: “Munyekadhi Ester, owa hala shike? Lombwela ndje, ongame notandi shi ku pe. Otandi gwanitha eindilo lyoye, nando li pule ndje etata lyoshilongo shandje.”
Omunyekadhi Ester okwa yamukula a ti: “Nkeyama, ngele otashi ku opalele, otandi ku indile neifupipiko, u zimine, ndi kale nomwenyo, noshigwana shandje shi kale nomwenyo.
Tse noshigwana shetu otwa landithilwa po okuhanagulwa po, okudhipagwa nokukombwa po. Ando twa landithwa po ashike aapika, ando nde shi mwenene, oshoka kashi shi sha shokukudhila omukwaniilwa.”
Omukwaniilwa Kserkses okwa pula omunyekadhi Ester: “Olye ano ta ningi iihuna mbika? Omuntu ngoka oku li peni?”

Ester okwa yamukula a ti: “Omutondi gwetu, omuhepeki gwetu, ye oye oshiponga shetu, oHaman!”
Haman okwa tongolola omukwaniilwa nomunyekadhi Ester a kankwa.

Omukwaniilwa okwa yambuka po a thita po kondjahi. Okwa zi mo moshinyanga e ta yi pondje koshikunino shuuwa shokuvululukilwa. Haman okwa mono kutya omukwaniilwa okwa tokola oku mu geela, onkee a kala po ta galikana Ester omolwomwenyo gwe.

Okwa adhika opo ti iyumbile komeho goshipundi shaEster ti indile ombili, omukwaniilwa sho a galukile moshinyanga okuza koshikunino. Omukwaniilwa sho e shi mono, okwi igidha a ti: “Omuntu nguka ota thiminike omunyekadhi nokuli montaneho yandje, muuwa wandje mwene?”
Omukwaniilwa manga inaa mana okupopya ndhika, yo aapiya ye aathonwantu oya siikila nale Haman koshipala.

Gumwe gwomuyo, edhina lye Harbona, okwa ti: “Nkeyama, pongulu yaHaman ope na ohake yi na omutumbo gwoondya omilongo ntano e yi dhikile Mordekai, ngoka a hupitha omwenyo gwoye.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa ti: “Tulii ko Haman.”
Osho ngaaka Haman a tulwa kohake ndjoka a li e yi dhikile Mordekai. Nena ondjahi yomukwaniilwa oya polo.
8: Esiku tuu ndyoka omukwaniilwa Kserkses okwa pe omunyekadhi Ester omaliko agehe gaHaman, omutondi gwAajuda. Ester okwa lombwele omukwaniilwa kutya Mordekai omukwawo, nokuza mpoka Mordekai okwa pitikilwa okukala koshipala shomukwaniilwa.
Omukwaniilwa okwa hukula ko okalinga ke koshihako (hoka a kuthululile Haman) e te ka pe Mordekai. Ester okwa langeke Mordekai metonatelo lyomaliko gaHaman.
Ester okwa popitha ishewe omukwaniilwa, i inyongamena koompadhi dhe e ta lili. Okwe mu indile, a ninge po sha, opo a keelele ondumbo yaHaman, oluvalo lwaAgag, yaa tsile kAajuda.
Omukwaniilwa okwe mu ganeke nondhimbo yuukwaniilwa yoshingoli, Ester nokwa thikama po e ta ti:

“Nkeyama, ngele tashi ku opalele nou na ohenda nangame nongele oshu uka kungoye, gandja eutho tali ningulula oshipango shaHaman yaHammedata, oluvalo lwaAgag, shokuhanagula po Aajuda miitopolwa ayihe yoshilongo.
Otandi vulu ngiini oku shi idhidhimikila, ngele oshiponga tashi adha oshigwana shetu, nezimo lyandje mwene tali dhipagwa po?”
Nena omukwaniilwa Kserkses okwa ti komunyekadhi Ester naMordekai, Omujuda: “Talii ko, onda tulitha Haman kohake omolwondumbo ndjika yokukondjitha Aajuda nonda pe Ester omaliko ge.
Eutho lya gandjwa medhina lyomukwaniilwa nolya sitombwa noshihako she, kali shi kuningululwa. Ihe medhina lyandje otamu vulu okunyola eutho epe tali popi Aajuda e tamu li sitomba noshihako shandje.”

Mesiku etimulongo netitatu lyomwedhi omutitatu, omwedhi Sivan, Mordekai okwa hiya oohamushanga yomukwaniilwa e te ya nyolitha eutho li tuminwe oongoloneya, ookomufala naaleli yomiitopolwa ayihe 127 okuza kuIndia sigo kuEtiopia. Eutho olya li lya nyolwa momalaka agehe gomiitopolwa moondanda dhago nokAajuda melaka lyawo nomoondanda dhalyo.
Mordekai okwa nyolitha oontumwafo medhina lyomukwaniilwa Kserkses e te dhi sitomba noshihako shuuwa. Odha tumwa naakayili ya londa uukambe womiigunda yuuwa u na ondapo.

Eutho ndika otali zimine Aajuda yi ilongekidhile okwiipopila. Ngele otaa matukilwa kaakwiita yomoshitopolwa shontumba, otaa vulu okukondja e taye ya hanagula po noku ya dhipaga pamwe naakiintu yawo noyana. Otaa vulu oku ya komba po nokuyuga po omaliko gawo.
Esiku uuna Aajuda taa vulu okuninga shika miitopolwa ayihe yoshilongo shaKserkses, olyo etimulongo netitatu lyomwedhi omutimulongo nomutiyali, omwedhi Adar.
Enyolululo lyeutho ndika oli na okuninga ompango moshitopolwa kehe noyi na okutseyithilwa iigwana ayihe, opo Aajuda ya kale yi ilongekidhila okugalulila aatondi yawo ondjahi, uuna esiku lya thiki.
Palombwelo lyomukwaniilwa eutho olya holokithwa moshilandolelo Susa, naakayili ya londa uukambe womiigunda yuuwa, oya yi koondjila nokweendelela.

Mordekai okwa zi muuwa a zala oonguwo dhuukwaniilwa oombulau noontokele, elwaakani lyoliina etiliganembwilili noshishani oshinene shoshingoli. Nomomapandaanda gaSusa omwa li tamu kwelengendja omawi genyanyu noondigolo.
Aajuda oya li ya nyanyukwa noya pepelelwa, oya adhika kelago nesimaneko.

Moshilando kehe nomoshikandjo kehe moka eutho lyomukwaniilwa lya leshwa, Aajuda oyi igidha esiku lyongondji, oshituthi nenyanyu. Aantu oyendji yomiigwana yilwe oyi iningi Aajuda, oshoka oya li ye ya tila.
9: Esiku etimulongo netitatu lyaAdar olye ya, esiku ndyoka eutho lyomukwaniilwa lya li li na okugwanithwa, esiku uuna aatondi yAajuda ya li ya tegelela, ye ya tule mokakuwilili. Ihe nani Aajuda oye ya sindi.

Moshikandjo shAajuda moshilando kehe moshilongo ashihe Aajuda oyi ilongekidha nawa okuhomona kehe ngoka ta kambadhala oku ya etela oshiponga. Aantu oya li ye ya tila akuhe, nokakwa li ngoka a vulu oku ya kondjitha.
Aaleli ayehe yomiitopolwa, oongoloneya, ookomufala naakwanepangelo yomukwaniilwa oya gama kAajuda, oshoka oya li ya tila Mordekai.
Osha li sha tseyika noshilongo ashihe kutya ngashingeyi Mordekai elenga ekuluntu muuwa nokwa li ta nkondopala natango.
Omolwashoka Aajuda ya ningile aatondi yawo shoka ya hala. Oye ya ponokele nomagongamwele e taye ya dhipaga.
Moshilandolelo Susa Aajuda oya dhipagele mo aantu omathele gatano.

Mokati kawo omwa li aana aamati omulongo yaHaman yaHammedata, omutondi gwAajuda. Oyo Parshandata, Dalfon, Aspata, Porata, Adalia, Aridata, Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai naVaiesata. Ihe Aajuda inaa yuga iihakanwa.
Esiku tuu ndyoka omwaalu gwaadhipagwa yomuSusa ogwa tseyithilwa omukwaniilwa.

Okwa ti komunyekadhi Ester: “MuSusa amuke Aajuda oya dhipaga aantu omathele gatano, mumwe naana aamati yaHaman. Ngele omiitopolwa yilwe nduno, oya ningi ngiini! Ngashingeyi owa hala shike? Otandi ke shi ku pa. Lombwela ndje owala shoka wa hala natango, neindilo lyoye otali gwanithwa.”
Ester okwa yamukula a ti: “Nkeyama, ngele otashi ku opalele, ongula pitika natango, Aajuda ya ninge muSusa shoka ya ningi nena. Omidhimba dhaana aamati yaHaman nadhi tulwe kohake.”
Omukwaniilwa okwa tokola shi ningwe, neutho ndika olya gandjwa muSusa. Omidhimba dhaana aamati omulongo yaHaman odha tsilikwa puuyelele.
Mesiku etimulongo netine lyaAdar Aajuda yomuSusa oya dhipaga ishewe aantu omathele gatatu moshilando. Natango inaa hakana iihakanwa nande.
Aajuda yomiitopolwa oya li ya gongala okwiipopila. Oya manguluka kaatondi yawo, sho ya dhipaga aantu omayuvi omilongo heyali nagatano mboka ya li ye ya tonde. Ihe inaa hakana iihakanwa.
Esiku ndika etimulongo netitatu lyaAdar. Mesiku etimulongo netine inaku dhipagwa we omuntu, nolya ningi esiku lyoshituthi nolyenyanyu.
Aajuda yomuSusa oya yapula esiku etimulongo netitano, li ninge esiku lyoshituthi nolyenyanyu, oshoka oya dhipagele aatondi yawo mesiku etimulongo netitatu mesiku etimulongo netine.
Omolwashoka ano Aajuda mboka ya kala momikunda omishona, oya ningi esiku etimulongo netine lyomwedhi Adar esiku lyenyanyu nolyoshituthi notaa tuminathana iikunditha.
Mordekai okwa nyolitha ondjokonona yiinima mbika e ta tumine Aajuda ayehe moshilongo shaPersia, ongele popepi nenge kokule, oontumwafo
tadhi ya lombwele, ya dhane oshituthi kehe omumvo mesiku etimulongo netine netimulongo netitano lyaAdar.

Momasiku ngaka Aajuda oyi imangulula kaatondi yawo, nomomwedhi nguka oluhodhi lwawo olwa shituka enyanyu nokutakuma kwawo eligolo. Oya lombwelwa, ya dhane momasiku ngaka iituthi noonshingo nokutuminathana iikunditha yiikulya nokupa oohepele omagano.
Okudhana oshituthi shika okwa ningi omukalondjigilile, ngaashi Mordekai e ya nyolele.

Haman yaHammedata, oluvalo lwaAgag nomutondi gwAajuda, okwa li u umbu iihogololitho (nenge “purim”, ngaashi ye shi luka), opo a uthe esiku lyokuyonagula po Aajuda; okwa dhiladhila e ya kombe po sheke.
Ihe Ester okwa yi komukwaniilwa, nomukwaniilwa okwa gandja eutho lyopakunyola, ndyoka lya galulile Haman omupya ngoka e gu dhiladhilile Aajuda. Oye pamwe noyana oya tulwa kohake.
Omolwashoka omasiku ngaka oga lukwa Purim. Molwontumwafo yaMordekai nomolwiinima ayihe mbyoka ye yi ningilwa,
Aajuda oyi iyuthile omukalo gwokwaalunduluka kutya yo yene noluvalo lwawo naayehe mboka taa iningi Aajuda, oye na okudhana omasiku ngaka gaali kehe omumvo palombwelo lyaMordekai pethimbo lyo opala.
Omasiku ngaka oga li ge na okudhimbulukiwa pwaa na elunduluko nokudhanwa kepipi kehe lyAajuda megumbo kehe moshitopolwa kehe nomoshilando kehe.
Omunyekadhi Ester yaAbihail pamwe naMordekai oya nyola ontumwafo ontiyali kombinga yaPurim nokulongitha oonkondo dhawo, opo ye yi koleke.
Mordekai okwa tumine Aajuda ayehe yomiitopolwa 127 yoshilongo shaPersia oontumwafo noku ya halela ombili negameno.

Okwa koleke kutya Aajuda ayehe noluvalo lwawo oye na okudhana omasiku gaPurim pethimbo lyo opala, ngaashi omunyekadhi Ester naMordekai, Omujuda, ye shi utha nongaashi Aajuda yo yene ya li yu utha kombinga yeidhiliko lyiikulya noontakumo.
Elombwelo lyaEster olya koleke omautho gaPurim noga nyolelwa membo.
10: Omukwaniilwa Kserkses okwa utha iilonga yethiminiko moshilongo ashihe okuza komunkulofuta nookoontuntu sigo omokati koshilongo.
Iinima ayihe iinene niikumithi mbyoka e yi ningi, nehokololo alihe nkene a lenge Mordekai elenga enene, ayihe oya nyolelwa membo lyondjokonona yaakwaniilwa yaPersia naMedia.

Omujuda Mordekai okwa li omutiyali moshilongo a landula omukwaniilwa mwene Kserkses. Okwa li a simana noku holike kAajuda ooyakwawo, oshoka okwa longele oshigwana shawo uuwanawa nokwa popile elago lyoluvalo lwawo.

1: Okwa li ku na omulumentu, edhina lye Job, a kala moshilongo Uz. Okwa li omukeenashipo nomuyuuki. Okwa li ha tila Kalunga noha tondo uuwinayi.
Okwa li e na oyana aamati yaheyali naakadhona yatatu.
Okwa li e na oonzi omayuvi gaheyali, oongamelo omayuvi gatatu, oongombe eyuvi limwe nuusino omathele gatano. Okwa li wo e na aapiya oyendjiyendji, nokwa li omuyamba e vule aayuzilo ayehe.
Oyana aamati oya li haa ningi iituthi pamalufo momagumbo gawo. Oya li wo haa hiya aamwayina aakadhona kiituthi mbika.

Oshituthi ngele sha pu, mesiku kehe lya landula Job oha meneka e ta yamba omolwomwana kehe ontselelandjambo, opo a kale a yogoka. Okwe shi ningi olwindji, oshoka okwa dhiladhila kutya pamwe oyana oya yono noya sheke Kalunga momadhiladhilo gawo.
Esiku limwe aayengeli yaKalunga oya holoka koshipala shOmuwa, naSatana okwa li mokati kawo.

Omuwa okwa pula Satana: “Oto ziilile peni?”
Satana okwa yamukula Omuwa: “Onde endagula mpaka naampeyaka nonda taakana evi.”
Omuwa okwe mu pula a ti: “Ino mona omuntu gwandje Job? Kombanda yevi kaku na omuntu e shi okwiinekelwa e mu fa, omulumentu ha tila Kalunga noha tondo uuwinayi.”
Satana okwa yamukula a ti: “U shi Job oha tila Kalunga owala?
Oshoka owala ho mu gamene pamwe negumbo lye naashihe shoka e shi na. Owa yambeke iilonga ye nowe mu pe iimuna yi indjipala moshilongo ashihe.
Ando u yelekele e to ganeke oshikaha shoye, u yone po eliko lye, nena ote ku iteka po mbala.”
Omuwa okwa ti kuSatana: “Eewa, ayihe e yi na, otandi yi tula miikaha yoye, ihe ino mu guma kolutu.” Satana nokwa zi po.
Esiku limwe manga aana yaJob ya li moshituthi megumbo lyomumwayinamati osheeli,
omutumwa okwe ya kuJob ta matuka e ta ti: “Otwa li tatu pupula omapya noonani, uusino nowa li tau napa popepi.
Ohaluka Aasaba oya matukile iimuna e taye yi yaka po. Oya dhipaga po aapiya yoye ayehe. Ongame awike nda hupu po nonde ya ndi shi ku lombwele.”
Manga inaa mana okupopya, omupiya omukwawo okwe ya po e ta ti: “Olwaadhi olwa akula po oonzi naasita e talu ya dhipaga po ayehe. Ongame awike nda hupu po nonde ya ndi shi ku lombwele.”

Manga inaa mana okupopya, omupiya omukwawo okwe ya e ta ti: “Aahomoni Aababilonia ye li iiluku itatu, oye tu ponokele e taa yugu po oongamelo noya dhipaga po aapiya yoye ayehe. Ongame awike nda hupu po nonde ya ndi shi ku lombwele.”
Manga inaa mana okupopya, omupiya omukwawo okwe ya po e ta ti: “Aamwoye oya li moshituthi megumbo lyosheeli shoye.
Ombepo yoshikungulu oya zi kombuga noya hanagula po egumbo lyasho noya dhipaga po ayehe. Ongame awike nda hupu po nonde ya ndi shi ku lombwele.”
Job okwa yambuka po e ta tuula oonguwo dhe molwoluhodhi. Okwa kulula omutse gwe nokwa tsu oshipala she pevi e ta galikana
ta ti: “Olutu lwowala nda zile mela lyameme notandi ka ya ndi li olutu lwowala. Omuwa okwe yi pele ndje, Omuwa okwe yi kutha ndje. Edhina lye nali simanekwe.”
Mumbika ayihe ya ningwa po, Job ina yona a pe ando Kalunga ombedhi.
2: Opwa ningi ishewe, aayengeli yaKalunga sho ya holoka koshipala shOmuwa, Satana okwa li wo mokati kawo.

Omuwa okwe mu pula a ti: “Oto zi peni?”
Satana okwa yamukula a ti: “Onde ende mpaka naampeyaka nonda taakana evi alihe.”

Omuwa okwa pula a ti: “Ino mona omuntu gwandje Job? Kombanda yevi kaku na omuntu e mu fa. Oye omuyuuki kee na oshipo, omulumentu ha tila Kalunga noha tondo uuwinayi. Ngoye owa lombwele ndje, ndi mu dhenge pwaa na etompelo, ihe Job okwa dhiginine eitaalo lye.”
Satana okwa yamukula a ti: “Omuntu ota gandja po iinima ye ayihe, opo a kale e na omwenyo.
Ihe ngele to gumu olutu lwe, nena ote ku sheke montaneho!”
Omuwa okwa ti kuSatana: “Eewa, ngashingeyi otandi mu gandja miikaha yoye, mu dhenga kolutu, ihe omwenyo gwe ino gu guma.”
Satana okwa zi ko koshipala shOmuwa nokwa umbu Job iitumbuka molutu aluhe.
Job okwa kuutumba momutoko nokwa kutha oshikangwa e ta yaga nasho iitumbuka ye.
Omukadhi okwa ti kuye: “Natango owa hala ngaa okukala omuyuuki? Sheka Kalunga, u se.”

Job okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Oto popi wa fa omukiintu omugoya. Ndishi Kalunga ngele te tu pe uuwanawa, otatu u taamba. Otatu mu pe tuu uusama, ngele te tu pe uudhigu?” Mwaayihe mbika Job ina yona sha, a tamaneke Kalunga.
Ookuume kaJob yatatu oyo Elifas gwomoshilando Teman, Bildad Omushuak naSofar Omunaema. Ano sho yu uvu kutya Job ota alukwa, oya tokola ye ke mu talele po noku mu hekeleka.
Manga ya li kokule, oya mono Job, ihe inaye mu dhimbulula. Sho ye ya popepi naye, oya tameke okulila mokule e taa tuula oonguwo dhawo molwoluhodhi yo taa igundu evi momitse.
Opo ihe oye mu kuutumbile omasiku gaheyali, uusiku nomutenya, yo itaa popi nando osha, oshoka oya mono kutya Job oku li muudhigu uunene.
3: Hugunina Job okwa popi e ta thingi esiku lyokuvalwa kwe.

Esiku nda valwa nali thingwe,
nuusiku mbwiyaka kwa tiwa: “Okamati ke ya ko!”

Muusiku mbwiyaka inamu valwa sha,
muwo inamu uvika ondigolo.

Mboka haa thingi omasiku, naye shi ninge,
oyo tuu mboka yi ilongekidha okupendutha Leviatan.

Oshoka inau edhilila ndje po osheelo shoshivalelo shameme,
u siikile omeho gandje gaa tale iihuna.

Omolwashike inaandi nyangwa pokuvalwa,
ndi se sho ndi li pokupulumuthwa?

Omolwashike oongolo dhameme dha yakula ndje,
nomagundji ge ga yamutha ndje?
Ando ngashingeyi onda vululukwa nonda thuwa,

opamwe naakwaniilwa naapangeli yevi, mboka yi itungile oombala,
ihe ngashingeyi omakulukuma gowala.

Onda li ndi na okukala nda fa omalenga,
ngoka gu udhitha omagumbo gago oshingoli noshisiliveli.

Nenge omolwashike inaandi holekwa mevi nda fa omupononwa,
ongaashi okahanona inaaka mona uuyelele wetango?

Mombila aakaanakalunga otaa hulitha po okuyona kwawo,
omo moka aaloloki taa vululukwa.

Aapika wo otaa kala mo ye na ombili;
itaa pulakene we omagandagulo.

Aanenentu naadhinwa oye thike pamwe,
nomupika okwa manguluka komuhona gwe.

Omolwashike mbo ye li muudhigu taa ethiwa ya kale nomwenyo?
Omolwashike aanaluhodhi taa pewa uuyelele?

Oya tegelela eso, ihe itali thiki;
otaye li kongo nuupenda lya fa eliko.
Itaa nyanyukwa, manga inaaya sa e taa fumvikwa.

Omuntu ngoka Kalunga e mu nine iiholekwa,
omolwashike e na okukala kombanda yevi e li mekondeka?

Peha lyokulya otandi lili;
omahodhi gandje otaga matuka ga fa omeya.

Shoka hashi tilitha nokuhalutha ndje,
osha ningilwa ndje.

Kandi na mbili, kandi na luthuwo;
kandi na vululuko, ihe epiyagano lyowala.
4: Nena Elifas Omuteman okwa yamukula ngeyi.

Job, ngele oku na gumwe a hala a popye nangoye,
oto vulwa ando?

Dhiladhila, nkene wa pukulula oyendji
nowa pameka omaako ga gwa.

Oohapu dhoye odha kumike aatenguuki;
owa kankameke mboka ya tonyala.

Ihe ngashingeyi sho wa adhika kuudhigu, owa tyololoka;
sho we ku gumu, owa haluka.

Okulongela Kalunga hakwo wi inekela?
Oondjila dhoye dhaa na oshipo,
nadhi kale etegameno lyoye.

Dhiladhila nawa,
olye a kala kee na mbudhi a adhika komupya?
Openi pwa li omuyuuki a yonwa po?

Onda koneke kutya mboka haa papula iimpungu yuudhudhu,
oyo wo mboka haa kunu uukolokoshi
notaye u teya wo.

Otaa ka pepwa po komufudho gwaKalunga,
nehwamo lyondjahi ye otali ya hanagula po.

Oonime oohahu ohadhi gono nohadhi pumbu kondjala,
ihe omayego goonime oongundjuka oga teywa mo.

Onime otayi si, ngele kayi na sho tayi li,
nuunimona otau halakana.

Elaka olya popitha ndje meholamo;
omakutsi gandje ogu uvu enongono.

Oondjodhi otadhi ende mokati kuusiku,
uuna oomposi tadhi kwata omuntu.

Uumbanda nekakamo olya kwata ndje,
nonda dhekweta okuza komutse sigo okoompadhi.

Ombepo oya dhenge ndje moshipala,
nolufufu kolutu lwandje olwa shindalala.

Oya mwena, ihe ine vula okukoneka kutya oshike shoka.
Ongoshihehelela shi li momeho gandje.
Ondu uvu ewi tali nongona tali ti:

“Nakukasa ota ningi tuu omuyuuki koshipala shaKalunga?
Nenge omuyelele momeho gomushiti gwe?

Kalunga ini inekela naapiya ye yomegulu,
nomaayengeli ye ota mono mo omapuko.

Ongiini ando mboka ya shitwa neloya,
oomboka yu umbwa montsi yevi,
mbo taa yonuka po mbala ya fa embilimbili?

Otaa tetagulilwa methimbo lyokuza ketendo lyeluwa
sigo okeningino lyetango.
Otaa yonuka po sigo aluhe
noitaa dhimbulukiwa we.

Uuyamba wawo auhe owa yiwa nawo;
otaa si yaa na oondunge.”
5:
Job, igidha!
Oku na tuu ngo te ku yamukula?
Oguni gwomaayapuki te ku yamukula?

Ongeyo otayi li egoya,
nefupa otali fala omuhasha meso.

Ngame mwene onda mono omugoya ta yugu,
ihe ohaluka egumbo lye olya thingwa.

Oyana oya kala kokule negameno;
moompangu otaa lyatelwa pevi pwaa na omupopili.

Aasindjala otaa li po iilya ye —
otaa teya nomombungwiidhi
aanotelwa otaa kwata po eliko lye.

Oshoka oshiponga ihashi hituka mohi,
nuudhigu ihau ndjituka mevi.

Omuntu oti iyetele uudhigu,
osho lela ngaashi oohandje hadhi tuka dhu uka pombanda.

Ihe ando ngame onda li ngoye,
ando otandi uka kuKalunga
notandi mu faalele uudhigu wandje.

Ota longo iinyengandunge itaayi vulu okuyelekwa,
iilongankondo itaayi vulu okuyalulwa.

Evi ote li lokithile omvula,
nomeya ote ga poolele momalundu.

Eeno, oye Kalunga ta yambula po aafupi
e ta nyanyudha mboka taa lili.

Ota pilaaleke oompangela dhaanandunge
nota hanagula po omakoto gaanongo, opo yaa tompole sha.

Omilema otadhi ke ya luudhila moshanga shomutenya,
notaa ka pampadhala ngaashi muusiku.

Kalunga ota hupitha oohepele meso,
ote ya hupitha miikaha yaanankondo.

Ohepele ote yi pe etegameno
nomukolokoshi ote mu mweneke.

Omunelago omuntu ngoka Kalunga te mu pukulula.
Ino dhina egeeloputudho lyOmunankondoawike.

Oshoka ota dhenge, ihe ota panga wo,
ote ehameke, ihe iikaha ye otayi aludha.

Ote ku hupitha miiponga ihamano,
nomoshitiheyali ito adhika kuupyakadhi.

Mondjala ote ku keelele meso,
nomiita ite ku etha u se.

Ote ku gamene komasheko;
ito pumbwa okutila, uuna ehanagulo tali ya.

Oto ka yola ehanagulo nuulumbu
noito ka tila iilikama.

Epya lyoye itali ka kala noowege,
niilikama itayi ke ku etela, nando oshiponga shasha.

Oto ka kala nombili metsali lyoye
niimuna yoye otayi ka kala ya gwana po inaapu kana sha.

Aamwoye otaa ka indjipala,
noluvalo lwoye otalu ka fa omwiidhi gwokelundu.

Oto ka ya mombila muukokele wa kola,
ngaashi iilya ya adha okuteywa.

Job, shika otwe shi konakona
notwa tseya kutya osho lela.
Shi taamba ano.
6:
Uudhigu nuuwehame wandje
ando u yelekwe koshiviha,

ando uudhigudhigu u vule ehekevi lyopooha dhefuta,
omolwasho oohapu dhandje inadhi dhiladhilwa nawa.

Ongolo ohayi lili tuu, ngele oyi li pomwiidhi,
nenge ondumetana ohayi komo, uuna yi li pelonzi?

Iikulya yomunya otayi liwa tuu, ngele inayi toywa,
nenge muutokele weyi omu na tuu omulyo gwasha?

Itandi vulu oku yi lya,
iikulya ya tya ngaaka otayi alukitha ndje.

Kalunga oshike itaa yamukula eindilo lyandje,
a pe ndje shoka nda hala?

Kalunga okwa hokwa okunyanyagula ndje,
okwa ganeke oshikaha she, a tete ndje.

Omukumo gwandje oguni, ndi kale ndi na etegameno?
Onakuyiwa yandje oyini, ndi kale ndi idhidhimika?

Ondi na oonkondo nda fa emanya?
Olutu lwandje oshiyela?

Itandi vulu we okwiikwatha ngame mwene;
kape na ngo ta hupitha ndje.

Omuntu e li muudhigu ota pumbwa ekwatho lyookuume,
nonando ne ethe Omunankondoawike.

Ihe ne, ookuume kandje, omwa fundju ndje,
omwa fa omilonga tadhi pwine, uuna kwaa na mvula,

uuna omeya gadho itaaga tondoka,
sho ga ningi iikangwa nolumi talu ga hekelitha.
Ihe uupyu ngele we ya, otadhi hengumuka.

Omasilu gomilonga otaga uka huka naahwiyaka
notaga londo pombanda, sigo ga hulu.

Oongamelo tadhi zi kuTema otadhi kongo omeya,
aahalithi Aasheba oye na etegameno,
ihe etegameno lyawo otali kanene momilonga dha pwina.

Ngame otii mu tala mwa fa omilonga ndhoka,
omu wete oshiponga shandje nomwa haluka.

Inandi mu pula, mu pe ndje sha,
ine indila nando osha shomeliko lyeni.

Inandi mu pula, mu hupithe ndje miikaha yomutondi
nenge yakayamukulwa.

Eewa ano, nongekii ndje,
mu lombwele ndje omapuko gandje.
Otandi ngungumana e tandi mu pulakene.

Oohapu dhi na uukwashili otadhi tompola sha.
Ihe ne oompata dheni otadhi kwatha shike?

Otamu dhiladhila okupopya kwandje ombepo yowala tayi pepe,
ihe omolwashike tamu yamukula omuntu a kanitha omukumo?

Otamu umbile oothigwa iihogololitho
notamu iyambapaleke neliko lyakuume keni.

Ngashingeyi talii ndje nawa.
Itandi mu fundju.

Omwa ya kokule unene. Etheni uugoyoki.
Inamu pangula ndje. Inandi puka.

Elaka lyandje oli na uukolokoshi?
Eiyuvo lyandje itali vulu ando okuulukila ndje epuko?
7:
Omuntu ita kala nani mekondjo, manga e li kombanda yevi?
Omasiku ge inaga fa ganakukutwa miilonga?

Ongaashi omupika a hala momuzile
nongomulongelindjambi ta tegelele ofuto ye.

Oomwedhi noomwedhi ine mona kutya ote kala ndi na omwenyo.
Omausiku otage etele ndje uuwehame.

Ngele tandi ka lala, otandi kala nokudhiladhila,
otandi ka penduka tuu?
Uusiku otau ningi uule, notandi igalula nda hala ku she.

Olutu lwandje otalu lika po komazinyo nokolwaga,
notandi tumbu omathina.

Omasiku gandje otaga tondoka ge vule okweenda kwonane mokuhondja.
Otaga hulu po pwaa na etegameno.

Kalunga, dhimbulukwa kutya okukalamwenyo kwandje okwa fa omufudho;
omasiku gandje gelago oga hula po.

Ou wete ndje ngashingeyi,
ihe ito ka mona ndje we.
Oto ka konga ndje, ihe ongohela nda li po.

Ngaashi oshikogo tashi halakana notashi yi,
osho naangoka ta kulukile muusi, ita galuka mo we.

Ita ka galukila we kaandjawo;
ota dhimbiwa kwaayehe mboka ya li ye mu shi.

Onkee ano itandi mwena!
Otandi popi muuwehame wandje
notandi yemata muululume womwenyo gwandje.

Kalunga, omolwashike wa langelitha ndje?
Oto tala kutya ngame efuta,
nenge oshilikama shamo?

Sho te dhiladhila,
ontala yandje otayi loolola ndje,
ombete yandje otayi yakula ndje uuwehame.

Oto halutha ndje noondjodhi
noto tilitha ndje nomamoniko.

Nandi hogolole po okupondwa e te si,
shi vule okukala iipongo yowala.

Omuntu omushike, sho ho mu ningi nawa
noho mu sile oshimpwiyu?

Oho mu konakona ongula kehe,
noto mu yeleke ethimbo kehe.

Uunake to etha okutongolola ndje,
ito etha nando, ndi fudhe po?

Ngele nani onda yona kungoye,
onda yona shike, ngoye omutonateli gwaantu?
Omolwashike wa ningi ndje omushekwa?
Onda ningi omutenge kungoye?

Ito dhimi po omayono gandje
e to theta po oondjo dhandje?
Oshoka ethimbo olya thika,
notandi ka lala mbala mombila;
oto ka konga ndje,
ihe kandi po we.
8: Bildad Omushuak okwa yamukula ngeyi.

Sigo uunake to popi oohapu dha tya ngaaka?
Oohapu dhoye odhi li mombepo yuuntsa.

Kalunga ota goyokitha tuu uuyuuki?
Omunankondoawike ita vulu okugoyokitha oshili.

Aamwoye sho ya yono kuKalunga,
okwe ya geelele eyono lyawo.

Konga Kalunga nomwenyo aguhe
e to galikana Omunankondoawike.

Ngele ngoye omuyelele nomuyuuki,
nena ota thikama e ku kwathe
note ku galulile aanegumbo yoye.

Etameko lyoye olya li eshona,
ihe onakuyiwa yoye otayi ka yambekwa.

Pula utale omapipi gonale,
noto ka tseya shoka oohekulu ya koneke.

Oshoka tse opo twa valwa ohela nokatu shi po sha;
omasiku getu kombanda yevi oga fa omuzizimba.

Itaye ku pukulula noku ku longa?
Itaye ku hololele shoka shi li moontulo dhawo?

Omanenge otaga mene tuu pokuma pwaa na edhiya?
Oombungu otadhi tsapuka mpoka pwaa na omeya?

Omanga dhi li mokukoka, inaadhi tetwa manga,
otadhi ganya mbala dhi vule omwiidhi.

Shika otashi yeleke mboka haa dhimbwa Kalunga,
osho wo etegameno lyaakaanakalunga tali kana,
uuna Kalunga a dhimbiwa.

Shoka yi inekela itashi kwatha sha;
shoka yi itula osha fa egumbo lyewiiwili.

Ngele oto egamene koondali dhewiiwili,
ito vulu okuthikama
noito vulu okwiikwatelela ko.

Aakaanakalunga oya fa oshimeno sha tsikwa pooha dhomeya
nohashi mono etango.
Otashi taandeleke omidhi dhasho akuhe.
Omidhi dhasho otadhi idhingile komamanya notadhi ikwatelele ko.

Ihe uuna tashi vudhwa mo,
nena kape na ngoka ta tseya mpo sha li.

Otashi kukuta mbala,
nopeha lyasho otapu mene shilwe.

Osha yela kutya Kalunga ite ekelehi omukeenashipo
nenge a kwathe omuyoni.

Ote ke ku nyanyudha,
noto ka yola.

Aatondi yoye ote ke ya sitha ohoni,
nomagumbo gaalunde otaga ka teka po.
9: Job okwa yamukula ngeyi:

Eeno, onda tseya kutya shika oshoshili.
Ihe nakukasa ota wapa ngiini okukala omuyuuki koshipala shaKalunga?

Kaku na omuntu ta vulu okuludhika naKalunga noku mu yamukula.
Ita vulu okuyamukula nando epulo lye limwe lyomomapulo eyuvi.

Oondundu ote dhi pungulula inaadhi shi tseya
nomokugeya kwe ote dhi hanagula po.

Ota tumu omakakamo gevi, notage li shikashika,
nota telaganitha oongudhi dhalyo.

Ota lombwele etango lyaa minikile we
nota luudhike oonyothi uusiku.

Oye a alele ko egulu
noye te ende kombanda yomakuthikuthi mefuta.
Oye a shiti Oshothi, Okalimbanombwa, Omanyuku nEkaladhidhi.

Oha longo iinyengandunge tayi nyenge oondunge dhetu,
niikumitha itaayi wapa okuyalulwa.

Kalunga ngele te ende pungame, itandi mu mono,
ngele ta piti po, itandi mu dhimbulula.

Kalunga ngele ta kutha sha,
olye ta vulu oku mu keelela?
Olye ta vulu oku mu pula: “Oto ningi shike?”

Kalunga ita shunitha ondjahi ye,
naakwathi yaRahab otaye mu tsile oongolo.

Otandi vulu ngiini okuludhika naKalunga?
Otandi adha peni iitya, tu tompathane naye?

Nando ondi kale omuyuuki,
itandi vulu oku mu yamukula.
Otandi vulu owala okwiindila omutokoli gwandje, a sile ndje ohenda.

Nando onde mu ithanene e ta yamukula ndje,
natango itandi itaale kutya otu uvu ndje.

Ota dhengitha ndje oshikungulu
noti indjipaleke iilalo yandje pwaa na etompelo.

Ite etha we ndi fudhe po;
okwa pe ndje uululume.

Ote vulu okuthiminika ngoka e na oonkondo e vule ndje?
Ote vulu oku mu fala koompangu?
Olye te mu fala ko?

Nando ondi kale omuyuuki,
okana kandje otaka pe ndje uusama.
Nando ondi kale omukeenashipo,
otaka tamaneke ndje.

Nonando kandi na uusama,
kashi shi oshinima shandje.
Onda vulwa okukala nomwenyo.

Ashihe osha faathana:
Kalunga ota dhipaga po omuyuuki nomulunde.

Ngele omuyuuki ta adhika keso lyombaadhilila,
Kalunga ote mu yolo, sho kee na omukumo.

Uuna uuyuni tau yi mepangelo lyaakaanakalunga,
aatokolihapu ayehe ote ya posipaleke.
Ngele Kalunga ine shi ninga, olye te shi ningi?

Omasiku gandje otage endelele ge vule omumatuki;
otaga tuka po gaa na nando enyanyu lyasha.

Otaga matuka ga fa oowato,
noga fa omakodhi taga fegula iihakanwa.

Ngele tandi ti kutya otandi ka dhimbwa omayemato gandje,
nena ote lundulula oshipala shandje e tandi imemeha.

Onda tilithwa kuuwehame,
oshoka ondi shi shi kutya Kalunga ita tala ndje omuyuuki.

Ngele ngame omunandjo,
omolwashike tandi ihepeke?

Kaku na othewa tayi yogo po oondjo dhandje,
nomutoko itagu yeleke iikaha yandje.

Kalunga otu umbile ndje moshilambo shontopo,
noonguwo dhandje otadhi si ndje ohoni.

Oshoka Kalunga ke shi muntu,
opo ndi vule oku mu yamukula
nondi tamanane naye moompangu.

Kape na nando omuntu gumwe
ta vulu okuninga omupanguli pokati ketu,
a tokole pokati kandje naKalunga.

Olye ta kutha ndje omadhengo gaKalunga,
opo gaa haluthe ndje we?

Nena ando otandi popi inaandi mu tila,
ihe ngashingeyi ite vulu sha.
10:
Onda kenyanana okukala nomwenyo.
Otandi holola omayemato gandje
notandi popi moluululume womwenyo gwandje.

Otandi lombwele Kalunga kaa pangule ndje,
ihe a lombwele ndje shoka nda yona.

Okuhepeka ndje okwe ku opalela tuu?
Osho opala tuu okunyema nokweekelahi iilonga yiikaha yoye, manga to pitika oompangela dhaakaanakalunga?
Oho tala iinima ngaashi omuntu te yi tala?

Omasiku goye oga fa gomuntu,
nenge omimvo dhoye odhi thike podhomuntu?
Omolwashike to kongo omapuko gandje noto konakona omayono gandje?

Ou shi shi kutya kandi na uusama,
nokaku na ngoka ta vulu okukutha ndje mo miikaha yoye.

Iikaha yoye oyo yu umbinga ndje nonda mewa,
ihe ngashingeyi oto hanagula ndje po.

Dhimbulukwa kutya owa shiti ndje meloya.
Owa hala u shune ndje montsi?

Owa tilehi ndje ngaashi omahini
nowa kukutike ndje ngaashi ehini.

Olutu lwandje owe lu tungitha omasipa noothipa
nowe lu zaleke oshipa noontumba.

Owa pe ndje omwenyo nowa li u hole ndje
e to sile ndje oshimpwiyu.

Shika owe shi kaleke momutima gwoye;
onda tseya kutya shika osha kala elalakano lyoye okudhenga ndje.

Ando onda yonene,
ando owa mono ndje,
noino etha ndi kale inaandi geelwa.

Ngele onda yono, yaye ngame!
Nonando kandi na uusama,
ite vulu okuyelutha omutse gwandje.
Onda sa ohoni nonda pwila muuwehame.

Sho te kambadhala okuyeluka,
oto hundjunine ndje ngaashi onkoshi
noto ulukile ndje oonkondo dhoye.

Omolwashike ano wa pititha ndje mo moshivalelo shameme?
Ando onda sile mo, manga kaaku na ngo a mona ndje!

Oshihwepo ando nda li inee holoka po;
ando onda sile moshivalelo shameme nokuukilila mombila.

Omasiku gandje kage shi omashona nani?
Etha ndje, ndi ikalele,
opo ndi nyanyukwe methimbo lya hupu ko.

Otandi yi mbala hoka ihaaku galukiwa,
koshilongo shomilema,
mombwili yeso,

molumbogo lwomilema omiluudhe thokothoko,
mekolombongo lyomuzizimba gweso nevundakano,
moka uuyelele wa faathana nomilema.
11: Sofar Omunaema okwa yamukula ngeyi.

Omapulo agehe ngano otaga kala inaaga yamukulwa?
Omupopi nguno oku li tuu mondjila?

Job, okupopya kwoye kwanathangwa otaku tu tompo, twaa vule oku ku yamukula?
Kaku na ngo te ku ganda, ngele to sheke?

Oto lombwele Kalunga kutya omaiuvito goye kage na ndjo,
ngoye omuyogoki koshipala she.
Akutu, onda hala ando Kalunga a popye, e ku tamaneke.

Ne ku hololele oshiholekwa shuunongo,
oshoka uunongo washili ou li opendji.
Kalunga ite ku pula ngaashi wi ilongela.

Oto wapa tuu okutseya iiholekwa yaKalunga?
Oto vulu tuu okuyeleka uunene wOmunankondoawike?

Owo u vule uule wegulu — oshike to vulu okuninga?
Owo u vule uule woshaasi — oshike to vulu okutseya?

Uunene waKalunga ou vule evi
nowa mbwalangandja u vule efuta.

Kalunga ngele te ya e te ku edhilile mondholongo
nota ithana aantu koompangu,
olye ta vulu oku mu keelela?

Kalunga aapwidhi oku ya shi;
iilonga yawo ayihe iiwinayi ita kala inee yi mona.

Momutsemwapwa ota vulu okuninga oondunge,
ihe okasino itaka vulu okuninga omuntu.

Job, ikonakona nawa momutima gwoye;
yeluthila kuye omaako goye.

Etha uuwinayi;
ino pitika, uukolokoshi u kale megumbo lyoye.

Nena oto ka yelutha oshipala shoye waa na ohoni;
oto ka kala othika waa na uumbanda.

Oto ka dhimbwa uudhigu woye;
oto ke u dhimbulukwa owala wa fa omeya ga tondoka po.

Omasiku goye otaga ka fa uuyelele moshanga shomutenya,
nomilema otadhi ka fa uuyelele wongula.

Oto ka kala nawa, u na egameno;
to kala wa gamenwa nou na ombili.

Oto ka lala, nokapu na ngoka te ku halutha,
naantu oyendji otaa ka hala, u kale u ya hole.

Omeho gaakaanakalunga otaga ka tsika,
nokaye na mpo taa ka holama.
Otaa ka tegelela owala okusa.
12: Job okwa yamukula ngeyi.

Eeno, osho lela, one aantu,
nuunongo otau ka sa pamwe nane!

Ngame wo ondi na oondunge nde mu fa.
Kandi shi oshikengelela showala.
Olye inaa tseya iinima mbino ayihe?

Onda yolwa kookuume kandje,
nando ngame ohandi indile Kalunga e ta yamukula.
Onda yolwa, nando ngame omuyuuki nomukeenashipo!

Aalinawa otaa dhini oshiponga,
omupya tagu adha ngoka ta gwile po.

Pula iinamwenyo, oyo notayi ku nongeke,
nenge u pule oondhila dhokegulu.

Popya niishitwa yokevi,
oyo notayi ku lombwele,
nenge oohi dhomefuta otadhi ku yelithile.
Ayihe mbika oya tseya kutya Omuwa oye e yi shita.

Omwenyo gwiishitwa ayihe ogu li miikaha ye,
osho wo omufudho gwaantu ayehe.

Ngaashi okutsi ku hole okuuva,
osho wo elaka li hole okulola iikulya.

Oondunge otadhi monika mokati kaakokele;
okukala nomwenyo omule otaku ku etele owino.

Kalunga oye oluthithiya lwoondunge noonkondo,
oku na uunongo nomayele.

Kalunga ngele ta kumuna po,
olye ta vulu okutungulula?
Ngele ta tula omuntu mondjedhililo,
olye te mu mangulula mo?

Kalunga ngele ta kankeke omeya, otaku ya oshikukuta,
nongele te ga etha, otaga kungulula evi.

Kalunga oku na oonkondo noye omusindani aluhe;
nakupukithwa nomupukithi ayehe oye li miikaha ye.

Aagandjimayele ote ya fala mokusindika,
naatokolihapu ote ya goyapaleke.

Aakwaniilwa ote ya kutha oonkondo yaa mange we aantu,
note ya ningi oonkwatwa.

Aayambi ya luwa iinima yawo ote ya fala kiilongo,
nota shundula aanankondo.

Ota mweneke aayinekelwa
nota hulitha po omayele gaakuluntu.

Aanenentu ote ya undulile mesithahoni,
noonkondo dhaapangeli ote dhi hulitha po.

Ota holola puuyelele iinima yomomilema,
nomilema ote dhi eta muuyelele.

Oti indjipaleke iigwana e te yi hanagula po;
ote yi halakanitha noku yi pongeka.

Aapangeli yomuuyuni ote ya kutha omayele;
ote ya pukithile mombuga mwaa na omapola.

Otaa pampadhala momilema mwaa na uuyelele,
note ya telaganitha ya fa oonkolwi.
13:
Ayihe mbika wa popi, onde yi mona,
nomakutsi gandje oge yi uva.

Shoka mwa tseya, onde shi tseya wo;
kamu vule ndje.

Onda hala ndi popye nOmunankondoawike,
nonda hala ndi tamanane naKalunga.

Otamu gwayeke ndje owala omahoka goombwa komulungu;
ne oonganga mwaa na ekwatho.

Ando omwa mwenene inaamu popitha ndje,
ando omwa ningi aanandunge.

Pulakeneni ano omatompelo gandje;
ne mu uve iitya yomilungu dhandje.

Omwa hala okupopya omapuko medhina lyaKalunga?
Omakoto geni otaga kwatha tuu Kalunga?

Otamu gamene Kalunga nokupopya iifundja?
Otamu yi koompangu peha lye?

Otashi ka kala tuu nawa, ngele te mu konakona?
Otamu vulu tuu okukotokela Kalunga,
ngaashi hamu kotokele aantu?

Kalunga ote ke mu pandula tuu,
ngele omu na ontondo ya holama?

Eadhimo lye itali mu tilitha?
Ehalutho lye itali mu kakamitha?

Omayeletumbulo geni kage na oshilonga, oga fa owala omutoko.
Omatompelo geni otaga halakana ngaashi eloya.

Pii ndje olweedhe, ndi popye;
shoka tashi adha ndje, nashi ningwe.

Omwenyo gwandje otii gu tula tuu pokakangwa?
Itandi kambadhala okwiigamena?

Kalunga nando ona ukithe ndje egonga, onde mu inekela;
otandi ipopile ashike koshipala she.

Shika osho ehupitho lyandje,
oshoka omukeenakalunga ita kala koshipala she.

Ngashingeyi pulakeneni nawa;
omakutsi geni naga taambe shoka te popi.

Ondi ilongekidha okwiipopila,
oshoka onda tseya kutya ondi li moshili.

Oku na tuu ngoka ta vulu okupa ndje uusama?
Ngele osho, ote mwena e te si.

Kalunga, pitikila ndje iinima mbika iyali,
nena itandi ke ku holama:

Oshikaha shoye shi kaleka kokule nangame;
hulitha po okutilitha ndje nomagando goye.

Kalunga, ithana ndje notandi ku itaale,
nenge u pitike, ndi popye e to yamukula.

Oondjo nomayono ano ogendji nde ga ningi?
Ulukila ndje oondjo nomayono gandje.

Omolwashike to holeke ndje oshipala shoye
noto tala ndje omutondi gwoye?

Oto tilitha efo tali pepwa kombepo.
Oto tidhatidha etutu lyowala.

Owa tokolele ndje epangulo elulu
nowa taambitha ndje omayono gomuugundjuka wandje.

Oshoka omuntu ota pepuka po a fa omuti tagu tukwa
nongonguwo tayi lika po.
14:
Omuntu a valwa komukiintu
omasiku ge omafupi
nogu udha uupyakadhi.

Ota hapa ongongala nota ganya;
okwa fa omuzizimba tagu matuka nota kana po.

Omuntu a tya ngawo oto mu tongolola?
Oto mu eta koshipala shoye, a pangulwe?

Maantu ya nyata otamu zi tuu omuyelele?
Itamu zi nando ogumwe!

Onkee ano, kala wa fa waahe mu wete, opo a vululukwe po,
sigo a thiki kethimbo lye ongomulongeli gwondjambi.

Nomuti wo ogu na etegameno:
ngele tagu kewa po, otagu tsapuka ishewe,
niitayi yagwo iipe itayi pu po.

Nando omidhi dhagwo tadhi kulupile mevi,
noshithindi shagwo tashi sile mo,

ihe ngele gwa mono omeya,
otagu tsapuka ishewe iitayi iipe.

Omuntu ota si noke na po we sha;
ota fudha mo omufudho nolwa hulu.

Ngaashi omeya taga pwine metale,
nenge omulonga tagu filala,

osho ngeyi omuntu ta lala
noita penduka po we.
Manga egulu inaali hula po,
aantu itaa papudhuka moomposi dhawo.

Andola u langeke ndje ashike muusi,
u holeke ndje, sigo ondjahi yoye ya kodha.
Ando u holeke ndje mo ethimbo lyu uthwa
e to ka dhimbulukwa ndje ihe konale.

Omuntu ngele okwa si,
ota kala ishewe e na omwenyo?
Momasiku guudhigu wandje
otandi tegelele, sigo emanguluko lyandje lya thiki.

Oto ka ithana ndje notandi ku itaale;
oto ka yuulukwa omushitwa gwoye.

Oto ka tonatela onkatu yandje kehe,
noito tala omayono gandje.

Omayono gandje oto ga holeke mompunda;
oto siikile oondjo dhandje.

Ngaashi oondundu tadhi gu,
omamanya taga halakana,

omeya taga wegula omamanya
nekunguluko lyomeya tali fulu po evi,
osho to hanagula po etegameno lyomuntu.

Oto mu sindi sigo aluhe, nota kana po.
Oto shundula oshipala she e to mu tidha po.

Oyana ngele taa simanekwa, ite shi tseya,
nongele taa dhinwa, ite shi mono.

Ota kala e na uuwehame molutu lwe
noti ilili ye mwene.
15: Elifas Omuteman okwa yamukula ngeyi:

Job, omunamayele ota gandja tuu eyamukulo lyaa na oondunge,
nenge otu udhitha ela lye nombepo ompyu yokuuzilo?

Ota ningi omaludhi gaa na shilonga,
oohapu dhaa na sho tadhi kwatha?

Ihe ongoye to hanagula po etilokalunga
noto dhini okugalikana Kalunga.

Oondjo dhoye otadhi holoka moohapu dhoye;
oto landula okupopya kwaaniineya.

Okana koye oko take ku pangula, hangame;
omilungu dhoye mwene tadhi ku tompo.

Ongoye omuvalwa gwotango mokati kaantu?
Owa valwa, manga oondundu inaadhi holoka?

Owa pulakenene oompangela dhaKalunga?
Oto dhiladhila ongoye awike omunandunge?

Oshike wa tseya, tse kaatu shi shi?
Omatseho ogeni po u na kaatu ga na?

Aakulupe naasamane yoomvi oye li nomokati ketu,
aasamane aakuluntu nokuho.

Omahekeleko gaKalunga inage ku gwana,
noohapu oontalala we dhi lombwelwa?

Omolwashike omwenyo gwoye tagu ku thigi po,
nomeho goye taga pakuma?

Owa geela Kalunga,
sho to pititha mo oohapu dha tya ngawo mokana koye?

Omuntu a wape ngiini okukala omuyelele,
omuvalwa komukiintu a ninge omuyuuki?

Ngele nomaayapuki ye ini inekela mo nando ogumwe,
negulu lyo lyene inali yela momeho ge,

omuntu haye ngoka a nyata nokwa yonuka,
ta nu uulunde ngaashi omeya?

Job, pulakena ndje, ndi ku pukulule,
nandi ku lombwele shoka nda mona.

Aanamayele oya hokolola
yo inaa holeka shoka ye shi uva koohekulu.

Oyo ayeke ya li mo moshilongo;
mokati kawo kamwa li omukwiilongo.

Omukeenakalunga oku li muudhigu omasiku agehe;
uuwehame owe mu tegelela.

Ita vulu okuhunuka mo momilema;
oku uthilwa a se kegongamwele.

Ota telagana ta kongo iipalutha
ye ina tseya esiku lyoshiponga li li popepi.

Uuwehame nuumbanda otau mu tilitha,
otau mu adha ngaashi ehomono tali akele omukwaniilwa.

Okwa ganeke omaako ge, a kondjithe Kalunga,
nokwi inenepekele Omunankondoawike.

Otu ukilile Kalunga e na othingo ya taganana
nehuuyanza lya kola.

Oshipala she okwe shi gwayeka omagadhi;
omatundji ge oga pama,

Inamu mu etha i ifundjaleke netalaleko lyaa na oshilonga,
oshoka ita ka likola sha.

Ota ka lemba, manga e li metifa lyokukala kwe;
ota ka ganya ngaashi oshitayi ye ita penduka po we.

Ota ka fa omuviinu tagu yagumuka omagongwa,
nokwa fa omuolivi tagu yagumuka oonsheno.

Aakaanakalunga kaye na oluvalo,
nomulilo otagu lungunitha po omatsali gaaholi yoombumbo.

Otaa kokitha uupyakadhi e taa vala omalwa;
otaa kokitha omakotokelo meni lyawo.
16: Job okwa yamukula ngeyi:

Iinima ngaambika onde yi uva nale;
ne amuhe aahekeleki mwaa na shilonga.

Oohapu dheni odhi na tuu ehulilo?
Oshike tashi mu endelelitha okuyamukula?

Ngame wo ote vulu okupopya nde mu fa, ando one mwa li ngame,
ote vulu okupopya, ndi mu tompe
noku mu pukapukila omutse gwandje.

Oohapu dhandje otadhi vulu oku mu laadhipika;
etalaleko tali zi mokana kandje, otali vulu okufudhitha.

Ihe ngele tandi popi, uuwehame wandje itau pepelele,
nongele tandi mwena, itau pu po.

Kalunga, owa hepeke ndje unene;
oluvalo lwandje owe lu hanagula po.

Aantu oya makulila ndje omakana
nokuninga ndje oshipwedhela.
Otaa dhenge ndje koompanda ya dhina ndje,
otaa imanga okapandi, ya hangene ndje.

Kalunga okwa gandja ndje miikaha yaakolokoshi
noku umbile ndje momake gaakaanakalunga.

Oondjumbeta dhe odha kunduka ndje,
niikuti ye oya yaha ndje miitiyanathigo pwaa na henda,
nonyango yandje oya tikile pevi.

Okwa matukile ndje omathimbo nomathimbo
nokwa ponokele ndje ongomukwiita omuhahu.

Mokusa oluhodhi ondi izaleke ehahi,
nesimano lyandje onde li fumvike montsi.

Oshipala shandje osha pembe kokulila,
nomulema omuluudhe ogwa kunduka oombafu dhandje,

ihe natango tuu iikaha yandje oya kwatunuka kondjahi,
nomagalikano gandje omayelele.

Evi, ino siikila uuwinayi mbo nda ningilwa!
Ino etha okulila kwandje ku mwenekwe!

Tala, ombangi yandje oyi li megulu;
omupopili gwandje oku li muule wokombanda.

Ookuume kandje otaa yolo ndje.
Omahodhi gandje otaga tondokele kuKalunga.

Ando pu kale ngoka ta galikanene ndje kuKalunga,
ngaashi omuntu ta galikanene kuume ke!

Oku na owala oomvula dhimwe,
ndi ye molweendo itaandi galuka we.
17:
Aasheki yandje otaa kunduka ndje;
omeho gandje otaga tala uutondwe wawo.

Kalunga, ninga omupopili gwandje.
Olye we ta popile ndje?

Omadhiladhilo gawo oga patwa, kaye na omayele,
onkee itaa ka sindana.

Omuntu ngoka ta popi nayi kuume ke omolwokufutwa,
omeho goyana otaga ka tsika mo.

Kalunga okwa ningi ndje omunyanwa gwashaa ngoka,
omuntu gwokuhiyilwa omayeye moshipala.

Omeho gandje oga tsiyala koluhodhi;
olutu lwandje olwa fa omuzizimba.

Aayuuki otaye shi kuminwa;
aakaanashipo otaa thikamene aakaanakalunga.

Ihe nando ongeyi, aayuuki otaa dhiginine oshili yawo,
naamboka ye na iikaha ya yela, otaa tsikile nomukumo.

Eewa, galukeni, ileni amuhe!
Mokati keni kandi wete mo omunandunge.

Omasiku gandje oga pita po,
oompangela dhandje odha hulithwa po
nosho wo ondjuulukwe yandje.

Aantu mbaka otaa faathanitha uusiku nomutenya,
sho taa ti: “Momilema otamu zi uuyelele.”

Ngele ote tegelele muusi omo mu kale maandjetu,
nenge te yala ontala yandje momilema,

ngele ote lombwele eolelo kutya ongoye tate,
nomazinyo otandi ga ithana meme nomumwamemekadhona,

nena ando etegameno lyandje oli li we peni?
Olye te ke li mona?

Otali ka ya pamwe nangame mombila?
Otatu ka ningina pamwe nalyo mevi?
18: Bildad Omushuak okwa yamukula ngeyi:

Job, uunake to hulitha okupopya?
Ninga omunandunge, nena otatu wapa okupopya.

Omolwashike to tu tala twa fa iimuna,
notwa ningi aagoya momeho goye?

Mondjahi oto inyanyagula mwene.
Evi otali ka mbugalekwa molwondjahi yoye,
nenge oondundu otadhi lundululwa po pomahala gadho?

Eeno, uuyelele womukeenakalunga otau dhimi po,
noonte dhe itadhi yele we.

Olamba yometsali lye otayi dhimi,
onyeka ye mu minikila otayi dhimwa po.

Oonkatu dhe nando odha li dha kola, otadhi ka pegeya;
uunongo we mwene otau mu thigi po.
Oompadhi dhe otadhi yi momwigo e ta yulwa.

Omwigo otagu mu kwata koshithi,
netavu otali mu yulu lye mu nkenena.

Elulo olye mu tegelwa mevi,
nekelo olye mu fulilwa mepola.

Ehalutho otali tilitha akuhe,
notali mu landula shaa mpoka ta yi.

Omupya ogwe mu ekamena okana,
noshiponga oshi li popepi naye.

Omukithi omudhigu otagu li ko iilyo ye kolutu
notagu tokola ko omagulu nomaako.

Ota kuthwa metsali lye e li inekela
nota falwa komukwaniilwa gwomatilitho.

Omulilo itagu thigi mo sha metsali lye,
osulufuli otayi fike po onganda ye.

Omidhi dhe otadhi sile mevi,
niitayi ye otayi kukutile kombanda.

Ita dhimbulukiwa we kombanda yevi,
nesimano lye otali hulu po.

Ota tidhwa muuyelele, a ye momilema,
nota kondwa mo mokati kaantu.

Ke na oshitutuma nenge oluvalo mokati koyaandjawo,
megumbo lye itamu hupu nando omuntu e na omwenyo.

Omupya gwe ogwa kumitha aayuninginino,
naauzilo oya tila taa kakama.

Eeno, shika osho tashi adha aakaanakalunga,
ndjika oyo onkalo yaamboka kaaye shi Kalunga.
19: Sigo uunake tamu ehameke ndje notamu alula ndje noohapu?

Omwa hindi ndje lwomulongo
nomwa ponokele ndje mwaa na nando ohoni.

Ngele oshoshili kutya onda puka,
nena omapuko gandje oshinima shandje mwene.

Omwa hala mu hololele ndje einenepeko lyeni,
ne mu tompe ndje molwaasho ndi ishonopeka.

Tseyeni kutya Kalunga oye a ningi ngaaka, hane!
Oye a tula ndje melulo.

Nonando onda kugu nda ti: “Onda lundilwa!”
Ine mona eyamukulo.
Nando nda pula ekwatho,
inandi mona eutho.

Okwa hula ndje esimano neliko,
noshishani shandje okwe shi kutha ko komutse.

Okwa tuulagula ndje e tandi hulu po;
etegameno lyandje okwe li vudha mo ngaashi omuti.

Ondjahi ye oya hwamene ndje,
nokwa yalulile ndje mokati kaatondi ye.

Okwa kutha ndje aamwameme;
aashiwikile yandje okwe ya ningi yaa shi ndje we.

Aakwetu oye li ndje kokule,
ookuume kandje oya dhimbwa ndje.

Nando ndi ithane omupiya gwandje, iti itaale,
nando ndi mu indile neifupipiko, ita pe ndje.

Onda tondwa nokomukulukadhi gwandje,
onda ningi iikungitha mokati kaamwameme.

Nuumatyona otau nyonkele ndje;
sho te yambuka po, otau sheke ndje.

Ookuume kandje lela oya tonda ndje,
aaholike yandje oya pilukila ndje.

Oshipa shandje osha kakatela komasipa;
oontumba dhokoshama odho adhike ndi na.

Silii ndje ohenda, silii ndje ohenda, ookuume kandje!
Oshikaha shaKalunga osha dhenge ndje.

Omolwashike tamu lambalala ndje mwa fa one Kalunga?
Inamu vulwa ndje nani?

Akutu, oohapu dhandje ando odha li dha nyolwa,
dha shangelwa mondhingambo,

nenge dha negelwa memanya nopena yosheela,
nena otadhi kala sigo aluhe.

Ondi shi shi kutya Omukulili gwandje oku na omwenyo;
pehulilo ota ka thikama kevi.

Olutu lwandje nando nalu yonagulwe po,
nonatango tuu otandi ka mona Kalunga ndi li molutu.

Ngame otandi ke mu mona nomeho gandje mwene, hagulwe.
Omwenyo gwandje ogu na ngiini ondjuulukwe onene!

Ngele tamu ti: “Otatu mu ehameke nomukalo guni?
Uudhigu oye mwene e u iyetele.”

Onkee ano, tileni egongamwele,
oshoka otali holola ondjahi yaKalunga,
ne mu tseye kutya oku na omupanguli.
20: Sofar Omunaema okwa yamukula ngeyi:

Job, omatedho gandje owe ga piyaganeke,
ite vulu okukala inaandi yamukula.

Ondu uvu oohapu dhomusheko dha sitha ndje ohoni,
ihe pamayele gandje ote tseya, nkene te yamukula.

Owe shi tseya okuza konale,
okuza omuntu sho a shitilwa muuyuni,
kutya enyanyu lyomulunde nolyomukeenakalunga olyo efupi.

Nando uuntsa we u tse kegulu,
nomutse gwe gu adhe kiikogo,

ota kana po a fa onyata ye.
Mboka ya li haye mu mono,
otaa ka tya: “Oku li peni ano?”

Ota tuka po ngondjodhi noita monika we,
ota wilola po ongemoniko lyuusiku.

Omeho ge mu mwene, itage mu mono we,
nopehala mpo a li, ita monika po we.

Oyana otaa ka panga uukuume naafupi
notaa ka shunithila ooyene eliko lyawo ndyo e ya yugile.

Oonkondo dhomuugundjuka we ndho dha li momasipa ge,
otadhi ka ya mevi pamwe naye.

Uulunde ou na omulyo mokana ke,
note u holeke kohi yelaka lye.

Ina hala oku u etha,
ote u kaleke mokana ke.

Ihe iikulya mbika otayi shituka onyango mela lye,
notayi ningi uuzigo wontoka meni lye.

Eliko e li lile, ote li kungu mo,
Kalunga ote li mu kungitha mo.

Okwa fa a lya uuzigo wontoka;
omayego gefu otage mu dhipaga.

Ita ka mona omilonga noompompolonga
tadhi kunguluka omahini nomagadhi goonyushi.

Ota gandja po ashihe shoka a longele nuudhigu,
noita ka nyanyukilwa iihohela yiipindi ye.

Oshoka okwa hepeke oohepele nokwe dhi ethele moluhepo
e ta lala omagumbo inee ga tunga.

Uufukedhi we itau lotele;
eliko lye itali mu kwatha sha.

Olwiho lwe inalu mu thigila po nando osha,
onkee uuyamba we itau kalelele.

Metifa lyuuyamba we omupya otagu mu kwata;
oluhepo olululu otalu mu matukile.

Uuna a hokwa okuudhitha ela lye,
Kalunga ote mu tumine ondjahi ye ompyu
note mu lokithile ongeyo ye.

Nando na fadhuke po iikondjitho yosheela,
omivi otadhi mu yaha.

Omilema thokothoko otadhi langele emona lye,
nomulilo itaagu dhimi otagu mu lungunitha po,
nakehe shoka sha kala megumbo lye, otashi pi po.

Egulu otali holola omayono ge puuyelele,
nevi otali mu tsile ondumbo.

Efundja otali ka kungulula po egumbo lye;
uuyamba we otau yi nomeya mesiku lyondjahi yaKalunga.

Shika osho oshipewa shomukeenakalunga,
uuthiga e u tulilwa po kuKalunga.
21:
Pulakeneni nawa oohapu dhandje;
nadhi mu hekeleke.

Idhidhimikilii ndje manga tandi popi,
nongele nda hulitha, shekeni ihe.

Sho te lili, ote lilile omuntu?
Itashi vulika ndi idhidhimike?

Talii ndje e tamu kumwa;
ikwateni komilungu.

Ngele tandi shi dhiladhila, otashi halutha ndje;
otandi ningi omahwilili.

Omolwashike aakaanakalunga taa ethiwa ya kale nomwenyo,
taa li nawa notaa ningi aanankondo?

Otaa kokitha oyana ye li puyo,
naatekulu yawo oye li momeho gawo.

Momagumbo gawo omu na ombili, kamu na uumbanda.
Ondhimbo yaKalunga itayi ya adha.

Oontsezi dhiimuna yawo odhi na ombuto ombwanawa;
oonzinzi dhawo otadhi vala nawa.

Otaa pititha mo oyana ngaashi oonzi,
nuuhanona wawo otau nyanyukwa.

Otaa imbi taa dhenge oontunda nokuhika uuharpa,
notaa nyanyukilwa ehiko lyomankuma.

Otaa kala ethimbo alihe ye na elago,
notaa yi mombila ye na ombili.

Aakaanakalunga otaa lombwele Kalunga a ze po puyo;
inaa hala okutseya ehalo lye.

Otaa ti: “Omunankondoawike olye, opo tu mu longele?
Otashi tu kwatha shike oku mu galikana?”

Ihe itaa mono elago koonkondo dhawo yene,
onkee omadhiladhilo gawo naga kale ndje kokule.

Olungapi uuyelele waakaanakalunga tau dhimwa po,
nolungapi oshiponga tashi ya akele?
Kalunga ote ya tumine iiponga mondjahi ye?

Otaa fe iiyagaya tayi yi ombepo
nongetutu tali pepwa po kokambiya?

Omwa hala Kalunga a geele omunona molwoondjo dhahe.
Ihe hasho, Kalunga na geele omuyoni ye mwene,
opo e shi tseye.

Omeho ge naga tale omupya gwe mwene,
noye mwene e na okunwa ondjahi yOmunankondoawike.

Oshoka oku na shike nasho,
uuna ta thigi po yaandjawo,
uuna omasiku ge taga ti kehulilo?

Oku na tuu omuntu ta longo Kalunga oondunge,
oongoka ta pangula naamboka yomegulu?

Omuntu gumwe ota si e na oonkondo dha gwana,
e li nawa noku na ombili.

Oondjupa dhe odhu udha omahini,
nomasipa ge oge na omongo ogwindji.

Manga omuntu mukwawo ta si e na uululume momutima
ye ina mona nando uuwanawa washa.

Ayehe otaa si e taa fumvikwa mevi,
omazinyo notage ya li po.

Taleni, onda tseya shoka tamu dhiladhila,
sho tamu kotokele ndje niineya yeni.

Otamu pula: “Egumbo lyomunenentu oli li peni,
eha moka hamu longelwa uukolokoshi?”

Omwa pulile mbo taa ende momapola?
Omwa tseya omahokololo ngoka taye ge mu lombwele?

Omukeenakalunga ota ka hupa tuu mesiku lyegeelo,
ota ka hunuka mo tuu mesiku lyondjahi?

Olye te mu ulukile omikalo dhe,
nolye te mu geelele shoka a longo?

Ota falwa kombila,
aalangeli notaa tonatele ombila ye.

Omahekeleko geni itaga kwatha ndje sha.
Omayamukulo geni ogu udha iifundja.
22:
Omuntu ota vulu tuu okwoopalela Kalunga?
Omunandunge ote mu kwatha tuu sha?

Ngele ngoye omuyuuki, otashi kwatha shike Omunankondoawike?
Ota likola po shike, oondjila dhoye ngele kadhi na oshipo?

Kalunga ite ku geele molwaasho ho mu tila,
noite ku fala koompangu molwaasho ho mu simaneke.

Omayono goye ogo ga lundu pombanda.
Uukolokoshi woye owo waa na ehulilo.

Mumwanyoko owe mu pula oongunga pwaa na etompelo
nowa hula omunankayi omizalo dhe.

Omusinota owe mu tindile omeya,
nomusindjala ino mu pa iikulya,

nando ongoye omulumentu omuyamba,
omunedhina moshilongo.

Omuselekadhi owe mu tidha po iikaha yowala,
nowa keelele oothigwa dhi kwathwe.

Onkee oomwigo odhe ku tegelwa nodhe ku kunduka;
otadhi ku halutha ombaadhilila.

Omolwaasho ku na omilema waa dhi wete
nefundja lyomeya tali ku siikile.

Kalunga ke li megulu lyokombandambanda?
Tala noonyothi, nkene dhi li muuleeleka.

Ngoye oto pula: “Kalunga ota tseya shike?
Okwa siikilwa kiikogo iiluudhe — ota vulu ngiini oku tu tokola?

Iikogo otayi mu siikile, opo kee tu mone,
note ende momunkulo gweyalelo.”
Owa hala okukala momadhiladhilo gaakaanakalunga?

Oya kuthwa po, manga ethimbo lyawo inaali thika,
nomakankameno gawo oga kungululwa po kefundja.

Oya lombwele Kalunga ya ti: “Za po putse!
Omunankondoawike ote tu ningi ngiini?”

Oye tuu ngoka a udhitha omagumbo gawo niinima iiwanawa,
ihe omatedho gawo ogi iyukila.

Aayuuki otaa mono eyonuuko lyawo e taa nyanyukwa,
naakaanashipo otaa ya nyonkele taa ti:

“Eeno, aatondi yetu ya halakanithwa po,
nuuyamba wawo wa fikwa po komulilo.”

Igandja kuKalunga, opo u kale u na ombili naye,
nena oto ka kala u li nawa.

Taamba omapukululo ge
e to pungula oohapu dhe momutima gwoye.

Ngele oto galukile kOmunankondoawike
nongele oto etha uulunde u kombwe mo maandjeni,
nena oto ka hepuluka.

Ngele oto ekelehi oshingoli shoye montsi,
oshingolilela shokuOfir to shi umbile molusilu lu li mokati koondundu,

nena Omunankondoawike ota ningi oshingoli shoye,
oshisiliveli shoye sha hogololwa.

Okuza mpoka oto ka panda Omunankondoawike
noto ka taalelitha oshipala shoye kuKalunga.

Uuna to galikana, ote ku yamukula,
noto longo ngaashi wu uvaneke.

Omatokolo goye otaga ka gwanithwa,
nuuyelele otau minikile mondjila yoye.

Aantu ngele taa kuthwa kiipundi,
nena oto ti: “Na simanekwe!”
Kalunga nota hupitha aadhinwa.

Kalunga ota hupitha omukeenashipo.
Eeno, nangoye wo ote ku hupitha,
ngele iilonga yoye oyu uka.
23:
Ngame natango ote nyenyeta note lili omahodhi omapyu;
oshikaha shaKalunga osha thinda ndje.

Ando onda li nda tseya mpoka tandi mu adha,
ando otandi yi kuye.

Otandi vulu okutamanana koshipala she,
ndi popye omatompelo gandje.

Onda hala okutseya kutya ota yamukula ndje ngiini,
nokuuva shoka ta lombwele ndje.

Ota yi ndje moshipala noonkondo dhe oonene?
Aawe! Ota pulakene ndje nawa.

Ongame omuyuuki, ote vulu okutamanana naye
notandi manguluka, ndaa thikame we komeho gomupanguli gwandje.

Ihe ngele tandi ka konga kuuzilo, Kalunga itandi mu adha ko;
nongele tandi uka kuuninginino, itandi mu mono ko.

Uuna e li miilonga kuumbangalantu, itandi mu mono;
uuna ta shuna kuumbugantu, ite mono nando okuwilola kwe.

Kalunga okwa tseya okukala kwandje,
ngele ta yeleke ndje,
ota mono ndje nda yela nda fa oshingoli.

Onda landula ondjila ndjoka a halela ndje,
itandi zi mo nande.

Itandi gamuka ko nando kiipango ye,
oohapu dhe onde dhi pungula shi vule iikulya yandje yesiku kehe.

Kalunga oku li ngaashi a kala shito,
olye ta vulu oku mu tamaneka?
Oye ta longo shoka a hala.

Ota tsakanitha shoka nda tokolelwa.
Shika oshinima shimwe shomomadhiladhilo ge.

Omolwasho tandi tila oshipala she;
ngele tandi mu dhiladhila, otandi kakama.

Kalunga okwa kutha ndje omukumo;
Omunankondoawike okwe etele ndje uudhigu.

Ihe ngame itandi mwenekwa komilema
nokuuluudhe thokothoko wa siikila ndje.
24:
Omolwashike Omunankondoawike itu utha esiku, uuna ta pangula?
Omolwashike mboka ye mu tseya, itaye li mono?

Aantu otaa nenepeke oongamba dhomapya gawo,
notaa litha iimuna ye yi yaka.

Otaa hingi po okasino kothigwa,
notaa kwata ongombe yomuselekadhi ombambyona.

Otaa pukitha oohepele,
notaa holamitha aafupi ayehe yomoshilongo.

Otadhi pupula iipalutha momapya,
notadhi toonona omakukila miitsambe yaakaanakalunga.

Otadhi lala omudhu, dha pumbwa oonguwo;
kadhi na omakumbyatha gokwiisiikila dhaa se uutalala.

Otadhi ende dha hipa komvula yepoola;
sho dha pumbwa egameno, otadhi ondama pekololo.

Aakaanakalunga ohaa piki othigwa ohanana,
nokahanona kohepele ohaye ka kwata po, opo ongunga yi futwe.

Ihe oohepele otadhi ende nomalutu gowala, dhaa na oonguwo;
otadhi humbata iilya, ihe itadhi yi li.

Otadhi yenge omagadhi gooholivi,
otadhi kolo omandjembele, ihe odha sa enota.

Omakemo goonakudhipagwa otaga uvika moshilando,
ihe Kalunga ita pulakene nando omagalikano gawo.

Oku na aantu ya tsa ondumbo nuuyelele;
inaye u koneka noitaye u landula.

Omudhipagi ota meneka, manga eluwa inaali tenda,
nota dhipaga ohepele; nomuusiku ota yaka.

Oshoka oyo ayehe ohaa endele kumwe nomilema,
nomilema itadhi ya tilitha.

Aakaanakalunga otaa yiwa nayo komeya gefundja,
omapya gawo oga thingwa,
nokape na ngo ta longo miitsambe yomuviinu.

Ngaashi uupyu nuukukutu tau kutha po uututo,
osho omulunde ta kana po.

Oshoka oha yugu omukiintu ihaa vala,
noiha si omuselekadhi ohenda.

Ihe Kalunga aanankondo ote ya tidha po;
nando naa kale ya kola, itaa kala ye na egameno.

Nando Kalunga te ya etha e taa kala ya fa taa vululukwa,
omeho ge oga tonatela oondjila dhawo.

Otaa kala ya simana okathimbo,
ihe ohaluka kaye po we.
Otaa fupipikwa notaa gongelwa ya fa yakwawo,
notaa teywa ya fa iilya.

Oku na tuu ngo ta vulu okutinda kutya hasho?
Oku na tuu ngo ta vulu okutya, ote popi iifundja.
25: Bildad Omushuak okwa yamukula ngeyi.

Epangelo nesimano nali pewe Kalunga;
oshilongo shomegulu ote shi kaleke nombili.

Omatangakwiita ge otaga wapa tuu okuyalulwa?
Olye ngo itaa minikilwa kuuyelele waKalunga?

Omuntu ota vulu tuu okukala omuyuuki koshipala shaKalunga?
Nakuvalwa komuntu ota vulu tuu okukala omuyelele?

Tala, nomwedhi inagu yela,
noonyothi kadhi na uuyelele momeho ge.

Unene tuu omuntu oye ezinyo,
omuna gwomuntu okapuka kowala.
26:
Owa kwatha ngiini omunkundi!
Owa koleke tuu omaako ga loloka?

Omayele ogeni po wa nongeke omusama?
Uunongo ou thike peni we u holola?

Olye e ku popitha oohapu ndhika?
Owa hwamekwa kombepo yini po, u dhi tye?

Aasi oye li muumbanda uunene,
ayehe mboka ye li mevi kohi yomeya.

Uusi ou li puuyelele koshipala shaKalunga,
noshaasi oshi li pontundulu.

Kalunga ota yalaleke eyalelo lyokuumbangalantu,
nota tula evi powalawala.

Ota kaleke omeya miikogo,
niikogo itayi tuuka kuudhigu wago.

Omwedhi gwa toka ote gu kwidhidhike,
note gu siikilitha iikogo.

Ota tende omusinda kombanda yomeya
nota yoolola uuyelele momilema.

Oongundhi dheyalelo otadhi tenguka
notadhi tila kegando lye.

Koonkondo dhe ota tukulutha efuta,
nokomayele ge ota teyagula po evovo Rahab.

Omufudho gwe otagu yeleke eyalelo;
iikaha ye otayi dhipaga eninangamba lya kotoka.
27:
Otandi uvaneke kuKalunga omunamwenyo nOmunankondoawike,
ngoka inaa zimina uuyuuki wandje nokwa pe ndje uululu.
Manga ndi na omwenyo,

omilunga dhandje itadhi ka popya uukolokoshi,
nelaka lyandje itali ka tumbula iifundja.

Itandi ka zimina okupopya kweni kutya oku li mondjila,
sigo okusa itandi ki idhimbika uuyuuki wandje.

Itandi ke etha uushili wandje;
eiyuvo lyandje olya yela.

Aatondi yandje naa talwe ya fa aakolokoshi,
naaniita nangame ya fe iipululu.

Aakaanakalunga oye na etegameno lyashike ngele taa hulu po,
uuna Kalunga te ya kutha omwenyo?

Kalunga ota ka uva tuu okulila kwawo,
uuna oshiponga tashi ya adha?

Otaa ka nyanyukilwa tuu Omunankondoawike?
Otaa ka galikana tuu Kalunga omasiku agehe?

Otandi mu nongeke, mu tseye oonkondo dhaKalunga,
oondjila dhOmunankondoawike itandi dhi holeke.

Taleni, ngaashi mwe shi imonena!
Omolwashike tamu ihepeke?

Mpaka ope na omupya, Kalunga e gu nunina aakaanakalunga,
shika oshipewa shaakolokoshi sha zi kOmunankondoawike.

Oyana nando oyendji, oyu uthilwa okusila miita,
noluvalo lwawo italu ka kala lu na iikulya ya gwana.

Elega otali kutha po mboka ya hupu po,
naaselekadhi yawo itaa ke ya lila.

Aakaanakalunga nando naa indumbile oshisiliveli shi thike pontsi yevi
noonguwo dhaa shi kuyalulwa,
itashi kwatha sha.

Omuyuuki ote dhi zala po,
nomunashili ota ka kutha po oshisiliveli shawo.

Omagumbo gawo oga fa owala omawiiwili,
ongaashi omatsali gaalangeli yepya.

Otaa ka lala aayamba,
ihe sho taa penduka, uuyamba wawo wa kana po.

Uumbanda otau ya siikile ngaashi efundja;
ombepo yoshikungulu otayi yi nayo uusiku.

Ombepo yokuuzilo otayi ya pepe po
notayi ya umbu mo momagumbo gawo.

Otayi ya ndanga po pwaa na ohenda,
manga taa kambadhala okuya ontuku.

Ombepo otayi ya dhenge moshipala
notayi ya tilitha noonkondo dhayo.
28:
Oku na oomina dhoshisiliveli,
nomahala mpoka oshingoli hashi yelithwa.

Oshiyela otashi fulwa mevi,
noshikushu otashi hemunwa tashi zi moshimanya.

Aantu otaa entamene momilema,
otaa konakona muule womevi
notaa kongo oshimanya muuleeleka.

Otaa fulu iikolo yoomina mevi,
kokule naantu mboka ye li kombanda;
pokuma ihaapu endiwa kaantu,
opo mpoka taa fulu ye li muuwike.

Mevi omo hamu zi iikulya,
ihe meni lyalyo otamu lunduluka mwa fa mu na omulilo.

Omamanya gosafire ohaga zi mevi;
ontsi yalyo oyi na oshingoli.

Nondhila yekodhi inayi tseya ondjila ndjo yu uka koomina,
nomeho gembiimbili inage yi mona.

Iiyamakuti iinuuntsa inayi yi lamba,
nonime inayi enda mo.

Aantu otaa panda omamanya omakukutukukutu,
otaa dhikula mo oondundu nomidhi dhadho.

Otaa hoko omikala moondundu;
omeho gawo oge wete emanya kehe li na ondilo.

Otaa itsu oonza dhomilonga,
notaa holola puuyelele iinima ya holekwa.

Ihe uunongo otau adhika peni?
Openi tatu ilongo oondunge?

Omuntu itu uvu ko ondilo yawo;
itau adhika maantu yokombanda yevi.

Muule womohi kau mo,
nefuta kali u na.

Itau vulu okulandwa noshingolilela,
ondando yawo oyi vule ndjoka yoshisiliveli.

Itau vulu okulandwa noshingoli shokuOfir,
nenge nomamanya gondilo gaoniks nosafire.

Ondilo yawo oyi vule yoshingoli nenge yemanya lyokristali,
noitau landakanithwa nuuwe woshingoli.

Ondilo yoonyoka noyojaspes itayi adha mo.
Ondando yuunongo oyi vule ndjoka yorubini.

Itau yelekwa nondilo yotopasi yokuEtiopia;
itau vulu okulandwa noshingolielela.

Ihe uunongo otau zi peni ano?
Oondunge otatu dhi adha peni?

Owa holekwa aantu ayehe yokombanda yevi,
nowa holekwa oondhila dhokegulu.

Eso noshaasi oya ti,
oye wu uvu omufofoto.

Kalunga oye awike a tseya ondjila yoku wu adha;
oye e shi mpoka wa kala.

Oshoka Kalunga ota mono sigo okooha dhuuyuni,
nota tala ayiheyihe yi li kohi yegulu.

Okwa pe ombepo oonkondo dhayo
nokwa yeleke uule womeya.

Omvula kehe okwe yi ningile eutho,
noombadhi ondjila yadho.

Nena okwa tala uunongo e te wu yeleke;
okwe wu koleke ko e te wu zimine.

Okwa lombwele aantu a ti:
“Okutila Kalunga okwo uunongo,
nokwiidhilika uuwinayi okwo oondunge.”
29: Job okwa tameke ishewe okupopya.

Akutu, ando onda li ngaashi momasiku ngeyaka,
Kalunga sho a li ta gamene ndje!

Kalunga okwa kala pungame nokwa minikile ndje nuuyelele we,
nomomilema onde endithwa kuye.

Eeno, omasiku ngeyaka onda li ndi na uukuume naKalunga,
nokwa yambeke egumbo lyandje.

Omunankondoawike okwa li pamwe nangame,
naamwandje oya li ya kunduka ndje.

Onda li ndi na omukando ogwindji,
noondundu odha kungulukithile ndje omagadhi gooholivi.

Uuna nda yi koshigongi shaakuluntu yoshilando
nonda kuutumba mpo hapu gongala aantu,

aagundjuka ngele ya mono ndje, oya yapukile ndje,
naasamane aakulupe oya simaneke ndje ya thikama.

Aanenentu oye etha okupopya
noya mutike omakana gawo.

Omawi goomvalekele oga thiti,
nomalaka gawo oga kakatele koondaathelo.

Kehe ngoka u uvu ndje te popi, okwa popile ndje muuwanawa,
naambo ya mono ndje, oya hokolola ndje.

Oshoka onda hupitha oohepele tadhi kugile ndje ekwatho,
noothigwa ndhoka dhaa na omupopili.

Omuntu e li muudhigu uunene, okwa pandula ndje;
onda nyanyudha omwenyo gwomuselekadhi.

Onda longo pashili nopauyuuki
nonde u dhiginine ngaashi omuzalo gwandje.

Onda li omeho gaaposi
nomagulu giilema.

Onda ningi he yaakwanaluhepo
nonda gama komukwiilongo e li muudhigu.

Onda teyagula po oonkondo dhaakolokoshi
nonde ya yugu iihakanwa yawo.

Onda dhiladhila, otandi ka kala nomwenyo omule
notandi ka sila megumbo lyandje.

Onda li nda fa omuti gu na omidhi dha adha komeya
niitayi yagwo oya gwilwa komume.

Kehe omuntu okwa li ha simaneke ndje,
niikondjitho yandje oya li ya kola.

Aantu oya pulakene ndje nokumwena
noya taamba omayele ngoka nde ya pe.

Ngele nda popi, inaa tya we sha;
oohapu dhandje oye dhi taamba nawa.
Oya tegelele ndje ngaashi omunepya a tegelela omvula yontemuna.

Onde ya uvile ohenda, sho ya tyololoka;
enyanyu moshipala shandje olye ya tsu omukumo.

Onde ya kwatele komeho nonda kuutumba nda fa omuwiliki gwawo.
Onda li nda fa omukwaniilwa mokati komatangakwiita ge
nonda li omuhekeleki gwoonakulila.
30:
Ihe ngashingeyi nokuli aagundjuka otaa sheke ndje.
Oohe onde ya sheshitha okukala pamwe noombwa dhandje taa litha iimuna.

Oonkondo dhiikaha yawo inadhi kwatha ndje sha;
inaa longela ndje sha.

Oya li oohepele naasindjala;
uusiku oye endagula taa kongo iikulya.

Oya li omafo giihwa,
noombimbo odha li iikulya yawo.

Oya li ya kondwa mo maandjawo;
aantu oye ya kugile onkugo ya fa aafuthi.

Oya thiminikwa okukala momakololo
nomomakwena kohi yomamanya.

Oya kugu mokati kiihwa
noyi ingundu mumwe ye li mongoya.

Oya li aagoya naadhinwa
noya tidhwa mo moshilongo.

Ngashingeyi oyana otaa sheke ndje miiyimbo;
onda ningi omuhapo mokati kawo.

Otaa nyanyala ndje e taa kala ndje kokule;
inaa tila okuhiyila ndje omayeye moshipala.

Ngashingeyi sho Kalunga a nkundipaleke ndje nokwa fupipike ndje,
oya ponokele ndje mondjahi onene.

Aaponokeli otaa zi ndje kolulyo;
oya tegele ndje omwigo, opo ndi lyate mo.

Oya fulile ndje omakelo ga kunduka ndje,
ya hala okuyona ndje po pwaa na ekeelelo lyasha.

Sho nda kuthwa eshigo lyandje,
