Omuwa Omunankondoawike oku li pamwe natse;
Kalunga kaJakob oye omupopili gwetu.

Ileni, mu tale iilonga yOmuwa.
Konekeni iikumithalonga
mbyoka e yi longo kombanda yevi.

Oye a ti: “Etheni okukondja.
Shi tseyeni kutya ongame Kalunga, ndi li kombanda yiigwana
nokombanda yuuyuni auhe.”

Omuwa Omunankondoawike oku li pamwe natse;
Kalunga kaJakob oye omupopili gwetu.
47:
Aantu amuhe, hakeleni nenyanyu!
Hambeleleni Kalunga nomawi ga yeluka!

Omuwa gwokombandambanda oye e na okutilika;
oye omukwaniilwa omunene ta pangele uuyuni auhe.

Oye e tu sinditha aakuuyuni;
okwe tu pangelitha iigwana.

Okwe tu hogololele evi moka tu li,
eliko lyaantu ye e ya hole
noye li uvitile uuntsa.

Kalunga ota yi koshipangelapundi she.
Ope na oondjimbo dhenyanyu
nomahiko gomankuma, sho tu uka ko.

Imbileni Kalunga omahambelelondjimbo;
imbileni omukwaniilwa gwetu.

Kalunga oye omukwaniilwa guuyuni auhe;
mu hambeleleni noondjimbo!

Kalunga okwa kuutumba koshipangelapundi she oshiyapuki;
oye omupangeli gwiigwana.
48:
Omuwa oye omunene, i ilongela okusimanekwa
moshilando shaKalunga ketu,
kondundu ye ondjapuki.

Kalunga okwa holola kutya puye opu na egameno
meni lyomapopilongulu goshilando.

Aakwaniilwa oya gongala,
ye ya okumatukila ondundu Sion.

Ihe sho ya mono oshilando, oya kumwa;
oya tila e taa fadhuka po.

Oya adhika kuumbanda nokehaluko
ngaashi omusimba e li pokuvala,
nongoosikepa tadhi telaganithwa koshikungulu oshidhigu.

Otu uvu shoka Kalunga a longo,
nongashingeyi otwe shi mono moshilando shaKalunga,
Omuwa Omunankondoawike; ota gamene oshilando she sigo aluhe.

Motempeli yoye, Kalunga,
otatu dhimbulukwa esilohenda lyoye.

Oto hambelelwa kaakuuyuni ayehe,
edhina lyoye otali itaandelitha kombanda yevi alihe.
Oto pangele nuuyuuki.

Aantu ne yaKalunga, dhingolokeni Sion,
ne mu yalule ooshungo dhasho.

Konekeni omakuma ne mu tale omapopilongulu,
opo mu ka hokololele oluvalo lwokonakuyiwa:

“Kalunga ketu oye nguka aluhe sigo aluhe;
oye te ke tu enditha nomethimbo tali ya.”
49:
Kehe gumwe, pulakena!
Pulakeneni, ne aantu yomuuyuni auhe,

aawa naathigona,
aayamba noohepele.

Omadhiladhilo gandje ogomuule;
otandi popi oohapu dhoondunge.

Onda gama unene komayeletumbulo
notandi ga fatulula mokuhika okahumba.

Momathimbo guudhigu ine tila nando osha,
uuna nda kundukwa kaatondi,

kaadhudhu mbo haa inekele uuyamba wawo
nohaa inenepekele omaliko gawo ogendji.

oshoka ofuto molwomwenyo gwomuntu
onene noonkondo.
Shoka te shi futu ando,
itashi gwana.

Ofuto ndjoka itayi mu keelele mombila;
itayi mu kaleke nomwenyo sigo aluhe.

Kehe gumwe okwa tseya kutya
naanandunge wo ohaa si;
aagoya naathethe wo
okombila yu uka.
Ayehe mbaka omauyamba gawo
otaye ga thigile omaluvalo gawo.

Koneka sho tashi adha
mbo yi iyinekela yo yene,
shoka tashi ka tsakaneka
mboka ya gwanenwa komaliko.

Otaa si omulape ya fa oonzi,
neso otali ya landula ngomusita.
Omalutu gawo otaga olele mbala
muuyuni wokuusi kokule nomagumbo gawo,
yo itaa yelekwa naayuuki.

Ihe Kalunga ota popile ndje;
ota hupitha ndje moonyala dheso.

Ino piyaganekwa komuntu ngo ta ningi omuyamba,
ngele eliko lye tali indjipala;

Omuntu nando oku kale a gwana
mokukalamwenyo huno kwongashingeyi
nota simanekwa, sho e li nawa,

ota ka sa ashike ngaashi oohekulu,
oomboka ye li momilema dhaaluhe.
50:
Omuwa Kalunga Omunankondoawike ota popi;
oti ithana evi alihe okuza kuuzilo sigo okuuninginino.

Uuyelele waKalunga otau zi muSion,
moshilando sho opala, sho opalelela.

Oti ithana egulu nevi, ga ninge oonzapo oku mu tala,
sho ta pangula aantu ye.

Oye ta ti: “Ileni kungame,
aantu yandje aainekelwa,
mbo mwa dhike ehangano nangame mokuyambela ndje omayambo.”

Ewangandjo otali hokolola kutya Kalunga oye omuyuuki,
oshoka oye mwene omupanguli.

Itandi ku nyenyetelele omayambo goye
nomafikilondjambo ngoka ho etele ndje aluhe.

Ngame itandi pumbwa oondumetana dhomoohambo dhoye
nenge iikombo yomiigunda yoye.

Iithitukuti ayihe oyandje,
osho wo iimuna kiikulundundu yomayuvi.

Oondhila adhihe dhomiihwa odhandje
niinamwenyo ayihe yokelundu.

Ngele ando ondi niwe kondjala,
itandi shi ku lombwele,
oshoka uuyuni naashihe shi li mo, oshandje.

Ohandi li tuu onyama yoondumetana
nenge ndi nwe ombinzi yiikombo?

Pa Kalunga koye omayambo gomapandulo,
gwanithila Omunankondoawike omauvaneko goye.

Ihe komukolokoshi Kalunga ota ti ngeyi:
“Omolwashike to tumbula iipango yandje?
Oto popile shike ehangano lyandje?

Oho tindi, ndi ku pukulule;
oho ekelehi omalombwelo gandje.

Oho panga uukuume nomufuthi ngo to tsakaneke
noho itula kumwe naahondeli.

“Okana kwoye otaku popi aluhe uukolokoshi;
iho fudha inoo popya iifundja.

Aamwanyoko oto ya tamaneke
naana yanyoko oto ya pe uusama.

Owa longo ayihe mbika,
ihe ngame inandi tya sha.
Owa dhiladhila kutya onde ku fa.
Ihe ngashingeyi otandi ku nyenyetele
notandi ku ulukile epuko lyoye.

“Ne mboka hamu dhini ndje,
pulakeneni, opo ndaaye mu yone po,
nokaku na we ngoka te mu hupitha.

Omapandulo ogo omayambo gokusimaneka ndje,
notandi ka hupitha ayehe
mbo haa vulika kungame.”
51:
Kalunga, sila ndje ohenda
omoluuwanawa woye owindji.
Dhima po oondjo dhandje
omolwesilohenda lyoye enene.

Yoga ndje uuwinayi wandje auhe,
ngu u thete po ondjo yandje.

Omayono gandje onde ga dhimbulula;
oondjo dhandje odhi li aluhe momeho gandje.

Okungoye awike nda yono,
nonda ningi shoka ho shi tondo.
Onkee ano ino puka, sho to pangula ndje;
oshu uka, sho to geele ndje.

Ngame omulunde okuza kevalo,
okuza kesiku ndyoka nda valelwa muuyuni.

Ngoye oto pula, ndi kale moshili;
pe ndje omadhiladhilo ge na oondunge.

Isiikila, waa tale oondjo dhandje,
dhima po omayono gandje agehe.

Kalunga, shitila ndje omutima omuyogoki,
ngu u tule meni lyandje ombepo ompe noyevuliko.

Ino kutha ndje po koshipala shoye;
ngoye ino kutha ndje Ombepo yoye ondjapuki.

Pe ndje natango enyanyu lyomehupitho lyoye,
ngoye u ninge ndje omuvuliki.

Nena aalunde otandi ke ya longa okuvulika kiipango yoye,
notaa ka galukila kungoye.

Kalunga, omuhupithi gwandje,
keelela ndje ndaa dhipagwe,
notandi ka hokolola nenyanyu uuyuuki woye.

Omuwa, makula okana kandje,
e tandi ku hambelele.

Omayambo ito ga pumbwa, ando nde ge ku pe;
omafikilondjambo ino ga hokwa.

Kalunga, ombepo yi ishonopeka oyo eyambo lyandje,
omutima gwi itedhulula ito gu ekelehi.

Kalunga, sila Sion ohenda, ngu u mu kwathe;
tungulula omakuma gaJerusalem.

Nena oto ka nyanyukilwa omayambo gu uka nomafikilondjambo getu.
Oondumetana otadhi ka yambelwa koshiyambelo shoye.
52:
Munankondo ngoye,
omolwashike to inenepekele uukolokoshi woye?
Esilohenda lyaKalunga otali kala sigo aluhe.

Ou hole uukolokoshi peha lyuuwanawa
nou hole iifundja peha lyoshili.

Mufundja ngoye,
ou hole okupopya nayi yakweni!

Aayuuki otaye shi mono e taa tila;
otaye ku yolo e taa ti:

“Tala kunguka inaa pumbwa egameno lyaKalunga,
ihe okwi inekele uuyamba we owindji,
mokukolokosha omo a kongo egameno.”

Ihe ngame onda fa omuti gwomuolivi gwa mena megumbo lyaKalunga;
otandi inekele esilohenda lye aluhe sigo aluhe.

Kalunga, onda hala oku ku pandula aluhe;
ndi ku pandulile iilonga yoye.
Megongalo lyaantu yoye
otandi hokolola uuwanawa woye.
53:
Kalunga oku li megulu noto ontamene aantu kombanda yevi,
opo a tale, ngele oku na omunandunge
nongele oku na nando ogumwe te mu simaneke.

Ihe ayehe oya puguma; ayehe oya yonana.
Kaku na nando gumwe ta longo shoka shi li mondjila,
nando ogumwe.

“Aakolokoshi mbaka inaye shi tseya nani?” Kalunga ta pula.
“Oyo haa hupu mokuyuga aantu yandje
yo ihaa galikana ndje.”

Oyo taa ka adhika kehaluko enene inaaye li mona nale,
oshoka Kalunga ota ka halakanitha iipongo yaambo ye tonde aantu ye.
Kalunga okwe ya ekelehi,
naIsrael ote ke ya sinda thilu.

Ando muSion mu zile Israel ekwatho!
Uuna Omuwa ta ka hepulutha natango aantu ye,
nena Aaisraeli otaa ka nyanyukwa ngiini!
54:
Kalunga, hupitha ndje koonkondo dhoye;
mangulula ndje nomatha goye!

Kalunga, uva egalikano lyandje;
pulakena omatumbulo gandje!

Ihe Kalunga oye omukwathi gwandje.
Omuwa oye omupopili gwandje.

Kalunga na galulile aatondi yandje uukolokoshi wawo.
Ote ya yono po, oshoka oku shi kwiinekelwa.

Omuwa, onda hala oku ku yambela nenyanyu omayambo;
onda hala oku ku pandulila uuwanawa woye.

Owa hupitha ndje muudhigu wandje auhe,
onda tala aatondi yandje ya sindika.
55:
Kalunga, uva egalikano lyandje;
ino pilamena eindilo lyandje!

Pulakena e to yamukula ndje;
onda namekwa kiimpwiyu yandje.

Onda mbandamekwa komatilitho gaatondi,
onda thindilwa pevi komathiminiko gaakolokoshi.
Otaye etele ndje uudhigu;
oya geela ndje noye tonde ndje.

Onda tilithwa,
nomahalutho geso otaga thindi ndje.

Onda kwatwa ketilo nokekakamo,
uumbanda owa tono ndje.

Ando onda li nomawawa ngaashi onguti,
ando ote tuka, ndi ka konge evululuko.

Onda hala okutukila kokule
nokutungila egumbo mombuga.

Onda hala ndi ikongele nziya epopilongulu,
ndaa dhengwe kombepo nokoshikungulu.
Omuwa, piyaganeka okupopya kwaatondi yandje!

Moshilando ondi wete mo eyugo
niipotha tayi shi kunduka omutenya nuusiku,
oshu udha uudhudhu nuupyakadhi.

Akuhe oku na eyonuuko;
omapandaanda ogu udha ethiminiko nekotokelo.

Ando okwa li omutondi gwandje a sheke ndje,
ando onda vulu oku shi idhidhimikila;
ngele ando omukondjithi gwandje ti inenepekele ndje,
ando ote vulu oku mu holama.

Ihe ngo te shi ningi,
okuume kandje hatu kala naye, omwiinekelwa.

Moonkundathana, otwa li hatu egululilathana omitima
notwa galikana pamwe motempeli.

Eso nali kuthe po aatondi yandje, ethimbo manga inaali thika;
naa kulukile mbala mehala lyaasi ye na omwenyo!
Uuwinayi ou li momagumbo gawo
nomomitima dhawo.

Ihe ngame ote pula ekwatho kOmuwa Kalunga,
oye nota hupitha ndje.

Omayemato nomakemo gandje otaga thiki kuye
ongula, omutenya nuusiku, oye notu uvu ewi lyandje.

Oye ta galula ndje nombili kolugodhi,
sho nda li te kondjitha aatondi oyendji.

Kuume kandje konale okwa kondjitha ookuume ke;
ina gwanitha omauvaneko ge.

Oohapu dhe odhi na omuthenu gu vule gwomagadhi,
ihe oku na uutondwe momutima;
iitya ye oyi na omuheka,
ihe otayi tete ya fa omagonga ga tsa.

Uudhigu woye u fala kOmuwa, oye te ku popile;
ihe etha aayuuki ya sindike.

Ihe ngoye Kalunga oto hulitha po aadhipagi naafundja mboka,
manga etatakati lyokukalamwenyo kwawo inaali thika.
Ihe ngame onde ku inekela.
56:
Okuza ongula sigo okomatango
aakondjithi yandje otaa matukile ndje.
Oyendji mboka taa kondjitha ndje.

Uuna nda tila, onde ku inekela,
Omuwa Omunankondoawike.

Aatondi yandje otaa hindi ndje esiku alihe;
aluhe otaa uvanene okuningila ndje uuwinayi.

Otaa gongala e taa langele ndje.
Otaa tala shoka te longo,
opo ya dhipage ndje.

Kalunga, ya geelela uukolokoshi wawo;
sinda aantu mboka nondjahi yoye!

Esiku tandi ku ithana,
aatondi yandje otaa shuna lwaanima.
Ondi shi shi: Kalunga okwa gama kungame —
Omuwa ngoka tandi mu pandulile omauvaneko ge.

Onde mu inekela noite tila.
Omuntu ota ningi ndje shike?

Kalunga, otandi ku pe shoka nde shi uvaneke;
otandi ku pe omayambo gomapandulo,

Oshoka owa hupitha ndje meso
nowa gamene ndje, ndaa sindike.
Nena otandi ende koshipala shaKalunga,
omuuyelele waanamwenyo.
57:
Kalunga, sila ndje ohenda,
sila ndje ohenda, oshoka okungoye tandi kongo egameno.
Otandi holama momuzile gwomawawa goye,
sigo iikungulu iidhigu tayi kodha.

Otandi ithana Kalunga gwokombandambanda,
Kalunga ngo ha gwanithile ndje oompumbwe adhihe.

Oye ta yamukula ndje e li megulu
e ta hupitha ndje;
ota sindi aathiminiki yandje.
Kalunga ota hololele ndje esilohenda lye
nuudhiginini we.

Onda kondekwa kaatondi,
mbo ya fa oonime dha fukila onyama yomuntu.
Omayego gawo oga fa oomwele niikuti;
omalaka gawo oga fa omagonga ga tsa.

Kalunga, holola uunene woye kegulu
nesimano lyoye kombanda yevi alihe.

Aatondi yandje oyu umbu oshiyulitho shokuyula ndje;
onda tonwa kuudhigu.
Oyo ya fulile ndje ekelo mondjila,
ihe oya gwile mo yo yene.

Kalunga, ngame ondi na einekelo lya kola;
otandi imbi e tandi ku simaneke!

Mwenyo gwandje, penduka!
Okaharpa nokashandja kandje, imba!
Onda hala okupendutha etango.

Omuwa, otandi ku pandula mokati kiigwana.
Otandi ku simaneke mokati kaakuuyuni.

Ohole yoye yaa na ndjele, oya tsa kegulu;
uudhiginini woye otau thiki keyalelo.

Kalunga, holola uunene woye kegulu
nesimano lyoye kombanda yevi alihe.
58:
Ne aapangeli, ohamu tokola tuu pauyuuki?
Ohamu pangula tuu aantu ayehe shi thike pamwe?

Ihamu shi ningi!
Ohamu dhiladhila owala egeelo ndyo tamu ya pe
notamu eta uupwidhi neyugo moshilongo.

Aakolokoshi otaa tsikile uukolokoshi wawo;
ohaa fundju okuza kevalo lyawo.

Oyu udha uuzigo ya fa omayoka;
otaa thitike omakutsi gawo ya fa efu embolo,

ndyoka ihaali uvu ewi lyomunonomi gwomayoka,
neizizimo lyompulile onkulungu.
Kalunga, teya omayego goonime ndhika oonkolokoshi.

Naa kane po ongomeya taga pwine;
naa lyatelwe pevi ongomwiidhi gwomondjila.

Aantu otaa ti: “Aayuuki oya pewa ondjambi;
eeno, oku na Kalunga omupangeli guuyuni.”
59:
Kalunga kandje, hupitha ndje miikaha yaatondi yandje;
gamena ndje kumboka ya hala okuponokela ndje!

Hupitha ndje kaakolokoshi;
yululula ndje miikaha yaadhipagi!

Omuwa, hamolweyono lyasha ando nde li ninga,
sho taa matukile komahala gawo.

Pethimbo lyongulohi otaa galuka
notaa ulula ya fa oombwa, sho taa ende moshilando.

Pulakena komasheko nomatilitho gawo.
Omalaka gomomakana gawo oga fa omagonga,
ihe otaa dhiladhila kutya kaku na ngoka e ya pulakena.

Ihe ngoye, Omuwa, oto ya yolo;
oto sheke aapagani ayehe.

Ngame ondi inekela oonkondo dhoye;
ongoye epopilongulu lyandje, Kalunga.

Kalunga kandje oku hole ndje note ya kungame;
oye ta talitha ndje okusindika kwaatondi yandje.

Kalunga, ino ya dhipaga po,
opo oshigwana shandje shaaye shi dhimbwe.
Ya halakanitha noonkondo dhoye
e to ya sindi,
Omuwa, omugameni gwetu.

Oondjo odhi li komilungu dhawo;
oohapu dhawo adhihe odhuulunde.
Naa kwatelwe muuntsa wawo,
oshoka ohaa tukana e taa fundju.

Ya geela wa sa ondjahi; ya yona po thiluthilu.
Nena kehe gumwe ota ka tseya kutya Kalunga oye omupangeli muIsrael,
nepangelo lye otali adha sigo okooha dhuuyuni.

Ongulohi aatondi yandje otaa galuka,
otaa ulula ya fa oombwa,
sho tadhi ende moshilando,

ongoombwa tadhi kongo iikulya notadhi nkwina,
ngele inadhi mona sha.

Ihe ngame otandi imbi omolwoonkondo dhoye;
kehe ongula otandi imbi mokule omolwesilohenda lyoye.
Owa kala egameno lyandje,
epopilongulu lyandje methimbo lyuudhigu.

Otandi ku pandula, omupopili gwandje.
Kalunga oye egameno lyandje,
Kalunga ngoka e hole ndje.
60:
Kalunga, owe tu ekelehi nowe tu halakanitha po;
owe tu geele, ihe ngashingeyi tu sila ohenda ishewe.

Owa kakamitha evi, nowe li tendeke omusa;
ngashingeyi hondja omisa dhalyo, oshoka otali tatuka.

Aantu yoye owe ya tsike uudhigu uunene;
otwa tantala ongaantu ya kolwa.

Mboka haa ku tila owe ya londodha,
opo ya ye epangulo ontuku.

Kalunga okwa popi e li muuyapuki we:
“Mesindano otandi tende Shekem
nolusilu lwaSukkot otandi lu topolele aantu yandje.

Moab osho oshiyaha shandje shokwiiyogela
notandi ka umbila Edom oongaku dhandje,
okuholola kutya ongame mwene gwasho.
Aafilisti, inamu nyanyukilwa edhiladhilo ndyoka
kutya omwa sinda ndje.”

Kalunga,
olye ta fala ndje moshilando sha kola?
Olye ta thindikile ndje kuEdom?

Owe tu ekelahi nani?
To ka enda tuu pamwe nomatangakwiita getu?

Tu kwatha mokukondjitha aatondi yetu.
Ekwatho lyomuntu kali na shilonga.

Pamwe naKalunga otatu ka sindana;
otatu ka sinda aatondi yetu.
61:
Kalunga, pulakena okulila kwandje;
uva egalikano lyandje.

Mokwaanetegameno nomokukala kokule noyaandjetu
otandi ku ithana!
Londeka ndje puule,

oshoka ongoye omugameni gwandje,
epopilongulu lyandje lya kola kaatondi yandje!

Kaleka ndje muuyapuki woye sigo aluhe;
tula ndje megameno kohi yomawawa goye.

Kalunga, owu uvu omauvaneko gandje,
nowa pe ndje oshipewa shaamboka haye ku simaneke.

Komasiku gomukwaniilwa gwedhela ko oomvula odhindji;
lelepeka okukalamwenyo kwe!

Na pangele aluhe koshipala shoye, Kalunga;
mu gamena nesilohenda nuudhiginini woye.

Onkee ano otandi ke ku imbila aluhe omahambelelo,
sho tii ku pe esiku kehe shoka nde shi uvaneke.
62:
Sigo uunake ne amuhe tamu kondjitha omuntu gumwe,
ngoka oshimbembe a fa olukutu lwa kulupa?

Otamu kundathana okuhulitha po esimano lye;
omu hole iifundja.
Momakana otamu tumbula omayambeko,
ihe momitima otamu sheke.

Omwenyo gwandje, omuKalunga amuke to mono evululuko;
omuye awike u na etegameno.

Oye awike ta gamene ndje nota hupitha ndje.
Oye epopilongulu lyandje,
ite sindika.

Ehupitho lyandje nesimano lyandje
oli li muKalunga;
oye emanya lyandje lya kola
nepopilongulu lyandje.

Aantu ne, inekeleni aluhe Kalunga.
Anekeni omaudhigu geni koshipala she,
oshoka oye omupopili gwetu.

Olwindji ondu uvu Kalunga ta popi ta ti,
oye Kalunga omunankondo,

oye Omuwa omunahole.
Eeno, ota futu kehe omuntu
shi thike piilonga ye.
63:
Kalunga, ongoye Kalunga kandje,
otandi ku kongo.
Onde ku yuulukwa nda mana mo;
ngaashi evi lya kukuta lya sa oluteni,
osho omwenyo gwandje gwe ku yuulukwa.

Nandi ku mone u li muuyapuki woye;
nandi tale oonkondo nesimano lyoye.

Okusilwa ohenda kungoye oku vulile ndje okukala nomufudho,
notandi ke ku simaneka.

Onda hala oku ku hambelela, manga ndi na omwenyo;
megalikano otandi yeluthile omaako gandje kungoye.

Omwenyo gwandje otagu kuta ongaashi moshituthi;
omilungu nokana kandje otake ku tanga.

Otandi ku dhimbulukwa mokukala kwandje;
otandi ku dhiladhila miikako yuusiku,

oshoka ongoye ekwatho lyandje,
momuzile gwomawawa goye
otandi imbi nokunyanyukwa.

Otandi ku dhama;
oshikaha shoye osha gamena ndje.

Mbo taa kongo omwenyo gwandje,
otaa ka kulukila meso.

Otaa ka lika po kegongamwele
notaa ka ninga oondya dhoombandje.

Ihe omukwaniilwa ota ka nyanyukwa,
oshoka Kalunga ote mu pe esindano.
Ayehe mbo haa uvaneke medhina lyaKalunga,
otaa ke mu hambelela,
ihe omakana gaafundja otaga ka mwenekwa.
64:
Kalunga, uva ndje mokulila kwandje;
gamena omwenyo gwandje komatilitho gaatondi.

Holeka ndje omolwondjuvanena yaadhudhu
nongundu yaakolokoshi.

Otaa upike omalaka gawo ngaashi omagonga;
otaa zi iitya iilulu ya fa omaholongo.

Otaa uluma okutaandelitha iifundja yawo;
omuyuuki otaye mu langele e taye mu yaha.

Otaa kolekelathana mokulonga uukolokoshi
notaa uvanene, nkene ye na okutega oomwigo dhawo.
Otaa ti: “Olye te dhi mono?”

Otaa uvanene okulonga uudhudhu
e taa ti: “Otu na ompangela ya kola.”
Omutima gwomuntu oshilongo shi ili.

Ihe Kalunga ote ya yaha niikuti ye,
e taa gwile po mbala.

Aayuuki naa nyanyukilwe Omuwa
yo naa konge eholameno muye.
Ayehe mboka yaa na iihelele,
otaye ke mu hambelela.
65:
Kalunga, osho opala oku ku hambelela muSion;
otatu ku gwanithile omauvaneko getu.

Eeno, ongoye nguka ho uvu omagalikano.
Aantu ayehe otaye ya kungoye omolwoondjo dhawo

Omayono getu oge tu tono,
ihe owe ga dhimi po.

Aanelago oomboka we ya hogolola
nowe ya kaleke muuyapuki woye.
Otatu ka kuta kuuwanawa womegumbo lyoye,
otempeli yoye ondjapuki.

Kalunga omuhupithi gwetu,
owe tu yamukula miilonga yoye iikumithi sho we tu hupitha.
Aantu yomuuyuni auhe noyokombanda yomafuta
otaye ku inekele.

Owa thikameke po oondundu koonkondo dhoye;
omatha ogo omuzalo gwoye.

Aakali kombanda yevi otaa kuminwa iinyengandunge yoye.
Aantu yokoombinga adhihe dhevi
otaye ku hambelele.

Evi oho li sile oshimpwiyu, sho ho li tekele;
oho li yambapaleke.
Omilonga dhaKalunga odhu udha omeya okupa aantu iilya,
oshoka osho we li tulile po.

Oto tutike omasilu gevi
noto yelekanitha iituntu yalyo.
Oto li nengeneke niihomo,
niimeno yalyo oto yi yambeke.

Oto gandja eteyo ewanawa;
iinkoti yoye oyu udha uuyamba.

Omalundu oga ziza;
oondundu odha nyanyukwa.
66: Aantu amuhe, hambeleleni Kalunga!

Tangeni esimano lyedhina lye;
mu simanekeni nokuhambelela!

Tyeni kuKalunga:
“Iilonga yoye iikumithi ngiini!
Oonkondo dhoye odho oonene,
sho aatondi yoye taye ku tsile oongolo ya tila.

Ileni, mu tale iilonga yaKalunga,
iikumitha ye mokati kaantu.

Aantu ne, simanekeni Kalunga ketu;
omaimbilo gepandulo naga uvike.

Okwe tu kaleke nomwenyo
nokwe tu gamene twaa punduke.

Kalunga, owe tu yeleke;
ngaashi oshisiliveli hashi yelithwa momulilo.

Owe tu ethele momwigo
nowe tu tsike omitenge omidhigu koothingo dhetu.

Otandi eta omafikilondjambo kotempeli yoye;
otandi ku gwanithile omauvaneko gandje.

Otandi ku pe ngaashi nda popile,
sho nda li muudhigu.

Ileni, pulakeneni amuhe mboka hamu tila Kalunga.
Otandi mu lombwele shoka Kalunga e shi ningile ndje.

Otandi mu kugile ekwatho;
otandi mu hambelele noondjimbo.

Ando onda li nda mwenena oondjo dhandje inaandi dhi hempulula,
ando Omuwa ina uva ndje.

Ihe Kalunga oku uva ndje;
oku uva egalikano lyandje.

Otandi hambelele Kalunga,
sho inaa tinda eindilo lyandje,
ye a kale ando itaa sile ndje ohenda.
67:
Kalunga, aantu ayehe naye ku simaneke;
aantu ayehe naye ku hambelele!

Iigwana nayi nyanyukwe yo nayi ligole,
oshoka oto pangula aantu shi thike pamwe
noto wilike oshigwana kehe kombanda yevi.

Kalunga, aantu naye ku pe esimano;
aantu ayehe naye ku hambelele!

Evi olya menitha iimeno yalyo;
Kalunga, Kalunga ketu okwe tu yambeke.
68:
Kalunga okwa thikama nokwa tidha po aatondi.
Mboka haa tsu ondumbo naye,
naa ye ontuku.

Imbileni Kalunga, imbeni nokusimaneka edhina lye;
longekidheni epola lyaanguka he ende miikogo.
Omuwa olyo edhina lye —
nyanyukweni koshipala she.

Oye ta pe omapongo omagumbo,
ota piitha mo oonkwatwa e te ya pe emanguluko,
ihe oonakwaavulika otaa ka kala
mevi lya lokota komutenya.

Kalunga, owa kwatele komeho aantu yoye,
sho we ende nayo mombuga.

Evi olya kakama, negulu olya lokitha omvula
omolwokuholoka kwaKalunga puSinai,
eholoko lyaKalunga kaIsrael.

Kalunga, owa gandja omvula ya gwana;
owa mwenyeke evi lya li lya kukuta.

Omuwa okwa gandja oshipango
naakiintu oyendji oya ningi aayuvithi

“Aakwaniilwa naakwiita yawo otaa yi ontuku.”
Aakiintu momagumbo otaa topola oshihakanwa:

iifetha yoonguti dha kolongithwa oshisiliveli,
nomawawa gadho taga tayima oshingolilela,
omanga yamwe yomuyo ye li mokati koonzi.

Kalunga Omunankondoawike
sho a halakanitha aakwaniilwa mbeya,
osha li sha fa oompawe tadhi loko kondundu Salmon.

Ondundu Baasha oya tumbalala,
ondundu yomitse omile!

Ne oondundu dhomitse odhindji,
omolwashike mwa sila efupa ondundu ndjoka
Omuwa Kalunga a hogolola a kale ko sigo aluhe?

Omatembakwiita gaKalunga ogo omayuvi ogendji;
Omuwa okwa zi kuSinai e te ya motempeli ye ondjapuki.

Sho a yi kombandambanda,
okwa faalele oonkwatwa;
okwa pewa oombalagelo kaantu nokoonakwaavulika wo —
Omuwa Kalunga oko ta ka kala aluheluhe.

Esimano nali pewe Omuwa Kalunga, omuhupithi gwetu;
ngoka ta humbata omaudhigu getu esiku kehe.

Kalunga ketu oye Kalunga ha hupitha;
Omuwa ngoka te tu hupitha meso.

Kalunga ota ka keka ko omitse dhaatondi ye,
odhaamboka taa tsikile okuyona kwawo.

Omuwa okwa ti:
“Aatondi yeni otaye ke mu galukila taa zi kuBaasha,
kohi yefuta otii ya kutha ko,

opo mu ke ende mombinzi yaatondi yeni,
manga oombwa dheni tadhi shakumine ombinzi yawo.”

Komeholela oku na aaimbi,
taku landula aahiki yuuhumba,
pamwe nayo aakadhona aahiki yoontunda.

Simanekeni Kalunga megongalo lyaantu ye;
hambeleleni Omuwa megongalo lyaIsrael.

Ezimo enkelo lyaBenjamin olyo lye ya kwatela komeho,
opo ihe aana yokombanda yaJuda pamwe nongundu yawo,
notaku landula aana yokombanda yaSebulon naNaftali.

Kalunga, holola oonkondo dhoye;
ulika oonkondo dhoye ngaashi shito.

Dhi holola motempeli yoye muJerusalem,
moka aakwaniilwa taa ku etele omagano.

Ganda Egipiti, oshilikama shoka mokati komanenge,
oshigunda shoontsezi mokati kuutaagona!
Ayihe ngele yi igandja,
otayi ke ku tsila oongolo
e tayi ku pe oshisiliveli.
Halakanitha aantu mbo ye hole okuhinga iita.

Imbileni Kalunga, omapangelo gokombanda yevi,
simanekeni Omuwa!

Oonguka te ende miikogo, mewangandjo lyonalenale;
uveni ngu ta ndunduma newi enene.
69:
Kalunga, hupitha ndje,
oshoka omeya oga tsa ndje pothingo.

Onda vulwa kokwiithana ekwatho
omuligu gwandje ogwa thita.
Omeho gandje otaga nyengwa okumona Kalunga kandje.

Mbo ye tonde ndje pwaa na etompelo,
oye vule omwaalu gwomafufu gokomutse gwandje.
Oyendji oya ningi aatondi yandje,
nando inandi ya ninga sha;
oya hala okudhipaga ndje.
Otandi thiminikwa okufuta shoka inaandi shi yaka.

Kalunga, omayono gandje inage ku holekwa;
omapuko gandje owe ga tseya.

Mboka ye na etegameno lyawo mungoye,
inaa sithwa ohoni molwandje,
Omuwa Omupangeliawike nOmunankondoawike.
Mboka haye ku kongo, inaa sithwa ohoni molwandje,
Kalunga kaIsrael!

Oshoka ondi idhidhimikile esheko omolwoye
nonda humbata esithohoni.

Onda ningi ondjendi mokati kaamwatate,
omukwiilongo mokati kaana yameme.

Oshoka uulaadhi omolwongulu yoye otau thiminike ndje,
nomasheko gaambo haa ku sheke, oga gwile ndje.

Uuna ndi ifupipike nokwiidhilika,
nena aantu oya sheke ndje;

uuna nda zala ehahi lyokuholola oluhodhi,
aantu oya yolo ndje.

Mbo ya kuutumba peelo lyegumbo,
otaa sheke ndje,
nonda ningi eimbilo lyoonkolwi.

Ihe ngame otandi ku indile, Omuwa,
yamukula ndje pethimbo lye ku opalela.
Kalunga, omolwohole yoye onene
yamukula ndje,
oshoka ongoye omuhupithi.

Omuwa, yamukula ndje omolwohole yoye;
tala ndje omolwesilohenda lyoye enene.

Omupiya gwoye ino mu pilamena;
yamukula ndje mbala, ondi li muudhigu.

Hedha ndje popepi, u hupitha ndje;
hupitha ndje omolwaatondi yandje.

Owa tseya, nkene nda shekwa,
nda fupipikwa nonda sithwa ohoni.
Aatondi yandje ayehe oye li montaneho yoye.

Oya tulile ndje onyango miikulya, sho nda li nda sa ondjala;
noya pe ndje omaviinu omalulu, sho nda sa enota.

Omatelekela gawo nage ya etele epunduko,
noondjambo dhawo nadhi ya fale meyonuuko.

Tsikitha omeho gawo!
Andalaleka oombunda dhawo sigo aluhe!

Tilila ondjahi yoye kombanda yawo;
ongeyo yoye nayi ya hwamene.

Oontanda dhawo nadhi tembukiwe, mootenda dhawo
inamu pitikwa mu kale nando olye.

Kaleka oondjo dhawo membo lyoye,
ngoye ino ya mangulula.

Naa dhimwe mo membo lyaanamwenyo
noino ya yalulila membo lyaayuuki.

Ondi na uuwehame nonda kanitha omukumo;
Kalunga, hupitha ndje ngu u gamene ndje.

Otandi ka simaneka edhina lyaKalunga
notandi mu pandula noku mu hambelela.

Shika otashi hokiwa kOmuwa shi vule omayambo giimuna,
oshi vule eyambo lyoondumetana.

Omuwa ohu uvu omaindilo goohepele,
ye iha dhimbwa oonkwatwa moondholongo.

Egulu nevi nali mu simaneke,
naashihe hashi inyenge momafuta.

Oshoka Omuwa ota hupitha Jerusalem
nota ka tungulula iilando yaJuda.
Nena aantu ye otaa ka tula mo
e taye shi lala.

Aana yaapiya ye otaa ke shi thigulula,
naamboka ye hole edhina lye,
otaa ka kala mo.
70:
Kalunga, hupitha ndje!
Omuwa, hupitha ndje mbala!

Mbo taa kongo omwenyo gwandje,
naa sithwe ohoni e taa piyagana.
Mbo ya hala ndi shunduke,
naa shunithwe ya gugwa.

Mbo taa yolo ndje ongandja,
naa shunithwe ya sa ohoni.

Ayehe mboka taa ya kungoye,
naa nyanyukwe e taa ligola.
Ayehe mboka ye hole ehupitho lyoye,
aluhe naa tye: “Kalunga omunene ngiini!”
71:
Omuwa, omungoye awike te holama;
ino etha ndi sindike.

Kalunga kandje, hupitha ndje miikaha yaakaanakalunga,
moonkondo dhaakolokoshi nodhaadhudhu.

Oshoka ongoye awike etegameno lyandje,
onde ku inekela okuza muugundjuka wandje.

Onda ningi nda fa ndaa shi omuntu momeho goyendji,
ihe ongoye egameno lyandje.

Otandi ku hambelele esiku kehe
notandi tseyitha esimano lyoye.

Ino ekelahi ndje,
sho ndaa na oonkondo.

Kalunga, ino kala ndje kokule;
Kalunga kandje, endelela, u kwathe ndje.

Ihe ngame otandi kala aluhe nde ku inekela;
otandi ku simaneke aluhe sigo aluhe.

Otandi ka hokolola iilonga yoye iiwanawa;
esiku kehe ondi na okutya:
“Ongoye omuhupithi,”
nonando ote nyengwa oku shi fatulula nawa.

Kalunga, owa longo ndje okuza muugundjuka,
sigo onena otandi uvitha iilonga yoye iikumithi.

Ngashingeyi sho nda kulupa nondi na oomvi,
ino etha ndje, Kalunga!
Kala pungame, sho te tseyitha oonkondo niikumitha yoye komaluvalo taga landula.

Uukuluntu wandje u indjipalitha
ngu u talaleke ndje ishewe.

Otandi ku hambelele nokaharpa;
Kalunga kandje, otandi ku pandula,
oshoka ou shi kwiinekelwa.
Otandi ku imbile nokaharpa, Omuyapuki gwaIsrael.

Omilungu dhandje nadhi makuke kenyanyu,
ngame ngaashi ndi li, otandi ku hambelele,
oshoka owa hupitha ndje.

Esiku alihe otandi ka tumbula iilonga yuuyuuki woye,
oshoka mbo ya li ya halele ndje oshiponga,
oya mwenekwa e taa sithwa ohoni.
72:
Kalunga, longa omukwaniilwa,
a tokole oohapu pauyuuki woye.
Mu lombwela, a landule eutho lyoye,

opo a pangule aantu yoye pauyuuki,
naathiminikwa e ya uthile nawa.

Oondundu nadhi etele aantu uuyamba,
niikulundundu nayi ze uuwanawa.

Omukwaniilwa na popile aathiminikwa moshigwana;
na kwathe oohepele e ta tidha po aahepeki.

Manga etango li li ko, nomwedhi tagu monika,
aantu yoye naye ku simaneke.

Omukwaniilwa na kale naalelwa ye ngaashi omvula niimeno,
omvula yomuzimbi tayi tutike evi.

Na pangele okuza kefuta sigo okefuta ekwawo,
okuza kuEufrat sigo okooha dhuuyuni.

Aakali mombuga otaa ke mu tsila oongolo,
naatondi ye otaa ki ihata po.

Aakwaniilwa yokuSpania naamboka yokoontuntu
otaa ke mu etela oombalagelo;
aakwaniilwa yokuSheba noyokuSeba
otaa ke mu etela omagano.

Aakwaniilwa ayehe otaye ke mu tsila oongolo;
iigwana ayihe otayi ke mu longela.

Ota hupitha ohepele ngo te mu lilile,
omuthiminikwa ngo kee na ngo te mu kwatha.

Ota sile oshimbembe nohepele olukeno
note ya hupitha meso.

Ote ya hupitha methiminiko nomepiyagano,
oshoka oomwenyo dhawo odhi na ondilo momeho ge.

Omukwaniilwa na kale aluhe nomwenyo!
Ne etelwe oshingoli shokuSheba.
Aantu naye mu galikanene aluhe
yo naye mu halele omayambeko gaKalunga esiku kehe.

Moshilongo namu kale eloolo lyiilya;
kiikulundundu naku kale omapya,
niiyimati nayi monike ngaashi yokuLibanon.
Iilando nayi udhe aantu
ngaashi omwiidhi gwokelundu.

Edhina lyomukwaniilwa nali simane sigo aluhe;
nali kale ko ngaashi etango li li kegulu.
Iigwana ayihe otayi ka yambekwa omolwe
notayi ke mu ithana
“Omulalekwa nuuyamba.”

Esimano nali ninge lyOmuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael!
Oye awike ha longo iikumitha ya tya ngeyi.

Esimano nali ninge lyedhina lye sigo aluhe!
Eadhimo lye nali udhithe uuyuni auhe.
Amen! Amen!
Omagalikano gaDavid yaIsai oga hulile mpaka.
73:
Kalunga oye omwaanawa shili kuIsrael,
kumboka ye na oomwenyo dha yela.

Ihe ngame ando nda kanitha einekelo;
okonyala ndaa na we eitaalo,

oshoka onda li nda sila aainenepeki efupa,
sho nda mono uulinawa waakaanakalunga.
Ihaya alukwa; oye na oonkondo nuundjolowele.

Inaa adhika komaudhigu ngaashi aantu yalwe;
inaya ala komavu ngaashi yalwe.

Onkee ano uuntsa otau kala wa fa iimona yoompole moothingo dhawo;
epiyagano otali ya siikile ngaashi onguwo.

Omitima dhawo otadhi fuluka uuwinayi;
omadhiladhilo gawo otaga tungu oompangela dhuukolokoshi.

Otaa sheke Kalunga e li megulu;
taa tumbula omalombwelo guuntsa kaakali kombanda yevi.

Onkee ano aantu otaye ya pulakene
e taa itaale kehe shoka taa ti.

Otaa ti: “Kalunga ite shi tseya;
gwokombandambanda ite shi dhimbulula.”

Aakaanakalunga osho naanaa ye li ngaaka;
aluhe oye na uupu, nomaliko gawo otaga indjipala.

Itashi kwatha sha nani,
sho ndi ikeelele kuuwinayi nonda kala inee yona?

Kalunga, esiku alihe owa dhenge ndje nomeehamo;
owa geele ndje esiku kehe.

Ando onda tumbulile oohapu dha tya ngawo,
ando onda ningi shoka inaashi opala okuuvika mokati kaantu yoye.

Sho nda kambadhala okudhiladhila oshinima shino,
oshe etele ndje uudhigu.

Ihe sho nde ya mongulu yaKalunga,
nena ondu uvu ko kutya oshike tashi ka ningilwa aakaanakalunga.

Oto ke ya enditha pehala tali pundukitha
noto ke ya undulila meyonuuko.

Mbalambala otaa kana po;
otaa kulukile mehanagulo.

Ngaashi omuntu ta penduthwa kondjodhi,
osho taa ka kana po,
uuna Omuwa to iholola.

Ano omwenyo gwandje sho gwa li gwa geye,
niitiyanathigo sho ya tsu ndje,

onda ningi egoya, kandi uvite ko sha,
nda li nda fa oshiyamakuti koshipala shoye.

Ihe nando ongeyi, ondi li aluhe pungoye;
owa kwata ndje koshikaha.

Otandi wilikwa komaudhikilo goye,
nopehulilo oto ka thikitha ndje meadhimo.

Kaku na we gulwe e ku vulile ndje,
megulu nenge kombanda yevi.

Mbo ye li kokule nangoye,
otaa ka yonuka po;
ayehe mbo yaa shi kwiinekelwa,
oto ya kombo po.

Ihe ngame, osho opalela ndje okukala popepi naKalunga.
Omuwa Omupangeliawike onde mu ningi egameno lyandje,
niilonga ye ayihe otandi ke yi hokolola.
74:
Kalunga, omolwashike we tu ekelehi ngeyi?
Oto geele oonzi dhuusita woye sigo aluhe?

Enda momakulukuma ngaka;
aatondi oya hanagula po ashihe motempeli.

Aatondi oya dhanene pehala lyoye eyapuki;
oya dhike po omapandela gawo.
Oya li ya fa aalumentu taa kwata omakuya e taa keke po okuti.
Oya hanagula po iikwashiti ayihe nomakuya nonoosilwa dhawo.

Oya fike po otempeli yoye
noya nyateke ehala mpo ho simanekelwa.

Oya popi ya ti: “Otatu ya kombo po thilu!”
Ehala kehe moshilongo lyokusimaneka Kalunga oye li fike po.

Kalunga, sigo uunake aatondi taye ku sheke?
Otaa ethiwa, ya tumbule owala edhina lyoye?

Omolwashike itoo tu kwatha?
Omolwashike itoo ganeke oshikaha shoye, u ya yone po?

Kalunga, ongoye omukwaniilwa gwetu okuza konale;
owa kala omuhupithi gwetu.

Owa topola efuta noonkondo dhoye;
owa nyanyula omitse dhiilyani yomomeya.

Owa tete ko omitse dhevovo,
nolya ningi oondya dhiilikama yomombuga.

Owe egulula oothithiya nomilonga dhomevi
nowa pwinike omilonga ndhoka hadhi tondoka ethimbo alihe.

Owa shiti omutenya nosho wo uusiku;
owa tula ko etango nomwedhi.

Ongoye wa tende oongamba dhevi;
owa tula ko othinge nokufu.

Omuwa, tala aatondi yoye, nkene taye ku sheke,
aagoya, nkene ya dhini edhina lyoye.

Ino gandja oomwenyo dhomapongo kiilikama;
ino dhimbwa aantu yoye aatidhaganwa.

Dhimbulukwa ehangano ndyo wa hangana natse;
oshilongo oshu udha omahalutho nepiyagano.

Ino etha aathiminikwa ya sithwe ohoni;
oohepele nomapongo nage ku pandule.

Kalunga, thikama, u ipopile!
Aagoya otaa ku yolo ethimbo alihe.
Tala, aatondi otaa tumbula omatilitho nomahalutho ethimbo kehe.
75:
Otatu ku hambelele, Kalunga, otatu ku pandula,
oshoka ou li popepi natse.
Otatu hokolola esimano lyoye
notatu uvitha iikumithalonga yoye.

Evi nando li kakame,
nakehe shoka shi na omwenyo nando nashi tile,
otandi li kwata lyaa tenguke.

Otandi lombwele aakaanakalunga,
ye ethe uuntsa wawo.

Otandi ya lombwele,
ye ethe okutuwalala kwawo.”

Esimano itali zi kuuzilo nenge kuuninginino,
nohakombuga.

Oye Kalunga ngoka ta pangula,
ota geele yamwe e ta mangulula yakwawo.

Moshikaha shOmuwa omu na oshitenga shomaviinu ga tutumika
noga vongakanithwa niigwanga iilulu.
Oye okwa pimpi oshitenga shondjahi ye,
naakaanakalunga ayehe yokombanda yevi
otaye ga nu po nehete lyago.

Ihe ngame ondi na oku shi hokolola sigo aluhe;
otandi simaneke aluhe Kalunga kaJakob.

Kalunga ota hanagula po oonkondo dhaakaanakalunga,
ihe aayuuki ote ya nenepeke.
76:
Kalunga okwa tseyika muJuda;
edhina lye olya simana muIsrael.

Okwa dhikile etsali muJerusalem;
omutumba gwe ogu li muSion.

Omo moka a hanagula po iikuti yaatondi,
omahuuyanza nomagonga niikondjitho yawo ayihe.

Omuwa, eadhimo lyoye enene ngiini!
Esimano lyoye ekumithi, sho wa galuka koondundu hoka wa sindi aatondi yoye.

Kegando lyoye, Kalunga kaJakob,
uukambe naakayili yawo oya si.

Omuwa, ongoye awike u na okutilika.
Kaku na ngo ta vulu okukala koshipala shoye,
uuna wa geya.

Epangulo owe li tumbula u li megulu;
uuyuni owa tila e tau mwena thilu,
sho wa thikama, u pangele nou hupithe aathiminikwa kombanda yevi.

Ondjahi yaantu otayi ka hulila moku ku simaneka,
naamboka taa hupu miita,
otaa ke ku pandula.

Uvanekela Omuwa Kalunga koye omauvaneko
e to ga tsakanitha;
iilongo ayihe yopuushiinda
nayi ete oombalagelo kunguka e na okutilika.

Kalunga ota shonopeke aapangeli aanuuntsa;
ota tilitha aakwaniilwa yomuuyuni.
77:
Otandi kugu kuKalunga;
otandi mu ithana, oye notu uvu ndje.

Otandi ku dhiladhila, Kalunga, e tandi tongo;
onda kunkwa nonda sholola.

Onda tonata uusiku auhe; ondi na uudhigu
noite vulu okupopya.

Onda dhiladhila omasiku gonale
nonda dhimbulukwa onakuziwa.
Onda lala te dhiladhila nondi ipula nda ti:

“Kalunga okwe tu ekelehi sigo aluhe?
Ite tu sile we ohenda?

Ohole ye yaaluhe oya hulu po?
Euvaneko lye itali tsakanithwa we?

Kalunga okwa dhimbwa kutya oye omunesilohenda?
Ongeyo ye oya kutha po olukeno lwe?”

Ngame onda ti:
“Otashi ehameke ndje unene,
sho oshikaha shaKalunga sha nkundipala.”

Itandi ka dhimbwa nando iilongankondo yoye, Omuwa;
otandi ka dhimbulukwa iikumithalonga yoye yonale.

Ote kala nokutedhatedha iilongankondo yoye;
otandi dhimbulukwa iilonga yoye iinene.

Iilonga yoye ayihe oya yapuka;
kaku na gulwe omunene a fa Kalunga ketu.

Ongoye Kalunga ho longo iikumitha;
ho holola oonkondo dhoye mokati kaantu.

Owa hupitha aantu yoye noshikaha shoye shoonkondo;
oluvalo lwaJakob naJosef.

Kalunga, omeya oge ku mono e taga tila;
efuta ele olya kakama.

Iikogo oya tilehi omeya;
kegulu okwa zi omityalakato noombadhi dha shela koombinga adhihe.

Owe enditha aantu yoye ngaashi oshigunda shoonzi,
omewiliko lyaMoses naAaron.
78:
Aantu yandje, pulakeneni omalongo gandje;
uvii ko oohapu dhandje.

Otandi longitha iipopiwamayele;
otandi fatulula iiholekwa yonakuziwa.

Otandi popi iinima twe yi uva notu yi shi;
iinima twe yi lombwelwa kootate yonale.

Omuwa okwa pe Aaisraeli iipango
nokwa pe oluvalo lwaJakob omautho.
Okwa lombwele ootatekulu omalongo ngoka ye na oku ga longa oyana.

Oluvalo lwokomeho opo lu tseye iipango yOmuwa,
naamboka inaa valwa natango,
otaa tegelelwa ye ke yi longe oyana.

Osho ngeyi otaa ki inekela Kalunga
noitaa ka dhimbwa iilonga ye,
ihe otaa ka vulika kiipango ye.

Itaa ka fa nando oohekulu
mbo ya kala aapandala yo ihaa vulika.
Oya li inaa igameka kuKalunga
noinaye mu inekela.

Aalumentu Aaefraim oya li ya homata,
aayumbi yomatati ya pyokoka,
ihe molugodhi oya sindika.

Inaa dhiginina ehangano naKalunga;
oya tindi okuvulika kiipango ye.

Oya dhimbwa shoka e shi ningi,
iikumitha mbyoka ya mono te yi longo.

Omuwa okwa longo iikumitha
montaneho yoohekulu muEgipiti, melundu lyaZoan

Okwa taula efuta nokwe ya pititha mo;
okwa thikameke omeya ngaashi oontuni.

Omutenya Omuwa okwe ya wilike noshikogo shomuzile,
nuusiku okwe ya minikile nonyeka yuuyelele.

Mombuga okwa tatula emanya
nokwe ya pe omeya ogendji.

Okwe ya egululile oothithiya memanya
nokwa pimpile omeya pevi ngaashi gomulonga.

Ihe oya tsikile okuyona kuKalunga;
mombuga inaa vulika kungoka gwokombandambanda.

Oya makele Kalunga owina,
sho ye mu pula iikulya.

Oya dhini Kalunga, sho ya ti:
“Kalunga ota vulu tuu okugandja iikulya mombuga?

Otwa mona ngaa kutya okwa dhenge emanya,
omeya noga pimpuka mo;
ihe ota vulu tuu oku tu pa iikulya
nota pe tuu aantu ye onyama?”

oshoka inaa itaala Kalunga
yo inaa inekela kutya oha kwatha.

Okwa ithana eyalelo
nokwe egulula iiyelo yalyo.

Okwe ya lokithile omanna;
okwe ya pe iikulya yokegulu.

Oya li iikulya yaayengeli;
Omuwa okwe ya pe iikulya ya gwana.

Okwa pepitha ombepo yokuuzilo,
nokoonkondo dhe okwa tukulukitha ombepo yokuumbugantu.

Okwa tumine aantu ye oondhila dhonyama,
odhindji dhi thike pehekevi lyopooha dhefuta.

Okwe dhi lambelitha moontanda dhawo,
nomomudhingoloko gwomatsali gawo.

Aantu oya li e taa kuta;
Kalunga okwe ya pe iipalutha ya gwana.

Ihe manga inaaya za pokulya,
nomanga iikulya ya li natango momakana gawo,

Kalunga okwe ya geele,
okwa dhipaga po aanenentu yomuyo
nokwa kombo po aalumentu aagundjuka muIsrael.

Onkee okwa hulitha po omasiku gawo ngaashi omufudho,
noomvula dhawo mehaluko.

Ohaa dhimbulukwa kutya Kalunga oye omugameni gwawo,
Omunankondoawike oye omukwathi gwawo.

Oohapu dhawo odha li iifundja yowala;
omakana gawo oga popi iilombo.

Kaya li nande yi inekela Kalunga
yo inaa ikolelela mehangano naye.

Ihe Kalunga okwa kala omunahenda;
okwe ya dhimine po omayono gawo
ye ine ya yona po.
Omathimbo nomathimbo
okwa mweneke ondjahi ye
ye ine etha yi mu tone.

Okwa dhimbulukwa kutya oyo aantu yowala;
oya fa ombepo tayi pepe noitayi galuka we.

Olungapi inaaya vulika kuye mombuga,
nolungapi ye mu nikitha oluhodhi!

Omalupita nomalupita oya yeleke Kalunga;
oya geyitha Kalunga Omuyapuki gwaIsrael.

Inaa dhimbulukwa iilonga ye yoonkondo
nesiku ndiya, sho e ya hupitha miikaha yaatondi,

esiku ndiya a holola iilongankondo ye
niikumitha muEgipiti, melundu lyaZoan.

Omilonga dhamo okwe dhi shitukitha ombinzi,
nAayegipiti inaa vula okunwa omeya gadho.

Okwe ya tumine iipupu yomatopola
e tage ya li,
nomafuma tage ya hepeke.

Iilya yawo momapya okwe yi likitha po kokambayaya,
niimeno yawo koombahu.

Omiviinu dhawo okwe dhi teya po nomvula yoompawe,
nomikwiyu dhawo noshikungulu.

Iimuna yawo okwe yi dhipagitha po oompawe,
niigunda yiimuna yawo oya akulwa komalwaadhi.

Ina kankeka ondjahi ye nenge e ya keelele meso,
ihe okwe ya dhipaga po nelega.

Okwa dhipaga po iisheeli yAayegipiti,
aamati aatango yomomatsali gawo.

Moku ya piitha mo inaa mona oshiponga yo inaa tila;
ihe aatondi yawo oya sile mefuta.

Okwe ya eta kevi eyapuki,
koshilongo shoondundu e shi kwata ko noonkondo dhe.

Ihe oya makele Kalunga gwokombandambanda,
inaa vulika kiipango ye.

Oya li aapandala noinaa vulika ya fa oohekulu.
Oya li yaa shi kwiinekelwa,
ya fa uutati inaau lukilwa nawa.

Oye mu geyitha nokusimaneka iikalunga koondundu;
oya pendutha ondjahi ye niimenka yawo.

Kalunga sho e shi mono,
okwa geye nokwe ekelehi aantu ye Aaisraeli.

Okwe etha po etsalihangano lye muShilo
egumbo lye ndyoka e li dhikile mokati kaantu.

Okwa falitha oshikethahangano shoonkondo dhe muupika,
nesimano lye miikaha yaatondi.

Okwa geele aantu ye;
okwe ya etha, ya dhipagwe nomagonga.

Omulilo ogwa fike po aamati aagundjuka;
aafuko aakadhona inaa vula okwiimbilwa omaimbilo gohango.

Aayambi yawo oya dhipagwa nomagonga,
naaselekadhi yawo inaa vula okulila oosa.

Nena Omuwa okwa penduka ongomuntu a li a kotha,
ongaashi ofule a kolwa komaviinu.

Okwa dhenge aatondi ye
nokwe ya sitha ohoni.

Ihe okwi iteka oluvalo lwaJosef;
ina hokwa ezimo lyaEfraim.

Okwa hogolola ezimo lyaJuda;
ondundu Sion okwe yi hokwa.

Okwa hogolola David omupiya gwe,
e mu kutha muusita woonzi.

Mokuza muusita woonzi,
okwe mu ningi omusita gwaantu ye Aaisraeli.

David okwe ya litha nuuyuuki
nokwa li e na oondunge moku ya wilika.
79:
Omidhimba dhaantu yoye odha ningi iikulya yoondhila,
nomalutu gaapiya yoye oga pewa iilikama.

Iigwana yopuushiinda otayi tu sheke;
otayi tu yolo notayi tu nyeme.

Omuwa, sigo uunake to kala wa geya?
Sigo uunake ongeyo yoye tayi hwama ya fa omulilo?

Geela iigwana mbyoka yaa ku shi;
aantu mboka ihaaya tumbula edhina lyoye.

Oshoka oya mana po Jakob;
oya hanagula po ehala lyoye.

Kalunga, omuhupithi gwetu,
tu kwatha.
Omolwesimano lyedhina lyoye
tu hupitha e to dhimi po oondjo dhetu.

Iigwana omolwashike yi na okutya:
“Kalunga keni oku li peni?”
Geela iigwana montaneho yetu,
sho ya dhipaga po aapiya yoye.

Okulila kwaaedhililwa mondholongo
naku thike momakutsi goye.
Oonkondo dhoyenadhi hupithe mbo ya pangulilwa eso.

Omuwa, iigwana iishiinda yetu
yi galulila luheyali uuwinayi wayo,
sho ye ku sheke.
80:
Ihololela omazimo gaEfraim,
Benjamin naManasse.
Holola oonkondo dhoye,
ila, u tu hupithe.

Kalunga, tu tula ishewe omwenyo!
Tu sila ohenda, tu kale tu na omwenyo!

Omuwa Kalunga Omunankondoawike,
osigo uunake to ekelehi omagalikano gaantu yoye?

Owe etha tu dhinwe kaashiinda,
naatondi yetu ye tu sheke.

Kalunga Omunankondoawike,
tu tula ishewe omwenyo!
Tu sila ohenda, tu kale tu na omwenyo!

Owa kutha omuviinu muEgipiti;
owa tidha mo iigwana yilwe e to gu tsike mo.

Owe gu longekidhile oshimpungu;
omidhi odha koko e tadhi taandele.

Omuzile gwagwo ogwa siikile oondundu,
niitayi yagwo oya kuwike omisendeli ominene.

Iitayi yagwo oyi ifala sigo okefuta;
iitutuma yagwo sigo okomulonga Eufrat.

Omolwashike wa kumuna po enkolokuma lyagwo?
Ngashingeyi aapitipo otaa toonona ko omandjembele.

Omamwanka otage gu lyatagula po,
niiyamakuti otayi gu li po.

Kalunga Omunankondoawike, tala kutse!
Tu tala u li megulu; ila, u hupithe aantu yoye.

Ila, u hupithe omuviinu ngu wa kunu,
omuti ngu omuhaha wa kokitha.

Aatondi oye gu keke po e taye gu fike po;
ya geela e to ya yono po.

Popila e to gamene aantu yoye we ya hogolola,
oshigwana we shi ningi oshinankondo.

Itatu ku etha we; tu kaleka nomwenyo,
notatu ke ku pandula.

Omuwa Kalunga Omunankondoawike,
tu tula ishewe omwenyo.
Tu sila ohenda e to tu hupitha.
81:
Tamekeni eimbilo, dhengeni oontunda.
Hikeni uuharpa nuushandja.

Hikeni enkuma moshituthi shomwedhi omupe,
ngele gwe ya ko nenge gwa toka.

Ndjika oyo ompango muIsrael;
elombwelo lya zi kuKalunga kaJakob.

Ompango okwe yi pe Aaisraeli,
sho a dhenge evi lyaEgipiti.
Ondu uvu ewi inaandi li uva nale lya ti:

“Onda kutha ko omitenge komapepe geni;
onde mu lombwele, mu thige po iilonga iidhigu.

Muumbanda weni omwi ithana ndje
e tandi mu hupitha.
Onde mu yamukula moshikogo shomindundumo.
Onde mu yeleke pomeya gaMeriba.

Inamu simaneka nando oshikalunga;
inamu kala mu na oshimenka.

Ongame Omuwa Kalunga keni,
ngoka nde mu tembudha muEgipiti.
Ekamekeni omakana geni,
ngame notandi mu palutha.

“Ihe aantu yandje inaa pulakena ndje;
Israel ina vulika kungame.

Onkee onde ya ethele mokwaavulika kwawo,
noya longo ngaashi ya hala.
Ando ya li ya pulakene ndje e taa vulika kungame,
ando onda tidha e te halakanitha po aatondi yawo.

Ihe ne, otandi ke mu palutha niilyalela;
otandi ke mu pa omagadhi goonyushi.”
82:
Kalunga ota ningi oompangu megulu;
ota tseyitha epangulo mokati kookalunga.

Inamu pangula we paugoyoki;
omukeenakalunga, inamu mu ningila pondhipi.

Popileni oohepele noothigwa,
uthileni aadhinwa naakwanaluhepo pauyuuki.

“One aagoya ngiini ne mwaa na oondunge!
Omwa yonana thilu,
nuuyuuki owa kana ko kombanda yevi.

Ngame onda ti: ‘One ookalunga;
ne amuhe aana yaanguka gwokombandambanda.’

Kalunga, thikama, u pangule uuyuni auhe;
iigwana ayihe oyoye.
83:
Kalunga, ino mwena;
ino tya thilu!

Tala, nkene mbo ye ku tonde ya kolokosha;
tala, sho inaa hala okuvulika.

Otaa ende aantu yoye mevi;
otaa kotokele mbo ye li megameno lyoye.

Otaa ti: “Ileni, tu halakanithii po oshigwana shawo,
opo Israel a dhimbiwe sigo aluhe.”

Otaa uvathana ompangela yawo
notaa tungu elongelokumwe lyawo, ye ku kondjithe:

aantu yaGebal, Ammon naAmalek,
Aafilisti nAatiro.

Assur naye wo okwa hangana nayo,
kuume kaAmmon naMoab omunankondo, yomoluvalo lwaLot.

Kalunga, ya ninga ngaashi wa ningi Aamidiana
nongaashi wa ningi Sisera naJabin pomulonga Kishon.

Owe ya dhipagele puEndor,
nomidhimba dhawo odho olele pontundulu.

Aawiliki yawo ya ninga ngaashi wa ningile Oreb naSeeb;
ya sinda ngaashi wa sindi Seba naZalmunna.

Mboka ya popi ya ti:
“Otatu ka kwata po omayana gaKalunga.”

Kalunga, ya ninga ngaashi ontsi tayi pepwa po kombepo,
ngaashi iiyagaya tayi yi nokambiya.

Ngaashi epeya tali fike po omugulu,
nongaashi omulilo tagu hwameke oondundu,

ya tidha po noshikungulu shoye;
ya halutha noshihomo shoye.

Omuwa, ya sitha ohoni;
naa tseye oonkondo dhoye.

Naa sindike e taa tila sigo aluhe;
naa sile mohoni yawo.

Naye ku tseye kutya ongoye awike Omuwa Omupangeliawike
kombanda yevi alihe.
84:
Otempeli yoye onde yi hokwa ngiini,
Omuwa Omunankondoawike!

Omwenyo gwandje otagu yuulukwa
okuya motempeli yOmuwa.
Omutima nolutu lwandje olu na enyanyu
okuuka kuKalunga omunamwenyo.

Enza olya tungu oshihandhila,
nevalelanganda olya mono egumbo.
Omo lya kaleke oyana popepi noshiyambelo shoye,
Omuwa Omunankondoawike,
omukwaniilwa gwandje naKalunga kandje.

Aanelago oomboka haa kala motempeli yoye
notaye ku hambelele aluhe.

Aanelago oomboka taa pewa oonkondo kungoye,
oomboka ye li molweendo oluyapuki
taa uka kuSion.

Sho taa ende mesilu lyomombuga,
otaye li shitukitha oothithiya,
nomvula yontemuna otayi li udhitha omeya.

Otaa nkondopala, sho taa humu ko;
otaa ka holoka koshipala shaKalunga muSion.

Omuwa Kalunga Omunankondoawike,
uva egalikano lyandje.
Kalunga kaJakob, uva ndje!

Kalunga, yambeka omukwaniilwa,
omugwayekwa gwoye omuholike.

Okukala esiku limwe motempeli yoye
oku vule okukala omasiku geyuvi palwe.
Ngame onda hokwa okukala pomweelo gwegumbo lyaKalunga kandje,
shi vule okukala nomagumbo gaakaanakalunga.

Oshoka Omuwa Kalunga oye uuyelele negameno;
ote tu sile ohenda noku tu nenepeka.
Mboka haa longo uuwanawa,
otaa kala yaa na omupya.

Kalunga Omunankondoawike,
aanelago oomboka haa ku inekele!
85:
Omuwa, owa kala nokusila evi lyetu ohenda;
owa mwenyekulula aantu yoye Aaisraeli.

Owa dhimi po oondjo dhawo
nowe ya kuthile po omayono gawo.

Owe etha oku ya geela
nowa loteke ondjahi yoye.

Oto kala we tu geela sigo aluhe?
Oto lelepeke ondjahi yoye, yi adhe omaluvalo agehe?

Tu mwenyeka ishewe,
tse aantu yoye tu ku nyanyukilwe.

Omuwa, tu ulukila ohole yoye yashili;
tu kwatha ngu u tu hupithe.

Ekwatho lyOmuwa oli li popepi naamboka haye mu simaneke;
ota kala moshilongo shetu.

Ohole neinekelo otayi ka tsakanena;
uuyuuki nombili otayi ka minikathana.

Evuliko lyomuntu otali ka holoka,
nuuyuuki waKalunga otau ka taalela kevi.

Omuwa ota ka gandja shoka oshiwanawa,
nevi lyetu otali ka za iipalutha.

Uuyuuki otau ka tetekela Omuwa
notau mu longekidhile ondjila.
86:
Omuwa, pulakena e to yamukula ndje,
oshoka ngame ohepele nomukwanaluhepo.

Gamena ndje, oshoka ondi igameka kungoye.
Ongoye Kalunga kandje,
nangame omupiya gwoye nde ku inekela.

Omuwa, sila ndje ohenda;
otandi ku indile esiku alihe.

Omuwa, nyanyudha omupiya gwoye,
oshoka omagalikano gandje
otaga yelukile kungoye.

Omuwa, ongoye omunalukeno noho tu dhimine po;
ou na esilohenda kumboka taye ku indile.

Omuwa, uva egalikano lyandje;
otandi lili, ndi silwe ohenda.

Otandi ku ithana ethimbo kehe lyuudhigu,
oshoka oho yamukula omaindilo gandje.

Kaku na Kalunga gulwe e ku fa,
Omuwa; kaku na ngo ta longo ngaashi ho longo.

Iigwana ayihe mbyoka wa shiti, otayi ke ya e tayi ku tsile oongolo;
otayi ke ku simaneka, Omuwa.

Oshoka ongoye omunankondo noho longo iikumitha;
ongoye awike Kalunga.

Omuwa, longa ndje, ndi tseye ehalo lyoye,
notandi ka vulika nokukala moshili.
Longa ndje, ndi ku simaneke
nomwenyo aguhe.

Ohole yoye onene ngiini kungame!
Owa hupitha omwenyo gwandje
meso lyo lyene.

Ihe ngoye, Omuwa,
ongoye Kalunga omunesilohenda nomunahole,
omwiidhidhimiki, omunalukeno nomwiinekelwa.

Omuwa, ulukila ndje endhindhiliko
tali hololele ndje uuwanawa woye.
Nena aatondi yandje ngele taye shi mono,
otaa si ohoni, sho wa kwatha ndje nowa tsu ndje omukumo.
87:
Omuwa okwa tungile oshilando she
kondundu ondjapuki.

MuIsrael kamu na ehala e li hole,
ngaashi e hole oshilando Jerusalem.

Shilando shaKalunga,
pulakena, Omuwa sho te ku tanga
omolwiinima iinene:

“Egipiti naBabilonia otandi ke yi yalulila momwaalu gwiigwana
mbyo hayi vulika kungame.
Komwaalu gwaakali muJerusalem
otandi ka gwedha ko Aafilisti, Aatiro nAaetiopia.”

Nena Sion otashi ka tiwa:
“Iigwana ayihe otayi kala mo,
Omunankondoawike ote shi koleke.”

Oyo notaa ka imba nokunyanyukwa taa ti:
“Omayambeko agehe oge li muSion.”
88:
Omuwa Kalunga, omuhupithi gwandje,
otandi lili esiku kehe,
nuusiku wo otandi ya kungoye.

Uva egalikano lyandje;
pulakena, sho tandi ku kugile ekwatho!

Omaudhigu ogendji oga gwile ndje;
ondi li popepi nokusa.

Eso olye eta ndje mo,
nokaku na ngo ta kwatha.

Onda yalulilwa mokati kaasi,
ongaashi aadhipagwa ya lala momayendo,
mbo itaaya dhimbulukiwa we
noitaa mono we ekwatho lyoye.

Owu umbile ndje muule wombila,
momilema dholumbogo oluleeleka.

Ongeyo yoye oya dhigupalela ndje,
oya hwamena ndje ya fa omulilo.

Omeho gandje oga nama kuudhigu.
Omuwa, ohandi ku ithana esiku kehe
nohandi ku yeluthile omaako gandje megalikano.

Aasi oho ya longele tuu iikumitha?
Itaa yumuka ando e taye ku hambelele?

Esilohenda lyoye ohali tumbulwa tuu mombila,
nenge mehala lyehanagulo
ohamu popiwa tuu uudhiginini woye?

Iikumithalonga yoye ohayi monika tuu mehala lyomilema,
nenge uuwanawa woye otau tseyika tuu
moshilongo shaambo ya dhimbiwa?

Omuwa, otandi ku indile ekwatho;
ongula kehe otandi ku galikana.

Omuwa, omolwashike to ekelehi ndje?
Omolwashike to etha ndje?

Onda kala muudhigu okuza muugundjuka wandje
nonda kala popepi neso.
Onda pwa po molwokukala megeelo lyoye.

Ongeyo yoye otayi taukile ndje;
omaponokelo goye omadhigu otaga nyanyula ndje.

Esiku kehe mbika ayihe oya dhingoloka ndje
ngaashi efundja tali zi koombinga adhihe.

Owa pitika nookuume kandjelela ye ethe ndje;
omilema adhike ndi li nadho.
89:
Omuwa, otandi imbi e tandi tanga esilohenda lyoye;
otandi hokolola aluhe uudhiginini woye.

Ondi shi shi ohole yoye otayi kala omathimbo agehe,
uudhiginini woye owa kola ngaashi eyalelo.

‘Gumwe gwomaamwoye ota ka kala aluhe omukwaniilwa;
uukwaniilwa woye otii u kaleke po sigo aluhe.’ ”

Omuwa, egulu otali imbi molwiikumitha yoye;
aayapuki otaa hambelele oshili yoye.

Omuwa, megulu kamu na nando ogumwe e ku fa;
mokati koonakukala megulu kamu na ngo ta yelekwa nangoye.

Ngoye owa simana mokati kaayapuki;
ayehe ye li pungoye, otaye ku tila.

Oto ngambeke efuta enene;
oto mweneke omakuthikuthi galyo.

Oto nyanyagula evovo Rahab e to li dhipaga po;
oto sindi aatondi yoye noshikaha shoye oshinankondo.

Egulu olyoye, nosho wo evi;
ongoye wa shiti uuyuni noshaa shoka shi li mo.

Ongoye omunankondo ngiini!
Oshikaha shoye osha yeluka
shi na oonkondo!

Epangelo lyoye olya tungilwa kuuyuuki nokoshili;
ohole nuudhiginini otayi holoka miilonga yoye.

Aanelago oomboka haye ku simaneke noondjimbo;
oomboka haa ende muuyelele wesilohenda lyoye.

Ongoye enyanyu lyawo esiku alihe,
notaye ku hambelelele uuwanawa woye.

Ongoye esimano noonkondo dhetu;
okehalo lyoye tatu sindana.

Memoniko nalenale owa lombwele omupiya gwoye omukwaniilwa wa ti:
“Onda kwatha omukwiita ofule
nonda gandja epangelo kungoka nde mu hogolola mokati kaantu.

Omupiya gwandje David onde mu ningi omukwaniilwa,
sho nde mu gwayeke nomugwayo omuyapuki.

Oonkondo dhandje otadhi kala aluhe pamwe naye,
noshikaha shandje otashi mu koleke.

Aatondi ye itaa ka sindana mokutsa ondumbo naye;
aakaanakalunga itaye ke mu sinda.

Otandi nyanyagula po aatondi ye
notandi dhipaga po aahepeki ye.

Otandi kala ndi mu hole nonde mu inekela.
Otandi mu pe aluhe esindano.

Otandi ka taandeleka oshilongo she sigo okefuta,
nepangelo lye sigo ohandiyaka yomilonga.

Otandi ke mu ninga osheeli shandje shomumati,
omunene mokati kaakwaniilwa.

“Ihe oonakuza muye mbaka
ngele itaa vulika kompango yandje,
noitaa ende ngaashi tandi ya lombwele,

tashi ti, taa dhini omalongo gandje
noitaa dhiginine iipango yandje,

nena otandi ya geelele oondjo dhawo
notandi ya dhenge molwomayono gawo.

Ihe itandi etha okukala ndi hole David,
nenge ndi dhimbwe shoka nde mu uvanekela.

Itandi ka teya po ehangano lyetu naye,
nenge ndi ethe po euvaneko
nando olimwelimwe nde li mu lombwela.

“Lumwe aluke olwa gwana,
sho nde mu uvanekele nokugana okuyapuki:
David itandi mu fundju.

Ota ka kala aluhe e na oluvalo,
notandi kala nokugamena epangelo lye,
manga etango li li ko tali minikile.

Otali kala ko ngaashi omwedhi gu li ko,
ombangi yi shi kwiinekelwa yokeyalelo.”

Ihe nani owa geele omukwaniilwa omuhogololwa;
owe mu thigi po nowe mu ekelehi.

Owa teya po ehangano lyeni naye,
noshishani shepangelo lye owe shi umbile menono.

Owa teya po omakuma goshilando she;
noohote dhe owe dhi thigi omakulukuma gowala.

Aatondi ye owe ya pe esindano
nowe ya nyanyudha.

Iikondjitho ye owe yi simpike
nowe mu etha, a sindike molugodhi.

Owa hulitha po esimano lye,
noshipundi shepangelo lye owe shi ekelehi.

Owe mu kulupike, ethimbo manga inaali thika;
owe mu sitha ohoni.

Omuwa, oto kala wa holama sigo aluhe?
Osigo uunake ondjahi yoye
ya hwama ya fa omulilo?

Olye ta vulu okukala e na omwenyo itaa si?
Omuntu ota vulu tuu okwiikeelela mombila?

Omuwa, ohole yoye yonale oyi li peni?
Omauvaneko ngo wa pele David, oge li peni?

Omuwa, ino dhimbwa, nkene omupiya gwoye nda shekwa,
sho ndi idhidhimikile omapopyo agehe giigwana.

Omuwa, aatondi yoye oya sheke omukwaniilwa we mu hogolola;
oye mu landula nomasheko shaa mpoka a yi.

Esimano nali ninge lyOmuwa sigo aluhe!
Amen! Amen!
90:
Omuwa, ongoye wa kala aluhe
egameno lyetu.

Manga inoo shita oondundu nomanga inoo holola po uuyuni,
ngoye Kalunga kaaluhe oko wa li
noto ka kala aluhe sigo aluhe.

Oto lombwele omuntu, a shune mpoka a za;
oto mu shuna montsi yevi.

Pethimbo lyongula otagu koko notagu sheneke,
ihe komatango otagu kukuta e tagu si.

Otatu hulu po kondjahi yoye;
otatu kana po kegeelo lyoye.

Otse otatu hulu po kondjahi yoye;
otatu kana po ngaashi omufudho.

Oomvula dhokukalamwenyo kwetu omilongo heyali,
nongele odhindji, omilongo hetatu,
ihe odhi na uudhigu noluhodhi;
otadhi piti po mbala twa fa twa tuka.

Olye a tseya oonkondo dhondjahi yoye?
Olye e shi oshilanduliko shongeyo yoye?

Tu longa okukoneka uuhupi womasiku getu,
opo tu ninge aanandunge.

Okugeya kwoye otaku tsikile sigo uunake?
Omuwa, sila aapiya yoye ohenda!

Ongula kehe tu ulukila esilohenda lyoye,
opo tu imbe nenyanyu omasiku getu agehe.

Tu nyanyudha ihe shi thike poluhodhi ndoka we tu pele,
ngaashi twa mono iihuna ethimbo ele.

Otse aapiya yoye, tu talitha iilongankondo yoye;
talitha omaluvalo getu iilonga yoye ya simana.

Omuwa Kalunga ketu, esilohenda lyoye nali kale kombanda yetu.
Koleka iilonga yiikaha yetu!
91:
Kehe ngoka ti itula mepopilo lyOmuwa,
nakehe ngoka ta kala megameno lyOmunankondoawike,

ota vulu okutya kuye:
“Ongoye omupopili nomugameni gwandje.
Ongoye Kalunga kandje, nde ku inekela.”

Omuwa ota kandula po iiponga ayihe
note ku gamene komikithi dhomalega.

Ito pumbwa okutila iiponga yuusiku
nenge eponokelo omutenya.

Elega itali ku akele uusiku,
nuuvu itau ku kwata omutenya.

Ponto yoye nando napa se eyuvi
nokolulyo lwoye omayuvi omulongo,
ngoye ito adhika koshiponga.

Oto kala wa tala,
aakaanakalunga nkene taa geelwa.

Oshoka Omuwa oye omupopili gwoye;
gwokombandambanda owe mu ningi omugameni gwoye.

Onkee oshiponga itashi ku adha,
nepiyagano itali thiki popepi nondunda yoye.

Otaye ku papatele momaako gawo,
waa pume oompadhi dhoye komamanya.

Oto ka lyata oonime nomayoka,
oonime oohahu nomayoka guuzigo.

Kalunga ota ti:
“Otandi hupitha mboka ye hole ndje
notandi gamene mboka ye shi kutya ongame Omuwa.

Uuna taa ithana ndje,
otandi ya yamukula;
uuna ye li muudhigu,
ote kala pamwe nayo.
Otandi ya hupitha e tii ya simanekitha.

Otandi ya pe omwenyo omule
notandi ya hupitha.”
92:
Omuwa, osho opala oku ku hambelela,
okusimaneka edhina lyoye,
Gwokombandambanda,

okuuvitha ongula kehe esilohenda lyoye,
nuusiku kehe uudhiginini woye.

Otandi lilitha uuhumba wootheta;
otandi imbi nokaharpa.

Omuwa, iilonga yoye iinene ngiini!
Omadhiladhilo goye olye te ga pikula?

Ngoka itee shi dhimbulula, oye omugoya,
naangoka itee shi mono, ke na omayele.

Aakaanakalunga nando naa kale muulinawa
ya fa omwiidhi omutalala,
aakolokoshi nando naa hupe nawa,
ayehe otaa ka dhimwa po thilu.

Oshoka ngoye Omuwa
ou li kombandambanda sigo aluhe.

Omuwa,
owa pe ndje oonkondo dha fa dhonyati
nowa laleke ndje nuuyamba.

Onda mono okusindika kwaatondi yandje
nondu uvu okulila kwaakolokoshi.

Aayuuki otaa ka koka ya fa omilunga;
otaa ka ziza ya fa omisendeli dhaLibanon.

Otaa fe omiti dha tsikwa mongulu yOmuwa,
tadhi kokele motempeli yaKalunga ketu.

Otadhi imi aluhe iiyimati;
aluhe odha hapa nodha ziza.

Shika otashi holola kutya
Omuwa oye omuyuuki;
oye omugameni gwandje,
ke na nando uuwinayi.
93:
Omuwa oye omukwaniilwa.
Okwa zala eadhimo noonkondo.
Evi olya dhikwa lya dhikika,
itali tenguka.

Omuwa, oshipundi shoye shepangelo
osha kala okuza nale.

Omuwa, omafuta otaga popi mokule;
endundumo lyago otali uvika.

Omuwa omunankondo
oku vule epopyo lyomeya gefuta,
oku vule omakuthikuthi galyo;
Omuwa Gwokombandambanda
oye omunankondo!

Omuwa, omautho goye ihaga lunduluka,
otempeli yoye oyo ondjapuki
aluhe sigo aluhe.
94:
Omuwa, ongoye Kalunga ho geele;
holola ondjahi yoye!

Ongoye omupanguli gwaantu ayehe;
thikama, u pe aanuuntsa shoka ye shi ilongela.

Omuwa, sigo uunake aakaanakalunga taa kala nokunyanyukwa?
Sigo uunake, Omuwa?

Sigo uunake aakolokoshi taa inenepeke
notaa itangele uukolokoshi wawo?

Omuwa, oyo taa thenyene aantu yoye kongudhi;
otaa hepeke aantu yoye.

Otaa dhipaga aaselekadhi noothigwa,
osho wo aakwiilongo mbo ye li moshilongo.

Otaa ti: “Omuwa ke tu wete;
Kalunga kaIsrael ita dhimbulula sha.”

Aantu yandje, one aagoya ngiini?
Otamu ka ninga oondunge uunake?

Kalunga ngoka e tu pa omakutsi,
ota kala tuu ihu uvu ko?
Kalunga ngoka e tu pa omeho,
ota kala tuu ihaa mono ko?

Omupangeli gwiigwana ita vulu oku yi geela?
Omunongeki gwaantu ayehe ita tseya sha?

Omuwa okwa tseya ashihe shoka taa dhiladhila;
okwa tseya uuhupi woondunge dhawo.

Omuwa, omunelago oye ngoka to mu putudha;
oongoka to mu longo ompango yoye!

Oto mu pe ehekeleko momasiku guudhigu,
sigo aakaanakalunga ya fulilwa ekelo, ya gwile mo.

Omuwa ite ekelehi aantu ye;
ite etha po mboka ye.

Eutho eyuuki otali ka holoka moompangu,
aayuuki ayehe otaye ke li landula.

Olye ta pingene ndje mokugeela aakaanakalunga?
Olye ta pangula aakolokoshi peha lyandje?

Ando Omuwa ina kwatha ndje,
ando onda yi mbala kehala lyeimweneneno.

Ngame onda ti: “Otandi ihata po!”
Ihe, Omuwa, owa ambidhidha ndje molwohole yoye.

Uuna nda tila nonda sa iimpwiyu,
oto hekeleke ndje e to nyanyudha ndje.

Ngoye Omuwa, ku na ehangano naapanguli aadhudhu,
mbo haa popile uukolokoshi.

Ohaa ende aayuuki mevi,
naamboka inaaya yona sha,
otaa ya pangulile eso.

Ihe Omuwa oye omupopili gwandje;
Kalunga kandje ota gamene ndje.
95:
Ileni, tu hambeleleni Omuwa!
Ileni, tu imbeni tse tu nyanyukilweni Kalunga
ngoka he tu gamene!

Tu yeni koshipala she noku mu pandula.
Tu imbeni nenyanyu noku mu hambelela.

Oshoka oye Kalunga omunankondo,
omukwaniilwa omunene kombanda yiikalunga.

Oye ta pangele evi alihe,
okuza muule walyo sigo okoondungu dhoondundu.

Oye Kalunga ketu; otse oonzi dhuusita we,
aantu he ya sile oshimpwiyu.

Oye ota ti: “Onena tuu ndjika,
sho tamu uvu ewi lyandje,
inamu ikukutika, ongaashi oohokulu puMeriba
nongaashi ya li esiku ndiyaka mombuga puMassa.

Mwiyaka oya makele ndje noya yeleke ndje,
nando ya mono iilonga mbyoka nde yi ya longele.

Methimbo lyoomvula omilongo ne
aantu mboka oya ningitha ndje omwenyo omwiinayi.
Ngame nonda ti: ‘Oyo oonakwaavulika ngiini!
Otaa tindi okuvulika kiipango yandje.’

Nena onda geye nonda ningi etokolo lya kola:
‘Itamu ka thika mo moshilongo
moka nda li ndi na oku mu pa evululuko.’ ”
96:
Imbileni Omuwa ondjimbo ompe!
Imbileni Omuwa, uuyuni auhe!

Imbileni Omuwa, ne mu mu simaneke.
Hokololeni esiku kehe elaka etoye kutya okwe tu hupitha.

Uvithileni iigwana esimano lye,
iilonga yoonkondo okiigwana ayihe.

Omuwa oye omunene noku na okusimanekwa;
oku na okutumbalekwa e vule iikalunga ayihe.

Iikalunga yiigwana ayihe yilwe oyo iimenka yowala,
ihe Omuwa oye a shiti omagulu.

Esimano neadhimo olye mu kunduka;
oonkondo neopalo oli li motempeli ye.

Hambeleleni Omuwa, one aantu amuhe kombanda yevi;
tangeni eadhimo noonkondo dhe.

Peni edhina lyOmuwa esimano;
eteni omagano, sho tamu ya motempeli ye.

Inyongameneni koshipala shOmuyapuki,
uuna ta holoka; evi alihe nali kakame koshipala she!

Lombweleni iigwana ayihe tamu ti:
“Omuwa oye omukwaniilwa!
Evi olya dhikika lya kola, itali tenguka;
Omuwa ota ka pangula aantu pauyuuki.”

Egulu nevi naga nyanyukwe!
Efuta ndunduma, niishitwa ayihe yi li mungoye;

omalundu nyanyukwe, naashihe shi li mune!
Omiti adhihe dhomomugulu otadhi ka kugilila kenyanyu

Omuwa sho te ya okupangela uuyuni.
Ota ka pangula aantu ayehe yokombanda yevi
e na uuyuuki noshili.
97:
Omuwa oye omukwaniilwa!
Evi, nyanyukwa!
Ne oontuntu dhomomafuta, ligoleni!

Iikogo nomilema odhe mu dhingoloka;
ota pangele nuuyuuki noshili.

Omulilo otagu mu tetekele,
nota lungunitha po aatondi ye mbo ye mu kundukidha.

Olwaadhi lwe otalu minikile uuyuni auhe;
evi otali shi mono e tali kakama.

Koshipala shOmuwa
oondundu otadhi hengumuka dha fa ezi,
okoshipala shOmuwa guuyuni auhe.

Egulu otali hokolola uuyuuki we,
niigwana ayihe otayi mono eadhimo lye.

Aantu yomuSion otaa nyanyukwa,
niilando yomuJuda oya shambukwa,
oshoka Omuwa oye omupanguli.

Omuwa oku hole mboka haa tondo uuwinayi,
ota gamene aantu ye
note ya hupitha miikaha yaakolokoshi.

Nyanyukilweni Omuwa, aayuuki amuhe;
simanekeni edhina lye eyapuki.
98:
Omuwa okwa tseyitha esindano lye;
okwa hololele iigwana uuyuuki we.

Okwa kala aluhe e na ohole nuudhiginini kAaisraeli.
Aantu ayehe oya mono kutya
Kalunga ketu oye omusindani.

Evi alihe nali nyanyukwe nokuligolela Omuwa;
nali mu imbile oondjimbo dhenyanyu nodhomahambelelo!

Hikeni omankuma noontunda;
imbileni Omuwa, omukwaniilwa gwetu.

Efuta nali ndundume,
naashihe shoka shi li mo;
evi nali imbe,
naayehe mboka ye li ko.

Omilonga nadhi hakele,
noondundu adhihe nadhi ligole koshipala shOmuwa,

Oshoka ote ya okupangula uuyuni.
Ota ka pangula aantu ayehe
kombanda yevi pauyuuki nopashili.
99:
Omuwa oye omukwaniilwa;
aantu otaa kakama.
Oye a kuutumba koshipangelapundi she
shi li kombanda yaakerubi,
evi notali kakama.

Omuwa oye omunankondo muSion;
oye a simana kombanda yiigwana ayihe

Kehe gumwe oku na okusimaneka edhina lye ekumithi netilithi.
Oye omuyapuki!

Ongoye omukwaniilwa omunankondo,
ou hole shoka shu uka;
owa dhike eutho eyuuki muIsrael
nowa gandja uuyuuki noshili.

Moses naAaron oya li aayambi ye,
naSamuel okwa li gumwe gwaamboka haa ithana edhina lye.
Oyi indile Omuwa,
nokwe ya yamukula.

Omuwa Kalunga ketu,
owa yamukula omagalikano gawo.
Owe ya dhimine po oondjo dhawo,
nonando owe ya geelele wo omayono gawo.

Simanekeni Omuwa Kalunga ketu,
ne mu galikane kondundu ye ondjapuki.
Omuwa Kalunga ketu oye omuyapuki.
100:
Longeleni Omuwa nenyanyu;
ileni koshipala she mwa nyanyukwa!
101:
Omuwa, otandi ku imbile molwesilohenda
nomoluuyuuki woye; otandi ku hambelele.

Otandi ikeelele ndi kale ndaa na ombedhi.
Oto ya uunake kungame?
Otandi angala uuwinayi megumbo lyandje,

Iineya nayi kale ndje kokule;
itandi popile uudhudhu

Ngoka ta ningilile mo mukwawo,
otandi mu tidha po.
Itandi gama nando komuholuuntsa nokomwiinomi

Otandi gama kwaamboka aainekelwa
notandi ya kaleke mombala yandje.
Mboka yaa na oshipo,
otandi ya ningi aayakuli yandje.

Esiku kehe otandi kombo mo aakolokoshi moshilongo;
otandi ka tidha mo aadhudhu moshilando shOmuwa.
102:
Omuwa, uva egalikano lyandje,
pulakena, sho tandi ku lilile ekwatho!

Ino thiga ndje po, sho ndi li muudhigu!
Pulakena eindilo lyandje,
yamukula ndje mbala, sho tandi ku ithana!

Otandi kana po nda fa olwithi;
molutu lwandje otamu pi ongo mu na omulilo.

Onda leela nda fa omwiidhi gwa ganya;
onda kanitha ehalo lyiikulya.

Otandi tongo mokule;
onda nanga omasipa gowala.

Ondi li muuwike nda fa endoko mombuga,
ongaashi ehwiyu momakulukuma.

Ohe lala inee kotha;
ondi ikalela nda fa okadhila ke li kombanda yondunda.

Iikulya yandje omutoko;
nokunwa kwandje okwa gwedhakanithwa nomahodhi,

oshoka owa geele ndje;
owe etha ndje nowe ekelehi ndje.

Omasiku gandje oga fa omuzile gwokomatango,
ongaashi omwiidhi tagu kukuta.

Ihe Omuwa, ongoye omukwaniilwa sigo aluhe;
omaluvalo agehe otage ku dhimbulukwa.

Tse aapiya yoye otu hole omutungilo gwasho;
otu uvite oluhodhi, sho sha halakanithwa po.

Iigwana otayi ka tila Omuwa,
naakwaniilwa ayehe yomuuyuni eadhimo lye.

Uuna Omuwa ta ka tungulula Sion,
ota ka holola uunene we.

Ota ka uva omagalikano gomapongo
noita ka dhina omaindilo gago.

Nyola ayihe mbika,
u yi pungulile omaluvalo tage ya,
opo mboka inaaya valwa natango
ya ka tseye shoka Omuwa e shi longo
e taye mu simaneke.

Omuwa ota tala pevi e li megulu muuyapuki we;
ota mono kombanda yevi.

Otu uvu omakemo goonkwatwa
nota mangulula mbo ya tokolelwa eso.

uuna iigwana nomapangelo
tayi ka gongala okusimaneka Omuwa.

Omuwa okwa nkundipaleke ndje,
manga omugundjuka; okwa fupipike omasiku gandje.

nalenale owa shiti evi,
neyalelo olyo iilonga yiikaha yoye.

Oyo otayi hulu po,
ihe ngoye oto kalelele;
ayihe otayi ka kulupa ya fa oonguwo.
Oto ke yi ekelahi ya fa iinyanyu,
notayi kana po.

Ihe ngoye oto kala ngaashi wa za,
ito hulu po.

Megameno lyoye aana yetu
otaa kala ya vululukwa,
nomaluvalo gawo oto ke ga popila.
103:
Omwenyo gwandje, hambelela Omuwa!
Ashihe shi li mungame,
nashi simaneke edhina lye eyapuki!

Omwenyo gwandje, hambelela Omuwa!
Ino dhimbwa uuwanawa we.

Oye ta dhimi po oondjo dhandje
nota aludha uuvu wandje auhe.

Oye ta hupitha ndje meso
nota landula ndje nesilohenda
nontalanteni ye.

Ota kutitha ndje nuuwanawa we
nota kaleke ndje nda nyashuka nda fa ontsa.

Omuwa ota pangula pauyuuki,
naathiminikwa ote ya popile.

Okwa hololele Moses omadhiladhilo ge,
Aaisraeli iilongankondo ye.

Omuwa oye omunamutimahenda nomunalukeno,
ohi idhidhimike mokugeya
noku na ohole ihaayi lunduluka.

Iha tamanana ethimbo kehe,
ye iha kala a geya sigo aluhe.

Ote tu geele, ngaashi twe shi ilongela,
note tu pula pakuyona kwetu.

Ngaashi uule wokuza pevi okuya kegulu,
osho sha tya uunene wohole ye
kumboka haye mu simaneke.

Ngaashi uuzilo u li kokule nuuninginino,
osho ta kaleke kokule natse oondjo dhetu.

Ngaashi aanona taa silwa ohenda kuhe,
osho Omuwa ta sile ohenda mboka haye mu simaneke.

Okwa tseya kutya otwa shitwa nashike;
oku shi shi kutya otse ontsi yevi.

Oshoka omasiku getu oga fa omwiidhi.
Otatu nyanyukwa twa fa ongala yokelundu;

ombepo sho ya tameke oku yi pepela,
otayi si noitayi monika we.

Ihe esilohenda lyOmuwa itali lunduluka
kumboka haye mu simaneke,
nuuwanawa we komaluvalo nomaluvalo

okumboka haa dhiginine ehangano lye
naamboka haa vulika kiipango ye.

Omuwa oku li koshipangelapundi she megulu;
ota pangele ayihe.

Hambeleleni Omuwa,
ne aayengeli oofule naanankondo,
mbo hamu fala omalombwelo ge
nohamu vulika koohapu dhe.

Iishitwa ayihe nayi simaneke Omuwa,
akuhe nkoka ku na epangelo lye.
Mwenyo gwandje, hambelela Omuwa!
104:
owi isiikila uuyelele.
Owa yala egulu ngaashi othayila

nowa tungile egumbo lyoye
mokati komeya gokombanda.
Iikogo owe yi ningi ya fa etemba lyoye lyokweenda mo,
nombepo omawawa goye gokutuka.

Iihomo yombepo oto yi ningi aatumwa yoye,
noombadhi aapiya yoye.

Evi owe li tula komakankameno ga kola,
itali tenguka.

Kombanda yalyo owa yala ko efuta ngaashi onguwo;
omeya galyo oga tumba ge vule oondundu.

Oga kunguluka ga zi koondundu
nokuuka momasilu, okomahala nkoka we ga uthile.

Owe ga dhikile oongamba itaadhi kondwa,
nowe ga ngambeke kaaga siikile we evi.

Owa tula oothithiya momasilu
nowa palele omilonga pokati koondundu.

Otadhi gandja omeya kiiyamakuti;
uusino womokuti otau zi enota.

Momiti dhopooha dhomeya
uudhila otau tungile mo iihandhila
e tau nyanyukwa.

Miikogo otamu zi omvula tayi loko koondundu;
evi olya kuta omayambeko goye.

Oto menitha omwiidhi gwiimuna
niimeno yokukwatha aantu,
sho to ya menithile mevi iipalutha.

Omaviinu otaga nyanyudha omuntu,
omagadhi otaga adhimitha oshipala,
niikulya otayi pe omuntu oonkondo oompe.

Omisendeli dhaLibanon odha lokwa omvula oyindji;
odho omiti dhOmuwa e dhi kuna.

Uudhila otau tungile mo iihandhila yawo,
nomandoko otaga tungile mo wo.

Uupundja otau ende koondundu,
nuuhele oko tau holama.

Owa shiti omwedhi okuutha omathimbo;
etango oli shi ethimbo lyokuningina kwalyo.

Owa tula ko uusiku;
momilema iikwakuti ayihe otayi hituluka.

Shaa tuu etango tali piti,
ayihe otayi shuna yi ka lale komahala gayo.

Ihe aantu otaa penduka, ya ye kiilonga,
notaa longo sigo okomatango.

Omuwa, owa shiti iinima oyindji!
Tala nkene wa shiti ayihe noondunge!
Evi olyu udha iishitwa yoye.

Tala efuta enene lya mbwalangandja,
omu na iinamwenyo yaa shi kuyalulwa,
iinene niishona.

Oosikepa otadhi ende mefuta;
Leviatan ndjoka wa shiti, otayi dhanene mo.

Ayihe mbika otayi ligamene kungoye,
u yi pe iipalutha pethimbo.

Oto yi pe e tayi taamba;
oto yi palutha e tayi kuta.

Esimano lyOmuwa nali kale sigo aluhe!
Omuwa na nyanyukilwe eshito lye!

Oye okwa tala evi, olyo nolya kakama;
okwa gumu oondundu, odho nodha kungu omulilo.

Omuwa na taambe ndje, sho tandi mu dhiladhila;
otandi nyanyukilwa Omuwa.

Aalunde naa kane ko kombanda yevi,
naakaanakalunga inaa monika ko we.
Omwenyo gwandje, hambelela Omuwa!
Halleluja!
105:
Imbileni Omuwa omahambelelondjimbo;
hokololeni iilongankumwe e yi longo.

Tangeni edhina lye eyapuki;
amuhe mbo hamu ya koshipala shOmuwa, nyanyukweni!

Kongeni ekwatho kOmuwa,
ne mu mu simaneke aluheluhe.

Ne oluvalo lwaAbraham, omupiya gwe,
ne oluvalo lwaJakob, omuhogololwa gwe,
dhimbulukweni iikumithalonga mbyoka Kalunga e yi longo
nomapangulo ngoka a gandja.

Omuwa oye Kalunga ketu;
oye ta pangula uuyuni auhe.

Ota dhiginine ehangano lye sigo aluhe,
euvaneko lye sigo omaluvalo nomaluvalo.

Ota dhiginine ehangano lye naAbraham
neuvaneko lye kuIsak.

Omuwa okwa dhike ehangano lya kola naJakob,
ehangano lyaaluhe naIsrael.

Oye okwa ti: “Otandi ke ku pa evi lyaKaanan,
notali ka ninga eliko lyoye.”

Aantu yaKalunga oya li aashona komwaalu;
oya kala oondjendi mevi lyaKaanan

Oya tembukile koshilongo noshilongo;
oya kala mokati kaantu mbaka naambeyaka.

Ihe Kalunga ina pitika ya hepekwe;
okwe ya gamene nokwa ganda aapangeli ta ti:

“Inamu ningila aahogololwa yandje uuwinayi,
inamu ehameka aahunganeki yandje.”

Omuwa okwa tumine oshilongo shawo ondjala
nokwa kutha po iikulya ayihe.

Okwe ya tetekelithile omulumentu gumwe,
Josef, ngoka a landithwa po omupika.

Oye okwa kwatwa e ta tulwa momalyenge
nokwa tulwa olinga yosheela mothingo,

sigo ehunganeko lye lya gwanithwa.
Oohapu dhOmuwa odhe shi koleke wo.

Omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti okwe mu mangululitha mo;
omupangeli gwiigwana okwe mu piitha mo.

Okwe mu ningi elenga lyegumbo lye
nomutonateli gweliko lye alihe.

Okwa lenge Josef mokati komalenga ge agehe,
a pukulule aagandjindunge ye.

Opo ihe Jakob okwe ke ya kuEgipiti
nokwa tula moshilongo shoka.

Aayegipiti okwe ya sikumudha, ya tonde aantu ye
noya kotokele aapiya ye.

Okwe ya tumine omupiya gwe Moses,
naAaron, omuhogololwa gwe.

Kalunga okwe ya longitha iinyengandunge
nokwe ya ningitha iikumithalonga muEgipiti.

Kalunga okwa tumine oshilongo shAayegipiti omilema,
oshoka inaa vulika kelombwelo lye.

Omilonga dhawo dhomeya
okwe dhi shitukitha ombinzi
nokwa dhipaga po oohi dhawo adhihe.

Oshilongo shawo osha li tashi wiwima omafuma;
oga li gu udha nomoondjugo dhaapangeli yawo.

Kalunga okwa popi kutya naku ye oompawe nomatopola;
iipupu yayo noya tuka noshilongo ashihe.
Peha lyomvula, okwa tumine oshilongo shawo oompawe noombadhi.

Okwa halakanitha po omiviinu nomikwiyu dhawo
nokwa teya po omiti dhawo.
Okwa popi, oombahu nodha holoka, omayuvi nomayuvi.

Odha li po iimeno ayihe yomomapya;
odha mana po iikunwa ayihe.

Okwa dhipaga po iisheelimati yawo ayihe,
aavalwa yawo aatango ayehe.

Aayegipiti oya li ya tila
nAaisraeli oya li ya nyanyukwa, sho ya zi mo.

Kalunga okwa tula ko oshikogo
okusiikila aantu ye,
nuusiku uuyelele woku ya minikila.

Okwa tsu ombululu memanya,
omeya noga tsipuka mo,
noga kunguluka nombuga ngaashi omulonga.

Omuwa okwa dhimbulukwa euvaneko lye eyapuki
e li uvanekele omupiya gwe Abraham.

Oye okwa piitha mo aahogololwa ye
noyi imbi nokunyanyukwa.

Okwe ya langeke miilongo yaantu yalwe,
nomapya gawo okwe ga pe po Aaisraeli

Okwe shi ningi, opo aantu ye ya vulike kiipango ye
noya dhiginine omalombwelo ge.
Halleluja!
106:
Olye ta vulu okuyalula iikumitha mbyo a longa?
Olye ta vulu oku mu pa esimano lya gwana?

Aanelago oomboka haa kala moshili,
mboka haa longo aluhe shoka shu uka.

Talitha ndje uulinawa waantu yoye aahogololwa,
opo ndi nyanyukwe pamwe noshigwana shoye
nondi itangele mungoye pamwe nayo.

Otse otwa yono ngaashi ootate wo;
otwa longo uudhudhu nuukolokoshi.

Ootate muEgipiti inaa longwa sha
kiilongakumithi yaKalunga.
Oya dhimbwa, nkene a kala e ya hole aluhe,
sho ya tangalala pEfuta etiligane.

Ihe okwe ya hupitha ngaashi u uvaneke,
opo i iholole kutya oye omunankondo.

Okwa lombwele Efuta etiligane li gandje ompito,
olyo nolya pwine,
nokwe enditha aantu ye puukukutu.

Okwe ya hupitha miikaha yaatondi yawo
nokwe ya yugulula ko kaahepeki yawo

Ihe omeya oga siikile aatondi yawo;
inapu hupa nando ogumwe.

Nena aantu ye oyi itaale omauvaneko ge
noye mu imbile ehambelelo.

Ihe konima oya dhimbwa shoka e shi longo
noya longo inaaya pula ewiliko lye.

Mombuga oya falafalwa komahalo gawo ga puka
noya hindi Kalunga.

Kalunga okwe ya pe shoka ye mu indile,
ihe okwe ya tumine wo omukithi omudhigu.

Mombuga oya sile Moses efupa,
naAaron omuhogololwa gwOmuwa.

Evi olye ekama nolya nina po Datan;
olya siikile Abiram naangandjawo ayehe.

Omulilo ogwa hwamene aalanduli yawo
nogwa fike po aakolokoshi mboka.

PuSinai oya tholoma ontana yoshingoli
noya galikana oshikalunga shoka.

Peha lyokusimaneka Kalunga,
oya simaneke efano lyoshinamwenyo hashi li omwiidhi.

Oya dhimbwa Kalunga ngoka e ya hupitha,
ngoka a longo iilongankondo muEgipiti,

oongoka a ningi iilonga iikumithi
niitilithi pEfuta etiligane.

Kalunga sho a popi kutya okwa hala okuyona po aantu ye,
omupiya gwe Moses okwa thikama
nokwa galikana Kalunga e te mu indile kee ya geele.

Ano oyi iteka evi ewanawa,
oshoka inaa itaala euvaneko lyaKalunga

Oya kala momatsali taa ngungutula
noinaa hala okuuva Omuwa shoka ta ti.

Omuwa okwe ya lombwele elondodho lya kola kutya
ngele itaa vulika, ote ke ya etha, ya sile mombuga.
Ote ke etha oluvalo lwawo lu sile nolu halakanene miilongo niilongo.

PuPeor oyi igameke kuBaal
noya li omayambo ga yambelwa iikalunga yaa na omwenyo.

Oya geyitha Omuwa niilonga yawo
noya adhika komukithi gwelega.

Ihe Pinehas okwa thikama
nokwa geele aayoni, nomukithi ogwa mwena.

Shika osha holola uuwanawa wOmuwa,
notashi ka dhimbulukiwa komaluvalo nomaluvalo.

Pomeya gaMeriba aantu oya geyitha Omuwa,
naMoses okwa geelwa omolwawo.

Oya geyitha Ombepo yaKalunga,
onkee Moses okwe ya nyenyetele
itaa fudha po.

Inaa halakanitha po aapagani,
ngaashi Omuwa e ya lombwele,

ihe oya hokanathana nayo
noya taamba omikalo dhawo.

Oya simaneke iimenka yawo,
naashika oshe ya fala meyonuuko.

Oya gandja oyana aamati naakadhona,
ya ninge omayambo kiikalunga yAakaanana.

Oya dhipaga oyana yaa na oondjo,
noshilongo osha nyatekwa kiilonga yawo.

Oyi inyateke niilonga yawo
noye etha Kalunga.

Omuwa nokwa geele aantu ye;
oya ningi iikungitha kuye.

Okwe ya ethele miikaha yaapagani,
noya yi mepangelo lyaatondi yawo.

Aatondi yawo oye ya hepeke
noye ya humbateke omitenge omidhigu.

Olwindji Omuwa okwa kala nokuhupitha aantu ye,
ihe yo inaa vulika noya yono aluhe.

Ihe Omuwa oku uvu onkugo yawo,
sho ye li muudhigu,
ye ina gamuka ko kuyo.

Okwa dhimbulukwa ehangano lye
ndyoka e li dhike molwawo,
nokwa geuluka molwohole ye.

Okwa pe aahepeki yawo ombepo yolukeno,
opo ye ya sile ohenda.

nena oyana otaa ke ku landula muukwaniilwa aluhe sigo aluhe.”

“Ndika olyo ehala lyandje lyokukala aluhe;
onda hala okukala muka nokupangela.

Otandi yambeke Sion niilikolomwa yasho;
oohepele dhamo otandi ke dhi pa eloolo.

Aayambi yamo otandi ke ya etela ehupitho,
naantu yandje otaa ki imba nokunyanyukwa.

Otandi ka koleka uukwaniilwa waDavid, noluvalo lwe
otalu ka ya koshipundi she shuukwaniilwa.

Aatondi ye otandi ke ya sitha ohoni,
ihe oshishani otashi ka adhima komutse gwe.”
133:
Osho opala sho opalelela
aantu ayehe ngele taa kala ye holathana
ngaashi aamwayinathana.

Okukala kwa tya ngaaka
okwa fa omugwayo gwezimba lya nika nawa tagu tilwa komutse
notagu pononokele koombenzi dhaAaron
nokoongenge dhoonguwo dhe.

Ongaashi omume gwokondundu Hermon
tagu gwile kondundu Sion.
Oko hoka Omuwa ta gandja eyambeko nomwenyo sigo aluhe.
134:
Hambeleleni Omuwa, ne aalongeli ye
mboka tamu yakula uusiku mongulu yOmuwa.

Yelutheni omaako geni,
sho tamu galikana motempeli,
ne mu hambelele Omuwa!

Omuwa, omushiti gwegulu nogwevi
ne mu laleke nuuyamba muSion!
135:
Halleluja! Hambeleleni Omuwa!
Simanekeni edhina lye,
ne aalongeli yOmuwa,

one mboka tamu thikama mongulu yOmuwa,
motempeli yaKalunga ketu.

Hambeleleni Omuwa, oshoka oye omwaanawa;
osho opala okusimaneka edhina lye.

Omuwa okwa hogolola Jakob a ninge gwe,
naIsrael a ninge eliko lye.

Ondi shi shi kutya Omuwa oye omunene,
Omuwa gwetu oye omunene
e vule iikalunga ayihe.

Omuwa oha longo ashihe shoka she mu opalela,
megulu nokombanda yevi.
Mefuta nomuule walyo.

Ote enditha iikogo okuza kohulo yevi,
ota tumu omvula yi na oombadhi
nota tukulutha ombepo mompungulilo ye.

Okwa dhipaga po aatango yAayegipiti,
aatango yaantu noyiimuna.

Okwa longo iikumitha niinyengandunge muEgipiti;
okwa geele omukwaniilwa nomalenga ge agehe.

Oye nguka a dhenge iigwana oyindji
nokwa dhipaga aakwaniilwa aanankondo:

Sihon, omukwaniilwa gwaAayamori,
Og, omukwaniilwa gwaBaasha
naakwaniilwa ayehe yaKaanan.

Okwa gandja evi lyawo kaantu ye,
lya ningi lyoshigwana she Israel.

Omuwa, edhina lyoye otali simanekwa aluhe sigo aluhe.
Omuwa, oto ka simanekwa komaluvalo agehe.

Omuwa ota ka popila aantu ye
nota ka sila aalongeli ye ohenda.
