Omuntu a kuta ota lyatagula nomagadhi goonyushi, ihe ngoka a sa ondjala, oku uvite niilulululu iitoye.
Ongondhila tayi tuka kokule noshihandhila shayo, osho wo omuntu ngoka a pukile e li kokule noyaandjawo.
Omagadhi gomugwayo niitsinino ohayi nyanyudha omutima; osho wo ohole yakuume ngoka e na ehalo lyokupukulula.
Ino thiga po kuume koye nakuume kaho; mesiku lyomupya gwoye ino ya kaandjamumwanyoko. Omushiinda ngoka e li popepi nangoye oku vule omumwanyoko ngoka e li kokule.
Mumwandje, ninga oondunge, u nyanyudhe omwenyo gwandje, opo ndi wape okuyamukula ngoka ta sitha ndje ohoni.
Omunawino ota dhimbulula oshiponga e te shi holama, manga aasama taa nduungile yu uka ko e taa itsu musho.
Kutha po onguwo yaangoka a popile gulwe, nou mu kuthe a ninge ombambyona yomukwiilongo.
Ngoka ta koloma noti igidhile mukwawo omayambeko moontundumene, otashi mu yalulilwa etulomutima.
Ontongo tayi ziya esiku lyomuzimbi nomukulukadhi e na omulungu oya faathana.
Ngoka a hala oku mu holeka, ota holeke ombepo, ota kwata omagadhi nolulyo lwe.
Oshitenda ohashi wege oshitenda oshikwawo, omuntu oha wege omuntu omukwawo.
Ngoka ta tekula omukwiyu, ota li oonkwiyu, naangoka ta yakula nawa mwene gwe, ota ka simanekwa.
Ngaashi oshipala tashi imonene momeya, osho omutima gwomuntu tagu monika kumukwawo.
Oshaasi nonakupila ihayi kuta, nomeho gomuntu ihaga kuta.
Ontelekelo oyoshisiliveli neziko olyoshingoli, ihe omuntu ota yelekwa nesimano ndyoka ta simanekwa nalyo.
Egoya nando u li tsile koshini mumwe noomuma, uugoya walyo itau zi mo.
Koneka nokukonekelela iipala yoonzi noyiikombo yoye, dhiginina iimuna yoye.
Oshoka eliko itali kala sigo aluhe, noshishani otashi thiki tuu kepipi nepipi?
Omwiidhi nge gwa muwa nohuluhulu tayi holoka niigwanga yokoondundu tayi gongelwa,
nena uunzigona otau gandja oonguwo kungoye niikombo iimaliwa yokulanda epya.
Ou na omahini gomoosi giikombo ga gwanena oku ku palutha negumbo lyoye naalelwa yoye.
28: Aakaanakalunga otaa fadhuka po pwaa na ngoka te ya tidha, ihe aayuuki oye na uulaadhi ya fa onime ongundjuka.
Omolwomayono oshilongo otashi kala shi na aawa oyendji, ihe omolwomunongo gumwe omunamayele elandulathano otali kala po.
Omuntu omukwanaluhepo ta hepeke oohepele okwa fa omvula tayi vovola iilya yo itayi gandja iipalutha.
Mboka taa etha ompango, otaa tanga aakaanakalunga, ihe mboka taa dhiginine ompango, oyu uvite uugelele molwawo.
Aawinayi kaye uvite ko uuyuuki, ihe mboka haa kongo Omuwa oyu uvite ko ayihe.
Ohepele ndjoka tayi ende yaa na oshipwe, oyi vule omuyamba ngoka te ende oondjila mbali dha goyoka.
Omumati omunandunge oye ngoka ta dhiginine ompango, ihe ngoka ta kala naahanaguli, ota sitha he ohoni.
Ngoka ti indjipalitha eliko lye nontanitho ya pitilila, ote yi gongelele ngoka ta ka sila oohepele ohenda.
Ngoka ta thitike omakutsi ge kaa uve ompango, negalikano lye olyo iihuna.
Ngoka ta fala aayuuki mondjila yepuko, ota ka gwila mekelo lye mwene, aakaanashipwe otaa ka thigulula elago.
Omuyamba oye omunongo momeho ge mwene; ihe ohepele onandunge otayi mu konakona.
Aayuuki nge taa ligola, eopalo enene, ihe aakaanakalunga sho taa holoka, aantu otaa holama.
Oongoka ta holeke iilonga ye iiwinayi, oye ke na elago, ihe ngoka te yi hempulula note yi etha, oye ta silwa ohenda.
Omunelago oye ngoka ta kala aluhe a tila Omuwa, ihe ngoka ta kukutike omwenyo gwe, ota ka gwila momupya.
Ngaashi onime tayi pumbu nemwanka lya sa ondjala, osho omukeenakalunga ta pangele oshigwana oshikweyi.
Omukwaniilwa kee na oondunge, oha yugu aantu, ihe ngoka e tonde eliko lyiifundja, ota nyanyukilwa omwenyo omule.
Omuntu ngoka e na uutoni, ota kala ta holamaholama sigo okeso lye; nokape na ngoka te mu gamene.
Ngoka te ende pauyuuki, ota ka kwathwa, ihe ngoka te ende oondjila mbali dha goyoka, ota ka punduka ohaluka.
Ngoka ta longo epya lye, ota mono iilya, ihe ngoka ta lalakanene iinima yowala, ota ka hepa unene.
Omuntu omwiinekelwa ota yambekwa unene, ihe ngoka a pya ompiya okuninga omuyamba, ita kala inaa geelwa.
Inashi opala okukala nolutandu, oshoka omolwokapambu koshikwiila omuntu ta vulu okuyona.
Omunefupa otu ulumine uuyamba ye ina tseya kutya oluhepo otalu ke mu kwata.
Ngoka ta ganda omuntu, ota ka pandika shi vule ngoka ta mbembeleke.
Ngoka ta yugu he nenge yina e ta ti: “Kashi shi ondjo,” oye omukwawo gwomuhanaguli.
Omunalwiho ota tukula oontamanana, ihe ngoka ti inekele Omuwa, ota talalekwa.
Ngoka i inekela omutima gwe mwene oye egoya, ihe ngoka te ende mowino, ota hupithwa.
Oongoka ta pe sha oohepele, ita hepa; ihe ngoka te dhi thithikilile omeho ge, ota thingwa koyendji.
Aakaanakalunga nge taa yeluka, aantu otaa holama; ihe nge taa hulu po, aayuuki otaa indjipala.
29: Omuntu ngoka a geelwa e ta kukutike aluhe othingo ye, ota teywa po pwaa na ehungo lyasha.
Aayuuki nge taa indjipala, oshigwana otashi nyanyukwa, ihe aakaanakalunga nge taa pangele, oshigwana otashi keme.
Omuntu ngoka e hole owino, ota nyanyudha he, ihe ngoka ta vundakana noohonda, ota hanagula po eliko lye.
Omukwaniilwa ota lele oshilongo she nuuyuuki, ihe ngoka ta yugu aantu, ote shi teya po.
Omuntu ngoka ta mbembeleke mukwawo, ota lukile omwigo kohi yoonkatu dhe.
Omudhudhu oha yulwa keyono lye mwene, ihe omuyuuki ota ka ligola nokunyanyukwa.
Omuyuuki okwa tseya onkalo yoohepele, ihe omukeenakalunga ke na ko nasha nayo.
Aasheki ohaa piyaganeke oshilongo, ihe aanawino ohaa kodheke ondjahi.
Omunawino ngele ota hokololithathana moompangu negoya, egoya onkee lya kudhila nduno nokuyola pwaa na elotelo.
Aadhipagi ohaa tondo omukeenashipwe, ohaa kongo oomwenyo dhaayuuki.
Omugoya ota mana mo ondjahi ye ayihe, ihe omunawino ohi ikwata.
Omukwaniilwa ngoka ta pulakene oohapu dhiifundja, aapiya ye ayehe otaa ningi aakaanakalunga.
Ohepele nomuthiminiki otaa tsakanene, Omuwa ota minikile omeho gawo ayehe yaali.
Omukwaniilwa ngoka tu uthile oohepele pauyuuki, oshipangelapundi she otashi kala sha kola aluhe.
Olunwa negeelo ohali gandja owino, ihe omumati ngoka a lelwa ondembula, ota sitha yina ohoni.
Aakaanakalunga ngele taa indjipala, omayonagulo otaga indjipala wo, ihe aayuuki otaa ke ya tala, sho taa kana po.
Putudha omumwoyemati, nena ote ke ku vululukitha, e ta ka nyanyudha omwenyo gwoye.
Ngele kape na ehololo, oshigwana otashi pwidhuka; ihe omunelago oongoka ta dhiginine ompango.
Omupiya iha londodhwa koohapu, oshoka oku uvite ko nawa, ihe ke na ko nasha nadho.
Owa mona tuu omuntu a sa ompiya okupopya? Omusama oku na wo etegameno e mu vule.
Omuntu ngele ta lele omupiya gwe ondembula okuza kuunona, komeho ote ke ku pilukila.
Omugeyentu oha tukula oontamanana, nomukehuki oku na omayono ogendji.
Uuntsa womuntu otau mu shundula, ihe omwiifupipiki ota simanekwa.
Ngoka taa topolelathana nomufuthi oshinima, ota tondo omwenyo gwe mwene; otu uvu eganitho ye ita holola sha.
Okutila omuntu okulukila omwigo, ihe ngoka ti inekele Omuwa, ota gamenwa.
Oyendji ohaa kongo ohokwe koshipala shomukwaniilwa, ihe uuyuuki womuntu ohau zi kOmuwa.
Omuntu omufundja oye iihuna koshipala shaayuuki, nomuyuuki koshipala shaakaanakalunga.
30:
Oohapu dhaAgur yaJake — ontomona. Omuntu ta popi:
“Kalunga, ondi ivulitha;
Nampongo, ondi ilolokitha,
ongame epongo.

Ngame omugoya unene okuninga omuntu;
kandi na oondunge dhopantu.

Inandi nongela owino,
opo ndi kale nda tseya Omuyapuki.

Olye a londo kegulu nokwa kuluka ko?
Olye a kaminina ombepo meke lye?
Olye a kwatelelela omeya monguwo ye?
Olye a dhike ooha dhevi adhihe?
Edhina lye olye? Nedhina lyomwana olye?
Lombwela ndje, ngele ou li shi.
“Ohapu yaKalunga kehe oya yelithwa; oye eholameno lyaamboka taa holama puye.
Poohapu dhe ino gwedha po sha, opo kee ku tamaneke nowaa holoke puuyelele omufundja.”
“Otandi ku indile iinima iyali, ino yi tindila ndje, manga inaandi sa.
Uufudhime niifundja yi kaleka kokule nangame. Uuyamba nenge oluhepo ino lu pa ndje; palutha ndje noshikwiila shoka sha yeleka ndje.
Ngele nda kuta unene, otashi vulika tandi ku idhimbike tandi ti: ‘Omuwa oye lye?’ Nongele ndi li moluhepo, otashi vulika ndi ka yake nondi kwatithe edhina lyaKalunga kandje oshidhila.”
Ino lombola ko omupiya kumwene gwe, opo kee ku tuke nowaa monike ombudhi.
Oku na oluvalo talu thingi he noitalu yambeke yina.
Oku na aantu ya yela momeho gawo yene, nando inaa yogoka ko koongaga dhawo.
Oku na aantu ye na omeho ge na uuntsa nohaa tala nethithimano.
Oku na aantu mboka omayego gawo omagongamwele noondjego dhawo omakuwaha, opo ya taasine po aathigona moshilongo noohepele mokati kaantu.

Ethipimbinzi oli na oyana aakadhona yaali, oyo Pendje! Pendje!
Oku na iinima itatu mbyoka ihaayi kuta, iinima ine mbyoka ihaayi ti: “Sha gwana!”
Oyo oshaasi, ela entimbe, evi ndyoka ihaali kumwa omeya, nomulilo, ngoka ihaagu ti: “Opuwo nduno!”
Ngoka ta sheke he e ta dhini evuliko okuvulika kuyina, omadhilakola gomolusilu otage ke mu shomona omeho, nuukodhigona otau ga li po.
Oku na iinima itatu mbyoka tayi kumitha ndje, eeno, ine mbyoka kaandi yi uvite ko:
oshinkoti shekodhi mewangandjo, omusinda gweyoka kemanya, oshitauwa shosikepa mokati kefuta noshinkoti shomulumentu komukadhona.
Osho ondjila yomukulukadhi omuhondeli: ota li e to opaleke okana ke ta ti: “Inandi yona sha!”
Kohi yiinima itatu evi otali kakama, nokohi yiine itali vulu okukala lya kola:
omupika ngele ta ningi omukwaniilwa nomusama ngele e na iikulya ya ha,
omukiintu e tondike nge ta hokanwa, nomupika omukiintu nge ta pingene mwene gwe.
Oku na iishitwa ine mbyoka iishuushuka kombanda yevi, ihe oyi na owino oyindjiyindji:
Uudhidhi owo iishitwa yaa na oonkondo, ihe otau pungula iikulya yawo mothinge.
Uuhele owo iishitwa yaa na omatha, ihe ohau ningi omakwena gawo momamanya.
Oombahu kadhi na omukwaniilwa, ihe iiluku yadho oyi li melandulathano lyo opala.
Eyengele oto vulu oku li kwata niikaha yowala, ihe ohali kala muuwa waakwaniilwa.
Oku na iishitwa itatu mbyoka hayi katuka nokutuwalala, eeno, ine mbyoka hayi ende nokwiithela:
onime, omukwaniilwa mokati kiinamwenyo, ndjoka ihaayi henukile sha,
ekondombolo li na oshilundo, oshikombo shoshitsezi, nomukwaniilwa e na omatanga ga homata.
Ngele wa sameka nowi inenepeke nenge wa dhiladhila uuwinayi, ikwata komilungu noshikaha.
Oshoka okuhika omahini otaku eta omagadhi, mokuhika eyulu otamu zi ombinzi nomokuhika ondjahi otamu zi oontamanana.
31: Oohapu ndhoka Lemuel, omukwaniilwa gwaMassa, a pukululwa nadho kuyina:
“Oshike, mumwandjemati, omumati gwomoshivalelo shandje, omumati gwomauvaneko gandje, nandi tye shike?
Oonkondo dhoye ino dhi manena maakiintu, ngoye u vundakane naamboka haa yono po aakwaniilwa.
Akutu, Lemuel, inashi opalela aakwaniilwa, eeno, inashi opalela aakwaniilwa okunwa omaviinu, naawagona okupula iikolitha.
Ota ningi a nwe ye a dhimbwe shoka ompango tayi ti e ta goyokitha uuyuuki waakwanaluhepo.
Iikolitha yi peni ngoka a hala okukana, nomaviinu oomboka ye na uudhigu uululululu.
Mbeyaka naa nwe yo ya dhimbwe oluhepo lwawo nokwaadhiladhila we uukweyi wawo.
“Makula okana koye, u popile ombolo naayehe mboka taa hala okwoongotela.
Makula okana koye, pangula pauyuuki, popila uuthemba womukweyi nohepele.”
Olye ta ka hokana omukulukadhi omwaanawa? Oshoka omungunda gwe ogu vule omawe omanene.
Omutima gwomulumentu gwe ohagu mu inekele, ye ita pumbwa omaliko.
Omulumentu gwe ohe mu ningile uuwanawa, hauwinayi, omasiku agehe gokukalamwenyo kwe.
Oha sile oshimpwiyu omafufu goonzi noongodhi dholiina noha longo niikaha yi na ondjungu.
Oku li po a fa osikepapindiki — ohe eta mo iipalutha ye tayi zi kokule.
Oha meneka moontundumene e ta topolele aanegumbo ye iikulya niitopolwa yu uthilwa aadhike ye.
Ota hala epya note li kulile, meliko lyiikaha ye ta tsike oshitsambe she shomiviinu.
Oombwetelo dhe okwe dhi zaleka oonkondo nomaako ge okwe ga koleka.
Oku uvite eliko lye tali koko, nolamba ye itayi dhimi uusiku.
Oha tsu iikaha ye koshiyogohitho, nomake ge otaga dhiginine oshiyogohithopingo.
Eke lye ohe li kamunukile ohepele, niikaha ye ohe yi ganekele aakwanaluhepo.
Egumbo lye ihali tila uutalala wombambi, oshoka yaandjawo ayehe oya zala oonguwo dhomafufu goonzi.
Oti itungile omakumbatha, oonguwo dhe odholiina ombwanawa ontiliganembwilili.
Omulumentu gwe okwa tseyika posheelo shoshilando, mpoka ta kuutumba pamwe naakuluntu yoshilando.
Ota hondjo oohema dholiina note dhi landitha po, nomapaya te ga halitha po kaahalithi yiipindi.
Oonkondo nesimano odho omizalo dhe, nota yolele esiku tali landula.
Okana ke ote ka makulile oohapu dhowino, nokelaka lye oku na enongeko lyuukuume.
Oha tonatele nawa iilonga yomegumbo lye noiha li oshikwiila shonyalo.
Oyanamati otaa thikama e taa tumbula elago lye; omulumentu gwe wo ote mu tanga ta ti:
“Aakiintu oyendji aadhiginini miilonga yawo, ihe ngoye ou ya vule ayehe.”
Oshuuluko shomukiintu kashi shi kwiinekelwa nuumbweshukile ohau yonuka; omukulukadhi ngoka ha tila Omuwa, oku na okutangwa.
Na tundulukithwe kiiyimati yiilonga yiikaha ye, iilonga ye nayi mu tange miiyelo.

1: Ndhika oohapu dhomuuvithi, omuna gwaDavid, ngoka a li omukwaniilwa muJerusalem.
Omuuvithi ota ti: “Ayihe oyowala, eeno, ayihe oyowalawala!”
Omuntu oti ilikolele shike mokwiipyakidhila kwe akuhe kohi yetango?
Epipi limwe tali ka pita nekwawo otali ya, ihe evi otali kala sigo aluhe.
Etango otali piti, netango otali ningine nokushuna ishewe pehala mpoka hali pitile.
Ombepo otayi pepe yu uka kuumbugantu notayi ka galukila kuumbangalantu; otayi idhingoloka aluhe nokugalukila komakundukilo gayo.
Omilonga adhihe otadhi tondokele mefuta, ihe efuta itali udha nando; kehala hoka omilonga tadhi tondokele, otadhi tondokele ko aluhe.
Iinima ayihe oyi na eipyakidhilo nokape na omuntu ta vulu oku shi popya. Eho ihali kuta okutala, kwo okutsi ihaku vulwa okupulakena.
Shoka sha li ko, otashi ka kala ko ishewe; shoka sha ningwa, otashi ka ningwa natango.
Kohi yetango kaku na sha taku tiwa: “Tala utale, shika oshipeepee!” Oko sha li nale muuyuni waakulu yonale.
Kaku na ondhimbuluko yasha yootatekulu, nomapipi ngoka tage ya, itaga dhimbulukiwa kungoka taga ka kala ko ohugunina.
Ngame omuuvithi onda li omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael muJerusalem.
Ondu ukitha omwenyo gwandje kekonakono lyuunongo nokudhiladhila ayihe mbyoka tayi ningwa kohi yegulu. Shika osho oshinakugwanithwa oshidhigu Kalunga e shi pe aana yaantu, ya se oshimpwiyu nasho.
Onda mono iilonga ayihe mbyoka tayi ningwa kohi yetango; ayihe oyowala nokutidha ombepo.
Shoka sha goyoka, itashi vulu okuuthwa, naashoka shaa po, itashi vulu okuyalulwa.
Ondi ipopile nda ti: “Tala, onda koko nonda likola aluhe owino oyindji ndi vule ayehe mboka ya tetekelele ndje okulela muJerusalem, nomwenyo gwandje ogwa mono owino nuunongo.”
Ihe sho nda yelutha omwenyo gwandje, ndi ilonge okutseya owino nuunongo nokuuva ko uugoya nuusama, onde shi dhimbulula kutya nani osho okutidha ombepo.
Oshoka mowino oyindji omo mu na uupyakadhi owindji naangoka ti indjipaleke uunongo, oti indjipalitha uuwehame.
2: Ondi ipopile momwenyo nda ti: “Eewa, otandi ke ku makelitha enyanyu, nyanyukilwa uuwanawa!” Ihe tala, naashika osima yowala.
Koondjola onda ti, shika uugoya! Kenyanyu onda ti, otashi kwatha shike?

Onde shi dhiladhila momwenyo gwandje, ndi nyanyudhe olutu lwandje nomaviinu — manga omwenyo gwandje tagu endithwa kowino — nondi ikwatelele kuusama, opo ndi mone shoka sho opalela aana yaantu ye na oku shi ninga kohi yegulu momukokomoko gwomwaalu gwomasiku gokukalamwenyo kwawo.
Onda longa iilonga iinene; ondi itungile omagumbo, nondi itsikile iitsambe yomiviinu.
Ondi ikunine omapya niikunino nonda tsike omiti dhiiyimati dhi ili nodhi ili.
Ondi ihupile omatale, opo ndi tekele iimeno nomiti omishona.
Ondi ilandele aapika aalumentu naakiintu, nonda likola mboka ya valelwa megumbo lyandje. Onda munu oongombe, oonzi niikombo, ndi vule ayehe mboka ya tetekelele ndje muJerusalem.
Ondi igongelele wo oshisiliveli noshingoli nomaliko gaakwaniilwa niilongo; ondi imonene aayimbi aalumentu naakiintu nomanyanyu gaana yaantu, aaholike oyendjiyendji.
Onda koko aluhe nda ningi omunene ndi vule ayehe mboka ya li ndje komeho muJerusalem. Onda kaleke owino yandje pungame.

Noshaa shoka omeho gandje ge shi hala, inandi ge shi indika; omwenyo gwandje inagu iyageka enyanyu nando olimwe, oshoka omwenyo gwandje ogwa nyanyukilwa iilonga yandje ayihe ndi ipyakidhile nayo, nosho sha li oshitopolwa shiilonga yuupyakadhi wandje.

Sho nda tala iilonga yandje ayihe mbyoka ye etwa po kiikaha yandje nuupyakadhi woonkambadhala dhandje adhihe ndhoka nda ningi — tala, ayihe oya li osima yowala nokutidha ombepo, nokaku na sha shomupondo kohi yetango.
Onda pungulukile owino, uugoya nuusama nde u tongolola nomeho. Omukwaniilwa ota vulu okuninga shike shoka inaashi ningwa nale komutetekeli gwe?
Eeno, onda tala ko, owino oyi na omwago yi vule uugoya, ngaashi uuyelele u na omwago u vule omilema.
Omunawino oku na omeho momutse gwe, ihe omusama ote ende momilema. Ihe onde shi dhimbulula kutya ayehe otaa ka adhika keadhiko limwe.

Onkee ndi ipopile momwenyo gwandje nda ti: “Shoka ngaa tashi adha omugoya, osho wo tashi ka adha ndje. Owino oye etele ndje po shike ano?” Nondi ipopile momutima gwandje kutya naashika wo osima yowala.
Oshoka sho shene okudhimbulukiwa kwomunawino oku thike pamwe nokwegoya, oshoka monakuyiwa ayehe otaa ka dhimbiwa; ndishi omunawino naye wo ota si ngaashi egoya.
Onkee ano nda ketelwa kokukalamwenyo, oshoka iilonga mbyoka hayi longwa kohi yetango, oya ehameka ndje, molwaashoka ayihe oyowala nokutidha ombepo.
Onda kunyukwa oonkambadhala dhandje adhihe ndhoka nda gwanitha nuudhigu kohi yetango, nondi na oku dhi thigila omuntu ngoka ta landula ndje.
Olye a tseya ngele ye omunawino nenge egoya? Oye ta ka lela iilonga yandje mbyoka nde yi tsakanitha nuudhigu nonde yi likola nuunongo kohi yetango. Naashika wo osima yowala.
Onkee ano ondi iyekelele molwiilonga ayihe mbyoka nda tsakanitha nuudhigu kohi yetango.
Omuntu nando ti ipyakidhile nowino, nuunongo nonuunkulungu, ayihe ote yi thigile ngoka inee yi longela. Naashika osima yowala, oshiponga nokuli.
Oshoka omuntu oku na ondjambi yashike momaipyakidhilo nomoonkambadhala dhe ti ihepeke nadho kohi yetango?
Oshoka omasiku ge agehe oge na uuwehame nomaihepeko ge agehe omalulu, nokuli uusiku omwenyo gwe itagu vululukwa nando. Naashika owaleelela.
Omuntu ke na elago lilwe lyaa shi okulya nokunwa nokunyanyudha omwenyo gwe niilonga ye yuupyakadhi. Onde shi mono wo kutya osha zi miikaha yaKalunga.
Oshoka olye ta vulu okulya nokunyanyukwa keehe mu na?

Oshoka omuntu ngoka e mu opalela, Kalunga ote mu pe owino, uunongo nenyanyu, ihe omulunde ote mu pe oshilonga shokugongela noshokundumbila pamwe, opo e yi gandje kungoka e mu opalela. Naashika wo owaleelela nokutidha ombepo.
3: Ayihe oyi na otundi yayo, noshaa shoka kohi yegulu oshi na ethimbo lyasho:

ethimbo lyokuvalwa,
nethimbo lyokusa
ethimbo lyokutsika,
nethimbo lyokutudha mo shoka sha tsikilwe

ethimbo lyokudhipaga,
nethimbo lyokwaaludha
ethimbo lyokukumuna po,
nethimbo lyokutunga

ethimbo lyokulila,
nethimbo lyokuyola
ethimbo lyokunika uuthigwa,
nethimbo lyokudhana

ethimbo lyokuhalakanitha omamanya,
nethimbo lyoku ga gongela
ethimbo lyepapatelathano,
nethimbo lyokukala kokule nepapatelathano

ethimbo lyokukonga,
nethimbo lyokukanitha
ethimbo lyokupungula,
nethimbo lyokweekelahi

ethimbo lyokutuula,
nethimbo lyokuhondja
ethimbo lyokumwena,
nethimbo lyokupopya

ethimbo lyokuholathana,
nethimbo lyokutondathana
ethimbo lyiita,
nethimbo lyombili.
Nakulonga oku na ekwatho lyashike mumbyoka e yi longo?
Onda tala kiilonga mbyoka iidhigu Kalunga a pe aana yaantu yi ipyakidhile nayo.
Ayihe okwe yi ningi yo opala pethimbo lye. Okwa tula uukwaaluhe moomwenyo dhaantu, po pwaa na omuntu ta tseya iilonga mbyoka Kalunga a longo okuza ketameko sigo okehulilo.
Onde shi dhimbulula kutya omuntu mokukalamwenyo kwe ke na elago lilwe lyaa shi okunyanyukwa nokulonga uuwanawa.
Naashika wo omuntu a lye ye a nwe noku nyanyukilwe iilonga yuupyakadhi we auhe — osho omagano gaKalunga.
Onda dhimbulula kutya ayihe mbyoka Kalunga a ningi, otayi kala po sigo aluhe, itaku gwedhwa sha noitaku kuthwa sha; Kalunga okwe yi ningi ngaaka, opo a tilike.
Ayihe mbyoka yi li ko, oko ya li nale; naambyoka tayi ka kala ko, oko ya li nale; Kalunga nota ka kongulula po mbyoka ya pitilila po.
Kohi yetango onda dhimbulula ko ishewe ehala lyetokolo — oko kwa li uukolokoshi, nehala lyuuyuuki — oko kwa li uukolokoshi.
Ondi ipopile momwenyo gwandje nda ti: “Kalunga ota ka pangula aayuuki naakolokoshi, oshoka oku na ethimbo lyoshinima kehe nolyoshilonga kehe.”
Ondi ipopile momwenyo gwandje nda ti: “Molwaana yaantu otashi ningwa po, opo Kalunga e ya yeleke noya dhimbulule kutya muyo yene oya fa iimuna.”

Oshoka shoka tashi adha aana yaantu, osho tashi adha wo iimuna; ayehe oye na oshipewa shi thike pamwe. Ngaashi gumwe ta si, osho wo mukwawo ta si, naayehe oye na omufudho gwa faathana. Omuntu ke vulathane niimuna, oshoka ayihe oyowalawala.
Ayihe otayi yi kehala limwe. Ayihe oya za montsi yevi, naayihe otayi galukile montsi yevi.
Olye e shi shi kutya omwenyo gwaana yaantu otagu londo handiyaka pombanda, nomwenyo gwiimuna otagu kulukile moombogo dhevi?

Onda dhimbulula ano kutya kape na oshiwanawa shaa shi shika, omuntu nge ti inyanyudha niilonga ye, oshoka oyo oshipewa she, oshoka olye te mu fala ko hoka, opo a mone shoka tashi ka kala ko, nge a zi po?
4: Konima yaambika onda tala komahepeko agehe taga ningwa kohi yetango. Onda mono omahodhi gaahepekwa nokaye na omutalaleki; aahepeki yawo oya li aanankondo, ihe aahepekwa kaya li ye na omutalaleki.
Onkee ano nda tanga aasi mboka ya sa nale, oyo aanelago ye vule aantu mboka ye na omwenyo ngashingeyi.
Ihe omunelagolela e ya vule ayehe mboka yaali, oye ngoka inaa valwa noina mona uukolokoshi mboka tau longwa muuyuni.
Komeho onda dhimbulula kutya omaipyakidhilo agehe nuulaadhi miilonga owo okusilathana efupa. Naashika wo owaleelela nokutidha ombepo.
Egoya otali ihukata omaako e tali ikunya onyama yalyo lyene.
Ekaminina lyevululuko oli vule eshambekela lyu udha uupyakadhi nokutidha ombepo.
Naishewe onda mono ko oonkambadhala dhowala kohi yetango.

Oku na gumwe awikewike kee na mukwawo omutiyali, ke na wo omwanamati nenge omumwayina; ihe kape na ehulilo koonkambadhala dhe adhihe dhiilonga ye, omeho ge itaga kuta uuyamba. Ano otandi ihepekele lye notandi idhilike uuwanawa? Naashika wo owalalela nosha puka.
Yaali ye vule gumwe, oshoka oye na ondjambi ombwanawa yomaipyakidhilo giilonga yawo.
Oshoka gumwe ngele ta punduka, mukwawo ota vulu oku mu toola po, ihe yayee ngoka ta punduka po pwaa na mukwawo e mu toole po.
Natango tuu yaali nge ya lala pamwe, otaa ningilathana omuyenye, ihe gumwe oti ipupyaleke ngiini?
Ngele oku na ngoka ta matukile po gumwe, nena ayehe yaali otaye mu thikamene. Ongodhi ya yogohwa oondali ndatu, ihayi tokoka mbala.
Omugundjuka ohepele, ihe oku na oondunge, oku vule omukwaniilwa a kulupa kee na oondunge noke shi kulombwelwa,
nando a zile mondjedhililo a ka ninge omukwaniilwa, nenge a zile muuhepele a ka lele oshilongo.
Onda mono, nkene aanamwenyo ayehe mboka ya kala kohi yetango ya gama kombinga yomugundjuka ngoka te mu landula.
Kakwa li ku na ehulilo lyaantu ayehe mboka e ya kwatele komeho. Ihe aatekulu ye inaye mu nyanyukilwa. Osho ngaaka shika owaleelela nokutidha ombepo.
5: Gamena oompadhi dhoye, nge to yi kongulu yaKalunga. Okuhedha ko noku ka pulakena oku vule aasama taye eta oontselelandjambo, oshoka kaye na oondunge, nosho ngeyi haa yono.
Ino ulumika okana koye, nomwenyo gwoye ino gu endelelitha okupopya oohapu koshipala shaKalunga, oshoka Kalunga oku li megulu, nangoye ou li kombanda yevi. Onkee oohapu dhoye odhi na okukala oonshona.
Oshoka oondjodhi ohadhi zi miimpwiyu oyindji nokupopya kwomugoya omoohapu odhindji.
Ngele to uvanekele Kalunga euvaneko, ino shelelelwa oku li gwanitha, oshoka omagoya inage mu opalela. Gwanitha shoka wu uvaneke.
Okukala inoo uvaneka sha hwepo, shi vule okuuvaneka ngoye ito tompola sha.

Ino pitika okana koye ke ku etele ondjo. Ino popya koshipala shomumbala gwaKalunga u tye: “Euvaneko lyandje olya li epuko.” Omolwashike Kalunga e na okugeyithwa koohapu dhoye nokuyona po iilonga yiikaha yoye?
Oshoka oondjodhi noohapu odhindji odhowala, ihe ngoye tila Kalunga.
Ngele to mono ko ehepeko lyoohepele negoyokitho lyomautho nuuyuuki moshilongo, ino kuminwa oshinima shoka, oshoka omunene ota tonatele omunene omukwawo, naanene ishewe ye ya vule taye ya tonatele.
Uuwanawa woshilongo, ongele omapya agehe taga kala ge na omukwaniilwa.
Nakuhola iimaliwa ihe yi kuta, nanakuhola uuyamba iha gwana. Naashika owaleelela.
Iinima ngele tayi indjipala, naali otaa indjipala wo; mwene gwayo ota mono mo omupondo gwashike, shila oku yi tongolola owala?
Oomposi dhanakulonga oontoye, ashihe shimwe, ngele ta li oshindji nenge oshishona, ihe eloolo lyomuyamba otali mu imbi oomposi.
Oku na oshiponga oshidhigu nde shi mono kohi yetango: uuyamba tau pungulwa kumwene gwawo, sigo oshiponga she she ya.
Omaliko taga kana molwoshiponga. Nando na vale omunona omumati, ita thigulula sha.
Ngashika a zile mela lyayina olutu lwowala, osho ta ka ya owala ngashika a zile mo; noita ka faalela sha shomiilonga yuupyakadhi we a ye nasho.
Naashika oshipongalela: ngaashi a zile mo, osho ngaa ta ka ya. Okwa mono shike miilonga mbyoka yowala i ipyakidhile nayo?
Omasiku ge ote ga manene momilema, noku na uuwehame, ehepeko nondjahi.

Onda koneka kutya osho opalela omuntu a lye ye a nwe a nyanyukilwe uuwanawa wuupyakadhi we mboka i ipyakidhile nawo kohi yetango momasiku omafupi gokukalamwenyo ngoka Kalunga e ge mu pa, oshoka osho oshipewa she.
Osho omagano gaKalunga, ngele ota pe omuntu uuyamba nomaliko e te mu pe ompito yokulya ko nokutaamba oshipewa she, opo i inyanyudhe miilonga ye yuupyakadhi.
Oshoka iha dhimbulukwa unene omasiku gokukalamwenyo kwe, molwashoka Kalunga e mu pitikile i ipyakidhile nenyanyu lyokomwenyo gwe.
6: Oku na oshiponga shoka nda mono kohi yetango tashi thindile uuntu pohi.

Omuntu ngoka a pewa kuKalunga uuyamba nomaliko nesimano, ina hepa we sha, ihe Kalunga ite mu pe ompito yoku yi nyanyukilwa, oshoka omuyeni ote yi nyanyukilwa. Shika eihepeko lyowala nuuwehame uululululu.
Omuntu nge ta vala aanona ethele nota kala ko olule, omimvo nokuli odhindji, ihe omwenyo gwe itagu kuta uuwanawa ye ita fumvikwa nokuli nawa, nena otandi ti: Omupononwa oku na elago e mu vule.
Oshoka te ya po owala nota yi momilema, nedhina lye otali siikilwa komilema.
Ina mona etango noine li tseya. Oku na evululuko e vule omuntu ngo.
Eeno, nando omuntu ngoka na kale e na omwenyo lwoomvula omayuvi gaali, ihe ina nyanyukilwa uuwanawa — ayihe itayi ka hulila pehala limwe?
Iilonga yuupyakadhi ayihe yomuntu oyokokana ke, ihe uuhalu itau fudhithwa.
Oshoka omunawino oku na shike e vule omusama, nohepele otayi mono shike mokutseya okukala mokati kaanamwenyo?
Okuligamena nomeho oku vule okweendagula kuuhalu. Naashika owaleelela nokutidha ombepo.
Ashihe shoka tashi ningwa, oshu uthwa nale; osha tseyika nale kutya omuntu omushike, ita vulu okutamaneka ngoka e mu vule.
Oohapu odhindji otadhi indjipalitha uupyakadhi, omuntu oti imonene mo shike?
Oshoka olye ta tseya shoka tashi opalele omuntu momasiku gokukalamwenyo kwe okufupi, ga fa omuzizimba? Olye ta tseyithile omuntu shoka tashi ka kala ko konima ye kohi yetango?
7: Edhina lya simana oli vule omugwayo gwa nika nawa, nesiku lyokusa oli vule esiku lyokuvalwa.
Okuya koshigumbo taku lilwa oosa oku vule okuya kegumbo li na oontselela, oshoka eso olyo ehulilo lyaantu ayehe, nomunamwenyo ote shi dhiladhila momutima gwe.
Okunika uupongo oku vule okuyola, oshoka oshipala ngele shi na oshizimbi, nena omwenyo ogu li nawa.
Omutima gwaanandunge otagu kala moshigumbo shoosa, manga omutima gwaagoya gu li megumbo lyenyanyu.
Okupulakena egando lyomunandunge oku vule okupulakena eimbilo lyomagoya.
Oshoka iikwekwela yaagoya oya fa omityotyomo dhomano taga pi kohi yombiga. Shika owaleelela.
Okwiihakanena iimaliwa otaku goyapaleke omunandunge, noombumbo otadhi nyateke omutima.

Ehulilo lyoshinima oli vule etameko lyasho.
Omutalanteni oku vule omwiinenepeki.
Ino uluma okugeya mombepo yoye, oshoka ondjahi ohayi kala meni lyegoya.
Ino tya: “Omasiku gonale oshike ga li omawanawa ge vule gongashingeyi?” Oshoka ito shi popi moondunge.
Owino ombwanawa ya fa uuthiga, oyo ekwatho lyaamboka ye na omwenyo.
Oshoka owino oyo egameno, ngaashi iimaliwa oyo egameno, ihe ekwatho lyuunongo olyo ndika — owino otayi gamene omwenyo gwamwene gwayo.
Tala iilonga yaKalunga, oshoka olye ta vulu okuutha shoka a shita sha goyoka?
Nyanyukwa esiku ewanawa, nomesiku lyiiponga dhimbulukwa kutya Kalunga okwe li shiti ngaashika ndiyaka; omuntu ke shi shi shoka tashi mu adha konakuyiwa.
Ayihe onde yi mono momasiku gandje gowala: oku na aayuuki mboka taa sile muuyuuki wawo noku na aakaanakalunga mboka taa kalele uukeenakalunga wawo olule.
Ino ninga omuyuuki unene ngoye ino imonitha omunawino wa tsa pombanda — omolwashike wa hala okuhula po?
Ino ninga omukeenakalunga unene noino ninga egoya — omolwashike to si po mbala esiku inaali thika?
Osho opala okudhiginina shimwe nokwaagamuka ko koshikwawo, oshoka ngoka ha tila Kalunga, ota henuka ayihe mbika.
Owino otayi koleke omunawino shi vule oofule omulongo ya kala moshilando.
Oshoka kombanda yevi kaku na omuyuuki ngoka ta longo uuwanawa auke ye ita yono.
Ino pulakena oohapu adhihe aantu taa popi, opo waa uve omupiya gwoye te ku tuku.
Oshoka omwenyo gwoye mwene ogwa tseya kutya oho tuku ooyakweni.
Ayihe mbika onde yi konakona nowino. Onda popi nda ti: “Onda hala ndi ninge omunawino,” ihe osha kala ndje kokule.
Onkalo yowino oyi li kokule nomuule unene, olye ta vulu oku yi pikula?
Momwenyo gwandje onda tameke okukonakona nokutedhatedha nokukonga owino, opo ndi tseye kutya uukeenakalunga owo uugoya, nuugoya owo okwaanandunge.
Onda mono sha oshilulululu shi vule eso, omukiintu. Oye omwigo, omutima gwe etavu niikaha ye oonkandja. Omwaanawa koshipala shaKalunga ota manguluka miikaha ye, ihe omulunde ote mu kwata po.
Eeno, osho shoka nde shi dhimbulula, omuuvithi a ti, sho nda kambadhala okuyeleka oshinima noshikwawo, ndi mone ehuku.
Shoka nde shi kongakonga, ihe inandi shi mona, osho shika: Maantu eyuvi onda mono mo omulumentu gumwe omunashili, ihe inandi mona mo omukiintu omunashili nando ogumwe momwaalu tuu ngoka.
Tala, onda mono ashike kutya Kalunga okwa shiti aantu aayuuki, ihe yo yene ohayi ikongele iihelele oyindji.
8: Olye a fa omunawino, nolye a tseya okufatula iinima? Owino yomuntu otayi adhimitha oshipala she, nuukukutu woshipala she tau lundululwa kuyo.
Otandi ti: Vulika komalombwelo gomukwaniilwa, unene omolwegano we li ganene Kalunga.
Za po koshipala shomukwaniilwa, ngoye ino kalela po oshinima shoka inaashi mu opalela, oshoka ashihe shoka a hala, ote shi gwanitha.
Oshoka oohapu dhomukwaniilwa odhi na oonkondo, nolye ta vulu oku mu pula ta ti: “Oto ningi shike?”
Nakudhiginina iipango ye ita adhika kuuwinayi; nomwenyo gwomunandunge otagu tseya ethimbo netokolo lyu uka.
Oshoka oshinima kehe oshi na ethimbo lyasho neuthilo, nando uuwinayi womuntu otau mu thindile pohi.
Omuntu ke na owino yaashoka tashi ke mu adha komeho, olye te mu hololele shoka tashi ya konakuyiwa?
Kaku na omuntu ta vulu okupangela ombepo e yi keelele, kaku na ngoka e na oonkondo dhokuutha esiku lyeso nokaku na elaleko molugodhi; osho wo uukolokoshi itau hupitha ngoka te u ningi.
Ayihe mbika onde yi dhimbulula, sho omwenyo gwandje gwa koneke oshilonga kehe tashi ningwa kohi yetango methimbo uuna omuntu gumwe ta dhiladhilile mukwawo oshiponga.
Onda mono wo aakolokoshi taa fumvikwa taa yi mevululuko, manga mboka ye ende pauyuuki taa zi mehala eyapuki noya dhimbiwa moshilando. Naashika owalawala.
Uuna epangulo lyaalongi yuudhudhu itaali endelele okupangulwa, omwenyo gwaana yaantu ogwa fula okulonga uudhudhu.
Omulunde nando na yone lwethele nota kala nomwenyo omule, ondi shi shi kutya mboka haa tila Kalunga oye li nawa, oshoka haye mu tila,
ihe omulunde ita kala nawa noita lelepaleke omasiku ngaashi omuzizimba, oshoka iha tila Kalunga.
Shoka hashi ningwa kombanda yevi, oshowala, owaleelela, aayuuki sho taa ningwa ngaashi aakaanakalunga, naakaanakalunga sho haa ningwa ngaashi aayuuki. Osho nda ti kutya owala, owaleelela.

Opo mpoka nda tanga enyanyu, oshoka kohi yetango kaku na sha sho opalela omuntu, shila okulya nokunwa nokwiinyanyudha. Oyo mbika ta vulu okuninga momaipyakidhilo ge, manga e li kombanda yevi mokukalamwenyo nkoka Kalunga e ku mu pa kohi yetango.
Sho nda pungulula omutima gwandje, ndi ilonge okutseya owino nokutala iinima mbyoka tayi ningwa kombanda yevi, eeno, nokuli omutenya nuusiku kaku na ngoka ta mono oomposi —

onda mono miilonga ayihe yaKalunga kutya omuntu ita vulu okuuva ko shoka tashi ningwa kohi yetango; omuntu ni ipyakidhile okukonakona, ihe itu uvu ko sha. Nando omunawino a dhiladhile e yi uve ko, ita tompola sha.
9: Ayihe mbika onde yi kwatele momutima gwandje, naayihe onde yi simonona, kutya aayuuki naanawino niilonga yawo oyi li miikaha yaKalunga, ohole nosho wo uutondwe omuntu ina tseya shoka tashi mu adha komeho.

Ayihe oyi thike pamwe kwaayehe. Oshipewa shimwe ashike komuyuuki nokomukolokoshi, komwaanawa nokomwiinayi, komuyogoki nokomwiinyateki, kungoka ta yamba omayambo nokungoka itaa yamba omayambo; omwaanawa ke vulathane nomulunde, naangoka ta gana oha ningwa ngaashi ngoka a tila egano.

Mwaayihe tayi ningwa kohi yetango, omu na oshiponga shika: ayehe oye na oshipewa shimwe noomwenyo dhaana yaantu odhu udha uuwinayi nomitima dhawo uugoya mokukalamwenyo kwawo akuhe; navulwa taa yi koonakusa!
Onkene tuu ngoka e li mokati kaanamwenyo, oku na ngaa etegameno, oshoka ombwa yi na omwenyo oyi vule onime ya sa.
Oshoka aanamwenyo otaa tseya kutya oye na okusa, ihe aasi itaa tseya sha nando, nokaa na we ondjambi yasha, oshoka ondhimbulukilo yawo otayi dhimbiwa.
Ohole yawo, uutondwe wawo nuulaadhi wawo owa kana nale nokuli, nokaa na we sha mumbyoka tayi ningwa kohi yetango.
Inda ano, lya oshikwiila shoye nenyanyu nou nwe omaviinu goye nomutima gwa tundulukwa, oshoka Kalunga okwa hokwa nale iilonga yoye.
Tokitha aluhe oonguwo dhoye, nomugwayo inagu pumba ko komutse gwoye.

Nyanyudha omwenyo gwoye namukadhoye, ngoka u mu holelele omasiku goye agehe ganathangwa ngoka Kalunga e ku pa kohi yetango — omasiku goye agehe ganathangwa, oshoka osho oshipewa shoye mokukalamwenyo nomiilonga yoye mbyoka to yi longo nuudhigu kohi yetango.
Longa ashihe to vulu niikaha yoye, shi longa noonkondo dhoye, oshoka kaku na iilonga, ompangela, uunongo nenge owino moshaasi, moka noka ya mo.

Naishewe kohi yetango onda mono ko kutya esindano mokumatuka kali li aluhe mepangelo lyaamboka ye na ontuku, iita hayomapenda, oshikwiila hashaanawino, uuyamba hawaanandunge nolupundi halwoonkulungu, oshoka ethimbo neuthilo otali adha ayehe.

Eeno, omuntu ina tseya ethimbo lye mwene ngashika oohi ndhoka dha yulwa monete yoshiponga nenge oondhila ndhoka hadhi yulwa moomwigo. Osho wo aana yaantu otaa yulwa methimbo lyoshiponga, nge taa gwile mo ohaluka.
Naashika onde shi tala kohi yetango osho uunongo, nosha li oshinene momeho gandje:
Okwa li okalando okashona naalumentu aashona ya li mo. Omukwaniilwa omunene okwe ka matukile, e ka kondeke e te ka tungile etuni lyokukondekela.
Muko omwa li omulumentu ohepele, ihe omunawino; nguka okwa hupitha okalando nowino ye. Ihe kaku na we omuntu a dhimbulukwa omulumentu ngwiyaka ohepele.
Nena onda ti: Owino oyi vule oonkondo dhoofule, ihe owino yohepele oya dhinika, noohapu dhe itadhi pulakenwa.
Oohapu dhaanawino dha pulakenwa nengungumano, odhi vule omagandagulo gomukwaniilwa mokati komagoya.
Owino oyi vule omatati golugodhi, ihe omulunde gumwe ota yono po uuwanawa owindji.
10: Oondhi dha sa otadhi oleke nokumbutika omugwayo gwomupiluli; uusama uushona ou na ondjundo yi vule omayele nesimano.
Omwenyo gwomunawino ogwa gama kolulyo, ihe omutima gwomusama okolumoho.
Eeno, omugoya ngele te ende mepola, oondunge otadhi mu pumbu, noti ihololele shaa ngoka kutya ye egoya.
Ondjahi yomukwaniilwa ngele tayi ku hwamene, ino etha iilonga yoye, oshoka engungumano otali sindi omapuko omanene.
Oku na epuko limwe nde li koneke kohi yetango, ombedhi ndjoka tayi zi komupangeli:
aasama taa yelwa pombanda unene, naayamba taa shonopekwa.
Onda mono aapika ya kayila uukambe, naawa taye ende kolupadhi ya fa aapika.
Ngoka ta fulu ekelo, ota vulu okugwila mo; ngoka ta kumuna ekuma, ota lika keyoka.
Ngoka ta tandula omamanya, ote ehamekwa kugo; ngoka ta panda iikuni, ota tosholwa iilalo kuyo.
Ngele ekuya olya simpa, nomuntu ite li upike, nena nge te li longitha, ota hepeke oonkondo; ihe omunawino ote li upike.
Eyoka ngele tali li omuntu, manga inaali nonomwa, nena uunkulungu womunonomi kau na we oshilonga.
Oohapu dha za mokana komunawino, odha simana, ihe omilungu dhomugoya otadhi mu nina po ye mwene.
Etameko lyoohapu dhomokana ke olyo uugoya, nehulilo lyokupopya kwe uulayi wa pitilila.
Egoya ohali popyagana omahapu ogendji, ihe omuntu ito tseya shoka tashi ka ningwa naashoka tashi ka kala ko konima ye nolye te ke mu lombwela shika.
Uupyakadhi womugoya otau mu lolokitha, oshoka ita tseya nokuli okuya koshilando.
Yaye shilongo ngoye, omukwaniilwa ngele okanona, nomalenga goye haga menekele omatelekela ongulangula!
Omunelago shilongo ngoye, ngele omukwaniilwa gwoye omunedhina, nongele omalenga goye haga ningi iituthi pethimbo lyo opala pashilumentu nohangaashi oonkolwi.
Omoluunyenge omitenge dhongulu otadhi teka po, nomoluunyolowe ongulu tayi kala yi na oontongo.
Iitelekela ohayi telekelwa okunyanyudha, omaviinu haga hangelwa okushambudha omwenyo; ihe iimaliwa ohayi eta po ayihe.
Omukwaniilwa ino mu tuka nando omomadhiladhilo goye, nomondunda yoye yokulala ino tuka omuyamba, oshoka oondhila dhokegulu otadhi fala ewi lyoye, niikwamawawa tayi holola oohapu dhoye.
11: Umbila oshikwiila shoye kombanda yomeya, oshoka nge pwa piti omasiku ogendji, oto ke shi monununa.
Oshitopolwa shi pa ooheyali, eeno, oohetatu wo, oshoka ino tseya oshiponga oshini tashi ka kala kombanda yevi.
Iikogo ngele oyu udha, omvula otayi lokele kevi. Omuti ngele otagu gwile lwokuumbugantu nenge lwokuumbangalantu, otagu lala pehala tuu mpoka gwa gwile.
Oongoka ha tala ombepo, ita kunu; naangoka ha tala iikogo, ita teya.
Ngaashi ino tseya ondjila yombepo, nenge nkene omasipa taga tungwa mela lyomusimba, osho wo ino tseya iilonga yaKalunga, ngoka a longo ayihe.
Kuna oombuto dhoye ongula, ngoye ino vululukitha wo iikaha yoye komatango, oshoka ino tseya, oyini po tayi ka mena, oondjika nenge oondjiyaka, nenge adhihe mbali tadhi ka mena.
Uuyelele owo uutoye, nosho opalela omeho okutala etango.

Oshoka omuntu nge ta kala e na omwenyo omule omimvo odhindji, oku na okwiinyanyudha mwaadhihe e ta dhimbulukwa omasiku gomilema, kutya otaga ka kala ogendji. Ayihe mbyoka tayi ya, oyowala, owaleelela.

Mugundjuka ngoye, nyanyukwa muugundjuka woye, nou nyanyudhe omutima gwoye momathimbo guugundjuka woye. Enda momapola gokomutima gwoye nomokuligamena kwomeho goye, ihe kala u shi shi kutya Kalunga ote ke ku etela ayihe mbika mepangulo.
Tidha mo oshizimbi momutima gwoye nou kaleke uuwehame kokule nolutu lwoye, oshoka uugundjuka osho owala osho owala, owaleelela.
12: Dhimbulukwa Omushiti gwoye momasiku guugundjuka woye, manga omasiku guudhigu inaage ya nomimvo inaadhi hedha ko, uuna to ka popya to ti: “Inandi dhi hokwa.”
Momasiku ngoka etango, omutenya, omwedhi noonyothi otadhi ka kala dha luudha, niikogo ohayi galuka konima yomvula.
Omasiku ngoka aalangeli yegumbo taa ka kakama, aalumentu aanankondo taa andalalithwa, aatsi taa zimbuka, oshoka oya ninga po aashona, naamboka taye entamene momakende taa kala momilema.

Omasiku ngoka omiyelo dha taalela omapandaanda, otadhi ka kala dhe edhilwa po, omuthindo gwokoshini ogwa shonopala, omuntu ota penduka po, ngele uudhila opo tau tameke okulila, nomawi agehe oga gogoma.

Omuntu ota kala a tila momitunda, nomondjila omu na iihaluthi. Omuti omumandeli tagu tsapuka oonsheno, oshipethipethi tashi ende tashi gaganyata, noonkuto dhoshihwa shokaperi itadhi eta we uuhalu wokulya.
Omuntu ota yi kegumbo lye lyaaluhe, naalilasa taye endaenda momapandaanda.
Ongodhi yoshisiliveli otayi tokoka, noshiyuma shoshingoli otashi tatuka. Oshiyuma shomeya otashi tatukile pomuthima, noshikweyitho otashi gwile monyombo.
Ontsi otayi shuna mevi, ngaashika ya li nale, nombepo otayi galukile kuKalunga, ngoka e yi gandjele.
Ayihe oyowala, omuuvithi ota ti, ayihe oyowalawala, owaleelela.
Omuuvithi ka li ashike omunawino, okwa longo wo aantu uunongo, okwa dhiladhila e ta konakona, okwa tungu omayeletumbulo ogendji.
Omuuvithi okwa kongo a mone oohapu dho opala nodha nyolwa dhu uka, oohapu dhoshili.
Oohapu dhaanawino odha fa iishongitho nomatumbulo gawo oomboha dha dhengelwa muule; oga gandjwa kOmusita gumwe awike.
Naishewe, mumwandje, londodhwa kushika: okunyola omambo ogendji ihaku hulu, nokwiipyakidhila nokulesha unene ohaku lolokitha olutu.
Ekota lyaashihe shu uvika, olyo ndika: Tila Kalunga nou dhiginine iipango ye, oshoka aantu ayehe osho ye na okuninga.
Oshoka Kalunga ote eta iilonga ayihe mepangulo, ndyoka tali adha iinima ayihe ya holekwa, iiwanawa nenge iiwinayi.

1:
Ondjimbolela yaSalomo.
Omufuko:

Omathipo goye gokomilungu naga kuwike ndje;
ohole yoye ontoye yi vule omaviinu.

Kwata ndje utale — natu endelele.
Omukwaniilwa okwa fala ndje momutala gwe.
Ookuume:
Otwa hala okuligola noku ku nyanyukilwa;
otatu tanga ohole yoye yi vule omaviinu.
Omufuko:
Omolwashoka ye ku hole shili.

Aakadhona yomuJerusalem,
ngame omuluudhe, ihe onda mbweshukila.
Omuluudhe nda fa omatsali gaKedar,
ihe onda sheneka nda fa omashigolapi muuwa waSalomo.

Inamu tongolola ndje, nando ngame omuluudhe,
molwashoka nda pya omutenya.
Aamati aana yameme oya geele ndje
noya ningi ndje omulangeli gwiitsambe yomiviinu.
Oshitsambe shandje mwene shomiviinu inandi shi langela.

Muholike gwandje, lombwela ndje utale,
openi ho litha iimuna yoye
nopeni ho yi gondjitha omutenya?
Omolwashike ndi na okukala tandi ku kongo mokati kiimuna yayakweni?
Mbushiki:

Sha yela shomaakiintu, ngele ino shi tseya,
pita mo u landule oshinkoti shoonzi
nou lithe iikombo yoye pomatsali gaanahambo.

Kanuunyalona kandje,
otandi ku faathanitha nokakambe okakiintu
ka kutilwa komeho getemba lyaFarao.

Oompanda dhoye odho opala ngiini pokati komagola
nothingo yoye metunda lyoshimona!

Otatu ku hambulile omagola goshingoli ge na oombandi dhoshisiliveli.
Omufuko:

Omukwaniilwa manga a li poshililo,
lyo ezimba lyomugwayo gwandje gwonardi otali nika nawalela.

Omuholike gwandje kungame oye oshihampi shomira
ta vululukwa pokati komagundji gandje.

Omuholike gwandje kungame okwa fa ehila lyoongala dhohenna
miitsambe yomiviinu kuEn-gedi.
Mbushiki:

Kanuunyalona kandje, ngoye owo opala ngiini!
Memememe, owa poloka mo ngiini!
Omeho goye oga fa oonguti.
Omufuko:

Muholike gwandje, ngoye owo opala ngiini!
Oh, oshuuluko shoye oshi thike peni, taa!
Ombete yetu oya hapa nawa.
Mbushiki:

Egumbo lyetu olya tungwa momiti dhomisendeli,
nomitenge dhalyo momikiperesi.
Omufuko:
2:
Ngame ongala yokelundu lyaSharon,
ongala yomavo gomomadhiya.
Mbushiki:

Omuholike gwandje mokati kaakadhona
okwa fa ongala ya sheneka mokati komano.

Omuholike gwandje mokati kaamati
okwa fa omuyapula mokati komiti dhomokuti.
Otandi yuulukwa okukuutumba momuzile gwagwo,
niiyimati yagwo oyi na omulyo mokana kandje.

Okwa fala ndje mondunda yomaviinu,
nepandela lye kombanda yandje olyo ohole.

Kolekii ndje nomakaka gomandjembele,
ne mu ndjangeke ndje niiyapula,
oshoka onda pya ompiya yohole.

Olumoho lwe olu li kohi yomutse gwandje,
nolulyo lwe otalu papatele ndje.

Ne aafuko Aajerusalem,
otandi mu ganitha poomenye nopoompalala dhokomalundu:
inamu pendutha ohole nenge mu yi kudhile,
manga inaayi shi yuulukwa.
Omufuko:

Pulakena! Omuholike gwandje!
Tala, oye ngwiyaka te ya.
Ota nuka omalondo koondundu,
ta ndjomboka kiikulundundu.

Omuholike gwandje okwa fa omenye nenge ompalala ongundjuka.
Oye ngwiya a thikama pondje pekuma lyetu.
Ota talele momakende,
to ontamene miitenda ya tatakana.

Oshoka tala, okufu okwa kuka,
nethimbo lyuutalala lya piti.

Iihwa oya ziza moshiheke,
ethimbo lyoondjimbo lya thikana,
netendeguti otali kululula moshilongo shetu.

Omikwiyu otadhi tiliganeke oondhiye,
nomiviinu dha sheneka otadhi taandelitha ezimba lya nika nawa.
Kanuunyalona kandje, yambuka;
nandjelo gwandje, ila!

Kanguti kandje momakolombongo, ngoka to holama
momakololo gometayimanya, talitha ndje ondjelo yoye,
uvitha ndje ewi lyoye,
oshoka ewi lyoye ohali kolitha,
nondjelo yoye ohayi fuula.

Tu yulileni oombandje,
uuyandje mboka hau li po iitsambe yomiviinu,
oshoka iitsambe yetu oya sheneka.”
Omufuko:

Omuholike gwandje ogwandje mwene, nangame ogwe,
ogwaangoka ta litha mokati koongala dhokelundu,

sigo oshingulohi kwa pepelela,
nomizizimba tadhi lelepala.
Galuka ko, muholike gwandje,
ngaashi omenye nenge ompalala ongundjuka
koondundu dha nika iikwekwenyete.
3:
Okombete yandje uusiku
nda kongo omuholike gwomwenyo gwandje.
Onde mu kongo, ihe inandi mu mona.

Onda hala okuthikama, ndi ka shilile noshilando,
momapandaanda nopomahalandjandja
tandi kongo omuholike gwomwenyo gwandje,
ihe inandi mu mona.

Aalangeli mboka taa endaenda noshilando, oya adha ndje.
“Inamu mona omuholike gwomwenyo gwandje?”

Opo sho nde ya pitilile po,
onda mono omuholike gwomwenyo gwandje.
Onde mu papatele noinandi mu etha,
manga inaandi mu fala mokagumbo kameme,
meni lyondjugo yaangoka a pulumutha ndje.

Ne aafuko Aajerusalem,
otandi mu ganitha poomenye nopoompalala dhokomalundu:
inamu pendutha ohole nenge mu yi kudhile,
manga inaayi shi hokwa.
Omufuko:

Olye ngoka te ya ta zi kombuga a fa olwithi lwokuungululu,
a nika ezimba lyomira, nolyiitsinino yiigwanga yi ili noyi ili yomupindiki?

Tala! Osho oshiindopundi shaSalomo
sha kundukwa kaakwiita omilongo hamano,
omapenda gaIsrael.

Ayehe oya homata omagongamwele,
ya pyokokela iita;
shaa ngoka oku na egongamwele ponto ye,
ye shi ningila omalondokelo uusiku.

Omukwaniilwa Salomo okwi ihongithile oshiindopundi,
osha ningwa miipilangi yokuLibanon.

Oongudhi dhasho okwe dhi ningitha oshisiliveli,
neegameno dhasho olyoshingoli.
Omutumba ogwa siikilwa noshiyata oshitiliganembwilili;
meni omwo opalekwa nawa nohole kaakadhona Aajerusalem.

Aakadhona yaSion, pitii mo,
ne mu ligamene omukwaniilwa Salomo.
Okwa zala oshishani shoka yina e mu shanipike nasho
esiku ndyoka a fukike,
esiku ndyoka omwenyo gwe gwa li gwa nyanyukwa.
Mbushiki:
4:
Kanuunyalona kandje, owo opala ngiini!
Taa, owa poloka mo ngiini!
Omeho goye taga konita mewiiwili lyoye,
oga fa oonguti.
Omafufu goye oga fa oshigunda shiikombo tayi kuluka kondundu Gilead.

Omayego goye oga fa oshigunda shoonzi opo dha kululwa,
opo tadhi zi mendipo.
Adhihe odha vala oonkwanambwiyu,
nomokati kadho kamu na nando oyimwe yaa na okanzona.

Omilungu dhoye odha fa okapaya okatiligane tye,
nokana koye oko okatoye.
Oombandu dhoye meni lyewiiwili lyoye
odha fa oombinga dhondunga yomugranati.

Othingo yoye oya fa oshungo yaDavid ya tungwa nuulenga
moka mwe endjelela omahuuyanza eyuvi, agehe ogo omahuuyanza goofule.

Omagundji goye oga fa uumbambyona uyali,
ongaashi uukwanambwiyu wombambi tau napa mokati koongala dha sheneka.

Oshingulohi sho kwa pepa,
nomizizimba tadhi lelepala,
otandi yi kondundu yomira noshikulundundu shiitsinino.

Kanuunyalona kandje,
ayihe oye ku opala; ino pumbwa sha.

Mufuko gwandje, ila,
za nangame kuLibanon.
Za ko kondungu yondundu Amana,
kondungu yondundu Senir nokondungu yaHermon,
okiiholameno yoonime nokoondundu dhoongwe.

Owa goola ndje, mumwameme,
muyalekwa gwandje; owa goola ndje nekeuko limwe
nokamona kamwe komuumona womothingo yoye.

Mumwameme, muyalekwa gwandje,
ohole yoye oyo opala ngiini!
Ohole yoye ontoye yi vule omaviinu,
nezimba lyomugwayo gwoye oli vule iizimba ayihe yilwe!

Omilungu dhoye, muyalekwa gwandje,
ohadhi ndonda omagadhi goonyushi.
Omagadhi goonyushi nomahini oge li kohi yelaka lyoye,
nezimba lyoonguwo dhoye olya fa ezimba lyaLibanon.

Mumwameme, muyalekwa gwandje,
owa fa oshikunino shokuvululukilwa sha pateka,
owa fa omuthima gwa siikilwa nothithiya yopaumwene.

Ngoye owa fa oshikunino shomiti dhomigranati
dhi na iiyimati hayi eta olwiho okuliwa,
oshikunino shiihwa yohenna niigwanga yonardi,

onardi nosaframi, olutope nokanakamuma
pamwe nomiti dhi ili nodhi ili dhiitsinino,
omira, endombo niizimbalela yi ili noyi ili.

Ongoye othithiya yiikunino,
omuthima gwomeya omanamwenyo
taga kunguluka taga zi kuLibanon.
Omufuko:

Mbepo yokuumbangalantu, penduka,
nombepo yokuumbugantu, ila!
Pepeleni oshikunino shandje,
opo omazimba gasho ga nika nawa ga taandele.
Omuholike gwandje ne ye moshikunino she,
na lye iiyimati yasho iitoye.
Mbushiki:
5:
Mumwameme, muyalekwa gwandje,
onde ya moshikunino shandje;
otandi gongele omira niizimba yandje.
Otandi li oshithima shehila lyoonyushi nomagadhi gandje goonyushi,
otandi nu omaviinu nomahini gandje.
Ookuume:
Ookuume, lyeni ne mu kolwe kohole.
Omufuko:

Ngame onda li nda kotha
ihe omwenyo gwandje ogwa tonata.
Pulakena! Omuholike gwandje ta konkola.
Mbushiki:
Mumwameme, kanuunyalona kandje, egulula ndje,
onguti yandje, namuyelele gwandje!
Oshoka omutse gwandje ogwa hipa omume,
nomafufu gandje oga hipa omata guusiku.
Omufuko:

Ondi ihula nale oonguwo dhandje,
nandi dhi zalulule?
Onda yogo nale oompadhi dhandje,
nandi dhi luudhike ishewe?

Omuholike gwandje okwa tsu oshikaha she mombululu yomweelo.
Nena omwenyo gwandje ogwe mu tukulukile.

Onda yambuka ndi ke egulule omuholike gwandje,
niikaha yandje otayi hiha omira,
nominwe dhandje odha menka omugwayo gwomira poshipatitho shomweelo.

Onde egulula omuholike gwandje,
ihe omuholike gwandje okwa adhika a zi po, a henuka po.
Sho a li ta popi, onda ngwangwanekwa.
Onde mu kongo, ihe inandi mu mona;
onde mu ithana, ihe ina yamukula ndje.

Aalangeli mboka taa endaenda noshilando,
oya adha ndje.
Oya dhenge ndje noya toshola ndje iilalo;
aalangeli yopomakuma oya kutha po elwaakani lyandje.

Aakadhona Aajerusalem, otandi mu ganitha:
ngele tamu mono omuholike gwandje,
otamu ke mu lombwela shike?
Mu lombweleni kutya onda pya ompiya yohole.
Ookuume:

Ngoye omunandjelo mokati kaakiintu,
omuholike gwoye oku na shike e vule yakwawo?
Omuholike gwoye omwaanawa ngiini e vule yakwawo,
sho to tu ganitha ngeyi?
Omufuko:

Omuholike gwandje omuyelele omushekesheke.
Okwa simana mokati komayuvi omulongo.

Omutse gwe oshingoli, oshingoli oshiyelele,
nomafufu ge goondhinga omaluudhe ngedhilakola.

Omeho ge oga fa oonguti pomatondokelo gomeya.
Omayego ge omatokele ga fa ga yogwa momahini
noga dhama nawa.

Oompanda dhe odha fa iimpungu yiimeno hayi zi eka lya nika nawa.
Omilungu dhe ongoongala dha sheneka tadhi ndonda omira.

Omaako ge oga fa omitenge dhoshingoli dha dhamithwa ookrisoliti,
nolutu lwe olwa fa omayego goondjamba ga hongwa
nuunkulungu noga siikilwa noosafire.

Omagulu ge oga fa oongudhi dhomarmera
dha ndjikwa moompadhi dhoshingoli sho sheneshene.
Olupe lwe olwa fa lwondundu Libanon,
lwa tuwalala lwa fa omisendeli.

Okana ke okatoyetoye,
eeno, ashihe shomuye otashi kolitha ndje.
Osho omuholike gwandje, kuume kandje,
e li ngaaka, ne aafuko Aajerusalem.
Ookuume:
6:
Ngoye omunandjelo mokati kaakiintu,
omuholike gwoye oku uka ano peni?
Omuholike gwoye okwa yi nondjila yini,
opo tu ke mu konge pamwe nangoye?
Omufuko:

Omuholike gwandje okwa yi koshikunino she,
okiimpungu yiimeno hayi zi eka lya nika nawa.
Okwa ka litha miikunino nokutona oongala.

Omuholike gwandje ogwandje mwene,
nangame ogwe,
ogwaangoka ta litha mokati koongala dhokelundu.
Mbushiki:

Kanuunyalona kandje,
ngoye owo opala wa fa Tirza,
ou na oshuuluko wa fa Jerusalem
nowa tilikilila wa fa omatanga gaakwiita.

Pilamenitha ndje omeho goye,
oshoka otaga gwililile ndje po.
Omafufu goye oga fa oshigunda shiikombo tayi kuluka kondundu Gilead.

Omayego goye oga fa oshigunda shoonzi oonyali,
opo tadhi zi mendipo.
Adhihe odha vala oonkwanambwiyu,
nomokati kadho kamu na nando oyimwe yaa na okanzona.

Oombandu dhoye meni lyewiiwili lyoye
odha fa oombinga dhondunga yomugranati.

Naku kale aanyekadhi omilongo hamano
naakiintu yopooha omilongo hetatu
naadhike yaa shi kuyalulwa,

onguti yandje namuyelele gwandje oku ilile.
Oye epona lyayina, omuningilwa kombunda komupulumuthi gwe.
Aakadhona oye mu tala
noye mu tanga omunelago,
aanyekadhi naakiintu yopooha oye mu simaneke.

Olye ngoka ta holoka mpeya ongeluwa tali tende,
omwaanawalela a fa omwedhi gwa toka,
omushekesheke a fa etango
nomuyeluki ongOmulalawili.

Onda yi koshikunino shominkete,
ndi ka tale omwiidhi omutalala nondi koneke,
ngele omiviinu odha tsapuka
nomugranati gwa sheneka oongala.

Ohaluka yowala ondjuulukwe yandje
oya kuutumbike ndje momatemba gaanamadhina yoshigwana shandje.
Ookuume:

Galukila huka, galukila huka,
omukadhona Omushulami;
galukila huka, galukila huka
opo tu ku tongolole nawa.
Mbushiki:
Omolwashike mwa hala okutongolola Omushulami
ngaashi muudhano kuMahanaim?
7:
Oompadhi dhoye dha zala oongaku
odho opala ngiini,
ngoye mukadhona omvalekele!
Omaziti moombwetelo dhoye oga ngongwa konkulungu
ngaashi oshimona shontsino shomothingo.

Ekuvu lyoye olya fa okayo ka hongekeka,
moka ongwedhakanitha yomaviinu ihaayi pu mo.
Ela lyoye ongondumba yiilya
ya kundukwa koongala dha sheneka.

Omagundji goye oga fa uumbambyona uyali,
oto ti uukwanambwiyu wombambi.

Othingo yoye oya fa oshungo yomayego goondjamba.
Omeho goye ongomadhiya muHeshbon posheelo shaBat Rabbim.
Eyulu lyoye olya fa oshungo kuLibanon
ya taalela lwokuDamaskus.

Omutse gwoye ogwa yeluka gwa fa Karmel.
Omafufu gokomutse gwoye ogo omaluudhe nohaga adhima —
oondhinga dhago odha kwata omukwaniilwa.

Ngoye owo opala ngiini,
oto kolitha ndje ngiini,
ngoye muholike gwandje,
mukadhona gwenyanyu lyandje!

Ongoye omule gwokashendjelutu wa fa omulunga,
nomagundji goye ongomahila goondjembele.

Onda popi nda ti:
“Etha utale ndi londe komulunga,
ndi kwate omahila gagwo.”
Omagundji goye naga kale ga fa omahila goondjembele,
ezimba lyomufudho gwoye ongaandyoka lyiiyapula,

nokana koye ka fa omaviinu omatoye.
Omufuko:
Eeno, ihe otaga thenunukile nombili momuholike gwandje,
notaga kungulukile komilungu dhoonakukotha.

Ngame mwene ogwomuholike gwandje,
noha yuulukwa ndje.

Ila, muholike gwandje, tu pite mo
tu uke pondje komalundu,
natu ye tu ka tokelwe komikunda.

Natu meneke tu ye kiitsambe yomiviinu;
natu ka tale, omiviinu ngele dha tutuma,
oongala dhadho ngele odha sheneka,
nomigranati ngele odhi li metifa lyoongala.
Noko nkoka tandi ke ku pela ohole yandje.

Iiyimati yohole ohayi gandja ezimba,
nopiiyelo yetu ope na iiyimati ayihe iitoye,
iipe niikulu; onde yi ku pungulila, muholike gwandje.
8:
Ando owa li omumwamememati, wa yama komagundji gameme!
Nge tandi ku tsakaneke pondje,
ando tandi ku thipi komilungu,
nokape na ngoka ta dhini ndje.

Ando tandi ku fala mokagumbo kameme,
ando to ka pukulula ndje,
ando tandi ku nwetha omaviinu
mwa tulwa iizimba ya nika nawa,
oshinuwa sha kolwa moogranati dhandje.

Olumoho lwe olu li kohi yomutse gwandje,
nolulyo lwe otalu papatele ndje.

Ne aafuko Aajerusalem, otandi mu ganitha:
Inamu pendutha ohole nenge mu yi kudhile,
manga inaayi shi yuulukwa.
Ookuume:

Olye ngoka te ya ta zi kombuga
te egamene omuholike gwe?
Mbushiki:
Onde ku pendutha mokati komiyapula.
Oko tuu nkoka nyoko e ku pulumuthile,
oko a li noshitheta, sho e ku eta paantu.

Tula ndje komutima gwoye nda fa oshihako,
ngaashi okalinga koshihako kokwooko kwoye;
oshoka ohole oya kola ya fa eso,
uukodhi wayo ihau kodhuluka wa fa oshaasi.
Ehayango lyayo olyo ehayango lyomulilo,
ehayango lyOmuwa.

Efundja lyomeya ihali vulu okudhima ohole,
nomilonga ihadhi vulu oku yi kungulula po.
Omuntu nando na gandjele ohole eliko lye alihe,
ota ka dhinwa ashike.
Aamwayina yomufuko:

Tse otu na okamwamemekadhona onkelo inaaka tumba natango omagundji.
Omumwameme nguka otatu mu ningi ngiini,
uuna te endelwa?

Ye ngele ekuma, otatu mu tungile oshungo yoshisiliveli,
ihe ngele omweelo, otatu mu siikile niipilangi yomisedeli.
Omufuko:

Ngame mwene ekuma,
nomagundji gandje oga fa ooshungo.
Momeho ge onda ningi nda fa ngoka te eta egwaneneno.

Oshitsambe shandje shomiviinu oshandjelela,
oshi li pungame mpaka.
Salomo na likole iimaliwa ye eyuvi,
nomathele gaali ogaamboka taa langele iiyimati ye.
Mbushiki:

Muyalekwa gwandje ngoka wa kala miikunino,
ookuume ohaa pulakene ewi lyoye,
li pulakenitha ndje wo!
Omufuko:

Galuka ko, muholike gwandje,
ngaashi omenye nenge ompalala ongundjuka
koondundu dha mena omiti dhiizimba.

1: Membo muka omu na omatumwalaka taga popi Juda naJerusalem, ngoka Kalunga e ga hololele Jesaja yaAmos muuyuni waakwaniilwa yaJuda Usia, Jotam, Ahas naHiskia.
Omuwa okwa popi a ti: “Uva ko, ngoye egulu! Nangoye evi, pulakena! Onda kokitha aanona nonde ya putudha, ihe oya tsile ndje ondumbo.
Ongombe oyi shi mwene gwayo, nokasino etemba lyokulila lyamwene gwako, ihe Israel ina tseya sha, aantu yandje kayu uvite ko.”
Yaye ngoye, oshigwana shuulunde, ne aantu mwa yona nayi, oluvalo lwaakolokoshi, aana yaatangalali! Omwi iteka Omuwa, omwa sheke Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki nomwe mu pilamene.
Omwa hala ngaa natango okudhengwa, sho tamu kala mwa tsa ondumbo? Israel, omutse gwoye ogu udha oombole, nomutima gwoye ogwa ala.
Okuza koshithi shompadhi sigo okomutse kaku na eha li li nawa. Okwa kanyata iilalo, omadhidhimika nomatuntila ngoka inaaga pangwa, inaaga mangwa go inaaga tulwa omuti.
Oshilongo sheni osha mbugala, niilando yeni oya lungunithwa po. Montaneho yeni aakwiilongo oya yugu po omapya geni; oga ninga omaputa, sho ga hanagulwa po kaayeni.
OJerusalem ashike sha hupu po, oshilando shi li mekondeka — osha fa shaa na epopilo, sha fa etsali lyomukeeleli gwoshitsambe shomiviinu nenge etala moshilonda shuutanga.
Ando Omuwa Omunankondoawike ine tu hupithila aantu yamwe, ando twa kombwa po twa fa Sodom notwa ningwa ngaashi Gomorra.
Jerusalem, aaleli yoye naantu yoye oya fa Aasodomu nAagomorra. Pulakena shoka Omuwa ta popi te ku lombwele. Ndhindhilika shoka Kalunga ketu te ku tsomayele.

Ota ti: “Ou shi onda hokwa oontselelandjambo adhihe ndhoka tamu yambele ndje? Onda kuta koonzi ndhoka mwa lungunitha dhi ninge omafikilondjambo nokomagadhi gomitanda dheni dho ondodhwa. Onda kunyukwa ombinzi yoontsezi, yoonzi noyiikombo.
Olye e mu lombwele, mu yi etele ndje ayihe, sho tamu holoka koshipala shandje? Olye e mu lombwele, mu ye motempeli yandje nokulyatagula kweni?

Inamu etela ndje we oondjambo dhiikulya dhaa na oshilonga! Iitsinino oyo iihuna kungame. Ite vulu we okwiidhidhimikila iituthi yeni yOmwedhi omupe, Omasabati niigongi yeni yomalongelokalunga. Ayihe oya nyatekwa kuulunde weni.
Otandi tondo iituthi yeni yOmwedhi omupe nomasiku geni omayapuki; ogo omutenge nda vulwa oku gu humbata.
“Uuna tamu yelutha omaako geni megalikano, itandi ke mu tala nando. Nando mu galikane olule ngiini, itandi ka pulakena, oshoka iikaha yeni oya nika ombinzi.
Iyogeni, mu yele. Etheni uuwinayi mbuka ndi wete tamu u ningi. Eeno, etheni okulonga iihuna,
ne mu ilonge okulonga uuwanawa. Seni oshimpwiyu uuyuuki u gwanithwe, kwatheni aahepekwa, uthileni oothigwa, nomu popile aaselekadhi.”

Omuwa ota ti: “Ileni tu ka tamananeni. Oondjo dheni nando nadhi kale dha tiligana mbyumbyumbyumbyu, otadhi ka toka dha fa oompawe; nonando nadhi kale dha tiliganenena, otadhi yele dha fa omafufu omatokele goonzi.
Ngele otamu zimine nokuvulika kungame, otamu ka lya uutoye wevi lyeni.
Ihe ngele otamu tindi nomwa tangalala, otamu ka dhipagwa kegongamwele. Ongame Omuwa nde dhi popi ndhoka.”
Oshilando shoka sha li nale oshidhiginini, osha ningi sha fa ohonda! Nale osha li shu udha aayuuki, ihe ngashingeyi aadhipagi ya kala mo.
Jerusalem, nale owa li wa fa oshisiliveli, ihe ngashingeyi owa kanitha omwago; owa li wa fa omaviinu go gene, ihe ngashingeyi wa hayuka wa fa omeya gowala.
Aawiliki yoye oya ningi aanandumbo nookuume kaafuthi. Ohaa taamba oombumbo nohaa lalakanene omilongelo. Ihaa popile oothigwa moompangu nenge ya pulakene aaselekadhi, uuna taa eta uudhigu wawo.
Onkee ano ngashingeyi pulakeneni, sho Omuwa Omunankondoawike, Kalunga kaIsrael omunankondo ta popi ta ti: “Otandi mu kwatele iikonene, ne aatondi yandje, noitamu ka etela ndje we omukundu gwasha.
Otandi ke mu kondjitha. Otandi ke mu yelitha, ngaashi osheela hashi yelithwa, e tandi mu kutha ondoya nomulilo.
Otandi ke mu pa aatokolihapu ya fa mbeyaka yonale, naagandjindunge ngaashi ya li petameko. Nena Jerusalem otashi ka ithanwa oshilando shuuyuuki, oshilando oshidhiginini.”
Omuwa ota hupitha Jerusalem naamboka ye li mo yi itedhulula, oshoka oye omuyuuki.
Ihe aanandumbo naayoni ote ya hanagula po nota dhipaga po mboka taye mu etha po.
Otamu ka sithwa ohoni omolwomiti ndhoka dhiidhila mwe dhi longele; otamu ka yemata omolwiikunino mbyoka yiinonoma mwa hogolola.
Otamu ka kala mwa fa omwandi tagu si, mwa fa oshitsambe ihaashi tekelwa.
Ngashi naanaa oshihenguti tashi hwamekwa kohandje, osho wo niilonga yaanankondo tayi ka hanagulwa po kuukolokoshi wawo nokaku na nando ogumwe ta vulu okumweneka ehanagulo ndyoka.
2: Ndika olyo elaka ndyoka Kalunga a gandja kuJesaja yaAmos tali popi Juda naJerusalem:

Momasiku tage ke ya ondundu hoka kwa tungilwa otempeli,
otayi ka ninga ondeendeka yi vule adhihe,
otayi ki itumba kombanda yoondundu adhihe.
Iigwana oyindji otayi ka matukila kuyo,

naantu yayo otaa ka tya:
“Natu londeni kondundu yOmuwa,
tu ye kotempeli yaKalunga kaIsrael.
Ote ke tu nongeka shoka a hala tu longe;
otatu ke enda momapola e ga hogolola.
Oshoka elongo lyOmuwa otali zi muJerusalem;
okuza muSion ota popitha aantu ye.”

Oye ta loteke oontamanana mokati kiigwana iinankondo.
Otaa ka hambula omagonga gawo, omatemo
nomagongamwele gawo iimwitho.
Iigwana itayi ka ya we kiita,
itayi ilongekidhile we olugodhi.
Ngashingeyi ne yomoluvalo lwaJakob, yambukeni, ileni tu lyangeni muuyelele mboka Omuwa te tu minikile nawo.
Kalunga, ongoye we etha aantu yoye, oluvalo lwaJakob! Evi olyu udha uunganga wokUuzilo nuumpulile wokuFilistia. Aantu ohaa panga uukuume naakwiilongo.
Evi lyawo olyu udha oshisiliveli noshingoli, nopwaa na ehulilo lyomapungulilo guuyamba wawo. Evi lyawo olyu udha uukambe, nomatembakwiita gawo kage na ehulilo.
Evi olyu udha iimenka, nohaa longele iinima mbyoka ye yi longa nomake gawo yene.
Omuntu kehe ota ka fupipikwa nokusithwa ohoni. Omuwa, ino ya dhimina po!
Otaa ka holama momakololo goondundu notaa fulu omakwena mevi, ya kambadhale okuhenuka ondjahi yOmuwa noya ka holame etilitho lye neadhimo lyoonkondo dhe!
Esiku onali ya, uuna uuntsa wopantu tau hulithwa po neinomo lyuuntu tali hanagulwa po. Nena Omuwa oye awike ta ka simana pombanda.
Esiku ndyoka Omuwa Omunankondoawike ota ka fupipika shaa ngoka e na oonkondo, kehe ngoka ti itanga noti inomo.
Ota ka komangela po omisedeli omile dhaLibanon noomwandi adhihe moshilongo Baasha.
Ota ka yeleka oondundu adhihe oondeendeka niikulundundu,
oshungo kehe ondeendeka nomakuma gepopilongulu kehe.
Ota ka ninginitha oosikepa oonenenene dho opala.
Eitango lyopantu otali hulithwa po, neinomo lyopantu otali shundulwa. Iimenka otayi ka hula po thiluthilu, nOmuwa awike ta ka simana pombanda esiku ndyoka.
Aantu otaa ka holama momakololo moondundu notaa fulu omakwena mevi, ya kambadhale okuhenuka ondjahi yOmuwa noya holame etilitho neadhimo lyoonkondo dhe, uuna te ya a ndjingandjinge evi.
Uuna esiku ndyoka nali ya, otaa ka ekelahi iimenka yoshisiliveli noyoshingoli mbyoka ye yi hambula notaye yi thigile oombuku nomalimalima.
Uuna Omuwa te ya a ndjingandjinge evi, aantu otaa ka holama moombogo nomomakololo goondundu ya kambadhale okuhenuka ondjahi yOmuwa noya holame etilitho neadhimo lyoonkondo dhe.
Inamu inekela we omuntu. Oye omufudho gwowala. Oku na omwago gwashike?
3: Oshoka tala, Omuwa Omunankondoawike ota ka kutha Jerusalam naJuda shoka tashi ya kwatha naashoka yi inekela. Ota kutha po iikulya nomeya gawo,
oofule naakwiita yawo, aatokolihapu naahunganeki yawo, oonganga naakuluntu yawo,
ooyene yomatanga nomalenga gawo, aagandjindunge noonkulungu dhawo naayanekeli.
Omuwa oshigwana ote ke shi lelitha kuumatyona, naapwidhi otaye shi pangele.
Ayehe otaa ka thiminikathana. Aagundjuka otaye ki inomena aakulupe, naantu yaamakaha otaa ka dhina aasimanekwa.
Esiku onali ya, uuna aakwanezimo taa hogolola gumwe mezimo lyawo e taa ti kuye: “Molwaashoka u na omizalo, ninga omukuluntu gwetu methimbo ndika edhigu.”
Ihe ngwiyaka ota ka yamukula ta ti: “Hangame nando! Itandi vulu oku mu kwatha. Kandi na iikulya nenge omizalo. Inamu ninga ndje omukuluntu gweni!”
Eeno, Jerusalem osha pangulwa! Juda otashi teka po! Ashihe shoka taa popi notaa longo, osha tsa ondumbo nOmuwa; otaa hindi Omuwa mwene, noshi li po shi igalala.
Omeho gawo ga pota otage ya pe ombedhi. Uulunde wawo ohaye u igalaleke ya fa Aasodomu, ihaye u holeke. Oya pangulwa noye shi iyetele.
Aayuuki otaa ka kala ye na elago, niinima ayihe otayi ya longele uuwanawa. Otaa ka vula okunyanyukilwa iiyimati yiilonga yawo.
Ihe yaye aalunde! Shoka ya ningile yakwawo, otaa ke shi ningilwa.

Aaniimaliwa otaa ka thindila aantu yandje pevi, naanangunga yawo taye ya nyokoma.
Aantu yandje, aaleli yeni oye mu tula mohwati, opo mwaa tseye ondjila ndjoka tamu ende nayo.
Omuwa okwi ilongekidha a holoke moompangu, ota thikama a pangule aantu ye.
Omuwa ota fala aakuluntu naawiliki yoshigwana she moompangu. Ota tamanana ta ti: “Omwa yugu po iitsambe yomiviinu, nomagumbo geni ogu udha iinima mwe yi yuga oohepele.
Kamu na uuthemba wokuthemenena aantu yandje nokukutha po eliko lyoohepele. Ongame Omuwa Omupangeliawike nOmunankondoawike nde dhi popi.”
Omuwa ote ti: “Taleni, nkene aakiintu Aajerusalem tayi inomo! Ohaye ende ya yelutha omayulu mombanda. Aluhe ohaa ndengandenga. Ohaa ende okanyaganye e taa kwelengendjitha oongondo dhokomagulu gawo.
Omolwaashika Omuwa ta menitha aakadhona yomuSion iipena ya ninge omapalu nota holola epenge lyawo.”
Esiku otali ya, uuna Omuwa ta ka hula aakiintu Aajerusalem ayihe mbyoka haye yi inomene — oongondo dhokomagulu, nuulenga komitse nomoothingo dhawo,
omagola, uugondo wopiikesho yawo, nomawiiwili;
omatsilu, uulyenge wopoompando, omapaya ga nyonyombwa, oohanga dhomugwayo gwiizimba, niigegeti;
uulinga ye u zala kominwe nokomayulu gawo,
oonguwo dhawo adhihe dhokoshituthi, oondjatha, omalwaakani nuumpunda wiimaliwa;
uuyitalelo, oonguwo dholiina, iisaali niikayiwa.

Peha lyokugwaya omugwayo gwa nika nawa otaa ka nika nayi; peha lyepaya otaa zala oombale; peha lyomafufu ga fufulwa nawa otapu ya epalu; peha lyonguwo yoliina otaa zala ehahi; peha lyembweshukilo iiyadhi.
Aalumentu yomoshilando, eeno tuu, naamboka aalumentwelela aanankondo otaa ka dhipagelwa molugodhi.
Iiyelo yoshilando otayi ka lila nokutakuma, noshilando sho shene otashi ka kala sha fa omukiintu, omuhulwakadhi a kuutumba mevi.
4: Esiku ndyoka aakiintu yaheyali otaa kwata omulumentu gumwe notaa ti: “Otatu li iikulya yetu yene notatu zala oonguwo dhetu yene, otwa hala ashike u ninge omusamane gwetu, opo twaa se ohoni.”
Esiku otali ya, uuna Omuwa ta ka kokitha oshimeno nomuti kehe gu ninge omunene tagu lelema nawa. Aaisraeli ayehe mboka taa hupu ko, otaa ka nyanyukwa nokwiitangela iimeno mbyoka ya mena mevi.
Ayehe mboka ya hupile muJerusalem, oomboka Omuwa e ya hogolola ya hupe ko, otaa ka ithanwa aayapuki.
Okoonkondo dhe Omuwa ta ka tokola nokuyoga oshigwana e ta panga uutoni waJerusalem te shi ningi nombepo yepangulo noyelungunitho.
Nena Omuwa ota ka tumina kondundu Sion nokwaayehe mboka ya gongala ko, oshikogo sholwithi omutenya neye lyomulilo uusiku. Eadhimo lyaKalunga otali siikile nokugamena oshilando ashihe.
Eadhimo lye otali ka siikila oshilando noku shi tula momunzile, shi shigwe kuupyu womutenya noku shi ninga ehala lyegameneno, oku shi shiga koshikungulu nokomvula.
5:
Pulakeneni, manga tandi imbi eimbilo ndika,
eimbilo lyomuholike gwandje noshitsambe she shomiviinu:
Omuholike gwandje okwa li e na oshitsambe shomiviinu
koshikulundundu mevi lyo ondoka.

Okwe shi papula e ta fulu mo omamanya;
okwa tsike mo omiviinu dha hogololwa.
Okwe shi tungile oshungo yetonatelelo
nokwa hoko etemba lyokukolela oomviinu.
Okwa tegelele, shi ime omandjembele omatoye,
ihe oshi imi omalulu.
Ngashingeyi, ne Aajerusalem naalumentu Aajuda, tokoleni pokati ketu noshitsambe shandje shomiviinu.
Oshitsambe shandje ondi na oku shi ningila shike natango? Omolwashike ano shi imi omandjembele omalulu, manga nda tegelela omatoye?
Ano shika osho tandi ka ningila oshitsambe shandje shomiviinu: enkolo lyasho otandi li gumbulula, ote kutha po eshigo lyasho notandi etha iiyamakuti yi shi lye po, noshi lyatagulwe po.
Otandi shi ningi eputu. Omiviinu dhamo itandi ke dhi thona nenge ndi dhi helele. Otandi shi etha shi mene oondjoho nomano. Otandi ka keelela iikogo yaahe shi lokele we omvula.

Oshitsambe shomiviinu shOmuwa Omunankondoawike osho oshigwana shaIsrael, aalumentu yaJuda oyo oshilonda shenyanyu lye. Okwe ya tegelele ya longe uuwanawa, ihe peha lyawo oya tilehi ombinzi. Okwe ya tegelele yu uthe pauyuuki, ihe opwe ya elilagano lyopombanda.
Yaye mboka taa gwedha egumbo kegumbo ekwawo notaa tula kumwe omapya, sigo ayihe ya ningi yawo, sigo kape na we eha lyokukala kuyalwe, noyo ayeke taa kala moshilongo.
Ondu uvu Omuwa Omunankondoawike ta popi ta ti: Omagumbo geni agehe otaga ka kala ga mbugala, oongoka omanene noga tungika kage na we aantu.
Oshitsambe tashi pululwa niipululo omulongo mesiku limwe, otashi gandja ondjupa yimwe yomaviinu; niilya ya kunwa oontungwa omulongo, otayi zi ontungwa yimwe.
Yaye mboka haa meneka ongula onene ya tameke okunwa nohaa hungile taa nu iikolitha.
Miituthi yawo yomatelekela omu na iiketala, uuharpa, oontunda noohiya pamwe nomaviinu. Ihe ihaa ndhindhilike nando iilonga yOmuwa yo kayu uvite ko shoka ta ningi.
Omolwashoka aantu yandje kaaye na oondunge, otaa ka falwa muupongekwa. Aambala yawo otaa ka sa po kondjala, naashamba otaa ka sa po kenota.
Uusi otau ke ya sa ondjala notau ekameke okana kawo ka mbwalangandja. Otau nina po aanamadhina yaJerusalem noongundu dhaamboka haa yogelele momanyanyu gawo.
Shaa ngoka ota ka tyololoka, naayehe mboka hayi inomo, otaa ka fupipikwa.
Ihe Omuwa Omunankondoawike ota holola uunene we mokulonga shoka shu uka, nota holola uuyapuki we mokutokola aantu ye.
Momakulukuma giilando oonzigona otadhi ka napa omwiidhi, nuukombwena otau ka mona oshinapelo.
Yaye mboka taa ihilile egeelo, itaa vulu okumanguluka kondjambi yuulunde.
Otamu ti: “Omuwa ne endelele a gwanithe shoka a popi, opo tu shi mone. Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki na tsakanithe omadhiladhilo ge; ne tu talithe shoka a dhiladhila.”

Yaye mboka haa ti, uuwinayi owo uuwanawa, nuuwanawa owo uuwinayi, oomboka haa pilike omilema dhi ninge uuyelele, nuuyelele u ninge omilema! Shoka oshilulu ohaa shi ningi oshitoye, naashoka oshitoye ohaa shi ningi oshilulu.
Yaye mboka haa itala oyo aanawino nohaa itangele oondunge dhawo!
Yaye mboka haa inomene okunwa omaviinu e taa vuka mokuhanga oondungila,
mboka haa mangulula omunandjo omolwoombumbo nohaa keelele uuyuuki womukeenandjo!

Omolwaashoka, ongashika iiyagaya nomwiidhi omukukutu tagu igonyo nokulunguna momulilo, osho omidhi dhawo tadhi ka ola, neopalo lyawo tali pepuka po lya fa ontsi, oshoka oye ekelehi shoka Omuwa Omunankondoawike, Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki, e tu longo.

Omuwa okwa geele oshigwana she nokwa ganeke oshikaha she e shi dhenge. Oondundu otadhi ka kakama, nomidhimba dhaamboka taa ka sa, otadhi ka kala momapandaanda dha fa uuhoho. Naampaka ondjahi yOmuwa inayi lota, ihe oshikaha she otashi kala natango sha taganana.
Omuwa ota gandja endhindhiliko lyokwiithana oshigwana shokokule. Ote ya hikile ohiya, ya ze kooha dhuuyuni. Oko taa zi taa endelele nokukwinyola.
Mongundu yawo kamu na nando ogumwe a loloka, kape na nando ogumwe ta tantala. Ihaa kumuka noihaa kotha. Kape na epaya tali tokoka nenge olukaku talu dhituka.
Iikuti yawo oya honga, nomatati gawo oga lukilikika. Omakondo guukambe wawo ogo omakukutu ngemanya, nomagulu gomatembakwiita gawo otaga iteluka ga fa okambiya.
Aakwiita yawo otaa ndunduma ngoonime, ongaashi oonime oongundjuka tadhi pumbu notadhi gono, sho tadhi kwata oshihakanwa e tadhi shi kookolola po, nokape na omukwathi.
Uuna esiku ndyoka nali ya, otaa ka ndundumina Israel, ngaashi efuta hali ndunduma. Taleni utale oshilongo shika! Oku na ashike omilema nehaluko! Uuyelele owa ninwa po komilema.
6: Momumvo ngwiyaka omukwaniilwa Usia a si, onda mono Omuwa. Okwa li a kuutumba koshipangelapundi she, pombanda puule meadhimo, noongenge dhoonguwo dhe odhu udhitha otempeli ayihe.
Aaserafi oye mu kunduka, noshaa ngoka okwa li e na omawawa gahamano. Omawawa gaali oye gi isiikile koshipala nomawawa gaali oye gi isiikile kolutu nomawawa gaali oya tuka nago.

Oya li taa paathana omalufo taa ti:
“Omuyapuki, omuyapuki, omuyapuki!
“Omuwa Omunankondoawike omuyapuki!
“Eadhimo lye olyu udha uuyuni.”
Oshihomo shomawi gawo osha kakameke omakankameno gotempeli, notempeli yo yene oyu udha olwithi.

Onda popi nda ti: “Yaye ngame! Otandi ka kana, oshoka ngame omulumentu ndi na omilungu dha nyata, nonda kala mokati kaantu ye na omilungu dha nyata, nonomeho gandje mwene onda tala Omukwaniilwa, Omuwa Omunankondoawike!”
Nena gumwe gwomaaserafi okwe ya kungame ta tuka, a humbata ekala lya hanya e li kutha nonkwato koshiyambelo.
Okwa gumu omilungu dhandje nekala lya hanya nokwa ti: “Tala, olya gumu omilungu dhoye; ngashingeyi oondjo dhoye odha thetwa po, nomayono goye oga dhimwa po.”

Opo ihe ndu uvu Omuwa ti igidha ta ti: “Olye ngo tandi mu tumu? Olye ta ningi omutumwa gwetu?”
Onda yamukula nda ti: “Otandi yi! Tuma ndje!”
Osho ngaaka a lombwele ndje ndi ye ko ndi ka lombwele aantu elaka tali ti: “Okuuva ohamu uvu, ihe kamu uvite ko. Okumona ohamu mono, ihe kamu wete ko.
Kukutika oomwenyo dhaantu yoshigwana shika, thitika omakutsi gawo, thithikilitha omeho gawo, opo yaa mone ko yo yaa uve ko. Ngele otaa uvu ko notaa galukile kungame, otaa aludhwa.”

Onda pula nda ti: “Otashi kala ngawo sigo uunake, Omuwa?”
Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Osigo iilando ya kumunwa po noya mbugala — sigo omagumbo taga kala gaa na aantu — sigo oshilongo tashi ningi ombuga yowala.
Otandi ka fala aantu kokulekule, noshilongo ashihe otashi mbugala.

Nongele tamu hupu oshitimulongo shaantu moshilongo, nasho wo otashi ka yonagulwa po. Ihe otashi ka ninga sha fa oshithindi shomusati nenge shomwandi sha thigala mevi, omuti nge gwa kekwa po. Oshithindi shoka osho ombuto ondjapuki.”
7: Omukwaniilwa Ahas yaJotam yaUsia sho a li ta pangele Juda, iita oya tukuluka. Rezin, omukwaniilwa gwaSiria, naPeka yaRemalia, omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael, oya matukile Jerusalem, ihe oya nyengwa oku shi teya po.

Elaka sho lya adha omukwaniilwa gwaJuda tali ti, omatangakwiita gaSiria oge li nale nokuli moshilongo shaIsrael, nena oye mwene naantu ye oya sholola noya kakama ya fa omiti tadhi shikashikwa kombepo.

Omuwa okwa lombwele Jesaja a ti: “Kutha omumwoyemati Shear-Jashub, u ye u ka tsakaneke omukwaniilwa Ahas. Oto ke mu adha pondjila yaatungi yoonguwo pomukanka gwomeya ngoka tagu kutha omeya mondama yopombanda.
Mu lombwela a kale a kotoka, a ngungumane nokaa sholole nenge a piyagane. Ondjahi yomukwaniilwa Rezin nAasiria noyomukwaniilwa Peka oya fa owala olwithi talu tsinagala kiikuni iyali.
Siria, Israel nomuna gwaRemalia oye ku tsile ondumbo.
Oya dhiladhila okumatukila Juda, okuhalutha aantu ya game kuyo nokutula omuna gwaTabeel koshipundi.
“Ihe ngame, Omuwa, otandi popi te ti aawe, itaa tompola sha noitashi ningwa nando.
Omolwashike? Oshoka Siria kashi vule Damaskus, oshilandopangelo shamo, naDamasko kashi vule omukwaniilwa Rezin. Nonge pwa piti omimvo omilongo hamano nantano, Israel otashi kala sha teka po.

Oshilongo Israel kashi vule Samaria, oshilandopangelo shamo, naSamaria kashi vule omukwaniilwa Peka.
“Ngele itamu ikolelele meitaalo, itamu kala po.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele Ahas ishewe a ti:
“Pula Omuwa Kalunga koye e ku pe endhindhiliko. Otashi vulika li ze mookandoli, muuyuni wokuusi nenge mookathele, megulu.”
Ahas okwa yamukula a ti: “Itandi pula endhindhiliko, opo ndaa hinde Omuwa.”
Jesaja okwa popi a ti: “Ne oluvalo lwaDavid, pulakeneni ngashingeyi. Inashi gwana tuu, sho hamu lolokitha aantu? Omwa hala mu lolokithe wo Kalunga kandje?
Eewa ano, Omuwa mwene te mu pe endhindhiliko: omukadhona ta ningi omusimba nota vala omumati, nedhina lye oImmanuel.
Ota ka lya omahini gomoosi nomagadhi goonyushi, sigo ta koko a tseye okuhogolola uuyuuki nokweetha uuwinayi.
Nokuli manga ethimbo ndyoka inaali ya, iilongo yaakwaniilwa mboka yaali mwe ya tila, otayi ningi omaputu gowala.
“Omuwa ota ka eta kombanda yoye, kombanda yaantu yoye nokombanda yegumbo lyoye iiponga yi kenyeneka yi vule ayihe ya li ko, hela Juda naIsrael ya topokele — ote eta omukwaniilwa gwaAssur.
“Uuna esiku ndyoka tali ya, Omuwa ota hikile Aayegipiti ohiya, ye ye ya fa oondhi tadhi zi kokule kiimpoko yaNiili, nAayassur, ye ye ya fa oonyushi tadhi zi kevi lyawo.
Otadhi ya tadhi kanyata omakolombongo goondundu nomakololo gomomamanya notadhi gumbakana iihwa niipemba ayihe.
“Uuna esiku ndyoka tali ya, Omuwa ota ka ithana omukululi handiyaka yomulonga gwEufrat. Oye omupangeli gwaAssur. Ote ke mu kulula omafufu komitse, noombenzi wo ote dhi kulula ko.
“Esiku otali ya, uuna omunahambo ta hupitha owala ongombe ondjelipa niikombo iyali,
otayi kandwa omahini ga gwana. Eeno, aakaliko taa ka hupa moshilongo, otaa ka kala ye na omahini nomagadhi goonyushi gokulya.
“Uuna esiku ndyoka nali ya, ehala kehe lya mena oomviinu eyuvi tadhi zi iimaliwa iisiliveli eyuvi, otali ka mena omano noondjoho.
Aantu oko taa ka weya ye na omatati niikuti, oshoka oshilongo ashihe otashi ka mena omano noondjoho.
Koondundu adhihe hoka kwa li haku kala iimeno ya kunwa ko, otaku ka mena omano, nokape na ngoka ta ka vula okuya ko. Otadhi ka ninga omahala gokunapa oongombe nokweendagulwa koonzi.”
8: Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Kutha oshipelende oshinene, u nyolele mo oondanda dha tonata: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Bas.
Kutha aantu yaali aainekelwa, omuyambi Uria naSakaria yaJerebekia, ya ninge oonzapo dhandje.”
Mukadhandje okwa ningi omusimba. Sho a vala okamati, Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Mu luka Maher-Shalal-Hash-Bas.
Okamati manga inaaka tseya okutumbula tate nenge meme, uuyamba waDamaskus auhe niihakanwa ayihe yaSamaria otayi yiwa nayo komukwaniilwa gwaAssur.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje ishewe a ti:
“Aantu mbaka sho ya dhini omeya gomokalonga Siloa haga tondoka kashona, notaa kakama koshipala shomukwaniilwa Rezin noshomukwaniilwa Peka,
ongame, Omuwa, tandi ka tala ko omupangeli gwaAssur nomatangakwiita ge agehe, a ponokele Juda. Otaa ka matuka ya fa omeya gefundja lyomulonga gwEufrat taga kungulukile kominkulo dhagwo adhihe.
Otaa ka kungulula po Juda ngefundja tali tsu komapepe e tali siikile ayihe. Otaa ka halakana nevi alihe. Kalunga na kale pamwe natse!”
Pwidhukeni, ne iigwana, ihe otamu ka sindika! Pulakeneni, ne ooha dhuuyuni: Ihomatekeleni iita, ihe otamu ka dhengwa! Eeno, ilongekidheni, ihe otamu ka sindika!
Pangeleni oompangela, ihe itamu tompola sha. Uvathaneni, ihe itashi tsakanithwa, oshoka Kalunga oku li pamwe natse.
Omuwa okwa londodha ndje noonkondo dhe adhihe, ndaa ende nondjila yoshigwana shika. Okwa ti:
“Ino zimina shoka oshigwana shika tashi ti shi longa, ngoye ino tila iinima mbyoka hashi yi tila. Ino kwatwa kehaluko.
Ngame Omuwa Omunankondoawike, ngame omuyapuki, ongame awike u na okutila nokuhalukila.
Omoluuyapuki wandje uutilithi onda fa emanya ndyoka aantu tayi ipumu ko; onda fa omwigo tagu yulu aantu yomiilongo Juda naIsrael nAajerusalem.
Oyendji otaa ka tantala, otaa ka gwila po notaa ka nyanyulwa. Otaa ka yulwa komwigo.”
Onda hala okupungula nawa elondodho ndika lya zi kOmuwa nokupatela ompango moomwenyo dhaalongwa yandje.
Omuwa okwa holama oshigwana she mwene, ihe ngame onde mu inekela nondi na etegameno muye.
Ongame nguka naanona mbaka Omuwa e ya pe ndje. Omuwa Omunankondoawike, ngoka oshipangelapundi she shi li kondundu Sion, okwe tu tuma tu ninge oontumwalaka dhi na omwenyo kAaisraeli.

Nge taku tiwa, mu pule elaka kaathithi nokoompulile, mboka haa nongona nohaa dhilomota, omolwashike ando mwaa ka pule elaka kuKalunga keni? Omolwashike moshinima shaanamwenyo mu na okupula elaka kaathithi?
Ya yamukula u tye: “Pulakeneni shoka Omuwa te mu nongeke. Inamu pulakena koompulile. Shoka tadhi mu lombwele, itashi mu opalele.”
Oshigwana otashi ka endaenda noshilongo, sha tyololoka nosha sa ondjala. Mondjala yasho nomondjahi yasho otashi ka tuka omukwaniilwa gwasho naKalunga kasho. Otashi ligalala sha tala pombanda,
