nenge sha tongolola pevi, ihe itashi mono sha shaa shi uudhigu nomilema, omilema dhi tilitha, moka ya mbolokotithilwa mo.
9:
Itaku ka kala ku na ompito yokuhenuka uudhigu mbuka.
Evi lyomazimo gaSebulon nogaNaftali olya li lya dhinika, ihe konakuyiwa esimano otali ke ya koshikandjo shika okuza kEfuta lyopokati sigo okevi lyohandiyaka yaJordan, nokuGalilea, moka aakwiilongo ya kala.

Oshigwana she ende momilema,
otashi mono uuyelele owindji.
Oomboka ya kala momilema thokothoko,
uuyelele otau ya minikile.

Aantu oto ya shambudha noonkondo, Omuwa,
oto ya pe enyanyu enene.
Otaa nyanyukilwa koshipala shoye,
ngaashi aantu haa nyanyukwa, uuna taa teya iilya nenge taa topola oshihakanwa.

Oshoka ongoye wa teya ondjoko yawo ndjoka ya li ye yi uvitile uudhigu,
nowa tokola ongola ndjoka ye ya dhenge komapepe.
Omuwa, owa dhenge iigwana mbyoka ya hepeke aantu yoye,
naanaa ngaashi wa dhengele Aamidiana nale ndjiyaka.

Oongaku dhaahomoni noonguwo dhawo dha yaywa mombinzi
otadhi fikwa po.

Otwa valelwa omunona!
Otwa pewa omumati!
Epangelo olye; oli li komapepe ge.
Ota lukwa Omupukululi omukumithi,
Kalunga omunankondo, He yomuukwaaluhe,
Omuwa gwombili.

Uukwaniilwa we kau na mpoka tau hulu po,
noshilongo she otashi kala aluhe shi na ombili.
Ota ka kuutumba koshipangelapundi shaDavid ta lele oshilongo she.
Oonkondo dhe odha kankamekelwa keutho nokuuyuuki,
okuza nena sigo aluhe.
Uulaadhi wOmuwa Omunankondoawike otau shi ningi.
Omuwa okwa tumbulile oshilongo shaIsrael epangulo, a pangule oluvalo lwaJakob.
Aaisraeli ayehe, shaa ngoka a kala moshilando Samaria, ota ka tseya kutya shika okwe shi ninga. Ihe otayi inomo noya lunduka. Otaa ti:
“Oondhopi odha kumuka po, ihe otatu ka tunga po omakuma gomamanya ga hongwa. Omikwiyu odha hokoka po, ihe tse otatu ka tsika mo omisedeli.”
Omuwa okwe ya shongele aatondi yawo ye ya matukile.
Siria kuuzilo naFilistia kuuninginino oye ekama omakana gawo ya nine po Israel. Nomushika ondjahi yOmuwa inayi lota; okwooko kwe onatango kwa taganana.
Aaisraeli inayi itedhulula natango. Nando Omuwa Omunankondoawike okwe ya geele, inaa galukila kuye.
Polumwe Omuwa ota ka geela Israel naawiliki ye; ote ke ya teta omutse nomushila.
Aakuluntu naanenentu oyo omutse, naahunganeki mboka taa longo omalongo giifundja, oyo omushila.
Aawiliki yaantu mbaka oya ningi aapukithi, naawilikwa oya piyaganekwa thiluthilu.

Omolwashoka Omuwa ina hokwa aagundjukamati yawo noita sile nando aaselekadhi yawo noothigwa ohenda, oshoka aantu ayehe oyo aakaanakalunga naakolokoshi, naashihe shoka taa popi, oshiwinayi. Nopushika ondjahi yOmuwa inayi lota natango; okwooko kwe onatango kwa taganana.
Uukolokoshi waantu owa hwama wa fa epeya tali lungunitha po omano noondjoho. Owa taandela wa fa okuti taku pi notaku gundumuka olwithi.
Molwaasho Omuwa Omunankondoawike a geya, ondjahi ye oya hwama ya fa omulilo tagu lilima noshilongo tagu lungunitha po aantu, noitaa silathana ohenda.
Shaa mpoka moshilongo aantu otaa hakana nokulya po uundjagumuke wiikulya mboka taa mono, ihe itaa kuta. Nando naa lye po oyana, aawe, onkene tuu itaa kuta.
Aamanasse nAaefraim otaa matukilathana, noyo kumwe ayehe otaa ponokele Juda. Natango ondjahi yOmuwa inayi lota; okwooko kwe onatango kwa taganana.
10: Yaye mboka haa toto oompango dhaa ukile, oomboka haa tungu omautho haga hepeke aantu yandje!
Osho haa keelele oohepele uuthemba wawo nohaa kutha aakweyi etokolo lyu uka. Osho haa thetula aaselekadhi eliko lyawo nohaa kutha po uuthiga woothigwa.

Otamu ka ninga ngiini, uuna Omuwa te mu geele? Otamu ka ninga ngiini, uuna te mu undulile ehanagulo tali zi moshilongo shokokule? Otamu ka matukila peni, mu ka mone ekwatho? Uuyamba weni otamu ke u holeka peni?
Otamu ka dhipagelwa miita nenge mu kwatwe po oonkwatwa. Natango ondjahi yOmuwa inayi lota, onatango tuu oshikaha she sha taganana.
Yaye Assur, ongoye ongola yondjahi yandje! Otandi longitha Assur ongondhimbo yokudhenga mboka nda geela.
Otandi tumu Assur okudhenga oshigwana oshikeenakalunga, aantu mboka ya geyitha ndje. Otandi ya tumu, ya yuge, ya hakane yo ya lyatagule aantu ngaashi iiyagaya momapandaanda.
Ihe omupangeli gwaAssur ita dhiladhila ngaaka, kali shi elalakano lye. Elalakano lye olyo okuhanagula nokukomba po iigwana oyindji.
Oti itanga ta ti: “Oondjayi dhandje adhihe dhaakwiita odho aakwaniilwa.
Onda lala iilando Kalno naKarkemish, Hamat naArpad, Samaria naDamaskus.
Onda ganeke okwooko kwandje, ndi geele iilongo mbyoka hayi simaneke iimenka oyindji yi vule mbyoka yaJerusalem naSamaria.
Onda teya po Samaria niimenka yasho ayihe; osho te ningile wo Jerusalem niiyelekela mbyoka tayi simanekelwa mo.”
Ihe Omuwa ota ti: “Uuna te mana shoka tandi longo kondundu Sion nomuJerusalem, otandi ka geela omupangeli gwaAssur omolwomwiityo gwe nuutsa we auhe.”

Omupangeli gwaAssur oti inomo ta ti: “Ayihe mbika ongame nde yi longo. Ngame ondi na oonkondo nowino nonda kotoka. Onda dhimi po oongamba pokati kiigwana nonde ya yugu uuyamba mboka ya li ya pungula. Aantu onde ya lyatagula nda fa ontsezi.

Iigwana yomuuyuni oya ningi ya fa oshihandhila shokadhila, uuyamba wawo onde u gongele nuupu nda fa tandi gongele omayi. Kakwa li ewawa lya papamene ndje, li haluthe ndje, nenge okana ke ekamene ndje, ka kudhile ndje.”

Ihe Omuwa ota ti: “Ekuya otali inomo tuu kutya olyo enene li vule ngoka te li tetitha? Oshisaaha oshi na tuu esimano li vule lyaangoka ta saaha nasho? Oshiti ohashi longitha tuu ngoka e shi yedha, nenge ondhimbo ohayi dhungadhunga tuu omuntu?”
Omuwa Omunankondoawike ota tumu uuvu, a geele aakwiita yaAssur yo ondoka. Momalutu gawo otamu ka yaka omulilo gwa fa epeya.
Kalunga, uuyelele waIsrael, ota ka kala omulilo. Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki ota ka kala omalaka gomulilo. Mesiku limwe otaga fike po omano noondjoho muIsrael.
Omakuti ge ga thitakana nomapya go ondoka otaga hanagulwa po thiluthilu, ngaashi omuvu ta thipuka.
Momakuti ge otamu ka hupa omiti omishona, nokanona taka vulu oku dhi yalula.
Esiku otali ya, uuna Aaisraeli mboka ya hupu ko, itaa inekele we oshigwana shoka konyala she ya hanagula po. Otaa ka inekela shili Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki.
Aaisraeli aashona ayeke taa ka galukila kuKalunga kawo omunankondo.
Nando Aaisraeli oyendjiyendji ya fa ehekevi lyomooha dhefuta, aashona yowala taa ka galuka ko. Ehanagulopo olya tokolelwa Aaisraeli, noye li ilongela lela.
Eeno shili, Omuwa, Omuwa Omunankondoawike ota ka tsakanitha etokolo lyehanagulopo moshilongo ashihe.
Omuwa Omupangeliawike nOmunankondoawike ota lombwele aantu ye mboka ye li muSion ta ti: “Inamu tila Aayassur, nando taye mu hepeke, ngaashi Aayegipiti ya ningile.
Egeelo lyandje kune otali hulithwa po mbala notandi ke ya hanagula po.
Ongame, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, otandi ke ya nakula nongola yandje, ngaashi nda dhengele Aamidiana pemanya lyaOreb. Otandi geele Assur, ngaashi nda geelele Egipiti.
Uuna esiku ndyoka lya thiki, otandi mu mangulula mepangelo lyaAssur, nondjoko yawo itayi ka kala we komapepe geni.”
Etangakwiita lyaatondi otali homona Ai. Otaa pitilile muMigron. Omatemba gawo otaye ga thigi muMikmash.
Otaa kondo etaulilo notaa ka hungila muGeba. Aantu yomuRama otaa haluka, naantu yomoshilando shaSaul Gibea otaa kukuma taa yi ondapo.
Aagallim, kugeni onkugo! Ne Aalajesha, pulakeneni! Yamukuleni, ne Aayanatot!
Aamadmena nAagebimi otaa fadhuka po ya ka holame.
Esiku tuu ndyoka aatondi oye li moshilando Nob, naahwiyaka otaa ganeke oongonyo kondundu Sion muJerusalem.
Omuwa Omunankondoawike ote ke ya pompona ya fa iitayi tayi tetwa ko komuti. Ndhoka dhi ifala pombanda nomileeleka dhomudho otadhi komangelwa po notadhi lyatelwa pevi.
Omuwa ote ya komangele po ya fa omiti dhomokati komugulu tadhi komangelwa nekuya; nando nadhi kale omiwanawa ngaashi muLibanon, otadhi kewa po.
11: Oshitutuma otashi tsapuka moshithindi shaIsai; noshitayi omomidhi dhasho e tashi imi iiyimati.

Ombepo yOmuwa otayi mu lambele,
ombepo yowino noyoondunge,
ombepo yomayele noyoonkondo,
ombepo yuunongo noyokutila Omuwa —

oye nota ka nyanyukilwa etilo okutila Omuwa.
Iha pangula pakutala kwomeho,
ye iha tokola pakuuva omauvila,

ihe ohu uthile oonakuhepa nuuyuuki
nota popile uuthemba woohepele moshilongo
Nohapu ye yoonkondo ota dhenge evi
naakolokoshi ote ya dhipaga nomufudho gwomokana ke.

Uuyuuki owo epaya lyomombunda ye,
uudhiginini noshili omuya gwomoombwetelo dhe.

Embungu otali ka kala pamwe nokanzigona,
nongwe tayi kala ya lala pokakombwena.
Okatana nokankoshona otau napele pamwe,
nokamati okashona take u litha.

Ongombe onzinzi nemwanka enyali otayi napele pamwe,
noyana taa gondjo pamwe.
Nonime otayi li omwiidhi ya fa ongombe.

Okahanona haka yamu taka dhana pomututu gwontoka,
nokamputu opo ka toyo otaka tsu oshikaha shako kokwena kwepili.

Kondundu yandje ondjapuki
itaku ka longwa uuwinayi nenge iikolokosha,
oshoka evi otali ka udha okutseya Omuwa
kwa fa omeya ga siikila efuta.
Esiku otali ya, uuna oshitutuma shaIsai tashi ka ninga epandela lyiigwana. Iigwana otayi ka gongalela kuye, nonkalelo ye oyi na eopalo.

Mesiku ndyoka Omuwa ota ka ganeka okwooko kwe olutiyali, a galulile kegumbo yamwe yomaantu ye mboka ya hupile muAssur nomuEgipiti, muPatros, Etiopia, Elam, Babilonia naHamat, pominkulo nokoontuntu dhomomafuta.
Omuwa ota ka yelutha epandela, u ulukile iigwana kutya ota gongele ishewe Aaisraeli nAajuda mboka ya halakana e te ya kongolola koombinga adhihe dhevi.
Oshilongo shaIsrael itashi ka sila we Juda efupa, naJuda ita ka ninga omutondi gwaIsrael.
Ayehe otaa matukile Aafilisti kuuninginino e taa ka yuga aantu yokuuzilo. Otaa ka sinda Aaedomi nAamoabi, nAayammoni otaa ka vulika kuyo.
Omuwa ota ka kukutika Ekololo lyaSues nota pepitha ombepo ompyu kombanda yomulonga gwEufrat note gu topagula muulonga uheyali uushona tau vulu okutaagulukwa kolupadhi.
Ogwo notagu ningi onenendjila yokweendwa kaantu ye Aaisraeli mboka ya hupu ko taa zi kuAssur, naanaa ngaashi oohekulu ya zile muEgipiti.
12:
Esiku otali ya, uuna to popi e to ti:
“Otandi ku hambelele, Omuwa!
Owa geele ndje, ihe ondjahi yoye oya loto,
ongoye nowa fudhitha ndje.

Oshili, Kalunga oye ehupitho lyandje;
onde mu inekela no ihe tila sha.
Omuwa, Omuwa oye oonkondo dhandje neimbilo lyandje.
Oye a ningi ehupitho lyandje.”
Nenyanyu otamu ka teka mo omeya momithima dhehupitho.

Esiku ndyoka otamu popi e tamu ti:
“Hambeleleni Omuwa! Uvitheni edhina lye!
Hokololeni iilonga ye mokati kiigwana!
Uvitheni tamu ti edhina lye olya simana pombanda!

Imbileni Omuwa, oshoka okwa longo iinima iinene!
Yi tseyithileni uuyuni auhe!

Igidheni mokule ne mu imbe nenyanyu, ne Aasioni,
oshoka Kalunga Omuyapuki gwaIsrael oye omunene, a kala mokati keni.”
13: Ndhika odho oohapu dhomahunganeko tadhi popi Babilon, dha hololelwa Jesaja yaAmos kuKalunga.
Yelutheni epandela pontundulu kondungu yondundu, mu igidhe aakwiita! Yelutheni omaako mu ya lape, opo ya matukile iiyelo yoshilando shi na uuntsa.
Omuwa okwi ithana aakwiita ye oofule yi ihupula, ya hinge iita iiyapuki yo ya geele mboka e ya sila ondjahi.
Pulakeneni omundundumo koondundu — omuzizimo gwengathithi enene lyaantu, ombuyagano yiigwana niilongo tayi gongala. Omuwa, Kalunga komatangakwiita, ota dheula aakwiita ye.
Otaye ya taa zi kiilongo yokokule kooha dhuuyuni. Mondjahi ye Omuwa ote ya a hanagule po oshilongo ashihe.
Memekukwee! Esiku lyOmuwa oli li popepi. Omunankondoawike ote eta ehanagulopo.
Nena omake gaantu ayehe otaga ka nemanana, nomukumo gwawo otagu tyololoka.
Otaa ka haluka, otaa gwilililwa po kuuwehame ya fa omukulukadhi a adhika koshitheta. Otaa talathana ya sholola, niipala yawo ya pemba kohoni.
Esiku lyOmuwa otali ya. Olyo esiku etilithi li na uulaadhi nondjahi ondulu. Oshilongo otashi mbugala, nomulunde kehe ota hanagulwa po.
Oonyothi dhokegulu nomakaladhidhi gadho itaga ka minikila we. Etango otali ka kala lya luudha, sho tali piti, nomwedhi itagu toka we.
Omuwa ota ti: “Otandi geele evi omoluuwinayi walyo, naakolokoshi omolwomayono gawo. Otandi ka hulitha po uuntsa waatangalali notandi ka thindila pohi omwiityo gwaakolokoshi.
Oomboka taa hupu ko, otaa ka pumba ye vule oshingoli.
Otandi kakamitha omagulu; nevi otali ka ndjingandjingwa pehala lyalyo mesiku ndyoka, uuna ngame, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, tandi holola ondjahi yandje.
“Aakwiilongo mboka ya kala muBabilon, otaa ka ya ontuku kiilongo yawo, ya fa uupundja tau hunuka mokati kaakongo. Otaa halakana ya fa oonzi dhaa na omusita.
Shaa ngoka ta adhika, ota ka tsuwa negonga, shaa ngoka ta kwatwa, ota ka dhipagwa po.
Uunona wawo otau ka nyanyagulwa montaneho yawo, omagumbo gawo otaga ka yugwa naakulukadhi yawo otaa ka laliwa nayo.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Otandi ka sikumudha Aamedia ya matukile Babilon. Kaye na onkwa noshisiliveli noihaa haluka oshingoli.
Omatati gawo otaga yaha aagundjuka. Kaye na onge nuuhanona, nuunona itaye u tala nolukeno.
Babilonia osho oshilongo sho opala shi vule ayihe, osho uuntsa waantu yasho. Ihe ngame, Omuwa, otandi ka hanagula po Babilon, ngaashi nda ningi Sodom naGomorra!
Kape na we mpoka tashi ka kalwa kaantu. Kape na Omuarabia ta dhike mo etsali lye, nokape na omusita ta napithile mo iimuna ye.
Otashi ningi ehala lyokugondja oombidhi. Moongulu dhasho omahwiyu taga ka tunga iihandhila, oompo odhi na mo onkalo yadho, niikombo yomokuti otayi ka ndjomboka-ndjomboka apehe.
Moongulumbala otamu yogelele oombandje, nomambungu otaga ulula miinyanga yasho. Eeno, ethimbo lyaBabilon olya thikana! Omasiku gasho ga pitilila.”
14: Omuwa ota ka sila Aaisraeli ohenda e te ya hogolola ishewe, ya ninge aantu ye mwene. Ote ke ya fala ishewe mevi lyawo, naakwiilongo otaye ya e tayi itula mokati kawo.

Iigwana oyindji otayi ka kwatha Aaisraeli ya galukile kevi ndyoka Omuwa e li ya pe, naankoka iigwana otayi ka ninga aapika yAaisraeli, yi ya longele. Mboka ya kwatele po Israel, otaa ka kwatwa po kuIsrael, nAaisraeli otaa ka pangela aantu mboka ye ya hepekele nale.
Omuwa ota ka pa Aaisraeli epepelelo, ya manguluke kuuwehame nokomahepeko gawo nokiilonga yuupika ya thiminikilwa oku yi longa.

Uuna Omuwa ta gwanitha mbika, aantu otaa ka nyekela omukwaniilwa gwaBabilon taa ti:
“Omukwaniilwa omunanyanya a gwile po! Ita ka hepeka we omuntu!
Omuwa okwa teya oonkondo dhaapangeli aakaanakalunga
mboka ya li haa ponokele iigwana mondjahi nokuthiminika aapikwa yawo nonyanya pwaa na nando ohenda.
Uuyuni auhe otau nyanyukilwa evululuko nombili, noshaa ngoka oti imbi ta hambelele.
Omikiperesi nomisedeli dhaLibanon otadhi nyanyukilwa etekopo lyomukwaniilwa, oshoka kape na we ngoka te dhi komangele po, oshoka ke po.
“Uusi owa tegamena omukwaniilwa gwaBabilon. Aathithi yaamboka ya li aanankondo kevi, oya penduka. Aakwampungu yaakwaniilwa oya yambuka kiipangelapundi yawo.
Ayehe otaye mu igidha taa ti: ‘I! Wa ningi nani we tu fa! Owe tu fa lelalela!
Owa li ho simanekwa noshihomo shuuhumba, ihe ngashingeyi we ya ishewe muuyuni wokuusi. To lala pombanza yeolelo nowa siikilwa komazinyo.’
“Nyothingula, omuna gweluwa! Owa ningwa ngiini, sho wu umbilwa pevi, ngoye ngoka wa sindi iigwana?

Owi ipopile momwenyo gwoye wa ti: ‘Otandi ka londa kegulu, otandi ka thikameka oshipangelapundi shandje pombanda handiya yoonyothi dhaKalunga. Otandi ka kuutumba koshipangelapundi kondundu yokugongalela ookalunga, mookathelelela kondundu yiiholekwa.
Otandi londo handiyaka yiikogo, ngame ndi fe Omunankondoawike.’
Ihe nani owu umbilwa mohi moshaasi, mombwili yekolombongo.
“Aasi ye ku tongolola, otaye ku sheke taa pula taa ti: ‘Omulumentu oye tuu nguka a kakamitha nale uuyuni nokwa ndjingandjinga iilongo?
Oye tuu omulumentu ngoka a teya po iilando e ta mbugaleke uuyuni? Oye tuu ngono inaa mangulula nando oonkwatwa dhe nenge e dhi ethe dhi ye koyaandjawo?’
Aakwaniilwa ayehe yomuuyuni oya lala moombila dhawo nokusimanekwa,
ihe ngoye ku na ombila, nomudhimba gwoye ogwa umbilwa meolelo. Ogwa siikilwa komidhimba dhaakwiita ya sile molugodhi, ogwa umbilwa pamwe nadho mombogo yemanya nogwa lyatagulwa.
Molwashoka wa yono po oshilongo shoye mwene e to dhipaga aantu yoye, ito ka fumvikwa wa fa aakwaniilwa yalwe. Kape na nando ogumwe gwomegumbo lyoye ta ka hupa ko.
Etheni utale, eso li homate! Aamati aana yomukwaniilwa otaa ka sa moluulunde woohekulu. Kape na nando ogumwe gwomuyo ta ka pangela uuyuni nenge e u tungile iilando.”
Omuwa Omunankondoawike ota ti: “Otandi ka ponokela Babilon e tandi shi kumuna po. Itandi hupitha po sha — itaku hupu aanona, itaku hupu omuntu e na omwenyo. Ongame mwene, Omuwa, nde dhi popi.
Babilon otandi shi ningi ondombe yontopo nehala lyomahwiyu. Babilon otandi shi kombo po noshikombe shoka tashi kutha po ayihe. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi!”
Omuwa Omunankondoawike okwa gana ta ti: “Shoka nda nuna, otashi ka ningwa, shoka ndu utha okuningwa, otashi ka gwanithwa.

Aayassur otandi ke ya dhipaga mo moshilongo shandje shaIsrael e tandi ya lyatagulile koondundu dhandje. Aantu yandje otandi ke ya mangulula mondjoko yAayassur nokomutenge ngoka ya li ye na oku gu humbata.
Shika osho nda tokola kombinga yuuyuni; nokwooko kwandje okwa taganana okugeela iigwana.”
Omuwa Omunankondoawike okwa tokola e shi gwanithe. Okwa taganeke okwooko kwe a geele, nokape na ngoka ta vulu oku mu kankeka.
Elaka ndika olyu uvithwa omumvo ngwiyaka omukwaniilwa Ahas a sa.
Aafilisti, ongola ndjoka ye mu dhenge, oya tokoka, ihe kamu na okunyanyukwa. Uuna eyoka tali si, ekwawo etilithi otali hituka peha lyalyo. Meyi lyeyoka omwa tendulwa oshikoko shomawawa.
Omuwa ota ka ninga omusita gwaantu ye oohepele, naakwanaluhepo ote ke ya tula megameno. Ihe ne Aafilisti ote ke mu tumina ondjala yekomba, noitayi hupitha ko nando ogumwe a kale e na omwenyo.
Iilando ne amuhe yAafilisti, kugeni ne mu kolomoke! Amuhe kakameni! Oshikogo sholwithi otashi zi kuumbangalantu — osho etangakwiita moka kaamu na nando omumbanda.
Oontumwa ndhoka tadhi zi kuFilistia, otadhi yamukulwa ngiini? Eyamukulo olyo ndika kutya Omuwa okwa tungu Sion, naantu ye aahepekwa otaa ka mona mo egameno.
15:
Ehunganeko ndika otali popi Moab
Iilando Ar naKir otayi hanagulwa po muusiku umwe, neimweneneno tali siikile evi lyaMoab.
Aadibon: otaa londo kiikulundundu, ya ka lilile pomahala giinonoma. Aamoabi otaa lilagana moluhodhi omolwiilando Nebo naMedeba; oya kulula omitse dhawo noombenzi dhawo moluhodhi.
Aantu momapandaanda oya zala omahahi; momahalandjandja goshilando nokombanda yoongulu aantu taa lili yo taa kugu.
Aaheshboni nAaelale taa kugu, nonkugo yawo otayi uvika sigololo okuJahas. Nokuli aakwiita otaa kakama; omukumo gwawo ogwa kana.

Omwenyo gwandje tagu lili Moab. Aantu oya yi ontuku sigo okuZoar nokuEglat Shelishija. Yamwe otaa londo ondjila yokuLuhit taa yi taa lili; yamwe otaa ka holama kuHoronajim taa kugagana omolwehanagulo.
Okalonga Nimrim otaka pwine, omwiidhi gwe ka kunduka otagu kukuta, noitaku kala we sha sha ziza.
Aantu otaa tokola esilukuti lyomipopeli taa kambadhala okufadhuka po nomaliko gawo agehe.
Koongamba dhaMoab otaku kugu onkugo tayi uvika. Otayi mbololoka yi uvitike kiilando Eglaim naBeerelim.
Poshilando Dibon omeya momulonga oga tiliganekwa kombinzi, ihe natango Kalunga oku na sha oshitilithi e shi pungulila aantu yasho. Eeno, mboka ya hupu muMoab, ote ke ya tumina omudhipagi.
16: Aamoabi otaa kutha onzigona moshilando Sela shi li mombuga e taye yi gandja omagano komuntu ngoka ta pangele muJerusalem.
Oye li komunkulo gwomulonga Arnon ya tegelela notaa pwampwauka mpaka naampeyaka ya fa oondhila dha hanagulilwa po iihandhila yadho.

Otaa lombwele Aajuda taa ti: “Tu lombweleni shoka tu na okuninga. Tu shigeni ngaashi omuti ngoka gu na enzile lyaalofu moshanga shomutenya. Tu gondjitheni momunzile gweni. Otse oontauki; tu holekeni pwaa kale ngoka te tu mono.

Tu pitikeni tu kale moshilongo sheni. Tu gameneni kumboka ya hala ye tu yonagule po.”
(Ehepeko nehanagulo otali ka hula, naamboka taa mbugaleke oshilongo, otaa ka hula po.
Nena gumwe gwomoluvalo lwaDavid ota ka ninga omukwaniilwa, nota ka lela aantu nuudhiginini nohole. Oye omutokoli ha gwanitha eutho lyu uka noha lalakanene uuyuuki.)
Aajuda otaa ti: “Otwa kundana, nkene Aamoabi ye na uuntsa; oye na oshilundo, etuwalalo, einomo nepumpagano, ihe omwiityo gwawo ogwowala.”
Aamoabi otaa ka lila moluudhigu tau ya hepeke. Ayehe otaa ka lilila omakaka gomandjembele ya li haye ga li nale muKir Heres. Otaa ka teka po.

Iitsambe yomiviinu yokuHeshbon niilonda yomiviinu yokuSibma oya hanagulwa po — omo moka mwa zi omaviinu haga kolitha aaleli yiigwana. Omaviinu ngoka oga li haga pindikwa sigo okoshilando Jaser, sigo okombuga kuuzilo, nokuuninginino handiyaka yEfuta lyeso.
Ngashingeyi otandi lilile omiviinu dhokuSibma, ngaashi Jaser tashi lili. Omahodhi gandje otaga pononoka omolwaHeshbon naElale, molwaashoka kaku na nando eteyo lyokunyanyudha aantu.
Kaku na ngoka ta nyanyukilwa omatathapya. Kaku na omuligoli nenge ngoka ti imbi miitsambe yomiviinu. Kaku na omukoli gwomandjembele a hange omaviinu; ondigolo yenyanyu oya hula.
Onda yemata meni lyandje omolwaMoab, momwenyo gwandje onda sila Kir Heres oluhodhi.
Aamoabi otayi ikulupike yo yene okuya kiinonoma yokoondundu noku ka galikana mootempeli dhawo; itashi ya kwatha.
Elaka olyo ndika Omuwa e li gandja nale tali popi Moab.

Ngashingeyi Omuwa ota ti: “Moomvula ndatu, ngaashi omupiya e li kondhalate te dhi yalula, eliko enene lyaMoab otali ka kana po. Maantu ye oyendji aashonashona yowala taa ka hupa ko ye na omwenyo, ihe kaye na omwago.”
17: Omuwa ota ti: “Oshilando Damaskus itashi kala we olule; otashi ka ninga ondumba yomakulukuma.
Iilando yaSiria otayi ka hanagulwa po sigo aluhe. Otayi ka ninga omaunapelo goonzi nogoongombe, nokape na ngoka te dhi tidha mo.

Israel ota ka kala itaa vulu okwiipopila, naDamaskus otashi kanitha eipangelo lyasho. Aasiria mboka taa hupu ko ye na omwenyo, otaa ka sa nohoni ya fa Aaisraeli. Ongame, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, nde dhi popi.”
Omuwa okwa ti: “Esiku otali ya, uuna esimano lyaIsrael tali hulu po, nuuyamba we tau halakana po.
Israel ota ka fa epya lya teywa iilya, a fa epya molusilu lwaRafaim uuna lya teywa.

Aantu aashuushuka yowala taa ka hupa ko, naIsrael ota ka fa omuolivi gwa likolwa ooholivi, shila oku na owala oombali noondatu ndhoka dha hupile kuundjendja nenge ooholivi ndhoka dha hupile piitayi yopevi. Ongame, Omuwa Kalunga kaIsrael, nde dhi popi.”
Esiku nge lya thikana, aantu otaa ka galukila komukwathi nokOmushiti gwawo, Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki.
Itaa ki inekela we iiyambelo ye yi tungu niikaha yawo yene, nenge yi itule iilonga yiikaha yawo — iiyelekela yoshikalungakiintu Asheera niiyambelo yiitsinino.
Esiku otali ya, uuna iilando ya kola tayi ka ninga ombuga notayi kumunwa po ya fa iilando mbyoka ya thigwa po kAahevi nokAayamori, sho ya fadhuka po Aaisraeli.
Israel, owa dhimbwa Kalunga ngoka e ku hupitha nokwe ku gamene a fa emanya lya kola. Peha lye owa tsike po iikunino yiinonoma, opo u longele iikalunga yokiilongo.
Ihe nando yi koke mbalambala yi sheneke, itayi ka likolwa sha. Otaku kala owala omukundu nuuvu waa shi kupangwa.
Iigwana iinankondo oya tsu ondumbo notayi ndundumitha ewi lyayo lya fa efuta, lya fa epupo lyomakuthikuthi omanene.
Iigwana otayi ndunduma ya fa omakuthikuthi, sho taga hedha ko, ihe Kalunga ote yi ganda, oyo notayi shuna. Ote yi tidha po ya fa ontsi kombanda yondundu, ya fa iiyagaya mokambiya.
Otayi tilitha aantu ongulohi, ihe ongula nge kwa shi, kayi po we. Shika osho oshipewa shashaa ngoka te tu yugu evi lyetu.
18: Pomilonga dhaEtiopia ope na oshilongo mpoka oshihomo shomawawa tashi uvika.

Okuza koshilongo shoka oontumwa otadhi ende moowato dhomanenge muNiili. Galukileni kegumbo, ne oontumwa mu na ontuku! Faaleleni elaka koshilongo sheni sha kambakanwa komilonga, koshigwana sheni sha kola sho shi na omatha, kaantu yeni aaleeleka ye na oshipa tashi adhima, mboka taa tilika kuuyuni auhe.
Pulakeneni, amuhe mboka mwa kala kombanda yevi! Taleni utale epandela tali yeluthwa koondungu dhoondundu! Pulakeneni ekugagano lyenkuma!
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Otandi ka entamena ndi li megulu ndi ilongelela nda fa omata gomume muusiku wopothinge, ndi ilongelela nda fa etango tali minikile moshanga shomutenya.
Omandjembele manga inaaga toononwa, oongala sho dha yagumuka nomandjembele taga tiligana, aatondi otaa ka teya po Etiopia nuupu ya fa ombele tayi pompona ko iitayi komuviinu.
Omidhimba dhaakwiita yawo otadhi ka thigilwa oondhila niithitukuti. Othinge otaa lika po komambiimbili nokufu okiithitukuti.”

Esiku otali ya, uuna Omuwa Omunankondoawike ta ka taamba omayambo koshilongo shika sha kambakanwa komilonga, koshigwana shika sha kola noshinankondo, kaantu mbaka aaleeleka ye na oshipa tashi adhima, mboka haa tilika kuuyuni auhe. Otaa ke ya kondundu Sion, nkoka Omuwa Omunankondoawike ta simanekelwa.
19:
Ndika olyo elaka tali popi Egipiti.
Omuwa ote ya kuEgipiti a londa oshikogo shi na ontuku. Iimenka yaEgipiti tayi kakama koshipala she, nAayegipiti otaa tyololoka.

Omuwa ota popi ta ti: “MuEgipiti otandi tukuluthile mo iita yuukwashilongo, aantu naamwayina taa kondjithathana, omushiinda nomushiinda. Oshilando otashi kondjitha oshilando oshikwawo, oshikandjo noshikandjo oshikwawo.
Otandi ka ngwangwaneka ombepo yAayegipiti e tandi piyaganeke oompangela dhawo. Otaa ka pula omayele kiimenka yawo, kaayanekeli, kiihehelela nokoombepo dhuumpulile.
Aayegipiti otandi ke ya gandja miikaha yomutyakaleki, omukwaniilwa omudhudhu ngoka te ke ya pangela. Ongame, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, nde dhi popya.”
Omeya otaga ka pwina mo muNiili, nomulonga otagu ka kukuta.
Omikanka ndhoka tadhi zi momulonga, otadhi ka nika nayi, sho tadhi pwine. Oombungu nomanenge otaga ka ganya,
niimeno ayihe ya kunwa komunkulo gwaNiili, otayi ka lemba nokukukuta e tayi pepwa po.
Aayuli yoohi otaa ka nyenyeta nokuyemata. Oondjolo noonete dhawo kadhi na we oshilonga.
Aatekuli yiigwanga yoliina naatungi yoliina otaa ka kanitha omukumo.
Aayogohi yoongodhi noonakwiilongela oondjambi otaa ka sithwa uunye.
Aakuluntu yoshilando Zoan omagoya gowala! Aanandungelela yaEgipiti otaa ka gandja omayele guugoyalela. Otaa vulu ngiini okulombwela omukwaniilwa gwawo kutya yo aayilongi yuunongo naakwaniilwa?
Ngoye nduno omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti, aagandjindunge yoye aanamayele oye li peni? Pamwe otaa vulu oku ku lombwela kutya oshike shoka Omuwa Omunankondoawike a dhiladhilila Egipiti.
Aawiliki yaZoan oya ningi omagoya, nomalenga gaMemfis oga lyalyakana. Oya li ndishi ye na okuwilika oshigwana? Ihe oye shi pukitha owala.
Omuwa okwe ya pilaaleke, ya gandje omayele ga goyoka. Pahedhi ndjika Egipiti otali puka miinima ayihe notali tantala lya fa onkolwe tayi gwile monkungo yayo.
MuEgipiti kamu na nando ogumwe, omuyamba nenge ohepele, omunenentu nenge omumbala, ngoka ta vulu okugandja ekwatho.
Esiku otali ya uuna Aayegipiti taa ka tila ya fa omukulukadhi. Otaa ka kakama meshololo, shampa ya mono kutya Omuwa Omunankondoawike a tagananeka okwooko kwe e ya geele.
Aayegipiti otaa ka tila Juda. Shaa tuu taa uvu edhina Juda tali tumbulwa, otaa ka haluka molwaashoka Omuwa Omunankondoawike e shi ya dhiladhilile.
Mesiku ndyoka otaku ka kala iilando itano muEgipiti moka aantu taa popi elaka lyOshihebeli notaa gana kOmuwa Omunankondoawike. Oshilando shimwe shomuyo otashi ka lukwa Ir Heres.
Esiku ndyoka muEgipiti otamu ka kala oshiyambelo shOmuwa nongudhimanya ye mu yapulilwa kongamba yaEgipiti.
Otayi ka kala omandhindhiliko gOmuwa Omunankondoawike kutya oku li mokati kawo muEgipiti. Uuna oshigwana tashi hepekwa e tashi kugile Omuwa ekwatho, nena ota ka tuma ngoka te ya hupitha.

Omuwa oti ihololele ye mwene Aayegipiti, oyo notaye ke mu tseya noku mu longela. Otaye mu etele oontselelandjambo noondjambo dhiikulya. Otaye ke mu uvanekela omauvaneko nokugana notaye ke ga gwanitha.
Omuwa ota ka geela Aayegipiti, ihe ote ke ya aludha. Otaa ka galukila kuye, oye notu uvu omagalikano gawo noku ya aludha.
Esiku otali ya, uuna taku ka kala onenendjila pokati kaEgipiti naAssur. Aantu yomiilongo mbyoka iyali otaa ka enda mo mokweendathana kwawo, niigwana mbyoka iyali ayihe otayi ka longela Omuwa.
Esiku ndyoka Israel ota ka kala e thike pamwe naEgipiti naAssur, niigwana mbika itatu otayi ka ninga eyambeko lyuuyuni auhe.
Omuwa Omunankondoawike ote ke ya yambeka e ta ti: “Otandi mu yambeke, ne Aayegipiti aantu yandje, ne Aayassur oshilonga shiikaha yandje nane Aaisraeli oshigwana shandje sha hogololwa.”
20: Momumvo ngwiyaka ondjayi onene ya tumwa kuSargon, omupangeli gwaAssur, oye ya kuAshdod e tayi shi matukile noku shi kwata po.
Methimbo ndyoka Omuwa okwa popitha Jesaja yaAmos a ti kuye: “Ihula ehahi ndyoka we li zala noongaku dhoye.” Oye nokwe shi ningi e te ende olutu lwowala noompadhi dhowala.
Omuwa okwa ti: “Omuntu gwandje Jesaja okwe ende olutu lwowala noompadhi dhowala omimvo ndatu. Shika ehunganeko kuEgipiti naEtiopia

kutya osho omupangeli gwaAssur te ke enditha oonkwatwa ndhoka e dhi kwata miilongo mbyoka iyali. Aagundjuka naakuluntu otaa ke enda oompadhi dhowala nomalutu gowala, ye li omudhuu — osho ohoni kuEgipiti.
Oomboka yi inekela Etiopia nohaa tanga Egipiti, otaa ke shi yematela, etegameno lyawo otali ka kana po.
Esiku ndyoka aantu mboka ya kala komunkulo gwaFilistia, otaa ka tya: ‘Taleni shoka sha ningilwa aantu mboka twa li twe yi inekela taye tu gamene komupangeli gwaAssur! Otatu ka hunukeni ngiini?’ ”
21:
Ndika ehunganeko tali hunganeke Babilon.
Ngashika iikungulumbepo tayi zi kombuga kuumbugantu, osho omuponokeli ta ziilile kombuga, koshilongo oshitilithi.

Ondu ulukilwa emoniko lyiiningwanima iitilithi, emoniko lyomahanagulo.
Matukila, Elam! Media, ninga ekondeka! Kalunga ota ka hulitha po omahepeko ngoka ge etwa kuBabilon.
Shoka nda mono nondu uvu memoniko, osha halutha ndje noonkondo, nuuwehame owa kwata ndje wa fa uudhigu womukulukadhi ta thetwa.
Omwenyo gwandje otagu nuka mo. Otandi kakama kuumbanda. Onda hala ku toke, ihe ewiwilo otali gelelitha ndje.
Memoniko iitaafula tayi yalwa, aayenda ya kuutumbe. Otaa li yo taa nu. Ohaluka taku igidhwa: “Oondjayi, yambukeni! Longekidheni omahuuyanza!”
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Inda u ka langeke omupekapeki; na hokolole shoka ta mono.
Ngele ta mono aantu taa ya momusholondondo gwooyaali nooyaali ya kayila uukambe, uusino noongamelo, oku na oku ya ndhindhilika nawa.”
Omupekapeki okwi igidha: “Tatekulu, onda thikama pomalangelo uusiku nomutenya.”
Ohaluka, oyo mbeya taa ya! Aalumentu ya kayila uukambe ooyaali nooyaali. Omupekapeki okwa popi onkundana ta ti: “Babilon osha teka po! Iimenka ayihe mbyoka ya li haa simaneke, oya tatulilwa pevi.”
Aantu yandje Aaisraeli, ne omwa yungulwa mwa fa iilya, ihe ngashingeyi onde mu tomonene onkundana ombwanawa ndjoka ndu uvu kOmuwa Omunankondoawike, Kalunga kaIsrael.

Ndika ehunganeko tali popi Edom
Omuntu gumwe okwi ithana ndje e li muSeir a ti: “Mulangeli, uusiku otau hulu po uunake? Mulangeli, uusiku otau hulu po uunake?”
Omulangeli okwa yamukula: “Ongula otayi shi, nonando inaku yela natango. Ngele omwa hala okupula ishewe, galukeni.”

Ndika ehunganeko tali popi Arabia.
Aantu ne yomuDedan, mboka mu na ontanda yiiyendo mombuga yaArabia,
gandjeni omeya kaasinota mboka taa ya kune. Aantu ne yomoshilongo Tema, peni oontauki iikulya.
Aantu otaa kukuma taa fadhuka po omagongamwele ngoka tage ya dhipaga nokuli, otaa yi ontuku omatati ngoka tage ya yaha nokuli, otaa yi ontuku yiita.
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Omumvo gumwe nge gwa piti po — ngashika omumvo gwondhalate yomuunguli — esimano alihe lyaKedar otali hulu po.
Aashona ayeke yomoondjumbeta oofule dhaKedar taa ka hupa ko. Ongame, Omuwa Kalunga kaIsrael, nde dhi popi.”
22:
Ndika ehunganeko tali hunganeke Esilu lyemoniko.
Oshike sha ningwa po? Omolwashike aantu ayehe moshilando ya londa kombanda yoongulu?

Oshilando ashihe osha piyagana, shu udha onkugo nelondoko.
Aalumentu yoye oya dhipagwa inaaya kondja ya sile molugodhi andola.
Aakuluntu yoye ayehe oya fadhuka po noya kwatwa, manga inaaya umba nando oshikuti shimweshimwe.
Ngashingeyi ethii ndje, ndi lile nokulililila oosa dhaantu mboka ya si. Inamu kambadhala mu hekeleke ndje nando.

Ndika ethimbo lyeshololo, lyesindiko nolyepiyagano mEsilu lyemoniko, Omupangeliawike Omuwa Omunankondoawike okwe shi tu tumine. Omakuma goshilando shetu oga kumunwa po, noonkugo odha mbolongondja mokati koondundu.
Aakwiita ya zi koshilongo Elam, oye ya ya kayila uukambe, ya homata omatati niikuti. Aakwiita ya zi koshilongo Kir, oya longekidha omahuuyanza gawo.
Omatathapya gomuJuda ogu udha omatembakwiita; aakwiita ya kayila uukambe oya li momusholondondo ya thikama komeho gomiyelo dhaJerusalem.

Omagameneno agehe gaJuda oga teka po.
Uuna shika sha ningwa, omwa ka kutha omatati moshinyanga shomiti.
Omwa mono omahala ogendji moka omakuma gaJerusalem taga pumbwa okuthitikwa. Omwa konakona omagumbo agehe muJerusalem e tamu kumuna po gamwe gomugo, opo mu mone oondhopi mu thitike omakuma goshilando.
Omwa tungu ondama meni lyoshilando okupungula omeya taga tondoka taga zi kedhiya ekulu. Ihe ne inamu pulakena Kalunga, ngoka a dhiladhila ayihe mbika nale naangoka e yi eta po yi ningwe.
Omupangeliawike Omuwa Omunankondoawike okwa li te mu ithana, mu ye mu lile ne mu takume; mu kulule omitse dheni ne mu zale omahahi.
Ihe omwa ningi shike? Omwa yolo owala nokudhana iituthi. Omwa tsele iimuna, omwa dhipaga oonzi mu lye, nomwa nu omaviinu. Omwa ti: “Tu lyeni tse tu nweni, oshoka ngula otatu si.”

Omupangeliawike Omuwa Omunankondoawike oye mwenemwene a lombwele ndje a ti: “Oshili ondjo ndjika itayi ka dhimwa po sigo esiku lyokusa kweni. Ongame, Omupangeliawike Omuwa Omunankondoawike, nde dhi popi.”
Omupangeliawike Omuwa Omunankondoawike okwa lombwele ndje, ndi ye kuShebna, omusilishimpwiyu guuwa, ndi mu lombwele ndi tye:
“Oto dhiladhila ongoye olye? Epitikilo u li na olyashike, sho to ihokithile ombila memanya lyomondundu?
Kotoka, Omuwa ote ke ku kutha po e te ku ekelehi.
Ote ke ku toola po wa fa okatanga e te ke ku umbila moshilongo oshinene. Omo to ka sila ontega nomatembakwiita wa li we ga inomene. Oto ka sitha egumbo lyamwene gwoye ohoni.
Omuwa ote ku kutha uulenga e te ku shundula.
“Uuna shika tashi ka ningwa, otandi ka ithana omuntu gwandje Eliakim lyaHilkia.
Otandi ke mu zaleka ondjatha yoye yoshilonga nepaya e tandi mu pe oonkondo adhihe wa li u dhi na. Ota ka ninga he yAajerusalem nAajuda.
Otandi ke mu pa oshipatululo shegumbo lyaDavid. Ngele te egulula, kape na ngoka te edhile po; nongele te edhile po, kape na ngoka te egulula.
Otandi ke mu dhengela pokuma pwa kola ngomboha, noye ta ka ninga ekota lyesimano lyezimo lyahe.
“Ihe oluvalo olwindji lwahe, aatekulu naatekulululwa otaa ka kala kombunda ye. Ote ke ya leka ya fa iiyuma, uuyo nomatenga ge li kontsiliko.
Uuna shika tashi ningwa, omboha ndjoka ya li ya dhengelwa pokuma pwa kola, otayi ka nengena e tayi gu po. Shika otashi ka ninga ehulilo lyaayihe mbyoka ya li ye endjelela ko.” Omuwa oye e dhi popya.
23:
Ndika ehunganeko tali popi Tiro.
Takumeni nokulila ne aanasikepa yokuSpania! Oshilandotulilo sheni Tiro osha hanagulwa po; omagumbo nomatulilo gasho kage po we. Onkundana ndjika oye ya zile kuKipro, sho ya li taa galukile kegumbo.
Lilaganeni, ne aahalithi yokuSidoni! Omwa tumine aantu,
ya tokole efuta ya ka shingithe nokulanda iilya kuEgipiti nokupindika niigwana ayihe.
Shilando Sidon, sa ohoni! Efuta, omeya ganandjandja muule wago, otage ku idhimbike e taga ti: “Kandi na nando aanona. Moshitheta shandje ine pulumutha omumati nenge omukadhona.”
Nokuli Aayegipiti otaa ka kakama e taa haluka, uuna taa kundana kutya Tiro osha hanagulwa po.
Takumeni nokulila, ne Aafoinikia! Indeni ontuku kuSpania!
Otashi vulika ngiini kutya shika osho oshilando Tiro shomashambudho, shoka sha dhikilwe nalenale? Oshilando shika osho tuu shoka sha tumine aatembukili komavi gokokule kombanda yefuta?
Olye ngoka a dhiladhila a etele Tiro omupya gwa tya ngawo, oshilando oshiyamba shoka aahalithi yasho ya li aawagona, aanenentu kombanda yevi?
Omuwa Omunankondoawike okwe shi dhiladhila, opo a hulithe po einomo lyawo mushoka ya ningi nokufupipika aanenentu yamo.
Ne aantu yomiitembukilwa muSpania, tamekeni okulonga omapya. Kaku na we ngoka te mu gamene.
Omuwa okwa taganekele efuta okwooko kwe e ta teya po iilongo. Okwa tokola okuhanagulitha po omapopilongulu gaFoinikia.
Shilando ngoye Sidon, elago lyoye olya hula, naantu yoye taa hepekwa. Nando ya ye ontuku kuKipro, itaa ka hupa.

(Oya li Aababilonia, kaye shi Aayassur, mboka ya longekidhile iithitukuti ompito yokuya kuTiro. Aababilonia oyo ya tungu ooshungo dhekondekela, ya kumuna po omapopilongulu gaTiro nokuhanagula po oshilando.)
Lileni nokutakuma, ne aanasikepa yokuSpania! Oshilando mwi inekela osha hanagulwa po.
Ethimbo otali ya, uuna Tiro tashi ka dhimbiwa omimvo omilongo heyali, dhi thike pomasiku gomukwaniilwa gumwe. Omimvo ndhoka nge dha piti, Tiro otashi ka ninga, ngaashi oshiimbo shopauhonda tashi ti:

“Kutha okaharpa koye, endagula nomukunda,
ngoye ohonda ya dhimbiwa!
Hika nawa, imba natango,
opo aalumentu ye ku dhimbulukwe!”
Omimvo omilongo heyali nge dha piti po, Omuwa ota ka galulila Tiro omapindiko gasho omakulu, nosho tashi ki ishingitha kiilongo ayihe yomuuyuni.

Iimaliwa mbyoka tashi ke yi likola mehalitho, otayi ka yoololelwa Omuwa. Itashi ki ingungunina nando osha, ihe mboka haa longele Omuwa, oyo taa ku utha iimaliwa yasho yokulanda iikulya nomizalo taye dhi pumbwa.
24: Omuwa ota ka hanagula po evi e tali ningi eputu lyowala. Ota ka gonyagula evi e ta halakanitha aantu yalyo.
Ayehe otaa ningilwa sha faathana: shomuyambi osho shomukwanegongalo, shomuhona osho shomupiya, shomulandithi osho shomulandi, shomulilwangunga osho shomulingunga, shomuyamba osho shohepele.
Evi otali ka kombwa po e tali ka yugwa po. Omuwa okwa popya notashi ka tsakanithwa.
Evi otali ka kaha notali ka kukuta; uuyuni auhe otau nongwa noonkondo; evi neyalelo otaga thithonoka po.
Aantu oya nyateke evi mokuyona iipango yaKalunga nokutaaguluka ehangano lyaaluhe ndyoka a hangana nayo.
Omolwashoka Omuwa okwa uthile evi etulomutima. Aantu yalyo otaa futilwa shoka ya longele. Aantu aashonashona mboka taa ka kala ye na omwenyo.
Omiviinu otadhi ganya nomaviinu taga kala ga pumba. Shaa ngoka a li nale nawa, ngashingeyi okwa nika uupongo.
Ehiko lyenyanyu lyuuharpa nolyoontunda dhawo olya mwena.
Aantu itaa nu we omaviinu nokwiimba; omalovu oga lulila aanwi.
Moshilando omu na evundakano, naantu momagumbo gawo otaa iyedhilile mo ya holame.
Aantu otaa lilagana momapandaanda, oshoka kape na we omaviinu. Enyanyu olya kana po; olya tidhwa mo mevi.
Oshilando osha kumunwa po nomiyelo dhasho odha teywa po.
Shika otashi ningilwa iigwana ayihe ya kala kombanda yevi. Otashi ka kala sha fa ehulilo pethimbo lyeshopolo lyooholivi komiolivi nongetoonono lyomandjembele komiviinu.
Mboka taa ka hupa ko, otaa ki imba kenyanyu. Mboka yokuuninginino otaa ka hempulula Omuwa omunene,
naamboka yokuuzilo otaa ke mu tanga. Aantu mboka ya kunkula nefuta, otaa ka hambelela Omuwa Kalunga kaIsrael.

Okuza kooha dhuuyuni otaku ka uvika omaimbilo taga tanga Israel, oshigwana oshiyuuki.
Ihe ngame onda ti: “Otandi thithonoka po, otandi thipuka po! Yaye ngame! Aagwaaleki taa tsikile okugwaaleka notaa vuka moku shi ninga.”
Omahalutho, omakelo noomwigo otadhi mu tegelele, ne aakali kombanda yevi.
Shaa ngoka ta kambadhala okufadhuka po ehalutho, ota gwile mekelo, naangoka ta zi mekelo, ota ka yulwa komwigo. Iikungulu yomvula otayi puuka kegulu, nomakankameno gevi otaga kakama.
Evi otali ka pambuka e tali nyanyulwa po nokumwahuka.
Evi lyo lyene otali ka tantala lya fa onkolwe notali pepwa po lya fa otenda yothayila moshikungulu. Uuyuni owa thindilwa pevi kuulunde wawo; otau ka gwila po, ihe itau ka yambuka po we.
Ethimbo otali ya, uuna Omuwa ta pangula aanankondo yomewangandjo naakwaniilwa yevi pohi.
Omuwa ota ka mbwinda mumwe aakwaniilwa ya fa oonkwatwa noku ya umbila melambo. Ote ya tula mondholongo, ya kale mo sigo ethimbo lyegeelo lyawo lya adha.

Omwedhi otagu ka luudha, netango itali ka minikila we, oshoka Omuwa Omunankondoawike oye ta ka kala omukwaniilwa. Ota ka pangela muJerusalem kondundu Sion, naawiliki yoshigwana otaa ka tala eadhimo lye.
25:
Iilando we yi ningi omakulukuma,
nowa kumuna po oongulushigo dhayo.
Oongulumbala ndhoka dha tungwa kaatondi yetu,
odha kana po sigo aluhe.

Aantu yiigwana iinankondo otaa ke ku hambelela;
oto ka tilika miilando yiigwana iidhudhu.

Owa palutha oohepele naasindjala,
nowe ya hupitha methimbo lyuuyina.
Owe ya gamene kiikungulu nowe ya shigi kepupyu lyomutenya.
Aadhudhu oya ponoka ko ya fa oshikungulu

noya fa oluteni mevi lyomutenya.
Ihe ngoye, Omuwa, owa mweneke aatondi yetu;
oto mweneke omauyagano gaalumentu aadhudhu,
ngaashi omutenya momunzile gwoshikogo.
Kondundu Sion Omuwa Omunankondoawike ota hangele iigwana ayihe oshituthi shoontumba dhomagadhi noshomaviinu ga dhindolekeka.
Kondundu ndjika ota ka kayununa po esiikilo ndyoka tali kwidhidhike iigwana ayihe.
Omuwa Omupangeliawike ota ka hanagula po eso sigo aluhe. Ota ka theta po omahodhi momeho gaayehe e ta kutha po okudhinwa kwaantu ye muuyuni auhe. Omuwa mwenemwene a popi ngeyi.
Esiku ndyoka otaku tiwa: “Kalunga ketu oye nguka! Otwe mu inekela, noye e tu hupitha. Oye Omuwa! Otwe mu inekela notu li nawa ngashingeyi notu na enyanyu, oshoka okwe tu hupitha.”
Omuwa ota ka gamena ondundu Sion, ihe Aamoabi otaa ka lyatagulwa ya fa iiyagaya tayi lyatelwa muuhoho.
Otaa ka lapa nomaako gawo ya fa taa yogo ontente, ihe Omuwa ote ke ya fupipika, niikaha yawo otayi ka nemanana.
Ota ka kumuna po omapopilongulu gaMoab pamwe nomakuma gago omaleeleka e te ga undulile pevi montsi.
26:
Esiku onali ya, uuna aantu taa ki imba ekandanga mevi lyaJuda taa ti:
“Oshilongo shetu osha kola!
Kalunga mwene ota gamene omakuma gasho!

Egululeni iiyelo yoshilando,
opo oshigwana oshiyuuki shi ye mo,
oshigwana hashi dhiginine eitaalo.

Omuwa, oho gandja ombililela
kumboka ihaa tenguka noye ku inekela.

Inekeleni Omuwa sigo aluhe;
ote ke tu gamena aluhe.

Otashi tampagulwa kaathiminikwa,
noompadhi dhaakweyi otadhi shi lyatagula.”

Omuwa, ongoye to yelekanithile aayuuki ondjila;
ondjila ndjoka taa ende oya yelekana.

Otatu landula ehalo lyoye notwe ku inekela;
etegameno lyomitima dhetu oli li medhina lyoye.

Omwenyo gwandje ogwe ku yuulukwa uusiku,
moontundumene ombepo yandje tayi ku kongo.
Uuna to pangula evi naantu yalyo,
ayehe otaa ka koneka uuyuuki.

Nando to sile aakolokoshi ohenda,
itaa koneke nando uuyuuki.
Moshilongo nando mu kale aayuuki,
aalunde otaa kolokosha owala;
otaa tindi okudhimbulula uunene woye.

Aatondi yoye itaa tseya kutya oto ke ya geela.
Omuwa, ya sitha ohoni nou ya dhenge;
naa adhike kegeelo we li ya longekidhile.
Ya ulukila, nkene u hole aantu yoye.

Omuwa Kalunga ketu,
otwa pangelwa kaapangeli yalwe peha lyoye,
nando ongoye awike Omuwa gwetu.

Ngashingeyi oya si noitaa ka kala we ye na omwenyo.
Oomwenyo dhawo oya topoka nadho,
itadhi ka yumuka we,
oshoka owe ya geele e to ya hanagula po.
Kape na we ngoka te ya dhimbulukwa.

Omuwa, ongoye wi indjipalitha oshigwana shetu,
owa taandelitha oshilongo shasho koombinga adhihe,
naashika oshe ku etele esimano.

Omuwa, ongoye wa geele aantu yoye,
nomuuwehame oye ku galikana.

Omuwa, otwa keme kuudhigu
twa fa omukulukadhi e na oshitheta.

Otwa li muuwehame woshitheta,
ihe mokuvala otwa fa twa vala ombepo.
Inatu mona esindano lyoshilongo shetu,
inatu tompola sha.

Oonakusa yoye otaa ka ninga omwenyo ishewe!
Omidhimba dhawo otadhi ka yumuka.
Ayehe mboka ya kotha moombila,
otaa ka penduka nokwiimba ekandanga.
Ngashika omume tayi tutike evi,
osho Omuwa ta ka mwenyeka mboka ya sa nale.
Ne aantu yandje, indeni momagumbo geni, mu iyedhilile mo. Holameni okathimbo, manga ondjahi yaKalunga tayi pitilile po.
Omuwa ote ya ta zi monkalelo ye, a geelele oonakukala kombanda yevi oondjo dhawo. Aadhipagi mboka ya dhipaga aantu meholamo kombanda yevi, otaa ka hololwa, nevi itali ka holeka we mboka ya dhipagwa.
27: Esiku ndyoka Omuwa ota ka leka egongamwele lya tsa nekukutu, a tse nalyo Leviatan, eyoka ndyoka li na ontuku, Leviatan, eyoka ndyoka hali nifauka nokungolyauka, evovo lyomefuta, note li dhipaga po.
Esiku ndyoka Omuwa ota popi oshitsambe she e shi hokwa a ti:
“Otandi shi langele e tandi shi tekele omeya ethimbo alihe. Uusiku tandi shi tonatele nomutenya tandi shi keelele, pwaa kale ngoka te shi yono po.
Oshitsambe itandi shi geele we. Ngele osha mena owala omano noondjoho, otandi dhi vudha mo noku dhi fika po.
Ihe aatondi yaantu yandje ngele oya hala egameno lyandje, naa hangane nangame. Eeno, naa hangane nangame.”
Momasiku tage ya oluvalo lwaJakob otalu ka tsama ngaashi omuti, Israel ota ka temuna oongala nokututuma. Evi otali ka udha iiyimati mbyoka taa imitha.
Israel ina geelwa kOmuwa noonkondo noina kanitha aantu oyendji ngashika aatondi ye.
Omuwa okwa geele aantu ye, sho e ya tumu muupongekwa. Okwe ya kuthitha mo ombepo ondhigu yokuuzilo.

Uulunde waIsrael otau ka dhimwa po ashike, ngele omamanya giiyambelo yoshipagani taga ka tatulwa ga ninge ga fa omamanya gokaalaka ga nyanyulwa, noitapa thigala nando oshiyambelo shiitsinino nenge iiyelekela yoshikalungakiintu Asheera.
Oshilandohote osha ningi omakulukuma gowala. Osha mbugalekwa sha fa eputu lyowala. Osha ningi uunapelo wiimuna, moka tayi gondjo e tayi gugula mo.
Iitayi yomiti nge ya kukuta, otayi teka ko, naakiintu otaye yi tyaya po, yi ninge iikuni. Molwaashoka aantu kaa uvite ko, Kalunga Omushiti gwawo ite ya sile ohenda nenge e ya uvitile ando olukeno.
Mesiku ndyoka, okuza kuEufrat sigo okongamba yaEgipiti, Omuwa ota ka gongela aantu ye oogumwe noogumwe a fa omuntu ta yele iilya te yi yoolola metutu.
Uuna esiku ndyoka nali ya, enkuma otali ka hikwa, li ithane Aaisraeli ayehe aapongekwa kuAssur nokuEgipiti. Otaa ke ya notaa ka longela Omuwa muJerusalem kondundu ye ondjapuki.
28: Yaye ngoye, shilongo Israel! Esimano lyoye otali ka ganya lya fa iishani yoongala komitse dhaawiliki yoye oonkolwi. Omitse dhawo odha gwayekwa tadhi nika nawa, ihe oya gwila po ya kolwa.

Omuwa okwa longekidha omuntu gwontumba ngoka e na oonkondo e ya ponokele, ngoka te ya kolokele a fa oshikungulu shoompawe, a fa epoola lyomvula. Ongaashi omvula kataula nefundja ota ka mbolokotela oshilongo.
Eitango lyaakuluntu oonkolwi otali ka lyatelwa kohi yoompadhi.
Esimano lyaawiliki oonkolwi otali ka kana po lya fa ekuko lyoondhiye pethimbo lyadho, dha toononwa nodha liwa ko pethimbo lyetiligano lyadho.
Esiku otali ya, uuna Omuwa Omunankondoawike ta ka kala a fa oshishani shoongala kaantu ye oonakuhupako.
Ota ka gandja euvoko lyuuyuuki kaatokolihapu e ta koleke aakeeleli yomiyelo dhoshilando dhaa matukilwe.

Eeno, naahunganeki pamwe naayambi ohaa kolwa taa tengenya. Oyi idhenga mo momaviinu notaa kolwa taa tantala uutse wa pwa ko. Omoluunkolwe aahunganeki otaa puka momamoniko, naayambi otaa nyengwa okutokola iiyetwapo mbyoka taa etelwa.
Miililo yawo omu udha oonkungo noonyata, nokamu na sha inaashi nyatekwa.
Otaa nyenyetele ndje taa ti: “Olye ta ka pewa omayele komulumentu nguka? Olye ta pumbwa elaka lye? Otali opalele owala uuhanona mboka hau yamu!
Ota kambadhala e tu longe ondanda nondanda, omukweyo nomukweyo, oshilongwa noshilongwa.”
Ngele itamu pulakene ndje, nena Kalunga ote ke mu nongekitha kaantu taa dhuma elaka ekwiilongo, ye mu longe oshilongwa nelaka tali kokoma.
Amuhe okwe mu pe evululuko nombili, ihe ne omwa tindi oku mu pulakena.

Omolwaashoka Omuwa te ke mu longa ondanda nondanda, omukweyo nomukweyo, oshilongwa noshilongwa. Nena otamu ka tantala monkatu kehe tamu katuka. Otamu ka tosholwa iilalo, tamu gwile mekelo notamu ka kwatwa po oonkwatwa.
Ngashingeyi ne aahuni, one tuu mboka tamu pangele Jerusalem notamu lele aantu yasho, pulakeneni shoka Omuwa ta ti.

Otamu itanga tamu ti tse neso otu uvathana, otwa adha eziminathano nuuyuni wokuusi. Otamu inekele oshiponga tashi mu hunutha, uuna nashi ke ya, oshoka ne omwi itula iifundja notamu ikotokele mu hupe aniwa.
Omuwa Omupangeliawike ota ti: “Pulakena, otandi tula muSion emanya lya simana, emanya lya hogololwa, emanya lyokolonela okuninga ekankameno lya kola nolya pama; ngoka i itaala, iha tenguka.

Uuyuuki otau ka ninga oshiyelekithongodhi, noshili otayi ningi ongodhi yoshumbu.”
Iikungulu yoompawe otayi ka komba po iifundja ayihe mbyoka mwi inekela, nefundja tali ka kungulula po egameno lyeni.
Euvaneno ndyoka mwa uvanena neso, otali ka kuthwa po neziminathano lyeni noshaasi otali dhimwa po. Uuna oshiponga tashi ka tukuka, otamu ka gwilililwa po.
Otashi ke mu kwata, tashi ya nofu nanofu, ongula nongula. Otamu ke shi humbata omutenya nuusiku. Onkundana ompe kehe ya zi kuKalunga, otayi ka eta eshololo.
Otamu ka fa omulumentu ngoka ta kambadhala okulala mombete yoshingumbulila; ita vulu okutaandela, nekumbyatha efupi itali gwana.
Omuwa ota ka kondja, ngaashi a ningile kondundu Perazim nomesilu lyaGibeon, opo a gwanithe shoka a dhiladhila a longe. Ota ka gwanitha iilonga ye tayi halutha, iilonga ye yomeholeko.
Inamu dhina elondodho tandi li mu pe! Ngele tamu shi ningi, otashi ke mu dhigupalela okuya ontuku. Ondu uvu eutho lyOmuwa Omunankondoawike lyokuhanagula po oshilongo ashihe.
Pulakeneni kushoka tandi popi; pakalekeleni omakutsi kushoka tandi mu lombwele.
Kaku na omunepya ha kala ta pulula epya lye ethimbo alihe, e li longekidhile ekuno.
Ngele a mana okupulula, ota kunu mo ombuto yiimeno ngaashi yodiili noyookumina, ta kunu oompa dhosiima nodhiishokelya nokomunkulo gwepya ota kunu ko osiima yoombo ndatu.
Ota tseya, nkene e na okulonga, oshoka Kalunga okwe mu longa.
Ita longitha omuhi omunene a yungule oodiili nenge ookumina, aawe, ota longitha oshiti oshipu sho opalela iimeno mbika.
Ita likitha po iilya ye kuuhwa, ota tseya okuyungula nawa iilya, yi ze molungu inaayi tanduka.
Uunongo mbuka auhe owa zi kOmuwa Omunankondoawike. Oye omunandunge ta nongeke uunongo, notau tompola ayihe.
29: Yaye Ariel, Ariel, oshilando shokukala David! Gwedheni omumvo komumvo omukwawo, niituthi nayi dhanwe pethimbo lyayo.
Kalunga ota ka undulila Ariel oshiponga. Oshilando otashi ka kala shu udha elilagano netakumo, otashi ka kala sha fa oshiyambelo shi li metente lyombinzi.
Kalunga ota ka ponokela oshilando, te shi kunduka note shi kondeke.
Jerusalem otashi ka fa oshiluli tashi kambadhala okupopya shi li mevi, ewi otali uma tali zi montsi yevi.
Jerusalem, aakwiilongo ayehe mboka taye ku matukile, otaa ka pepwa po ya fa ontsi yevi, nomatangakwiita gawo omatilithi otaga pepwa po ga fa etutu. Ohaluka manga inaashi tegelelwa,
Omuwa Omunankondoawike ote mu mangulula nomipwalakato, omakakamo gevi noshihomo oshinene. Ota tumu ombepo yepukutula, oshikungulu nomulilo hagu lyana.
Nena omatangakwiita agehe giigwana tayi kondjitha oshilando shoshiyambelo shaKalunga ye shi kondeka noku shi ponokela, otaga ka kana ga fa ondjodhi, ongaashi oshinima tashi hehelele uusiku.

Iigwana ayihe mbyoka tayi gongala yi ponokele Jerusalem, otayi ka kala ya fa omulumentu a sa ondjala, ta yaguma ta li e ta penduka kondjala, nenge ya fa omuntu a sa enota ta yaguma ta nu, nomokupenduka kwe okwa kangwa kenota.
Ifalii ko utale mu ninge aagoya! Hedhii ko utale mu ninge aaposi! Kolweni, nando inamu nwa omaviinu! Tantaleni, nando inamu nwa omagongo!
Omuwa okwe mu kumukitha nokwe mu kothitha oomposi oondhigu. Aahunganeki oyo ya li ye na okukala omeho goshigwana, ihe Kalunga okwe ya posipaleke.

Efatululo lyemoniko lyehunganeko kehe otali mu holekwa; otali ka fa embo lya hotekwa oshihotekitho. Ngele to li pe omuntu e shi kulesha e to mu pula, e li ku leshele, ota ka tya, ita vulu, oshoka olya hotwa.
Ngele to li pe omuntu ngoka kee shi kulesha e to mu pula, e li ku leshele, ota ka yamukula kutya ita tseya sha.

Omuwa okwa ti: “Aantu mbaka ohaa ya kungame nomilungu dhawo notaa simaneke ndje nomakana gawo, ihe oomwenyo dhawo odhi li kokule nangame. Elongelokalunga lyawo lyokulongela ndje olya tungwa owala komautho gaantu.
Omolwashoka tandi ya halutha niikumitha tayi hukakana yo inaayi tegelelwa. Uunongo waanongo otau ka kana, noondunge dhaanandunge otadhi ka shunduka.”
Yaye mboka taa kambadhala okuholeka Omuwa omadhiladhilo gawo. Otaa tsakanitha oompangela dhawo meholamo notaa dhiladhila kutya kape na ngoka te ya mono nenge ta tseya shoka taa ningi.

Yaye uulayi wawo! Oshike shi vule oshikwawo, omuhongi gwiiyuma nenge eloya? Ope na tuu oshiyuma tashi lombwele omuhongi gwasho tashi ti: “Hangoye wa honga ndje.” Nenge shi mu lombwele shi tye: “Ku shi shoka to ningi.”
Okathimbo kowala, Libanon sho tayi shituka yi ninge etathapya, netathapya otali ka fa okuti.
Uuna esiku ndyoka tali ya, ombolo otayi ka uva embo tali leshwa mokule, nomuposi, ngoka a kala momilema, omeho ge otaga tonata nota mono ko.
Oohepele naafupi otaa ka mona elago ndyoka Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki, te li gandja.
Ndika otali ka ninga ehulilo lyaamboka haa hepeke yakwawo nohaa dhini Kalunga. Omulunde kehe ota ka hanagulwa po.
Kalunga ota ka yonagula po ayehe mboka haa hokola yakwawo, mboka haa keelele okugeelwa kwaakolokoshi naamboka haa popi iifundja ya goyokithe uuyuuki.
Omolwashoka Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, ngoka a hupitha Abraham muudhigu, ta ti ngeyi: “Aantu yandje, itamu ka sithwa we ohoni, niipala yeni itayi ka pemba we kohoni.
Sho tamu tala aanona mboka tandi ye mu pe, nena otamu ka tseya kutya ongame Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki. Otamu simaneke ndje notamu kala nokutila ndje.
Aagoya otaa ka nyanyukilwa elongo.”
30: Omuwa okwa popi a ti: “Yaye mboka haa lele Juda, oshoka oya tsile ndje ondumbo. Otaa landula oondunge inaadhi za mungame. Otaa hangana ehangano tali kondjitha ehalo lyandje nokundumbila oondjo mumwe.
Otaa ka konga ekwatho kuEgipiti yo inaa pula ndje. Oya hala Egipiti li ya popile, nomukwaniilwa gwalyo e ya gamene.
Ihe omukwaniilwa ita ka vula oku ya popila, negameno lyokuEgipiti otali ka hulila momupya.
Nando aakalelipo yawo ya thika muEgipiti ya kale miilando Zoan naHanes,
Aajuda otaa ka pongola, sho yi inekela oshigwana shaa shi kwiinekelwa, oshigwana shoka tashi nyengwa oku ya kwatha.”

Ndika elaka lyaKalunga tali popi iithitukuti yomombuga kuumbugantu tali ti: “Aakalelipo otaye ende taa taakana oshilongo shi na iiponga, oonime, omayoka guuzigo niikoko hayi tuka. Otaa kutile omilongelo dhi na ondilo kuusino nokoongamelo dhawo, ye dhi fale koshigwana itaashi vulu oku ya kwatha.
Ekwatho ndyoka Egipiti te li gandja, itali tompola sha. Onkee nda luku Egipiti oshilukadhina ‘Munalwango lwa mwenekwa.’ ”
Kalunga okwa lombwele ndje, ndi nyolele membo onkalo yaantu, sho shi kale ehokololo tali holola kutya yo aawinayi.
Aluhe oya tsile Kalunga ondumbo, aluhe otaa fundju, aluhe otaa tindi okupulakena omalongo gOmuwa.
Otaa ganda aahunganeki ya mwene. Otaa ti: “Inamu tu lombwela uuyuuki mboka. Tu lombweleni shoka twa hala tu uve. Etheni tu kale nomafafaeko getu.
Zii po putse, inamu tula omandangalati mondjila yetu. Tse inatu hala okuuva, sho tamu popi Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki.”
Ihe Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki ota popi ta ti: “Ne kamu na ko nasha naashoka tandi mu lombwele nomwi itula ekuni mekoto.
Otamu hunu. Omwa fa ekuma eleeleka lya tenda omusa li gwe po; ohaluka tamu ka ongotela po.
Otamu ka nyanyulwa mwa fa oshuma sheloya sha tatuka nayi, noshikangwakangwa shokuhumbata omulilo nenge shoku ka talitha omeya kiipeleki, osho ngaa inaashi hupa po.”

Omuwa Omupangeliawike, Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki, ota lombwele oshigwana ta ti: “Galukeni, itedhululeni ne mu inekele ndje meimweneneno, notamu kala mu na oonkondo e tamu hupithwa.” Ihe ne omwa tindi oku shi ninga.

Omwa dhiladhila, mu ye ontuku aatondi yeni mwa kayila uukambe u na ondapo. Eeno, omu li mondjila, efadhukopo otamu li vulu! Omwa dhiladhila, uukambe weni ou na ondapo shili, ihe mboka taye mu tidha, oye mu vule!

Eyuvi lyomune otali ka ya ontuku, nge tali mono omukwiita gumwe gwomaatondi naakwiita yatano oya gwana oku mu fadhukitha po amuhe. Kape na nando ogumwe gwomomatanga geni ta thigala po, shila epandela alike tali kala kondungu yondundu.
Natango tuu Omuwa ota tegelele e mu sile ohenda. Okwi ilongekidha e mu sile olukeno, oshoka aluhe oha ningi ashike shoka shu uka. Aanelago oyo mboka ye mu inekela.
Ne aantu mboka mwa kala muJerusalem, itamu ka lila we. Omuwa oye omunamutimahenda; uuna tamu mu kugile onkugo, ote mu kwatha.
Omuwa ote mu pititha momathimbo omadhigu, ihe oye mwene ta ka kala mo oku mu longa noitamu ka kala we noku mu konga.
Nge tamu peguka mo mondjila mu ye kolulyo nenge kolumoho, otamu ka uva ewi konima yeni tali ti: “Ondjila oyo ndjika. Yi landuleni.”
Otamu ka kutha iimenka yeni ya kolongwa noshisiliveli niimenka ya kolongwa noshingoli e tamu yi ekelehi ya fa onyata notamu igidha tamu ti: “Ukeni hwii!”
Nongele mwa kunu oombuto dheni, Omuwa ota ka lokitha omvula e dhi menithe dhi koke, notamu ka mona eloolo lyeteyo, niimuna yeni tayi ka kala nomaunapelo ga andjuka.
Oonani nuusino hau pulula omapya geni, otau ka lya omwiidhi gwehetuhetu.
Esiku ndyoka uuna omapopilongulu gaatondi yoye taga kwatwa po, naantu yawo taa dhipagwa po, omilonga dhomeya otadhi ka tondoka tadhi kunguluka tadhi zi koondundu adhihe nokiikulundundu ayihe.

Omwedhi otagu ka minikila gwa fa etango, netango otali ka yelelela li vule shito luheyali, uuyelele wa fa womasiku gaheyali wa gongelelwa esiku limwe. Mbika ayihe otayi ka ningwa, Omuwa sho ta manga nota aludha iilalo yaantu ye.
Oonkondo dhOmuwa nesimano lye otali imonikila oshinano oshile. Omulilo nolwithi otayi holola ondjahi ye. Ota popi, noohapu dhe odha hwama omulilo.
Omufudho gwe ogwa fa efundja tali kungulula po ayihe. Otagu kombo po iigwana notagu hulitha po omadhiladhilo gayo omawinayi.

Ihe ne, aantu yaKalunga, otamu ka kala mu na elago notamu ki imba, ngaashi hamu ningi moshituthi oshiyapuki uusiku. Otamu ka kala mu na elago mwa fa mboka taa ende nokuhika oohiya yu uka kotempeli yOmuwa, omupopili gwaIsrael.
Omuwa ota ka uvithitha ko omuntu kehe embolongondjo lyewi lye, opo a kale u uvite oonkondo dhondjahi ye. Otaku ka kala omalaka gomulilo, omipwalakato miikogo, omvula yepoola noyoompawe.
Aayassur otaa ka haluthwa, uuna taa uvu ewi lyOmuwa noyu uvite oonkondo dhepangulo lye.
Omuwa nge te ya dhenge ishewe niishewe, nena aantu otaa kala taa hiki oontunda nuuharpa. Kalunga mwene ta ka kondjitha Aayassur.

Onalenale ndjoka eziko enenenene olya longekidhwa li kale li na ehwamo tali fike po omupangeli gwaAssur. Oli li po eleeleka nolya mbwalangandja, lya longelwa iikuni oyindjiyindji. Omuwa ota ka fudha omufudho gwomulilo notagu yakitha ehwamo lyagwo.
31: Yaye mboka taa yi kuEgipiti ya ka konge ekwatho! Oyi inekela omatangakwiita gaEgipiti ga kola — uukambe, omatembakwiita naakwiita. Ihe yo inaa inekela Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki, nenge ye mu galikane, e ya kwathe.
Oku shi shi shoka ta ka longa. Ota ka tuma oshiponga. Ota kondjitha aatondi ye nokugeela mboka haye ya popile.

Aayegipiti kaye shi Kalunga, oyo aantu yowala. Uukambe wawo owo onyama, kau shi ombepo. Omuwa nge ta ningi po sha, oshikwathi otashi ihata po, noshigwana oshikwathwa otashi gwile po. Ayihe iyali otayi yonwa po.

Eeno, shika osho naanaa shoka Omuwa a lombwele ndje a ti: “Ngaashi onime nenge okanimegona taka gonene poshihakanwa shako, nando oku ze ongundu yaasita taye ka kugile onkugo ye ka kondjithe, itaka zi po kekudhilo lyomawi gawo nenge ka keelelwe kokwiigidha kwawo. Osho ngame Omuwa Omunankondoawike tandi ka kulukila pohi, ndi ka kondje olugodhi kondundu Sion nokondungu yayo.
Ngame, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, otandi ka gamena Jerusalem notandi shi popile, naanaa ngaashi ondhila tayi tengelele poshihandhila shayo, yi gamene uudhilona wayo.”
Omuwa okwa ti: “Aaisraeli ne, omwa yona kungame nomwa kondjitha ndje. Ihe ngashingeyi galukileni kungame.
Ethimbo otali ya, uuna ne amuhe tamu ka ekelahi iimenka yeni yuulunde mbyoka mwa hambula moshisiliveli nomoshingoli.
Assur otashi ka hanagulwa po kiita, ihe hakaantu. Aayassur otaa ka ya ondapo yolugodhi, naagundjuka yawo otaa ka ninga aapika.

Omupangeli gwawo ota ka ya ontuku ta kukuma, naambala otaa ka sholola notaa thigi po omapandela gawo golugodhi.” Omuwa oye a popi — Omuwa tuu ngoka ta longelwa muJerusalem, oye ngoka omulilo gwomafikilondjambo gwa tema muSion.
32: Talii ko, omukwaniilwa ota ka lela nuuyuuki, nomalenga otaga ka pangula nawalela.
Omulumentu kehe ota ka kala eshigo lyokushiga ombepo negameno kiikungulu. Otaa ka fa omilonga dhomeya tadhi tondoka mombuga, ya fa omuzile gwetayimanya enenenene mevi lya notelwa.
Omeho gawo otaga ka kala ga tonata, nomakutsi gawo ga shokwa okupulakena.
Omadhiladhilo gombolo otaga ka ilonga okuuva ko, nelaka lyoshikokoma otali ka popya lyu uvitike.
Kape na ngoka ta ka dhiladhila kutya omugoya oye omvalekele nenge a tye ombudhi oya simana.
Omugoya oha popi uugoya, ta dhiladhila okulonga iihuna. Shoka ta ningi naashoka ta popi, otashi sheke Omuwa, noiha palutha aasindjala nenge a pe aanotelwa ya nwe.
Omunamakoto oku na uuwinayi noha longo uukolokoshi; ota gana a yone po oohepele niifundja noku ya imba okukala nuuthemba wawo.
Ihe omunashili ota longo uuyuuki nota kala mushoka shu uka.
Aakiintu ne mwa kala melalangali inaamu piyaganekwa kusha, pulakeneni shoka tandi popi.
Ngashingeyi omu li nawa mu na ombili, ihe omumvo tagu ya pethimbo ngaandika otamu ka kala meihupulo, oshoka itaku ka kala we elikolo lyomandjembele, netoonono lyiiyimati kali ko we.
Ne omwa kala melalangali inaamu piyaganekwa nando okusha, ihe ngashingeyi kaleni mwa kakama kuumbanda! Ihuleni oonguwo dheni ne mu zale omahahi moombunda dheni.
Ikwateni ombandamutse tamu lili, oshoka omatathapya niitsambe yomiviinu oya yonagulwa po.
Omano nokano kaKahandja ka mena mevi lyaantu yandje. Lilileni omagumbo agehe ngoka ga li ge na aantu aanelago noshilando shoka sha li melalangali.

Nuuwa wo wene otau ka thigwa po, noshilandopangelo otashi ka ninga eputu. Omagumbo nomapopilongulu ngoka ge ya gamene, otaga ka ninga omakulukuma sigo aluhe, nkoka uusinokuti tau nuka omalondo, niimuna tayi ka mona omaunapelo.
Omuwa ote ke tu tumina Ombepo ye polumwe. Evi lya shunduka otali ka kala lyo ondoka, nomapya taga ka valeka.
Eutho lyu uka nuuyuuki otau ka kala moshilongo.
Shaa ngoka ota ka longa shoka shu uka, otaku ka kala ombili, evululuko negameno sigo aluhe.
Aantu yaKalunga taa ka kala yaa na nando ombudhi, nomagumbo gawo ge na ombili nevululuko.
Ihe oompawe otadhi ka loka momakuti, noshilando otashi kumuka po.
Aanelago one mboka tamu ka kuna pomatondokelo gomeya kehe, notamu ka kala mu na omaunapelo omawanawa goongombe nuusino.
33: Yaye aatondi yetu! Oya yugu noya kotokele, nando kaku na ngoka e ya yugu nenge e ya kotokele. Ihe ethimbo lyawo lyokuyuga nokukotokela otali hulu po, noyo yene taa ka ninga omulape gwokuyugwa nokukotokelwa.
Omuwa, tu sila ohenda. Otwe ku inekela. Tu gamena esiku nesiku nou tu hupithe methimbo lyuudhigu.
Uuna to tu kondjele, iigwana otayi yi ontuku oshihomo shiita.
Omaliko gawo otaga nyantukwa nago koombahu, otaga yiwa nago koshiluku shomakamuti.
Omuwa omunene ngiini! Oye ha pangele ayihe. Jerusalem ohe shi udhitha uuyuuki nuukwashili. Oha kolekele oshigwana omathimbo gasho.
Aluhe ota popile aantu ye e te ya pe uunongo nomayele. Etilo okutila Omuwa olyo uuyamba waSion.
Aalumentu oofule otaa kugu onkugo. Aakalelipo yoshilongo mboka taa kambadhala ye ete ombili, otaa kugu ya lulilwa.
Oonenendjila odha mbugala, kape na we aayendanandjila. Omauvathano oga tewa, nomaziminathano oga yonagulwa. Kape na omuntu ta simanekwa we.
Oshilongo osha polimana sha mbugala. Omakuti gaLibanon oga ganya po, esilu lyaSharon lyo ondoka olya fa owala ombuga, muBaasha nokuKarmel omafo otaga yagumuka ko komiti.
Omuwa ota lombwele iigwana ta ti: “Ngashingeyi otandi ikwatele ko. Otandi ka holola oonkondo dhandje kutya ongame lye.
Otamu pangele oompangela dhaa na oshilonga naashihe tamu shi ningi, kashi na omwago. Ombepo yandje oya fa omulilo ngoka tagu mu lungunitha po.
Otamu ka nyanyuka mwa fa omamanya gokaalaka taga fikwa, mwa fa omano taga tomekwa ga ninge omutoko.
Ne mboka yokokule, uveni shoka nda longo; nane mboka yopopepi tseyeni oonkondo dhandje.”
Aalunde yomuSion otaa kakama kehaluko. Otaa popi taa ti: “Epangulo lyaKalunga olya fa omulilo gwa tema sigo aluhe. Ope na tuu gumwe gwomutse ta ka hupa ko komulilo hagu lyana?”
Otamu vulu okuhupa ko, ngele otamu popi notamu longo shoka shu uka. Inamu nyokoma oohepele noinamu taamba oombumbo. Inamu gama kumboka taa dhiladhila okudhipaga nenge okulonga uukolokoshi.
Nena otamu ka kala mwaa na ombudhi yasha; otamu ka kala megameno mwa fa mu li mepopilongulu lya kola. Otamu ka kala mu na iikulya yokulya nomeya gokunwa.
Oto ka mona ko omukwaniilwa meopalo lye ta lele oshilongo shoka sha taandela koombinga adhihedhihe.
Uumbanda woye uukulu wokutila aafendelithi aakwiilongo naatonateli yooshungo otau ka kala owala momadhiladhilo.
Ito ka mona we aakwiilongo aadhudhu mboka haa popi elaka ndyoka waa li shi.

Tala utale Sion, oshilando moka hatu dhana iituthi yomalongelokalunga! Tala Jerusalem! Ehala olyevululuko ngiini lyokukala omuntu! Olya fa etsali ndyoka ihaali tenguka, oomboha dhalyo ihadhi dhikulwa mo noongodhi dhalyo ihadhi tokolwa.
Omuwa ote ke tu ulukila eadhimo lye. Otatu ka kala pomilonga ominene nopomatondokelo gomeya, ihe oosikepa dhaatondi itadhi ka thayila mo.

Oongodhi adhihe dhokooshumbu dhoosikepa odha yululuka, oothayila itadhi wapa okuyalalekwa! Otatu ka kwata po uuyamba auhe waakwiita aatondi yetu. Otaku ka kala oshindjishindji, noshilema otashi ka mona po oshitopolelwa shasho. Omuwa ye mwene ta ka ninga omukwaniilwa gwetu; oye te ke tu lela e te tu gamene.
Kape na nando ogumwe muSion ta ka tya: “Otandi ehama.” Omayonagulo gawo agehe otaga ka dhimwa po.
34: Ileni, ne iigwana ayihe! Gongaleni ne mu pulakene. Uuyuni auhe nane amuhe mwa kala kombanda yevi, ileni mu pulakene.
Omuwa okwa geela iigwana ayihe nomatangakwiita gayo. Okwe ga pangulile okuyonwa po.
Omidhimba dhawo itadhi ka fumvikwa; otadhi ka langathana nokwoolela nkoka nokunika; oondundu otadhi ka tiligana ombinzi.
Etango, omwedhi noonyothi otadhi ka nyanyauka, sigo dha ningi ontsi. Ewangandjo otali ka gonywa lya fa ondhinga yembo, noonyothi otadhi ka gwa mo dha fa omafo taga yagumuka komiviinu nenge komikwiyu.
Omuwa okwa longekidha egongamwele lye megulu, nongashingeyi otali ka dhipaga Edom, aantu tuu mboka ya pangulilwa okuyonwa po.

Egongamwele lye otali ka gwayekwa ombinzi yawo noofu ngaashi ombinzi niinkene yoonzigona noyiikombo mbyoka hayi yambwa omafikilondjambo. Omuwa ota ka yamba omafikilondjambo ngaka moshilando Bozra; ota ka ninga omatselelo omanene moshilongo Edom.
Aantu otaa ka gwila po ya fa oonyati oondumentu noya fa oontsezi oongundjuka, nevi otali ka tiliganekwa kombinzi nolya siikilwa kiikagadhi.
Ndika olyo ethimbo ndyoka Omuwa ta ka mangulula Sion nota ka geela aatondi yaSion.
Omilonga dhaEdom otadhi ka ninga ontopo yonka, nevi otali ka ninga osulufuli. Evi alihe otali ka pya lya fa oteya.
Otali ka pya omutenya nuusiku, nolwithi otalu ka tsinagala mo aluhe sigo aluhe. Evi otali ka kala lya mbugala sigo omapipi nomapipi, nokape na we ngoka te ende mulyo sigo aluhe.
Omahwiyu nomadhilakola otaga ka lala oshilongo. Omuwa ote ke shi mbugaleka ishewe, ngaashi sha li nale peshito.
Itaku ka kala omukwaniilwa a lele oshilongo, nomalenga agehe otaga ka kala kaage mo.
Omano noondjoho otadhi ka mena mo moongulumbala adhihe nomiilando yomadhingililokuma, nuuyandje nomahwiyu otaga ka kala mo.
Iiyaluhwa ohayi tsakanene mo nomambungu, niikombo iindandi ohayi igidhathana. Evukule lyomomilema omo tali ya li konge omulalo.
Omahwiyu otaga tungu mo iihandhila yago e taga valele mo omayi, taga tendula uuhwiyugona wago e tage u paluthile mo. Oontsa oko tadhi ka gongala, onkwawo ponkwawo.

Shi konakoneni membo lyOmuwa lyiishitwa yi na omwenyo ne mu leshe shoka tali ti. Kape na nando oshimwe shomiishitwa mbika tashi kana po noshaa na oshikwawo. Omuwa okwe shi popi shi ningwe; oye mwenemwene te ke yi gongela.
Omuwa oye mwenemwene te yi topolele evi e te yi pe uuthiga wayo, yi kale mo okuza kepipi nepipi.
35:
Ombuga nomalondo otaga ka nyanyukwa,
ontale otayi ka tundulukwa
nokutemuna oongala.

Ombuga otayi ka imba nokuligola kenyanyu;
otayi ka opala ya fa oondundu dhaLibanon
notayi ka ondoka ya fa omapya gokuKarmel naSharon.
Aantu otaa mono eadhimo lyOmuwa,
otaa tala uunene noonkondo dhe.

Kolekeni omaako ngoka ga vulwa
noongolo ndhoka dha loloka.

Lombweleni ayehe mboka ya tyololoka tamu ti:
“Ikoleleni, inamu tila!”
Kalunga ote ya e mu mangulule,
ote ya a pangule aatondi yeni.

Omeho gaaposi otaga ka tsikuluka,
nomakutsi goombolo otaga ka uva ko.

Oshitiningili otashi ka nuka ngomenye,
nelaka lyoshikokoma otali imbi kenyanyu.
Omeya otaga ka tsipuka mombuga,
nomontale otamu ka tondoka omilonga.

Ehekevi lya pupyala otali ka pola,
nomalondo otaga ka ninga omadhiya goothithiya.
Pokuma pwa li pwa kala oombandje,
otapa mene omwiidhi, oombungu nomanenge.

Otaku ka kala onenendjila ya lukwa Ondjila ondjapuki.
Ondjila ndjoka ihayi endwa komulunde,
naangoka te ende nayo, iha puka nando na kale omugoya.

Itamu ka kala oonime;
kape na iilikama iigeyi tayi tokola ondjila ndjoka.
Ayehe mboka Omuwa e ya mangulula,
otaa ka shuna kaandjawo nondjila ndjoka.

Aakulilwa yOmuwa otaa ka galuka.
Otaa yi muSion nokuligola,
enyanyu lyaaluhe otali adhima miipala yawo.
Etunduluko nenyanyu olye ya kola,
oluhodhi nomayemato kage po we.
36: Momumvo omutimulongo nomutine gwepangelo lyomukwaniilwa Hiskia, Sennakerib, omupangeli gwaAssur okwa matukile iilandohote yaJuda e te yi kutha ko.

Okwa tumu elenga lye ekuluntu lya zi muLakish pamwe netangakwiita enene, li ka kondjithe omukwaniilwa Hiskia muJerusalem. Elenga olya kwata po ondjila yaatungi yoonguwo pomukanka gwomeya ngoka tagu kutha omeya mondama yopombanda.
Aajuda yatatu oya yi yeke mu tsakaneke: elenga lyomuuwa Eliakim lyaHilkia, amushangampangu Shebna naamushangandjayi Joa yaAsaf.
Elenga enene lyomupangeli gwaAssur olya ti kuyo: “Lombwela Hiskia kutya omupangeli omunene gwaAssur ota ti ngeyi: ‘Einekelo lyoye olyo okwiinekela shike?’
Otandi ti: ‘Moohapu dhanathangwa ohamu zi tuu omayele noonkondo pethimbo lyiita? Ngoye owi inekela lye, sho wa tsile ndje ondumbo?
Ngiika owi inekela Egipiti, ihe Egipiti olya fa enenge lya shandjuka tali tsu oshikaha shomuntu ngoka ti itsile ko. Omukwaniilwa gwaEgipiti osho a tya, ngele pe na ngoka te mu inekele.’ ”

Elenga enene olya tsikile ko tali ti: “Nenge otamu lombwele ndje mu tye, otwi inekela Omuwa, Kalunga ketu? Hamba, Hiskia ina hanagula po nani omaha gokunonomena niiyambelo yOmuwa, sho a lombwele Aajuda nAajerusalem, ya simaneke oshiyambelo shimwe ashike?
Medhina lyamwene gwandje, omupangeli gwaAssur, otandi mbetse nangoye. Otandi ku pe uukambe omayuvi gaali, ngele oto vulu oku u monena aakayili.
Ngoye ito gwana nando okumatukila elenga limwe eshona lyokuAssur, ndele natango owi inekela Egipiti te ku tumine omatembakwiita naakayilinkambe!
Nenge oto dhiladhila kutya onda homona oshilongo shika noku shi hanagula po ndaa na eutho lyOmuwa? Omuwa oye mwene a lombwele ndje, ndi shi matukile, ngame ndi shi hanagule po.”
Eliakim, Shebna naJoa oya lombwele elenga ya ti: “Tatekulu, popya Oshiaramea, otu shi uvite. Ino popya Oshihebeli, aantu ayehe ye li kombanda yedhingililokuma otaye tu pulakene.”

Elenga olya yamukula lya ti: “Oto dhiladhila kutya mwene gwandje okwa tumu ndje kumwene gwoye nokungoye amuke, ndi popye oohapu ndhika? Aawoo, ondi na okulombwela wo aantu mboka ye li kekuma, mboka ye na okulya omapumba gawo notaa nu omasita gawo naanaa ngaashi ne.”
Elenga olya thikama po e tali igidha mOshihebeli tali ti: “Pulakeneni sho omupangeli gwaAssur te mu lombwele!
Ote mu londodha, mwaa kotokelwe kuHiskia. Hiskia ita vulu oku mu hupitha.
Inamu pitika, e mu heke mu inekele Omuwa. Inamu dhiladhila kutya Omuwa ote ke mu hupitha, nenge a keelele omatangakwiita getu gaAssur okukwata po oshilando sheni.

Inamu pulakena Hiskia. Omupangeli gwaAssur ote mu lombwele, mu pite mo moshilando, mu ye pondje ne mu igandje. Amuhe otamu ka pitikilwa, mu lye omandjembele komiviinu dheni yene, oonkwiyu komikwiyu dheni yene nokunwa omeya momithima dheni yene,
sigo omupangeli te mu fala moshilongo sha faathana nosheni, moka mu na iitsambe yomiviinu tayi gandja omaviinu nomu na iilya yokuninga iikwiila.
Inamu tulwa muugoya kuHiskia, mu dhiladhile kutya Omuwa ote mu hupitha. Ookalunga yiigwana yilwe oya hupitha tuu iilongo yawo miikaha yomupangeli gwaAssur?
Ookalunga yaHamat noyaArpad oye li peni ngashingeyi? Ookalunga yaSefarvaim oye li peni? Oya hupitha tuu Samaria?
Uunake gumwe gwookalunga mbaka ya hupitha nando oshilongo shimwe shomuyo miikaha yomupangeli gwetu? Ndele nena oshike tashi mu dhiladhilitha kutya Omuwa ota hupitha Jerusalem?”
Aantu oya li ya tya thilu, naanaa ngaashi omukwaniilwa Hiskia e ya lombwele; inaa popye nando osha.
Nena Eliakim, Shebna naJoa oya tuula oonguwo dhawo moluhodhi e taa zi po e taa ka lombwela omukwaniilwa shoka elenga lyokuAssur lya ti.
37: Hiskia sho u uvu ehokololo lyawo, okwa tuula onguwo ye moluhodhi, a zala ehahi e ta yi kotempeli yOmuwa.
Okwa tumu elenga lyomuuwa Eliakim, amushangampangu Shebna naayambi aakuluntu komuhunganeki Jesaja yaAmos. Oya li ya zala omahahi.
Okwe ya tuma kuJesaja nelaka tali ti: “Esiku lyonena olyomalwa, olyegeelo nolyeshundulo. Otwa fa omukiintu ta thetwa, ihe ita vulu okupulumutha.

Omupangeli gwaAssur okwa tumu elenga lye ekuluntu okusheka Kalunga omunamwenyo. Omuwa, Kalunga koye, na uve omasheko ngaka nokugeela ngoka e ga popi. Galikana Kalunga omolwaamboka yomaantu yetu ya hupa ko.”
Jesaja sho u uvu elaka lyomukwaniilwa Hiskia,
okwa yamukula ta ti: “Omuwa ota ti: ‘Ino tila oohapu ndhoka dhuumatyona womupangeli gwaAssur we dhi uvu tadhi sheke ndje!
Otandi ku uvithitha omupangeli onkundana ndjoka tayi mu galukithile koshilongo she mwene, nkoka tandi ke mu dhipagithila.’ ”
Elenga lyaAssur olya mono kutya omupangeli a zi mo muLakish nokwa li ta kondjitha oshilando shopopepi Libna; onkee olya yi kuye.

Onkundana ya adha Aayassur, oya ti kutya etangakwiita lyAayegipiti mewiliko lyomukwaniilwa Tirhaka gwaSudan oli li mondjila, li ya homone. Omupangeli sho e shi uvu, okwa tumu aatumwa komukwaniilwa Hiskia.
Ye mu lombwele ngeyi: “Kalunga ngoka we mu inekela, okwe ku lombwele kutya ito ka ya miikaha yandje, ihe shika inashi ku tula muugoya.
Owa kundana shoka omupangeli gwaAssur ta ningile iilongo ayihe mbyoka a tokola e yi hanagule po. Oto dhiladhila kutya oto ka hunuka?
Ootatekulu oya hanagula po iilando Gosan, Haran naRezef noya dhipaga aantu yaBeteden mboka ya kala mu Telassar, ko kakwa li nando okalunga kamwe ta vulu oku ya hupitha.
Aakwaniilwa yomiilando Hamat, Arpad, Sefarvaim, Hena naIvva oye li peni?”
Omukwaniilwa Hiskia okwa taamba ontumwafo miikaha yaatumwa e te yi lesha. Okwa yi ihe kotempeli e ta aneke ontumwafo koshipala shOmuwa.
E ta galikana ta ti:
“Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, ngoka wa kuutumba koshipangelapundi shoye kombanda yaakerubi, ongoye awike Kalunga ngoka to lele iilongo ayihe yomuuyuni. Ongoye wa shiti egulu nevi wo.
Ngashingeyi, Omuwa, tala, nkene tatu ningwa. Pulakena oohapu adhihe dhaSennakerib, nkene te ku sheke, ngoye Kalunga omunamwenyo.
Omuwa, otse atuhe otwa tseya kutya aapangeli yaAssur oya hanagula po iigwana oyindji e taa ningi omavi gayo omaputu.
Oya lungunitha po ookalunga kawo mboka kaaya li ookalunga nando, oyo iiyelekela ayike ya hongwa kaantu miiti nomomamanya.
Ngashingeyi, Omuwa, Kalunga ketu, tu hupitha miikaha yAayassur, opo iigwana ayihe yomuuyuni yi tseye kutya ongoye awike Omuwa Kalunga.”
Jesaja okwa tumu komukwaniilwa Hiskia elaka tali mu tseyithile eyamukulo kegalikano lye.
Omuwa okwa ti: “Sennakerib, oshilando Jerusalem otashi ku yolo e tashi ku dhini.
Olye ngoka andola we mu sheke noku mu popya nayi? Ongoye owa dhini ndje, ngame Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki.

Owa tumu aatumwa yoye, u inenepekele ndje kutya ngoye nomatembakwiita goye agehe wa sindi oondundu oondeendeka dhaLibanon. Owi itanga to ti, owa komangele omiti omisendeli omile nomiti omikiperesi dho opala nowa thiki nomomaha gomuuleeleka momakuti.
Owi inomo to ti, owa hupu omithima e to nu omeya momavi gokiilongo noompadhi dhaakwiita yoye odha lyatagula po omulonga Niili e tagu pwine.
“Ino shi uva nani kutya shika ongame nde shi dhiladhila nalenale? Ngashingeyi onde shi gwanitha. Onde ku pe oonkondo, u kumune po iilandohote, yi ninge omakulukuma.
Aantu mboka ya kala mo oya tyololoka; oya li ya haluka noya kunkwa. Oya li ya fa omwiidhi melundu nenge iigwanga tayi mene kombanda yondunda, uuna ombepo ompyu yokuuzilo tayi yi pepele.
“Ihe ngame onde ku tseya aguhe, shoka to ningi naankoka to yi. Onda tseya, nkene wa pindjala okukondjitha ndje.
Onda taamba etseyitho lyepindjalo lyoye nomwiityo gwoye, nongashingeyi otandi tula ondjolo momayulu goye noshitomo mokana koye e tandi ku shunitha nondjila ndjoka we ya nayo.”

Jesaja okwa ti komukwaniilwa Hiskia: “Endhindhiliko lyaashika tashi ka ningwa, olyo ndika. Nuumvo nomumvo tagu ya omu na okulya oshinkumbwe ashike, ihe omumvo tagu ka landula ko otamu ka vula okukuna nokuteya iilya yeni, notamu ka tsika omiviinu e tamu li omandjembele.
Oomboka taa hupile muJuda, otaa ka tsapuka ya fa iimeno tayi fala omidhi dhayo muule mevi e tayi imi iiyimati.
MuJerusalem otamu ka kala aantu nokondundu Sion oomboka ya hupu ko, oshoka Omuwa oye ta ningitha ayihe mbika.

“Omuwa okwa popi omupangeli gwaAssur ta ti: ‘Ite ya mo, a hite meni lyoshilando shika nenge a umbile mo nando oshikuti shimwe molugodhi. Kape na omukwiita e na ehuuyanza ta vulu okuya popepi noshilando, noshilando itashi tungilwa omutuni gwekondekela.
Ota ka shuna nondjila ndjoka e ya nayo ite ya meni lyoshilando shika. Ongame, Omuwa, nde dhi tya.
Otandi popile oshilando shika e tandi shi gamene omolwesimano lyandje mwene nomolweuvaneko nde li uvanekele omuntu gwandje David.’ ”
Omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwa yi kontanda yAayassur e ta dhipagele ko aakwiita 185 000. Sho kwa shi, oya adhika ya lala ya sa ayehe.
Nena omupangeli gwaAssur Sennakerib okwa zi po e ta shuna kuNinive.

Esiku limwe, sho a li ta saagele motempeli yoshikalunga she Nisrok, yaali yomoyanamati, Adrammelek naSharezer, oye mu dhipaga nomagongamwele e taa fadhuka po taa yi koshilongo Ararat. Gumwe gwomoyanamati Asarhaddon okwe mu landula muukwaniilwa.
38: Pomasiku ngeyaka Hiskia okwa kwatwa kuuvu uudhigu, konyala a se. Omuhanganeki Jesaja yaAmos okwa yi e ke mu talele po e ta ti kuye: “Omuwa ota ti: ‘Longekidha egumbo lyoye, oshoka ono si. Ito ka aluka we.’ ”
Hiskia okwa pungulukile mekuma nokwa galikana:
“Omuwa, dhimbulukwa kutya onde ku longele nuudhiginini neinekelo nonda kambadhala aluhe okuninga shoka she ku opalela.” Okwa lili nokulililila.
Nena Omuwa okwa lombwele Jesaja
a shune kuHiskia, e mu lombwele a tye: “Ongame Omuwa, Kalunga kahokulu David, ndu uvu egalikano lyoye nonda mono omahodhi goye. Otandi ke ku kaleka ko omimvo omulongo nantano u na omwenyo.
“Otandi ku hupitha miikaha yomupangeli gwaAssur pamwe noshilando shika Jerusalem. Otandi ka popila oshilando shika.”
Jesaja okwa yamukula a ti: “Omuwa ote ke ku pa endhindhiliko, a holole kutya ota dhiginine euvaneko lye.
Omuwa ota ka shunitha omuzile monima oonkatu omulongo moshiulikithimbo shomukwaniilwa Ahas.” Omuzile nogwa shuna monima oonkatu omulongo.
Hiskia sho a aluka kuuvu we, okwa nyola eimbilo ndika lyehambelelo:

Onda dhiladhila kutya metifa lyokukalamwenyo kwandje
otandi ka kulukila muuyuni wokuusi
e tandi kuthwa ngaaka oshihupe shokukala ndi na omwenyo.

Onda dhiladhila kutya itii ka mona we Omuwa,
eeno, Omuwa gwandje omevi lyaanamwenyo.
Itii ka ligamena we aana yaantu
nenge ndi kale pamwe naamboka ye li kombanda yevi ndika.

Omwenyo gwandje ogwa kuthwa mo nogwa adha ehulilo.
Ongetsali lyaanahambo tali dhikulwa po,
ongoshiyata tashi tetwa moongodhi dhokoshitungitho,
sho sha pu okutungwa.
Onda dhiladhila kutya Kalunga ota hulitha ndje po.

Uusiku auhe onda kugu kuuwehame,
oto ti onkoshi tayi kokota po omasipa gandje.
Onda dhiladhila kutya Kalunga ota hulitha ndje po.

Otandi kululula ongonguti.
Omeho gandje oga ningi oshiwiwili, sho te ligamene kegulu.
Omuwa, ondi na uudhigu,
ila, u kwathe ndje!

Otandi ti ngiini?
Nenge ondi mu lombwele shike?
Omwenyo gwandje ogwa lulilwa,
noite vulu nando okukotha.

Omuwa, otandi ku kalele,
eeno, ongoye awike tuu!
Panga ndje ndi kale ndi na omwenyo.

Tala, oluhodhi olululu olwa shitukile ndje elago.
Mohole yoye owa hupitha ndje,
owa hili ndje moshilambo shekano.
Oondjo dhandje adhihe ongoye we dhi umbile konima yoye.

Oshoka ombila itayi vulu oku ku hambelela,
uusi itau ku tanga.
Mboka ya kulukile moshaasi,
ihaa inekele uudhiginini woye.

Aanamwenyo, eeno, aanamwenyo
oyo taye ku hambelele,
ngashika ngame tandi shi ningi nena.
