Oohe taa hokololele oyana oshili yoye.

Omuwa, ongoye wa aludha ndje.
Otatu hiki uuharpa e tatu ku imbile omahambelelo
motempeli yoye omasiku getu agehe.
Jesaja okwa lombwele omukwaniilwa a tule ekamina lyoonkwiyu poshitumbuka she, oye nota aluka.
Omukwaniilwa Hiskia okwe mu pula a ti: “Endhindhiliko olini po tali ulike kutya otii ka vula okuya motempeli?”
39: Lwopomathimbo ngoka omukwaniilwa gwaBabilonia Merodak Baladan, omuna gwaBaladan, okwa kundana kutya omukwaniilwa Hiskia okwa li ta alukwa, onkee okwe mu tumine ontumwafo nomagano.

Hiskia okwa kundu nawa aatumwa e te ya ulukile uuyamba we — iisiliveli ye niingoli ye, iizimba ye nomagadhi gondilo, niikwaniipangitho ye ayihe yuukwiita. Kakwa li sha moompungulo dhe nenge shaa mpoka moshilongo she inee shi ya ulukila.

Nena omuhunganeki Jesaja okwa yi komukwaniilwa Hiskia e ta pula ta ti: “Aantu mbaka oya zi peni noye ku lombwele shike?”
Hiskia okwa yamukula a ti: “Oya zi koshilongo shokokule kuBabilonia.”

Jesaja okwa pula a ti: “Mombala oya mono mo shike?”
Hiskia okwa yamukula a ti: “Oya tala iinima ayihe. Kamu na sha moompungulo inaandi shi ya ulukila.”
Jesaja okwa ti komukwaniilwa: “Omuwa Omunankondoawike ota ti kutya
esiku onali ke ya, uuna shaa shoka shi li muuwa woye, shaa shoka oohokulu ye shi pungulile, tashi ka falwa kuBabilon. Itapa thigwa sha.
Yamwe yomoluvalo lwoyelela otaa ka kuthwa po e taa ka ningwa aathonwantu, ya yakule muuwa womukwaniilwa gwaBabilon.”
Omukwaniilwa Hiskia shika okwe shi uvu ko tashi ti kutya, otaku ka kala ombili negameno monkalamwenyo ye, nomolwasho okwa yamukula ngeyi: “Oohapu dhOmuwa ndhoka wa popi, oombwanawa.”
40:
Kalunga ketu ota ti:
“Hekelekeni, hekelekeni aantu yandje.

Aajerusalem ya tseni omukumo.
Ya lombweleni kutya ehepeko lyawo olya hulu,
noondjo dhawo ngashingeyi odha dhimwa po.
Onde ya geele egeelo lya gwana molwoondjo dhawo.”

Ewi tali kolomoka tali ti:
“Longekidhileni Omuwa ondjila mombuga!
Paleleni Kalunga ketu epola montale!

Omasilu agehe naga filwe po;
oondundu adhihe nadhi kumunwe po.
Iikulundundu nayi palwe,
niisilukutumba nayi yelekanithwe.

Eadhimo lyOmuwa otali iholola:
naana yaantu otaye ke li mona ko.
Omuwa oye mwene e shi uvaneke.”

Ewi olya ti: “Uvitha!”
Onda pula nda ti:
“Nandi uvithe shike?”
“Uvitha to ti: Aantu ayehe oya fa omwiidhi;
nesimano lyawo olya fa oongala dhokelundu.

Omwiidhi otagu kukuta,
noongala otadhi ganya, uuna Omuwa te dhi pepithile ombepo.
Aantu kaa vulathane nomwiidhi.

Eeno, omwiidhi otagu kukuta,
noongala otadhi ganya,
ihe oohapu dhaKalunga ketu
otadhi kala sigo aluhe.”

Jerusalem, londa pombanda kondundu
nou uvithe elaka etoye!
Sion, igidha newi lyopombandambanda,
u tomone onkundana ombwanawa!
Kugagana shili ngoye ino tila!
Lombwela iilando yaJuda kutya Kalunga kawo ote ya!

Omuwa Omupangeliawike ote ya okulela,
oye omunankondoawike.
Ote etelele aantu mboka a mangulula,

Oku na tuu ngoka ta vulu okuyeleka efuta neshambekela,
nenge a yeleke eyalelo nolundya lwe?
Oku na tuu ngoka ta pungula ontsi yevi montungwa,
nenge a vihe oondundu niikulundundu moshiviha?

Oku na tuu ngoka ta vulu okulombwela Omuwa shoka e na okuninga?
Olye ta vulu oku mu longa,
nenge e mu pe omayele?

Kalunga ota pula oondunge kulye,
opo a tseye ye uve ko
nokwiilonga kutya iinima ohayi ningwa ngiini?

KOmuwa iigwana kayi na po sha;
kuye oya faathana neta limwe lyomeya,
iipuupuka moshiviha ya fa ontsi.
Nge ta tumbu oontuntu,
odho oompu dha fa owala ontsi.

Iiyamakuti ayihe momakuti gaLibanon
inayi gwana okuyambelwa Kalunga ketu,
nomiti adhihe kadhi shi odhindji
dhi ninge iikuni yokutema omulilo.

Iigwana ayihe kayi shi sha koshipala she,
kayi na omwago gwasha kuye.

Kalunga ota yelekwa nalye?
Otamu mu faathanitha nashike?

Ita faathanitha noshimenka sha hongwa kiikaha yaantu,
oshilonga shiiyela ya kolongwa noshingoli
nosha tulwa mekota lyoshisiliveli.

Omuntu ngoka ita vulu okulanda oshisiliveli nenge oshingoli,
ota hogolola omuti gu na olute lwa kola.
Ota ka konga onkulungu, a honge oshiyelekelakalunga,
shi dhikwe itaashi tenguka.

Kamu shi shi?
Inamu shi lombwelwa nale?
Inamu kundana, uuyuni nkene wa tameka po?

Owa shitwa kungoka a kuutumba koshipangelapundi
mookathele mwi handiyaka yeyalelo;
aantu kombanda yevi oya fa uudhidhi.
Egulu ote li yala lya fa onguwo,
ote li alele ngetsali lyokukala mo.

Aawa ote ya kutha ko kiipundi,
aapangeli yomuuyuni ote ya shundula.

Oya fa iimeno opo ya tsikwa,
opo tayi tsapuka omidhi.
Omuwa nge a pepitha ombepo,
otaa pepuka po,
taa yi ombepo ya fa etutu.

Kalunga omuyapuki ota vulu okuyelekwa nalye?
Oku na tuu ngoka e mu fa?

Tala owala utale kegulu!
Olye a shiti oonyothi ndhoka wa tala?
Oye ngoka te dhi enditha dha fa etangakwiita.
Adhihe okwe dhi tseya nawa,
nokehe yimwe ote yi tumbula kedhina lyayo!
Oonkondo dhe oonenenene,
odha kolelela nokape na ndjoka e yi hunutha po.

Israel, omolwashike to ngungutula to ti,
Omuwa ina tseya uudhigu woye
nenge e ku kwathe, sho to hepekelwa uuyuuki?

Ku shi shi nani?
Nani ino shi uva kutya Omuwa oye Kalunga kaaluhe?
Oye a shiti omakankameno gevi.
Oye iha vulwa ye iha loloka.
Owino ye oya nyengana okutseyika.

Oye ta tsu omukumo oonakuvulwa
naamboka yaa na oonkondo,
oonkondo dhawo ote dhi indjipaleke odhindji.

Aagundjuka ohaa vulwa nohaa adhika kuutongwe,
aalumentu aagundjuka otaa punduka e taa ihata po,
41:
Kalunga ota popi ta ti:
“Mweneni ne mu pulakene ndje, one oontuntu dhokokule!
Ilongekidheni, tu ka kaleni moompangu;
otamu kala mu na ompito yokupopya.
Natu tokoleni, olye ngoka e li mondjila.

“Olye ano ngoka e etele omusindani a ziilile kuuzilo
nokwe mu ningi omusindani shaa nkoka ta yi?
Olye te mu pe esindano,
a sinde aakwaniilwa niigwana?
Egongamwele lye otali ya dhengele pevi ya fa ontsi yevi.
Iikuti ye otayi ya hwanukile ya fa iiyagaya tayi pepwa kombepo.

Ote ya tidha ta katuka kee na nando ombudhi,
ta kwinyola a fa itaa lyata pevi.

Olye ngoka e shi longa nokwe shi toto?
Olye u utha olweendo lwehistoli?
Ngame, Omuwa, onda li petamekolela,
ngame, Omuwa, otandi ka kala pehulilolela.
Oonkulungu otadhi kwathathana nokutsaathana omukumo.

Engomba otali kumike omuhambuli gwoshingoli,
nomumbunzi gwoshimenka ota lombwele ngoka ta ndanda poshikalo ta ti:
‘Owa ninga nawa.’
Oyo notaa kwatele oshimenka peha lyasho noomboha.”

“Ihe omuntu gwandje Israel,
ngoye Jakob, ngoka nde ku hogolola,
ngoye oluvalo lwakuume kandje Abraham,

ngame onde ku kongolola kooha dhuuyuni;
onde ku ithana ko koombinga dhokokulekule,
nonde ku lombwele nda ti: ‘Ngoye omuntu gwandje.’
Inandi ku ekelahi nando, ihe onde ku hogolola.

Ino tila — ongame ndi li pungoye!
Ongame Kalunga koye — ino limbililwa!
Otandi ku kankameke e tandi ku kwatha;
otandi ku gamene notandi ku hupitha.

“Ayehe mboka taa tsu ondumbo nangoye,
otaa sithwa ohoni e taa sindika.
Ayehe taye ku kondjitha,
otaa ka sa po.

Ayehe mboka ya li aatondi yoye,
ito ke ya mona we, nando u ya konge.
Ayehe mboka ye ku hingile iita,
otaa ka pepuka po thilu.

Omuwa ota popi ta ti:
“Ino tila, ezinyo ngoye Israel,
nangoye Jakob, okanima okashuushuu,
oshoka ongame mwene tandi ku kwatha.
Ngame Omuyapuki, Kalunga kaIsrael
ongame tandi ku hupitha.

Otandi ku ningi omuhi gwokunyanyagula gu na ondjundo.
Oto ka nyanyagula oondundu noku dhi hanagula po;
oondundu otadhi ka vundulwa
dhi ninge ontsi.

Uuna aantu yandje moluhepo lwawo taa kongo omeya,
uuna oondaathelo dhawo dha kangala kenota,
nena ngame Omuwa otandi ka yamukula omagalikano gawo;
ngame, Kalunga kaIsrael, itandi ke ya etha nando.

Otandi ka tondokitha omilonga miikulundundu yomamanya,
noothithiya otadhi ka kunguluka momasilu.
Ombuga otandi yi shitukitha omatope gomeya,
nevi lya kalanda tandi li shitukitha omadhiya.

Mombuga otandi ka tsika mo omisedeli,
omithiya, omihombo nomiolivi.
Oontale otadhi ka shituka omakuti gomikiperesi, omipopeli nomihongo.

Aantu otaye ke shi mona
notaa ka tseya kutya ngame Omuwa onde shi ningi.
Otaa ka uva ko kutya Omuyapuki, Kalunga kaIsrael oye e shi eta po.

Omuwa, omukwaniilwa gwaIsrael ota ti:
“Ne ookalunga kiigwana,
eteni huka oontamanana dheni,
tumbuleni omatompelo geni.

Ileni huka ne mu hunganeke shoka tashi ka ningwa,
opo tu shi tseye, uuna tashi ka ningwa.
Fatululileni oompangu iiningwanima yonale,
ne mu tu lombwele kutya otayi ti ngiini.

Tu lombweleni, onakuyiwa shoka tayi tu etele,
opo tu ka tseye kutya one ookalunga!
Longeni po uuwanawa nenge uuwinayi;
tu tilitheni ne mu tu haluthe!

One yene kamu shi sha,
niilonga yeni osima yowala.
Yaye mboka taye mu hogolola!”

“Onda hogolola omulumentu ngoka a kala kuuzilo
otandi ke mu eta a homone ta zi kuumbangalantu.
Ota ka lyata aapangeli ngaashi omunoko nongeloya lyomuhongi gwiiyuma.

Olye gwomune e shi hunganeke, nkene tashi ka ningwa,
opo tatu vulu okutya, omu li mondjila?
Kape na nando ogumwe gweni a popi sha kusho;
kape na ngoka u uva shoka tamu ti.

Ngame Omuwa onda lombwele tango Sion onkundana;
onda tumu omutumwa kuJerusalem a ka tye:
‘Aantu yeni otaa galuka!
Eeno, otaye ya kegumbo!’

Tala, ayehe oyo aaniifundja yowala,
itaa vulu okuninga nando oshaashaa.
Iimenka yawo kayi na omwago, ombepo yowala.”
42:
Omuwa ota ti:
“Omupiya gwandje oye nguka, ngoka tandi mu nkondopaleke —
Oye tuu ngoka nde mu hogolola, omuntu nde mu hokwa.
Onde mu udhitha Ombepo yandje,
oye nota ka uthila iigwana ayihe nuuyuuki.

Ita ka igidha nenge a kololoke
nenge ewi lye li kugagane momapandaanda.

Oshihenguti sha tanduka ite shi nyanyagula
nonyeka tayi tsina ite yi dhimi po.
Ota ka uthila ayehe pauyuuki.

“Ongame Omuwa nde ku ithana
e tandi ku koleke noku ku nkondopaleka,
u tale, uuyuuki ngele otau gwanithwa tuu kombanda yevi.
Omungoye tandi ka hangana naantu ayehe;
mungoye otandi ka minikila iigwana.

Oto ka tonatitha omeho gaaposi
nokumangulula mboka ya kuutumba momilema moondjedhililo.

Iinima nda hunganekithile nale, oya ningi yoshili.
Ngashingeyi otii mu lombwele iinima iipeepeka,
tandi shi ningi nokuli, manga inaayi ningwa.”

Ombuga niilando yayo nayi tange Kalunga;
omikunda dhaKedar nadhi mu hambelele!
One mboka mwa kala moshilando Sela,
igidheni nokuligola koondunga dhoondundu!

Hambeleleni, mboka mwa kala moontuntu dhomefuta,
ne mu simaneke Omuwa!

Kalunga ota ti:
“Onda mwena unene ethimbo ele nda tya thilu.
Ine yamukula nando aantu yandje.
Ngashingeyi ethimbo lyokulonga lya thiki;
otandi keme nda fa omukiintu ta thetwa.

Otandi hanagula po iikulundundu noondundu,
otandi kukutike omwiidhi nomiti.
Omilonga otandi dhi shitukitha oontuntu
nomatale otandi ga pwinike.

“Otandi ka enditha aaposi
moondjila inaaye enda mo nale.
Omilema dhawo otandi dhi shitukitha uuyelele,
nevi lyiisilukutumba otandi li ya yelekanithile.
Ngaka ogo omauvaneko gandje,
notandi ga tsakanitha pwaa na ekandakando.

Ayehe mboka yi inekela iimenka,
mboka taa galikana iiyelekela, aniwa ookalunga kawo,
otaa ka fupipikwa nokusithwa ohoni.”

Omuwa ota ti:
“Pulakeneni, ne oombolo!
Tongololeni nawa, ne aaposi!

Oku na tuu omuposi e vule omupiya gwandje?
Oku na tuu ombolo yi vule omutumwa gwandje tandi mu tumu?

Israel, wa mono oshindji unene,
ihe ino pupa ko.
Ou na omakutsi gokuuva,
ihe owu uvu shike?”

Omuwa oye Kalunga,
ngoka a sa uulaadhi okuhupitha,
onkee okwa ningi ompango ye ya kola noya simana.

Ihe aantu ye oya yugwa,
oye edhililwa moondholongo
noya patelwa moondjedhililo.
Oya yugwa noya luwa,
nokape na ngoka e ya mangulule.

Ope na tuu gumwe mune ta pulakene shika?
Okuza ngashingeyi olye ta pupu ko shili kushika?

Olye a gandja po Jakob a luwe, naIsrael a yugwe?
Oye Omuwa, ngoka twa yono kuye,
oshoka inatu hala okulandula oondjila dhe
nokuvulika kiipango ye.
43:
Omuwa ngoka e ku shiti, Jakob,
oye tuu ngoka e ku umbu,
Israel, ota ti:
“Ino tila, oshoka onde ku kulila,
onde ku ithana edhina lyoye, ongoye ogwandje.

Ngele to pitile momeya, ondi li pungoye,
nongele ku na omilonga dhomeya, itadhi ku ninginitha.
Ngele to pitile momulilo, ito lunguna po,
nomalaka gomulilo itage ku fike.

Oshoka ongame Omuwa, Kalunga koye,
Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki, tandi ku hupitha.
Otandi gandja Egipiti iikulila yoye,
Etiopia naSeba opeha lyoye.

Molwashoka ou na ondilo momeho gandje,
molwashoka owa simana nondi ku hole,
otandi gandja aantu peha lyoye,
yalwe ya ye pehala lyomwenyo gwoye.

Ino tila — ondi li pamwe nangoye!
“Oluvalo lwoye otandi ke lu kongolola kokule kuuzilo
notandi ke lu tala ko kuuninginino
e tandi lu eta kegumbo.

Otii ka lombwela uumbangalantu u ya ethe ye ye,
nuumbugantu u ya galule ye ye.
Etheni aamwandjemati ye ye taa zi kokule,
naamwandjekadhona taa zi kooha dhuuyuni.

Oyo mboka ya lukilwa edhina lyandje,
oomboka nda shitile esimano lyandje.”

Omuwa ota ti:
“Ithaneni aantu yandje koompangu.
Oye na omeho, ihe oyo aaposi;
oye na omakutsi, ihe oyo oombolo!

Ithaneni iigwana yi ye koompangu.
Olye gwomookalunga kawo ta vulu okuhunganeka onakuyiwa?
Olye gwomuyo a hunganeke iinima yananena?
Ookalunga mboka naa ete po oonzapo dhawo,
ya holole kutya oye na oshili,
ye ete etompelo lyoshili yoohapu dhawo.

“Aaisraeli, one oonzapo dhandje;
aantu yandje nde mu hogolola, opo mu tseye ndje ne mu itaale ndje
nokuuva ko kutya ongame.
Kaku na Kalunga a li ndje komeho,
nokaku na ta ka landula ndje.

“Ongame, ongame Omuwa,
kaku na omuhupithi gulwe, ongame awike.

Ongame nda hunganeke shoka tashi ka ningwa po
nonde mu kwatha noku mu uvithila.
Mokati keni kamwa li kalunga omukwiilongo a ningile ngeyi;
one oonzapo dhandje kutya ongame Kalunga.

Omuwa, Omuyapuki gwaIsrael,
ngoka e mu hupitha ota ti:
“Omolwoye tandi tumu iita yi matukile Babilon;
otandi teyagula po omiyelo dhoshilando,
nondigolo yaantu yawo otayi shituka onkugo.

Ongame Omuwa Kalunga keni omuyapuki.
Ongame nde ku shiti, Israel,
ngame omukwaniilwa gwoye.”

Konalenale Omuwa okwa ningile ondjila ye ende mefuta,
epola lye enda mokati komeya ga pindjala.

Okwe enditha etangakwiita enankondo sigo omehanagulo,
etanga lyomatembakwiita nuukambe.
Vwangu, oyo mbeyaka ya ningina,
eeno, inaa anduka ko we;
oya dhimi ya fa elapi lyolamba!

Ihe Omuwa ota ti:
“Inamu dhama miiningwanima yonale,
inamu kakatela mumbyoka ya ningilwe nalenale ndjo.

Taleni nawa iinima iipe opo tandi ke yi ninga.
Otayi ningwa nokuli ngashingeyi —
otamu vulu oku yi tala nena!
Otandi kokola ondjila momakuti
e tandi tondokitha omeya mombuga.

Niithitukuti otayi ka simaneka ndje;
oombandje noompo otadhi ka hambelela ndje,
uuna tandi tondokitha omeya mombuga,
ndi gandje omeya kaantu yandje aahogololwa.

Oyo aantu mboka ndi ishitile ngame mwene,
oyo notaa ka imbila ndje omahambelelo.”

Iho etele ndje we oonzi dhomafikilondjambo;
iho simaneke ndje we noontselelandjambo dhoye.
Inandi ku tsika omutenge, ndi ku pule oondjambo dhiikulya
nenge ndi ku piyaganeke, ndi pule omatsininondjambo.

Ino etela ndje we omatsininondjambo
nenge u geulukithe ndje noofu dhiimuna yoye.
Ihe owa humbatitha ndje uudhigu woondjo dhoye
nowa hepekitha ndje komayanagulo goye.

Ihe natango tuu, ongame, eeno, ongame Kalunga
tandi dhimi po omayonagulo goye omolwandje mwene,
noondjo dhoye itandi dhi dhimbulukwa we.

“Natu yeni koompangu,
eteleleni eipopilo lyeni!
Tuleni iihokolola yeni moompangu,
mu monike aayelele!

Hokulu gwonalenale okwa yonene;
aawiliki yeni ya tsa ondumbo nangame,
44:
Omuwa ota ti:
“Shigwana shandje Israel
noluvalo lwaJakob nde lu hogolola,
pulakena ngashingeyi.

Ongame Omuwa ngoka nde ku shiti;
okuza kokuvalwa kwoye onde ku kwatha.
Ino tila, oshigwana shandje Jeshurun,
ngoye oluvalo lwaJakob nde lu hogolola.

“Otandi ka poolela omeya mevi lya sa enota
nokutondokitha omilonga puukukutu.
Ongame tandi tilile Ombepo yandje kombanda yaana yeni
nomayambeko gandje kombanda yoluvalo lweni.

Otaa ka mena ya fa omwiidhi gwomelonzi,
ya fa iihwa yopomilonga hadhi tondoka omeya.

“Nguka ota ka tya: ‘Ngame ogwOmuwa,’
namukwawo oti iluku edhina Jakob.
Natango gumwe ti inyolithitha koshikaha she oshitya ‘gwOmuwa’
e ta taamba edhina Israel.”

Omuwa, omukwaniilwa nOmukulili gwaIsrael,
Omuwa Omunankondoawike ta ti:
“Ongame omutango nongame omuhugunini.
Kaku na we Kalunga ponto yandje.

Oku na tuu ngoka ta vulu okulonga shoka nda longo?
Olye a hunganekele ayihe mbyoka ya ningwa
okuza konale ndjoka sigo opehulilo lyomathimbo?

Inamu tila, ne aantu yandje!
Omwe shi tseya kutya okuza kuuyuni wonale sigo ongashingeyi
onda hunganeke ayihe mbyoka yi na okuningwa,
none oonzapo dhandje.
Oku na tuu kalunga gulwe?
Oku na tuu kalunga gulwe omunankondo inaandi mu uva?”
Ayehe mboka taa hongo iimenka, oyo oyowala, niikalunga mbyoka taa tanga, kayi na oshilonga. Mboka taa simaneke iikalunga, oyo aaposi nomagoya — otaa ka sithwa ohoni.
Inashi opala okuhambula oshiyelekela noku shi simaneka!
Shaa ngoka te shi simaneke, ota ka fupipikwa. Aantu mboka taa hongo iimenka, oyo oyowala, kaye na omwago. Ya eteni koompangu — otaa ka haluthwa notaa sithwa ohoni.
Omuhambuli ta kwata oshitenda e te shi tula momulilo. Omaako ge ge na oonkondo, otaga yelutha osilwa, a hambule oshitenda, shi ninge olupe. Sho te shi hambula, ota si ondjala nenota e ta loloka.

Omuhongi gwiipilangi ota yeleke oshiti nota thaneke efano nompya. Ote shi hongo nepanda e ta tula omandhindhiliko nopasera. Ota ningi efano molupe lwomuntu noku li mbunza nawa, opo e li tule megumbo lye.
Oku na okwiikomangelela omisendeli, opo e dhi longithe, nenge a hogolole omukiperesi nenge omwandi mokuti. Nenge oku na okutsika omupanda e ta tegelele omvula yi gu kokeke.

Omuntu ta longitha iitayi yomuti tuu ngoka, yi ninge iikuni, noshiti te shi hongo oshimenka. Iitayi yimwe te yi huhulukwa po nokwiitelekela iikulya, manga iitayi yimwe te yi ningi kalunga, e mu simaneke.
Iitayi yimwe te yi temitha omulilo, ta yotha nayo onyama e te yi li e ta kuta. Ota huhulukwa e ta ti: “Omulilo omwaanawa nguka! Omulilo gu na omuyenye ngiini!”
Shoka sha hupu ko, ote shi hongo po oshimenka note shi inyongamene noku shi simaneka. Ote shi hambelele ta ti: “Ongoye kalunga kandje, hupitha ndje.”
Aantu ya tya ngaaka aagoya okutseya shoka taa ningi. Kaye wete ko, oshoka otaa thithikile omeho gawo, nokaye uvite ko oshili, oshoka otaa pata oomwenyo dhawo.

Inashi ya momadhiladhilo gawo yo kaye na oondunge nomayele ya tye ando: “Ee, iitayi yimwe nde yi tema po. Yimwe nda telekitha iikulya peziko nonda yotha onyama nonde yi li po. Oshihupe shoshiti onde shi hongo oshimenka. Ngashingeyi ongame nguka tandi shi inyongamene, endangalati lyoshiti.”
Otashi ningi omuntu a fa ta li omutoko. Omatedho ge guugoya oge mu pukitha kutya ota kwathwa. Ita zimine ye mwene kutya oshimenka shoka a yelutha momaako ge, kashi shi kalunga nando.

Omuwa ota ti:
“Israel, ngoye oluvalo lwaJakob,
dhimbulukwa iinima mbika,
oshoka ongame nde ku shiti.
Ongoye omupiya gwandje,
nangame itandi ku dhimbwa.

Otandi dhimi po omayono goye ngashika oshikogo,
noondjo dhoye ngashika osheentsi shongula.
Galukila kungame;
ongame tandi ku hupitha.”

Imbeni nokuhambelela, ne omagulu,
oshoka Omuwa okwe shi ningi!
Ligoleni, ne oombogo dhevi!
Mbolongondjitheni oondjimbohambelelo, ne oondundu,
oshoka Omuwa okwa kulile oluvalo lwaJakob,
oye a hololele Israel eadhimo lye.

Omuwa, omuhupithi gwoye,
ngoka e ku shitile mela lyanyoko, ota ti:
“Ongame Omuwa, Omushiti gwiinima ayihe.
Ongame awike nda alele egulu nonda yala evi,
ko kakwa li ngoka a kwatha ndje.

Aayanekeli otandi ya ningi aagoya,
nokukeelela omahunganeko gaakoneki yoonyothi.
Oohapu dhaanongo otandi dhi goyokitha
notandi holola kutya uunongo wawo owo uugoya.

Ihe aapiya yandje nge taa hunganeke,
uuna tandi tumu aatumwa ya holole omadhiladhilo gandje,
omadhiladhilo nomahunganeko ngoka otandi ke ga tsitha ga ninge goshili.
Ote lombwele Jerusalem kutya aantu yasho omo taa ka kala ishewe,
niilando yaJuda kutya otayi ka tungululwa.
Otandi ka tungulula omakulukuma gasho.

Ongame ngoka tandi lombwele efuta te ti:
‘Pwina; otandi ka kukutika omilonga dhoye.’

Otandi popi Kores te ti:
‘Oye omuntu gwandje,
oye ta gwanitha elalakano lyandje alihe.’
Ota ka tya: ‘Jerusalem nashi tungululwe,’
nokotempeli: ‘Omukanka nagu tamekwe.’ ”
45:
Omuwa okwa hogolola Kores a ninge omukwaniilwa!
Okwa mu gwayeke a sinde iigwana;
ote mu tumu, a kuthe aakwaniilwa kiipundi yawo.
Omuwa ote ke mu egululila iiyelo yiilando.
Omuwa ota lombwele Kores ta ti:

“Ongame mwenemwene tandi ku palele ondjila,
tandi yelekanitha oondundu niikulundundu.
Otandi ka teya po omiyelo dhiiyela iikushu
tandi tatula iiyedhilitho yadho yiiyela.

Otandi ke ku pa omaliko gomomilema
nuuyamba womomahala gomeholamo.
Oto ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael
ngoka nde ku ithana edhina lyoye.

Otandi ku langeke po, u kwathe oshigwana shandje Israel,
oluvalo lwaJakob ndoka nda hogolola.
Onde ku pe esimano enene,
nando owa li inoo tseya ndje.

“Ongame Omuwa; kaku na kalunga gulwe.
Otandi ke ku pa oonkondo ndhoka to pumbwa,
nando ngoye ino tseya ndje.

Otandi shi ningi,
opo shaa ngoka kooha dhuuyuni sigo okooha oonkwawo
a kale e shi shi kutya ongame Omuwa
nokaku na we kalunga gulwe.

Otandi ka gandja esindano tali zi kegulu ngomvula;
evi otali ke li taamba
notali ka tsapuka emanguluko nuuyuuki.
Ongame, Omuwa, tandi ka ningitha mbika.”

Oshuma sheloya otashi vulu tuu shi tamanane nomuhongi gwasho,
oshuma sho inaashi fa iikwawo ayihe?
Eloya otali pula tuu omuhongi gwiiyuma shoka ta ningi?
Oshiyuma otashi tamanana tuu kutya omuhongi gwasho ke na uunkulungu?

Ope na tuu ngoka ta vulu okulombwela he kutya owa valela ndje shike?
Nenge a tye kuyina, owa pulumuthile ndje shike?

Omuwa omuyapuki, Kalunga kaIsrael omushiti gwe,
oye tuu ngoka tu utha onakuyiwa.
Ota ti: “Kamu na uuthemba, mu pule ndje aana yandje
nenge mu lombwele ndje shoka ndi na okuninga!

Ongame awike ngoka nda shiti evi
nonda shitile ko aantu ya kale ko.
Koonkondo dhandje onda alele egulu;
otandi enditha etango, omwedhi noonyothi.

Ongame mwene nda pendutha Kores
a gwanithe elalakano lyandje,
a longe uuyuuki.
Otandi ukitha ondjila kehe te ende nayo.
Ota ka tungulula oshilando shandje Jerusalem
nota mangulula aantu yandje aapongekwa.
Kape na ngoka e mu futu sha
nenge e mu pe oombumbo ando, opo e shi ninge.”
Omuwa Omunankondoawike oye e shi popi.

Omuwa ota popi ta ti:
“Uuyamba waEgipiti neliko lyaEtiopia otali ningi lyoye.
Aalumentu aaleeleka yokuSeba otaa ka ninga aapika yoye;
otaye ke ku landula taye ende ye li momalyenge.
Otaye ku inyongamene yo taa hempulula taa ti: Kalunga oku li shili nangoye,
oye awike, nokaku na we kalunga gulwe.

Kalunga kaIsrael, ngoka a kulile aantu ye,
oye Kalunga ngoka hi iholeke.

Oomboka tayi iningile iimenka, otaa ka sithwa ohoni;
ayehe yomuyo otaa ka gugwa.

Okwa shiti egulu
oye awike Kalunga!
Oye a tholoma evi e te li umbu,
okwe li pameke noku li kalitha ko.
Ine li shita li mbugale,
ihe ehala lyokukala aantu.
Oye tuu nguka ta ti: “Ongame Omuwa,
nokaku na kalunga gulwe.

Inandi popya meholamo
nenge ndi holeke elalakano lyandje.
Inandi lombwela oluvalo lwaJakob:
‘Kongii ndje powalawala.’
Ongame Omuwa te popi oshili;
tandi holola uuyuuki.”

Omuwa ota popi ta ti:
“Gongaleni, ileni, hedheni pamwe,
aahupiko yomiigwana;
holokeni koompangu!
Aantu mboka kaaye shi sha,
otayi iholola niimenka yawo yiiti
notaa galikana ookalunga mboka itaa vulu oku ya hupitha.

Ileni, mu tule iihokolola yeni moompangu;
etheni aapopili ya pulathane omayele.
Olye a hunganekele nale shoka tashi ka ningwa?
Hangame Omuwa, Kalunga ngoka ta kulile aantu ye?
Kaku na kalunga gulwe.

Galukileni kungame ngashingeyi mu hupithwe,
ne aantu yomuuyuni auhe!
Ongame awike Kalunga, kaku na gulwe.

Omauvaneko gandje ogoshili,
noitaga ka lunduluka nando.
Otandi uvaneke nokugana pungame mwene
kutya shaa ngoka ote ke ya noti inyongamene koshipala shandje
nokusimaneka ndje.

“Otaa ka hempulula kutya esindano noonkondo
otadhi monika mungame awike;
ihe ayehe mboka ye tonde ndje,
otaa ka sa ohoni.

Ongame Omuwa tandi ka mangulula oluvalo aluhe lwaJakob,
oyo notaa ka hambelela ndje.”
46:
Ndika olyo ehulilo lyiimenka yaBabilon.
Bel naNebo oya li ya simanekwa nale,
ihe ngashingeyi otayi tsilikwa kuusino,
yi ninge omitsalo koombunda dhiinamwenyo ya loloka.

“Pulakenii ndje, ne oluvalo lwaJakob,
amuhe mboka mwa hupu ko yomoshigwana shaIsrael.
Onde mu dhiginine okuza kevalo lyeni.

Ongame Kalunga keni notandi mu gamene,
sigo tamu kulupa mu ninge oomvi.
Onde mu shiti notandi mu gamene;
otandi mu kwatha notandi mu hupitha.

“Otamu yeleke ndje nalye?
Oku na tuu ngoka a fa ndje?

Oyo taye shi itsike komapepe gawo e taye shi humbata;
otaye shi thikameke, sho itaashi vulu okwiinyenga.
Ngele ku na ngoka te shi galikana,
itashi vulu okuyamukula nenge shi mu hupithe muudhigu.

“Ne aalunde, dhimbulukweni shika;
shi konakoneni moomwenyo dheni, ne aanandumbo.

Okuza kontsapo onda hunganeke mbyoka tayi ya;
onalenale nda popi mbyoka tayi ka ningwa.
Onda tile, omadhiladhilo gandje itaga ka gwila pevi,
notii ka gwanitha ashihe nda hala oku shi ninga.

Otandi ithana omuntu e ye ta zi kuuzilo;
ota ka koloka ko a fa okakodhi
e ta gwanitha shoka nda dhiladhila.
Onda popi, notashi ka gwanithwa.

Pulakenii ndje, ne aatangalali,
one tuu mboka mwa kala kokule nuuyuuki.

Otandi eta esiku lyuuyuuki popepi,
kali li we kokule.
Ehupitho lyandje itali kankama we.
Otandi hupitha Sion
nokweetela Israel esimano.
47:
“Babilon, kuluka ko koshipangelapundi shoye,
kuutumba pevi montsi yevi.
Owa li nale wa fa omufuko,
oshilando ihaashi sindika,
ihe ku shi we omvalekele nomulelwa ondembula.
Ngashingeyi wa ningi omupika!

Kutha omuhi, nkwalula omunziya!
Isiikulula oshipala!
Hula mo utale ohema yoye ombwanawa!
Humina ohema yoye, u ka tokole omilonga!

Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki ote tu mangulula —
edhina lye Omuwa Omunankondoawike.

Owa dhiladhila u kale omunyekadhi aluhe.
Ino ipula niinima mbika
nenge u dhiladhile, nkene tayi ka hula po.

“Pulakena shika, ngoye omuholi gwiipala,
ngoka u li nawa e to ipopile to ti:
‘Ongame omunene nokaku na we.
Kandi na mpoka tandi ningi omuselekadhi
nenge ndi kale ndaa na oluvalo.’

Ihe ohaluka yowala, mesiku limwe
iinima mbika ayihe tayi ka ningwa.
Nando ou na oonganga odhindji noompulile ku mana,
omusamane gwoye oto ke mu kanitha,
oye pamwe naamwoye.

“Owa kala wa hokwa uuwinayi woye;
owa dhiladhila kutya kape na ngoka te ku mono.
Owa pukithwa koondunge nokuunongo woye.
Owi ipopile wa ti: ‘Ongame kalunga,
kaku na we gulwe a fa ndje.’

Oshiponga otashi ku ya,
nokaku na onganga tayi vulu oku shi kodheka.
Ehanagulo otali ku adha ohaluka —
ehanagulo inoo li yaguma nale.

Holoka noonganga noompulile dhoye,
ndhoka wa li ho anekelitha okuza muugundjuka woye.
Pamwe otadhi ke ku kwatha ngaa;
pamwe to ka halutha tuu aatondi yoye.

Owi ilolokitha nomayele gaagandjindunge yoye oyendji.
Aakonekinyothi yoye naa holoke po, opo ye ku hupithe —
aantu mboka haa koneke oonyothi,
mboka haa konenene oshipala shegulu,
naye ku lombwele omwedhi nomwedhi
shoka tashi ku ningilwa.

“Otaa ka fa etutu,
nomulilo otagu ke ya lungunitha po!
Itaa ka vula nando okwiihupitha.
Omalaka gomulilo otage ke ya latha po,
kagu shi omulilo gwokuhuhulukwa.

Mbika ayihe otaye yi ku ningile,
oomboka mwa longele kumwe nayo okuza kuugundjuka woye.
Shaa ngoka gwomuyo oti iyukile,
kaku na ngoka ta vulu oku ku hupitha.”
48:
Pulakeneni ndhika, ne oluvalo lwaJakob,
one tuu mboka tamu tiwa Israel,
ne yomoludhi lwaJuda,
one mboka hamu gana medhina lyOmuwa
e tamu ithana Kalunga kaIsrael —
ihe itamu shi ningi moshili nomuuyuuki.

Otamu iluku aanashilando oshiyapuki
nomwi itula Kalunga kaIsrael,
ngoka edhina lye Omuwa Omunankondoawike.

Onda tseya kutya ngoye omutangalali,
omathenga goye ga fa ga ningwa mosheela
noshipala shoye omoshikushu.

Onde ku hunganekele nale onakuyiwa yoye,
nda tomona iiningwanima, manga inaayi ningwa,
opo waa tye, iimenka yoye niiyelekela yoye oye yi eta po.

“Ayihe nde yi popile, oya gwanithwa.
Zimina ashike kutya omahunganeko gandje oge li mondjila.
Ngashingeyi otandi ku lombwele iinima iipe tayi ke ya,
iiholekwa mbyoka inoo yi tseya nale.

Ongashingeyi owala tandi yi longo,
kape na shimwe sha fa shika sha ningilwe nale.
Ngele nani oya ningilwe, oto vulu okutya owe yi tseya nale.

Ondi shi shi kutya ngoye ku shi omwiinekelwa,
ngoye hela wa kala omupandala.
Omolwasho ino uva iinima mbika nale,
omolwasho kaku na nando ohapu yimwe ya yile momakutsi goye.

“Ongame omutalanteni omolwedhina lyandje mwene.
Opo aantu ya pandule ndje,
otandi kankeke ondjahi yandje.
Onde yi lotitha, ndaaye ku hanagule po.

Onde ku yeleke momulilo gwomahepeko,
ongoshisiliveli tashi hemuninwa montelekelo.
Ihe onda dhimbulula kutya ngoye ogwowala nani.

Shoka tandi shi ningi,
otandi shi ningi molwandje mwene.
Itandi ka etha nando, edhina lyandje li shekwe,
nenge esimano lyandje li ye kugulwe.

“Pulakena ndje, oluvalo lwaJakob,
Israel, ngoye ngoka nde ku ithana.
Ongame Kalunga, omutango nomuhugunini,
Kalunga awike tuu ti.

Oshikaha shandje osha dhike evi,
nolulyo lwandje lwa alele egulu.
Sho ndi ithana evi neyalelo,
oya holoka po polumwe yo yene.

“One amuhe gongaleni, ne mu pulakene!
Oku na tuu kalunga, ngoka a hunganeke kutya
omuntu ngoka nda hogolola, ota ka homona Babilon?
Ota ka ninga shoka nda hala e shi ninge.

Ongame awike nda popi nonde mu ithana;
onde mu pititha mo e tandi mu pe elago.

Ngashingeyi hedheni kungame, mu uve shoka tandi ti:
‘Okuza ketameko inandi popya meholamo.
Oko nda li okuza kethimbo ndyoka mbika tayi ningwa.’ ”
(Ngashingeyi Omuwa Omupangeliawike okwa tumu ndje pamwe nOmbepo ye.)

Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki,
Omuwa omukulili gwoye ota ti:
“Ongame Omuwa Kalunga koye,
ngoka tii ku longele shoka she ku opalela
noku ku ulukila ondjila u na okweenda nayo.

Oluvalo lwoye otalu indjipala lwa fa omawe gehekevi,
naamwoye ongoomuma tadhi nyenge okuyalulwa.
Edhina lyawo itali ka kana,
itandi ke ya hanagula po.”

Pitii mo muBabilon,
tembukii mo muKaldea!
Igidheni onkundana yenyanyu;
yi tseyithileni apehepehe tamu ti:
“Omuwa a hupitha oshigwana she Israel!”

Omuwa sho e enditha aantu ye
mombuga ya kalanda noyomutenya, oya li inaa sa enota.
Okwe ya kuthile omeya memanya:
okwa panda emanya, omeya noga tondoka mo.

Omuwa ota ti:
“Aakaanakalunga kaye na nando ombili.”
49:
Pulakenii ndje, ne aantu yokoontuntu dhomefuta,
ne iigwana yokokulekule!
Omuwa okwa hogolola ndje, manga inaandi valwa;
okwa tumbula edhina lyandje, manga nda li mekolo lyameme.

Okwa upike oohapu dhandje, dhi tse dha fa egongamwele.
Okwa gamene ndje noshikaha she mwene,
okwa ningi ndje oshikuti sha yagwa,
e ta holeke ndje mombalukutu ye.

Onda ti: “Onda longo, ihe osima yowala.
Onda mana mo oonkondo dhandje, ihe inashi tompola sha.”
Ihe natango tuu tandi inekele Omuwa ta popile ndje;
ota ka futa ndje ondjambi yiilonga yandje.

Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti:
“Ngoye omupiya gwandje, inashi ku gwanena,
nge to galula owala omazimo gaJakob
noto eta ko oonakuhupa yaIsrael.
Otandi ku ningi uuyelele waapagani,
ehupitho lyandje opo li thike nokooha dhuuyuni.”

Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki nomuhupithi
ota ti kungoka a dhinikika,
ngoka e tondike kiigwana
nokwa ningi omupika gwaapangeli:
“Aakwaniilwa otaa ka mona, sho to manguluka
notaa ka thikama ye ku simaneke;
aawa otaye ke shi tala
notaa ka tsa oongolo, ye ku tumbaleke.”
Shika otashi ka ningwa,
oshoka Omuwa okwa hogolola omupiya gwe;
Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki
oha dhiginine omauvaneko ge.

Omuwa ota lombwele aantu ye ta ti:
“Ethimbo lyo opala onde ku uvu,
nethimbo lyehupitho onde ku kwatha.
Otandi ku dhiginine nomungoye tandi hangana niigwana.
Otandi ke ku tula ishewe mevi ndyoka lya mbugala ngashingeyi.

Otandi lombwele oonkwatwa te ti:
‘Mangulukeni!’
naamboka ya kala momilema:
‘Zii mo, mu ye muuyelele!’
Otaa ka fa oonzi tadhi napa koondundu;

itaa ka sa we ondjala nenge enota.
Etango nepupyu lyombuga itali ya hepeke,
oshoka otaa ka endithwa komuhepuluthi gwawo.
Ote ke ya fala komatope gomeya.

“Otandi ka ninga onenendjila ya tokola moondundu
nokupalela aantu yandje epola lyokweenda mo.

Tala, aantu yandje otaa ya taa zi komakule.
Otaa zi kuumbangalantu nokuuninginino,
nokevi lyaAswan muumbugantu.”

Imbeni, ne omagulu!
Kugilila kenyanyu, ngoye evi!
Oondundu nadhi mbolongondjithe omaimbilo!
Omuwa ota hekeleke aantu ye;
ote ehamenwa okuhepekwa kwaantu ye.

Ihe Aajerusalem oya ti:
“Omuwa okwe tu etha!
Oye e tu dhimbwa.”

Omuwa ota yamukula ta ti:
“Ope na tuu omwali ta dhimbwa okahanona ke,
a kale kee hole ando omunona e mu vala?
Nonando nee yina a dhimbwe omwana,
ngame itandi ku dhimbwa.

Tala, omiikaha yandje nde ku negele.
Tala, omeke lyandje nda nyolela edhina lyoye,
omadhingililokuma goye, Jerusalem,
oge li aluhe momeho gandje.

“Aamwoye otaa ya nziya,
naamboka ye ku mbugaleke, otaa shuna.

Yelutha omeho goye,
ngoye u ligamene koombinga noombinga.
Aantu yoye otaa kongoloka, otaye ya kegumbo!
Oshili ngaashi ndi na omwenyo,
oto ka kala u na uuntsa omolwaantu yoye,
wa fa omufuko a zala iimona ye.

“Oshilongo shoye osha li sha teka po nosha ninga eputu,
ihe ngashingeyi otashi ka ninga oshishona kaantu mboka taa ka kala mo.
Naamboka ye ku hepeke nale,
otaa ka kala kokule nangoye.

Aamwoye ya valelwa muupongekwa,
otaye ke ku lombwela taa ti:
‘Oshilongo shika oshishona unene,
otatu pumbwa ehala lyokukala!’

Nena oto ki ipopila to ti:
‘Akwetu, aanona mboka ayehe olye e ya valele ndje?
Onda li omuntimbe noinandi mona oluvalo.
Onda li omupongekwa nomweekelwahi —
olye a putudha aanona mbaka?
Onda li po awike —
aanona mbaka oya zi peni?’ ”

Omuwa Omupangeliawike ota ti ngeyi:
“Tala, otandi ka lapa aapagani,
otandi ka yeluthila iigwana ombaaneli yandje;
otaa ka eta aamwoye aamati ye ya ukata,
notaa humbata aamwoye aakadhona komapepe gawo.

Aakwaniilwa otaa ka ninga aatekuli yoye;
naanyekadhi otaa ka ninga aayamuthi yoye.
Otaye ke ku inyongamena ya tsa iipala yawo mevi,
notaa ka latha ontsi koompadhi dhoye.
Nena oto ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa.
Mboka taa inekele ndje nokwiifupipika,
itaa ka sa ohoni.

Oto vulu tuu okuyuga aakwiita iihakanwa yawo?
Oto vulu tuu okuyugulula ko oonkwatwa miikaha yofule?”

Omuwa ota yamukula ta ti:
“Osho naanaa tashi ka ningwa.
Aakwiita otaa ka kuthwa oonkwatwa dhawo,
niihakanwa yoofule otayi ka yugwa ko.
Otandi ka kondjitha kehe ngoka te ku kondjitha,
notandi ka mangulula aamwoye.

Aahepeki yoye otandi ke ya litha onyama yawo yene.
Otaa ka kolwa kombinzi yawo yene ngashika komaviinu.
Aantu ayehe otaa ka tseya, ongame Omuwa,
ongame omuhupithi gwoye.
Omunankondo gwaJakob oye omukulili gwoye.”
50:
Omuwa ota ti:
“Otamu dhiladhila nda tidha po aantu yandje,
ya ye ngaashi omulumentu ta henge po omukadhi?
Ngele osho, ombapila yehengano oyi li peni?
Otamu dhiladhila nde mu landitha po muupika
nda fa omuntu ta landitha po oyana, ya ninge aapika?
Aawe, omwa yi muupongekwa omolwoondjo dheni yene;
omwa tidhwa po molwomayono geni.

“Omolwashike kaakwa li nando ogumwe, sho nde ya?
Omolwashike kaakwa li ngoka i itaale, sho ndi ithana?
Oshikaha shandje sha ningi oshifupi oku mu kwatha?
Onda pumbwa oonkondo, ndi mu mangulule?
Noshipango shandje otandi kukutike efuta,
nomilonga otandi dhi shitukitha ombuga.

Egulu otandi li zaleke onguwo onduudhe
e tandi li siikilitha oshako onduudhe.”

Omuwa Omupangeliawike
okwa longo ndje shoka ndi na okutya,
opo ndi koleke mboka ya gundila po.
Ongula kehe ota ladhipike ndje,
opo ndi uve shoka ta nongeke ndje.

Omuwa okwa thitulula omakutsi gandje.
Ngame inandi mu tinda, inandi shuna monima.

Ombunda yandje nde yi pe mboka ya dhenge ndje.
Ngame inandi ya kankeka, sho ya tuku ndje,
sho ya dhakagula oombenzi dhandje
noya hiyile ndje omayeye moshipala.

Omasheko gawo inaga alula ndje,
oshoka Omuwa Omupangeliawike oha kwatha ndje.
Ondi idhigupaleke, opo ndi ya idhidhimikile.
Onda tseya kutya itandi sithwa ohoni,

oshoka Kalunga a kala ndje popepi
noye tu utha ndje omuyuuki.
Olye ta tompele ndje uuwinayi?
Natu tongololathaneni!
Omutamaneki gwandje olye?
Oye na tsakaneke ndje!

Omuwa Omupangeliawike ota popile ndje.
Olye ihe ta tompele ndje uuwinayi?
Aatamaneki yandje ayehe otaa kana po;
otaa kulupa ya ninge iinyakwi ya lika koothithi.

Amuhe ne mboka hamu simaneke Omuwa
nohamu vulika kiipango yomupiya gwe,
epola ndyoka tamu ende, otali vulu okuluudha nayi,
ihe inekeleni Omuwa, ituleni muKalunga keni.

Amuhe mboka hamu pangele ompangela okuyonagula po yalwe,
otamu ka hanagulwa po koompangela dheni yene.
Omuwa oye mwene ta ka ninga ayihe mbika;
otamu ka hepekwa kuuwehame mboka wa tulwa po.
51:
Omuwa ota popi ta ti:
“Pulakenii ndje, one mboka mwa hala okuhupithwa,
ne mboka hamu kongo ekwatho kungame.
Taleni utale emanya moka mwa pandwa,
moshitapo shomamanya moka mwa hupwa.

Taleni hokulu Abraham,
nanyokokulu Sara, ngoka e mu vala.
Sho ndi ithana Abraham, ka li e na aanona,
ihe onde mu yambeke e tandi mu pe oluvalo;
oluvalo lwe onde lu indjipaleke.

“Otandi ka hepulutha Sion,
omakulukuma gasho agehe otii ke ga tala nohenda.
Ombuga yasho otii yi shitukitha Eden,
nomaputu gasho otii ga shitukitha oshikunino shOmuwa.
Otamu ka kala enyanyu neligolo,
oondjimbo dhepandulo nodhehambelelo.

“Pulakenii ndje, ne aantu yandje,
pakalekeni omakutsi geni, ne iigwana.
Otandi gandja omalongo gandje kiigwana;
oompango dhandje tadhi yi etele uuyelele.

“Pulakenii ndje, ne mboka mwa tseya uuyuuki,
ne mboka mwa pungula omalongo gandje moomwenyo dheni.
Inamu tila aantu, nge taye mu nyekele notaye mu nyeme,

oshoka oothithi otadhi ya li ya fa oonguwo,
noontuko tadhi ya mana po ya fa omafufu goonzi.
Ihe uuyuuki wandje kau na mpoka tau hulu po,
nesilohenda lyandje ohali kala sigo aluhe.”

Penduka po! Yambuka po!
Zala oonkondo, ngoye okwooko kwOmuwa.
Penduka po utale ngaashi muuyuni wonale, methimbo lyomapipi gonale.
Hangoye ngoka wa tetagula Rahab iintimbu,
oongoka wa ulula oshikoko?

Ongoye tuu ngoka wa pwinike efuta
nowa pala epola mokati komeya omanene,
opo aakulilwa yoye ye ende puukukutu.

Aakulilwa yOmuwa otaa ka galuka, taa ya kuSion nokuligola,
nenyanyu lyaaluhe otali adhima miipala yawo.
Oya adhika kenyanyu neligolo,
oya manguluka moluhodhi nomeyemato.

Omuwa ota ti:
“Ongame, eeno, ongame mwene handi mu hekeleke.
Otamu vulu ngiini okukala mwa tila omuntu omusi,
omuna gwomuntu, ngoka a fa omwiidhi tagu ganya?

Omwa dhimbwa Omuwa, omushiti gweni,
ngoka a alele egulu nokwa dhike omakankameno gevi?
Omolwashike tamu kala mwa tila ondjahi yaahepeki yeni,
mboka ya hala ye mu yone po?
Ondjahi yawo itayi mu adha we.

“Ongame Omuwa Kalunga keni;
otandi tukulutha efuta
e tandi tutumike omakuthikuthi galyo.
Edhina lyandje Omunankondoawike.

Onda alele egulu nonda dhike omakankameno gevi.
Otandi lombwele Sion tandi ti:
‘One aantu yandje!
Onde mu longo omalongo gandje
notandi mu gamene noshikaha shandje.’ ”

Jerusalem, penduka po!
Iyelutha u yambuke po!
Owa nu oshitenga shegeelo
shoka Omuwa mondjahi ye e shi ku pe, u shi nwe.
Owe shi tula kekothi, notashi ku tantalitha.

Kaku na ngoka te ku enditha,
kaku na gulwe mokati kaantu yoye te ku kwatele komeho.

Iiponga yopaali ye ku lambele:
oshilongo shoye osha mbugalekwa kiita,
naantu yoye ya si po kondjala.
Kape na nando ogumwe e ku uvitile ohenda.

Aamwoye aamati oya lala yi iyekelela poshikololo shepandaanda kehe,
ya fa ohumba ya gwila mekelo.
Oyu uvite ondjahi yOmuwa
nomagando gaKalunga koye.

Pulakena kushika,
muhepekwa ngoye ngoka wa kolwa, nando hakomaviinu.

Omuwa Kalunga koye ote ku popile nota ti:
“Otandi kutha po oshitenga shoka nde ku pele mondjahi yandje.
Ito ka nwa we omaviinu ngoka tage ku telaganitha.

Otandi ke ga nwetha mboka taye ku hepeke,
mboka taye ku langitha momapandaanda
notaye ku lyatagula wa fa iiyagaya.”
52:
Penduka po! Eeno, yambuka po,
Sion! Izaleka oonkondo!
Inzandula mo monguwo yoye yoshituthi, Jerusalem,
ngoye oshilando oshiyapuki!
Aafukolume naantu ya nyata itaa ka pita we miiyelo yoye.

Jerusalem, ipupula ontsi!
Yambuka mo montsi, u kuutumbe koshipangelapundi!
Idhitulula omalyenge mothingo yoye,
ngoye omukadhona onkwatwa Sion.
Omuwa ota lombwele aantu ye ta ti: “Sho mwa ningi aapika, inamu landwa niimaliwa; osho tamu ka mangululwa pwaa na ofuto yasha.
Aantu yandje oya yi tango kuEgipiti ya kale mo muundjendi; opo ihe Assur e ya kwata po koonkondo.
Nongashingeyi muBabilonia osha ningwa sha faathana: one aapongekwa noinamu kulilwa nasha. Mboka taye mu pangele, otayi itanga yo tayi inomo notaa sheke edhina lyandje aluhe.
Mesiku tali ya otamu ka tseya ndje kutya ongame Kalunga nonde shi mu lombwela.”

Oompadhi odho opala ngiini
dhaangoka te ya ta zi koondundu te eta onkundana ombwanawa,
tu uvitha ombili!
Ota tseyitha elaka etoye lyehupitho e ta ti kuSion:
“Kalunga koye oye omukwaniilwa!”

Pulakeneni!
Aalangeli yoshilando otaa yelutha omawi gawo,
oyo ayehe taa kugilile kenyanyu.
Oshoka oye wete Omuwa oshipala noshipala,
sho te ya ta galukile kuSion.

Nyanyukweni mu kugilile mokule,
ne omakulukuma gaJerusalem,
oshoka Omuwa ota hekeleke aantu ye,
okwa hupitha Jerusalem.

Omuwa ota longitha okwooko kwe okuyapuki
nota ka hupitha aantu ye,
nuuyuni auhe otau ke shi mona.

Zii mo muBabilon! Shi thigeni po!
Inamu guma tuu shoka sha nyata!
Iyoololeni mo musho ne mu iyapule,
ne aahumbati yiiyuma yOmuwa.

Itamu pumbwa okuza mo ompulukuta,
itamu zi mo ontuku,
oshoka Omuwa ote mu tetekelele,
Kalunga kaIsrael te mu wilike.

Oyendji oya li ye mu halukila,
oshoka olupe lwe olwa li lwa shituka,
inalu fa we lwaantu;
ondjelo ye oya tutuka,
inayi fa we yaana yaantu.

Ihe iigwana oyindji otayi mu kuminwa,
naakwaniilwa otaye mu tsile omazima ya kumwa,
oshoka otaa ka tseya sha inaaye shi hokololelwa nale,
notaa ka uva ko shoka inaaye shi uva nale.
53:
Olye i itaale shoka twa uvithilwa?
Nokwooko kwOmuwa okwa hololelwa lye?

Okwa kokele montaneho yOmuwa a fa oshitutuma,
a fa oshimpona shomevi lya kalanda.
Ka li e na olupe nenge ondjelo,
sho twe mu tala.
Ka li e na eopalo, tu mu hokwe ando.

Okwa li a dhinwa nokwe ekelwahi kaantu,
omulumentu gwomahepeko nomuvuntu.
Okwa li a fa ngoka aantu ye mu isiikilile iipala yawo,
yaaye mu tale.
Okwa li a dhinwa, natse inatu mu simaneka nando.

Oshili, okwi itsike uuvu wetu,
nuuwehame wetu e u humbata.
Otwe mu tala a dhengwa kuKalunga,
a geelwa nokwa hepekwa.

Ihe okwa tsuwa omolwomayono getu
nokwa nyanyagulilwa oondjo dhetu.
Egeelo olye mu ya, opo tu mone ombili,
notwa aludhwa kiilalo ye.

Otse atuhe twa pukile twa fa oonzi,
noshaa ngoka okwi iyukile nepola lye mwene.
Ihe Omuwa okwe mu tsike oondjo dhetu atuhe.

Okwa hepekwa nokwa monithwa iihuna,
ihe ina makula okana ke.
Ongaashi onzigona tayi falwa koshidhipagelo,
ongonzi tayi mwenenene omukululi gwayo,
osho naye wo ina makula okana ke.

Okwa kuthwa po a thiminikwa nokwa pangulwa,
ihe olye gwomepipi lye e shi dhiladhila?
Oshoka okwa kuthwa mo mevi lyaanamwenyo;
Omolwomayono goshigwana shandje okwa adhika kegeelo.

Okwa pewa ombila ye paakolokoshi,
ihe okwa fumvikwa pomuyamba,
oshoka oye ina yona sha
nokwa li kee na iifundja mokana ke.

Ihe olya li ehalo lyOmuwa
oku mu nyanyula noku mu etela uuwehame.
Eso lye olyo eyonondjambo,
nota ka mona ko oluvalo lwe.
Ehalo lyOmuwa otali gwanithwa muye.

Konima yomahepeko gomwenyo gwe
ota ka kala ishewe menyanyu;
ota ka tseya kutya nani ina hepekwa osima yowala.
Omupiya gwandje omuyapuki ota ka humbata egeelo lyoyendji,
nomolwe otandi ya dhimine po.

Onkee ano otandi ke mu pa oshitendelwa mokati kaawa,
oye nota ka topola iihakanwa pamwe naanankondo;
oshoka omwenyo gwe okwe gu yambele meso,
nokwa yalulilwa maakolokoshi.
Okwa humbata po oondjo dhoyendji
nokwa galikanene aayonaguli.
54:
Ligola, ngoye omuntimbe,
ngoye ngoka inoo vala!
Kugilila nokunyanyukwa newi lyopombanda, ngoye ngoka inoo thetwa,
oshoka Omuwa ota ti,
omuthigwapo oku na oyana oyendji ye vule aana yomuhokanwa.

Oto ka taandelitha oongamba dhoye koombinga adhihe.
Oluvalo lwoye otalu ka lala iilongo mbyoka iigwana yilwe yi yi na ngashingeyi.
Iilando ya mbugala otayi ka udha aantu.

Ino tila — ito ka sithwa we ohoni; ito ka fupipikwa we.
Oto ka dhimbwa ohoni yomuufuko woye,
noito dhimbulukwa we ezaza lyomuuselekadhi woye.

Omushiti gwoye oye omusamane gwoye,
Omuwa Omunankondoawike olyo edhina lye.
Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki ote ku hupitha —
oye omupangeli gwuuyuni auhe.

Israel, owa fa omufuko e ethiwa komulume
noku li moluhodhi olululu.
Ihe Omuwa ote ku ithana,
u galuke ta ti:

“Onde ku etha okathimbo okashona,
ihe otandi ku galula nesilohenda enene.

Muupyundjahi onde ku iholeke oshipala shandje okathimbo,
ihe otandi ku sile ohenda hayi kalelele.”
Omuwa omukulili gwoye osho ta ti.

“Muuyuni waNoa ondu uvaneke kutya
efundja lyaa ye ko we kombanda yevi.
Ngashingeyi otandi uvaneke,
ndaaye ku geele we nomagandambadhi nenge ndi ku dhenge.

Oondundu nando odhi dhikuke po,
niikulundundu nando oyi kakame,
esilohenda lyandje itali ku thigi po,
nuukuume wetu nangoye itau teka po.”
Omuwa naku ku silohenda osho ta ti.

Omuwa ota ti:
“Omunamupya ngoye, omutelaganithwa kiikungulu
nopwaa na ngoka e ku hekeleke!
Otandi ku tungulula nooagate,
nomakankameno goye noosafire.

Ooshungo dhoye otandi dhi tungulula noorubini,
omiyelo dhoye nookristali,
nedhingililokuma nomamanya gondilo.

“Ongame mwene tandi ka longa aantu yandje,
notandi ya pe elago nombili.

Eutho nuuyuuki otau ke ku koleka.
Uukolokoshi otau ka kala kokule nangoye,
ito pumbwa okutila.
Omahalutho oga gamuka ko, itage ku hedha popepi.

“Tala, ongame nda shiti omuhambudhi,
ngoka ta pepele omupepo ta hambula iikuti.
Ongame nda shiti wo omukwiita,
ngoka ta longitha omatati a dhipage.

Oshikondjitho kehe tashi hambulwa shi ku kondjithe,
itashi tompola sha.
Nelaka kehe tali ku tamaneke,
oto li tompele ondjo.
Otandi ka popila aapiya yandje
e tandi ya pe esindano.”
Omuwa oye a popi.
55:
Ileni, amuhe mboka mwa sa enota,
ileni huka komeya!
Naamboka mwaa na iimaliwa,
ileni, landeni mu lye!
Ileni, landeni omaviinu nomahini;
itayi gu sha.

Omolwashike iimaliwa yeni tamu yi gandjele iinima ihaayi kutitha?
Omolwashike tamu tula oondjambi dheni miinima ihaayi mu kutha ondjala?
Uvii ndje, opo mu lye iikulya yuuyamba,
noomwenyo dheni otadhi ka kutithwa kuutoye.

Pulakeneni, ne mu ye kungame
notamu kala mu na omwenyo!
Otandi ka hangana nane ehangano lyaaluhe
notandi mu pe omayambeko ngeyaka ndu uvanekele David.

Tala, onda lenge David omuwiliki nondjayi yiigwana,
nomuye onde yi ulukile oonkondo dhandje.

Oshili, oto ka ithana iigwana yaakwiilongo inoo yi tseya,
niigwana mbyoka inaayi ku tseya,
otayi ke ku endelela po,
oshoka Omuwa Kalunga koye, Omuyapuki Kalunga kaIsrael,
oye e ku pe esimano

Kongeni Omuwa, manga ta monika,
ne mu mu ithane, manga e li popepi.

Omukeenakalunga ne ethe oondjila dhe,
nomukolokoshi omadhiladhilo ge.
Na galukile kOmuwa Kalunga ketu,
ngoka te mu sile ohenda e te mu kuthile po.

Omuwa ota ti:
“Omadhiladhilo gandje kage shi omadhiladhilo geni,
noondjila dhandje kadhi shi oondjila dheni.

Ongaashi egulu li li pombanda puule li vule evi,
osho wo oondjila dhandje dhi vule oondjila dheni,
nomadhiladhilo gandje ge vule omadhiladhilo geni.

“Eeno, ngashika omvula nomume tayi gu kegulu
noitayi shuna inaayi tutika evi
noku li menitha iimeno noku yi kokitha,
yi ete ombuto komukuni niikulya yokulya,

osho wo oohapu dhandje tadhi zi mokana kandje.
Itadhi galukile kungame owala
inaadhi gwanitha ehalo lyandje;
otadhi tsakanitha elalakano ndyoka nde dhi li tumine.

“Eeno, otamu ka tembuka mo nenyanyu
notamu ka thindikilwa nombili.
Oondundu niikulundundu otayi ka tanta nokuligola pombanda,
nomiti adhihe dhokelundu otadhi ka hakela nomake gadho.

Omikiperesi otadhi ka mena pokuma pwa li hapu mene omano,
nomiti omimirte opokuma hapu mene oondjoho.
Shika otashi ka ningila Omuwa esimano,
endhindhiliko lyaaluhe ndyoka itaali ka dhimwa po nando.”
56: Omuwa ota popi ta ti: “Dhiginineni oshili ne mu longe shoka shu uka, oshoka otandi ya ndi mu hupithe mbala.
Otandi ka yambeka mboka haa dhiginine Esabati aluhe noihaye li longitha pombambo. Otandi ka yambeka ayehe mboka ihaa longo uuwinayi.”

Omukwiilongo ngoka e li maantu yOmuwa, ina tya: “Omuwa ita pitika ndje, ndi mu longele pamwe naantu ye.”
Omulumentu ngoka a thonwa, ina dhiladhila kutya sho itaa vulu okuvala, ita vulu okukala maantu yaKalunga.
Molwaashika Omuwa ota ti: “Omuthonwantu ngoka ta yapula Esabati lyandje, ngoka a hogolola shoka sho opalela ndje nota dhiginine ehangano lyandje,
edhina lye otandi li dhimbulukwa motempeli yandje nomokati kaantu yandje shi vulithe e na aanona aamati naakadhona. Ita ka dhimbiwa nando.”
Omuwa ota lombwele aakwiilongo mboka ya ningi yomaantu ye, mboka ye mu hole notaye mu longele, mboka taa yapula Esabati notaa dhiginine ehangano lye nawa, ta ti:

“Otandi ke mu fala kuSion, ondundu yandje ondjapuki, otandi mu nyanyudhile mongulu yandje yomagalikano notandi taamba omafikilondjambo noontselelandjambo tamu dhi yamba koshiyambelo shandje. Otempeli yandje otayi ka ithanwa ongulu yokugalikanena yaantu yomiigwana ayihe.”
Omupangeliawike Omuwa Omunankondoawike ngoka te eta aantu ye Aaisraeli kegumbo taa zi muupongekwa, okwa uvaneke kutya ota ka kongolola wo aantu yalwe ya kale puyo.
Ne iigwana yaakwiilongo, ileni ngaashi iiyamakuti mu lye aantu yOmuwa.
Aalangeli ayehe yaIsrael oyo aaposi, kaye uvite ko sha. Oyo ayehe oombwa oombolo, itadhi vulu okugwedha. Otadhi galauka tadhi yaguma, odhi hole oomposi.
Oya fa oombwa dha lumba, ihadhi kuta. Aawiliki osho ye li. Kaye uvite ko sha. Shaa ngoka ota ningi ngaashi a hala nota kongo ashike eliko lye mwene.
Otaa igidhathana taa ti: “Ileni, tu peni omaviinu, otatu ka kolwa komalovu! Esiku lyangula otali ka kala lya fa lyonena, nenge tu tye li vule po nokuli.”
57: Omuyuuki ota yonuka po, nokaku na omuntu te shi dhiladhila momwenyo gwe. Aakaanakalunga otaa kuthwa po, nokaku na ngoka te shi pula, oshoka otaa kuthwa po, opo ya hupithwe muuwinayi.
Mboka ye ende muuyuuki, otaa yi mombili; otaa mono evululuko, sho taa lala meso.
Ihe ne, aamati aana yompulile onkiintu, oluvalo lwomuhondeli nolwanakuhola iipala, ileni huka.
Olye ngoka tamu mu sheke? Olye tamu nyonkele notamu mu yedhele mo omalaka geni? Ne kamu shi omahe gaanandumbo noluvalo lwaafundja?
Otamu longele iikalunga yoluvalo, sho tamu nikula momizile dhoomwandi nodhomuti kehe omutalala. Ohamu dhipaga nokuyamba aana yeni momasilu nomomakolombongo gomamanya.

Ohamu kutha omamanya gongolonga momasilu e tamu ga simaneke ga fa ookalunga. Ohamu ga tile omaviinu ga ninge iinuwandjambo e tamu ga etele oondjambo dhiikulya. Otamu dhiladhila kutya onda panda iinima mbyono?
Ohamu londo koondundu oondeendeka mu ka yambe omafikilondjambo nokukala moluhondelo.

Iiyelekela yeni yoshipagani omwe yi tula piiyelo meni lyomagumbo geni. Otamu iteka ndje, sho tamu ihula oonguwo dheni noku ka lala naaholi yeni koontala dheni dha tamununwa. Omwi ilandele ookuume, opo ya kutithe uuhalu weni nomwa tala omapenge gawo.
Omwa gwaya omugwayo nomagadhi guutiko e tamu yi mu ka longele Molek. Opo mu vule okumona iikalunga mu yi longele, omwa tumu aatumwa kokule, sigololo okuuyuni wokuusi.
Omwa vulwa komaendagulo geni, ihe inamu tya nando: “Otatu shi etha.” Omwa dhiladhila uuholume wiimenka otau mu koleke noitamu ka nkundipala we.
Iikalunga mbika iishike ye mu tilitha, opo mu lombwele ndje iifundja nomu dhimbwe ndje thiluthilu? Omwe etha okulongela ndje, sho nde mu mwenene ethimbo ele?
Otamu dhiladhila kutya shoka tamu ningi oshu uka, ihe ngame otandi holola iikala yeni, niikalunga yeni itayi vulu nando oku mu kwatha.
Sho tamu yi kugile ekwatho, nayi mu hupithe! Epepo lyombepo otali yi pepe po! Ihe mboka yi inekela ndje, otaa ka kala ye na omwenyo moshilongo notaa ka longela ndje motempeli yandje.
Otaku ka tiwa: “Kokoleni, opalekeni mu pale ondjila. Etheni aantu yandje ye ye kungame. Kandulii po iipundukitho mondjila.

“Ongame Kalunga omuyapuki gwokombandambanda, ngoka ndi na omwenyo aluhe sigo aluhe. Onda kala kombandambanda muuyapuki, ihe onda kala wo paantu mboka yi ifupipika noyi itedhulula, opo ndi talaleke oomwenyo dhaaifupipiki nokuhekeleka omitima dha nyanyagulwa.
Oshoka ihandi tamanana aluhe noihandi geye aluhe. Ando osho ngeyi, ando ombepo tayi gundile po koshipala shandje, omwenyo ngoka nde gu shiti.
Onde ya geelele ondjo yawo yolwiho; onde ya dhenge e tandi ya etha. Ihe yo oya tangalala noya lambalala oondjila dhawo yene.
“Onda mona, nkene taa longo, ihe otandi ya aludha. Otandi ya enditha notandi ya kwatha. Otandi ka talaleka mboka taa lili.
Ote gandja ombili kwaayehe, kumboka yopopepi noyokokule. Otandi panga aantu yandje.
Ihe aakaanakalunga oya fa efuta lya tukuluka. Omakuthikuthi galyo inaga hala nando okulotela notaga fulukitha mo enono nontopo.”
Kalunga kandje ota ti: “Aakaanakalunga kaye na nando ombili.”
58: Igidha mokule, ino mwena! Yelutha ewi lyoye lya fa lyenkuma. Hololela Israel oondjo dhe, naana yaJakob omayono gawo.

Oshoka esiku nesiku oyo taa kongo ndje; oya fa ye na uulaadhi okutseya oondjila dhandje, oya fa oshigwana hashi longo uuyuuki noinashi etha iipango yaKalunga kasho. Otaa pula ndje omautho gu uka ya fa ye na uulaadhi waKalunga e ye popepi nayo.

Otaa pula taa ti: “Omolwashike tatu idhilike iikulya, ngele Omuwa ine shi ndhindhilika? Omolwashike tatu kala twaa na iikulya, ngele ye ke na ko nasha?”
Omuwa ote ya lombwele ta ti: “Oshili oyo ndjika kutya pethimbo tamu idhilike iikulya, otamu ipyakidhile niinima yeni yene notamu hepeke aalongeli yeni.
Mokwiidhilika kweni iikulya otamu tamanana, tamu lokosha notamu kondjithathana. Otamu dhiladhila kutya ogwo omukalo gweidhiliko ngoka tagu pulakenitha ndje omagalikano geni?

Uuna tamu idhilike iikulya, otamu ihepeke tamu nyongameke omitse dheni pevi mwa fa omafo gomanenge notamu yala omahahi nokugunda omutoko, mu lale po. Olyo tamu ti eidhiliko ndyono? Otamu dhiladhila kutya otandi li hokwa?
“Eidhiliko lyiikulya ndyoka nde li hokwa, olyo ndi: Dhitululeni oongodhi dhuugoyoki, kutululeni oositolopa dhoondjoko ne mu mangulule aahepekwa. Teyeni po oondjoko adhihe.
Topoleleni aasindjala iikulya, edhilileni oondjendi oohepele momagumbo geni nokuzaleka aanankayi. Inamu tinda okukwatha aakweni.
“Nena uuyelele woye otau tende wa fa eluwa, niilalo yoye otayi ka aluka mbala. Omuhupithi gwoye ote ku kwatele komeho, neadhimo lyOmuwa otali ku gamene konima.

Nge to galikana, otandi ku zimine. Ngele to ithana ndje, otandi ku yamukula.
“Ngele to hulitha po omathiminiko, ondhino nomutyanayi kehe;
ngele to palutha aasindjala noto ningi nawa mboka ye li muuyina, nena uuyelele otau ku tendele nomilema dhe ku kunduka, otadhi ka shituka oshanga shomutenya.
Otandi ke ku wilika aluhe noku ku kutitha nuuwanawa. Otandi ke ku ninga ondjolowele wa kola nawa. Oto ka fa eyana lya kumwa nawa omeya, wa fa oluthithiya lwomeya ihaalu pwine.
Aatekulu yoye otaa ka tungulula omakulukuma gonale, otaa ka gongolola omatungo pomahala gago omakulu. Oto ka ithanwa omugongololi gwomakulukuma nomutungululi gwoondjila nomagumbo.”

Omuwa ota ti: “Ngele otamu dhiginine Esabati noitamu li yono nokwiipyakidhila niinima yeni yene mesiku lyandje eyapuki, ngele otamu simaneke Esabati olyo esiku lyenyanyu, esiku lya yapulilwa Omuwa, noitamu yi kolweendo nenge tamu longo sha nenge tamu popi oohapu dhiipolopolo,
Otamu ka mona enyanyu ndyoka tali zi mokulongela ndje. Otandi ke mu simanekitha muuyuni auhe, notamu ka nyanyukilwa oshilongo shoka nda pele hokulu Jakob. Ongame Omuwa, ongame tuu nda popi.”
59: Inamu dhiladhila kutya Omuwa ota nyengwa oku mu hupitha nenge a thita omakutsi kaa uve, sho tamu galikana.
Omolwomayono geni ite mu pulakene. Oondjo dheni odho dhe mu yoolola muKalunga keni, mwaa mone oshipala she.
Iikaha yeni oya tiligana ombinzi, noonyala dheni odha nika omayono. Omilungu dheni otadhi popi iifundja, nelaka lyeni otali nongona omagwaaleko.
Otamu yi koompangu, ihe kamu na uuyuuki. Otamu popile iifundja, opo mu kale nawa. Otamu ningi aasimba e tamu vala iihuna.
Otamu utumanene omayi goshikoko notamu tungu omawiiwili. Ngoka ta li omayi ngoka, ota si; nongele limwe tali tendulwa, otamu zi epili.
Omawiiwili kage shi kuzalwa, itamu vulu okwiisiikila nago. Iilonga yeni oyo iiwinayi, niikaha yeni oyu udha iikolokosha.
Aluhe otamu matukile okulonga uuwinayi notamu endelele okutilahi ombinzi yomukeenandjo. Omadhiladhilo geni oga goyoka; ehanagulo oli li momapola geni.
Itamu tseya ondjila yombili, nomoompadhi dheni kamu na uuyuuki. Omapola geni oga ngolyauka, nokape na ngoka e li mugo ta kala nombili.
Aantu otaa ti: “Ngashingeyi otu shi shi kutya omolwashike Kalunga itee tu hupitha miikaha yaamboka taye tu hepeke. Otwa tegamena uuyelele, ihe otatu lyanga momilema thokothoko.
Otatu pwampwauka twa fa aaposi. Otatu lontauka omutenya twa fa tu li muusiku ongashika muuyuni womilema dheso.
Otatu gono ngomamwanka, tatu kululula ngoonguti. Otatu kongo uuyuuki, ihe itatu u mono. Otwa hala emanguluko, ihe olya kala kokule.
“Omuwa, omayono getu ngoka twa yono kungoye, ogendjigendji. Oondjo dhetu otadhi tu tamaneke. Omayono getu otage tu landula notwa tseya iilonga yetu iiwinayi.
Otwa tsu ondumbo nangoye, otwe ku idhimbike notwa tindi oku ku landula. Otwa hepeke yalwe notwe ku pilamene. Meni lyetu otwa dhiladhila iifundja, nomakana getu oga popi iilombo.
Okutokola kwomondjila otaku pegulwa po, nuuyuuki itau vulu okuhedha ko. Oshili otayi goyokithwa montaneho, nuuyuuki itau gwanithwa nando.

Oshili oya pumba, naangoka te etha uuwinayi, ota yugwa.”
Omuwa okwe shi tala nokwa geye, sho kaku na uuyuuki.
Okwa tala nonkumwe kutya kakwa li nando oongoka ta kwatha aahepekwa. Omolwashoka ta longitha oonkondo dhe mwene, e ya mangulule noku ya pa esindano.
Ota zala uuyuuki wa fa ehuuyanza, nesindano lya fa egala lyosheela. Oti izaleke iikonene ya fa omutsuhu noti ikuwikile muulaadhi wa fa elwaakani.
Ota ka geela aatondi ye pailonga yawo, naamboka wo ya kala kokulekule.
Otaye ke mu tila okuza kuuzilo sigo okuuninginino. Shaa ngoka ota tila oonkondo dhe oonene. Ote ya a fa efundja lyomulonga, ta tsinuka ko a fa oshikungulu shombepo.
Omuwa ota lombwele aantu ye ta ti: “Otandi ke ya kuSion ndi mu popile nondi hupithe ayehe mboka yi itedhulula moondjo dhawo.

Otandi ka hangana nane. Onde mu tilile Ombepo yandje nonde mu pe oohapu dhandje, dhi kale pune sigo aluhe. Okuza mpaka otamu ka vulika kungame nokulonga aana yeni noluvalo lwawo lu vulike kungame aluhe sigo aluhe.”
60:
Thikama, yela,
oshoka uuyelele woye owa holoka,
neadhimo lyOmuwa otali ku tayimine noonte dhalyo.

Tala, omilema odha siikila evi
nuuluudhe thokothoko iigwana,
ihe Omuwa ota adhimine kombanda yoye,
nesimano lye otali ku minikile.

Iigwana otayi ke ya kuuyelele woye,
naakwaniilwa keminikilo lyeadhimo lyoye.

omwenyo gwoye otagu nyanyukwa nokushambukwa.
Uuyamba wokomafuta otau etwa kungoye,
aayamba yomiigwana otaa ya kungoye.

Iiyendo yoongamelo otayi ka napakana noshilongo sheni,
oongamelo oongundjuka dhokuMidian nokuEfa.
Adhihe otadhi zi kuSheba dha humbata oshingoli niitsinino.
Aantu notaa ka holola esimano lyOmuwa.

Oonzi adhihe dhokuKedar niikombo yokuNebaiot
otayi ka etwa kungoye,
yi ninge omafikilondjambo go opalela Omuwa.
Omuwa ota ka adhimitha otempeli ye shi vule shito.

Oolye mboka taa ya taa mweluluka ya fa iikogo,
noya fa oonguti tadhi ya kiihandhila yadho?

Otaku zi oosikepa tadhi ya tadhi zi koontuntu dhokokule,
tadhi eta aantu yaKalunga kegumbo.
Otadhi ya eta pamwe noshingoli noshisiliveli shawo,
opo ya simaneke edhina lyOmuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki,
ngoka a simanekitha iigwana, yo yi simaneke aantu ye.

Aakwiilongo otaa ka tungulula edhingililokuma lyoye.
Aakwaniilwa yawo otaa ku longele.
Onde ku geele mondjahi yandje,
ihe ngashingeyi otandi ku hololele ohole nesilohenda lyandje.

Iiyelo yoye otayi kala ye eguluka omutenya nuusiku,
opo aakwaniilwa yiigwana ye ku etele uuyamba wayo

Ihe iigwana mbyoka itaayi ku longele,
otayi ka hanagulwa po thilu.

Eopalo lyaLibanon otali ya kungoye.
Iipilangi yomikiperesi, yomisedeli noyomihongo
otayi ka etwa okwoopaleka nayo Jerusalem
nokupoleka otempeli yandje.

Aamati aana yaahepeki yoye
otaa ke ya yi isizimika meifupipiko.
Mboka ye ku dhini nale,
otaa ka nyongama poompadhi dhoye.
Otaye ke ku luka “Oshilando shOmuwa,”
“Sion, oshilando shaKalunga kaIsrael omuyapuki.”

Owa li oshilando she ethiwa nosha tondika,
nokapwa li ngoka a pitile mungoye.
Ihe otandi ke ku nenepeka noku ku opaleka,
oto ka ninga ehala lyenyanyu aluhe sigo aluhe.

Oto ka likola uuyamba wiigwana nowaakwaniilwa yayo.
Oto ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa, omuhupithi gwoye,
nOmunankondo gwaJakob oye omukulili gwoye.

Otandi ku etele oshingoli peha lyoshikushu,
oshisiliveli peha lyiiyela iiluudhe.
Peha lyoshiti otandi ku etele oshikushu
nopeha lyomamanya, iiyela iiluudhe.
Aapangeli yoye itaye ke ku hepeka we;
otaye ke ku lela nuuyuuki nombili.

Mevi lyoye kamu na we ngoka ta hokolola uukolokoshi,
ehanagulo neyonuko kali mo moshilongo shoye.
Otandi ke ku gamena noku ku shiga nda fa ekuma;
nangoye oto ka hambelela ndje, oshoka onde ku hupitha.

Etango itali ku minikile we omutenya,
nomwedhi kagu shi we uuyelele woye uusiku.
Ongame, Omuwa, tandi ka kala uuyelele woye waaluhe,
eadhimo lyesimano lyandje otali ku minikile.

Omasiku guuthigwa woye otaga kuka.
Ongame, Omuwa, tandi kala uuyelele woye waaluhe.
Etango lyoye itali ningine we,
nomwedhi gwoye itagu si we.

Aantu yoye ayehe otaa ka ninga aayuuki,
notaa ka thigulula oshilongo sigo aluhe.
Onde ya tsike, onde ya tula mo,
opo ndi hololele ayehe eadhimo lyandje.

Aashuushuka yomune otaa ka ninga eyuvi,
naashona otaa ningi oshigwana oshinankondo.
Ongame Omuwa; otandi shi ningi methimbo lyo opala.
61:
Ombepo yOmuwa Omupangeliawike oya lambele ndje,
oshoka oye a gwayeke ndje,
ndi uvithile oohepele onkundana ombwanawa,
ndi aludhe mboka ye na omwenyo gwa nyanyagulwa,
ndi igidhile aapongekwa emangululo,
nondi pitithe mo oonkwatwa moondholongo.

Okwa tumu ndje,
ndi uvithe kutya ethimbo olya thikana,
uuna Omuwa ta hupitha aantu ye
nota dhenge aatondi yawo.
Okwa tumu ndje,
ndi hekeleke ayehe mboka taa lili.

Okwa tumu ndje,
ndi etele oonakulila enyanyu peha lyuupongo,
ehambelelo peha lyoluhodhi.
Otaa ka fa omiti ndhoka Omuwa mwene e dhi tsike.
Otaa ka longa uuyuuki,
naKalunga ota ka hambelelelwa shoka e shi ninga.

Otaa ka tungulula omakulukuma gonale,
nokwoopaleka omaputu gootatekulu.
Otaa ka ngongolola iilando ya mbugala,
mbyoka ya hanagulwa po kaakulu yonale.

Aantu yandje, aakwiilongo otaye ke mu longela.
Oyo taa ka litha iimuna yeni
notaa longo omapya geni niitsambe yeni yomiviinu.

Otamu ka ithanwa aayambi yOmuwa,
aapiya yaKalunga ketu.
Otamu ka nyanyukilwa uuyamba wiigwana,
notaku tangwa taku tiwa oweni.

Ohoni yeni nokugugwa taku hulu.
Otamu ka kala moshilongo sheni yene.
Uuyamba weni otau ka ndambulwa,
nenyanyu lyeni otali kala aluhe sigo aluhe.

Omuwa ota ti:
“Ondi hole uuyuuki note tondo eyugo nuumbudhi.
Muudhiginini wandje otandi ya futu
notandi hangana nayo ehangano lyaaluhe.

Otaa ka kala ya simana mokati kiigwana.
Shaa ngoka te ya mono,
ota ka tseya kutya oyo aantu mboka nde ya yambeka.”

Otandi nyanyukilwa unene mOmuwa;
omwenyo gwandje tagu ligola muKalunga kandje,
oshoka okwa zaleke ndje omuzalo gwehupitho
nokwa kuwike ndje ondjatha yuuyuuki.
Okwa tula oshishani komutse gwandje nda fa omuyambi,
nonda fa omufuko i igoleke niipako ye.

Oshili, ngaashi evi tali menitha iimeno, notayi koko,
osho Omuwa Omupangeliawike ta hupitha aantu ye,
niigwana ayihe otayi ke mu hambelela.
62:
Itandi ka mwena molwaSion
nomolwaJerusalem itandi ka kala nda tya thilu,
sigo uuyuuki washo tau tende wa fa eluwa,
nehupitho lyasho tali yeta lya fa onyeka.

Iigwana otayi ka ligamena uuyuuki woye,
naakwaniilwa ayehe eadhimo lyoye.
Oto ka lukwa edhina epe,
ndyoka Omuwa mwene te ke li gandja.

Oto ka ninga oshishani sheadhimo moshikaha shOmuwa,
negala lyuukwaniilwa meke lyaKalunga koye.

Ito ka ithanwa we “Omuhengwa”,
nenge oshilongo shoye shi lukwe “Eputu”.
Edhina lyoye epe olyo “Kalunga e na ombili naye”.
Oshilongo shoye otashi lukwa “Ondjokana yi na elago”,
oshoka Omuwa okwe ku hokwa
nota kala a fa ombushiki koshilongo shoye.

Ngashika omumati ta hokana omufuko gwe,
osho naanaa naku ku shita te ke ku hokana.
Ngashika mbushiki ta nyanyukilwa omufuko gwe,
osho wo Kalunga te ke ku nyanyukilwa.

Jerusalem, kedhingililokuma lyoye onda langeke ko aalangeli.
Naa kale itaaya mwena uusiku nomutenya.
Naa dhimbulukithe Omuwa omauvaneko ge.
Inamu mu etha e ga dhimbwe.

Inamu mu pa evululuko,
manga inaa tungulula Jerusalem
e te shi ningi oshilando tashi tangwa kuuyuni auhe.

Omuwa okwa gana koshikaha she shokoluyo
nokokwooko kwoonkondo dhe
kutya iilya yoye itayi ningi we oondya dhaatondi yoye.
Aakwiilongo itaa ka nwa we omaviinu goye
we ga longele nuudhigu.

Ihe mboka taa teya iilya,
oyo taye yi li nokuhambelela Omuwa.
Mboka taa likola omandjembele,
otaa ka nwa omaviinu momikala dhotempeli yandje.

Aajerusalem, pitii mo, pitileni miiyelo!
Paleleni aagalukilimo epola!
Tungeni onenendjila; umbii mo omamanya!
Yeluthileni iigwana ombaaneli!

Shika Omuwa okwe shi tumbulile uuyuni auhe ta ti:
“Lombweleni omuna omukadhona Sion tamu ti:
‘Omuwa ote ya e ku hupithe e na ondjambi ye
note ke ku futa.’ ”

Otamu ka lukwa “Oshigwana oshiyapuki”, “Aakulilwa yOmuwa”.
Ngoye Jerusalem oto ka ithanwa “Omuyuulukiwa”, “Oshilando inaashi ethiwa”.
63:
“Olye ngoka te ya ta ziilile kuBozra shomuEdom? Olye ngoka a zala onguwo ya tiligana, te ende a tuwalala e na oonkondo odhindji?
“Ongame ngu tandi popi muuyuuki ndi na oonkondo okuhupitha.
“Omolwashike onguwo yoye ya tiligana ya fa yomuntu ha lyata omandjembele metemba lyokukolela oomviinu?”

Omuwa ta yamukula ta ti: “Ongame awike nda lyatagula iigwana nda fa te kolo omandjembele, nokakwa li ngoka a kwatha ndje. Mondjahi yandje onde ya lyatagula, nombinzi yawo oya shanukile koonguwo dhandje.
Onda tokola kutya ethimbo lyokuhupitha aantu yandje olya thikana, nolya li ethimbo lyokugeela aatondi yawo.
Onda li nda kumwa, sho nda tala e te mono kutya kaku na nando ogumwe a kwatha ndje. Ihe ondjahi yandje oya koleke ndje, nondi imonene esindano ngame mwene.
Mondjahi yandje onda lyatagula iigwana ayihe e tandi yi tyankagula. Ombinzi yawo onde yi poolele mevi.”

Otandi hokolola ontalanteni yOmuwa,
iilonga tuu mbyoka tayi mu hambelelitha.
Aaisraeli okwe ya yambeke neyambeko enene,
omolwesilohenda lye nohole ye yaa na ondjele.
Omuwa okwa ti: “Oshili, oyo aantu yandje; oyo itaa ka kotokela ndje.” Onkee ano e ya hupitha
komahepeko gawo agehe. Hamuyengeli, ihe Omuwa oye mwenemwene e ya hupitha. Mohole ye nomontalanteni ye okwe ya yululula mo. Okwa li e ya sile oshimpwiyu nonale,
ihe oye mu tsile ondumbo noya nikitha Ombepo ye ondjapuki uuthigwa. Osho a shituka omutondi gwawo e te ya kondjitha.

Opo mpoka oya dhimbulukwa uuyuni uukulu, omasiku gaMoses, omupiya gwOmuwa, noya pula ya ti: “Ngashingeyi Omuwa oku li peni? Oongoka a hupitha aawiliki yaantu ye mefuta. Omuwa ngoka a gandja Ombepo ye kuMoses, oku li peni?

Omuwa ngoka okwe enditha Moses koonkondo dhe nokwa thikamitha omeya omaleeleka gefuta e te endithile mo aantu ye nokwi ilikolele esimano lyaaluhe.”
Oye endithwa kOmuwa ya li ya fa uukambe mombuga, inaa punduka nando.
Omuwa okwa pe aantu ye evululuko, ngashika iimuna ya yi melonzi lyomwiidhi gwelendulendu. Okwe enditha aantu ye nokweetela edhina lye esimano.
Omuwa, tu taalela megulu moka wa kala muuyapuki woye meadhimo. Uulaadhi woye niilongankondo yoye oyi li peni? Ohole nonteni yoye oyi li peni? Ino kala waa na ko nasha natse!
Oshoka ongoye tate. Abraham ke tu shi, naIsrael ine tu tseya. Ngoye Omuwa, ongoye mwene tate, “Omukulili gwetu” olyo edhina lyoye hela wa za nalenale.

Omolwashike to tu etha, tu puke mo moondjila dhoye? Omolwashike to tu etha, tu kukutike oomwenyo dhetu tu kale inaatu ku tila? Galuka omolwaamboka taye ku longele, molwaantu mboka ya kala aantu yoye aluhe.
Tse mbaka aantu yoye aayapuki, otwa tidhwa mo kaatondi yetu konima yokathimbo okafupi; oyo taa lyatagula otempeli yoye.
Oto tu ningi twa fa aantu inaatu pangelwa kungoye, hela twa za nale, aantu twa fa inaatu lukilwa edhina lyoye.
64: Akutu, andola u tuule egulu omusa e to kulukile pohi! Oondundu ando dhi hemukile koshipala shoye,
ngaashi omulilo tagu fike po iihwa notagu fulukitha omeya! Kulukila pohi, u tseyithile aatondi yoye edhina lyoye nou kakamithe iigwana koshipala shoye.
Okwa li ethimbo, sho we ya e to longo iilonga iitilithi mbyoka inaatu yi tegelela nando; oondundu odhe ku tala e tadhi kakama.
Noshitonale kaku na ngoka omakutsi ge gu uvile nenge omeho ge ga tonatele kalunga gulwe a fa ngoye ngoka ho longo to popile ngoka te ku inekele.

Oto tsakaneke mboka taa mono enyanyu tali zi megwanitho lyuuyuuki, oyo tuu mboka haa dhimbulukwa, nkene wa hala ya kale. Ando twa li ngaaka aluhe, ando otwa hupithwa. Owe tu geele, ihe otwa tsikile okuyona.
Atuhe otwa yono; niilonga yetu iiwanawa oya nyata ayiheyihe. Omolwomayono getu otwa fa omafo ga kukuta notaga pepwa po kombepo.
Kape na ngoka a galukile kungoye momagalikano; kape na ngoka te ya kungoye a kwathwe. Owe tu iholeke nowe tu etha omoluulunde wetu.
Ihe, Omuwa, ongoye tate. Tse eloya, ngoye omuhongi gwiiyuma. Owe tu shiti,
onkee ino tu geela nenge u dhimbulukwe omayono getu sigo aluhe. Otse aantu yoye; tu sila ohenda.
Iilando yoye iiyapuki oya ningi ombuga, eeno, Sion osha ningi ombuga, Jerusalem eputu lyowala.
Otempeli yetu ondjapuki noya simana, moka ootatekulu ye ku simanekele, oya fikwa po nomulilo, nuuyamba wetu auhe wa lala momakulukuma.
Omuwa, ayihe mbika itayi ku inyengitha? Ito ka ninga po sha, sho to tu hepekitha shi vulithe poonkondo dhetu?
65: “Ondi imonithile mboka inaa pula ndje nonda monika kumboka inaa konga ndje. Onda lombwele oshigwana inaashi ithana edhina lyandje nda ti: ‘Ongame ngu, ongame nguka.’
Ondi ilongekidha aluhe ndi tsakaneke aantu yandje, mboka ya tangalala nohaa longo uuwinayi notaa landula oondjila dhawo yene.
Otaa hindi ndje aluhe notaa geyitha ndje. Otaa yamba miikunino yiinonoma notaa fike iitsinino kiiyambelo yuupagani.
Otaa ka hungila moombila nomomakololo, yo taa pula aathithi. Otaa li onyama yoshingulu nomuhoka gwonyama ya saagelelwa iimenka.
Otaa lombwelathana taa ti: ‘Kala kokule natse, otse aayapukilela, ino tu guma!’ Itandi vulu okwiidhidhimikila aantu ya tya ngaaka — ondjahi yandje yoku ya geela oya fa omulilo ihaagu dhimi.
“Onda tokola nokuli, nkene tandi ya geele. Epangulo lyawo olya nyolwa li li koshipala shandje. Itandi mwenene shoka ya ningi; otandi ke ya futila
oondjo dhawo noondjo dhoohekulu. Oya fikile iitsinino komahala giinonoma koondundu noya sheke ndje nayi. Otandi ya geele, ngaashi iilonga yawo yonale ye shi ilongele.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Kaku na ngoka ta yono po omandjembele omawanawa, oshoka otamu zi omaviinu. Nangame wo itandi ka yona po aantu yandje ayehe. Otandi ka hupitha mo mboka haa longele ndje.
Otandi ka holola oluvalo muJakob nomuJuda, oomboka taa ka thigulula oondundu dhandje. Aantu yandje aahogololwa taye ke dhi thigulula, naapiya yandje oko taa ka kala.
Otaa ka longela ndje notaa ka litha oonzi dhawo niimuna yawo momalundu gaSharon muuninginino nomEsilu lyomalwa muuzilo.
“Ihe otashi ka kala shi ili kune mboka hamu etha Omuwa nohamu dhimbwa Sion, ondundu yandje ondjapuki, one mboka hamu yalele Gad oshililo nohamu hangele oshikalunga Meni omalovu.
Otamu ka sa tamu dhipagwa, oshoka inamu itaala, sho nde mu ithana nenge mu pulakene, sho nda popi. Omwa hogolola shoka inaashi opalela ndje nomwa ningi shoka oshiwinayi koshipala shandje.

Onkee tandi mu lombwele kutya mboka haa longele ndje nohaa vulika kungame, otaa ka kala ye na iikulya niikunuwa ya ha, ihe ne otamu ka sa po kondjala nokenota. Otaa ka kala ye na elago, ihe ne otamu ka kala momupya.
Otaa ka imba omahambelelo, ihe ne otamu ka ula nomutima gwa nyanyagulwa.
Aantu yandje aahogololwa otaa ka tumbula edhina lyandje, uuna taa thingana. Ngame, Omuwa Omupangeliawike, otandi ke mu dhipaga po. Ihe mboka taa vulika kungame, otandi ke ya lukulula edhina epe.

Shaa ngoka moshilongo ta ka pula eyambeko, ota ka pula a yambekwe kuKalunga kashili. Shaa ngoka ta gana, ota ka gana kedhina lyaKalunga kashili. Omalwa gomuuyuni wonale otaga hulu po notaga dhimbiwa.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Tala, otandi shiti egulu epe nevi epe. Iiningwanima yonale otayi ka dhimbiwa thiluthilu.
Nyanyukweni nokuligola pombanda omolwaayihe mbyoka tandi yi shiti. Otandi shiti Jerusalem shi ninge oshilando shenyanyu, naantu yasho otaa ka kala ye na elago.
Ngame otandi ka nyanyukilwa Jerusalem naantu yasho. Itamu ka kala elilagano nenge ewi lyonkugo.

Uuhanona itau ka sila we muumputu, naantu ayehe otaa ka sa ya koka. Ngoka ta si e na omimvo ethele, ota ka talwa a sa omugundjuka unene. Ngoka ta si inaa thikitha omimvo ethele, otaku ka tiwa okwa thingwa.
Otaa ka tunga omagumbo, opo ya kale mo yo yene. Otaa ka tsika omiviinu, opo ya lye iiyimati yadho yo yene.

Itaa ka tunga omagumbo, yalwe ya kale mo, nenge ya tsike omuviinu dhi ka liwe kuyalwe. Omasiku gaantu yandje otaga ka kala omale ga fa omasiku gomuti. Aahogololwa yandje otaa ka kala ko olule nokunyanyukilwa iilonga yiikaha yawo yene.
Itaa ki ihepeka owala, noyana itaye ke ya valela omupya. Otandi ke ya yambeka pamwe noluvalo lwawo sigo aluhe.
Manga nokuli inaaya galikana, otandi ya uvu, nomanga inaaya indila ndje, otandi ya yamukula.

Embungu nokanzigona otayi ka napela pamwe; onime otayi li omwiidhi ya fa ongombe, neyoka oondya dhalyo ontsi yevi. Kondundu yandje ondjapuki kaku na we ehala mpoka tapu longwa uuwinayi nenge pu yonwe sha.” Osho Omuwa ta popi.
66: Omuwa ota ti: “Egulu olyo oshipangelapundi shandje, nevi olyo oshilyatelelo shokoompadhi dhandje. Egumbo tamu tungile ndje, olya tya ngiini? Ehala lyandje lyokuvululukilwa otali kala peni?
Oshikaha shandje hasho sha shiti ayihe mbino? Nosho ngeyi oya ningwa,” Omuwa osho ta popi. “Ngame otandi hokwa mboka yi ifupipika notayi itedhulula, oomboka haa tila ndje nohaa vulika kungame.

Aantu otaa ningi shoka ya hala. Ashihe shimwe kuyo, ngele taa tsele ongombe yi ninge efikilondjambo nenge taa dhipaga omuntu; ngele taa yamba onzigona nenge ya teye ombwa othingo; ngele taa gandja ondjambo yiikulya nenge taa yamba ombinzi yoshingulu; ngele taa fike iitsinino nenge taa galikana oshimenka. Oya hogolola oondjila dhawo yene, noomwenyo dhawo odha hokwa omasaagelo pamukalo gu tonditha.

Osho nangame wo tandi hogolola omukalo gwoku ya hepeka. Otandi ya undulile shoka haa tila, oshoka sho nde ya ithana, inaa itaala ndje noinaa pulakena, sho nda popi. Oya ningi shoka oshiwinayi momeho gandje, noya hogolola shoka inaashi opalela ndje.”

Pulakeneni shoka Omuwa ta popi, one mboka hamu mu tila nohamu vulika kuye. Elaka otali ti: “Molwaashoka mwa inekela ndje, yamwe yomooyakwenilela otaye mu tondo nokaa na ko nasha nane. Otaye mu nyenkele notaa ti: ‘Omuwa na holole uunene we ye e mu hupithe, opo tu vule okumona enyanyu lyeni.’ Ihe oyolela taa ka sa ohoni.
Pulakeneni utale! Euyagano oli li moshilando, oshihomo otashi uvika motempeli. Oshihomo shika oshOmuwa ta geele aatondi ye!
“Okwa pulumutha, manga inaa akukilwa koshitheta; nomanga uuwehame inaau mu kama, okwa pulumutha omumati.

Olye e shi uvile nale sha fa mpono? Olye e shi mwene nale sha tya ngeyi? Oshilongo otashi valwa tuu mesiku limwe, nenge oshigwana otashi vulu kutotwa po ohaluka? Sion ita hepekwa koshitheta ngele ta vala aanona ye.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Otandi thitulula oshivalelo, omuntu a kale inaa vala ando? Nenge hangame ngoka te valitha, ndi shi thitike?”
Nyanyukilweni pamwe naJerusalem, ligoleni omolwasho, amuhe mboka mu hole oshilando shika. Nyanyukweni pamwe nasho ngashingeyi, amuhe mboka mwe shi lilile.
Oshoka otamu yamu e tamu kuta komagundji gomahepulutho gasho. Otamu yamu mu kutilile e tamu nyanyukilwa omagundji gasho ga hula.
Omuwa ota ti: “Otandi ke mu galulila ombili ya fa omulonga; uuyamba wiigwana otau ka kungulukila kune wa fa efundja. Otamu ka fa omunona ta yamu komagundji gayina, ta kwiininwa nokuukatwa nohole.
Otandi ke mu hepuluthila muJerusalem, ngaashi yina ta hepulutha omwana.

Uuna tamu mono iinima mbika tayi gwanithwa, otamu ka nyanyukwa; otayi mu koleke noku mu aludha. Nena otamu ka tseya kutya ongame, Omuwa, tandi kwatha mboka haa vulika kungame notandi geele aatondi yandje.”
Tala, Omuwa ote ya momulilo, nomatembakwiita ge ga fa okambiya. Ota tumu ondjahi ye ya hwamenena, nomagandambadhi ge oga geta omalaka gomulilo.
Aantu ayehe yomuuyuni ye na ondjo, ote ya geele nomulilo negongamwele; oyendji otaa ka dhipagwa.

Omuwa ota ti: “Ehulilo otali ya kwaayehe mboka tayi iyapulile okuya kiikunino yiinonoma taa landula omulumentu e li mokati kawo, naamboka taa li onyama yoshingulu, oombuku niikulya yilwe yi nyanyalitha.
Omadhiladhilo niilonga yawo ondi yi shi. Otandi ya ndi gongele aantu yiigwana ayihe. Uuna taa gongala, otaa ka mona, nkene oonkondo dhandje tadhi longo.

“Otandi ka ninga endhindhiliko mokati kawo notandi ka tuma yamwe yomwaamboka ya hupu ko, kiigwana kuSpania, Libia, Lidia, Meshek, Rosh, Tubal naGreka nokoontuntu dhokokule mefuta ndhoka inaadhi uva ndje nenge dhi mone esimano lyandje. Otaa ka hokolola esimano lyandje mokati kiigwana.

Otaa ka etela yakweni taa zi kiigwana ayihe ya ninge omagano gandje. Otaye ya eta kondundu yandje ondjapuki muJerusalem ya kayila uukambe, omamulutiya noongamelo, ye li momatembakwiita nomuukala, naanaa ngaashi Aaisraeli taa eta ondjambo yiikulya kotempeli miiyuma iiyapuki.
Yamwe yomuyo otandi ya ningi aayambi nAalevi.
“Ngashika egulu epe nevi epe tandi ke ga shita notaga kala koshipala shandje, osho wo oluvalo lweni nedhina lyeni tali ka kala po.
Moshituthi kehe shomwedhi omupe nomEsabati kehe aantu ayehe otaa ka gongala kungame taa galikana koshipala shandje.” Omuwa osho ta ti.
“Otaa ka pita mo notaa mono omidhimba dhaamboka ya tsu ondumbo nangame; ezinyo lyawo itali si, nomulilo gwawo itagu dhimi. Oyo notaa ka nyanyalitha aantu ayehe.”

1: Ndhika oohapu dhaJeremia yaHilkia, gumwe gwomaayambi yokuAnatot mOshikandjo shaBenjamin.
Oohapu dhOmuwa odha adha Jeremia momumvo omutimulongo nomutitatu gwepangelo lyaJosia yaAmmon, omukwaniilwa gwaJuda,

niishewe muuyuni waJehoiakim yaJosia, omukwaniilwa gwaJuda, sigo omomwedhi omutitano gwomomumvo omutimulongo nagumwe gwepangelo lyaSedekia yaJosia, omukwaniilwa gwaJuda, uuna Aajerusalem ya falwa muupongekwa.
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti:
“Onde ku hogolola, manga inaandi ku shitila moshivalelo shanyoko, nomanga inoo valwa, onde ku yapula nonde ku lenge omuhunganeki gwiigwana.”
Onda yamukula nda ti: “Omuwa Omupangeliawike, kandi shi okupopya, oshoka ngame omunona.”
Ihe Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Ino tya, ngoye omunona; inda kaantu mboka tandi ku tumu kuyo, ngoye u ya lombwele ashihe tandi shi ku lombwele, u shi popye.
Ino ya tila, oshoka ondi li pungoye notandi ku gamene. Ongame Omuwa nda popi!”
Omuwa okwa ganeke oshikaha she ta gumu omilungu dhandje e ta lombwele ndje ta ti: “Tala, otandi tula oohapu dhandje mokana koye.
Otandi ku lenge u vule iigwana niilongo, opo u dhikule nokuhalakanitha, u hanagule nokuhata pevi nou tungulule nokutsika.”

Omuwa okwa pula ndje a ti: “Jeremia, ou wete shike?”
Onda yamukula: “Ondi wete oshitayi shomuti omumandeli.”
Omuwa okwa ti: “Ou li mondjila, otandi tonata ndi tale oohapu dhandje dhi tsakanithwe.”

Omuwa okwa pula ndje ishewe a ti: “Ou wete shike?”
Onda yamukula: “Ondi wete ombiga yi li kuumbangalantu, tayi fuluka, ye endamena kuumbangalantu.”
Omuwa okwa ti kungame: “Kuumbangalantu okwo taku zi oshiponga shoka tashi ka adha oonakukala moshilongo,
oshoka otandi ithana iigwana ayihe yokuumbangalantu yi ye. Aakwaniilwa yayo otaa ka tula iipangelapundi yawo pomiyelo dhaJerusalem nokukunduka omankolo gasho nokukunduka wo iilando yilwe yaJuda.
Otandi ka geela aantu yandje, oshoka oya yono, oye etha ndje, oya yambele iikalunga iikwiilongo noya hambula iimenka e taye yi longele.
Jeremia, ilongekidha, u ye u ka lombwele aantu ayihe mbyoka nde ku lombwele u yi ya lombwele. Ino ya tila, opo ndaaye ku tule uumbanda, ngele to kala puyo.
Nena ndjika otandi ku ningi oshilando sha kola, ongundhi yosheela nekuma lyoshikushu okukondjitha oshilongo ashihe, aakwaniilwa yaJuda, omalenga, naayambi. Aantu yomoshilongo
otaye ke ku kondjitha, ihe itaye ku sindi, oshoka ondi li pamwe nangoye notandi ku hupitha. Ongame Omuwa nda popi.”
2: Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje,

ndi ka uvithile aantu ayehe muJerusalem kutya Omuwa ota ti ngeyi:
“Otandi dhimbulukwa eopalo lyuugundjuka woye,
ohole yoye momasiku guufuko woye,
nkene wa landula ndje mombuga,
montale moka ihaamu kunwa.

Israel, ngoye ogwandjelela,
ngoye eliko lyandje eyapuki.
Ayehe mboka ye ku ningi nayi,
oyi ipetha ombedhi noya adhika koshiponga.
Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
Uveni oohapu dhOmuwa, ne oluvalo lwaJakob, ne omazimo agehe gaIsrael.

Omuwa ota ti:
“Oohokulu oya mwene ndje ombedhi yashike?
Oshike she ya pilamenitha ndje?
Oya ka simaneka iimenka yaa na omwago,
noyo yene ya ningi aanima yowala.

Inaa kala ye na ko nasha nangame,
nando onde ya hupitha muEgipiti
