nonde ya pandakanitha ombuga,
eha lyoontale nolyomakolombongo,
evi lya kalanda lya nika iiponga,
moka mwaa na nando olye,
nokaku na ngoka he li tokola ando.

Onde ya eta mevi lyo ondoka,
opo ya nyanyukilwe eteyo lyalyo nuuwanawa walyo wulwe.
Ihe oya shundula evi lyandje
noya nyateke oshilongo nde shi ya pe.

Aayambi inaa pula ya tye: ‘Omuwa oku li peni?’
Aayambi yandje mwene oya ningi kaaye shi ndje.
Aaleli oya tsu ondumbo nangame;
aahunganeki oyu uvitha medhina lyaBaal
noya longele iimenka yaa na omwago.”

“Onkee ano ngame Omuwa
tandi tamaneke aantu yandje,
notandi ka tamaneka aatekulu yawo.

Indeni kuuninginino kontuntu Kipro,
ne mu tume yamwe lwokuuzilo koshilongo Kedar.
Otamu ka mona kutya
kaku na nando osha sha fa mbika sha ningilwe nale.

Kaku na oshigwana shilwe sha pingakanithile ookalunga yasho,
nando yo yene kaye shi ookalunga.
Ihe aantu yandje oya pingakanitha ndje po,
Kalunga ngoka e ya simanekitha.
Oya pingakanitha ndje naashoka kaashi na ekwatho.

Onda lombwele eyalelo, li tale nuugelele
noli kumwe tali zi omahwilili.

Oshoka aantu yandje oya yono paali:
Oya pilamene ndje, othithiya yomeya omanamwenyo,
noyi ihupile omithima dhawo yene,
omithima dhiipopo, ndhoka itaadhi vulu okukala nomeya.”

Oye mu gonene ya fa oonime;
oya mbugaleke oshilongo she,
niilando ye oya kumunwa po.
Oya thigwa po owala.

Eeno, aalumentu yokuMemfis naTakpanhes
oya kunya omutse gwe gu ninge ongwala.

Israel, ongoye mwene we shi iyetele!
Owe etha ndje, Omuwa Kalunga koye,
sho nda li tandi ku enditha nondjila.

Omolwashike to yi kuEgipiti,
u ka nwe omeya gaNiili?
Omolwashike to yi kuAssur,
u ka nwe omeya gaEufrat?

Uuwinayi woye mwene otau ku pangula,
nokupilamena ndje kwoye otaku ku tokola.
Oto ka koneka, nkene sha puka noshilulululu,
sho we etha ndje, Omuwa Kalunga koye,
noino inekela ndje we nando.
Ongame, Omupangeliawike Omuwa Omunankondoawike, nda popi.”

Omuwa Omupangeliawike ota ti:
“Israel, owe ekelehi ndje nalenale;
owa tindi okuvulika kungame nokulongela ndje.
Owa longele iikalunga yoluvalo koondundu adhihe oondeendeka
nomomizile dhomiti adhihe omitalala.

Onde ku tsike ngaashi omuviinu gwa hogololwa,
ombuto ya hogololekeka.
Ihe tala utale, nkene wa tya!
Owa fa omuviinu gwaa na oshilonga nogwo ola.

Nando u iyoge nomeya gomutoko
nenge nothewa yekoha,
ondi wete natango oontongo dhoondjo dhoye.

Oto vulu ngiini okutya ino inyateka,
nokutya ino longela Baal?
Tala, nkene wa yono molusilu;
tala shoka wa ningi.
Owa fa ongamelo ongundjuka ya nikula,
notayi pwampwauka yu uka huka naahwiyaka,

tayi tondauka nombuga.
Ngele ya nikula, olye ta vulu oku yi pangela?
Ondumentu ndjoka ye yi hala,
itayi pumbwa okwiivulitha;
otayi monika nuupu pethimbo lyenikulo.

Israel, ino matuka, sigo oompadhi dhoye dha kala owala,
nomuligu gwoye tagu kukuta kokulandula iikalunga.
Ihe oto ti: ‘Aawe! Ite vulu okushuna.
Ondi hole iikalunga iikwiilongo notandi yi landula.’ ”
Omuwa ota ti: “Aaisraeli ne, otamu ka sithwa ohoni ngashika omufuthi ngoka a adhikilila. Aakwaniilwa, omalenga, aayambi naahunganeki yeni otaa ka sithwa ohoni.

Amuhe mboka tamu ti, omuti ogwo ho nemanya olyo nyoko, otamu ka sithwa ohoni, oshoka omwa pilamene ndje peha lyokugalukila kungame. Ihe uuna tamu adhika kuudhigu, otamu ithana ndje ndi ye oku mu hupitha.
“Iikalunga mbyoka wi ihambulile, oyi li peni? Nayi ku hupithe, sho wa adhika kuudhigu — ngele otayi shi vulu! Juda, omwaalu gwiikalunga yoye ogu thike pamwe nomwaalu gwiilando yoye.
Oto tamananene shike? Omolwashike wa tsu ondumbo nangame?
Onde ku geele, ihe inashi eta uuwanawa. Ino pitika, ndi ku tule mondjila. Aahunganeki yoye owe ya dhipaga wa fa onime ya pindjala.
Aaisraeli ne, pulakeneni shoka tandi popi. Kune ano onda fa ombuga, onda fa oshilongo shomilema shi na iiponga? Omolwashike ano tamu ti, otamu ningi shoka mwa hala noitamu galukile we kungame?
Omukadhona oha dhimbwa tuu uulenga we nomufuko ofeyi ye? Ihe aantu yandje oya dhimbwa ndje omasiku ogendji gaa shi kuyalulwa.
Ku na uudhigu washa okumona ondjila, ngele oto kongo aaholi yiipala. Eeno, nuuwinayi womukiintu otau konekwa mungoye.

Oonguwo dhoye odha nyata kombinzi yoohepele naakaanandjo, hakombinzi yaakolokoshi.
“Onkene tuu
oto ti: ‘Kandi na ondjo; oshili, Omuwa ina geela ndje.’ Ihe ngame, Omuwa, otandi ke ku geela, molwashoka wa tindi okuzimina kutya ou na ondjo.
Owi iningi gwowala, sho wi igameke kiikalunga yiigwana yilwe. Oto ka sithwa ohoni kuEgipiti, naanaa ngaashi wa ningilwe kuAssur.
Naankoka oto ka za ko wi ikwata ombandamutse, molwashoka Omuwa okwe ekelehi mboka wa li wi inekela, noito ka kwathwa kuyo.”
3: Omuwa ota ti: “Ngele oku na omusamane ta henge po omukadhi, nomukadhi ta ka hokanwa kugulwe, ita vulu we oku mu hokanununa. Shika otashi nyateke oshilongo nayi. Ihe ngoye Israel, sho wa hondelwa kaaholike yoye oyendji, oto galukile tuu kungame?

Yelutha utale omeho goye u ligamene kiikulundundu. Oku na tuu ehala mpoka inoo hondelelwa po? Owa tegamene aasamane yoye pooha dhoondjila wa fa Omuarabia a langela oshihakanwa mombuga. Owa nyateke oshilongo noluhondelo lwoye.
Omolwashoka omvula ya keelelwa okuloka, omvula yontemuno ya kala inaayi loka we. Nando wa kala moluhondelo, ino sa ohoni.
“Nongashingeyi oto lombwele ndje to ti: ‘Ongoye tate, nou hole ndje okuza kuugundjuka.
Ino hala okugeyagana aluhe noino hala okukonenena ndje sigo aluhe.’ Israel, osho to popi, ihe oto longo iihuna ayihe to vulu oku yi huna.”

Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje muuyuni womukwaniilwa Josia ta ti: “Owa mona tuu, omuhasha Israel nkene a ningi? Okwa londo koondundu adhihe oondeendeka nokwa yi momizile dhomiti adhihe omitalala e ta lalwa naye nkoka.
Onda dhiladhila kutya ngele a gwanitha mbika, ota ka galukila kungame. Ihe ina galuka nando, nomumwayina omuhasha Juda okwe shi tala wo.
Juda okwa mono kutya onda henge po Israel, nonde mu tidha po, oshoka okwa pilamene ndje e ta ningi ohonda. Ihe Juda, omumwayina gwaIsrael, ina tila ndje. Naye wo okwa ningi ohonda
noina sa nando ohoni. Okwa nyateke oshilongo noluhondelo, sho a simaneke omamanya nomiti omitalala.
Nokonima yaambika ayihe Juda, omumwayina omuhasha gwaIsrael, ina galukila kungame. Okwi ifethitha ashike, ihe ine shi ninga moshili. Ongame Omuwa nda popi.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje kutya Israel nando okwe mu pilamene, okwa ningi ngaa hwepo e vule omwiiteki Juda.
Okwa lombwele ndje, ndi ka lombwele Israel ndi tye: “Israel ngoka wi iteka ndje, galukila kungame. Ngame omunamutimahenda noihandi geye osima. Itandi ku geele we sigo aluhe.

Zimina owala kutya ngoye omunandjo, nowa tsu ondumbo nOmuwa, Kalunga koye. Hempulula kutya owa saagelele iikalunga yokiilongo momuti kehe omutalala noino vulika kiipango yandje. Ongame Omuwa nda popi.
“Aantu ne mboka mwi iteka ndje, galukeni; one aantu yandje. Otandi ka kutha gumwe gwomune moshilando kehe, nayaali yomoludhi kehe notandi ke mu galulila kondundu Sion.
Otandi ke mu pa aaleli haa vulika kungame, notaye mu lele nuunongo noondunge.
Nongele mwi indjipala oyendji moshilongo shoka, aantu itaa ka tumbula we oshikethahangano. Itaye ke shi dhiladhila we nenge ye shi dhimbulukwe; itaye shi pumbwa we noitaa ka pangela we oshipe.

Uuna ethimbo ndyoka nali thiki, Jerusalem otashi ka ithanwa ‘Oshipangelapundi shOmuwa’, niigwana ayihe oko tayi ka gongala yi simaneke ndje. Itaa ka ninga we, ngaashi omitima dhawo omiwinayi nodha tangalala tadhi ya lombwele.
Israel ota hangana naJuda, noyo ayehe otaa zi muupongekwa moshilongo shokuumbangalantu notaa galukile koshilongo shoka nde shi pele oohekulu, shi ninge eliko lyawo.”

Omuwa ota ti:
“Israel, onda halele ndi ku taambe omumwandjemati,
otandi ku pe evi lyo ondoka,
evi ewanawa muuyuni auhe.
Onde ku halele, u ithane ndje tate,
noku na mpoka no ka pilamena ndje we.

Ihe owa fa omukulukadhi ti iteka pomusamane gwe,
ngoye ino inekela ndje.
Ongame Omuwa nda popi.”

Ewi otali igidha muule koondungu dhoondundu.
Oyo Aaisraeli taa kugu notaa galikana,
oshoka oya kala moondjo
noya dhimbwa Omuwa Kalunga kawo.
Inatu mona ekwatho miinonoma yuupagani koondungu dhoondundu. Ekwatho lyaIsrael otali zi ashike kOmuwa Kalunga ketu.
Ihe okulongela Baal, oshikalunga shohoni, oshe tu kanithitha oonzi dhetu, osho wo aanona yetu aamati naakadhona — ashihe shoka ootatekulu ya longelele muuyuni wonale.
Natu laleni mohoni e tatu pitika ondhino yi tu kwidhidhike. Otse nootatekulu twa yono aluhe kOmuwa Kalunga ketu; inatu vulika nando kiipango ye.”
4: Omuwa ota ti: “Aaisraeli ne, ngele omwa hala okugaluka, galukileni kungame. Ngele tamu etha iimenka handi yi tondo e tamu inekele ndje,
otashi ka kala shu uka, sho tamu gana medhina lyandje. Nena iigwana ayihe otayi ka galikana ndje ndi yi yambeke, notayi ka hambelela ndje.”
Omuwa ota lombwele Aajuda nAajerusalem ta ti: “Kokoleni oshikokola, inamu kuna mokati komano.

Dhiginineni ehangano nangame, Omuwa gweni, iyapulilii ndje, ne Aajuda nAajerusalem. Ngele itamu shi ningi, ondjahi yandje otayi ka hwama ya fa omulilo omolwiinima iiwinayi mwe yi ningi. Otandi ka hwama nopwaa na omudhimi gwomulilo ngo.”

Hikeni omankuma noshilonga ashihe!
Ga fudhileni ga kugagane nawa!
Lombweleni Aajuda nAajerusalem
ya ye miilandohote.

Yelutheni endhindhiliko lyokuuka lwokuSion.
Zii ko neendelelo mu ka holame! Inamu kwatakwata!
Oshoka otandi eta oshiponga tashi zi kuumbangalantu,
ehanagulo enenenene.

Omuhanaguli okwa mbunzuka ko
a fa onkoshi ya hituka moshiholameno shayo.
Ote ya a hanagule po Juda.
Iilando yaJuda otayi ka kumunwa po,
nokaku na ngoka ta ka kala mo muyo.

Zaleni omahahi mu lile ne mu takume,
oshoka ehwamo lyondjahi yOmuwa inali penga Juda.
Omuwa ota ti: “Esiku ndyoka aakwaniilwa nomalenga otaga tyololoka; aayambi otaa kunkwa, naahunganeki otaa kumwa.”
Ngame onda ti: “Omuwa Omupangeliawike, oshili, owa kotokele Aajerusalem! Owa tile, otaku kala ombili, ihe egongamwele olyo ndyoka li li poothingo dhawo.”
Esiku otali ya, uuna Aajerusalem taa ka lombwelwa kutya ombepo ompyu otayi pepe tayi ziilile kombuga, yu uka kuyo. Inayi opala, yi pepe po ashike etutu —
ombepo ndjoka tayi ya palombwelo lyOmuwa, otayi ka ninga epukutula! Omuwa oye mwene ta tumbulile aantu ye epangulo.
Talii ko, omutondi te ya a fa iikogo. Omatembakwiita ge oga fa ombepo yoshikungulu, nuukambe we otau endelele u vule omakodhi. Yaye tse! Ehanagulo tali ya!
Jerusalem, yoga ko uuwinayi komwenyo gwoye, opo u hupithwe. Sigo uunake to tsikile nomadhiladhilo guulunde?
Aatumwa ya zi koshilando Dan nokoondundu dhaEfraim, otaa hokolola onkundana ombwinayi.
Oye ya okulondodha iigwana nokulombwela Jerusalem kutya aatondi otaa ya taa zi koshilongo shokokule. Aatondi mbaka otaa ka kugila iilando yaJuda onkugo
notaa ka kondeka Jerusalem ya fa aantu ya keelela epya, oshoka aantu yasho oya tsu ondumbo nOmuwa. Omuwa oye a popi.
Juda, owe shi iyetele mwene mokukala mondjila ndjoka wa lamba nomokulonga shoka wa ningi. Uulunde woye owe eta iihuna yomahepeko; otayi ku tsu momutima.

Yayee, tandi tapata, tandi nkundumanekwa kuuwehame!
Omutima gwandje! Omwenyo gwandje gwa tukuluka!
Ite vulu okumwena;
ondu uvite omankuma nonkugo yolugodhi.

Oshiponga otashi landula oshiponga oshikwawo.
Oshilongo ashiheshihe osha hanagulwa po.
Omatsali getu oga dhikulwa mo ohaluka,
nomagumbo getu ga ningi iihanuhanu yowala.

Sigo uunake tandi tala uugeyi wolugodhi
nokukala te pulakene ehiko lyomankuma?

Omuwa ota ti:
“Aantu yandje aagoya, inaa tseya ndje.
Oyo aanona aatsini;
kaye na nando omayele.
Oya pyokoka mokulonga uuwinayi,
ihe otaa nyengwa okulonga uuwanawa.”

Onda tala evi —
olya li lya vongakana nolya mbugala;
onda ligamene kegulu —
kakwa li ku na uuyelele.

Onda tala koondundu —
okwa li ekakamo,
niikulundundu ayihe oya li tayi tengauka.

Onda mono kutya kaku na aantu;
noondhila odha tuka ko.

Omuwa okwe shi popi ta ti:
“Evi alihe otali ka mbugala,
nando itandi li hanagula po thiluthilu.

Evi otali ka lila;
eyalelo otali ka luudha.
Omuwa okwa popi noita ka lundulula we omadhiladhilo ge.
Okwa utha etokolo lye
noite li shunithile mo we.”

Paigidho lyaakayilinkambe noondjumbeta
shaa ngoka ota yi ontuku.
Yamwe otaa ka matukila komakuti,
yamwe otaa ka londakana omamanya.
Oshilando kehe otashi ka thigwa po,
nokaku na ngoka ta ka kala mo we.

Yaye ngoye Jerusalem!
Omolwashike wa zala uutiligane?
Omolwashike wa zala omawe nowa gwayeke oombafu dhoye?
Owi imbonzola mo osima yowala!
Aaholi yoye oye ku ekelehi
noya hala oku ku dhipaga po.

Otandi uvu onkugo ya fa yomukulukadhi ta thetwa,
ekemo lya fa lyomukiintu opo ti iyelipa omunona.
Oyo onkugo yaJerusalem ta hetha mefudhagano,
okwa yelutha omaako ge ta takuma ta ti:
“Akwetse! Otandi ka sila miikaha yaadhipagi.”
5:
Aajerusalem, matukileni momapandaanda geni!
Ligameneni akuhe! Italeni ne yene!
Kongeni omalandithilo!
Otamu vulu tuu okumona omuntu ta ningi nawa
nota kambadhala okwiinekela Kalunga?
Ngele osho, nena Omuwa ota ka dhimina po Jerusalem.

Nonando tamu ti, otamu longele Omuwa,
itamu dhiladhila shoka tamu popi.

Oshili, Omuwa ota tala uudhiginini.
Okwe mu dhenge, ihe inamu pupa ko;
okwe mu nyanyagula, ihe omwa tindi okunongela sha.
Omwa tangalala noinamu etha uulunde weni.

Onda dhiladhila: “Mbaka oohepele dhowala naashamba.
Oye na uugoya; inaa tseya shoka Kalunga kawo ta pumbwa,
shoka Kalunga a hala ya ninge.

Otandi hedha kaanenentu e tandi popi nayo.
Oshili, otaa tseya Kalunga shoka ta pumbwa,
shoka Omuwa a hala ya ninge.”
Ihe oye ekelehi epangelo lyOmuwa
noya tindi okuvulika kuye.

Omolwashoka oonime tadhi ka hituluka momugulu, dhi ya lye po;
omambungu gomombuga otage ke ya ndimbula iintimbu,
noongwe otadhi ka hundjunina miilando yawo.
Aantu ngele otaa gwaya mo, otadhi ya tuula,
oshoka uulunde wawo wi indjipala,
esiku nesiku oya pilamene Kalunga.

Omuwa okwa pula a ti:
“Omolwashike ndi dhimine po aantu yandje?
Oye etha ndje noya longele ookalunga yaa shi yoshili.
Onda palutha aantu yandje sigo ya kuta,
ihe oyo ya hondele noya kala momagumbo goohonda.

Oya fa uukambe uutsezi wo ondoka wa nikula
taa haluka aakiintu yayakwawo.

Ondi kale ando inaandi ya geelela iihuna mbika
nondaa konenene oshigwana miinima ya tya ngaaka?

Otandi tumu aatondi ya ke po omiviinu dhaantu yandje,
ihe haku ya hanagula po sheke.
Otandi ya lombwele ya ponone ko iitayi,
oshoka iitayi mbyoka kayi shi yandje.

Aaisraeli nAajuda oya gwaaleke ndje shili.
Ongame Omuwa nda popi.”
Aantu yOmuwa oye mu idhimbike ta ti: “Ita ka ninga sha! Itatu adhika koshiponga! Itatu adhika kiita nenge kondjala yekomba.”

Oya ti, aahunganeki kaye na omwago, oohapu dhawo ombepo yowala, kaye na elaka lya za kOmuwa. Omuwa, Kalunga Omunankondoawike, okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Jeremia, aantu sho taa popi iinima ya tya ngaaka, otandi ka tema oohapu dhandje dhi ninge omulilo mokana koye. Aantu otaa ningi ya fa iikuni, nomulilo otagu ya lungunitha po.”
Aaisraeli ne, Omuwa ote eta oshigwana tashi zi kokule, shi mu matukile. Osho oshigwana oshinankondo noshikulu, shoka elaka lyasho inoo li tseya.
Oondjumbeta dhasho odho aakwiita aanankondo taa dhipaga yaa na onge yasha.

Otaa ka dhilagula po iilya yeni niikulya yeni; otaa ka dhipaga po aana yeni aamati naakadhona. Otaa ka tsela po iimuna yeni, oongombe niikombo. Otaa ka hanagula po omiviinu nomikwiyu dheni. Iilandohote yeni mbyoka mwi itula, otayi ka hanagulwa po kiita yawo.
Omuwa ota ti: “Ihe nomomasiku ngoka wo itandi ke mu yonagula po thiluthilu.

Aantu nge taa pula taa ti: ‘Omolwashike Omuwa Kalunga ketu a ningile aantu ye iinima ya tya ngaaka?’ Ya yamukula to ti: ‘Ngaashi mwi iteka ndje nomwa longele iikalunga iikwiilongo mevi lyeni yene, osho tamu ka longela aakwiilongo mevi lyaa shi lyeni.’ ”
Omuwa ota ti: “Shi hokololeleni oluvalo lwaJakob, ne mu shi tseyithile Aajuda:
Pulakena, shigwana ngoye oshigoya noshaa na oondunge. Ne omu na omeho, ihe kamu wete ko; omu na omakutsi, ihe kamu uvite ko.

Ongame Omuwa, oshike ihaamu tila ndje? Omolwashike itaamu kakama koshipala shandje? Onda ndumbile ehekevi li ninge ongamba yefuta, ongamba yolela itaayi taakanwa we. Efuta otali vulu okufuluka, ihe itali vulu oku yi taaguluka. Omakuthikuthi otaga yaya, ihe itaga vulu okuwayuka mo.
Ihe yantu ne! One aatangalali naanamanganga; omwa pilamene ko nomwa thigi ndje po.
Inamu hala nando mu simaneke ndje, nando handi mu lokithile omvula yontemuna noyothinge nohandi mu pe eteyo omumvo kehe.
Uulunde weni owe mu keelele uuwanawa mbuka auhe.
“Aantu aawinayi oya kala mokati kaantu yandje. Otaa hondjunine ya fa aategi yoomwigo ya yule oondhila, ihe otaa lukile omatavu ya yule aantu.
Naanaa ngaashi omukongo tu udha oshikuku she oondhila, osho yu udhitha omagumbo gawo nomaliko ga yugwa. Osho she ya ningi aanankondo naayamba.
Oyo ondoka ya ndinda nawa. Miilonga yawo iiwinayi kamu na ongamba. Itaa uthile oothigwa pauyuuki nenge ya popile oohepele.
“Ihe ngame Omuwa otandi ke ya geelela iihuna mbika, otandi ka kwatela oshigwana shika iikonene.
Moshilongo omwa ningwa iihuna.
Aahunganeki otaa hunganeke iifundja, aayambi otaa pangele pamalombwelo gaahunganeki, naantu yandje oye shi hole pahedhi ndjika. Ihe otaa ka ninga shike, ayihe nge ya hulu po?”
6: Aabenjamin ne, tembukii mo, mu ka holame! Zii mo muJerusalem! Hikeni enkuma muTekoa! Dhikeni endhindhiliko muBetakerem! Oshiponga nehanagulo otali ziilile kuumbangalantu.
Oshilando Sion osho opala, ihe otashi ka hanagulwa po.
Aakwaniilwa pamwe nomatangakwiita gawo otaa ka yungila ko oontanda. Taa dhike omatsali gawo ya kunduka oshilando, noshaa ngoka ote li dhike mpoka a hala.
Otaa ka tya: “Ilongekidheni, mu ponokele Jerusalem! Langeleni komauta! Tu shi matukileni moshanga shomutenya!” Ihe otaa ti ishewe: “Okwa fa kwa toko, etango lya peguka, omizile dha ningi omile.
Thikameni utale tu shi ponokele uusiku; tu kumunii po omankolokuma goshilando.”
Omuwa, Omunankondoawike okwa lombwele aakwaniilwa mbaka ya ke po omiti noya tungile Jerusalem omutuni gwekondekela. Okwa ti: “Otandi geele oshilando shika, oshoka oshu udha uukolokoshi.
Otashi zi uuwinayi sha fa omuthima tagu vile omeya. Ondu uvite omayugathano nomahanagulo moshilando nondi wete mo ashike uuwehame niilalo.
Aajerusalem ne, uudhigu mbuka nau kale elondodho kune; ngele hasho, otandi mu thigi po; oshilando sheni otandi shi shitukitha ombuga, ehala lyaa na aantu.”
Omuwa Omunankondoawike ota ti: “Israel ota ka toononwa thilu a fa omuviinu gwa kekwa omahila agehegehe. Osho u na okumangulula shaa ngoka, manga ku na ethimbo.”
Onda yamukula: “Olye ta pulakene ndje, sho te popi ndi ya londodhe? Oya tangalala notaa tindi okupulakena elaka lyoye; otaa yolo shoka to lombwele ndje ndi shi tye.

Omuwa, ondjahi yoku ya geela otayi lilima mungame wo; itandi vulu oku yi idhidhimikila.”
Omuwa okwa ti kungame: “Yi tilila maanona ye li momapandaanda nomaalumentu aagundjuka ya gongala pamwe; maasamane nomaakulukadhi ongashikwawo; nando oya kulupa, itaa hupu ko.
Omagumbo gawo otaga ka gandjwa po kuyalwe, nosho wo omapya gawo naakiintu yawo. Otandi ka geela aantu yoshilongo shika.
Ayehe, aagundjuka naakuluntu, oye hole eliko lyiifundja. Nokuli aahunganeki naayambi otaa kotokele aantu.
Iilalo yaantu yandje otaa hala oku yi panga taa ti: ‘Oku na ombili,’ ko kwaa na nando ombili.

Oya li tuu ya sa ohoni, sho ya longo iihuna mbika? Aawoo, inaa sa nando ohoni; inaa tseya nokuli shoka tayi ti. Otaa ka nganyukila po pamwe naambeyaka yalwe ya pundukila po nale; sho tandi ya geele, otali ka ninga ehulilo lyawo. Ongame Omuwa nda popi.”

Omuwa ota ti: “Ka thikameni poompagiila mu tale. Puleni omapola goshitonale, puleni ondjila ombwanawa mu ende mo notamu kala nombili.”
Ihe oya ti: “Itatu ende mo.”
Omuwa okwa langeke aalangeli ya pulakene elondodho lyenkuma. Ihe oya ti: “Itatu pulakene.”
Onkee ano Omuwa okwa ti: “Pulakeneni, ne iigwana, konekeni shoka tashi ka ningilwa aantu yandje.
Ngoye evi, pulakena! Aantu mbaka otandi ya undulile oshiponga, iiyimati yiineya yawo, oshoka inaa pulakena oohapu dhandje.
Ondi na shike niitsinino taye yi eta tayi zi kuSheba nenge iizimba tayi zi koshilongo shokokule? Itandi ka taamba nando omafikilondjambo gawo nenge ndi mbilipalithwe koontselelandjambo dhawo.
Otandi ka teleganitha aantu mbaka e taa punduka. Oohe noyanamati otaa ka sa, nosho tashi ningilwa ookuume naashiinda.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Aantu otaa ya taa zi koshilongo shokuumbangalantu; oshigwana oshinankondo tashi zi kokule, oshi ilongekidhila olugodhi.
Oye na omatati nomagonga; oyo aageyentu ye na onyanya. Otaa kugu ya fa efuta tali pupu, sho ya kayila uukambe wawo. Oyi ilongekidhila olugodhi ya kondjithe Sion.”
Aajerusalem oya ti: “Otu uvu onkundana, nomaako getu oga lemanekwa; otwa kwatwa kehaluko nokuuwehame twa fa omukiintu e na oshitheta.
Inamu pita mo, mu ye komapya nenge mu ka ende momapola, oshoka omutondi oku na egongamwele, naakuhe oku na iihuna yowala.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Aantu yandje ne, zaleni omahahi ne mu gwaye omutoko. Lileni omahodhi omapyu mwa fa tamu lili omumati epona, oshoka ngoka te ya e mu hanagule po, ota homona mbala.
Jeremia, onde ku langeke u ninge omuyeleki gwaantu yandje; ya yeleka nokukonakona iikala yawo.
Oyo ayehe aanamanganga, aakukutu ya fa osheela oshikushu nosheela oshiluudhe. Oyo ayehe yo ola, taye endagula taa popi oluhoko.
Omupepo otagu pepele, ihe osheela itashi hemuka shi ze omange. Itashi kwatha sha, aantu yandje ya yelithwe, oshoka mboka haa longo uuwinayi, inaa kuthwa mo.
Otaa ka lukwa omange, uutale waa na oshilonga, oshoka ongame Omuwa nde ya ekelehi.”
7: Ndjika oyo ohapu ndjoka ya adha Jeremia ya zi kOmuwa tayi ti:
“Thikama pomweelo gwongulu yOmuwa, ngoye u ka uvithe elaka ndika tali ti: ‘Uveni oohapu dhOmuwa, ne Aajuda mboka hamu pitile momiyelo ndhika, mu ka simaneke Omuwa.’ ”
Omuwa Omunankondoawike, Kalunga kaIsrael, ota ti: “Yelitheni oondjila niilonga yeni, ongame notandi mu etha mu kale mehala ndika.
Inamu inekela oohapu dhomakoto mu tye: ‘Ndjika otempeli yOmuwa, uuyapuki wOmuwa, otempeli yOmuwa!’
Opalekeni oondjila dheni ne mu ethe iilonga iiwinayi tamu yi ningi. Uthileni aantu ayehe pauyuuki.
Inamu hepeka aakwiilongo, oothigwa naaselekadhi. Inamu dhipaga aantu yaa na ondjo moshilongo shika. Inamu longela iikalunga yaakwiilongo, oshoka otashi mu yono po.
Ngele otamu lunduluka, otandi mu etha mu kale mo moshilongo shika nde shi pe oohokulu shi ninge eliko lyawo lyaaluhe.
Taleni, ne otamu inekele oohapu dhomakoto.
“Ohamu yaka, ohamu dhipaga, ohamu hondele, ohamu gana iifundja, ohamu yambele Baal omafikilondjambo nohamu longele iikalunga inaamu yi tseya nale.
Otamu longo iinima mbyoka handi tondo notamu ya tamu thikama koshipala shandje motempeli e tamu ti: ‘Otwa hupithwa!’
Otamu dhiladhila kutya otempeli yandje oyo oshiholameno shaayugi? Ondi wete shoka tamu ningi.
“Indeni kuShilo, ehala lyotango ndyoka nda hogolola li ninge eha lyelongelokalunga, mu tale shoka nde li ningile moluulunde waantu yandje Aaisraeli.
Omwa yono ayihe; nando nda popi kune olwindji, omwa tindi okupulakena. Inamu zimina, sho nde mu ithana.
Shoka nda ningile Shilo, osho tandi ningile otempeli yandje ndjika mwi inekela. Mehala ndika nde li mu pe noohokulu, osho tandi ka ninga, ngaashi nda ningile Shilo.
Otandi mu tidha po koshipala shandje, ngaashi nda tidhile po Aaisraeli aakweni. Ongame Omuwa nda popi.”
Omuwa okwa ti kuJeremia: “Ngoye ino galikanena aantu mbaka. Ino kuga nenge u galikane omolwawo; ino indila ndje, oshoka itandi ku pulakene.
Ou wete tuu shoka taa ningi miilando yomuJuda nomomapandaanda gaJerusalem?
Aanona otaa tyaya iikuni, aasamane taa tema omulilo, naakiintu taa telekele omunyekadhi gwokegulu iikwiila. Otaa saagelele iikalunga omayambo gomaviinu, opo ye ehameke ndje.
Ihe ongame tuu shili ngoka taye ehameke? Aawe, otayi iyalula yo yene notayi isitha ohoni yo yene.

Onkee ano ngame, Omuwa Omupangeliawike, otandi ka poolela ondjahi yandje ya hwama kotempeli ndjika. Otandi ke yi tilila aantu niinamwenyo sha faathana, nokuli nokomiti nokiimeno. Ondjahi yandje otayi ka fa omulilo nokaku na ngoka te gu dhimi po.
“Omuwa Omunankondoawike, Kalunga kaIsrael, ota popi ta ti: Gwedheni omafikilondjambo koontselelandjambo ne mu lye po onyama ayihe ne yene.
Oshoka sho nda popitha oohokulu nonde ya tembudha muEgipiti, inandi ya pa oshipango shasha kombinga yomafikilondjambo noontselelandjambo.
Ihe onde ya lombwele nda ti: ‘Vulikeni kungame, notandi ningi Kalunga keni, one notamu ningi aantu yandje. Endeni momapola ngoka tandi mu lombwele, opo mu kale nawa.’
Ihe yo inaa vulika nenge ya pupe ko. Oya kala muutangalali wawo nomeikukutiko lyomitima dhawo omiwinayi. Oya ningi aawinayi peha lyokuninga aawanawa.
Okuza kesiku ndyoka oohokulu ya zi muEgipiti sigo okesiku lyonena, onda dhiginine oku mu tumina aahunganeki, aamati yandje.
Ihe kakwa li ngoka a pulakene nenge a pupe ko. Omwa tangalala owala, nomu na iipotha mu vule oohokulu.
“Sho to ya lombwele oohapu ndhika, itaye ku pulakene; sho to ya ithana, itayi itaale.
Ya lombwela ano kutya oshigwana shawo inashi vulika kungame, Omuwa Kalunga kasho, nenge shi ilonge komageelo gasho. Oshili oye ekelwahi, itayi tumbulwa we.”

“Lileni ne Aajerusalem;
kululii ko omafufu geni mu ga ekelehi.
Lileni oosa koondungu dhoondundu,
oshoka ongame, Omuwa, nda geya
nonde ekelehi aantu yandje.
“Aajuda oya ningi nayi. Oya tula iimenka yawo iinyanyalithi motempeli yandje. Osho ngeyi ya nyateke otempeli yandje.
Mesilu Ben Hinnom oya tungile mo oshiyambelo sha lukwa Tofet, opo ya fikile ko oyana aamati naakadhona momulilo. Ngame inandi shi ya lombwela, noinashi ya nando okuli momadhiladhilo gandje.
Ethimbo otali ya, uuna itaashi ka ithanwa we Tofet nenge esilu Ben Hinnom, ihe Esilu lyonakupila. Oko taa ka fumvika aantu, oshoka kape na we eha lyokufumvika.
Omidhimba otadhi ka ninga oondya dhoondhila nodhiithitukuti, nokape na ngoka te yi tidha po.
Oshilongo otashi ka mbugala. Miilando yaJuda nomomapandaanda gaJerusalem otandi ka hulitha ekugililo lyenyanyu nondigolo nomatanto goshituthi shohango.”
8: “Momasiku ngeyaka omasipa gaakwaniilwa nogomalenga gaJuda, nosho wo omasipa gaayambi nogaahunganeki nogaantu yalwe mboka ya kala muJerusalem, otaga ka fumvulwa mo moombila dhawo.

Peha lyoku ga gongela noku ga fumvika otaga ka kala ga fa uuhoho ga napakana nelundu. Otaga ka anekwa montaneho yetango, omwedhi noonyothi ndhoka aantu mbaka ya li ye dhi hole, ye dhi longele, ye dhi pula noku dhi galikana.
Aantu yoshigwana shika oshiwinayi mboka taa hupu ko, momahala moka nde ya halakanithile, otaa ka hokwa okusa shi vule okukala ye na omwenyo. Ongame Omuwa Omunankondoawike nda popi.”
Ya lombwela to ti, Omuwa ota ti: “Nakwiihata pohi ita penduka po? Nakupuka ondjila ita pukuluka?
Omolwashike ano aantu yandje hela mwa pilamene ndje, inamu galuka we? Omwa kakatela kiimenka yeni notamu tindi okugalukila kungame?

Onda pulakena nawa, ihe ne inamu popya oshili. Kape na gumwe gwomune a sila oondjo dhe oluhodhi; kape na gumwe gwomune a pula a ti: ‘Oshike nda longo nda puka?’ Shaa ngoka ota nduungile nepola lye a fa okakambe okapwidhi taka matukile molugodhi.
Oonkumbinkumbi odhi shi ethimbo lyokushuna; omatendenguti, uundigilili nomambiimbili otaga tseya ethimbo lyokutembuka. Ihe ne aantu yandje inamu tseya oompango ndhoka tandi mu lele nadho.
Otamu vulu ngiini okutya one aanandunge nomwa tseya oompango dhandje? Taleni, oompango odha pilikwa kaanongompango yaa shi kwiinekelwa.
Aanandunge yeni otaa sithwa ohoni, otaa haluthwa notaa kwatwa. Oye ekelehi oohapu dhandje; nena oye na po uunongo wuni?
Omapya gawo otandi ga gandja kooyene aape, naakiintu yawo kaalumentu yalwe. Shaa ngoka, omunene nenge omushona, ota kambadhala okukotokela miimaliwa. Nokuli aahunganeki naayambi otaa kotokele aantu.
Otaa palampadha iilalo yaantu yandje ya fa inaayi geya unene, yo taa ti: ‘Ombili, ombili,’ ko kwaa na nando ombili.

Yantu yandje, omwa sa tuu ohoni, sho mwa longo iihuna yi thike mpoka? Aawe, inamu gugwa nando, ne kamu uvite ohoni. Otamu ka punduka, yalwe sho taa ka gwila po. Uuna tandi mu pangula, otali ka kala ehulilo lyeni. Ongame Omuwa nda popi.

“Onda halele okugongela aantu yandje, ngashika omuntu ta gongele eteyo lye; ihe yo oya fa omuviinu gwaa na omandjembele, ya fa omukwiyu gwaa na oonkwiyu; nokuli omafo oga ganya. Onkee ando onda pitika aantu yokokule ya kuthe po oshilongo.”
Omolwashike twa mbwateni tse twa mwena? Gongaleni! Tu matukileni kiilandohote, tu ka sile mo. Omuwa Kalunga ketu okwe tu pangula, tu se; okwe tu pe uuzigo, tu nwe, oshoka otwa yono kuye.
Otwa tegamene ombili nethimbo lyealudho, ihe inashi kwatha sha; ehalutho olyo alike lye ya.

Aatondi yetu oye li nokuli moshilando Dan; otatu uvu uukambe wawo tau pembe. Oshilongo ashihe tashi kakama, uukambe wawo sho tau lili. Aatondi yetu ye ya ya hanagule po oshilongo shetu noshaa shoka shi li musho, oshilando shetu naantu yasho ayehe.
Omuwa ota ti: “Kotokeni! Otandi ka tuma omayoka ge na uuzigo mokati keni, omayoka kaage shi kunonomwa, ogo notage mu li.”

Oluhodhi lwandje italu vulu okukodhekwa,
omutima gwandje tagu alukwa.

Pulakeneni!
Ondu uvite aantu yandje taa kugu moshilongo ashihe taa ti:
“Omuwa ke mo we muSion?
Omukwaniilwa gwaSion ke po we mpaka?”
Omuwa, omukwaniilwa gwawo, ota yamukula:
“Omolwashike mwa geyitha ndje mokulongela iimenka yeni,
nokwiinyongamena kiikalunga yeni iikwiilongo yaa na oshilonga?”

Aantu otayi igidha taa ti:
“Othinge oya ti komusheko,
neteyo olya pu,
ihe tse inatu kwathwa.”

Kamu na omugwayo muGilead?
Kamu na nando aapangi?
Omolwashike aantu yandje inaa pangwa?
9:
Omutse gwandje andola gwa li omuthima gwomeya,
nomeho gandje othithiya yomahodhi,
ando te lili uusiku nomutenya
omolwaantu yandje mboka ya dhipagwa po.

Ando onda li ndi na ehala mombuga,
moka te vulu okukala kokule naantu yandje.
Oyo ayehe aahasha, ongundu yaakengeleli.

Aluhe oyi ilongekidha okufundja;
oshili ihayi pangele moshilongo.
Omuwa ota popi ta ti:
“Aantu yandje otaa ningi nayi aluhe, yo inaa tseya ndje.”

Shaa ngoka ni iyageke kuume ke,
nokape na ngoka ti inekele mumwayina.
Oshoka omumwayina kehe omunamakoto a fa Jakob,
nokehe ngoka ota lundile ookuume ke.

Kuume ta kotokele kuume,
nokaku na ngoka ta popi oshili.
Oya longo omalaka gawo okufundja;
ohaa ivulitha muulunde.

Oye li mokati komakoto;
momakoto gawo otaa tindi okutseya ndje.

Molwaashika Omuwa Omunankondoawike ota ti:
“Otandi ka yelitha aantu yandje ngashika iiwengendje
notandi ke ya yeleka.
Aantu yandje ya ningi nayi —
otandi ya ningi ishewe shike?

Omalaka gawo ogo iikuti hayi lyana;
aluhe taa fundju.
Shaa ngoka ota popi oohapu oontalala komushiinda gwe,
ihe ote mu tegele etavu.

Itandi ke ya geelela andola iihuna mbika?
Itandi ka galulila andola oshigwana uuwinayi wa fa mbuka?
Ongame Omuwa nda popi.”

“Otandi lilile oondundu
notandi takumine omaunapelo.
Oshoka oga kukuta po,
nokape na ngoka te ende mokati kago.
Ekololoko lyoongombe itali uvika we;
oondhila niithitukuti oya yi ontuku.

“Jerusalem otandi shi ningi ondumba yomakulukuma,
otandi shi ningi ehala lyokukala oombandje;
iilando yomuJuda otayi ka mbugala,
ehala itaali kalwa nando okulye.”

Onda pula nda ti: “Omuwa, omolwashike oshilongo sha hanagulwa po nosha kukuta sha fa ombuga, nokaku na nando oongoka te yi tokola? Olye e na oondunge e shi uve ko? Owe shi fatululile lye, opo a vule okulombwela yalwe?”
Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Osha ningwa, oshoka aantu yandje oye etha elongo ndyoka nde li ya pele. Inaa vulika kungame nenge ya ninge, ngaashi nde ya lombwele.
Oya kala ya tangalala noya longele iimenka yaBaal, ngaashi ya longwa koohekulu, ye shi ninge.
Onkee ano pulakeneni shoka ngame, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, Kalunga kaIsrael, tandi ti: Otandi ka pa aantu yandje oshigwanga oshilulu ya lye, notandi ya nwetha omeya guuzigo.
Otandi ke ya halakanithila mokati kiigwana mbyoka noohekulu nayo wo inaaye yi kundana nale, notandi ka tuma iita yi ya kondjithe, sigo nde ya yono po naanaa.”

Omuwa Omunankondoawike ota ti:
“Shi kuthii mo nduno!
Hiyeni aakiintu ye shi kulila,
tumeni koonkulungu dhokulila oosa.”

Oshigwana osha ti:
“Ya lombweleni, ya matuke ye tu lilile ko oosa,
sigo omeho getu taga udha omahodhi,
noombafu dhetu dha hipa kokulila.”

Oshihomo shoondila otashi uvika muSion:
“Otwa hanagulwa po ngiini!
Ohoni yetu onene ngiini!
Otatu thigi po oshilongo shetu,
oshoka omagumbo getu oga kumunwa po.”

Onda ti:
“Ne aakiintu, pulakeneni oohapu dhOmuwa,
mu ndhindhilike shoka ta popi.
Longeni aana yeni aakadhona okulila,
nookuume keni uunkulungu wokulila oosa.

Eso olye ya lya pitile momakende getu
nolya ningine moombala dhetu.
Momapandaanda olya kanyata aanona,
naagundjuka opomahala guundingosho.

Omidhimba odha langathana akuhe,
odha fa oondumba dhuuhoho momapya,
odha fa iilya ya teywa ya thigwa po kaateyi,
iilya mbyoka itaayi gongelwa.
Shika osho shoka Omuwa a lombwele ndje, ndi shi popye.”

Omuwa ota ti:
“Omunandunge ke na okwiitangela uunongo we,
omunankondo iti itangele oonkondo dhe,
nomuyamba iti itangele uuyamba we.

Ngoka ti itanga,
ni itangele okuuva ko nokutseya ndje,
oshoka ohole yandje kayi na ondjele,
nohandi longo shoka oshiwanawa noshu uka.
Iinima mbika otayi opalele ndje.
Ongame Omuwa nda popi.”

Omuwa ota ti: “Esiku otali ya, uuna tandi ka pangula Aayegipiti, Aajuda, Aaedom, Aayammoni, Aamoabi naantu yomombuga mboka haa ikulula omapalu. Aantu mbaka ayehe oya pita etanda, ihe inaa dhiginina ehangano; oye na owala endhindhiliko lyalyo. Kaku na nando ogumwe gwomaantu mbaka nomAaisraeli a dhiginina ehangano lyandje.”
10: Aaisraeli ne, pulakeneni kelaka ndyoka Omuwa te mu lombwele.

Ota ti:
“Inamu landula omikalo dhiigwana yaapagani;
inamu haluthwa komandhindhiliko gokeyalelo,
nando ohaga halutha iigwana mbyoka.

Eitaalo lyaantu mboka olyowala.
Tala, omuti otagu komangelwa mokuti,
onkulungu otayi gu mbunzu nawa nekuya lyayo,

notagu tulwa uulenga woshisiliveli nowoshingoli.
Otagu kwatelwa peha lyagwo noomboha,
dhi gu koleke gwaa gwe po.

Iimenka ya tya ngaaka oya fa enduguya mepya lyomatanga.
Itayi vulu okupopya;
ohayi humbatwa, oshoka kayi shi kweenda.
Inamu yi tila; itayi mu ningi sha,
oshiwanawa nenge oshiwinayi.”

Olye ando itee ku simaneke,
omukwaniilwa gwiigwana ayihe?
Owi ilongela esimano.
Kaku na ngoka e ku fa mokati kaanandunge ayehe yomiigwana
nenge mokati kaakwaniilwa yayo.

Ayehe yomuyo oyo aagoya nomathethe.
Miimenka ya hongwa miiti, otaa koneke mo shike?

Iimenka yawo oya kolongwa noshisiliveli shokuSpania
noshingoli sha za kuUfas.
Oyo iilonga yaahambudhi oonkulungu.
Oya zala oonguwo oombulau noontiliganembwilili
dha tungika kaayogohi yoompumpo.

Ihe ngoye, Omuwa ongoye Kalunga kashili.
Ongoye Kalunga omunamwenyo
nomukwaniilwa gwaaluheluhe.
Nge to geye, uuyuni otau telagana;
iigwana itayi vulu okwiidhidhimikila ondjahi yoye.

(Ya lombwela kutya iikalunga mbyoka inayi shita egulu nevi,
otayi ka hula ko kombanda yevi alihe.)

Okoohapu dhe omeya gomeyalelo taga ndunduma:
ote eta iikogo okuza kooha dhevi.
Ota shelitha oombadhi miikogo,
nota tumu ombepo tayi zi moompungulo dhe.

Omuntu kehe omugoya noke na ontseyo;
mboka haa hongo iimenka, oya thethelekwa,
oshoka iimenka mbyoka taa hambula,
oyiifundja nokayi na omwenyo.

Kalunga kaJakob ine yi fa;
oye ngoka a shiti ayihe,
nokwa hogolola Israel a ninge oshigwana she mwene.
Omuwa Omunankondoawike olyo edhina lye.
Gongeleni iinima yeni, mu tembuke mo moshilongo, moka mwa thitikilwa.
Omuwa ote ke mu ekelahi mo moshilongo shika; ote ke mu nyanyagula, sigo itaaku hupu nando ogumwe gwomune. Omuwa oye a popi.

Aajerusalem otaa kugu taa ti:
“Otwa nyankagulwa ngiini ngeyi!
Iilalo yetu itayi aluka nando.
Otwa dhiladhila tu shi idhidhimikile!

Onda yamukula:
“Aawiliki yetu oya ningi aagoya;
itaa pula Omuwa e ya wilike.
Omolwashoka oya ndopa,
naantu yetu oya halakanithwa po.

Pulakeneni! Otaku zi omulombo!
Oku na einyengo enene moshigwana shokuumbangalantu;
etangakwiita lyasho otali shitukitha iilando yaJuda ombuga,
moka tamu kala oombandje.”

Dhenga ndje, Omuwa,
ihe hanoshikanyauko,
ngoye ino tu geela muupyundjahi;
otashi ningi shi kale ehulilo lyetu.

Ondjahi yoye yi poolela miigwana mbyoka ihaayi ku longele,
omaantu mboka ihaa ithana edhina lyoye.
Oya dhipaga po aantu yoye;
oye tu hanagula po sheke
noya kumuna po oshilongo shetu.
11: Oohapu dhOmuwa odha adha Jeremia tadhi ti:
“Pulakeneni oohapu dhehangano. Lombweleni Aajuda nAajerusalem
kutya ngame, Omuwa Kalunga kaIsrael, otandi thingi shaa ngoka itaa vulika koohapu dhehangano ndika.

Olyo ehangano ndyoka nda hangana noohekulu, sho nde ya tembudha mo muEgipiti, mevi ndyoka lya li lya fa eziko lya hanya. Onde ya lombwele, ya vulike kungame noya gwanithe shoka tandi ti. Onde ya lombwele kutya ngele otaa vulika, otaa kala aantu yandje, nangame ote kala Kalunga kawo.

Nena otandi dhiginine euvaneko lyandje nde li uvanekele oohekulu kutya otandi ya pe evi ndika eyamba nolyo ondoka ye li na ngashingeyi.”
Onda yamukula nda ti: “Oshili, Omuwa.”

Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti:
“Inda kiilando yaJuda nomomapandaanda gaJerusalem. Uvithila ko oohapu dhandje u lombwele aantu ya pulakene oohapu dhehangano noya vulike kudho.
Oohekulu sho nde ya tembudha muEgipiti, onde ya londodha nokugana, ya vulike kungame, nonda dhiginine okulondodha aantu yandje sigo onena.

Ihe inaa pulakena nenge ya vulike. Shaa ngoka okwa tsikile uutangalali nuuwinayi shi vule nale. Onde ya lombwele, ya dhiginine ehangano, ihe oya tindi. Onkee onde ya undulile omageelo ngoka ga nyolelwa mo.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Aajuda nAajerusalem oya tsa ondumbo nangame.
Oya shuna muulunde woohekulu, mboka ya tindi okulonga shoka nda ti; oya longele ookalunga yalwe; Israel naJuda oya teya ehangano ndyoka nda hangana noohekulu.
Onkee ano ngashingeyi ngame Omuwa otandi ya londodha kutya otandi ya undulile ehanagulo, oyo noitaa ka hunuka mo. Nongele taa kugile ndje ekwatho, itandi ke ya pulakena.
Aajuda nAajerusalem otaa ka ya kiikalunga mbyoka ye yi yambele omafikilondjambo notaye yi kugile ekwatho. Ihe iikalunga mbyoka itayi vulu oku ya hupitha, uuna ehanagulo tali ya.

Mpoka pu thike omwaalu gwiilando muJuda, opo pu thike omwaalu gwiikalunga yawo; naampoka pu thike omwaalu gwomapandaanda muJerusalem, opo pu thike omwaalu gwiiyambelo yomafikilondjambo ya tungilwa Baal, oshikalunga shi nyanyalitha.
Jeremia, ino galikana ndje nenge u indile ndje molwaantu mbaka. Ngele oye li muudhigu taa kugile ndje, itandi ke ya pulakena.”

Omuwa ota ti: “Aantu mboka ndi ya hole, otaa longo uuwinayi. Oye na uuthemba washike okukala motempeli yandje? Otaa dhiladhila kutya otaa vulu okukeelela oshiponga, sho taa uvaneke omauvaneko notaa yamba oontselelandjambo? Otashi ya pe elago shika?
Onde ya luku omuolivi gwa hetukila, gwa kanyata iiyimati yo opala; ihe ngashingeyi otandi ka hwameka omafo gagwo, notaku uvika endundumo, note pompona ko iitayi yagwo.

“Ongame, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, nda tsike Israel naJuda; ihe ngashingeyi otandi ya undulile oshiponga. Oye shi iyetele yo yene, oshoka oya yono; oya geyitha ndje, sho ya yambele Baal omafikilondjambo.”
Omuwa okwa tseyithile ndje ondumbo ndjoka aatondi yandje ya pangele molwandje.

Onda li nda fa onzigona tayi falwa koshidhipagelo; inandi tseya kutya otaa kondjitha ndje, sho ya dhiladhilile ndje uuwinayi. Oya li taa ti: “Omuti natu gu komangele po, manga gwa ziza nawa, natu mu dhipageni po, opo pwaa kale ngoka te mu dhimbulukwa we.”

Onda galikana nda ti: “Omuwa Omunankondoawike, ngoye omutokolihapu omuyuuki, oto konakona omatedho nokuyeleka oomwenyo dhaantu. Ondi itula miikaha yoye, tonatela ndje; aantu mbaka ya galulila uuwinayi.”
Aantu yokuAnatot oya hala okudhipaga ndje po, ngele otandi dhiginine okuuvitha oohapu dhOmuwa.
Onkee ano Omuwa Omunankondoawike okwa ti: “Otandi ke ya geela! Aagundjuka aamati yawo taa ka sila miita; aanona yawo otaa ka sa kondjala.
Ondu utha ethimbo lyokweetela Aayanatot oshiponga, nuuna ethimbo ndyoka tali thiki, kape na nando ogumwe gwawo ta hupu ko.”
12:
Omuwa, ngoye omuyuuki aluhe;
ote vulu tuu okutamanana nangoye?
Onkene tuu ote popi nangoye kombinga yuuyuuki.
Omolwashike aalunde ye na elago?
Omolwashike aanandumbo taa kala nombili?

Oto ya tsike e taa tsama;
otaa koko notaa imi iiyimati.
Otaye ku popi aluhe nawa momakana,
ihe itaa ku longele.

Ihe, Omuwa, ngoye owa tseya ndje;
ou wete shoka te ningi,
nonkene ndi ku hole.
Pwedhulula po aawinayi mbaka
ngashika oonzi tadhi falwa koshidhipagelo;
ya tonatela,
sigo ethimbo lyokudhipagwa kwawo lya thiki.

Evi lyetu otali kala lya kalanda sigo uunake,
nomwiidhi gwa ganya momalundu agehe?
Iinamwenyo noondhila otadhi si moluulunde waantu yetu,
oshoka otaa ti: “Kalunga ke wete shoka tatu longo.”

Omuwa okwa ti:
“Jeremia, ngele owa loloka okuthigathana naantu,
oto vulu ngiini okuthigathana nuukambe?
Ngele ito vulu okuthikama mokati koshilongo,
oto ke shi vula ngiini mongoya yaJordan?

Omuwa ota ti:
“Onde etha Israel, onda thigi po oshigwana shandje.
Onda gandja mboka ndi hole miikaha yaatondi yawo.

Aahogololwa yandje oya pilukile ndje.
Oya fa onime momugulu, otaa vavele ndje,
nosho ngaaka onde ya tondo.

Aahogololwa yandje oya fa ondhila
ya kondekwa koombinga noombinga komakodhi.
Hiyeni iithitukuti ayihe, yi ye koshituthi!

Oye li ningi omaputu;
oli li po lya mbugala koshipala shandje.
Oshilongo ashihe osha mbugala,
nokamu na ngoka te shi sile oshimpwiyu.

Aantu yandje oya kunu osiima,
ihe oya teya oshinkumbwe;
oya longo noonkondo, ihe inaa mona sha.
Moluupyundjahi wandje iilya yawo oya theta.”

Omuwa ota ti: “Otandi popi sha kombinga yaashiinda yaIsrael mboka ya teya po oshilongo nde shi pe Aaisraeli. Aawinayi mboka otandi ke ya kutha mo miilonga yawo, ngaashi oshimeno tashi vudhwa mevi notandi mangulula Aajuda miikaha yawo.
Sho nde ya kutha mo, otandi ya sile ohenda. Otandi ka galulila oshigwana kehe kevi lyasho nokoshilongo shasho.

Nando oya longele aantu yandje okugana medhina lyaBaal, otaya ka ninga oshitopolwa shomaantu yandje noye na elago, ngele otaya ilongo omikalo dhaantu yandje notaya gana medhina lyandje taa ti: ‘Oshili, ngaashi Omuwa e na omwenyo.’
Ihe ngele oku na oshigwana itaashi vulika, otandi ke shi dhakula mo thilu noku shi hanagula po. Ongame Omuwa nda popi.”
13: Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Ki ilandele epaya lyoliina, u li zale mombunda yoye, ihe ino li yaya tuu momeya.”
Onda landa epaya, ngashika Omuwa a ti, nonde li zala mombunda.
Oohapu dhOmuwa odha adha ndje ishewe tadhi ti:
“Kutha epaya ndyoka wa landa nowe li zala mombunda, inda komulonga Eufrat u li holeke molumbogo lwemanya.”
Onda yi nonde li holeke pomulonga Eufrat, ngaashi Omuwa a lombwele ndje.
Sho pwa piti omasiku ogendji, Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Inda kuEufrat u ka tale ko epaya ndyoka nde ku lombwelele u ke li holeke ko.”
Onda shuna ko nonda kutha mo epaya mehala moka nde li holekele. Ihe olya li lya kulupa lyaa na we oshilonga.
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti:
“Ano osho ngeyi tandi shundula einenepeko lyaJuda nuuntsa waJerusalem.
Aantu mbaka aawinayi oya tindi okuvulika kungame. Oya ningi aatangalali notaa simaneke nokulongela iikalunga yaapagani. Onkee ano otaa ka ninga ya fa epaya ndika kaali na we oshilonga.

Ngashika epaya lya kwata mombunda, osho ngaaka onda hala okukwatathana nAaisraeli ayehe nAajuda. Onde shi ningi, opo ya kale aantu yandje taa hambelele nokusimaneka edhina lyandje, ihe yo inaa vulika kungame.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Jeremia, lombwela Aaisraeli kutya oshiyuma kehe shomaviinu ohashi udhithwa nomaviinu. Otaa ka yamukula kutya oya tseya kutya iiyuma yomaviinu ohayi udhithwa omaviinu.
Ya lombwela nduno kutya ongame Omuwa tandi ka nwetha aantu moshilongo shika nomaviinu, sigo ya kolwa: aakwaniilwa, mboka oluvalo lwaDavid, aayambi, aahunganeki nAajerusalem ayehe.
Otandi ke ya nyanyagulithathana, shamukuluntu osho ngaa shamunona. Itandi kankekwa nando kuugelele nenge kesilohenda, opo ndaaye ya dhipage ando.”

Aaisraeli ne, Omuwa okwa popya!
Ifupipikeni, mu pulakene.

Simanekeni Omuwa, Kalunga keni,
manga inaa tuma omilema,
notamu ka telagana noondundu.
Otamu tegelele uuyelele,
ihe oye te u shitukitha omilema thokothoko.

Ngele itamu pulakene elondodho ndika,
uuntsa weni otau lilitha ndje ompompohodhi;
ote lili omahodhi omapyu,
omahodhi otaga pononoka ashike,
aantu yOmuwa sho taa kwatwa po
e taa falwa muupongekwa.
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Lombwela omukwaniilwa nayina, ya kuluke ko kiipangelapundi yawo, oshoka iishani yawo yuulenga oya gu ko komitse dhawo.
Iilando muumbugantu waJuda oya kondekwa nokaku na ngoka ta vulu oku yi egulula. Aajuda ayehe oya kwatwa po noya falwa muupongekwa.”
Tala utale, Jerusalem! Aatondi yoye otaye ya taa ziilile kuumbangalantu. Aantu mboka ye ku inekelelwa, oye li peni, aantu yoye mboka ho inomene?
Oto ka popya shike, uuna aantu mboka wa dhiladhila ookuume koye, taye ku sindi notaye ku pangele? Oto ka adhika koshitheta sha fa shomukulukadhi ta vala.
Ngele oto pula kutya omolwashike iinima mbika ye ku ningilwa — omolwashike oonguwo dhoye dha togonyonwa po nowa kondjithwa — osha ningwa omoluulunde woye uunene.
Omuetiopia ota vulu tuu okulundulula oshipa she, nenge ongwe yi ikuthe iitotono yayo? Ngele otashi vulika, nena nangoye wo ngoka ho longo uuwinayi auke, oto vulu okwiilonga uuyuuki.
Omuwa ota ka halakanitha aantu yoye ya fa etutu tali pepwa po kombepo yokombuga.
Shika oshipewa shoye, oshitopolelwa shoka Omuwa e shi ku uthile, oshoka owe mu dhimbwa nowi inekela iikalunga yiifundja.
Omuwa oye mwenemwene ta yelutha onguwo yoye, epenge lyoye li monike.

Okwe ku mono to longo shoka ha tondo. Okwe ku mono to yi kiikalunga yaapagani koondundu nokomalundu, wa fa omuntu a lopela mukadhamushiinda she, wa fa okakambe okatsezi ka lamba okanzinzi. Yaye ne Aajerusalem! Onamu yogoka uunake?
14: Oohapu ndhika dhOmuwa dha lombwelwa Jeremia, otadhi popi oluteni:

“Juda ota lilagana;
iilando ye oya shunduka,
aantu ye oya mbwata pevi moluhodhi,
naJerusalem ta kugu onkugo.

Aanamadhina taa tumu aapiya ya ka teke omeya.
Otaa yi kiitentemba, ihe itaa mono ko omeya.
Otaa galuka niiyuma yi li owala.
Oya tyololoka yo ya ngwangwana,
otaa holeke iipala yawo.

Evi olya kalanda, oshoka oshilongo inashi lokwa.
Aanamapya naaniimuna oya haluka
notaa holeke iipala yawo.

Oholongo onyali otayi thigi po okanimona kayo
molwoluhepo lwomwiidhi.

Uusinokuti owa lontomana koondungu dhoondundu
tau fudhagana wa fa oombandje.
Owa tsika oshitanana, oshoka kau na uunapelo.

Aantu yandje otaa kugile ndje taa ti:
‘Nando uulunde wetu u tu tompe,
Omuwa, tu kwatha, ngaashi wa uvaneka.
Otwe ku pilamene olwindji;
otwa yono kungoye.

Omuwa, ongoye etegameno lyaIsrael;
ongoye omuhupithi gwetu methimbo lyiiponga.
Omolwashike wa fa omukwiilongo mevi lyetu,
wa fa omweendanandjila ngoka to penduka mo esiku limwe?

Omolwashike wa fa omuntu a haluka,
wa fa omukwiita kee na oonkondo dhokukwatha?
Oshili, ongoye Omuwa to kala pamwe natse!
Otse aantu yoye;
ino tu thiga po nando.’ ”
Aantu mbaka Omuwa ote ya popi ta ti: “Oye hole okunyekuka po pungame notaa nyengwa okwiipangela. Onkee ano inandi ya hokwa. Otandi dhimbulukwa omayono gawo notandi ya geele moluulunde wawo.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Ino galikana ndje nando, ndi kwathe aantu mbaka.

Nokuli nando naa idhilike iikulya, itandi ka pulakena onkugo yawo, nonando ya yambele ndje omafikilondjambo noondjambo dhiikulya, itandi ya hokwa nando. Otandi ke ya dhipagela miita, mondjala nomelega.”
Ngame onda ti: “Omuwa Omupangelinkondoawike, owa tseya aahunganeki mboka taa lombwele aantu kutya itaku kala iita nenge ondjala, oshoka owu uvaneke kutya moshilongo otamu ka kala ombili.”

Omuwa okwa yamukula a ti: “Aahunganeki mboka otaa popi iifundja medhina lyandje; ngame inandi ya tuma, inandi ya lombwela nenge ndi popye nayo. Omamoniko gawo inaga za kungame. Omahunganeko gawo kage na oshilonga, ogo omafafaeko gawo yene.

Ongame Omuwa tandi ku lombwele shoka tandi ka ninga aahunganeki mboka inaandi ya tuma, ihe otaa hunganeke medhina lyandje kutya iita nondjala itayi ke ya mo moshilongo shika — otandi ke ya dhipagela miita nomondjala.

Aantu mboka ye ya lombwele iinima mbika, otaa dhipagwa pahedhi ya faathana. Omidhimba dhawo otadhi ka umbilwa momapandaanda gaJerusalem, noitaku ka kala mboka taye dhi fumvike. Ayehe osho taa ka ningilwa ngaaka — aakiintu yawo, oyana aamati naakadhona. Otandi ke ya futithitha uulunde wawo.”

Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje, ndi hokololele aantu oluhodhi lwandje ndi tye:
“Omeho gandje otaga pononoka omahodhi uusiku nomutenya.
Itandi etha okulila, oshoka aantu yandje oya tosholwa nayi
noya hendagulwa nayi.

Nge te piti mo, ndi ye komalundu,
ote tala omidhimba dhaantu ya sile miita.
Nge tandi ya miilando, ote tala aantu ya sa kondjala.
Aahunganeki naayambi otaa yi koshilongo kaaye shi ko.”

Omuwa, owe ekelahi shilishili Juda?
Owa tonda nduno Aasioni?
Omolwashike we tu hende nayinayi ngeyi,
notatu nyengathana okupangwa?
Otwa tegelele ombili, ihe inatu yi mona;
otwa tegelele ealudho, ihe uumbanda wowala we ya po.

Omuwa, tse otwa yona kungoye,
otatu hempulula oondjo dhetu nomayono gootatekulu.

Molwedhina lyoye ino tu etha.
Ino sitha Jerusalem ohoni;
osho oshipangelapundi shoye shesimano.
Ino teya po ehangano we li hangana natse.

Kaku na oshikalunga shaapagani
tashi vulu okulokitha omvula;
newangandjo lyo lyene ihali lokitha nando oshihomo shimwe.
Otwe ku inekela, Omuwa Kalunga ketu,
oshoka ongoye awike to longo mbika.
15: Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Nando oMoses naSamuel ya thikame koshipala shandje ya galikanene aantu mbaka, itandi ya sile nando ohenda. Naa ze po, naa ze koshipala shandje.

Ngele taye ku pula taa ti: ‘Otatu yi peni?’ Ya lombwela etokolo lyandje ndika: mboka yu uthilwa elega, otaa yi ya ka se kelega; mboka yu uthilwa egongamwele, otaa yi ya ka dhipagwe; mboka yu uthilwa ondjala, otaa yi ya ka se kondjala; naamboka yu uthilwa okukwatwa, otaa yi muupongekwa.

Ongame, Omuwa, nda tokola ndi ya undulile iiponga yopane: otaa ka dhipagelwa miita; omidhimba dhawo otadhi ka kookololwa koombwa; otadhi ka lika po koondhila; iithitukuti otayi ka mana po shoka sha hupu ko.
Otandi ya ningi oshinyanyalithi kiilongo ayihe muuyuni omolwiihuna mbyoka Manasse gaHiskia, omukwaniilwa gwaJuda, a longo muJerusalem.”

Omuwa ota ti:
“Aajerusalem ne,
olye te ke mu sila ohenda,
nolye ngoka te ke mu nikila uuthigwa?
Olye ta ka myauka po oku mu pula sho mu li po?

Ne omwe ekelehi ndje;
ne omwa pilamene ndje.
Otandi taganeke omaako gandje e tandi mu nyanyagula.
Onda vulwa okuloteka ondjahi yandje.

Moshilando kehe otandi ke mu umbila mombepo mwa fa etutu.
Otandi mu hanagula po, ne aantu yandje.
Otandi dhipaga aana yeni, oshoka inamu etha oondjila dheni oombwinayi.

Moshilongo sheni otamu ka kala aaselekadhi oyendji
ye vule ehekevi mooha dhefuta.
Aalumentu yeni aagundjuka otandi ya dhipagitha po inaa koka,
notashi lilitha ooyina omahodhi omapyu.
Ohaluka yowala tandi ya gwilike uuwehame nehaluka.

Omukiintu ngoka a kanitha oyana yaheyali,
ota yi oshitelele e ta fudha mo omwenyo gwe.
Etango lye olya ningine mokati komutenya;
okwa adhika komupya nokwa sithwa ohoni.
One mboka tamu hupu ko,
otandi mu dhipagitha kaatondi yeni.
Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
Yaye ngame, meme sho wa vala ndje, ndi ninge omulumentu gwomaludhi nogwondumbo moshilongo ashihe! Inandi lila omuntu ongunga nenge ndi lilwe ongunga komuntu, ihe ayehe otaa tuku ndje.
Omuwa okwa ti: “Oshili, otandi ku mangulula molwelalakano ewanawa; oshili, aatondi yoye otandi ye ku galikanitha mesiku lyoshiponga nomesiku lyuudhigu.
(Oku na tuu omuntu ta vulu okuteya osheela, unene osheela sha yaminwa mumwe nuutale woshikushu shokuumbangalantu?)”
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Otandi ka tuma aatondi ya kuthe po uuyamba nomaliko gaantu yandje, opo ndi ya geelele uulunde mboka ya longo moshilongo ashihe.
Otandi ke ya longithitha ya longele aatondi yawo moshilongo inaaye shi tseya shito, oshoka ondjahi yandje oya fa omulilo, notayi kala ya hwama sigo aluhe.”
Onda popi nda ti: “Omuwa, ou uvite ko. Dhimbulukwa ndje, u kwathe ndje. Galulila aatidhagani yandje uuwinayi. Ino ya idhidhimikila, sigo ya dhipaga ndje. Dhimbulukwa kutya ngame onda shekwa omolwoye.
Owa lombwele ndje, nonda pulakene ohapu kehe. Ngame ogwoye, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, nomolwashoka oohapu dhoye dhu udhitha omwenyo gwandje enyanyu nelago.
Inandi hepitha ethimbo lyandje paantu yalwe, mokuyola nomokunyanyukwa. Onda vulika komalombwelo goye, ondi ikalele nonda li mondjahi.
“Omolwashike tandi hepekwa? Omolwashike iilalo yandje ya nyengathana okwaaludhwa? Oshike itaayi aluka? Owa hala okufundjaleka ndje ngaashi omulonga tagu pwine mothinge?”

Omuwa okwa yamukula ta ti: “Ngele to itedhulula, otandi ku galula, noto ka ninga ishewe omupiya gwandje. Peha lyokupopya iinima yowala ngele to uvitha elaka lyomungunda, oto ka ninga ishewe omuhunganeki. Oshigwana otashi ya kungoye, noito pumbwa okuya kusho.
Otandi ku ningi ekuma lyoshikushu okukondjitha oshigwana shika. Otashi ke ku kondjitha, ihe itashi ku sindi, oshoka otandi kala pamwe nangoye. Otandi ku gamene notandi ku hupitha.
Otandi ku yugulula miikaha yaakolokoshi noyaananyanya. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
16: Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje ishewe a ti:
“Ino hokana, u kale u na aanona mehala ndika.
Otandi ke ku lombwela shoka tashi ka ningilwa aanona mboka taa valelwa mpaka, naakuluntu yawo.

Otaa ka sa komikithi omidhigu, nokaku na ngoka te ya lili nenge te ya fumvike. Omidhimba dhawo otadhi ka lala dha fa oondumba dhuuhoho mepya. Otaa ka dhipagelwa miita, nenge taa ka sa po kondjala, nomidhimba dhawo otadhi ka ninga oondya dhoondhila nodhiithitukuti.
“Ino ya megumbo tamu lilwa oosa. Ino sila nando olye oluhodhi. Itandi ka yambeka we oshigwana shika, nenge ndi shi hololele ohole nohenda.
Ayehe, aayamba naathigona, oye na okusa moshilongo shika, ihe kaku na ngoka te ya lili oosa nenge e ya fumvike. Kaku na ngoka ti ishata oonsha nenge a kulule omutse gwe, e ya lile.
Kape na oshikwiila tashi pewa aalilasa mokuhupulutha oonakusilwa, kape na oshinuwa shehupulutho tashi pewa ngoka a silwa he nenge yina.
“Ino ya megumbo mu na onshingo. Ino kuutumba pamwe naamboka taa li e taa nu.

Pulakena shoka ngame, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, Kalunga kaIsrael, tandi ti: ‘Otandi ka mweneka ekugililo lyenyanyu nondigolo nomatanto goshituthi shohango.’ Aantu yaampaka otaye ke shi mona tashi ningwa.
“Nge to ya hokololele ayihe mbika, otaye ke ku pula taa ti: ‘Omolwashike Omuwa a tokola e tu geele nonyanya? Ondjo yetu oyini, notwa yono ngiini kOmuwa Kalunga ketu?’
Ya lombwela kutya Omuwa okwa ti: ‘Oohokulu oya pilamene ndje noya longele nokusimaneka iikalunga, oye etha ndje noinaa vulika komautho gandje.
Ihe ne omwa ningi nayilela mu vule oohokulu. Ne amuhe aatangalali naakolokoshi noinamu vulika kungame.
Omolwashoka otandi ke mu tidha mo moshilongo shika noku mu fala koshilongo inaashi tseyika nokoohokulu. Oko tamu ka longela iikalunga uusiku nomutenya, noitandi mu sile nando ohenda.’ ”
Omuwa ota ti: “Ethimbo otali ya, uuna aantu itaa ka gana we medhina lyOmuwa omunamwenyo ngoka e ya tembudha mo muEgipiti,

ihe otaa gana medhina lyOmuwa omunamwenyo ngoka e ya tembudha mo moshilongo shokuumbangalantu nomiilongo ayihe moka nde ya halakanithile mo. Otandi ke ya kongolola ko ndi ya ete koshilongo shawo yene, kevi ndyoka nde li pe oohekulu. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Otandi tumu aayuli yoohi oyendji, ye ye ya kwate po aantu yandje. Opo ihe otandi ka tuma aakongo oyendji, ye ye ye ya yewe koondundu adhihe nokiikulundundu nomomakolombongo goondundu.
Ondi wete ashihe taye shi ningi. Kape na shoka sha holekwa ndje; uulunde wawo itau kana mo momeho gandje.
Otandi ndambula ofuto yawo okufutila uukolokoshi nuulunde wawo, oshoka oya nyateke evi lyandje niimenka yawo iinyanyalithi, mbyoka yaa na omwenyo, noye li udhitha niiyelekela yawo yiifundja.”

Omuwa, ongoye awike to gamene ndje noto koleke ndje; oto kwatha ndje momathimbo guudhigu. Iigwana otayi ke ya kungoye tayi zi kooha dhuuyuni e tayi ti: “Ootatekulu oyi iningi oshege, oya kala niimenka yowala yaa na ekwatho lyasha.
Omuntu ota vulu tuu okwiihambulila ookalunga? Aawe, ngele ote shi ningi, kaye shi ookalunga.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Osho ano tandi tseyithile iigwana ayihe oonkondo dhandje nomatha gandje: Otayi ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa.”
17: Omuwa ota ti: “Aajuda ne, uulunde weni owa nyolwa nopena yosheela, owa takelwa moomwenyo dheni nondungu yondiamande nowa negelwa kookolonela dhiiyambelo yeni.
Aantu yeni ohaa saagele piiyambelo nopoongundhi dha dhikilwa oshikalungakiintu Asheera momuzile gwomuti kehe omutalala, koondungu dhoondundu,
nokoondundu dhomolushandja. Otandi ka sikumudha aatondi yeni ya yuge po uuyamba weni nomaliko geni moluulunde auhe mboka mwa longo mevi lyeni alihe.
Ne omu na okweetha evi nde li mu pe, otandi ke mu longithitha mu longele aatondi yeni mevi inaamu li tseya nale, oshoka ondjahi yandje oya fa omulilo, notayi kala ya hwama aluhe.”

Omuwa ota ti:
“Otandi pangula omuntu ngoka ta pilamene ndje
noti inekele omuntu, oonkondo dhomuntu gwowala

Okwa fa oshihwa mombuga tashi koko montale ya kukuta
mevi lyoshimongwa, moka ihaamu koko sha shilwe.
Ita ningilwa uuwanawa washa.
“Ihe ote yambeke omuntu ngoka i inekela ndje.

Okwa fa omuti tagu kokele pomatondokelo gomeya
tagu taandelekele omidhi momeya.
Itagu tila, nando ombepo ompyu tayi pepe,
oshoka omafo gagwo oga ziza.
Kagu na mbudhi, nando omvula yaa ko,
otagu imi aluhe iiyimati.

“Omwenyo ogwo omunamakoto kombanda yiinima ayihe,
nokagu shi kwaaludhwa.
Olye ta vulu oku gu uva ko?

Ongame, Omuwa, tandi konakona omatedho
notandi yeleke oomwenyo dhaantu.
Shaa ngoka otandi mu ningi pakukala kwe,
otandi mu futu pailonga ye.”

Ngashika onkanga tayi tendula omayi inaayi ga vala,
osho wo omuntu ngoka ta likola uuyamba nomakoto.
Omasiku ge nge ga ti metifa, ote u thigi po,
nopehulilo ota ningi egoya.

Otempeli yetu oya fa oshipangelapundi sha simana;
oya thikama kondundu ondeendeka okuza ketameko.

Omuwa, ongoye etegameno lyaIsrael,
ayehe mboka taye ku etha, otaa si ohoni.
Otaa dhimi po ya fa omadhina ga nyolelwa montsi,
oshoka oyo ye ku etha, Omuwa,
omuthima gwomeya omanamwenyo.
Panga ndje, Omuwa, ongame notandi aluka; hupitha ndje, note kala ndaa na ombudhi. Ongoye awike tandi hambelele!
Aantu otaa lombwele ndje taa ti: “Oohapu dhOmuwa odhi li peni? Nadhi kale dha tsa nduno!”
Ihe, Omuwa, inandi ku ulumika nando, u ya undulile omupya; inandi ya halela ethimbo lyomalwa. Omuwa, owe shi tseya; ou shi shoka nda ti.
Ino halutha ndje; ongoye eholameno lyandje, uudhigu nge tau ya.
Sitha aatidhagani yandje ohoni, ihe gamena ndje. Ya halutha noonkondo, ihe ino tilitha ndje. Ya undulila omupya, u ya ndimbule iintimbu.

Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Jeremia, inda u ka uvithe oohapu dhandje pOsheelo shaantu, mpoka hapu pitile aakwaniilwa yaJuda, nge taa yi nenge taa piti moshilando; inda ihe komiyelo adhihe dhilwe dhaJerusalem.
Lombwela aakwaniilwa nAajuda ayehe noshaa ngoka a kala muJerusalem ha pitile miiyelo mbika, a pulakene shoka tandi popi.
Ya lombwela kutya ngele oye hole oomwenyo dhawo, inaa humbata nando omutenge gwasha mEsabati; kaye na okuhumbata sha taa pitile miiyelo yaJerusalem,
nenge ya humbate sha ye shi kutha momagumbo gawo mEsabati. Inaa longa sha mEsabati. Naye li dhiginine esiku eyapuki, ngaashi nda lombwele oohekulu.
Oohekulu inaa pulakena ndje nenge ya pupe ndje. Oya tangalala; inaa vulika kungame nenge yi ilonge ndje.

“Lombwela aantu mbaka kutya oye na okuvulika kiipango yandje ayihe. Inaa humbata nando omutenge taa pitile miiyelo yoshilando mEsabati. Oye na okudhiginina Esabati, li ninge esiku eyapuki, nokaye na okulonga sha.

Nena aakwaniilwa nomalenga otaga ka pitila momiyelo dhaJerusalem notaga kala ge na uukwaniilwa mboka David a li e u na. Aajuda pamwe nAajerusalem otaa ka londa komatembakwiita nokuukambe, noshilando Jerusalem otashi ka udha aantu.

Aantu otaa ka za kiilando yaJuda nokomikunda dha kunduka Jerusalem; otaa ke ya taa zi koshikandjo shaBenjamin nokiikulundundu yoponyonga yoondundu, koondundu nokuumbugantu waJuda. Otaa ka eta kotempeli yandje omafikilondjambo, oontselelandjambo, oondjambo dhiikulya nodhiitsinino nosho wo omahambelelondjambo.

Ihe oye na okuvulika kungame nokudhiginina Esabati, esiku eyapuki. Inaa humbata nando omutenge gwasha taa pitile miiyelo yaJerusalem esiku ndyoka, oshoka ngele taye shi ningi, otandi ka tomeka iiyelo yaJerusalem omulilo. Omulilo otagu ka hwama moombala dhaJerusalem, nokaku na ngoka ta vulu oku gu dhima.”
18: Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti:
“Kulukila monzimbogo yomuhongi gwiiyuma, omo tandi ku lombwelele oohapu.”
Onda yi mo nonda adha omuhongi gwiiyuma ta longele poshidhingolokitaafula she.
Oshihongwa ngele osha yonuka, ngaashi hashi ningwa olwindji, okwe shi mbumbinga nokwa hongo oshiyuma shilwe shi ili.
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti:
“Kandi na uuthemba okuninga aantu yandje Aaisraeli, ngaashi omuhongi gwiiyuma ta ningi neloya? Omu li miikaha yandje ngashika eloya li li miikaha yomuhongi gwiiyuma.
Ngele nda ti, otii ka tudha mo oshigwana nenge oshilongo, ndi shi teyagule noku shi hanagula po,
ihe oshigwana shoka ngele oshi itedhulula she etha uuwinayi washo, itandi ka ninga we, ngaashi nda tile.
Kombinga onkwawo ngele tandi ti, otandi ka tsika nenge ndi tunge po oshigwana nenge oshilongo,
ihe oshigwana shoka itashi vulika kungame e tashi kolokosha, itii ka ninga shoka nda tile.
Onkee ano lombwela Aajuda nAajerusalem kutya otandi ya dhiladhilile omageelo. Ya lombwela, ya tule po uulunde wawo — ya ethe oondjila dhawo oombwinayi nokwoopaleka iikala niilonga yawo.
Otaa ka yamukula taa ti: ‘Aawe, omolwashike tu na oku shi ninga? Otatu kala twa tangalala notatu ningi naanaa ngaashi twa hala, kehe ngoka meikukutiko lyomwenyo gwe.’ ”

Omuwa ota ti:
“Ka puleni utale koshigwana kehe,
ngele oshinima sha tya ngaaka osha ningilwe nale.
Aaisraeli oya hunu!

Oondundu dhaLibanon otadhi kala tuu dhaa na olumi?
Omalunza gomeya koondungu dhadho otaga pwine po tuu,
uupompolonga waahwiyaka waa pompolokithe omeya omatalala?

Aantu yandje otandi ya halakanithile komeho gaatondi yawo,
ya fa ontsi tayi pepwa po kombepo yokuuzilo.
Otandi ya pilamene;
itandi ya kwatha mesiku lyuudhigu wawo.”

Aantu oya ti: “Jeremia natu mu ninge sha! Oshoka aayambi ohaye tu longo aluhe ompango, aanandunge ohaye tu tsu omayele, naahunganeki ohaa uvitha oohapu dhaKalunga. Natu mu nukileni nomalaka getu, tse twaa pulakene we shoka ta popi.”
Onda galikana nda ti: “Omuwa, uva shoka tandi ti nou pulakene shoka aatondi yandje taa popi ndje.
Uuwinayi otau ningi tuu ondjambi yuuwanawa? Oya fulile ndje ekelo, ndi gwile mo. Dhimbulukwa, nkene nde ya kungoye notandi ya popile, opo waaye ya geele.
Ihe ngashingeyi, Omuwa oyana naa se kondjala; ya dhipagela miita. Aakiiintu yawo naa ninge aaselekadhi yaa na oluvalo; aalumentu naa se po kelega, aalumentu aagundjuka naa sile miita.
Tuma ongundu yaayugi yi hanagule po omagumbo gawo pwaa na elondodho; ya halutha, ya lilagane muumbanda. Oya fulile ndje ekelo, ndi gwile mo, noya lukilile ndje omwigo gu yule ndje.
Ihe, Omuwa, oto tseya iipotha yawo yokudhipaga ndje. Ino ya kuthila po uuwinayi wawo nenge u dhime po uulunde mboka ye u ningi. Ya hata pevi, ngoye u ya tamaneke esiku lyondjahi yoye.”
19: Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje, ndi ka lande oshuma sheloya nondi kuthe aakuluntu yamwe yoshigwana noyomaayambi,
tu ye kesilu Ben Hinnom nokupitila mOmweelo gwiikangwa, opo ndi uvithile ko oohapu te dhi pe ndje.

Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje, ndi tye: “Aakwaniilwa yaJuda nAajerusalem, pulakeneni shoka ngame, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, Kalunga kaIsrael, tandi ti. Otandi ka eta oshiponga mehala ndika, noshaa ngoka te shi kundana, ota ka kunkwa.

Otandi ka ninga ngaaka, oshoka aantu oye etha ndje e taa nyateke ehala ndika nokuyamba omafikilondjambo kiikalunga yaapagani — iikalunga tuu mbyoka yo yene nenge oohekulu nenge aakwaniilwa yaJuda inaye yi tseya. Ehala ndika oye li udhitha ombinzi yaakaanandjo.
Noya tungu iiyambelo yaBaal, opo ya lungunithile ko oyana ya ninge omafikilondjambo. Inandi ya lombwela nando, ye shi ninge; inashi ya mo nando okuli momadhiladhilo gandje.
Onkee ano ethimbo otali ya, uuna ehala ndika itaali ka ithanwa we Tofet nenge esilu Ben Hinnom. Otali ka tseyika Esilu lyonakupila.

Mehala tuu ndika otandi ka keelela oondunge adhihe dhAajuda nAajerusalem. Otandi ke ya sinditha kaatondi yawo, notaye ya dhipagele molugodhi. Omidhimba dhawo otadhi ka ninga oondya dhoondhila nodhiithitukuti.
Oshilando shika otandi ke shi ninga eha lyehalutho, li dhinike aluhe. Ayehe mboka taa piti po, otaa haluka ya kumwa.
Aatondi otaa ka kondeka oshilando notaa dhipaga aantu yasho. Ekondeka otali ka ninga elulululu, sigo aantu moshilando taa lyaathana po notaa li po wo uunona wawo.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje, ndi tatule oshiyuma montaneho yaantu mboka nda yi nayo

noku ya lombwela kutya Omuwa Omunankondoawike okwa ti: “Otandi tatula aantu mbaka noshilando shika, notashi ka fa oshiyuma shika sheloya sha tatuka, itashi vulu we okutulwa kumwe. Aantu otaa ka fumvika aasi yawo muTofet, oshoka itaku ka kala we ehala lyokufumvika palwe.
Otandi uvaneke kutya oshilando shika naantu yasho otandi shi ningi sha fa Tofet.

Omagumbo gaJerusalem nomagumbo gaakwaniilwa yaJuda otaga ka kala ge na oshidhila ngaashi Tofet — omagumbo agehe ngoka kombanda yoondunda kwa fikililwa oonyothi iitsinino nokwa tililwa iikalunga yilwe oondjambo dhomaviinu.”
Opo ihe onda zi muTofet, moka Omuwa a tumine ndje, ndi ka uvithe oohapu dhe. Onda yi nonda ka thikama mehale lyotempeli nonda lombwele aantu ayehe
kutya Omuwa Omunankondoawike, Kalunga kaIsrael, okwa ti: “Otandi undulile oshilando shika niilando ayihe yi li popepi nasho, egeelo lyandje, oshoka one aatangalali noitamu pulakene shoka te ti.”
20: Omuyambi Pashhur yaImmer, ngoka a li omutonateli omukuluntu gwotempeli, sho u uvu tandi uvitha iinima mbika,
okwa ti, nandi dhengwe nokutulwa moonkandja posheelo shopombanda shaBenjamin motempeli.
Ongula sho kwa shi, Pashhur okwa mangululitha ndje nonde mu lombwele nda ti: “Omuwa ite ku luku we Pashhur, ote ku ithana Magor Missabib.

Omuwa mwene okwa ti: ‘Otandi ku ningi oshihaluthi kungoye mwene nokookuume koye, noto ke ya tala ayehe taa dhipagwa negongamwele lyaatondi. Aajuda ayehe otandi ya gandja miikaha yomukwaniilwa gwaBabilon; ota ka fala yamwe po aapongekwa koshilongo she nayamwe ote ya dhipaga po.
Otandi ka etha aatondi ya yuge po uuyamba auhe woshilando shika nokukwata iilikolwa nolutumbo aluhe lwasho, nokuli nomaliko gaakwaniilwa yaJuda, e taye ga fala kuBabilon.
Nangoye Pashhur naanegumbo yoye ayehe otamu ka kwatwa po notamu ka falwa kuBabilon. Oko to ka sila e to fumvikwa pamwe nookuume koye ayehe, oyo tuu mboka wa lombwele iifundja oyindjiyindji.’ ”

Omuwa, ongoye wa kotokele ndje, nonda kotokelwa.
Ongoye omunankondo u vule ndje,
owa gwililile ndje po.
Shaa ngoka ota ningi ndje oshipwedhela,
otaa nyonkele ndje omutenya aguhe.

Nge tandi popi,
ondi na okwiigidha tandi kololoka te ti: “Eyugo! Ehanagulo!”
Omuwa, otandi yolwa nonda nyemwa,
uuna tandi uvitha oohapu dhoye.

Ihe nge te ti: “Otandi dhimbwa, ite popi we medhina lye,”
nena etumwalaka lyoye olya fa omulilo gwa hwama meni lyandje.
Onde gu idhidhimikile,
ihe ine vula okumwena.

Ondu uvite, ayehe taa nongona taa ti:
“Omahalutho akuhe! Natu ke mu popyeni kaambala!”
Nookuume kandje oya langela ndje taa ti:
“Pamwe tatu mu tula muugoya, nena otatu mu kwata
e tatu polithile ondjahi yetu muye.”

Ihe, Omuwa, ongoye u li pamwe nangame,
omunankondo nomunamatha;
aatidhagani yandje otaa ka punduka
yo itaa vulu sha.
Otaa ka sithwa ohoni sigo aluhe,
oshoka itaa ka tompola sha.
Ohoni yawo itayi ka dhimbiwa.

Ihe, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, oto yeleke aayuuki;
owa tseya shoka shi li momitima nomomatedho gawo.
Pitika ndje ndi tale, sho to geele aatondi yandje,
oshoka ondi ikalitha miikaha yoye.

Imbileni Omuwa!
Hambeleleni Omuwa!
Oye ha yululula omuhepekwa miikaha yaakolokoshi.

Esiku nda valwa nali thingwe!
Esiku ndyoka meme a vala ndje inali yambekwa!

Ethingano nali adhe omuntu ngoka a nyanyudha tate pombanda,
sho e mu etele onkundana tayi ti:
“Okamati! Wa mono omumati!”

Na fe iilando mbyoka Omuwa a hanagula po pwaa na ohenda.
Ongula na uve onkugo yuuwehame
nonkalu moshanga shomutenya,

oshoka ina dhipagela ndje mela lyameme.
Ando oshivalelo shameme sha ningi ombila yandje
nela lye ondjugo yandje sigo aluhe!

Omolwashike nda zi mo moshivalelo shameme,
ndi mone iihuna nuudhigu mbu
nondi hulithile omwenyo gwandje mohoni?
21: Omukwaniilwa Sedekia okwa tumu Pashhur yaMalkija nomuyambi Sefania yaMaaseia kungame ye na eindilo ndika tali ti:

“Tu kwatha u tu galikanene kOmuwa, oshoka omukwaniilwa gwaBabilonia Nebukadnezzar naakwiita ye oya kondeka oshilando. Ngiika Omuwa te tu monithile oshilongandhindhiliko ngashika nale nota thiminike Nebukadnezzar a ze po.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje, nonda lombwele aatumwa

ya ka lombwele Sedekia kutya Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, okwa ti: “Sedekia, otandi ka dhenga etangakwiita lyoye ndyoka tali kondjitha omukwaniilwa gwaBabilonia naakwiita ye. Omatati gaakwiita yoye otandi ke ga ndumbila ondumba pokati koshilando.
Otandi ke ku kondjitha noshikaha shoonkondo nokwooko kwa taganana, nondjahi yandje, nongeyo yandje nonuupyundjahi wandje.
Otandi ka dhipaga ayehe moshilando shika; aantu niinamwenyo otayi si kelega etilithi.

Ihe ngoye, omalenga goye naantu mboka ya hupu ko kiita, kondjala nokelega, otandi ke mu kwatitha po amuhe komukwaniilwa Nebukadnezzar nokaatondi yeni, mboka ya hala oku mu dhipaga. Nebukadnezzar ote ke mu dhipaga. Ita ka hupitha ko nando ogumwe gwomune nenge e mu sile ohenda nenge e mu etele olukeno. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje, ndi lombwele aantu ndi tye: “Pulakeneni! Ongame, Omuwa, otandi mu pe ehogololo, mu hogolole ondjila ndjoka tayi fala komwenyo nenge ndjoka tayi fala meso.

Shaa ngoka ta kala moshilando shika, ota ka dhipagelwa miita nenge ta ka sa kondjala nenge kelega. Ihe ngoka ta piti mo noti igandja kAababilonia, aakondeki yoshilando, ota ka hupa e ta kala e na omwenyo.
Onda tokola ndaa hupithe oshilando shika, ihe ndi shi hanagule po. Otashi ka gandjwa miikaha yomukwaniilwa gwaBabilon, oye note shi fike po, shi lungune po. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”

Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje, ndi gandje elaka ndika kombala yaJuda, oluvalo lwaDavid, tali ti: “Pulakeneni shoka ngame, Omuwa, tandi ti. Tokoleni pauyuuki esiku kehe. Hupitheni omuyugwa miikaha yomuyugi. Ngele itamu shi ningi, uuwinayi mboka tamu ningi, otau ka hwameka ondjahi yandje ya fa omulilo itaagu dhimwa.
Ngoye, Jerusalem, owa kuutumba puule pombanda yomasilu, wa fa ondundu ya yeluka kombanda yolushandja. Otandi ke ku kondjitha. Oto ti kaku na ngoka te ku ponokele nenge a teyagule omapopilo goye.
Otandi ku geelele shoka wa ningi. Ombala yoye otandi ke yi tomeka omulilo, nomulilo otagu ka lungunitha po ashihe shoka she yi kunduka. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
22: Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje, ndi ye kuuwa womukwaniilwa gwaJuda, oluvalo lwaDavid, ndi ka lombwele omukwaniilwa, omalenga ge nAajerusalem, ya pulakene shoka Omuwa a popi ta ti:

“Ongame, Omuwa, tandi mu lombwele mu longe shoka oshiwanawa noshu uka. Hupitheni omuyugwa miikaha yomuyugi. Inamu ngwandjagula nenge mu hepeke aakwiilongo, oothigwa nenge aaselekadhi, ne inamu dhipagela aantu yaa na ondjo mehala ndika eyapuki.

Ngele otamu ningi shili, ngaashi nde mu lombwele, nena oluvalo lwaDavid otalu ka tsikila okukala muukwaniilwa. Noyo ayehe kumwe nomalenga gawo naantu yawo otaa tsikile okupitila miiyelo yuuwa ye li momatembakwiita noya kayila uukambe.
Ihe ngele itamu vulika komalombwelo gandje, nena otandi mu ganene kutya uuwa mbuka otau ka teka po. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.
“Sho te tala uuwa waJuda, owo opalela ndje wa fa oshilongo Gilead nowa fa oondundu dhaLibanon; ihe otandi u ningi ehala lyaa na aantu.
Otandi tumu aantu ye u hanagule po. Ayehe otaye etelele omakuya gawo, otaa keke po omiti omisendeli notaye dhi umbile meziko.
“Aantu yomiigwana oyindji otaa ka pitilila po poshilando shika notaa pulathana taa ti: ‘Omolwashike Omuwa a ningile ngeyi oshilando shika oshinene?’
Eyamukulo otali ka kala: ‘Oshoka oye etha ehangano lyOmuwa, Kalunga kawo, e taa simaneke nokulongela ookalunga yalwe.’ ”
Aajuda ne, inamu lila omusi Josia; inamu sila oluhodhi ngoka a ka lala nale. Ihe lileni omwanamati Joahas; otaye ke mu fala ko, noita galuka ko we, nevi a valelwa mo, ite ke li mona we.
Omuwa ota popi Joahas yaJosia, ngoka a landula he muukwaniilwa waJuda ta ti: “Okwa yi a yililila, ita galuka we.
Ota ka sila moshilongo shoka a falwa, noita ka mona we oshilongo shika.”

Yaye ngoka ta tungitha uuwa we uukolokoshi,
nomafilitsa ge uugoyoki.
Ota longitha omukwawo osima
noita gandja ondjambi yaaniilonga ye.

Yaye ngoka ta popi ta ti:
“Otandi ki itungila ongulumbala yi na efilitsa lyomala ga andjuka.”
Ota tungile mo omakende,
ote yi ambeke nomisendeli
e te yi painda nuutiligane.

Ou shi, otashi ku ningi omukwaniilwa wa za ko,
nge wa tungu uuwa womisendeli,
egumbo ewanawa li vule galwe?
Ho okwa li inaa hepa iikulya niikunuwa,
ihe okwa longo shoka shu uka nosho opala,
naayihe oye ende nawa.

Ihe ngoye oho lalakanene okutaneka owala eliko lyoye mwene,
okutilahi ombinzi yaakaanandjo
nokuthindila nonyanya aantu yoye pevi.
Omuwa oye a popi.

Onkee ano Omuwa ta popi Jehoiakim yaJosia, omukwaniilwa gwaJuda, ta ti:
“Kaku na ngoka ta ka lila oosa dhe ta ti:
‘Akutu, tatekulu, akwetse, mentu gwameme!’
Kaku na ngoka te ke mu lila nenge a popye a tye:
‘Akutu shime, akwetse Nkeyama!’

Ota ka fumvikwa a fa okasino taka kookololwa po
e taka dhogelwa handiyaka yiiyelo yaJerusalem.”

YAjerusalem, londeni kuLibanon mu kugagane,
indeni koshilongo Baasha mu igidhe;
kololokeni koondundu dhaMoab,
oshoka ookuume keni ayehe oya dhengwa.

Omuwa okwe mu lombwele nale, manga mu li meloolo,
ihe ne omwa tindi okupulakena.
Shika osho hamu ningi aluhe mokukala kweni;
ne ihamu vulika kOmuwa.

Aawiliki yeni otaa ka pepwa po kombepo,
ookuume keni otaa ka kwatwa po miita,
oshilando sheni otashi shundulwa nokusa ohoni,
omoluuwinayi mboka mwa ningi.

Owa kala megumbo lyomisendeli dhaLibanon,
lya fa oshihandhila shokuvululukilwa mo.
Oto ka fudhagana ngiini,
uuna uuwehame tau ku kalukile,
nuudhigu wa fa womukulukadhi ta thetwa.
Omuwa okwa lombwele omukwaniilwa gwaJuda Jehoiakin yaJehoiakim ta ti: “Oshili, ngaashi ndi na omwenyo, nando u kale okalinga koshihako koshikaha shandje shokolulyo, otandi ku hukula ko.
Otandi ku gandja kaantu mboka we ya tila, oomboka ya hala oku ku dhipaga. Otandi ke ku gandja miikaha yaNebukadnezzar, omukwaniilwa gwaBabilon, noyaakwiita ye.
Otandi ke mu umbila ne nanyoko muupongekwa koshilongo hoka inaamu valelwa ko, noko tamu ka sila amuhe.
Oshilongo shika shondjuulukwe yeni itamu shi mono we, itamu galukile we kusho.”
Omulumentu nguka Jehoiakin okwa ningi nani a dhinika, a fa oshiyuma sha tatuka noshe ekelwahi, inaashi halika we? Omolwashike a dhogwa pamwe noyana, u umbilwa moshilongo kee shi shi?
Evi, evi, evi! Pulakena oohapu dhOmuwa!

Omuwa ota popi ta ti:
“Ndhindhilikeni omulumentu nguka
a fa kee na oluvalo,
omuntu kee na elago mokukala kwe akuhe.
Kaku na nando ogumwe gwomoyana
ta kala e na elago lyokukuutumba koshipangelapundi shaDavid
ye a pangele we muJuda.”
23: “Akwetse aasita mboka taa yonagula nokuhalakanitha oonzi dhuusita wandje,” Omuwa osho ta ti.

Onkee ano Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, ota popi ta lombwele aasita mboka taa litha aantu ye ta ti: “Inamu sila nawa aantu yandje oshimpwiyu; omwe ya halakanitha nomwe ya tidha po. Ngashingeyi otandi ke mu geelela uuwinayi mboka mwe u ningi.
Otandi ka gongela oshihupe shaantu yandje miilongo moka nde ya halakanithile mo notandi ya eta kevi lyawo. Otaa ka kala ye na aanona oyendji notayi indjipala.
Otandi ka langeka aaleli ye ya sile oshimpwiyu. Aantu yandje itaa ka tila we nenge ya haluke, noitandi ke ya geela we. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Esiku otali ya, uuna tandi ka hogolola omukwaniilwa omuyuuki gwomoluvalo lwaDavid. Omukwaniilwa ngoka ota ka lela nowino nota longo shoka shu uka nosho opala mevi alihe.
Uuna ta ningi omukwaniilwa, Aajuda otaa ka kala yaa na ombudhi yasha, nAaisraeli otaa ka kala ye na ombili. Ota ka lukwa ‘Omuwa ehupitho lyetu.’ ”
Omuwa ota ti: “Esiku otali ya, uuna aantu itaa ka gana we medhina lyOmuwa omunamwenyo ngoka a tembudha mo Aaisraeli muEgipiti,
ihe otaa gana medhina lyOmuwa omunamwenyo ngoka e ya tembudha mo moshilongo shokuumbangalantu nomiilongo ayihe moka nde ya halakanithile mo. Nena otaa ka kala mevi lyawo yene.”

Omutima gwandje ogwa nyanyagulwa,
nonda kwatwa kuugolwe.
OmolwOmuwa noohapu dhe oondjapuki
onda fa omuntu a kolwa,
omulumentu a dhenga omeya.

Evi olyu udha mboka yi iteka Omuwa;
otaa uka muuwinayi
notaa longitha oonkondo dhawo pombambo.
Molwethingano lyOmuwa oshilongo otashi lili,
nomaunapelo oga kukuta.

Ondjila yawo otayi ka ninga omuthenu yo yi na omilema.
Otandi ke ya tengukitha, ya gwile po.
Otandi ke ya umbila omupya;
ethimbo lyegeelo lyawo olya thikana.
Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.

Onda mono oshiyematitha maahunganeki yomuSamaria:
oya hunganeke medhina lyaBaal
noya pukitha aantu yandje.

Ihe maahunganeki yomuJerusalem onda mono mo iihuna:
otaa hondele yo taa fundju;
otaa koleke mboka taa kolokosha,
onkee ano kaku na nando ogumwe te etha uuwinayi.
Kungame oyo ayehe aawinayi,
oya fa Aasodomu nAagomorra.

“Onkee ano ngame, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, otandi popi aahunganeki Aajerusalem te ti: otandi ke ya litha oshigwanga oshilulu noku ya nwetha omeya guuzigo, oshoka oya taandelitha uukwaanakalunga noshilongo ashihe.”
Omuwa Omunankondoawike ota lombwele Aajerusalem ta ti: “Inamu pulakena shoka aahunganeki mboka taa ti! Otaye mu tula muugoya, otaye mu lombwele omafafaeko gawo yene, hangaashi nde ya lombwela.
Otaa dhiginine okulombwela aantu mboka haa dhini ndje kutya Omuwa ota ti: ‘Otamu kala nombili.’ Nokumboka ya tangalala koomwenyo dhawo, otaa ti: ‘Itamu adhika nando okoshiponga shasha.’ ”
Olye gwomuyo a kundathana nOmuwa, a pulakene nokuuva elaka lye? Olye a dhimbulula nokupupa ko koohapu dhe?
Ondjahi ye oyo oshikungulu, ombepo yepukutula tayi ka tukulukila komitse dhaakaanakalunga,
noitayi ka lota, sigo a gwanitha ayihe mbyoka a nuna okuninga. Momasiku tage ya aantu ye otaa ka uva ko nawa ayihe mbika.
Omuwa okwa ti: “Aahunganeki mbaka inandi ya tuma, nando oya yi. Inandi ya pa elaka lyandje, ihe otaa popi medhina lyandje.
Andola oya kundathana nangame, ando oyu uvithile aantu yandje oohapu dhandje noku ya galula ko koondjila dhawo oombwinayi nokiilonga yawo iiwinayi.
“Ongame Kalunga ndi li apehe, hapeha limwe alike.
Kaku na ngoka ta vulu okuholama ndje, ndaaye mu mone andola. Hangame nguka tandi udha egulu nokombanda yevi?
Onda tseya aahunganeki mboka, nkene taa popi iifundja medhina lyandje. Aniwa onde ya lombwela oohapu dhandje moondjodhi dhawo.
Sigo uunake aahunganeki mboka taa pukitha aantu yandje niilombo yawo ye yi toto?
Otaa dhiladhila kutya oondjodhi ndhoka taa hokololelathana, otadhi dhimbitha ndje kaantu yandje, naanaa ngaashi oohekulu ya dhimbwa ndje e taa gama kuBaal.
Omuhunganeki ngoka a yaguma, oku na okutya, ndjika ondjodhi yowala, ihe omuhunganeki ngoka u uvu oohapu dhandje, oku na oku dhi uvitha nuudhiginini. Etutu otali yelekwa tuu niilya?
Oohapu dhandje odha fa omulilo, nodha fa osilwa tayi nyanyagula omamanya.
Otandi kondjitha aahunganeki mboka taa taambathana oohapu yo taye dhi uvitha dha fa dhandje.
Otandi tsu ondumbo naahunganeki mboka taa uvitha oohapu dhawo notaa ti, odha za kungame.

Pulakeneni shoka ngame, Omuwa, tandi mu lombwele. Onda tsa ondumbo naahunganeki mboka taa hokolola oondjodhi dhawo dhu udha iifundja. Otaa uvitha oondjodhi dhawo e taa pukitha aantu yandje niilombo yawo nomainomo gawo. Inandi ya tuma nando nenge ndi ya lombwele ya ye, nokaye na omupondo gwasha kaantu yandje. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”

Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Jeremia, uuna gumwe gwomaantu yandje nenge omuhunganeki nenge omuyambi te ku pula ta ti: ‘Etumwalaka lyOmuwa oshike?’ ou na oku mu lombwela to ti: ‘One omutenge gwOmuwa, note ke mu ekelahi.’
Ngele gumwe gwomaantu yandje nenge omuhunganeki nenge omuyambi ta longitha iitya mbika ‘omutenge gwOmuwa’, otandi ke mu geela negumbo lye.
Peha lyasho shaa ngoka oku na okupula ookuume ke naakwawo ta ti: ‘Omuwa okwa gandja eyamukulo lini? Omuwa okwa ti ngiini?’

Ano inaa popya we ya tye ‘omutenge gwOmuwa’, oshoka ngele oku na ngoka te shi ningi, etumwalaka lyandje otali ka ninga shili omutenge kuye. Aantu oya goyokitha oohapu dhaKalunga kawo, Kalunga omunamwenyo, Omuwa Omunankondoawike.
Jeremia, pula aahunganeki to ti: ‘Omuwa okwe mu pe eyamukulo lyashike? Omuwa okwa ti ngiini?’
Nongele itaa vulika kelombwelo lyandje yo taa tumbula iitya ‘omutenge gwOmuwa’, nena ya lombwela kutya
