“Yaye Aanebo, oshilando shawo otashi hanagulwa po!
Kirjatajim otashi kwatwa po,
epopilongulu lyasho otali kumunwa po,
naantu yasho otaa sithwa ohoni.

Eadhimo lyaMoab otali hulu po.
MuHeshbon otaa pangele okuhanagula po Moab.
Nangoye Madmen, oto mwenekwa,
omatangakwiita otage ku matukile.
Aahoronajim otaa kugu: ‘Oshiponga! Oshiponga!’

“Moab osha teka po;
pulakeneni, aanona otaa lili.

Uveni omahekumuno gawo mondjila yu uka kuLuhit,
oonkugo dhiiponga mondjila yu uka kuHoronajim.

Otaa ti: ‘Fadhukii po, mu ka holame.
Kwinyoleni mwa fa oongolo mombuga!’

“Moab, owi inekela oonkondo nuuyamba woye,
ihe ono sindika;
kalunga koye Kemosh ota yi muupongekwa,
pamwe nomalenga naayambi.

Dhikeni emanyambila lyaMoab,
otashi ka hanagulwa po mbala.
Iilando yasho otayi kumunwa po,
nokwaa na we ngoka ta kala mo.”
(Ngoka ta tonyala mokulongela Omuwa, na tulwe omutima! Na thingwe ngoka ta ngungunine egongamwele lye lyaa tilehi ombinzi!)

Omuwa okwa ti: “Moab okwa kala aluhe megameno, noina falwa muupongekwa. Moab okwa fa omaviinu gi ilongelela inaaga pimpwa mo moshiyuma, ga tulwe moshiyuma oshikwawo. Omulyo gwago inagu lunduluka, notaga shata nawa ge vule agehe.
“Onkee ano esiku otali ya, uuna tandi ka tuma aantu taa ka tilahi Moab a fa omaviinu. Otaa ka mana okutilahi omaviinu agehe miiyuma notaye yi tatula po.
Nena Aamoabi otaa ka sithwa ohoni pamwe nakalunga kawo Kemosh, naanaa ngaashi Aaisraeli ya li ya sithwa ohoni omolwokwiinekela ontsezi yoshingoli kuBetel, oshikalunga shoka ya li yi inekela.

“Aalumentu ne Aamoabi, oshike tamu iti oofule?
Omwe shi mona molugodhi?

Moab ota hanagulwa po,
iilando ye otayi matukilwa.
Aagundjuka ye yo opala otaa dhipagwa po.
Ongame omukwaniilwa, Omuwa Omunankondoawike,
nongame tuu ngoka nda popi,

Epangulo lyaMoab otali hedha ko;
ekumukopo lye otali endelele.

“Ne mboka aashiinda, lileni oshigwana shika,
amuhe mboka mwa tseya esimano lyasho.
Tyeni: ‘Epangelo lyasho lya kola olya teka po;
kashi na we esimano noonkondo.’

One mboka mwa kala muDibon,
zii ko komahala geni gesimano,
mu kuutumbe mevi montsi;
omuteyipo gwaMoab oye nguka,
a kumune po oonguluhote dhoye.

Ne mboka mwa kala muAroer,
thikameni mepola mu tegelele; puleni aafadhukipo,
moneni utale shoka sha ningwa mo.

‘Moab okwa teka po,’ osho taa yamukula,
‘mu lileni, okwa sithwa ohoni.
Uvitheni pomulonga Arnon kutya Moab okwa teka po.’
“Epangulo olya thiki kiilando yoketumbalovi: Holon, Jahsa, Mefaat.
Dibon, Nebo, Bet Diblataim,
Kiriataim, Betgamul, Betmeon,
Keriot naBozra. Epangulo olya thiki kiilando ayihe yaMoab, kokule nopopepi.
Oonkondo dhaMoab odha teka po; omatha ge oga kana po. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
Omuwa okwa ti: “Kolitheni Moab, oshoka okwa tsu ondumbo nangame. Moab ota ka galangata monkungo ye mwene, naantu otaye ke mu yola.
Moab, oto dhimbulukwa tuu, sho wa ningi Aaisraeli oshipwedhela? Owe ya nyonkele ya fa aantu ya kwatelwa mongundu yaafuthi.
“Aantu ne mwa kala muMoab, thigii po iilando yeni. Indeni mu ka kale komatayimanya! Feni onguti tayi yala oshihandhila shayo pooha dhekolombongo.
Moab oku na uuntsa wa pitilila. Ondu uvu, nkene aantu ye ye na omwiityo, uuntseyele, oshilundo noshiikwatelo.
Ngame, Omuwa, onda tseya elunduko lyawo. Einomo lyawo itali eta sha, naashoka taa longo itashi kalelele.
Omolwashoka tandi lili Aamoabi ayehe nondi na oluhodhi omolwaantu yokuKir Heres.

Otandi lili Aasibma unene shi vule Aajaser. Oshilando Sibma, owa fa omuviinu gu na iitayi ya taakana Efuta lya sa tayi ifala sigo oJaser. Ihe iiyimati yoye yothinge nomandjembele goye oga hanagulwa po.
Elago nenyanyu olya kuthwa mevi lyo ondoka lyaMoab. Onda mweneke ekunguluko lyomaviinu komatemba gokukolela. Kaku na we ngoka ta kolo omaviinu ti imbi ye ta kugilile kenyanyu.
“Aantu yomuHeshbon naElale otaa kugu, nonkugo yawo otayi uvika sigo okuJahas; otayi uvika kaantu yomuZoar, notayi uvika sigo okuHoronajim naEglat Shelishia. Okalonga Nimrim otaka pwine.
Aamoabi otandi ke ya mweneka okuyamba omafikilondjambo pomahala gawo giinonoma nokokuyambela iikalunga yawo oontselelandjambo. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.
“Omwenyo gwandje otagu lili Moab naantu yomuKir Heres gwa fa ohiya tayi hikwa, oshoka omaliko gawo ga yiwa nago.
Oyo ayehe ya kulula omitse noombenzi dhawo. Oyi ishata komaako noya zala omahahi.
Koontala dhomagumbo agehe nomomahalandjandja gaMoab omu na elilagano alike, oshoka onda tatula po Moab ongoshiyuma inaashi halika we.
Moab a tatuka po! Lileni oosa! Moab a sithwa ohoni! Moab a ningwa oshipwedhela noshihaluthi shaashiinda ye ayehe. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Tala, oku na sha sha fa ekodhi lya yalaleka omawawa galyo, tali tuka tali ukilile kuMoab.
Iilando nomapopilongulu otaga kwatwa po. Esiku ndyoka aakwiita yaMoab otaa ka haluka ya fa omukulukadhi ta thetwa.
Moab ota ka hanagulwa po, noita ka ninga we oshigwana, oshoka okwa tsu ondumbo nangame.
Omahalutho, omakelo noomwigo otadhi mu tegelele, ne Aamoabi. Omuwa oye a popi.
Ngoka ta kambadhala okufadhuka po ehalutho, ota gwile mekelo, naangoka ta zi mo mekelo, ota ka yulwa komwigo, oshoka otandi etele Moab ethimbo lyehanagulo.

Oontauki dhaa na ekwatho, otadhi kambadhala okumona egameno muHeshbon, oshilando shonale shomukwaniilwa Sihon, ihe oshi li momalaka gomulilo. Omulilo gwa yaka kooha dhoshilongo nokoondundu dhaMoab e hole iita.
Akwetse Moab! Aantu mboka ya simaneke Kemosh, oya hanagulwa po, noyana aamati naakadhona oya yiwa nayo oonkwatwa.

Ihe momasiku tage ke ya otandi ka hepulutha ishewe Moab.”
Oohapu dhepangulo lyaMoab otadhi hulile mpaka.
49: Omuwa okwa popi Ammon ta ti: “Aalumentu Aaisraeli oye li peni? Kaku na nando ogumwe a popile evi lyawo? Omolwashike ye etha aalongeli yaMilkom taa kwata po oshikandjo shezimo lyaGad e taa kala mo?

Ihe esiku otali ya, uuna aantu yomoshilandopangelo Rabba tandi ke ya uvitha onkugo yolugodhi, notashi ka kumunwa po, nomikunda dhasho otadhi ka lunguna po. Nena Israel ota ka kuthulula ko evi lye kumboka ye li kuthile po.

Heshbon, takuma, oshoka Ai osha hanagulwa po. Aakiintu yomuRabba, lileni oosa. Zaleni omahahi ne mu lile. Pwampwaukeni pokati komakulukuma. Kalunga keni Milkom ota falwa muupika pamwe naayambi nomalenga ge.
Aahasha ne, otamu itangele shike? Oonkondo dheni odha kwisha. Oshike mwi inekela oonkondo dheni notamu ti, kaku na ngoka te mu itakeke?
Otandi ke mu undulila ehaluko tali zi koombinga adhihe. Amuhe otamu ka ya ontuku. Shaa ngoka ota ka holeka omwenyo gwe mwene, nokape na we ngoka ta ka gongela ishewe omatanga.
“Ihe konakuyiwa otandi ka hepulutha Ammon ishewe. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
Omuwa Omunankondoawike okwa popi Edom ta ti: “Aaedom oya kanitha tuu oondunge dhawo? Aagandjindunge yawo itaye ya tsu we omayele mushoka taa ningi? Uunongo wawo auhe owa kana?
Aadedan, pilukeni mu matuke! Ka holameni! Otandi ka hanagula po oluvalo lwaEsau, oshoka ethimbo olya thiki, ndi ya geele.
Aatononi yomandjembele ohaa thigi ko omakukila komiviinu, aafuthi uusiku ohaa kutha po ashike shoka ye shi hala.
Ihe oluvalo lwaEsau otandi ke lu hula thiluthilu noku lu tula pontundulu, noitalu vulu we okuholama. Aaedom ayehe otaa ka yonagulwa po. Kape na ngoka ta hupu ko.
Thigilii ndje oothigwa dheni, notandi ke dhi tekula; aaselekadhi yeni nayi inekele ndje.
“Nokuli mboka inaayi ilongela okugeelwa, oye na okunwa moshitenga shegeelo. Omolwashike ngoye u kale inoo geelwa? Aawe, nangoye wo ou na okunwa mo.

Ongame mwene nda gana kutya oshilando Bozra otashi ka ningwa ehalutho notashi mbugala; aantu otaye ke shi nyonkela e taa tumbula edhina lyasho, nge taa tukana. Omikunda adhihe dhopopepi otadhi ka yonagulwa po sigo aluhe. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
Onda ti: “Edom, onda taamba elaka lya zi kOmuwa. Okwa tumu omutumwa a lombwele iigwana, yi gongaleke omatangakwiita gayo, ge ku ponokele.
Omuwa ote ke ku yululukitha, nokape na ngoka te ku simaneke.

Uuntsa woye owe ku ningilila mo. Kaku na ngoka te ku tila, ngaashi ho shi dhiladhila. Owa kala momakololo nokoondungu dhoondundu. Ihe nando u yale oshihandhila shoye pombanda wa fa ekodhi, Omuwa ote ke ku undulila pohi. Omuwa oye a popi.”
Omuwa okwa ti: “Ehanagulo ndyoka tali ka adha Edom, otali ka kala etilithi, noshaa ngoka ta piti po, ota ka haluka nokukumwa.
Edom ota ka ningilwa, ngaashi sha ningilwa Sodom naGomorra, sho ya hanagulwa po nomikunda dhopuushiinda. Nokape na we ngoka ta ka kala mo. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.

Otandi ke ya nda fa onime ya hituluka mongoya yomugulu gwaJordan tayi ya melundu lyuunapelo, notandi ka yitha Aaedom ontuku ohaluka, ya thige po oshilongo shawo. Nena omupangeli ngoka tandi hogolola, ota ka lela oshigwana. Olye ta yelekwa nangame? Olye ti itakeke ndje? Omupangeli lye ta kondjitha ndje?
Onkee ano pulakeneni shoka nda dhiladhilile Aaedom, naashoka nda sheya okuningila aantu yokoshilando Teman. Nokuli aanona yawo otaa ka kookololwa po, noshaa ngoka ota ka haluka.
Uuna Edom ta teka po, otaku ka kala endundumo enene tali kakamitha evi alihe, nekugagano lyehaluko otali ka uvika sigololo okEkololo lyaAkaba.
Tala, omutondi ote ya a fa ekodhi tali yeluka lya yalaleka omawawa galyo tali tengele lyu uka kuBozra. Esiku ndyoka aakwiita yaEdom otaa ka sholola ya fa omukulukadhi ta thetwa.”
Omuwa okwa popi Damaskus ta ti: “Aantu yomiilando yaHamat naArpad oya piyagana noya timpililwa, oshoka oya kundana onkundana ombwinayi, oya lulilwa ya fa efuta lya pindjala, itaa vulu okungungumana.
Aadamaskus otaa tyololoka, taa kwatwa kuumbanda e taa yi ontuku. Oye na uuwehame wa fa womukulukadhi ta thetwa.
Oshilando sha simana nda li nde shi hokwa, otashi hanagulwa po thilu.
Esiku ndyoka aagundjuka aamatilela otaa dhipagelwa momapandaanda goshilando, naakwiita yasho ayehe otaa kombwa po.
Otandi ka tomeka omadhingililokuma gaDamaskus omulilo e tandi fike po uuwa womukwaniilwa Benhadad. Ongame, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, nda popi.”
Omuwa okwa popi ezimo lyaKedar niikandjo yaHazor, mbyoka ya lalwa komukwaniilwa gwaBabilonia Nebukadnezzar, ta ti: “Homoneni Kedar, mu hanagule po ezimo ndyoka lyaantu yokuuzilo!
Kuthii po omatsali gawo niigunda yoonzi dhawo, omalapi gootenda dhawo naayihe yi li mootenda dhawo. Kuthii po oongamelo dhawo ne mu lombwele aantu mu tye: ‘Iihuna oyi li koombinga adhihe!’
“Aantu ne yomuHazor, ongame, Omuwa, otandi mu londodha, mu ye ontuku mu ka holame. Nebukadnezzar, omukwaniilwa gwaBabilon, okwa tsu ondumbo nane nokwa ti:
‘Ileni! Tu ponokeleni aantu mboka, manga ya thuwa! Oshilando shawo kashi na iiyelo nenge omakumba, ano kashi na eshigo lyasha.’
“Kwatii po oongamelo dhawo niimuna yawo ayihe! Otandi ka halakanithila koombinga adhihe aantu mboka haa ikulula omapalu. Otandi ya tumine oshiponga tashi zi koombinga adhihe.
Hazor otashi ka mbugala sigo aluhe. Otashi ka ninga ehala lyoombandje. Kaku na we omuntu ta ka kala mo. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
Pethimbo Sedekia a ningi omukwaniilwa gwaJuda, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, okwa lombwele ndje ehunganeko tali popi oshilongo Elam.
Okwa ti: “Otandi ka dhipaga po oondjumbeta dhomuElam adhihe ndhoka dhe mu kingika.
Otandi ka pepitha ombepo yi pepele Elam tayi ziilile koombinga adhihe, naantu yasho otandi ya halakanithile akuhe, sigo kaku na we oshilongo hoka taa ka holama ko.
Otandi ka tilitha Aaelam, ya tile aatondi yawo mboka ya hala oku ya dhipaga. Mondjahi yandje ya hwama otandi ka hanagula po Aaelam e tandi ya tumine iita, sigo nde ya kombo po thilu.
Otandi ka hanagula po aakwaniilwa naawiliki yawo e tandi tula ko oshipangelapundi shandje.
Ihe konakuyiwa otandi ka hepulutha Aaelam ishewe. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
50: Ndika olyo elaka ndyoka Omuwa e li pe ndje tali popi oshilando Babilon naantu yasho.

“Hokololeleni iigwana onkundana! Yi uvitheni!
Yelutheni ombaaneli, mu tomone onkundana!
Inamu yi holeka nando!
Babilon osha teka po!
Kalunga kasho Merodak okwa nyankulwa po!
Iimenka yaBabilon oya sithwa ohoni,
iiyelekela yasho iinyanyalithi ya singulwa po!
“Oshigwana tashi zi kuumbangalantu, otashi ya okuponokela Babilonia notashi shi ningi ombuga. Aantu niinamwenyo otayi yi ontuku, nokape na ngoka ta kala mo.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Ethimbo otali ya, uuna Aaisraeli nAajuda ayehe taa ke ya taa lili, taa kongo ndje, Kalunga kawo.
Otaa ka pula ondjila yu uka kuSion notaye yi landula. Otaa ka hangana nangame ehangano lyaaluhe noitaye li yono we.
“Aantu yandje oya fa oonzi ndhoka omusita e dhi kanithile moondundu. Oye endaenda ya fa oonzi tadhi londakana oondundu, noya dhimbwa kaandjawo.
Oya ponokelwa kwaayehe ye ya mono. Aatondi yawo otaa ti: ‘Oya yono kOmuwa, onkee shoka twa ningi, oshi li mondjila. Oohekulu oyi inekele Omuwa, nayo yene oya li ye na oku mu inekela.’
“Aaisraeli ne, zii mo muBabilonia! Shi thigii po! Ningeni shanamutango oku shi thiga po!

Otandi ka sikumudha engathithi lyiigwana muumbangalantu noku yi ponokelitha Babilonia. Otaa ka tsa ompola molugodhi, ya kondjithe oshilongo noku shi lala. Oyo oondjumbeta oonkulungu, aashoneki yiikuti ihaayi palutha.
Babilonia otashi ka luwa po, naamboka taye shi lu po, otaa ka kagunyuna po ashihe ye shi hala. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Aababilonia ne, omwa yugu oshigwana shandje. Omu na elago mwa nyanyukwa mwa fa ondema tayi yungula olupale, tamu hehema mwa fa okakambe okatsezi,
ihe oshilando sheni oshinene otashi ka fupipikwa nokusithwa ohoni. Babilonia otashi ka ninga oshishona shi vulike kiigwana ayihe; otashi ka notelwa nokumbugala.
Molwondjahi yandje kape na ngoka ta ka kala mo muBabilon; otashi ka kumuka po, naamboka taa ka pita pusho, otaa ka haluka nokukumwa.
“Ondjumbeta, tseni ompola, mu kondeke Babilon. Hwanunineni iikuti yeni ayihe kuBabilon, oshoka osha yono kungame, Omuwa.

Tseni onkalu koombinga adhihe dhoshilando! Babilon otashi igandja. Omadhingililokuma gasho otaga kumunwa po. Otandi polithile ondjahi yandje mAababilonia. Onkee polithileni ondjahi yeni muyo, mu ya ninge, ngaashi ya ningile aantu ooyakwawo.
Inamu etha ombuto yi kunwe moshilongo shoka nenge eteyo li teywe. Omukwiilongo kehe a kala mo, ota ka haluka kehomono lyaahanaguli e ta ka shuna koshilongo shaandjawo.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Aaisraeli oya fa oonzi dha kukuma nodha halakanithwa koonime. Tango oya ponokelwa komupangeli gwaAssur. Opo ihe Nebukadnezzar, omukwaniilwa gwaBabilon, okwa kunya omasipa gawo.
Molwashika ngame, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, otandi ka geela omukwaniilwa Nebukadnezzar noshilongo she, naanaa ngaashi nda geelele omupangeli gwaAssur.
Otandi ka galulila Aaisraeli kevi lyawo. Otaa ka lya iikulya ya mena kondundu Karmel nomoshikandjo Baasha notaa ka kutitha ondjala yawo niilikolwa tayi zi miikandjo yaEfraim naGilead.
Ethimbo nge lya thikana, muIsrael itamu ka monika we ombedhi nuukolokoshi muJuda, oshoka otandi ka dhimina po aantu mboka nde ya hupitha ko. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Ponokeleni aantu muMeratajim nomuPekod. Ya yapulileni Omuwa nokugana, mu ya dhipage noku ya hanagula po sheke. Gwanitheni ashihe tandi mu lombwele. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.
Oshihomo sholugodhi otashi uvika moshilongo, noku na ehanagulo enene.
Babilonia osha nyankagula po uuyuni auhe, ngashingeyi osilwa ndjoka oya nyanyagulwa po! Iigwana ayihe oya haluka kushoka sha ningilwa oshilongo shoka.
Babilonia, owa kondjitha ndje, nowa kwatwa komwigo ngoka nde ku tegele, nando ino shi tseya.
Onde egulula ompungulilo yandje yomatati nomondjahi yandje onde ga kutha mo, oshoka ngame, Omupangeliawike, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, ondi na iilonga tandi yi longo muBabilon.
Shi matukileni tamu ziilile koombinga adhihe. Matuleni iigandhi yasho. Iihakanwa yi ndumbileni ondumba ya fa ondumba yiilya. Hanagulii po oshilongo. Inamu thiga po nando oluthipa.
Dhipagii po aakwiita ayehe. Ya faleni konakupila. Yaye Aababilonia! Ethimbo olya thikana, ya geelwe.”
(Oontauki ndhoka dha zi muBabilonia nodhe ya kuJerusalem, odha hokolola, nkene Omuwa Kalunga ketu a polithile ondjahi ye mAababilonia, mboka ya hanagula po otempeli ye.)

“Lombweleni oondjumbeta, ya ponokele Babilon. Tumii ko mboka ye shi okushoneka nawa iikuti. Kondekeni oshilando, inamu etha mu ze nando omuntu. Shi peni ondjambi ndjoka she yi ilongele; shi ningeni ngaashi sha ningi yakwawo, oshoka osha shongo ndje, ongame, Omuyapuki gwaIsrael.
Onkee ano aagundjuka yasho otaa ka sila momapandaanda goshilando, naakwiita yasho ayehe otaa ka kombwa po esiku ndyoka. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.
“Babilonia, owa kinga unene, onkee ngame, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, onda tsa ondumbo nangoye. Ethimbo olya thiki, ndi ku geele.
Shigwana ngoye ho inomo, oto ka punduka; oto gwile po, nokaku na ngoka te ku kwatha. Iilando yoye otandi ke yi tomeka omulilo, noshaa shoka she ku kunduka, otashi ka hanagulwa po.”
Omuwa Omunankondoawike ota ti: “Aaisraeli nAajuda oya hepekwa. Ayehe mboka ye ya kwata po, oye ya thitikinine mo noinaye ya etha we.
Ihe omumangululi gwawo oye omunankondo — edhina lye oye Omuwa Omunankondoawike. Oye mwenemwene ti ikwatele ko nota ka eta ombili kombanda yevi, ihe kAababilonia omalwa.”

Omuwa ota ti:
“Nakusa oBabilon!
Oonakusa aantu yasho, aaleli yasho naanongo yasho.

Oonakusa aahunganeki yasho yiifundja —
oya goyapala ngiini!
Oonakusa aakwiita yasho —
oya haluka ngiini!

Hanagulii po uukambe nomatembakwiita gasho.
Oonakusa aakwiita yasho aahehelwa —
oyo aambanda ngiini!
Hanagulii po omaliko gasho;
hakaneni iihakanwa.

Oluteni nalu kalaganye,
omilonga dhi pwine.
Babilonia evi lyiimenka iitilithi,
mbyoka ya thethepaleke aantu.
“Babilon otashi ka kalwa koombidhi, komambungu nokoondhila dha nyata. Itamu ka kala we aantu, sigo aluhe.
Babilon otashi ka ningwa ngaashi Sodom naGomorra, sho nde ya hanagula nomikunda dhopuushiinda wayo. Kaku na we ngoka na ka kala mo. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.

Oya homata omatati nomagonga;
oyo aananyanya, kaa na nando onge.
Oshihomo shawo osha fa efuta tali pupu,
sho ya kayila uukambe wawo.
Oyi ilongekidhila okuhomona Babilonia.

Omukwaniilwa gwaBabilonia sho tu uvu onkundana,
omaako ge otaga gonwa.
Ye mwene ota kwatwa komahwilili
a fa omukiintu ta thetwa.

“Otandi ke ya nda fa onime ya hituluka mongoya yomugulu gwaJordan tayi ya melundu lyuunapelo, nohaluka otandi ka yitha Aababilonia ontuku, ya thige po oshilando shawo. Nena omupangeli ngoka tandi hogolola, ota ka lela oshigwana. Olye ta yelekwa nangame? Olye ti itakeke ndje? Omupangeli lye ta kondjitha ndje?
Onkee ano pulakeneni shoka nda dhiladhilile oshilando Babilon, naashoka nda sheya okuningila aantu yasho. Nokuli naanona yawo otaa ka kookololwa po, noshaa ngoka ota ka haluka.
Uuna Babilon tashi teka po, otaku ka kala endundumo enene tali kakamitha evi alihe, nekugagano lyehaluko otali ka uvika kiigwana.”
51: Omuwa ota ti: “Otandi ka tukulutha ombepo yehanagulo, yi kondjithe Babilonia naLeb-Kamai.

Otandi ka tuma aakwiilongo ya hanagule po Babilonia ya fa ombepo tayi pepe po etutu. Esiku ndyoka lyehanagulo uuna nali thiki, otaye ke shi homona taa ziilile koombinga adhihe notaa mbugaleke oshilongo.
Inamu pa oondjumbeta dhasho ompito okulukila omatati gadho nenge dhi homate omahwahwa gadho. Inamu hupitha ko aagundjuka. Etangakwiita alihe okomupeshe!
Otaa ka ninga oomwahe nokusila momapandaanda giilando yawo.
Ngame, Omuwa, Kalunga Omunankondoawike, inandi etha Israel naJuda, nando oya yono kungame, Omuyapuki gwaIsrael.
Tembukii mo muBabilonia! Ka holekeni okafudho keni! Inamu dhipagelwa uulunde wAababilonia! Ongame mwene tandi ikwatele ko noku shi geela ngaashi shi ilongele.
Babilonia osha li sha fa oshitenga shoshingoli miikaha yandje; osha kolitha uuyuni auhe. Iigwana oya kolwa komaviinu gasho noya pwidhuka moondunge dhayo.
Babilonia osha teka po ohaluka nosha hanagulwa po. Shi lileni! Shi gwayekeni omuti piilalo yasho, pamwe tashi vulu okwaaludhwa.

Aakwiilongo mboka ya kala mo, oya ti: ‘Otwa kambadhala okukwatha Babilonia, ihe ethimbo olya pu po. Tu tembukii mo, tu shune kaandjetu. Kalunga okwa geela Babilonia noonkondo dhe adhihe nokwe shi hanagula po thiluthilu.’ ”
Omuwa ota ti: “Aantu yandje taa kugu taa ti: ‘Omuwa okwa holola kutya otu li mondjila. Tu yeni tu ka lombwele aantu muJerusalem shoka Omuwa Kalunga ketu a ningi.’ ”

Omuwa okwa sikumudha aakwaniilwa yaMedia, oshoka okwa dhiladhila a hanagule po Babilonia. Ota ka polithila ondjahi ye musho omolwehanagulo lyotempeli ye.
Oondjayi dhiita otadhi igidha: “Upikeni iikuti yeni, kutheni omahuuyanza!

Yelutheni epandela lyokuponokela omadhingililokuma gaBabilon! Indjipalekeni aatonateli! Langekeni aapekapeki! Tuleni aantu miilangela!”
Omuwa ota gwanitha shoka a tile, ote shi ningile Aababilonia.
Oshilongo shoka oshi na omilonga odhindji nomaliko ogendji, ihe ethimbo lyasho lya pu po, nongodhi yasho yomwenyo ya tokoka.
Omuwa Omunankondoawike okwa gana momwenyo gwe kutya ote eta aantu oyendji, ya ponokele Babilonia ya fa oshiluku shoombahu, oyo notaa kugilile kenyanyu lyekandanga.

Omuwa okwa shiti evi koonkondo dhe;
nokuunongo we okwa umbu uuyuni nokwa alele omagulu.

Okoohapu dhe omeya gomeyalelo taga ndunduma;
ote eta iikogo okuza kooha dhevi.
Ota shelitha oombadhi miikogo,
nota tumu ombepo tayi zi moompungulo dhe.

Omuntu kehe omugoya noke na ontseyo;
mboka haa hongo iimenka, oya thethelekwa,
oshoka iimenka mbyoka ya hambula,
oyiifundja nokayi na omwenyo.

Kalunga kaJakob ine yi fa;
oye ngoka a shiti ayihe,
nokwa hogolola Israel a ninge oshigwana she mwene.
Omuwa Omunankondoawike olyo edhina lye.

Omuwa ota ti:
“Babilonia, ngoye osilwa yandje,
omatati gandje miita.
Onde ku teyitha po iigwana niilongo,

u tunte uukambe naakayili yawo,
u tunte omatembakwiita naahingi yago,

u dhipage aasamane naakulukadhi,
u tsele aakuluntu naanona,
u kombe po aamati naakadhona,

u kutule aasita niimuna yawo ominino,
u ndande aapululi noonani dhawo,
u mbandule omalenga naambala.”
Omuwa ota ti: “Otamu ka mona ndje tandi galulile Babilonia naantu yasho uuwinayi mboka ye u ningile Jerusalem.
Babilonia, owa fa ondundu tayi hanagula po uuyuni auhe, ihe ngame, Omuwa, ongame omutondi gwoye. Otandi ke ku kwata, noku ku yelekanitha nevi e tandi ku thigi momutoko.
Mungoye itamu kuthwa we emanya tali longithwa metungo. Oto ka mbugala sigo aluhe. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.

“Yelutheni epandela, mu homone! Hikeni enkuma, opo iigwana yi uve ko! Dheulileni iigwana iita yokukondjitha Babilonia! Lombweleni aakwaniilwa yaArarat, Minni naAshkenas, ya homone. Langekeni ondjayi yokuwilika eponokelo. Eteni po uukambe wa fa oshiluku shoombahu.
Dheulileni iigwana iita yokukondjitha Babilonia. Tumeni mu hiye aakwaniilwa yaMedia, aawiliki nomalenga gawo nomatangakwiita giilongo ayihe mbyoka taye yi pangele.
Evi otali kakama notali imanana, oshoka Omuwa ota gwanitha omadhiladhilo ge, a mbugaleke Babilonia, kaamu kale we nando omuntu.
Aakwiita Aababilonia oye etha okukondja, otaa kala momapopilongulu gawo. Oya kanitha omukumo; oya fa aakulukadhi. Omiyelo dhoshilando odha teywa po, nomagumbo ga tomekwa omulilo.
Aatumwa ya tsatsakana otaa matukile komukwaniilwa gwaBabilonia, ye mu lombwele kutya omiyelo dhoshilando odha teywa po koombinga adhihe.
Aatondi oya kwata po onkondo yomulonga noya tomeke omapopilongulu omulilo. Aakwiita Aababilonia oya haluka.
Ohaluka aatondi taye ya hata pevi e taye ya lyatagula ya fa iilya polupale. Ongame, Omuwa Omunankondoawike, Kalunga kaIsrael, nda popi.”

Omukwaniilwa gwaBabilonia okwa keke po Jerusalem
e te shi li po.
Okwa koona oshilando sha fa ombiga;
okwe shi ndhilagula po a fa evukule.
Okwa yugu po shoka a hala
e te ekelehi iihupe.

Aasioni naa tye:
“Babilonia nashi geelwe
molwiikolokosha she yi tu ningile.”
Aajerusalem naa tye:
“Babilonia nashi geelwe
molwashoka she tu hepeke.”

Omuwa okwa lombwele Aajerusalem ta ti: “Otandi ke mu popila moontamanana dheni e tandi ka galulila aatondi yeni shoka ye mu ningile. Otandi ka pwinika oonza dhomeya gaBabilonia, omilonga dhasho otadhi ka kukuta.
Oshilongo shoka otashi ka ninga ondumba yomakulukuma, moka tamu kala iithitukuti. Otashi ka ninga ehaluthitho; kamu na omuntu ta ka kala mo, noshaa ngoka te shi mono, ota ka haluka.
Aababilonia ayehe otaa ndunduma ya fa oonime notaa gono ya fa uunkoshigona.
Aafukedhi ano? Otandi ke ya hangela oshituthi e tandi ya kolitha ya nyanyukwe. Otaa ka kotha e taa kothelele.
Otandi ke ya fala koshidhipagelo, ya ka kutulwe ominino ya fa oonzigona, iikombo noonzi. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
Omuwa ota popi Babilon ta ti: “Oshilando shoka sha li hashi tangwa kuuyuni, otashi kwatwa po! Babilon otashi ningi emoniko lyehalutho momeho giigwana.
Efuta otali kungulukile Babilon e tali shi siikile nomakuthikuthi taga pupu.
Iilando otayi ningi ontale, ombuga ya kalanda yaa na omeya. Kaku na we aantu taa kala mo nenge taa pitile mo.

Otandi ka pangula Bel muBabilonia noku mu ethitha iinima e yi yugu po; iigwana itayi ke mu longela we.
“Omadhingililokuma gaBabilon oga kumuka po.
Aaisraeli, zii mo musho. Fadhukii po, mu ka holeke oomwenyo dheni kuupyundjahi wandje.
Inamu tyololoka nenge mu tile molwomitoto ndhoka tamu kundana. Omumvo kehe omutoto ogwi ili tagu taandelithwa — omitoto dhiikolokosha moshilongo, aakwaniilwa sho taa kondjithathana.
Onkee ano tandi ti, ethimbo otali ya, uuna tandi ka geela iimenka yaBabilonia. Oshilongo ashihe otashi ka sithwa ohoni, naantu yasho ayehe otaa ka dhipagwa.
Shaa shoka kombanda yevi nomegulu otashi ka ligola, uuna Babilonia tashi hanagulwa po kaantu mboka taa ziilile kuumbangalantu.
Babilonia osha dhipagitha aantu akuhe muuyuni. Ngashingeyi Babilonia otashi teka po, oshoka osha dhipagitha Aaisraeli oyendji. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
Omuwa ota lombwele aantu ye muBabilonia ta ti: “Omwa hunuka meso! Indeni! Inamu dhikala! Nando omu li kokule negumbo, dhimbulukwii ndje, Omuwa gweni, ne mu tedhe Jerusalem.
Otamu ti: ‘Otwa sithwa ohoni notwa gugwa; otu uvite twaa na omwago, oshoka aakwiilongo oya kwata po omahala omayapuki motempeli.’
Onkee ano tandi ti, ethimbo otali ya, uuna tandi ka geela iimenka yaBabilon, noomwahe otadhi ka tongagana noshilongo ashihe.
Babilon nando oshi vule okulonda kegulu e tashi itungile ko epopilongulu, otandi ka tuma ko aantu ye shi hanagule po. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”

Omuwa ota ti:
“Pulakena, oku na onkugo tayi zi muBabilon,
elilagano omolwehanagulo moshilongo.

Otandi hanagula po Babilon,
otandi shi mweneke thiluthilu.
Omatangakwiita otage shi ulumine
ga fa omakuthikuthi taga pupu,
notage shi nukile noshihomo sheigidho.

Oye ya okuhanagula po Babilon;
aakwiita yasho otaa kwatwa po,
nomatati gawo taga teywa po.
Ongame Kalunga tandi geele uuwinayi,
notandi ningi Babilon, ngaashi shi ilongele.

Aaleli yasho otandi ya kolitha —
aanongo, aawiliki naakwiita.
Otaa ka kotha e taa kothelele.
Ngame, omukwaniilwa, nde shi popi,
ongame Omuwa Omunankondoawike.

Omadhingililokuma gaBabilon oshinankondo otaga ka kumunwa po,
nomiyelo dhasho dhoondungululu tadhi ka fikwa po.
Iigwana otayi ivulitha miilonga yaa na omupondo;
oonkambadhala dhayo otadhi yi momulilo.
Ongame, Omuwa, Omunankondoawike, nda popi.”

Seraia yaNerija, omutekulu gwaMakseja, okwa li elenga lyomekolo lyomukwaniilwa Sedekia. Momumvo omutine Sedekia sho a li omukwaniilwa gwaJuda, Seraia okwa yi kuBabilonia pamwe naye, nonde mu pe omakumagidho gamwe.
Onda nyolele membo ehokololo alihe tali ka adha Babilonia naayihe ya pamba Babilonia.
Onda lombwele Seraia nda ti: “Nge wa thiki kuBabilon, dhimbulukwa okuleshela aantu mokule ashihe nde shi nyola.
Galikana ihe u tye: ‘Omuwa, owa ti, oto yono po ehala ndika, opo mulyo mwaa kale nando oshishitwa, omuntu nenge oshinamwenyo, notali ningi ombuga sigo aluhe.’
Seraia, nge wa hulitha okuleshela aantu embo ndika, li mangela kemanya e to li umbile momulonga Eufrat

e to ti: ‘Babilonia osho tashi ka ningwa ngeyi — otashi ka kopita noitashi anduka ko we, omolwehanagulo ndyoka Omuwa te li shi undulile.’ ”
Oohapu dhaJeremia odha hulile mpaka ihe.
52: Sedekia okwa li e na omimvo omilongo mbali nagumwe, sho a ningi omukwaniilwa gwaJuda, nokwa lele muJerusalem omimvo omulongo nagumwe. Yina oHamutal yaJeremia gwokuLibna.
Omukwaniilwa Sedekia okwa yono kOmuwa, naanaa ngaashi Jehoiakim a ningile.

Shika osha geyitha Omuwa noonkondo, sigo a kandula ko Aajerusalem nAajuda koshipala she.
Sedekia sho a tsu ondumbo nomukwaniilwa gwaBabilonia Nebukadnezzar,

Nebukadnezzar okwe ya nomatangakwiita ge agehe e ta ponokele Jerusalem mesiku etimulongo lyomwedhi omutimulongo gwomumvo omutimugoyi gwepangelo lyaSedekia. Oya yungu ontanda yawo pondje yoshilando e taa tungu omituni dhekondekela.
Oshilando osha kala mekondekela sigo omumvo omutimulongo nogwotango gwepangelo lyaSedekia.
Mesiku etimugoyi lyomwedhi omutine gwomumvo tuu ngoka ondjala yekomba sho ya li ya geya, naantu kaa na sho taa li,

omakuma goshilando oga kumunwa po. Aababilonia nando oya li ya kondeka oshilando, aakwiita ayehe oyi iyaka mo uusiku. Oya pitile momukala gwosheelo pokati komadhingililokuma gaali kombinga yeyana lyuuwa e taa fadhuka po yu uka kolusilu lwaJordan.
Ihe aakwiita Aababilonia oya landula omukwaniilwa Sedekia e taye mu kwatele molushandja popepi naJeriko, naakwiita ye ayehe oye mu halakana.
Sedekia okwa falwa a yi komukwaniilwa Nebukadnezzar, ngoka a li muRibla moshikandjo shaHamat, naamoka Nebukadnezzar okwe mu pangula.
MuRibla okwa dhipagitha aana yaSedekia aamati montaneho ye, nomalenga gaJuda okwe ga dhipagitha po.
Opo ihe okwa tsipulitha mo omeho gaSedekia e te mu tula momalyenge nokwe mu fala kuBabilon. Sedekia okwa kala mondjedhililo muBabilon sigo okeso lye.

Mesiku etiheyali lyomwedhi omutitano gwomumvo omutimulongo nomutimugoyi gwepangelo lyaNebukadnezzar, omukwaniilwa gwaBabilon, Nebusaradan, omugandjindunge gwomukwaniilwa nondjayi yiita ye, okwe ya muJerusalem.
Okwa fike po otempeli, ombala nomagumbo gaanamadhina agehe muJerusalem,
naakwiita ye oya kumuna po omadhingililokuma goshilando.
Nena Nebusaradan okwa fala kuBabilonia aantu mboka ya thigalele moshilongo, oshihupe shomangomba naamboka yi igandjele kAababilonia.
MuJuda okwa thigile mo oohepele, mboka yaa na sho taa likola, e te ya tula miilonga yiitsambe yomiviinu nomomapya.
Aababilonia oya tatula po oongudhi dhiikushu nuutemba mboka wa li motempeli, osho wo ondama yoshikushu, e taa fala iikushu ayihe kuBabilon.

Oya fala ko wo iihupulo, iikangwa yokuyuka omutoko gwokoshiyambelo, iikonde yokutetitha uulapi woolamba, iiyaha yokukutha ombinzi moontselelandjambo, iitsininitho niikwaniipangitho yiikushu ayihe ya li hayi longithwa motempeli melongelokalunga.

Oya fala shaa shoka sha ningwa moshingoli nenge moshisiliveli, iiyaha iishona, iikangwa yomakala ga hanya, iiyaha yokukala ombinzi yoontselelandjambo, iikwatelwa yomutoko, iihukikwanyeka, iiyaha yiitsinino nuuyo wokutilila oondjambo dhomaviinu.
Iinima yoshikushu yotempeli mbyoka Salomo a li e yi hambulitha — oongudhi mbali, uutemba, ondama noongombe omulongo nambali ndhoka ondama ya li ya tentekwa kudho — oya li iidhigu okuvihwa.

Oongudhi mbali odha li dha faathana: Shaa ndjoka oya li yi na omuthika gwoondya omulongo nahetatu nolumbumbu lwoondya omulongo nambali. Odha li dhi na omitutu noombati dhi thike pomutamo gweke. Kombanda yongudhi kehe okwa li oshipaka shoshikushu shoondya ntano momuthika. Molumbumbu lwoshipaka kehe omwa li uulenga woshikushu wa tatakanithwa. Muulenga mbuka omwa li oondunga dhoshikushu dhomuti omugranati.
Metatakanitho kehe omwa li oondunga dhomugranati ethele, mwaandhoka omilongo omugoyi nahamano dha monika okuza pevi.
Nebusaradan, ondjayi yiita, okwa kwata po omuyambimukuluntu Seraia, omuyambi omutiyali Sefania naayambi aalangeli yatatu yoposheelo shotempeli.

Moshilando okwa kutha mo omumbala ngoka a li omutaleli gwetangakwiita, aagandjimayele yaheyali yomukwaniilwa mboka ya kalele natango moshilando, amushanga gwondjayi yiita, ngoka a li ha kutu aakwiita, naanamadhina yalwe omilongo hamano.
Nebusaradan okwe ya fala komukwaniilwa gwaBabilonia moshilando Ribla,

shoka shi li moshikandjo shaHamat. Oko nkoka omukwaniilwa e ya dhengitha e te ya dhipagitha.
Osho ngaaka Aajuda ya falwa muupika kokule nevi lyawo.
Ndika olyo ehokololo lyaantu mboka Nebukadnezzar e ya kwata po e te ya fala muupongekwa: Momumvo gwe omutiheyali muukwaniilwa okwa fala ko aantu 3 023;
momumvo gwe omutimulongo nomutihetatu aantu 832 yomuJerusalem;
nomomumvo gwe omutimilongombali nomutitatu aantu 745 ya kwatwa mo kuNebusaradan. Ayehe kumwe aantu 4 600 oya falwa.

Momumvo ngoka Evilmerodak a ningi omukwaniilwa gwaBabilon, okwa sile omukwaniilwa gwaJuda Jehoiakin ohenda e te mu pititha mo mondjedhililo. Shika osha ningwa mesiku etimilongombali netiheyali lyomwedhi omutimulongo nomutiyali gwomumvo omutimilongondatu nomutiheyali, sho Jehoiakin a falwa muupika.
Evilmerodak okwe mu ningi nawa e te mu yele nesimano e vule aakwaniilwa aakwawo a li nayo muupika muBabilonia.
Jehoiakin okwa li a pitikwa, a hule mo oonguwo dhe dhomondjedhililo e ta li poshitaafula shomukwaniilwa omasiku ge agehe, manga a li e na omwenyo.
Esiku kehe manga a li e na omwenyo, okwa li a gwanithilwa oompumbwe dhe adhihe.

1:
Oshilando shoka sha li shu udha aantu,
osha si uuwike ngiini!
Shoka sha li oshinankondo mokati kiigwana,
osha ningi sha fa omuselekadhi.
Shoka sha li omunyekadhi mokati kiilongo,
osha ningi omupika gwowala.

Ota lili omahodhi omapyu uusiku auhe,
omahodhi otaga pononoka koompanda dhe.
Kaku na nando ogumwe gwomaaholike ye a hupu ko te mu talaleke.
Ookuume ke ayehe oye mu kotokele
noya ningi aatondi ye.

Juda okwa falwa muupongekwa,
oku li muupika nomoluhepo.
Oku li mokati kiigwana, ye ita mono evululuko.
Aatidhagani ye oye mu kondeke,
okwa thitikininwa pokakololo.

Aathiminiki ye oya sindana,
aatondi ye otaa nyanyukwa.
Omuwa mwene okwe mu sitha oluhodhi
omolwomayono ge ogendjigendji.
Uunona we owa kwatwa po komutondi
nowa falwa muupongekwa.

Esimano lyomukadhona Sion olye mu thigi po.
Aawiliki ye oya fa oomenye dhaa na omaunapelo.
Muunkundi wawo oya nduungile komeho gaakwatipo yawo.

Momasiku guukweyi muupongekwa
Jerusalem ota dhimbulukwa uuyamba we auhe wonale,
uuna aantu ye ya gwile komeho gaatondi,
nokakwa li ngoka e ya e mu kwathe.
Aathiminiki ye oye mu tongolola
yo taa yolo okutekapo kwe.

Jerusalem okwa yono nokuyonenena,
okwi inyateke nayilela.
Ayehe mboka ya li haye mu simaneke,
otaye mu dhini ngashingeyi; oya mono eshunduko lye.
Jerusalem ota hekumuna a pungulula oshipala she.

Omuthininiki okwa ganeke iikaha ye,
a kwate po omaliko ge agehe.
Okwa mono aapagani taa hiti motempeli ye,
aantu mboka wi indike okuya megongalo lyoye.

Aantu ayehe otaa keme,
sho taa kongo oshikwiila.
Eliko lyawo lyondilo otaye li tula miilya,
opo ya kwatele mo omwenyo.
“Shi tala, Omuwa, u shi ndhindhilike, nkene tandi dhinwa.”

Kamu uvite ondjaalela,
amuhe mboka tamu pitilile po?
Lengalengeni mu tale:
oku na tuu uuwehame u thike puuwehame wandje,
mboka Omuwa a dhenge ndje nawo mesiku lyehwamo lyondjahi ye?

Okwa tumu omulilo gwa koloka muule
nogwe ya momasipa gandje.
Okwa lukile omwigo kohi yoompadhi dhandje
nokwa kulukithile ndje mo.
Okwa mbugalekitha ndje
nokwa alukitha ndje omasiku agehe.

Oshikaha she osha kutile ndje ondjoko yomayono gandje.
Okwe yi tsike kothingo yandje
nokwa pegeyitha oonkondo dhandje.
Omuwa okwa tula ndje miikaha yaatondi yandje,
nonda nyengwa okwiipopila.

Omuwa okwe ekelehi aakwiita yandje ayehe oofule.
Okwa hiyile ndje aakwiita,
opo ya hanagule po aagundjuka yandje.
Metemba lye lyokukolela,
Omuwa okwa lyatele mo omukadhona Juda.

Omolwashoka tandi lili;
omeho gandje otaga pononoka omahodhi.
Ngoka ta vulu okutalaleka ndje, oku li kokule.
Aamwandje oya halakanithwa po,
oshoka omutondi a lundalala.

Sion ota yelutha omaako ge:
kaku na ngoka te mu hekeleke.
Omuwa okwa tukulukithile Jakob aatondi koombinga adhihe.
Oya tala Jerusalem onyata ayike.

Omuwa ota pongolola nawa,
oshoka onda pingathana neutho lye.
Pulakeneni, ne iigwana ayihe,
ne mu mone uuwehame wandje.
Aakadhona yandje naamati yandje
oya falwa muupongekwa.

Onda kugile ookuume kandje ekwatho,
ihe oye etha ndje.
Aayambi naawiliki yandje oya sile moshilando kondjala,
sho ya li taa kongo okulya, ya kwatele mo omwenyo.

Omuwa, tala, uuwehame wandje uunene ngiini!
Omandjandja gandje otaga nyulukuta kuugelele.
Omutima gwandje otagu pilukile meni lyandje.
Akutukutu ko! Nda ningi omutangalali —
pondje egongamwele olya yugu ndje aanona,
ndele nomeni omu na elega.

Pulakeneni omakemo gandje.
Kaku na ngoka ta hekeleke ndje.
Aatondi yandje ayehe oyu uvu omupya gwandje;
otaa ligolele shoka wa ningi.
Thikitha esiku we li ya hunganekele,
opo ya fe ndje.

Ya pangulila uukolokoshi wawo;
ya ninga ngaashi wa ningile ndje molwoondjo dhandje.
Omakemo gandje ogendji,
nomutima gwandje otagu alukwa.
2:
Akwetse! Omuwa mondjahi ye okwa tula omukadhona Sion momilema.
Okwe ekelehi esimano lyaIsrael lyomegulu,
e li umbile pevi.
Ina dhimbulukwa we oshilyatelelo shokoompadhi dhe mesiku lyondjahi ye.

Omuwa okwa hanagula po omagumbo gaJakob pwaa na ohenda.
Mondjahi ye okwa nyanyagula omapopilongulu gaJuda,
okwe ga kumunine pevi.
Okwa sitha oshilongo naawiliki yasho ohoni.

Omuupyundjahi we, a teyagula oonkondo dhaIsrael.
Okwa tindi okukwatha pokuhomona kwomutondi
nokwa hwameke muJakob omulilo tagu lungunike ayihe yopopepi.

Okwa lukile uutati we ongomutondi,
a yelutha olulyo lwe i ilongekidha.
Ngaashi omutondi, okwa hanagula po ashihe sho opala momeho;
momatsali gomukadhona Sion,
a poolele mo ondjahi ye ya fa omulilo.

Okwa hwagununa po enkolo lye
a fa ta yonagula po oshikunino;
a halakanitha po ehala lye lyoshigongi.
Omuwa okwe ekelehi edhimbulukwo lyiituthi nOmasabati muSion.
Muupyundjahi we okwi inaga omukwaniilwa nomuyambi.

Omuwa okwe ekelehi oshiyambelo she
e ta thigi po otempeli ye.
Omakuma guuwa we e ga gandja kaatondi.
Oya kugu onkugo motempeli yOmuwa
ya fa yomesiku lyoshituthi.

Omuwa okwa li a tokola
a kumune po omadhingililokuma gaSion;
okwa tama oshiyelekithongodhi
ye ina yelutha we oshikaha she,
sigo a hanagula po ayihe thilu.
Omapopilongulu nomadhingililokuma
ogo ongotele pevi nokuyemata.

Iiyelo yaJerusalem oya ningine mevi,
okwa teyagula po iiyedhilitho yayo.
Omukwaniilwa naanamadhina yasho oye li muupongekwa.
Ompango ihayi longwa we,
naahunganeki ihaa mono we omamoniko taga zi kOmuwa.

Aawiliki yomukadhona Sion,
oya mbwata mevi ya tya thilu.
Oyi igunda ontsi momitse dhawo yo ya zala omahahi.
Aafuko Aajerusalem,
omitse dhawo odha nyongama.

Omeho gandje oga dhimeya kokulila,
omandjandja gandje otaga nyulukuta,
ehuli lyandje olya hililwa pevi,
oshoka oshigwana shandje osha gonwa,
aanona nuuhanona otau gundile momapandaanda goshilando.

Otaa pula ooyina taa ti:
“Oshithima oshi li peni?”
Otaa galangata ya fa oomwahe momapandaanda goshilando
e taa fudha mo oomwenyo dhawo ye li komagundji gooyina.

Omukadhona Jerusalem, nandi ku hokololele shike,
nandi ku yeleke nashike?
Olye ngoka ndi mu tule pungoye,
e ku hekeleke, omukadhona Sion?
Omupya gwoye omunene ngefuta,
olye ta vulu oku ku aludha?

Omamoniko gaahunganeki yoye
oga li giilombo gaa na omwago;
inaa yanuna nando uulunde woye,
oga ningi ondjambi yokupongekwa kwoye.
Oye ku lombwele omahunganeko giifundja nogomapukitho.

Aapitipo ayehe otaye ku hakelele omake.
Otaa hiki omwiilwa taa pukapukile omukadhona Jerusalem komitse e taa ti:
“Oshilando osho tuu shoka kwa tiwa osheopalo lyo lyene
nenyanyu lyuuyuni auhe?”

Aatondi yoye ayehe otaye ku nyonkele.
Otaa hiki omwiilwa yo tayi ikokota komayego.
Otaa ti: “Twe mu dhilagula po.
Ndika olyo esiku twa kala twa tegelela.
Ngashingeyi otwa thiki mulyo, twe li mono.”

Omuwa a tsakanitha shoka a popile,
okwa gwanitha oohapu dhe dha popilwe momasiku gonale.
Okwa hanagula pwaa na ohenda,
a pe omutondi gwoye ompito yoku ku nyonkela
nokuholola oonkondo dhe.

Omukadhona Sion, kuga muule, kugila Omuwa.
Omahodhi goye naga pononoke omutenya nuusiku ga fa efundja.
Ino ipa nando evululuko,
ino thithikila omeho goye.

Yambuka po, lilagana uusiku auhe nokomutakushi.
Omwenyo gwoye gu tilahi ongomeya koshipala shOmuwa.
Yeluthila omaako goye kuye omolwoomwenyo dhaamwoye,
mboka taa sile pookolonela dhomapandaanda kondjala.

Omuwa, tala u shi dhiladhile:
Olye we mu ningile ngeyi?
Omolwashike aakiintu taa li po uuhanona wawo,
oomputu ye dhi yamutha, ye dhi ukata?
Omolwashike omuyambi nomuhunganeki
taa dhipagelwa motempeli yOmuwa?

Aanona naakuluntu, oya kangawala pevi momapandaanda.
Aafuko yandje naamati,
oya gwila po ya sa kegongamwele.
Owe ya dhipaga mesiku lyondjahi yoye,
owe ya tsele waa na ohenda.

Owa hiya aahaluthi yandje koombinga adhihe,
ye ye koshituthi shomatilitho.
Mesiku lyondjahi yoye kakwa li ngoka a fadhuka po.
Ayehe mboka nda tekula nonde ya palutha,
omutondi a tula kothingo.
3:
Ngame omuntu nda talithwa omalwa
koshivugati shondjahi ye.

Ondu undagulwa nda thiminikilwa momilema
pwaa na uuyelele washa.

Esiku alihe ota pilukile ndje
noshikaha she, a kondjithe ndje.

Okwa yugu ndje oshipa
e ta kunya onyama yandje komasipa e ga teya.

Okwa hongele ndje ondjoko,
a kondeke ndje nuudhigu nuuwehame.

Okwa thiminike ndje, ndi pukile momilema
pamwe noonakusa yonalenale.

Okwa tungile ndje ekondeka,
ite vulu okuhunuka mo.
A tula ndje momalyenge ga kola.

Nando otandi kugagana tandi igidha,
ita pulakene omagalikano gandje.

Okwa thitike ondjila yandje nomamanya,
omapola gandje okwe ga golipaleke.

Okwa langele ndje a fa emwanka,
a fa onime tayi tegelele ndje moshiholameno shayo.

Okwa tidha ndje mo mondjila yandje nokwa tuulagula ndje;
okwa thigi ndje po.

Okwa lukile uutati we
e ta shoneke ndje niikuti ye.
Okwa ndjike iikuti ye molutu lwandje.

Onda ningi ondjolwi yoshigwana shandje ashihe,
otaa sheke ndje miiyimbo yawo aluhe.
Okwa kolitha ndje kuululu wonyango.

Omayego gandje okwe ga teyagulitha omawe
nokwa tsu oshipala shandje mevi.

Omwenyo gwandje okwe gu yugu ombili;
onda dhimbwa elago nenyanyu.

Ngashingeyi otandi ti: “Oonkondo dhandje odha pwine,
kandi na we etegameno lyasha tali zi kOmuwa.”

Dhimbulukwa omalwa gandje nokwaalaala kwandje,
onyango ondulundulu.

Otandi yi dhimbulukwa nawa,
omwenyo gwandje ogwa thindililwa mo nayo.

Shimwe otandi shi lombwele omwenyo gwandje,
note mono etegameno.

Okesilohenda lyOmuwa, sho inaatu yonwa po thilu,
ontalanteni ye inayi hula po.

Esilohenda lye olyo epe kehe ongula;
uudhiginini we kau na ondjele.

Omwenyo gwandje otagu ti: “Omuwa oye oshitendelwa shandje;
ongame nonde mu inekela.”

Omuwa oye omwaanawa kwaamboka ye mu inekela,
komwenyo ngoka tagu mu kongo.
Osho opala okutegelela ehupitho lyOmuwa meimweneneno.

Osho opala omulumentu a humbate ondjoko
okuza kuugundjuka we.

Na kuutumbe muuwike nokumwena,
uuna Omuwa te yi mu tsike.

Na lale montsi —
pamwe oku na natango etegameno.

Na gandje olupanda kungoka te mu dhenge,
na mone omasheko ga gwana.
Oshoka Omuwa ite ekelehi omuntu sigo aluhe.

Ngele ota geye, oku na ohenda,
esilohenda lye enenenene.

Nokuli iha nyanyukilwa okuhepeka aana yaantu
nenge oku ya nikitha oluhodhi.

Oonkwatwa adhihe moshilongo uuna tadhi vunyagulwa
notadhi lyatagulwa noompadhi,

uuna uuthemba womuntu tau thininikwa
koshipala shaanguka gwokombandambanda,

uuna omuntu ta kuthwa uuyuuki —
Omuwa ke shi wete?

Olye a popi, iinima noye ya po?
Olye e shi ningi, ngele ke shi Omuwa?

Openi nduno, ngele kamu shi mokana kwaanguka gwokombandambanda,
hamu zi uuwinayi nuuwanawa?

Omuntu oshike ta tamananene?
Oshipu okukala ta keme moluulunde we.

Tu konakoneni oondjila dhetu,
tu dhi simonone, tu galukile kOmuwa.

Tu yelutheni oomwenyo nomaako getu
kuKalunga megulu tu tye:

Otwa yono notwa kolokosha,
ongoye noino tu dhimina po.

Ongoye wi idhingile ondjahi nowe tu tidhagana,
owe tu dhipaga waa na ohenda.
Owi idhingile moshikogo itamu piti omagalikano.
Owe tu ningi etutu niifakufaku mokati kiigwana.

Aatondi yetu ye tu makulile omakana,
taye tu nyana miiyimbo.

Omahalutho nomakolombongo ogo oshitopolelwa shetu,
ekano nehanagulo.

Omeho gandje oga togala momulonga gwomahodhi
okulila ehanagulo lya adha oshigwana shandje.
Omeho gandje otaga lili gaa na evululuko,

sigo Omuwa to ontamene pevi,
e tu taalele megulu.

Omeho gandje oga pushuka iilalo
kokulila aakadhona ayehe yomoshilando shandje.

Oya yewe ndje, ya tidha ndje ngondhila,
oyo mboka ye tonde ndje owala.

Oyu undulile omwenyo gwandje monyombo,
noyu umbile mo omamanya.

Omeya oga pitilile omutse gwandje;
onda ti: “Nda kana.”
Omuwa, onde ku ithana muuleelee wonyombo.

Ou uvite onkugo yandje tayi ti: “Ino thitika okutsi kwoye,
kwaa uve omagalikano gandje.”

Owa hedha popepi, uuna ndoka nde ku ithana;
owa ti: “Ino tila.”

Ongoye, Omuwa, owa popile ndje miihokolola,
owa hupitha omwenyo gwandje.

Omuwa, ou wete omathiminiko tandi ga thiminikwa.
Uthila ndje.

Owa mono omafudhagano gawo agehe,
iineya yawo ayihe taa dhiladhilile ndje.

Omuwa, owu uvu okusheka kwawo,
niiponga ayihe taye yi dhiladhilile ndje.

Aatondi yandje otaa piyaganeke ndje
nomanongono gawo omasiku agehe.

Nando oya kuutumbe nenge ya thikame,
tala, ongame oshiimbo shawo.
Omuwa, shi ya futila, ngaashi ye shi ilongele.

Kukutika oomwenyo dhawo,
etulomutima lyoye nali ya lambele.

Ya tidha mondjahi,
ya nakula mo kohi yegulu lyoye.
4:
Akwetse, oshingoli osha ninga iikogo,
oshingoli oshiyelele osha dhimeya.
Omamanya omayapuki oga halakanithwa
ga napakana momapandaanda.

Aana yaSion, mboka ya li ye na ondilo ya fa yoshingoli sha hogololwa,
oya talwa ngashingeyi ya fa iiyuma yeloya,
oshilonga shomuhongi gwiiyuma.

Nuululunga wo hau gandja omagundji nohau yamutha uunimona wawo,
ihe aakiintu yoshigwana shandje oye na olungwenye
ya fa oompo dhomombuga.

Elaka lyokahanona otali kakatele kondaathelo omolwenota.
Uunona tau indile oshikwiila,
ihe kaku na ngoka te shi u pambulile.

Mboka ya li haa li nawa,
ngashingeyi oya kangawala momapandaanda;
mboka ya li haa ithele moonguwo oombwilili,
ngashingeyi otaa lala pelunda lyomutoko.

Uukolokoshi woshigwana shandje owa lundu pombanda
u vule uulunde waSodom,
shoka sha hanagulwa po mepathimo,
pwaa na omuntu e shi gumithe iikaha ye.

Nale aawagona yaSion oya li taa tayima ya fa oompawe,
aatotototo ye vule omahini.
Omalutu gawo oga li ge vule oonyoka dha kwehulwa,
neopalo lyawo olya li li vule eadhimo lyosafire.

Ngashingeyi oye na iipala ya fa ombiga yomudhilo,
itaa dhimbululwa we momapandaanda.
Oshipa shawo osha kakatela komasipa,
oya kukuta ya fa oshikuni.

Aanelago oyo mboka ya si kegongamwele,
oyo aahwepo ye vule mboka ya si kondjala,
oomboka ya gunda taa thithonoka
kompumbwe yiilya yomomapya.

Niikaha yawo yene, aakiintu aanahenda oya paka po oyana,
mboka ya ningi iikulya yawo
momupya ngoka gwa adha oshigwana shandje.

Omuwa okwe etha uupyundjahi we u hwame;
okwa tilehi mo ongeyo ye.
Okwa hwameke eziko lyomulilo muSion,
ndyoka lya lungunike po omakankameno ge.

Aakwaniilwa yokombanda yevi inaye shi itaala
nenge wo aakali ayehe muuyuni
kutya omuthininiki omutondi ona ka vula a hite miiyelo yaJerusalem.

Oshe ya adha moluulunde waahunganeki
nomoluumbudhi waayambi,
mboka ya tilehi ombinzi yaayuuki mokatilela koshilando.

Otaa pwampwauka momapandaanda ya fa aaposi.
Oya hipa ombinzi nokaku na ngoka
e na omukumo okuguma oonguwo dhawo.

Aantu oyi igidha ya ti:
“Kandukii po, hedhii ko, inamu tu guma!”
Sho ya tauka mo ya yi kiigwana yilwe,
inaa ziminwa nando, ya kale mokati kayo.

Omuwa oye mwene e ya halakanitha,
ite ya tonatele we nohokwe.
Aantu itaa simaneke we aayambi
noitaa pulakene aawiliki.

Otwa lolodha owala omeho getu
tatu tegelele ekwatho — osima yowala!
Kooshungo dhetu otwa pekapeka
twa tegelela oshigwana shoka inaashi vula oku tu hupitha.

Aatondi yetu oya tala oonkatu dhetu
noye edhile omagumbo getu.
Ehulilo lyetu olya thikana,
omasiku getu oga hulu.

Aatidhagani yetu oya li oontondoki,
oye vule omakodhi mewangandjo.
Oya landula oshinkoti shetu moondundu,
oye tu langele mombuga.

Omukwaniilwa gwetu, omugwayekwa gwOmuwa,
okwa gwile momakelo gawo.
Okwa li omufudho gwomomayulu getu,
ngoka twa popile tatu ti:
“Meni lyomuzile gwe otatu ka kala mokati kiigwana.”

Nyanyukwa nokuligola, ngoye oshigwana shaEdom,
ngoka wa kala moshilongo Uz!
Molufo lwoye oshitenga otashi ke ku adha:
Otashi ke ku kolitha, e to mbugalekwa.
5:
Omuwa, dhimbulukwa shoka twa ningilwa;
tu tala u mone ehutuko lyetu.

Uuthiga wetu owa yi kaayeni.
Omagumbo getu oga yi kaatyakala.

Otwa ningi oothigwa, katu na ootate;
oomeme oya fa aaselekadhi.

Omeya tatu ga nu, otatu ga futile;
iikuni tatu yi pumbwa, otayi tu pula ondando.

Ondjoko oyi li moothingo dhetu, otatu haulwa.
Otatu longo sigo eso, pwaa na oluthuwo.

Otwa yeluthile omaako getu kuEgipiti nenge kuAssur,
aniwa tu pewe iikulya ya gwana.

Ootate oya yono, ihe kaye po we.
Otse tatu si uudhigu woondjo dhawo.

Otatu lelwa kaapika
ihe kaku na ngoka te tu mangulula miikaha yawo.

Puupatekedhi woomwenyo dhetu tatu mono iikulya yetu
mokuhenuka egongamwele mombuga.

Oshipa shetu sha hanya sha fa eziko,
osha luudhikwa kepupyu lyondjala.

Oya gugitha aakulukadhi muSion,
aakadhona momikunda dhaJuda.

Oya tula aawagona kohake,
yo inaa simaneka aakuluntu yoomvi.

Aalumentu aagundjuka oya humbata iikweyithilomanya,
aamati otaa tonwa kiipandi yiikuni.

Aasamane kaye mo we momiyelo,
naagundjuka oye etha iiketala.

Enyanyu olya kana mo moomwenyo dhetu,
okutanta kwetu okwa shituka oondila.

Oshishani shesimano osha gu komitse dhetu.
Yaye tse, sho twa yono!

Molwashika oomwenyo dhetu dha ziyalala,
nomolwashika omeho getu ga siilila.

Molwashoka ondundu Sion ya mbugala,
noombandje tadhi yi lyatagula.

Ihe Omuwa, ongoye to kala po sigo aluhe,
oshipangelapundi shoye otashi kala okuza komapipi nomapipi.

Oshike to tu dhimbwa sigo aluhe?
Oshike to tu etha sigo osigo?

Tu galulila kungoye, Omuwa, notatu galukile ko.
Pepaleka omasiku getu ngashika muushitonale.
Nenge owe tu ekelehi mondjahi yaa na ondjele?

1: Mesiku etitano lyomwedhi omutine gwomumvo omutimulongo nomutitatu, ngame, omuyambi Hesekiel yaBusi, sho nda kala pamwe naapongekwa Aajuda pomulonga Kebar muBabilon, egulu olye eguluka nonda mono emoniko lyaKalunga.
(Ogwa li omumvo omutitano, sho omukwaniilwa Jehoiakin a li a falwa muupongekwa.)
Mwiyaka muBabilonia pomulonga Kebar ondu uvu Omuwa ta popitha ndje, noshikaha she osha thinda ndje.

Onda ligamene nonda mono okambiya taka zi kuumbangalantu, ka fa oshikogo oshinene sha geta omulilo, newangandjo lye shi kunduka olya li lya hanya. Mokati kasho omwa li eadhimo tali tayima, lya fa oshikushu sha hanya.
Mokati kokambiya onda ndhindhilike mo iinamwenyo ine molupe lwomuntu,
ihe kehe shimwe shomuyo osha li shi na iipala ine nomawawa gane.
Omagulu gayo oga li gu ukilila, noya li yi na omakondo ga fa gongombe. Taga adhima ga fa oshikushu sha kwehulwa.
Kakele kiipala ine nomawawa gane, kehe shimwe oshi na iikaha ine, oshikaha shimwe kohi yewawa kehe.
Omawawa gaali goshinamwenyo kehe oga li ga yalalekwa taga gumathana nogoshikwawo. Mokweenda oyu ukilila owala, inayi punguluka.
Oshinamwenyo kehe osha li shi na iipala ine: komeho oshipala shomuntu, kolulyo oshipala shonime, kolumoho oshipala shongombe nokonima oshipala shekodhi.
Omawawa gaali goshinamwenyo kehe oga li ga yeluka ga gumathana noondungu dhomawawa goshinamwenyo kehe she shi egama, nomawawa gaali oga li ga lambalala olutu lwasho.
Oshinamwenyo kehe osha li sha tala koombinga adhihe ne, onkee ongundu ya vulu okuya shaa hoka ya hala, pwaa na epunguluko lyasha.
Mokati kiinamwenyo omwa li sha sha geta sha fa onyeka, tashi inyenganyenga aluhe. Omulilo ogwa li gwa yaka gu na omalaka taga igandjana.
Iinamwenyo oya telagana nokuuka huka naahwiyaka ngeshelo lyolwaadhi.
Sho nda tongolola iinamwenyo, onda mono omagulutemba gane ga guma pevi; okugulu kumwe okwa li kombinga yoshinamwenyo kehe.
Omagulutemba agehe gane oga li ga faathana, shaa nkoka otaku adhima kwa fa emanya li na ondilo, noshaa hoka okwa li ku na okugulutemba okukwawo kwe ku shigakana mokati,
opo okugulutemba kehe otaku ngoongola mokati koombinga adhihe ne.
Omigoyo dhomagulutemba odha li dhu udha omeho.
Shaa hoka iinamwenyo tayi uka, nomagulutemba oko taga uka pamwe nayo; niinamwenyo nge tayi yeluka po pevi, nomagulutemba osho taga ningi wo.
Iinamwenyo otayi yi shaa nkoka ya hala, nomagulutemba otaga ningi naanaa, ngaashi iinamwenyo tayi ningi, oshoka iinamwenyo otayi ga utha.
Onkee shaa tuu iinamwenyo tayi yi nenge tayi thikama nenge tayi uka mombanda, nomagulutemba osho naanaa taga ningi wo.
Kombanda yomitse dhiinamwenyo okwa li ondunda ya tungwa momamanya gokristali taga adhima.
Iinamwenyo oya li meni lyondunda, shaa shoka sha yalaleka omawawa gaali gu uka pushoka shi li pusho, noshi isiikile nomawawa gaali.

Ondu uvu oshihomo shomawawa gayo, sho tayi papama mokutuka. Oshihomo shoka osha fa shefuta, sha fa oshihomo shetangakwiita enene, sha fa oshihomo shaKalunga Omunankondoawike. Nge ya lambele, otayi gonyo omawawa gayo,
ihe natango oshihomo otashi pupu pombanda yondunda komitse dhayo.
Kombanda yondunda yayo okwa li sha sha fa oshipangelapundi sha ningwa mosafire, nokoshipangelapundi kwa kuutumba nakukala a fa omuntu.
Olupe lwe olwa fa eadhimo lyoshikushu shi li meziko lya hanya. Koombinga adhihe ota tayima uuyelele wo wene.
Meadhimo omwa li omalwaala agehe guutamvula. Osho sha li olupe lweadhimo lyOmuwa.
2: Sho nde shi mono, onda tsu oshipala mevi. Ongame nondu uvu ewi tali ti: “Muna gwomuntu, thikama. Onda hala ndi popye nangoye.”
Ewi manga tali popi, yo ombepo yaKalunga oye ya mungame e tayi yambula ndje po, nonatango ondu uvu ewi tali ti:
“Muna gwomuntu, otandi ku tumu kAaisraeli. Oya tsa ondumbo notaa kondjitha ndje sigo onena ndjika, naanaa ngaashi oohekulu ye shi ningi.
Oyo aatangalali noihaa simaneke ndje nando, onkee tandi ku tumu kuyo, u ya tseyithile shoka ngame, Omuwa Omupangeliawike, tandi ya lombwele.
Kashi na nee mbudhi, aatangalali mboka ngele otaye ku pulakene nenge itaye ku pulakene, otaa ka tseya kutya omuhunganeki okwa kala mokati kawo.

“Ihe ngoye, muna gwomuntu, ino ya tila nenge u tile oohapu dhawo. Otaye ke ku nyema noku ku dhina. Oto ka kala wa fa u li mokati koondje. Ihe nando ongeyi, ino tila aanandumbo mboka nenge shaa shoka taa popi.
Ya lombwela oohapu dhandje, ngele otaa pulakene nenge itaa pulakene. Dhimbulukwa kutya oyo aatangalali.
“Muna gwomuntu, pulakena shoka tandi ku lombwele. Ino tsa ondumbo u ya fe. Makula okana koye u lye shoka tandi ke ku pa.”
Onda mono oshikaha sha ganekwa shu ukithwa kungame, nosha li sha yelutha ondhinga yembo.
Oshikaha osha dhingulula ondhinga yembo, nonda dhimbulula kutya oya li ya nyolwa meni nokombanda. Omwa li mwa nyolelwa oontakumandjimbo, omahekumuno nomayemato. Kalunga okwa ti:
3: “Muna gwomuntu, lya po ondhinga yembo ndjika, opo u ye u ka hunganekele Aaisraeli.”
Onda makula okana kandje, nokwa pe ndje ondhinga yembo, ndi yi lye po.
Okwa ti: “Muna gwomuntu, lya po ondhinga yembo ndjika tandi yi ku pe, kutitha nayo ela lyoye.” Onde yi li po, noya li yi na omulyo gwa fa omagadhi goonyushi.
Kalunga okwa ti: “Muna gwomuntu, inda kAaisraeli, u ya lombwele shoka tandi shi ku lombwele.
Itandi ku tumu koshigwana shoka hashi popi elaka lyaatakumi, ihe okAaisraeli.
Ngele otandi ku tumu kiigwana mbyoka hayi popi elaka waa li uvite ko, otaye ke ku pulakena.
Ihe kape na nando ogumwe gwomAaisraeli ta ka hala a pulakene; nokuli itaa ka pulakena ndje nando. Ayehe oyo aatangalali ye na omanganga.
Ngashingeyi otandi ku ningi omukukutu wa kindja we ya fa.
Otandi ke ku ninga omukukutu wa fa emanya nongaashi ondiamande; ino tila aatangalali mboka.”
Kalunga okwa tsikile a ti: “Muna gwomuntu, taamba oohapu dhandje adhihe tandi dhi ku lombwele. Dhi dhimbulukwa nawa.
Inda ihe kaapongekwa aakweni, u ya lombwele shoka ngame, Omuwa Omupangeliawike, tandi ya lombwele, ngele otaye ku pulakene nenge aawe.”
Ombepo yaKalunga oya yambula ndje po, nondu uvu konima yandje ewi enene tali ndunduma tali ti: “Hambeleleni esimano lyOmuwa megulu pombanda!”
Ondu uvu oshihomo shomawawa giinamwenyo, sho tagi idhenge kumwe mewangandjo, nekolokoto lyomagulu lya fa epupo lyekakamo lyevi.
Oonkondo dhOmuwa odha kwata ndje, nOmbepo ye oye enditha ndje, nonda adhika koshinyenu nda geya.
Onde ya kuTel Abib pomulonga Kebar, nkoka kwa kala aapongekwa, nonda kala ko omasiku gaheyali nda kwatwa kushoka nda monene nonde shi uvile.
Omasiku gaheyali sho ga piti po, Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti:
“Muna gwomuntu, otandi ku ningi omulangeli gwoshigwana Israel. Ou na oku ya londodha nomalondodho tandi ge ku lombwele.
Ngele otandi tomona kutya omulunde ota ka sa, ihe ngoye ito mu londodha, i itedhulule nokweetha oondjila dhe oombwinayi, ota ka sila muulunde we, ihe ombinzi ye otandi yi ku pula.
Ngele oto londodha omulunde, a ethe uulunde we, ihe ye ite shi ningi, nena ota ka sila muulunde we, ihe ngoye owa hupitha omwenyo gwoye.
“Omuyuuki ngele ote etha uuyuuki we nokuyona, notandi mu tula moshiponga, ota ka sa, ngele ino mu londodha. Ota sile muulunde we, nuuyuuki we itau dhimbulukiwa we, ihe ombinzi ye otandi yi ku pula.
Ngele oto londodha omuyuuki, opo kaa yone, oye note ku pulakene noita yono, ota kala e na omwenyo, nangoye wa hupitha omwenyo gwoye.”
Oshikaha shOmuwa osha li kombanda yandje, oye nokwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Thikama, u ye molusilu. Omo tandi ka popya nangoye.”
Onda yi ihe molusilu, nonda mono eadhimo lyaKalunga, naanaa ngaashi nde li mwene pomulonga Kebar. Onda tsu oshipala shandje mevi,
ihe Ombepo yaKalunga oya lambele ndje e tayi thikameke ndje. Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Inda megumbo, u ki iyedhilile mo.
Muna gwomuntu, otaye ke ku manga noongodhi, opo kuu pite mo u ye mokati kaantu.
Otandi ka lemaneka elaka lyoye, opo waa vule okulondodha aantu mbaka aapandala.

Ngele tandi ke ku popitha ishewe notandi ka makula okana koye, nena oto ke ya lombwela shoka ngame, Omuwa Omupangeliawike, tandi ti. Yamwe yomuyo otaa ka pulakena, ihe yamwe itaye ke ku pulakena, oshoka oyo aantu ye na iityani.”
4: Kalunga okwa popi a ti: “Muna gwomuntu, kutha ondhopi, yi tula komeho goye, e to thaneke kombanda yayo oshilando Jerusalem.
Shi tula ekondeka: shi fulila omukanka, shi ndumbilila omutuni, shi yungila oontanda noku shi kundukidha niikumunithi yekuma.
Kutha oshikangwa shosheela e to shi dhike sha fa ekuma pokati keni noshilando. Taalela koshilando. Oshi li mekondeka lyoye. Shika otashi ningi endhindhiliko koshigwana Israel.
“Langela kolumoho lwoye, ngame notandi ke ku tsika oondjo dhoshigwana Israel. Oto ka kala omasiku 390 to hepekwa omolwoondjo dhawo. Onde ku geelele esiku limwe omolwomumvo gumwe gwepangulo lyaIsrael.
Ngele wa vulilwa ko, galukila kolulyo lwoye, u hepekelwe oondjo dhaJuda omasiku omilongo ne — esiku limwe omolwomumvo gumwe gwepangulo lyawo.
“Omeho goye ga nzanena mo ekondeka lyaJerusalem. Shi takela omunwe, u shi hunganekele.
Otandi ke ku manga, opo waa wape okugalukila kolupati olukwawo, sigo ekondeka lya piti.
“Kutha osiima, iishokelya, omakunde, oofukwa, omahangu nosiima yoombo ndatu. Yi ninga oshikwiila shohwangalahwahwa. Shika osho to ka lya omasiku 390, sho wa langela kolumoho.
Oto ka pitikilwa uusila wekopi limwe mesiku, u ninge oshikwiila, notashi kala sigo esiku lya landula ko.
Oto ka kala wo u na ondjele yomeya gokunwa, oompamba mbali mesiku.
Ou na okutema omulilo gwomapumba gaantu omakukutu, e to yothele ko oshikwiila montaneho yawo e to shi li po.”
Omuwa okwa popi a ti: “Shika otashi hungunine Aaisraeli kutya oye na okulya iikulya mbyoka yi indikwa kompango, uuna tandi ya halakanithile niilongo yaapagani.”

Onda yamukula nda ti: “Aawe, Omuwa Omupangeliawike! Kandi na okwiinyateka. Okuza kuunona wandje inandi lya onyama yoshinamwenyo shi isila nenge sha lika kiilikama. Inandi lya nando iikulya ya talika ya nyata.”
Kalunga okwa ti: “Onawa nduno, otandi ku pitika u longithe omapumba goongombe, opo u yothele ko oshikwiila shoye.”

Okwa tsikile ko a ti: “Muna gwomuntu, otandi ka hulitha po okugandja oshikwiila muJerusalem. Aantu yamo otaa ka lulilwa nokusa oshimpwiyu, ngele taa hawalekwa iikulya mbyoka taa li nomeya ngoka taa nu.
Otaa ka sa olunagela molwompumbwe yiikulya nomeya; otaa ki ihupula notaa ka thithonoka po omoluulunde wawo.”
5: Omuwa okwa ti: “Muna gwomuntu, kutha egongamwele lya tsa, u ikulule. Viha omafufu agehe e to ga topola iitopolwa itatu.

Oshititatu shago shi lungunithila moshilando, ekondeka nge lya piti. Kutha ishewe oshititatu, shi tetagula po negongamwele lyoye e to shi halakanithile pondje yoshilando. Oshihupe shi halakanithila mombepo, ongame notandi shi landulitha egongamwele lya pweywa mo.
Thiga po omafufu omashona, u ga dhingile momigoyo dhoonguwo dhoye.
Kutha ishewe gamwe e to ga umbile meziko, u ga lungunithe po. Okuza kugo omulilo otagu yaka sigo okoshigwana shaIsrael ashihe.”
Omuwa Omupangeliawike ota ti: “Tala kuJerusalem. Onde mu tula pondingandinga yuuyuni, a kundukwa kiilongo.

Ihe Jerusalem okwa tsu ondumbo niipango yandje e ti igalaleke uulunde we e vule iigwana yilwe, e vule okwaavulika kwiilongo ye mu kunduka. Jerusalem okwe ekelehi iipango yandje nokwa tindi okudhiginina omautho gandje.

Jerusalem, pulakena ngashingeyi shoka ngame, Omuwa Omupangeliawike, tandi ti. Omolwashoka inoo vulika koompango dhandje noino dhiginina omautho gandje, owa yono nokuyonenena, u vule iigwana ye ku kunduka. Owa lambalala ontshingo.
Onkee ano ngame, Omuwa Omupangeliawike, tandi ku lombwele kutya ngame omutondi gwoye. Otandi ke ku pangula epangulo montaneho yiigwana.
Molwiinima mbyoka wa ningi handi yi tondo, otandi ka geela Jerusalem egeelo inaandi li mu geela nale noitandi ke shi ninga we.
Molwashika aavali muJerusalem otaa ka lya po oyana, naanona otaa ka lya po aakuluntu yawo. Otandi ke mu geela nokuhalakanithila koombinga adhihe mboka ya hupu ko ye na omwenyo.
“Onkee ano ngame, ngaashi ndi na omwenyo — ndhika oohapu dhOmuwa Omupangeliawike — oshoka owa nyateke otempeli yandje nuulunde owindji niihuna mbyoka wa ningi, otandi ke ku teta po pwaa na ohenda.

Oshititatu shimwe shaantu yoye otashi ka sa po kelega moshilando; oshititatu oshikwawo otashi ka dhipagwa po komagongamwele pondje yoshilando; noshititatu shahugunina otandi ke shi halakanithila mombepo noku ya landula negongamwele.
“Oto ka kala u uvite uupyundjahi wandje wa pupyala, sigo tandi geyuluka. Uuna ayihe mbika tayi ningwa, oto ka hempulula kutya ongame Omuwa nde shi ku lombwela, sho nda geyithwa kuukolokoshi woye.
Omupitipo kehe gwomiigwana ye ku kunduka, ote ke ku sheka a thikama kokule.
“Uuna tandi geye muupyundjahi ndi ku pangule, iigwana ayihe ye ku kunduka, otayi ka haluka. Otayi ke ku tala nuunyanyali e tayi ku nyenkele.
Otandi ka hulitha po eloolo lyeni notamu ka sa po kondjala. Otamu ka hepekwa kondjala ya fa iikuti ya upikwa tayi mu hanagula po.
Otandi ka tuma ondjala niilikama yi lye po aana yeni. Otamu ka sa kuuvu nokokutilwahi kwombinzi. Otandi mu undulile iita, yi mu dhipage po. Ongame, Omuwa, nda popi.”
6: Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti:
“Muna gwomuntu, taalela lwokoondundu dhaIsrael, u dhi lombwele oohapu dhandje.

Lombwela oondundu dhaIsrael, dhi pulakene oohapu dhOmuwa — dhi uve shoka ngame, Omuwa Omupangeliawike, tandi shi lombwele oondundu niikulundundu, omakolombongo nomasilu. Otandi ka tuma egongamwele, li hanagule po omahala mpoka aantu haa saagelele iimenka.
Iiyambelo otayi ka kumunwa po, niiyambelo yiitsinino otayi ka teywa po. Aantu ayehe otaa ka dhipagelwa koshipala shiimenka yawo.
Otandi ka halakanitha omidhimba dhAaisraeli; iipongo yawo otandi ke yi halakanithila piiyambelo yawo.
Iilando ayihe yaIsrael otayi ka hanagulwa po, opo iiyambelo yawo ayihe niimenka yawo yi ka nyanyagulwe po; iiyambelo yawo yiitsinino otayi ka teyagulwa po, naayihe mbyoka ya ninga, otayi ka hula po.
Aantu otaa ka dhipagelwa apehe, naamboka taa ka hupa ko, otaa ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa.
“Otandi ka hupitha yamwe, ya hunuke edhipago notaa ka halakanithilwa mokati kiigwana,

moka taa ka kala aapongekwa. Otaa ka dhimbulukwa ndje nokutseya kutya onde ya geele noinandi ya sila ohenda, oshoka oomwenyo dhawo kadhi na uudhiginini, odhi iteka ndje noya hokwa iimenka peha lyandje. Oyo notaa ka mbilingwa kuuwinayi wawo nokiihuna mbyoka ye yi longo.
Otaa ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa, nomakumagidho gandje kage shi owala omagandagulo.”
Omuwa Omupangeliawike ota ti: “Hakela omake goye, tutulitha oompadhi dhoye. Kuga onkugo omolwiihuna ayihe niilonga yuupwidhi ya longwa kuIsrael. Otaa ka sa kiita, kondjala nokelega.
Mboka yokokule otaa kwatwa kuuvu e taa si; mboka yopopepi otaa ka dhipagelwa molugodhi; mboka taa hupu ko, otaa ka sa po kondjala. Otaa ka uva uupyundjahi wandje.

Omidhimba otadhi halakanene mokati kiimenka, dha kunduka iiyambelo, dha halakanena koshikulundundu kehe oshile, koondungu dhoondundu, momuzile gwomuti kehe omutalala nomomwandi kehe omunene — opehala kehe mpoka ya li haa yambele iimenka iitsinino. Nena shaa ngoka ota ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa.

Eeno, otandi ka tagananeka oshikaha shandje notandi hanagula po oshilongo shawo. Otandi ke shi mbugaleka okuza kombuga yokuumbugantu sigo okoshilando Ribla muumbangalantu. Itandi ka hupitha nando ehala limwe lya kalwa kAaisraeli. Otaa ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa.”
7: Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti:
“Muna gwomuntu, shika osho shoka ngame, Omuwa Omupangeliawike, tandi shi lombwele oshilongo Israel: Ndika olyo ehulilo lyoshilongo ashihe!
“Israel, ehulilo olya hedha ko. Oto ka mona ondjahi yandje, oshoka otandi ke ku pangulila shoka wa longo. Otandi ke ku futila iilonga yiihuna ayihe we yi longo.
Itandi ku hunutha nenge ndi ku sile ohenda. Otandi ke ku geelela iilonga yiihuna we yi longo, opo u ka tseye kutya ongame Omuwa.”
Omuwa Omupangeliawike ota ti: “Iiponga otayi ke ku adha ya hukilathana.
Opuwo ihe. Ehulilo olye ya. Olya thikana.
Ehulilo otali adha aantu yoye mboka ya kala moshilongo. Ethimbo olya thikana, uuna itaaku ka kala we iituthi pomahala giinonoma koondundu, evundakano ashike.
“Nziyanziya oto ka uva uupyundjahi wandje. Otandi ke ku pangulila shoka wa longo. Otandi ke ku futila iilonga yiihuna ayihe we yi longo.
Itandi ku katutha nenge ndi ku sile ohenda. Otandi ke ku geelela iilonga yiihuna mbyoka we yi longo, opo u ka tseye kutya ongame Omuwa, nongame tandi ku geele.”
Esiku lyoshiponga olya adha Israel. Iikolokosha oya vuka unene. Einenepeko olya tumbalala.
Iikolokosha oya ningi ondhimbo yokudhengitha aakaanakalunga. Muyo itamu ka hupa nando olye, noitaa thigilwa sha shomuuyamba wawo, omutumbo nenge esimano lyawo.
Esiku otali ya. Esiku oli li popepi, uuna okulanda sha nokulanditha po sha itaku ti we sha, oshoka egeelo lyaKalunga otali ka hwamena oshigwana ashihe.
Kape na omuhalithi ta ka kala e na olweedhe, a ka shune kushoka a landitha po nale, oshoka ondjahi yaKalunga otayi ka lambela ayehe. Aakolokoshi itaa ka hupa ko.
Omankuma taga lili, noshaa ngoka oti ilongekidha. Ihe kape na ngoka ta yi kiita, oshoka ondjahi yaKalunga otayi lambele ayehe oshita.
Omalugodhi oge li momapandaanda, uuvu nondjala oyi li momagumbo. Shaa ngoka ta zi moshilando, ota ka sila molugodhi, noshaa ngoka ta kala moshilando, ota ningi omulape gwondjala nuuvu.
Yamwe otaa ka fadhukila koondundu ya fa oonguti dha haluthwa tadhi zi mo mesilu. Ayehe yomuyo otaa ka kemena uulunde wawo.
Iikaha yaayehe otayi yululuka, noongolo dhawo otadhi ka kakama.
Otaa ka zala omahahi yo taa kakama kuumbanda. Omitse dhawo otadhi ka kululwa, noyo ayehe otaa ka sithwa ohoni.

Otaa ka ekelahi iingoli yawo niisiliveli momapandaanda ngaashi iinyakwi, oshoka oshingoli noshisiliveli itashi ya hupitha, uuna Omuwa te ya poolele ondjahi ye. Itaye shi longitha ya kutithe oomwenyo dhawo nenge ya udhithe omala gawo. Oshingoli noshisiliveli oshe ya fala muulunde.
Nale oya li yi itangele iipako yawo yoshingoli, oye yi hambula iimenka iinyanyalithi. Omolwashoka Omuwa a etha uuyamba wawo u ya kunkute.
Omuwa ota ti: “Otandi pitika aakwiilongo ye ya yuge, naakolokoshi otaa ka kutha po uuyamba wawo auhe noku u nyateka.
Itandi ka keelela nande otempeli yandje ondjapuki yi shundulwe, uuna aayugi taa gwayele mo noku yi nyateka.
“Shaa shoka osha vundakana — oshilongo oshu udha aadhipagi, niilando oyu udhilila uukolokoshi.
Otandi eta po aantu aadhudhu, notaa lala omagumbo geni. Aalumentu yeni aanankondolela otaa ka kanitha uuntsa wawo, uuna tandi ka etha iigwana yi shundule omahala geni gomalongelokalunga.
Eihupulo otali ya. Otamu ka konga ombili, ihe itamu yi mono.

Iiponga otayi ya ya hukilathana nomukungu gwoonkundana oombwinayi otagu iyetelele mo. Otamu ka pula aahunganeki, ye mu hololele shoka ya mono shokomeho. Aayambi itaa ka kala ye na sha ye shi longe aantu, naawiliki itaa ka kala ye na omayele gasha ye ga gandje.

Omukwaniilwa ota ka lila, elenga otali kanitha etegameno, noshigwana otashi ka kakama kuumbanda. Otandi ke ku pangulila ayihe mbyoka wa longo, notandi ke ku tokolela, ngaashi wa longele yakweni. Shika otashi ke ku ulukila kutya ongame Omuwa.”
8: Mesiku etitano lyomwedhi omutihamano gwomumvo omutihamano guupongekwa, aawiliki yaapongekwa Aajuda oya li ya kuutumba megumbo lyandje pamwe nangame. Ohaluka oshikaha shOmuwa Omupangeliawike oshe ya kombanda yandje.
Onda keuka nonda mono emoniko lyolupe lwomuntu ta adhima. Okuza moombwetelo dhe okuuka pohi olutu olwa fa omulilo, okuza moombwetelo okuuka pombanda ota tayima a fa oshikushu sha kwehulwa.

Okwa ganeke sha sha fa oshikaha e ta kwata ndje komafufu. Ombepo yaKalunga oya yambula ndje po noya fala ndje pombanda meyalelo e tayi fala ndje kuJerusalem. Oya fala ndje mosheelo shokuumbangalantu shehale lyaayambi lyomotempeli, moka mwa li oshimenka shokutukula ondjahi yaKalunga.
Onda mono mo eadhimo lyaKalunga naanaa ngaashi nde li mwene pomulonga Kebar.
Kalunga okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Muna gwomuntu, taalela lwokuumbangalantu.” Onda tala, lwokuumbangalantu wosheelo shoshiyambelo onda mono oshimenka shokutukula ondjahi yaKalunga.

Kalunga okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Muna gwomuntu, ou wete tuu shoka tashi ningwa? Tala kiilonga yiihuna tayi longwa kAaisraeli mpaka, tayi tidhile ndje kokule nehala lyandje eyapuki. Natango oto ka mona iilonga yiihuna yi vule mbika.”
Okwa fala ndje posheelo shehale enene e tu ulukile ndje ombululu mekuma.
Okwa ti: “Muna gwomuntu, gwaya mekuma.” Onda gwaya mulyo e te mono omweelo.
Okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Inda mo, u tale iilonga yiihuna iinene mbyoka taa longo.”
Onda yi mo nonda tala. Omakuma oga li ga thanekwa omayoka niinamwenyo yoshidhila niimenka ayihe mbyoka hayi longelwa kAaisraeli.
Okwa li aawiliki yaIsrael omilongo heyali, pamwe naJaazania yaShafan. Shaa ngoka okwa li a yelutha oshitsininitho, nolwithi olwa li talu tsinagala talu zi moshitsininitho.

Kalunga okwa pula ndje a ti: “Muna gwomuntu, ou wete tuu shoka aawiliki yAaisraeli taa longo meholamo? Otaa ningi elongelokalunga mongulu yu udha omathano giimenka. Otaa dhiladhila: ‘Omuwa ke tu wete. Omuwa okwa thigi po nale oshilongo shika.’ ”
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Oto ke ya mona, sho taa longo iihuna yi vulithe mpoka.”
Okwa fala ndje komweelo gwotempeli gwokuumbangalantu e tu ulukile ndje aakulukadhi taa lili oosa dhoshikalunga Tammuz.
Okwa pula ndje a ti: “Muna gwomuntu, ou shi wete tuu? Oto ka mona iihuna yi vulithe mpoka.”

Oye nokwa fala ndje kehale lyaayambi motempeli. Hwiyaka, popepi neelo lyotempeli, pokati koshiyambelo nomukala, opwa li aasamane ye thike ando pomilongo mbali nayatano. Oya li ya pilamena otempeli, ya nyongama ya taalela lwokuuzilo, taa simaneke etango sho tali piti.

Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Muna gwomuntu, ou shi wete tuu? Aajuda mbaka inashi ya gwanena, sho taa longo iihuna mbyoka to mono mpaka notaa taandelitha uukolokoshi noshilongo ashihe. Aawe, otaye ya notaye yi longo motempeli yo yene notaa geyitha ndje unene. Tala, nkene taa hindi pamukalo gu kenyeneka.
Otaa ka uva uupyundjahi wandje. Itandi ke ya hututha nenge ndi ya sile ohenda. Otaa ka galikana ndje nokukuga ngaashi taa vulu, ihe itandi ke ya pulakena.”
9: Ondu uvu Kalunga ti igidha ta ti: “Ileni huka, one tuu mboka tamu geele oshilando shika. Eteleleni omatati geni.”

Ohaluka aalumentu yahamano oya ziilile pondje kosheelo shotempeli shokuumbangalantu, shaa ngoka oku na uutati. Puyo opwa li omulumentu a zala oonguwo dholiina nepaya li na okakende kohinga. Oye ya e taa thikama poshiyambelo shoshikushu.
Eadhimo lyaKalunga kaIsrael olya yeluka kombanda yaakerubi nolyu uka keelo lyotempeli. Omuwa okwi ithana omulumentu ngoka a zala oonguwo dholiina e ta ti:
“Enda Jerusalem ashihe, u ndhindhilike endhindhiliko moshipala shashaa ngoka ta keme nokwa lulilwa molwiihuna ayihe mbyoka tayi longwa moshilando.”
Ondu uvu sho Kalunga ta lombwele aalumentu yalwe ta ti: “Mu landulileni moshilando, mu ka dhipage. Inamu hunutha nando ogumwe; inamu sila nando ogumwe ohenda.

Dhipageni aasamane, aamati, aafuko, aakulukadhi oonzinzi naanona. Ihe mboka ye na endhindhiliko, inamu ya guma. Tamekeni potempeli yandje.” Osho ngaaka ya tameke paawiliki mboka ya li ya thikama potempeli.
Kalunga okwe ya lombwele a ti: “Nyatekeni otempeli. Omahale gayo gu udhitheni omidhimba. Ka longeni!” Osho ngaaka ya tameke okudhipaga aantu moshilando.
Manga ya li taa dhipaga, ngame onda thigwa po awike. Ondi ihata po nda tsa oshipala shandje mevi nondi igidha nda ti: “Omuwa Omupangeliawike, oto geele Jerusalem e to dhipaga po ayehe muIsrael?”

Kalunga okwa yamukula a ti: “Aaisraeli nAajuda oye na ondjo yuulunde uunene. Oya dhipaga po ayehe moshilongo noyu udhitha Jerusalem uukolokoshi. Otaa ti ngame Omuwa onda thigi po oshilongo shawo nokandi ya wete we.
Ihe itandi ya sile nando ohenda, otandi ya ningile shoka ye shi ningile yakwawo.”
Omulumentu ngoka a zala oonguwo dholiina, okwa shuna nokwe shi hokololele Omuwa a ti: “Onda gwanitha oohapu dhoye.”
10: Onda tala kondunda komitse dhiinamwenyo yomawawa nokombanda yayo okwa li sha sha fa oshipangelapundi sha ningwa memanya lyosafire.

Kalunga okwa lombwele omulumentu ngoka a zala oonguwo dholiina a ti: “Inda pokati komagulutemba kohi yiinamwenyo e to udhitha omake goye nomakala ga hanya. Ga halakanithila noshilando.”
Onde mu tongolola, sho ta yi.
Iinamwenyo yomawawa oya li ya thikama kuumbugantu wotempeli, sho a yi mo, oshikogo oshu udha ehale lyaayambi.
Eadhimo lyOmuwa olya yeluka kombanda yaakerubi lyu uka kosheelo shotempeli, nomehale omwa li mwa udha uuyelele.
Oshihomo shomawawa gaakerubi osha li shu uvika sigo okehale enene. Osha li tashi pupu sha fa ewi lyaKalunga Omunankondoawike.
Omuwa sho a lombwele omulumentu ngoka a zala oonguwo dholiina, a kuthe omakala gamwe mokati komagulutemba ngoka ga li kohi yaakerubi, omulumentu okwa yi mo e ta thikama pokugulu kumwe.

Omukerubi gumwe okwa tula oshikaha she momulilo ngoka gwa li mokati kawo, a kutha mo omakala gamwe e te ga tula miikaha yomulumentu ngoka a zala oonguwo dholiina. Omulumentu okwa taamba omakala gomulilo e ta yi.
Kohi yewawa kehe lyomukerubi okwa monika sha sha fa oshikaha shomuntu.

Onda mono wo kutya okwa li ku na omagulutemba gane ga faathana, kumwe okombinga yomukerubi kehe. Omagulutemba otaga adhima ga fa emanya lyokrisoliti, noshaa hoka okwa li ku na okugulutemba okukwawo hoka kwe ku shigakana mokati.
Aakerubi nge taa yi, otaa vulu okuuka shaa hoka inaa punguluka. Otaa uka kombinga ndjoka ya hala okuya pwaa na epunguluko lyasha.
Omalutu gawo, oombunda, omaako, omawawa nomagulutemba ogu udha omeho.
Omagulutemba ngaka oga li ga faathana naangeyaka nda mwene memoniko lyotango.
Omukerubi kehe okwa li e na iipala ine, shimwe oshongombe, shimwe oshomuntu, shimwe oshonime nashimwe oshekodhi.
(Aakerubi mbaka oyo ngaa mbeyaka nda mwene pomulonga Kebar.) Aakerubi ngele taa yelukile mewangandjo
notaa yi, omagulutemba otage ende pamwe nayo. Uuna taa yalaleke omawawa gawo taa tuka, omagulutemba inaga thigala po.
Uuna aakerubi taa kankama, omagulutemba otaga kankama wo; uuna aakerubi taa tuka, omagulutemba otaga yi pamwe nayo, oshoka aakerubi taye ga utha.
Eadhimo lyOmuwa nolya zi po posheelo shotempeli nolya yi kombanda yaakerubi.
Oya yalaleke omawawa gawo e taa tuka po pevi, manga nde ya tongolola, nomagulutemba oga yi pamwe nayo. Oya kankama pomweelo gwotempeli gwokuuzilo, neadhimo olya li kombanda yawo.
Onde ya dhimbulula kutya oyo aakerubi mbeyaka nda mwene kohi yaKalunga kaIsrael pomulonga Kebar.
Shaa ngoka okwa li e na iipala ine nomawawa gane, nokewawa kehe okwa li ku na sha sha fa oshikaha shomuntu.
Iipala yawo oya li ya fa naanaa iipala mbiyaka nda mwene pomulonga Kebar. Shaa ngoka okwe ende u ukilila komeho.
11: Ombepo yOmuwa oya yelutha ndje po, noya fala ndje komweelo gwotempeli gwokuuzilo. Pomweelo onda mono po aalumentu omilongo mbali nayatano ye li pamwe naJaazania yaAssur naPelatia yaBenaia, aawiliki yoshigwana yaali.
Kalunga okwa lombwele ndje a ti: “Muna gwomuntu, aalumentu mbaka otaa dhiladhila omadhiladhilo omawinayi e taa gandja omayele omawinayi moshilando shika.
Otaa ti: ‘Otatu ka tunga po omagumbo ishewe mbala. Oshilando osha fa ombiga tayi yaya, notse otwa fa onyama yi li muyo.’
Ngashingeyi ya hunganekela, ngoye omuna gwomuntu.”
Ombepo yOmuwa oya lambele ndje nokwa lombwele ndje ndi faalele aantu elaka tali ti: “Aaisraeli ne, ondi shi shi shoka tamu popi naashoka tamu dhiladhila.
Omwa dhipaga aantu oyendji moshilando, sigo omapandaanda gu udha omidhimba.

“Onkee ano ngame, Omuwa Omupangeliawike, tandi lombwele oshilando shika kutya osho naanaa ombiga ndjoka tayi yaya, ihe onyama oshike? Oyo omidhimba dhaamboka mwe ya dhipaga! Itamu ka kala po mpaka — otandi ke mu umbila pondje yoshilando!
Omwa tila egongamwele, ihe otandi ka eta mboka taye mu ponokele ye na omagongamwele.
Otandi ke mu fala pondje yoshilando noku mu gandja kaakwiilongo. Onde mu tokolela eso,
notamu ka dhipagelwa molugodhi moshilongo sheni yene. Shaa ngoka ota ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa.
Oshilando shika itashi ke mu gamena, ngaashi ombiga tayi gamene onyama yi li muyo. Otandi ke mu geela shaa mpoka mu li moshilongo Israel.
Otamu ka tseya kutya ongame Omuwa — one mboka mwa yono oompango dhandje noinamu vulika komautho gandje, ihe omwa dhiginine oohedhi dhiigwana ye mu kunduka.”

Manga nda li tandi hunganeke, ye Pelatia yaBenaia okwi ihata pevi omukukutu. Ondi ihata po nda tsu oshipala mevi e tandi igidha te ti: “Aawe, Omuwa Omupangeliawike! Oto ka dhipaga po shaa ngoka a hupu muIsrael?”
Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti:

“Muna gwomuntu, aantu mboka ye li muJerusalem, otaye ku popi nAaisraeli ooyakweni mboka mwa kala nayo muupongekwa. Otaa ti: ‘Aapongekwa oye li kokule unene okulongela Omuwa. Omuwa okwe tu pe evi ndika, li kale eliko lyetu.’

“Ngashingeyi lombwela aapongekwa ooyakweni shoka tandi popi. Ongame mwene nde ya tumu, ya ka kale kokule mokati kiigwana noku ya halakanithila miilongo yilwe. Onkene tuu ethimbo ndyoka taa kala ko, otandi ka kala pamwe nayo momavi moka ya kala mo.
“Onkee ya lombwela shoka ngame, Omuwa Omupangeliawike, tandi ti. Otandi ya kongolola ko kiilongo ayihe hoka nde ya halakanithile ko, notandi ke ya galulila kevi lyaIsrael.
Uuna taa shuna, otaa ka kanyutuka ko kiimenka ayihe yi sitha ohoni noyi nyanyalitha.
Otandi ke ya pa omwenyo omupe nombepo ompe. Otandi ke ya kutha omutimamanya notandi ya pe omwenyo hagu vulika.
Otaa ka vulika koompango dhandje nokudhiginina omautho gandje agehe. Otaa ka ninga aantu yandje, ongame note kala Kalunga kawo.
Ihe otandi ka geela aantu mboka ye hole okusimaneka iimenka iisithahoni niinyanyalithi. Otandi ke ya geelela shoka ya longo.” Omuwa Omupangeliawike a popi.
Aakerubi oya tuka po, nomagulutemba oga yi wo pamwe nayo. Eadhimo lyaKalunga kaIsrael olya li lye ya siikila.
Eadhimo lyaKalunga nolya thigi po oshilando e tali yi kondundu yokuuzilo washo.
Memoniko Ombepo yaKalunga oya yambula ndje po e tayi eta ndje kaapongekwa muBabilon. Opo ihe emoniko olye etha ndje,
nonda hokololele aapongekwa ayihe mbyoka Omuwa a ulukile ndje.
12: Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti:
“Muna gwomuntu, owa kala mokati kaantu aanandumbo. Oye na omeho, ihe kaye wete ko; oye na omakutsi, ihe kayu uvite ko, oshoka oyo aatangalali.
“Muna gwomuntu, manga ngashingeyi omutenge wa fa ontauki e to piti mo komatango. Monika kwaayehe, sho to yi kehala lilwe. Otashi vulika aatangalali taye ku koneke.
Manga inaaku wiwila, manga omutenge gwoye okuya muupongekwa, opo ya wape ye ku mone. Ongulohi naye ku tongolole ihe, sho to yi wa fa to yi muupongekwa.
Manga ye ku tongolola, tsa ombululu mekuma lyongulu yoye e to pitile mo wa humbata omutenge gwoye.
Naye ku tongolole, sho to itsike omutenge noto zi mo wa uka momilema wi isiikila komeho, opo kuu mone ho wa uka. Shoka to ningi, otashi kala elondodho kAaisraeli.”

Onda ningi shoka Omuwa a lombwele ndje ndi shi ninge. Esiku ndyoka onda manga omutenge, ngaashi ontauki hayi ningi, nongulohi ndjoka sho taku luudha, onda tsu ombululu mekuma niikaha yandje e te piti mo. Manga ayehe ye shi tongolola, ondi itsike omutenge e te yi.
Ongula yanakwasha Omuwa okwa lombwele ndje a ti:
“Muna gwomuntu, ngashingeyi sho Aaisraeli mbaka aanandumbo taye ku pula shoka to ningi,
