Ngoye oto kala u udha enyanyu neligolo, noyendji yalwe otaa ka nyanyukilwa evalo lyako.
Oshoka omunona nguka ota ka kala omunene koshipala shOmuwa. Oye ita nu omaviinu nenge oshinuwa kehe hashi kolitha. Oye te ku udha Ombepo Ondjapuki nomanga e li mela lyayina.
Oyendji yomAaisraeli ote ya galulile kOmuwa, Kalunga kawo.
Oye omutumwa gwOmuwa te ya e na ombepo noonkondo dhaElia. Oye ota hanganitha oohe noyana, ota galulile oonakwaavulika mondjila yu uka nota longekidha aantu, ya wape okutaamba Omuwa gwawo.”
Sakaria okwa ti komuyengeli: “Shika otandi shi tseya ngiini? Oshoka ngame onda kulupa nomukiintu gwandje wo oku li methimbo lyuukulupe.”
Omuyengeli okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Ongame Gabriel nda thikama koshipala shaKalunga, ngoka a tumu ndje, ndi ku lombwele nondi ku uvithile elaka ndika etoye.
Ano ngashingeyi pulakena: Sho ino itaala oohapu dhandje, oto ka kala itoo popi sigo esiku ndyoka ayihe nde yi ku lombwele tayi ka gwanithwa.”
Aantu oya li ya tegelele Sakaria noya kumwa, sho a kala ethimbo ele unene motempeli.

Ano sho a zi mo, okwa li itaa vulu okupopya nayo. Aantu noya dhimbulula kutya okwa mono emoniko motempeli. Molwaashoka Sakaria okwa li itaa vulu okupopya nayo, okwe ya lombwele nokuninga omandhindhiliko niikaha.
Omasiku giilonga yomotempeli sho ga pu ko, Sakaria okwa shuna kegumbo.
Konima yomasiku omukulukadhi gwe Elisabet okwa ningi omusimba nokwa kala megumbo uule woomwedhi ntano inaa za mo nokwa ti:
“Shika onde shi ningilwa kOmuwa. Ngashingeyi Omuwa okwa sile ndje ohenda, sho a kutha ndje okudhinwa kaantu.”
Elisabet sho a ningi omusimba gwoomwedhi hamano, Kalunga okwa tumu omuyengeli Gabriel koshilando shomuGalilea, edhina lyasho Nasaret,
a ye komukadhona a yalekwa komulumentu, edhina lye Josef, gwomezimo lyaDavid. Edhina lyomukadhona oMaria.
Omuyengeli okwe ya kuye e ta ti: “Ombili nayi kale nangoye! Omuwa na kale pamwe nangoye ye ne ku yambeke!”
Maria okwa haluthwa kepopitho nokwe li dhiladhila kutya otali ti ngiini.
Omuyengeli okwa ti kuye ishewe: “Maria, ino tila, owa silwa ohenda kuKalunga.
Oto ka ninga omusimba e to vala okanona okamati nou na oku ka luka Jesus.
Oye ta ningi omunene e ti ithanwa Omuna gwaKalunga gwokombandambanda. Omuwa Kalunga ote mu ningi omukwaniilwa ongaashi he David.
Oye ta ningi omukwaniilwa gwoluvalo lwaJakob sigo aluhe; nuukwaniilwa we kau na mpoka tau ka hula po.”
Maria okwa ti komuyengeli: “Otashi ka vulika ngiini, oshoka ngame omukadhona natango?”
Omuyengeli okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Ombepo Ondjapuki otayi ku lambele, noonkondo dhaKalunga gwokombandambanda otadhi ku siikile. Onkee ano omunona nguka ota ka lukwa Omuna gwaKalunga.
Tala, naElisabet omunezimo lyoye ngoka a popiwa kutya iha vala, okwa ningi ngashingeyi omusimba gwoomwedhi hamano, nonando okwa kulupa.
Oshoka kaku na shoka tashi nyenge Kalunga.”
Maria okwa ti: “Ongame omuntu gwOmuwa. Nandi ningwe ngaashi wa ti.” Omuyengeli nokwa zi po puye.
Pethimbo olyo tuu ndyoka Maria okwa thikama e ta yi nokweendelela koshilando shomuJudea, shi li momukunda gu na oondundu.
Maria sho e ya maandjaSakaria, okwa popitha Elisabet.
Elisabet sho u uvu epopitho lyaMaria, okanona oka nyulukuta mela lye. Opo Elisabet oku udha Ombepo Ondjapuki
nokwa popi mokule a ti: “Kala wa yambekwa mokati kaakiintu aakweni, nosho wo okanona hoka to ka vala, naka yambekwe.
Osha zile ndje peni, yina yOmuwa gwandje sho te ya kungame?
Oshoka manga tuu ewi lyepopitho lyoye tali thiki momakutsi gandje, okanona oka nyulukuta kenyanyu mela lyandje.
Omunelago oongoka wi itaala kutya shoka to shi lombwelwa kOmuwa, otashi ka gwanithwa.”

Maria okwa ti:
“Omwenyo gwandje otagu hambelele Omuwa,
ombepo yandje otayi nyanyukilwa Kalunga, omuhupithi gwandje,

oshoka okwa dhimbulukwa omuntu gwe mokwiishonopeka kwe.
Okuza ngashingeyi aantu ayehe otaa ki ithana ndje omunelago,

oshoka Omuwa omunankondo okwa ningile ndje iinima iinene.
Edhina lye olyo eyapuki.
Oye ta sile ohenda ayehe mboka haye mu tila yomomapipi agehe.

Oye okwa longo iilongankondo.
Oonakuholuuntsa okwe ya halakanitha po pamwe nomadhiladhilo gawo.

Aakwaniilwa aanankondo okwe ya kutha ko kiipangelapundi yawo,
nokwa nenepeke aaishonopeki.

Mboka ya sa ondjala, okwe ya kutitha nuuwanawa,
aayamba okwe ya tidha po ye li iikaha yowala.

Oye okwa dhiginine euvaneko ndyoka e li lombwele ootate.
Oye e ya okukwatha omuntu gwe Israel,
nokwa dhimbulukwa okusila Abraham ohenda noluvalo lwe sigo aluhe.”
Maria okwa menekele puElisabet oomwedhi ndatu, opo ihe okwa shuna kaandjawo.
Ethimbo lyaElisabet lyokuvala sho lya thiki, okwa vala okanona okamati.
Aashiinda ye naanezimo sho yu uvu, nkene Omuwa e mu hololele esilohenda enene li thike mpoka, oya nyanyukwa pamwe naye.
Esiku etihetatu oye ya, ya fukaleke okanona, noya li ya hala ye ka lukile he Sakaria.
Ihe yina okwa ti: “Itashi vulika. Edhina lyako otali lukwa Johannes.”
Oyo noya ti kuye: “Mezimo lyoye kamu na nando omuntu e na edhina ndyoka.”
Oyo noya lombwele he nokuninga omandhindhiliko niikaha, opo ye mu pule kutya okanona okwa hala ka lukwe edhina lini.
Oye okwi indile, a pewe okapelende kokunyolela nokwa nyolele mo kutya: “Edhina lyako oJohannes.” Aantu ayehe noya kumwa.
Opo tuu mpoka ewi lye olya thituluka nelaka lye olya manguluka, nokwa tameke okupopya e ta hambelele Kalunga.
Aantu ayehe yopuushiinda oya kwatwa kehaluko, nakehe gumwe gwomoshitopolwa shoka shoondundu muJudea oku uvu ayihe mbika ya ningwa.
Ayehe mboka ye shi uvu, oya pungula oohapu ndhika moomwenyo dhawo noya ti: “Okanona haka otaka ka kala ka tya ngiini?” Oyo oya dhimbulula kutya, oko oke li miikaha yOmuwa.
He Sakaria oku udha Ombepo Ondjapuki nokwa hunganeke a ti:

“Omuwa, Kalunga kaIsrael, na hambelelwe!
Oshoka okwe ya okuhupitha nokumangulula aantu ye.
Oye okwe tu pe Omukulili ofule a zi mezimo lyomuntu gwe David.
Ngaashi aahunganeki ye aayapuki ye shi uvaneke nale kutya:
Oye ote ke tu hupitha maatondi yetu nomiikaha yaayehe mboka ye tu tonde.

Shika ote shi ningi molwesilohenda lye ndyoka e li hololele ootate,
sho ha dhimbulukwa ehangano lye eyapuki.
Oye okwa ganene tate yetu Abraham kutya,
ote ke tu hupitha miikaha yaatondi yetu, opo tu mu longele twaa na uumbanda,
tse tu ninge aayapuki naayuuki koshipala she omasiku getu agehe.

Ngoye okanona oto ki ithanwa omuhunganeki gwaKalunga gwokombandambanda,
oshoka oto ka tetekela Omuwa, u mu opalekele ondjila.
Ongoye to ka tseyithila aantu ye ehupitho, uuna oondjo dhawo dha dhimwa po.

Oshoka Kalunga ketu oku na olukeno nesilohenda,
onkee eluwa lyehupitho otali tu tendele, li tu minikile.
Tse mboka twa kuutumba momilema nomomuzizimba gweso, li ukithe oompadhi dhetu mondjila yombili.”
Omunona okwa koko nokwa kolo pambepo. Oye okwa kala mombuga sigo esiku ndyoka i ihololele Aaisraeli.
2: Pomasiku ngeyaka omupangeli Omuroma Augustus okwa gandja oshipango kutya aantu ayehe ye li mepangelo lye, oye na okwiinyolitha, opo ya gandje oompale.
Einyolitho ndika olyo lyotango nolya ningwa, Kirenius sho a li omuleli gwaSiria.
Aantu ayehe oya yi, ye ki inyolithe, kehe gumwe omoshilando shaandjawo.
Josef wo okwa thikama muNasaret shomuGalilea nokwa yi kuJudea koshilando shaDavid, shi ithanwa Betlehem, oshoka oye okwa li omunezimo lyaDavid.
Oye okwa yi, e ki inyolithe pamwe nomuyalekwa gwe Maria, ngoka a li omusimba.
Ano manga ya li muBetlehem, ethimbo lyaMaria lyokuvala olya thiki.
Oye okwa yelipa osheeli she shokamati nokwe ka dhingile momalapi e te ka langeke metemba lyokulila iimuna, oshoka mongulu yaayenda kamwa li mu na eha.
Komukunda ngoka okwa li ku na aasita ye li kelundu ya langela iimuna yawo uusiku.
Omuyengeli gwOmuwa okwe ya holokele, neadhimo lyOmuwa olye ya adhimine. Aasita oya haluka noonkondo.
Omuyengeli okwa ti kuyo: “Inamu tila! Oshoka ngame otandi mu uvithile elaka lyenyanyu enene tali ningi lyaantu ayehe.
Nena tuu ndjika mwa valelwa Omukulili moshilando shaDavid. Oye Kristus, Omuwa.
Endhindhiliko lyoku mu dhimbulula olyo ndika: Otamu ka mona okahanona ka dhingilwa nomalapi noka langekwa metemba lyokulila iimuna.”
Ombaadhilila pomuyengeli nguka opwa li pu na ongundu onene yaayengeli yomegulu, ya hambelele Kalunga ya ti:

“Esimano olyaKalunga gwokombandambanda!
Nombili kombanda yevi maantu e ya hokwa!”
Aayengeli sho ya zi po puyo, ya shuna megulu, aasita oya lombwelathana ya ti: “Tu yeni ano kuBetlehem, tu ka tale shoka sha ningwa ko, Omuwa e shi tu hololele.”
Oyo oya yi nokweendelela noya mono Maria naJosef nokahanona ka langekwa metemba lyokulila iimuna.
Aasita sho ya mono okahanona, oya hokololele aantu shoka omuyengeli a tile okanona haka.
Ayehe mboka ye shi uvu, oya kuminwa oohapu ndhoka ye dhi hokololelwa kaasita.
Ihe Maria okwa kala ta dhiladhila oohapu ndhoka adhihe nokwe dhi pungula momwenyo gwe.
Aasita oya shuna nokusimaneka nokuhambelela Kalunga, oshoka ayihe oye yi uvu noye yi mono, ngaashi omuyengeli e ya lombwele.
Sho pwa piti omasiku gahetatu, okanona oka fukalekwa noka lukwa Jesus, edhina tuu ndyoka ke li lukwa komuyengeli, manga ka li mela lyayina.
Omasiku geiyopaleko pampango yaMoses sho ga pu ko, oya fala okanona kuJerusalem e taye ke eta koshipala shOmuwa.
Shika osha nyolwa mompango yOmuwa kutya: Okanona okasheeli kehe taka valwa kuyina, oke na okuyoololelwa Omuwa,
nonaku gandjwe omayambo: omatendenguti gaali nenge uungutyona uyali.
Ano muJerusalem omwa li mu na omulumentu, edhina lye Simeon. Oye okwa li omuyuuki, ha tila Kalunga nokwa kala a tegelela ehupitho lyaIsrael. Ombepo Ondjapuki oya li muye.
Oye okwa li a tseyithilwa kOmbepo Ondjapuki kutya ita si, manga inaa mona Omugwayekwa gwOmuwa.
Ombepo Ondjapuki noya fala Simeon motempeli. Nena aakuluntu yaJesus oye mu eta kotempeli noye mu ningile, ngaashi ompango tayi shi ti.
Simeon oku ukata okanona momaako ge nokwa hambelele Kalunga a ti:

“Ngashingeyi Omuwa, sho wa gwanitha omauvaneko goye,
laleka ndje ihe, omuntu gwoye, ndi ye nombili.
Oshoka onda mono nomeho gandje ehupitho ndyoka
we li longekidha montaneho yaantu ayehe:
Uuyelele wokuminikila aapagani, nesimano lyaantu yoye Aaisraeli.”
He nayina oya kuminwa oohapu ndhoka Simeon e dhi popi.

Simeon okwe ya yambeke e ta ti kuMaria, yina yokanona: “Omunona nguka okwa tulwa po kuKalunga okupundukitha nokuyambukitha oyendji yomAaisraeli. Oye endhindhiliko lya zi kuKalunga, ihe oyendji itaye ke mu taamba.
Osho ngeyi omadhiladhilo gawo omawinayi ngoka ga holama otage ya puuyelele. Ihe uudhigu ongegongamwele lya tsa otau ka ulula omutima gwoye.”
Okwa li ku na omuhunganeki omukiintu, edhina lye Anna, omuna gwaFanuel, gwomezimo lyaAser. Oye okwa li a koka. Manga a li omukadhona, okwa hokanwa e ta kala nomulumentu gwe oomvula heyali;
Okwa adhika ihe omuselekadhi gwoomvula omilongo hetatu nane. Ethimbo alihe okwa kala motempeli koshipala shaKalunga uusiku nomutenya ti idhilike iikulya nokugalikana.
Ethimbo olyo tuu ndyoka okwe ya po nokwa hambelele Kalunga e ta hokolola okanona kwaayehe mboka ya li ya tegelela ethimbo lyekulilo lyaJerusalem.
Sho ya tsakanitha ayihe pampango yOmuwa, oya shuna kuGalilea koshilando shaandjawo kuNasaret.
Omunona okwa koko nokwa kolo u udha oondunge nokwa hokiwa kuKalunga.
Aakuluntu yaJesus oya li haa yi omumvo kehe kuJerusalem koshituthi shOpaasa.
Jesus sho a gwanitha oomvula omulongo nambali, oya yi naye koshituthi, ngaashi hashi ningwa aluhe.
Omasiku goshituthi sho ga piti, oya shuna kegumbo, ihe Jesus okwa thigala muJerusalem. Aakuluntu oya li inaaye shi tseya kutya oku li peni.
Oya tengeneke owala kutya oku li mongundu yaayendi, sigo ye ende esiku alihe. Opo ihe oya tameke oku mu konga maanezimo nomaashiwikile.
Sho inaaye mu mona, oya shuna kuJerusalem, ye ke mu konge.
Konima yomasiku gatatu oye mu mono ihe motempeli, a kuutumba mokati kaalongi Aajuda, te ya pulakene ye te ya pula.
Ayehe mboka ye mu pulakene, oya kuminwa oondunge dhe nomayamukulo ge.
Aakuluntu ye sho ye mu mono, oya kumwa. Yina nokwa ti kuye: “Mumwandje, omolwashike we tu ningile ngeyi? Ngame naho otwe ku kongo nokunika uuthigwa.”
Jesus okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Omwa kongele ndje shike? Kamu shi shi nani kutya ngame ondi na okukala mumbika yaTate?”
Ihe kaya li yu uvite ko kutya okwa hala oku ya lombwela shike.
Jesus okwa zi mo pamwe nayo e taa shuna kuNasaret nokwa kala ha vulika kuyo. Yina okwa pungula oohapu ndhoka adhihe momwenyo gwe.
Jesus okwa koko palutu nomoondunge, a hokiwa kuKalunga nokaantu.
3: Omumvo omutimulongo nantano gwepangelo lyaTiberius, omupangeli Omuroma, Pontius Pilatus okwa li omuleli gwaJudea, naHerodes omuleli gwaGalilea, nomumwayina Filippus okwa li omuleli gwaIturea na Trakonitis, Lisanias okwa li omuleli gwaAbilene,
Annas naKajafas oya li aayambi aakuluntu yayakwawo. Pethimbo olyo tuu ndyoka oohapu dhaKalunga odha adha Johannes, omuna gwaSakaria, mombuga.
Johannes okwa yi komikunda adhihe dhopopepi nomulonga gwaJordan noku uvitha kutya aantu nayi itedhulule e taa shashwa, Kalunga nota dhimi po oondjo dhawo,

ongaashi omuhunganeki Jesaja a nyola ta ti:
“Ewi lyanakwiigidha mombuga tali ti:
‘Longekidhileni Omuwa ondjila,
yelekanitheni omapola ge.’
Aantu ayehe otaa ka mona ehupitho lyaKalunga.”
Oongundu dhaantu odhe ya kuJohannes, ya shashwe kuye, nokwa ti kuyo: “Oluvalo lwomayoka ne, olye e mu londodha okuya ontuku egeelo lyaKalunga ndyoka tali ya?

Imikeni ano iiyimati mbyoka tayi holola kutya omwi itedhulula. Inamu tameka okupopya mu tye: ‘Tse otu na tate Abraham,’ oshoka otandi mu lombwele: Kalunga ota vulu okuyumudhila Abraham aanona momamanya ngaka.
Ekuya olye egekwa nale nokuli pekota lyomuti. Okehe tuu omuti itaagu imi iiyimati iiwanawa, otagu kewa po e tagu umbilwa momulilo.”
Aantu mbeyaka oya pula Johannes ya ti: “Natu ninge ngiini ano?”
Oye okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Kehe ngoka e na oohema mbali, na pe mukwawo ngoka kee na sha, naangoka e na iikulya, na pe mukwawo ngoka kee yi na.”
Aafendelithi wo oye ya kuJohannes, e ya shashe, noye mu pula ya ti: “Tatekulu, otu na okuninga ngiini?”
Oye okwa ti kuyo: “Inamu fendelitha sha pitilila.”

Osho wo aakwiita oye mu pula ya ti: “Ongiini kombinga yetu? Otu na okuninga ngiini?”
Oye okwe ya lombwele a ti: “Inamu yuga omuntu iimaliwa ye ne inamu kotokela. Kaleni mwa gwanenwa kondjambi yeni.”
Aantu sho ya li mokutegelela, ayehe oya dhiladhila kutya, pamwe Johannes oye Kristus.

Ihe Johannes okwe ya lombwele ayehe ta ti: “Ngame otandi mu shasha nomeya, ihe oku na gumwe ngoka e vule ndje oonkondo te ke ya. Ngame inandi gwana nande okudhitula omiya dhoongaku dhe. Oye ote ke mu shasha nOmbepo Ondjapuki nomulilo.
Oye e na oshiyelitho miikaha ye. Ota kombo olupale lwe e ta yele. Iilya ote yi pungula miigandhi ye, ihe etutu ote li fike po nomulilo ihaagu dhimi po.”
Johannes okwa kumagidha aantu nomakumagidho omakwawo ogendji nokwe ya uvithile elaka etoye.
Omuleli Herodes okwa nyenyetelwa kuJohannes molwaashoka okwa adhika a hokana Herodias, omukiintu gwamumwayina, nomoluuwinayi ulwe kwa li e u ningi.
Uuwinayi u vule uukwawo Herodes e u ningi owo mbuka, sho e edhilile Johannes mondholongo.
Aantu ayehe sho ya shashwa, Jesus naye wo okwa shashwa. Manga a li ta galikana, egulu olye eguluka,
nOmbepo Ondjapuki oya kuluka noye mu lambele yi na olupe lwolutu lwa fa lwonguti. Ewi nolya zi megulu lya ti: “Ongoye omumwandje omuholike, onde ku hokwa.”
Jesus sho a tameke okuuvitha, okwa li e na oomvula dhi thike lwopomilongo ndatu nokwa kala, ngaashi aantu ye mu dhiladhila kutya oye omuna gwaJosef yaeli,
lyaMatati gaLevi lyaMelki gaJannai gaJosef,
yaMatatias gaAmos yaNahum yaEsli lyaNangai,
yaMaat gaMatatias gaSemei yaJosek yaJoda,
yaJohanan yaResa lyaSerubbabel lyaShealtiel lyaNeri,
lyaMelki gaAddi yaKosam yaElmadam lyaEr,
lyaJosua yaElieser lyaJorim yaMatati gaLevi,
lyaSimeon yaJuda yaJosef yaJonam yaEliakim,
lyaMelki gaMenna gaMatata gaNatan yaDavid,
yaIsai yaObed yaBoas yaSalmon yaNahshon,
yaAminadab yaAdmin yaArni yaHezron lyaPerez yaJuda,
yaJakob yaIsak yaAbraham yaTera yaNahor,
yaSerug lyaReu yaPelek yaEber lyaShela,
yaKainan yaArfaksad yaSem yaNoa yaLamek,
yaMetusala gaEnok lyaJared yaMahalalel gaKainan,
yaEnos lyaSet yaAdam yaKalunga.
4: Jesus okwa zi kuJordan u udha Ombepo Ondjapuki. Ombepo noye mu fala kombuga,
hoka a makelwa komuhindadhi omasiku omilongo ne. Omasiku ngoka okwa kala inaa lya sha, onkee sho ga hulu po, okwa li u uvite nayi nokwa sa ondjala.
Omuhindadhi okwa ti kuye: “Ngele ngoye Omuna gwaKalunga, lombwela emanya ndika, li shituke oshikwiila.”
Jesus okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Okwa nyolwa: ‘Omuntu ita kala e na omwenyo koshikwiila ashike.’ ”
Omuhindadhi okwe mu kutha nokwe mu fala pokuma puule e te mu ulukile mepathimo lyeho omapangelo agehe gomuuyuni.
Omuhindadhi okwa ti kuye: “Otandi ku ningi omupangeli gwaayihe notandi ku pe omauyamba agehe, oshoka ayihe mbika otandi vulu oku yi pa kehe ngoka nda hala.
Ayihe mbika otayi ningi yoye, ngele to tsile ndje oongolo e to galikana ndje.”
Jesus okwe mu yamukula nokwa ti: “Okwa nyolwa: ‘Omuwa Kalunga koye oye awike u na oku mu galikana noku mu longela.’ ”
Omuhindadhi okwe mu fala kuJerusalem nokwe mu londeke koshihoko shotempeli e ta ti kuye: “Ngele ngoye Omuna gwaKalunga, iyundulila pevi,
oshoka okwa nyolwa: ‘Kalunga ote ku tumine aayengeli ye, e taye ku gamene.
Oyo otaye ku papatele momaako gawo, opo waa pume oompadhi dhoye komamanya.’ ”
Jesus okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Okwa nyolwa natango: ‘Ino makela Omuwa Kalunga koye.’ ”
Ano omuhindadhi sho a hulitha okumakela Jesus moshinima kehe, okwe mu thigi po manga.
Jesus okwa shuna kuGalilea nokwe endithwa koonkondo dhOmbepo Ondjapuki. Okupopiwa kwe okwa taandele nomikunda adhihe dhopuushiinda.
Oye okwa longele aantu moosinagoga dhaahoka nokwa simanekwa kwaayehe.
Jesus okwe ya muNasaret, moshilando moka a putukila. NomEsabati okwa yi mosinagoga, ngaashi i igilila. Oye okwa thikama, a leshe Omanyolo omayapuki,
nokwa pewa embo lyomuhunganeki Jesaja. Sho a gonyununa ongonga yalyo, okwi itsu ehala mpoka pwa nyolwa ngeyi:

“Ombepo yOmuwa oya lambele ndje.
Osho ngeyi Omuwa okwa gwayeke ndje,
ndi uvithile oohepele elaka etoye.
Okwa tumu ndje, ndi igidhile oonkwatwa emanguluko,
naaposi ya tonate,
okumangulula oonakuhepekwa,

okutseyitha omumvo,
uuna Omuwa te ya, a hupithe aantu ye.”
Jesus sho a mana okulesha embo, okwe li pe omuyakuli e ta kuutumba. Aantu ayehe mboka ya li mosinagoga, oye mu tongolola.
Oye okwa tameke oku ya lombwela e ta ti: “Nena ndjika oohapu ndhoka mu uvu dha leshwa, odha gwanithwa.”
Oyo ayehe oye mu popile muuwanawa. Noya kuminwa oohapu oombwanawa dha zi mokana ke ya ti: “Ke shi nani omuna gwaJosef?”
Oye okwa ti kuyo: “Ondi shi shi nawa kutya omwa hala okulombwela ndje eyele. ‘Mwaaludhi, iyaludha!’ Notamu ti ishewe: ‘Shoka tu uvu wa ningi muKapernaum, shi ninga wo muka.’ ”
Jesus okwa ti: “Ongame otandi mu lombwele: Kaku na omuhunganeki ha taambwa nawa kaantu yomoshilongo shaandjawo.

“Dhimbulukweni shoka sha li sha ningwa pethimbo lyomuhunganeki Elia. Kapu na omalimbililo, muIsrael omwa li mu na aaselekadhi oyendji, sho kwa li inaaku lokwa ethimbo lyoomvula ndatu netata, nokwa li ondjala ondhigu moshilongo ashihe.
Ihe Kalunga ina tuma Elia nando okugumwe gwomaaselekadhi mbaka, ihe okwe mu tumu owala komuselekadhi gwokuSarefat shomomikunda dhaSidon.
MuIsrael omwa li wo mu na aanashilundu oyendji pethimbo lyomuhunganeki Elisa, ihe Elisa ina aludha nando ogumwe gwomuyo, oNaeman awike Omusiria.”
Aantu mboka ya li mosinagoga sho yu uvu oohapu ndhoka, oya geye noonkondo.
Oyo noya thikama noya tidha mo Jesus moshilando, oye mu fala kolungenge lwondundu hoka oshilando shawo sha li sha tungilwa, opo ye mu undulile pevi.
Ihe Jesus okwa piti mokati kawo ayehe nokwa yi.
Jesus okwa yi kuKapernaum, oshilando shomuGalilea, nokwa longo aantu mesiku lyEsabati.
Aantu mboka oya kuminwa elongo lye, oshoka oohapu dhe odha li dhi na oonkondo.
Mosinagoga moka omwa li mu na omulumentu e niwe kombepo ya nyata yoompwidhuli. Oye okwi igidha mokule a ti:
“Iihuna yowala! Jesus Omunasareti, owe tu halela shike? Owe ya u tu yone po? Ondi ku shi kutya ongoye Omuyapuki gwaKalunga.”
Jesus okwa ganda ombepo ya nyata a ti: “Mwena thilu, u ze mo muye!” Ombepo oye mu hata pevi mokati kaantu noya zi mo muye, inayi mu ningila nando uuwinayi washa.
Aantu ayehe oya kumwa noya pulathana ya ti: “Ota popi ngiini ngeyi? Oye e na epitikilo noonkondo okuganda oombepo dha nyata noku dhi tidha mo.”
Oshiningwanima shoka osha taandele akuhe momikunda ndhoka.
Ano Jesus sho a zi mo mosinagoga, okwa yi kaandjaSimon. Yinamweno yaSimon okwa li ta alukwa olwiidhi lwa geya noonkondo. Oyo noye mu popi kuJesus.
Jesus okwa hedha kuye nokwa ganda olwiidhi, olwo nolwe mu etha. Mbalambala yinamweno okwa thikama nokwa tameke oku ya yakula.
Etango sho lya yi mo, aantu ayehe mboka ya li ye na aavu yomavu gi ili nogi ili, oye ya eta kuJesus. Jesus okwa tenteke iihaka ye kukehe omuvu nokwe ya aludha ayehe.

Oompwidhuli wo odha zi mo maantu oyendji tadhi igidha tadhi ti: “Ongoye Omuna gwaKalunga!”
Ihe Jesus okwe dhi ganda ye ine dhi pitika, dhi popye, oshoka odha li dhi mu shi kutya oye Kristus.
Ongula sho kwa shi, Jesus okwa zi mo moshilando nokwa yi kokuma kwaa na omagumbo. Aantu oya tameke oku mu konga, naasho ye mu mono, oye mu kwatele po, kaa ze po puyo.
Ihe Jesus okwe ya lombwele a ti: “Elaka etoye lyOshilongo shaKalunga ondi na oku li uvitha wo miilando yilwe, oshoka osho naanaa shika Kalunga a tumu ndje, ndi shi ninge.”
Oye noku uvithile moosinagoga dhomuJudea.
5: Esiku limwe Jesus sho a li a thikama pefuta lyaGenesaret, aantu oye mu gongalele, ya pulakene oohapu dhaKalunga.
Oye okwa mono oowato mbali dhi li pomunkulo gwefuta, ihe aayuli yoohi oya adhika ya za po, ya ka yoga iiyulitho yawo.
Jesus okwa yi mowato yimwe yaandhoka, omundjoka yaSimon, nokwe mu lombwele, e yi humithe momeya kashona. Opo Jesus okwa kuutumba mowato ndjoka e ta longo aantu.
Sho a mana okupopya, okwa lombwele Simon e ta ti: “Dhugila owato lwopuule, ne mu umbile iiyulitho yeni momeya, mu tameke okuyula.”
Simon okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Muhongi, otwi ihepeke uusiku auhe nokulonga, ihe inatu kwata nando osha. Ihe ngashingeyi iiyulitho otandi yi umbile mo molwelombwelo lyoye.”
Oyo sho ye shi ningi, oya kwata oohi odhindji noonkondo niiyulitho oya tameke okutomoka.
Oyo noya lapa aayuli ooyakwawo yomowato yilwe, ye ye oku ya kwatha. Oyo oye ya noyu udhitha oowato adhihe mbali noohi, nodha tameke okuningina kuudhigu.
Ano Simon Petrus sho a mono shoka sha ningwa po, okwa tsu oongolo koshipala shaJesus e ta ti: “Omuwa, za po pungame, oshoka ngame omulumentu omulunde!”
Oshoka Petrus nosho wo ayehe mboka ya li pamwe naye, oya kuminwa eyulo lyoohi ndyoka ye li yulu.
Osho tuu wo Jakob naJohannes, aana yaSebedeus, mboka ya li puSimon. Jesus okwa ti kuSimon: “Ino tila, okuza ngashingeyi oto ningi omuyuli gwaantu.”
Oyo oya dhugile oowato dhawo komunkulo noya thigi po iinima ayihe e taa landula Jesus.

Jesus sho a li moshilando shimwe shaankoka, omwa li omulumentu a kanyata oshilundu. Omunashilundu sho a mono Jesus, okwa tsu oongolo koshipala she nokwe mu hehela ta ti: “Omuwa, ngele owa hala okwaaludha ndje, oto shi vulu.”
Jesus okwa ganeke oshikaha nokwe mu gumu e ta ti: “Onda hala, yela.” Mbalambala oshilundu noshe mu etha nokwa yele.

Jesus okwe mu kumagidha noonkondo a ti: “Ino shi popya nando okulye, inda owala, u ki iyulike komuyambi, ngoye u gandje omagano gealuko ngoka gu uthwa kuMoses, opo ge ya ningile onzapo kutya owa aluka.”
Ihe ehokololo ndyoka olya taandele owala mbala akuhe, naantu oyendji oye ya kuye oku mu pulakena, nokwa panga omavu gawo.
Opo ihe okwa yi komahala gaa na aantu nokwa galikana.

Esiku limwe Jesus sho a li ta longo aantu, aafarisayi naalongimpango oya kuutumba mpoka, ya zi komikunda adhihe dhomuGalilea nodhomuJudea nosho wo kuJerusalem. Omuwa nokwa pe Jesus oonkondo dhokwaaludha aavu.
Aalumentu yamwe oye etele Jesus omusilombanda ye mu inda kontala. Oyo noya kambadhala oku mu fala meni lyegumbo ndyoka, ye mu langeke puJesus.
Ihe omolwowindji waantu oya nyengwa oku shi ninga. Onkene oya londo noyu ulula ombululu pombanda yondunda e taye mu kulukithile nontala ye pevi mokati kaantu noye mu tula puJesus.
Jesus sho a mono eitaalo lyawo, okwa lombwele omusilombanda: “Kuume kandje, oondjo dhoye odha dhimwa po.”
Ihe aalongimpango naafarisayi oya tameke okupopya taa ti: “Nguka olye ta sheke Kalunga? Kaku na nando omuntu ta vulu okudhima po oondjo, oKalunga awike.”
Jesus sho a dhimbulula omadhiladhilo gawo, okwe ya yamukula e ta ti: “Omolwashike tamu idhiladhilile ngawo?
Oshipu oshini po? Okulombwela omusilombanda: ‘Oondjo dhoye odha dhimwe po,’ nenge oku mu lombwela: ‘Thikama, ngu u ende?’
Ihe opo mu kale mu shi shi kutya Omuna gwOmuntu oku na oonkondo kombanda yevi okudhima po oondjo,” okwa ti komusilombanda: “Otandi ku lombwele: Thikama, kutha ontala yoye, u ye kaandjeni.”
Oye okwa thikama mbala montaneho yaantu ayehe nokwa kutha ontala ye e ta yi kaandjawo te ende ta hambelele Kalunga.
Aantu ayehe oya kumwa nomokuudha etilo oya hambelele Kalunga ya ti: “Nena ndjika otwa mono iinyengandunge.”
Konima yaambika Jesus okwa zi mo moshilando nokwa mono omufendelithi, edhina lye Levi, a kuutumba pongulu yoompale dhopoongamba e ta ti kuye: “Landula ndje.”
Levi okwa thikama nokwa thigi po iinima ayihe e te mu landula.
Opo Levi okwa ningile Jesus oshituthi oshinene megumbo lye. Ongundu onene yaafendelithi nosho wo aantu yalwe oya kuutumba poshililo pamwe nayo.
Nena aafarisayi naalongimpango mboka yomongundu yawo oya nyenyetele aalongwa yaJesus ya ti: “Omolwashike tamu li notamu nu pamwe naafendelithi naalunde?”
Jesus okwe ya yamukula nokwa ti: “Aandjolowele inaa pumbwa omwaaludhi, ihe aavu tuu ayeke.
Oshoka ngame inandi ya okwiithana mboka yi iwete aayuuki, ihe aalunde tuu, yi itedhulule.”
Aantu yamwe oya ti kuJesus: “Aalongwa yaJohannes ohaa idhilike iikulya olwindji nohaa galikana. Nosho wo aalongwa yaafarisayi haa ningi, ihe aalongwa yoye ihaa idhilike iikulya.”
Jesus okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Ndishi ito tegelele, aahiywa yombushiki yi idhilike iikulya, manga ombushiki e li puyo?
Omasiku otage ke ya, uuna ombushiki taye yi kuthwa; nena otaye ki idhilika ihe iikulya.”

Jesus okwe ya lombwele natango eyele ndika: “Kaku na omuntu ta kutha oshaando konguwo ompe e te shi andeke konguwo onkulu. Ngele te shi ningi, ota tuulitha onguwo ompe. Osho wo oshaando oshipe itashi vulu okukalathana noshaando oshikulu.
Omaviinu omape ihaga zilwa moompunda oonkulu, ngele tashi ningwa, nena omaviinu omape otaga tuula oompunda e taga tika mo, noompunda otadhi yonuka.
Ihe omaviinu omape oge na okuzilwa moompunda oompe.
Kaku na ngoka i igilila omaviinu omakulu, ta hala ishewe omape, oshoka ota ti: ‘Omakulu omawanawa.’ ”
6: MEsabati lyontumba Jesus okwa piti pokati komapya. Aalongwa ye oya polola omaha noye ga thengele pomake gawo e taa li.
Nena yamwe yomaafarisayi oya ti: “Omolwashike tamu longo shoka shi indikwa kompango mEsabati?”
Jesus okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Inamu lesha nani shoka David e shi ningi, sho a li a sa ondjala, oye mwene naantu ye?
Oye okwa yi mongulu yaKalunga e ta kutha mo iikwiila mbyoka ya yambelwa Kalunga nokwe yi li po e ta pe wo mboka ya li puye. Iikwiila ya tya ngaaka aayambi ayeke ya li ya pitikilwa oku yi lya.”
Opo Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Omuna gwOmuntu oye Omuwa nogwEsabati.”
MEsabati ekwawo Jesus okwa yi mosinagoga nokwa longo aantu. Omo omwa li mu na omulumentu e na oshikaha shokolulyo sha lemana.
Nena aalongimpango naafarisayi oya kongo ompito yokutamaneka Jesus, onkee oye mu langele, ya tale, ngele ota aludha mEsabati.
Ihe Jesus okwa dhimbulula omadhiladhilo gawo nokwa ti komulumentu gwoshikaha sha lemana: “Thikama, u ye huka montaneho yaayehe.” Oye okwa thikama e te ya.
Jesus okwe ya pula e ta ti: “Oshike sha pitikwa okulongwa mEsabati: okulonga uuwanawa nenge okulonga uuwinayi, okuhupitha omwenyo nenge oku gu kanitha?”
Jesus okwa tala iipala yaayehe mboka ya kuutumba mpoka nokwa lombwele omulumentu ngoka a ti: “Utha oshikaha shoye.” Oye okwe shi utha, osho nosha aluka.
Ihe aatamaneki oye mu geele noonkondo noya pulathana kutya Jesus oye na oku mu ninga ngiini.
Pethimbo tuu ndyoka Jesus okwa londo kondundu, a ka galikane, nokwa kala ko uusiku auhe ta galikana Kalunga.
Ano ongula sho kwa shi, okwi ithana aalongwa ye, ye ye kuye nokwa hogolola mo muyo omulongo nayaali mboka e ya luku aayapostoli:
Simon, ngoka Jesus e mu luku wo Petrus, nomumwayina Andreas, Jakob naJohannes, Filippus naBartolomeus,
Mateus naTomas, Jakob yaAlfeus naSimon, ngoka i ithanwa omulaadhi,
Judas yaJakob naJudas Iskariot, ngoka a ningi omugwaaleki gwe.

Jesus okwa kuluka kondundu pamwe nayo nokwa thikama pelundu puuyelele pamwe nongundu onene yaalongwa ye. Okwa li wo ku na aantu oyendji ya zi kuJudea nokuJerusalem, nosho wo komunkulo gwefuta, popepi naTiro naSidon.
Oye ya oku mu pulakena nokupangwa omavu gawo. Naamboka ya li ya hepekwa koombepo dha nyata, oye ya kuye nokwe ya aludha.
Ayehe mboka oya kambadhala oku mu guma, oshoka oonkondo ndhoka dha zi muJesus odhe ya aludha.

Jesus okwa tala kaalongwa ye e ta ti:
“Aanelago one mboka mwa hepa,
oshoka Oshilongo shaKalunga osheni.

Aanelago one mboka mwa sa ondjala ngashingeyi,
oshoka otamu ka kutithwa.
Aanelago one mboka tamu lili ngashingeyi,
oshoka otamu ka yola.
“One aanelago, aantu ngele taye mu tondo, taye mu tidha po, taye mu sheke, nenge taa ti kutya one aawinayi omolwOmuna gwOmuntu.

Uuna tashi ningwa, nyanyukweni e tamu tanta,
oshoka ondjambi yeni onene yi li megulu.
Oshoka noohe osho ya ningile wo aahunganeki.

Ihe yayee ne mbo aayamba ngashingeyi,
sho mu iwete mwa gwana.

Yayee one mboka mwa kuta ngashingeyi,
oshoka otamu ka sa ondjala.
Yayee one mboka tamu yolo ngashingeyi,
oshoka otamu ka sa oluhodhi notamu ka lila.

“Yayee, aantu ayehe ngele taye mu popile muuwanawa,
oshoka noohe osho ya ningile aahunganeki aafundja.”
“Ihe ne mboka tamu pulakene, otandi mu lombwele: Holeni aatondi yeni, mboka ye mu huge, ya ningileni uuwanawa.
Yambekeni mboka taye mu thingi, galikaneneni mboka taye mu sheke.
Oongoka te ku dhenge kolupanda lumwe, mu etha, a dhenge nolukwawo. Ngoka te ku kutha ohema yoye, mu pa nombaikitha yoye wo.
Kehe ngoka te ku indile sha, mu pa. Ngoka te ku yugu iinima yoye, ino yi mu pula we.
Shoka mwa hala aantu ye mu ningile, osho ya ningileni wo.
“Ngele ne omu hole owala aantu mboka ye mu hole, otamu tegelele tuu epandulo lyasha? Oshoka naalunde wo oye hole aantu mboka ye ya hole.
Ngele ohamu ningile owala uuwanawa aantu mboka haye mu ningile uuwanawa, otamu tegelele tuu epandulo lyasha? Oshoka naalunde wo osho haa ningi.
Ngele ohamu pe owala mboka taye ke mu pa komeho, otamu tegelele tuu epandulo lyasha? Oshoka naalunde ohaa paathana, opo ya ka galulilwe shi thike pushoka ye shi gandja.

Holeni aatondi yeni e tamu ya ningile uuwanawa. Gandjeni, ne inamu tegelela, mu galulilwe. Oshoka ondjambi yeni onene, notamu ningi aana yaKalunga gwokombandambanda. Oshoka Kalunga oye omwaanawa kumboka ihaa pandula naamboka oonakwiihola.
Kaleni mu na ohenda ngashika Ho yeni e na ohenda.”
“Inamu pangula yakweni, opo Kalunga kee mu pangule; inamu tokola, opo Kalunga kee mu tokole. Dhiminathaneni po oondjo, Kalunga ote mu dhimine po wo.

Gandjeni, Kalunga ote mu pe oshiyelekitho shoka tashi holola iilonga yeni iiwanawa, shu udha, sha thindwa, sha huwa, tashi tika e tashi tulwa mekolo lyeni. Oshoka oshiyelekitho shoka tamu shi yelekitha yakweni, osho Kalunga te ke mu yelekitha.”
Jesus okwe ya lombwele eyele a ti: “Omuposi ota vulu tuu okukwata omuposi mukwawo keti? Ayehe yaali itaa gwile moshilambo?
Omulongwa ke vule ndishi omulongi gwe. Ihe omulongwa kehe ngoka a pwa okulongwa, oku thike pomulongi gwe.”
“Omolwashike wa tala okahwandu okashona ke li meho lyamukweni, ihe endangalati li li meho lyoye ku li wete?

Nenge oto vulu ngiini okulombwela mukweni: ‘Kuume, andiya, ndi kuthe mo okahwandu ke li meho lyoye,’ ihe endangalati ndyoka li li meho lyoye mwene ku li wete? Mufudhime ngoye, kutha mo tango endangalati meho lyoye mwene, nena oto vulu okumona ko e to kutha mo okahwandu ke li meho lyamukweni.”
“Omuti omwaanawa kagu wapa okwiima iiyimati iiwinayi, nomuti omwiinayi kagu wapa okwiima iiyimati iiwanawa.
Oshoka kehe omuti ohagu dhimbululwa kiiyimati yagwo. Ndishi oonkwiyu ihadhi likolwa komano nenge oomviinu komankono?

Omuntu omwaanawa ota holola mompungulo ombwanawa yomutima gwe uuwanawa. Osho wo omuntu omwiinayi ota holola mo uuwinayi mompungulo ye ombwinayi. Oshoka shoka shu udhilila momutima, okana ohake shi piitha mo.”
“Omolwashike hamu ithana ndje: ‘Omuwa, Omuwa’, ihe ihamu longo shono tandi shi mu lombwele?
Kehe ngoka te ya kungame nota pulakene oohapu dhandje e ta vulika kudho, otandi mu ulukile nkene a tya.

Oye okwa fa omulumentu ta tungu ongulu. Oye okwa fulu nokwa tungile ekankameno kemanya. Opo eyelu olye ya, nefundja olya panuka ko e tali itsu mongulu ndjoka, ihe inayi teka po, oshoka oya li ya tungwa ya kola.

Ihe ngoka tu uvu oohapu ndhika dhandje, ye ita vulika kudho, okwa fa omulumentu a tungile ongulu pehekevi, ye ina fula omukanka. Ano efundja sho lya panuka ko e tali itsu mongulu ndjoka, oya kumuka po, nekumukopo lyayo olya li enene.”
7: Jesus sho a mana okulombwela aantu oohapu ndhoka, okwa yi kuKapernaum.
Omukuluntu gwaakwiita Omuroma okwa li e na omumati gwe e mu hole ta alukwa e li pokusa.
Omulumentu nguka sho a kundana Jesus, okwa tumu aakuluntu yAajuda kuye oku mu indila, e ye, a aludhe omumati gwe.
Oyo oye ya kuJesus noye mu hehela nuupenda ya ti: “Omulumentu nguka okwa gwana okukwathwa kungoye.
Oye oku hole oshigwana shetu shAajuda nokwe tu tungila osinagoga.”

Jesus okwa yi pamwe nayo. Manga inaa thika pegumbo, omukuluntu gwaakwiita okwa tumu ookuume ke yamwe kuJesus, ye mu lombwele kutya: “Omuwa, ino ihepeka owala, oshoka ngame inandi opala, u ye megumbo lyandje.
Ngame sho ndi itala, inandi opala, ndi ye kungoye. Popya owala ohapu yimwe, omumati gwandje nota aluka.

Oshoka nangame wo omuntu omupangelwa, ihe ondi na aakwiita mepangelo lyandje. Otandi lombwele nguka. ‘Inda!’ nota yi. Otandi lombwele nomukwawo: ‘Ila!’ note ya. Sho tandi lombwele nomupika gwandje: ‘Longa shika!’ ote shi longo.”

Jesus sho e shi uvu, okwa kumwa nokwa taalele kongundu yaantu mboka ya li taye mu landula e ta ti kuyo: “Otandi mu lombwele, nomAaisraeli inandi mona mo nando omuntu gumwe e na eitaalo li thike pundika.”
Ano aatumwa sho ya galukile megumbo, oya adha omumati a aluka nale.
Inapu pita ethimbo ele, Jesus okwa yi koshilando, edhina lyasho Nain. Aalongwa ye nongundu onene yaantu oye mu landula.
Sho a thiki peelo lyoshilando, okwa tsakanene naantu yi inda omudhimba taa yi kefumviko lyomumati a valwa awike, kuyina omuselekadhi. Ongundu onene yaantu yomoshilando oya thindikile omuselekadhi.
Omuwa sho a mono omuselekadhi ngoka, okwe mu uvile olukeno e ta ti kuye: “Ino lila we.”
Jesus okwa hedha popepi nokwa gumu ontala hoka kwa indwa omudhimba, aayindi noya thikama. Nena Jesus okwa ti: “Mugundjuka, otandi ku lombwele, penduka po!”
Omumati ngoka a li a sa, okwa penduka nokwa tameke okupopya. Jesus nokwa ti: “Omumwoye oye ngu.”
Aantu oya tameke okutila noya hambelele Kalunga ya ti: “Omuhunganeki omunene a holoka mokati ketu. Kalunga okwe ya okuhupitha aantu ye.”
Ehokololo ndika tali popi shoka Jesus e shi ningi, olya taandele muJudea ashihe nomomikunda dhopuushiinda.
Aalongwa yaJohannes oye mu hokololele ayihe mbika.
Nena Johannes okwi ithana yaali yomaalongwa ye nokwe ya tumu kOmuwa oku mu pula: “Ongoye tuu nguka nakuya, nenge otu na okutegelela gulwe?”
Ano aalongwa mbeyaka sho ya thiki kuJesus, oya ti: “Johannes Omushashi okwe tu tumu kungoye, tu pule: ‘Ongoye tuu nguka nakuya, nenge otu na okutegelela gulwe?’ ”
Pethimbo tuu ndyoka Jesus okwa aludha aantu oyendji ya li ye na omavu, omauwehame noompwidhuli nokwa tonatitha aaposi.

Oye okwa yamukula aalongwa yaJohannes a ti: “Indeni, mu ka hokololele Johannes mbyoka mwe yi mono nomwe yi uvu: Aaposi otaa mono ko, iilema otayi ende, aanashilundu otaa yele, oombolo otaa uvu ko, aasi otaa yumudhwa noohepele otaa uvithilwa elaka etoye.
Ihe omunelago oye tuu ngoka itaa etha ndje.”
Ano aalongwa yaJohannes sho ya yi, Jesus okwa tameke okulombwela aantu ta popi Johannes ta ti: “Mombuga omwa yile, mu ka tale shike? Enenge tali nyenganyengithwa kombepo?
Nenge omwa yile, mu ka tale shike? Omuntu a zala oonguwo dho opala? Tala, aantu mboka haa zala oonguwo tadhi adhima, oye li muutoye moombala dhaakwaniilwa.
Lombwelii ndje, mombuga omwa ka talele tuu shike? Omuhunganeki andola? Ongame tandi mu lombwele: Oye e vule omuhunganeki.
Oye tuu ngoka a nyolwa kwa tiwa: ‘Ongame tandi tumu omutumwa gwandje, e ku tetekele. Oye ngoka te ku opalekele ondjila.’
Ongame tandi mu lombwele: Kaku na nando ogumwe gwomaantu omunene e vule Johannes Omushashi. Ihe mOshilongo shaKalunga ngoka omushuushuka kwaayehe oye e mu vule.”
Aantu ayehe naafendelithi mboka ya li ya pulakene euvitho lyaJohannes, oya vulika kehalo eyuuki lyaKalunga e taa shashwa kuJohannes.
Ihe aafarisayi naanongompango inaa vulika kehalo lyaKalunga, onkee oya tindi okushashwa kuJohannes.
“Ihe aantu yopethimbo ndika otandi ya yeleke nashike? Oya fa shike?
Oya fa uunona wa kuutumba pomalandelo tau igidhile uukwawo e tau ti: ‘Otse twe mu hakelele, ihe ne inamu tutula uudhano. Otse notwi imbi omaimbilo goosa, ihe ne inamu lila.’
Johannes Omushashi okwe ya, ti idhilike iikulya ye ita nu omaviinu, ihe ne otamu ti: ‘Oye oku na oompwidhuli.’
Omuna gwOmuntu okwe ya, ta li ye ta nu. One notamu ti: ‘Tala komufukedhi nonkolwi, kuume kaafendelithi nokaalunde.’
Ihe uunongo waKalunga owa hololwa u uka kwaayehe mboka ye u taamba.”
Omufarisayi gumwe okwa hiya Jesus, a lye pamwe naye. Jesus okwa yi megumbo lye nokwa kuutumba e ta li.
Moshilando shoka omwa li mu na omukiintu a li a kala muulunde. Sho u uvu kutya Jesus oku li megumbo lyomufarisayi ta li, okwa yi mo e na ohanga yu udha omugwayo.

Oye okwa thikama lwokonima yaJesus poompadhi dhe nokwa tameke okulila e ta thetitha oompadhi dhaJesus nomahodhi ge nokwe dhi kukutike nomafufu gokomutse gwe. Nena okwa simaneke Jesus nokuhupita oompadhi dhe nokwe dhi gwayeke omugwawo gwa nika nawa.
Ihe omufarisayi ngoka a hiya Jesus sho e shi mono, okwi ipopile a ti: “Omulumentu nguka ngele omuhunganeki, okwa li e na okutseya wo omukiintu nguka e mu gumu kutya omulunde.”
Jesus okwe mu lombwele a ti: “Simon, onda hala, tu popye po.” Oye a yamukula: “Oshike, Muhongi?”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Okwa li ku na omuyamba gumwe a lilwa iimaliwa kaantu yaali: Gumwe okwe mu lile oongunga dhiimaliwa omathele gatano nomukwawo omilongo ntano.
Ano sho ya li kaaye na shoka taa futu, okwe dhi ya dhimine po ayehe. Olye ano gwaambaka yaali ta kala e na ohole oyindji?”

Simon okwa yamukula a ti: “Ndishi oye ngoka a dhiminwa po oongunga odhindji.”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Eyamukulo lyoye oli li mondjila.”

Opo Jesus okwa tala omukiintu ngoka nokwa ti kuSimon: “Omukiintu nguno ou mu wete? Ongame sho nde ya megumbo lyoye, ino pa ndje omeya gokwiiyoga koompadhi, ihe omukiintu nguno okwa theta oompadhi dhandje nomahodhi ge e te dhi kukutike nomafufu gokomutse gwe.
Ngoye ino thipa ndje komilungu, ihe omukiintu nguno, sho nde ya mo, ine etha okusimaneka ndje nokuthipa oompadhi dhandje.
Ngoye ino gwayeka omutse gwandje nomagadhi, ihe ye okwa gwayeke oompadhi dhandje nomugwayo gwa nika nawa.
Onkee ano otandi ku lombwele: Omukiintu nguno sho a holola ohole oyindji, osha ulike wo kutya okwa dhiminwa po oondjo odhindji. Oshoka ngoka a dhiminwa po oondjo oonshona, oku na wo ohole onshona.”
Jesus okwa ti komukiintu: “Oondjo dhoye odha dhimwa po.”
Aantu mboka ya li ya kuutumba poshililo, oya tameke okupulathana ya ti: “Nguka olye ano, ta vulu okudhima po oondjo?”
Opo Jesus okwa lombwele omukiintu: “Eitaalo lyoye lye ku hupitha. Inda nombili.”
8: Methimbo lya landula Jesus okwe ende miilando nomomikunda noku uvitha elaka etoye lyOshilongo shaKalunga. Aalongwa ye omulongo nayaali oye ende pamwe naye
nosho wo aakiintu mboka a li e ya aludha, sho ya li ye na oompwidhuli nomavu galwe: Maria Magdalena, mungoka mwa li mwa tidhwa oompwidhuli heyali,
naJohanna, omukiintu gwaKusa, elenga lyaHerodes nosho wo Susanna naakiintu yalwe mboka ya li ya longitha omaliko gawo e taa yakula Jesus naalongwa ye.
Aantu oya tameke okuya kuJesus, ya zi kiilando niilando, nongundu onene sho ye mu gongalele, okwe ya lombwele eyele ndika:
“Omukuni okwa yi, a ka kune oombuto mepya. Ano mokukuna kwe oombuto dhimwe odha gwile mondjila, noondhila odhe ya e tadhi dhi shomona po.
Dhimwe odha gwile poshipale pwaa na evi olindji nomokumena odha ganya, oshoka evi lyapo ihali lwedha okukukuta.
Dhimwe odha gwile moongwena. Oongwena odha koko mumwe nadho nodhe dhi thininike.

Dhimwe odha gwile mevi ewanawa nodha mene e tadhi vala lwethele.”
Jesus sho a mana okupopya, okwa ti kuyo: “Pulakeneni, ngoka e na omakutsi gokuuva, nu uve ko!”
Aalongwa yaJesus oye mu pula oondunge dheyele ndika kutya otali ti ngiini.
Oye nokwa ti: “Ne omwa pewa okuuva ko iiholekwa yOshilongo shaKalunga, ihe yalwe otaa lombwelwa momayele. Onkee: Okumona ohaa mono, ihe kaa wete ko. Okuuva ohaa uvu, ihe kaa uvite ko.”
“Eyele otali ti: Oombuto odho oohapu dhaKalunga.
Ndhoka dha gwile mondjila, odha fa aantu mboka haa pulakene oohapu, ihe omuhindadhi ote ya e ta kutha mo oohapu ndhoka dha kunwa moomwenyo dhawo, opo yaa vule okwiitaala, ya hupithwe.
Ndhoka dha gwile poshipale, odha fa aantu mboka taa uvu oohapu e taye dhi taamba nenyanyu, ihe itadhi ningine muyo. Otaa itaale okathimbo kowala, ihe uuna taa adhika kemakelo, otaa etha eitaalo.
Ndhoka dha kunwa moongwena, odha fa aantu mboka taa uvu oohapu, ihe konima yethimbo iimpwiyu, uuyamba nuuhalu wopauyuni otayi thininike oohapu, kaaya imike iiyimati.
Ndhoka dha gwile mevi ewanawa, odha fa aantu mboka taa uvu oohapu notaye dhi taamba nomwenyo omwaanawa gu na evuliko e taa dhiginine, sigo taa imike iiyimati.”
“Kaku na omuntu ta tema olamba e te yi tula kohi yontungwa nenge kohi yontala. Ihe oku na oku yi tula koshihukikwa, opo aantu ngele taa ya megumbo, ya mone uuyelele.”
“Oshoka kaku na shoka sha holekwa itaashi ka hololwa, nokaku na shoka sha holama itaashi ka tseyika, shi ye puuyelele.”
“Kotokeni, mu tale, nkene hamu pulakene. Oshoka mboka ye na, oyo otaa pewa, ihe mboka kaye na, oyo otaa kuthwa noshishona shoka taa dhiladhila kutya oshawo.”
Yina yaJesus naamwayina aalumentu oye ya kuye, ihe oya nyengwa okuthika kuye omolwowindji waantu.
Nena gumwe gwomaantu mboka okwa ti kuJesus: “Tala, nyoko naamwanyoko oya thikama pondje, taye ku kongo, ya hala, ya popye nangoye.”
Jesus okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Meme naamwameme oyo mboka taa uvu oohapu dhaKalunga e taa vulika kudho.”
Esiku limwe Jesus okwa yi mowato pamwe naalongwa ye nokwa ti kuyo: “Tu taagulukileni handiyaka yetale.” Oyo noya yi.
Ano mokudhuga kwawo oye okwa tameke okukotha. Oshikungulu shombepo osha tukuluka kombanda yetale. Omeya noga tameke okuya mowato noshiponga osha li popepi nayo.

Aalongwa oye ya kuJesus noye mu pendutha ya ti: “Omuwa, Omuwa, tatu sile mwee!”
Opo Jesus okwa penduka nokwa ganda ombepo nomakuthikuthi, nokwa mwena kwa tya thilu.

Oye nokwa ti kaalongwa: “Eitaalo lyeni oli li peni?”
Ihe oya kumwa noya tila e taa pulathana: “Nguka olye ano, sho ta ganda ombepo nomakuthikuthi, oyo notayi vulika kuye?”
Oyo oya dhugu yu uka koshilongo shAagerasa, shi li handiyaka yefuta lyaGalilea.
Jesus sho a thiki kuukukutu, okwa tsakaneke omulumentu ta zi koshilando e niwe kompwidhuli. Oye okwa kala ethimbo ele te ende omupwedhu ye ina kala megumbo, ihe okwa kala moombila dhomomakololo.
Sho a mono Jesus, okwi igidha, a tsu oongolo koshipala she nokwa popi mokule a ti: “Jesus, Omuna gwa Kalunga gwokombandambanda! Owa halela ndje shike? Otandi ku galikana waa hepeke ndje.”

Oye okwa popi ngeyi, oshoka Jesus okwa tidha mo ombepo ya nyata muye. Olwindji sho ye mu kwata, okwe edhililwa mondholongo a mangwa nomalyenge nomiya kiikaha nokomagulu, ihe ohi itokola mo, ompwidhuli e tayi mu fala kombuga.

Opo Jesus okwe mu pula a ti: “Edhina lyoye olini?”
Oye a yamukula: “Edhina lyandje ongame Ngundu,” oshoka muye omwa li mu na oompwidhuli odhindji.
Oompwidhuli odha hehela Jesus, kee dhi undulile molumbogo lwomuule.
Popepi nondundu opwa li oshigunda oshinene shiingulu tayi napa. Oompwidhuli odha hehela Jesus, e dhi pitike, dhi ye miingulu. Oye okwe dhi pitika.
Oompwidhuli odha zi momulumentu ngoka nodha yi miingulu. Nena oshigunda ashihe shiingulu osha nuka okuza komutuni omule noshi iyumbile mefuta e tashi sile mo.
Aasita yiingulu sho ya mono shoka sha ningwa po, oya fadhuka po noya ka hokolola oshiningwanima shika moshilando nomomikunda ndhoka.
Aantu noye ya okutala shoka sha ningwa po. Oyo oye ya kuJesus noya mono omulumentu ngoka a zi oompwidhuli, a kuutumba puJesus a zala nawa noku na oondunge; oyo noya tila.
Aantu mboka ye shi mono, oya hokololele yalwe, nkene omulumentu ngoka a li e na oompwidhuli, a aludhwa.
Nena aantu ayehe yomomikunda ndhoka dhAagerasa oyi indile Jesus, a ze mo moshilongo shawo, oshoka oya li ya tila noonkondo. Opo Jesus okwa yi mowato e ta shuna.

Omulumentu ngoka a li e na oompwidhuli, okwi indile Jesus, a pitikwe okukala puye.
Ihe Jesus okwe mu laleke a ti:

“Shuna kaandjeni, u ke ya hokololele shoka Kalunga e shi ku ningile.”
Omulumentu okwa yi nokwa hokolola moshilongo ashihe shoka Jesus e shi mu ningile.
Jesus sho a galuka ko, aantu oyendji oye mu tsakaneke, oshoka oya adhika ye mu tegelela.
Nena omulumentu gumwe, edhina lye Jairus, omukuluntu gwosinagoga, okwe ya kuye. Oye okwa tsu oongolo poompadhi dhaJesus nokwe mu hehela, a ye megumbo lye,

oshoka okwa li e na omwana omukadhona omuvalwa awike gwoomvula omulongo nambali e li pokusa.
Jesus manga ta yi pamwe naJairus, aantu oye mu uminine.
Okwa li wo ku na omukiintu a ala uuvu wetiko lyombinzi oomvula omulongo nambali. Oye okwa manene eliko lye alihe moonganga, ihe odha nyengwa oku mu aludha.
Omukiintu ngoka okwe ya te endele konima yaJesus nokwa gumu koongenge dhonguwo ye; mbalambala etiko lye olya kodha.

Jesus okwa pula: “Olye a gumu ndje?”
Nena kehe gumwe okwe shi idhimbike, ihe Petrus okwa ti: “Muhongi, aantu oyendji ye ku kundukidha noye ku uminina.”
Jesus okwa ti: “Onde shi dhimbulula kutya ope na gumwe a gumu ndje, omolwoonkondo ndhoka dha zi mungame.”

Ano omukiintu sho a dhimbulula kutya ita vulu we okuholama, okwe ya nokwa tsu oongolo koshipala shaJesus, a tila ta kakama. Nena okwa lombwele Jesus montaneho yaantu ayehe kutya omolwashike e mu gumu nankene a aludhwa mbalambala.
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Mumwandje, eitaalo lyoye lye ku aludha. Inda nombili.”
Manga Jesus a li ta popi, opwe ya omulumentu a zi kaandjawo yomukuluntu gwosinagoga a ti: “Omumwoye omukadhona a mana oondjenda. Oto monithile we shike Muhongi iihuna?”
Jesus sho u uvu oohapu ndhoka, okwa ti kuJairus: “Ino tila, itaala owala, omumwoye ota aluka.”
Jesus sho e ya megumbo, ina pitika nando omuntu gumwe a ye mo pamwe naye, kakele kaPetrus, Johannes naJakob nahe nayina yomunona ayeke.
Aantu ayehe mboka ya li mo, oya hekumuna noya lili oosa omolwe. Ihe Jesus okwa ti. “Inamu lila, omukadhona ina sa, ihe okwa kotha.”
Aantu oya yolo Jesus, oshoka oya li ye shi shi kutya omukadhona okwa sa.
Jesus okwe mu kwata koshikaha nokwa popi mokule a ti: “Mumwandje penduka po!”
Omwenyo gwe ogwe ya mo nokwa thikama nziya. Jesus okwe ya lombwele, ya pe omunona iikulya.
Aakuluntu yomunona oya kumwa, ihe Jesus okwe ya indile, yaa hokololele nando omuntu shoka sha ningwa po.
9: Jesus okwi ithana aalongwa ye omulongo nayaali nokwe ya pe oonkondo nepitikilo okutidha mo oompwidhuli nokwaaludha omavu.
Nena okwe ya tumu okuuvitha Oshilongo shaKalunga nokwaaludha aavu.
Oye a ti kuyo: “Inamu ya nasha mondjila: handhimbo, hampunda yokweenda nayo, haikulya, haimaliwa, hahema mbali, yimwe oya gwana.
Ngele tamu yi megumbo lyontumba, kaleni moka, sigo tamu ka za mo moshilando shoka.
Ngele itamu taambwa, zii mo moshilando shoka, ne mu pupule ko ontsi koompadhi dheni, opo shi ninge onzapo yoku ya pa uusama.”
Aalongwa oya yi noye ende omikunda adhihe. Oyu uvithile aantu elaka etoye noya aludha aavu akuhe.
Herodes, omuleli gwaGalilea, sho u uvu ayihe mbyoka ya ningwa po, ina tseya shoka e na okuninga. Oshoka aantu yamwe oya popi ya ti kutya Johannes Omushashi okwa yumuka kuusi.
Ihe yamwe oya ti, oElia a holoka; yamwe ishewe oya ti kutya gumwe gwomaahunganeki yonale a yumuka kuusi.
Herodes okwa ti: “Johannes onde mu tetitha omutse, ihe omulumentu nguka olye ano? Ondu uvu omahokololo ogendji tage mu hokolola.” Oye nokwa kala ta kongo ompito, a mone Jesus.
Aayapostoli oya galuka noya hokololele Jesus ayihe mbyoka ye yi longo. Oye okwe ya kutha maantu nokwe ya fala, ye ki ikalele lwokoshilando, edhina lyasho Betsaida.
Oongundu dhaantu sho dhe shi uvu, odhe mu landulile ko. Oye okwe ya taamba nenyanyu nokwe ya hokololele Oshilongo shaKalunga e ta aludha aavu mboka ya li ya pumbwa okwaaludhwa.
Ano sho kwa ningi ongulohi, aalongwa ye oye ya kuye noya ti: “Pokuma mpaka omombuga yowala, onkee laleka aantu, ya ye momikunda nomomagumbo gopuushiinda, ya ka konge omulalo niikulya.”

Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Ya peni iikulya.”
Oyo ya ti kuye: “Mpaka otu na po iikwiila itano ayike noohi mbali. Owa hala, tu ye, tu ka landele aantu ayehe mbaka iikulya?”

Aalumentu mboka ya li po, oya li ye thike pomayuvi gatano.
Opo Jesus okwa lombwele aalongwa ye e ta ti: “Kuutumbikeni aantu moongundu, kehe yimwe aantu omilongo ntano.”
Oyo oye shi ningi e taye ya kuutumbike ayehe.
Jesus okwa kutha iikwiila mbyoka itano noohi mbali, okwa ligamene kegulu nokwe yi hambelelele Kalunga, e yi pambula nokwe yi pe aalongwa ye, ye yi topolele aantu.
Oyo ayehe oya li e taa kuta. Aalongwa oya toola iihupe yuupambu, oontungwa omulongo nambali.
Pethimbo lyontumba Jesus sho a li ta galikana muuwike, aalongwa ye oye ya kuye. Oye okwe ya pula a ti: “Aantu otaa tile ndje ngiini, ongame lye?”
Oyo oye mu yamukula ya ti: “Yamwe otaa ti oJohannes Omushashi, yamwe otaa ti oElia, nayamwe otaa ti gumwe gwomaahunganeki yonale a yumuka kuusi.”

Oye okwe ya pula natango: “Ne otamu tile ndje ngiini, ongame lye?”
Petrus okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Ongoye Omugwayekwa gwaKalunga.”
Nena okwe ya indike, kaaye mu popye nando okulye.
Jesus okwa tsikile ko a ti: “Omuna gwOmuntu ota ka hepekwa nomahepeko ogendji note ke ekelwahi kaakuluntu, kaayambi aakuluntu nokaalongimpango. Oye ota dhipagwa, ihe esiku etitatu ota ka yumudhwa.”
Jesus okwa lombwele aantu ayehe e ta ti: “Ngele ku na ngoka a hala okulandula ndje, oye ni idhimbwe ye mwene, ni itsike omushigakano gwe esiku kehe, ye na landule ndje.
Oshoka oongoka a hala okuhupitha omwenyo gwe, oye te gu kanitha, ihe ngoka ta kanitha omwenyo gwe molwandje, oye te gu hupitha.
Oshoka otashi kwatha shike, omuntu nando ni ilikolele uuyuni auhe, ye e ta kanitha omwenyo gwe nenge ti iyono po?
Ngele ku na ngoka ta si ndje ohoni nosho wo oohapu dhandje, nena Omuna gwOmuntu ote ke mu sa wo ohoni, uuna te ke ya e li mesimano lye mwene nolyaHe nolyaayengeli aayapuki.
Ongame tandi mu lombwele: Opu na yamwe mwaambaka ya thikama mpaka, itaa makele eso, manga inaaya mona Oshilongo shaKalunga.”
Jesus sho a popi ngeyi, opwa piti konyala omasiku gahetatu nokwa kutha Petrus, Johannes naJakob e ta yi nayo kondundu, a ka galikane.
Manga a li ta galikana, olupe lwoshipala she olwa shituluka, noonguwo dhe odha toka dhe eta uuyelele.
Ombaadhilila opwa holoka aalumentu yaali, Moses naElia, e taa kundathana naye.
Oyo oya holoka ye na eadhimo lyomegulu noya kundathana naJesus, nkene ta ka tsakanitha ehalo lyaKalunga, sho ta ka sa muJerusalem.
Ihe Petrus nayakwawo oya li yu umbwa oomposi, ihe sho ya papudhuka mo, oya mono eadhimo lyaJesus naalumentu mboka yaali ya thikama puye.

Ano Moses naElia sho ya topoka naJesus, Petrus okwa ti kuye: “Muhongi, opwe tu opalela mpaka okukala. Otatu ka dhikila po omatsali gatatu, limwe olyoye, limwe olyaMoses nalimwe olyaElia.” Petrus ina tseya shoka a li ta popi.
Ano manga ta popi, oshikogo osha holoka noshe ya siikile nomuzile gwasho. Aalongwa mboka oya tila, sho ya siikilwa koshikogo.
Ewi olya zi moshikogo lya ti: “Nguka Omumwandje, ngoka nde mu hogolola, mu uveni.”
Konima yokupopya kwewi aalongwa oya mono Jesus e li awike. Oyo noye shi mwenene yo inaa hokololela nando omuntu sha pethimbo ndyoka shoka ye shi mono.
Mesiku lya landula ko, sho ya kuluka kondundu, aantu oyendji oya tsakaneke Jesus.
Omulumentu gumwe okwi igidha mokati kongundu a ti: “Muhongi, otandi ku indile, u sile ohenda omumwandje, omuvalwa awike.
Oku na ompwidhuli, ndjoka omathimbo gamwe hayi mu kwata, nota tameke okwiigidha oshihalulu, e tayi mu mbungambunga, sigo te eta ondutu. Oyo ohayi kala tayi mu ehameke noyi na uudhigu oku mu etha.
Onda li ndi indile aalongwa yoye, ye yi tidhe mo, ihe oya nyengwa.”

Jesus okwa yamukula a ti: “Yayee, aantu yopethimbo ndika yaa na eitaalo noya pilaala, osigo uunake tandi kala pune? Osigo uunake ndi na oku mu idhidhimikila?” Opo Jesus okwa ti kuhe: “Eta omumwoye huka kungame.”
Omumati manga te ya, ompwidhuli oye mu hata pevi e tayi mu mbungambunga. Nena Jesus okwa ganda ombepo ya nyata nokwa aludha omumati e te mu fala kuhe.

Aantu ayehe oya kuminwa oonkondo oonene dhaKalunga.
Aantu oya li ya kuminwa natango ayihe mbyoka Jesus e yi longo, sho a lombwele aalongwa ye e ta ti:
“Taambeni oohapu ndhika tandi mu lombwele ngashingeyi, mu dhi dhiginine: Omuna gwOmuntu ota ka gandjwa miikaha yaantu.”
Aalongwa inaa uva ko kutya otashi ti ngiini, oshoka osha li she ya holekwa, ihe oya tila oku mu pula.
Mokati kaalongwa omwa penduka edhiladhilo kutya olye omukuluntu e vule ooyakwawo ayehe.
Jesus sho a dhimbulula omadhiladhilo gawo, okwa kutha okanona nokwe ka thikameke ponto ye

e ta ti kuyo: “Kehe ngoka ta taamba medhina lyandje okanona nkaka, oye ta taamba ndje; naangoka ta taamba ndje, ota taamba wo ngoka a tuma ndje. Oshoka ngoka gwomokati keni omudhinwa kwaayehe, oye omukuluntu.”
Johannes okwa popi a ti: “Muhongi, otwa mono omuntu gumwe ta tidha mo oompwidhuli medhina lyoye, otse notwe mu indike, oshoka ka li gwomongundu yetu.”
Opo Jesus okwa yamukula Johannes naalongwa yalwe a ti: “Inamu mu indika, oshoka ngoka kee na ondumbo nane, oye okwa gama kune.”
Ano omasiku sho ga thiki popepi, uuna Jesus e na okulonda, a ye megulu, okwa tokola okuukilila kuJerusalem.
Oye okwa tetekelitha aatumwa ye, ya ye komukunda gwontumba muSamaria, opo ye ke mu longekidhile ehala lyokulala.
Ihe mbeyaka oya tindi okutaamba Jesus, oshoka okwa li u uka kuJerusalem.
Ano aalongwa ye Jakob naJohannes, sho ye shi mono, oya ti: “Omuwa, owa hala, tu indile omulilo gu ze megulu, gu ya halakanithe po?”
Nena Jesus okwe ya tala e te ya ganda.
Oyo noya yi komukunda gulwe.
Ano mokweenda kwawo omulumentu gumwe okwa ti kuJesus: “Onda hala oku ku landula shaa mpoka to yi.”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Oombandje odhi na omakwena, noondhila odhi na iihandhila, ihe Omuna gwOmuntu ke na mpoka ta langeke omutse gwe.”

Jesus okwa lombwele natango gulwe a ti: “Landula ndje!”
Nguka okwa ti: “Omuwa, pitika ndje manga, ndi ye, ndi ka fumvike tate.”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Etha aasi, ya fumvike aasi yawo. Inda, u ka uvithe Oshilongo shaKalunga.”
Gumwe ishewe okwa ti: “Omuwa, onda hala oku ku landula, ihe etha ndje manga, ndi ka laleke yaandjetu.”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Kehe ngoka ta tameke okupulula e ta tala konima, ino opalela Oshilongo shaKalunga.”
10: Konima yaambika Omuwa okwa hogolola aalongwa yalwe omilongo heyali nayaali nokwe ya tetekelitha, ya ye koshilando nokehala kehe hoka ye mwene e na okuya ko.
Oye okwe ya lombwele a ti: “Iilya oyi li po oyindji, ihe aalongi oyo aashona. Galikaneni ano mwene gwiilya, a tume aalongi keteyo lye.
Indeni! Ngame otandi mu tumu ongoonzi mokati komambungu.”
“Inamu humbata okampunda kiimaliwa nenge ompunda yokweenda nayo, hangaku koompadhi, ne inamu mana po ethimbo nokukunda aantu mondjila.
Ngele tamu yi megumbo lyontumba, tyeni tango: ‘Ombili nayi kale megumbo ndika.’
Ngele omu na omuntu e hole ombili, nena ekundo lyeni lyombili otali kala kuye; ihe ngele hasho, ombili yeni otayi mu galukile.
Kaleni megumbo olyo tuu ndyoka, mu lye ne mu nwe shoka tamu shi pewa; oshoka nakulonga kehe oku na okupewa ondjambi ye. Inamu za megumbo limwe, mu ye kekwawo.
Ngele tamu yi moshilando shontumba e tamu taambwa, lyeni shoka tamu shi pewa.
Aludheni aavu yomoshilando shoka, ne mu ya lombwele mu tye: ‘Oshilongo shaKalunga she ya popepi nane.’
Ngele tamu yi moshilando, ihe inamu taambwa, indeni komapandaanda gasho e tamu ti:
‘Ontsi yomoshilando sheni, ndjoka ya kakatela koompadhi dhetu, otatu yi pupula ko oku mu pa uusama. Ihe tseyeni kutya Oshilongo shaKalunga she ya popepi.’
Ngame otandi mu lombwele: Sodom otashi ka ninga ihwepo, shi vule oshilando shoka mesiku ndyoka lyepangulo.”
“Yayee ngoye Korasin! Yayee ngoye Betsaida! Oshoka ando muTiro nomuSidon mwa li mwa ningilwa iilongankondo mbyoka ya ningilwa mune, ando yo oyi itedhulula nale mokuzala omahahi nokukuutumba momutoko.
Ihe Tiro naSidon otayi ka kala ihwepo yi mu vule mesiku ndyoka lyepangulo.
Nangoye wo Kapernaum, oto ka lengwa sigo omegulu? Aawe, oto ka kulukithilwa sigo omoheli.”
Jesus okwa ti kaalongwa ye: “Oongoka ta vulika koohapu dheni, oye ta vulika wo koohapu dhandje; ngoka itee mu taamba, ita taamba ndje; naangoka ita taamba ndje, ita taamba wo ngoka a tuma ndje.”
Aalumentu omilongo heyali nayaali oya galuka yu udha enyanyu enene noya ti: “Omuwa, noompwidhuli wo sho twe dhi ganda medhina lyoye, odha vulika kutse.”
Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Onda mono Satana a gu megulu ongolwaadhi.
Pulakeneni! Ne onde mu pa oonkondo dhokulyata omayoka noondje nokusinda oonkondo adhihe dhaSatana, nokaku na shoka tashi mu etele oshiponga.
Ihe inamu nyanyukilwa, oompwidhuli sho tadhi vulika kune; nyanyukilweni, omadhina geni sho ga nyolelwa membo lyomegulu.”

Pethimbo tuu ndyoka Jesus oku udhithwa enyanyu kOmbepo Ondjapuki e ta ti: “Otandi ku hambelele, Tate, Omuwa gwegulu nogwevi, oshoka iinima mbika ongoye we yi holeke aanongo naanamayele nowe yi hololele mboka ya fa uunona. Eeno, Tate, shika osho she ku opalela.”
“Iinima ayihe onde yi pewa kuTate. Kaku na ngoka a tseya kutya Omwana oye olye, oTate awike. Osho wo kaku na ngoka a tseya Tate oye olye, Omwana awike, naamboka Omwana a hogolola oku ye mu hololela.”
Jesus naalongwa ye sho ya li yi ikalele, okwe ya tala e ta ti kuyo: “Omeho geni oge na elago, sho taga mono iinima mbika mwe yi tala.
Oshoka otandi mu lombwele: Aahunganeki oyendji naakwaniilwa oya li ya hala nokuhalelela okumona mbyoka tamu yi tala, yo inaye yi mona, nokuuva ndhoka tamu dhi uvu, yo inaye dhi uva.”
Nena omunongompango gumwe okwe ya, a makele Jesus e ta ti: “Muhongi, ondi na okuninga shike, ndi mone omwenyo gwaaluhe?”
Jesus okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Omanyolo otaga ti ngiini? Oho ga fatulula ngiini?”

Oye okwa yamukula a ti: “ ‘Hola Omuwa Kalunga koye komutima gwoye aguhe nokomwenyo gwoye aguhe nokomadhiladhilo goye agehe nonoonkondo dhoye adhihe’; na: ‘Hola mukweni, ngaashi ngoye wi ihole mwene.’ ”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Owa yamukula mondjila, shi gwanitha e to kala u na omwenyo.”
Omunongompango sho a li a hala okwiiyulika kutya oye omuyuuki, okwa pula Jesus a ti: “Mukwetu olye?”
Opo Jesus okwa yamukula a ti: “Omulumentu gwontumba okwa li ta zi kuJerusalem u uka kuJeriko nokwa adhika kaayugi. Oye mu hula oonguwo noye mu mokagula e taye mu thigi e na okamwenyo okashona.
Ohaluka omuyambi gwontumba okwa adhika te ende nondjila ndjoka. Sho e mu mono, okwa tsu moluha e te mu pitilile.
Osho wo Omulevi, sho e ya pehala mpoka, okwe mu mono nokwa tsu moluha e te mu pitilile.
Ihe Omusamaria manga a li te ende nondjila ndjoka, okwe ya po nokwa mono omulumentu ngoka a mona iihuna nokwa li e mu uvitile olukeno.
Oye okwa yi kuye nokwa panga iilalo ye nokutila mo omahooli nomaviinu e te yi manga. Oye okwe mu kayilike konkutsa ye nokwe mu sisidhile kongulu yaayenda e te mu hungu.

Esiku lya landula manga inaa ya, okwa kutha iimaliwa iisiliveli iyali nokwe yi pe mwene gwongulu yaayenda e ta ti kuye: ‘Hunga omuvu nguka, nuuna tandi ka galuka, otandi ke ku galulila ashihe shoka we mu futile.’ ”
Jesus okwa ti: “Ano pandunge dhoye oguni po gwaambaka yatatu a kala omukwawo gwaanguka a adhikile kaayugi?”

Omunongompango okwa yamukula a ti: “Oye ngoka e mu sile ohenda.”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Nangoye wo inda, u ka ninge ngaaka.”
Jesus naalongwa ye oya tsikile ondjila yawo noye ya komukunda gwontumba. Omukiintu gumwe edhina lye Marta okwe mu taamba maandjawo.
Oye okwa li e na omumwayina, edhina lye Maria, ngoka a li a hokwa okukuutumba poompadhi dhOmuwa nokwa pulakene oohapu dhe.
Ihe Marta okwi ipyakidhile unene niilonga nokwe ya kuJesus e ta ti: “Omuwa, ku na ko nasha nangame, omumwameme sho e etha ndje, ndi yakule awike? Mu lombwela, e ye, a kwathe ndje.”
Omuwa okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Marta, Marta, ou na iimpwiyu oyindji nowa piyagana,
ihe oshinima shimwe shi na oshilonga, osho shika: Maria okwi ihogololele ombinga ombwanawa itee yi kuthwa nando okulye.”
11: Esiku limwe Jesus okwa li ta galikana pehala lyontumba. Sho a hulitha, gumwe gwomaalongwa ye okwa ti kuye: “Omuwa, tu longa okugalikana, ngaashi Johannes a longo aalongwa ye.”

Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Ngele tamu galikana, tyeni:
‘Tate, edhina lyoye nali yapulwe,
Oshilongo shoye nashi ye.
Tu pa wo nena oshithima shetu twe shi pumbwa.

Dhima po oondjo dhetu,
ngashika natse wo tatu dhimi po dhaamboka ya yono kutse.
Ino tu fala mehongololo.’ ”
Jesus okwa ti kaalongwa ye: “Olye gwomune e na kuume ke te ya kaandjawo mokati kuusiku e te mu lombwele: ‘Kuume kandje, pe ndje iikwiila itatu.
Oshoka ondi na kuume kandje, opo a thiki ngashingeyi a zi mondjila, ihe ngame kandi na nando osha shoku mu pa, a lye.’
Natu tye, kuume koye ngoka ote ku yamukula e li meni e ta ti: ‘Ino yonena ndje oomposi. Omweelo ogwa patwa nale, naamwandje oya lala mpaka pungame. Ite vulu okupenduka, ndi yi ku pe.’
Ngame otandi mu lombwele: Ngele ita penduka, e ku pe iikwiila mbyono omoluukuume weni naye, oku na okupenduka e te ku pe shoka we shi pumbwa omoluudhiginini woye woku mu indila.
“Onkee tandi mu lombwele: Indileni, e tamu pewa; kongeni, e tamu mono; konkoleni, e tamu egululwa.
Oshoka kehe ngoka ti indile, ota pewa; naangoka ta kongo, ota mono; naangoka ta konkola, ote egululwa.
Omuvali olye gwomokati keni, omwana ngele te mu indile ohi, te mu pe eyoka?
Nenge te mu indile eyi, ye te mu pe ondje?
Ano ne mboka aawinayi ngele omu shi okupa aana yeni omagano omawanawa, unene tuu Ho yeni yomegulu ota gandja Ombepo Ondjapuki kumboka taye mu indile.”
Jesus okwa tidha momulumentu ompwidhuli ihayi popi. Opwa ningi ihe, ompwidhuli sho ya tidhwa mo, omulumentu ngoka okwa tameke okupopya. Aantu oya kumwa,
nayamwe yomuyo oya ti: “OBelsebul, omukuluntu gwoompwidhuli e mu pe oonkondo dhokutidha mo oompwidhuli.”
Yamwe ishewe oye mu makele noye mu pula, e ya talithe oshikumithalonga shokuholola kutya ota longithwa kuKalunga.
Ihe Jesus sho a dhimbulula omadhiladhilo gawo, okwa ti kuyo: “Okehe tuu oshilongo tashi itsile ondumbo, otashi yonuka po. Osho wo egumbo ngele tali itsile ondumbo, itali kala po.
Satana ngele ti itsile ondumbo, oshilongo she otashi vulu tuu okukala po? One otamu ti kutya oonkondo dhokutidha mo oompwidhuli onde dhi pewa kuBelsebul.
Ngele osho tandi dhi tidha mo ngawo, aana yeni otaye dhi tidha mo noonkondo dhalye? Onkee ano oyo taa ningi aapanguli yeni.
Ihe ngele ngame otandi tidha mo oompwidhuli noonkondo dhaKalunga, nena Oshilongo shaKalunga oshi li pune.”
“Uuna omulumentu omunankondo e na iikondjitho ya gwana, nena ota tonatele nawa egumbo lye, neliko lye olya gamenwa.
Ihe ngele ta matukilwa komulumentu mukwawo e mu vule oonkondo e ta sindika, mukwawo ote mu yugu iikondjitho ye ayihe mbyoka a li inekela e ta topola oshihakanwa.”
“Kehe ngoka kee li kombinga yandje, oye okwa tsa ondumbo nangame. Naangoka itaa gongele pamwe nangame, oye ota halakanitha po.”
“Ombepo ya nyata ngele tayi zi momuntu, otayi endagula nomitunda dhaa na omeya, tayi kongo evululuko, yo itayi li mono. Otayi ti: ‘Otandi shuna megumbo lyandje moka nda zile.’
Ngele ya galuka, otayi adha egumbo lya kombwa nolyo opalekwa.
Nena otayi yi notayi etelele oombepo oonkwawo heyali dhi yi vule muuwinayi. Odho tadhi ya notadhi kala moka. Nena okukala kwahugunina kwomuntu ngoka otaku ningi okwiinayi ku vule kwopetameko.”
Jesus sho a mana okupopya ngeyi, omukiintu gumwe okwa thikama mokati kongundu nokwa popi mokule e ta ti kuye. “Omukiintu a li e ku vala e te ku yamutha, oye omunelago!”
Ihe Jesus okwa yamukula a ti: “Eeno, ihe aanelago oomboka taa uvu oohapu dhaKalunga e taye dhi dhiginine.”
Aantu manga taye mu ngundumanene, Jesus okwa tsikile ta ti: “Aantu yopethimbo ndika oyo aawinayi. Oya hala oshikumithalonga, ihe itaa pewa oshikumithalonga shilwe, osho tuu shoka shaJona.
Oshoka ngaashi omuhunganeki Jona a li endhindhiliko kAaninive, osho wo Omuna gwOmuntu ota ka kala endhindhiliko kaantu yopethimbo ndika.

Omukwaniilwa omukiintu gwokuumbugantu ota ka holoka mesiku lyepangulo pamwe nane note ke mu pa uusama, oshoka oye okwa zile kooha dhuuyuni, a pulakene oondunge dhaSalomo; ihe nguka e li mpaka, oku vule Salomo.
Aaninive otaa ka holoka mesiku lyepangulo pamwe nane notaye ke mu pa uusama, oshoka oyo oyi itedhululithwa keuvitho lyaJona; ihe nguka e li mpaka oku vule Jona.”
“Kaku na omuntu ta tema olamba e te yi holeke nenge te yi tula kohi yontungwa. Aawe, okoshihukikwa, opo mboka taye ya megumbo, ya mone uuyelele.
Omeho geni ogo olamba yolutu. Ano omeho goye ngele omandjolowele, nena olutu lwoye aluhe olu na uuyelele. Ihe omeho goye ngele kage li nawa, nena olutu lwoye aluhe olu li momilema.
Kotoka ano, uuyelele mbuka u li mungoye waa ninge omilema.
Ngele olutu lwoye aluhe olu na uuyelele, kaalu na nando ombinga yimwe yi li momilema, nena olutu aluhe otalu gandja uuyelele, noto kala wa fa wa minikilwa kuuyelele wolamba.”
Jesus sho a mana okupopya, omufarisayi gumwe okwe mu ithana komwiha maandjawo. Jesus okwa yi nokwa kuutumba poshililo.
Ihe omufarisayi okwa kumwa, sho a dhimbulula kutya Jesus ini iyoga kiikaha, manga inaa tameka okulya.
Opo Omuwa okwe mu lombwele a ti: “Ne aafarisayi, ndishi ohamu yogo oshitenga netemba kombanda, ihe ne yene meni omu udha eyugo nuuwinayi auhe.
Magoya ne! Kalunga ngoka a shiti kombanda, haye tuu a shiti nomeni wo?
Ano gandjeni koohepele shoka shi li moshitenga, nena ayihe otayi kala ya yogoka.”
“Yayee ne, aafarisayi! Oshoka ohamu gandja kuKalunga oshitimulongo shiigwanga yaa na oshilonga: ominti, iizimba noomboga, ihe ohamu dhini uuyuuki nohole yokuhola Kalunga.”
“Yayee ne, aafarisayi! Oshoka omu hole okukuutumba kiipundi yokomeho moosinagoga nokukundilwa pokuma hapu gongala aantu.
Yayee ne! Oshoka omwa fa oombila dha filala, naantu otaa ende kombanda yadho yo inaa tseya sha.”
Gumwe gwomaanongompango okwa ti kuJesus: “Muhongi, sho wa popi ngawo, owe tu shekitha.”
Jesus okwa ti: “Yayee ne, aanongompango! Oshoka ohamu tsike omitenge omidhigu komapepe gaantu, ihe ne yene ihamu gumu ko nando onomunwe gumwe.
Yayee ne! Oshoka ohamu tungu oombila dhaahunganeki mboka ya dhipagwa koohokulu yonale.
Ano osho ngeyi otamu iholola kutya omwa tseya notamu zimine shoka oohokulu ya ningi; oyo oya dhipaga aahunganeki, ihe ne otamu ya tungile oompampa.
Onkee ano uunongo waKalunga otau ti: ‘Otandi ya tumine aahunganeki naatumwa. Yamwe yomuyo otaye ya dhipaga nayamwe otaye ya tidhagana.’
Onkee ano aantu yopethimbo ndika otaa ka geelwa omolwedhipago lyaahunganeki ayehe mboka ye ya dhipaga okuza keshito lyuuyuni,
okuza kokudhipagwa kwaAbel sigo okokudhipagwa kwaSakaria, ngoka a dhipagelwa pokati koshiyambelo nEha eyapuki. Eeno, otandi mu lombwele, aantu yopethimbo ndika itaa kala inaa geelwa.”
“Yayee ne, aanongompango! One omwa kutha po oshipatululo shokweegulula omweelo gwegumbo lyuunongo. Ne yene sho itaamu yi mo, otamu keelele mboka ya hala okuya mo.”
Jesus sho a zi mo megumbo, aalongimpango naafarisayi oya tameke oku mu gongalela noku mu pa uusama miinima oyindji;
oya kambadhala oku mu langela, opo ye mu kwate moohapu.
12: Aantu omayuvi nomayuvi oya gongala e taa lyatathana. Tango Jesus okwa lombwele aalongwa ye a ti: “Kotokeleni efulika lyaafarisayi nokutya uufudhime wawo.
Kaku na shoka sha siikilwa itaashi ka hololwa, naashoka sha holama itaashi ka tseyika.
Kehe tuu shoka mwe shi popi momilema, otashi ka uvika puuyelele. Naashoka mwe shi nongonene aantu momakutsi meholamo, otashi ka uvithwa kiihoko yoongulu.”
“Ne ookuume kandje, otandi mu lombwele: Inamu tila mboka taa dhipaga olutu, ihe itaa vulu we okuninga sha shilwe.
Otandi mu ulukile ngoka mu na oku mu tila: tileni Kalunga ngoka, sho a dhipaga, e na oonkondo okuundulila moheli. Eeno, otandi mu lombwele, mu tileni!”
“Omanza gatano itaga landithwa po nani nando uupeni uyali auke? Ihe kaku na nando olimwe lya dhimbiwa kuKalunga.
Oshoka nomafufu geni gokomutse oga yalulwa. Ano inamu tila: one mu vule omanza ogendji.”
“Otandi mu lombwele: Kehe tuu ngoka ta hempulula montaneho kutya ogwandje, osho wo Omuna gwOmuntu ote mu hempulula montaneho yaayengeli yaKalunga.
Ngoka ti idhimbike ndje paantu, nOmuna gwOmuntu ote mu idhimbike wo montaneho yaayengeli yaKalunga.”
“Ngoka ta popi ohapu a tsa ondumbo nOmuna gwOmuntu, ote yi dhiminwa po. Ihe ngoka ta sheke Ombepo Ondjapuki, oye ita dhiminwa po.”
“Uuna aantu taye mu fala moosinagoga kiipala yomalenga noyaakwaniilwa, inamu kala mu na oshimpwiyu kutya otamu ki ipopila ngiini nenge otamu ka popya shike.
Oshoka Ombepo Ondjapuki ote mu longo pethimbo tuu ndyoka shoka mu na okupopya.”
Gumwe gwongundu okwa ti kuJesus: “Muhongi, lombwela omumwameme omukuluntu, tu topolelathane uuthiga weliko lyatate.”
Jesus okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Mulumentu, olye u utha ndje, ndi ninge omutokoli nomutopoli guuthiga weni?”
Opo Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Angaleni ne mu ikotokele kombinga yuuhalu weliko, oshoka okukalamwenyo kwomuntu kombanda yevi itaku lelepekwa kowindji weliko lye.”
Nena Jesus okwe ya lombwele eyele a ti: “Epya lyomuyamba gwontumba olya vala nawa.
Oye okwa tameke okudhiladhila ngeyi: ‘Kandi na mpoka tandi pungula iilya yandje. Otandi ningi ngiini?
Otandi ningi ngeyi,’ osho i ipopile. ‘Otandi hanagula po iigandhi yandje e tandi tungu yilwe iinene, moka tandi ka pungula mo iilya yandje neliko lyandje alihe.
Nena otandi ilombwele ihe: Munelago ngoye! Owa pungulilwa ashihe shoka we shi pumbwa methimbo lyoomvula odhindji. Onkee fudha ihe lya, nwa e to inyanyudha!’
Ihe Kalunga okwe mu lombwele: ‘Goya ngoye! Uusiku mbuka wonena omwenyo gwoye oto gu kuthwa; nena iinima ayihe mbika we yi ilikolele, otayi ningi yalye?’
“Shika osho tashi ningilwa ngoka ti igongelele omaliko, ye kee shi omuyamba koshipala shaKalunga.”
Nena Jesus okwa ti kaalongwa: “Shika otashi ti, onda hala oku mu lombwela: Inamu kala mu na oshimpwiyu kutya otamu li shike, opo mu kale mu na omwenyo nenge oshimpwiyu shomizalo.
Oshoka okukala u na omwenyo oku vule iikulya, nolutu olu vule omizalo.
Taleni omakola. Ihaga kunu noihaga teya; osho wo kage na oondunda dhokupungula nenge iigandhi, ihe Kalunga ohe ga palutha. Ihe ne omu vule oondhila.
Olye ando gwomune ta vulu okugwedha ko noshimpwiyu she kuule womasiku gokukalamwenyo kwe?
Ngele nani ne itamu vulu okuninga oshinima oshishona sha tya ngawo, omolwashike mwa sa oshimpwiyu shiinima yilwe?
Taleni nokundhindhilika oongala dhokelundu, nkene hadhi koko. Odho ihadhi longo, dho ihadhi iningile oonguwo. Ihe ngame otandi mu lombwele: NaSalomo meopalo lye alihe ina zala a fe yimwe yadho.
Ano Kalunga ngele ta zaleke omwiidhi gwokelundu ngoka gwa thikama owala nena, ihe ngula otagu umbilwa meziko, ano ne mboka yeitaalo enkundi ite shi mu ningile ando?”
“Inamu ipiyaganeka, mu kale tamu kongo kutya otamu li shike nenge otamu nu shike.
Oshoka aapagani yomuuyuni ohaa kongo mbika ayihe. Oshoka Ho oku shi shi kutya omwa pumbwa mbika ayihe.
Peha lyaambika kongeni tango Oshilongo shaKalunga, nena mbika ayihe otamu yi gwedhelwa ko.”
“Inamu tila, ne oshigunda oshishona! Oshoka Ho okwa hala oku mu pa Oshilongo.

Landithii po eliko lyeni alihe, iimaliwa e tamu yi pe oohepele. Ilandeleni uumpunda wiimaliwa ihaau kulupa neliko lyomegulu ndyoka ihaali hulu po, moka ihaamu yi aafuthi noothithi itadhi vulu oku li yona po.
Oshoka kokuma nkoka ku na eliko lyoye, oko ku na nomwenyo gwoye wo.”
“Kaleni mwi ilongekidha, mu na omapaya ga patwa noolamba dha tema,
ongaashi aantu ya tegelela omuwa gwawo ta zi koshituthi shohango. Uuna te ya e ta konkola, oyo otaye mu egulula mbala.
Aamati aanelago oyo mboka, omuwa gwawo sho ta galuka, te ya adha ya tonata. Ongame tandi mu lombwele: Oye ota pata epaya lye note ya kuutumbike e te ya yakula.
Oyo aanelago ngiini, ngele ote ya adha yi ilongekidha, nonando one ye pokati kuusiku nenge koongulasha!
One omu shi shi, mwene gwegumbo ngele oku na owino kutya omufuthi ote ya uunake, nena ite mu etha, a teye po egumbo lye.
Onkee ano nane wo kaleni mwi ilongekidha, oshoka Omuna gwOmuntu ote ke ya pethimbo tuu ndyoka inaamu mu tegelela.”
Petrus okwa ti: “Omuwa, eyele ndino otse to li lombwele nenge oto lombwele kehe gumwe?”
Omuwa okwa yamukula: “Olye ano omumati omwiinekelwa nomunandunge? Oye ngoka omuwa gwe e mu pe oshilonga shokutonatela egumbo lye, opo a pe aamati ooyakwawo iikulya pethimbo lyayo.
Omumati omunelago oye ngoka, omuwa gwe ngele te ya, te mu adha ta ningi ngaaka.
Oshili tandi mu lombwele: Omuwa gwe ote mu pe etonatelo lyiinima ye ayihe.
Ihe omumati ngoka ngele oti ilombwele ye mwene ta ti: ‘Omuwa gwandje ite ya mbala.’ Oye ta tameke ihe okudhenga aayakuli ooyakwawo, aalumentu naakiintu, ta li nota nu e ta kolwa.
Nena omuwa ote ya esiku ndyoka inee mu tegelela nethimbo ndyoka inee li tseya; omuwa note mu hendagula e te mu pe oshipewa she pamwe noonakwaavulika.”
“Omumati ngoka a tseya shoka omuwa gwe a hala, shi longwe, ihe ini ilongekidha ye ina gwanitha shoka omuwa gwe e shi hala, oye ota dhengwa unene.

Ihe omumati ngoka inaa tseya shoka omuwa gwe e shi hala, e ta ningi epuko, oye ota dhengwa kashona. Oshoka kehe ngoka a pewa oshindji, ota ka pulwa oshindji; naangoka a pewa oshindjishindji, ota ka pulwa natango oshindjishindji.”
“Ngame onde ya okutema omulilo kombanda yevi nonda hala nokuhalelela gwa hwama.
Onda tega, ndi shashwe eshasho ndyoka, ihe otandi kala ndi li muudhigu sigo sha gwanithwa.
Omu shi, onde ya okweeta ombili kombanda yevi? Otandi mu lombwele: inandi ya okweeta ombili, ihe etopoko.
Okuza mpaka aantu yatano yomegumbo limwe otaa ka topoka ngeyi; yatatu ya tsilathana ondumbo nayaali, osho wo yaali otaa tsilathana ondumbo nayatatu.

Aanona aamati otaa ka tsa ondumbo noohe, noohe noyana aamati. Aanona aakadhona otaa ka tsa ondumbo nooyina, nooyina onoyana aakadhona. Oshitenya shomukiintu otashi ka tsa ondumbo nayinamweno, nosho wo yinamweno ota ka tsa ondumbo noshitenya she.”
Jesus okwa lombwele ishewe aantu ta ti: “Ngele tamu mono omugamba gwa mena kuuninginino, ohamu ti: ‘Otaku ka lokwa,’ nosho tashi ningwa.
Ihe ombepo ngele otayi pepe tayi zi kuuninginino, otamu ti: ‘Otaku zi oluteni,’ nosho tashi ningwa.
Aafudhime ne! Omu shi okundhindhilika shoka shi li pevi nokegulu, ihe kamu shi okundhindhilika ethimbo ndika.”
“Omolwashike ihaamu tokola ne yene shoka shi li mondjila?

Ngele ope na ngoka te ku tamaneke e ku fale kompangu, kambadhala, mu opaleke oshinima naye, manga inaamu thika, opo kee ku gandje nethiminiko komupanguli, omupanguli e te ku gandja komumbala, omumbala e te ku edhilile mondholongo.
Otandi ku lombwele: Ku na mpoka to zi mo, manga inoo mana okufuta nokapeni kahugunina.”
13: Pethimbo tuu ndyoka opwa li pu na aantu mboka ya hokololele Jesus kombinga yAagalilea mboka, Pilatus e ya dhipaga, manga ya li taa yambele Kalunga omayambo.
Jesus okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Ne otamu dhiladhila ndishi kutya okudhipagwa kwAagalilea mbeya otaku holola kutya oya li aalunde unene ye vule Aagalilea ayehe yalwe?
Aawe, hasho! Otandi mu lombwele, ngele itamu itedhulula, otamu ka kana ngaashi yo.
Nenge omu shi, aantu mbeya omulongo nayahetatu sho ya li ya gwilwa koshungongulu yomuSiloa e taa si, oya li aalunde unene ando ye vule aantu yalwe mboka ye li muJerusalem?
Aawe, hasho! Otandi mu lombwele, ngele itamu itedhulula, otamu ka kana ngaashi yo.”
Nena Jesus okwe ya lombwele eyele ndika: “Okwa li ku na omusamane gumwe a tsike omukwiyu meyana lye lyomiviinu. Oye okwa yi, a ka konge iiyimati mugwo, ihe ina mona mo sha.

Oye okwa ti komulongi gweyana: ‘Tala, methimbo lyoomvula ndatu onda kala handi ya mpaka okukonga oonkwiyu komukwiyu nguka, ihe inandi mona mo sha. Gu ka po! Omolwashike gu na okumana owala evi oonkondo?’
Ihe omulongi okwa yamukula: ‘Tatekulu, gu etha natango omvula yimwe, manga tandi fulu omukanka, gu gu kundukidhe, e tandi gu tutile ishewe uuhoho.
Nena ngele otagu imi iiyimati momumvo tagu ya, onawa unene; ihe ngele itagu imi, nena nagu kewe po.’ ”
Esiku lyEsabati Jesus okwa li ta longo aantu mosinagoga.
Omo omwa li mu na omukiintu e niwe kombepo ya nyata, oyo noye mu etele uuvu oomvula omulongo nahetatu. Oye okwa li a andalala ye ina vula okuukilila.
Jesus sho e mu mono, okwe mu ithana a ti: “Nekulu, wa aluka kuuvu woye!”
Jesus okwa tula iikaha ye kombanda yomukiintu, nguka nokwi iyukililitha nziya e ta hambelele Kalunga.

Ihe omukuluntu gwosinagoga okwa tameke okugeela Jesus, sho a aludha mEsabati. Oye okwa yi mo moohapu nokwa lombwele aantu a ti: “Otu na omasiku gahamano ngoka tu na okulonga; ileni momasiku ngoka, mu aludhwe, ihe hamEsabati.”
Omuwa okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Aafudhime ne! Ihamu piitha mo ongombe nenge okasino moshigunda mEsabati e tamu ke yi hugila?
Ihe mpaka opu na omuna gwaAbraham, ngoka Satana a kala e mu tula moomango oomvula omulongo nahetatu. Ita mangululwa ando moomango ndhika mEsabati?”
Ano Jesus sho a popi ngeyi, aatondi ye ayehe oya si ohoni, ihe aantu yalwe ayehe oya nyanyukilwa iilonga iikumithi mbyoka e yi longo.
Jesus okwa ti: “Oshilongo shaKalunga osha fa shike? Otandi shi yeleke nashike?
Osha fa omuma yosinapi, omulumentu e yi kutha nokwe yi kunu mepya lye. Oyo oya koko e tayi ningi omuti, noondhila odha tungile iihandhila yadho miitayi yagwo.”
Jesus okwa ti ishewe: “Oshilongo shaKalunga otandi shi yeleke nashike?
Osha fa efulika, omukiintu e li kutha nokwe li pilulile muusila woontungwa ndatu, sigo auhe wa fulu.”
Jesus okwe ende miilando nomomikunda nokwa longo aantu, sho a li mondjila ye yokuuka kuJerusalem.

Omuntu gumwe okwe mu pula a ti: “Omuwa, aantu mboka taa ka hupithwa aashona yowala?”
Jesus okwe ya yamukula a ti:
“Kondjeni, mu ye mo mosheelo shoka sha patekidha. Oshoka otandi mu lombwele: Aantu oyendji otaa kambadhala okuya mo, ihe itaa ka vula.
“Mwene gwegumbo ngele a penduka e te edhile omweelo, nena otamu thikama pondje e tamu konkola komweelo e tamu ti: ‘Omuwa, tu egulula!’ Oye note mu yamukula: ‘Kandi shi wo mpoka tamu zi!’
One otamu yamukula: ‘Otse otwa lileni notwa nwineni pamwe poshililo; osho wo owa longo aantu moshilando shetu.’
Oye ote ke mu lombwela ta ti: ‘Kandi shi wo mpoka tamu zi. Zii po pungame, one aakolokoshi!’
Otaku ka kala elilagano neikokoto lyomayego, sho tamu ka mona Abraham, Isak naJakob naahunganeki ye li mOshilongo shaKalunga, manga ne mwe edhililwa pondje.
Aantu otaa ka za kuuzilo nokuuninginino, kuumbangalantu nokuumbugantu e taa ka kuutumba poshililo mOshilongo shaKalunga.
Nena mboka aahugunini otaa ka ninga aatango, naamboka aatango otaa ka ninga aahugunini.”
Pethimbo olyo tuu ndyoka aafarisayi yamwe oye ya kuJesus noya ti kuye: “Za po mpaka, u ye kulwe, oshoka Herodes okwa hala oku ku dhipaga.”
Jesus okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Indeni, mu ka lombwele ombandje ndjoka: ‘Ngame nena otandi tidha mo oompwidhuli notandi aludha aavu, ihe ngula nahela otandi ka hulitha iilonga yandje.’
Nonando ongawo, ondi na okutsikila ondjila yandje nena, ngula nahela, oshoka omuhunganeki ita dhipagelwa palwe, ihe omuJerusalem.”

“Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Ongoye ho dhipaga aahunganeki noho dhipaga nomamanya aatumwa yaKalunga. Olungapi nda li nda hala okugongela aamwoye, ngaashi ondjuhwa hayi gongele uuyuhwena wayo meni lyomawawa gayo, ihe inamu hala.
Ngashingeyi egumbo lyeni otali thigwa ombuga yowala. Ongame tandi mu lombwele: One itamu mono ndje we sigo ethimbo ndyoka, uuna tamu ka tya: ‘Na lalekwe nuuyamba oonguka te ya medhina lyOmuwa!’ ”
14: Esiku limwe lyEsabati Jesus okwa yi megumbo lyagumwe gwomaafarisayi mboka aakuluntu, a ka lye; aantu oya li ya langela Jesus.
Omulumentu a li a zinda olutu aluhe, okwe ya kuJesus.
Nena Jesus okwa yi mo moohapu nokwa pula aanongompango naafarisayi a ti: “Ompango yetu otayi pitika tuu, omuntu a aludhe mEsabati nenge aawe?”
Ihe inaa yamukula sha. Jesus okwa kutha omulumentu ngoka nokwe mu aludha e te mu lombwele, a ye.
