Nena okwe ya lombwele a ti: “Ngele gumwe gwomune oku na omwana omumati nenge ongombe e tayi gwile momuthima mEsabati, ite yi hili mo andola nonando Esabati?”
Ihe kaya li taa vulu oku mu yamukula moshinima shika.
Jesus okwa dhimbulula, aayenda yamwe yi ihogololele iipundi ya simana, onkee ayehe okwe ya lombwele eyele ndika a ti:
“Ngele ku na ngoka e ku hiya koshituthi shohango, ino kuutumba kiipundi ya simana, oshoka otashi vulika, ku na gumwe a simana e ku vule, a hiywa wo.
Nena omwiithani gweni amuhe yaali ote ya e te ku lombwele ta ti: ‘Pa mukweni nguka eha lyoye.’ Nena oto kala wa sa ohoni, sho u na okukuutumba mehala lyokonima.

Ihe ngele wa hiywa, inda u ka kuutumbe mehala lyokonima, opo ngoka e ku hiya ngele te ya, ote ku lombwele ihe: ‘Kuume kandje, ila huka kehala ewanawa.’ Shika otashi ku simanekitha montaneho yaayenda yalwe ayehe.
Oshoka ngoka ti inenepeke, ota shonopekwa, naangoka ti ishonopeke, ota nenepekwa.”

Nena Jesus okwa ti kungoka e mu hiya: “Ngele to paka po omwiha nenge uulalelo, ino hiya ookuume koye nenge aamwanyoko aalumentu nenge aanezimo yoye nenge aashiinda yoye aayamba, oshoka mboka otaye ke ku hiya komeho e to futilwa mushoka we shi ningi.
Hiya oohepele, iitiningili, iilema naaposi.
Nena oto kala wa yambekwa, oshoka mbaka kaye na sha shoku ku pa. Ihe oto ka futwa kuKalunga, uuna mboka ya longa uuwanawa taa ka yumudhwa kuusi.”
Gumwe gwaayenda mboka ya li ya kuutumba poshililo, sho e shi uvu, okwa ti kuJesus: “Aanelago oomboka taa ka lya koshililo mOshilongo shaKalunga.”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Omusamane gumwe okwa longekidha oshituthi oshinene nokwa hiya aantu oyendji.
Ano ethimbo lyoshituthi sho lya thiki, okwa tumu omumati gwe, e ki ithane aahiywa ta ti: ‘Ileni, ayihe oya longekidhwa.’
Ihe ayehe oya tameke okutinda komukalo gumwe. Gwotango okwa ti komutumwa: ‘Ngame onda landa epya, ondi na okuya ko, ndi ke li tale.’
Mukwawo okwa ti: ‘Ngame onda landa oonani omulongo, otandi yi, ndi ke dhi tale, nkene tadhi longo. Otandi ku indile, u mangulule ndje.’
Gumwe ishewe okwa ti: ‘Ngame opo nda hokana, itandi vulu okuya.’
“Omumati okwa galuka nokwa hokololele omuwa gwe ashihe. Nena omusamane mwene gwegumbo okwa geye nokwa ti komumati gwe: ‘Endelela, u ye koondjila nokomapandaanda goshilando.’
Omumati okwa ti: ‘Omuwa, onda longo, ngaashi wa lombwele ndje, ihe natango omu na eha.’
Nena omuwa okwa ti komumati: ‘Inda natango koondjila nomapola, u ya lombwele, ye ye mo, opo egumbo lyandje lyu udhe.
Oshoka otandi mu lombwele: Kaku na nando ogumwe gwaalumentu mbeyaka yi ithanenwe tango, ta makele iikulya yandje.’ ”
Oongundu oonene dhaantu odhe ende pamwe naJesus. Oye okwa taalele kuyo e ta ti:
“Kehe ngoka te ya kungame, ita vulu okuninga omulongwa gwandje, ngele ita dhimbwa he nayina, omukiintu gwe noyana, aamwayina aalumentu naakiintu, naye mwene nokuli.
Kehe ngoka itaa humbata omushigakano gwe e ta landula ndje, ita vulu okuninga omulongwa gwandje.
“Ngele ku na gumwe e na edhiladhilo okutunga oshungo, oku na okukuutumba tango, a yalule kutya otayi pula shi thike peni, ye a tale, ngele oku na iimaliwa ya gwana oku yi tunga sigo ya pu.
Opo shaa ninge, sho a mana okutunga ekankameno, ta ka nyengwa okuhulitha etungo alihe. Nena ayehe mboka taye shi mono, otaye ke mu sheka
taa ti: ‘Omulumentu nguka okwa tameke okutunga, ihe okwa nyengwa okuhulitha etungo.’ ”

“Omukwaniilwa gwontumba ngele ta yi, a ka kondjithe omukwaniilwa mukwawo gulwe, ita kuutumba manga, a dhiladhile, ngele ota vulu naalumentu omayuvi omulongo gumwe aguke okutsakaneka ngoka te ya nomayuvi omilongo mbali?
Ngele a nyengwa, ota tumu ko aatumwa, manga ngwiyaka e li kokule, e mu indile ombili.
Osho tuu kaku na nando ogumwe gwomune ta vulu okukala omulongwa gwandje, ngele ite etha ayihe e yi na.”
“Omongwa ogwo oshinima oshiwanawa, ihe uuna tagu hahuka, otagu toyalekwa we nashike?
Itagu opalele we mepya nenge muuhoho, otagu ekelwahi owala. Ngoka e na omakutsi, nu uve ko!”
15: Aafendelithi ayehe naalunde oye ya okupulakena Jesus.
Ihe aafarisayi naalongimpango oya ngungutula ya ti: “Nguno ota taamba aalunde e ta li pamwe nayo.”
Onkee Jesus okwe ya lombwele eyele ndika a ti:

“Natu tye, gumwe gwomune oku na oonzi ethele limwe, ihe yimwe yomudho te yi kanitha. Ota ningi ngiini? Oye ota thigi po oonzi omilongo omugoyi nomugoyi melundu e ta ka konga ndjiyaka ya kana, sigo te yi mono.
Ngele e yi mono, ota nyanyukwa noonkondo, ote yi humbata komapepe ge
e te yi eta kegumbo. Oti ithana ihe ookuume ke naashiinda she e ta ti: ‘Nyanyukweni pamwe nangame, oshoka onzi yandje ndjoka ya li ya kana, nde yi mono!’

Otandi mu lombwele: osho wo megulu otamu kala enyanyu omolwomulunde gumwe i itedhulula, li vule ndyoka lyokunyanyukilwa aayuuki omilongo omugoyi nomugoyi mboka taa dhiladhila kutya inaa pumbwa eitedhululo.”
“Natu tye, omukiintu oku na iimaliwa iisiliveli omulongo e ta kanitha po shimwe. Ita hwameke ando olamba e ta kombo egumbo noku shi konga nuupenda, sigo te shi mono?
Ngele e shi mono, oti ithana ihe ookuume ke naashiinda she ta ti: ‘Nyanyukweni pamwe nangame, oshoka oshimaliwa shandje shoka sha li sha kana, nde shi mono!’
Otandi mu lombwele: osho wo aayengeli yaKalunga otaa nyanyukilwa omulunde gumwe ngoka i itedhulula.”
Jesus okwa ti ishewe: “Okwa li ku na omusamane e na aamati yaali.
Ngoka omushona kumukwawo okwa ti kuhe: ‘Tate, pe ndje ombinga yomeliko ndjoka ndi na oku yi pewa.’ Nena he okwa topolele oyana yaali eliko ndyoka.
“Inapa pita omasiku ogendji, omwana nguka omushona okwa gongele iinima ye ayihe e ta yi koshilongo shokokule. Oye okwa hanagula po eliko lye nkoka nokukala muuholume.
Ihe sho a mana po ashiheshihe, oshilongo shiyaka osha adhika ihe kondjala ondhigu, oye nokwa tameke okuhepa.
Oye okwa yi, a ka longe pomuntu gumwe gwomoshilongo shoka, nguka okwe mu tumu kohambo ye yiingulu.
Okwa li e shi, ota vulu okwiipalutha nomakunde ngoka haga liwa kiingulu, ihe ine ga pewa.
Lwahugunina sho a dhimbulula okukala kwe, okwa ti: ‘Aaniilonga ayehe ya tate oye na iikulya ya gwana, manga ngame te si ondjala!
Otandi thikama, ndi ye kutate, e tandi mu lombwele te ti: Tate, onda yono kuKalunga nokungoye.
Inandi gwana we, ndi ithanwe omumwoye, taamba ndje ongagumwe gwomaalumentu mboka taye ku longele.’

Oye okwa thikama nokwe ya kuhe.
“Ano manga a li kokule, he okwe mu mono nokwe mu uvitile olukeno e ta matuka, e ke mu tsakaneke, okwe mu papatele e te mu thipi komilungu.
Omwana okwe mu lombwele a ti: ‘Tate onda yono kuKalunga nokungoye. Inandi gwana we, ndi ithanwe omumwoye.’
Nena he okwa lombwele ihe aapiya ye: ‘Endeleleni, mu ete onguwo ndjiyaka ombwanawa, mu yi mu zaleke. Mu zalekeni okalinga komunwe gwe noongaku koompadhi dhe.
Indeni, mu ka tale wo ontana ndjiyaka yo ondoka, yi dhipageni, tu lyeni tse tu nyanyukweni.
Oshoka omumwandje nguka a li a sa, ngashingeyi oku na omwenyo; okwa li a kana, ihe ngashingeyi okwa monika.’ Oyo oya tameke ihe okudhana oshituthi ya nyanyukwa.
“Ihe omwana omukuluntu okwa adhika e li kepya. Sho e ya, a thiki popepi negumbo, oku uvu ehiko lyuuhumba nomatanto.
Oye okwi ithana gumwe gwomaapiya e te mu pula: ‘Oshike shi li megumbo?’
Oye okwe mu yamukula a ti: ‘Omumwanyoko okwe ya, ho e te mu dhipagele ontana ndjiyaka yo ondoka, sho e mu mono e na omwenyo.’
“Omwana omukuluntu okwa geye ihe nokwa tindi okuya megumbo. Nena he okwe ya pondje nokwe mu popitha nombili, a ye meni.

Oye okwa ti kuhe: ‘Tala tate, oomvula odhindji onde ku longele ongomupika noinandi yona oshipango shoye nando oshimwe. Owa pe ndje shike? Ino pa ndje nando oshikombo sho sheneshene, opo ndi nyanyukwe pamwe nookuume kandje.
Ihe omumwoye ngono a hanagula po eliko lyoye moohonda, sho e ya, owe mu dhipagele ontana ndjiyaka yo ondoka!’
He okwa ti kuye: ‘Mumwandje, ngoye ou li aluhe pungame, ayihe yandje oyoye.
Ihe osho opala, tu ningeni oshituthi e tatu nyanyukwa, oshoka omumwanyoko ngoka a li a sa, ngashingeyi oku na omwenyo; okwa li a kana, ihe ngashingeyi okwa monika.’ ”
16: Jesus okwa lombwele aalongwa ye a ti: “Okwa li ku na omulumentu omuyamba e na elenga lye, e li lombwelwa, tali hanagula po eliko lye.
Oye okwe mu ithana nokwa ti kulyo: ‘Ondu uva shike kombinga yoye? Ulukila ndje, nkene wa kala to tonatele eliko lyandje.’
Elenga olya tameke okwiipula: ‘Otandi ningi ngiini, omuwa gwandje sho ta kutha ndje uulenga? Iilonga iidhigu itandi yi vulu, ngame ishewe otandi si ohoni okuhehela.
Ngashingeyi ondi shi shi shoka ndi na okuninga, opo uuna te kuthwa iilonga yandje, ndi kale ndi na ookuume mboka taa ka taamba ndje momagumbo gawo.’
“Nena okwi ithana aantu ayehe mboka ya li ye na oongunga dhomuwa gwe. Oye okwa ti kungoka gwotango: ‘Oongunga ndhoka wa lila omuwa gwandje, odhi thike peni?’
Oye okwa yamukula: ‘Omagadhi iiyuma ethele limwe.’ Elenga okwe mu lombwele a ti ‘Taamba eyalulo, kuutumba mbala, u nyole mo omilongo ntano.’
Oye okwa ti ishewe komutiyali: ‘Ngoye oongunga dhoye odhi thike peni?’ ‘Ooshako ethele limwe dhiilya,’ osho a yamukula. Elenga okwe mu lombwele a ti: ‘Taamba eyalulo, u nyole mo omilongo hetatu.’ ”
“Mwene gwelenga ndika efundja okwe li pandula, sho lya longo ngeyi noondunge. Oshoka aantu mboka haa ende pauyuni mbuka, oye na oondunge mokukalathana nooyakwawo ye vule aana yaKalunga.”
Jesus okwa ti ihe: “Onkee ano otandi mu lombwele: ikongeleni ookuume neliko lyomuuyuni mbuka, opo uuna tali hulu po, mu ka taambwe megumbo lyaaluhe.
Ngoka ti inekelwa miinima iishona, oti inekelwa wo miinima iinene; naangoka omufundja miinima iishona, oye wo omufundja miinima iinene.
Ne ano ngele kamu shi okwiinekelwa mokulongitha eliko lyomuuyuni mbuka, otamu vulu ngiini okwiinekelelwa eliko lyashili?
Nongele ne kamu shi aainekelwa miinima mbyoka yaa shi yeni, olye te mu pe mbyoka yeni yene?
“Kaku na omupika ta vulu okulongela aawa yaali; oshoka ota tondo gumwe, ye e ta kala e hole mukwawo, nenge ta simaneke nguka, ye e ta dhini ngwiyaka. Kamu vulu okulongela Kalunga pamwe nemona.”
Aafarisayi sho yu uvu iinima mbika, oya yolo Jesus, oshoka oya li ye hole iimaliwa.

Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “One ohamu iholola montaneho yaantu kutya one aayuuki, ihe Kalunga oku shi omitima dheni nkene dha tya. Oshoka shoka aantu taye shi tala shi na esimano, osho iihuna koshipala shaKalunga.”
“Ompango yaMoses nomanyolo gaahunganeki oya hulile muJohannes Omushashi. Okuza mpoka elaka etoye tali popi Oshilongo shaKalunga, otali uvithwa, nakehe gumwe ota matuka, a ye mo.
Ihe okuhulapo kwegulu nevi okuhwepo ku vule okukana po kwokankwanu kamwe komompango.”
“Omulumentu kehe ngoka ta henge po omukiintu gwe e ta hokana gulwe, oye ota hondele. Naangoka ta hokana omuhengwa, naye ota hondele.”
“Okwa li ku na omulumentu omuyamba ha zala oonguwo dhondilo noha li uutoye esiku kehe.
Ihe posheelo shegumbo lye opwa li pwa lala ohepele gumwe, edhina lye Lasarus, u udha omathina,
nokwa hala okwiikutitha nuundjagumuke mboka tau gu koshitaafula shomuyamba. Olwindji oombwa odhe ya nodha latha omathina ge.
“Ano ohepele nguka okwa si nokwa papatelwa kaayengeli noye mu fala megulu puAbraham. Omuyamba okwa si wo nokwa fumvikwa.
Moshaasi okwa kala muuwehame. Sho a yelutha omeho, okwa mono kokule naye Abraham ye li naLasarus.
Oye nokwi igidha a ti: ‘Tate Abraham! Sila ndje ohenda, u tume Lasarus, a yaye omunwe gwe momeya, a talaleke elaka lyandje, oshoka ondi li muuwehame uunene momulilo!’

“Ihe Abraham okwa ti kuye: ‘Mumwandje, dhimbulukwa kutya, manga wa li kombanda yevi, owa pelwe iinima ayihe iiwanawa, ihe Lasarus okwa pelwe iinima ayihe mbyoka iiwinayi. Ngashingeyi Lasarus oku li mehala ndika ewanawa, manga ngoye to ehamekwa.
Ihe nando ongaaka, pokati ketu nangoye opu na olumbogo olunene, opo mboka ya hala okutaagulukila hoka kune, kaaye shi vule, nenge ya hala okutaagulukila huka kutse.’
Omuyamba okwa ti: ‘Ano otandi ku indile tatekulu, u tume Lasarus kegumbo lyatate.
Ondi na ko aamwameme aalumentu yatano, opo e ke ya londodhe, kaaye ye mehala ndika lyuuwehame.’
“Abraham okwa ti: ‘Aamwanyoko oye na oohapu dhaKalunga, naa vulike kudho.’
Omuyamba okwa yamukula: ‘Aawe, tate Abraham! Andola okwa li taku yumuka gumwe gwomaasi e ta yi kuyo, ando otaa etha uulunde.’
Abraham okwa ti: ‘Ngele itaa vulika koohapu dhaKalunga, natango itaa itaale, nando naku yumuke gumwe gwomaasi.’ ”
17: Jesus okwa ti kaalongwa ye: “Omahongololo oge na okuya, ihe yayee omuntu ngoka, te ga eta!
Ngoka ta hongolola kamwe komuushona mbuka, okwa gwana, a mangelwe emanya edhigudhigu mothingo ye e tu umbilwa muule wefuta.

Onkee ano ikotokeleni!”
“Mukweni ngele a yono, mu pukulula, nongele i itedhulula, mu dhimina po.
Ngele ta yono kungoye luheyali mesiku, note ya kungoye meyono kehe ta ti: ‘Onda sa oluhodhi,’ mu pa ombili.”
Aayapostoli oya lombwele Omuwa ya ti: “Tu gwedhela eitaalo.”
Omuwa okwa yamukula: “Andola omu na eitaalo li thike pomuma yosinapi, ndjoka onshonanshona, otamu vulu okulombwela omuti nguka omunene: ‘Itumba po mpaka, u iyundulile mefuta!’ Notagu vulika kune.”
“Tu tye, oku na omuntu mokati keni e na omumati gwe ta longo mepya nenge ta litha iimuna. Nge a zi kepya, mwene gwe ote mu lombwele tuu ta ti: ‘Endelela nziya, u lye’?
Aawe ndishi, ihe ote mu lombwele: ‘Pakela ndje po uulalelo e to izaleke, u yakule ndje, manga tandi li e tandi nu. Opo ihe oto vulu okulya e to nu.’
Omumati ngono a longo owala shoka a lombwelwa, ndishi ita pandulwa?
Ano osho nane wo ngele omwa gwanitha owala ayihe mbyoka mwe yi lombwelwa, omu na okutya: ‘Otse aamati aahethi, sho twa longo owala shoka twa li tu na oku shi longa.’ ”
Jesus sho a li mondjila ta yi kuJerusalem, okwe ende ta kunkula nongamba yopokati kaSamaria naGalilea.
Sho e ya momukunda gumwe, okwa tsakanekwa kaalumentu aanashilundu omulongo. Oyo oya thikama kokule naye
noyi igidha ya ti: “Muhongi Jesus, tu sila ohenda!”

Jesus okwe ya tala nokwa ti kuyo: “Indeni, mu ki iyulike komuyambi.”
Ano manga ya li mondjila taa yi, oya aluka.
Ihe gumwe gwawo sho a mono a aluka, okwa galukile kuJesus, ye ta hambelele Kalunga newi lyopombanda.
Oye okwi ihata poompadhi dhaJesus e te mu pandula. Omulumentu nguka okwa li Omusamaria.
Opo Jesus okwa ti: “Aalumentu mboka ya aludhwa kaya li omulongo? Omugoyi oye li peni?
Omolwashike omukwiilongo nguno oye awike a galuka, a hambelele Kalunga?”
Jesus okwe mu lombwele: “Thikama, u ye; eitaalo lyoye lye ku aludha.”
Aafarisayi yamwe oya pula Jesus kutya Oshilongo shaKalunga otashi ya uunake. Oye okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Oshilongo shaKalunga itashi ya shi na omandhindhiliko taga monika nomeho.
Kaku na ngoka ta ka tya: ‘Tala, osho shika nenge osho shiyaka.’ Oshoka Oshilongo shaKalunga oshi li meni mune.”
Nena Jesus okwa lombwele aalongwa a ti: “Otaku ke ya ethimbo, uuna tamu ka hala okumona nando esiku limwe lyOmuna gwOmuntu, ihe itamu ke li mona.
Otaku ka kala mboka taye mu lombwele taa ti: ‘Tala, hwiyaka,’ nenge: ‘Tala, huka.’ Ano inamu ya ko ne inamu ya landula.
Oshoka ngashika olwaadhi talu adhima okuza kombinga yimwe sigo okonkwawo, osho wo Omuna gwOmuntu ta ka kala mesiku lye.
Ihe tango oku na okuhepekwa nomahepeko ogendji nokweekelwahi kaantu yopethimbo ndika.
Oshoka ngaashi sha li pomasiku gaNoa, osho tuu wo tashi ka kala pomasiku gOmuna gwOmuntu:
Aantu oya li ye hole okulya nokunwa, okuhokana nokuhokanitha, sigo esiku ndyoka Noa a yi monguluwato, eyelu nolye ya e tali ya hanagula po ayehe.
Otaku ka kala, ngaashi sha li pethimbo lyaLot. Aantu oya li ye hole okulya nokunwa, okulanda nokulanditha, okukuna nokutunga.
Esiku ndyoka Lot sho a zi mo muSodom, omulilo nomamanya gosulufuli oya gu kegulu, noya hanagulwa po ayehe.
Ano osho tashi ka kala wo nomesiku ndyoka lyOmuna gwOmuntu ta ka holoka.
“Mesiku ndyoka ngoka ta adhika kombanda yongulu a thiga iinima ye megumbo, ina kuluka ko, e ke yi tale; osho tuu wo ngoka ta adhika mepya, ina galukila megumbo.
Dhimbulukweni omukiintu gwaLot!
Oongoka ta kambadhala okuhupitha omwenyo gwe, ote gu kanitha, naangoka te gu kanitha, ote gu hupitha.
Otandi mu lombwele: Uusiku mbwiyaka otaku ka kala aantu yaali ya lala montala yimwe; gumwe ta kuthwa po, mukwawo ta thigwa po.
Aakiintu yaali taa tsu poshini; gumwe ta kuthwa po, mukwawo ta thigwa po.
Aalumentu yaali ye li mepya; gumwe ta kuthwa po, mukwawo ta thigwa po.”

Aalongwa oye mu pula ya ti: “Openi, Omuwa?”
Jesus okwa yamukula a ti: “Kokuma nkoka ku na omudhimba, oko haku gongala oontsa.”
18: Jesus okwe ya lombwele eyele ndika, opo e ya longe, nkene ye na okugalikana aluhe yo yaa vulwe, a ti:
“Moshilando shimwe omwa li mu na omutokoli ihaa tila Kalunga ye ke na ko nasha naantu ooyakwawo.
Moshilando osho tuu shoka omwa li wo omuselekadhi e ya olwindji kuye nokwa ti: ‘Uthila ndje pauyuuki kombinga yoohapu dhetu nomutamaneki gwandje.’
Omutokoli okwa li ta tindi ethimbo ele, ihe konima okwi ipopile a ti: ‘Nando ihandi tila Kalunga nokandi na ko nasha naantu ooyakwetu,
ihe molwaashoka omuselekadhi nguka ote etele ndje uupyakadhi, onda hala oku mu uthila, opo kaa kenyaneke ndje nokuya aluhe kungame.’ ”
Omuwa okwa ti ihe: “Pulakeneni omutokoli nguka ke na uuyuuki sho a ti.
Ano Kalunga itu uthile ando aahogololwa mboka haye mu ithana omutenya nuusiku? Ote ya tegelelitha tuu ethimbo ele inee ya kwatha?
Otandi mu lombwele, ote ya uthile mbalambala. Ihe Omuna gwOmuntu uuna te ke ya, ota ka adha ko tuu eitaalo kombanda yevi?”
Jesus okwa hokololele mboka yi idhiladhilile yo yene kutya oyo aayuuki e taa dhini aantu yalwe, ndika eyele:
“Aalumentu yaali oya yi motempeli, ya ka galikane, gumwe omufarisayi nomukwawo omufendelithi.”

“Omufarisayi okwa thikama i ikalela nokwa galikana puye mwene e ta ti: ‘Kalunga, otandi ku hambelele, oshoka ngame inandi fa aantu yalwe: aayugi, aakolokoshi naahondeli; otandi ku hambelele wo, sho inaandi fa omufendelithi ngono.
Iikulya ohandi idhilike omasiku gaali moshiwike kehe nohandi ku pe oshitimulongo shomwaayihe mbyoka nde yi likola.’
“Ihe omufendelithi okwa thikama kokule ye ina vula okutala kegulu, oshoka okwa sa oluhodhi e ta ti: ‘Kalunga, sila ndje ohenda, ongame omulunde!’ ”
Opo Jesus okwa ti: “Otandi mu lombwele: nguka okwa shuna kegumbo omuyuuki koshipala shaKalunga e vule mukwawo. Oshoka ngoka ti inenepeke, ota shonopekwa, naangoka ti ishonopeke, ota nenepekwa.”
Aantu yamwe oye eta uuhanona wawo kuJesus, a tenteke iikaha ye kuwo. Ihe aalongwa sho ye shi mono, oya ganda mboka ye u eta.
Ihe Jesus okwi ithana uunona, u ye kuye, a ti: “Etheni uunona, u ye kungame. Inamu u keelela ko, oshoka Oshilongo shaKalunga oshaamboka ye u fa.
Ongame tandi mu lombwele: Oongoka itaa taamba Oshilongo shaKalunga ongokanona, oye ita yi mo musho.”
Gumwe gwomaakuluntu Aajuda okwe mu pula a ti: “Muhongi omwaanawa, nandi longe shike, ndi mone omwenyo gwaaluhe?”
Jesus okwe mu pula: “Omolwashike to ti ndje omwaanawa? Kaku na nando omuntu omwaanawa, oKalunga awike.
Iipango ou yi shi: ‘Ino hondela, Ino yaka, Ino lundila, Simaneka ho nanyoko.’ ”
Nguka okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Ayihe mbika onde yi gwanitha okuza muugundjuka wandje.”

Jesus sho e shi uvu, okwa ti kuye: “Oku na oshinima shimwe natango u na oku shi ninga. Landitha po ayihe mbyoka u yi na, iimaliwa e to yi pe oohepele, ngoye e to kala u na eliko megulu. Ila ihe, u landule ndje.”
Ano omulumentu nguka sho u uvu oohapu ndhoka, okwa tameke okusa oluhodhi noonkondo, oshoka okwa li e na eliko olindji.
Jesus sho a dhimbulula kutya okwa sa oluhodhi, okwa ti: “Aayamba oye na uudhigu ngiini okuya mOshilongo shaKalunga!
Okupitila kwongamelo mombululu yonane okuhwepo ku vule okuya kwomuyamba mOshilongo shaKalunga.”
Aantu mboka ye dhi uvu, oya pula ya ti: “Olye ano ta vulu okuhupithwa?”
Jesus okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Shoka tashi nyenge aantu, itashi nyenge Kalunga.”
Nena Petrus okwa ti: “Tala, otse otwa thigi po omagumbo getu e tatu ku landula.”
Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Eeno, ihe ongame tandi mu lombwele, kehe ngoka ta thigi po egumbo nenge omukiintu nenge aamwayina aalumentu nenge aakuluntu ye nenge oyana omolwOshilongo shaKalunga,
ota ka mona ko oyindji muuyuni mbuka, nomwenyo gwaaluhe ote ke gu pewa muuyuni tau ya.”
Jesus okwi ikalekele aalongwa omulongo nayaali nokwa ti kuyo: “Tala, otatu yeni kuJerusalem, hoka taku ka tsakanithwa ayihe mbyoka ya nyolwa kaahunganeki tayi popi Omuna gwOmuntu.
Oye ota ka gandjwa miikaha yaapagani, mboka taye mu yolo, taye mu sheke e taye mu hiyile omayeye.
Oyo otaye ke mu dhenga e taye mu dhipaga, ihe esiku etitatu ota ka yumudhwa.
“Aalongwa oya li yaa uvite nando osha; oohapu ndhoka odha li dhe ya holekwa, yo inaa uva ko kutya Jesus okwa hala okutya shike.”
Jesus sho e ya popepi naJeriko, omuposi gumwe okwa kuutumba pooha dhondjila ta hehela.
Sho u uvu, ongundu yaantu tayi ende po, okwa pula a ti: “Oshike shino?”
Aantu oye mu lombwele ya ti: “OJesus Omunasareti te ende po.”
Oye okwi igidha ihe a ti: “Jesus, omuna gwaDavid, sila ndje ohenda!”
Aantu yokomeho oye mu ganda, a mwene. Ihe omuposi okwa dhiginine okwiigidha mokule a ti: “Omuna gwaDavid, sila ndje ohenda!”
Jesus okwa thikama nokwe ya lombwele, ye ete omuposi kuye. Sho e ya lwopopepi, Jesus okwe mu pula:

“Owa hala, ndi ku ningile shike?”
Oye okwa ti: “Omuwa, onda hala, ndi mone ko ishewe.”
Nena Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Tonata! Eitaalo lyoye lye ku aludha.”
Mbalambala okwa mono ko e ta landula Jesus ye ta pandula Kalunga. Aantu sho ye shi mono, ayehe oya hambelele Kalunga.
19: Jesus sho e ya muJeriko nokwa piti mo.
Okwa li ku na omukuluntu gwaafendelithi, omulumentu omuyamba, edhina lye Sakeus.
Oye okwa kambadhala, a mone ye a tseye Jesus, ihe shoka okwa li omuhupi komuthika, okwa nyengwa oku mu mona omolwowindji waantu.
Oye okwa matuka a tetekele komeho gongundu nokwa londo komukwiyu, a wape okumona Jesus, oshoka ondjila oya li ye enda pomukwiyu.
Ano Jesus sho e ya mpoka, okwa ligamene pombanda nokwa ti kuSakeus: “Sakeus, londoloka mbala, oshoka ondi na oku ka talela po nena maandjeni.”
Sakeus nokwa taamba Jesus nenyanyu.
Aantu ayehe mboka ye shi mono, oya ngungutula ya ti: “Nguno okwa yi, a ka talele po omulumentu omulunde.”

Nena Sakeus okwa thikama nokwa lombwele Omuwa a ti: “Omuwa, pulakena! Etata lyeliko lyandje otandi ke li pa oohepele, nongele ku na ngoka nde mu yugu nokulongitha iifundja, otandi ke mu shunithila iinima oyo tuu mbyoka lune.”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Nena tuu ndjika ehupitho lye ya megumbo ndika, oshoka naye wo omuna gwaAbraham.
Oshoka Omuna gwOmuntu okwe ya okukonga nokuhupitha shoka sha kana.”
Jesus okwa hokololele mboka ya li taye mu pulakene eyele ndika. Oye okwa li popepi naJerusalem naantu oya li ye shi, Oshilongo shaKalunga otashi holoka mbala.
Jesus okwa ti ihe: “Okwa li ku na omulumentu omuvalekele e ta yi koshilongo shokokule, a ka ningwe omukwaniilwa, ye a galuke.
Manga inaa ya, okwi ithana aamati ye omulongo nokwe ya pe kehe gumwe iimaliwa iisiliveli omulongo e ta ti kuyo: ‘Indeni, mu ke yi likolithe iikwawo, manga tandi galuka.’
Ihe aakwashilongo she oye mu tondo noye mu tumine aatumwa ya ti: ‘Omulumentu nguka inatu mu hala, a ninge omukwaniilwa gwetu.’
“Omulumentu okwa ningwa omukwaniilwa e ta galuka. Opo okwi ithana aamati ye, mboka e ya pele iimaliwa, ye ye kuye, opo a tseye kutya oya likola shi thike peni.
“Gwotango okwe ya nokwa ti: ‘Omuwa, iimaliwa yoye omulongo onde yi likolitha iikwawo omulongo.’
Oye okwa ti: ‘Yaloo, omumati ngoye omwaanawa! Ongoye sho wa li omwiinekelwa miinima iishona, otandi ke ku pa epangelo lyiilando omulongo.’
Omutiyali okwe ya nokwa ti: ‘Omuwa, iimaliwa yoye omulongo onde yi likolitha iikwawo itano.’
Nguka okwe mu lombwele a ti: ‘Ngoye oto ka pangela iilando itano.’
“Mukwawo okwe ya e ta ti: ‘Iimaliwa yoye oyo mbika; onda kala nde yi pungula moshikayiwa.
Ngame onda li nde ku tila, oshoka ongoye omulumentu omudhigu. Oho kutha shono shaa shi shoye, noho teya shoka inoo shi kuna.’
Oye okwa ti kuye: ‘Ongoye omumati omukolokoshi! Otandi ku pangula omolwoohapu dhoye. Ou shi ndje omudhigu handi kutha shoka shaa shi shandje, nohandi teya shoka inaandi shi kuna.
Omolwashike inoo tula iimaliwa yandje mombaanga? Opo ando ngame sho nda galuka, nda galulilwa shoka shandje kwa gwedhelwa ontanitho.’
“Nena omukwaniilwa okwa lombwele mboka ya li ya thikama mpoka: ‘Mu kutheni iimaliwa mbyoka, mu yi pe ngoka a likolitha iimaliwa omulongo.’
Oyo oya ti kuye: ‘Ngoka oku na nale iimaliwa iikwawo omulongo.’
Oye okwe ya yamukula a ti: ‘Ngoka e na, oye ta pewa oshindji. Ihe ngoka kee na, oye ta kuthwa naashoka e shi na.
Ngashingeyi aatondi yandje mbaka inaa hala, ndi ninge omukwaniilwa gwawo, ye eteni nkuka, mu ya dhipagele koshipala shandje.’ ”
Jesus sho a popi ngaaka, okwa kwata komeho u uka kuJerusalem.
Sho a thiki popepi naBetfage naBetania pOndundu yooholivi, okwa tetekelitha aalongwa ye yaali

e ta ti kuyo: “Indeni komukunda ngwiyaka gu li komeho geni. Ngele mwa thiki ko, otamu ka mona ontana yokasino ya pandekwa, ndjoka inaayi kayilwa nando onale komuntu. Yi pandukululeni mo, ne mu yi ete nkuka.
Ngele ku na ngoka te mu pula: ‘Otamu yi pandukululile shike?’ Mu lombweleni kutya Omuwa okwe yi pumbwa.”
Oyo oya yi noya adha ayihe yi li, ngaashi Jesus e yi ya lombwele.
Ano manga taa pandukulula mo ontana, ooyene oye ya pula ya ti: “Omolwashike tamu yi pandukulula mo?”
Oyo oya yamukula ya ti: “Omuwa okwe yi pumbwa.”
Oyo oye yi eta kuJesus noya yala oonguwo pombunda yayo e taa kayilike ko Jesus.
Manga te ende, aantu oya yala oonguwo dhawo mondjila.

Ano sho a thiki popepi naJerusalem, pehala mpoka ondjila tayi kuluka tayi zi kOndundu yooholivi, ongundu onene yaalongwa ye oya tameke okupandula nokuhambelela Kalunga mokulekule omolwiilongankondo ayihe mbyoka ye yi mono
ya ti: “Omukwaniilwa ngoka te ya medhina lyOmuwa, na lalekwe nuuyamba kuKalunga! Ombili omegulu nesimano olyaKalunga!”
Nena yamwe yomaafarisayi oya lombwele Jesus mokati kongundu ya ti: “Muhongi, lombwela aalongwa yoye, ya mwene.”
Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Otandi mu lombwele: ngele taa mwena, nena omamanya otagi igidha.”
Jesus sho a hedha popepi noshilando, okwe shi tala e te shi lili
a ti: “Ando ongoye wa dhimbulula nena kutya oshike we shi pumbwa omolwombili yoye. Ihe shika osha holekwa omeho goye.
Oshoka omasiku otage ke ya, uuna aatondi yoye taye ke ku kondeka e taye ku kundukidha koombinga adhihe.

Oyo otaye ku hanagula po thiluthilu naantu ayehe ye li mo; itaa ka thiga po mpaka emanya lya tentekwa kekwawo inaaye li kumuna po, oshoka ngoye ino dhimbulula ethimbo ndyoka Kalunga e ya, e ku hupithe.”
Jesus okwa yi motempeli nokwa tameke okutidha mo aahalithi
e ta ti kuyo: “Okwa nyolwa: ‘Ongulu yandje oyi na okwiithanwa ongulu yegalikano,’ ihe ne omwe yi ningi ombogo yaayugi.”
Esiku kehe Jesus okwa li ta longo aantu motempeli. Opo aayambi aakuluntu, aalongimpango naakuluntu yoshigwana oye mu kongo, ye mu dhipage,
ihe oya nyengwa oku shi ninga, oshoka aantu ayehe oya li ya hokwa oku mu pulakena.
20: Esiku limwe, Jesus sho a li ta longo aantu motempeli e te ya uvithile elaka etoye, aayambi aakuluntu naalongimpango pamwe naakuluntu yoshigwana oye ya
e taa ti kuye: “Tu lombwela, okoonkondo dhalye ho longo ngeyi? Olye e ku pa epitikilo lyokuninga iinima ya tya ngeyi?”
Jesus okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Nangame wo otandi mu pula epulo limwe. Yamukulii ndje.
Okushasha kwaJohannes okwa zi kuKalunga nenge omaantu?”
Oyo oya kundathana ya ti: “Ngele tatu ti: ‘Okwa zi kuKalunga,’ nena ota ka pula: omolwashike inaamu itaala Johannes?
Ihe ngele tatu ti: ‘Omaantu,’ nena aantu ayehe mbaka otaye ke tu dhipaga nomamanya, oshoka oye shi shi kutya Johannes oye omuhunganeki.”
Oyo oya yamukula ya ti: “Katu shi wo mpoka kwa za.”
Nena Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Ano nangame wo itandi mu lombwele, okoonkondo dhalye tandi longo ngeyi.”
Nena Jesus okwa lombwele aantu eyele ndika: “Omusamane gumwe okwa tsike omiti dhomiviinu meyana lye nokwa langeke mo aalongi yeyana e ta yi koshilongo shilwe, nkoka ta kala ko ethimbo ele.
Ethimbo lyokukola oomviinu sho lya thiki, okwa tumu omupika gwe kaalongi yeyana, ye mu pe iiyimati mbyoka e na oku yi pewa. Ihe aalongi oya dhenge omupiya noye mu shunitha e li iikaha yowala.
Oye a tumu ko ishewe omupika gulwe, naanguka wo oye mu dhenge noye mu sitha ohoni e taye mu shunitha e li iikaha yowala.
Oye okwa tumu ko omupika omutitatu. Naye wo aalongi oye mu dhenge e taye mu umbu mo meyana.
Nena mwene gweyana okwa ti: ‘Otandi ningi ngiini? Otandi tumu ko omumwandje omuholike; nguka otaye mu tila.’
Ihe aalongi yeyana sho ye mu mono, oya lombwelathana ya ti: ‘Nguno omuna gwamwene gweyana. Tu mu dhipageni, eliko li ninge lyetu!’

Oyo oye mu umbu mo meyana e taye mu dhipaga.”
“Mwene gweyana ota ka ninga ngiini aantu mbano?” Jesus okwa pula.

“Oye ote ya e te ya dhipaga po, neyana ote li pe yalwe.”
Aantu sho ye shi uvu, oya ti: “Itashi vulika!”

Jesus okwe ya tala e te ya pula ta ti: “Enyolo ndika otali ti ngiini?
‘Emanya ndyoka aatungi ye li ekelehi,
olyo lya ningi emanya li na oshilonga li vule agehe.’ ”
“Kehe tuu ngoka ta pundukile kemanya ndyoka, oye ota teka; naangoka ta gwilwa kemanya ndyoka, oye ota nyanyagulwa.”
Aalongimpango naayambi aakuluntu oya kambadhala okukwata Jesus pethimbo tuu ndyoka, oshoka oya dhimbulula kutya oyo taa popiwa meyele ndika, ihe oya tila aantu.
Oyo oya tegelele ompito yilwe noya futu meholamo aalumentu yamwe, ye shi okweenda miineya. Mbaka oye ya tumu kuJesus, ye mu kwate moohapu, opo ye mu gandje kepangelo nomeutho lyomuleli gwoshilongo.
Aalumentu yiineya oya ti kuJesus: “Muhongi, otu shi shi kutya oho popi noho longo aantu oshili. Ongoye iho tala olupe lwomuntu, nondjila yaKalunga oto yi longo pashili.
Tu lombwela: Osho opala tuu, tu pe omupangeli Omuroma oompale, nenge inashi opala?”
Jesus okwa dhimbulula omakoto gawo e ta ti kuyo:

“Ulukilii ndje oshimaliwa shoshene. Efano ndika nenyolo ndika li li ko, olyalye?”
Oyo oya yamukula: “Olyomupangeli Omuroma.”
Nena Jesus okwe ya lombwele a ti: “Ano shono shomupangeli, shi peni omupangeli, naashoka shaKalunga, shi peni Kalunga.”
Ano oyo oya nyengwa oku mu kwata nando omoshinima shimwe montaneho yaantu, onkee oya mwena owala ya kuminwa eyamukulo lye.
Aasadukayi yamwe oye ya kuJesus oomboka haa ti, kaku na eyumuko noye mu pula ya ti:
“Muhongi, Moses okwe tu nyolele ngeyi: ‘Ngele ku na omulumentu inaa mona oluvalo, ye ta si, nena omukiintu gwe na hokanwe komumwayina, opo nakusa a monenwe oluvalo.’
Okwa li ku na aalumentu aamwayinathana ye li yaheyali. Omutango okwa hokana nokwa si kee ne oluvalo.
Osho wo omutiyali okwa hokana po omuselekadhi ngoka,
osho omutitatu wo. Shika osha ningwa kwaayehe yaheyali, ihe oya si kaaye na oluvalo.
Ohugunina omukiintu okwa si wo.
Ano mesiku uuna aasi taa ka yumudhwa, ota ka ninga gwalye mwaambaka, oshoka ayehe yaheyali oya li ye mu hokana?”
Jesus okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Aantu yomuuyuni mbuka ohaa hokana nohaa hokanwa,
ihe mboka ya talwa ya gwana okuyumudhwa kuusi noyo opalela okuya muuyuni mbwiyaka tau ya, ihaa hokana noihaa hokanwa.
Oyo oya fa aayengeli yaKalunga noitaa si. Oyo aana yaKalunga, oshoka oya yumudhwa kuusi.
NaMoses wo okwe shi holola sha yela kutya aasi otaa ka yumudhwa. Mehokololo ndyoka tali popi oshihwa sha hwama ota ti kutya Omuwa oye Kalunga kaAbraham, Kalunga kaIsak naKalunga kaJakob.
Kalunga ke shi Kalunga kaasi, aawe, okaanamwenyo; oshoka mekwatathano naye ayehe otaa kala ye na omwenyo.”
Nena yamwe yomaalongimpango oya yi mo ya ti: “Owa yamukula nawa, Muhongi.”
Okuza mpoka inaa vula we okupula Jesus sha.
Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Aantu otaa vulu ngiini okutya, Kristus oye omuna gwaDavid?

Oshoka David ye mwene membo lyOmapisalomi ota ti:
‘Omuwa okwa lombwele Omuwa gwandje:
Kala omutumba kolulyo lwandje,
sigo tandi tula aatondi yoye kohi yoompadhi dhoye.’
“David ngele ote mu ithana Omuwa, ano Kristus oye omwana pamukalo guni?”
Aantu ayehe manga ya li taa pulakene, Jesus okwa ti kaalongwa ye:
“Angaleni aalongimpango mboka ye hole okweenda ya zala oonguwo oondeendeka nokukundilwa pokuma hapu gongala aantu. Oyo oye hole kiipundi yokomeho moosinagoga nopomahala ga simana miituthi.
Oyo ohaa li omagumbo gaaselekadhi nohaa galikana omagalikano omaleeleka gokumonika kwowala. Oyo otaa ka mona epangulo edhigu.”
21: Jesus okwa lengalenga nokwa mono, aayamba nkene taa tula omagano moshiketha shotempeli.
Nena okwa mono omuselekadhi gumwe ohepele a tula mo uupeni uyali.
Oye okwa ti: “Otandi mu lombwele kutya kape na omalimbililo, omuselekadhi nguka ohepele okwa tula mo oshindji e vule ayehe yalwe.
Oshoka ayehe mboka oya tula mo, ya kutha muuyamba wawo, ihe omuselekadhi moluhepo lwe okwa gandja ashihe shoka a li e shi na, iipalutha ye ayihe.”
Yamwe yomuyo sho ya popi kombinga yotempeli, nkene ya tungwa nomamanya go opala noya zalekwa nomagano ngoka ga pewa Kalunga, Jesus okwa ti:
“Omu yi wete ayihe mbino; omasiku otage ke ya, uuna itaapa ka thigwa nando emanya lya tentekwa kekwawo inaali kumunwa po.”
Oyo oye mu pula ya ti: “Muhongi, shika otashi ningwa uunake? Nendhindhiliko ndyoka tali ka holola kutya ethimbo lya thiki, mbika yi ningwe, olini?”
Jesus okwa ti: “Kotokeni, mwaa pukithwe. Oshoka otaku ka holoka aantu oyendji medhina lyandje taa iti kutya oyo ngame notaa ti kutya ethimbo olya thika. Ihe inamu ya landula.
Inamu tilithwa, ngele tamu uvu oonkundana dhiita nomapiyagano. Mbika oyi na okuningwa, ihe ehulilo inali thikana natango.”
Oye okwe ya lombwele natango a ti: “Iigwana otayi ka thikama okukondjithathana, niilongo otayi ka matukilathana.
Otaku ke ya omakakamo gevi omatilithi, oondjala nomalega koombinga noombinga. Kegulu otaku ka holoka iitilithi iinene nomandhindhiliko omakumithi.”

“Manga ayihe mbika inaayi ningwa, otamu ka kwatwa notamu ka tidhaganwa. Otamu ka falwa koompangu moosinagoga e tamu ke edhililwa mondholongo. Otamu ka falwa wo kiipala yaakwaniilwa noyomalenga omolwandje.
Otashi ka kala ompito yeni, mu ninge oonzapo dhokupopya oshili mokati kawo.
Ilongekidheni ano, mwaa kale mu na oshimpwiyu kutya otamu ki ipopila ngiini.
Oshoka ngame otandi ke mu pa iitya noondunge tadhi nyenge aatondi yeni ayehe oku mu kondjitha noku mu ludhikitha.
Otamu ka gandjwa miikaha yaatidhagani kaakuluntu yeni, kaamwanyoko aalumentu, kaanezimo nokookuume keni; yamwe yomune otaye ke ya dhipaga.
Otamu ka tondwa kwaayehe omolwandje.
Ihe one otamu kala mwa gamenwa, nefufu limwe lyokomitse dheni itali kana.
Mokwiidhidhimika otamu ihupithile oomwenyo dheni.”
“Uuna tamu mono, Jerusalem sha kondekwa komatanga gaakwiita, tseyeni kutya oshi li popepi nokuhanagulwa po.
Nena ayehe mboka ye li muJudea, naa tembukile koondundu; naamboka ye li moshilando shoshene, naa fadhuke po; naamboka taa adhika kondje yasho, inaa galukila mo.
Oshoka ngaka ogo omasiku ngoka Kalunga ta geele Aaisraeli, opo Omanyolo ga tsakanithwe ngoka taga ti:
Yayee aasimba naamwali yopomasiku ngoka! Oshoka uudhigu uunene otau ka adha oshilongo shika, nondjahi yaKalunga otayi ke ya kombanda yaantu mbaka.
Oyo otaa ka sa kegongamwele notaa ka falwa muupika miilongo ayihe. Aapagani otaa ka lyatagula Jerusalem, sigo ethimbo lyawo lya hulu po.
“Otaku ka holoka omandhindhiliko ketango, komwedhi nokoonyothi. Aantu ayehe yokombanda yevi otaa ka limbililwa notaa ka tilithwa kepopomo lyefuta nokomakuthikuthi galyo.
Aantu otaa ka sa omoluumbanda mokutegelela mbyoka tayi ka adha evi alihe, oshoka oonkondo dhomewangandjo otadhi ka tukuluka.
Oyo otaa ka mona Omuna gwOmuntu te ya te endele moshikogo e na oonkondo odhindji neadhimo.
Ano mbika ayihe ngele tayi tameke okuningwa, yelutheni omitse dheni, mu ukilila nokutegelela, oshoka ehupitho lyeni lya thiki popepi.”
Nena Jesus okwe ya lombwele eyele a ti: “Dhiladhileni omukwiyu nosho wo omiti dhilwe.
Omafo gadho ngele taga mbunyuka, nena omu shi shi kutya othinge oyi li popepi.
Ano osho wo, ngele tamu mono ayihe mbika tayi ningwa, kaleni mu shi shi kutya Oshilongo shaKalunga oshi li popepi.
“Ongame tandi mu lombwele: Aantu mboka ye na omwenyo ngashingeyi, itaa si, manga ayihe mbika inaayi gwanithwa.
Egulu nevi otayi hulu po, ihe oohapu dhandje kadhi na mpoka tadhi hulu po.”
“Ikotokeleni ne yene! Inamu etha, omadhiladhilo geni ga luudhikwe kiituthi nokuunkolwi nokiimpwiyu yopauyuni, opo esiku ndyoka lyaaye mu adhe ombaadhilila.
Oshoka otali ya ongomwigo, tali akele aantu ayehe kombanda yevi alihe.
Tonateni, ne mu galikane ethimbo kehe, mu mone oonkondo dhoku mu pititha mumbika ayihe tayi ka ningwa, nokuthikama koshipala shOmuna gwOmuntu.”
Momasiku ngoka Jesus okwa longo aantu motempeli pethimbo lyomutenya, ihe uusiku ngele we ya, oha yi, a ka lale kOndundu yooholivi.
Aantu ayehe oya meneka ongula onene e taa yi kotempeli, ye ke mu pulakene.
22: Ano ethimbo lyoshituthi shiikwiila inaayi fulikwa, nokutya Opaasa, olya thiki.
Aayambi aakuluntu naalongimpango oya li taa kongo ompito, ya dhipage Jesus, oshoka oya li ya tila aantu.
Nena Satana okwa yi muJudas i ithanwa Iskariot, gumwe gwaamboka omulongo nayaali.
Opo Judas okwa yi nokwa kundathana naayambi aakuluntu nosho wo naakuluntu yaalangeli yotempeli, nkene e na okugandja Jesus miikaha yawo.
Oyo oya nyanyukwa noyu uvaneke, ye mu pe iimaliwa.
Judas okwe shi zimine nokwa kala ta kongo ethimbo lyo opala okugandja Jesus kuyo, manga aantu inaaye shi tseya.
Esiku olya thiki pomasiku goshituthi shiikwiila inaayi fulikwa, uuna onzigona yOpaasa yi na okudhipagwa.
Jesus okwa tumu Petrus naJohannes nokwe ya lombwele a ti: “Indeni, mu ke tu longekidhile uulalelo wOpaasa, tu u lye.”
Oyo oye mu pula ya ti: “Openi wa hala, tu ke u longekidhe?”
Oye okwa ti: “Pulakeneni! Ngele mwa yi moshilando, otamu ka tsakaneka omulumentu a humbata etenga lyomeya. Mu landuleni sigo omegumbo moka u uka,
e tamu lombwele mwene gwegumbo tamu ti: ‘Muhongi ote ku pula: Openi pu na oshinyanga shaayenda, ndi lile mo pamwe naalongwa yandje uulalelo wOpaasa?’
Oye note mu ulukile ondjugo onene yopombanda yo opalekwa. Longekidheni ayihe.”
Oyo oya yi noya adha ayihe yi li, ngaashi Jesus e ya lombwele, e taa longekidha uulalelo wOpaasa.
Ethimbo sho lya thiki, Jesus okwa kuutumba poshililo pamwe naayapostoli.
Oye nokwa ti kuyo: “Onda yuulukwa vale okulya Opaasa ndjika pamwe nane, manga inaandi hepekwa.
Oshoka otandi mu lombwele: Itandi li we Opaasa, sigo uuna tandi ka lya ndjiyaka yomOshilongo shaKalunga.”
Nena Jesus okwa kutha oshitenga, a hambelele nokwa ti: “Shi taambeni, mu paathane.
Oshoka otandi mu lombwele: Okuza mpaka itandi nu we omaviinu, Oshilongo shaKalunga manga inaashi holoka.”
Oye a kutha wo oshikwiila, a hambelele, okwe shi pambula nokwe shi ya pe e ta ti: “Shika osho olutu lwandje ndoka talu mu gandjelwa. Shi ningeni nokudhimbulukwa ndje.”
Osho tuu wo, sho ya mana okulya, okwe ya pe oshitenga e ta ti: “Oshitenga shika osho ehangano epe lyomombinzi yandje ndjoka tayi tilwahi molweni.”
“Ano tala! Ngoka ta gwaaleke ndje, oku li mpaka poshililo pamwe nangame.
Oshoka Omuna gwOmuntu oku na okusa, ngaashi Kalunga e shi tokola nale; ihe yaye omuntu ngoka te mu gwaaleke!”
Oyo oya tameke okupulathana kutya olye ngoka gwomokati kawo te shi ningi.
Mokati kaalongwa omwa penduka edhiladhilo kutya olye ngoka e na okutalwa omukuluntu e vule ooyakwawo ayehe.
Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Aakwaniilwa yomuuyuni mbuka ohaa pangele aantu yawo koonkondo, naapangeli yawo oya hala, yi ithanwe ookuume kaantu.
Ihe ne inamu kala ngaaka! Omukuluntu gwomokati keni na ninge omuhugunini, naangoka gwokomeho na ninge omuyakuli.
Oshoka olye e na esimano, oye ngoka a kuutumba poshililo ta li nenge oye ngoka ta yakula? Ndishi oye ngoka a kuutumba owala. Ihe ngame ondi li mokati keni nda fa omuyakuli.”
“One mwa kala pamwe nangame momamakelo gandje agehe.
Ngaashi Tate a pe ndje epitikilo lyokupangela, osho nangame wo otandi mu pe oshilongo.
One tamu ka lya notamu ka nwa poshililo shandje omOshilongo shandje e tamu ka kuutumba kiipangelapundi, mu pangule omazimo omulongo nagaali gaIsrael.”
“Simon, Simon! Pulakena! Satana okwa pula e ta pewa epitikilo, e mu makele ne amuhe, ongaashi omukiintu ta yele iilya polupale.
Ihe ngame onde ku galikanene, opo eitaalo lyoye lyaa kane. Nongele wa galukile kungame, tsa wo ooyakweni omukumo.”
Petrus okwa ti kuye: “Omuwa, ngame ondi ilongekidha okuya mondholongo pamwe nangoye nosho wo okusa pamwe nangoye.”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Petrus, otandi ku lombwele: Uusiku mbu wonena ekondombolo manga inaali iga, oto idhimbike ndje lutatu to ti ku shi ndje.”

Nena Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Sho nde mu tumiine mwaa na okampunda kiimaliwa, ompunda yokweenda nayo noongaku, omwa li mwa pumbwa sha?”
Oyo oya ti: “Aawe.”
Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Ihe ngashingeyi ngoka e na okampunda kiimaliwa nenge ompunda yokweenda nayo, ne yi kuthe. Ngoka kee na egongamwele, na landithe po ombaikitha ye, e li ilandele.
Oshoka otandi mu lombwele: Enyolo ndyoka tali ti: ‘Oye a yalulilwa maakolokoshi,’ oli na okutsakanithwa. Oshoka ashihe shoka sha nyolwa tashi popi ndje, oshi na okuninga shoshili.”

Aalongwa oya ti kuye: “Omuwa, tala, otu na po omagongamwele gaali.”
Oye okwa ti kuyo: “Sigo opo mpo sha gwana!”
Jesus okwa zi mo nokwa yi, ngaashi i igilila, kOndundu yooholivi. Aalongwa ye oya yi pamwe naye.
Sho a thiki kehala ndyoka, okwa ti kuyo: “Galikaneni, mwaa pwile memakelo.”
Nena okwe ya thigi po okakako ke thike pedhaadhigo lyemanya nokwa tsu oongolo e ta galikana
a ti: “Tate, ngele oto shi pitika, oshitenga shika nashi pitilile ndje po. Ihe hamolwehalo lyandje, ihe olyoye li gwanithwe.”
[Omuyengeli gwomegulu okwe ya kuye nokwe mu tsu omukumo.
Oye okwa adhika kuuwehame uunene nokwa galikana a mana mo. Omazigudhe ngoka ga zi muye, oga li ga fa omata gombinzi noga ndondele pevi.]
Konima yokugalikana okwa thikama e ta shuna kaalongwa ye nokwe ya adha ya kotha, oshoka oya li ya sa oluhodhi.
Oye okwa ti kuyo: “Omolwashike tamu kotha? Pendukeni, mu galikane, mwaa pwile memakelo.”
Manga Jesus ta popi, ongundu yaantu oye ya po, ya kwatelwa komeho kuJudas, gumwe gwomaalongwa omulongo nayaali. Oye okwa hedha kuJesus nokwe mu thipi komilungu.
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Judas, Omuna gwOmuntu oto mu gwaaleke noku mu thipa komilungu?”
Ano aalongwa mboka ya li pamwe naJesus, sho ya mono shoka tashi ningwa, oya ti: “Omuwa, natu kondje nomagongamwele getu?”
Nena gumwe oku umpile omumati gwomuyambimukuluntu nokwe mu fegula okutsi kwokolulyo.
Jesus okwa yamukula a ti: “Opuwo, inashi ningwa we!” Oye okwa gumu okutsi kwomumati nokwe mu aludha.
Nena Jesus okwa lombwele aayambi aakuluntu, aakuluntu yaalangeli yotempeli naakuluntu yoshigwana mboka ye ya oku mu kwata a ti: “Omwe ya, mu kwate ndje ongomukolokoshi mu na omagongamwele noondhimbo?
Esiku kehe onda kala pamwe nane motempeli, ihe inamu kwata ndje. Ihe ndika olyo ethimbo lyeni nolyoonkondo dhomupangeli gwomilema.”
Oyo oya kwata Jesus noye mu fala megumbo lyomuyambimukuluntu. Petrus okwa landula mo e li konima kokule.
Molugumbo lwomeni omwa li mu na yamwe ya kuutumba taa huhulukwa pomulilo, naPetrus okwe ya e ta kuutumba mongundu yawo.
Ano gumwe gwomaayakuli aakadhona sho a mono Petrus ta huhulukwa, okwe mu tongolola e ta ti: “Omulumentu nguka naye wo okwa li pamwe naJesus.”
Ihe Petrus okwi idhimbike a ti: “Nekulu, kandi mu shi nando.”

Konima yokathimbo omulumentu gumwe okwe mu dhimbulula e ta ti: “Nangoye wo ogumwe gwawo.”
Petrus okwa yamukula a ti: “Mentu ngoye, hangame.”
Sho pwa piti otundi yimwe, omulumentu gumwe ishewe okwa koleke a ti: “Kapu na omalimbililo, omulumentu nguka okwa li pamwe naye, oshoka naye wo Omugalilea.”

Petrus okwa yamukula a ti: “Mentu ngoye, kandi uvite ko shoka to popi.”
Ano manga ta popi, ekondombolo olyi igi.
Opo Omuwa okwa punguluka nokwa tongolola Petrus. Petrus okwa dhimbulukwa oohapu dhOmuwa, sho a tile: “Nena tuu ndjika, ekondombolo manga inaali iga, ongoye to idhimbike ndje lutatu.”
Petrus okwa yi pondje e ta lili nokulililila.
Aalumentu mboka ya li ya langela Jesus, oye mu sheke e taye mu dhenge.
Oyo oye mu siikile koshipala noye mu pula ya ti: “Tengeneka, olye e ku dhenge?”
Oyo oye mu sheke omasheko omakwawo ogendji.
Ano sho kwa shi, aakuluntu yoshigwana, aayambi naalongimpango oya gongala, naJesus okwa etwa moshigongi shawo.

Oyo oye mu pula ya ti: “Tu lombwela, ngele ongoye Kristus.”
Oye okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Ngele ando ondi mu lombwele, itamu itaale ndje.
Nongele ando ondi mu pule epulo limwe, itamu yamukula ndje.
Ihe okuza mpaka otamu ka mona Omuna gwOmuntu a kuutumba kolulyo lwaKalunga, ngoka e na oonkondo adhihe.”

Oyo ayehe oye mu pula ya ti: “Ngoye ano Omuna gwaKalunga?”
Oye okwa ti kuyo: “One omwa ti kutya ongame.”
Oyo oya ti: “Tse inatu pumbwa nando onzapo yimwe yi tu lombwele. Otse yene otu uvu oohapu adhihe ndhoka e dhi popi.”
23: Ongundu ayihe yaantu oya thikama noya fala Jesus kuPilatus.
Oyo oya tameke oku mu tamaneka taa ti: “Omulumentu nguka otwe mu kwata, oshoka ota pukitha aantu note ya indike okugandja oompale komupangeli Omuroma, ye ti iti kutya oye Kristus, omukwaniilwa.”

Pilatus okwe mu pula a ti: “Ongoye omukwaniilwa gwAajuda?”
Jesus okwe mu yamukula: “Osho wa ti.”
Nena Pilatus okwa lombwele aayambi aakuluntu nongundu ayihe a ti: “Kandi wete etompelo lyokupa omulumentu nguka oondjo.”
Ihe aatamaneki oya dhiginine noonkondo ya ti: “Oye ota piyaganeke aantu nelongo lye. Oye okwa tameke muGalilea nokwe ende muJudea ashihe sigo oompaka.”
Ano Pilatus sho e shi uvu, okwa pula a ti: “Omulumentu nguka Omugalilea?”
Sho a kundana kutya Jesus okwa za koshitopolwa shoka shi li mepangelo lyaHerodes, okwe mu tumu kuHerodes, oshoka Herodes okwa li muJerusalem pethimbo ndyoka.
Herodes okwa nyanyukwa unene, sho a mono Jesus, oshoka okwa adhika e mu uvu owala nokwa kala ethimbo ele e na ehalo oku mu mona; unene okwa kala a hala, a mone Jesus ta longo oshikumithalonga.
Ano Herodes sho a pula Jesus omapulo ogendji, Jesus ina yamukula nando osha.
Aayambi aakuluntu naalongimpango oye ya po noya lundile Jesus ye na uulaadhi.
Nena Herodes pamwe naakwiita ye oye mu dhini noye mu sheke. Oyo oye mu zaleke onguwo onene yesimano. Herodes nokwe mu shunitha kuPilatus.
Okuza kesiku tuu ndyoka Herodes naPilatus oya panga ihe uukuume, oshoka nale oya li ye tondathane.
Pilatus okwa gongele aayambi aakuluntu, aakuluntu Aajuda naantu yalwe

e ta ti kuyo: “One omwe eta omulumentu nguka kungame tamu ti kutya ota pukitha aantu. Ngashingeyi onde mu pula nokuli montaneho yeni amuhe, ihe inandi mona muye nando eyono limwe ndyoka tamu mu tamanekele.
Herodes wo sho inee mu mona e na oondjo, okwe mu shunitha kutse. Omulumentu nguka ina ninga nando osha shoku mu dhipagitha.
Onda hala ndi mu dhengithe e tandi mu etha, a ye.” [
Pethimbo kehe lyoshituthi shOpaasa Pilatus ohe ya mangululile onkwatwa yimwe.]
Nena aantu ayehe oyi igidha mokule ya ti. “Na dhipagwe! Tu mangululila Barabbas!”
Barabbas okwa li e edhililwa mondholongo omolwekolokosho ndyoka lya li lya holoka moshilando nomolwedhipago.
Pilatus okwe ya tseyithile ishewe kutya okwa hala okumangulula Jesus.
Ihe oyo oyi igidha mokule ya ti: “Na alelwe, na alelwe komushigakano!”
Pilatus okwe ya pula olutitatu a ti: “Uuwinayi owashike ano ningi? Ngame inandi mu mona e na oondjo dhoku mu dhipagitha. Otandi mu dhengitha owala e tandi mu etha.”
Ihe oya dhiginine okwiigidha mokule taa ti kutya Jesus na alelwe komushigakano. Neigidho lyawo olya sindana.
Nena Pilatus okwa tokola, ehalo lyawo li gwanithwe.
Oye okwa mangulula omulumentu ngwiyaka taa pula, ngoka a li a tulwa mondholongo omolwekolokosho nedhipago, nokwa gandja Jesus miikaha yawo, ye ke mu ninge ngaashi ya hala.

Oyo oya yi naJesus. Mokweenda kwawo oya tsakaneke Simon, omulumentu Omukireni, a li ta zi kepya u uka moshilando. Aakwiita oye mu thikamitha noye mu tsike omushigakano komapepe ge, e gu humbate konima yaJesus.
Ongundu onene yaantu oya landula Jesus. Mokati kawo omwa li aakiintu mboka ya li taa lili notaa hekumuna omolwe.
Jesus okwa punguluka nokwe ya tala e ta ti. “Aakiintu Aajerusalem, inamu lila ndje, ihe ilileni ne yene naana yeni.
Oshoka omasiku otage ke ya, uuna aantu taa ka tya: ‘Aakiintu aanelago oomboka inaa mona uunona, inaa vala yo inaa yamutha.’
Pethimbo ndyoka aantu otaa ka popya taa ti: ‘Oondundu, tu gwileni! iikulundundu, tu siikileni!’
Oshoka omuti omutalala ngele otagu ningwa ngeyi, nena omuti omukukutu otagu ningwa ngiini?”
Jesus okwa falwa, a ka dhipagwe pamwe naalumentu aakolokoshi yaali.
Sho ya thiki kehala ndyoka lyi ithanwa Oshala sholukwe, oko ya alele Jesus komushigakano pamwe naakolokoshi mboka yaali komishigakano dhawo, gumwe okolulyo lwe nomukwawo okolumoho lwe.

Jesus okwa ti: “Tate, ya dhimina po oondjo dhawo, oshoka inaa tseya shoka taa ningi.”
Oyo oya topolelathana oonguwo dhe pamukalo gwoku dhi umbila oshihogololitho.
Aantu oya thikama mpoka noye mu tala, manga aakuluntu Aajuda ye mu sheke ya ti: “Okwa li ha hupitha aantu yalwe, ni ihupithe ano, ngele oye Kristus, omuhogololwa gwaKalunga.”
Aakwiita wo oye mu sheke; oyo oye ya kuye noye mu pe omaviinu omalulu
e taa ti: “Ihupitha ano, ngele ngoye omukwaniilwa gwAajuda.”
Oohapu ndhika odha li dha nyolwa kombanda yomutse gwe: “Nguka oye omukwaniilwa gwAajuda.”
Gumwe gwomaakolokoshi okwe mu sheke wo a ti: “Ongoye Kristus? Ihupitha ano, u tu hupithe wo.”
Nena mukwawo okwe mu ganda a ti: “Iho tila Kalunga? Natse otu li megeelo olyo ndyoka.
Okuhepekwa kwetu oku li mondjila, sho tatu ningilwa shoka twe shi ilongela, ihe nguka ina ninga nando uuwinayi washa.”
Oye okwa ti kuJesus: “Jesus, dhimbulukwa ndje ngele wa thiki mOshilongo shoye.”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Ongame tandi ku lombwele, nena tuu ndjika oto ka kala pamwe nangame mOparadisa.”
Pokati komutenya lwopotundi omulongo nambali etango inali minikila, onkee okwa ningi omilema moshilongo ashihe sigo opotundi ontintatu yokomatango.
Nena etopolitho lyotempeli olya tuuka pokati.
Jesus okwi igidha mokule a ti: “Tate, omwenyo gwandje otandi gu gandja miikaha yoye.” Ano sho a popi ngeyi, okwa si.
Ano omukuluntu gwaakwiita sho a mono ayihe mbyoka ya ningwa po, okwa simaneke Kalunga a ti: “Kapu na omalimbililo, omulumentu nguka ke na oondjo.”
Aantu mboka ya gongalele okutala, sho ya mono shoka sha ningwa po, ayehe oya shuna komagumbo ya sa oluhodhi.
Aantu ayehe mboka ya li ye shaathane nawa naJesus, osho wo aakiintu mboka ye mu landula okuza kuGalilea, oya thikama kokule noya tala ayihe mbika.
Okwa li ku na omulumentu, edhina lye Josef, gwomuArimatia, oshilando shAajuda.
Oye okwa li e na omikalo omiwanawa, he ende moshili nokwa kala a tegelela Oshilongo shaKalunga. Nonando oye okwa li oshilyo shoshigongi shaatokoli, ina zimina omatokolo niilonga yawo.
Oye okwa yi kuPilatus nokwe mu indile omudhimba gwaJesus.
Oye okwe gu kutha nokwe gu dhingile moshiyata oshitokele nokwe gu langeke mombila ya li ya hokwa memanya, inaamu tulwa nando nale omuntu.
Esiku olya li Etitano, nEsabati olya li pokutameka.
Aakiintu mboka ya li ya landula Jesus okuza kuGalilea, oya yi pamwe naJosef noya mono ombila nomudhimba mpoka gwa langekwa.

Ano sho ya shuna komagumbo, oya longekidha iizimba ya nika nawa nomugwayo, ya ka gwayeke omudhimba.
MEsabati oya vululukwa, ngaashi shu uthwa kompango.
24: Ongula onene yesiku lyotango lyoshiwike aakiintu oya yi kombila ye na iizimba ya nika nawa, mbyoka ye yi longekidha.
Sho ye ya posheelo, oya adha emanya lya kandulwa po nale.
Oyo oya yi mo, ihe inaa mona mo omudhimba gwOmuwa Jesus.
Ano manga ya li ya limbililwa, ombaadhilila aalumentu yaali ya zala oonguwo tadhi adhima, oya thikama puyo.
Aakiintu oya haluka noyi ihata pevi. Aalumentu mboka oye ya popitha ya ti: “Omolwashike tamu kongo ngoka e na omwenyo mokati kaasi?
Ke mo muka, okwa yumudhwa kuusi. Dhimbulukweni shoka e mu lombwelele, manga a li muGalilea.
Okwa tile: ‘Omuna gwOmuntu oku na okugandjwa miikaha yaalunde, e ta ka alelwa komushigakano, ihe ngele pwa piti omasiku gatatu, ota ka yumudhwa kuusi.’ ”
Nena aakiintu oya dhimbulukwa oohapu dhaJesus.
Sho ya galuka kombila, oya hokolola ayihe mbika kaalongwa omulongo nagumwe nokuyalwe wo.
Aakiintu mbaka oyo Maria Magdalena, Johanna naMaria, yina yaJakob; oyo pamwe naakiintu ooyakwawo yalwe oya hokololele aayapostoli iinima mbika ayihe.
Ihe aayapostoli oya tala kutya oohapu dhaakiintu kadhi na oshilonga, onkee inaye dhi itaala.
Ihe Petrus okwa thikama e ta matukile kombila. Oye okwa ontamene mo nokwa mono mo owala omalapi ngoka ga li omudhimba. Nena okwa shuna kegumbo a kuminwa shoka sha ningwa po.
Mesiku olyo tuu ndyoka yaali yomaalongwa oya li taa ende yu uka kokalando, edhina lyako Emmaus, ke li ookilometa omulongo nambali okuza kuJerusalem.
Oyo oya li taa kundathana iinima ayihe mbyoka ya ningwa po.
Ano manga taa popi notaa kundathana, Jesus mwene okwa hedha puyo e te ende pamwe nayo.
Oyo oye mu mono ngaa, ihe inaye mu dhimbulula.

Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Otamu kundathana shike mokweenda kweni?”
Oyo oya thikama ya lulika iipala yawo.
Gumwe gwawo, edhina lye Kleopas, okwe mu pula a ti: “Ongoye awike wa kala muJerusalem, ino uva shoka sha ningwa mo pomasiku ngano?”

Jesus okwe ya pula a ti: “Omwa ningwa shike?”
Oyo oya yamukula ya ti: “Ooshoka sha ningwa kombinga yaJesus Omunasareti. Omulumentu nguka okwa li omuhunganeki e na oonkondo miilonga nomoohapu montaneho yaKalunga noyaantu ayehe.
Ihe aayambi aakuluntu naapangeli yetu oye mu gandja mompangu, a ka se, e taye mu alele komushigakano.
Tse otwa li twi inekele kutya omulumentu nguka oye ngoka e na okuhupitha Aaisraeli. Nena nokuli esiku etitatu, mbika ayihe sho ya ningwa.
Aakiintu yamwe yomokati ketu oye tu kumitha, sho ye ya ongula onene kombila,
ihe inaa mona omudhimba gwaJesus. Oyo sho ya galuka, oya hokolola kutya oya mono emoniko lyaayengeli mboka ye ya lombwele kutya Jesus oku na omwenyo.
Okuza mpoka yamwe yomokati kawo oya yi ko kombila noya adha ko naanaa, ngaashi ya lombwelwa kaakiintu, ihe Jesus ye mwene inaye mu mona.”
Nena Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Kamu shi tuu aagoya, sho mwa nyengwa okwiitaala ayihe mbyoka ya popiwa kaahunganeki!
Ndishi Kristus okwa li e na okuhepekwa pamukalo nguno, opo a ye mesimano lye?”
Opo Jesus okwe ya fatululile shoka sha tiwa kombinga ye mOmanyolo agehe okutameka momambo gaMoses sigo omambo agehe gaahunganeki.
Oyo sho ye ya popepi nokalando moka ya li taa yi, Jesus okwa ningi a fa ta pitilile po.
Oyo oye mu galula ya ti: “Kala putse, oshoka otaku toko, nomilema odhe ya.” Nena okwa yi megumbo nokwa kala puyo.
Ano sho a kuutumba poshililo pamwe nayo, okwa kutha oshikwiila, e shi yambeke nokwe shi pambula e te shi ya pe.
Omeho gawo oga tonata noye mu dhimbulula; ihe ohaluka okwe ya kana.
Oyo oya pulathana ya ti: “Katwa li tuu tu na ehwamo moomwenyo dhetu, sho a popi natse mondjila nokwe tu fatululile Omanyolo!”
Mbalambala oya thikama e taa shuna kuJerusalem noya adha ko aalongwa omulongo nagumwe ya gongala nooyakwawo yalwe.
Mbaka oya ti kuyo: “Kapu na omalimbililo, Omuwa okwa yumudhwa! Okwa monika kuSimon!”
Nena aalongwa mboka yaali oye ya fatululile shoka sha ningwa mondjila nankene ya dhimbulula Omuwa, sho a pambula oshikwiila.
Manga mbaka taa hokolola, Omuwa mwene okwa thikama mokati kawo e ta ti kuyo: “Ombili nayi kale nane.”
Oyo oya kwatwa kuumbanda nokehaluko, oshoka oya dhiladhila kutya oya mono oshiluli.
Ihe oye okwa ti kuyo: “Omolwashike mwa tila? Omolwashike oomwenyo dheni dha limbililwa?
Taleni iikaha yandje noompadhi dhandje, mu dhimbulule kutya ongame. Gumii ndje, mu tale, oshoka oshiluli kashi na oontumba nomasipa, ngaashi ngame ndi yi na.”
Sho a popi ngeyi, okwe ya ulukile iikaha ye noompadhi dhe.
Natango tuu inaa hala okwiitaala, oshoka oyo oya li yu udha enyanyu nonkumwe. Oye okwe ya pula a ti: “Omu na po sha shokuliwa?”
Oyo oye mu pe okantumba kohi ya pya.
Oye okwe ka kutha nokwe ka li montaneho yawo.

Oye okwa ti kuyo: “Iinima mbika oyo tuu mbyoka nde mu lombwelele, sho nda li pune, nda ti: Ayihe mbyoka ya nyolwa mompango yaMoses tayi popi ndje nenge momanyolo gaahunganeki nenge momapisalomi, oyi na okugwanithwa.”
Opo okwa patulula omadhiladhilo gawo, yu uve ko Omanyolo.
Oye nokwa ti kuyo: “Okwa nyolwa kutya Kristus okwa li e na okuhepekwa, nongele pwa piti omasiku gatatu, ota ka yumudhwa kuusi.
Medhina lye aantu ayehe oye na okuuvithilwa kutya nayi itedhulule, Kalunga nota dhimi po oondjo dhawo. Tamekeni muJerusalem.
One aahokololi yiinima mbika ayihe.
Ngame otandi ke mu tumina shoka Tate e shi uvaneke. Ihe ne omu na okukala moshilando muka, sigo tamu pewa oonkondo dhopombanda.”
Jesus okwa kutha mo aalongwa ye moshilando nokwe ya fala kuBetania. Oko nkoka okwa yelutha iikaha ye nokwe ya yambeke.
Moku ya yambeka okwa kana po puyo nokwa falwa megulu.
Aalongwa oya tsu oongolo e taye mu galikana noya shuna kuJerusalem yu udha enyanyu enene.
Oyo oya kala aluhe motempeli taa hambelele Kalunga.

1: Ohapu oya li ko, manga uuyuni inaau shitwa. Ohapu oya li Kalunga nOhapu oya li Kalunga.
Okuza ketamekolela Ohapu oya li puKalunga.
Kalunga okwe mu shititha iinima ayihe, nokaku na nando oshinima shimwe shomeshito inaashi shitwa kee po.
Ohapu oya li yi na omwenyo, nomwenyo ogwa ningi uuyelele waantu.
Uuyelele mbuka owa minikile momilema, nomilema inadhi u dhima po.
Okwa li ku na omulumentu a tumwa kuKalunga, edhina lye Johannes.
Oye okwe ya, a hokololele aantu uuyelele, opo ayehe yi itaalithwe kuye.
Haye mwene a li uuyelele, ihe okwe ya, a hokolole uuyelele.
Uuyelele mbuka washili otau ya muuyuni, u minikile omuntu kehe.
Ohapu okwa li muuyuni, naKalunga okwe mu shititha uuyuni, ihe uuyuni inau mu dhimbulula.
Oye okwe ya kumboka yaandjawo, naamboka yaandjawo inaye mu taamba.
Ihe ayehe mboka ye mu taamba noye mu itaale, okwe ya pe oonkondo, ya ninge aana yaKalunga.
Oyo inaa valwa pamukalo gwopanshitwe, nokutya kaye shi oluvalo lwomuntu, ihe oya valwa muKalunga.
Ohapu nokwa ningi omuntu nokwa kala mokati ketu. Otse otwa tala eadhimo lye, eadhimo lyomuvalwa awike gwaHe. Oye okwa li u udha esilohenda noshili.
Johannes okwe mu hokolola nokwi igidha a ti: “Nguka oye naanaa ngoka nde mu popile nda ti: ‘Ngoka te ya konima yandje, okwa li ndje komeho, oshoka okwa li ko, manga ngame nda li ndaa ko.’ ”
Nomowindji wesilohenda lye tseni atuheni otwa pewa mo esilohenda lya gwedhele kesilohenda.
Oshoka ompango Kalunga okwe yi gandja ya pitile muMoses, ihe esilohenda noshili oye etwa kuJesus Kristus.
Kaku na omuntu a mono Kalunga nando olumwe, ihe Kalunga Omuvalwa awike ngoka e li puHe, oye e mu holola.
Ndika olyo ehokololo lyaJohannes, Aajuda yomuJerusalem sho ya tumu kuye aayambi nAalevi oku mu pula: “Ongoye lye?”
Johannes ina tinda okuyamukula, ihe okwa hempulula sha yela a ti: “Hangame Kristus.”

Oyo noye mu pula: “Ongoye lye ano? Ongoye Elia?”
Oye okwa ti: “Aawe, hangame!”
“Ongoye omuhunganeki?”
Oye okwa yamukula. “Aawe.”
Oyo noya ti kuye: “Ongoye lye ano, opo tu fale eyamukulo kumboka ye tu tumu. Ngoye oto itile ngiini?”

Johannes okwa yamukula noohapu dhomuhunganeki Jesaja a ti:
“Ongame ewi lyanakwiigidha mombuga tali ti:
‘Yelekanithileni Omuwa ondjila.’ ”
Aatumwa mboka oya li yomaafarisayi.
Oyo noya pula Johannes ya ti: “Omolwashike ano to shasha, ngele hangoye Kristus nenge Elia nenge omuhunganeki?”
Johannes okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Ngame otandi mu shasha nomeya, ihe mokati keni omwa thikama ngoka ne kaamu mu shi.
Ngoka te ya konima yandje, oye tuu ngoka inaandi gwana okudhitula omiya dhoongaku dhe.”
Iinima mbika oya ningilwa muBetania handiyaka yomulonga gwaJordan, nkoka Johannes a li ta shasha aantu.
Esiku lya landula Johannes okwa mono Jesus te ya kuye nokwa ti: “Tala, Onzigona yaKalunga, tayi kutha po oondjo dhuuyuni!
Ngoka oye naanaa ngoka nde mu popile nda ti: ‘Omulumentu te ya konima yandje, oye omunene, oshoka okwa li ko, manga ngame nda li ndaa ko.’
Ngame onda li kaandi mu shi, ihe onde ya okushasha nomeya, opo a tseyithilwe Aaisraeli.”
Johannes okwe mu hokolola a ti: “Onda mono Ombepo ya kuluka megulu ya fa onguti noye mu lambele.

Ngame nonda li kaandi mu shi, ihe Kalunga, ngoka a tumu ndje okushasha nomeya, okwa lombwele ndje a ti: ‘Ngoka to mu mono ta lambelwa kOmbepo notayi kala kombanda ye, oye ngoka ta shasha nOmbepo Ondjapuki.’
Ngame onde shi mono notandi mu hokololele nokutya oye Omuna gwaKalunga.”
Esiku lya landula Johannes okwa li ko ishewe a thikama nayaali yomaalongwa ye.
Johannes sho a mono Jesus te ende po, okwa ti: “Tala, Onzigona yaKalunga.”
Aalongwa ye yaali oye mu uvu, sho ta popi ngaaka noya landula Jesus.

Nena Jesus okwa punguluka nokwe ya mono, sho taye mu landula, nokwa pula: “Otamu kongo shike?”
Oyo oye mu yamukula: “Owa kala peni, Rabbi?” (Oshitya shika otashi ti “Muhongi.”)
Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Ileni, mu tale!” Oyo sho ya yi naye, oya mono mpoka a kala noya kala puye oshihupe shesiku ndyoka. Otundi oya li ontine yokomatango.
Gumwe gwomaalongwa mbeyaka yaali mboka ya li yu uvu Johannes sho a popi noya landula Jesus, oAndreas, omumwayina gwaSimon.
Andreas okwa tsakaneke tangotango omumwayina Simon nokwe mu lombwele a ti: “Tse otwa mono Omugwayekwa” (Oshitya shika otashi ti “Kristus.”)

Ye okwa fala Simon kuJesus.
Jesus okwe mu tala nokwa ti: “Ongoye Simon yaJohannes; oto ki ithanwa Kefas,” (kokutya Petrus ndyoka tali ti “emanya”.)
Esiku lya landula Jesus okwa li a hala okuya kuGalilea. Okwa tsakaneke Filippus nokwa ti kuye: “Landula ndje.”
Filippus okwa li Omubetsaida, oshilando moka Andreas naPetrus ya kala mo.
Filippus okwa tsakaneke Natanael nokwa ti kuye: “Tse otwa mono omulumentu ngoka a nyolwa kuMoses membo lyompango nokaahunganeki. Oye Jesus, omuna gwaJosef Omunasareti.”

Natanael okwe mu pula a ti: “MuNasaret otamu vulu tuu okuza uuwanawa washa?”
Filippus okwe mu lombwele. “Ila, u tale!”
Jesus okwa mono Natanael te ya kuye nokwe mu popi a ti: “Tala, Omwiisraeli gwashili, ngoka kee na nando iifundja!”

Natanael okwe mu pula a ti: “Owa tseya ndje ngiini?”
Jesus okwa ti: “Onde ku mono, sho wa li momukwiyu, manga Filippus inee ku ithana.”
Natanael okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Muhongi, ongoye Omuna gwaKalunga! Ongoye Omukwaniilwa gwAaisraeli!”
Jesus okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Ngoye ndishi owi itaale owala, sho nde ku lombwele kutya onde ku mono, sho wa li momukwiyu? Oto ka mona iinima iinene yi vule mbika.”
Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Ngame otandi mu lombwele oshili: Otamu ka mona egulu lye eguluka, naayengeli yaKalunga taa londo notaa kulukile kOmuna gwOmuntu.”
2: Sho pwa piti omasiku gatatu, okwa li ku na ohango muKana, oshilando shomuGalilea. Yina yaJesus oko a li.
Jesus naalongwa ye oya li wo ya hiywa kohango.
Omaviinu agehe sho ga pu po, yina yaJesus okwa ti kuye: “Kaye na omaviinu.”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Ino kala u na oshimpwiyu nangame, meme. Ethimbo lyandje inali thika natango.”
Yina yaJesus okwa lombwele aayakuli a ti: “Shaa shoka te mu lombwele, shi ningeni.”
Pamukalo gwokuyoga kwAajuda okwa li ku na iiyuma ihamano yomamanya popepi. Oshuma kehe oshi thike pomayemele gahetatu nenge omulongo nagaali.
Jesus okwa lombwele aayakuli a ti: “Tekeleni iiyuma omeya, yu udhe.” Oyo noye yi tekele yu udhilila sigo okomilungu.
Ye okwa ti kuyo: “Ngashingeyi ga pimpii mo ihe, mu ga faalele omuyakuli omukuluntu gwaayenda.” Oyo noye ge mu faalele.

Omuyakuli omukuluntu sho a makele omeya ngoka ga shituka omaviinu, okwa li kee shi mpoka ga zi. Aayakuli mboka ya teke omeya, oyo ayeke ya li ye shi shi. Omuyakuli omukuluntu okwi ithana ihe ombushiki
nokwa ti kuye: “Omuntu kehe oha gandja tango omaviinu ngoka omatoye, opo ihe ngele aantu ya kolwa, ote ya pe ngoka omawinayi. Ihe ngoye sigo oompaka owa holeke omaviinu omatoye.”
Oshikumithalonga shika shotango Jesus okwe shi ningile muKana, oshilando shomuGalilea. Okwa holola eadhimo lye, aalongwa ye noye mu itaale.
Konima yoshiningwanima shika Jesus mwene nayina naamwayina aalumentu naalongwa ye oya yi kuKapernaum noya kala ko omasiku gamwe.
Opaasa yAajuda sho ya li popepi, Jesus okwa yi kuJerusalem.
Okwa adha aantu motempeli taa landitha oongombe, oonzi noonguti, naapingakanithi yiimaliwa ya kuutumba piitaafula yawo.
Okwa tungu ongola yepando nokwe ya tidha mo ayehe motempeli pamwe noongombe noonzi dhawo. Okwa tilehi iimaliwa, niitaafula yawo okwe yi undulile pevi.
Aalandithi yoonguti okwe ya lombwele a ti: “Kuthii mo iinima mbika ayihe! Ongulu yaTate inamu yi ninga oshilandelo.”
Aalongwa ye oya dhimbulukwa kutya enyolo otali ti: “Uulaadhi omolwongulu yoye, Kalunga, otau li ndje.”
Aajuda oya pula Jesus ya ti: “Oshikumithalonga oshini po to longo, u tu ulukile kutya ou na epitikilo okulonga ngeyi?”
Jesus okwe ya yamukula a ti: “Kumunii po otempeli ndjika, ngame notandi yi tungulula momasiku gatatu.”
Nena Aajuda oye mu lombwele: “Otempeli ndjika oya tungwa oomvula omilongo ne nahamano, ongoye noto yi tungulula momasiku gatatu?”
Ihe otempeli ndjoka Jesus a popi, oyo olutu lwe.
Ano Jesus sho a yumudhwa kuusi, aalongwa ye oya dhimbulukwa oohapu ndhoka a li a popi. Oyo noyi itaale enyolo noohapu ndhoka Jesus e dhi ya lombwele.
Jesus sho a li muJerusalem pethimbo lyoshituthi shOpaasa, aantu oyendji oya mono iikumithalonga mbyoka a longo noye mu itaale.
Ihe ye ini iholola kuyo, oshoka ye mwene okwa li e ya shi ayehe.
Ye ina pumbwa omuntu e mu hokololele sha kombinga yomuntu, oshoka okwa tseya ye mwene shoka shi li momuntu.
3: Gumwe gwomaafarisayi, edhina lye Nikodemus, oshilyo shomongundu yaapangeli Aajuda,

okwe ya kuJesus uusiku nokwa ti kuye: “Muhongi, otu shi shi, ongoye omulongi ngoka a tumwa kuKalunga, oshoka kaku na nando ogumwe ta vulu okulonga iikumithalonga mbyoka to longo, okuninga Kalunga e li pamwe naye.”
Jesus okwe mu yamukula nokwa ti: “Ngame otandi ku lombwele oshili: Omuntu ngele ita valululwa, ita vulu okumona Oshilongo shaKalunga.”
Nikodemus okwa ti kuye: “Omuntu ngele omukuluntu, ota vulu ngiini okuvalwa ishewe? Ita vulu ndishi okushuna moshivalelo shayina, a valwe olutiyali?”
Jesus okwe mu yamukula: “Ngame otandi ku lombwele oshili: Kape na omuntu ta vulu okuya mOshilongo shaKalunga, ngele ina valululwa momeya nomOmbepo.
Shoka sha valwa panyama, osho onyama, naashoka sha valwa pambepo, osho Ombepo.
Ino kumwa, sho nde ku lombwele kutya omu na okuvalululwa.
Ano ombepo ohayi pepe shaa mpoka ya hala. Oto uvu oshihomo shayo, ihe ku shi mpoka tayi zi naankoka yu uka. Osho naanaa shi li kukehe ngoka a valwa pambepo.”
Nikodemus okwe mu pula a ti: “Shika otashi vulika ngiini?”
Jesus okwa yamukula a ti: “Ngoye omulongi gwAaisraeli, ihe nani shika ku shi shi?
Otandi ku lombwele oshili. Tse otatu popi shoka tu shi shi notatu hokolola shoka twa mona, ihe ne inamu hala okutaamba ehokololo lyetu.
Ngele tandi mu lombwele iinima yokombanda yevi, ihe itamu itaale, otamu vulu ngiini okwiitaala, ngele tandi mu hokololele iinima yomegulu?
Kape na nando ogumwe a yile megulu kakele kOmuna gwOmuntu, ngoka a zi megulu.”
“Ngashika naanaa Moses a li a yelutha eyoka pombanda mombuga, osho wo Omuna gwOmuntu e na oku ka yeluthwa pombanda,
opo kehe ngoka te mu itaale, a kale e na omwenyo gwaaluhe.
Oshoka osho ngeyi Kalunga a kala e hole uuyuni, oye a gandja Omwana awike, opo shaa ngoka te mu itaale, kaa kane, ihe a kale e na omwenyo gwaaluhe.
Oshoka Kalunga ina tuma Omwana muuyuni, a pangule uuyuni, aawe, okwe mu tumu, opo uuyuni u hupithwe kuye.”
“Ngoka i itaala Omwana, ita pangulwa; ngoka ini itaala, okwa pangulwa nale, oshoka ini itaala Omuvalwa awike gwaKalunga.
Ihe epangulo oli li mpoka kutya uuyelele owe ya muuyuni, ihe aantu oye hole omilema shi vulithe pokuhola uuyelele, oshoka iilonga yawo iiwinayi.
Kehe ngoka ha longo uuwinayi, oku tonde uuyelele noite ya puuyelele, oshoka ina hala, iilonga ye iiwinayi yi holoke.
Ihe ngoka ta longo iilonga yu uka, ote ya puuyelele, opo uuyelele u holole kutya iilonga ye oya longwa omolwokuvulika kuKalunga.”
Konima yaambika Jesus naalongwa ye oya yi kuJudea. Ye okwa kala ko omasiku gamwe pamwe nayo ta shasha aantu.
Johannes okwa li ta shasha puAinon, popepi naSalim, oshoka kokuma nkoka okwa li ku na omeya ogendji. Aantu oyendji oye ya kuJohannes, oye nokwe ya shasha,
oshoka Johannes okwa li ine edhililwa natango mondholongo.
Yamwe yomaalongwa yaJohannes oya tameke okuludhika nOmujuda gumwe kombinga yeyogo lyopaShijuda.
Yo oye ya kuJohannes noya ti kuye: “Muhongi, tala ko, omulumentu ngoka a li pamwe nangoye handiyaka yomulonga gwaJordan naangoka we mu hokolola, ota shasha, naantu ayehe otaa yi kuye.”
Johannes okwa yamukula a ti: “Kape na omuntu ta vulu okwiikuthila nando osha, okuninga Kalunga te shi mu pe.
One yene oonzapo dhandje, sho nda tile, ngame kandi shi Kristus, ihe onda tumwa oku mu tetekela.
Ngoka e na omufuko, oye ombushiki. Ihe kuume kombushiki ota thikama e ta pulakene nota nyanyukilwa ewi lyombushiki. Osho wo nenyanyu ndika lyandje olya gwanenena.
Oye e na okunenepala, ihe ngame ondi na okushonopala.”
“Oongoka a za pombanda, oye omunene e vule ayehe. Ngoka gwopavi, ogwopavi nota popi iinima yopavi. Ngoka a za megulu, oye omunene e vule ayehe.
Oye ta hokolola shoka a mono nokwa uvu, ihe kape na nando ogumwe ta taamba ehokololo lye.
Oongoka ta taamba ehokololo lye, ota koleke nokutya Kalunga oye Kalunga kashili.
Ngoka a tumwa kuKalunga, oye ta popi oohapu dhaKalunga; oshoka Kalunga ite mu pe Ombepo ta yeleke, ihe ote mu pe sha gwana.
He oku hole Omwana nokwe mu pa iinima ayihe miikaha ye.
Oongoka i itaala Omwana, oku na omwenyo gwaaluhe, ihe ngoka itaa vulika kOmwana, ita ka mona omwenyo, ihe ondjahi yaKalunga otayi kala kombanda ye.”
4: Aafarisayi oyu uvu kutya Jesus okwa likola nokwa shasha aalongwa oyendji ye vule mboka yaJohannes.
Nonando Jesus mwene ina shasha nando omuntu gumwe, ihe aalongwa ye oyo ya shasha.
Jesus sho u uvu shoka tashi tiwa kaantu, okwa thigi po Judea nokwa shuna kuGalilea.
Mondjila ye yokuya nkoka okwa li e na okupitila muSamaria.
Oye nokwe ya koshilando shomuSamaria, edhina lyasho Sikar, shi li popepi nepya ndyoka Jakob a pele omwana Josef.
Popepi nepya ndyoka opwa li pu na oluthithiya lwaJakob. Jesus okwa li a vulithwa kondjila nokwa kuutumba pomuthima. Otundi oya li lwopomulongo nambali yomutenya.
Omukiintu Omusamaria okwe ya komuthima okuteka omeya. Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Pe ndje wo, ndi nwe mo.”
Aalongwa ye oya adhika ya ya koshilando, ya ka landa iikulya.
Omukiintu Omusamaria okwa yamukula: “Ngoye Omujuda, ihe ngame omukiintu Omusamaria. Oto vulu tuu okwiindila ndje, ndi ku pe, u nwe?” Oshoka Aajuda nAasamaria ihaa endathana.
Jesus okwa yamukula a ti: “Ando owa li wa tseya shoka Kalunga ha gandja naanguka olye te ku indile omeya, ando ngoye owe mu indile, e ku pe omeya omanamwenyo.”
Omukiintu okwa ti kuye: “Omuwa, ngoye ku na nando oshitekitho nomuthima omule. Omeya omanamwenyo oto ga adha peni?
Ngoye omunene nani u vule tatekulu Jakob, ngoka e tu pa omuthima nguno nokwa li ha nu mo ye mwene pamwe noyana niimuna ye?”
Jesus okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Kehe ngoka ta nu omeya ngaka, ota ka sa enota natango.
Ihe shaa ngoka ta nu omeya ngoka tandi ge mu pe, oye ita ka sa we enota sigo aluhe. Oshoka omeya ngoka tandi ge mu pe, otaga ka ninga muye oluthithiya lwomeya taga fuluka sigo omomwenyo gwaaluhe.”
Omukiintu okwa ti kuye: “Omuwa, pe ndje wo omeya ngoka, opo ndaa se we enota, ngame kaandi ye we nkuka komuthima okuteka.”
Jesus okwe mu lombwele: “Inda, u ki ithane omulumentu gwoye, ngoye u ye naye nkuka.”

Omukiintu okwe mu yamukula a ti: “Kandi na omulumentu.”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Owa popi dhoshili kutya ku na omulumentu.
Oshoka ngoye owa li u na aalumentu yatano, naangoka u na ngashingeyi, ke shi omulumentu gwoye. Moshinima shoka owa popi dhoshili.”
Omukiintu okwa ti kuye: “Omuwa, ondi ku wete kutya ngoye omuhunganeki.
Ootatekulu Aasamaria oya li haa galikana Kalunga kondundu ndjika, ihe ne Aajuda ohamu ti kutya Jerusalem olyo ehala moka tu na okugalikanena.”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Nekulu, itaala ndje. Ethimbo otali ya, uuna ndoka itaamu ka galikana Tate kondundu ndjika nenge muJerusalem.
Ne Aasamaria omu shi tuu ngoka hamu mu galikana? Tse Aajuda otu shi ngoka hatu mu galikana, oshoka ehupitho otali zi mAajuda.
Ihe ethimbo otali ya noli li po ngashingeyi, uuna aagalikani yashili taa ka galikana Tate mOmbepo nomoshili. Oshoka aagalikani ya tya ngaaka oyo naanaa mboka Tate e ya hala.
Kalunga oye Ombepo, onkee naamboka taye mu galikana, oye na okugalikana mOmbepo nomoshili.”
Omukiintu okwa ti kuye: “Ondi shi shi kutya Kristus, nokutya Omugwayekwa ote ke ya. Nge te ya, ote ke tu lombwela iinima ayihe.”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Ongame naanaa nguka te popi nangoye.”
Pethimbo olyo tuu ndyoka aalongwa ye oye ya. Oya kumwa, sho ya mono Jesus ta popi nomukiintu ngoka. Ihe kapwa li nando ogumwe e mu pula: “Owa hala shike?” nenge: “Omolwashike to popi naye?”
Omukiintu okwa thigi po ihe oshuma she nokwa yi koshilando. Okwa lombwele aantu:
“Ileni, mu tale omulumentu ngoka a lombwele ndje ayihe nde yi ninga. Pamwe oye Kristus?”
Oyo oya zi mo moshilando noye ya kuJesus.
Aalongwa oya kala taa lombwele Jesus taa ti: “Muhongi, lya.”
Ihe Ye okwa yamukula a ti: “Ngame ondi na iikulya mbyoka kaamu yi shi.”
Aalongwa ye oya pulathana ihe: “Pamwe ope na ngoka e mu etele iikulya?”
Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Iikulya yandje oyo okulonga ehalo lyaanguka a tumu ndje nokutsakanitha oshilonga shoka e shi pe ndje.
“Ne ohamu ti: ‘Oku na natango oomwedhi ne, eteyo li thike.’ Ngame otandi mu lombwele: Yelutheni omeho geni, mu tale kutya omapya oga thika okuteywa.
Ngashingeyi nokuli omuteyi ota taamba ondjambi ye niilya ote yi pungulile momwenyo gwaaluhe, opo omukuni a nyanyukwe pamwe nomuteyi.
Oshoka moshinima shika ohapu oya tsa kutya: ‘Omukuni okwi ili nomuteyi okwi ili.’
Ngame onde mu tumu okuteya mpoka inaamu longa po. Yalwe oyo ya longo, ne nomwe ya okulya iiyimati yiilonga yawo.”
Oyendji yomAasamaria yomoshilando shoka oyi itaale Jesus omolwoohapu dhomukiintu, ngoka a ti: “Oye okwa lombwele ndje iinima ayihe mbyoka nde yi ninga.”
Aasamaria sho ye ya kuye, oye mu indile, a menekele puyo. Ye okwa menekele puyo omasiku gaali.
Aantu oyendji ye vule mboka yotango oyi itaale Jesus omolwoohapu dhe mwene.
Yo noya lombwele omukiintu: “Tse otwi itaala, hamolwoohapu dhoye, ihe omolwashoka twe mu uvu tse yene notu shi shi, oye lela omuhupithi guuyuni.”
Omasiku ngoka gaali sho ga piti po, Jesus okwa zi ko nkoka nokwa yi kuGalilea.
Oshoka Jesus mwene okwa ti: “Omuhunganeki iha simanekwa moshilongo shaandjawo.”
Ano Jesus sho a thiki kuGalilea, Aagalilea oye mu taamba, oshoka nayo wo oya li moshituthi shOpaasa muJerusalem noya mono ashihe shoka a ningi pethimbo lyoshituthi.
Jesus okwe ya ishewe muKana, oshilando shomuGalilea, moka a li a shitukitha omeya ga ninge omaviinu. MuKapernaum omwa li mu na elenga lyontumba lyomukwaniilwa li na omwana omumati ta alukwa.
Sho lya kundana kutya Jesus okwa zi ko kuJudea e ya kuGalilea, olya yi kuye oku mu indila, e ye kuKapernaum, a aludhe omwana, oshoka okwa li e li pokusa.
Jesus okwe mu lombwele a ti: “Ngele itamu mono iikumithalonga niilongankondo, itamu itaale.”
Elenga olya ti kuye: “Omuwa, ila, manga omumwandje inaa sa!”

Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Inda, omumwoye oku na omwenyo.”
Omulumentu okwi itaale oohapu dhaJesus e dhi mu lombwele nokwa yi.
Mondjila ye yokushuna kegumbo aamati ye oye mu tsakaneke noye mu lombwele kutya omwana oku na omwenyo.
Okwe ya pula ethimbo, uuna a tameke okukala nawa. Yo oya ti kuye: “Ohela potundi yotango yomutenya olwiidhi olwe mu etha po.”
He okwa dhimbulukwa kutya opotundi naanaa ndjoka Jesus e mu lombwele a ti: “Omumwoye oku na omwenyo.” Oye nokwi itaale pamwe negumbo lye alihe.
Oshikumithalonga shika osho oshitiyali shoka Jesus a ningi, sho a zi kuJudea e te ya kuGalilea.
5: Konima yaambika okwa li ku na oshituthi shAajuda. Jesus okwa yi kuJerusalem.
Ano muJerusalem posheelo shoonzi opwa li pu na edhiya hali ithanwa Betesda mOshihebeli noli na oondunda ntano.
Moondunda ndhoka omwa li mwa lala ongundu onene yaavu: aaposi, iilema niitiningili. Aavu mbaka oya li ya tegelela, omeya ga nyenganyengithwe.
Oshoka pomathimbo nomathimbo omuyengeli gwOmuwa oha kulukile medhiya e ta nyenganyengitha omeya. Omuvu ngoka ta thiki tango medhiya, omeya sho ga nyenganyengithwa, ota aluka kuuvu kehe kwa li e u na.
Okwa li ku na omulumentu gumwe a li a ala oomvula omilongo ndatu nahetatu.
Jesus sho e mu mono a lala, okwa li e shi shi kutya omulumentu ngoka okwa ala ethimbo ele. Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Owa hala okwaaluka?”
Omuvu okwa yamukula: “Omuwa, kandi na ngoka ta fala ndje medhiya, uuna omeya taga nyenganyengithwa. Olwindji manga tandi kambadhala okuya mo, mukwetu gulwe ta tetekele ndje okuthika mo.”
Jesus okwa ti kuye: “Thikama, kutha ontala yoye, ngu u ende.”

Mbalambala omulumentu okwa aluka. Ye okwa kutha po ontala ye nokwa yi.
Oshinima shika osha ningwa mesiku lyEsabati.
Onkee Aajuda oya lombwele omulumentu ngoka a aludhwa ya ti: “Nena esiku lyEsabati, nompango itayi ku pitikile, u humbate ontala yoye.”
Ye okwe ya yamukula: “Omulumentu ngoka a aludha ndje, oye a lombwele ndje: ‘Kutha ontala yoye, ngu u ye.’ ”
Oyo oye mu pula: “Omulumentu olye ngono e ku lombwele kutya: ‘Kutha ontala yoye, ngu u ye?’ ”
Ihe omwaaludhwa okwa li inee mu tseya oye olye, oshoka Jesus okwa adhika a ya nale nomolwashoka wo opwa li pu na aantu oyendji.
Konima yethimbo Jesus okwe mu mono motempeli nokwa ti kuye: “Tala, ngashingeyi owa aluka. Ino yona we, opo waa adhike kuuwinayi u vule mbuka.”
Omulumentu okwa yi nokwa hokololele Aajuda kutya oJesus e mu aludha.
Omolwoshinima shika Aajuda oya tameke okutidhagana Jesus, oshoka okwa aludha omuntu mEsabati.
Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Tate ota longo aluhe, nangame wo ondi na okulonga.”
Omolwoohapu ndhika Aajuda oya tokola oku mu dhipaga, oshoka oye ina yona ashike Esabati, ihe okwa ti wo kutya Kalunga Oye He. Osho ngeyi okwi iningi e thike puKalunga.
Jesus okwa ti kuyo: “Ngame otandi mu lombwele oshili: Omwana ita vulu okuninga nando osha muye mwene. Ota longo owala shoka e wete He ta ningi. Shoka He ta longo, osho wo Omwana ta ningi.
Oshoka He oku hole Omwana note mu ulukile iinima ayihe mbyoka ye mwene ta longo. Ye note ke mu ulukila iilonga iinene yi vule mbika, opo mu kumwe.
Oshoka ngashika naanaa He ta yumudha aasi nota gandja omwenyo, osho wo Omwana ta gandja omwenyo kumboka a hala.
He ita pangula nando ogumwe, ihe epangulo alihe okwe li gandja kOmwana,
aantu ayehe opo ya simaneke Omwana, ngashika naanaa taa simaneke He. Oongoka itaa simaneke Omwana, ita vulu wo okusimaneka He, ngoka e mu tuma.
“Ngame otandi mu lombwele oshili: ngoka tu uvu oohapu dhandje noti itaale ngoka a tuma ndje, oku na omwenyo gwaaluhe. Ita pangulwa we, ihe okwa za mo nale meso nokwe ya momwenyo.
Ngame otandi mu lombwele oshili: Ethimbo otali ke ya nolye ya nale nokuli, uuna oonakusa taa ka uva ewi lyOmuna gwaKalunga. Ayehe mboka taye li uvu, otaa ka kala ye na omwenyo.
Oshoka ngashika naanaa He e li po oluthithiya lwomwenyo muye mwene, osho wo okwa pe Omwana oonkondo, a kale oluthithiya lwomwenyo muye mwene.
Okwa pe Omwana oonkondo dhokupangula, oshoka Omwana oye Omuna gwOmuntu.
Inamu kuminwa oshinima shika; oshoka ethimbo otali ya, uuna oonakusa ayehe mboka ye li moombila, taa ka uva ewi lye.
Yo notaa ka za mo moombila dhawo: mboka ya longo uuwanawa, otaa ka yumudhwa e taa kala ye na omwenyo, naamboka ya longo uuwinayi, otaa ka yumudhwa e taa ka pangulwa.”

“Ngame itandi vulu okuninga nando osha mungame mwene. Otandi pangula owala ngaashi Kalunga a lombwele ndje, nepangulo lyandje oli li mondjila. Oshoka itandi landula ehalo lyandje mwene, ihe olyaanguka a tuma ndje.”
“Ngele otandi ihokolola mwene, nena ehokololo lyandje kali shi okwiinekelwa.
Ihe oku na gulwe ngoka ta hokolola ndje. Ngame nondi shi shi kutya ehokololo ndyoka ta hokolola ndje, olyoshili.
Ne omwa tumine aatumwa yeni kuJohannes, nokwa hokolola oshili.
Ngame itandi taamba ehokololo lyomuntu, ihe otandi popi ngeyi, opo mu hupithwe.
Johannes okwa li olamba ya tema notayi minikile, ihe ne omwa li mwa hala okunyanyukilwa muuyelele we okathimbo okafupi kowala.
Ihe ngame ondi na ehokololo enene li vule ndiyaka lyaJohannes: iilonga mbyoka tandi yi longo, oombyoka nda pewa kuTate, oyo tayi hokolola ndje notayi ulike kutya Tate oye a tuma ndje.
Tate, ngoka a tuma ndje, oye mwene ta hokolola ndje. Ne inamu uva nando olumwe ewi lye, ne inamu mona ondjelo ye.
Oohapu dhe kadhi mo mune ongoshinima tashi kalelele, oshoka ne inamu itaala ngoka a tumwa kuye.
Ne otamu konakona mOmanyolo, oshoka otamu dhiladhila kutya mugo omo tamu mono omwenyo gwaaluhe. Omanyolo ngoka ogo naanaa taga hokolola ndje.
Ne inamu hala okuya kungame, opo mu kale mu na omwenyo.
“Ngame itandi kongo esimano lyaantu.
Ihe ngame ondi mu shi kutya kamu na ohole yokuhola Kalunga moomwenyo dheni.
Ngame onde ya medhina lyaTate, ne noinamu taamba ndje. Ngele taku zi gulwe i ili te ya molwe mwene, ne otamu mu taamba.
Otamu vulu ngiini okwiitaala, ne mboka hamu simanekathana, ihe esimano ndyoka tali zi kuKalunga awike, ihamu li kongo.
Inamu dhiladhila kutya ongame tandi ke mu lya ko kuTate. Moses oye te ke mu lya ko, Moses tuu ngoka mwe mu inekela.
Oshoka ando omwa li mwi itaala shili Moses, ando nangame wo omwi itaala ndje. Oshoka Moses okwa nyola ta hokolola ndje.
