Nani ompango oya tsa ondumbo nomauvaneko gaKalunga? Aawe, itashi vulika! Oshoka ando okwa gandjelwe ompango ndjoka yi na oonkondo okupa aantu omwenyo, nena ando omuntu ota vulu okuninga omuyuuki koshipala shaKalunga omolwompango.
Ihe enyolo otali ti kutya uuyuni auhe ou li kohi yoonkondo dhuulunde, opo mboka yi itaala, ya pewe eyambeko ndyoka lyu uvanekwa, sho yi itaala Jesus Kristus.
Ihe manga ethimbo lyeitaalo lya li inaali ya, tse otwa li twe edhililwa mondholongo kompango ongoonkwatwa, sigo eitaalo lya hololwa.
Osho ngeyi ompango oya kala omuputudhi gwetu, sigo Kristus e ya, opo tu ningwe aayuuki koshipala shaKalunga omolweitaalo.
Onkee ano ngashingeyi sho tu na ethimbo lyeitaalo, otse katu li we melelo lyomuputudhi.
One amuhe aana yaKalunga muukumwe naKristus Jesus omolweitaalo.
Oshoka sho mwa shashwa, omwa yi muukumwe naJesus Kristus nomwa zala uukwatya waKristus mwene.
Onkee ano kape na we eyooloko pokati kOmujuda nomupagani, komupika nomuvalwa, komulumentu nomukiintu, ihe ne amuhe gumwe muukumwe naJesus Kristus.
One ngele oyaKristus, nena one aana yaAbraham notamu ka pewa shoka Kalunga e shi uvaneka.
4: Ihe ngame otandi ti: Omuvalwa manga omunona, ina yooloka nomupika, nonando na kale oye mwene guuthiga auhe wahe.
Manga e li omushona, ohapu kala aantu mboka taye mu sile oshimpwiyu notaa tonatele iinima ye sigo ethimbo ndyoka lyu uthwa kuhe.
Pamukalo nguka natse wo manga twa li aanona, otwa li twa pikwa koombepo dhomewangandjo sigo esiku ndyoka twa adha uukuluntu.
Ihe ethimbo lyo opala sho lya thikana, Kalunga okwa tumu Omwana. Oye okwa valwa komukiintu nokwa kala kohi yompango yAajuda,
a vule okumangulula mboka ya kala kohi yompango, opo tse tu ninge aana yaKalunga.
Kalunga opo u ulike kutya otse oyana, okwe tu pe Ombepo yOmwana moomwenyo dhetu, Ombepo ndjoka tayi igidha: “Tate, Tate!”
Onkee ano kamu shi we aapika, ihe aavalwa. Onkee molwaashoka one oyana, nena Kalunga ote ke mu pa ashihe shoka e shi nine aathigululi ye.
Nale omwa li inaamu tseya Kalunga, onkee omwa li mwa pikwa kiikalunga kaayi shi ookalunga muukwatya wayo.

Ihe ngashingeyi sho mwa tseya Kalunga, nenge ndi tye, ngashingeyi sho mwa tseyika kuKalunga, otamu vulu ngiini okwiigameka ishewe koombepo ndhoka tadhi pangele mewangandjo nodhaa na oshilonga? Omolwashike mwa hala ishewe okuninga aapika yadho?
One ohamu yoolola omasiku gontumba, oomwedhi, omathimbo gomumvo nomimvo.
Onda tila omolweni. Iilonga yandje ayihe mokati keni oya ningi osima yowala?
Aamwameme, otandi mu indile, ituleni pehala lyandje, ngashika nangame wo tandi itula pehala lyeni. Ne inamu ningila ndje uuwinayi nando owasha.
Ne otamu dhimbulukwa kutya omoluunkundi wandje wokolutu onde mu uvithile tango evaangeli.
Ihe ne inamu dhina ndje noinamu huga ndje, nonando onkalo yolutu lwandje oya li eyeleko enene kune. Ihe omwa taamba ndje, ngashika tamu taamba omuyengeli gwaKalunga nenge Jesus Kristus mwene nokuli.
One omwa li mwa nyanyukwa unene. Oshike ano sha ningwa po? Ngame mwene otandi vulu oku shi mu lombwela kutya ando sha li tashi vulika, ando omwa kolola mo omeho geni e tamu ga pe ndje.
Ano ngashingeyi onda ningi omutondi gweni, sho nde mu hokololele oshili?
Aantu yamwe mboka oya hwama unene omolweni, ihe elalakano lyawo kali shi ewanawa. Oyo oya hala oku mu tokola ko kungame, opo mu ya ningile ngaashi yo ye mu ningile.
Aluhe osho opala okuhwamena oshinima oshiwanawa, hauna ndoka ashike ndi li pune.
Aamwameme aaholike, ngashika naanaa omukiintu e li muuwehame wokuvala, osho wo nangame ndi uvite uuwehame omolweni, sigo ondjelo yaKristus ya tungwa mune.
Onda halele ando ondi li pune ngashingeyi, opo ndi popye nane newi li ili. Ondi li po ndu uvite uudhigu omolweni.
Lombwelii ndje ano, ne mboka mwa hala okukala kohi yompango: Inamu uva nani ompango shoka tayi ti?
Ompango otayi ti kutya Abraham okwa li e na oyana aamati yaali, gumwe omuna gwomudhike nomukwawo omuna gwomuhokanwa.
Omuna gwomudhike okwa li a valwa pamukalo gwopanshitwe, ihe omuna gwomuhokanwa omolwoonkondo dheuvaneko lyaKalunga.
Ehokololo ndika olyo eyele. Aakiintu mbaka yaali oyo omahangano gaali. Ehangano limwe oondyoka lyokondundu yaSinai hali vala aapika, olyo Hagar.
Oshoka Hagar oye ondundu yaSinai yi li muArabia. Oye efano lyoshilando shaJerusalem shopethimbo ndika, shoka shi li muupika pamwe naantu yamo ayehe.
Ihe Jerusalem shomegulu osho omukiintu omuhokanwa, meme yetu.

Oshoka enyolo otali ti:
“Nyanyukwa, ngoye nguka ihoo vala!
Ligola nokwiigidha pombanda, ngoye nguka inoo thetwa nando olumwe!
Oshoka omukiintu ngoka e ethiwa ota ka kala e na aanona oyendji
ye vule yaangoka e na omulumentu.”
Aamwameme, nane wo aana yaKalunga omolweuvaneko lye, ngashika naanaa Isak a li.
Pomasiku ngeyaka omunona ngoka a valwa pamukalo gwopanshitwe, okwa tidhagana mukwawo ngoka a valwa koonkondo dhOmbepo yaKalunga. Osho shi li po nonena.
Ihe enyolo otali ti ngiini? Otali ti: “Laleka omudhike nomwana, oshoka omuna gwomudhike ita vulu okutopola uuthiga nomuna gwomuhokanwa.”
Onkee ano, aamwameme, tse katu shi aana yomudhike, ihe otse aana yomuhokanwa.
5: Kristus okwe tu mangulula, opo tu kale twa manguluka. Ikoleleni ano, oshoka omwa manguluka, ne inamu zimina we, mu ninge aapika.
Pulakeneni! Ongame Paulus tandi mu lombwele kutya one ngele otamu zimine, mu fukalekwe, nena otashi ti Kristus ke na shoka te mu kwatha.
Onda hala oku shi tumbula natango nomuthindo kutya kehe ngoka ta zimine a fukalekwe, oye oku na okugwanitha ompango ayihe.
Ne mboka mwa hala okuninga aayuuki koshipala shaKalunga omolwokugwanitha ompango, omwi ikutha mo ne yene muKristus. One omwa gwa mo mesilohenda lyaKalunga.
Ihe tse etegameno lyetu olyo ndika kutya Kalunga ote ke tu ninga aayuuki, onkee otatu shi tegelele meitaalo koonkondo dhOmbepo yaKalunga.
Oshoka tse ngele otu li muukumwe naKristus Jesus, nena okukala wa fukalekwa nenge inoo fukalekwa, ayihe mbika itayi kwatha sha. Ihe shoka tashi kwatha, osho eitaalo ndyoka tali holoka mohole.
One omwa li hamu matuka nawa, mu sindane. Olye e mu ethitha okuvulika koshili? Oye okwe mu hongolola nashike?
Ehongololo ndyoka inali za kuKalunga, ngoka te mu ithana.
Okafulika okashona otaka tumbike ondombo ayihe.
Ihe omoluukumwe wetu nOmuwa ngame onde mu inekela kutya ne itamu ka taamba edhiladhilo lilwe. Omuntu ngoka te mu piyaganeke, ota ka geelwa kuKalunga, na kale oye lye.

Ihe ngame, aamwameme, omolwashike ando tandi tidhaganwa natango, ngele tandi uvitha kutya efukaleko olya pumbiwa? Shika ngele oshoshili, nena ando euvitho lyandje kombinga yomushigakano gwaKristus itali eta we uudhigu.
Ando aalumentu mboka taye mu piyaganeke, yi ithonithe nokuli!
Ne aamwameme, omwi ithanwa, mu kale mwa manguluka. Ihe inamu etha, emanguluko ndika lyeni li ninge ompito yuuhalu wopantu, ihe yakulathaneni nohole.
Oshoka ompango ayihe oya kwatelelwa moshipango shika shimwe: “Hola mukweni, ngaashi wi ihole ngoye mwene.”
Ihe ngele tamu kala ngaashi iilikama, tamu lyaathana ne tamu etelathana iiponga, kotokeni ano, opo mwaa manathane po.
Ngame otandi mu lombwele tandi ti: Kaleni tamu endithwa kOmbepo mokukalamwenyo kweni akuhe. Nena itamu ka gwanitha we uuhalu wopantu.

Oshoka uuhalu wetu wopantu itau tsu kumwe naashoka Ombepo e shi hala. Naashoka sha halika kOmbepo, itashi tsu kumwe nuuhalu wopantu. Iinima mbika iyali ohayi kala aluhe tayi kondjithathana, onkee itamu vulu okulonga pahalo lyeni yene.
Ihe one ngele tamu endithwa kOmbepo, nena itamu pangelwa we kompango.
Ihe iilonga yuuhalu wopantu oyi igalala. Aantu oye hole uuholume, iipala nuukeeneidhiliko,
otaa simaneke iimenka notaa longo muumpulile. Oyo otaa tondathana, otaa tamanana, otaa silathana efupa, otaa geelathana notaa kotokelathana. Oyo otaa topoka moongundu nomiimpaga.

Oye na uukodhi, uunkolwi nuufukedhi niinima iikwawo ya fa mbika. Otandi mu kumagidha natango, ngaashi nda li nde mu kumagidha nale: Aantu mboka taa longo iilonga ya tya ngeyi, itaa ka thigulula Oshilongo shaKalunga.
Ihe iiyimati yOmbepo oyo mbika: ohole, enyanyu, ombili, eidhidhimiko, uukuume, uuwanawa, okukala omwiinekelwa,
eifupipiko neikwatonawa. Kaku na nando ompango ya tsa ondumbo niinima mbika.
Naamboka yaJesus Kristus oya dhipaga okukala kwawo kwopantu nuuhalu auhe.
Ombepo otayi tu pe omwenyo, onkee oyo nayi kale tayi utha wo okukalamwenyo kwetu.
Inatu kaleni tu na uuntsa, tu hindathaneni nenge tu silathaneni efupa.
6: Aamwameme, ngele oku na ngoka ta gwile meyono lyontumba, nena aantu mboka yomokati keni yopambepo naye mu pukulule; ihe naye shi ninge nonge. Kala wa kotoka, opo nangoye wo waa hongololwe.
Kwathathaneni mokuhumbata omitenge. Osho ngeyi otamu gwanitha ompango yaKristus.
Ngele oku na ngoka ta dhiladhila kutya oye sha, nando ke shi sha, oti ifundjaleke.
Kehe gumwe na konakone ye mwene, iilonga ye nkene ya tya. Iilonga ye ngele iiwanawa, nena ota vulu okwiitangela shoka e shi longo, ihe ita vulu okuyelekanitha iilonga ye niilonga yamukwawo.
Oshoka kehe gumwe oku na okuhumbata ye mwene omutenge gwe.
Omuntu ngoka ta longwa oohapu dhaKalunga, oku na okutopola iinima ayihe iiwanawa mbyoka e yi na nomulongi gwe.
Inamu ifundjaleka, Kalunga iha nyekelwa. Oshoka shono omuntu te shi kunu, osho wo ta ka teya.
Ngele okwa kunu pauhalu we, nena eteyo olyo eso, ihe ngele okwa kunu mOmbepo, nena ota ka teya omwenyo gwaaluhe mOmbepo.
Ano inatu vulweni okulonga uuwanawa, oshoka ngele itatu seni uunye, nena ethimbo otali ke ya, uuna tatu ka teya iiyimati.
Onkee ano manga tu na ethimbo, natu ningileni kehe gumwe uuwanawa, ihe unene tuu mboka tu li nayo meitaalo limwe.
Taleni, nkene tandi mu nyolele noshikaha shandje mwene moondanda oonene.

Aantu ayehe mboka ya hala okwiisimanekela nokwiitangela iinima yi wetike, oyo wo mboka taa kambadhala oku mu thiminika, mu ifukalekithe. Oyo otaye shi ningi ashike, opo kaaya hepekelwe omushigakano gwaKristus.
Nokuli naamboka haa longitha efukaleko, nayo wo ihaa vulika kompango. Ihe oyo oya hala ashike, ne mu ifukalekithe, opo ya wape okwiitanga kutya oye mu vulikitha.
Ihe ngame kombinga yandje otandi itangele ashike omushigakano gwOmuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus. Oshoka mugwo uuyuni owa kwatunuka ko kungame, nangame onda kwatunuka ko kuwo.
Itashi kwatha nando osha okukala wa fukalekwa nenge inoo fukalekwa. Shoka ashike tashi kwatha, osho okuninga omushitwa omupe.
Ombili nohenda nayi kale naayehe mboka taa landula eutho ndika mokukalamwenyo kwawo, yo nayi kale naantu yaKalunga ayehe.
Inaku kala we nando oongoka te etele ndje uudhigu washa. Oshoka iiyadhi mbyoka ndi yi na kolutu lwandje, otayi ulike kutya ngame omupika gwaJesus.
Esilohenda lyOmuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus nali kale nane, aamwameme amuhe. Amen.

1:
Ontumwafo ndjika oya zi kuPaulus, omuyapostoli gwaJesus pahalo lyaKalunga.
Oya nyolelwa aantu yaKalunga ye li muEfeso, mboka aainekelwa mekwatathano lyawo naJesus Kristus.
Silweni ohenda, ne mu kale mu na ombili yaKalunga Tate noyOmuwa Jesus Kristus.
Kalunga, He yOmuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus, na hambelelwe! Oye tuu ngoka e tu laleke nuuyamba muukumwe naKristus, sho e tu pe omagano agehe gopambepo taga zi megulu.
Kalunga sho e tu hole, okwe tu hogolola nale molwaKristus, manga uuyuni inaau shitwa, tu kale aayapuki twaa na oshipo koshipala she.
Oye okwa kala e shi nuna nale kutya ote ke tu taamba, tu ninge oyana omolwaJesus Kristus. Shika osho enyanyu nelalakano lye.
Onkee Kalunga na hambelelwe omoluuwindji wesilohenda lye nomolwomagano agehe ngoka e ge tu pa mOmwana omuholike.
Oshoka tse otwa mangululwa notwa dhiminwa po oondjo dhetu omolweso lyaKristus. Esilohenda lyaKalunga ekumithi ngiini!
Esilohenda ndika Kalunga okwe li tu pa olindji, li ninge oondunge nuunongo wetu miinima ayihe.
Kalunga okwa ningi shoka a kala nale a hala oku shi longa nokwe tu hololele oshiholekwa shoka a li a hala oku shi tu hololela muKristus.
Kalunga oku uvaneke okutsakanitha edhiladhilo lye pethimbo lyo opala. Oye ota ka hanganitha eshito alihe, nokutya ayihe yomegulu noyokombanda yevi otayi ka tulwa kumwe nomutse, Kristus.
Oshoka ayihe oya ningwa pamadhiladhilo nopatokolo lyaKalunga. Kalunga okwe tu hogolola molwaKristus, tu ninge aantu ye, ongaashi e shi tokola nale okuza petameko.
Onkee ano tu tangeni esimano lyaKalunga, oshoka otse aatango mboka twa kala tu na etegameno muKristus.

Nane wo sho mu uvu ohapu yoshili, elaka etoye ndyoka lye mu etele ehupitho, omwi itaale Kristus. Kalunga nokwe mu tula oshihako shoku mu ndhindhilika kutya mwa ningi aantu ye, sho e mu pe Ombepo Ondjapuki ngoka e mu uvanekela.
Ombepo oye okapilo kutya tse otatu ka pewa shoka Kalunga e shi uvanekela aantu ye. Ombepo ote tu tsu omukumo, tu inekele kutya Kalunga ota ka mangulula aantu ye. Tu tangeni ano esimano lye!
Onkee ano ngame sho ndu uvu, nkene mwi itaala Omuwa Jesus nohole yeni yokuhola aantu yaKalunga ayehe,
inandi etha we okuhambelela Kalunga omolweni. Ngame ohandi mu dhimbulukwa aluhe momagalikano gandje
nohandi indile Tate a simana, Kalunga He yOmuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus, e mu pe Ombepo ngoka te mu pe oondunge note mu hololele Kalunga, opo mu kale mu mu shi.
Ngame otandi galikana, oondunge dheni dhi wape okumona uuyelele waKalunga, opo mu tseye onkalo yetegameno ndyoka e li mu ithanena, eudhililo lyomayambeko ngoka e ga uvanekela aantu ye,
nuuwindji woonkondo ndhoka tadhi longo mutse ooitaali.
Oonkondo ndhoka Kalunga e dhi longitha, sho a yumudha Jesus Kristus kuusi nokwe mu kuutumbike kolulyo lwe megulu.
Oko nkoka Kristus ta pangele aapangeli ayehe yomegulu, aaleli aanankondo naawa. Oye oku vule aanamadhina ayehe aanankondo yomuuyuni mbuka naambwiyaka tau ya.
Onkee Kalunga okwa tula iinima ayihe mepangelo lyaKristus nokwe mu ningi omutse gwegongalo nogwiinima ayihe.
Egongalo olyo olutu lwaKristus nolyo egwanopo lyaKristus, ngoka u udhitha iinima ayihe.
2: Nale omwa li mwa sa pambepo omolwokwaavulika kweni kuKalunga nomolwoondjo dheni.
Pethimbo ndiyaka omwa landula oondjila oombwinayi dhuuyuni mbuka. Omwa vulika komupangeli gwoonkondo dhombepo yomewangandjo, ombepo ndjoka tayi pangele ngashingeyi aantu mboka ihaa vulika kuKalunga.

Eeno, tseni atuheni osho twa li twe ya fa. Otwa landula uuhalu wuuntu wetu notwa longo shaa shoka sho opalela uuhalu womomalutu getu nowomadhiladhilo getu. Ngashika naanaa aantu yalwe ayehe, natse wo panshitwe yetu otwa li twi ilongela egeelo lyaKalunga.
Ihe Kalunga, nguka u udha esilohenda omolwohole ye onene, sho e tu hole,
okwe tu tula omwenyo pamwe naKristus. Okwe shi tu ningile, manga twa li twa sa pambepo omolwokwaavulika kwetu kuye. Ne omwa hupithwa kesilohenda lyaKalunga.
Muukumwe wetu naKristus Jesus, Kalunga okwe tu yumudha kuusi pamwe naKristus, opo tu wape okupangela pamwe naye megulu.
Oye okwe shi ningi, opo a holole sigo okomathimbo ngoka tage ke ya uuwindji wesilohenda lye nowohole ye ndjoka e yi tu hololele muJesus Kristus.
Oshoka omwa hupithwa kesilohenda lyaKalunga keitaalo. Ehupitho ndika inali za mune yene, aawe, olyo omagano gaKalunga.
Mpaka kape na sha shokwiitangela, oshoka shika inashi za moonkambadhala dheni.
Kalunga oye omushiti gwetu, onkee muukumwe naKristus Jesus oye okwe tu shiti, tu kale tu na iilonga iiwanawa mokukalamwenyo kwetu. Iilonga mbyoka Kalunga okwe yi tu uthila nale, tu yi longe.

One aapagani kevalo. Aajuda ohaa ti kutya inamu fukalekwa, manga yo haa iti, oya fukalekwa nokuulika kefukaleko ndyoka aalumentu yo yene haa li ningi niikaha yawo komalutu gawo. Dhimbulukweni shoka mwa li mwa tya omathimbo ngoka ga piti.

Pethimbo ndiyaka omwa li mwaa na Kristus. One omwa li aakwiilongo nokamwa li yomongundu yaahogololwa yaKalunga. One omwa li mwaa na oshitopolwa mehangano ndyoka lyi ikwatelela komauvaneko ngoka Kalunga e ga uvanekela aantu ye. One omwa li mwa kala muuyuni mbuka mwaa na etegameno nomwaa na Kalunga.
Ihe ngashingeyi muukumwe naKristus Jesus, ne mboka mwa kala shito yokokule, omwe etwa popepi omolweso lyaKristus.
Oshoka Kristus oye mwene e tu etele ombili, sho a hanganitha Aajuda naapagani, ya ninge oshigwana shimwe. Nolutu lwe mwene okwa kumuna po ekuma lya li pokati kawo, tashi ti, etondathano.
Oye okwa hanagula po ompango yAajuda pamwe niipango yawo, opo a shite momihoko ndhika adhihe mbali oshigwana shimwe oshipe muukumwe naye mwene moku ya paathanitha ombili.
Kristus sho a si komushigakano, okwa hanagula po etondathano. Koonkondo dhomushigakano gwe okwa hanganitha omihoko adhihe mbali, dhi ninge olutu lumwe. Osho ngeyi okwe ya galulile kuKalunga.
Onkee ano okwe ya noku uvithile aantu ayehe elaka etoye lyombili. Oye okwe li mu uvithile, ne aapagani mboka mwa li mwa kala shito kokule naKalunga nosho wo Aajuda mboka ya li shito popepi naye.
OmolwaKristus tseni atuheni, Aajuda naapagani, otu na ompito okuhedha koshipala shaTate Kalunga koonkondo dhOmbepo tuu ngoka gumwe.
Onkee ano ne aapagani, kamu shi we oondjendi nenge aakwiilongo, aawe, ngashingeyi omu na uukwashilongo umwe naantu yaKalunga nomwa ningi aanegumbo lye.
Nane wo omwa tungilwa kekankameno hoka ku na aayapostoli naahunganeki, naahoka Jesus Kristus mwene e li ko emanya lyokolonela.
Oye ta kwatakanitha etungo alihe kumwe note li kokeke, sigo tali ningi otempeli ondjapuki mOmuwa.
Muukumwe naKristus nane wo otamu tungilwa mumwe nooyakweni ayehe yalwe, mu ninge egumbo moka Kalunga ta kala mo nOmbepo ye.
3: Onkee ngame Paulus, ngoka ndi li onkwatwa molwaJesus Kristus ngashingeyi peha lyeni aapagani, ohandi galikana Kalunga.
Ondi inekela, omu uva kutya Kalunga okwa pe ndje molwesilohenda lye oshilonga shika shelelo lyegumbo lye, ndi shi longe omoluuwanawa weni.
Eeno, Kalunga okwa holola oshiholekwa she nokwa tseyithile ndje memoniko, ngashika naanaa nda li nde mu nyolele nale pafupi kombinga yoshinima shika.
Nongele otamu lesha shoka nda nyola, nena otamu ka koneka kutya ngame ondu uvite ko oshiholekwa shika shaKristus.
Oshiholekwa shika osha kala sha holekwa aantu yomapipi ngoka ga piti, ihe ngashingeyi Kalunga okwe shi hololele aayapostoli naahunganeki ye aayapuki mOmbepo Ondjapuki.

Oshiholekwa osho shika kutya omolwevaangeli aapagani oye na oshitopolwa momayambeko gaKalunga pamwe nAajuda. Oyo ayehe iilyo yolutu lumwe noye na wo oshitopolwa momauvaneko ngoka Kalunga e ga uvaneka muJesus Kristus.
Ngame onda ningi omuyakuli gwevaangeli pamagano gesilohenda lyaKalunga, ngoka e ga pe ndje pakulonga kwoonkondo dhe.
Ngame tuu nguka, omufupi ndi vulike kaantu yaKalunga ayehe, onda pewa kesilohenda, ndi uvithile aapagani elaka etoye lyuuyamba waKristus waa shi kuyelekwa,
nondi tseyithile aantu ayehe oshiholekwa shika shaKalunga kutya otashi ti ngiini. Kalunga, omushiti gwiinima ayihe, okwa li a kaleke oshiholekwa shika sha holama uule womathimbo agehe ngoka ga piti,
opo pethimbo ndika lyongashingeyi egongalo li tseyithile aapangeli yomaayengeli naanankondo yomegulu uunongo waKalunga momalupe gawo agehe gi ili nogi ili.
Kalunga okwe shi ningi palalakano lye lya kala po aluhe, ndyoka e li gwanitha muKristus Jesus, Omuwa gwetu.
Muukumwe naye nomolweitaalo lyetu oku mu itaala, tse otu na ompito okuhedha koshipala shaKalunga neinekelo lya kola.
Onkee otandi mu kumagidha, mwaa se uunye, oshoka ngame otandi hepekwa molweni; ashihe otashi ningwa omoluuwanawa weni.
Onkee ano otandi tsu oongolo koshipala shaTate,
kungoka kwa za edhina tate mezimo kehe lyomegulu nolyokombanda yevi.
Ngame otandi galikana Kalunga omoluunene wesimano lye, e mu pe oonkondo tadhi zi mOmbepo ye, opo mu wape okukala mwa kola kombinga yomuntu gweni gwomeni.
Kristus na tunge egumbo lye momitima dheni keitaalo. Otandi mu galikanene, mu kale mu na omidhi nekankameno mohole,
ne mu wape pamwe naantu yaKalunga ayehe okuuva ko uumbwalangandja nuunene, uule wopombanda nuule womohi wohole yaKristus.
Eeno, tseyeni ohole ye, nonando itayi vulu okutseyika thiluthilu, e tamu kala ihe mu udhithwa egwano alihe lyaKalunga.
Kalunga sho ta longo noonkondo ndhoka dhi li mutse, ota vulu okulonga oshindji shi vulithe pushoka tatu shi indile nenge tatu shi dhiladhila.
Oye na simanekwe megongalo nomuKristus Jesus uule womathimbo agehe aluhe sigo aluhe! Amen.
4: Ngame ngoka nda kwatwa molwaashoka tandi longele Omuwa, otandi mu kumagidha kutya okweenda kweni naku kale kwo opalathana neithano ndyoka Kalunga e mu ithana nalyo.
Kaleni aluhe aaifupipiki, aatalanteni naaidhidhimiki. Hololeni ohole yeni mokuyakulathana.
Ningeni ashihe shoka tamu vulu okukoleka uukumwe weni wOmombepo Ondjapuki omolwombili ndjoka tayi mu mangele kumwe.
Olutu olumwe nOmbepo oyimwe, ngashika naanaa etegameno ndyoka Kalunga e mu ithanena, olimwe.
Omuwa ogumwe, eitaalo olimwe neshasho olimwe.
Kalunga ogumwe, He yaantu ayehe, ngoka Omuwa gwaayehe nota longo mwaayihe noku li mwaayihe.
Kehe gumwe gwomutse Kalunga okwe mu pa omagano gasha opandjele yokugandja kwaKristus.
Ihe otashi ti ngiini, oye okwa londo a yi pombanda? Otashi ti, oye okwa kuluka tango, nokutya a kulukile muule womeni lyevi.
Ano ngoka a kuluka, oye tuu a londo a yi megulu, opo a udhithe ewangandjo alihe nokukalapo kwe.
Oye wo ngoka a pe aantu omagano. Oye oku utha, yamwe ya ninge aayapostoli, yamwe aahunganeki, yamwe aayuvithi, yamwe aasita nayamwe aalongihapu.
Oye okwe shi ningi, a longekidhile aantu yaKalunga ayehe oshilonga sheyakulo lyopakriste, okutunga olutu lwaKristus.
Natseni atuheni tatu hangana kumwe muukumwe womeitaalo lyetu nomontseyo yetu okutseya Omuna gwaKalunga. Otatu ka ninga ihe aakuluntu twa koka, twa thika kegwano lyuukuluntu waKristus.
Nena otse itatu kala we aanona haa tengatengithwa nohaa alaalithwa kombepo kehe yomalongo gaantu aafundja, mboka taa pukitha yakwawo noku ya tegela oomwigo.
Ihe mokupopya oshili tayi pangelwa kohole, otu na okukoka muKristus, ngoka e li omutse.

Mewiliko lye iilyo ayihe yolutu yi ili noyi ili otayi kwatathana kumwe nolutu aluhe lwa kwatelwa kumwe koluthipa kehe ndoka lu li molutu. Onkee oshilyo kehe pehala lyasho ngele tashi longo, ngashika shi na okulonga, nena olutu aluhe otalu koko notalu itungu lwo lwene e talu kala talu pangelwa kohole.
Medhina lyOmuwa otandi mu lombwele ihe oshinima shika noku mu kumagidha kutya, inamu enda we ngashika aapagani, mboka taa ende muugoya womadhiladhilo gawo.
Omadhiladhilo gawo oga sa komilema. Kalunga ite ya pe omwenyo, oshoka kaye na oondunge noyi ikukutika.
Oyo ihaa si ohoni. Otaa iyethele yo yene moonyata dhuulunde kaaye na eidhiliko noyaa na nando onge.
Ihe ne inamu longwa okutseya Kristus pamukalo gwa tya ngaaka.
Ondi inekela, omwe mu uvu, naasho mu li aalanduli ye, omwa longwa oshili ndjoka yi li muJesus.
Ano ihuleni omuntu gweni omukulu ngoka mwe mu landula nale, ngoka hi iyono po ye mwene mokwiifundjaleka nuuhalu we.
Omitima dheni nomadhiladhilo geni naga shituluke lela, ga ninge omape.
Zaleni omuntu omupe ngoka a shitwa a fa Kalunga nohi iholola ye mwene mokukalamwenyo ku uka nokwa yapuka.
Onkee ano etheni iifundja. Ihe kehe gumwe na lombwele mukwawo oshili, oshoka tse atuhe iilyo yolutu lwaKristus.
Ngele tamu geye, inamu etha ondjahi yeni yi mu fale sigo omokuyona; inamu kala mwa geya esiku alihe.
Inamu pa omuhindadhi ompito, e mu sinde.
Omufuthi na ethe po okuyaka kwe, ye a tameke okwiilongela sha pamukalo omwaanawa, ye a vule ihe okukala e na sha okukwatha oohepele.
Inamu popya oohapu oombwinayi. Popyeni ashike oohapu ndhoka oombwanawa tadhi tungu nodha pumbiwa, opo aapulakeni yeni ye dhi hokwe.

Ombepo Ondjapuki yaKalunga inamu yi nikitha uuthigwa, oshoka oyo oshihako shaKalunga shoku mu ndhindhilika kutya mwa ningi aantu ye, okapilo koku mu tsa omukumo kutya esiku otali ke ya, uuna ndoka Kalunga te ke mu mangulula.
Etheni ano uululu auhe, ondjahi nonkone, omakudhilo nenge omatukano, uuwinayi kehe nau mu kale kokule.
Ihe kalathaneni mu na uukuume nolukeno. Silathaneni ohenda nokudhiminathana po oondjo, ngashika naanaa Kalunga e mu dhimine po oondjo dheni molwaKristus.
5: Kambadhaleni ano okuholela Kalunga, oshoka one oyana aaholike.
Okukalamwenyo kweni naku kale taku pangelwa kohole, ngashika Kristus a li e tu hole e ta gandja omwenyo gwe omolwetu, gu ninge eyambo lya nika nawa nolyo opalela Kalunga.
One aantu yaKalunga, onkee itashi vulika, mokati keni tamu uvika oluhondelo niilonga ya nyata yoludhi kehe nolwiho.
Osho wo inashi opala, ngele ne otamu popi oohapu tadhi sitha ohoni, omategu guugoya nenge oohapu dha nyata, shila omahambelelo okuhambelela Kalunga.

Ndhindhilikeni ihe nawa oshinima shika: kape na ando omuhondeli nenge omuntu kehe e li muulunde nenge omunalwiho, oshoka olwiho olwo okusimaneka iimenka, ta ka kala e na oshitopolwa mOshilongo shaKristus noshaKalunga.
Inamu etha, mu pukithwe nando okomuntu gumwe noohapu dhuugoya, oshoka omolwiinima ya tya ngaaka, ondjahi yaKalunga otayi ka adha aantu mboka ihaa vulika kuye.
Ano inamu kala mu na ekwatathano naantu ya tya ngaaka.
Nale omwa li aantu yomomilema, ihe ngashingeyi sho mwa ningi aantu yOmuwa, one omu li muuyelele. Onkee ano kaleni ngashika aantu yomuuyelele.
Oshoka uuyelele owo otau eta eteyo olindji ngashika uuwanawa, uuyuuki noshili.
Kambadhaleni okwiilonga okutseya shoka sho opalela Omuwa.
Inamu kala mu na ekwatathano naantu mboka haa longo iilonga yaa fele yomomilema. Ihe hololeni iinima ya tya ngaaka puuyelele.
Oshoka okutumbula iinima mbyoka haa ningi meholamo, osho ohoni yowala.
Ihe uuna iinima ayihe tayi ka hololwa puuyelele, nena uukwatya wayo otau ka kala puuyelele.

Oshoka shaa shoka sha hololwa puuyelele, otashi kala sha yela. Onkee ano otaku tiwa:
“Penduka, ngoye ngoka wa kotha, za mo meso!
Kristus note ku minikile.”
Ikonakoneni ano nawa, nkene mu na okukala. Inamu kala ngashika omagoya, kaleni ngaashi aanandunge.
Longitheni nawa ethimbo kehe mu li na, oshoka omasiku ngaka omawinayi.
Inamu kala ano omagoya, ihe kambadhaleni okukonakona kutya Omuwa okwa hala, mu ninge shike.
Inamu kolwa komaviinu, oshoka uunkolwi otau mu etele oshiponga, ihe udheni Ombepo Ondjapuki.
Hokololelathaneni oohapu dhomapisalomi, omaimbilo noondjimbo oondjapuki dhopambepo. Imbileni Omuwa omaimbilo nomapisalomi, mu simanekeni momitima dheni.
Hambeleleni aluhe Kalunga Tate molwaayihe medhina lyOmuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus.
Ilongeni evuliko mokati keni omolwetilo lyeni okutila Kristus.
Aakiintu, vulikeni kaalumentu yeni, ngaashi hamu vulika kOmuwa.
Oshoka omulumentu oku na epitikilo okupangela omukiintu gwe, naanaa ngashika Kristus e na epitikilo okupangela egongalo lye. Nokuli Kristus ye mwene oye Omuhupithi gwegongalo lye, nokutya olutu lwe.
Osho ngeyi aakiintu oye na okuvulika kaalumentu yawo miinima ayihe pamukalo naanaa ngoka egongalo tali vulika kuKristus.
Aalumentu, holeni aakiintu yeni, naanaa ngashika Kristus e hole egongalo lye nokwi igandja meso omolwalyo.
Oye okwe shi ningi, opo a yoololele Kalunga egongalo nohapu ye, nge e li yelitha noku li yoga momeya,
opo i iyetele po egongalo lyo opala, lya yogoka, lya yelithwa, lyaa na ontongo nenge egonyoto nenge onyata ya sha.
Ano aalumentu oye na okuhola aakiintu yawo, naanaa ngashika ye hole omalutu gawo yene.
Oshoka kaku na nando omuntu e tonde olutu lwe mwene, ihe kehe gumwe ohe lu palutha nohe lu sile oshimpwiyu, naanaa ngashika Kristus ha sile egongalo lye oshimpwiyu;
oshoka tse iilyo yolutu lwe, yegongalo lye.
Ngashika enyolo tali ti: “Onkee ano omulumentu oku na okuthiga po he nayina e ti ihanganitha nomukiintu gwe, ayehe yaali notaa ningi omuntu gumwe.”
Oshiholekwa shika sha hololwa menyolo ndika, osho oshinene. Ngame ondi uvite ko kutya otashi ulike Kristus negongalo lye.
Ihe otashi ulike wo kutya omulumentu kehe oku na okuhola omukiintu gwe, ngashika i ihole ye mwene, nomukiintu kehe oku na okusimaneka omulumentu gwe.
6: Aanona, vulikeni kaakuluntu yeni. Shika osho oshinakugwanithwa sheni shopakriste, onkee ano osho oshu uka, mu shi ninge.
“Simaneka ho nanyoko.” Shika osho oshipango shotango, shoka kusho kwa gwedhwa euvaneko:
“Opo u kale u na okukalamwenyo okuwanawa, ngoye u kale u na omwenyo ethimbo ele kombanda yevi.”
Aakuluntu, inamu hinda aana yeni noku ya geyitha, ihe ya putudheni ne mu ya kumagidhe paukriste.
Aapika, vulikeni kooyene yeni yomuuyuni nokutila nokukakama. Ihe shi ningeni nomwenyo aguhe, ongaashi tamu longele Kristus.
Shika inamu shi ninga ashike uuna ndoka ye mu wete, mu hokiwe ando kuyo, ihe longeni nomwenyo aguhe shoka sha hokiwa kuKalunga ngashika aamati yaKristus.
Longeni iilonga yeni nenyanyu ongaamboka tamu longele Omuwa mwene, hamuntu ashike.
Dhimbulukweni, kutya Omuwa ota ka futa omuntu kehe ngoka ta longo uuwanawa, na kale omupika nenge omuvalwa.
Ooyene, kaleni nawa naapika yeni. Etheni okulongitha omatilitho. Dhimbulukweni, kutya ne amuhe omu na Omuwa gumwe awike megulu, ngoka ta ningile aantu ayehe shi thike pamwe.
Hugunina, ikoleleleni mOmuwa, mu mone omomukumo moonkondo dhe oonene.
Ihomatekeni iikondjitho ayihe mbyoka Kalunga te yi mu pe, opo mu vule okukandeka omakotokelo omawinayi gomuhindadhi.
Oshoka tse itatu kondjitha aantu, ihe otatu kondjitha oonkondo dhomombepo, aanankondo yuuyuni mbuka womilema nosho wo oonkondo dhuuwinayi mewangandjo.

Onkee ano ngashingeyi ihomatekeni iikondjitho ayihe mbyoka Kalunga te yi mu pe. Omasiku omawinayi ngele tage ya, nena otamu ka vula okwiipopila komahomono gomukondjithi gweni nokukala omuthika, ngele mwa kondjo sigo okehulilo.
Kaleni ano omuthika mwi ilongekidha; zaleni oshili, yi ninge epaya moombunda dheni. Izalekeni uuyuuki, u ninge ehuuyanza poontulo dheni.
Kaleni mwi ilongekidha okuuvitha elaka etoye lyombili, li kale oongaku dhokoompadhi dheni.
Ethimbo alihe zaleni eitaalo ongehuuyanza, opo mu wape okudhima nalyo iikuti ayihe ya hwama omulilo mbyoka tayi umbwa kuMwiinayi.
Taambeni ehupitho, li ninge ongegala lyosheela, noohapu dhaKalunga ongegongamwele, ndyoka Ombepo te li mu pe.
Mbika ayihe yi longeni negalikano okwiindila ekwatho lyaKalunga. Galikaneni aluhe, Ombepo ngaashi te mu wilike. Onkee ano kaleni mwa tonata ne inamu teka omukumo. Galikaneneni aantu yaKalunga ayehe.
Galikanenii ndje wo, opo Kalunga a pe ndje oohapu ndhoka ndi na oku popya pethimbo ndyoka, opo ndi popye nuulaadhi oshiholekwa shika shevaangeli.
Oshoka ngame omutumwa omolwevaangeli, nonando ngashingeyi ondi li mondholongo. Onkee ano galikaneni, opo mokuuvitha kwandje ndi popye nuulaadhi, ngaashi ndi na oku shi ninga.
Tikikus, omumwameme omuholike nomuyakuli omwiinekelwa moshilonga shOmuwa, ote mu hokololele iinima ayihe kombinga yandje, opo mu tseye, nkene ndi li po.
Onkee ngame otandi mu tumu kune, e mu hokololele, nkene tu li po, ye e mu tse omukumo.
Kalunga Tate nOmuwa Jesus Kristus na gandje ombili nohole neitaalo kaamwameme ayehe.
Esilohenda lyaKalunga nali kale naayehe mboka ye hole Omuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus, yo naa pewe ohole yaa na ehulilo.

1: Ontumwafo ndjika oya zi kuPaulus naTimoteus, aamati yaJesus Kristus, ya nyolelwa aantu yaKalunga ayehe yomuFilippi, mboka yi itaala Jesus Kristus pamwe naawiliki yegongalo lyaKalunga naayakuli yalwe.
Silweni ohenda, ne mu kale mu na ombili yaKalunga noyOmuwa Jesus Kristus.
Otandi hambelele Kalunga kandje omolweni amuhe, kehe ethimbo tandi mu dhiladhila.
Momagalikano gandje agehe otandi mu galikanene nenyanyu,
oshoka omwa kwatha ndje moshilonga sheuvitho lyevaangeli okuza kesiku lyotango sigo ongashingeyi.
Ngame ondi inekela shili kutya Kalunga, ngoka a tameke oshilonga oshiwanawa mune, ote shi tsikile, sigo tashi ka pwa mesiku lyaJesus Kristus.

Ngame ondi mu hole. Nokuli osho oshu uka lela, ngame ndi kale noku mu dhiladhila ngeyi, oshoka one aasilwahenda kuKalunga pamwe nangame; ngashingeyi sho ndi li mondholongo naasho wo nda li inaandi kwatwa okupopila nokukoleka evaangeli.
Kalunga oku shi shi kutya otandi popi oshili, sho tandi ti: Onde mu yuulukwa nohole yomuJesus Kristus.
Egalikano lyandje olyo ndika kutya Kalunga a kokithe nokutaneka ohole yeni mokutseya nomokuninga omatokolo ge na oondunge,
opo mu kale mu na owino yokuyoolola iinima mbyoka yi na oshilonga. Nena mesiku lyaKristus one otamu ka kala ihe mwa yela mwaa na nando okantongo kasha.
Okukalamwenyo kweni otaku kala ihe ku udha iiyimati iiwanawa mbyoka Jesus Kristus awike ta vulu oku yi mu imitha, iiyimati yokusimanekitha noyokuhambelelitha Kalunga.
Aamwameme, ngame onda hala, mu kale mu shi shi kutya iinima mbyoka ya ningilwa ndje, oya kwathele lela mokutaandelitha evaangeli.
Nokuli etanga alihe lyaalangeli yuuwa naambala yalwe ooyakwawo yaamuka oye shi shi ngashingeyi kutya ngame onda tulwa mondholongo molwaashoka ndi li omumati gwaKristus.
Okukala kwandje mondholongo okwa pe oyendji yomaamwameme aalumentu omukumo okwiinekela Omuwa nokuuvitha nuulaadhi yaa na uumbanda.
Eeno, yamwe yomuyo otaa uvitha Kristus omolwefupa nomolwondumbo, ihe ooyakwawo otaye mu uvitha nehalo ewanawa.
Mboka otaye shi ningithwa kohole, oshoka oyo oye shi shi kutya Kalunga okwa pe ndje oshilonga shokupopila evaangeli.
Mbeyaka ooyakwawo ihaa uvitha Kristus nehalo ewanawa, ihe omombepo yokwiihola noyondumbo. Ngashingeyi sho ndi li mondholongo, oye shi aniwa otaa gwedhele ndje uudhigu u vule wonale.

Ihe shoka kashi na mbudhi. Ngame ondi li po nde shi nyanyukilwa notandi ke shi nyanyukilwa komeho, Kristus shaa ashike tu uvithwa pamukalo kehe ngoka tagu vulika, ongele nelalakano ewanawa nenge nelalakano lya puka.
Nokuli ngame ondi shi shi kutya omolwomagalikano geni nokekwatho lyOmbepo yaJesus Kristus otandi ka manguluka.

Oshoka ondjuulukwe yandje onene netegameno lyandje olyo ndika kutya ngame ndaa idhimbike nando okuli oshinakugwanithwa shandje. Ethimbo alihe, unene okuza kongashingeyi, otandi kala ndi na omukumo omunene, opo ngame mwene nuuntu wandje auhe ndi simanekithe Kristus. Ashihe shimwe, ngele ondi na omwenyo nenge tandi si.
Oshoka kombinga yandje Kristus oye omwenyo gwandje nokusa okwo elikolo.
Ihe ngele nani mokukala ndi na omwenyo molutu nduka, otandi vulu okulonga sha shi na oshilonga oshinene, nena onda nyengwa nokandi shi wo kutya oshini po ndi na okuhogolola po.
Ondi li po tandi thiminikwa koombinga adhihe mbali: Onda hala nokuhalelela, ndi thige po okukalamwenyo huka, ndi ka kale puKristus. Shika osho oshinima oshiwanawa shi vule oshikwawo.
Ihe osha pumbiwa unene noonkondo, ndi kale ndi na omwenyo omolweni.
Onkee ngame ondi inekela lela nondi shi shi kutya otandi ka kala ndi na omwenyo. Eeno, otandi ka kala natango pune oku mu kokitha noku mu nyanyudha meitaalo.
Ngele nda kala pune natango, nena ne otamu ka vula ihe okwiisimanekela ndje mokukala kweni muKristus Jesus.

Oshinima oshinene nosha simana osho shoka kutya omikalo dheni nadhi kale dho opalathana nevaangeli lyaKristus, opo nge nde ya ko, ndi mu mone nongele ndi li kokule, ndi mu uve mu li mwa thikama omuthika mu na elalakano limwe alike, nokutya okukondjela eitaalo lyomevaangeli pamwe nangame.
Inamu tila aakondjithi yeni, ihe kaleni aluhe mu na omukumo. Omukumo gweni otagu ya tompo kutya oyo itaa ka sindana, ihe ne otamu ka sindana, oshoka Kalunga oye te mu pe esindano.
Oshoka ne omwa pewa ohenda yokuyakula Kristus, hamoku mu itaala akuke, ihe nomoku mu hepekelwa wo.
One wo otamu vulu okukondja pamwe nangame. Olugodhi ndoka olwo naanaa ndoka mwa li mwa mono ndje ndi lu na, nosigo onena omu uvite ndje ndi lu na.
2: Okukala kweni muKristus otaku mu koleke tuu? Ohole otayi mu hekeleke tuu? Omu na tuu ehangano lyOmbepo? Omu holathane nomu na tuu olukeno mokukalathana kweni?
Ngame otandi mu indile, nyanyudhii ndje nenyanyu lya tsakana. Kaleni mwa tsa ompango yimwe. Holathaneni, ne mu kale mu na ombepo yimwe nedhiladhilo limwe.
Inamu longa nando osha mombepo yokwiihola nenge yokukonga esimano lyowala, ihe ifupipikeni kiipala yayakweni, ne mwaa dhiladhile kutya one aawanawa mu ya vule.
Lalakaneneni uuwanawa wooyakweni wo, haamboka ashike weni yene.
Okukala kweni naku kale kwa fa kwaJesus Kristus.

Oye okwa li e na uukwatya waKalunga,
ye ina dhiladhila nando olumwe,
a kambadhale nokuhakana okukala a fa Kalunga.

Ihe okwi ihula uukalunga,
e ta zala olupe lwomupika.
Oye okwa ningi a fa omuntu
nokwa holoka molupe lwomuntu.

Oye okwi ifupipike
nokwe ende ondjila yevuliko sigo omeso lye lyokomushigakano.

Onkee ano Kalunga okwe mu yele pombandambanda
nokwe mu luku edhina enene li vule omadhina agehe,

opo kehe shimwe megulu nokombanda yevi nomohi yevi,
shi tse oongolo medhina lyaJesus.

Nomokusimanekitha Kalunga He ayihe yi hokolole montaneho kutya Jesus Kristus
oye Omuwa.
Aaholike yandje, ngashika mwa kala hamu vulika aluhe kungame, manga nda li pune, vulikeni wo ngashingeyi, sho ndaa po we pune. Kaleni tamu longo nokutila nokukakama molwehupitho lyeni.
Oshoka Kalunga oye mwene ta longo aluhe mune oku mu pa ehalo noonkondo, opo a tsakanithe elalakano lye ewanawa.
Longeni iilonga yeni ayihe mwaa na omangungutulo nenge omaludhi.

Kaleni aana yaKalunga mwaa na oshipo nomwa yela, mwaa na nando okantongo mokukala kweni muuyuni mbuka u na aantu ya pilaala noya goyoka. One omu na okukala tamu adhima mokati kawo, ngashika oonyothi tadhi adhima pombanda kegulu,
sho tamu ya uvithile ohapu yomwenyo. Nena ngame otandi ka vula okwiitanga omolweni mesiku lyaKristus, oshoka oonkambadhala dhandje niilonga yandje ayihe kaya li ashike eihepeko lyowala.
Nonando ombinzi yandje yi tilwehi kombanda yomayambo ngoka eitaalo lyeni tali ga yambele Kalunga, ngame onda nyanyukwa notandi ka nyanyukwa pamwe nane amuhe.
Nane wo nyanyukweni pamwe nangame.
Ngame ondi na einekelo mOmuwa Jesus kutya otandi ka vula okutuma mbala Timoteus kune, opo ndi tsuwe omukumo konkundana ndjoka tayi ka za kune.
Oshoka Timoteus oye awike he mu dhiladhila ngaashi ngame noku na oshimpwiyu nane.
Oshoka ooyakweni ayehe oyi ipyakidhila ashike niinima yawo yene, haambyoka yaJesus Kristus.
Ihe uudhiginini we omu u shi, nkene twa kala tatu longo pamwe naye moshilonga shevaangeli ngashika he nomwana.
Ano oye tuu nda dhiladhila okutuma kune, uuna nda mono nkene tandi ningwa.
Ondi na nokuli einekelo okwiinekela Omuwa kutya ngame mwene wo otandi ke ya mbala kune.
Onde shi tala wo kutya osha pumbiwa okutuma kune omumwameme nomutumwa gweni, ngoka a kwatha ndje moluhepo lwandje. Oye Epafroditus, omukwiita omukwetu.
Oye okwe mu yuulukwa nokwa hala nokuhalelela oku mu talela po, oshoka okwa zizilikwa noonkondo molwaasho mwe shi uva kutya okwa li ta alukwa.
Eeno, oye okwa li ta alukililwa, konyala nokuli a se, ihe Kalunga okwe mu sile ohenda. Nokuli haye awike a silwa ohenda, ihe nangame wo, opo ndaa gwedhelwe oluhodhi olukwawo lu vule nduka.
Ngame onda hala nokuhalelela oku mu tuma kune, opo mu nyanyukwe, ngele tamu mu mono, noluhodhi lwandje lu ninge oluhwepo.
Mu taambeni ano nenyanyu, oshoka oye omumwanyoko mOmuwa. Aalumentu ya tya ngaaka ya simanekeni,
oshoka omolwoshilonga shaKristus okwa hupula omwenyo gwe, konyala nokuli a se, opo a kwathe ndje ekwatho ndyoka ne yene inaamu vula oku li pa ndje.
3: Hugunina, aamwameme, Omuwa ne mu gwedhele ko natango enyanyu olindji. Ngame inandi shi kunyukwa okweendulula iinima mbyoka nde yi mu nyolele nale, ihe otashi mu koleke.
Kotokeleni oombwa ndho, aantu mboka haa longo uuwinayi, aalumentu mboka haa itangele efukaleko lyokombanda.
Oshoka aafukalekwa yashili otse mbaka hatu galikana Kalunga mOmbepo notwa nyanyukilwa okukala kwetu muKristus Jesus. Tse itatu itangele nando oshilonga shimwe shokombanda,
nando ngame otandi vulu okwiinekela wo iinima ya tya ngaaka. Ngele ku na ngoka ta dhiladhila kutya ota vulu okwiinekela iilonga yokombanda, nena ngame ondi mu vule.

Ngame tuu nguka nda fukalekwa konima yoshiwike shimwe okuza kokuvalwa kwandje. Ngame Omuisraeli kevalo, omunezimo lyaBenjamin, Omuhebelilela. Kombinga yokudhiginina ompango yAajuda onda li omufarisayi.
Ngame onda li omulaadhi noonkondo mokutidhagana egongalo. Ngame onda li ndaa na okantongo kasha kombinga yuuyuuki mboka omuntu te u adha molwokuvulika komalombwelo gompango.
Ihe ayihe mbyoka nda li nde yi tala yi na omupondo, ngashingeyi otayi etele ndje oshiponga omolwaKristus.

Eeno shili, iinima ayihe yilwe oyo ekanitho lyowala, ngele tandi yi yeleke nokutseya Jesus Kristus, Omuwa gwandje, shoka osho oshinima shondilo shi vule ayihe. Omolwe onde ekelehi iinima ayihe nonde yi tala oyo iiyagaya yowala, opo ndi likole Kristus,

ngame ndi kale muukumwe naye. Ngame kandi na we uuyuuki wandje mwene, uuyuuki mboka hau adhika mokuvulika kompango. Ihe ngashingeyi ondi na uuyuuki mboka tau gandjwa molweitaalo okwiitaala Jesus Kristus, uuyuuki tau zi kuKalunga nowi ikwatelela keitaalo.
Shoka nde shi hala ngashingeyi, osho okutseya Kristus, okumakela oonkondo dheyumuko lye, okukala ndi na oshitopolwa momahepeko ge nondi mu fe mokusa,
opo nangame wo ndi yumudhwe mo meso, ndi ye momwenyo.
Ngame itandi itanga kutya onda adha nale esindano moshinima shika nenge onda adha nale ethikilo. Aawe, otandi matuka, opo ndi li adhe, oshoka Jesus Kristus okwa likola ndje.

Aamwameme, ngame inandi itala natango kutya onde li adha, aawe, ihe oshinima shimwe tandi ningi, otandi dhimbwa shoka shi li konima notandi ningi ashihe shoka tandi vulu, opo ndi adhe shoka shi li komeho gandje.
Onkee otandi matuka ndu ukilila kethikilo, opo ndi ka likole ondjambi yesindano. Ondjambi ndjika oyo omwenyo gwomegulu, ngoka Kalunga e gu ithanena ndje molwaJesus Kristus.
Ano tseni atuheni mboka twa koka pambepo, natu kaleni tatu dhiladhila ngeyi. Nongele nani oku na yamwe ye na omadhiladhilo gi ili, nena Kalunga ote ke mu yelithila oshinima shoka.
Natu humeni owala komeho nondjila naanaa ndjoka twe ende nayo sigo oompaka.
Aamwameme, kaleni nokuholela ndje. Tse otwe mu pe oshiholelwa oshiwanawa, onkee ano landuleni aantu mboka haa landula oshiholelwa shetu.
Ngaashi nde mu lombwele nale olwindji, otandi shi endulula natango ndi na omahodhi kutya oku na aantu oyendji mboka ya ningi aatondi yeso lyaKristus lyokomushigakano.

Oyo otaa ka ya sigo omoheli, oshoka uuhalu womalutu gawo oye u ningi kalunga kawo. Oyo ohaa isimanekele iinima mbyoka ya li ye na okukala ye yi sa ohoni nohaa dhiladhila ashike iinima mbyoka yomuuyuni mbuka.
Ihe tse uukwashilongo wetu ou li megulu notwa tegelela nondjuulukwe onene Omuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus, a ze megulu, e ye e tu hupithe.

Oye tuu ngoka ta ka shitulula omalutu getu ngaka omankundi nomasi e te ga ningi, ga kale ngaashi olutu lwe lu na eadhimo. Oye ota longitha oonkondo dhe tadhi vulu okutula iinima ayihe kohi yepangelo lye.
4: Onkee ano aamwameme, ne mboka ndi mu hole nonde mu yuulukwa, one enyanyu lyandje noshishani shandje. Kaleni aluhe mwa thikama omuthika mwi ikolelela mOmuwa.
Euodia naSintike, otandi mu kumagidha, mu kambadhale okuuvathana ngashika aakiintu aamwayinathana mOmuwa.

Nangoye wo, omuyakuli gwandje omwiinekelwa, onda hala, u kwathe aakiintu mboka, oshoka oyo oya longo nuudhiginini okutaandelitha evaangeli pamwe nangame naKlemens nonaalongi ooyakwawo yalwe ayehe mboka nda longo pamwe nayo, oomboka ye na omadhina ga nyolelwa membo lyaKalunga lyaanamwenyo.
Kaleni aluhe mwa nyanyukwa mokukala mOmuwa. Otandi shi tumbula natango: nyanyukweni!
Kaleni mu na olukeno naantu ayehe. Omuwa ote ya mbala.
Inamu kala mu na nando oshimpwiyu shasha, ihe oompumbwe dheni dhi tseyithileni Kalunga momagalikano geni agehe. Ihe indileni aluhe nomwenyo gu udha ehambelelo.
Nombili yaKalunga, ndjoka yi vule uunongo auhe wopantu, otayi gamene oomwenyo dheni nomadhiladhilo geni muKristus Jesus.
Hugunina, aamwameme, kaleni nokudhiladhila iinima mbyoka iiwanawa noya gwana okusimanekwa: iinima mbyoka yoshili yo opala, yu uka, ya yogoka noyi na epopilo ewanawa.
Ningeni iinima mbyoka mwe yi longwa nomwe yi lombwelwa kungame, ongele moohapu dhandje nenge omiilonga yandje. Nena Kalunga, ngoka te tu pe ombili, ota kala ihe pamwe nane.
Onda nyanyukwa shili mOmuwa, sho mwa mono ishewe ompito okusila ndje oshimpwiyu konima yethimbo ele. Osho shoka mwa li mwa hala oku shi ninga shito, ihe inamu mona ompito.
Shika itandi shi popi omolwoluhepo, oshoka ondi igilila okukala naashoka ndi shi na,
nashi kale oshishona nenge nashi kale oshindji. Onda pyokoka miinima ayihe: okukala nda kuta nenge okukala nda sa ondjala, okukala meloolo nenge okukala moluhepo.
Ngame otandi vulu shaa shoka, oshoka Kristus ota koleke ndje.
Ihe ne omwa ninga nawa shili, sho mwa kwatha ndje muudhigu wandje,

Ne Aafilippi, omu shi shi nawa kutya, sho nda zile muMakedonia pomasiku ngeyaka gopetameko, manga nda li tandi uvitha elaka etoye, egongalo lyeni olyo alike lya li lya kwatha ndje. Eeno, ne amuke omwa li mwa topola pamwe nangame etano neshonopalo lyiiniwe.
Ongame sho nda li ndi na oluhepo muTessalonika, one omwa li mwa tumine ndje ekwatho, halumwe aluke, ihe lwaali nokuli.
Shika itashi ti, onda hala ashike ando okutaamba omagano, ihe onda hala, mu ilikolele sha ne yene.
Ngashingeyi ondi na oshindji shi vule shoka nda pumbwa. Ondi na eloolo, Epafroditus sho e etele ndje omagano geni, taga ningi eyambo lyezimba lya nika nawa, lyo opala nolya hokiwa kuKalunga.
Kalunga kandje, ngoka e na uuyamba auhe muKristus Jesus, ote ke mu gwanithila ashihe shoka mwe shi pumbwa.

Kalunga, Tate yetu, oye na simanekwe aluhe sigo aluhe.
Amen.
Kundilii po aantu yaKalunga ayehe noyaJesus Kristus. Aamwameme ayehe mboka ye li mpaka, otaye mu kundile po.
Aayapuki ayehe otaye mu kundile po, unene mboka yomuuwa womupangeli Omuroma.
Esilohenda lyOmuwa Jesus Kristus nali kale pamwe nane amuhe.

1: Ontumwafo ndjika oya zi kuPaulus, omuyapostoli gwaKristus Jesus, kehalo lyaKalunga, nokomumwameme Timoteus.

Oya nyolelwa aantu yaKalunga ye li muKolossa naamwameme aainekelwa muKristus.
Esilohenda nombili yaKalunga Tate nayi kale pamwe nane.
Tse aluhe otatu hambelele Kalunga, He yOmuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus, sho tatu mu galikanene.
Oshoka otu uvu eitaalo lyeni okwiitaala Kristus Jesus nohole yeni okuhola aantu yaKalunga ayehe.

Ano elaka etoye nolyoshili sho lyu uvithilwa mokati keni, omu uvu lwotango etegameno ndyoka tali li gandja. One omu uva kutya shoka mwe shi tegamena pauvaneko, oshe mu pungulilwa nawa megulu, onkee eitaalo lyeni nohole yeni oya kankamekwa ketegameno ndyoka.

Evaangeli olye eta omayambeko nolya taandele nuuyuni auhe, ngashika naanaa lya taandele mokati keni, okuza kesiku ndyoka mu uvu lwotango esilohenda lyaKalunga nomwi ilongo oku li tseya naanaa ngashika li li.
Shika omwe shi longwa kuEpafras, omuyakuli mukwetu omuholike nomwiinekelwa moshilonga shaKristus peha lyetu.
Oye okwe tu hokololele ohole yeni ndjoka mwe yi pewa kOmbepo.

Onkee ano tse ohatu mu galikanene aluhe okuza kesiku ndyoka tu uvu sha kombinga yeni. Tse otatu indile Kalunga, e mu udhithe Ombepo ye, ndjoka tayi mu pe ontseyo okutseya ehalo lye nuunongo auhe noondunge.

Nena otamu ka vula okukala ngashika Omuwa a hala mu kale, nokulonga aluhe shoka she mu opalela. Okukalamwenyo kweni otaku ka kala ihe kwa yambekwa miilonga ayihe iiwanawa, nontseyo yeni okutseya Kalunga otayi ka koka.
Oonkondo ndhoka tadhi zi mesimano lyoonkondo dhaKristus, nadhi mu koleke, opo mu wape okwiidhidhimikila ashihe shoka tashi mu adha.
Nyanyukweni ne mu hambelele Tate Kalunga, ngoka e mu ningi mu kale mu na oshitopolwa sheni moshipewa shoka a kala e shi nunina aantu ye moshilongo shuuyelele.
Oshoka Kalunga oye e tu nakula mo mepangelo lyomilema nokwe tu eta moshilongo shOmwana omuholike.
Omwana oye tuu ngoka e tu mangulula nokwa dhimi po oondjo dhetu.
Kristus oye olupe lu wetike lwaKalunga, ngoka ihaa monika. Oye omutango gwiishitwa ayihe noku li kombanda yiishitwa ayihe.

Kalunga okwa shititha Kristus iinima ayihe yomegulu noyokombanda yevi, iinima mbyoka yi wetike naambyoka yaa wetike, ongele oonkondo dhomombepo nenge aaleli nenge omapangelo. Kalunga okwe mu shititha ewangandjo alihe.
Kristus okwa li ko manga iinima ayihe ya li yaa ko. Onkee muukumwe naye iinima ayihe otayi ka kala yi li pomahala gayolela.
Oye omutse gwolutu, nokutya gwegongalo. Oye oluthithiya lwomwenyo gwomolutu nomutango mokuyumudhwa kuusi, opo a kale oye awike omutango miinima ayihe.
Oshoka Kalunga okwa tokola, Omwana a kale e na egwanopo lyondjelo ayihe yaKalunga muye mwene.
MolwOmwana okwa panga ombili nuuyuni auhe meso lyOmwana lyokomushigakano. Osho ngeyi Kalunga okwa galulile kuye iinima ayihe yokombanda yevi noyomegulu.
One omwa kala nale kokule naKalunga nomwi iningi aatondi ye miilonga nomomadhiladhilo geni omawinayi.
Ihe ngashingeyi Kalunga okwe mu hanganitha naye mwene molweso lyOmwana, opo e mu ninge aayapuki, aayelele nomwaa na oondjo koshipala she.

Onkee ano dhiginineni eitaalo lyeni. Ikoleleleni komukanka ngoka gwa kola nogwashili. Inamu pitika, mu nakulwe mo metegameno lyeni ndyoka mwe li ilikolele, sho mu uvu nomwa taamba evaangeli. Evaangeli ndyoka ngame Paulus nda ningi omuyakuli gwalyo, olyo tuu ndyoka tali uvithilwa aantu ayehe yomuuyuni.

Ngame onda nyanyukwa ngashingeyi, sho tandi hepekwa omolweni. Oshoka mokuhepekwa ngeyi kolutu otandi kwathele okutsakanitha shoka sha hupa ko natango shomomahepeko gaKristus molwolutu lwe, kokutya egongalo.
Kalunga okwa ningi ndje omuyakuli gwegongalo, sho a pe ndje oshilonga shoka, ndi shi longe omoluuwanawa weni. Oshilonga shika osho okuuvitha oohapu dhe,
ndhoka dha kala shito oshiholekwa shoka Kalunga a kala e shi holeka aantu ayehe omathimbo agehe ngoka ga piti, ihe ngashingeyi okwe shi hololele aantu ye.

Oshoka ompangela yaKalunga oyo okutseyithila aantu ye oshiholekwa shuuyamba noshesimano ndyoka a kala e li nunina aantu ye. Oshiholekwa osho shika kutya Kristus oku li mune, kokutya one otamu ka kala mu na oshitopolwa meadhimo lyaKalunga.

Onkee ano tse otatu uvithile aantu ayehe Kristus. Otatu londodha notatu longo omuntu kehe muunongo auhe mboka tau vulu okwaadhika. Otatu kaleke kehe gumwe puuyelele koshipala shaKalunga, a ninge omukuluntu a koka muukumwe naKristus.
Onkee ano otandi ihepeke notandi kondjo, opo ndi adhe ethikilo ndyoka. Otandi longo koonkondo dhaKristus ndhoka dhi li mungame.
2: Pitikilii ndje, ndi mu hokololele uudhigu mboka ndi u na mokulonga kwandje omolweni nomolwaantu yomuLaodikea nosho wo mboka inaa tseya ndje moshipala.
Otandi shi ningi, opo ohole yi ya kwatakanithe kumwe, noya mone omukumo okutseya iinima ayihe. Oyo otaa ka tseya ihe kutya Kristus oye oshiholekwa shaKalunga.
Oye oshipatululo shoka tashi patulula omaliko agehe gaKalunga guunongo nogowino, ngoka ga holekwa.
Shika otandi shi mu lombwele, mwaa pukithwe nando okomuntu gumwe noohapu dhomuheka.
Oshoka ngame nando ndaa po pune palutu, onkee tuu ondi li pamwe nane pambepo. Nonda nyanyukwa okumona uukolele weitaalo lyeni mokwiitaala Kristus.
Ano sho mwa taamba Jesus Kristus, a kale Omuwa gweni, kaleni ihe muukumwe naye.
Dhameni muye ne mu itungile muye. Kaleni meitaalo shi vulithe shito, ngashika mwa longwa. Ihe kaleni mu udhilila omahambelelo.

Kotokeni ano, mwaa yulwe nando okomuntu nomalongo guunongo wopantu nomafundjaleko gaa fele. Ogo ogi ikwatelela komithigululwakalo dhaantu noga za moombepo ndhoka tadhi pangele mewangandjo, ihe ne kaleni muKristus.
Oshoka muKristus nokutya muuntu we, omu na egwanopo lyondjelo yuukalunga auhe.
Onkee muukumwe naye one omwa pewa egwanopo alihe lyomwenyo. Kristus oku vule aapangeli ayehe yomombepo naanankondo ayehe.

Muukumwe naKristus one omwa fukalekwa, hanefukaleko ndyoka hali ningwa niikaha kaantu, aawe, ihe onefukaleko lyaKristus mwene. Mefukaleko ndika one omwa mangululwa mo moonkondo dhomolutu nduka luulunde.
Oshoka mokushashwa omwa fumvikwa pamwe naKristus. Meshasho tuu ndyoka omwa yumudhwa wo pamwe naKristus kuusi omolweitaalo lyeni okwiitaala oonkondo dhaKalunga, ngoka a yumudha Kristus.

One omwa kala nale mwa sa pambepo omolwoondjo dheni nomolwaashoka omwa li aapagani mwaa na ompango yaKalunga. Ihe ngashingeyi Kalunga okwe mu tula omwenyo pamwe naKristus nokwa dhimi po oondjo dhetu adhihe.
Oye okwa dhimi po enyolo hali tu tamaneke pamwe niipango yalyo nokwe li hanagula po thiluthilu, sho e li alele komushigakano.

Komushigakano hoka Kristus okwa yugu aaleli yomombepo naapangeli oonkondo dhawo. Oye oku ulike uukatalume wawo montaneho yaayehe, sho e ya kwatele komeho mosheendo she shesindano, ngashika omuntu te ende noonkwatwa dhe.
Ano inamu etha, mu pewe uusama kombinga yaashoka hamu li nohamu nu, nokombinga wo yomasiku omanene nenge yoshituthi shomwedhi omupe nenge kombinga yEsabati.
Mbika ayihe oyo omuzizimba gwowala gwiinima yokomeho, ihe oshinima sho shene oKristus.

Inamu zimina, mu pangulwe nando okomuntu ngoka ti iningi e vule yalwe omolwomamoniko gontumba noti isimanekele eifupipiko lyiifundja nesimaneko lyaayengeli. Omuntu a tya ngaaka okwa tuwalalekwa komadhiladhilo ge gopantu.
Nokuli oye okwe etha okutala kuKristus, ngoka e li omutse. Oshoka meutho lyaKristus olutu aluhe otalu paluthwa notalu kwatelwa kumwe koongolo nokoothipa e talu koko, ngashika Kalunga a hala.

One omwa sa pamwe naKristus nomwa mangululwa mo moonkondo dhoombepo ndhoka tadhi pangele mewangandjo. Ongiini ano, sho mu li po natango mwa fa aantu yomuuyuni mbuka mokukala kweni? Omolwashike tamu vulika kiipango yiidhila ngashika mbika:
“Ino shi kwata,” “Ino shi lola,” “Ino shi guma?”
Mbika ayihe otayi longithwa e tayi hulu po. Iipango mbyoka ayihe nomalongo ngoka agehe oya ningwa kaantu.

Eeno, pakutala oya fa yi na uunongo mesimaneko lyawo lyaayengeli kethiminiko, meifupipiko lyiifundja nomeihepeko lyawo edhigu okuhepeka omalutu gawo. Ihe kaayi na nando oshilonga shasha kombinga yokupangela uuhalu womolutu.
3: One omwa yumudhwa kuusi pamwe naKristus. Kongeni ano iinima mbiyaka yomegulu, moka Kristus e li a kuutumba koshipangelapundi kolulyo lwaKalunga.
Dhiladhileni iinima yaahwiyaka kombanda, haambika yopevi.
Oshoka one omwa sa pamwe naKristus noomwenyo dheni odha holekwa muKalunga pamwe naKristus.
Kristus oye omwenyo gweni, uuna ta holoka, nena nane wo otamu ka holoka pamwe naye notamu ka kala mu na oshitopolwa meadhimo lye.
Dhipageni ano uuhalu weni wopavi mboka tau longo mune ngashika oluhondelo, iipala, uuholume nuuhalu uuwinayi nolwiho. Nokuli olwiho olwo olupe lumwe lwesimaneko lyiimenka.
Iinima ya tya ngaaka otayi eta ondjahi yaKalunga kombanda yaantu mboka ihaa vulika kuye.
Nane yene omo wo mwa kala nale mongundu yaantu ya tya ngaaka, okukalamwenyo kweni sho kwa li taku pangelwa kuuhalu owo tuu mboka.
Ihe ngashingeyi one omu na okweetha iinima mbika ayihe: ondjahi, uugeyi nuuwinayi auhe. Momakana geni inamu pita we omasheko nenge oohapu oombwinayi.
Inamu lombwelathana iifundja, oshoka one omwi ihula omuntu gweni omukulu pamwe nomikalo dhe,
nomwa zala omuntu omupe. Kalunga ota shitulula aluhe omuntu nguka omupe mune, a fe ondjelo yomushiti gwe, opo e mu thikithe kegwano lyoku mu tseya.
Onkee ano kape na we eyoloko pokati komupagani nOmujuda, kaangoka a fukalekwa naangoka inaa fukalekwa, omupika nomuvalwa, omukwiilongo nomudhinwa, ihe ayihe oKristus ngoka e li mwaayihe.
One aantu yaKalunga. Kalunga oku mu hole nokwe mu hogolola, mu kale aantu ye mwene. Onkee ano kaleni mu na olukeno, ohenda, eifupipiko, ombili neidhidhimiko.
Kwathathaneni, dhiminathanii po oondjo ethimbo kehe, uuna pe na ngoka a ningathana namukwawo. Dhiminathanii po oondjo naanaa, ngashika Omuwa e mu dhimine po.
Kumbika ayihe gwedhii ko ohole, oshoka ohole oyo epaya tali vulu okumangela iinima ayihe kumwe.
Ombili ndjoka Kristus te yi gandja, nayi mu pangele, oshoka ombili ndjika oyo ndjoka Kalunga e yi mu ithanena, mu kale nayo molutu lumwe. Hambeleleni ihe Kalunga aluhe.

Oohapu dhaKristus nuuyamba auhe wadho nadhi kale dhu udhilila mune. Longathaneni nokupukululathana noondunge adhihe. Imbeni omapisalomi, omaimbilo noondjimbo oondjapuki. Imbileni Kalunga omahambelelo taga zi meni moomwenyo dheni.
Kehe shoka tamu shi longo nenge tamu shi popi, shi ningeni medhina lyOmuwa Jesus, ne mu hambelele Kalunga Tate omolwe.
Aakiintu, vulikeni kaalumentu yeni, oshoka osho oshinakugwanithwa sheni shaakriste.
Aalumentu, holeni aakiintu yeni, ne inamu kala mu na onyanya nayo.
Aanona, vulikeni aluhe kaakuluntu yeni, oshoka osho oshinakugwanithwa sheni shopakriste nosho opalela Kalunga.
Aakuluntu, inamu hinda aana yeni, opo yaa kanithe einekelo.
Aapika, vulikeni kooyene yeni yopantu miinima ayihe. Inamu shi ninga owala uuna ndoka ye mu wete, mu hokiwe ando kuyo. Ihe shi ningeni nomwenyo aguhe omolwetilo lyeni okutila Omuwa.
Shaa shoka tamu shi longo, shi longeni nomwenyo aguhe ongaamboka itaamu longele aantu, ihe Omuwa ye mwene.
Dhimbulukweni kutya Omuwa ote ke mu futa. One otamu ka pewa shoka Kalunga e shi nunina aantu ye; oshoka otamu longele Omuwa Kristus ye mwene.
Omukolokoshi kehe ota ka futilwa uuwinayi mboka e u longa, oshoka Kalunga oha ningile aantu ayehe shi thike pamwe.
4: Ooyene, tekuleni aalelwa yeni nawa nonuuyuuki. Dhimbulukweni, kutya nane wo omu na Omuwa megulu.
Dhiginineni okugalikana, ihe galikaneni nokukotoka. Hambeleleni Kalunga.
Tu galikanenii wo, Kalunga opo e tu pe ompito ombwanawa okuuvitha oohapu dhe, okuholola oshiholekwa shaKristus, shoka sha tulitha ndje mondholongo moka ndi li mo ngashingeyi.
Galikanenii ndje, opo ndi vule okupopya pamukalo ngoka tagu yelitha oshiholekwa shika, ngashika naanaa nda tegelelwa, ndi shi ninge.
Kaleni mu na oondunge mokukalathana kweni naantu mboka kaaye shi ooitaali. Longitheni nawa ompito kehe tamu yi mono.
Oohapu dheni nadhi kale aluhe oombwanawa notadhi hokitha omuntu oku mu pulakena. Kambadhaleni, mu kale aluhe mu shi, nkene mu na okuyamukula aantu.
Tikikus, omumwameme omuholike, omwiinekelwa nomuyakuli omukwetu moshilonga shOmuwa, ote ke mu hokololela iinima ayihe kombinga yandje.
Onkee ano otandi mu tumu kune, opo e mu nyanyudhe, sho te ke mu hokololela, nkene tse atuhe tu li po.
Oye ote ya pamwe naOnesimus, omumwameme omuholike nomwiinekelwa, omukwanegongalo lyaandjeni. Mboka ayehe yaali otaye ke mu hokololela ashihe shoka sha ningwa ko huka.
Aristarkus, ngoka tu li naye mondholongo, ote mu kundile po. Osho wo Markus, gwaantsezi yaBarnabas, oongoka mwa lombwelelwe, mu mu yakule, ngele te ke ya kune.
Josua, ngoka hi ithanwa Justus, naye wo ote mu kundile po. Mbaka yatatu oyo ooitaali mboka ya zi muujuda notaa longo pamwe nangame omolwOshilongo shaKalunga. Oyo oya kala ekwatho enene kungame.

Epafras, gumwe gwomongundu yeni nomuyakuli gwaJesus Kristus, ote mu kundile po wo. Oye he mu galikanene aluhe nuudhiginini noti indile Kalunga, mu wape okukala mwa kola meitaalo nohamu vulika kehalo lyaKalunga miinima ayihe.
Ngame mwene otandi vulu oku mu hokololela eihepeko lyaEpafras omolweni nomolwaantu yomuLaodikea noyomuHierapolis.
Lukas, ndohotola gwetu omuholike, naDemas otaye mu kundile po.
Kundilii po aamwameme yomuLaodikea, naNimfas nosho egongalo ndyoka hali gongala megumbo lye.
Ontumwafo ndjika ngele ya leshwa megongalo lyeni, yi tumeni, yi ka leshwe wo megongalo lyokuLaodikea; ne mu taambe wo ndjoka tamu yi tuminwa kAalaodikea, mu yi leshe.
Lombweleni Arkippus kutya na tsakanithe oshilonga shoka e shi pewa okulongela Omuwa.

Mpaka otandi nyola po noshikaha shandje mwene. Omakundo ga si kuPaulus. Inamu dhimbwa kutya ondi li momalyenge.
Esilohenda lyaKalunga nali kale nane.

1:
Ontumwafo ndjika oya zi kuPaulus, Silvanus naTimoteus. Oya nyolelwa egongalo lyomuTessalonika, lyaantu yaKalunga Tate noyOmuwa Jesus Kristus.
Esilohenda nombili nayi kale nane.
Tse ohatu hambelele Kalunga aluhe omolweni nohatu mu dhimbulukwa wo aluhe momagalikano getu.
Ohatu mu dhimbulukwa koshipala shaKalunga Tate, nkene mu na eitaalo li na iilonga, nkene mu na ohole tayi mu longitha nuupenda nonkene okutegamena kweni Omuwa gwetweni Jesus Kristus kwa kola.
Aamwameme, tse otu shi shi kutya Kalunga oku mu hole nokwe mu hogolola, mu ninge aantu ye.

Oshoka elaka etoye ndyoka twe mu etele, kalya li owala oohapu dhomokana, ihe olya holoka moonkondo nomOmbepo Ondjapuki mokuholola oshili ayihe. Okukala kwetu omwe ku tseya, sho twa li pune; osha ningwa moluuwanawa weni.
Ne omwa ningi aaholeli yetu noyOmuwa. Nonando omwa li moothina odhindji, oohapu dhaKalunga omwe dhi taamba nenyanyu lyomOmbepo Ondjapuki.
Onkee ano omwa ningi oshiholelwa shooitaali ayehe yomuMakedonia noyomuGreka.
Oshoka elaka tali popi Omuwa, olya zi mune nolya taandele nokuli pondje yaMakedonia noyaGreka. Eitaalo lyeni okwiitaala Kalunga olya kundanwa akuhe. Kaku na we sha tu na oku shi popya.
Aantu yo yene ohaa hokolola, nkene mwe tu taamba, sho twe mu talele po nonkene mwe etha iimenka e tamu ya kuKalunga. One omwa hala okulongela Kalunga kashili nomunamwenyo
nokutegelela Omwana, a ze megulu. Oye Jesus ngoka Kalunga e mu yumudha kuusi naangoka te tu hupitha, twaa adhike kondjahi yaKalunga ndjoka tayi ke ya.
2: Aamwameme, omu shi shi kutya etalelopo lyetu kune kalya li osima.

Omwa tseya wo kutya, manga inaatu ya kune muTessalonika, otwa li twa hindwa notwa shekwa muFilippi. Ihe Kalunga okwe tu pe omukumo oku mu hokololela elaka etoye lya zi kuye, nonando opwa li omakondjitho ogendji.
Oshoka omakumagidho getu kage na elalakano ewinayi lya nyata nenge lyoku mu pukitha.

Ihe otwa popi aluhe pahalo lyaKalunga, oshoka okwe tu tala, tu shi ku pewa oshilonga shokuuvitha elaka etoye. Tse itatu kambadhala okwoopalela aantu, ihe oKalunga ngoka ta konakona omadhiladhilo getu.
Oshoka omwa tseya nawa kutya tse inatu ya kune noohapu dhomakoto nenge okwiikongela eliko nomuheka; Kalunga oye onzapo yetu.
Tse inatu kambadhala, tu simanekwe nando okomuntu, ngee kune nenge kuyalwe.
Sho tu li po aayapostoli yaKristus, otwa li twa gwana ando oku mu thiminika, ihe otwa kala mokati keni nombili, ngaashi yina ta sile oyana oshimpwiyu.
Omolwohole yetu yoku mu hola inatu ya kune owala nelaka etoye lya za kuKalunga, ihe otwa hupula wo oomwenyo dhetu molweni. Ne aaholike yetu.
Aamwameme, otamu dhimbulukwa nawa kutya, sho twe mu uvithile elaka etoye lya za kuKalunga, otwe shi ningi nokwiihepeka. Otwa longo omutenya nuusiku, opo twaaye mu etele nando uupyakadhi washa.
One oonzapo dhetu pamwe naKalunga, omikalo dhetu mokukalathana kwetu nane mboka ooitaali odha li dhu uka, omiwanawa nodhaa na uusama.
One omwa tseya, nkene twa li twa kala nane, ngaashi he e li noyana.
Otse otwe mu tsu omukumo, otwe mu hekeleke notwa kala noku mu kumagidha, mu opalele Kalunga mokukalamwenyo kweni, Kalunga ngoka e mu ithanene mOshilongo she nomeadhimo lye.

Onkee ano natse wo ohatu hambelele aluhe Kalunga. Oshoka sho twe mu etele oohapu dhaKalunga, omwe dhi uvu e tamu dhi taamba, hangaashi oohapu dhomuntu, ihe odhaKalunga, dho odho tuu shili. Oshoka Kalunga ota longo mune mboka mwi itaala.

Aamwameme, ne omwa ningilwa iinima ya fa mbyoka ya ningilwa omagongalo gaKalunga gomuJudea, ya ningilwa aantu yaKristus yaahwiyaka. Omwa hepekwa kaantu yomoshilongo sheni, ngashika naanaa yo ya hepekwa kAajuda.
Aajuda tuu mboka ya dhipaga Omuwa Jesus naahunganeki noye tu tidhagana wo. Oyo inaa opalela nando Kalunga. Oyo oye tonde aantu ayehe.

Oya kambadhala oku tu keelela, twaa uvithile aapagani oohapu dhaKalunga ndhoka tadhi ya fala mehupitho. Osho ngeyi otaa udhitha nayi oshiyelekitho noondjo dhawo. Ngashingeyi ondjahi yaKalunga oya gwile nokuli kombanda yawo.
Aamwameme, sho twa li twa topoka nane okathimbo palutu, otwa kala noku mu dhiladhila. Omwa li mwe tu yi kokule, notwa kambadhala oku mu mona natango.
Otwa li twa hala, tu galukile kune, unene ngame Paulus onda kambadhala shi vule lumwe okuya kune ishewe, ihe Satana okwe tu keelele.
Hane nani etegameno lyetu, enyanyu lyetu nuulenga wesindano lyetu mboka tatu itangele koshipala shOmuwa gwetu Jesus, uuna te ya?
Eeno shili, one esimano nenyanyu lyetu.
3: Lwahugunina otwa nyengwa oku shi idhidhimikila. Otwa tokola okukala atuke muAtena,
manga tatu tumu omumwatate Timoteus, ngoka a longo pamwe natse oshilonga shaKalunga shokuuvitha elaka etoye tali popi Kristus. Otwe mu tumu, e mu tse omukumo ye a koleke eitaalo lyeni,
opo kwaa kale nando ogumwe ta shuna monima omolwomatidhagano. One omu shi shi kutya omatidhagano ga tya ngaaka ogo ombinga yimwe yehalo lyaKalunga mokukala kwetu.
Oshoka sho twa li pune, otwe mu londodha kutya onatu ka tidhaganwa, naashika omwe shi mono kutya osho naanaa tashi ningwa ngashingeyi.

Shika osho sha tumitha ndje Timoteus kune. Inandi vula we okwiidhidhimika, onkee onde mu tumu, opo a tale, ngele omu li tuu natango meitaalo. Kwaa ninge, pamwe omuhongololi e mu hongolola, niilonga yetu ayihe e tayi ningi eihepeko lyowala.

Ngashingeyi Timoteus okwa galukile ishewe kutse nokwe etelele elaka lyenyanyu tali popi eitaalo nohole yeni. Okwe tu hokololele wo kutya ohamu tu dhimbulukwa aluhe nomwe tu yuulukwa noonkondo, ngashika naanaa natse wo twe mu yuulukwa.
Aamwameme, otwa tsuwa omukumo omolweni mokuhepekwa nomomaudhigu getu. Eitaalo lyeni olye tu koleke,
oshoka ngashingeyi oomwenyo omo dhi li, ngele ne otamu kala mwa kankama mOmuwa.
Ehambelelo lyetu oli thike peni tu li na koshipala shaKalunga ketu, omolweni!
Ohatu galikana Kalunga noomwenyo dhetu adhihe uusiku nomutenya, tu mone ompito yokumona iipala yeni, tse tu gwedhe ko shoka sha kambela keitaalo lyeni.
Kalunga Tate nOmuwa gwetu Jesus naye tu longekidhile ompito yoku mu talela po.
Omuwa ne mu pe ohole yokuholathana, nohole yeni yokuhola aantu ayehe nayi koke yi thike pohole yetu yoku mu hola.
Osho ngeyi ota koleke omitima dheni, mu kale aayapuki nomwaa na oshipo koshipala shaKalunga Tate, uuna Omuwa gwetu Jesus te ya pamwe naayapuki ye ayehe.
4: Aamwameme, hugunina otwe mu lombwele, nkene mu na okukala, opo mu opalele Kalunga. Shika osho hamu ningi shito. Onkee otatu mu indile noku mu kumagidha medhina lyOmuwa Jesus, mu shi ninge mu vule shito.
Omalombwelo ngoka twe mu pe mewiliko lyOmuwa Jesus, omu ga shi.
Kalunga okwa hala, mu kale aayapuki ne mu yande oluhondelo.
Omulumentu kehe gwomokati keni na kale a tseya, nkene e na okukala nomukiintu, a kale naye pamukalo gu uka nogwesimaneko.
Ina kala naye pakahalu kuulunde ngashika aapagani mboka inaa tseya Kalunga.

Ano moshinima shika inaku kala nando omulumentu ta yono kumukwawo nenge te mu yugu. Shika otwe shi mu lombwele nale notwe mu kumagidha noonkondo kutya Omuwa ota ka geela mboka taa longo uuwinayi wa tya ngaaka.
Kalunga ine tu ithanena okukala muuholume, ihe okukala aayapuki.
Onkee ngoka ta dhini elongo ndika, ita dhini aantu, ihe oKalunga ngoka ha gandja Ombepo Ondjapuki.
Itamu pumbwa okunyolelwa kombinga yokuhola ooitaali ooyakweni. Oshoka Kalunga mwene okwe mu longa, mu kale mu holathane.
Shika omwe shi holola nale mokukalathana kweni nooitaali ayehe yomuMakedonia. Aamwameme, otatu mu indile, mu shi ninge mu vule shito.
Kaleni mu na elalakano okukala mwa gundjila, tamu longo iilonga yeni e tamu ikongele iipalutha yeni, ngaashi twe mu lombwele nale.
Pamukalo gwa tya ngeyi otamu simanekitha uukriste weni mokati kaamboka yaa shi ooitaali noitamu pumbwa okukala tamu indile oompumbwe dheni kuyalwe.
Aamwameme, otwa hala mu tseye kutya aantu mboka ya sa, oye li ngiini, opo mwaaye ya sile oluhodhi ngashika mboka yaa na etegameno.
Tse otwi itaala kutya Jesus okwa sile e ta yumuka; onkee otwi itaala wo kutya uuna Jesus te ya, Kalunga ota ka yumudha pamwe naJesus aantu mboka ya sile meitaalo.
Mpaka otatu mu lombwele elongo lya zi kOmuwa. Uuna ndoka Omuwa te ya, tse mboka tatu ka adhika tu na omwenyo, itatu ka tetekela mboka ya sa nale.
Tango otaku ka uvika elombwelo, ewi lyomuyengeli omukuluntu nehiko lyenkuma lyaKalunga. Nena Omuwa mwene ota ka kuluka ta zi megulu. Aantu mboka ya si yi itaala Kristus, otaa ka yumudhwa tango.
Opo ihe tse mboka tatu ka adhika tu na omwenyo pethimbo ndyoka, otatu ka gongelwa atuhe pamwe nayo pombanda miikogo, tu ka tsakaneke Omuwa mombepo. Osho ngeyi otatu ka kala ihe aluhe pOmuwa.
Onkee ano talalekathaneni noohapu ndhika.
5: Aamwameme, kape na ompumbwe yoku mu nyolela kombinga yethimbo notundi, uuna iinima mbika tayi ka ningwa.
Oshoka omwa tseya nawa kutya esiku lyOmuwa otali ya ongomufuthi te ende uusiku.
Manga aantu ye li mokutya: “Ope na ombili, naayihe oya gamenwa,” nena ohaluka ehanagulo otali ya adha. Itaa ka vula okuya ontuku, oshoka otashi ka kala ngaashi omusimba ta adhika koshitheta.
Aamwameme, ne kamu shi yomomilema, esiku ndyoka li mu adhe ando ohaluka ngaashi omufuthi.
Ne amuhe aantu yomuuyelele noyomomutenya. Otse katu shi aantu yomuusiku nenge yomomilema.
Onkee ano inatu kaleni twa kotha ngaashi yalwe; tu kaleni twa tonata notu na eidhiliko.
Aakothi ohaa kotha uusiku noonkolwi ohadhi kolwa uusiku.
Ihe otse aantu yomuuyelele, onkee otu na okukala tu na eidhiliko. Tu zaleni eitaalo nohole ongehuuyanza, netegameno lyehupitho lyetu ongegala lyosheela.
Kalunga ine tu hogolola, e tu geele, ihe otu hupithwe omolwOmuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus.
Oye a si peha lyetu, opo tu kale pamwe naye, uuna te ya, nokashi na mbudhi kutya otu na omwenyo nenge otwa sa.
Onkee ano kumagidhathaneni ne mu kwathathane, ngaashi hamu shi ningi nokuli.
Aamwameme, otatu mu indile, mu simaneke mboka taa longo mokati keni. Omuwa Kalunga oye e ya hogolola, ye mu wilike noye mu pukulule.
Ya simanekeni ne mu ya hole omwolwoshilonga shoka taye shi longo. Kaleni mu na ombili mokati keni.
Aamwameme, otatu mu kumagidha: gandeni aananyalo, tseni aambanda omukumo, ambidhidheni aankundi ne mu idhidhimikile ayehe.
Kotokeni, kwaa kale nando omuntu ta galulile mukwawo uuwinayi, ihe lalakaneneni aluhe okuningilathana uuwanawa noku u ningila wo aantu ayehe.
Nyanyukweni aluhe,
galikaneni aluhe,
panduleni aluhe. Shika osho Kalunga a hala, mu ninge mokukala kweni muKristus Jesus.
Inamu keelela Ombepo Ondjapuki,
inamu dhina omahunganeko.
Konakoneni iinima ayihe; dhiginineni shoka oshiwanawa,
ne mu yande uuwinayi kehe.
Kalunga kombili na yapule okukala kweni akuhe ye ne mu gamene, opo ombepo, omwenyo nolutu yi kale yaa na nando oshipo sigo okokugaluka kwOmuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus.
Ngoka he mu ithana, ote ke shi gwanitha, oshoka oye omwiinekelwa.
Aamwameme, tu galikanenii wo.
Kundilii po ooitaali ayehe nohole yaamwayinathana.
Otandi mu kumagidha palombwelo lyOmuwa, ontumwafo ndjika mu yi leshele ooitaali ayehe.
Esilohenda lyOmuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus nali kale nane.

1: Ontumwafo ndjika oya zi kuPaulus, Silvanus naTimoteus. Oya nyolelwa egongalo lyomuTessalonika, lyaantu yaKalunga Tate noyOmuwa Jesus Kristus.
Silweni ohenda ne mu kale mu na ombili yaKalunga Tate noyOmuwa Jesus Kristus.
Aamwameme, tse otu na okuhambelela Kalunga aluhe omolweni. Osho opala, tu shi ninge, oshoka eitaalo lyeni otali koko nohole yeni yokuholathana otayi indjipala noonkondo.
Onkee ano tse momagongalo gaKalunga ohatu itanga molweni. Tse otatu mu itangele, sho hamu idhidhimike nomwa dhiginina eitaalo momatidhagano nomomahepeko ngoka hage mu adha.
Shika otashi holola kutya epangulo lyaKalunga olyo eyuuki, oshoka kehulilo lyaambika ayihe, Kalunga ote ke mu ninga mwoopalela Oshilongo she, shoka tamu shi hepekelwa.
Oshoka Kalunga oha longo shoka shu uka; ota ka galulila omahepeko kombanda yaamboka ya li ye mu hepeke,
no te ke mu pa evululuko pamwe natse. Oye ote ke shi ninga, uuna Omuwa Jesus ta ka za megulu pamwe naayengeli ye aanankondo.
Oye ote ke ya momulilo gwa hwama okugeela mboka inaa tseya Kalunga naamboka inaa vulika kelaka etoye tali popi Omuwa gwetu Jesus.
Oyo otaa ka adhika kegeelo lyehanagulo lyaaluhe, ndyoka tali ke ya kaleka kokule naKalunga nonesimano lyoonkondo dhe.
Ihe aantu ye otaye ke mu hambelela nooitaali ayehe otaye mu tanga esiku ndyoka te ya. Nena nane wo otamu ka kala mongundu yawo, oshoka omwi itaala elaka ndyoka twe li mu uvithile.
Onkee ano tse ohatu mu galikanene aluhe. Otatu galikana Kalunga, e mu ukithe paithano ndyoka e mu ithanena. Oye ne mu pe oonkondo nehalo lyokulonga uuwanawa nolyokutsakanitha iilonga yeni yomeitaalo.
Osho ngeyi mokusimaneka edhina lyOmuwa gwetu Jesus naye wo ote ke mu simaneka omolwesilohenda lyaKalunga ketu nolyOmuwa Jesus Kristus.
2: Mpaka otandi popi kombinga yokugaluka kwOmuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus nokombinga yoku ka gongelwa kwetu, tu ka kale puye. Aamwameme, otandi mu indile,

inamu etha, mu piyaganekwe nuupu nenge mu tilithwe koohapu tadhi ti kutya esiku lyOmuwa olye ya nale. Inamu itaala oohapu dha tya ngaaka, nando dhi kale dhi ikwatelela mehunganeko lyontumba nenge moshipopiwa nenge montumwafo ya zi kutse aniwa.
Inamu etha, mu fundjalekwe nando okulye. Oshoka esiku ndyoka itali ya, manga aantu oyendji inaa tsa ondumbo naKalunga nomanga Mwiinayi mwene, ngoka i ilongela oheli, inaa holoka.
Oye ota ka kondjitha ayihe mbyoka hayi ithanwa naKalunga nenge iiyapuki. Ote ki inenepekela iinima ayihe nota ka kuutumba motempeli yaKalunga e ti iluku Kalunga.
Otamu dhimbulukwa tuu? Ayihe mbika onde yi mu lombwelele, manga nda li pune.
Ihe sigo onena ope na shoka tashi keelele oshinima shika shaa ningwe, nane omwa tseya kutya oshike. Onkee ano Mwiinayi ota ka holoka pethimbo lye mu opalela.
Uukolokoshi we otau longo nokuli meholamo, ihe shoka tashi ka ningwa po, itashi ningwa, manga pu na ngoka e shi keelela.
Nena Mwiinayi ngoka ota ka holoka, ihe Omuwa Jesus, uuna te ya, ote ke mu dhipaga nomuku gwomokana ke e te mu hanagula po neadhimo lyeholoko lye.
Mwiinayi ngoka ote ke ya e na oonkondo dhaSatana nota ka longa iikumithalonga, omandhindhiliko niilongankondo yiifundja yoludhi kehe,
nota ka longitha omakoto okupukitha mboka ye li mondjila ndjoka yu uka mekano. Oyo otaa ka kana, oshoka inaa taamba ohole noshili yoku ya hupitha.
Onkee ano Kalunga ote ke ya tumina epukitho edhigu, opo yi itaale iifundja.
Nena ayehe mboka ya hokwa uulunde noinaa hala okwiitaala oshili, otaa ka pangulwa.

Aamwameme naaholike yOmuwa, tse otu na okuhambelela Kalunga aluhe omolweni. Oshoka Kalunga okwe mu hogolola petameko, mu hupithwe. Oye okwe mu ningi aantu ye aayapuki koonkondo dhOmbepo nokokwiitaala kweni oshili.
Kalunga okwe mu ithana nelaka etoye ndyoka twe li mu uvithile. Oye okwe mu ithana, mu kale mu na oshitopolwa meadhimo lyOmuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus.
Onkee ano aamwameme, kaleni mwi ikolelela mwa dhiginina omalongo ngoka twe ge mu longo momauvitho nomontumwafo yetu.
Omuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus mwene naKalunga Tate yetu, ngoka e tu hole nokwe tu pa kesilohenda lye omukumo gwaaluhe netegameno ewanawa,
ne mu tse omukumo ye ne mu koleke, mu longe nomu popye ashike shoka oshiwanawa.
3: Hugunina, aamwameme, tu galikaneneni, opo oohapu dhOmuwa dhi taandele mbala nodhi simanekwe, ngashika naanaa mokati keni.
Galikaneni wo, Kalunga e tu hupithe maantu aadhudhu naawinayi, oshoka haantu ayehe yi itaala elaka lye.
Ihe Omuwa oye omwiinekelwa, oye ote mu koleke e te mu gamene kuuwinayi.
Omuwa ne tu pe einekelo mune. Otu shi shi kutya ohamu longo, ngaashi twe mu lombwele, notamu ke shi ninga nokomeho.
Omuwa na thikithe oomwenyo dheni mohole yokuhola Kalunga nomeidhidhimiko lyaKristus.
Aamwameme, otatu mu lombwele medhina lyOmuwa Jesus Kristus: Ikalekeni kokule naantu mboka inaa hala okulonga sha noitaa landula omakumagidho getu.
Ne omwa tseya nawa kutya omu na okulonga, ngaashi twe mu pe oshiholelwa. Tse inatu kala aananyalo mokati keni.
Inatu taamba nando okulya iikwatha yasha inaatu yi futila. Ihe otwa longo nokwiihepeka uusiku nomutenya, opo twaa etele nando ogumwe gwomune uupyakadhi.
Shika inatu shi ninga ando, sho twaa na epitikilo lyokukala tatu kwathwa kune, ihe otwe shi ningi, opo tu mu pe oshiholelwa.
Sho twa li pune, otwe mu lombwele tatu ti: “Ngoka inaa hala okulonga, ina ethiwa a lye.”
Otatu popi ngeyi, oshoka otu uvu kutya mokati keni omu na aantu aananyalo inaa hala okulonga sha, ihe oye na owala ethimbo lyokwiitula miinima yayakwawo.
Medhina lyOmuwa Jesus Kristus otatu ganda nokukumagidha aantu ya tya ngeyi, naa kale ya ngungumana e taa longo, yi imonene iipalutha.
Aamwameme inamu vulwa okulonga uuwanawa.
Otashi vulika ku na gumwe ngoka inaa hala okuvulika kelaka ndyoka twe mu tumine montumwafo ndjika. Ngele oku na omuntu a tya ngaaka, mu konekeni ne inamu endathana naye, opo a se ohoni.
Ihe inamu mu tala omutondi gweni, ihe mu pukululeni ongomumwanyoko.
Omuwa ngoka oluthithiya lwombili yetu, ne mu pe aluhe ombili pamikalo adhihe. Omuwa na kale pamwe nane amuhe.
Otandi nyola ngeyi noshikaha shandje mwene: Omakundo ga zi kuPaulus. Nguka ogwo omukalo gwandje gwokushaina ontumwafo kehe; osho handi nyola ngaaka.
Esilohenda lyOmuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus nali kale nane amuhe.

1: Ontumwafo ndjika oya zi kuPaulus, omuyapostoli gwaJesus Kristus, opalombwelo lyaKalunga, omuhupithi gwetu, nolyaJesus Kristus, etegameno lyetu.
Oya nyolelwa Timoteus, omumwandjelela meitaalo. Esilohenda, ontalanteni nombili yaKalunga Tate noyOmuwa gwetu Jesus Kristus nayi kale nangoye.
Sho nda li mondjila yokuuka kuMakedonia, onda li nde ku lombwele kutya onda hala u kale muEfeso, opo u indike aantu mboka ye li mo taa longo omalongo ga puka.

Ya lombwela ano, ye ethe po oongano dhawo nomukalo gwawo gwokusimaneka oondjokonona dhomadhina goohekulu, oshoka iinima ya tya ngeyi otayi eta owala omaludhi. Oyo inayi opalela edhiladhilo lyaKalunga, ndyoka tali tseyika mokwiitaala.
Elalakano lyekumagidho ndika olyo oku ya penduthila ohole tayi zi momwenyo gwa yela, meiyuvo ewanawa nomeitaalo lyashili.
Aantu yamwe oya za mo miinima mbika e tayi ipukitha nomapopyagano guugoya.
Oyo oya hala okukala aalongi yompango yaKalunga, nando kaa uvite ko shoka taa popi naashoka taa ludhike.
Tse otu shi shi kutya ompango oyo ombwanawa, ngele tayi longithwa pamukalo ngoka yi na okulongithwa.

Otu na okutseya kutya oompango ihadhi ningilwa aantu mboka haa longo uuwanawa, ihe aayoni naakolokoshi, aakeenakonasha naKalunga naalunde, mboka kaaye na eiyapulo nuukwambepo, aadhipagi yoohe nooyina nosho wo aadhipagi yalwe,
aahondeli, omashenge naalali nomashenge, aayakipo yaantu, aafundja naamboka haa gana iifundja nenge haa ningi shoka inaashi tsa kumwe nelongo ndyoka lyu uka.
Elongo lyu uka otali monika mevaangeli ndyoka nde li pewa, ndi li uvithe, elaka etoye lya zi kuKalunga keadhimo nomulalekwa nuuyamba.

Ngame otandi hambelele Jesus Kristus, Omuwa gwetu, sho a pe ndje oonkondo dhokulonga oshilonga shandje. Otandi mu hambelele, sho a tala ndje kutya otandi vulu oku mu longela, e ta tula ndje miilonga ye,
nando ngame onda li nale handi mu popi nayi, nde mu tidhagana nonde mu sheke. Ihe Kalunga okwa sile ndje ohenda, oshoka onda li inaandi itaala nokanda li ndi shi wo shoka te ningi.
Omuwa gwetu okwa hololele ndje esilohenda lye lya gwanenena nokwa pe ndje eitaalo nohole mbyoka tu yi na muukumwe naKristus Jesus.
Ohapu ndjika oyoshili noyi shilela okutaambwa nokwiitaalwa: Jesus Kristus okwe ya muuyuni, a hupithe aalunde, nangame omulunde omunene ndi vule aalunde ayehe.

Onda hala ndi tye: Kalunga okwa sile ndje ohenda, opo Jesus Kristus a holole mungame komeho gaayehe eidhidhimiko lye alihe lyokwiidhidhimikila ndje. Ngame onda ningi oshiholelwa shaayehe mboka taye ke mu itaala, ya mone omwenyo gwaaluhe.

Kalunga awike, omukwaniilwa gwaaluhe, ngoka kee na ehulilo noiha monika, na hambelelwe ye na simanekwe aluheluhe!
Amen.
Omumwandje Timoteus, otandi ku pe oshilonga shika shokukumagidha opahapu dhehunganeko ndyoka lyonale lye ku popi. Oohapu dhehunganeko ndyoka nadhi ninge omatati goye, u kondje ekondjo lya mana mo.
Dhiginina eitaalo neiyuvo lya yela. Aantu yamwe inaa vulika keiyuvo lyawo, onkee oya teya omutenge gwolweendo lweitaalo lyawo.
Mongundu yawo omu na Himeneus naAleksander, mboka nde ya gandja miikaha yaSatana, opo shi ya longe, yaa sheke we Kalunga.
2: Omakumagidho gandje ogo ngaka: Tangotango naku ningwe omaindilo, omagalikano, omagalikaneno nomahambelelo koshipala shaKalunga omolwaantu ayehe.
Naku galikanenwe aakwaniilwa naapangeli ayehe, opo tu kale nokukala kwa ngungumana nokwombili mokusimaneka Kalunga akuhe nomikalo omiwanawa.
Shika osho oshiwanawa nosho opalela Kalunga, omuhupithi gwetu,
ngoka a hala, aantu ayehe ya hupithwe noya tseye oshili.
Oshoka Kalunga ogumwe awike, naangoka a hanganitha aantu naKalunga, ogumwe, omuntu Jesus Kristus,
ngoka i igandja, a ninge iikulila yaantu ayehe. Shika osha ningwa pethimbo lyo opala, oshoka Kalunga okwa li a hala aantu ayehe ya hupithwe.
Onkee ano ngame onda tumwa, ndi ninge omuyapostoli nomulongi mokati kaapagani nondi uvithe elaka tali popi eitaalo noshili. Otandi popi oshili, ite fundju.
Onda hala, aalumentu ya galikane akuhe nokuyelutha omaako gawo pombanda yaa na uutondwe nomalimbililo.

Onda hala wo, aakiintu ya dhiladhile nawa kombinga yomizalo dhawo, yo ya zale oonguwo dhi shi kutalwa nodha yogoka. Inaa panda omafufu ya zalekwe oombandi dhiingoli nomagwe taga adhima nenge oonguwo dhi na ondilo.
Peha lyaambika kaleni mu udha iilonga iiwanawa, ngaashi sho opalela aakiintu ooitaali.
Melongelokalunga aakiintu naa pulakene ya mwena nokuvulika kelandulathano.
Ngame itandi pitika, aakiintu ya ninge aalongihapu nenge ya pangele aalumentu, ihe naa kale ya mwena.
Oshoka Adam oye a shitwa tango e taku landula ihe Eva.
Adam haye a pukithwa, ihe omukiintu oye a pukithwa nokwa yono oshipango shaKalunga.
Ano omukiintu ota ka hupithwa omolwokuvala uunona, ihe ongele ta dhiginine eitaalo, ohole yopakriste neiyapulo.
